nanu kṣaṇika-nityatvādi-yathāvasthitavastusvabhāvavāditvāt sugateśvarakapilabrahmaṇāmeva dharmatīrthakaratvam, atasta eva śāstrasyādau vandyā tatpraṇītameva ca pramāṇādilakṣaṇaṃ tatra vyutpādanārham ityāśaṅkya svapramāṇādilakṣaṇavartmani kaṇṭakaśuddhyarthaṃ nirākurvannāha–

niranvayakṣaṇikacittānām anyonyavilakṣaṇakṣaṇikajñānānā santāneṣu santatiṣu, kathaṃbhūteṣu ? asatsveva avidyamāneṣveva, asattvaṃ ca teṣāṃ pramāṇatovicāryamāṇānāmanupapadyamānattvātsiddham, tadanupapadyamā natvaṃ cānantarameva samarthayiṣyate

nanu mābhūvaṃstatsantānā taccittāni tu kāryakāraṇabhāvaprabandhena pravarttamānāni bhaviṣyanti ityatrāha–tattvāhetuphalātmanāṃ tattvenaparamārthena ahetuphalabhūtaḥ akāryakāraṇabhūtaḥ ātmā svarūpaṃ yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ tathābhūtānāṃ taccittānāṃ santāneṣu asatsveva satsu, cet yadi vuddhaḥ svayam ātmanā vyavatiṣṭhate–sthitiṃ labhate, kena ? svaparasaṅkalpena svaparayoḥ saṅkalpaḥ asatoḥ santau ityavasāyaḥ tena, kimarthaṃ vyavatiṣṭhata ityāha–sattvārthaṃ duḥkhād duḥkhahetorvā vineyajanoddharaṇārtham, kayā ? karuṇayā taduktam–
tiṣṭhantyeva parādhīnā yepā tu mahatī kṛpā

tiṣṭhantyeva parādhīnā yeṣāṃ tu mahatī kṛpā || iti
kṛpā hi trividhā sattvālambanā putrakalatrādiṣu, dharmālambanā saṅghādiṣu, nirālampanā saṃpuṭasaṃdaṣṭamaṇḍūkoddharaṇādiṣu
tatra mahatī nirālambanā kṛpā sugatānā sattvadharmā'napekṣatvāt iti
te tiṣṭhantyeva na kadācit nirvānti dharmadeśanayā jagadupakāraniratatvāt jagataśca anantatvāt

sa itthaṃbhūto buddhaḥ asati vastuni sattvādhyavasāyavān naiva dharmatīrthakaro yathāvasthitavastusvabhāvavāditvābhāvād īśvarakapilabrahmavat, kintu mithyāvikalpātmaka eva mithyā asatyo yo vikalpaḥ saṃvṛtyaparanāmā tadātmaka eva, kiṃvat ? nityatvavat–yathā nityatvamīśvara-kapila-brahmaṇām tatpraṇītatattvasya ca yat paraiḥ pratijñātaṃ tat mithyāvikalpātmakameva, na punaḥ paramārthato'sti tathā buddho'pi iti
nanvasya sarvasyā'bhyupagamānna doṣa iti pratibhāsādvaitavādī, taṃ prati tatra ityādyāha

tatra tasmin pratibhāsādvaitavādyabhyupagate, kasmin ? samaye saṃgataḥ sakalavijñānavyaktitādātmyena sthitaḥ ayaḥ pratibhāsastasmin samaye nārthakriyā anubhavaḥ antyā tāvadiyamarthakriyā yaduta svaviṣayavijñānotpādanaṃ nāma ityabhidhānāt
tatrāpi vastutaḥ paramārthato na, saṃvṛtyā tu syāt
yathā ca nitya-kṣaṇikaikānte'dvaite cārthakriyā nopapadyate tathāgre pratipādayiṣyate
tatretyādi–tasmin samaye sagata samastajñāneṣvanugata aya pratibhāsa samaya, tasmin pratibhāsādvaite vastuna advayapadārthasya arthakriyā anubhavo na syāt
taduktam– matyā ? tāvadiyamarthakriyā yaduta svaviṣayavijñānotpādana nāma iti

yopyāha–pramāṇādilakṣaṇaparīkṣārthaṃ śāstramidamārabhyate, nacāsatpramāṇādeḥ parīkṣā ghaṭate, tadasattvaṃ ca sarvapratyayānāṃ nirālambanatayā svapnapratyayatulyatvātiti, tanmatamapākarttumāha– tatra ityādi
tatra tasmin paropagate samaye samaḥ sadṛśo jāgratsvapnadaśāsādhāraṇo'yo bodhaḥ śakandhvāditvādakārasya pararūpatvam tasmin, kim ? ityāha–nārthakriyā iti

tatra arthaḥ kṣaṇikaniraṃśajñānamātram tasya tena arthyamānatvāt, tato'nyaḥanarthaḥ viparyayāt, tayoḥ kriyā hānopādānalakṣaṇā sā na syāt; nahyarthasyopādānamanarthasya ca parihāraḥ sarvajñānānāṃ samatve yukta ityagre pratipādayiṣyate
kathaṃ sā na syāt ? ityāha–vastunaḥvastutaḥ paramārthena
vastunaḥ iti ca pāṭhe sādhanadūpaṇalakṣaṇād vastuna sakāśādityarthaḥ

nanu ca asatsveva cittasantāneṣu ityayuktamuktam teṣāṃ sattvasaṃbhavāt; tathāhi– paramārthasantaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaprabandhena pravarttamānāḥ pūrvottaracittakṣaṇāḥ pratikṣaṇaviśarāravo'parāmṛṣṭabhedāḥ santānaśabdavācyāḥ
na ca pratikṣaṇaviśarārutve cittakṣaṇānāṃ karmaphalasambandhāśrayasyaikasyātmano'sattvāt kṛta nāśa-akṛtābhyāgamadoṣopanipātaḥ; santānāpekṣayā tatsambandhasaṃbhavāt
ekasantatipatitānāṃ hi cittakṣaṇānāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇikatve'pi karmaphalasambandhasyopapatterna taddoṣopanipātaprasaṅgaḥ
nāpi santānibhya santāno bhinno bhinno'bhinno vetyādyanalpavikalpāpātaḥ; tasya vastuviṣayatvāt santānasya cā'vastutvāt

vyavahārārthaṃ hi vibhinneṣvapi kṣaṇeṣvabhedaparāmarśarūpā saṃvṛtiḥ santānaḥ, so'vastutvādbhedābhedavikalpaiḥ avaktavya eva, yadavastu tadbhedābhedādivikalpairavaktavyameva yathā gaganendīvaram, avastu ca vibhinnakṣaṇeṣvabhedakalpanārūpatayā santāna iti

nanvevamapyanyonyavilakṣaṇacittakṣaṇeṣu pratyabhijñāturekasyātmano'nabhyupagamāt pratyabhijñānādyanupapattiḥ; ityapyasamīcīnam; sādṛśyādeva tadupapatteḥ pradīpavat, yathaiva hi pratikṣaṇavinā śiṣvapi pradīpajvālādipu sādṛśyāt sa evāyaṃ pradīpaḥ iti pratyabhijñānamāvirbhavati evamatrāpi
sadṛśāparabhāvanivandhanaṃ ca ekatayā pratyabhijñānaṃ lūnapunarjāteṣviva nakhakeśādiṣu ityatra virodhābhāvāt

yatra santāne paṭīyasā anubhavena uttarottaraviśiṣṭattaratamakṣaṇotpādāt smṛtyādibījamāhitam tatraiva smaraṇādayaḥ samutpadyante nānyatra, pratiniyatatvāt kāryakāraṇabhāvasyasmaraṇādipūrvakāśca pratyabhijñānādayaḥ prasūyanta ityaviruddham

nityaikarūpatve cātmana kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvānupapattito'sattvāt kathaṃ pratyabhijñānādihetutvam ? yatra kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvānupapatti tadasat yathā vandhyāstanandhaya, asti ca nityaikarūpatayābhimate ātmani tathā tadanupapattiḥ

na cāsya kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvānupapattirasiddhā, tathāhi–krameṇāsyārthakriyākāritve ki yenaiva svabhāvenaikaṃ kārya karoti tenaivāparam, svabhāvāntareṇa vā ? yadi tenaiva, tarhi dvitīyādikṣaṇasādhyakāryasya prathamakṣaṇa evotpādaprasaṅgaḥ, tadutpādakasvarūpasya prāgapi bhāvāt
prayogaḥ–yadā yadutpādaheturasti tattadotpattimatprasiddham yathā tatkālābhimataṃ kāryam, asti ca dvitīyādikṣaṇasādhyakāryasya prakṣamakṣaṇa evotpādako nityaikarūpatayābhimatasyātmanaḥ svabhāva iti
atha svabhāvāntareṇāsau tatkaroti; tarhi pūrvasvabhāvasya pracyutatvāt siddhamasya kṣaṇikattva svabhāvapracyutilakṣaṇatvāttasya
yaugapadyenāpyasya kāryakāritve yugapadevākhilakāryotpādakasvabhāvatayā prathamakṣaṇa evākhilakāryotpādanāt kṣaṇāntare tadutpādyakāryā'bhāvato'narthakriyākāritvena aśvaviṣāṇavadasattvānuṣaṅga
naiva pratyakṣata kāryavirahādvā śaktiviraho'kṣaṇiktve ucyate, kintu tadvyāpakavirahāt, tathāhi–kramayogapadyābhyā kāryakriyā vyāptā prakārāntarā'bhāvāt
tata kāryakriyāśaktivyāpakayo tayo akṣaṇikatve virovāt nivṛtte tadvyāptāyā kriyāśakterapi nivṛtti iti sarvaśaktivirahalakṣaṇam asattvam akṣaṇikatve vyāpakānupalabdhi ākarṣati viruddhayorekatrā'yogāt
tato nivṛtta sattva kṣaṇikeṣveva avatiṣṭhamānaṃ tadātmatāmanubhavatīti–yat sat tat kṣaṇikameva
na bhavanti sthirā bhāvā ni sattvāste tato matā
kiṃ yena svabhāvenādyāmarthakriyā karoti kiṃ tenaivātarāṇi kāryāṇi samāsāditasvabhāvāntaro vā karoti

kiñca, kramabhāvisukhādiparyāyavyāpakatvamātmano bhavatābhyupagamyate, tacca kimekena svabhāvenāsyeṣyate, anekena vā ? yadyekena, tadā teṣāmekarūpatāpatti, yadekasvabhāvena vyāpyate tadekarūpameva yathaikaparyāyasvarūpam, ekasvabhāvena vyāpyante cātmanā sukhādayo'nekaparyāyā iti
athaikādṛśena svabhāvena tena te vyāpyante atrāpi anekasvabhāvena sajātīyena ityuktaṃ syāt, tatra ca saivānavasthā
nacāparaṃ prakārāntaramasti, ata kathaṃ kramabhuvāṃ sukhādīnāmanvitaṃ rūpaṃ siddhyeta yenātmasiddhi syāditi ?

tatra hi ki kāryam, kiñca kāraṇam ? yadabhūttvā bhavati tatkāryamiti cet; nanvabhavane bhavane ca kasya kartṛtvam tasyaiva, anyasya vā ? na tāvattasyaiva, sarvathāpyasataḥ kartṛtvadharmādhāratvānupapatteḥ
yat sarvathāpyasat na tat kartṛtvadharmādhāraḥ, yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, sarvathāpyasacca paramate kāryamiti
bhavanaṃ hi svarūpasvīkaraṇam, tacca sarvathāpyasato vandhyāstanandhayasyevā'tidurghaṭam
nāpyanyasya; asyaiva kāryatvaprasaṅgāt, yadeva hyabhavane bhavane ca kartṛ tadeva kāryam, tasyāpi sarvathāpyasattve na kāryatvam uktānumānavirodhāt
yasya prayatnānantaramātmalābha tatkhalu abhūtvā bhavati yathā ghaṭādi kāryam
abhūtvābhāvitvaṃ syādvādaratnākare pṛ॰ 418 prameyaratnamālāyāñca pṛ॰ 68 prasaṅgataḥ carcitam
kāraṇatvamapi kāryamātrotpādakatvam, niyatakāryotpādakatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ syāt, tataḥ kāryārthī na kaścinniyatopādānaṃ kuryāt
yad vāstavaṃ rūpaṃ tadvidyamānenaiva viśeṣaṇena viśeṣyate yathā svasaṃvedanaṃ svasaṃvidrūpatayā, vāstavaṃ ca kāraṇatvaṃṇasvarūpamiti
asatā kāryeṇa idamasya janakam iti kāraṇasya viśeṣyatve cā'sattvaprasaṅgaḥ
yat sarvathāpyasatā viśeṣyate tadasat yathā asan ghaṭaḥityabhāvena viśeṣyamāṇo ghaṭaḥ, asatā sarvathā kāryeṇa viśeṣyate ca paramate kāraṇamiti
vikalpādhirūḍhena kāryeṇa kāraṇasya viśeṣyatvamityapyetena pratyākhyātam; na khalu vikalpādhirūḍhaṃ kāryamasadrūpatāṃ parityajati
vikalpādhirūḍhena viśeṣyatve ca na vāstavarūpaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ siddhyet
yat vikalpādhirūḍhaviśeṣaṇasāpekṣaṃ rūpaṃ na tadvāstavam yathā māṇavake'gnitvam, vikalpādhirūr̤harūḍhakāryalakṣaṇaviśeṣaṇasāpekṣañca kāraṇe kāraṇatvaṃ rūpamiti
sarvathā'sati ca kārye vyāpriyamāṇānāṃ kāraṇānāṃ nirālambanā pravṛttiriṣṭā syāt, evañca vivakṣitakāryotpattivat ākāśakuśeśayādyutpattāvapi tatpravṛttiprasaṅgāt na kiñcidantyantamasat syāt
tatra teṣāmapravṛttau vā vivakṣitakāryepyapravṛttiḥ sarvathā' sattvā'viśeṣāt
yat sarvathāpyasat na tatra kāraṇānāṃ pravṛttiḥ yathā khapuṣpādau, sarvathā' sacca bhavanmate kāryamiti
yadi ca, kimapyanālambya kāraṇānāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāttadā vivakṣitakāraṇasya vivakṣitakāryavat kāryāntare'pi pravṛttiprasaṅgāt kāraṇāntarakalpanānarthakyaṃ syāt

astu vā avicāritaramaṇīyasvabhāvaṃ bhavanmate kiñcit kāryatvaṃ kāraṇatvañca; tathāpi vinaṣṭātkāraṇāt kāryamutpadyeta, avinaṣṭāt, vinaśyadavasthādvā ? na tāvadvinaṣṭāt; svarūpeṇāsataḥ sakalaśaktivikalasya tatprati kāraṇatvānupapatteḥ
yat svarūpeṇāsat na tataḥ kiñcit prabhavati yathā vandhyāstanandhayāt putraḥ, svarūpeṇāsacca paramate kāraṇamiti
vinaṣṭam kāryaṃ karoti iti kimapi mahādbhutam ! na hi mṛtācchikhinaḥ kekāyitasambhavaḥ

kathaṃ vā'to jāyamānaṃ kārya sahetukaṃ syāt ? athāvinaṣṭāttata tadutpadyate; tarhi datto jalāñjaliḥ kṣaṇakṣayāya bhāvānāmanekakṣaṇasthāyitvaprasiddheḥ, te hi prathamamutpadya kāryakaraṇāya vyāpriyante tadanantaraṃ kāryamāvirbhāvayantīti
athotpattisamaya evaite kāryamāvirbhāvayanti, tanna; sakalasantānocchedaprasakteḥ tadutpādyakāryasyāpi tadaiva svakāryotpādakatvaprasaṅgāt
tulanā–kiñcānyat naṣṭādvā pūrvakṣaṇāduttarasya kṣaṇasya udaya syāt, anaṣṭāt, naśyamānādvā ityādi
na vinaṣṭaṃ kāraṇamasattvācciratarātītavat aṣṭaśa॰ aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 182
kṣaṇikaṃ vastu vinaṣṭaṃ sat kāryamutpādayati, avinaṣṭam, ubhayarūpam, anubhayarūpaṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 147 pū॰
tulanā– satyeva kāraṇe yadi kārya trailokyamekakṣaṇavartti syāt, kāraṇakṣaṇakāle eva sarvasya uttarottarakṣaṇasantānasya bhāvāt tata santānā'bhāvāt
atha vinaśyadavasthāt kāraṇāt kāryamutpadyate; na; ekāntavādino vinaśyadavasthāyā evānupapatteḥ

ekadaikasya hi vastunaḥ kenacidrūpeṇa vināśaḥ kenaciccāvasthānaṃ vinaśyadavasthocyate, sā ca anekāntasvabhāvatvād ekānte kathaṃ ghaṭeta ? kiñca, asau vinaśyadavasthā satī, asatī vā ? yadi satī; tadā tayāpi kṣaṇikasvabhāvayā bhavitavyam iti ko'syāstadvato viśeṣaḥ ? atha asatī; kathaṃ tayā kroḍīkṛtasya janakatvam ? yadasadrūpeṇa kroḍīkṛtaṃ na tat kasyacijjanakam yathā gaganāmbhojam, asadrūpayā vinaśyadavasthayā kroḍīkṛtaṃ ca bhavanmate kāraṇatvenābhimataṃ vastviti

kiñca, ayaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ kālpanikaḥ, vāstavo vā ? kālpanikatve karmaphalasambandho'pi tādṛśa eva syāt, laukāyatikatvaprasaṅgaśca pūrvabhavāntyacittakṣaṇasya aihikādyacittakṣaṇena saha vāstavasambandhābhāvāt
atha vāstavaḥ; tanna; ekāntabhinnānāṃ kṣaṇikārthānāṃ vāstavatatsambandhānupapatteḥ

atha kāryasya bhavanaṃ kāraṇasya bhavanam ityetāvāneva atra kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ; nanu yat kāryasya bhavanaṃ tat kāryaniṣṭhameva, yacca kāraṇasya bhavanaṃ tat tanniṣṭhameva iti nānayoḥ kaścit sambandhaḥ, anyathā ghaṭasya bhavanaṃ paṭasya bhavanam ityayamapi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ syāt, tataśca niyatakāryārthinā yatkiñcit kāraṇamupādīyet

atha yatsvarūpamātre vyāvartamāne yasya vyāvṛttiḥ sa tasmin sati bhavati asati ca na bhavati ityanvayavyatirekataḥ tatkāryam; tanna; kṣaṇakṣayaikānte anvayavyatirekā'siddheḥ, kāraṇābhāve eva kāryasya sadā saṃbhavāt

svakāle sati samarthe kāraṇe anantaraṃ kāryamutpadyate nāsati ityanvayavyatirekasaṃbhavaḥ akiñcitkarepyaviśiṣṭaḥ, yathaiva hi kāryaṃ vivakṣitakṣaṇena samanantarabhāvinā vinā nāvirbhavati evaṃ pūrvottarasamānasamayairnānāvidhaiḥ kṣaṇāntarairapi
niyatakāle hi bhavatā bhāvena avaśyaṃ kutaścit pūrvakālabhāvinā kutaściduttarakālabhāvinā kenacitsamānasamayabhāvinā bhavitavyam
na ca te pūrvottarasamānasamayavartinaḥ santānāntarakṣaṇāḥ tasya kāraṇam akiñcitkaratvāt, evaṃ vivakṣitopi kṣaṇo'kiñcitkaratvāt pūrvakālavartyapi na tasya kāraṇaṃ syāt
sati bhavati itya– ā॰, ba॰, ja॰
kiñca, upādāna–sahakāribhāvena kāraṇaṃ kāryamāvirbhāvayate, na ca kṣaṇikaikānte tadbhāvo ghaṭate
tatra hi upādānatvaṃ pūrvakālabhāvitvam, svasadṛśasamānadeśakāryārambhakatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣo'yuktaḥ; santānāntarakṣaṇaiḥ vyabhicārāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ; saugataiḥ deśa-sādṛśyayoranabhyupagamāt, abhyupagame vā atyantavilakṣaṇakṣaṇikavādavirodhaḥ
nīlādijñānasya pītādijñānaṃ prati ayogicittasya yogicittaṃ prati upādānatvābhāvaḥ syāt atyantavaisādṛśyāt
tadevaṃ kṣaṇikaikānte upādānakāraṇasyā'vyavasthiteḥ sahakārikāraṇasyāpya pyavyavasthitiḥ syāt tanmūlatvāttasyāḥ
ataḥ kathañcidanvayinyevā'rthe kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ upādānatvañcopapannam, tatraiva anvayavyatirekayoḥ tannibandhanayoḥ pūrvākāraparityāgā'jahadvṛtto ttarākāropādānasya ca upādānalakṣaṇasya saṃbhavāt

tulanā–tadbhāve'pi na jñāyate kiṃ kasya tatra upādānam iti ? rūpajñānaṃ rūpajñānasya evamanyatrāpi yojyam iticet; ādyaṃ saugataṃ jñānam anupādānaṃ prasaktaṃ pūrvaṃ tathāvidhasya tadupādānasya abhāvāt, anyathā kutaḥ sopāyaṃ sugatatvam
tulanā–kathañca niranvayavināśe kāraṇasya upādānasahakāritvasya vyavasthā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 147 pū॰
tulanā–tadā pravṛttivijñānānām upādānatāvirahe nimittattā'pi na syāt upādānatāvyāptatvānnimittatāyā
yat svarūpaṃ tyajatyeva yanna tyajati sarvathā

pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakasādhano hi kāryakāraṇabhāvo bauddhairiṣṭaḥ, prathamaṃ hi kāryakāraṇayoranupalambhaḥ śuddhabhūtalopalambhalakṣaṇaḥ, taduttarakālaṃ vahne upalambha tadanantarañca dhūmasya, taduttarakālaṃ vahneranupalambhe dhūmasyāpyanupalambha, taditthamanupalambhatrayeṇa upalambhadvayena ca vahnidhūmayoḥ tadbhāvo gṛhyate

upalambhatrayeṇa anupalambhadvayena vā, prathamato hi vahnidhūmayorupalambhaḥ, taduttarakālaṃ vahneranupalambhaḥ tadanantarañca dhūmasya, punarvahnerupalambhe dhūmasyāpyupalambha iti, tānyetāni pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakena pañcavastūni ekasaṃvitparāmarśaviṣayatām ekapramātraivānīyante
na hi krameṇa pratikṣaṇamutpadyāpagacchatāṃ parasparaviṣayavārtānabhijñānānām bhijñānām evaṃvidhaparāmarśātmako vyāpāro ghaṭate

vikalpasyāpi nirvikalpakaviṣaya eva vyāpārādasau na yuktaḥ; ya eva hi nīlādyartho nirvikalpakena gṛhītaḥ tatraiva tadanusārī vikalpaḥ pravartate nādhikaviṣaye, agṛhītagrāhitvena pramāṇāntaratvaprasaṅgāt

tadutpattiviniścayo'pi kāryahetu pañca pratyakṣopalambhā'nupalambhasādhana–kāryasya utpatte prāganupalambha, kāraṇopalambhe satyupalambha, upalabdhasya paścāt kāraṇā'nupalambhādanupalambha iti kāryasya dvau anupalambhau eka upalambha kāraṇasya ca upalambhā'nupalambhau iti
evam upalambhā'nupalambhai pañcabhi satyeva agnau dhūmasya bhāva asati abhāvo niścīyate
astu vā asya tadvyāpāra; tathāpyasau kṣaṇikaḥ, akṣaṇiko vā ? akṣaṇikatve nāmamātrabhedaḥ syāt ātmā vikalpa iti ca
kṣaṇikatve'pi nirvikalpānna viśeṣaḥ, tathācaikasya kāryakāraṇatāpratipattirna syāt pratikṣaṇaṃ bhedāt, yasya hi kāraṇapratyakṣatā na tasya kāryapratyakṣatā

astu vaikasya ubhayapratyakṣatā; tathāpi yasya kāraṇapratyakṣatāyāṃ kāryapratyakṣatā so'nyaḥ, yasya ca kāraṇānupalambhe kāryānupalambhaḥ so'nyaḥ iti vibhinnapramātṛpratyakṣānupalambhavat ekapramātṛpratyakṣānupalambhayorapyatyantabhedāt kathaṃ tatastadavagamaḥ syāt ? tathāhi–yau parasparato'tyantavibhinnau pratyakṣānupalambhau na tau kasyacit kāryakāraṇabhāvamavagacchataḥ yathā devadatta-yajñadattapratyakṣānupalambhau, parasparato'tyantavibhinnau ca bhavadbhirabhyupagamyete kāryakāraṇakṣaṇayo pratyakṣā nupalambhau iti
tannaikapramātranabhyupagame kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ tatpratipattirvā ghaṭate, tatkathaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhāvaprabandhena pravṛttiḥ syāt ?
kiñca, kṣaṇikatve siddhe teṣāṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvaprabandhena pravṛttiryuktā, na tu tatsiddhaṃ tatprasādhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt, tadabhāvaśca akṣaṇikatvasiddhau prasādhayiṣyate
kiñca, arthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvamicchatāpi pramāturekatvamavaśyamabhyupagantavyam, tadabhāve pūrvottarakṣaṇavivekalakṣaṇakṣaṇikatvasya pratipattyanupapatteḥ

pūrvākāradarśanaṃ hyanyasya jñānasya saṃvṛttam uttarākāradarśanaṃ cānyasya, ataścottarajñānaṃ svaviṣayaparicchedamātropakṣīṇaśaktikaṃ na pūrvajñānagṛhītaviṣayākārāt vilakṣaṇo' yam iti parāmṛṣṭuṃ kṣamaṃ sarvathā tadviṣayavārtānabhijñatvāt
yat sarvathā yadviṣayavārtānabhijñaṃ na tat tadviṣayāt svaviṣayasya vailakṣaṇyaparāmarśe samartham yathā caitrajñānaṃ mitrajñānaviṣayāt, sarvathā pūrvajñānaviṣayānabhijñañca uttarajñānamiti
na khalu caitreṇa anyākāre'rthe dṛṣṭe tadanantaraṃ mitrasya anyākārārthadarśane sati vilakṣaṇo'yam iti pratyavamarśo dṛṣṭaḥ

yaccānyaduktam–pūrvottarakṣaṇāḥ pratikṣaṇaviśarāravaḥ ityādi; tadapyasundaram; pūrvottarakṣaṇayoḥ vartamānakṣaṇakāle'sattvena asya tābhyāmasambaddhasya santānatvānupapatte, satāmeva hi anyonyasambandhāddhānāṃ loke santatiḥ prasiddhā pakṣivat

atha vartamānakṣaṇo'tītānāgatakṣaṇāpekṣaḥ santānaḥ syāt; nanvanayoḥ vinaṣṭānutpannatvena vyomotpalaprakhyayoḥ kāpekṣā nāma ? anyathā śaśaśṛṅga-vandhyāstanandhayāpekṣayāpi vartamānakṣaṇasya ekasantānatā syāt
atraivārthe prayogadvayam–bauddhābhimato vartamānajñānakṣaṇaḥ tadutpādyotpādakābhimatajñānakṣaṇāntareṇa ekasantāniko na bhavati, sattvāt, anabhimatajñānakṣaṇavat

yadapyuktam–aparāmṛṣṭabhedāḥ iti; tadapyayuktam; yato'bhedaparāmarśasteṣāṃ jñānāntarāt, svato vā ? yadi jñānāntarāt; kimasmadādisambandhinaḥ, yogisambandhino vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; asmadāderatītādikṣaṇagocarasya jñānasyā'saṃbhavāt svahetukṣaṇamātraviṣayatayā tasya saugatairabhyupagamāt
atha svata eva; tanna; atītā'nāgatakṣaṇayorasattvena abhedaparāmarśahetutvānupapatteḥ
yadasat na tadabhedaparāmarśahetu yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, asantau ca atītā'nāgatau jñānakṣaṇāviti
yadyatkāle asat na tasya tena saha ekasantānaheturabhedaparāmarśaḥ yathā rāvaṇa-śaṅgracakravarttyādinā, atītānāgatakṣaṇakāle asaṃśca vartamānakṣaṇa iti
tataḥ pratikṣaṇaviśarārukṣaṇānāmuktaprakāreṇa kāryakāraṇabhāvasya abhedaparāmarśasya cānupapatteḥ kathaṃ yathoktalakṣaṇaḥ santāno vyavatiṣṭheta ?
tulanā–yasmādabhedaparāmarśa prācīnottarakṣaṇānām jñānāntarāt, svato vā ? yadi jñānāntarāt; vimasmadādisambandhino yogisambandhino vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 1088
yathā rāvaṇaśaṅkhacakravarttibhyā saha iti syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 1088

astu vā; tathāpyasau san syāt, asan vā ? yadi san; tadā'sau anityaḥ, nityo vā ? prathamapakṣe santānibhyo'syā'viśeṣāt kathaṃ karmaphalasambandhavyavasthāhetutvaṃ yataḥ kṛtanāśākṛtābhyāgamadopopanipāto na syāt ? dvitīyapakṣe tu nānni vivādo nārthe, ātmana eva santānaḥ iti nāmāntarakaraṇāt
atha asan; kathaṃ tadvyavasthāhetuḥ ? yadasat na tat kasyacid vyavasthāhetuḥ yathā kharaviṣāṇam, asaṃśca bhavanmate santāna iti
sat syādasad vā ā॰, ba॰, ja॰
tulanā–atha dravyasattvamasyāvasīyate, saṃjñābhedamātram ātmā santāna iti nārthavipratipatti rāja bā॰ pṛ॰ 85
yadapyuktam–bhedābhedādivikalpairavaktavya eva santāno'vastutvāt ityādi; tadapyayuktam; avastuno vastuvyavasthāhetutvā'saṃbhavāt
yad vastuvyavasthāhetu na tadavastu yathā pratyakṣādi, karmādivastuvyavasthāhetuśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaḥ santāna iti
vastutve cāsya santānibhyo bheda, abhedo vā syāt ? abhede pratikṣaṇaṃ tenāpi tadvat vinaṣṭavyaṃ tato'bhinnatvāt tatsvarūpavat, santānivadvā santānasya bhedaprasaṅgaśca tata eva tadvat
bhede nityaḥ, anityo vā syāt ? nityatve sa eva nāmamātrabhedaḥ, sattvādernaśvaratve sādhyādhye'naikāntikatvañca
anityatve tu santānivad bhedāt kathaṃ karmādipratiniyamanibandhanatvam ? kathaṃ vā rūpādiskandhapañcakavyavasthā santānalakṣaṇasya ṣaṣṭhaskandhasya prasaṅgāt ?
tatra coktaṃ nacā'vastu santāna karttṛtā vrajet
svasiddhāntasya ca dhvastirna ca saṃgacchate jani
vāstavatve sthiro vā syāt kṣaṇiko veti cintyatām
uttiṣṭha bhikṣo phalitā tavāśā so'yaṃ samāpta kṣaṇabhaṅgavādaḥ
kiñca, asya tadvikalpairavaktavyatvamasattvāt, vakturaśakteḥ, ajñānādvā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; santānasyā'sattve karmādivyavasthāhetutvābhāvapratipādanāt
astu vā'sattvam; tathāpi asadrūpasya sadrūpād bhedopapatteḥ bhedena vaktuṃ śakteśca kathamasau tadrūpo'pyavaktavyaḥ syāt ? asadrūpohyartha sadrūpatayā vaktumaśakyo na punarasadrūpatayāpi
kiñca, saṃvṛtiḥ kalpanocyate; sā ca asati mukhye na pravartate
na savṛti sā'pi mṛṣāsvabhāvāmukhyādṛte gauṇavidhirna dṛṣṭā yuktanu॰ pṛ॰ 41
satyaṃ cet savṛti keya mṛṣā cet satyatā katham
tulanā–api ca savṛti kalpanā ucyate, sā ca asati mukhye na sabhavati syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 1090
saṃvriyate āvriyate yathābhūtaparijñānaṃ svabhāvāvaraṇād āvṛtaprakāśanācca ? anayā iti saṃvṛti
na ca mukhyarūpatayānvitaṃ rūpaṃ bhavatāṃ kvāpi prasiddhaṃ yat pūrvottarakṣaṇeṣu kāryakāraṇabhāvaprabandhena pravarttamāneṣu kalpyeta

pratyabhijñānānyathānupapatteśca; nahi yamahamadrākṣametarhi tameva spṛśāmi iti ekānusandhātṛvyatirekeṇaivaṃvidhamanusandhānaṃ saṃbhavati, pratikṣaṇamāvirbhavatāmaparāparajñānānāṃ parasparasvarūpā'nabhijñatayā anyonya pratyavamarśā'sāmarthyāt
yat parasparasvarūpānabhijñaṃ na tad anyonyapratyavamarśasamartham yathā devadatta-yajñadattavijñānam, parasparasvarūpānabhijñaṃ ca uktaprakāraṃ rūpasparśādijñānamiti

atha ekamevobhayapratisandhānātmakametajjñānamiṣyate; kathamevaṃ kṣaṇikavādaḥ tadātmano jñānasyā'nekakṣaṇasthāyitvāt ? kathaṃ vā nairātmyavāda tasyaivā''tmatvopapatte ? ekasya grahaṇa-smaraṇānusandhātu siddhatvāt
na hi pramātā nāma ananubhūtapūrvaṃ kiñcidvastu; kiṃ tarhi ? pratiniyatārthāvabhāsijñāneṣu ahamahamikayā pratiprāṇi bhāsamānamanvitaṃ cidrūpam, tadanabhyupagame pratisandhānavārttocchedaḥ syāt
na hi anyenānubhūte ghaṭe anyasya sa evāyaṃ ghaṭaḥ iti pratisandhānaṃ pratītam, anyathā prathamadarśane'pi tat syāt
atha dvitīyadarśane satyeva tad bhavati, nanvekasyāvasthātuḥ tad dvitīyadarśanam, anekasya vā ? yadyekasya; asmanmatasiddhiḥ

anekapakṣe tu ekāvasthātṛrahitatvāt devadattadarśanānantaraṃ yajñadattadarśana iva pratisandhānānupapattiḥ, nahi devadattānubhūtamarthaṃ yajñadatta itthaṃ pratisandhatte yamahamadrākṣaṃ devadattaḥ tamevāhaṃ yajñadattaḥ spṛśāmi iti, etattu syāt tena dṛṣṭaṃ spṛśāmi iti

kṣaṇikacittapakṣe tadapi vā na syāt; pūrvottaracittakṣaṇayorvibhinnakālatvato'nyo'nyārthadarśanā'bhāvāt, abhinnakālayoreva hi devadatta-yajñadattayoḥ anyonyārthadarśane sati tena dṛṣṭaṃ spṛśāmi iti pratisandhānaṃ pratītam
yamahamadrākṣa cakṣuṣā ta sparśanenāpi spṛśāmi iti, yaṃ cāspārkṣa sparśanena taṃ cakṣuṣā paśyāmi iti
ekaviṣayau cemau pratyayo ekakarttṛkau pratisandhīyete nyāya bhā॰ pṛ॰ 218
nahi bhavati yadrūpamadrākṣaṃ so'ya sparśa iti, nāpi bhavati yat sparśamaspārkṣa tadrūpaṃ paśyāmi iti
nāpi devadattadṛṣṭe yajñadattapratisandhāna dṛṣṭam, nahi bhavati devadattā yamādrākṣīt yajñadattaḥ tamadrākṣam iti
pratiniyataviṣayā itaretaravyāvṛttirūpā nairātmyavādino na bhavanti iti na yukta pratisandhānam, tasmāt ya pratisandhātā sa ātmā iti
katha hi ahamado'drākṣam idaṃ paśyāmi iti ca pūrvottaradarśinyekasminnasati pratyaya syāt
api ca darśanasmaraṇayo karttaryekasmin pratyakṣa pratyabhijñāpratyaya sarvasya lokasya prasiddha ahamado'drākṣamida paśyāmi

yadi hitayorbhinna kartāsyāt tato'ha smarāmi adrākṣīdanya iti pratīyāt, natveva pratyeti kaścit tathā anantarāmanantarām ātmana eva pratipattiṃ pratyabhijānan ekakartṛkāmottamāducchvāsād atītāśca pratipattīrājanmanaḥ ātmaikakarttṛkā pratisandadhānaḥ katha kṣaṇabhaṅgavādī vaināśiko nā'patrapet ? brahma॰ sū॰ śā॰ bhā॰
tasya sthānno sphuṭo bhedo vijñānāt kṣaṇabhaṅgurāt
yadā tu jñātaivaika pūrvāparakālayo pratyabhijñāyate yo'ha pūrvamadrākṣa sa evā'hamanupaśyāmi iti tadā pratyabhijñayaiva jñāturekatvāvagamāt, vijñānasya ca kṣaṇikatvāt tato'nyo jñātā siddho bhavatīti
tatra ātmā nāma yo'parāyattasvarūpa svabhāva, tadabhāvo nairātmyam
ahamahamikayātmā vivarttānanubhavan anādinidhana svalakṣaṇapratyakṣa sarvalokānāṃguṇaparyāyānātmasātkurvan sanneva siddhaḥ
sthityabhāve hi pramātuḥ anyena dṛṣṭaṃ nā'paraḥ pratyabhijñātumarhati

yadapi sādṛśyāt pradīpavat pratisandhānam ityuktam, tadapyayuktam; dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt, pradīpādau hi pramāturavasthāne sati viṣayabhede'pi sādṛśyāt pratisandhānaṃ yuktam, nātra, pramātṛ-prameyayoratyantabhedāt

na hi anyena dṛṣṭe'nyasya sādṛśyāt mayā dṛṣṭo'yam iti pratisandhānaṃ dṛṣṭam, so'yam ityādijñānaṃ hi smṛtimapekṣate, smṛtiḥ saṃskāram, so'pyanubhavamityanubhavādijñānamuktāphalānāmanusyūtaikapramātṛsūtrānupraveśe satyeva anubhavāt smṛtiḥ ityādyupapadyate, nānyathā

na ca pūrvabuddhiviśeṣāt tacchaktyanuvidhānena uttaraṃ buddhyantaramutpadyate, ataḥ saṃskārādeḥ saṃbhava ityabhidhātavyam; pūrvabuddhiviśeṣasyānubhavarūpatvāt tatprabhavabuddhyantarasyāpi anubhavarūpasyaivotpattiprasaṅgāt
sādṛśyāt pratyabhijñā cet na syādasadṛśeṣu sā
sa yadi brūyāt sādṛśyādetat saṃpatsyata iti, taṃ prati brūyāt tenedaṃ sadṛśam iti, dvayāyattatvāt sādṛśyasya
kṣaṇabhaṅgavādina sadṛśayordvayorvastuno gṛhīturekasyā'bhāvāt sādṛśyanimittaṃ pratisandhānam iti mithyāpralāpa eva syāt
yadapyuktam–sādṛśyādeva tatsaṃbhavāt pradīpavat iti; tadapi nāvadātam; dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt
pramāturanvitatvā'bhāve ca āmraphalādirūpopalambhe tadrūpāvinābhāviṣu gandharasādiṣu vibhinnapramātṛvat smaraṇapūrvakasyaivābhilāpāderanupapattestadupabhogāya pravṛttiratidurghaṭā syāt

iṣṭāniṣṭayoḥ prāptiparihārecchā hi anubhavasmaraṇādhāraikapramātṛniṣṭhā tadanantaraṃ niyamenotpadyamānatvāt, yā tu naikapramātṛniṣṭhā nāsau tadanantaraṃ niyamenotpadyate yathā devadattānubhūte yajñadattasyecchā, anubhavādyanantaraṃ niyamenotpadyate ca tatprāptiparihārāyeccheti

na khalu vibhinnakartṛkatve devadattenānubhūte iṣṭe'niṣṭe vā'rthe tatprāptiparihārāya yajñadattasyecchā prādurbhavantī pratīyate, ato vibhinnakartṛkatvād vyāvartamāneyam ekakartṛkatvenaiva vyāpyate, tato ya evānubhavati smarati ca sa evecchati ityekapramātṛsiddhiḥ
atha ekapramātrabhāve'pi vāsanāvaśādevecchā prabhavatītyucyate; nanu sā vāsanā vastu, avastu vā syāt ? vastutve nāmamātrabhedaḥ vāsanā, ātmā iti ca
kṣaṇikaikānte ca vāsyavāsakabhāvā'saṃbhavaḥ, sthitasya sthitena taddarśanāt vastradhūpādivat
kasyacidamlaphalasya gṛhītatadrasasāhacarye rūpe gandhe vā kenacidindriyeṇa gṛhyamāṇe rasanasya indriyāntarasya vikāro rasānusmṛtau rasagardhipravartito dantodakasamplavabhūto gṛhyate

pramāturekasyā'bhāve ca āmlādirūpopalambhe tadrūpāvinābhāviṣu gandharasādiṣu vibhinnapramātṛvat smaraṇapūrvakasya icchābhilāṣāderanupapatte tadupabhogāya pravṛttiriti durghaṭā syāt syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 1091

icchā nāma tāvadityamupajāyate–yajjātīyamarthamitthamupayuñjāna puruṣa purā sukhamanubhūtavān puna kālāntare tajjātīyamupalabhya sukhasādhanatāmanusmṛtya tamādātumicchati seyamanena krameṇa samupajāyamānā icchā pūrvā'parānusandhānasamarthamāśrayamanumāpayati
iṣṭāniṣṭayo vivādāpannā prāptiparihārecchā anubhavasmaraṇādhāraikapramātṛniṣṭhā syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 1091
vāsakādvāsanā bhinnā abhinnā vā bhaved yadi
asthiratvādbuddhīnām, sthira hi vāsakena vāsyamāna dṛṣṭam
pūrvacittasya vāsakatā aparasya vāsyatā na bhavatyeva kuta ityāha–pratyāsatterabhāvāt siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 197 u॰
na ca asthirāṇā bhinnakālatayā anyonyā'sambaddhānāñcateṣāṃ vāsyavāsakabhāvo yujyate, sthirasya sambaddhasya ca vastrādeḥ mṛgamadādinā bāsyatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti
yadapyabhihitam–nityaikarūpatve cātmanaḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvānupapattiḥ ityādi; tadapyasamyak; nityaikarūpatvasyātmano'nabhyupagamāt, tasya pariṇāminityatāpratijñānāt
tatraca kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvaṃ yathā saṃbhavati tathā'kṣaṇikatvasiddhipraghaṭṭake pratipādayiṣyate
jīvo aṇāhinihaṇo pariṇamamāṇo hu ṇavaṇavaṃ bhāvaṃ
yadapyuktam–sukhādīnāṃ kramabhuvāmātmā vyāpako bhavan kimekena svabhāvena bhavati anekena vā ityādi; tadapyasaṅgatam; anekasvabhāvenaiva tena teṣāṃ vyāṣyatvāt
nacaivamanavasthā arthāntarabhūtānāṃ teṣāmarthāntarabhūtaiḥ svabhāvairvyāptyanabhyupagamāt, tadrūpatayā pariṇāmo hi tadvyāptiḥ citrajñāne nīlādyākāravyāptivat
nahi tadrūpatayā pariṇateranyā tatra tadākāravyāptirasti, tajjñānāt tadākārāṇāmarthāntaratvānabhyupagamāt, abhyupagame vā taddoṣopanipātaprasaktiḥ

atha citrajñānasya nīlādyākārātmakatayā tadvyāpinaḥ svayaṃ saṃvedanānna tatprasaktiḥ; tarhi ātmano'pi saha krameṇa ca sukhādyanekākāravyāpinaḥ svayaṃ saṃvedanāt kathaṃ taddoṣopanipātaḥ syāt ? nahi dṛṣṭe'nupapattirnāma
tadapahnave ca bandhamokṣayorabhāvaḥ syāt tayorekādhikaraṇatvāt; tathāhi–vivādāpannau bandhamokṣau ekādhikaraṇau tattvāt lokaprasiddhabandhamokṣavat
sarvathā bhede hi baddha-muktaparyāyayoḥ anyo baddhaḥ anyaśca mucyate iti baddhasyaiva mokṣārthā pravṛttirna syāt
santā nāpekṣayā baddhasyaiva mokṣaḥ; ityapyanalpatamovilasitam; santānasyaivoktaprakāreṇa asaṃbhavāt
tathā nihita-mantritā-'dhītasmṛtiḥ dattagrahādiśca ekātmā'pahnave durghaṭa iti
tulanā–syānmataṃ sukhādīnā caitanyaṃ vyāpakaṃ bhavat kimekena svabhāvena bhavati anekena vā ? yadyekenatadetat citrajñāne'pi samānam
kathameka puruṣaḥ krameṇa anantān paryāyān vyāpnoti ? na tāvadekena svabhāvena sarveṣāmekarūpatāpattite'pi dūṣaṇābhāsavādinaḥ; katham ? kramato'nantaparyāyān eko vyāpnoti nā sakṛt
–ko bhavati kimekena svabhāvena na bhavati anekena na vā bhāṃ॰
tasya pītādyākāravyāpinaḥ svayaṃ saṃvedanānna tatprasaktiḥ; tarhi ātmano'pi saha krameṇa ca sukhādyanekākāravyāpinaḥ svayaṃ saṃvedanāt kathamupālambhaḥ syāt, nahi dṛṣṭhe' nupapannaṃ nāma
buddhisantatimātre tu na kaścid dīrghamadhvānaṃ saṃdhāvati na kaścit śarīraprabandhād vimucyate iti saṃsārāpavargā'nupapattiḥ
tattvasaṃgrahe karmaphalasambandhaparīkṣāyāṃ pūrvapakṣarūpeṇa kasyaciduktiḥ–ekādhikaraṇāvetau bandhamaukṣau tathāsthiteḥ
laukikāviva tau tena sarva cārutaraṃ smṛtam
buddhisantatimātre ca sattvabhedāt sarvamidaṃ prāṇivyavahārajātamapratisahitamavyāvṛttamapariniṣṭhitañca syāt tata smaraṇā'bhāvāt

eva tu niṣpramāṇe padārthā'sthairyapakṣe jñānaṃ tu janakasya niyatasya vastuno darśana darśanaviṣayīkṛtasya pravṛtti, pravṛttiviṣayīkṛtasya prāpti iti vyavahāro na syādarthakṣaṇanānātvāt pūrvadṛṣṭasya smaraṇa smṛtasya kasyacit pratyabhijñāna pratyabhijñātasya gṛhāderardhakṛtasya samāpanam ityādayaśca vyavahārā vilupyeran
tadevaṃ kaṇṭakaśuddhi vidhāya svamate pramāṇādilakṣaṇaprarūpaṇārthaṃ śāstramidamupakramate
ataḥ śāstramidamārabhyamāṇamabhidheya-tatsambandhavat, tadrahitaṃ vā syāt ? yadi tadrahitam; tatprārambhaprayāso niṣphalaḥ syāt, unmattavākyavat prekṣāvatāmanādaraṇīyatvāt
tadvaccedastu, tathāpi tadabhidheyaṃ niṣprayojanam, prayojanavadvā syāt ? niṣprayojanaṃ cet; tarhi tatprārambhaprayāso vyarthaḥ kākadantaparīkṣāvat tatra prāmāṇikānāmādarā'saṃbhavāt
atha prayojanavat; tat kimabhimataprayojanavat, anabhimataprayojanavadvā ? anabhimataprayojanavattve mātṛvivāhopadeśavat nitarāmanādaraṇīyatvam

abhidheyaṃ tu yadi niṣprayojana syāt tadā tatpratipattaye śabdasandarbho'pi nārambhaṇīya syāt yathā kākadantaprayojanā'bhāvāt na tatparīkṣā ārambhaṇīyā prekṣāvatā sarve prekṣāvanta pravṛttiprayojanamanviṣya pravarttante, tataśca ācāryeṇa prakaraṇa kimartha kṛta śrotṛbhiśca kimartha śrūyate iti saśayavyutpādana prayojanamabhidhīyate anukteṣu tu pratipattṛbhi niṣprayojanamabhidheyaṃ sambhāvyeta asya prakaraṇasya kākadantaparīkṣāvat
parokṣaṃ śeṣavijñānaṃ pramāṇe iti saṃgrahaḥ || 3 || iti
na vai jñānam ityeva pramāṇam, saṃśayaviparyāsakāraṇasya akiñcitkarasya ca jñānasya bhāvā'virodhāt

nahi tattvajñānam ityeva yathārthanirṇayasādhanamityaparaḥ, tenāpi tattvanirṇayaṃ prati sādhakatamasya jñānasyaiva prāmāṇyaṃ samarthyeta, vastubalāyātatadarthāntarasyāpi paramparayā tatkāraṇatopapatteḥ
tridhā hi śāstrāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ–uddeśaḥ, lakṣaṇam, parīkṣā ceti
uddiṣṭasya lakṣitasya ca yathāvallakṣaṇamupapadyate na vā iti pramāṇato'rthāvadhāraṇaṃ parīkṣā
vibhāgaśca uddeśa evāntarbhavati, sāmānyasaṃjñayā hi kīrtanam uddeśaḥ, prakārabhedasaṃjñayā kīrtanaṃ vibhāgaḥ iti

tatra pratyakṣetarapramāṇabhedāḥ śrutabhedāśca nayanikṣepāḥ lakṣaṇa-saṅkhyā-viṣaya-phalasampatsamanvitāḥ śāstrasyāsyābhidheyā ityuddeśataḥ sakalaśāstrārthasyābhidheyasyanena pratipādanād abhidheyarahitatvāśaṅkāvyudāsaḥ
tena ca sahāsya vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ iti sambandharahitatvārekānirāsaḥ
śakyānuṣṭhāneṣṭaprayojanaṃ tu sākṣāt tallakṣaṇavyutpattireva, paramparayā tu abhyudayaniḥśreyasāvāptiḥ
nacābhidheyādirahitaṃ śāstraṃ kurvatā paro vyutpādito bhavati, tathāvidhasyāsya parapratārakatvaprasaṅgāt
sa ca vyutpādyatvenābhipretaḥ parastridhā bhidyate–saṅkṣeparuciḥ, vistararuci, madhyamaruciśceti
sa ca trividho'pi paraḥ pratyekaṃ caturdhā bhidyate–vyutpannaḥ, avyutpanna, sandigdha, viparyastaśca
tatra vyutpanno viparyastaśca na pratipādyaḥ, vyutpitsāvirahāt
avyutpannastu svabhāvato vyutpitsārahito'pi lobhabhayādinā vyutpitsāyāmutpāditāyāṃ vyutpādyo bhavatyeva, yathā pituḥ putraḥ

sandigdho'pi yadā svagatasaṃśayakhyāpanapūrvakam anayoḥ kaḥ satya iti pūrvāparapakṣayo guṇadopanirūpaṇadvāreṇa māṃ bodhayatu bhavān iti tattvajñānārthamācāryamupasarpati tadaiva vyutpitsāsaṃbhavāt pratipādya, nānyadā
trividhā cāsya śāstrasya pravṛtti–uddeśo lakṣaṇaṃ parīkṣā ceti
lakṣitasya yathā lakṣaṇamupapadyate na veti pramāṇairavadhāraṇaṃ parīkṣā
padārthavyutpādanapravṛttasya śāstrasya ubhayathā pravṛtti uddeśo lakṣaṇañca
etaddūṣaṇatrayarahito dharmo lakṣaṇam, yathā go sāsnādimattvam
nanu ca vibhāgalakṣaṇā caturthyapi pravṛttirastyevauddeśarūpānapāyāttu uddeśa eva asau
sāmānyasaṃjñayā kīrttanamuddeśaḥ prakārabhedasaṃjñayā kīrttana vibhāga iti
kecit saṅkṣeparucayaḥ, apare nā'tisaṅkṣepeṇa nātivistareṇa pratipādyā sarvārthasi॰ pṛ॰ 13
tattvapratipitsāyā satyā trividha pratipādya saśayito viparyastabuddhi avyutpannaśca
catvāro hi pratipādyā vyutpanno'vyutpanna sandigdho viparyastaśca
tatra saṃśayita pratipādya tattvaparyavasāyinā praśnaviśeṣeṇa ācārya prati upasarpakatvāt nā'vyutpanno viparyasto vā tadviparītatvād bālakavad dasyuvadvā

nanu prasiddhe pramāṇe abhidheyādimattā śāstrasya syāt, na ca tat prasiddham; tasya hi prasiddhiḥ pramāṇāntarāt, tadantareṇa vā ? yadi pramāṇāntarāt; tadānavasthā, kutaḥ ? pramāṇāntarasyāpi pramāṇāntarāt prasiddhiprasaṅgāt

pramāṇāntaramantareṇa tatsiddhau ca sarvaṃ sarvasyeṣṭaṃ siddhyet, tathā ca sakalaśūnyatāsiddherapi prasaṅgāt kathamasyā'bhidheyādimattā siddhyediti ? tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; sakalaśūnyatāmabhyupagacchatā'pi pramāṇābhāvasya karttumaśakyatvāt
tathāhi–sakala śūnyavādino'pi asti pramāṇam, iṣṭāniṣṭayoḥ sādhanadūṣaṇā'nyathānupapatteḥ
nacaivamanavasthā, iṣṭasiddheḥ aniṣṭapratiṣedhasya ca pratiprāṇi prasiddhatvena aśeṣavādināṃ nirvivādataḥ pramāṇāntarāpekṣānupapatteḥ
nirākariṣyate ca sakalaśūnyatā bāhyārthasiddhyavasare vistarataḥ ityalamatiprasaṅgena
–sya anyathā syāt na na ca ā॰, ba॰, ja॰

yadi pratyakṣādīni pramāṇena upalabhyante yena pramāṇāntareṇa upalabhyante tat pramāṇāntaramastīti pramāṇāntarasadbhāva prasajyate ityanavasthāmāha–tasyāpyanyena tasyāpyanyena iti, na ca anavasthā śakyā'nujñātum anupapatteriti
yadi pratyakṣādyupalabdhau pramāṇāntaraṃ nivarttate, ātmetyupalabdhāvapi pramāṇāntaraṃ nirvartsyati aviśeṣāt, eva ca sarvapramāṇavilopa iti
pramāṇasiddhi parato vā syāt svata eva vā ? yadi yathā prameyasiddhi pramāṇādhīnāṃ eva pramāṇasiddhirapi pramāṇāntarādhīnā iti tasyāpyanyat tasyāpyanyat ityanavasthā
atha svata eva siddhi evamapi yathā pramāṇasya svata eva siddhi tathā prameyasyāpi prameyātmana eva siddhiriti pramāṇavyavasyākalpanā na ghaṭate

bodhasya svārthasādhanadṛṣaṇarūpasya vākyasya ca parārthasādhanadūṣaṇātmano'saṃbhavāt na pramāṇam, tata kena sādhanaṃ nairātmyasya svārthaṃ parārthaṃ vā kena dūṣaṇaṃ bahirantaśca bhāvasvabhāvānāmbahirantaśca paramārthasat tadanyatarāpāye'pi sādhanadūṣaṇaprayogā'nupapatteḥ
siddhiḥ pramāṇasaṃsiddhyabhāve' sti na hi kasyacit
nanu siddhe'pi pramāṇasadbhāve tatsvarūpaviśeṣaniścayāsiddhiḥ, jñānā'jñānarūpatayā tatra vādināṃ vipratipatterityāha–jñānam iti

yat tadiṣṭā'niṣṭasādhanadūṣaṇānyathānupapattitaḥ prasādhitaṃ pramāṇaṃ tajjñānam pramāṇatvāt, yat punarjñānaṃ na bhavati na tat pramāṇam yathā ghaṭādiḥ, pramāṇañcedaṃ vivādāpannam, tasmājjñānam, iti pramāṇasāmānyalakṣaṇam
taccaitallakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣa-parokṣaprakāreṇa dvidhābhidyate ityetat pramāṇe ityanena darśayati
indriyādyanapekṣaṃ pratibandhakāpāyopetātmamātranibandhanaṃ svaviṣaye niḥśeṣato viśadam avadhi-manaḥparyaya-kevalākhyaṃ jñānaṃ mukhyata pratyakṣam
pramāṇasya kramavikasitāni sāmānyalakṣaṇāni nimnaprakāreṇa draṣṭavyāni–tattvajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ te yugapatsarvabhāsanam
ko'syā'tiśayaḥ sakalaprameyavyavasthāhetutvaṃ yadvakṣyate siddhaṃ yannaparāpekṣyam ? ityādi–siddhi vi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 3 u॰
eṣaiva kārikā taduktam iti nirdiśya uddhṛtā nyāyaviniścayaṭīkāyām pṛ॰ 30 u॰ siddhaṃ yanna parāpekṣyaṃ siddhau svapararūpayoḥ, tatpramāṇaṃ tato nānyadavikalpamacetanam
geṇhai vatthusabhāvaṃ aviruddhaṃ sammarūva jaṃ ṇāṇaṃ
ajñātārthajñāpakaṃ pramāṇam iti pramāṇasāmānyalakṣaṇam pramāṇasamu॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 11
svavittirvā pramāṇaṃ tu sārūpyaṃ yogyatā'pi vā
bāhyarthe prameyesārūpyaṃ tu pramāṇam jñānātmani tu prameyeyogyatā pramāṇam
yogācārāstu bāhyārthamapalapanto jñānasyaiva anādivāsanopaplāvitaḥ nīlapītādiviṣayākāra prameyam, svākāra pramāṇam, svasaṃvittiḥ phalam iti manyante
mī॰ ślo॰ nyāyara॰ pṛ॰ 159 nirākāro bodho'rthasahabhāvyekasāmagryadhīnaḥ tatrārthe pramāṇam iti vaibhāpikoktam
miti samyak paricchitti tadvattā ca pramātṛtā
aduṣṭendriyajanyaṃ yatra yadasti tatra tadanubhavo vā, viśeṣyavṛttiprakārakānubhavo vā vidyā
pramīyate'nena iti nirvacanāt pramā prati karaṇatvaṃ gamyate
asandigdhā'viparītā'nadhigataviṣayā cittavṛtti bodhaśca pauruṣeya phalaṃ pramā, tatsādhanaṃ pramāṇamiti
dvayorekatarasya vāpyasannikṛṣṭārthaparicchitti pramā, tatsādhakatamaṃ yat tat trividham pramāṇam
atra yadi pramārūpaṃ phalaṃ puruṣaniṣṭhamātrameva ayate tadā buddhivṛttireva pramāṇam
yadi ca buddhiniṣṭhamātramucyate tadā tu uktendriyasannikarṣādireva pramāṇam
etacca viśeṣaṇatrayamupādadānena sūtrakāreṇa kāraṇadoṣabādhakajñānarahitamagṛhītagrāhi jñānaṃ pramāṇam iti pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ sūcitam
pratyakṣaparokṣarūpeṇa dvividhapramāṇavibhāgasya ullekha nimnapurātanagrantheṣu dṛśyate–jaṃ parado viṇṇāṇaṃ taṃ tu parokkhatti bhaṇidamatthesu
jaṃ kevaleṇa ṇādaṃ havadi hu jīveṇa paccakkham
duvihe nāṇe paṇṇattaṃ, taṃ jahā–paccakkhe ceva parokkhe ceva
idamanantaroktaṃ spaṣṭaṃ viśadaṃ vyavasāyātmaka jñānam, kathabhūtam ? svārthasannivānānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi pratisaṅkhyānirodhyavisaṃvādakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ-pramāṇa-yuktam
akṣasya akṣasya prativiṣayaṃ vṛtti pratyakṣam, vṛttistu sannikarṣo jñānaṃ vā
akṣamakṣaṃ pratītya utpadyate iti pratyakṣamsarveṣu padārtheṣu catuṣṭayasannikarṣād avitathamavyapadeśyaṃ yajjñānamutpadyate tat pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam
indriyajanyaṃ jñānam pratyakṣam, athavā jñānā'karaṇakaṃ jñānaṃ pratyakṣam
indriyapraṇālikayā cittasya bāhyavastūparāgāt tadviṣayā sāmānyaviśeṣātmano'rthasya viśeṣāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛtti pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇam
satsaṃprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇāṃ buddhijanma tatpratyakṣamanimittaṃ vidyamānopalambhanatvāt
cātra caitanyamevapṛ॰ 12tathā ca tattadindriyayogyavarttamānaviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyā'bhinnatvaṃ tattadākāravṛttyavacchinnajñānasya tattadaṃśe pratyakṣatvam
vyaktā tadātve yā buddhiḥ pratyakṣaṃ sā nirucyate
tat sarvathāvaraṇavilaye cetanasya svarūpāvirbhāvo mukhyaṃ kevalam 1
indriyanimittaṃ tu svaviṣaye deśato viśadaṃ cakṣurādijñānaṃ saṃvyavahārataḥ pratyakṣam
kathaṃ pu naranakṣāśritajñānasya pratyakṣavyapadeśaḥ ? iti cet; pravṛttinimittasadbhāvāt
akṣāśritattvaṃ hi pratyakṣaśabdasya vyutpattinimittaṃ gatikriyeva gośabdasya
anyaddhi śabdasya vyutpattinimittam anyadvācyam, anyathā gacchantyeva gauḥ gauḥ ityucyeta nānyā vyutpattinimittābhāvāt, jātyantarañca gatikriyāpariṇataṃ vyutpattinimittasadbhāvād gośabdavācyaṃ syāt
yadi vā, vyutpattinimittamapyatra vidyata eva; tathā hi–akṣaśabdoyamindriyavat ātmanyapi pravartate, akṣṇoti vyāpnoti jānāti iti akṣa ātmā iti vyutpatteḥ
tameva kṣīṇopaśāntāvaraṇaṃ kṣīṇāvaraṇaṃ vā prati niyatasya jñānasya pratyakṣaśabdātiśayatā sughaṭaiva
digambarāmnāye akalaṅkadevaiḥ, śvetāmbarāmnāye ca jinabhadragaṇikṣamāśramaṇaiḥ viśeṣāvaśyakabhāṣye mukhyasaṃvyavahārarūpeṇa pratyakṣaṃ dvidhā vibhaktam
bauddhagrantheṣvapi sāvyavahārikaśabdasya nirdeśo dṛśyate yathā sāṃvyavahārikasya idaṃ pramāṇasya lakṣaṇam tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 784
akṣāśritattvañca vyutpattinimittaṃ śabdasya, na tu pravṛttinimittam
anena tu akṣāśritatvena ekārthasamavetam arthasākṣātkāritvaṃ lakṣyate, tadeva ca śabdasya pravṛttinimittam

yadi ca akṣāśritattvameva pravṛttinimittaṃ syāt indriyajñānameva pratyakṣamucyeta, na mānasādi, yathā gacchatīti gau iti gamanakriyāyā vyutpādito'pi gośabda gamanakriyopalakṣitamekārthasamavetaṃ gotvaṃ pravṛttinimittīkaroti, tathā ca gacchati agacchati ca gavi gośabda siddho bhavati
yad indriyamāśritya ujjihīte arthasākṣātkārijñānaṃ tat pratyakṣam ityartha, etacca pratyakṣaśabdavyutpattinimittaṃ na pravṛttinimittam–ityādi, nyāyāva॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 16
indriyajñānamapi vyavahāre vaiśadyamātreṇa pratyakṣaṃ prasiddhamnyā॰ vi॰ bi॰ pṛ॰ 48 u॰
pāśake śakaṭe karṣe jñāne cātmani rāvaṇau
akṣṇoti vyāpnoti jānātītyakṣa ātmā tameva prāptakṣayopaśamaṃ prakṣīṇāvaraṇaṃ vā prati niyataṃ pratyakṣam
tathāca bhadrabāhu–jīvo akkho taṃ pai jaṃ vaṭṭaī taṃ tu hoi paccakkhaṃ
parao puṇa akkhassa vaṭṭantaṃ hoi pārokkhaṃ
jīvo akkho atyavvāvaṇa bhoyaṇa guṇaṇṇio jeṇa
taṃ paī vaṭṭaī ṇāṇa jaṃ paccakkhaṃ tayaṃ tiviham
taccedaṃ dvividhamapi pratyakṣaṃ kiṃviśiṣṭam ? ityāha–vijñānam iti
vividhaṃ svaparasambandhi jñānaṃ bhāsanaṃ yasya yasmin vā tadvijñānam, anena svasyaiva parasyaiva vā jñānaṃ grāhakam ityekānto nirastaḥ
athavā viśiṣṭaṃ bādhavarjitaṃ tad yasya yasmin veti grāhyam
anenāpi bhrāntameva svapararūpayoḥ sakalaṃ jñānam ityekāntaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ

yadi vā, pi vi nānā dravyaparyāyasāmānyaviśeṣarūpārtha rūpā arthā viṣayatayā tad ? yasya yasmin vā iti pratipattavyam, anenāpi dravyamātrasya, paryāyamātrasya, sāmānyaviśeṣayoranyataramātrasya, anyonyavibhinnobhayarūpasya vā jñānaṃ grāhakam ityekāntaḥ prativyūḍhaḥ
vigataṃ vā svarūpe pararūpe vā apekṣyaṃ tad yasya tattathoktamiti
anenāpi yatraiva janayedenāṃ tatraivāsya pramāṇatā ityekāntaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ
tattadekāntānāṃ ca prapañcataḥ pratikṣepo'gre vidhāsyata ityalamatiprasaṅgena
paragrāhakajñānavādina–parokṣajñānavādino mīmāsakā, jñānāntarapratyakṣajñānavādino yaugā, asvasaṃvedanajñānavādina sākhyā, bhūtacaitanikāścārvākāśca
idānīṃ dvitīyaṃ pramāṇaprakāraṃ parokṣaṃ śeṣam ityanena prarūpayati
yat tadviśadasvarūpājjñānāt śeṣamaviśadasvabhāvaṃ jñānaṃ tat parokṣam
asya ca vyākhyānaṃ pūrvamiva atrāpi dṛṣṭavyam

tathā ca pramāṇaviśeṣalakṣaṇasya dviprakārasyaiva prasiddheḥ dve eva pramāṇe prasiddhe, sakalatadvyaktibhedānāmatraivāntarbhāvāditi darśayannāhapramāṇe iti saṃgrahaḥ iti dve eva pramāṇe ityevaṃ saṃgrahaḥ sakalaśāstrārthasyeti
jaṃ parado viṇṇāṇaṃ taṃ tu parokkhatti bhaṇidamatthesu
parāṇīndriyāṇi manaśca prakāśopadeśādi ca bāhyanimittaṃ pratītya tadāvaraṇakarmakṣayopaśamāpekṣasya ātmana utpadyamānaṃ matiśrutaṃ parokṣam ityākhyāyate
akṣād ātmanaḥ parāvṛttaṃ parokṣam, tata paraiḥ indriyādibhiḥ ūkṣyate siñcyate abhivardhyata iti parokṣam
akkhassa poggalakayā jaṃ davvidiyamaṇā parā teṇaṃ
tehi to jaṃ ṇāṇaṃ parokkhamiha tamaṇumāṇaṃ va
akṣāṇā paraṃ parokṣam, akṣebhyaḥ parato varttata iti vā, pareṇa indriyādinā vā ūkṣyate parokṣam
tatra pramāṇasya yajjñānamiti sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tat sannikarṣādeḥ ityādinā samarthayate
kasyeva ? arthāntaravat, arthaḥ sanni karṣādiḥ, tasmādanyaḥ prameyo ghaṭādiḥ tadantaram tasyeva tadvat
nanu pramāṇatvañca syāt ajñānatvañca virodhā'bhāvāt, ataḥ sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvādanaikāntikatvam; ityanupapannam; ajñānavirodhinā jñānatvena pramāṇatvasya vyāptatvāt tatra tadvirodhasiddheḥ

prakarṣeṇa hi saṃśayādivyavacchedalakṣaṇena mīyate avyavadhānena paricchidyate yenārthaḥ tat pramāṇam, tatkathamajñānarūpasannikarṣādisvabhāvaṃ ghaṭeta ? na khalu sannikarṣādinā kiñcinmīyate, jñānakalpanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt

syānmatireṣā te–jñānameva pramāṇam ityavadhāraṇamanupapannam, ajñānarūpasyāpi sannikarṣādeḥ pramājanakatvena pramāṇatvopapatteḥ; tathā hi–pramājanakaṃ pramāṇam iti sūtraṃ vyācakṣāṇena bhāṣyakāreṇa upalabdhisādhanāni pramāṇāni nyāyabhā॰ pṛ॰ 18 ityuktam
tatra vyākhyātṝṇāṃ matabhedaḥ–kecit sannikarṣaḥ arthopalabdhau sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇam iti pratipannāḥ, anye tu kārakasākalyam
tatra hi sannikarṣa eva arthopalabdhau sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇam
sādhakatamatvaṃ hi pramāṇatvena vyāptaṃ na punarjñānatvamajñānatvaṃ vā, saṃśayādivat prameyārthavacca
yadi hyasannikṛṣṭamapyartha cakṣurādīndriyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, tarhi vyavahitamapi kinna gṛhṇīyād aviśeṣāt ?
nyāyavārtikakṛta udyotakarācāryā–upalabdhihetu pramāṇam yadupalabdhinimitaṃ tat pramāṇam
akaraṇā pramāṇotpatti iticet, na, indriyārthasannikarṣasya karaṇabhāvāt sādhakatamatvādvā na prasaṅga
tadevaṃ jñānamajñānaṃ vā upalabdhihetu pramāṇam nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 22
nanu sannikarṣāvagame ki pramāṇam ? vyavahitā'nupalabdhi iti brūma
yadi hi asannikṛṣṭamapi cakṣurādīndriyam arthaṃ gṛhṇīyād vyavahito'pi tato'rtha upalabhyeta
kiñca, indriyaṃ kārakam, kārakañcāsannikṛṣṭaṃ na phalaprādurbhāvāya prabhavati; tathā hi–indriyaṃ nā'sannikṛṣṭe'rthe phalamutpādayati kārakatvāt vāsyādivat
sparśanādīndriye ca prāpyakāritvaṃ suspaṣṭam, tatsādharmyādindriyāntareṣvapi tat kalpyatām aviśeṣāt
sa caivaṃ prasiddhasvarūpaḥ sa nnikarṣaḥ paṭprakāro bhavati–saṃyogaḥ, saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ, saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyaḥ, samavāyaḥ, samavetasamavāyaḥ, sambaddhaviśeṣaṇībhāvaśceti

tatra cakṣuṣo dravyeṇa saṃyogaḥ, tatsamavetairguṇakarmasāmānyaiḥ saṃyuktasamavāyaḥ, guṇakarmasamavetaiḥ sāmānyaiḥ saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyaḥ, śrotrasya śabdena samavāyaḥ, śabdatvena samavetasamavāya, ghaṭādyabhāvena samavāyena ca sambaddhaviśeṣaṇībhāva iti
pratyakṣañcātpadyamānaṃ catustridvisannikarṣādutpadyate, tatra bāhye rūpādau catuḥsannikarṣādeva pratyakṣamutpadyate–ātmā hi manasā yujyate, mana indriyeṇa, indriyamarthenati
saṃsṛṣṭañca kārakaṃ phalāya kalpate iti kalpanīya saṃsarga
sannikarṣaḥ punaḥ ṣāḍhā bhidyate nyāyavā॰ pṛ॰ 31
karṇavivaravarttyākāśasya śrotratvāt śabdasya ca ākāśaguṇatvena tatra samavāyāt
ghaṭā'bhāvavadbhūtalam ityatra cakṣuṣā saṃyuktaṃ bhūtalam, tadviśeṣaṇībhūtaśca abhāvaḥ iti
etena samavāye'pi pratyakṣatvaṃ prakāśitam, iheti tantusambaddhapaṭapratyayadarśanāt
sambandhapratyakṣe yāvadāśrayapratyakṣasya hetutvāt, samavāyasya ekatayā ekadā bhāvibhūtasakalāśrayavyaktīnāṃ jñānā'saṃbhavāt

dravye tāvat trividhe mahatyanekadravyavattvodbhūtarūpaprakāśacatuṣṭayasannikarṣād dharmādisāmagrye ca svarūpālocanamātramśabdasya trayasannikarṣāt śrotrasamavetasya tenaiva upalabdhiḥbuddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnānāṃ dvayorātmamanasoḥ saṃyogādupalabdhiḥ praśasta॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 187
yattāvaduktam–sannikarṣa eva sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇam ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tasyārthapramitau sādhakatamatvā'saṃbhavāt
yadbhāve hi pramiterbhāvavattā yadabhāve cā'bhāvavattā tattatra sādhakatamam
na caitat sannikarṣe sambhavati, tasmin satyapi kvacit pramityanupapatteḥ, ākāśādinā hi ghaṭavat cakṣuṣaḥ saṃyogo vidyate, na cāsau tatra pramitimutpādayati
na cākāśaghaṭayoścakṣuṣā saṃyogāviśeṣe'pi pramiterviśeṣo yuktaḥ; tasyāḥ taddhetukatvābhāvānuṣaṅgāt
yadaviśeṣe'pi yad viśiṣyate na tat taddhetukam yathā paramāṇoraviśeṣe'pi viśiṣyamāṇau ghaṭapaṭau, sannikarṣāviśeṣe'pi viśiṣyate ca pramitiriti

tasmād yad yatrotpannamavyavadhānena phalamutpādayati tadeva tatra sādhakatamam yathā apavarakāntarvartipadārthaprakāśe pradīpa, avyavadhānena pramitimutpādayati ca utpannaṃ svaviṣaye vijñānam, tasmāttadeva tatra sādhakatamam
tasmācca pramāṇam, na puna sannikarṣo viparyayāt
yadbhāve hi pramiterbhāvavattā yadabhāve ca abhāvavattā
na hi cakṣuṣā ghaṭavadākāśe saṃyogo vidyamāno'pi pramityutpādakaḥ ityādisarvam anayaivā''nupūrvyā prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 4–5, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 54–61 carcitam
kiñca, sannikarṣamātramatra pramāṇam, tadviśeṣo vā ? na tāvat sannikarṣamātram; saṃśayādāvapyasyā'viśeṣataḥ prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
viśiṣṭaścet, kimidaṃ tasya vaiśiṣṭyaṃ nāma-viśiṣṭakāraṇādātmalābhaḥ, viśiṣṭapramotpādakatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe ghaṭādivadākāśe'pyasya prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ, viśiṣṭakāraṇādātmalābhasyobhayatrāviśeṣāt

tadaviśeṣe cāsau kathaṃ ghaṭādyartha eva vaiśiṣṭyaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vā svīkuryānnākāśe ? dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ; viśiṣṭapramotpādakatvasya sannikarṣe pramiti prati sādhakatamatvābhāvato'siddhe, tadabhāvaścānantarameva pratipāditaḥ
siddhau vā kathamākāśādiparihāreṇa ghaṭādāvevāsya tat syāt ? ubhayatrāpyaviśeṣeṇāsau pramāmutpādayet naikatrāpi vā
nanu ākāśādāvevāsau pramāṃ notpādayati yogyatāyā abhāvāt, na ghaṭādau viparyayāt
nanu keyaṃ yogyatā nāma–śaktiḥ, pratipattuḥ pratibandhāpāyo vā
śaktiścet; kimatīndriyā, sahakārisannidhilakṣaṇā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yukta; apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt
sahakārikāraṇañca viṣayagatātiśayaviśeṣaḥ, karaṇapāṭavam, dharmaviśeṣaḥ, adharmaprakṣayaḥ, dravyam, guṇaḥ, karma vā syāt
yadi viṣayagatātiśayaviśeṣa; ki rūpādisamavāyaḥ, dṛśyatā vā ? na tāvadrūpādisamavāyaḥ; asya pramotpatti pratyakāraṇatvāt
kathamanyathā guṇakarmasāmānyeṣu tadrahiteṣu pramotpattiḥ syāt ? kathaṃ vā paramāṇau tadutpattirna syāt tatra tatsamavāyasaṃbhavāt ? mahatyanekadravyatvādrūpaviśeṣācca rūpopalabdhiḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 4
atha dṛśyatā; sā ākāśādāvastyeva, kathamanyathā asyeśvarapratyakṣatā ? karaṇānāñca pāṭavam kācakāmalādyanupahatatvam, ālokādisahakṛtatvaṃ vā ? dvayamapi ākāśādau saṃbhavatyeva

na khalu tasya tena virodhaḥ; yena tatsadbhāve dharmaviśeṣasyānutpattiḥ pradhvaṃso vā syāt, virodhe vā na ghaṭādyupalambhaḥ kadācidapi syāt tadutpattau dharmaviśeṣasya sahakāriṇo virodhyākāśādisaṃyogasadbhāvato'saṃbhavāt
adharmaprakṣayastu pratibandhakāpāya eva, tasya ca jñānahetutve sarvaṃ sustham tasyaiva pramāṃ prati niyāmakatvopapatteḥ

dravyamapi nityavyāpisvarūpam, tadviparītaṃ vā sannikarṣasya sahakāri syāt ? nityavyāpisvarūpañcet; tat nayananabhaḥsannikarṣepyastyeva, anyathā kathaṃ dikkālākāśātmanāṃ nityavyāpidravyasvarūpatā ? anityā'vyāpisvarūpañcet; tat manaḥ, nayanam, āloko vā syāt ? tritayamapi ākāśādinendriyasannikarṣe saṃbhavatyeva ghaṭādivat

guṇo'pi prameyagataḥ, pramātṛgataḥ, ubhayagato vā tatsahakārī syāt ? prameyagataścet; kinnākāśasya pratyakṣatā guṇasadbhāvāviśeṣāt ? nirguṇatve asya dravyatvānupapattiḥ, guṇavattvalakṣaṇatvād dravyasya
pramātṛgatopi adṛṣṭaḥ, anyo vā guṇo gaganendriyasannikarṣasamaye'styeva

karmāpi arthagatam, indriyagataṃ vā tatsahakāri syāt ? na tāvadarthagatam; pramotpattau tasyānaṅgatvāt, kathamanyathā sthirārthānāmupalabdhiḥ ? indriyagataṃ tu tat tatrāstyeva, ākāśendriyasannikarṣe nayanonmīlanādikarmaṇaḥ sadbhāvāt
tasmāt pratipattuḥ pratibandhāpāyarūpaiva yogyatā urarīkarttavyā, tatraivoktāśeṣadoṣāṇāmasaṃbhavāt
yasya yatra yathāvidho hi pratibandhāpāyaḥ, tasya tatra tathāvidhā'rthaparicchittirutpadyate

na caivaṃ yogyatāyā evārthaparicchittau sādhakatamatvataḥ pramāṇatvāt jñānaṃ pramāṇam iti pratijñā viruddhyate; asyāḥ svārthagrahaṇaśaktisvabhāvāyāḥ svārthāvabhāsijñānalakṣaṇapramāṇasāmagrītvata tadutpattāveva sādhakatamatvopapatteḥ
nanu nabhasi nayanasannikarṣasya yogyatāvirahāt na savedananimittatā ityapi na sādhīya, tadyogyatāyā eva sādhakatamatvā'nuṣaṅgāt
kā ceyaṃ sannikarṣasya yogyatā nāma ? pramāṇaparī॰ pṛ॰ 51
nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 41 ityādinā naiyāyikamate svarūpasahakārirūpaiva śakti svīkṛtā
vaiśeṣikadarśane tu–mahatyanekadravyavattvāt rūpāccopalabdhi anekadravyasamavāyāt rūpaviśeṣācca rūpopalabdhi
sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 100, syā॰ ratnākara pṛ॰ 56 ityādau tu vaiśeṣikasūtrasammata eva pāṭhaḥ
prameyakamalamārttaṇḍe pṛ॰ 75 pū॰ tu granthokta eva pāṭha
cakṣuṣaśca aprāpyakāritvena prasādhayiṣyamāṇatvānna ghaṭadinā saṃyogaḥ, tadabhāvānna rūpādinā saṃyuktasamavāyādiḥ
saṃyuktasamavāyācca cakṣuṣo rūpavat śabdarasādau, divākararūpavat tatkarmaṇyapi ca jñānamutpadyeta aviśeṣāt
saṃyuktasamavetasamavāyācca rūpatvavad rasatvādau, samavāyāt śabdavat nabhomahattvādau, samavetasamavāyāt śabdatvavat mahāparimāṇatvādau
na hi sambandhāntareṇā'sambaddhe vastuni sa ghaṭate sahyavindhyavat
yogyā'yogyatvakṛtagrahaṇā'grahaṇaniyamavāde vā yogyataiva sannikarṣo bhavatu kiṃ ṣaṭkaghoṣaṇena ? nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 49
etena asannikṛṣṭasya grahaṇe sarvasya sarvatrārthe jñānotpattiḥ syāt iti pratyuktam; yogyasyaiva grahaṇāt

kathamanyathā sannikṛṣṭe sarvatrāpyarthe jñānaṃ notpadyeta ? tato yasmin satyapi yannotpadyate na tat taddhetukam yathā vidyamāne'pi yavabīje'nutpadyamāno godhūmāṅkuraḥ, vidyamāne'pi sannikarṣe notpadyate cārthaparicchittiriti
yadapi sannikarṣasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ vyavahitārthānupalabdhireva ityuktam, tadapyayuktam; asiddhatvāttarayāḥ, kācābhrapaṭalasphaṭikasvacchodakādivyavahitānāmapyarthānāmupalabdheḥ
yadapi kārakatvāt ityādi tatprāpyakāritve sādhanamuktam; tadapi cakṣuṣo'prāpyakāritvaprasādhanaprastāve pratividhāsyate
ata pratyakṣañcotpadyamānaṃ catuḥ-tri-dvisannikarṣādutpadyate ityādi, vandhyāsutasaubhāgyatvādivyāvarṇanaprakhyaṃ pratibhāsate sannikarṣasyā'saṃbhave

kathañca sannikarṣaprāmāṇyābhyupagame sarvajñavārttāpi syāt ? tadvijñānaṃ hi mānasamindriyajaṃ vā catustridvisannikarṣād varttamāneṣvevārtheṣu syāt nātītānāgatepu, teṣāmasattve tatra taddheto sannikarṣasya sattvavirodhāt
yadasan na tatra jñānahetuḥ sannikarṣosti yathā kharaviṣāṇādau, na santi ca atītānāgatā varttamānārthajñānotpattisamaye bhāvā iti

atha yadā te bhaviṣyanti tadā tatsannikarṣāt tatra jñānamutpatsyate; kathamevamanantenāpi kālena īśvarasyā'śeṣajñatā syāt ? varttamānāśeṣārthagrahaṇādasyāśeṣajñatābhyupagame'pi, kathaṃ tadupadeśasya anāgate'rthe prāmāṇyaṃ syāt yatastadarthināṃ tadupadeśāttatra pravṛttiḥ syāt ? nityatvāttajjñānasyāyamadoṣaḥ; ityapyasamīcīnam; tannityatvasyeśvaranirākaraṇāvasare nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
yadi sannikarṣa pramāṇaṃ sūkṣmavyavahitaviprakṛṣṭānāmarthānāmagrahaṇaprasaṅga ata sarvajñatvā'bhāva syāt

kathañcaivaṃ vādinaḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ vyāptiḥ siddhyet yato'numānaṃ syāt, indriyapratyakṣasyeva mānasapratyakṣasyāpi sannikṛṣṭeṣvevārtheṣu pravṛtteḥ, vyāptiścāniyatadeśakālā iti kathaṃ sannikarṣaprabhavapratyakṣāt pratīyeta ? nanu sāmānyena vyāptiḥ, tatra ca tatprabhavapratyakṣasya sāmarthyaṃsaṃbhavāt kathannātastatsiddhiḥ ? ityapyasāṃpratam; sāmānyena vyāpteḥ vyāptivicārapraghaṭṭake nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
tanna sannikarṣasyājñānātmano'nupacaritaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ ghaṭate, nāpi kārakasākalyasya
na ca sāmagryāḥ kārakakalāparūpatvāt, tatra ca svarūpātiśayābhāvānna kasyacitsādhakatvamupapadyata ityabhidhātavyam; kārakasākalyasya karaṇatābhyupagame sādhakatamatvasyopapatteḥ
nahyekasya sāmagryekadeśasya pradīpādeḥ kvacitkārye karaṇatā pratīyate
ki tarhi ? sāmagrīsvarūpasya kārakasākalyasyaiva; tacca pramātṛprameyasadbhāve saṃpadyate
ataḥ sāmagryekadeśakārakasadbhāve'pi kāryasyānutpatteḥ naikadeśasya karaṇatā, sāmagrīsadbhāvetu tasyāvaśyaṃbhāvenotpatteḥ tasyā eva sannipatyajanakatvena sādhakatamatvādupapannaṃ karaṇatvam
na ca sākalyavyatirekeṇa kārakāntare sādhakatamatvaṃ saṃbhāvayituṃ śakyam
yadi hi tadvyatirekeṇāsakalāvasthāyāmapi kvacitkārake pramitiravakalpyeta, syāttatrāpi sādhakatamatvātkaraṇatvam, na cāsau tatrāvakalpyate pratītivirodhāt, tasmāt sākalyameva karaṇam
yata eva sādhakatamaṃ karaṇaṃ karaṇasādhanaśca pramāṇaśabdaḥ, tata eva sāmagryāḥ pramāṇatvaṃ yuktam, tadvyatirekeṇa kārakāntare kvacidapi tamabarthasaṃsparśā'nupapatteḥ
anekakārakasannidhāne kārya ghaṭamānam anyataravyapagame ca vighaṭamānaṃ kasmai atiśayaṃ prayacchet
na ca atiśayaḥ kāryajanmani kasyacidavadhāryate sarveṣāṃ tatra vyāpriyamāṇatvātsa ca sāmagryantargatasya na kasyacidekasya kārakasya kathayituṃ pāryate
sāmagryāstu so'tiśaya suvaca, sannihitā cet sāmagrī saṃpannameva phalam iti saiva atiśayavatī

nanu karaṇaṃ kartṛkarmāpekṣaṃ bhavati, kartṛkarmaṇośca sāmagryantaḥ–patitayoḥ svarūpapracyutitaḥ asaṃbhavāt kathaṃ tadapekṣaṃ sākalyasya karaṇatvamiti ? tadavicāritaramaṇīyam; sākalyāntargata kārakāpekṣayaivāsya karaṇatvopapatteḥ

sākalyaṃ hi nāma kārakāṇāṃ dharma, na ca svakīyo dharmaḥ svasyaiva svarūpāpahārāya prabhavati, sākalyāvasthāyāmapi kārakasvarūpasya pratyabhijñāyamānatvācca na tatraiṣāṃ svarūpapracyutiḥ, tasmāttadantargatakārakāpekṣayā labdhakaraṇabhāvaṃ sākalyaṃ pramāṇam, na tu jñānaṃ phalarūpatvāttasya
phalasya ca pramāṇatānupapannaiva; tato bhinnatvāttasya, pramīyate hi yenārthaḥ tatpramāṇam iti karaṇasādhane pramāṇaśabdavyutpādanāt karaṇasyaiva tadrūpatopapannā
atha vyatiriktaphalajanakamapi jñānameva pramāṇamucyate; tadayuktam; sakalalokāṅgīkṛta-ajñānasvabhāvasya śabdaliṅgāderapramāṇatā prasaṅgāt
tato jñānamapi sāmagryanupraviṣṭameva, viśeṣaṇajñānamiva viśeṣyapratyakṣe, liṅgajñānamiva liṅgipratītau, sārūpyadarśanamiva upamāne, śabdajñānamiva tadarthajñāne, pramāṇatvaṃ pratipadyate
tasmāt bodhābodhasvabhāvaṃ kārakasākalyaṃ pramāṇam ityayameva pakṣaḥ pramāṇopapanna iti
yattu kimapekṣaṃ sāmagryāḥ karaṇatvam iti, tadantargatakārakāpekṣam iti vrūma
kārakāṇāṃ dharma sāmagrī na svarūpahānāya teṣāṃ kalpate sākalyadaśāyāmapi tatsvarūpapratyabhijñānāttasmāt antargatakārakāpekṣayā labdhakaraṇabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam
bodha khalu pramāṇasya phala na sākṣāt pramāṇam
tasmāt sāmagryanupraviṣṭabodho viśeṣaṇajñānamiva kvacit pratyakṣe liṅgajñānamiva liṅgipramitau sārūpyadarśanamiva upamāne śabdaśravaṇamiva tadarthajñāne pramāṇatā pratipadyate
idaṃ sāmagrīpramāṇavādijayantamatam anayaiva prakriyayā sanmatiṭīkāyā pṛ॰ 471–72 syā॰ ratnākare ca pṛ॰ 62–64 varttate
tatsādhakatamaṃ yukta sākalyānna paraṃ ca tat
karaṇaṃ kārakāṇāṃ hi dharmo'sau na svarūpavat
ete saptaślokā bhaṭṭajayantakarttṛkapallavagatā samuddhṛtā, paraṃ ca mudritanyāyamañjaryā te nopalabhyante
nyāyamañjaryyāṃ pṛ॰ 15 karttṛkarmavilakṣaṇā saṃśayaviparyayarahitārthabodhavidhāyinī bodhā'bodhasvabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam' ityaparo'pi prakāra sāmagryā pradarśita

yattāvaduktam–avyabhicārādiviśeṣaṇa ityādi; tadayuktam; yato mukhyataḥ, upacāreṇa vā kārakasākalyasya prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ? mukhyopacārabhedena hi śabdānāṃ dvividhā pravṛttiḥ pratīyate, annaṃ vai prāṇāḥ ityādivat
tatra na tāvanmukhyataḥ, ajñānarūpasyāsya svaparapramitau mukhyataḥ sādhakatamatvābhāvato mukhyataḥ pramāṇatvasyānupapatteḥ
tatpramitau mukhyataḥ sādhakatamatvaṃ hi ajñānavirodhinā jñānenaiva vyāptam tatrāsya apareṇāvyavadhānāt

sākalyasya tu jñānena vyavadhānānna tanmukhyam; prayogaḥ–yad yatra apareṇa vyavahitaṃ na tattatra mukhyarūpatayā sādhakatamavyapadeśamarhati yathā chidikriyāyāṃ kuṭhāreṇa vyavahito'yaskāraḥ, svaparapramitau vijñānena vyavahitaṃ ca paraparikalpitaṃ sākalyamiti

upacāreṇa tatprāmāṇyābhyupagame tu na kiñcidaniṣṭam, mukhyarūpatayā hi svaparapramitau sādhakatamasya jñānasya utpādakatvāttasyāpi sādhakatamatvam, tasmācca pramāṇatvam, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt annaṃ vai prāṇāḥ ityādivat
tasya tattvaṃ goṇaṃ mukhya vā syāt ? natāvadgauṇam nyāyavini॰ vi॰ pṛ॰ 29 pū॰
yad yatra apareṇa vyavahitamprameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 3 u॰
kiñca tamagrahaṇasya prakarṣo'rthaḥ, prakarṣaśca apakṛṣṭasavyapekṣaḥ, ato yāvanna pṛthak sādhakaṃ sādhakataraṃ vā'vasthitam, na tāvatsādhakatamatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyate tadapekṣatvāttasya
sāmagrī ca anekakārakasvabhāvā, anekakārakasamudāye ca na kasyacit svarūpātiśayaḥ śakyate vaktum, sarveṣāmabhipretakāryaṃ prati vyāpārā'viśeṣāt

kartṛ-karma-karaṇasannidhau hi samutpadyamānaṃ pratīyate kāryam, tadabhāve cānutpadyamānaṃ tatkathaṃ kasyacidatiśayo nirdeṣṭuṃ śakyate ? niḥśeṣavivakṣāyāṃ ca apekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt kathaṃ sādhakatamatvam ? sakalakārakakalāparūpā kila sāmagrī, tasyāḥ kimapekṣaṃ sādhakatamatvam ? apekṣaṇīyasadbhāve vā na tadrūpatā asyāḥ syāt
nanu sādhakādyapekṣayā sādhakatamaṃ bhavati atiśayanasya evaṃ rūpatvāt tadarthatvāñca tamapratyayasya

kiñca idaṃ sādhakatamatvaṃ vivakṣātaḥ kasyacitsyāt, sannipatya kāryajananāt, sahasā kāryotpādanādvā ? tatra yadyapi anekakārakajanyaṃ kāryam tathāpi vivakṣātaḥ kārakāṇāṃ pravṛttiḥ, iti kasyacideva sādhakatamatvaṃ vivakṣyate iti cet; nanu vivakṣā puruṣecchā, nacāsati vailakṣaṇye tannibandhanā vastuvyavasthā yuktā atiprasaṅgāt
atha sannipatyakāryajananam, tadapi jñāne karttavye sarveṣāmindriyamano'rthādānāṃ tulyam, kasyacidapi asannipatyajanakatvābhāvāt, itaretarasaṃsarge satyevāsyotpatteḥ
jñāne ca janye kimasannipatyajanakam ? sarveṣāmindriyamano'rthādīnām itaretarasaṃsarge sati jñānaniṣpatteḥ
nāpi sahasaiva kāryotpādakatvaṃ sādhakatamatvam, karmaṇyapi asya gatatvāt
sīmantinīsamudāye hi adbhutarūpā sīmantinī jhaṭityātmaviṣayaṃ vijñānamutpādayati
atha sahasaiva kāryajananamatiśayaḥ; so'pi kasyāñcidavasthāyāṃ karaṇasyeva karmaṇo'pi śakyate vaktum
eva- mitarakārakakadamvasannidhāne satyapi sīmantinīmantareṇa taddarśana na sampadyate, āgatamātrāyāmeva tasyā bhavati iti tadapi karmakārakam atiśayayogitvāt karaṇa syāt
yadapyuktam–na hyekadeśasya dīpādeḥ karaṇatā ityādi; tadapyanupapannam; pratītibādhitatvāt
na hi kaścillaukikaḥ parīkṣako vā sāmagryāḥ karaṇatvaṃ pratipadyate, sāmagryā paśyāmaḥ iti tasyāḥ karaṇavibhaktyā nirdeśaprasaṅgāt
na caivaṃ kaścidapi nirdiśati dīpena paśyāmaḥ, cakṣuṣā nirīkṣāmahe iti tadekadeśānāmeva tannirdeśapratīteḥ
kiñca, karaṇamiti yo'yaṃ vyapadeśaḥ sa kartṛkarmāpekṣaḥ, kartrā kārye vyāpāryamāṇasya kārakaviśeṣasya karaṇatvapratīteḥ kuṭhārādivat
na ca loko'pi sāmagryā karaṇabhāvamanumanyate tasyā karaṇavibhaktimaprayuñjāna
nahi eva vaktāro bhavanti laukikā sāmagryā paśyāma iti, kintu dīpena paśyāma cakṣuṣā nirīkṣāmahe ityācakṣate
laukikānā tu kathamasau bhaviṣyati, na hi te sāmagryā nāmāpi jānate syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 6
sāmagryāśca karaṇatve kartṛkarmaṇī tadantargate, tato'rthāntarabhūte vā syātām ? prathamapakṣe sāmagrīsvarūpādabhinnatvāt tatsvarūpavat tayoḥ karaṇataivopapannā
naca karaṇarūpatāyāmapi anayoḥ kartṛkarmarūpatā yuktā parasparavirodhāt

kartṛtā hi jñānacirkīṣāprayatnādhārateṣyate, nirvarttyatvādidharmayogitvaṃ karmatvam, karaṇatvaṃ tu sādhakatamatvam ityeṣāṃ kathamekatra saṃbhavaḥ ? viṣayābhāve ca nirālambanāḥ sarvā saṃvidaḥ prasajyante, cakṣurādivat ālambanakārakasya pramāṇāntaḥpātitvāt
kaścedānī sāmagryā prameyaṃ pramimīte ? pramāturapi asyāmevāntarlīnatvāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayukta; sakalakārakavyatirekeṇārthāntarabhūtayo kartṛkarmaṇorabhāvāt, bhāve vā na kārakasākalyam
kāryotpattau hi yāvatāmupayogaḥ te sakalaśabdavācyāḥ, karttṛkarmaṇośca vyatireke kathaṃ pariśiṣṭānāṃ sakalatvam ?
na caiteṣā kartṛkarmarūpāṇāmapi karaṇatvaṃ parasparavirodhāt–prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 3 u॰
nirālambanāśca idānī sarvapramitayo bhaveyu ālambanakārakasya cakṣurādivat pramāṇānta pātitvāt
kaśca sāmagryā prameya pramimīte ? pramātā'pi tasyāmeva līnaḥ
yaccānyaduktam–sākalyāntargatakārakāpekṣayaivāsya karaṇatvopapatteḥ ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; yataḥ pṛthagavasthāpekṣāṇi kārakāṇi karmādibhāvaṃ bhajante, samudāyāvasthāpekṣāṇi tu karaṇabhāvaṃ
tathā ca yadā karmāditā na tadā karaṇatā, yadā tu sā, na tadā karmāditā iti naikamapi rūpaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta anyonyāpekṣatvāt, karmādirūpaṃ hi karaṇasvarūpāpekṣa tacca karmādyapekṣamiti

kiñca sāmagrījanane vyāpṛtāḥ karmādayaḥ, te'syāṃ kāraṇatvena pratīyante sā ca pramitilakṣaṇe phale karaṇatvena, ataśca phalaṃ prati sā ekaiva vyāpriyamāṇā kathaṃ viṣayāntare vyāpṛtakartṛkarmabhyāmatiśayaṃ pratipadyeta ? api ca, sāmagrījanane vyāpriyamāṇa ātmā yadā sāmagrīkaraṇatāṃ pratipadyate tadā phalaviṣaye kasya kartṛtvam ātmanaḥ sāmagrījanane vyāpārāt ? na ca ātmā ātmānaṃ sāmagryā madhye prakṣipya sāmagrī janayan paścāttāmeva karaṇatvena vyāpārayan kartṛtāmanubhavati ekasvarūpasyaivaṃvidhānekavyāpāravirodhāt, nityaikarūpe vastuni kāryakāritvānupapatteśca
atha ca tāni pṛthagavasthitāni karmādibhāvaṃ bhajante, atha ca tānyeva samuditāni karaṇībhavanti iti ko'yaṃ naya ? nyāyasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 14
evaṃ ca sākalyalakṣaṇadharmasya janane vyāpṛtāḥ kartrādaya tasmin kartṛtvena pratīyante, sa ca pramitilakṣaṇe phale karaṇatvenasyā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 68
kiñca, samagrā eva sāmagrī, samagrāṇāṃ dharmo vā ? tatrādyapakṣe sarveṣāṃ phalaṃ prati anvayavyatirekānuvidhānāt kasya karaṇatā iti na vidmaḥ

karaṇaṃ hi sādhakatamam, tamārthaśca prakarṣaḥ kāryaṃ prati avyavadhānena vyāpāraḥ, sa cet sarveṣāṃ tulyastadā kathaṃ kasyacideva karaṇatvaṃ siddhyet ? atha teṣāṃ dharmaḥ; sa ki nityaḥ, anityo vā syāt ? na tāvannityaḥ, kādācitkatvāt sukhādivat
athānityaḥ; kuto jāyeta tata eva, anyato vā ? na tāvadanyataḥ; anabhyupagamāt
tata evacet; tarhi ayamarthaḥ sampannaḥ-samagrāstāvat sāmagrīlakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ janayanti, sā ca phalam, tadā tasyā ekatvāt kimapekṣya sādhakatamatvaṃ syāt ?
yataḥ teṣāṃ sa dharma ki nitya, athā'nitya ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 68

kiñca, samagrāṇāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmagrī, bhāvaśabdena ca teṣāṃ sattā, svarūpamātram, samudāyaḥ, sambandhaḥ, jñānajanakatvaṃ vā'bhidhīyeta prakārāntarāsaṃbhavāt ? tatrādyavikalpadvaye atiprasaṅgaḥ; vyastāvasthāyāmapi tatsattāyāḥ svarūpamātrasya ca sadbhāvataḥ prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
samudāyo'pi ekābhiprāyatālakṣaṇaḥ, ekadeśe milanasvabhāvo vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; viṣayendriyādeḥ nirabhiprāyatvāt
sambandhapakṣo'pi anenaiva pratyākhyātaḥ; candrādeścakṣurādinā sambandhā'bhāvāt tasyāprāpyakāritvāt, tadaprāpyakāritvañcāgre prasādhayiṣyāmaḥ
atha jñānajanakatvaṃ bhāvaśabdenābhidhīyate; tarhi pramātṛprameyayorapi pramāṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ tajjanakatvā'viśeṣāt, tathāca pratītisiddhatadvyavasthāvilopaḥ syāt
na ca tajjanakatvā'viśeṣe'pi svecchāvaśāt kvacideva pramātrādivyavasthā yuktā; sarvasya sveṣṭatattvasiddhiprasaṅgāt icchāyāḥ sarvatra niraṅkuśatvāt
tacca iha sattā, svarūpamātram, samudāya, sambandha, jñānajanakatvaṃ vā vyākriyeta pakṣāntarā'bhāvāt syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 69
kiñca, ātmādayo bhāvāḥ nityaikarūpāstajjananasvabhāvā santaḥ tajjanayanti, atajjananasvabhāvā vā ? na tāvadatajjananasvabhāvāḥ; sarvasmāt sarvasyotpattiprasaṅgāt
atha tajjananasvabhāvā; kinna sarvadā te tajjanayanti nityānāṃ sarvadā tajjananasvabhāvānāṃ teṣāṃ sadā sattvāt ? ekapramāṇotpattisamaye sakalatadutpādyapramāṇotpattiprasaṅgaśca
yadā hi yajjanakamasti tat tadotpattimat prasiddham yathā tatkālābhimataṃ pramāṇam, asti ca pūrvottarakālabhāvināṃ nikhilapramāṇānāṃ tadā nityābhimatamātmādikāraṇamiti
tatsadbhāve'pyeṣāmanutpattau na kadācidapyatastadutpattiḥ ityakhilaṃ jagat pramāṇavikalamāpadyeta

tatkaraṇasamarthe satyapyātmādikāraṇe' bhavatāṃ svayameva paścādbhavatāṃ tatkāryatā ca kathameṣāmupapadyate ? yad yasmin samarthe satyapi notpadyate svayameva paścādyathākālamutpadyate na tat tatkāryam yathā satyapi kumbhakāre'nutpadyamāna paṭaḥ, notpadyate ca ātmādau tatkaraṇasamarthe satyapyakhilapramāṇānīti

yatra yadā yathā yat pramāṇamutpitsuḥ tatra tadā tathā ātmādestatkaraṇasamarthatvānnaikadā sakalapramāṇotpatti; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; svabhāvabhūtasāmarthyabhedamantareṇa kāryasya kālādibhedānupapatteḥ
yasya svabhāvabhūtasāmarthyabhedo nāsti nāsau kālādibhinnakāryakārī yathā niraṃśaḥ saugataparikalpitaḥ kṣaṇa, nāsti ca svabhāvabhūtasāmarthyabhedo nityaikasvabhāvābhimatasyātmāderiti
svabhāvabhūtasāmarthyābhede'pi kāryabhedābhyupagame ca pārthivaparamāṇvādikāraṇabhedaparikalpanaṃ vyartham, ekameva nityaikasvabhāva paramabrahmādikāraṇaṃ pṛthivyādyanekāryakāri parikalpyatām
nityānā tajjananasvabhāvatve sarvadā tadutpattiprasakti, prameyaka pṛ॰ 3 u॰
yadā yatra yathā yadbhavatiyathā ca kāraṇajātibhedamantareṇa kāryabhedo nopapadyate tathā tacchaktibhedamantareṇāpi

kiñca, sakalebhyaḥ sākalyaṃ bhinnam, abhinnaṃ vā syāt ? bhinnañcet; kimiti pṛthak ghaṭādivannopalabhyate ? kiñca, bhinnaṃ sat tattatra sambaddham, asambaddhaṃ vā ? asambaddha cet; kathaṃ taddharma ? yad yatra na sambaddhyate na tat taddharmaḥ yathā sahye'sambaddho vindhyo na taddharmaḥ, kārakeṣvasambaddhañca tatsākalyamiti
sambaddhañcet ki samavāyena, sayogena, viśeṣaṇabhāvena vā ? na tāvatsamavāyena; asyā'siddhe, tadasiddhiśca paṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ nirākariṣyamāṇatvātsiddhā
nāpi saṃyogena, asya guṇatvena dravyeṣveva saṃbhavāt, sākalyasya cā'dravyatvāt

astu vā kenacittattatraiva sambaddham; tathāpi yugapat sakalakārakeṣu sambaddhyate, krameṇa vā ? yugapaccet; kimekaṃ sat, anekaṃ vā ? yadyekam; sāmānyādirūpatāprasaṅgaḥ, tadrūpatā ca sāmānyādidoṣeṇa duṣṭatvānna śreyasī
athānekam; tarhi yāvanti kārakāṇi tāvaddhā tad bhidyeta
atha krameṇa; tarhi sakalakārakadharmatā sākalyasya na syāt; yadaiva hi tasyaikena sambandho, na tadaivānyeneti

athābhinnaṃ tat tebhyaḥ; tarhi tānyeva na sākalyam, tadā karaṇarūpataiva vā'śeṣakārakāṇāṃsyāt, sāpi vā na syāt karttṛkarmāpekṣatvāttasyāḥ, tayoścetthamasaṃbhavāt, tathā ca kasya pramāṇatā syāt ? tataḥ kārakasākalyasya svarūpeṇa vicāryamāṇasyānupapatterna prāmāṇyam
yat svarūpeṇa vicāryamāṇaṃ nopapadyate na tat pramāṇam yathā gaganendīvaram, svarūpeṇa vicāryamāṇaṃ nopapadyate ca paraparikalpitaṃ kārakasākalyamiti
upapadyatāṃ vā tat; tathāpi na mukhyataḥ pramāṇam, ajñānarūpasyāsya upacārādanyatra prāmāṇyānupapatteḥ
na ca liṅga-śabdādinā vyabhicāraḥ; tasyāpi upacārādeva prāmāṇyābhyupagamāt
nanu samagrebhya sāmagrī bhinnā cet kathannopalabhyate
astu vā kenacit sambandhena sambaddhaṃ tat teṣu, tathāpi yugapat sakaleṣu sambaddhyate krameṇa vā ? syā॰ ratnākara॰ pṛ॰ 71
abhede tu sarvakārakāṇi karaṇībhūtānyeva iti karttṛkarmavyavahārocchedaprasaṅgaḥ

kiñca, nirvikalpakapramityapekṣayā sannikarṣasya kārakasākalyasya vā pramājanakatvena prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, savikalpakapramityapekṣayā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; saṃśayādihetunirviṃkalpakadarśanajanakasyāpi sannikarṣādeḥ prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
na ca tatrāsya tajjanakatvaṃ nāstītyabhidhātavyam; saṃśayādeḥ pratyakṣābhāsatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt

yasya yadutpattau apareṇa vyavadhānaṃ na tasya tadutpattau sādhakatamatvam yathā chidikriyotpattau kuṭhāreṇa vyavahitasyāyaskārasya, vyavadhānañca nirvikalpakena savikalpakapramotpattau sannikarṣāderiti
nanu yadyapi sannikarṣasya kārakasākalyasya vā'jñānarūpasya prāmāṇyaṃ nopapadyate; tathāpi na jñānameva pramāṇaṃ siddhyati, indriyavṛtteḥ arthapramitau sādhakatamatvena prāmāṇyopapatte
ato viṣayasamparkāt prathamamindriyāṇāṃ tādrūpyāpattiḥ indriyavṛttiḥ, tadanu viṣayākārapariṇatendriyavṛttyālambanā manovṛttiḥ
atha kasmānmanovṛttiḥ akṣavṛttyālambanā na śabdādyālambanā ? iti cet; abahirvṛttitvāt, anyathā bāhyendriyakalpanānarthakyaṃ syāt

buddhirahaṅkāro mana cakṣu ityetāni catvāri yugapada rūpaṃ paśyanti aya sthāṇu ayaṃ puruṣa iti evameṣā yugapaccatuṣṭayasya vṛtti kramaśaśca–eva buddhyahaṅkāramanaścakṣuṣā kramaśo vṛttirdṛṣṭā cakṣūrūpaṃ paśyati, mana saṅkalpayati, ahaṅkāro'bhimānayati buddhiradhyavasyati
indriyapraṇālikayā cittasya bāhyavastūparāgāt tadviṣayā sāmānyaviśeṣātmano'rthasya viśeṣāvadhāraṇapradhānā vṛtti pratyakṣam
caitanyameva buddhidarṣaṇaprativimbitaṃ buddhivṛttyā arthākārayā tadākāratāmāpadyamānaṃ phalam
atreyaṃ prakriyā–indriyapraṇālikayā arthasannikarpeṇa liṅgajñānādinā vā ādau buddhe arthākārā vṛtti jāyate
pramātā cetana śuddha pramāṇaṃ vṛttireva ca
buddhi kila traiguṇyavikāra, traiguṇyañca acetanam, ityacetanaṃ kevalam indriyapraṇālikayā arthākāreṇa pariṇamatetena yo'sau nīlākāra pariṇāmo buddhe sa jñānalakṣaṇā vṛtti ityucyate
kā ceyamindriyavṛttiḥ–viṣayaṃ prati teṣāṃ gamanam, ābhimukhyaṃ vā syāt, ākāradhāritvaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; viṣayaṃ pratīndriyāṇāṃ gamanasya indriyāprāpyakāritvaprakrame nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayukta, viṣayaṃ pratyābhimukhyasya praguṇatāparaparyāyasya arthaparicchitau sādhakatamajñānahetutvād upacārata eva sādhakatamatvopapatteḥ
na khalu darpaṇādivat tadākāradhāritvena śrotrādīndriyaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate tadvattatra vipratipattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
na hi pratyakṣapratipanne'rthe kaścidabāliśo viprati padyate
na ca pratiniyatārthapratipattireva liṅgamityabhidhātavyam; tasyāḥ sārūpyamantareṇāpyupapatteḥ
na hi sphaṭikamukurādikamiva tadākāradhāritvena śravaṇādikamindriyaṃ pratyakṣata pratīyate–syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 72
astu vā kācit tadvṛttiḥ; tathāpyasau tebhyo bhinnā, abhinnā vā syāt ? yadyabhinnā; śrotrādimātrameva sā, tacca supuptādāvapyastīti supta-prabuddhayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgāt tadvyavahārābhāvaḥ syāt

atha bhinnā; kimasau tatra sambaddhā, asambaddhā vā ? yadyasambaddhā; kathaṃ śrotrāderiyaṃ vṛttiriti vyapadiśyeta ? yad yatrā'sambaddhaṃ na tat tasyeti vyapadiśyate yathā sahye vindhyaḥ, asambaddhā ca śrotrādinā vṛttiriti
atha sambaddhā; ki samavāyena, saṃyogena, viśeṣaṇabhāvena vā ? na tāvat samavāyena; asyā'siddhasvarūpatvāt, tadasiddhasvarūpatā cāgre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt prasiddhā
tatsvarūpasiddhau vā nityavyāpino'sya śrotrādeśca tathāvidhasya sadbhāve pratiniyatadeśā vṛttirabhivyajyate iti durghaṭam
nāpi saṃyogena; tadvṛtterdravyāntaratvānupaṅgāt, na hi dravyā'dravyayoḥ saṃyogo yuktaḥ; asya guṇatvena dravyāśrayatvāt

tasmād indriyavṛttervicāryamāṇāyā sattvā'saṃbhavāt katham viṣayākārapariṇatendriyavṛttyālambanā manovṛttiḥ iti sughaṭaṃ syāt ? indriyavṛtterviṣayākārapariṇatatvānupapattau manovṛttestadālambanatvānupapatteḥ
na caivaṃ bāhyendriyakalpanānarthakyānuṣaṅgaḥ; manasaḥ tatsāpekṣasyaiva arthapravṛttipratīteḥ, vijñānotpattau teṣāmanyonyaṃ sahakāribhāvāt
na khalu bāhyendriyanirapekṣā manaso vijñānotpattau pravṛttiḥ; adṛṣṭapūrve'pyarthe tatastadutpattiprasaṅgāt
nāpi mano'napekṣā bāhyendriyāṇām; anyatra gatacittasyāpyato vijñānotpattiprasaṅgāditi
prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 6 pū॰, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 73
tasmādittham indriyavṛttervicāryamāṇāyā sattvā'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ viṣayākārapariṇanendriyavṛttyālambanā manovṛtti iti sughaṭaṃ syāt
jñānaṃ hi nāma kriyātmakam, kriyā ca phalānumeyā, jñātṛvyāpāramantareṇa phalā'niṣpatte
kārakasya kārakatvamapi kriyāveśavaśādeva upapadyate, karotīti kārakam iti vyutpatte, itarathā hi tad vastumātraṃ syānna kārakam, kriyāviṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ kārakam ityabhidhānāt
na ca tanmātraṃ phalārthibhirupādīyate, abhipretaprayojanaprasādhakasyaiva tairupādānāt

tato yathā kārakāṇi tandula-salilā-'nala-sthālyādīni siddhasvabhāvāni asiddhasvabhāvapākalakṣaṇadhātvarthaṃ sādhayituṃ saṃsṛjyante, saṃsṛṣṭāni ca kriyāmutpādayanti, tathā ātmendriyamano'rthasamprayoge sati jñāturvyāpāro'rthaprākaṭyaheturupajāyate ato'sau pramāṇam, arthaprākaṭyalakṣaṇe phale sādhakatamatvāt, yatpunaḥ pramāṇaṃ na bhavati na tat tatra sādhakatamam yathā sannikarpādi, sādhakatamaśca tallakṣaṇe phale jñātṛvyāpāra iti
kriyāveśavaśācca kāraka kārakaṃ bhavati, aparathā hi tad vastusvarūpamātrameva syāt na kārakam
tasmād yathāhi kārakāṇi taṇḍulasalilā'nalasthālyādīni siddhasvabhāvāni sādhyaṃ vātvarthamekaṃ pākalakṣaṇamurarīkṛtya saṃsṛjyante, samṛṣṭāni
ca kriyāmutpādayanti, tathā ātmendriyamano'rthasannikarṣe sati jñānākhyo vyāpāra upajāyate
tadeva ca pramārūpa tadvatī karaṇañca dhī
janmaiva asya kriyā tadeva ca arthaprakāśanaphalaviśeṣāt pramā tadyogād dhīḥ karaṇam
athavā jñānakriyādvārako ya karttṛbhūtasya ātmana karmabhūtasya ca arthasya paraspara sambandho vyāptṛvyāpyatvalakṣaṇa sa mānasapratyakṣāvagato vijñānaṃ kalpayati

yattāvaduktam–jñātṛvyāpārasya prāmāṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati ityādi; tadasamī cīnam; yato'sya prasiddhasattākasya prāmāṇyaṃ prārthyeta, aprasiddhasattākasya vā ? na tāvadaprasiddhasattākasya; atiprasaṅgāt, anumānavirodhānuṣaṅgācca
tathāhi–yadaprasiddhasattākaṃ na tat pramāṇam yathā gaganendīvaram, aprasiddhasattākaśca prabhākaramatānusāribhirabhipreto jñātṛvyāpāra iti

atha prasiddhasattākasyāsya prāmāṇyaṃ prārthyeta, nanu kuto'sya prasiddhā sattā–svaprakriyopavarṇanamātrāt, pramāṇato vā ? prathamapakṣe sannikarṣāderapi tathā prasiddhasattākasya prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt kuto'pratipakṣā bhavatpakṣasiddhi syāt ? pramāṇato'pi–pratyakṣāt, anumānādervā tatsiddhiḥ syāt ? yadi pratyakṣāt; tatkim indriyārthasaṃyogajāt, ātmamanaḥsannikarṣaprabhavāt, svasaṃvedanādvā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ svasambaddhe grahaṇayogye cārthe jñānajanakatvābhyupagamāt
na ca jñātṛvyāpāreṇa saha teṣāṃ sambandhaḥ saṃbhavati; pratiniyatai rūpādibhirevaiṣāṃ sambandhasaṃbhavāt, atyantaparokṣatayā tasya grahaṇāyogyatvācca

astu vā tasya taiḥ sambandhaḥ, grahaṇayogyatā ca; tathāpyasau cakṣurādisahāyaḥ svaviṣayavijñānamutpādayan aparajñātṛvyāpārasahakṛta utpādayati, asahakṛto vā ? prathamapakṣe, anavasthā-tadvyāpārasyāpi aparatadvyāpārasāpekṣasya svaviṣayavijñānotpādakatvaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi–jñātṛvyāpāraḥ svaviṣayaṃ vijñānamaparajñātṛvyāpārasahakṛta evotpādayati, karmatayā svaviṣayavijñānotpādakatvāt, ghaṭādivat
tathābhūtasyāpyasya tadasahakṛtasya tajjanakatve ghaṭāderapi tannirapekṣasyaiva svaviṣayavijñānajanakatvaprasaṅgād alaṃ jñātṛvyāpāraparikalpanayā
na ca grahaṇā'yogye vastuni ātmamanaḥsannikarṣaprabhavaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pravarttitumutsahate, tadyogya eva sukhādāvasya pravṛttipratīteḥ
nāpi svasaṃvedanāttatsiddhiḥ; anabhyupagamāt, atyantaparokṣe tasmin svasaṃvedanavirodhācca
taddhi pratyakṣamanumānamanyadvā ? yadi pratyakṣa tatkiṃ svasaṃvedana vāhyendriyajaṃ mana prabhavaṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 6 pū॰
atha kārakanirvartyā kriyā, sā'pīdānī kāryatvāt savyāpārakārakakāryā bhaved ityanavasthā

sambandhapratipattiśca pratyakṣataḥ, anumānādvā syāt ? na tāvatpratyakṣataḥ; jñātṛvyāpārasya atyantaparokṣatayābhyupagame arthaprākaṭyalakṣaṇahetoḥ tatsambaddhatvena pratyakṣataḥ pratipatteranupapatteḥ, ubhayasvarūpagrahaṇe hi idamanena sambaddham iti sambandhapratītiryuktā agnidhūmavat
nāpyanumānāt; anavasthāprasaṅgāt–tadapi hyanumānaṃ niścitapratibandhāddhetorutpadyate tatpratibandhaniścayaśca anumānāntarāditi
etena arthāpattito'pi jñātṛvyāpārasiddhiḥ pratyuktā; tadutthāpakasyāpyarthasya sādhyasambandhasiddhāveva gamakatvopapatteḥ, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt, tatsiddhau coktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ
kiñca, asau jñātṛvyāpāraḥ kārakajanyaḥ, tadajanyo vā ? na tāvattadajanyaḥ; tathāhi– jñātṛvyāpāro na kārakā'janyaḥ, vyāpāratvāt, pācakādivyāpāravat
kiñca, asau tadajanyaḥ san bhāvarūpaḥ, abhāvarūpo vā syāt ? abhāvarūpatve arthaprakāśanalakṣaṇaphalajanakatvavirodhaḥ
avirodhe vā phalārthinaḥ kārakānveṣaṇamaphalameva syāt, viśvamadaridrañca syāt kāraṇā'bhāvādevā'khilaprāṇināmabhimataphalasiddheḥ
atha bhāvarūpaḥ; tatrāpi kimasau nityaḥ, anityo vā ? nityatve sarvasya sarvapadārthapratipattiprasaṅgāt pradīpādikārakānveṣaṇavaiyarthyam, andha-suptādivyabahārocchedānuṣaṅgaśca syāt
yo bhāvasvabhāvo'janyārtho nā'sau anityaḥ yathā''kāśādiḥ, tathābhūtaścāyaṃ jñātṛvyāpāra iti
astu vā anityaḥ; tathāpyasau–kālāntarasthāyī, kṣaṇiko vā ? prathamapakṣe kṣaṇikā hi sā na kālāntaramavatiṣṭhate iti vaco viruddhyate
dvitīyapakṣe tu kṣaṇādūrdhvam arthapratibhāsābhāvaprasaṅgād andhamūkaṃ jagatsyāt
pratikṣaṇamaparāparavyāpāropagame tu tadavasthaḥ suptādyabhāvadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ, kārakā'janyasyāsya deśakālasvabhāvapratiniyamā'yogāt
sa ca sambandhaḥ kimanvayaniścayadvāreṇa pratīyate, vyatirekaniścayadvāreṇa vā ? prathamapakṣe kiṃ pratyakṣeṇa, anumānena vā tannikṣayaḥ ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 6 u॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 28
kiñcāsau jñātṛvyāpāraḥ kārakairjanyo'janyo vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 7 pū॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 25
yadyajanyaḥ tadā'sau abhāvarūpaḥ bhāvarūpo vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 7 pū॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 25
tatra yadi nityā; tarhi sarvadā vastunaḥ kriyāyogāt phalaniṣpattiprasaṅgaḥ
śābarabhāṣye tu pṛ॰ 32 kṣaṇikā hi sā na buddhyantarakālamavasthāsyate iti
–prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 7 pū॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 25, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 122–ityeteṣu na cirakālamavatiṣṭhate iti pāṭhaḥ

atha kārakajanyo'sau, astvetat; tathāpi kriyārūpaḥ, akriyārūpo vā syāt ? yadi kriyārūpaḥ; tadāsau kriyā parispandasvabhāvā, aparispandasvabhāvā vā syāt ? tatrādyavikalpo'peśalaḥ; vyāpakatvenā''tmanaḥ tathābhūtakriyāśrayatvānupapatteḥ
yad vyāpakaṃ na tat parispandasvabhāvakriyāśrayaḥ yathā ākāśādiḥ, vyāpakaśca bhavanmate ātmeti
yadi vā, parispandasvabhāvā kriyā vyāpakadravyavṛttirna bhavati yathā dhvajādikriyā, parispandasvabhāvā ca jñātṛvyāpāralakṣaṇā kriyeti
tathā ca tadvyāpārasya jñāturanyatrāśritatvaprasaṅgāt kathaṃ jñātṛvyāpārarūpatā pramāṇatā vā syāt ? dhvajādyāśritasyotkṣepaṇādivyāpārasyāpi tatprasakteḥ

dvitīyavikalpe'pi aparispandaḥ–parispandābhāvaḥ, vastvantaraṃ vā ? yadi parispandābhāvaḥ; tadā'sya phala janakatvānupapattiḥ abhāvasya kāryakāritvavirodhāt, yathā cā'sya tatkāritvaṃ viruddhyate tathā abhāvaparīkṣāprastāve saprapañcaṃ prapañcayiṣyate
vastvantaramapi kiṃ cidrūpam, acidrūpaṃ vā ? cidrūpamapi–kiṃ dharmī, dharmo vā ? yadi dharmī; tadāsau pramāṇaṃ na syād ātmavat
dharmo'pi kimātmano bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā ? yadyabhinnaḥ; tadā ātmaiva iti pramāṇatānupapattiḥ
tatkāryatvāt tasyaiti vyapadeśe, tasya tatkāritvaṃ kiṃ vyāpārāntareṇa, anyathā vā ? yadi vyāpārāntareṇa; anavasthā
atha anyathā; tanna; nirvyāpārasya kāryakāritvābhyupagame vyāpārakalpanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt
acidrūṣamapi vastvantaram–dharmī, dharmo vā syāt ? yadi dharmī; loṣṭhavanna pramāṇaṃ syāt
atha dharmaḥ; kasya ? ātmanaḥ, anyasya vā ? yadyanyasya; na pramāṇam atiprasaṅgāt
akriyārūpo'pyasau ki bodharūpaḥ, abodharūpo vā ? bodharūpatve atyantaparokṣatvavirodhaḥ, tathābhūtasya bodharūpatānupapatteḥ, tadanupapattiśca svasaṃvedanasiddhau prasādhayiṣyate
abodharūpatve tu pramāṇatvānupapattiḥ ghaṭādivat, cidrūpasyātmano acidrūpavyāpāravirodhācca
tato jñātṛvyāpārasya uktanyāyena vicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ kathaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ?
kriyā sā vyāpaka– ā॰, ja॰, bhāṃ॰
prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 7 u॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 25

yadapyuktam–kārakasya kārakatvamapi kriyāveśavaśādeva ityādi; tatsatyameva; na hi parispandātmakaṃ paridṛśyamānaṃ kārakavyāpāramapahnumahe pratikārakaṃ vicitrasya jvālādivyāpārasya pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ, atīndriyasyaiva vyāpārasya bhavatkalpitasyā'pahnavāt, tasyoktaprakāreṇa kutaścidapi pramāṇādapratīteḥ
na ca nityaikarūpasyā'pariṇāmino jñāturanyasya vā vyāpārādikāryakāritvaṃ ghaṭate
etacca arthakriyā na yujyeta nityakṣaṇikapakṣayoḥ ityatra prapañcataḥ pratipādayiṣyate
tataḥ pramāṇaṃ jñātṛvyāpāro'rthaprākaṭyalakṣaṇe phale sādhakatamatvāt ityādi, vandhyāsutasaubhāgyavyāvarṇanaprakhyatāṃ pratipadyate, ityuparamyate

tadevam–ajñānātmanaḥ sannikarṣādervicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ, upapattau vā arthapramitau mukhyataḥ sādhakatamatvānupapattitaḥ prāmāṇyasyāpi mukhyato'nupapatteḥ, tatpramitau mukhyataḥ sādhakatamajñānalakṣaṇapramāṇotpādakatvād upacārādeva atrāsya prāmāṇyaṃ prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam
