na hi vayaṃ parispandātmaka paridṛśyamānaṃ vyāpāramapahnumahe, pratikārakaṃ vicitrasya jvalanādervyāpārasya pratyakṣamupalambhāt, atīndriyastu vyāpāro nāsti iti brūmahe
– deva tatrāsya ba॰, ja॰, –deva tatrāpyasya bhā॰
pratyakṣarūpaṃ jñānaṃ nirvikalpakam, anumānarūpaṃ tu savikalpakam
tatra pratyakṣalakṣaṇam–pratyakṣaṃ kalpanāpoḍhamabhrāntam nyāyabi॰ pṛ॰ 11 iti
na hi pratyakṣe'bhilāpasaṃsṛṣṭārthagrahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati, tadviṣaye saṅketa-vyavahārakālā'nanuyāyini śabdasanniveśā'sabhavāt
yaḥ saṅketavyavahārakālānanuyāyī na tatra vyavahāribhi śabdo niveśyate yathā utpannamātrapradhvaṃsini kvacidarthe, nānveti ca niyatadeśakālākāraṃ svalakṣaṇa deśāntarādāviti

ata kathaṃ tadviśiṣṭārthagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣeṇa yataḥ savikalpakaṃ tatsyāt ? yo yatra śabdo na niveśito na tadviśiṣṭasya tasya grahaṇaṃ yathā aniveśitā'śvaśabdasya godravyasya nā'śvaśabdaviśiṣṭasya grahaṇam, aniveśitaśca svalakṣaṇe kaścidapi śabda iti
kecittu svayūthyā eva abhrāntagrahaṇa necchanti, bhrāntasyāpi pītaśaṅkhādijñānasya pratyakṣatvāt; tathā hi–na tadanumānam aliṅgajatvāt, pramāṇañca avisaṃvāditvāt
yadṛcchāśabdepu nāmnā viśiṣṭo'rtha ucyate ḍittha iti
yogācāramatena ca tathāgatajñānamadvayaṃ muktvā sarva jñānaṃ grāhyagrāhakatvena vikalpitaṃ kalpanā
jātyādisasṛṣṭa tu manojñāna kalpanā ityanye kathayanti
na ca svalakṣaṇasya saṅketavyavahārāptakālavyāpakatvamasti, tasmānna tatra samaya tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 277

kiñca, atītādyartha svavācakasaṃsargeṇa vikalpayataḥ purovartini rūpādau yadotpadyate jñānaṃ tasya kathaṃ savikalpakatā vartamānārthanāmasaṃsargasya tadā'nupalabdheḥ ? arthe ca śabdānāmasaṃbhavāt tattādāmyābhāvācca kathamarthaprabhave jñāne'janakasya śabdasya ākārasaṃsargaḥ ? yad yasyā'janakaṃ na tat tarayākāramanuvidhatte yathā rasādutpannaṃ rasajñānaṃ nā'janakasya rūpādeḥ, nīlādyarthādevotpannañcendriyajñānamiti
tato yadeva jñānamarthasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vācakatvena śabdaṃ pratipadyate tadeva savikalpakam, nānyat
ata eva yogijñānamanekaśabdārthapratibhāsamapi yojanā'bhāvānna savikalpakam, viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭārthagrahaṇābhāvācca avikalpakaṃ pratyakṣam
na khalu viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatā pratyakṣeṇa grahītuṃ śakyā, tulyakālasyā'rthadvayasya tatra pratibhāsanāt
na ca svarūpamātreṇa pratīyamānayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt

prayogaḥ–yad yadarthasākṣātkaraṇapravṛttattaṃjñānaṃ tat tatsvarūpavyatirikta–viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyākāra-tatsaṃyojanāsvabhāva-kalpanākāraṃ na bhavati, yathā rūpādyākārapravṛttacakṣurādijñānam aviṣayīkṛtagandhādiviśeṣaṇayojanākāraṃ na bhavati, tathā ca sarvaṃ svaviṣayapravṛttaṃ jñānamiti
na hyarthe śabdā santi tadātmāno vā avyutpannasyāpi pratītiprasaṅgāt
tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 531, nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 133
na hyarthe śabdāḥ santi tadātmānī vā yena tasmin pratibhāsamāne te'pi pratibhāseranniti vacanāt

tatra sarvacittacaittānāmātmasaṃvedanaṃ svasaṃvedanam nyāyavi॰ pṛ॰ 19 indriyārthasamanantarapratyayaprabhavam indriyapratyakṣam svaviṣayānantaraviṣayasahakāriṇā indriyajñānena samanantarapratyayena janitaṃ manaḥpratyakṣam nyāyavi॰ pṛ॰ 18 bhūtārthabhāvanāprakarṣaparyantajaṃ yogipratyakṣam nyāyavi॰ pṛ॰ 20 iti

yattāvaduktam–kalpanāpoḍham ityādi, tatra keyaṃ kalpanā–abhilāpavatpratibhāsaḥ, niścayaḥ, jātyādyullekhaḥ, aspaṣṭākāratā, arthasannidhinirapekṣatā, anakṣaprabhavatā, dharmāntarāropo vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; pratibhāsasyā'bhilāpavattvānupapatteḥ
taddhi tatsvabhāvatvāt, taddhetutvādvā syāt ? na tāvattatsvabhāvatvāt; cetanā'cetanayoḥ viruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ tādātmyā'saṃbhavāt
yayorviruddhadharmādhyāsaḥ na tayostādātmyam yathā jalā'nalayoḥ, viruddhadharmādhyāsaśca cetanā'cetanarūpatayā śabda-jñānayoriti
nāpi taddhetutvāt; taddhi tajjanyatvam, tajjanakatvam, ubhayaṃ vā ? tajjanyatvena tadvattve, śrotrajñānasya avikalpakatvaṃ na syāt, tasyā'bhilāpaprabhavatayā tadvattvaprasaṅgāt
ataḥ abhilāpavatpratibhāsasya kalpanālakṣaṇatvā'nupapatteḥ yo yatra śabdo na niveśitaḥ ityādi pratyākhyātam
abhilāpavatī vitti tadyogyā vā'pi sā yataḥ

kā ceyaṃ katpanā nāma-jñānasya smaraṇānantarabhāvitvam, śabdākārānuviddhatvaṃ vā, jātyādyutlekho vā, asadarthaviṣayatvaṃ vā, anyāpekṣatayā arthasvarūpāvadhāraṇaṃ vā, upacāramātraṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 18 u॰
atha niścaya kalpanocyate, satyametat; tadrahitatvaṃ tu pratyakṣasyā'satyam; pramāṇasyā'niścayātmaktvānupapatteḥ; tathāhi–pratyakṣaṃ svārthavyavasāyātmakaṃ pramāṇatvād anumānavat
yatpunaḥ svayamaniścitasvarūpam arthā'niścayātmakañca na tatpramāṇam, yathā puruṣāntarajñānaṃ saṃśayādijñānañca
na khalu svārthā'vyavasāyātmakatvaṃ vihāya ātmāntarajñānasya saśayādeścā'prāmāṇye anyannibandhanamasti, tacca paraiḥ pratyakṣe pratijñāyamānam aprāmāṇyamanvākarṣati
niścayo hi saṃśayādivyavacchedena arthasvarūpāvadhāraṇam, tadrūpatā ca pramāṇasya pramāṇaśabdasya niruktyaivā'vasīyate

tathāhi–prakarṣeṇa saṃśayādivyavacchedalakṣaṇena mīyate paricchidyate yenā'rtha tat pramāṇam, na caitannirvikalpake saṃbhavatīti kathaṃ tatra pramāṇaśabdasyāpi pravṛttiḥ ? vyavahārā'nupayogitvācca na tat pramāṇam, yadvyavahārānupayogi na tat pramāṇam yathā gacchattṛṇasparśasaṃvedanam, tathā ca paraparikalpitaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ pratyakṣamiti
vyavahārañcāṅgīkṛtya bhavadbhi pramāṇacintā pratanyate, prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pramāṇavā॰ 2
na cā'vikalpakasya pravṛttyādivyavahāraprasādhakatvamasti, svārthā'niścāyakāt tato'nadhyavasāyādivad vyavahāriṇāṃ kvacitpravṛttyādyanupapatte

nanu nirvikalpakamapi pratyakṣaṃ vyatiriktavikalpotpādakatvataḥ pravartakatvāt pramāṇatāṃ pratipadyate, ityapi śraddhāmātram; tasyā'viditasvarūpasya sannikarṣādaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt, tasyāpi hi itthaṃ pravartakatvamupapadyate

paranirapekṣatayā svarūpopadarśakaṃ hi cetanamucyate, na cā'vikalpakādhyakṣaṃ svapne'pi tathā svarūpamupadarśayatīti kathaṃ taccetanaṃ yataḥ sannikarṣādviśeṣyeta ? ataḥ tadviśeṣa micchatā vyavasāyātmakaṃ tat pratipattavyam, nirvyāpārasya ananubhūyamānasvarūpasyāsya aparaprakāreṇa sannikarṣād bhedā'prasiddheḥ
akṛte tvanyavasāye nīlabodharūpatvenā'vyavasthāpita bhavati vijñānam, tathā ca pramāṇaphalam arthādhigamarūpatvamaniṣpannam, ata sādhakatamatvābhāvāt pramāṇameva na syājjñānam
adhigamo'pi vyavasāyātmaiva, tadanutpattau sato'pi darśanasya sādhanāntarāpekṣayā sannidhānā'bhedāt suṣuptacaitanyavat
nanu paśyāmi ityevaṃbhūto vikalpa evā'dhyakṣasya vyāpāraḥ, tatkathaṃ nirvyāpāratā ? ityapyasundaram; tadvyavasāyātmakatvaprasaṅgāt
na khalu vyāpāraḥ tadvato bhinno bhavadbhiraṅgīkriyate; tatsvabhāvatvāttasya
atha tatkāryatvāt tato bhinno'sau; kathaṃ tarhi tadvyāpāraḥ ? na hi putraḥ piturvyāpāro bhavati

astu vā; tathāpi–yadi avikalpakādhyakṣe vyavasāyasvabhāvatā na syāt tadā tatprabhavavikalpe'pi kuto'sau syāt ? sa hi bodharūpatayā, vilakṣaṇasāmagrīprabhavatayā vā vyavasāyasvabhāvatāṃ svīkuryāt ? yadi bodharūpatayā; tadā'sau pratyakṣe'pyasti, iti tadapi vyavasāyasvabhāvatāṃ svīkuryāt
tadaviśeṣe'pi yasya sākṣādarthe grahaṇavyāpāraḥ tanna niścinoti, yasya tu tadvyāpāropajīvitvam asau niścinoti iti aseḥ kośasya tīkṣṇatā
vilakṣaṇasāmagrīprabhavatā ca anayoḥ bhede siddhe siddhyet, na ca vikalpavyatirekeṇa avikalpakasvarūpaṃ svapne'pi prasiddham

ekameva hīdaṃ svārthavyavasāyātmakamindriyādisāmagrītaḥ samutpannaṃ vijñānamanubhūyate, na tatra svarūpabhedaḥ sāmagrībhedo vā kaścit kadācit kasyacit pratibhāti anyatra mahāmohākrāntāntaḥkaraṇāt saugatāt
kathañcaivaṃ buddhicaitanyayorbhedaṃ prativarṇayan sāṅkhyaḥ pratikṣipyeta ? vikalpā'vikalpayoriva anayorapratipannasvarūpayorapi abhyupagamamātrād bhedasiddhiprasaṅgāt
kathañcaivaṃ kāpilānāṃ buddhicaitanyayorbhedo'nupalabhyamāno'pi na syāt ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 8 pū॰
kiñca, ubhayorbhedena svarūpasaṃvitau anyasya anyatrā'dhyāropād ekatvādhyavasāyo yuktaḥ agnimāṇavakavat, na ca vikalpā'vikalpayoḥ kvacit kadācit kasyacit saṃvittirasti ityuktam
ekatvādhyavasāyaśca anayoḥ anyatarasmāt, anyato vā syāt ? anyatarasmāccet; kiṃ vikalpāt, nirvikalpakādvā ? na tāvannirvikalpakāt; tasya parāmarśaśūnyatayā ekatvādhyavasāyā'samarthatvāt
yad yadviṣayaṃ na bhavati na tat tasya kenacidekatvamadhyavasyati, yathā ghaṭaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ paramāṇvaviṣayatvānna tasya ghaṭādinā ekatvamadhyavasyati, nirvikalpakā'viṣayañcedaṃ vikalpajñānamiti
tadviṣayatve vā svalakṣaṇa viṣayatvaṃ vikalpānāmapi syāt
anyato'pi pūrvajñānāt, uttarajñānāt, anvitarūpātpratipatturvā tadekatvādhyavasāya syāt ? na tāvatpūrvajñānāt, tasya tatkāle pradhvastatvāt
tathaiva taddvayasyāpi nirvikalpakasya savikalpakasya vā satorna tadekatvādhyavasāyahetutvaṃ yuktam; ubhayatrobhayadopānupaṅgāt
tataḥ pratītito vastuvyavasthāmabhyupagacchatā ekamevānubhavasiddhasvārthavyavasāyātmakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratipattavyam, svaparaparicchitteḥ sakalavyavahāriṇāñca tanmukhaprekṣitvāt
tasyaiva avikalpakam iti nāmāntarakaraṇe na kiñcidaniṣṭam, saṃjñābhedasya arthabhedā'prasādhakatvāt
jātyādyullekhaḥ kalpanā ityapyaviruddham; jātyādīnāṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhūtānāṃ paramārthasatāṃ vyāmohavicchedenāvasāyasya kalpanātvopapatteḥ
tadekatvaṃ hi darśanamadhyavasyati, tatpṛṣṭhajo vyavasāyo vā, jñānāntaraṃ vā ? pramāṇaparī॰ pṛ॰ 53
ko'yaṃ tadadhyāropo nāma ? dṛśyaprāpyayorekatvagrahaṇam iti cet; na tarhi idaṃ pratyakṣata saṃbhavati; tasya svalakṣaṇaparyavasitavastuviṣayatvena abhyanujñānāt

yadapyuktam-yad yadarthasākṣātkārapravṛttaṃ jñānam ityādi, tatra ko'yaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyādyākāro nāma yo'rthasākṣātkaraṇapravṛtte jñāne pratipiddhyet–pratibimbam, ullekho vā ? pratibimbañcet; siddhasādhyatā, jñāne tatpratipedhasya asmābhirapyabhyupagamāt, sakalajñānānāṃ nirākāratvapratijñānāt
atha ullekha; tannipedho'nupapanna, pramāṇasya yathāvasthitārthasvarūpodyotakatvāt, tatsvarūpañca jātyādiviśiṣṭaṃ gauḥ śuklaḥ carati ityādipratyayāt prasiddham
jātyādisadbhāvaḥ tadviśiṣṭatvañca arthānāṃ viṣayaparicchede prapañcataḥ pratipādayiṣyate ityalamatiprasaṅgena

atha aspaṣṭākāratā vikalpasvarūpam, taccāsya vikalpakatvādeva siddhyati; tathāhi–yat savikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ tadaspaṣṭam yathā anumānam, tathācedaṃ vivādāpannaṃ jñānam; ityapyasāmpratam; nirvikalpakatva-savikalpakatvābhyāṃ jñānānāṃ spaṣṭatvā'spaṣṭatvayoraprasiddheḥ, svasāmagrīviśeṣādeva teṣāṃ tatprasiddhe
kathamanyathā pratyayatvāt pratyakṣamapi anumānavadaspaṣṭaṃ na syāt ? anyonyāśrayaśca; aspaṣṭākāratve hi siddhe savikalpakatvasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca aspaṣṭākāratvasiddhiriti
kiñca, asya aspaṣṭatā viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭārthagrāhitvāt, ekatvaparāmarśitvāt, parokṣākārollekhitvādvā syāt ? tatra ādyapakṣadvayamayuktam, vastusvarūpasya aspaṣṭatvā'hetutvāt
yat khalu vastusvarūpaṃ tannā'spaṣṭatvahetuḥ yathā nīlatvādi, vastusvarūpañca viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭatvādikamiti
na hi sarvatra vikalpaḥ parokṣa evārthe pravartate; vartamāne purovartinyapyarthe spaṣṭākārollekhamukhena tatpravṛttipratīteḥ
vikatpajñāna hi saṅketakāladṛṣṭatvena vastu gṛhṇat śabdasaṃsargayogyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
yathā ca pūrvotpanna vinaṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ sampratyasat tadvatpūrvavinaṣṭajñānaviṣayatvamapi samprati nāsti vastuna, tad asadrūpaṃ vastuno gṛhṇad asannihitārthagrāhitvāt asphuṭābham
nāpi arthasannidhinirapekṣatā vikalpalakṣaṇam; purovartinyarthe satyeva asyedantayā pravṛtteḥ, na hi īdṛśo vikalpo'sannihite'rthe saṃbhavati
ataśca sannihitārthalakṣaṇatve'pi yadi asyā'pratyakṣatā, na kiñcit pratyakṣaṃ syāt
nāpi anakṣaprabhavatā tallakṣaṇam; akṣā'nvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvataḥ akṣaprabhavatvasyātraivāvasāyāt, na hi nirvikalpakam akṣavyāpārānantaraṃ kadācidapyupalabhyate
yat svarūpeṇā'prasiddhaṃ na tad arthasākṣātkāri yathā vandhyāstanandhayavijñānam, svarūpeṇāprasiddhañca avikalpakatvābhimataṃ vijñānamiti

dharmāntarāropo'pi na tallakṣaṇam; vikalpe hi kasya dharmāntaramāropyate ? nirvikalpakasya cet; ki taddharmāntaram ? vaiśadyañcet; vandhyāsutasambandhi tat tatrāropyate ityapi kinna syāt ? tasya taddharmādhāratayā'prasiddheḥ kathaṃ tat tatrāropyate ityanyatrāpi samānam

na khalu nirvikalpamapi prāmāṇikasya ananyamanaso visphāritākṣasya taddharmādhāratayā kadācidapi prasiddham, iti akṣavyāpāraprabhavaṃ vaiśadyādhyāsitaṃ svārthasākṣātkāri vyavasāyātmakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratipattavyam
vaiśadyāropasya bhaṅgyantareṇa vistṛtacarcā nyāyaviniścayaṭīkāyām pṛ॰ 42-47 draṣṭavyāmdraṣṭavyā

bauddhasammataṃ kevala nirvikalpakaprāmāṇyapakṣaṃ vaiyākaraṇasammataṃ kevalasavikalpakaprāmāṇyapakṣañca nirākṛtya nirvikalpakasavikalpakobhayaprāmāṇyaṃ vyavasthāpayituṃ kumārilena carcā kṛtāsti mī॰ ślo॰ pratyakṣasū॰ ślo॰ 86–145
saiva carcā vācaspatimiśreṇa nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭīkāyām pṛ॰ 133– 137 bhaṭṭajayantena nyāyamañjaryyām pṛ॰ 92–100 śrīdharācāryeṇa ca praśastapā॰ kandalyāṃ pṛ॰ 189–194 bhaṅgyantareṇa bistaramupanītā dṛśyate
vinā ca siddherna ca lakṣaṇārtho na tāvakadveṣiṇi vīra satyam
na vai naiva jñānamityeva jñānamityetāvataiva pramāṇam
samīcīnaḥ saṅgato vā vādiprativādino'vipratipattibhūto vyavahāraḥ heyopādeyayorhānopādānalakṣaṇaḥ saṃjñānādilakṣaṇo vā, tatra anupayoginaḥ
iyaṃ śuktikā rajataṃ vā iti jñānaṃ saṃśayaḥ
rajate śuktikā iti, śuktikāyāṃ rajatam iti vā jñānaṃ viparyayaḥ
ayamarthaḥ–yathā saṃśayādihetorjñānasya jñānatve satyapi saṃvyavahārānupayogitvānna prāmāṇyam, tathā bhavatparikalpitanirvikalpakapratyakṣasyāpi
tathāhi–idaṃ rajatam ityanyonyaṃ vibhinnaṃ jñānadvayaṃ pratyakṣa-smaraṇarūpam vibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvād vibhinnaviṣayatvācca siddhyatyeva
indriyaṃ hi idamaṃśollekhinaḥ pratyakṣasya kāraṇam, saṃskāraśca smaraṇasya, iti siddhamatra vibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvam
yayośca vibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvaṃ tayoranyonyaṃ bhedaḥ yathā pratyakṣānumānayoḥ, vibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvañca idam rajatam iti jñānadvayasya
vibhinnaviṣayatvañcātra suprasiddham–idam iti jñānasya purovartiśuktiśakalāvalambanatvāt, rajatam iti jñānasya ca vyavahitarajataviṣayatvāt
yatra ca vibhinnaviṣayatvaṃ tatrānyonyaṃ bhedaḥ yathā rūpa-rasādijñāne, asti ca vibhinnaviṣayatvam idaṃ rajatam iti jñāne iti
itthaṃ pratyakṣāt smṛtirvibhinnāpi pramuṣṭā iti na vivekena pratibhāsate ityavivekakhyātiḥ, na tu ekamevedaṃ jñānam; tathātvena tadutpattau kāraṇā'bhāvāt
tatra hi kāraṇam-indriyam, anyadvā ? na tāvadanyat; uparatendriyavyāpārasyāpi tadutpattiprasaṅgāt
nāpīndriyam; taddhi rajatasadṛśe śuktiśakale samprayukta sat tatra nirvikalpakamupajanayat savikalpakamapi tatraivopajanayet na rajate, tasya indriyeṇā'sambandhād avartamānatvācca
na cā'sambaddhamavartamānañcendriyagrāhyam sambaddhaṃ varttamānañca gṛhyate cakṣurādinā mīmāṃ॰ ślo॰ sū॰ 4 ślo॰ 84 ityabhidhānāt

na ca doṣāṇāmayaṃ mahimā ityabhidhātavyam; yataḥ ko'yaṃ tanmahimā nāma–indriyaśakteḥ pratibandhaḥ, tatpradhvaṃsaḥ, viparītajñānāvirbhāvo vā ? tatra ādyavikalpadvayamayuktam; kāryānutpādaprasaṅgāt, na hi maṇimantrādinā dahanaśakteḥ pratibandhe pradhvaṃse vā sphoṭādikāryotpattirdṛṣṭā
tṛtīyavikalpopyanupapannaḥ; na khalu duṣṭā yavā viparītaṃ kāryamāvirbhāvayantaḥ pratīyante
ataḥ jñānadvayametat–idam iti hi pratyakṣaṃ purovyavasthitārthagrāhi, rajatam iti ca anubhūtarajatasmaraṇamiti
rajatākārā hi pratītī rajataviṣayaiva na śuktiviṣayā, anyākārāyāḥ pratīteḥ anyaviṣayatvā'yogāt, tadyoge vā sarvaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaviṣayaṃ syāt, iti sarvasya sarvadarśitvāpattiḥ
prayogaḥ–yad yadākāraṃ jñānaṃ tat tadviṣayameva yathā ghaṭākāraṃ ghaṭaviṣayameva, rajatākārañcedaṃ jñānamiti
yadi ca anyākārāpi pratītiḥ anyaviṣayā syāt, tadā asyāḥ svārthavyabhicārataḥ sarvatrāpyanāśvāsānna kvacit kasyacit pravṛttirnivṛttirvā kutaścit ityaśeṣavyavahārocchedaḥ
na ca rajatamagrataḥ sannihitam, ato'tītameva tat tadā smaryata iti
na tajjñānaṃ pratyakṣam; indriyārtha samprayogajatvā'bhāvāt, agṛhītarajatasya idaṃ rajatam iti pratyayānutpatteśca
yadi hi tatpratyakṣaṃ syāt tadā'gṛhītarajatasyāpi indriyavyāpārāt tadutpadyeta
na hyanyasamprayukte cakṣuṣyanyālambanasya jñānasya utpatti saṃbhavati andhasyā'nutpādāt
na hi tadindriyajam tena samprayogā'bhāvāt, asaṃyukte ca indriyaṃ vijñānaṃ na janayati bṛha॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 51
yadi cā'pratyakṣamapi cakṣuradhyakṣayati sarvasya sarvavittvaṃ kena vāryeta ? praśa॰ bhā॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 180
yuktañca duṣṭatāyā kāryā'kṣamatvaṃ na punaḥ kāryāntarasāmarthyam
tadeva tena vedyaṃ syānna tu śuktiravedanāt
parasmin bhāsamāne hi na paraṃ bhāsate yataḥ

nanu yadi atītaṃ rajataṃ smaryate tadā'tītasyāsya atītatayaiva pratibhāsaḥ syāt, na tu vartamānarajatatulyatayā; ityapyapeśalam; atītasyāpi rajatasya doṣato'tītatvenā'pratibhāsanāt, vartamānasya ca śuktilakṣaṇārthasya grāhakaṃ jñānaṃ śuktikeyam iti tallakṣaṇamarthaṃ svarūpeṇa pratipattumasamartham
śuktitvalakṣaṇaviśeṣaṇasya rajatācchukterbhedakasyā'grahaṇāt, sādhāraṇātmanā tu rajatānvayinā sthitaṃ vastu pratipadyamānaṃ rajatasmṛtijñānasya smarāmi ityākāraśūnyasya kāraṇatāṃ pratipadyate
rajatamidam iti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ samīcīnasannihitarajatapratyayatulyavyavahāratvañcātra na durghaṭam; bhedā'grahataḥ tadghaṭanāt
bhedā'grahaśca triprakāraḥ; tathā hi–prakāśyayorbhedo na gṛhyate, prakāśakayoḥ bhedo na gṛhyate, samyagjñānācca bhedo na gṛhyate iti ca

na ca smṛtipramoṣābhyupagame rajatajñānasya satyatvāt uttarajñānena bādhyatānupapattirityabhidhātavyam; śuktikeyam iti bhedabuddhau bhedā'nadhyavasāyanivāraṇena pūrvapratyayapraśaṃsitarajatocitapravṛttyādivyavahāranivāraṇataḥ tasyā upapatte
ye tu smṛtipramoṣamanicchanta śuktau rajatapratipatti viparītakhyāti pratipadyante teṣāṃ bāhyārthasiddhirna prāpnoti; taddṛṣṭāntenā'śeṣapratyayānāṃ nirālambanatvaprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi rajatapratyayo rajatā'bhāve'pi rajatamavabhāsayati tathā sarve bāhyārthapratyayāstadavabhāsinaḥ ityadvaitavādimatasiddhi syāt
viṣayāntarasādṛśyamavalambya agṛhītavivekaṃ yat jñānamutpannaṃ tatsadṛśaviṣayāntare smṛtihetutāṃ pratipadyate smarāmi iti jñānaśūnyasya
te na jñātā abhibhavāj jñātā sāmānyarūpatā
śuktikāyā rajatajñāna smarāmi iti pramoṣāt smṛtijñānamuktaṃ yukta rajatādiṣu
tato bhinne abuddhvā tu smaraṇagrahaṇe ime

tathā ca rajatasmṛte purovarttidravyamātragrahaṇasya ca mitha svarūpato viṣayataśca bhedā'grahāt sannihitarajatagocarajñānasārūpyeṇa idam rajatam iti bhinne api smaraṇa–grahaṇe abhedavyavahāraṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyavyapadeśañca pravartayata
bhedā'grahaprasañjitā' bhedavyavahāravādhanācca nedaṃ rajatamiti vivekapratyayasya bādhakatvamapi upapadyate
ye tu vivekā'khyāterdviṣantaḥ śuktau rajatapratītiṃ khyāpanti na te saṅkhyāvida, itthaṃ hi teṣā bāhyārthasiddhirna prāpnoti syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 107

so'yaṃ smṛtipramoṣa tattvā'grahaṇam akhyātirucyate, te ete grahaṇasmaraṇe vivikte api viviktatayā na gṛhyete iti vivekā'grahaṇam akhyātiḥ nyāya maṃ॰ pṛ॰ 179 ityādinā bhaṭṭajayantāḥ smṛtipramoṣam akhyātipadena vyapadiśanti
kāraṇabhedamātrāt kāryabhedaḥ prasādhyate, sāmagrībhedādvā ? prathamapakṣe na kiñcidekaṃ jñānaṃ syāt, ālokendriyādibhiranekaiḥ kāraṇairjanyamānasya ghaṭādijñānasyāpyanekatvaprasaṅgāt

nanu rajatamidam iti smṛtipratyakṣarūpaḥ kāryabhedo'tra vidyata eva, ataḥ sāmagrībhedaḥ kalpyata iti cet; na; anyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt–siddhe hi sāmagrībhede rajatamidam ityatra smṛtipratyakṣarūpatayā kāryabhedasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca sāmagrībhedasiddhiriti
tatra vibhinnakāraṇajanyatvādibhya sāmagryantargatā'nekakāraṇabhedāt prastutakāryabheda sisādhiyiṣataḥ, sāmagrībhedādvā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 109
etena yayorvibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvam ityādyanumānaṃ pratyuktam; tayorhi bhede siddhe vibhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvaṃ siddhyeta, tatsiddhau ca tayorbhedaḥ siddhyediti
tathā ca indriyaṃ hi pratyakṣasya kāraṇam ityādisvaprakriyāpradarśanamanupapannam
yadi cānyatra indriyasaṃskārayoḥ smṛtipratyakṣakāraṇatvena pratipannatvād atrāpi tatkāryabheda iṣyate; tarhi pratyabhijñānasyāpi ekatvaṃ na syāt saṃskārendriyaprabhavatvā'viśeṣāt
athātra kāryasyaikyadarśanāt tāvatyekaiva sāmagrī kalpyate; taditaratra samānam
tathā ca naikamevedaṃ jñānaṃ kāraṇābhāvāt ityādyayuktam; cakṣurādisāmagryā eva tatkāraṇatvāt
na ca kāryapratītau kāraṇābhāvā''śaṅkā yuktā, tatpratītereva tatsadbhāvaprasiddheḥ
purovartamānaṃ hi śuktiśakalaṃ cakṣurādayaḥ kācakāmalādidoṣopanipātād rajatarūpatayā darśayanti

kathamanyathā śuktisannidhānānapekṣastajjñānasya āvirbhāvo na bhavet ? taddhi tatra kāraṇatāmātreṇa vyāpriyeta, viṣayatayā vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; satyarajate cakṣurādyabhāva iva śuktiśakalābhāve'pi rajatajñānānutpattiprasaṅgāt

ekārthaviṣayamekameva hi idaṃ rajatam iti jñānamanubhūyate, idaṃśabdo hyatra purovartitāmātraṃ parāmṛśati, rajataśabdastu rajatarūpatāmātraṃ na punarviṣayāntaram, tadatra jñāne kathaṃ bhedāśaṅkā syāt ? satyarajatajñāne'pi tatprasaṅgāt, tayoḥ svarūpamātrapratibhāse viśeṣābhāvāt
yaccānyat–dopairindriyaśakteḥ pratibandhaḥ pradhvaṃso vā ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; yato na taistasyāḥ pratibandhaḥ pradhvaṃso vā vidhīyate, kintu svasannidhāne rajatamidam iti jñānamevotpādyate
na doṣai śakte pratibandha pradhvaṃso vā vidhīyate prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 15 pū॰

yadapyuktam–na khalu duṣṭā yavāḥ ityādi, tadapyuktimātram; yato duṣṭasya ayameva dharmo yatkāryānutpādakatvaṃ viparītakāryotpādakatvaṃ vā duṣṭabhṛtyavat, taccobhayamapi yavādāvastyeva aṅkuralakṣaṇakāryānutpādakatvasya upayuktānāmudaravyathādiviparītakāryotpādakatvasya ca pratīteḥ
nanu duṣṭasya kāryotpādakatvaṃ viruddham ityapyanena pratyuktam; tasya hi aviparītakāryotpādakatvaṃ viruddhaṃ na punarviparītakāryotpādakatvam
atha kāryotpādakatvamātramapi tatra viruddham; tarhi kathaṃ tataḥ smṛtipramoṣalakṣaṇakāryotpādaḥ syāt ? tataḥ yukto dopato viparītajñānasya śuktiśakalaviṣayatayotpādaḥ
pañcāṅgulādijñānena anekāntācca, na khalu viṣayabhede'pyasya bheda saṃbhavatīti
kiñca, rajatajñānasya śuktiśakalā'viṣayatve ki nirviṣayatvam, atītarajataviṣayatvaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvannirviṣayatvam; rajatamidam iti viṣayollekhapratīteḥ
nāpyatītarajataviṣayatvam, atītatayaiva tatra rajatapratibhāsaprasaṅgāt, tathā ca tatprāptyarthinām ataḥ pravṛttirna prāpnoti; atītasya prāptumaśakyatvāt

ata vartamānapurovartiśuktiśakalaviṣayameva tajjñānaṃ pratipattavyaṃ tatraiva pravṛttihetutvāt, yad yatraiva pravṛttihetuḥ tat tadviṣayameva yathā satyarajate rajatajñānam, vartamāne purovartinyeva śuktiśakale pravṛttihetuścedaṃ jñānamiti

atha atītarajataviṣayatve'pyasya doṣato'tītasya rajatasya śuktikāto bhedā'grahaṇāt tatra pravṛttihetutvam; tanna; bhedā'grahamātramya puruṣapravṛttihetutvānupapatteḥ, purovartitayā rajatapratibhāso hi tatpravṛttihetuḥ na punarbhedā'grahaḥ

atha atītarajataviṣayatve'pyasya rajatapratibhāsasya purovartisatyarajatapratibhāsatulyatvāt puruṣapravṛttihetutvam, tattulyatā ca tato bhedānavasāyaḥ iti cet; nanvevaṃ vartamānānavabhāsitayā atītarajatāvabhāsijñānatulyatāpyasyāsti iti tattulyatayā tadapravṛttihetutā'pyasya syād aviśeṣāt

tathā cā'yaṃ rajatajñānavān purovartini śuktiśakalalakṣaṇe'rthe pravarteta nivarteta vā yugapatparasparaviruddhakriyādvayamāpannaḥ ki kuryāt ? na ca 'tattulyatā'viśeṣe'pi ekatra svocitavyavahārapravartakatvaṃ nānyatra ityabhidhātuṃ yuktam; aprāmāṇikatvaprasaṅgāt
iti na viṣayabhedādapi asya jñānasya bhedaḥ
tatsiddhametad vivādādhyāsitaṃ rajatādivijñānaṃ purovartivastuviṣayaṃ rajatārthina tatra niyamena pravarttakatvāt

atha vibhinnākāratvāt tatra tadbhedaḥ prasādhyate; tadayuktam; yato nā''kārabhedādapi tadbhedaḥ citrajñānena pratyabhijñānena cānekāntāt, taddhi anekākārākrāntamapi ekamevax, evam rajata midam ityādijñānamapi

ataḥ tajjñānasya kutaścidbhedā'prasiddheḥ ekatvamevābhyupagantavyaṃ tathaiva tatsvarūpaprakāśanāt; yasya yathaiva svarūpaṃ prakāśate tat tathaivābhyupagantavyam yathā satyarajatādau rajatamidam ityādijñānasyaikatvena prakāśamānaṃ svarūpam ekatvenaivābhyupagamyate, ekatvenaiva prakāśate ca śuktikāśakale rajatamidam iti jñānasya svarūpamiti
na hi pratibhāsakṛtaṃ viśeṣamubhayatra kañcitpaśyāmaḥ, yena ekatraikaṃ jñānam anyatra tu dvayaṃ pratipadyāmahe
etattusyāt–ekaṃ pramāṇaṃ yathāvasthitavastusvarūpagrāhitvāt, aparaṃ tvapramāṇaṃ tadviparyayāditi
yato nākārabhedādapi jñānasya bheda saṃgacchate, pratyabhijñānena vyabhicārāt syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 115
astu vā jñānadvayam; tathāpi yugapat, krameṇa vā'syotpattiḥ syāt ? na tāvadyugapat; jñānayaugapadyaprasaṅgāt, karaṇasya krameṇaiva jñānotpādane sāmarthyam ityabhyupagamakṣatiprasaṅgācca
krameṇotpattāvapi idam iti pratyakṣāt pūrvam, uttaratra vā rajatasmṛtiḥ syāt ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; tadā smṛtibījasya saṃskārasya prabodhakapratyayā'pāyāt
prabuddhe ca saṃskāre smṛtirutpadyate nāprabuddhe atiprasaṅgāt
atha nirvikalpakāt tatsaṃskāraprabodhaḥ; tarhi savikalpakena saha rajatasmṛteryaugapadyaprasaṅgāt saivābhyupagamakṣatiḥ
na ca nirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ kutaścitpramāṇātprasiddham ityuktaṃ savilpakasiddhau
atha paścādutpadyate; tanna; yasmāt idam iti pratyakṣāt paścādutpadyamānaṃ rajatajñānaṃ niruddhavyāpāre'pi cakṣuṣi utpadyeta, tathā ca nimīlitākṣasyāpi tajjñānānubhavaḥ syāt

pratītiviruddhā ca tatkramotpattiḥ, na khalu pūrvaṃ purovartiśuktiśakalaṃ gṛhītvā paścād rajataṃ smarāmi iti tatsaṃvedanayoḥ svapne'pi kramapratītirasti, rajatātmakaṃ purovarti vastu sakṛdeva pratibhāti ityakhilajanānāṃ pratīte, anyathā bādhakopanipāte sati nedaṃ rajatam iti tādātmyapratipedho na syād aprasaktatvāttasya
ataḥ yad yatra pratiṣidhyate tat tatra prasaktam yathā kvacitpradeśe ghaṭaḥ, pratipidhyate ca purovartini śuktiśakale rajatamiti
tasya ki yaugapadyena paryāyeṇa vā prādurbhāva syāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 119

nanvevamapi ghaṭa-bhūtalayoriva śukti-rajatayoḥ saṃyoganiṣedho bhaviṣyati; ityapyasundaram; tadvadatra vaiyadhikaraṇyā'pratīteḥ, na khalu yathā nāstyatra ghaṭaḥ iti vaiyadhikaraṇyapratītiḥ tathā nedaṃ rajatam ityatrāpi
yatra ca vaiyadhikaraṇyapratītirnāsti na tatra saṃyoganiṣedhaḥ yathā nedaṃ nīlam ityādau, nāsti ca idaṃ rajatam ityādau vaiyadhikaraṇyapratītiriti

yathaiva hi advaitavādinā viśvasyaikatvamabhyupagacchatā pītasya nīlātmakatvaṃ yadāropitaṃ tadeva nedaṃ nīlam ityanena pratiṣidhyate, tathā śukti-rajatayoryat tādātmyaṃ pūrvavijñānenāropitaṃ tadeva nedaṃ rajatam ityanena bādhakena apanīyate, natu idamaṃśo rajatāṃśo vā niṣidhyate
tathā ca sataḥ śuktiśakalasya yā rajatātmakatāpratītiḥ sā avasthitarūpaviruddhatvād viparītakhyātiḥ na punaḥ smṛtipramoṣaḥ

kiñca, ko'yaṃ smṛte pramopo nāma–vināśa, pratyakṣeṇa sahaikatvādhyavasāyaḥ, pratyakṣarūpatāpattiḥ, tadityaśasyānanubhava, tirobhāvamātra vā ? yadi vināśa; tadā sādhyasādhanasambandhasmṛteḥ sādhyapratipattikāle vināśāt tatrāpi smṛtipramoṣa syāt

atha pratyakṣeṇa sahaikatvādhyavasāyo'syā pramoṣa, nanu kutaratayorekatvādhyavasāya–viṣayaikatvādhyavasāyāt, svarūpaikatvādhyavasāyādvā ? prathamavikalpe ko'yaṃ viṣayaikatvādhyavasāyo nāma ? anyataraviṣayasyānyataraviṣaye āropaścet; ki pratyakṣaviṣayasya smṛtiviṣaye, tadviṣayasya vā pratyakṣaviṣaye āropa syāt ? tatrādyapakṣe smaryamāṇarajatadeśe spaṣṭatayā śuktikāyā pratibhāsa syānna tu idam ityullekhena purovartitayā, tatrāropyamāṇatvāt, yatra yadāropyate tasya taddeśe pratibhāso bhavati yathā marīcikāyāmāropyamāṇasya jalasya marīcikādeśe, smṛtiviṣaye rajate āropyate ca pratyakṣaviṣayā śuktiketi
dvitīyapakṣe tu idantayā śuktikāyā spaṣṭa pratibhāso na prāpnoti, tatrāropyamāṇasya smṛtiviṣayasyā'spaṣṭatvāt
tanna viṣayaikatvādhyavasāyāt smṛte pratyakṣeṇa sahaikatvādhyavasāyo yukta
ko'ya vipramopo nāma–kimanubhavākārasvīkaraṇam, smaraṇākārapradhvaso vā, pūrvārthagṛhītitva vā, indriyārthasannikarṣajatvaṃ vā, indriyārthasannikarṣājatva vā ? tattvo॰ pṛ॰ 25
kaścāya smṛte pramoṣa ? smṛterabhāva, anyāvabhāso vā syāt, viparītākāraveditva vā, atītakālasya varttamānatayā grahaṇa vā, anubhavena saha kṣīrodakavadavivekena utpādo vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 15 u॰
kiṃ smṛterabhāva, uta anyāvabhāsa, āhosvidanyākāraveditvam iti vikalpā
ki pravvasa, uta pratyakṣeṇa saha ekatvādhyavasāya, āhosvit pratyakṣarūpatāpatti, utacit tadityaśasya ananubhava, tirobhāvamātra vā bhavet ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 120
jalasya iti śabda ādarśe ṭippaṇyā patitaḥ

nāpi svarūpaikatvādhyavasāyāt, sa hi tābhyāmeva vidhīyate, anyena vā ? na tāvattābhyāmeva, asvasaviditasvabhāvayo smṛti-pratyakṣayo svarūpamātrādhyavasāye'pyasāmarthye anyena sahaikatvādhyevasāye sāmarthyānupapatte
nāpyanyena jñānāntareṇa tadekatvādhyavasāya, tasyāpi asvasaviditasvabhāvasya svarūpamātrasyāpi vārtānabhijñasya anyenaikatvādhyavasāyavārtābhijñatā'nupapatte
kiñca, tena taddvayasya pratītasya ekatvamadhyavasīyate, apratītasya vā ? na tāvatpratītasya; dvayapratītau tadekatvādhyavasāyavirodhāt

atha yadaiva taddvaya pratīyate na tadaiva tadekatvādhyavasāyo yena virodha syāt, kintu pūrva taddvayaṃ pratītya paścādekatvenādhyavasīyata iti, tadayuktam, saṃvedanasya kṣaṇikatvena etāvanta kālamavasthityanupapatte

nāpi pratyakṣarūpatāpattiḥ; tadrūpatāpattau hi tasyāḥ smṛtirūpatāparityāgāt pratyakṣarūpataiva syānna smṛtirūpatā, tatkathamasyāḥ pramoṣaḥ ? anyathā mṛtpiṇḍasyāpi ghaṭarūpatāpattau mṛtpiṇḍarūpatāparityāge'pi mṛtpiṇḍatvaprasaṅgāt mṛtpiṇḍapramoṣo'pi syāt, pratyakṣabādhā ubhayatra samānā

atha tat ityaṃśasyānanubhavaḥ smṛteḥ pramoṣaḥ, tadrajatam ityākārā hi pratītiḥ smṛtiḥ, tacchabdasya anubhūtaparokṣārthābhidhāyakatvāt, sa yatra nānubhūyate tatra smṛtiḥ pramuṣṭā ityucyata iti; tadasāmpratam; rajatākārasyāpyanubhavābhāvaprasaṅgāt, tadrajatam iti hi rajatāṃśasambalitamekamevedaṃ smaraṇaṃ bhavateṣyate, tatra tacchabdasya pramoṣe rajatāṃśasyāpi pramoṣaḥ syāt niraṃśasyaikadeśena pramoṣānupapatteḥ
tadrajatam ityākārā hi pratīti smṛti, tacchabdasya anubhūtaparokṣārthā''lambanatvāt
sa yatra nānubhūyate tatra smṛti pramuṣṭā ityabhidhīyate iti
smṛtiḥ pramoṣasya anubhūtaparokṣārthābhidhāyakatacchabdasaṃvalitā'nubhūyate tatra ā॰, ba॰, ja॰
kiñca, pramoṣaḥ ityatra praśabdena ko'rtho'bhidhīyate–ekadeśāpahāraḥ, sarvāpahāro vā ? na tāvadekadeśāpahāraḥ; tatrāsya prayogavaiyarthyāt
ekadeśena hi caurairdravyāpahāre moṣaśabda eva loke prayujyate, ataḥ sarvāpahāra eva asyārtho yuktaḥ prakṛṣṭo moṣaḥ pramoṣaḥ iti
moṣasya cāyaṃ prakarṣo yat sarvātmanā vastuno'pahāra iti
evañca svavacanavirodhaḥ; smṛtirasti, kintu pramuṣṭā iti
yadi hi sā asti; kathaṃ pramuṣṭā ? pramuṣṭā cet; kathamasti iti ?
api ca pramoṣaśabdasya ko'rtho'bhipreta prajñāśālinā–kimekadeśāpahāra sarvāpahāro vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 122
yadi hi nāsti kathaṃ pramuṣṭā cet kathamastīti bhāṃ॰
tirobhāvo'pi jñānayaugapadye siddhe siddhyeta, na ca bhavatastatsiddham apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt

kiñca, asyāstirobhāvaḥ kāryā'kartṛtvam, āvṛtatvam, abhibhūtasvarūpāyā avasthānaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe ki tasyāḥ kāryam, yadakartṛtvāt tattirobhāva syāt ? paricchittiścet; sā tatrāstyeva, rajataparicchitteratrānubhūyamānatvāt
cirasthāyino hi padārthasyāvriyamāṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, naca jñānaṃ cirasthāyitayā kenacid dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā
tṛtīyapakṣopyanupapannaḥ; balavatā hi durbalasya svarūpābhibhavo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā savitrā tārānikurambasya
durbalatvañcāsyāḥ atītaviṣayatvāt, bādhyamānatvādvā ? prathamavikalpe smṛtivārtocchedaḥ, sarvasyā smṛteratītaviṣayatayā durbalatvato vartamānavastupratibhāsijñānena svarūpābhibhavaprasaṅgāt
yadapyuktam–viparītakhyātyabhyupagame bāhyārthasiddhirna syāt ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; asatyapratyayānām arthā'nālambanatve'pi satyapratyayānāṃ tadālambanatvaprasiddheḥ
tadevaṃ vivekākhyātipakṣasya vicāryamāṇasya sarvathānupapatternātrāgrahaḥ prekṣādakṣaiḥ kartavya iti
prathamaṃ tāvat prabhākaraguruṇā smarāmi iti smṛtipramoṣāt pratyakṣasammitaṃ tat ityādinā śābarabhāṣyasya bṛhatīṭīkāyāṃ pṛ॰ 56 smṛtipramoṣaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ
vra॰ śāṅkarabhāṣye pṛ॰ 15 vivekāgrahapadena, vivaraṇaprameyasaṅgrahe pṛ॰ 28 nyāyamañjaryāṃ pṛ॰ 179 nyāyavārtikatātparyaṭīkāyāñca pṛ॰ 89 akhyātipadena asya ullekho varttate
asya ca vividharūpeṇa samīkṣā–tattvopa॰ li॰ pṛ॰ 25
tathāhi–idaṃ rajatam iti jñāne rajatasattā viṣayabhūtā tāvannāsti; abhrāntatvānuṣaṅgāt
rajatākāreṇa śuktiśakalamālambanamityapyayuktam; anyasya anyākāreṇa grahaṇā'pratīteḥ, na khalu ghaṭākāreṇa paṭasya grahaṇaṃ pratītam
ato na kiñcidatra jñāne khyāti iti siddhā akhyātiḥ; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; viśeṣato vyapadeśābhāvaprasaṅgāt, yatra hi na kiñcidapi pratibhāti tatkena viśeṣeṇa rajatajñānamanyadvā vyapadiśyeta ?
jalāvabhāsini jñāne tāvanna jalasattā ālambanībhūtā'sti abhrāntatvaprasaṅgāt prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 13 u॰
kā ceyamakhyātiḥ-kiṃ khyāterabhāvaḥ, īṣatkhyātirvā ? prathamapakṣe bhrānti-suṣuptāvasthayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ, pratibhāsaviśeṣātmakatve hi bhrānteḥ supuptāvasthāto bhedaḥ syānnānyathā
atha īṣatkhyātiḥ akhyātiḥ; nanu kimidaṃ khyāterīṣattvam ? yathāvasthitārthā'pratibhāsitvamiti cet; tarhi viparītārthakhyātiriyaṃ syānnatu akhyātiḥ
tathāhi–idaṃ rajatam iti pratibhāsamānaṃ vastusvarūpaṃ jñānadharmaḥ, arthadharmo vā syāt ? na tāvajjñānadharmaḥ; anahaṅkārāspadatvāt, bahiḥ idantayā pratibhāsamānatvācca
ataḥ asadeva tat tatra pratibhātamiti asatkhyātiḥ; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; asataḥ prakhyopākhyāvirahitasya khapuṣpādivat pratibhāsā'saṃbhavāt
bhrāntivaicitryābhāvaprasaṅgaśca tannibandhanā'bhāvāt, nahi asatkhyātivādino jñānagatamarthagataṃ vā vaicitryamasti yannibandhanā'nekaprakārā bhrāntiḥ syāt
idaṃ rajatam iti pratibhāsamānaṃ vastu jñānam, artho vā bhavet ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 125
bhrāntibaicitryābhāvaprasaṅgaśca, nahi asatkhyātivādino'rthagataṃ jñānagata vā vaicitryamasti yena anekaprakārā bhrānti syāt

yadapyuktam–arthakriyākāritvābhāvāt iti; tatrāpi kiṃ jñānasādhyārthakriyākāritvābhāvo'bhipretaḥ, jñeyasādhyārthakriyākāritvā'bhāvo vā ? tatrādyapakṣe jñānadharmatayaivāsya sattvamanupapannam, na punaḥ sarvathā
ataḥ tatkāriṇa evārthasya grāhakaṃ jñānamabhrāntaṃ nānyat
asatkhyāteḥ pratividhānam– nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 86
na cāsya vicāryamāṇasya asattvaṃ vācyam; pratītivyatirekeṇa aparasya vicārasyaivāsaṃbhavāt
pratīti tya bādhitatvācca, na ca tatprasiddhe'rthe vicāro yuktaḥ, karatalagatā''malakāderapi hi pratibhāsabalenaiva sattvam, sa ca pratibhāsonyatrāpyaviśiṣṭaḥ

atha marīcikācakrādau jalādyarthasya pratibhātasya taddeśopasarpaṇe sati uttarakālaṃ pratibhāsābhāvādasattvam; tadayuktam; yato yadyapi uttarakālaṃ so'rtho na pratibhāti, tathāpi yadā pratibhāti tadā tāvadastyeva, anyathā vidyudāderapi svapratibhāsakāle sattvasiddhirna syāt
na khalu yathāvasthitārthagrāhitvā'viśeṣe kācitpratītirbhrāntā kāciccā'bhrāntā iti nirnibandhanā vyavasthitiryuktā; svecchākāritvaprasakteḥ
nahi vidyudādivad udakāderapi āśubhāvī niranvayo vināśaḥ kvacidupalabhyate
nacāsya vicāryamāṇasya asattvaṃ vicārasya pratītivyatirekeṇa anyasya asaṃbhavāt, pratītyavādhitatvācca, karatalāderapi hi pratimāsabalenaiva sattvam
prasiddhārthakhyāte mīmāsā prameyaka॰ mārttaṇḍe pṛ॰ 14 pū॰ syā॰ ratnākare ca pṛ॰ 126 avalokanīyā
tathāhi–śuktikāyām idaṃ rajatam iti rajataṃ pratibhāsate, tasya ca bāhyasya bādhakapratyayāt pratibhāso nopapadyate
na khalu yathaiva pratibhāsate tathaivārthaḥ ityabhyupagantuṃ yuktam; bhrāntatvā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt

ataḥ jñānasyaivāyamākāro'nādyavidyāvāsanāsāmarthyād bahiriva pratibhāsate ityātmakhyātiḥ; tadasamīcīnam; yata svarūpamātrasaṃvinniṣṭhatve arthākāradhāritve ca siddhe jñānasya ātmakhyāti siddhyeta, na ca tatsiddham, uttaratra ubhayasyāsya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
svākāramātragrāhitve ca akhilajñānānāṃ bhrāntā'bhrāntavivekaḥ bādhyabādhakamāvaśca na prāpnoti, tatra kasyacidapi vyabhicārā'bhāvāt
svātmasvarūpatayā rajatādyākārasya saṃvedane ca ahaṃ rajatam iti svātmaniṣṭhatayaiva saṃvittiḥ syāt, natu idaṃ rajatam iti bahirniṣṭhatayā
yat svātmarūpatayā saṃvedyate na tatra vahirniṣṭhatayā saṃvittiḥ yathā vijñānasvarūpe, svātmarūpatayā saṃvedyate ca ātmakhyātivādimate rajatādyākāra iti
atha anādyavidyāvāsanāvaśād bahirniṣṭhatvenā'sau pratīyate; kathamevaṃ viparītakhyātireveyaṃ na syāt, jñānādabhinnasya rajatādyākārasya anyathā'dhyavasāyāt ?
buddhi prakāśamānā ca tena tenātmanā bahi
sarvajñānānā svākāragrāhitve ca bhrāntābhrāntaviveko bādhyabādhakabhāvaśca na prāpnoti tatra vyabhicārābhāvā'viśeṣāt
vijñānātmano hi pratibhāse aha rajatam iti pratīti syāt na idaṃ rajatam iti
sa hi idamanahaṅkārāspadaṃ rajatamādarśayati na ca āntaram, aham iti hi tadā syāt pratipattu pratyayādavyatirekāt
kiñca, yadantarjñeyarūpa hi bahirvadavabhāsate ityabhyupagamād iyamapi viparītakhyātireva syāt
kiñca, vijñānādvaite brahmādvaite vā iyamātmakhyātiḥ syāt

tatra dvividhe'pyadvaye dvayadarśananibandhanā kathaṃ bhrānti syāt ? anādyavidyopapaplavāditi cet, nanu tatrāpi ki svarūpaṃ pratibhāti, anyarūpaṃ vā ? yadi svarūpam; katha bhrāntiḥ ? atha anyarūpam, kathamātmakhyātiḥ ? atha ātmarūpasyaiva bhrāntivaśādanyarūpatvenā'vabhāsanam; nanvidamitaretarāśrayatvam, tathāhi– anyarūpāvabhāsanād buddherbhrāntitvasiddhi, tatsiddheśca anyarūpāvabhāsanasiddhiriti

yadi ca jñānasya bāhyārthaviṣayatvanneṣyate tarhi yāvad rajatākārollekhena tadbhavati tāvannīlādyākārollekhenāpi kasmānna bhavati niyāmakā'bhāvāt ? atha anādyavidyāvāsanaiva tanniyāmikā; kathamevaṃ deśādiniyamena tajjñānotpattiḥ syāt ? atha avidyāyāḥ idameva māhātmyam–yadasantamapi deśādiniyamaṃ jñāne darśayati iti cet; naivam; asatkhyātitvaprasaṅgāt ? kathañcātmakhyātivādinaḥ chedā'bhighātādipratītiḥ syāt, svarūpamātrasaṃvittau tadasaṃbhavāt ? na khalu vijñānasvarūpasya sukhādeḥ saṃvittau tatpratītirdṛṣṭā
yadi ca jñānasya bāhyārthaviṣayatvaṃ neṣyate tarhi yathā rajatākārotlekhena tat pravarttate tathā nīlādyākārollekhenāpi kimiti na pravarttate niyāmakasya abhāvāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 130
ātmakhyāte prakārāntareṇa pratividhānam–nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 85
tathāhi–śuktikādau rajatādyākāraḥ pratibhāsamānaḥ san syāt, asan, ubhayarūpo vā ? na tāvat san; uttarakālaṃ bādhakānutpattiprasaṅgatastadbuddherabhrāntatvaprasakteḥ

tasmādayaṃ buddhisandarśito'rthaḥ sattvenāsattvenobhayadharmeṇa vā nirvaktuṃ na śakyata ityanirvacanīyārthakhyātiḥ; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; pratibhāsamānasyānirvacanīyakhyātitvavirodhāt; tathāhi–khyātiḥ iti kimayaṃ khyā prakathane ityasya prayogaḥ, khyā prathane ityasya vā ? ubhayatra sato'sataśca vacanīyatā pratibhāsyatā ca ghaṭata eva
san khalu sattvenāvagrahītuṃ vaktuñca yātyeva, anyathā ghaṭādīnāmapi anirvacanīyatvaprasaṅgaḥ
yadi cānirvacanīyatā'ṅgīkriyate tadā idaṃ rajatam iti jñānasya vyapadeśasya cānutpattireva syāt
sadeva hi pūrvadṛṣṭaṃ rajataṃ deśādivyavahitamapi sādṛśyavaśāttatra pratibhāti, tasmāt idaṃ tat ityullekha eva vacanīyatā, tadanullekha eva avacanīyateti
tatkiṃ marīciṣu toyanirbhāsapratyaya tattvagocara tathā ca samīcīna iti na bhrānto nāpi bādhyeta
addhā na vādhyeta yadi marīcī na toyātmatattvā na toyātmanā gṛhṇīyāt
toyātmanā tu gṛhṇan kathamabhrānta kathaṃ vā'vādhya
hanta toyābhāvātmanā marīcīnā toyabhāvātmatvaṃ tāvanna sat, tepā toyābhāvādabhedena toyabhāvātmatānupapatte
nāpyasat, vastvantarameva vastvantarasya asattvamāsthīyate tasmānna sat
nāpi sadasat; pararaparavirodhāt ityanirvācyameva āropaṇīyaṃ marīciṣu toyamāstheyam
api ca anirvacanīyārthakhyāti ityatra khyātiriti kimayaṃ khyā prakathane ityasya prayoga khyāprathane ityasya vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 133
syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 133 anyeṣu ca dvaitavādigrantheṣu dṛṣṭavyā
te hi prāhu–yasmāduktaprakāreṇa khyātyantarāṇi vicāryamāṇāni nopapadyante tasmād alaukikasyāntarbahirvā'nirūpitasvarūpasyārthasya khyātirabhyupagantavyā iti

tadavicāritaramaṇīyam, yata kimidam alaukikatvannāma arthasya–kimanyarūpatvam, anyakriyākāritvam, anyakāraṇaprabhavatvam, akāraṇaprabhavatva vā ? na tāvad anyarūpatvam, yādṛśameva hi satyasya rūpaṃ pratibhāti tādṛśameva asatyarayāpi, anyarūpāvabhāsitve ca viparītakhyātereva alaukikārthakhyātiḥ iti nāma kṛtaṃ syāt
nāpyanyakriyākāritvam; anyasya anyasādhyakriyākāritve kāraṇāntaraparikalpanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt, ekasmādeva kāraṇāt sakalakāryāṇāmutpatteḥ
akāraṇaprabhavatve'pi sadrūpatvam, asadrūpatvaṃ vā arthasya syāt ? sadrūpatve nityatvaprasaṅgaḥ, sataḥ kāraṇādanutpadyamānasyā'nityatvānupapatteḥ
atha asadrūpaḥ; katham idaṃ rajatam iti vidhirūpatayā tatpratīti ? na khalu ghaṭasya asadrūpatve ayaṃ ghaṭa iti vidhirūpā pratīti svapne'pi pratīyate
athā'sadrūpasyāpyarthasya kutaścid vibhramanimittāt sadrūpatayā pratīti; tarhi viparītārthakhyātiriyam nālaukikārthakhyāti syāt
tatra vyavahārapravarttaka laukikamucyate anyad alaukikam iti
kima anyasvabhāvatvamarthasya, anyārthakriyākāritvam, anyakāraṇajanyatvam, akāraṇajanyatva vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 135
tadevaṃ śuktikāyāṃ rajatajñāne paropavarṇitakhyātyantarāṇāṃ vicāryamāṇānāmanupapatte viparītakhyātireva atra pratipattavyā
tathāhi–tasyā kimālambana rajatam, śuktikā vā ? yadi rajatam, tadā asatkhyātiriyaṃ syānna viparītakhyāti asatastatra rajatasya pratibhāsanāt
atha anyadeśakālaṃ sadeva tat tatra pratibhāti ato na taddopa, tadayuktam, evaṃ sati idaṃ rajatam ityullekhena jñānānutpattiprasaṅgāt
nahi ataddeśakāle rajate asannikṛṣṭe cākṣuṣaṃ jñānaṃ bhavitumarhati, anyathā sarvatra tadutpattiprasakterviśvasyāpi tad grāhaka syāt
nāpi śuktikā, rajatākāreṇa utpadyamānatvāt, na ca anyākārāyāḥ pratīteḥ anyadālambanaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
tatra yadi rajatamālambana tadiyamasatkhyātireva na viparītakhyāti asatastatra rajatasya pratibhāsāt
ihāsannihitasyāsya tena sattvena koguṇa ? nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 176
kaladhautañcet nanvevamasatkhyātireṣā bhavet na punarviparītakhyāti asata kaladhautasya pratīte
śuktikāpratītau tu śuktireva na rajatam atra bhramārthaḥ kaḥ ? nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 177
asatkhyātau hi ekāntenā'sato'rthasya pratibhāsanamiṣyate, atra tu deśāntarādau sataḥ, ityanayormahān viśeṣaḥ

nanu tatrāsato rajatasya cakṣuṣā' sannikṛṣṭasya kathamidantayā pratibhāsaḥ syāt ? ityapyanupapannam; ataddeśakālasyāpyasya doṣavaśāt sannihitatayā pratibhāsaviṣayatopapatteḥ, ataeva tatpratīterviparītakhyātitvam
na cātaddeśakālasyāsya grahaṇe viśvasya grahaṇaprasaṅga ityabhidhātavyam; sadṛśārthadarśanodbhūtasmṛtyupasthāpitasyāsya pratibhāsābhyupagamāt
naca viśvasya tadupasthāpitatvamasti, ataḥ kathaṃ tadgrahaṇāśaṅkā'pi ? tadupasthāpanañca cetasi parisphurato'rthasya bahiravabhāsanamucyate, na punaḥ paśoriva rajvā niyantritasyopaḍhaukanam
na caitāvateyam ātmakhyātiḥ asatkhyātirvā vaktavyā; vijñānādvibhinnasyārthasya atrāvabhāsanāt, atyantā'sato'rthasya pratibhāsābhāvācca
nanvatra coditam asatkhyātireva sā bhavediti; naitat sādhu; deśāntarādau rajatasya vidyamānatvāt
nacāsya upasthāpanaṃ paśoriva rajvā saṃyamya ḍhaukanam, api tu hṛdaye parisphurato'rthasya bahiravabhāsanam
nacaitāvateyam ātmakhyāti rasatkhyātirvā iti vaktavyam; vijñānādvicchedapratīteḥ, atyantāsadarthapratibhāsābhāvācca iti

nanu rajatamidam ityādijñānasya pratyakṣarūpatayā smṛtyanapekṣatvāt kathaṃ tadupasthāpitārthāvabhāsitvam ? ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; pratyakṣarūpatvā'bhāvāttasya, pratyabhijñānasvarūpa hi tat dṛṣṭa-dṛśyamānārthasaṅkalanātmakatvāt sa evāyaṃ devadattaḥ ityādijñānavat
na cāsya pratyabhijñānatvābhyupagame apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaḥ; vṛkṣo'yam ityādijñānānāṃ pratyabhijñānatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt

tataḥ sthitaṃ smṛtyupasthāpitaṃ rajatamasyāḥ pratīterālambanamiti, nigūhitanijākārā parigṛhītarajatākārā śuktikaiva vā; trikoṇatvādiviśeṣagrahaṇābhāvāddhi sā nigūhitanijākārā, cākacikyādisadṛśadharma darśanopajanitarajatasmaraṇāropitarajatākāratvācca parigṛhītarajatākāreti

kathaṃ rajatākārasya pratyayasya śuktikālambanatvamatiprasaṅgāt ? ityapyacodyam; aṅgulyādinā hi karmatayā nirddiśyamānaṃ jñānasyālambanamucyate, tacca śuktāvastyeva, kathamanyathā tajjñānena asau apekṣyate ? sā hi anenāvaśyamapekṣaṇīyā, anyathā tadasannidhāne'pi tajjñānotpattiḥ syāt
apekṣā ca kāraṇatvena bhavet, viṣayatvena vā iti cintyam ? na tāvat kāraṇatvena; ālokābhāvavat śuktyabhāve'pi rajatajñānānutpattiprasaṅgāt, tathā ca satyarajatajñānāya datto jalāñjali
nanu yadi śuktikā'tra rajatākāreṇa pratibhāsate tadā rajatasyāvidyamānatvād asatkhyātiriyaṃ syāt; tadasāmpratam; sādṛśyasya atrā'pekṣyamāṇatvāt
rajatasādhāraṇaṃ hi śuklabhāsvarākāramapekṣya idaṃ vijñānamutpadyate, asatkhyātistu na sādṛśyamapekṣyotpadyate, khe khapuṣpakhyātivat
tadevaṃ viparyayajñānasya viparītakhyātisvarūpasya aprāmāṇyaprasiddheḥ sūktam–saṃśayaviparyayakāraṇa ityādi
ataeva pihitasvākārā parigṛhītaparākārā śuktikaiva atra pratibhātīti bhavatu pakṣaḥ
kintu idamiti aṅgulyā nirdiśyamāna karmatayā yajjñānasya janakaṃ tadālambanam ityucyamāne na kaściddoṣa

na kevalaṃ saṃśayaviparyayakāraṇajñānasya bhāvā'virodhāt na vai jñānamityeva pramāṇam, kintu akiñcitkarasya ca kṣaṇakṣaya-svargaprāpaṇasāmarthyādijñānasya bhāvā'virodhāt, anyathā kṣaṇakṣayādijñānasyāpi prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt tatrānumānamanarthakaṃ syāt
nanu tatra niścayājanakatvānna tatpramāṇam etadevāha–nahi ityādi
hi yasmāt na tattvasya paramārthasya jñānamityeva yathārthanirṇayasādhanam api tu kiñcideva, tadeva ca pramāṇam

na kevalaṃ tattvajñānamātraprāmāṇyavādinā api tu tenāpi diḍnāgādinā'pi uktadoṣabhayāt tattvanirṇayaṃ prati sādhakatamasyaiva jñānasya niścayātmanaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ sama- rthyeta, tasyaiva taṃ prati sādhakatamatvāt, anyathā tadapekṣānupapatteḥ
na punastattvajñānamātrasya sannikarṣādervā tat samarthyeta tadabhāvāt
vastuvalāyāto vikalpasāmarthyasiddho'nubhavaḥ, anubhavahetuśca sannikarṣādiḥ, sannikarṣādihetuśca viśiṣṭā''hāra-deśādiḥ, tasyāpyabhāve vikalpānupapatteḥ
vastubalāyātaṃ ca tat sanikarṣā''hārādiḥ tasmādanubhavāt arthāntaraṃ ca tasyāpi, na kevalamanubhavasyaiva tatkāraṇatvopapatteḥ vikalpajanakatvopapatteḥ
tathāhi–viśiṣṭāhāradeśādeḥ sannikarṣaḥ, tato'nubhavaḥ, tato vikalpa iti, atastasyāpi tadupapatteḥ pramāṇatā syāt
yataevaṃ tat tasmāt nājñānasya pramāṇatā svaparayoḥ pramāṇāntarāpekṣaṇāt, ajñānamiva ajñānam nirvikalpakadarśanam, sākṣāt sannikarṣādirvā, tasya pramāṇatā na
ki sarvathā sā tasya na ? ityatrāha–anyatropacārāt
kasya tarhi mukhyataḥ pramāṇatā ? ityatrāha–jñānasyaiva ityādi
ki viśiṣṭasya ? viśadanirbhāsinaḥ paramukhā' prekṣitayā svaparasvarūpayo spaṣṭapratibhāsasya pratyakṣatvam pratyakṣapramāṇatā
atra apara saugata prāha–yatraiva janayedenā tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti dharmottarasya matametat
yatraivāśe vikalpaṃ janayati tatraivāsya pramāṇatā iti vacanāt

nanu pratyakṣavyatiriktasya pramāṇāntarasyaivā'saṃbhavāt kasya parokṣarūpatā prarūpyate ? pratyakṣameva hi pramāṇam agauṇatvāt, nānumānaṃ tadviparyayāt; tathāhi–pakṣadharmatvaṃ hetoḥ svarūpam, pakṣaśca dharmadharmisamudāyātmā, tadaniścaye kathaṃ taddharmatāyāḥ niścayaḥ ? tanniścaye vā anumānavaiyarthyam
ato'vaśyaṃ pakṣadharmavyavahārasiddhaye tatsamudāye ruḍho'pi pakṣaśabdastadekadeśe dharmiṇyupacaraṇīyaḥ, ataḥ pakṣasyāpi gauṇatvaṃ, hetorapi gauṇatvam
yo hi dharmidharmaḥ sa pakṣadharma ityucyate, ato gauṇarūpatvāt gauṇakāraṇajanyatvādvā gauṇamanumānam
tathācāhu–pramāṇasya agauṇatvād anumānādarthaniścayo durlabha nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 118
tasmādavaśyaṃ pakṣadharmānvayavyavahārasiddhaye dharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi rūḍha pakṣaśabda tadekadeśe dharmiṇi gauṇyā vṛttyā varṇanīya

kiñca, arthaniścayātmakaṃ pramāṇaṃ bhavati, anumānācca arthaniścayo durlabhaḥ; tathāhi–pratīyamānādarthādarthāntarapratītiḥ anumānam, pratīyamānaścārtho'rthāntarasya sambaddhasya, asambaddhasya vā gamaka syāt ? na tāvadasambaddhasya; atiprasaṅgāt
atha sambaddhasya; kutastatsambandhasiddhipratyakṣāt, anumānādvā ? na tāvatpratyakṣāt; asya niyatadeśakālā''kāragocaracāritayā sārvatrikasambandhagrahaṇe sāmarthyā'bhāvāt
nāpyanumānāt; anavasthāprasaṅgāt, tadapi hi sambandhagrahaṇe sati pravartate

kiñca, avasthā-deśa-kālabhedena bhinnārthakriyākāriṇāṃ bhinnasāmarthyānāṃ cārthānāṃ na sākalyena svabhāvapratibandho'vadhārayituṃ śakya, sahasraśo'pyāmalikyādeḥ kaṣāyarase samupalabhyamāne'pi kṣīrādyavasekena mādhuryasyāpyupalambhāt
na ca sādhye satyeva sādhanasyopalambhāt tadabhāve'nupalambhāt tatsambandhasiddhi; tadanupalambhasyātidūrāsannatvādau pramāturaśaktatve karaṇasyā'sāmarthye prameyā'bhāve ca saṃbhavāt
yatra hi anagnau dhūmo na dṛśyate tatra pramātuḥ śaktyabhāvaḥ, karaṇasya sāmarthyavirahaḥ, viṣayasyābhāvo vā'nupalambhe kāraṇamiti
pratīyamānaścārthaḥ arthāntare sambandhastasya gamako bhavet, asambaddho vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 261
iya kārikā tattvasaṅgrahe kā॰ 1460 nyāyamañjaryāñca pṛ॰ 119 prasiddhiratidurlabhā iti kṛtvā uddhṛtā, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 70, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 262 ityādiṣu ca prakṛtapāṭhenaiva
–mito'rthaḥ syāt ku– ba॰, bhāmatī pṛ॰ 367, nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 120, tattvasa॰ pṛ॰ 426

kiñca, anumānasya dharmī, dharmaḥ, tatsamudāyo vā sādhyaḥ syāt ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; dharmiṇo'dhyakṣasiddhatvena sādhanānarthakyaprasaṅgāt, hetorananvayatvānuṣaṅgācca; na khalu yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatra parvataḥ ityanvayo'sti

dvitīyapakṣe'pi dharmaḥ sāmānyarūpaḥ, viśeṣarūpo vā sādhyaḥ syāt ? tatra sāmānyarūpe siddhasādhanam, agnimātre kasyacid vipratipattyabhāvāt ? naca tatpratītau kiñcitprayojanam, nahi agnitvaṃ dāhapākādau gotvaṃ vā vāhadohādāvupayujyamānaṃ pratītam
kiñca, sāmānyātpratītāt pravartamāna kathaṃ niyatadigabhimukhameva avaśyaṃ pravarteta ? nahi sāmānyaṃ niyatadikkaṃ vyāpitvābhāvaprasaṅgāt
atha sāmānyasya vyakti vinā'nupapatte, pratīte tasmin anyathānupapattyā vyaktipratīterdiṅniyamena pravṛttiḥ
nanu kimabhimatayā vyaktyā vinā nopapadyeta, vyaktimātreṇa vā ? na tāvadabhimatayā, vyaktyantare'pyasya sambhavāt
vyaktimātrapratītau ca iṣṭavyaktipratītyarthaṃ punaryatnāntaraṃ karttavyam, tatrāpi ca ayameva paryanuyogaḥ ityanavasthā

viśeṣarūpasya ca sādhyatve ananvaya eva hetuḥ, nahyatratyedānīntanena khādirādisvabhāvena cāgninā agnimān parvato dhūmavatvāt ityādau viśeṣe sādhye hetoranvayo ghaṭate, mahānasādau tathāvidhasādhyena dhūmādervyāptyapratīteḥ
anumānavirodhasya iṣṭavighātakṛto viruddhāvyabhicāriṇo vā sarvatrānumāne sambhāvyamānatvācca na viśeṣasyāpi sādhyatvam
nāpi tatsamudāyaḥ; tasyāpyanyatrānanvayāt, nahi yatra yatra dhūma tatra tatra agnimān parvataḥ ityanvayaḥ pratītaḥ
dharmiṇi sādhye hetorananvayitvam, nahi yatra dhūma tatra parvata ityanvaya
api ca anumānasya dharmī, dharma, tatsamudāyo vā sādhya syāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 262
mūlānumānaviṣayāpahāreṇa anumānavirodhasya viśeṣaviruddhāparābhidhānasya iṣṭavighātakṛtaḥ sandehahetoḥ viruddhāvyabhicāriṇo vā sarvatrānumāne sambhāvyamānatvācca duṣprāpaṃ prāmāṇyam
iṣṭasya śabdenā'nupāttasya vighātaṃ karoti viparyayasādhanāt iti iṣṭavighātakṛt nyāyavi॰ pṛ॰ 103
hetoryadātmīyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tadyuktayorhetvo ekatra dharmiṇi virodhinaḥ parasparaviruddhasādhyasādhakatvena upanipāte sati viruddhā'vyabhicārī iti viruddhā'vyabhicāriṇo lakṣaṇam
viruddhāvyabhicārī yathā–anitya śabda kṛtakatvāt ghaṭavat, nitya śabda śrāvaṇatvāt śabdatvavaditi, ubhayo saṃśayahetutvāt dvāvapyetāveko'naikāntika samuditāveva
hetvantarasādhitasya viruddhaṃ yat tanna vyabhicarati sa viruddhāvyabhicārī
yadi vā viruddhaścāso sādhanāntarasiddhasya dharmasya viruddhasādhanāt, avyabhicārī ca svasādhyāvyabhicārāt viruddhāvyabhicārī
dharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi sādhye tadubhayamaghaṭamānameva nāgniviśiṣṭadharādharadharmatayā dhūma prathama ? upalabdhuṃ śakyate
na cāpyevamanvaya–yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agnimān parvata iti
viśeṣe'nugamābhāva sāmānye siddhasādhanam tattvopa॰ pṛ॰ 88, prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 45 u॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 554
prameyakamalāmārttaṇḍasya ṭīppaṇyāṃ pṛ॰ 45 u॰ naṃ॰ 20 tu nānumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt niścayābhāvatastata etadrūpeṇa uttarārddhasya pūrtiḥ dṛśyate
sāhacarye ca sambandhe viśrambha iti mugdhatā | śatakṛtvo'pi taddṛṣṭau vyabhicārasya saṃbhavāt || 2
deśakāladaśābhedavicitrātmasu vastuṣu | avinābhāvaniyamo na śakyo labdhumañjasā || 3
na śakyo vastumāha ca nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 119
na pratyakṣīkṛtā yāvaddhūmāgnivyaktayo'khilāḥ | tāvatsyādapi dhūmo'sau yo'nagneriti śaṅkyate 5
ye tu pratyakṣato viśvaṃ paśyanti hi bhavādṛśaḥ | kiṃ divyacakṣuṣāṃ teṣāmanumāne prayojanam || 6
sāmānyadvārako'pyasti nāvinābhāvaniścayaḥ | vāstavaṃ hi na sāmānyaṃ nāma kiñcana vidyate || 7
bhūyodarśanagamyāpi na vyāptiravakalpate | sahasraśo'pi taddṛṣṭau vyabhicārāvadhāraṇāt || 8
bahukṛtvo'pi vastvātmā tatheti pariniścitaḥ | deśakālādibhedena dṛśyate punaranyathā || 9
bhūyodṛṣṭyā ca dhūmo'gnisahacārīti gamyatām | anagno tu sa nāstīti na bhūyodarśanādgatiḥ 10
na cāpyadṛṣṭimātreṇa gamakaḥ sahacāriṇaḥ | tatraiva niyatatvaṃ hi tadanyā'bhāvapūrvakam || 11
niyamaścānumāṅgatvaṃ gṛhītaḥ pratipadyate | grahaṇañcāsya nānyatra nāstitāniścayaṃ vinā || 12
darśanā'darśanābhyā tu niyamagrahaṇaṃ yadi | tadapyasadanagnau hi dhūmasyeṣṭamadarśanam || 13
anagniśca kiyān sarva jagajjvalanavarjitam | tatra dhūmasya nāstitva naiva paśyantyayoginaḥ 14
anagni ca kriyā sarvam syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 264
tadevaṃ niyamābhāvāt satyapi jñaptyasaṃbhavāt | anumānapramāṇatvadurāśā parimucyatām || 15
anumānavirodho vā yadi veṣṭavighātakṛt | viruddhāvyabhicārī vā sarvatra sulabhodayaḥ || 16
etā saptadaśāpi kārikā nyāyamañjaryāṃ pṛ॰ 119, 120 apica iti kṛtvā, syādvādaratnākare tu pṛ॰ 263, 264 dvitīyām antimāñca kārikā muktvā samuddhṛtā

yattāvaduktam–pratyakṣameva pramāṇam ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; yato'visaṃvādakatvaṃ pramāṇasya lakṣaṇam, tasya ca anumānādau vidyamānatvāt kathaṃ pratyakṣameva pramāṇam ityavadhāraṇaṃ ghaṭate ? tathāhi– anumānaṃ pramāṇam avisaṃvādakatvāt pratyakṣavat
na khalu pratyakṣe'visaṃvādakatvādanyataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ prasiddham, etaccānyatrāpyaviśiṣṭam anumānādināpyavagate'rthe visaṃvādā'sambhavāt
nahi pratyakṣepi tatpramāṇavādinā anyat prāmāṇyavyavasthānibandhanaṃ śakyamādarśayitum anyatra avisaṃvādāt

yacca agauṇatvāt ityuktam, tatra anumānasya kuto gauṇatvam–aviśadasvabhāvatvāt, svārthaniścaye parāpekṣatvāt, visaṃvādakatvāt, pratyakṣapūrvakatvāt, arthādanutpadyamānatvāt, avastuviṣayatvāt, dharmiṇi pakṣaśabdopacarātśabdopacārāt, bādhyamānatvāt, sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratibandhaprasādhakapramāṇā'bhāvādvā ? tatra na tāvadaviśadasvabhāvatvāt; vaiśadyasya pramāṇalakṣaṇatvā'bhāvāt
yadi hi tat pramāṇalakṣaṇaṃ syāt tadā'numānādestannivartamānaṃ prāmāṇyamādāya nivartate ityaprāmāṇyamasyopapannaṃ syāt, na caitattallakṣaṇam; dvicandrādijñāne vaiśadyasadbhāve'pi prāmāṇyā'sambhavāt
tadābhāsena pratipanne tasmin visaṃvāde tasyaiva gauṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ nānyasya, anyathā pratyakṣābhāse visaṃvādadarśanāt satyapratyakṣe'pi gauṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt

kiñca, liṅgādevānumānamutpadyate, tatkathaṃ pratyakṣāttadutpattisambhavaḥ tasya liṅgapratipattāveva vyāpārāt ? astu vā pratyakṣādeva tadutpattiḥ; tathāpi na gauṇatvaṃ tasya tatsāmagrītvāt, svasāmagrītaścopajāyamānasya gauṇatve pratyakṣasyāpi tatprasaṅgaḥ

atha aspaṣṭasvarūpatvāt svārthaniścaye parāpekṣatvāt pratyakṣapūrvakatvāt arthādanupajāyamānatvāt avastuviṣayatvāt, bādhyamānatvād, sādhyasāsādhanayo pratibandhasādhakapramāṇābhāvādvā tasya aprāmāṇyamucyate
yathaiva hi pratyakṣaṃ sākṣāt svārthaparicchittau nānumānādyapekṣaṃ tathā anumānam anumeyanirṇītau na pratyakṣāpekṣam utprekṣate
kiñca, pratyakṣapūrvakatvenānumānasya gauṇatve pratyakṣasyāpi kasyacidanumānapūrvakatvena gauṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ, dṛśyate hi sādhyamarthamanumānānniścitya pravartamānasya anumānapūrvikā pratyakṣapravṛttiḥ
arthādanutpadyamānatvenāsya gauṇatve tu adhyakṣasyāpi tatprasaṅgaḥ; tasyāpyarthādanutpatteḥ pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt
dharmiṇi pakṣaśabdopacārato'pi nāsya gauṇatvasiddhiḥ; saṅkṣepataḥ śabdaracanārthatvāttadupa cārasya
nahi lakṣaṇakārāṇāṃ lāghavena śabdaracanāṃ kurvatāṃ dharmiṇi pakṣaśabdopacāramātreṇa anumānasya gauṇatvaṃ bhavati atiprasaṅgāt
bādhyamānatvañca–samyaganumānasya, anumānābhāsasya vā ? prakṣamapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, satyadhūmādisādhanādagnyādyanumāne bādhā'sambhavāt
anumānābhāsasya tu bādhāsambhave tasyaiva gauṇatvaṃ yukta na samyaganumānasya; anyathā pratyakṣābhāsasya bādhopalambhāt samyakpratyakṣasyāpi gauṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt
tathā ca tatsambandhagrahaṇe pratyakṣaṃ pravarteta anumānaṃ vā ityādi pratyākhyātam, sārvatrikasambandhapratipattau ca yathā tasya sāmarthyaṃ tathā vakṣyate
kiñca, pratyakṣapūrvakatvena anumānasyāprāmāṇye pratyakṣasyāpi kasyacidanumānapūrvakatvena aprāmāṇyānuṣaṅga
pakṣadharmādipadāni yadi nāma vyākhyātṛbhi gauṇāni prayuktāni kimetāvatā pramāṇaṃ gauṇībhavet ? śabdāntareṇa hi tallakṣaṇābhidhāne na kaścid gauṇatādipramādaḥ

kiñca, pratyakṣameva pramāṇaṃ nānumānam iti vidhiniṣedhapratipattau pratyakṣasya sāmarthyam, agauṇatvādiliṅgasyā vā ? na tāvatpratyakṣasya; nahi tad indriyādisāmagrītaḥ samupajātam ahameva pramāṇaṃ nānumānam ityatrārthe samartham, pratiniyatarūpādipratipattāveva asya sāmarthyasambhavāt
apramāṇena ca vyavasthāṃ kurvāṇasya unmattatvaprasaṅgaḥ, nahi pramāṇādṛte prameyavyavasthā yuktā atiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, pratyakṣameva pramāṇam ityabhyupagacchatā pratyakṣamātraṃ pramāṇamabhyupagamyate, tadviśeṣo vā ? prathamapakṣe dvicandrādipratyakṣasyāpi prāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ

dvitīyapakṣe tu ko'yaṃ tadviśeṣo nāma ? yathārthatā iti cet; tarhi yathārthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pramāṇaṃ nā'yathārtham iti yadā paraḥ pratipādyate tadā kāścit pratyakṣavyaktīḥ paridhṛtya yathārthāścāṅgīkṛtya, yadīdṛśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ nānyādṛśam iti pratipādanīyaḥ, etacca pramāṇāntarādvinā na pratipādayituṃ śakyam, na khalu purovartivartamānapratiniyatarūpādiviṣayoparūḍhābhiḥ pratyakṣavyaktibhiḥ etatpratipādayituṃ pāryate

paraśca buddhimattvena stambhādibhyo vilakṣaṇaḥ pratipādyamānārthagrahaṇasamartho niścitaḥ pratipādyaḥ, na ca tanniścaye anumānādanyasya sāmarthyam; pratyakṣasya rūpādimadarthapratipattāveva sāmarthyāt
kathañca anumānānabhyupagame svavyavasthāpitapramāṇa-prameyavyatiriktapramāṇaprameyasya svargā'pūrvadevatādeśca niṣedhaḥ pratyakṣasya atrā'sāmarthyāt ? pramāṇādṛte prameyasiddhau cātiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, anumānāpahnavaḥ tatsvarūpābhāvāt, niravadyatallakṣaṇābhāvādvā syāt ? na tāvat svarūpābhāvāt; tatsvarūpasya akhilalokaprasiddhatvāt
yat svarūpamakhilalokaprasiddhaṃ na tasyāpahnavo yukta yathā pratyakṣasya, akhilalokaprasiddhañcānumānasya svarūpamiti
na cedamasiddham; avalāvālagopālādīnāṃ dhūmādyarthāt pāvakādyarthāntare nirārekaṃ pratyayapratīteḥ
kathaṃ vā tatsvarūpāpalāpe pratyakṣameva pramāṇamagauṇatvāt ityabhidadhataḥ svavacanavirodho na syāt ?
kimayam anumānasvarūpākṣepa eva kriyate uta tattārkikopalakṣitatallakṣaṇākṣepa iti ? tatrānumānasvarūpañca aśakyanihavameva sarvalokaprasiddhatvāt
niravadyatallakṣaṇābhāvo'pyayuktaḥ; sādhanāt sādhyavijñānamanumānam ityādeḥ niravadyatallakṣaṇasya agre pratipādayipyamāṇatvāt
kiñca, yadi parapraṇītaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ sāvadyaṃ tadā tat svayamanavadyamāvedyatām, na punastaddveṣeṇa lakṣyamapyanumānamapahnotuṃ yuktam, nahi prekṣāvān yūkābhayāt paridhānaparityāgaṃ vidadhāti
tadevamanubhavasiddhatvādanumānasvarūpamiva tasya lakṣaṇamapi tāntrikaviracitamavācakaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tatsvayamanavadyamāvedyatā natu taddveṣeṇa lakṣyamapyanumānaṃ nihotuṃ yuktam
yadapyuktam–avasthādeśakālādibhedāt ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; ūhākhyapramāṇaprasādāt samyagavadhṛtāyāṃ vyāptau viplavā'bhāvāt, pramātureva hi tatrāparādho nānumānasya
samyagavadhṛtāyā vyāptau viplavābhāvāt, pramātureva tatrāparādho nānumānasya
tadāhu– pramāturaparādho'yaṃ viśeṣaṃ yo na paśyati
yadapi viśeṣe'nugamābhāvaḥ ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; vyāpti-prayogakālāpekṣayā sādhyasya bhedāt
vyāptau hi sādhyaṃ dharmaḥ, prayogakāle tu tadviśiṣṭo dharmī iti vakṣyati, tatra kathamanugamābhāvaḥ siddhasādhanaṃ vā syāt ?
yaccānyaduktam–sarvatrānumāne'numānavirodhādeḥ saṃbhāvyamānatvāt ityādi; tadapyayuktam; samīcīnasādhane prayukte anumānavirodhāderasambhavāt

na khalu dhūmādisādhane parvatādyagnimattvasiddhau prayukte parvato'yamagnimān na bhavati parvatatvāt tadanyaparvatavat ityanumānavirodhasya, atratyena vā agninā agnimān na bhavati dhūmavattvāt mahānasavat iti viruddhā'vyabhicāriṇaḥ, dhūmādisādhanaṃ yathaivāgnimattvaṃ parvatādeḥ sādhayati tathā nimūla?nirvṛkṣapradeśāgnināpi agnimattvaṃ sādhayati, mahānasādau tathādarśanāt itīṣṭavighātakṛto vā saṃbhavaḥ; pratyakṣādiviruddhatvena asyānumānābhāsatvāt
nirbādhaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ kasyacit sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā yuktaṃ nānyat, atiprasaṅgāt
tato'numānādeḥ pramāṇāntaratvopapatteḥ sūktam aviśadanirbhāminaḥ parokṣatā iti
tathā ca pratyakṣa-parokṣayoḥ vibhinnasvarūpatvāt parasparataḥ siddho bhedaḥ
yayorvibhinnasvarūpatvaṃ tayoḥ parasparato bhedaḥ yathā jalānalayoḥ, vibhinnasvarūpatvañca viśadetarasvabhāvatayā pratyakṣaparokṣayoriti
vastubalapravṛttānumāne viṣaye na viruddhāvyabhicārī ca saṃbhavati
ke punarbuddhervaiśadyā'vaiśadye yadupetatvena pratyakṣetarayorbhedaḥ syāt ? iti ceducyate–
yāvajjñeyavyāpijñānarahitasakalapuruṣapariṣatparijñānasya tadantareṇā'nupapatteḥ, tadabhāvatattvajño na kaścit anupalabdheḥ khapuṣpavat
na vai jaiminiḥ anyo vā tadabhāvatattvajñaḥ sattvapuruṣatvavaktṛtvādeḥ rathyāpuruṣavat

puruṣātiśayasambhave'tīndriyārthadarśī kinna syāt ? atra anupalambhamapramāṇayan sarvajñādiviśeṣā'bhāve kutaḥ pramāṇayed abhedāt ? sādhakabādhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt tatra saṃśītiḥ ityanena pratyuktā; bādhakasyaivā'sambhavāt

anumānādibhyo'tirekeṇa ādhikyena varṇasaṃsthānādiviśeṣarūpatayā arthagrahaṇalakṣaṇena pracurataraviśeṣānvitārthāvadhāraṇarūpeṇa vā yad viśeṣāṇāṃ niyatadeśakālasaṃsthānādyarthākārāṇāṃ pratibhāsanaṃ tadbuddhervaiśadyama- bhipretam
asmāt param anyathābhūtaṃ yadviśeṣā'pratibhāsanaṃ tad avaiśadyam iti
svarūpāpekṣayā ca sarvaṃ jñānaṃ viśadameva, parisphuṭarūpatayā svarūpasya sarvajñānānāṃ svasaṃvedane pratibhāsanāt
bahirarthastu keṣāñcijjñānānāṃ parisphuṭarūpatayā pratibhāti keṣāñcittu tadviparītatayā, atastadapekṣayā teṣāṃ vaiśadyāvaiśadye pratipattavye
sarvasavitte svasaṃvedanasya kathañcit pramāṇatvopapatte tadapekṣāyā sarvaṃ pratyakṣam na kaścit pramāṇābhāsa
bahirarthagrahaṇāpekṣayā hi vijñānānā pratyakṣetaravyapadeśa, tatra pramāṇāntaravyavadhānā'vyavadhānasadbhāvena vaiśadyetarasambhavāt natu svarūpagrahaṇāpekṣayā tatra tadabhāvāt
taccedaṃ vaiśadyalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dviprakāraṃ bhavati–gauṇam, mukhyañceti
ayamarthaḥ–yad indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnām anindriyasya ca manasaḥ kāryam aṃśato viśadaṃ vijñānaṃ tat sāṃvyavahārikaṃ gauṇapratyakṣam ityarthaḥ

nanu ca indriyānindriyapratyakṣam ityanena sāṃvyavahārikapratyakṣasya sāmagrīprarūpaṇamayuktam; tatkāraṇasya ātmārthālokāderatrāsaṅgrahāt; iti cenna; asādhāraṇasyaiva tatkāraṇasyātra prarūpayitumabhipretatvāt
nacātmanaḥ samanantarapratyayasya vā pratyakṣaṃ pratyasādhāraṇakāraṇatvaṃ saṃbhavati; pratyayāntare'pyasyāviśiṣṭatvāt
nāpi sannikarṣādeḥ; tatra tatkāraṇatvasya prāgeva pratiṣedhāt, avyāpakatvāccāsya na tatkāraṇatvam, nahi cakṣūrūpayoḥ sannikarṣo'sti aprāpyakāritvāccakṣuṣaḥ
nanu cāsyā'prāpyakāritvapratijñā pramāṇaviruddhā; tathāhi–prāpyakāri cakṣuḥ bāhyendriyatvāt, yad bāhyendriyaṃ tatprāpyakāri pratipannam yathā tvagādi, bāhyendriyañca cakṣuḥ, tasmāt prāpyakāri
indriyatvāt ityucyamāne hi manasā vyabhicāraḥ syāt, tatparihārārthaṃ bāhyaviśeṣaṇam

atha matam–adhiṣṭhānadeśa eva cakṣuḥ nānyatra, adhiṣṭhānapidhāne viṣayāgrāhakatvāt; yad yad adhiṣṭhānapidhāne viṣayāgrāhakaṃ tattat adhiṣṭhānadeśa eva yathā ghrāṇādi, adhiṣṭhānapidhāne viṣayāgrāhakañca cakṣuḥ, tasmāt taddeśa eva, ataḥ kathamasya prāpyakāritvaṃ syāditi ? tadapi na saṅgatam; yataḥ adhiṣṭhānadeśa eva iti ko'rthaḥ ? kim adhiṣṭhānadeśe sat, uta adhiṣṭhānādavyatiriktam, tato'nyatra asaditi vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; adhiṣṭhānadeśe sattvasya prāpyakāritvāvirodhāt, nahyadhiṣṭhānadeśe sataḥ sparśanādeḥ prāpyakāritvavirodho dṛṣṭaḥ
dvitīyavikalpo'pyanupapannaḥ; adhiṣṭhānādavyatiriktatvasya kvacidapi indriye'prasiddheḥ, na khalu sparśanāderapi adhiṣṭhānādavyatiriktatvam ubhayo prasiddham
adhiṣṭhānaṃ hi golakarūpam, tasmānnisṛtāḥ raśmayo'rthadeśaṃ yāvat prasṛtāḥ santi pradīpānnisṛtaraśmivat
adhiṣṭhānapidhāne viṣayāgrāhakatvañca na prāpyakāritvaṃ vihanti ghrāṇādestatsadbhāve'pi prāpyakāritvā'virodhāt
nacedamapyasiddhaṃ tata eva, tathāhi–taijasaṃ cakṣuḥ rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt tadvadeva, ato raśmivattvasyātra prasiddheḥ
prāpyakāritve cakṣuṣo mahataḥ parvatāderaprakāśaprasaṅgaḥ ityetatpratyākhyātam, dhattūrakapuṣpavad ādau sūkṣmāṇāmapyante mahattvopapattestadraśmīnām
te hi ālokamilitā yāvadarthaṃ varddhante, mahataḥ parvatādeḥ prakāśakatvānyathānupapatte

nanu cakṣuṣaḥ prāpyakāritve kathaṃ śākhācandramasoryugapadgrahaṇam ? ityapi vārtam; yugapad grahaṇa syāsiddhatvāt; prathamato hi cakṣuḥ sannikṛṣṭāṃ śākhāṃ prāpya prakāśayati, paścādviprakṛṣṭaṃ candramasam, yugapatpratipattyabhimānastu utpalapatraśatavyatibhedavad bhrāntinibandhanaḥ
dūranikaṭādivyabahāro'pi cakṣuṣaḥ prāpyakāritve na durghaṭaḥ; śarīrāpekṣayā cakṣurviṣayasya sannikṛṣṭa-viprakṛṣṭatopapattitastasya sughaṭatvāt

yadi cāprāpyakāri cakṣuḥ syāttarhi kuḍyādyavyavahitavat tadvyavahitamyāpi ghaṭādermervādeścānekayojanaśatavyavahitasyāpi tat prakāśakaṃ syāt kvacitpratyāsattiviprakarpā'bhāvāt, na caivam, ataḥ prāpyakāri tat pratipattavyam
atha prāpyakāritve cakṣuṣa kiṃ pramāṇam ? indriyatvameva, prāpyakāri cakṣu indriyatvāt ghrāṇādivat
prāptaprakāśaka cakṣu vyavahitārthā'prakāśakatvāt pradīpavat, bāhyendriyatvāt tvagindriyavat
cakṣu śrotre prāpyārthaṃ paricchindāte bāhyendriyatvāt tvagindriyavat
iha kecidāhu–aprāpyakāri cakṣuḥ adhiṣṭhānā'sambaddhārthagrāhakatvāt tadasat, adhiṣṭhānāsambaddhārthagrāhitvasya pradīpenānaikāntikatvāt
tayormahadaṇvorgrahaṇa cakṣūraśmerarthasya ca sannikarṣaviśeṣād bhavati yathā pradīparaśmerarthasya ca iti
kṛṣṇasāraṃ raśmivat dravyatve sati rūpopalabdhau niyatasya sādhanāṅgasya nimittatvāt pradīpavad iti
athavā, raśmivaccakṣu dravyatve sati niya..tve ca sati sphaṭikādivyavahitārthaprakāśakatvāt pradīpavat
taijasatva tu tasya rūpādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpasyābhivyañjakatvāt pradīpavat
yadgandhādyavyañjakatve sati rūpasya vyañjakam indriya tattaijasam taijasatve ca sparśādyavyañjakatve sati rūpābhivyañjakatvaṃ pradīpavat praśa॰ kiraṇāvalī pṛ॰ 73
cakṣustaijasa parakīyasparśādyavyañjakatve sati parakīyarūpavyañjakatvāt pradīpavat muktāvalī pṛ॰ 176
yacca mahadaṇuprakāśakatva tadapyanyathāsiddhatvādasādhanam, tathāhi–cakṣurvahirgata bāhyālokasambandhādviṣayaparimāṇamutpadyate praśa॰ vyomavatī pṛ॰ 159
pṛthutaragrahaṇasyāpi pṛthvagratayā tadvadevopapatte praśa॰ kiraṇāvalī pṛ॰ 74
yatpunaretat śākhācandramaso tulyakālagrahaṇāt iti, tadapi na, anabhyupagamāt
ko hi svasthātmā śākhācandramaso tulyakālagrahaṇaṃ pratipadyate ? vālabhedāgrahaṇāt mithyāpratyaya eṣa utpaladalaśatavyatibhedavat iti
samasamayasavedane tu kecitparihāramevaṃ varṇayanti–sakalānarthān vyāpya yugapadavasthitena bāhyena tejasā saha ekībhūtāste cākṣuṣā raśmaya yugapad grahaṇahetava iti
tatra apare dūṣayanti–ittha prāptāvabhyupagamyamānāyām atidūravyavahitānāmapyarthānāṃ grahaṇa durnivāram
anye tvāhu kṣepīyastayā teṣā raśmīnā kālabhedānavagrahādyaugapadyābhimāna iti
tadapyanye nānumanyante–atisannikṛṣṭeṣu vastuṣu kālabheda padmapatraśatavyatibhedavanmā nāmāvasāyi
anekayojanasahasrāntariteṣu bhūmiṣṭheṣvartheṣu dhruve ca kālabhedānadhyavasāyo na buddhimanurañjayatīti

vayaṃ tu vadāma adṛṣṭasāpekṣatvādadoṣa, nayanaraśmibhirekībhūte'pi bāhye tejasi yāvāneva tasya bhāga adṛṣṭa vaśena upalabdhihetutayā upātta tāvāneva upalabdhaye prabhavati na sarva, iti na sarvopalambha yugapacca bhaumadhruvādidarśanasiddhi
yatra indriya śarīrañca arthena sambaddhyate tatra digdeśavyapadeśo na bhavati dūrāntikānuvidhānaṃ vā
yatra tu indriyameva kevalaṃ sambaddhyate tatra śarīramavadhiṃ kṛtvā sayuktasaṃyogālpīyastvaṃ bhūyastvaṃ vā'pekṣyamāṇasya digdeśapratyayā sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭapratyayāśca bhavanti

indriyasambandhasya atīndriyatvāt na tadbhāvā'bhāvakṛtau sāntaranirantarapratyayau, kintu śarīrasambandhabhāvābhāvakṛtau, yatra śarīrasambaddhasyārthasya grahaṇa tatra nirantaro'yam iti pratyaya, yatra tu tadasambaddhasya tatra sāntara iti praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 24
yadyaprāpyakāri cakṣu bhavati na kuḍyakaṭāde āvaraṇasya sāmarthyamasti ityavaraṇānupapatti syāt
ye punarapyakāri cakṣurāhu teṣā vyavahitapiprakṛṣṭārthagrahaṇaṃ durnivāram sannidhāna iva viprakṛṣṭe'pi sphuṭataramaṇīyāsopyarthā gṛhyeran
kārakatvācca; yat kārakaṃ tat prāpyakāri yathā vāsyādi, kārakañca cakṣuriti
karaṇa vāsyādi prāpyakāri dṛṣṭaṃ tathā ca indriyāṇi, tasmāt prāpyakārīṇi

yattāvaduktam–bāhyendriyatvāt iti; tatra kimidaṃ bāhyendriyatvaṃ nāma ? bahirarthagrahaṇābhimukhyam, bahirdeśāvasthāyitvam, bahiḥkāraṇaprabhavatvam, indriyasvarūpātītatvam, mano'nyatvaṃ vā syāt ? tatrādyavikalpe manasā'nekāntaḥ; tasyāprāpyakāritve'pi bahirarthagrahaṇābhimukhyato bāhyendriyatvasadbhāvāt

dvitīyavikalpe'pi raśmirūpasya, golakaravabhāvasya vā cakṣuṣo bahirdeśe'vasthāyitvaṃ syāt ? prathamapakṣe kimidaṃ tatra tasyāvasthāyitvam–āśritatvam, prakāśakatvena pravṛttirvā ? tatrādyavikalpe apasiddhāntaḥ; raśmirūpa sya cakṣuṣo bhavatā bahirdeśāśritatvasyānabhyupagamāt, golakāntargatatejodravyāśrayā hi raśmayo bhavadbhiḥ pratijñātāḥ
dvitīyavikalpe tvasiddho hetuḥ; raśmirūpasya cakṣuṣo grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvataḥ prakāśakatvena bahirdeśe tatpravṛtterasiddheḥ
golakasvabhāvasya tu cakṣuṣo bahirdeśāvasthāyitve pratyakṣabādhā; arthadeśāsambaddhasyāsya śarīrapradeśa eva pratyakṣataḥ pratīte

bahiḥkāraṇaprabhavatvamapi manasaivā'naikāntikam, ātmāpekṣayā hi bahiḥkāraṇaṃ pudgalatattvam tatprabhavatvañca cakṣurādīndriyavat manaso'styeva, asyāpi paudgalikatvena ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ prasādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt
mano'nyatvamapi manasa siddhau siddhyeta, na ca tatsiddhaṃ bhavatparikalpitasya manasa ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt

siddhyatu vā, tathāpi bāhyendriyatvaṃ mano'nyatve satīndriyatvam ucyate, tatra ca manovyavacchedārthaṃ bāhyaviśeṣaṇamayuktam, tasyāpi sarvatra prāpyakāritvāt, sukhādau hi saṃyuktasamavāyādisambandhāt, vyāptau tu sambandhasambandhāt taj jñānamutpādayati rūpādau netrādivat, na khalu rūpādau netrāderapi sambandhasambandhādanyaḥ sambandho'sti
ki bahirarthagrahaṇābhimukhyam, bahirdeśāvasthāyitvam bahi kāraṇaprabhavatya vā syāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 328
ātmāpekṣayā hi bahi kāraṇaṃ pudgalatattva tatprabhavatvañca cakṣurādīndriyavat manaso'pyastyeva

dharmitvena cātropāttaṃ cakṣuḥ golakasvabhāvam, raśmirūpaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ; arthenāsambaddhasya arthadeśaparihāreṇa śarīrapradeśa eva golakasvabhāvasya cakṣuṣaḥ pratyakṣata pratīteḥ, anyathā tadrahitatvena nayanapakṣmapradeśasyopalambhaḥ syāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu dharmiṇo'siddhiḥ, raśmirūpasya cakṣuṣa kutaścitpramāṇādaprasiddhe

tatsādhakaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvatpratyakṣam, arthavattatra tatsvarūpā'pratīteḥ na khalu raśmayaḥ pratyakṣata pratīyante vipratipattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt, nahi nīle nīlatayā pratīyamāne kaścid vipratipadyate
kiñca, indriyārthasannikarṣajaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bhavanmate, na cārthadeśe vidyamānaistai aparendriyasya sannikarṣo'sti yatastatra pratyakṣamutpadyeta anavasthāprasaṅgāt
anumānato'pi ataeva, anyato vā tatsiddhi syāt ? yadi ataeva; anyonyāśraya–prasiddhe hi anumānotthāne'tastatsiddhiḥ, asyāścānumānotthānamiti
cakṣuścātra dharmitvenopātta golakasvabhāva raśmirūpaṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 59 u॰
etena yaduktaṃ raśmiprasādhakamanumānam–raśmivaccakṣu taijasatvāt iti; tatpratyākhyātam, uktapakṣadoṣāṇāmatrāpyaviśeṣāt
kiñca, raśmivattā golakarūpasya cakṣuṣaḥ prasādhyate, tadvyati riktasya vā ? na tāvattadvyatiriktasya; tasyāsiddhasvarūpatvāt, apasiddhāntaprasaṅgācca
golakarūpasya tu tatsādhane pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhā; prabhāsuraprabhārahitasya golakasya pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ

atha adṛśyāstadraśmayaḥ anudbhūtarūpa sparśavattvāt, ato nāsya pratyakṣabādhā; kathamevaṃ rūpaprakāśakatvaṃ tasya syāt ? tathāhi–cakṣū rūpaprakāśakaṃ na bhavati, anudbhūtarūpatvāt, jalasaṃyuktānalavat
dṛṣṭānusāreṇa cādṛṣṭārthakalpanā, anyathā pṛthivyāderapi tadvattāprasaṅgaḥ; tathāhi–raśmivantaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ dravyatvāt pradīpavat
yathaiva hi taijasatvaṃ raśmivattayā vyāptaṃ pradīpe pratipannaṃ tathā dravyatvamapi
atha tatasteṣāṃ tatsādhane pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, so'nyatrāpi samānaḥ

atha mārjārādicakṣuṣoḥ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyante raśmayaḥ, tatkathaṃ tadvirodhaḥ ? yadi nāma tatra te pratīyante anyatra kimāyātam ? anyathā henni pītatvasya suvarṇatvena vyāptipratipatteḥ paṭādau pītatvopalambhāt suvarṇatvasiddhiḥ syāt
raśmivattve cāsya arthaprakāśane ālokāpekṣā na syāt; tathāhi–yad raśmivat tadarthaprakāśane nālokāpekṣaṃ yathā pradīpaḥ, raśmivacca bhavadbhirabhipretaṃ cakṣuriti
tathā tadvattve svasambaddhasyāñjanādeḥ prakāśakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, na khalu pradīpastadvān svasambaddhaṃ śalākādikaṃ na prakāśayati iti prātītikam
iti siddha ? na netrasya jyotiṣkatva prasādhayet
anudbhūtarūpaścāyaṃ nāyano raśmiḥ tasmāt pratyakṣato nopalabhyate iti
dṛṣṭaśca tejaso dharmabhedaḥ–udbhūtarūpasparśaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tejaḥ yathā ādityaraśmayaḥ
udbhūtarūpamanudbhūtasparśaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ tejaḥ yathā pradīparaśmayaḥ
cākṣuṣe ca raśmau rūpasaṃskāraḥ rūpodbhavo nāsti
madhyandinolkāprakāśe ca rūpasaṃskāro rūpānabhibhavo nāsti iti na teṣāṃ pratyakṣatā
dṛśyante hi naktaṃ nayanaraśmayaḥ naktañcarāṇāṃ vṛṣadaṃśaprabhṛtīnām, tena śeṣasyānumānāmāta
yadi ca prāpyakāri cakṣuḥ syāt tadā atyabhyāsepi paśyedakṣisthām añjanaśalākām, dūre ca vyaktadarśanaṃ syāt
prayogaḥ–yad raśmivat tatsvasambaddhamarthaṃ prakāśayatyeva yathā pradīpaḥ, raśmivacca cakṣuḥ, tasmātsvasambaddhaṃ kāmalādikaṃ prakāśayedeva

na cātra cakṣuṣaḥ sambandho'pi nāsti ityabhidhātavyam; yato golakasvarūpaṃ cakṣustatrāsambaddham, raśmirūpam, śaktisvabhāvaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ; golakasvarūpasya cakṣuṣaḥ kācādau sambandhapratīteḥ
dvitīyapakṣe'pi tatrāsya sambandho' styeva, nahi sphaṭikādikūpikāmadhyagatapradīpādiraśmayaḥ tato nirgacchantaḥ tatsaṃyoginā na sambaddhā tatprakāśakā vā na bhavantīti pratīti
śaktirūpamapi cakṣuḥ vyaktirūpacakṣuṣo bhinnadeśam, abhinnadeśaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvadbhinnadeśam, tacchaktitvavyāghātānuṣaṅgāt, nirāśrayatvaprasaṅgācca
atha tato'bhinnadeśam; tattatra sambaddham, asambaddhaṃ vā ? yadi sambaddham; bahirarthavat svāśrayaṃ tatsambaddhañcāñjanādikaṃ prakāśayet
yato vyaktirūpaṃ cakṣuḥ tatra asambaddhaṃ śaktisvabhāvaṃ vā raśmirūpaṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 59 u॰
taddhi golakasvarūpasya cakṣuṣo'bhyupagamyeta, raśmirūpasya vā ? yadi golakasvarūpasya; tadā'dhyakṣabādhā, bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśarahitasyāsya adhyakṣataḥ pratīte

anumānabādhaśca, tathāhi–cakṣurataijasaṃ na bhavati, bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśarahitatvāt, yad yattathāvidhaṃ tat tattat taijasaṃ na bhavati yathā mṛtpiṇḍādiḥ, bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśarahitañca cakṣuḥ, tasmāttaijasaṃ na bhavatīti
tathā, na taijasaṃ cakṣu, tamaḥprakāśakatvāt, yatpunastaijasaṃ tanna tama prakāśakaṃ yathā āloka, tamaprakāśakañca cakṣu, tasmānna taijasamiti
raśmirūpasya tu cakṣupo'siddhasvarūpatvānna taijasatvamupapadyate, na khalu raśmayaḥ pratyakṣādita prasiddhyantītyuktam

nanu mārjārādinetre netratvaṃ raśmivattayā vyāptaṃ pratipannam, ato'nyatrāpi manuṣyādinetre netratvādraśmivattvaṃ tatastaijasatvañca prasādhyate, tarhi gavādinetre netratvaṃ kṛṣṇatvena naranārinetre ca dhāvalyena vyāptaṃ pratipannam, ato'viśeṣeṇa kārṣṇyaṃ dhāvalyaṃ vā pārthivatvam āpyatvaṃ vā prasādhyatām aviśeṣāt
yadapi–rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt iti tattaijasatve sādhanamabhihitam, tadapi jalā'ñjana-candra-māṇikyādibhiranaikāntikam
na caitadvaktavyam–jalādīn prati gatvā vyāvṛttānāṃ cakṣūraśmīnāmeva tatprakāśakatvam, na jalādīnām iti, sarvatra dṛṣṭahetuvaiphalyāpatte
tathā ca dṛṣṭāntā'siddhi, pradīpādāvapi anyasyaiva tatprakāśakatvaprasaṅgāt, pratyakṣabādhanam ubhayatra
rūpaprakāśakatvañca rūpasyānubhava, tatra jñānajanakatvaṃ vā ? prathamavikalpe rūpajñānenānekānta, tasyātaijasatve'pi rūpānubhavasambhavāt
dvitīyavikalpe tu ghaṭādirūpeṇānekānta, tasyā'taijasa syāpi rūpajñānajanakatvābhyupagamāt
karaṇatve sati iti viśeṣaṇe'pi ālokārthasannikarṣeṇa cakṣūrūpayoḥ saṃyuktasamavāyena cānekāntaḥ, dravyatve sati iti viśeṣaṇe'pi candrādinā'nekāntaḥ
ataścakṣuṣā kutaścittaijasatvā'siddheḥ kathaṃ raśmivattvaṃ siddhyet yataḥ prāpyakāritvaṃ syāt ?
rūpādīnā madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt iti hetuśca jalājanacandramāṇikyādibhiranaikāntika

kiñca, asya prāpyakāritve viṣayaścakṣurdeśamāgacchet, cakṣurvā viṣayadeśam ? tatrādyavikalpe pratyakṣabādhā; cakṣuḥpradeśe viṣayasya gamanā'pratīteḥ, na hi cakṣuḥpradeśe parvatāderviṣayasyāgamanaṃ kenacid dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā'nupahatacetasā
dvitīyavikalpe'pi adhyakṣavirodhaḥ; viṣayaṃ prati cakṣuṣo gamanā'pratīteḥ, cakṣurgatvā nārthenābhisambaddhyate, indriyatvāt, tvagādivat ityanumānavirodhaśca
tadaviśeṣe'pi dṛṣṭātikrameṇa kasyacit tatra gatvā sambandhābhyupagame yathāpratīti asambandha eva kinnābhyupagabhyate alaṃ pratītyapalāpena ?
kiñca, cakṣurgatvā saṃyujya arthaṃ ced dyotayati, tarhi yathā viprakṛṣṭasyā''dityādeḥ saṃyuktasamavāyād rūpaṃ dyotayati, evaṃ karmā'pi dyotayet saṃyuktasamavāyā'viśeṣāt

kathañcaivaṃvādinaḥ kācā'bhrapaṭala-svacchodaka-sphaṭikādyantaritārthānāmupalambhaḥ syāt cakṣuṣastatra gacchataḥ kācādyavayavinā pratibandhāt ? atha kācādikaṃ bhittvā cakṣūraśmayo'rthadeśaṃ gacchanti; tarhi tadvyavahitārthopalambhasamaye kācāderanupalambhaḥ, tadādheyadravyasya pātaśca syāt tadādhārasyāvayavino nāśāt, na caivam, yugapattayornirantaramupalambhāt
pūrvapūrvavyūhanivṛttau uttarottaratadrūpavyūhāntarasyāśūtpatteḥ pradīpāgnijvālāvat nirantaratābhrame saugatamatasiddhiḥ; sarvārthānāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇikatve'pi itthaṃ nirantaratābhramaprasaṅgāt
etena śākhācandramasoḥ krameṇānubhave'pi āśuvṛttyotpalapatraśatavyatibhedavad yugapatpratipattyabhimāno bhrāntinibandhanaḥ iti pratyākhyātam
atyabhyāse ca dūre ca rūpaṃ vyakta na tatra kim
yadi cakṣu prāpyakāritvād viṣayadeśaṃ gacchettadā unmiṣitamātreṇa na candratārakādīnarthān gṛhṇīyāt
kācena abhrapaṭalena sphaṭikena ambunā ca antarita vyavahitaṃ rūpaṃ katha dṛśyate sapratighatvāt ? kācādivyavahitaṃ cakṣurna paśyet, tacca paśyati iti siddhānta
atha pūrvapūrvakācādivyūha nibṛttau uttarottaratadrūpavyūhāntarasyopapatteḥ pradīpajvālāvat nirantaratābhrānti ityucyate syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 326
yaccānyaduktam–śarīrāpekṣayā cakṣurviṣayasya sannikṛṣṭa-viprakṛṣṭatopapatterdūranikaṭādivyavahāraḥ suvaṭaḥ iti; tadapi śraddhāmātram; indriyasannikarṣeṇāsya pratipattau tathā tadvyavahārānupapatteḥ
tathāhi–yad indriyasannikarṣeṇa pratīyate na tatra dūranikaṭādivyavahāraḥ yathā rasādau, indriyasannikarṣeṇa pratīyate ca cakṣurviṣaya iti
prāpyakāritve ca cakṣuṣaḥ saṃśaya-viparyayānupapattiḥ; sāmānyavad viśeṣāṇāmapi sannikṛṣṭānāmupalambhasaṃbhavāt
na ca cakṣuṣā sannikṛṣṭa tvā'viśeṣe'pi sāmānyamevopalabhyate na viśeṣaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; viśeṣābhāvāt

na cāprāpyakāritve sakalārthaprakāśakatvaprasaṅgaḥ; yogyadeśāpekṣaṇād ayaskāntavat, nahi ayaskānto'yaso'prāptasyākarṣaṇe pravartamānaḥ sarvasyāyasaḥ tathāvidhasyākarṣaṇe samarthaḥ, api tu yogyadeśasthasyaiva
añjana-tilaka-mantrādirvā aprāptasyāpi stryāderākarṣakaḥ san na sarvasyākarṣako dṛṣṭa niyatasyaiva stryādeḥ tenākarṣaṇopalambhāt

bhavato'pi ca cakṣūraśmayo lokāntaṃ gatvā kimiti rūpaṃ na prakāśayanti, cakṣurvā saṃyuktasamavāyād yathā rūpaṃ prakāśayati tathā gandhādikamapi kimiti na prakāśayet tatrāpi tasyāviśeṣāt ? iti codye yogyataiva śaraṇam
aprāpyakāritve saṃśayaviparyayābhāva iti cet prāpyakāritve'pi tadaviśeṣāt tattvārtharājavā॰ pṛ॰ 48
atha dūṣaṇaṃ sarvāprāptagrāhakatvaṃ cakṣu śrotralakṣaṇasya dharmiṇa prasajyate, tadadūṣaṇam; anumānabādhāt
kathamityāha–kathaṃ tāvadayaskānto na sarvamaprāptamaya karṣati iti
na sarvāprāptagrāhakaṃ cakṣu śrotraṃ sarvāprāptagrahaṇaśaktihīnatvāt ayaskāntavat
ayaskānto hi aprāptamayo gṛhṇātina sarvamaprāptaṃ gṛhṇāti athavā na sarvasvagrāhyagrāhi cakṣu śrotraṃ indriyasvābhāvyāt
aprāpyakāritve vyavahitātiviprakṛṣṭagrahaṇaprasaṅga iti cenna, ayaskāntenaiva pratyuktatvāt
ayaskāntopalam aprāpya lohamākarṣadapi na vyavahitamākarṣati nātiviprakṛṣṭam
yadapi kārakatvāt ityuktam; tadapi manasā ayaskāntā'ñjanatilakamantrādinā cānaikāntikam, tasya kārakatve'pi aprāpyakāritvāt

yadapi atyāsannārthā'prakāśakatvāt ityasya sādhyāviśiṣṭatvamuktam; tadapyayuktam; prasaṅgasādhanatvādetasya, śrotrādau hi prāpyakāritvā'tyāsannārthaprakāśakatvayoḥ vyāpya-vyāpakabhāvasiddhau satyāṃ parasya vyāpakābhāveṣṭyā atyāsannārthā'prakāśakatvalakṣaṇayā aniṣṭasya prāpyakāritvalakṣaṇavyāpyābhāvasya āpādanamātramevānena vidhīyate iti
atha prāpyakāri cakṣu karaṇatvāt vāsyādivat iti brūṣe tarhi ayaskāntākarṣaṇopalena lohāsannikṛṣṭena vyabhicāra
bauddhāḥ tvag-ghrāṇa-rasanānāṃ prāpyakāritva cakṣu śrotrayoraprāpyakāritvañca svīkurvate
jaināstu tvag-ghrāṇa-rasana-śrotrāṇā prāpyakāritvaṃ cakṣuṣaśca aprāpyakāritvaṃ sādhayanti
viśeṣāva॰ bhā॰ gā॰ 204-212 pṛ॰ 122, tathā gā॰ 336-340 pṛ॰ 199
nanu śrotrādau hi ityādyayuktamuktam, cakṣaṣo'prāpyakāritve sādhye śrotrasya vipakṣatānupapatteḥ tadvattasyāpyaprāpyakāritvāt
prāpyakāritvecāsya tadviṣaye dūrādivyavahāro na syāt, asti cātrāyam dūre śabdaḥ nikaṭe śabda iti vyavahāropalambhāt, ato'prāpyakāritvamevāsyopapannam
tathā ca prayogaḥ–śabdaḥ svagrāhakeṇa asannikṛṣṭa eva gṛhyate, dūrādipratyayagrāhyatvāt, pādapādivat
na cāsannikṛṣṭasya śabdasya grahaṇe kathaṃ tataḥ śrotrābhighātaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; bhāsurarūpasyāsannikṛṣṭasya grahaṇe'pi ataścakṣuṣo'bhighātopalambhāt
iyāṃstu viśeṣa atra tejasvitā'bhighātahetuḥ, śabde tu tīvrateti
cakṣu-śrotra-mano'prāptaviṣayam upāttānupāttamahāhetuḥ śabda iti siddhāntāt tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 603
cakṣu śrotramanasām aprāptārthakāritvam sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 545
iyāstu viśeṣa atra tejasvitā abhighātahetu śabde tu tīvratā

yattāvaduktam–śabdaḥ svagrāhakeṇāsannikṛṣṭa eva gṛhyate ityādi; tatra pakṣasyādhyakṣabādhā; karṇaśaṣkulyantaḥpraviṣṭasya maśakādiśabdasya prakāśakatvena śrotrasyādhyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ, ato'gnāvanuṣṇatvavat svagrāhakeṇāsannikṛṣṭatvaṃ śabdasyādhyakṣabādhitam
hetuśca gandhenānaikāntikaḥ; tasya svagrāhakeṇa sannikṛṣṭasya grahaṇe'pi dūrādipratyayagrāhyatvapratīteḥ
na ca tathā pratīyamāne gandhe dūra-nikaṭādivyavahāro'siddha; dūre padmagandhaḥ, nikaṭe mālatīgandhaḥ ityādivyavahārasya loke suprasiddhatvāt

aprāpyakāritve śrotrasya cakṣuṣa iva atyāsannaviṣayaprakāśakatvaṃ na syāt iti maśakādiśabdasya prāptasya pratyakṣata prakāśakatvena pratīyamānasya aprāptārthaprakāśakatvaṃ tasya adhyakṣabādhitam agnau anuṣṇatvavat
kiñca, dūrādipratyayagrāhyatvaṃ sākārajñānapakṣamabhyupagamya ucyate, nirākārajñānapakṣaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; svajñānagatasya śabdākārasya grahaṇe dūra-nikaṭavyavahārānupapatteḥ
yasya hi nirākār ajñānaṃ bhinnadeśamartha vetti tasya idaṃ dūram, idaṃ nikaṭam iti vaktuṃ yuktam

sākārajñānavādina puna yad dūrādi na tajjñānavedyam, avedye ca na dūrādivyavahāro yukta, na hyandhasya kiñciddūra nikaṭaṃvā iti vyavahārastāttviko'sti; yacca vedyaṃ jñānasya svākāramātram na taddūrādi, jñānasvarūpādabhinnatvāt
nahi jñānasya svarūpa sukhādayo vā jñānādabhinnāḥ pratīyamānāḥ dūrādivyavahārabhājaḥ pratīyante, sarvatra āsannavyavahārocchedaprasaṅgāt
athātrāpi ākārādhāyakasya dūrāditvād dūrādivyavahāra, vyarthastarhi tadaprāpyakāritvaprasādhanaprayāsa, karṇaśaṣkulipraviṣṭaśabdagrahaṇe'pi dūrādivyavahārasya tanmūlakāraṇadūrāditvenopapadyamānatvāt
dṛśyate hi gandhasya ghrāṇendriyasannikṛṣṭasya grahaṇe'pi tanmūlakāraṇadūrāditvena dūre padmagandhaḥ ityādivyavahāraḥ
yata sākārajñānapakṣe anākārajñānapakṣe vāyamabhyupagama iti vācyam
