kiñca, svarūpata eva śabdo dūrādisvabhāva, dūrādikāraṇaprabhavatvāt, dūrādideśādāgatatvāt, dūrādideśe sthitatvādvā ? na tāvatsvarūpata; nikaṭasyāpi tathāvyavahāraprasaṅgāt
dūrādikāraṇaprabhavatvena cāsya dūrādivyavahārārhatve nātaḥ svagrāhakeṇāsannikṛṣṭasya grahaṇasiddhiḥ, gandhenānaikāntikatvapratipādanāt

atha dūrādideśādāgatatvāt śabdasya dūrāditvam, yuktamidaṃ tathaivāsya tadrūpatopapattergandhādivat, dūrādipradeśādāgato hi gandha śabdo vā svendriyasannikarṣeṇa pratīyamāno'pi yogyatāviśeṣavaśāt sannikṛṣṭa-viprakṛṣṭatayā pratīyate
kiṃ svabhāvat evāsya dūratvāditvāt, dūrādikāraṇaprabhavatvāt, dūrādideśe sthitatvādvā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 335
dūrādideśe sthitatvāttu tasya dūrāditve svottpattideśasthā eva śabdā śrotrairgṛhyante na vāgatāḥ ityabhyupagataṃ syāt

tathā ca yo nirvāte dūrasthena manāgapi na śrūyate śabdaḥ so'nukūlavāte kathaṃ śrūyeta ? yaśca āsannena śrūyate sa eva prativāte kasmāttena na śrūyate; tadvātena śrotrābhighātāt, śabdasya nāśitatvādvā ? yadi śrotrābhighātāt tarhi nirvātapradeśasthena śrūyatām
na ca tatpradeśe asatā śabdapradeśa eva satā'nena tadabhighāto yukta; parvate prajvalitāgninā mahānase annapākaprasaṅgāt
śabdasya nāśitatve tu yasyāpyasau vāto'nukūla tenāpi na śrūyeta aviśeṣāt
taṃ prati tenāsya preraṇe tacchrotreṇa prāpto'sau gṛhyate iti siddhamasya prāpyakāritvam

yadi ca svotpattideśa eva sarve śabdā vilayina katha tarhi nalikādiśabdasya bheryādiśabdasya ca karṇaśaṣkuligṛhaprapūraṇena pratipatti syāt ? kathaṃ vā dhavalagṛhādau pratiśabdanam ? na hi loṣṭhādaya kosapātrā'saṃsṛṣṭā śabdamupajanayantaḥ pratīyante
yadi ca svotpattideśastha eva śabdo gṛhyeta tadā tatrasthairbheryādiśabdairmahadbhiḥ alpīyaso'pi maśakādiśabdasyānabhibhavād anākulameva grahaṇaṃ syāt
ye svotpattideśasthā evendriyeṇāsannikṛṣṭā gṛhyante na teṣāmanyonyaṃ mahadbhiralpīyasāmapyabhibhavaḥ yathā parvatapādapādīnām, svotpattideśasthā evendriyeṇā'sannikṛṣṭā gṛhyante ca śabdā iti

nanu dūradeśavartināṃ parvataḥ pādapādīnabhibhūya ātmānamevopadarśayati, ataḥ sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; ityapyasamīcīnam; yatasteṣāṃ deśaviprakṛṣṭatayā tadgrahaṇā'yogyatvād apratibhāsaḥ nābhibhavāt, maśakādiśabdānāṃ tu aviprakṛṣṭānāmapi bheryādiśabdairabhibhavo'sti ato na teṣāṃ svotpattideśasthānāmeva grahaṇam
yadi ca svotpattideśastha eva śabda śrotreṇa gṛhyate nāgata tarhi katham anuvāte śabdasya taddeśotpattikasyaiva śravaṇam, prativāte'śravaṇam, mandavāte manāk śravaṇa bhavet ? sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 546

yadapyuktam–tacchabdaiḥ śrotrābhighātāt teṣāmagrahaṇam yathā bhāsurarūpeṇa cakṣuṣo'bhighātāt sūkṣmāgrahaṇam iti; tadapyayuktam; dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt, divākarakarā hi bhāsurarūpāt pratinivarttya cakṣuṣābhisambaddhyamānāstasya abhighātahetavo dṛṣṭāḥ atīvrāloke tadabhighātādṛṣṭeḥ, nacātra tathāvidhaṃ kiñcidasti yat śabdāt pratinivarttya tadabhighātakāraṇaṃ syāt

vāyu syāt iti cet; nirvāte tarhi na syāttadaśravaṇam śrotrābhighātakāraṇā'bhāvāt, dṛśyate cātrāpi bheryādikolāhale alpīyaso'grahaṇam, ato'nyonyadeśopasarpaṇena analpairalpaśabdānāmabhibhavo' bhyupagantavyaḥ
tathā ca dūradeśāgamanaviśiṣṭatvādeva asya gandhādivad dūratvaṃ siddham, na punaḥ svotpattideśasthānāmapi deśagatadūratvopacārāt, anyathā skhalitā tatpratipattiḥ syāt māṇavake' gnipratipattivat
kathaṃ vā tat śrotrasyāprāpyakāritvaṃ prasādhayet upacaritasyā'prasādhakatvāt ? na hi māṇavake'gnitvamupacaritaṃ dāhādikāryaṃ prasādhayati

kiñca, deśāpekṣayā yad dūratvaṃ śabdasya tat ki deśagrahaṇe sati syāt, asati vā ? na tāvadasati; viśeṣaṇatvāt, yad viśeṣaṇaṃ tad gṛhītameva viśeṣye viśiṣṭapratipattinimittam yathā daṇḍādi, viśeṣaṇañca śabdasya dūrādipratipattau deśa iti

tathā, śabde dūrādipratyayo dūradeśādigrahaṇe satyeva bhavati tatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayatvāt, yastatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayaḥ sa tadgrahaṇe satyeva bhavati yathā pādapādau dūrādipratyayaḥ, tatsāpekṣadūrādipratyayaścāyam, tasmāttadgrahaṇe satyeva bhavatīti
suprasiddho hi dūrāsannapādapādau cakṣuṣā dūrāsannadeśagrahaṇe satyeva dūrāsannavyavahāraḥ, ataḥ śabde'pyasau tadgrahaṇe satyeva iṣyatām
tatheṣṭau ca kutastadgrahaṇam–ki śrotrāt, anyato vā ? yadi śrotrāt; deśasyāpi śabdatvaprasaṅgaḥ tallakṣaṇatvāttasya
indriyāntareṇa tatprattipattau sāṅgatyābhāvāt na deśāpekṣayā dūraḥ śabdaḥ iti pratītiḥ syāt
na hi devadattagṛhītadūradeśāpekṣayā yajñadattasya dūra śabdaḥ iti pratītirdṛṣṭā

atha indriyadvayānubhavānantara bhāvini vikalpajñāne tathāpratīterayamadoṣaḥ; tarhi pūrvaṃ dūrādirahitasya pratītiḥ punastatsahitasya iti krameṇa tatpratītiḥ syāt, na caivam, prathamameva dūratvādiviśiṣṭasyāsya pratīte

tato gatipariṇatasya svayaṃ dūrādipratyayayogyatāviśiṣṭasya gandhasyeva śabdasyāpi dūrādipratyayagocaratvaṃ pratipattavyam, iti siddhaṃ prāpyakāritvaṃ śrotrasya, kathamanyathā tadviṣaye deśādisandeha syād rūpavat ? yathaiva hi rūpe pratīyamāne kimasmin deśe rūpametat pratibhāti anyasmin vā, asyāṃ diśi anyasyāṃ vā iti na sandehaḥ, niyatadigdeśatayaiva asya aprāpyakāriṇendriyeṇa pratipattisaṃbhavāt, tathā atrāpyasau na syāt, asti cātrasandeha–kimanta śabdo'yaṃ jāta bahirvā prācyāṃ diśi anyasyāṃ vā iti
atha deśādisandehāt tatraivaṃ sandehaḥ tarhi gandho'pyaprāpta eva gṛhyatāṃ deśādisandehādevātrāpi sandehasaṃbhavāt
atha ato ghrāṇavikāradarśanāt prāpto'sau pratīyate, tadetacchabde'pi samam, śrotravikārasya bādhiryāde śabdāt pratīte
yuktatve vā bhavati na kathaṃ dhvānarūpatvameṣām

nanu ca atīndriyajñānasya tadvato vā sadupalambhakapramāṇapañcakagocarātikrāntatayā abhāvapramāṇakavalīkṛtavigrahatvato'syā'sattvāt kasya mukhyapratyakṣatā prasādhyeta ? na ca tadatikrāntatā'syā'siddhā, atīndriyārthavediviṣayasya adhyakṣādīnāṃ madhye kasyacidapi pramāṇasyā'saṃbhavāt

kiñca, sambaddhe vartamāne cārthe pratyakṣa pravartate, na cāśeṣārthavedī cakṣurādīndriyeṇa sambaddho vartamānaśca, tatkathaṃtatprabhavapratyakṣe pratibhāseta ? nāpyanumānaṃ tadviṣayam, taddhi liṅgaliṅginoravinābhāvagrahaṇe sati pravartate, na ca sarvajñenāvinābhūtaṃ kiñcilliṅgamupalabhyate
taddhi kāryaṃ vā syāt, svabhāvo vā ? na tāvatkāryam, viprakarṣiṇā sarvajñena saha kasyacit kāryakāraṇabhāvā'siddhe, pratyakṣānu palambhasādhanatvāttasya
āgamo'pi nityaḥ, anityo vā sarvajñasadbhāvāvedakaḥ syāt ? na tāvannityaḥ; tatpratipādakasya nityasyāgamasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
hiraṇyagarbha prakṛtya sa sarvavit sa lokavit ityāderapyāgamasya karmārthavādavidhāyakatvena aśeṣajñavidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ, anādeścāgamasyādimatsarvajñapratipādanavirodhāt
anityo'pyāgamaḥ–sarvajñapraṇītaḥ, asarvajñapraṇīto vā tatpratipādakaḥ syāt ? prathamapakṣe anyonyāśrayaḥ–sarvajñasiddhau hi tatpraṇītatvenāgamasya prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau cātaḥ sarvajñasiddhiriti

asarvajñapraṇītasya cāgamasya apramāṇabhūtatvāt kathaṃ tatastatpratipattiḥ ? tathābhūtādapyatastatpratipattau svavacanādeva tatpratipattiḥ kinna syādaviśeṣāt ? nahyanāsāditapramāṇabhāvasyā'nyavākyasya svavacanāt kaścidviśeṣo'sti
na cāśeṣajñasadṛśaḥ kaścijjagati pratītaḥ, tadapratītau tatsādṛśyapratīteranupapatteḥ
prayogaḥ–yasya sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ nāsti sa nopamānaviṣayaḥ yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, nāsti ca sadṛśagrahaṇaṃ sarvajñasyeti
na ca dharmādyupadeśakaraṇānyathānupapatterbuddhādīnāṃ sarvajñatāsiddhirbhaviṣyatītyabhidhātavyam; teṣāṃ tadupadeśakaraṇasya vyāmohādeva upapatteḥ

te hi nikhilapadārthajñānotpattihetorvedād āvirbhūtaviśuddhabodhāḥ dharmādyaśeṣapadārthasārthamupadiśanti na punarbuddhādaya, anyathā manvādyupadeśavat tadupadeśo'pi trayīvidbhirāśrīyeta, na cāsau tairāśritaḥ, ato vyāmohādevāsau tadviṣayastaiḥ kṛta ityavasīyate
ataḥ sarvajñasya ākāśakuśeśayaprakhyatāṃ prāptatvāt kasyāśeṣajñatā prārthyeta ?
dṛṣṭo na caikadeśosti liṃṅga vā yo'numāpayet
nāpi kāryam, pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanatvāt kāryakāraṇabhāvasya, viprakarṣiṇā sarvajñena saha kasyacit kāryakāraṇabhāvā'siddhe
svabhāvo'pi heturna sarvadarśinaḥ sattāṃ sādhayati tadapratyakṣatve svabhāvasya tadavyatirekiṇo gṛhītumaśakyatvāt
na cāpyevaṃ paro nitya śakyo labdhumihāgamaḥ
nanvastyeva sarvajñaḥ sarvavid ityādirata āha–nityaśced iti
anityasya vigrahavata puruṣasya sarvajñatvaṃ pratipādayannāgamopi anityaḥ syāditi
sa sarvavit sa lokavit ityādeḥ hiraṇyagarbha sarvajñaḥ ityādeśca āgamasya
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ prakṛtya sarvajña sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 46
vidheḥ phalavādalakṣaṇā yā praśaṃsā sā stutiḥ sampratyayārthāaniṣṭaphalavādo nindā varjanārthāanyakartṛkasya vyāhatasya vidhervādaḥ parakṛtiḥaitihyasamācarito vidhiḥ purākalpa iti
anyathā nopapadyeta sārvajñyaṃ yadi no bhavet
ye tu manvādaya siddhāḥ prādhānyena trayīvidām
ṛgyajusāmākhyā trayo vedā trayī bhaṇyante, tā vidantīti trayīvido brāhmaṇā ucyante
stryā ṛk sāmayajuṣī iti vedāstrayastrayī ityamara

astu vā sarvajñaḥ; tathāpyasau samastamatītakālādiparigataṃ vastu svena svena rūpeṇa pratipadyate, kiṃ vā vartamānatayaiva ? prathamapakṣe tajjñānasya pratyakṣatānupapattiḥ avartamānavastuviṣayatvāt, yadavartamānavastuviṣayaṃ na tat pratyakṣam yathā smaraṇādi, avartamānavastuviṣayañca atītā'nāgatārthaviṣayatayā sarvajñajñānamiti
dvitīyapakṣe tu tajjñānasya bhrāntatvaprasaṅga; anyathāsthitasyārthasya anyathātvena grāhakatvāt
yadanyathāsthitasyārthasyānyathātvena grāhakaṃ tad bhrāntam yathā dvicandrādijñānam, anyathāsthitasya atītānāgatakālasyārthasya vartamānatayā grāhakañca sarvajñajñānamiti

kiñca, idamidānīmiha sat ityasyāṃ saṃvidi vastusattāvat tatprāk-pradhvaṃsābhāvau pratibhāsete, na vā ? yadi pratibhāsete; tadā yugapat, krameṇa vā ? yugapaccet; tarhi tadaivāsyānutpannapradhvastavyapadeśaprasaṅgād yugapajjanma-maraṇādivyapadeśaprasaṅga, yad yena svarūpeṇa pratibhāsate tattenaiva vyapadiśyate yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā, sattva-prāk-pradhvaṃsābhāvarūpatayā pratibhāsate ca aśepajñasyā'śepaṃ vastviti
nāpi krameṇa; atītānāgatārthānāṃ parisamāptyabhāvataḥ tajjñānasyāpyaparisamāpteḥ sarvajñatvā'yogāt
atha vastusattāvat tau na pratibhāsete; tadā kathamasau sarvajñaḥ syāditi ?
jānan yathā pradhāna vā śaktyā veṣyeta sarvavit
jñāna naikadhiyā dṛṣṭa bhinnā vā gataya kvacit
bhūta bhavad bhaviṣyaśca vastvanantaṃ krameṇa ka
ityādikārikābhi tattvasaṅgrahakāra pṛ॰ 844 sāmaṭa-yajñaṭayo sarvajñadūṣaka matam upasthāpayati
anayaiva bhaṅgyā nimnagrantheṣu kṛtaḥ sarvajñāviṣayaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ–tattvasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 830
yattāvaduktam–sadupalambhakapramāṇapañcakagocarātikrāntatayā'sattvamatīndriyajñānasya tadvato vā; tatra tadatikrāntatā tāvattasya asiddhā; tatsadbhāvāvedakasyānumānapramāṇasya sadbhāvāt iti
etat tat ityādinā darśayati–tad atīndriyajñānam, asti, suniścitā'saṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇatvāt sukhādivad iti
na tāvadāśrayāsiddho'yaṃ hetuḥ, dharmiṇo hetuprayogāt pūrvaṃ kutaścitpramāṇādaprasiddherityabhidhātavyam; vikalpaprasādāttasya prasiddheḥ
na hi kaścittasyā'gocaro'sti yanna krameta sarvatrāpratihatapravṛttitvāttasya
na khalu vanhyādyanumāne'pi parvatāderdharmiṇo vikalpādanyataḥ siddhiḥ ityagre vakṣyate

atīndriyārthadarśino hi bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣam, anumānādi, abhāvo vā syāt ? yadi pratyakṣam; tat kiṃ kvacit kadācittadabhāvaṃ prasādhayet, sarvatra sarvadā vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanam, nahi sarvatra sarvadā tatsadbhāvo'smābhiḥ pratijñātaḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tu atīndriyapratyakṣamantareṇa sarvatra sarvadā'tīndriyajñānā'bhāvā'siddhiḥ ityāvedayati– yāvat ityādinā

yāvajjñeyaṃ sakalaṃ jñeyaṃ vyāpnoti viṣayīkarotyevaṃ śīlaṃ yaj jñānaṃ tena rahitā śūnyā yā sakalā puruṣapariṣat tasyāḥ parijñānasya tadantareṇa atīndriyajñānamantareṇa anupapatteḥ, tadasti ityabhisambandhaḥ

na khalu prādeśikendriyajajñānena sarvatra sarvadā sarvadarśino'bhāvaḥ karttuṃ śakyaḥ tasyātadviṣayatvāt, yad yadviṣayaṃ na bhavati na tattatra viparītadharmasya bādhakam yathā śabdā'viṣayaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ jñānaṃ tadaśrāvaṇatvasya, sakaladeśakālavartipuruṣaparipadaviṣayañca prādeśikamindriyaprabhavaṃ jñānamiti
na khalu jñasvabhāvasya kaścidagocarosti yanna krameta

nanu na pravartamānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvadarśino bādhakam śabde śrāvaṇatvapratyakṣamivā'śrāvaṇatvasya, kintu nivartamānam, yatra hi pratyakṣasya nivṛttiḥ tasya abhāvo'vasīyate yathā śaśaśṛṅgasya, yatra tu pravṛttiḥ tasya sadbhāva yathā rūpādeḥ, na cātīndriyārthadarśiviṣayaṃ svapne'pi pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttam, atastannivṛttestasyāpyabhāvo'vasīyate; tadapyanupapannam; yato yadi vastunaḥ pratyakṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ vā syāt tadā tannivṛttau vastuno'pi nivṛttiḥ syāt, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
kāraṇasya hi vahnyādernivṛttau kāryasya dhūmādernivṛttirdṛṣṭā, vyāpakasya ca vṛkṣatvādernivṛttau vyāpyasya śiśapātvādernivṛtti
na cārthasya pratyakṣaṃ kāraṇam tadabhāve'pi tadbhāvāt
yad yadabhāve'pi bhavati na tattasya kāraṇam yathā gorabhāve'pi bhavannaśvo na gokāraṇakaḥ, deśādivyavadhāne asatyapi arvādarśipratyakṣe bhavati cārtha iti
yannivṛttāvapi yanna nivartate na tattasya vyāpakam yathā nivartamāne'pi kumbhe'nivartamānasya stambhasya na kumbho vyāpakaḥ, nivartamāne'pi pratyakṣe na nivartate ca deśādiviprakṛṣṭo'rtha iti
na cā'kāraṇā'vyāpakabhūtasyāsya nivṛttau akāryā'vyāpakabhūtasyārthasya nivṛttiryuktā atiprasaṅgāt
yo'pi kāryābhāvāt kvacit kāraṇasyā'bhāvaniścayaḥ so'pyapratibaddhasāmarthyasyaiva, na punaḥ kāraṇamātrasya
na ca arvākpratyakṣaṃ prati aśeṣārthānāṃ sāmarthyamasti yena tannivarttamānaṃ teṣāmabhāvaṃ sādhayet
na vayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pravarttamānamabhāvaṃ sādhayati iti brūmaḥ
nāpi yannivṛttau yanna nivarttate sa tasya svabhāvo yukta goriva gavayasya
yā ca kāryānupalabdhiruktā na sā kāraṇamātrasya abhāvaṃ gamayati, ki tarhi ? apratibaddhasāmarthyasyaiva
kiñca, adhyakṣanivṛtti-arthābhāvayo yadi vyāpya-vyāpakabhāva siddhyet tadā tannivṛtterarthābhāvo niścīyeta, nacāsau siddhaḥ triviprakṛṣṭe'rthe satyapi pratyakṣanivṛtteḥ pratīyamānatvāt
kiñca, bhavatpratyakṣanivṛttiḥ sarvavido'sattvaṃ prasādhayet, sarvapratyakṣanivṛttirvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapanna, bhavatpratyakṣanivṛtteḥ deśādivyavadhāne satyapyarthe pratīyamānatvāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ; sarvajñaviṣaye sarvapratyakṣanivṛtteḥ sarvajñamantareṇānupapatteḥ, nahi arvāgdṛśā sarvapramātṝṇāmasākṣātkaraṇe tatra tatpratyakṣaṃ na pravartate iti pratipattuṃ śakyam

nanvevaṃ sarvatrā'bhāvavyavahāroccheda syāt kvacit ghaṭādyabhāvasādhane'pi uktadoṣānuṣaṅgāt; ityapyacarcitābhidhānam, tatra ekajñānasaṃsargipadārthāntaropalambhato'bhāvavyavahāropapatteḥ, ekasya hi kaivalyam itarasya vaikalyam
nacāśeṣajñasya kenacit sārdham ekajñānasaṃsargitvamasti yasyopalambhāttadabhāvaḥ siddhyet, tasyātyantaparokṣatvāt
na ca pratyakṣanivṛttirvastvabhāvena vyāptā yenāsau vastvabhāvaḥ tato niścīyate

yadyevaṃ kathamanupalambhākhyāt pratyakṣāt ghaṭādyabhāvasiddhi pradeśāntare bhavadbhirvarṇyate ? naitadasti, ekajñānasasargayogyayorarthayo anyataramyaiva yā siddhi sā aparasya abhāvasiddhi iti kṛttvā
na caivaṃ sarvajñatvasyakenacit sārddhamekajñānasaṃsargitā niścitā yasya kevalasyopalambhāt tadabhāvaṃ vyavasyāmaḥ, tasya sarvadaiva atyantaparokṣatvāt

nāpyanumānam; dharmi-sādhya-sādhanānāṃ svarūpā'prasiddheḥ, tadbādhake hyanumāne dharmitvena sarvajño'bhipretaḥ, sugataḥ, sarvapuruṣā vā ? yadi sarvajñaḥ; tadā ki tatra sādhyam–asattvam, asarvajñatvaṃ vā ? yadyasattvam; ki tatra sādhanam–anupalambhaḥ, viruddhavidhiḥ, vaktṛtvādikaṃ vā ? yadyanupalambhaḥ; sa kiṃ sarvajñasya, tatkāraṇasya, tatkāryasya, tadvyāpakasya vā ? yadi sarvajñasya; so'pi kiṃ svasambandhī, sarvasambandhī vā ? svasambandhī cet; so'pi ki nirviśeṣaṇaḥ, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaviśeṣaṇo vā ? na tāvannirviśeṣaṇo'sau tadabhāvasādhanāya prabhavati; paracittaviśeṣādibhiranaikāntikatvāt
nāpyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaviśeṣaṇaḥ; sarvatra sarvadā sarvajñā'bhāvasādhanā'bhāvānuṣaṅgāt, na hi sarvathāpyasataḥ upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaṃ ghaṭate, kvacitkadācitsattvopalambhāvinābhāvitvāttasya
tathāhi–yadupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ na tat sarvathāpyasat yathā ghaṭādi, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaśca sarvajña iti
asiddhaśca sarvasambandhyanupalambhaḥ asarvavidā pratipattumaśakyatvāt, na khalu sarvātmanāṃ tajjñānānāñcāpratipattau tatsambandhī sarvajñānupalambhaḥ pratipattuṃ śakyaḥ
nāpi kvacit pradeśaviśeṣe chatrādyanupalambhāt chāyādyabhāvavat sarvajñasya kāraṇānupalambhādabhāvo yuktaḥ; tatkāraṇasya jñānāvaraṇādikarmaprakṣayasya anumānādinopalambhasaṃbhavāt
ādyavidhāyā sādhanam anupalambho, viruddhavidhirvā bhavet ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 382
anupalambho'pi kiṃ nirviśeṣaṇo'bhīṣṭaḥ upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya ityetasya viśeṣaṇasyā'nāśrayaṇāt, ahosvit saviśeṣaṇa iti
tatpratipādakāgamasyā'pauruṣeyatvāt kathaṃ tatkāryatā ? ityapyasāmpratam; apauruṣeyatvasya āgame pratiṣetsyamānatvāt, guṇavadvaktṛkatvenaiva aśeṣavacasāṃ prāmāṇyasya samarthayiṣyamāṇatvāt
sarvajñatvasya hi vyāpakaṃ sarvārthasākṣātkāritvam na punaḥ sarvārthaparijñānamātram, tasya asarvajñe'pyāgamadvāreṇa upalabhyamānatvāt

taccānumānataḥ prasiddham; tathāhi–kaścidātmā sakalārthasākṣātkārī, tadgrahaṇasvabhāvatve sati prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayatvāt, yad yadgrahaṇasvabhāvatve sati prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayam tat tatsākṣātkāri yathā apagatatimirādipratibandhaṃ locanavijñānaṃ rūpasākṣātkāri, sakalārthagrahaṇasvabhāvatve sati prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayaśca kaścidātmeti
na tāvadayaṃ viśeṣaṇāsiddho hetuḥ, āgamadvāreṇa'śeṣārthagrahaṇasvabhāvatvasya ātmani prasiddhatvāt
nāpi viśeṣyā'siddhaḥ; prakṣīṇapratibandhapratyayatvasya agre prasādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt, tannānupalambhaḥ tadabhāve hetuḥ
anumānamidaṃ prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 70 pū॰, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 370, prameyaratna॰ pṛ॰ 54, ityādiṣu vartate

nāpi viruddhavidhiḥ; yata sākṣāt, paramparayā vā viruddhasya vidhiḥ sarvajñābhāvaṃ prasādhayet ? prathamapakṣe sarvajñatvena sākṣādviruddhasya asarvajñatvasya kvacit kadācid vidhānāttasyābhāvaḥ sādhyeta, sarvatra sarvadā vā ? ādyavikalpe na sākalyenāśeṣajñābhāva siddhyet
yatraiva hi tadvidhānaṃ tatraiva tadabhāvaḥ siddhyet, nānyatra, nahi kvacit kadācidvahnervidhāne sarvatra sarvadā śītābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ
dvitīyavikalpo'pyasaṃbhāvyaḥ, arvāgdṛśaḥ sarvatra sarvadā'sarvajñatvavidherasaṃbhavāt, tatsaṃbhave vā asyaivāśeṣajñatvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt
yadvā arthāntarasya sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa vā viruddhasyaiva vidhānāt tanniṣedha nāviruddhasya tasya tatsahabhāvasaṃbhavāt
yathā–nāstyatra śītasparśo vahneriti sākṣādviruddhasya vahne vidhānāt śītasparśaniṣedha tadvat sarvajñaniṣedhe'pi syāt
pāramparyeṇa tu viruddhasya kvacit tadvyāpakaviruddhasyaiva vā vidhānāt sarvavido niṣedha yathā tuṣārasparśavyāpakaśītaviruddhavahnividhānāt tuṣārasparśaniṣedha
nāpi viruddhavidhi, yata sopi pratiniyatadeśādau tasya abhāvaṃ sādhayed, aśeṣadeśādau vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 382

paramparayāpi tadvyāpakaviruddhasya, tatkāraṇaviruddhasya, tadviruddhakāryasya vā vidhistadabhāvaṃ sādhayet ? na tāvattasya sarvajñatvasya vyāpakenā'khilārthasākṣātkāritvena viruddhasya tadasākṣātkāritvasya, niyatārthasākṣātkāritvasya vā vidhiḥ tadabhāvasādhanāya prabhavati; sa hi kvacit kadācittadabhāvaṃ prasādhayet tuṣārasparśavyāpakaśītaviruddhavahnividhānāt kvacit kadācit tuṣārasparśaniṣedhavat, na punaḥ sarvatra sarvadā, tatra tadā tadvyāpakaviruddhavidherasaṃbhavāt, kvacidātmaviśeṣe tadvyāpakavidheḥ prasādhitatvāt

tatkāraṇaviruddhavidhirapi kvacit kadācidevāśeṣajñābhāvaṃ prasādhayet, yathā romaharṣādikāraṇaśītaviruddhavahniviśeṣavidhānāt kvacitkadācit śītakāryaromaharṣādiniṣedhaḥ na punaḥ sākalyena, tatkāraṇaviruddhavidheḥ sākalyena saṃbhavābhāvāt
sarvajñatvasya hi kāraṇaṃ jñānāvaraṇādikarmaprakṣaya tadviruddhaśca tadaprakṣaya tasya vidhiḥ kvacidevātmani na sarvatra, tadatyantaprakṣayasya kvacidātmaviśeṣe prasādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt

etena tadviruddhakāryavidhirapi prativyūḍhaḥ, tena hi sarvajñatvena viruddhaṃ kiñcijjñatvaṃ tatkārya niyatārthaviṣayaṃ vacaḥ tasya vidhiḥ, so'pi na sāmastyena aśeṣajñā'bhāvaṃ sādhayituṃ samarthaḥ; yatraiva tadvidhistatraivāsya tadabhāvaprasādhanasāmarthyopapatteḥ, yathā yatraiva pradeśaviśeṣe śītādiviruddhadahanādikāryasya dhūmādervidhiḥ tatraiva śītasparśaniṣedhaḥ na sarvatra
nāpi vaktṛtvādikam; tadasattvābhyupagame vaktṛtvādidharmopetatvānupapatteḥ; anyathā svavacanavirodhānuṣaṅgāt
na khalu nāsti sarvajñaḥ, vaktṛtvādidharmopetaśca ityabhidadhatā svavacanavirodhaḥ pariharttuṃ śakyaḥ
nāpi asarvajñatā; svavacanavirodhasya atrāpyaviśiṣṭatvāt, nahi sarvajño'sarvajñaḥ iti bruvataḥ svavacanavirodhāsaṃbhavaḥ
kiñca, sarvavidaḥ pramāṇaviruddhārthavaktṛtvaṃ hetutvena vivakṣitam, tadviparītam, vaktṛtvamātraṃ nā ? prathamapakṣe asiddho hetuḥ; bhagavatastathābhūtārthavaktṛtvā'saṃbhavāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu viruddho hetuḥ; dṛṣṭeṣṭāviruddhārthavaktṛtvasya tatparijñāne satyeva saṃbhavāt
etena sugatadharmipakṣo'pi pratyākhyātaḥ; asattvādisādhyāpekṣayā anupalambhādisādhanāpekṣayā ca uktadoṣānuṣaṅgāviśeṣāt
kiñca, sugatasya sarvajñatāpratiṣedhe anyeṣāṃ tadvidhiravaśyaṃbhāvī viśeṣapratiṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñānāntarīyakatvāt ayaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ ityādivat
atha sarvapuruṣān pakṣīkṛtya teṣāṃ vaktṛtvāderasarvajñatā prasādhyate; tanna; vipakṣāt taraya vyatirekā'siddhau sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttitayā asarvajñatāprasādhakatvānupapatteḥ

rathyāpuruṣādau asarvajñatve satyeva vaktṛtvāderupalambhāt, sarvajñe ca kadācidapyanupalambhāt tato vyatirekasiddhiḥ, ityapi manorathamātram; sarvā''tmasambandhino'nupalambhasya asiddhā'naikāntikatvapratipādanāt
ime vikalpā prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 73 pū॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 45, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 384, prameyaratna॰ pṛ॰ 57, ityādiṣvapi varttante

nanu sarvajñasya kasyacidapyabhāvāt siddhā tato vaktṛtvādervyatirekasiddhiriti cet; kutaḥ punastadabhāvasiddhiḥ–ata eva, anyato vā ? ata eva cet; cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ, tathāhi–vaktṛtvādeḥ sarvajñābhāvasiddhau tato'sya vyatirekasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau cāsya asarvajñatvenaiva vyāptiḥ, tatsiddhau cātaḥ sarvajñābhāvasiddhiriti
atha anyataḥ; tadāsya vaiyarthyam, na cānyat tadabhāvagrāhakaṃ kiñcitpramāṇamasti
yadi ca anupalambhamātreṇa atīndriyārthadarśino'bhāvaḥ sādhyate tadā tadabhāvajñasyāpyato'bhāvaḥ kinnasādhyeta viśeṣābhāvāt ? iti pradarśayannāha–tadabhāva ityādi
tasya atīndriyajñānasya abhāvaḥ sa eva tattvaṃ taj jño na kaścid anupalabdheḥ khapuṣpavat iti
atha yadyapi asmadādistathābhūto nopalabhyate tathāpyanyastathābhūto bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha–na vai jaiminiranyo vā tadabhāvatattvajñaḥ sattva-puruṣatva-vaktṛtvāde rathyāpuruṣavat iti
upalakṣaṇañcai tat, tena vedārthajño'pi na bhavati tata eva tadvat ityapi draṣṭavyam, tathā ca lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ syāt
sattva-puruṣatvādyaviśeṣe'pi jaiminyāde rathyāpuruṣādvilakṣaṇatvāt tatparijñānātiśayo na viruddhyata ityatrāha–puruṣa ityādi

puruṣasya jaiminyādeḥ atiśayaḥ vedārtha-sarvajñābhāvatattvajñatālakṣaṇaḥ tasya saṃbhave atīndriyārthadarśī kinna syāt ? nanu tadabhāvatattvajño na kaścid anupalabdheḥ ityayuktamuktam; dṛśyānupalambhasyaiva pramāṇatvopapatteḥ, na cāyaṃ dṛśyānupalambhaḥ; arvāgdṛśaḥ paracetaso'dṛśyatvāt, ityāha–atra ityādi
atra tadabhāvatattvajñā'bhāvasādhane anupalambhamapramāṇayan mīmāṃsakaḥ sarvajña ādiḥ yasya vedakartrādeḥ sa eva viśeṣaḥ tasya abhāve sādhye kutaḥ pramāṇayet ? na kutaścidityarthaḥ
nahi guṇavato vakturabhāve vacasaḥ prāmāṇyam iti tadapauruṣeyatvapratipedhāvasare pratipādayiṣyate
tatkhalu upamānopameyayoradhyakṣatve sati gogavayavat sādṛśyālambanamudayamāsādayati, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
nacāśeṣapuruṣāḥ sarvajñaśca kenacid dṛṣṭā yena aśeṣapuruṣavat sarvajñaḥ sarvajñavadvā'śeṣapuruṣaḥ ityupamānaṃ syāt
taddṛṣṭau vā tasyaivāśeṣajñatvaprasaṅgāt kathamupamānāt sarvajñābhāvaḥ syāt ? yata idaṃ śobheta–

kiñca, aśeṣajñasya aśeṣapramātṛśarīrasaṃsthānavat avilakṣaṇaśarīrasaṃsthānatayopameyatā syāt, indriyaprabhavapratyakṣeṇārthaparicchedakatayā, kharaviṣāṇāvannīrūpatayā vā ? tatrādyavikalpo' nupapannaḥ; sarvajñabādhākaratvābhāvataḥ sarvajñavādināmaniṣṭā'sampādakatvāt

nahi śarīrasaṃsthānasya aśeṣajñatā tadvādibhiriṣyate, yena aśeṣajñaśarīrasaṃsthānasya itarajanaśarīrasaṃsthānā'vailakṣaṇye tadvattasya asarvajñatāpi syāt kintvātmanaḥ, sa cāto'tyantavilakṣaṇa tatkathaṃ tadavailakṣaṇye tasya asarvajñatopamānaṃ syāt ? nahyanyasya anyena sādṛśye tadvilakṣaṇe'nyatra adṛṣṭapūrve tad yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
nanu smaryamāṇameva vastu purovartipadārthasādṛśyopādhi, sādṛśyaṃ vā tena viśeṣitamupamānasya prameyam
smaraṇañca anubhūta eva viṣaye pravartate nānyatra atiprasaṅgāt
nacāśeṣapuruṣāḥ tadvartīni cetāṃsi ca kenacidasarvavidā'nubhūtāni yataḥ smaryeran

nāpyananubhūtānāṃ teṣāmasarvajñatvasādhāraṇaḥ kaściddharmo niścetuṃ śakyaḥ yadvaśāt ahamiva sarvadā sarve puruṣāḥ pratiniyatamarthamindriyaiḥ paśyanti, sarvapuruṣavadvā aham iti asarvajñatayopamīyeran
yadapi sattvādikaṃ kvacidasarvajñe dṛṣṭaṃ tadapi nāsarvajñatva eva sādhāraṇam sarvajñe'pi sattvādyavirodhāt; anyathā sarvapuruṣāṇāmavedārthajñatvaṃ mūrkhatvādi vā tadvad upamīyeta aviśeṣāt
yathā ca na kaścidabāliśo mavaye sattvādidharmadarśanāt ghaṭādīnāmapi gavayasādṛśyamupamimīte tathā sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ sattvādidharmadarśanāt nā'sarvajñatvamiti
etena kharaviṣāṇavat sarvajñaḥ sarvajñavadvā kharaviṣāṇam iti nīrūpatayā sarvajñasya upameyatā pratyuktā
tasmād yatsmaryate tat syāt sādṛśyena viśeṣitam

nāpyāgamaḥ; sa hi pauruṣeyaḥ, apauruṣeyo vā tadbādhakaḥ syāt ? na tāvadapauruṣeyaḥ; tasyāgamavicārāvasare prapañcataḥ pratiṣetsyamānatvāt, kārya evārthe bhavadbhiḥ prāmāṇyābhyupagamācca, svarūpe'pi prāmāṇye'tiprasaṅgāt
nacāśeṣajñābhāvapratipādakaṃ kiñcidvedavākyamasti, hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādivedavākyānāṃ tatsadbhāvāvedakānāmevānekaśaḥ śravaṇāt

atha karmā'rthavādaparatvātteṣāṃ na tatsadbhāvā''vedakatvam; kutaḥ punaḥ tatparatvaṃ teṣām na punaḥ tatsadbhāvāvedakatvam ? tasya asattvāccet; tadapi kutaḥ ? pramāṇāntarāt, tasya karmā'rthavādaparatayā tatsadbhāvānāvedakatvādvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; sarvajñā'sattvagrāhiṇaḥ pramāṇāntarasya prāgeva pratikṣiptatvāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu anyonyāśrayaḥ; tathāhi–sarvajñā'sattvasiddhau āgamasya karmārthavādaparatayā tatsadbhāvānāvedakatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca sarvajñā'sattvasiddhiriti

pauruṣeyo'pyāgamaḥ ki sarvajñapraṇītaḥ, tadabhāvavidhātṛpuruṣapraṇītaḥ, anyapraṇīto vā tadbādhakaḥ syāt ? yadi sarvajñapraṇītaḥ; kathaṃ tadbādhakaḥ virodhāt ? dvitīyapakṣe'pi aśeṣajñābhāvapratipādakāgamapraṇetā sakalaṃ sakalajñavikalaṃ jagat pratipadyate, na vā ? yadi pratipadyate; tadā yuktaḥ tatpraṇītāgamaḥ pramāṇam, na punaraśeṣajñasya bādhakaḥ, tathāpratipadyamānasya tatpraṇetureva aśeṣajñatvaprasiddheḥ
atha na pratipadyate; kathaṃ tarhi pramāṇam ajñānamahāmahīdharabharākrāntapuruṣapraṇītatvāt tathāvidharathyāpuruṣapraṇītāgamavat ? anyapraṇītapakṣe'pi etadeva dūṣaṇadvayaṃ draṣṭavyam

astu vā tat; tathāpi pratyakṣādipramāṇapañcakavinivṛttirūpaṃ tadbhavadbhiriṣṭam; tannivṛttiśca prasajyapratiṣedharūpā, paryudāsarūpā vā ? prasajyapratiṣedhapakṣe tasya arthaparicchittihetutvānupapattiḥ nīrūpatvāt
yannīrūpam tannārthaparicchittihetu yathā gaganendīvaram, nīrūpañca prasajyapratiṣedharūpamabhāvapramāṇamiti

paricchittihetutvaṃ hi bhāvadharma sa kathaṃ sarvathā tucchasvabhāvā'bhāvasya syād virodhāt ? tadabhāvācca kathaṃ pramāṇatā paricchittau sādhakatamasya pramāṇavyapadeśāt ? pramāṇā'bhāvarūpatvāccā'bhāvasya tadvyapadeśānupapattiḥ
yo yadabhāvaḥ sa tadvyapadeśaṃ nārhati yathā brāhmaṇā'bhāvo na brāhmaṇavyapadeśam, pratyakṣādipramāṇābhāvaścābhāvapramāṇamiti
yadi pramāṇanivṛttamātraṃ prasajyalakṣaṇamabhāvapramāṇa varṇyate tadā nāsau kasyacit pratipatti, nāpi pratipattihetu

paryudāsapakṣe'pi pramāṇapañcakā'bhāvaśabdābhidheyaṃ bhāvāntaraṃ vācyam, tacca pramāṇapañcakavinirmuktātmā, tadanyajñānaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe ki sarvathā pramāṇapañcakena vinirmukta ātmā, niṣedhyaviṣayapramāṇapañcakena vā ? yadi sarvathā; kathaṃ sarvajñābhāvaparicchedakatvam pramāṇamantareṇa prameyaparicchedakatvānupapatteḥ ? anyathā pramāṇaparikalpanānarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ
dvitīyapakṣe'pi ki bhavadīya ātmā sarvajñaviṣaye pramāṇapañcakavinirmuktatvāt tadabhāvaṃ prasādhayet, sarvasya vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, paracetovṛttiviśeṣairanekāntāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ, sarvasya pratipattuḥ tadviṣaye tadvinirmuktatvasya asarvavidā pratipattumaśakyatvāt

nāpi tadanyajñānapakṣaḥ; yato niṣedhyāt sarvajñatvāt anyat kiñcijjñatvaṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ tadanyajñānam; tacca ki kvacit kadācitkasyacit sarvajñatvābhāvaṃ prasādhayet, sarvatra sarvadā sarvasya vā ? prakṣamapakṣe siddhasādhyatā, yatra yadā yasya kiñcijjñatvasiddhiḥ tatra tadā tasyāsarvajñatvasiddherabhyupagamāt
dvitīyapakṣastu śraddhāmātragamyaḥ, kālatrayatrilokasthaprāṇināmasākṣātkaraṇe tatra kiñcijjñatvapratipatteranupapattita sarvatra sarvadā sarvasyā'sarvajñatvasiddherapyanupapatteḥ
tannābhāvapramāṇamapi aśeṣavido bādhakam, iti siddhaṃ suniścitāsaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇatvaṃ nikhilātītānāgatavartamānārthasākṣātkāriṇo'tīndriyapratyakṣasya
yadapyuktam–atītakālādiparigataṃ vastu svena svena rūpeṇa pratibhāsate ityādi; tadapyasāram; yata svenaiva tatpratibhāsate

kathaṃ tarhi avartamānatayā pratibhāsamānasyāsya pratyakṣatā yuktā iti cet ? parisphuṭatayā'rthasya grāhakatvāt, nahi sannihitadeśa-kālatayārthapratibhāsaḥ pratyakṣalakṣaṇam, svotsaṅgasthabālakaśarīre vyāhārādiliṅgato jīvasadbhāvāvabhāsasyāpi pratyakṣatāprasaṅgāt

ki tarhi ? parisphuṭatayārthapratibhāsa, sa cet atītāderapyarthasyāsti kathanna tasya pratyakṣatā ? yathā ca indriyaprabhavapratyakṣasya deśaviprakṛṣṭārthagrahaṇe'pi parisphuṭapratibhāsatvanna viruddhyate tathā atīndriyapratyakṣasya kālaviprakṛṣṭārthagrahaṇe'pi
na caivam atītādervartamānatāpattiḥ vartamānārthagrahaṇagrāhyatvāt vartamānārthavat ityabhidhātavyam; dūradeśārthasya adūradeśārthagrahaṇagrāhyatvāt adūradeśārthavat adūradeśatāprāpteḥ

etena idamidānīmiha sat ityasyāṃ saṃvidi vastusattāvat tatprāk-pradhvaṃsābhāvau pratibhāsete na vā' ityādyapi pratyākhyātam; yathaiva hi indriyaprabhavapratyakṣe yaddeśaviśiṣṭaṃ vastu nīlarūpamanīlarūpaṃ vā bhāvarūpamabhāvarūpaṃ vā taddeśaviśiṣṭatayaiva pratibhāsate, tadvat sarvajñajñāne'pi yaddeśakālākāraviśiṣṭaṃ vastu bhāvarūpamabhāvarūpaṃ vā taddeśakālākāratayaiva pratibhāsate, ataḥ kathaṃ yugapajjanmamaraṇādivyapadeśaprasaṅgaḥ pratiniyatārthasvarūpā'pratītirvā yataḥ sarvajñatā'sya suvyavasthitā na syāt ? bhaviṣyatkālasya hi vastusvabhāvasya vartamānavastusvabhāvatayā pratītau yugapajjanmamaraṇādivyapadeśaprasaṅgaḥ pratiniyatārthasvarūpāpratītiśca syāt na punaryathākālaṃ tatpratītau
prāyaḥ anayaiva diśā sarvajñasamarthanam adhonirdiṣṭagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam–tattvasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 846
nanu na suniścitā'sabhavadbādhakapramāṇatvāt sarvajñasadbhāvaḥ siddhyati, kintu kṣityādikāryakartṛtvāt
na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ; sāvayavatvena kṣityādeḥ kāryatvaprasiddheḥ
tadayaṃ niravadyo heturbuddhimantaṃ karttāraṃ sādhayan pakṣadharmatābalāt jaganirmāṇasamartha sarvajñatvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ sādhayati
śarīrānapekṣotpattikaṃ buddhimatpūrvakam kāraṇavattvātdravyeṣu sāvayavatvena tadguṇeṣu kāryaguṇatvena karmasu karmatvenaiva tadanumānāt
guṇaviśiṣṭamātmāntaramīśvaratasya ca dharmasamādhiphalam aṇimādyaṣṭavidhamaiśvaryaṃ saṅkalpānuvidhāyī cāsya dharma pratyātmavṛttīn dharmādharmasañcayān pṛthivyādīni ca bhūtāni pravarttayati
pradhānaparamāṇukarmāṇi prāk pravṛtte buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitāni pravarttante acetanatvāt vāsyādivat
ayamaparo hetu–buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhita mahābhūtādivyakta sukhaduḥkhādinimittaṃ bhavati rūpādimattvāt turyādivat
dharmādharmau buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhito puruṣasyopabhogaṃ kuruta karaṇatvāt vāsyādivat
buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitāni svāsu svāsu dhāraṇādikriyāsu mahābhūtāni vāyvantāni pravarttante acetanatvāt
vivādādhyāsitā tanu-taru-mahīdharādaya upādānābhijñakartṛkā utpattimattvāt acetanopādānatvādvā yathā prāsādādi
na caiṣāmutpattimattvamasiddham, sāvayavatvena vā mahattve sati kriyāvattvena vā vastrādivattatsiddhe

praśastamatistvāha–sargādau puruṣāṇā vyavahāro'nyopadeśapūrvaka uttarakāla prabuddhānā pratyarthaniyatatvāt aprasiddhavāgvyavahārāṇā kumārāṇā gavādiṣu pratyarthaniyato vāgvyavahāro yathāmātrādyupadeśapūrvaka iti

syānmatam–iṣṭavighātakṛdayaṃ hetuḥ, tathāhi–sarvajñaḥ sarvakarttā nityajñānecchāprayatnavān aśarīro buddhimānabhyupagamyate, dṛṣṭānte ca ghaṭādau tadvilakṣaṇaḥ karttopalabhyate, dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭadharmānusāreṇa ca adṛṣṭe'rthe pratipattirbhavatīti sisādhayiṣitadharmaviparyayasādhanādviruddho hetuḥ
dṛṣṭā ntaśca sādhyavikalaḥ; ghaṭādau tathābhūtasya buddhimato'bhāvāditi
tadasamīcīnam; yato na sādhyasādhanayorviśeṣeṇa vyāptiḥ sakalānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt, kintu sāmānyena
anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ hi vyāptiravadhāryate, tau ca ānantyād vyabhicārācca viśeṣeṣu grahītuṃ na śakyau, ato buddhimatkartṛpūrvakatvamātreṇaiva kāryatvasya vyāptiḥ pratyetavyā, na śarīritvādinā
na khalu kartṛtvasāmagryāṃ śarīraṃ praviśati, tadvyatirekeṇā'pi jñāna-cikīrṣā-prayatnāśrayatvena svaśarīrapreraṇe kartṛtvopalambhāt
akiñcitkarasyāpi śarīrasya sahacaramātreṇa kāraṇatve vahnipaiṅgilyasyāpi dhūmaṃ prati kāraṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ syāt
vidyamāne'pi hi śarīre jñānādīnāṃ samastānāṃ vyastānāṃ vā'bhāve kumbhakārādāvapi kartṛtvaṃ nopalabhyate
prathamaṃ hi kāryotpādakakārakakalāpajñānaṃ prādurbhavati, tataḥ tatkaraṇecchā, tataḥ prayatnaḥ, tataḥ phalaniṣpattiḥ ityamīṣāṃ trayāṇāmeva kāryakartṛtve sarvatrā'vyabhicāraḥ
nanvevamaśeṣajñeyajñānādhāravidhātṛpūrvakatve sādhye sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭānta viruddhaśca hetu naitadevam, bodhādhāre adhiṣṭhātari sādhye na sādhyavikalatva nāpi viruddhatvam
na cātra bodhādhārakāraṇatvakāryatvayo sāmānyavyāptervyāghātaḥ śakyasādhana, viśeṣeṇa tu vyāptivirahādasādhanatve dhūmasyāpyasādhanatvaprasaṅga
ghaṭasya yādṛśa karttā tādṛgeva bhaved bhuva
pṛ॰ 191 yadapi viśeṣaviruddhatvamasya pratipādita tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, viśeṣaviruddhasya hetvābhāsasyā'bhāvāt, abhyupagame vā sarvānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt
atha buddhimattayā īśvarasya śarīrayogamapi pratipadyate tenāpi pratipadyamānena śarīrādayo nityā anityā vā avaśyameṣitavyāḥ
atha nityān śarīrādīn kalpayasi evamapi dṛṣṭaviparītaṃ katpitaṃ bhavati dṛṣṭaviparpayaṃ pratipadyamānena buddhernityatvaṃ pratipattavyamicchā tu vidyate akliṣṭā'vyāhatā sarvārtheṣu yathā buddhiriti

aśarīrapūrvakatvañca śakyasādhanam; sarvopi karttā kārakasvarūpamavadhārayati, tata icchati-idamahamanena nirvarttayāmi iti, tata prayatate, tadanu kāyaṃ vyāpārayati, tataḥ karaṇānyadhitiṣṭhati, tata karoti, anavadhārayan anicchan aprayatamānaḥ kāyamavyāpārayan na karoti iti anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ buddhivat śarīramapi kāryotpattābupāyabhūtam tadidamaśarīrapūrvakatvānumānaṃ vyāptigrāhakapramāṇabādhitatvāt kālātyayāpadiṣṭaṃ vyāptivalena cābhipretamaśarīritvaviśeṣaṃ virundhad viśeṣaviruddhaṃ tataśca viruddhā vāntaraprabheda eveti pūrvapakṣasaṅkṣepa
atra pratisamādhiḥ–na tāvaccharīritvameva kartṛtvam; suṣuptasyodāsīnasya ca kartṛtvaprasaṅgāt, kintu paridṛṣṭasāmarthyakārakaprayojakatvaṃ tasmin sati kāryotpatte
asti tatrāpyasya svakarmopārjitaṃ tadeva śarīramiti cet, satyamasti, paraṃ preraṇopāyo na bhavati svātmani kriyāvirodhāt
icchāprayatnotpattāvapi śarīramapekṣaṇīyamiti cet; apekṣatāṃ yatra tayorāgantukatvam, yatra punaretau svābhāvikāvāsāte tatrāsyāpekṣaṇaṃ vyartham
dṛṣṭā hi rūpādīnā guṇānām āśrayabhedena dvayī gati tathā buddhyādīnāmapi bhaviṣyati
sarvajñatā cāsyā'khilakāryavrātasya kartṛtvāt siddhā, yo yasya kartā sa tadupādānādyabhijñaḥ yathā ghaṭotpādakaḥ kumbhakāro mṛdṛṇḍādyabhijñaḥ, jagataḥ karttā cāyaṃ bhagavān īśvara iti
upādānaṃ hi jagataścaturvidhāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, nimittakāraṇam adṛṣṭādi, bhoktā ātmā, bhogyaṃ tanukaraṇādi
te ca tadīyajñānādayo nityā, kumbhakārādijñānādibhyo vilakṣaṇatvāt
na ca sādhya-dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇoḥ sarvathā sāmyaṃ saṃbhavati, sakalānumānocchedaprasaṅgāt, nahi yādṛśo'gnirmahānase dṛṣṭaḥ tādṛśa eva parvate'sti
yat tadīśvarasya aiśvaryyaṃ kiṃ tannityamanityamiti ?nityam iti brūmaathāsya buddhinityatve kiṃ pramāṇamiti ? nanvidameva buddhimatkāraṇādhiṣṭhitā paramāṇavaḥ pravarttanta iti
tasya hi jñānakriyāśaktī nitye iti aiśvarya nityam
na ceśvarasya icchādīnāñca ekarūpatve nityatve ca sani kāryāṇāṃ kādācitkatvaṃ vaicitryañca virodhamadhyāste, kādācitkavicitrasahakārilābhena sāmagrīvaicitryasiddhau teṣāṃ tadvirodhā'saṃbhavāt

nanu kṣityāderbuddhimaddhetukatve akriyādarśino'pi jīrṇakūpaprāsādādivat kṛtabuddhirutpadyeta, na cotpadyate, ato dṛṣṭāntadṛṣṭasya hetordharmiṇyabhāvādasiddhatvam, tadapyayuktam; yata prāmāṇikam, itaraṃ vā'pekṣyedamucyate ? yadītaram; kathanna sakalānumānoccheda dhūmādāvapyasiddhatvānuṣaṅgāt ? prāmāṇikasya tu nāsiddhatvam, kāryatvasya buddhimatkāraṇapūrvakatvena pratipannā'vinābhāvasya kṣityādau prasiddheḥ, parvatādau dhūmādivat
na ca yāvanta padārthā kṛtakāḥ tāvantaḥ kṛtabuddhimātmanyāvirbhāvayanti iti niyamo'sti, khāta-pratipūritāyāṃ bhuvi akriyādarśina kṛtabuddherutpādābhāvāt

na ca akṛṣṭaprabhavai sthāvarādibhirvyabhicāro buddhimatkāraṇābhāve'pi svasāmagrītasteṣāmutpattipratīterityabhidhātavyam, teṣāṃ pakṣīkṛtatvāt, pakṣe eva sādhanavyabhicāre ca na kaściddheturgamaka syāt ityanumānavārtoccheda
buddhimatkāraṇābhāvaścātra anupalabdhito bhavatā prasādhyate, etaccāyuktam, dṛśyānupalabdhereva abhāvasādhakatvopapatte, na ceyamatra saṃbhavati kṣityādikartturadṛśyatvāt

nanu bhagavataḥ paramakāruṇikasya parārthapravṛtterjagannimittatve duḥkhotpādakaśarīrādyārambhakatvavirodha, tadavirodhe vā paramakāruṇikatvānupapatti, ityapi manorathamātram, dharmā'dharmasahakāriṇa kartṛtvāt, yaccharīrādyārambhe dharmo'dharmo vā sahakārī tasya sukhā'sukharūpaphalopabhogāya tathāvidhaśarīrādikamārabhate
bhagavato hi saṃsārāt prāṇino mocayiṣyāmi iti paropakārārthaiva pravṛtti
muktiśca eṣāṃ dharmādharmaprakṣayāt, tatprakṣayaśca phalopabhogaṃ vinā na ghaṭate iti karuṇāvato'pi tadvidhāne pravṛttiraviruddhā
yadi dharmādharmavaśāttasya pravṛtti, tarhi tābhyāmevā'khilakāryotpattirastu kimīśvarakalpanayā ? ityapyasādhīya, tayoracetanayo cetanādhiṣṭhitayoreva sva kārye pravṛttyupapatteḥ
tathāhi–dharmādharmau cetanādhiṣṭhitau svakārye pravartete, acetanatvāt, vāsyādivat
na cāsmadādyātmaiva adhiṣṭhāpako yuktaḥ; tasya adṛṣṭaparamāṇvādiviṣayavijñānā'bhāvāt
nāpyacetanasya akasmātpravṛttiḥ, anyathā niṣpanne'pi kārye tatpravarteta vivekaśūnyatvāditi

buddhimatyadhiṣṭhātari sādhye kathamacetanena karmaṇā siddhasādhanam, tasyāpyacetanatayā adhiṣṭhātrapekṣatvāt ? tathāhi–sarvamacetana cetanādhiṣṭhitaṃ pravarttamānaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā tantvādi, tathā ca karmādi
tathā ca asmadādyātmano na karmaviṣayaṃ jñānamindriyajam, nāpi paramāṇvādiviṣayam
na ca tadabhāve tasya preraka dṛṣṭam
pravṛttau vā pariniṣpannepi kārye pravartteta vivekaśūnyatvāt

yattāvat–kṣityāderbuddhimaddhetukatvasiddhaye kāryatvaṃ sādhanamuktam; tatkiṃ sāvayavatvam, prāgasataḥ svakāraṇasattāsamavāyaḥ, kṛtam iti pratyayaviṣayatvam, vikāritvaṃ vā syāt ? yadi sāvayavatvam; tadidamapi kimavayaveṣu vartamānatvam, avayavairārabhyamāṇatvam, pradeśavattvam, sāvayavam iti buddhiviṣayatvaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣe avayavasāmānyenā'nekāntaḥ, taddhi akāryamapi avayaveṣu vartata iti
dvitīyapakṣe tu sādhyā'viśiṣṭatvam; yathaiva hi kṣityādeḥ kāryatvaṃ sādhyam evaṃ paramāṇvādyavayavārabhyatvamapi
tṛtīyapakṣe'pi ākāśādinā'nekāntaḥ, tasya pradeśavattve'pi akāryatvāt, prasādhayiṣyate cāsya pradeśavattvaṃ ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake

na ca niravayavatve'pyasya sāvayavaghaṭādyarthasaṃyogād ghaṭākāśaṃ paṭākāśam iti sāvayavapratītigocaratvasaṃbhavāt aupacārikaṃ tattatra ityabhidhātavyam; niravayavatve'sya vyāpitvavirodhāt paramāṇuvat

nāpi prāgasataḥ svakāraṇasattāsambandhaḥ kāryatvam; tatsambandhasya samavāyākhyasya nityatvena kāryalakṣaṇatvā'yogāt, tallakṣaṇatve vā kāryasyāpi kṣityādestadvannityatvānuṣaṅgāt kasya buddhimaddhetukatvaṃ sādhyeta ? nirākariṣyate caitallakṣaṇaṃ kāryatvaṃ vistarataḥ ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāmiti
kṛtam iti pratyayaviṣayatvamapi na tallakṣaṇam; khananotsecanādinā kṛtamākāśam ityakārye'pyākāśe tasya gatatvāt
sato vastuno'nyathābhāvitvaṃ hi vikāritvam, tacca īśvare'pyastīti asyāpyaparabuddhimaddhetukatvaprasaṅgād anavasthā syāt
kāryatvaṃ svakāraṇasattāsamavāyaḥ syāt, abhūtvābhāvitvam, akriyādarśino'pi kṛtavuddhyutpādakatvaṃ kāraṇavyāpārānuvidhāyitvaṃ vā
sahāvayavairvartamānatvam, tairjanyamānatvaṃ vā, sāvayavamiti buddhiviṣayatvaṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 75 pū॰

kiñca, kādācitkaṃ vastu loke kāryatvena prasiddham, jagatastu maheśvaravat sadā sattvāt kathaṃ kāryatvam ? tadantargatānāṃ taru-tṛṇādīnāṃ kāryatvāt tasyāpi kāryatve maheśvarāntargatānāṃ buddhyādīnāṃ paramāṇvādyantargatānāṃ pākajarūpādīnāñca kāryatvāt maheśvarāderapi kāryatvānuṣaṅgaḥ, tathā ca asyāpyaparabuddhimaddhetukatvaprasaṅgāt anavasthā apasiddhāntaścānuṣajyate

astu vā yathākathañcijjagataḥ kāryatvam; tathāpi kiṃ kāryamātramatra hetutvena vivakṣitam, tadviśeṣo vā ? yadi kāryamātram; kathaṃ buddhimata kāraṇaviśeṣasya ato'numānam ? kāraṇamātreṇaivāsyā'vinābhāvaprasiddhe tanmātrasyaivāto'numānaṃ syāt, tatra cā'vipratipattiḥ
hetorakiñcitkaratvaṃ viruddhatvaṃ vā, buddhimatkartṛpūrvakatve sādhye kāraṇamātrasyaiva prasādhanāt

nanu yathā tārṇa-pārṇādiviśeṣān parihṛtya agnimātrasya dhūmamātrādanumānam, evaṃ kāryamātrād buddhimatkāraṇamātrasyānumānāt kathaṃ viruddhatvamatra ? ityapyasamīcīnama; anumānasya pratibandhāvaṣṭambhādeva pravṛtteḥ, pratibandhaśca kāryamātrasya kāraṇamātreṇaiva pratipanna dhūmamātrasyāgnimātreṇeva, na tu buddhimatā
na ca dhūmamātramapi agnimātrasya gamakam; apanītapāvakāpavarakadhūmenā'nekāntāt, api tu ucchaladvahalapatākākāraviśiṣṭam, tadvat kāryatvamapi kṛtabuddhyutpādakaṃ buddhimato gamakam, na sarvam

sārūpyamātreṇa gamakatve ca vāṣpāderapi agniṃ prati gamakatvaprasaṅga, maheśvaraṃ prati ātmatvāde saṃsāritvakiñcijjñatvā'khilajagadakartṛtvānumāpakatvānuṣaṅga, vastutvāde paramāṇuvat jagadabuddhimatpūrvakatvaprayojakatvaprasaṅgaśca syāt tulyākṣepasamādhānatvāt
tato vāṣpa-dhūmasaṃsthānayoḥ kenacidaṃśena sāmye'pi yathā kaścidviśeṣo'bhyupagamyate, yatsadbhāvāt dhūmo'gni gamayati na vāṣpādi, tathā kṣityādītarakāryatvasaṃsthānayorapi
atha kāryatvaviśeṣo hetu, yo buddhimatkartranvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvena niścitaḥ; so'siddha, tādṛgbhūtasyāsya kṣityādāvabhāvāt

samāropānneti cet, sopyubhayatra aviśeṣata kinna syāt kartturubhayatrātīndriyatvā'viśeṣāt ? atha prāmāṇikasya astyevātra kṛtabuddhi, nanu kena pramāṇena pramātuḥ prāmāṇikatvam–anenānumānena, anumānāntareṇa, āgamena, lokapratītyā vā ? tatrādyapakṣe anyonyāśraya; tathāhi–siddhaviśeṣaṇāddhetorasyotthānam, tadutthāne ca hetorviśeṣaṇasiddhiriti
anumānāntarañca nāstyeva, sattve vā tasyāpi saviśeṣaṇādeva hetorutthānam, tatrāpyanumānāntarādviśeṣaṇasiddhau anavasthā
āgamo'pi yuttayanugṛhota, ananugṛhīto vā pramātu prāmāṇikatvaṃ prasādhayet ? na tāvadananugṛhīta, atiprasaṅgāt

uktayukteśca āvartane cakrakaprasaṅga–akriyādarśino'pi kṛtabuddhyutpādakatvalakṣaṇakāryatvānumānasya hi siddhau tenāgamasya anugrahasiddhi, tadanugṛhotāccāgamāt pramātu prāmāṇikatvasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca akriyādarśino'pi kṛtabuddhyutpādakatvalakṣaṇakāryatvānumānasiddhiriti
nāpi kenacit sraṣṭrā jagat sṛṣṭam iti lokapratītyā prāmāṇikatvasiddhiḥ, asyā nirmūlatvāt na kadācidanīdṛśaṃ jagat iti pratītivat, vede mīmāṃsakasya akṛtrimatvapratītivacca
na hyasyā mūlamidamanumānam, liṅga-liṅgisambandhapratipatteḥ prāgabhāvata tadutthānasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
anyonyāśrayaśca, ane nānumānenāsyāḥ samūlatvasiddhau siddhaviśeṣaṇāddhetorasyānumānasyotthānasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau cāsyāḥ samūlatvasiddhiriti
nāpyāgamaḥ; tatrāpi itaretarāśrayatvānuṣaṅgāt–pramāṇabhūtāgamamūlatvasiddhau hi asyāḥ sātiśayapuruṣasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tatkṛtatvena pramāṇabhūtāgamamūlatvasiddhiriti
tataḥ kṣityādeḥ kṛtrimatvapratītiḥ lokapravādaparamparāyātā na pramāṇabalaprabhavā
upalambhe vā tatra tato jīrṇadevakulādiṣviva akriyādarśino'pi kṛtabuddhi syāt

nanu kṛtakena kṛtabuddhyutpādakenaiva bhāvyam iti nāstyayaṃ niyamaḥ, khātta-pratipūritāyāṃ bhūmau kṛtrimamaṇimuktāphalādau ca akriyādarśina kṛtabuddherutpādā'bhāvāt; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tatra akṛtrimabhūbhāgādisaṃsthānasārūpyasya kṛtabuddheranutpādakasya sadbhāvataḥ tadanutpādasyopapatteḥ
na ca kṣityādāvapi akṛtrimasaṃsthānasārūpyaṃ saṃbhavati, akṛtrimasaṃsthānasyaiva bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt, abhyupagame vā apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaḥ syāt
tato'kriyādarśino'pi kṛtabuddhyutpādakaḥ kṣityādyasaṃbhavī jīrṇakūpādau dṛṣṭakartṛkakūpādisajātīyatvalakṣaṇo viśeṣo bhavatā'bhyupagantavyaḥ, iti kathanna asiddho hetuḥ ?
siddhyatu vā; tathāpyasau viruddhaḥ, ghaṭādivat śarīrādiviśiṣṭasyaiva buddhimato'tra prasādhanāt
na caivaṃ sakalānumānocchedaḥ sarvatraivaṃ viruddhatvopapatterityabhidhātavyam; dhūmādyanumāne mahānasetarasādhāraṇasya agnyādeḥ pratipattisaṃbhavāt
atra pyevaṃ buddhimatsāmānyaprasiddherna viruddhatvamityapyayuktam; dṛśyaviśeṣādhārasyaiva tatsāmānyasya ataḥ prasiddheḥ nādṛśyaviśeṣādhārasya, tasya svapne'pyapratīteḥ kharaviṣāṇādhāratatsāmānyavat
hetuvyāpakatvenāpratipannasya gamyatve ca abhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśavato'pyagneḥ dhūmāt pratītiḥ syāt

tataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvavivekaṃ kurvatā yādṛśātkāraṇāt yādṛśaṃ kāryamupalavyaṃ tādṛśādeva tādṛśamanumātavyam, yathā yāvaddharmātmakādvahneḥ yāvaddharmātmakasya dhūmasyotpattiḥ sudṛḍhapramāṇātpratipannā tādṛśādeva dhūmāt tādṛśasyaivāgneranumānam
na ca prāsādādikāryavat kṣityādikārye'pi atiśayatāratamyapratīteḥ tatkartturatiśayavattvasiddhiḥ; tadvadasmādṛśasyaiva karturatiśayavataḥ siddhiprasaṅgāt
kṣityādinirmāṇe tasyāsāmarthyādanyādṛśo'sau siddhyati; ityapyayuktam; tatra kartrabhāvasyaiva evaṃ prasaṅgāt, anyādṛśasya karttuḥ hetuvyāpakatvena kadācidapyapratīteḥ
avyāpakasya ca gamyatve vyāpakamagamyam, avyāpakaṃ tu gamyam iti mahannyāyakauśalam
atha pariśeṣāt hetuvyāpakatvena akhilakārakaparijñānādyatiśayavān kartṛviśeṣaḥ prasādhyate, na hyanavagatakārakasāmarthyaḥ kāryasya karttā sarvasya sarvakartṛtvaprasaṅgāt

na cāsmadādeḥ kṣityādyaśeṣakārakasāmarthyāvagamo'sti paramāṇvāderatīndriyatvāt, tato'śeṣakārakaprayoktṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ kartṛtvaṃ tasya siddhyat tacchaktiparijñānādyatiśayapūrvakameva siddhyati; ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; prayoktṛtvasya śaktiparijñānā'vinābhāvā'siddheḥ suptamattapramattādyavasthāyāṃ vāgādihetūnāṃ tālvā dīnāṃ śaktiparijñānā'bhāve'pi prayoktṛtvopalambhāt
astu vā tadavinābhāva; tathāpi na samastakārakaśaktiparijñānaṃ siddhyati, sūtradhārādīnāṃ dharmādyaparijñāne'pi prāsādādau kārakaprayoktṛtvopalambhāt
yathā ca prārabdhakāryā'niṣpatteḥ sūtradhārādīnāṃ dharmādyaśeṣakārakā'parijñānaṃ tathā īśvarasyāpi tadastu prārabdhāṅkurādikāryā'niṣpattestatrāpyaviśeṣāt
bhavatu cāsyaiva tatparijñānam; tathāpi ekasyākhilakārakādhiṣṭātṛtvānupapattiḥ, anekasyā'pi anevakārakādhiṣṭhātṛtvopapatte

na hi nikhilaṃ kāryamekenaiva karttavyam ekaniyamitairanekairvā iti niyamo'sti, anekadhā kāryakartṛtvopalambhāt–ekena hi kvacidekaṃ kāryaṃ kriyate yathā paṭakuvindena, kvacittvanekaṃ yathā ghaṭaghaṭīśarāvādi kumbhakāreṇa, anekañcānekena yathā ghaṭa-paṭa-makuṭaśakaṭādi kulālādinā, kvacidanekenāpyekaṃ yathā uddehikābhirvalmīkam, na khalu tāsāṃ kaścideko'dhiṣṭhātā'sti

ekasūtradhārādhiṣṭhitānekasthapatyādīnā pravṛttyupalambhācca jagato maheśvaraikā'dhiṣṭhātṛkalpane anekoddehikānāmekenā'nadhiṣṭhitānāṃ pravṛttyupalambhāt tasya tenā'nadhiṣṭhitasyāpi pravṛttiḥ kinna syāt ubhayapratītyoḥ prāmāṇyā'viśeṣāt ?
ekakartturasiddhau ca sarvajñatva kimāśrayam ? tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 57
na hyayaṃ niyama nikhila kāryamekenaiva karttavyaṃ nāpi ekaniyatairvahubhi iti, anekadhā kāryakartṛtvopalambhāt

akṛṣṭaprabhavaistarutṛṇādibhirvyabhicārī cāyaṃ hetu, dvividhāni hi kāryāṇyupalabhyante, kānicid buddhimatpūrvakāṇi yathā ghaṭādīni, kānicittu tadviparītāni yathā akṛṣṭaprabhavavṛkṣādīni, ityubhayapratītyo prāmāṇyena ubhayo siddhisaṃbhavāt
teṣāṃ pakṣīkaraṇādavyabhicāre sa śyāma tatputratvāditaraputravat ityāderapi gamakatvaprasaṅgānna kaściddheturvyabhicārī syāt, vyabhicāraviṣayasya sarvatrāpi pakṣīkartuṃ śakyatvāt
īśvarabuddhyādibhiśca vyabhicāra; teṣāṃ kāryatve satyapi samavāyikāraṇādīśvarād vibhinnabuddhimatkartṛpūrvakatvā'bhāvāt
dṛṣṭānte hi ghaṭādau buddhimatkartṛpūrvakatvavat samavāyikāraṇādvyatiriktabuddhimatkartṛpūrvaktvenāpi vyāptiḥ kāryatvasya pratipannā
na caikasyaiva samavāyinimittakāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ ghaṭādau tathānupalambhāt, tatrānupalabdhasyāpi kalpane kṣityāderabuddhimaddhetukatvaṃ kinna kalpyeta aviśeṣāditi ?
kālātyayāpadiṣṭaścāyam; akṛṣṭaprabhavāṅkurādau kartrabhāvasya adhyakṣeṇaivādhyavasāyāt agneranuṣṇatve sādhye dravyatvavat

nanu yad dṛśyaṃ sat pratyakṣeṇa nopalabhyate tasya ato'bhāvaḥ nānyasya; anyathā ākāśāderapyabhāvaḥ syāt, na cāyaṃ dṛśyaḥ tatkathamato'sya abhāvaḥ syāt; ityapyasundaram; yato'sya siddhe kutaścitpramāṇātsadbhāve adṛśyatvenā'nupalambhaḥ syāt, tatsadbhāvaśca asmādeva, anyato vā pramāṇāt siddhyet ? prathamapakṣe cakrakam–ato hi tatsadbhāve siddhe asyā'dṛśyatvenānupalambhaḥ siddhyet, tatsiddhau ca kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvābhāvaḥ, tataścāsmāt tatsadbhāvasiddhiriti
astu vā tatsadbhāvaḥ, tathāpi asyā'dṛśyatve śarīrābhāvaḥ kāraṇam, vidyādiprabhāvaḥ, jātiviśeṣo vā ? na tāvat śarīrābhāvaḥ; aśarīrasya kāryakartṛtvānupapatteḥ

nanu śarīraṃ kartṛtvasāmagryāṃ na praviśati tadabhāve'pi jñānecchāprayatnāśrayatvamātreṇa svaśarīrapreraṇe kartṛtvopalambhāt; tadasat; śarīrasambandhenaiva tatpreraṇopalambhāt, tatsambandho hi ātmanaḥ saśarīratvam, tasminsatyeva svaśarīre'nyatra vā kāryakartṛtvamupapadyate

śarīrābhāve muktātmavajjñānādyāśrayatvamapyasaṃbhāvyam; tadutpattāvasya nimittakāraṇatvāt, tatkāraṇābhāve'pi tadutpattau muktātmano'pi tadutpattiprasaṅgaḥ, buddhimannimittā'bhāve'pi vā kṣityādyutpattiprasaṅgaḥ syāt
nityatvātteṣāmadoṣo'yam; ityapyasundaram; jñānādīnāṃ nityatvena kvacidapyapratīteḥ, īśvarajñānādayo na nityāḥ jñānāditvāt asmadādijñānādivat ityanumānavirodhācca
teṣāṃ dṛṣṭasvabhāvātikrame vā bhūruhādīnāmapi sa syādaviśeṣāt

tato jñānādīnāṃ śarīrasampādyatvamevā'bhyupagantavyam, tatkathamakiñcitkaraṃ śarīram, yataḥ sahacaramātreṇa kāraṇatve vahnipaiṅgilyasyāpi dhūmaṃ prati kāraṇatā prasajyeta ? na hi paiṅgilyamātraṃ dhūmakāraṇam haritālādau tatsadbhāvepi dhūmānutpatteḥ
vahniviśeṣitasya taddhetutve tu na kiñcidviruddham, yathaiva hi indhanasambaddho vahnirdhūmotpādakaḥ nānyaḥ, tathā vahniviśeṣitaṃ paiṅgilyaṃ tannibandhanaṃ nānyat
na khalu vidyābhṛtāṃ tantrādimatāñca śāśvatikamadṛśyatvaṃ dṛṣṭam

itaravidyābhṛdbhyo'sya vailakṣaṇyād dṛṣṭasvabhāvātikrameṣṭau jagato'pi itarakāryavailakṣaṇyāt tadatikrameṣṭiḥ kinna syāt ? piśācādivat jātiviśeṣo'syā'dṛśyatve hetuḥ; ityapyasundaram; ekasya jātiviśeṣā'saṃbhavāt anekavyaktiniṣṭhatvāttasya
nanu kuto'yaṃ śarīravānapi adṛśya vidyādiprabhāvāt, jātiviśeṣādvā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 433

astu vā'dṛśyo'sau, tathāpi sattāmātreṇa, jñānavattvena, jñānecchāprayatnavattvena, tatpūrvakavyāpāreṇa, aiśvaryeṇa vā kṣityāde kāraṇaṃ syāt ? prathamapakṣe kumbhakārāderapi tatkāraṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ sattāmātrasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt

atha yogināṃ tathābhūtamaśeṣārthaviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ nāsti tenā'yamadoṣa; asya kuta tat siddham ? sarvakartṛtvājñet, anyonyāśraya–sarvajñatvasiddhau hi sarvakartṛtvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca sarvajñatvasiddhiriti
vyāpāravattvamapi aśarīrasyāsambhāvyam; vyāpāro hi kāyakṛta, vākkṛto vā syāt ? ubhayamapi aśarīre na sambhavatyeva
na ca ksyacidapi evaṃvidhā pratītirasti yad vacanata kāyena vā'hamīśenātra prerita iti
tathāhi–nirvyāpāra īśvaraḥ sarvagatatvāt ākāśavat, sakriyatve cāsya atādavasthyānuṣaṅgādanityatvaṃ syāt, svāvasthāto'vicaladrūpasyaivārthasya nityaikarūpatopapatte
na ca paramāṇubhirvyabhicāraḥ, teṣāmapi pariṇāmā'nityatvasyeṣṭe, īśvarasyāpi tadvattadiṣṭau aparabuddhimaddhetukatvānuṣaṅgād anavasthā, anyathā tenaiva kāryatvādervyabhicāraḥ

yadi prāvānyena samastakārakaprayoktṛtvādīśvarasya sarvajñatva sādhyate, sarvajatvācca prayoktrantaranirapekṣa samastakārakaprayoktṛtvaṃ pradhānabhāvena, tadā parasparāśrayo doṣa kuto nivāryeta ? tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 368
pratikāryañcāsya ekadeśena, sarvātmanā vā vyāpāraḥ syāt ? ekadeśena cet; tarhi yāvantikāryāṇi tāvadbhireva īśvarā'vayavairbhāvyam iti niraṃśeśvarapratijñā hīyate
sarvātmanā vyāpāre yāvanti kāryāṇi tāvaddhā īśvarasya bhedaprasaṅgāt ekeśvarapratijñākṣati
kiñca, asau yenaikena svabhāvena ekaṃ kāryaṃ karoti tenaiva tatsthityādikaṃ kāryāntarañca, svabhāvāntareṇa vā ? yadi tenaiva, sthityutpattivipattīnāṃ kāryāntarāṇāñca krama vaicitryañca na syāt
sakalakāryāṇāmutpattivināśayoḥ sthitau ca maheśvarābhisanverekatve sakṛdutpattyādiprasaṅgāt vicitratvānupapatteriti

aiśvaryamapi jñātṛtvam, kartṛtvam, anyadvā syāt ? jñātṛtvañcet, tatki jñātṛtvamātram, sarvajñātṛtvaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣe jñātaiva asau syānneśvara, na hi yo yajjānāti sa tatra īśvara ityucyate anyajñātṛvat
dvitīyapakṣe'pi asya sarvajñatvameva syāt naiśvaryam sugatādivat
atha tayoreva tatra tannibandhanatvamiṣyate, nanvatrāpi tābhyāṃ kroḍīkṛtaṃ sarvam, kiñcidvā ? sarvasya kroḍīkāre yugapatsarvamutpadyet

kiñciccet; tarhi icchāprayatnaviṣayasya kramikatve kathamekarūpatvaṃ tayo syāt ? kiñca, iṣyamāṇārthāvacchedena icchotpadyate, na cottarakālabhāvyātmamanasaṃyogajajñānaviṣayākāraṃ vinā tatra niyataviṣayamātmānamapyasau svīkarttuṃ samartha
kiñca, asya sisṛkṣāsañjihīrṣe kiṃ yugapad bhavataḥ, krameṇa vā ? yugapadbhāve sṛṣṭi-saṃhārayoḥ yaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ
krameṇa utpattau kāraṇaṃ vācyam, kāraṇāpekṣāyāñca nityatvakṣatiḥ
atha nityamapi icchāprayatnādikaṃ vicitrasahakārisannidhānāt kāryavaicitryaṃ vidadhāti, nanu te sahakāriṇo'tadāyattāḥ, tadāyattā vā ? atadāyattatve taireva kāryatvādervyabhicāraḥ
tadāyattatve tadaiva te kuto na bhavanti ? taddhetūnāmabhāvāditi cet; te'pi tadāyattā na vā ityādidūṣaṇaṃ tadavastham ityanavasthā

kiñca, ete sahakāriṇaḥ tasyopakārakāḥ, na vā ? yadyanupakārakāḥ; kathaṃ sahakāriṇaḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? upakārakatve asya pariṇāmitvam tatkṛtopakārasya ato'narthāntaratvāt, arthāntaratve tasya iti vyapadeśo na syāt, tenāpyupakārāntarakaraṇe anavasthā

syādetat neśvara eva kevalaṃ kāraṇamapi tu dharmādharmādisahakārikāraṇāntaramapekṣya karotitadetadasamyak; yadi hi sahakāribhiḥ kaścidupakāribhi ? kaścidupakāra karttavyo bhavet, tadā tasya sahakāriṇi vyapekṣā

yāvatā nityatvāt parairanādheyātiśayasya na kiñcittasya sahakāribhiḥ prāptavyamastīti kimiti tāṃstathābhūtānanupakāriṇa sahakāriṇo'pekṣeta ? kiñca, ye'pi te sahakāriṇaḥ te'pi sarva eveśvarasyāyattajanmatayā nityaṃ samavahatā evatattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 54
nanu te'pi tajjñānādyāyattajanmāna kinna sarvadā sannidhīyante ? atha naiva te tadāyattotpattaya tarhi taireva kāryatvādiheturanaikāntika

kiñca, īśvarasya jagannirmāṇe yathāruci pravṛttiḥ, karmapāratantryeṇa, karuṇayā, dharmādiprayojanoddeśena, krīḍayā, nigrahānugrahavidhānārtham, svabhāvato vā ? yathāruci pravṛttau kadācidanyādṛśyapi sṛṣṭiḥ syāt
karmapāratantrye ca asya svātantryahāniḥ, etadeva hi svātantryam īśvaratvaṃ vā yadananyamukhaprekṣitvam
atha karuṇayā; tarhi kāruṇikatvād yugapat sarvānapi abhyudayena yuñjyāt, tato na kaścid duḥkhitaḥ syāt
atha eṣāmabhyudayaḥ syāt ityanayaivecchayā tāni tāni karmāṇi anubhāvayati, so'yaṃ prakṣālitā'śucimodakatyāganyāyaḥ
kāruṇikasya hi etadeva kāruṇikatvam–yat anyeṣāṃ duḥkhaleśo'pi mābhūt ityanusandhānam
atha īśvaraḥ ki karoti, pūrvārjitaiḥ karmabhireva te tathā vaśīkṛtā yena duḥkhamanubhavanti; tarhi tasya kaḥ puru ṣakāraḥ ? karmaṇāmupabhogenaiva prakṣayopapatte

adṛṣṭāpekṣasya ca kartṛtve kiṃ tatkalpanayā ? kalpito'pi asāvadṛṣṭādhīnaścet, jagadeva tadadhīnamastu kimanenāntargaḍunā ? atha dharmādiprayojanamuddiśyāyaṃ pravartate, tarhi kathamasau kṛtakṛtyaḥ syāt tasya tatprayojanavirodhāt ? krīḍāsadbhāve ca kathaṃ vītarāgatā rathyāpuruṣavat ? paramapurupaśceścaraḥ bāla-grahilavat krīḍati iti mahaccitram
nigrahānugrahapradatve'pi katha vītarāgadveṣatā ? tathāhi–rāgavān īśvara, anugrahapradatvāt, rājavat

atha svabhāvato'sau pravartate yathā āditya prakāśasvabhāvatvāt prakāśayati, tarhi caitanyasya sato'pi akiñcitkaratvāt jagato'cetanasyāpi svabhāvata pravṛttirastu, kimadhiṣṭhātṛparikalpanayā ? tasya anādau kāle svabhāvenaiva sthitatvāt
kathamacetanasya deśādiniyama niṣpanne'pi vā kārye pravṛttirnasyāt ? ityanyatrāpi samānam, nityādisvabhāvasyeśvarasyāpi taddoṣapratipādanāt
athāyamīśvara kurvāṇa kimartha karoti ? loke hi ye karttāro bhavanti te kiñciduddiśya pravarttante idamāpsyāmi idaṃ hāsyāmi ceti, na punarīśvarasya heyamasti duḥkhābhāvāt, nopādeyaṃ vaśitvāt

eke tāvad bruvate krīḍārthamīśvara sṛjati iti nanvetadayuktam, krīḍā hi nāma ratyarthaṃ bhavati na ca ratyarthī bhagavān vibhūtikhyāpanārtham ityapare etadapi tādṛgeva kimarthaṃ tarhi karoti ? tatsvābhāvyāt pravarttate ityaduṣṭam
buddhimattvañcāsya anityayā buddhyā, nityayā vā syāt ? na tāvannityayā, tannityatvasya pratītyā anumānena ca bādhitatvapratipādanāt

atha anityayā, kutau'sau jāyeta–indriyārthasannikarṣāt, samādhiviśeṣāt, tadutthadharmamāhātmyāt, anudhyānamātrādvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yukta; aśarīrasyāsya antaḥkaraṇasya anyasya cendriyasyānupapattermuktātmavat, upapattau vā na sarvajñatā tajjanitajñānasya niyataviṣayatvāt
kiñca, acetanāścakṣurādaya kenacidadhiṣṭhitāstajjñāna janayanti, anadhiṣṭhitā vā ? yadyanadhiṣṭhitā, tadā jagadapi acetanā kenacidanadhiṣṭhitā janayantu alamadhiṣṭhātṛkalpanayā
athādhiṣṭhitā, kimadhiṣṭhātrantareṇa, tenaiva vā ? adhiṣṭhātrantareṇa cet; anavasthā
tenaiva cet, cakrakam; tathāhi–jñātā santaste preryante, preritā jñānaṃ janayanti, janitajñānā jñātā bhavantīti

samādhiviśeṣa anudhyānañca jñānaviśeṣa eva, tasya ca adyāpyasiddhe kathaṃ svasmādeva svasyotpatti ? samādhiviśeṣā'saṃbhave ca kathaṃ taduttho dharmastatra saṃbhāvyeta, yatastanmāhātmyājjñānotpatti syāt ? aśarīrasya ca samādhiviśeṣādikaṃ muktātmavad durghaṭameva

ata kāraṇā'saṃbhavād īśvare jñānasadbhāvā'nupapatte kathaṃ tatra buddhimattā siddhyet ? atha nityā'nityabuddhiviśeṣānapekṣayā buddhisāmānyena tatra tadvattā prasādhyate, tadapyasāram; dvitīyaviśeṣasyā'saṃbhavāt, na khalu nityo buddhiviśeṣa kadācidapyanubhūyate, anityasyaivā'sya sarvadā'nubhavāt
ata siddhyat tatsāmānyamanityabuddhiviśeṣādhārameva siddhyet, tadviśeṣasya ceśvare kāraṇā'saṃbhavato'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ tadādhāramapi tatsāmānyaṃ siddhyet ?
astu vā yathākathañcid buddhimattvamasya, tathāpi śāstrāṇāṃ pramāṇetaravyavasthāvilopa, sarva śāstraṃ pramāṇameva syāt īśvarapraṇītatvāt tatpraṇītaprasiddhaśāstravat

saṃsāra vilopaśca; īśvaravyāpārāt pūrvaṃ tanukaraṇādyabhāvataḥ sakalātmaguṇānāṃ buddhyādīnāmapyabhāvāt, nahi tanukaraṇādyabhāve buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇā'bhāve ca ātyantikīṃ śuddhimāskandatāmātmanām amuktatvaṃ yuktamiti
saṃsāravidhāne pravṛtto'sau tadabhāvaṃ vidadhāti iti mahatī prekṣāpūrvakāritā ? tato yaugopakalpitasyeśvarasya akhilajagajjanakatvā'saṃbhavāt nātaḥ sarvajñatāsiddhiḥ
nyāyasū॰, bhāṣya, bā॰, bā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ 4
etena sāṅkhyaparikalpitasyāpīśvarasyā'śeṣajñatā pratyuktā, jagannimittakāraṇatvena asyāṃ pratijñāyamānāyāṃ proktāśeṣadoṣānuṣaṅgā'viśeṣāt
nanu sāṅkhyairīśvarasvarūpasyānyathā vyāvarṇanāt kathaṃ yaugopakalpiteśvarapakṣoktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ ? tathāhi–kleśa-karma-vipākāśayairaparāmṛṣṭaḥ puruṣaviśeṣa īśvaraḥ
3 karmāṇi śubhāśubhāni, tadviṣākāḥ karmaphalopabhogarūpāḥ, āśayāḥ nānāvidhatadanuguṇasaṃskārāḥ, tairaparāmṛṣṭo yaḥ puruṣaviśeṣaḥ sa īśvara iti
na caivaṃ sarvamuktātmanāmīśvaratvaprasaṅgaḥ tadaparāmṛṣṭatvā'viśeṣāt ityabhidhātavyam; teṣāṃ sarvadā bandhenā'parāmṛṣṭatvā'saṃbhavāt
yo hi sarvadā bandhavinirmuktaḥ kleśādibhiraparāmṛṣṭaḥ sa īśvaraḥ
na ca tadanye muktātmānastathāvidhāḥ; teṣāṃ prākṛta-vaikārika dakṣiṇālakṣaṇavandhatrayasadbhāvāt
prākṛto hi bandhaḥ ātmā'nātmavivekā'bhāvasvabhāvaḥ, viṣayā''saṅgasvarūpastu vaikārikaḥ, bhogādhirūḍhadharmādharmalakṣaṇaśca dakṣiṇābandhaḥ
anena ca bandhatrayeṇa āmūlādīśvara evā'spṛṣṭa, muktātmānastu etāni trīṇyapi bandhanāni vivekajñānena mādhyasthyena karmaphalopabhogena ca nirmūlyaiva kaivalyaṃ prāptā

ayaṃ tu bhagavān īśvara sadaiva muktaḥ sadaiveśvara na tasya pūrvā koṭirasti yathā saṃsārimuktātmanām, nāpyaparā yathā prakṛtilīnatattvajñānānāṃ yoginām, te hi mukti prāpyāpi punarbandhabhājo bhavanti
aiśvaryañcāsya niratiśayotkṛṣṭasattvāyā buddheryogāt siddham, niratiśayasattvotkarṣaścāsyā śāsanatrāṇalakṣaṇaśāstropādānāt

nanvevamitaretarāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi niratiśayasattvotkarṣe tallakṣaṇaśāstropādānasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca niratiśayasattvotkarṣasiddhiriti, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, īśvare śāstra-niratiśayasatvotkarṣayoḥ anādisambandhasaṃbhavāt
puruṣodṛkśakti buddhiḥ darśanaśaktiḥ ityetayo ekasvarūpāpattirevā'smitā kleśa ucyate
pañcaparvā bhavatyavidyā–avidyā'smitārāgadveṣābhiniveśā kleśā iti, eta eva svasaṃjñābhi tamo moha mahāmohaḥ tāmiśra andhatāmiśra iti cittamalaprasaṅgena abhidhāsyante
sa ca vandhastrividha prakṛtibandho vaikārikabandho dakṣiṇābandhaśca
tatra prakṛtibandho nāma aṣṭāsu prakṛtibuddhyahaṅkāratanmātreṣu prakṛtiṣu paratvenābhimāna
prakṛtilaya prakṛtibandha ityucyate, yajñādibhi dakṣiṇābandha ityucyate, aiśvaryādinimitto bhogo vaikārika ityucyate
avidyādaya kleśā, kuśalākuśalāni karmāṇi, tatphalaṃ vipāka, tadanuguṇā vāsanā āśaya
te ca manasi varttamānā puruṣe vyapadiśyante sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti, yathā jaya parājayo vā yoddhṛṣu varttamāna svāmini vyapadiśyate
yo hyanena bhogenāparāmṛṣṭa sa puruṣaviśeṣa īśvara
kaivalya prāptāstarhi santi ca vahava kevalina, te hi trīṇi bandhanāni chittvā kaivalya prāptā
īśvarasya ca tatsambandho na bhūto na bhāvī
yathā muktasya pūrvā bandhakoṭi prajñāyate naivamīśvarasya
yathā vā prakṛtilīnasya uttarā bandhakoṭi saṃbhāvyate naivamīśvarasya
sa tu sadaiva mukta sadaiva īśvara iti
yo'so prakṛṣṭasattvopādānāt īśvarasya śāśvatika utkarṣa sa kiṃ sanimitta ahosvinnirnimitta iti ? tasya śāstraṃ nimittam
etayo śāstrotkarṣayo īśvarasattve varttamānayo anādi sambandha
taccaiśvaryam aṣṭavidham–aṇimā, laghimā, mahimā, prāpti, prākāmyam, īśitvam, vaśitvam, yatrakāmāvasāyitā ceti
tatra aṇimā–yadaṇuśarīro bhūtvā sarvabhūtairadṛśya sarvaloke sañcarati
prākāmyam–yatpracurakāmo bhavati, viṣayān bhoktuṃ śaknoti ityarthaḥ
vaśitvam– yad bhūtāni sthāvarajaṅgamāni vaśaṃ nayati, vaśyendriyaśca bhavati
yatrakāmāvasāyitā–yad brāhmaprājāpatya-daiva-gāndharva-yakṣa-rākṣasa-pitrya-paiśāceṣu mānuṣyeṣu tairyagyoniṣu ca sthānāntareṣu ca yatra yatra kāmayate tatra tatra āvasatīti
aiśvaryam īśvarabhāvena ityaṣṭavidham–aṇimā, laghimā, garimā, mahimā, prāpti, prākāmyam, īśitvam, vaśitvam, yatrakāmāvasāyitvamiti

tatrāṇimā bhavatyaṇu, laghimālaghurbhavati, mahimā mahān bhavati, prāpti aṅgulyagreṇa spṛśati candram, prākāmyam icchānabhighāto bhūmāvunmajati nimajjati yathodake, vaśitva bhūtabhautikeṣu vaśī bhavati avaśyañcānyeṣām, īśitṛtvam–tepāmprabhavāpyayavyūhānāmīṣṭe, yatrakāmāvasāyitvam satyasaṅkalpatā, yathā saṅkalpa tathā bhūtaprakṛtīnāmavasthānam
vikriyagocarā ṛddhi anekavidhā–aṇimā, mahimā, laghimā, garimā, prāpti, prākāmyam, īśitvam, vaśitvam, apratighāta, antardhānam, kāmarūpitvam, ityevamādi
vijitaguṇārthavattvo hi yogī yad yadarthatayā saṅkalpayati tat tasmai prayojanāya kalpyate
tadyathā–brāhmaṃ prājāpatyam aindraṃ paitraṃ gāndharvaṃ yākṣaṃ rākṣasaṃ paiśācamityaṣṭavidho daivasarga
eteṣāñca jñānaiśvaryādīnāṃ prakṛṣṭa-prakṛṣṭatamadvāreṇa tāratamyadarśanāt yatra viśrāntaḥ prakarṣaḥ sa īśvara iti saṃbhāvanā'numānena asau vyavasthāpyate
tathāhi–yastāratamyaprakarṣaḥ sa kvacid viśrāmyati yathā parimāṇaprakarṣo vyomni, tāratamyaprakarṣaśca jñānaiśvaryādidharmāṇāmiti
tasya cetthaṃ prasiddhasvarūpasyeśvarasya niḥśeṣasaṃsāryanugrahārthameva pravṛttiḥ, sa hi kalpapralayamahāpralayeṣu samagraṃ jagaduddhariṣyāmi iti pratijñāvān avatiṣṭhate
sa ca dhyāyibhiścintyamāno vācakena praṇavādinā japyamānaḥ tebhyo'bhimataṃ phalaṃ prayacchati
kālenā'navacchedāccāsau pūrveṣāmapi kapilamaharṣiprabhṛtīnāṃ guruḥ, te hi kalpamahākalpādinā kālena avacchidyante, natu īśvara iti
tathā coktam–ādividvānnirmāṇacittamadhiṣṭhāya kāruṇyād bhagavān paramarṣi āsurathe jijñāsamānāya dharma provāca iti
pūrve hi guruva kālenāvacchedyante, yatra avacchedārthena kālo nopāvarttate sa eṣa pūrveṣāmapi guru

yattāvaduktam–kleśetyādi; tadavicāritaramaṇīyam; yataḥ kleśādibhiraparāmṛṣṭatvamātraṃ tasya svarūpam, tasmin sati aśeṣajñatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe mukta evāsau syāt tairaparāmṛṣṭatvāt tadanyamuktavat na punarīśvaraḥ, tadanyamuktātmanāmapi tattvaprasaṅgāt
sarvadā bandhenā'spṛṣṭatvā'bhāvānna teṣāṃ tatprasaṅgaḥ; ityapi śraddhāmātram; īśvarasyāpi sarvadā bandhenā'spṛṣṭatvā'saṃbhavāt, tadasaṃbha vaśca mokṣaprarūpaṇāvasare pratipādayiṣyate
atha tadaspṛṣṭatve sati aśeṣajñatvaṃ tasya svarūpam, tatkuta siddham aśeṣakartṛtvāt, aiśvaryāśrayatvādvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; yaugābhimateśvarapakṣanikṣiptadūṣaṇagaṇaprasaṅgāt
kartṛtvābhyupagame cāsya akartā nirguṇaḥ śuddhaḥ ityāderātmalakṣaṇasyā'nupapattiḥ
atha anyātmanāmevaitallakṣaṇaṃ neśvarasya, asyā'to viśiṣṭatvāt tenā'yamadoṣa; nanvevaṃ śuddhatvāderapi īśvarasvarūpatvā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt atīva tasya tebhyo viśiṣṭatvaṃ syāt
yata kleśādibhiraparāmṛṣṭatvamātraṃ tasya svarūpa tasmin sati aśeṣajñatvaṃ vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 454
astu vā'sya kartṛtvam, tathāpyasau svatantraḥ kārya kuryāt, prakṛtitantro vā ? yadi svatantraḥ, tadā yaugopakalpiteśvarānna viśiṣyate iti taddopeṇaiva duṣṭatā'sya pratipattavyā
atha prakṛtitantra; tanna, prakṛte svarūpata evā'siddheḥ, tadasiddhiśca agre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt siddhā
tattantratā cāsya anayā'tiśayādhānāt, militvaikakāryakāritvādvā syāt ? tatrādyakalpanā'yuktā, sarvathā nityatvena avikāriṇo'sya atiśayādhānā'saṃbhavāt
dvitīyakalpanāpyanupapannā, kāryāṇāṃ yaugapadyaprasaṅgāt apratihatasāmarthyasya īśvarapradhānākhyakāraṇadvayasya sarvatra sarvadā sannihitatvenā'vikalakāraṇatvātteṣām
yad yadā'vikalakāraṇaṃ tattadā bhavatyeva yathā antyakṣaṇaprāptasāmagrīto'ṅkura, avikalakāraṇañca nityavyāpīśvara-pradhānākhyakāraṇadvayādhīnamaśepaṃ kāryamiti
sa kiṃ svatantra sarva kārya kuryāt prakṛtiparatantro vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 454
sāhityaṃ sahakāritvāt etayo kalpyate ca yat

nanu kāraṇadvayasyā'sya sarvatra sarvadā sannihitatve'pi na sarvatra sarvadā kāryotpattiḥ, tatsthityutpattivināśavidhāne sattvarajastamasāmudbhūtavṛttīnāṃ yathākramaṃ sahakāritvāt, teṣāñca tathāvidhānāṃ kramabhāvitvāditi; tadapyapeśalam; yata prakṛtīśvarayo sthityutpattipralayānāṃ madhye anyatamotpādanasamaye tadaparotpādane sāmarthyamasti, na vā ? yadyasti, tarhi sṛṣṭisamaye'pi sthitipralayaprasaṅga avikalakāraṇatvādutpādavat, evaṃ sthitikāle'pi utpāda-vināśayoḥ vināśakāle ca sthityutpādayo prasaṅgaḥ
nahi parasparaparihāreṇāvasthitānāmutpādādidharmāṇām ekatra dharmiṇyekadā sadbhāvo yukta pratītivirodhāt
atha nāsti sāmarthyam; tadā ekameva sthityādīnāṃ madhye kārya sadā syāt yajjanane tayoḥ sāmarthyamasti, nāparaṃ tajjanane tayoḥ sāmarthyā'saṃbhavāt

nanu cānayoḥ tatsāmarthyasaṃbhave'pi yadodbhūtavṛttirajaḥ sahakāri bhavati tadotpattividhāyakatvam, yadā sattvam tadā sthitikāritvam, yadā tu tamaḥ tadā pralayotpādakatvam; ityapyasāmpratam; yatastepāmudbhūtavṛttitvaṃ nityam, anityaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvannityam; kādācitkatvāt, sthityādīnāṃ yaugapadyaprasaṅgācca
atha anityam; kuto jāyate prakṛtīśvarādeva, anyato vā kutaścit, svātantryeṇa vā ? prathamapakṣe sadā'sya sadbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtīśvarākhyasya hetornityarūpatayā sadā sannihitatvāt
atha anyataḥ; tanna; prakṛtīśvaravyatirekeṇa aparakāraṇasya bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt
tṛtīyapakṣe tu deśa-kālaniyamenā'sya āvirbhāvavirodhaḥ svātantryeṇa bhavataḥ tanniyamānupapatteḥ
svabhāvāntarāyattavṛttayo hi bhāvāḥ kādācitkāḥ syuḥ tadbhāvābhāvapratibaddhatvāt tatsattvā'sattvayoḥ, nānye teṣāmapekṣaṇīyasya kasyacidapyabhāvāt, apekṣaṇīyasadbhāve vā svātantryeṇotpādavirodhāt
ataḥ kartṛtvasya īśvare vicāryamāṇasya kathañcidapyanupapatternātaḥ tasyāśepajñatvasiddhiḥ
tathāhi–yadodbhūtavṛttinā rajasā yukto bhavati maheśvara tadā sargahetu prajānā bhavati prasavakāryatvādrajasa
yadā tu sattva samudbhūtavṛtti saṃśrayate tadā lokānā sthitikāraṇaṃ bhavati sattvasya sthitihetutvāt
yadā tu tamasodbhūtaśaktinā samāyukto bhavati tadā pralayaṃ nāśa sarvajagataḥ karoti tamasaḥ pralayahetutvāt
yathoktam–rajojuṣe janmani sattvavṛttaye sthitau prajānā pralaye tamaspṛśe
tataścāsya bhāva kadācit prakṛtīśvarādeva kāraṇāt, anyato vā heto svatantro vā syāt ? tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 61

nāpyaiśvaryāśrayatvāt, tatraiśvaryasyāpi vicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ, taddhi tatra svābhāvikam, prakṛtikṛtaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvat svābhāvikam; buddhidharmatayā sāṅgryaistasyābhyupagamāt, caitanyameva hi taiḥ ātmani svābhāvikaṃ svarūpamabhyugatam

atha prakṛtikṛtam; tathāhi–yadā prakṛtirbuddhilakṣaṇena vikāreṇa pariṇamate tadā tadavasthāviśeṣāḥ dharma-jñāna-vairāgya-aiśvaryādayaḥ prādurbhavantīti; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; evam īśvarasya bhavataiva aiśvaryā'bhāvapratipādanāt, na hi buddhipariṇāmasyaiśvaryasya saṃbhave tato'rthāntarasyāsya tad yuktam, anyātmano'pi tatprasaṅgāt

atha buddhyā saha sambandhasadbhāvāt tasyaiva tat nānyasya ityucyate; nanu ko'yaṃ tenāsyā sambandhaḥ–samavāya, saṃyogādiḥ, taduddeśena pravṛttimātraṃ vā ? na tāvat samavāyaḥ, anyadharmasyānyatra samavāyānupapatteḥ, yo yaddharma sa tato'nyatra na samavaiti yathā cidrūpatā, prakṛtidharmaśca buddhi, tasmāttato'rthāntare'smin na samavaitīti
na ca sphaṭikādisamavetena raktādidharmeṇā'nekānta; japāpuṣpasannidhāne sphaṭikādereva tathā pariṇamanāt
ātmano'pi buddhirūpatayā pariṇataprakṛtisannidhāne tathā pariṇāmābhyupagame cicchaktirapariṇāminyapratisaṅkramā vyāsabhā॰ pṛ॰ 15 ityādigranthavirodha
tanneśvareṇa saha buddheḥ samavāya sambandho ghaṭate
nāpi saṃyoga, buddheradravyatvāt atiprasaṅgācca; sarvairapi hi ātmabhirnityavyāpibhiḥ tasyā saṃyogo vidyata eva
etena saṃyuktasamavāyādirapi pratyākhyāta, asaṃbhavasya atiprasaṅgasya cātrāpyaviśeṣāt

atha taduddeśena pravṛttimātramevāsyāstena sambandha; tadapyasāmpratam; īśvaroddeśena asyāḥ pravṛtterevāsaṃbhavāt, puruṣārthakarttavyatāvaśena hi prakṛte pravartamānāyā buddhyādayo vikārāḥ vyaktimāsādayanti, na ceśvarasya kaścitpuruṣārtha karttavyo'sti, nityanirmuktatvena kṛtakṛtyatvāt tatkathaṃ tamuddiśya prakṛti pravarteta ? apravṛttāyāṃ vāsyāṃ kathamaiśvaryasaṃbhava ?
aiśvarya hi tatra svābhāvikam, prakṛtikṛtaṃ vā syāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 455
tatra buddheḥ sātvikaṃ rūpaṃ caturvivaṃ bhavati dharmo jñānaṃ virāgamaiśvargamiti
nanu ko'yamīśvareṇa sākaṃ buddhe sambandha–samavāya, saṃyogādi, īśvaroddeśena pravṛttimātra vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 456
tayā coktaṃ pañcaśikhena–apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛśakti apratisaṅkramā ca

kiñca, aiśvaryaṃ svābhimatakāryasampādane dravyasahāyādisampannatvamucyate, kāryañcet svābhimataṃ na kiñcidasau sampādayati kevalaṃ vastu yathāvajjānāti, kathaṃ tarhi tāvatāsya aiśvaryam ? nahi yo yat jānāti sa tatra īśvara ityucyate, atiprasaṅgāt
atha kālenānavacchinnaṃ tajjñānam tenāsau īśvara nānyaḥ, nanu kālenā'navacchinnatvaṃ nityatve gamakam naiśvarye
etena saṃbhāvanānumānaṃ pratyuktam, tato hi buddhyādiguṇānāṃ paramaprakarṣaḥ siddhyet naiśvaryam

kiñca, puruṣārthakarttavyatānurodhena prakṛtitaḥ pravartamānāyā niravaśeṣabhogapūrvakaṃ vivekakhyātiparyantaṃ puruṣārtha sampādya vinivṛttakartṛtvabhoktṛtvādyabhimānāyā buddhe svakāraṇe layaḥ sampadyate, tataśca īśvaraṃpratyasyāḥ kṛtārthatā syāt, na vā ? kṛtārthatve buddheḥ svakāraṇe līnatvāt gatamasyaiśvaryam
akṛtārthatve adyāpi bandhaleśasya sadbhāvād yogitulyatvamasya syāt, neśvaratvamiti
nanu vādhakābhāvavat sādhakasyāpi pramāṇasya tatrā'bhāvāt sandeho'stu, ityārekāṃ nighnannāha– sādhaka ityādi
sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvāt kāraṇāt tatra atīndriyapratyakṣe saṃśītiḥ anena yāvajjñeya ityādinā granthena pratyuktā nirastā
yadi nāma vādhakasyaivā'saṃbhavaḥ kimetāvatā atīndriyapratyakṣasya sadbhāvo bhaviṣyati ? ityatrāha– sarvatra ityādi
sarvatra dṛśye'nyatra vā viṣaye bādhakābhāvetarābhyāṃ bhāvā'bhāvavyavahārasiddhiḥ bādhakasyābhāvena hi vastuni bhāvavyavahārasiddhiḥ, bhāvena ca abhāvavyavahārasiddhiriti
nanu na bādhakābhāvād bhāvavyavahārasiddhiḥ api tu pratīteḥ ityāśaṅkyāha–tata eva ityādi
tata eva bādhakābhāvādeva anubhavasya sukhādisaṃvedanasya prāmāṇyavyavasthāpanāt iti evam alamatiprasaṅgena
sādhakavādhakapramāṇābhāvāt sarvajñe saṃśayo'stu ityayuktam; yasmāt sādhakavādhakapramāṇayoḥ nirṇayād bhāvābhāvayoravipratipatti bādhakanirṇayāttvasattāyām
nanu ca indriyā'nindriyapratyakṣasya vartamānamātraparyavasitatvena heyopādeyā'viṣayatvāt kathaṃ saṃvyavahāraniyuktatvam ? ityārekāyāmāha–
❀ arthagrahaṇaṃ yogyatālakṣaṇam, tadanantarabhūtaṃ sanmātradarśanaṃ svaviṣayavyavasthāpanavikalpam uttarapariṇāmaṃ pratipadyate avagrahaḥ
vavasāya ca avāyaṃ dharaṇaṃ puṇa dhāraṇa veti
īhā ūhā tarka parīkṣā vicāraṇā jijñāsā ityanarthāntaram

akṣāṇāṃ cakṣurādīndriyāṇāṃ arthānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ yoge sambandhe yogyatālakṣaṇesati, na tu saṃyogādilakṣaṇe tasya prāgeva pratikṣiptatvāt, sattālokaḥ sakalaheyopādeyasādhāraṇasattvamātrasya āloko darśanam ātmana prathamataḥ prādurbhavati, tadanu sa evā''lokaḥ arthākāravikalpadhīḥ bhavati

arthaḥ vyavahāriṇā heyatvena upādeyatvena vā prārthyamāno bhāvaḥ tasya ākāraḥ sattvasāmānyādavāntaro jātiviśeṣo manuṣyatvādiḥ tasya vikalpadhīḥ nirṇayarūpā buddhiḥ āvirbhavati tadrūpatayā darśanaṃ pariṇamata ityartha
anyasyā'prakṛtatvādaśrūyamāṇatvācca arthākārasyaiva viśeṣo balākādibhedo gṛhyate tasya ākāṅkṣā bhavitavyatāpratyayarūpatayā grahaṇābhimukhyam

tataśca jñānajñeyayo kathañcitkālāntarānuvṛttimattvaprasiddhe siddham indriyā'nindriyaprabhavapratyakṣasya savyavahāraniyuktatvaṃ heyopādeyārthaviṣayatvasaṃbhavāt, sarvathā' nanuvṛttimata eva tadasaṃbhavata tanniyuktatvā'nupapatte
nanu kārikāyāṃ darśanaṃ pūrvamuktam paścād avagrahaḥ, vṛttau tu viparyayaḥ kimartham ? iti cet avagrahād darśanasya kārikāyāṃ pūrva pratijñātasya anumeyatvakhyāpanārtham
yathaiva hi avāntarajātigrahaṇapūrvakam uttaraṃ viśeṣajñāna tattvāt, tathā tata eva avāntarajātigrahaṇaṃ sattā darśanapūrvakam; na ca sattāyāḥ paraṃ sāmānyamasti yato'navasthā syāt
viṣayaḥ ghaṭādiḥ viṣayī cakṣurādiḥ tayoḥ samīcīnaḥ yathārthajñānajanako nipātaḥ yogyadeśādyavasthānam tasya anantaram ādyaṃ grahaṇaṃ jñānam avagrahaḥ avāntaramanuṣyatvādijātiparicchedaḥ
tāvat śabdaḥ kramavācī viṣayo gocaraḥ arthaḥ kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? dravyaparyāyātmā
tatra dravyam pūrvottaravivarttavarttyanvayapratyayasamadhigamyam ūddhrvatāsāmānyam, tatra kramabhuvo vivarttāḥ paryāyāḥ te ātmā svabhāvo yasya sa tathoktaḥ

nanu jñānasvarūpātiraktasyā'rthasya sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt kasya dravyaparyāyātmakatvaviśiṣṭasya viṣayatvaṃ prarūpyate ? pratibhāsamānasyā'śeṣasya vastuno jñānasvarūpāntaḥpraviṣṭatvaprasiddheḥ saṃvedanameva pāramārthikaṃ tattvam
tathāhi–yadavabhāsate tajjñānameva yathā sukhādi, avabhāsante ca bhāvā iti
sa hi parataḥ sambaddhāt, asambaddhādvā bhavet ? na tāvadasambaddhāt; atiprasaṅgāt
atha sambaddhāt; kiṃ tādātmyena, tadutpattyā vā ? yadi tādātmyena tadā jñānarūpatā'rthānām jaḍasvabhāvatā vā jñānasya syāt, tādātmyasya anyonyasvarūpasvīkārasvabhāvatvāt
jaḍasvabhāvatve tu jñānasya arthavyavasthāvārtocchedaḥ jagato vivekavikalatayā āndhyaprasakteḥ
vijānāti na ca jñānaṃ bāhyamartha kathañcana
atha tadutpattyā; kutaḥ kimutpadyeta jñānādarthaḥ, arthādvā jñānam ? prathamapakṣe arthasya jñānarūpatāprasaṅgaḥ jñānādutpadyamānatvāt uttarajñānakṣaṇavat

atha arthājjñānamutpadyate; kiṃ samakālāt, bhinnakālādvā ? na tāvat samakālāt; samasamayabhāvinoḥ savyetaragoviṣāṇavat kāryakāraṇabhāvā'bhāvāt, anyathā arthaṃ prati jñānasyāpi kāraṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ aviśeṣāt
bhinnakālāttatastadutpattau jñānasyā'hetukatvaprasaktiḥ, tatkāle'rthasyā'sattvāt, yadasan na tataḥ kiñcidutpattumarhati yathā mṛtācchikhinaḥ kekāyitam, asaṃśca jñānakāle artha iti
kiñca, artho jñānasya janako nityaḥ saṃbhavet, anityo vā ? nityatve sarvaṃ jñānamekadaivotpādayet nityaikarūpatayā tasyaikadeva tajjananasāmarthyasaṃbhavāt, anyathā nityaikarūpatāvyāghātaḥ syāt
anityasya ca samakālasya bhinnakālasya vā tajjanakatvaṃ pratiṣiddham
tathā ekarūpaḥ, anekarūpo vā'sau syāt ? ekarūpatve dūrāsannānāṃ spaṣṭā'spaṣṭapratibhāsabhedo na syāt
anekarūpatve paramāṇuśo bhedāt na kasyacit sphuṭatayā asphuṭatayā vā sthūlaikapratibhāsaḥ syāt

kiñca, asau nirākārajñānagrāhyaḥ, sākārajñānagrāhyo vā ? nirākārajñānagrāhyatve pratikarma vyavasthāvilopaḥ, tathā ca ida nīlasya grāhakam idaṃ pītasya iti pratiniyatakarmavyavasthāpakā'bhāvāt pratiniyataviṣaye pratiniyatā pravṛttirapi durlabhā
sākāratve ca jñānasya arthakalpanāvaiyarthyam tatraiva grāhya-grāhakabhāvasya parisamāptatvāt

nanu jñānagatākārasya kādācitkasya paridṛśyamānakāraṇebhyaḥ upapadyaanupapadyamānatvāt kāraṇābhāve ca kāryasadbhāvā'nupapatte tadupapattaye tadākāro'rthaḥ kalpyate, yastathā jñāna janayatīti; tadapyasāmpratam, vāsanāsāmarthyāt tathābhūtajñānotpatternā'to'rthasadbhāvasiddhi, arthācca tathābhūtajñānasaṃbhave svapnendrajālagandharvanagarādau tadabhāva syāt

na hi svapnādau pratibhāsamāno'rtha asti, yaḥ svagatamākāraṃ vijñāne vidadhyāt, ato jñānābhāve gandharvanagarādyākārānupalambhāt tatsadbhāve copalambhāt anvaya-vyatirekābhyāṃ jñānasyaivāyamākāro'vasīyate
ata eva sarve pratyayā anālambanā pratyayatvāt svaptapratyayavaditi pramāṇapariśuddhi
kiñca, artho jñānādhirūḍha eva arthatāmāsādayati, jñānaṃ punararthanirapekṣaṃ svapnādau svasāmarthyenaiva asato'pyarthān avabhāsayadarthakriyāṃ nirvartayati, ato jñānādabhinno'rtha
kiñca, dvayordarśane anenā'yaṃ sadṛśa iti pratipattiryuktā, na ca jñānavyatirikto'rtha kadācid dṛṣṭaḥ yena arthasyāyamākāro na jñānasya ityadhyavasāya syāt
tato nīlādeḥ parataḥ prakāśānupapatteḥ siddha svayaṃ prakāśaniyatatvam, tasmācca jñānādabhinnatvam
tathāhi–yat svayaṃ prakāśate tajjñānādananyat yathā sukhādi, svayaṃ prakāśante ca nīlādaya iti
nanu nīla kathamātmasvarūpa prakāśayati ? nahi prakāśyā ghaṭādaya pradīpādinā svaprakāśakā ātmani kriyā viruddhyate nahi saivāsidhārā tayaiva chidyate
sahopalambhaniyamācca, yaddhi yena niyamena sahopalabhyate tat tato na bhidyate yathā taimiri kopalabhyamānādekasmāccandrād dvitīyaścandraḥ, niyatasahopalambhaśca jñānenārtha iti

bhede hi niyamena sahopalambho na dṛṣṭaḥ yathā ghaṭapaṭayoḥ, tathā ca bhedaḥ sahopalambhā'niyamena vyāptaḥ, tadviruddhaśca sahopalambhaniyamo dṛśyamānaḥ svaviruddhamaniyamaṃ nivarttayati, sa ca nivarttamānaḥ svavyāpyaṃ bhedaṃ nivarttayati, tato'yaṃ hetuḥ vipakṣādbhedāt svaviruddhavyāptāt nivarttamāno rāśyantarābhāvād abheda evāvatiṣṭhate ityavinābhāvasiddhiḥ
tathā yadvedyate taddhi jñānādabhinnam yathā vijñānasvarūpam, vedyante ca nolādaya ityato'pi vijñānādvaitasiddhiriti
viṣayasya hi nīlāde dhiyā saha sakṛdeva samvedana dhiyā saha ?, na pṛthak tata savedanādaparo viṣaya iti katham ? tathābhūtameva savedanamiti syāt vivecayitumaśakyam iti pratipāditam
yatsavedanamityādinā nīlataddhiyorabhedasādhanāya nirākārajñānavādinaṃ prati pramāṇayati–yatsavedanameva syādyasya savedana dhruvam
tasmādavyatirikta tat tato vā na vibhidyate
yathā nīladhiya svātmā dvitīyo vā yathoḍupaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yasmādapṛthak savedanameva tattasmādabhinna yathā nīladhī svasvabhāvāt, yathā vā taimirikajñānapratibhāsī dvitīya uḍupa–candramā, nīladhīvedanañcedam iti pakṣadharmoṣasahāra
dharmyatra nīlākārataddhiyau tayorabhinnatvaṃ sādhyadharma yathokta sahopalambhaniyamo hetu
īdṛśa eva ācāryīye sahopalambhaniyamādityādau prayoge hetvartho'bhipreta
tadanena prabandhena vedyatvalakṣaṇo hetu samaryito vijñānavādināṃ sa caivaṃ prayogamarhati–yad vedyate yena vedanena tat tasmānna bhidyate yathā jñānasya ātmā

yattāvaduktam–yadavabhāsate tajjñānam ityādi; tatra arthānāmavabhāsamānatvaṃ svataḥ, parato vā syāt ? svataścet; asiddham, nahi paranirapekṣapratibhāsā ghaṭādayaḥ kasyacit svapne'pi prasiddhāḥ, anyatra mahāmohākrāntacetaso yogācārāt
parataścet viruddham, tathāvabhāsamānatvasya jaḍatve satyeva saṃbhavāt, svasiddhau paramukhaprekṣitvalakṣaṇatvājjaḍatvasya

yad yenopalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptenākāreṇa na pratibhāsate na tat tadātmakam yathā ghaṭākāreṇa paṭaḥ, na pratibhāsate ca jñānākāreṇa ghaṭādyarthaḥ ityanumānācca ghaṭāderjaḍatvaprasiddheḥ anumānabādhitapakṣanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvam

nanu jñānād bhinnasyārthasya uktaprakāreṇā'prasiddheḥ kathaṃ parataḥ pratibhāsaḥ yato viruddhatvaṃ hetoḥ syāt ? tadayuktam; jñānārthayorbhedasyādhyakṣata eva prasiddheḥ, pratyakṣeṇa hi purovartisphuṭavikaṭākāro nīladhavalādirūpo dikpradeśaviśeṣaniyato'nātmaniṣṭho'rthaḥ pratīyate, pratīyamānasya cāpahnave antaḥsaṃvedane kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ ? iti sarvāpahnava eva syāt, nahi vijñānasya sukhādervā pratīteranyataḥ sattvam
na ca vijñānarūpatayā arthasattvamiṣṭameva ityabhidhātavyam; vijñānavyatiriktasyaivāsya pratibhāsamānatvāt
tathā ca, yad yatropalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sannopalabhyate tattatra nāsti yathā kvacitpradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca upalabhyamāne ghaṭādau tathābhūtaṃ jñānasvarūpamiti
tataśca yo viruddharūpānubhavo nāsau ekasvarūpārthaviṣayaḥ yathā sukha-duḥkhānubhava, asti ca artha-jñānayoḥ parasparaparihārasthitasvarūpatvena viruddhayoḥ svarūpānubhava iti

grāhakasvarūpaṃ hi vijñānamantaḥ grāhyasvarūpaṃ tu nīlādikaṃ bahiḥ parisphuṭaṃ prati bhāsate, tathāpi anayorabhede na kiñcit kutaścidbhidyeta, pratibhāsabhedaṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsañca vihāya anyasya bhedakasyā'saṃbhavāt
tathā, yad dvayākāratayā pratibhāsate tat tattvato bhinnam yathā sukhaduḥkhe, dvayākāratayā pratibhāsete ca viṣaya-jñānākārau ityanumānāccānayorbheda
abhede vā jñānarūpāgrahaṇe nīlāderapyagrahaṇaprasaṅga, yādṛśaṃ hi pāramārthikaṃ yasya rūpaṃ tasyāgrahaṇe tadapi na gṛhyate yathā pītasya pītarūpāgrahaṇe pītam, na gṛhyate ca jñānasvarūpaṃ nīlāderiti

nanu prakāśavyatiriktasya nīlāderūpalambhe syādetat, na cāsau tadvyatirikta kadācidapyupalabhyate, tadayuktam; yata ko'yaṃ prakāśo nāma aham iti buddhiḥ, nīlāderdṛśyatā vā ? prathamapakṣe siddho nīlādestato bheda, na hi bhinnamupalabhyamānameva abhinna yuktam sukhadu khāderapyabhedāpatte
etena dvitīyapakṣo'pi pratikṣipta; dṛśyatāyā darśananibandhanatvāt, ata eva darśanāt pūrvamapyasya sattvasiddhi
kṣaṇikatvamananyavedyatvaṃ nānāsantānatvamiti svata tāvanna siddhyati bhrānte
kiñca, arthābhāvo'nupalabdhe nānyata, ekaḥ pratiṣedhahetuḥ nyāyavi॰ pṛ॰ 39

na ca vaktavyam purovartijñānākāra evopalabhyate, tatkathamarthopalabdhiḥ ? yato na jñānākāratayā purovartinyarthe kasyacitpratītirasti, nīlamarthamupalabhāmahe iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena arthe pratītyutpatteḥ
astu vā'sau; tathāpi tatpratibimbita ākāra kādācitkatvāt kārya
yat khalu kādācitkam tatkārya dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭādi, kādācitkaśca jñānasya nīlādyākāra iti
kāryatvañca anyāpekṣayā vyāptam, yaccānyat tadvijñānasāmagrīto'dhikam tasyā satyāmapi tadanutpatte
yasyāṃ satyāmapi yannotpadyate tat tato'dhikakāraṇajanyam yathā bhūmyādikāraṇasāmagrīto'bhavannaṅkura tadadhikabījākhyakāraṇajanya, satsvapi cakṣurādiṣu notpadyate ca nīlākāra iti
