vāsanārūpaṃ cakṣurādibhyo'dhikaṃ kāraṇamatra bhaviṣyatīti cet, kim ālambanatvena, adhipatitvena, samanantaratvena vā ? prathamapakṣe artha eva nāmāntareṇokta syāt

yadi ca bāhyamarthamantareṇa rūpādijñānaṃ syāta, tadā katha pratiniyatadeśa-kāla-pramātṛniṣṭhatayā tatsyāt niyāmakā'bhāvataḥ sarvatra sarvadā sarvepāmaniyamenaiva tatprasaṅgāt ? kathaṃ vā tatraiva deśe tasyaiva pramātu kadācittadutpadyeta kadācinneti ? katha vā taimirikasyaiva santāne khe keśapāśadarśana nānyeṣām, tadupalabdhaiśca keśādibhi kārya na kriyate nānyai tulye'pyarthābhāve ? svapnadṛṣṭāntamātreṇa arthābhāve-deśādiniyamasya kalpane niraṃśai kaparamabrahmasiddhiprasaṅgaḥ, jalacandravat tasyaiva bhedena pratibhāsasaṃbhavāt
yathā ca anādivāsanāsāmarthyapratiniyamāt evaṃvidho vijñānādvaite bhedapratibhāsaprapañcaḥ, tathā nityaniraṃśaikarūpe brahmaṇyapi anādyavidyāsāmarthyapratiniyamāt
kiñca, bhrāntiḥ sarvatra sādharmyadarśanājjāyate, yathā anudakarūpāsu marīcikāsu udakabhrāntiḥ, na ca vijñaptimātravādinaḥ nacit kenacit sādharmyadarśanamasti yad bhedabhrānternimittaṃ syāt

nanu svāpādau arthābhāve sādharmyadarśanābhāve ca bhedabhrāntirupalabhyate tato'yamadoṣaḥ; tadasat; tatrāpi pāramparyeṇa bāhyārthopayogāt, na hyananubhūte'rthe svapnaḥ kadācit kvacidapyudeti, ato'nubhūtārthasāpekṣajanmatvāt svapnasya kathamarthābhāve saṃbhavaḥ ? nanvananubhūte'pi svaśiraśchedādau jñānamupajāyate; tanna; tatrāpi paraśiraśchedo dṛṣṭaḥ, svaśarīrañcānubhūtam, tatra manodoṣavaśād vivekamapaśyan ātmaśarīre śiraśchedamabhimanyate, atastatrāpi anubhūto'rtha eva kāraṇam
kathañca bāhyārthāpahnave jātinaiyatyasiddhiḥ ? jñānamātre hi jagati niyāmakābhāvāt manuṣyo'śvaḥ, aśvo'pi manuṣyaḥ, hastyapi pipīlikā, pipīlikāpi hastī syāt

bāhyārthābhyupagame tu tannaiyatyaṃ sughaṭameva; yena hi manuṣyatvajātyupabhogyasukhaduḥkhādinimittaṃ karma samācaritaṃ sa tatparipākavaśāttāmeva jāti pratipadyate, evamanye'pi prāṇinaḥ svopārjitasādhāraṇakarmabalāt tāstāḥ jātīḥ pratipadyante
ādarśe ba॰, ja॰, pratau ca truṭitametatsthalam, bhā॰ pratau tu nacit iti pāṭhaḥ
kiñca, arthasyā'sattvam icchāmātreṇa, sādhakapramāṇābhāvāt, saṃvādāsattvāt, arthakriyākāritvā'bhāvāt, bādhakapramāṇasadbhāvādvā ? yadīcchāmātreṇa tadā'tiprasaṅgaḥ, tadadvaitāderapi ato'sattvānuṣaṅgāt
saṃvādāsattvamapi asiddham; pratyakṣapratipanne jalādau anumānādeḥ saṃvādakasya saṃbhavāt
ayaṃ vakti, calatītyādirūpā bāhyā, aha sukhī duḥkhītyādisvarūpā ādhyātmikā arthakriyā

yaccātra bādhakamuktam–parataḥ sambaddhāt, asambaddhādvā ityādi; tatra sambaddhādeva jñānādarthasya pratibhāsaḥ, sambandhaśca yogyatālakṣaṇaḥ, na tādātmya-tadutpattilakṣaṇaḥ tasya kṣaṇakṣayādinā cakṣurādinā cā'nekāntāt
yogyasya cārthasya samakālasya bhinnakālasya vā grahaṇamaviruddham
sambandho hi yogyatāsvabhāva eva jñānārthayoḥ grāhyagrāhakabhāvāṅgaṃ na tu tādātmyādiḥ
kṣaṇakṣayasya jñānena tādātmye'pi jñānasya pratibhāso na kṣaṇakṣayasya, cakṣurāderjñānamutpadyate na ca jñānāt tatpratibhāsaḥ
nanu tathābhūtasyārthasya yāvajjñāna grāhakaṃ tāvadartho'pi jñānasya grāhakaḥ kuto na syāditi cet ? svabhāvabhedāt
na khalu ya evaikasya svabhāvaḥ sa evānyasyāpi, anyathā pradīpavat ghaṭasyāpi prakāśakatvaprasaṅga, tathā pratītiḥ anyatrāpi samānā
nīlādyākārāṇāṃ vā yāvad buddhirvyāpikā tāvannīlādaya kinnāsyā vyāpakāḥ, niyatānāñcaiṣāṃ yāvadasau vyāpikā tāvat sarveṣāṃ kinna vyāṣikā ? iti codye bhavato'pi nātaḥ svabhāvabhedapratīte anyaduttaram

yadapyabhihitam–artho nityo'nityo vā ekarūpo'nekarūpo vā ityādi, tadapi akhilārthānāmanekāntābhyupagamānnirastam, nahi sarvathā nityo'nityo vā ekarūpo'nekarūpo vā bahirantarvā'rtho'sti ityanekāntasiddhau prarūpayiṣyate
tathāhi–na tāvat pṛthivyādibāhyo'rtha asya grāhyo vidyate tasya ekānekasvabhāvaśūnyatvāt

yadapyuktam–artho jñānādhirūḍha evārthatāmāsādayati ityādi, tatra ko'dhirūḍhārtha–vyavasthitiḥ, apekṣā vā ? na tāvadvyavasthitiḥ, tasya jñānā'nātmabhūtasya svaparāprakāśakasya ātmaprakāśe paramukhaprekṣakasya jaḍavyavahāraviṣayasya adhyakṣādito bahirvyavasthitatvapratīteḥ, anyathā jāḍyavyavahāreṇa bahiśchidādikriyā na syāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu jñānārthayorbheda eva syāt, apekṣāyā svāmi-bhṛtyavat bhede satyeva sabhavāt
jñānāpekṣā'rthasya siddhi ityetāvatā arthasya jñānātmakatve kāryasyāpi kāraṇātmakatvaprasaṅgāt kāraṇādvaitamapyanuṣajyeta, na hi kāraṇanirapekṣā kāryasya siddhiriti
yaccānyaduktam–yat svayaṃ prakāśate tajjñānādananyat ityādi, tadapi śraddhāmātram, svayaṃ prakāśamānatvasya arthe prāgeva pratiṣedhāt
yaccoktam–sahopalambhaniyamāt ityādi, tadapyuktimātram; anaikāntikatvāt, bhinnā svapi hi kṛttikāsu sahopalambhaniyamo vartate
viruddhatvañca bhedenaiva sahopalambhasya vyāptatvāt, sahaśabdo hi bhedādhiṣṭhānaḥ, abhede sahaśabdārthānupapatteḥ, na hi sa eva tenaiva saha iti vyapadeśamarhati

vyāptiśūnyatvañcāsya; tathāhi–hetorvipakṣe bādhakapramāṇasadbhāvād vyāptiravaseyā, abhedasya ca bhedo vipakṣaḥ, tato niyatasahopalambhasya vyāvṛttau darśitāyāṃ gatyantarābhāvād abhedenaiva vyāptiḥ siddhyet, na cāyaṃ bhedād vyāvṛttaḥ, bhinnāsvapi hi kṛttikāsu niyatasahopalambhasya dṛṣṭatvāt
na ca etenaiva bādhyamānatvād abādhitatvamasiddham; pratyakṣavirodhe etasyānumānasya ātmalābhasyaivā'saṃbhavāt, labdhātmalābhañca sādhakaṃ bādhakaṃ vā tatsyāt
syādetat–yadyapi vipakṣe sattva na niścitaṃ sandigdha tu tataścānaikānto hetu sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvāt
yaśca sahopalambhaniyama ukta so'pi vikatpaṃ na sahate
yadi jñānārthayo sāhityena upalambha tato viruddho hetu nābhedaṃ sādhayitumarhati sāhityasya tadviruddhabhedavyāptatvāt abhede tadanupapatte
atha ekopalambhaniyama, na, ekatvasya avācaka sahaśabda
api ca kimekatvena upalambha āho eka upalambha jñānāryayo
atha ekopalambhaniyama tatrāha–ata eva sahopalambhaniyamo'pi pratyayaviṣayayo upāyopeyabhāvahetuko nānedahetuka ityavagantavyam
idamatrā''kūtam–sahopalambhaniyamaśca vedyatvañca hetū sandigdhavyatirekatayā anaikāntikauvistaratastu nyāyakaṇikāyām pṛ॰ 264 anusaraṇīya iti
kṛttikābhiśca vyabhicāraḥ prakṛtahetau, tathāhi–tāsu yugapadupalambhaniyamo'sti na cābheda, tadbhedasya sarvāvisaṃvādena prasiddhatvāt
tatra bhadantaśubhaguptastvāha–viruddho'yaṃ heturyasmāt sahaśabdaśca loke'nyo syā nnaivāne nye na vinā kvacit
punaḥ sa evāha–yadi sahaśabda ekārthaḥ tadā heturasiddhaḥ

sahopalambhaśabdena ca kimatrābhipretam–kimarthadvaye upalambhadvayasya sahabhāvaḥ, ekasminnevopalambhe arthadvayasya yugapatpratibhāsitvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe asiddho hetuḥ prativiṣayaṃ jñānabhedā'saṃbhavāt
sādhanavikalaśca dṛṣṭāntaḥ; na hi dvicandrapratibhāse pratibhāsadvayasāhityamasti, ekasyaiva jñānasya ubhayākārollekhitayā'dhyakṣato'dhyavasāyāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu viruddhatvam, ekatropalambhe sahārthadvayapratibhāsatvasya bhede satyeva saṃbhavāt

atha yadekasminnetra saṃvedane sphurati tat saṃvedanādabhinnam yathā saṃvedanasvarūpam, sphuranti ca tatraiva saṃvedane nīlādayo bhāvāḥ ityato'numānād bhede pratibhāsyatvā'saṃbhavānnāsya viruddhatvam; tanna; saṃvit-saṃvedyayorbhedasya pratyakṣādiprasiddhatvena pratipāditatvāt
kiñca, saṃvedanasya svaparāvabhāsasvabhāvatvāt parasya cā'bhāve tatsvabhāvasaṃvedanasvarūpasyāsaṃbhavena saṃvedanasyāpyasaṃbhavāt kasya kenā'bhedaḥ ?

yaccoktam–yadvedyate tadvijñānādabhinnam ityādi; tatra kimidaṃ vedyatvam–vedanakarmatvam, tatsambandhitvamātram, tatsvabhāvatvaṃ vā ? yadi vedanakarmatvam; tadā viruddhohetuḥkarmatvasya bhedenaiva vyāptatvāt, na hi chidikriyāyāḥ karmabhūtāni kāṣṭhāni abhinnānyupalabhyante, ataḥ kriyā-kārakayorbhede satyevopalabdheḥ bhedenaiva karma-kriyābhāvasya vyāptatvāt abhedaviparītārthasādhanatvād abhede sādhye viruddho hetu
abhede cānayoḥ ki saṃvedanādarthasyā'bhedaḥ, arthādvā saṃvedanasya ? prathamavikalpe saṃvedanameva syāt nārthaḥ tasya tatraivānupraviṣṭatvāt, tathā ca saṃvedyatvāt ityasiddho hetu
dvitīyavikalpe tu artha eva na saṃvedanam, iti kuto'sya abhedaḥ sādhyeta ? bhedasyānayoḥ pratyakṣapratipannatvāt kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvañca
atha saṃvitsambandhitvamātraṃ vedyatvam, tathāpi viruddhatvam sambandhitvasya bhede satyeva saṃbhavāt, bhedāśrayo hi sambandhaḥ tadabhāve tasyāpyabhāvāt saṃvitsambandhitvasyāsiddhiḥ ityasiddhatvañca
atha vedyatvaṃ saṃvitsvabhāvatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tadasiddhameva arthasyā'saṃvitsvabhāvatvasamarthanāt
tato nirbādhabodhād vastuvyavasthāmabhyupagacchatā tatsaṃvedanamiva asaṃvedanasvabhāvo bāhyārtho nīlasitādyanekākāraḥ pratipattavyaḥ

tathā kiṃ yad vedyate iti karmaṇi prayogāt vedanakarttṛkavidikriyārūpaṃ vedanakarmatvaṃ vedyatvaṃ heturiṣyate, kiṃ vā yadvedyate iti yacchabdasya vedanakriyayā sāmānādhikaraṇye bhāvanirdeśāt vidikriyārūpavedanasvabhāvatvam ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 167
asya ca vijñānādvaitavādasya vividharītyā paryālocanaṃ nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam–abhisamayālaṃkārāloka pṛ॰ 374

nanu jñānamevedaṃ citraṃ nīlasukhādyanekākārakhacitamābhāsate na punarbāhyo'rtha tatsadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt, yasya sadbhāve pramāṇaṃ nāsti tannāsti yathā kharaviṣāṇam, nāsti ca bāhyārthasadbhāve kiñcitpramāṇamiti
na cedamasiddham, tathāhi–tatsadbhāvāvedakaṃ nirākāram, sākāraṃ vā pramāṇaṃ syāt ? na tāvannirākāram; tasya sarvatrā'viśeṣataḥ pratikarmavyavasthānibandhanatvānupapatte
sākāratve tu siddhaṃ jñānameva nīlādyanekākārākrāntaṃ citramekam, na puna tadvyatirikto jaḍo'rthaḥ tadvyavasthāheto kasyacidapyabhāvāt
nacākāraviśiṣṭaṃ jñānameva tadvyavasthāhetu; tasya svākārānubhavamātreṇaiva caritārthatvāt
yadi savedanameva nīlākāramātmaprakāśakaṃ bāhyo'rtha kiṃ pramāṇamādāya vidito bhavet
nahi tatra pratyakṣa tasya svasavedanamātra eva paryavasānāt
na ca tata para nīlamābhāsate nīlākāradvayāpravedanāt
atha tadarthasya rūpaṃ tadā savedanamanyena rūpeṇa viditamaviditaṃ vā bhavet
yadyavidita sa tasyānubhava katha svarūpeṇājñātam asya savedanamiti katha saṃgacchate viditañcet tathāpi
tathācāhu kīrtipādā iti kṛtvā advayavajrasagraha tattvaratnāvalī pṛ॰ 18
dhiyo nīlādirūpatve bāhyo'rthaḥ kinnibandhanaḥ || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 433 iti

kiñca, prameyāt pūrvakālabhāvijñānaṃ tadvyavasthāpakaṃ syāt, uttarakālabhāvi vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamasyendriyārthasannikarṣaprabhavatā prameyamantareṇaivotpadyamānatvāt ? yatprameyamantareṇaivotpadyate na tadindriyārthasannikarṣajam yathā khapuṣpavijñānam, prameyamantareṇaivotpadyate ca prameyāt pūrvakālabhāvi tadvyavasthāpakatvenābhimataṃ jñānamiti

dvitīyapakṣe tu pramāṇāt pūrvakālavṛttitvaṃ prameyasya kutaścit pratipannam, na vā ? yadi na pratipannam; kathaṃ sadvyavahāraviṣayaḥ ? yat kutaścinna pratipannam na tat sadvyavahāraviṣayaḥ yathā gaganendīvaram, kutaścidapratipannañca pramāṇātpūrvakālavṛttitvaṃ prameyasyeti

atha pratipannam; kiṃ svataḥ, parato vā ? yadi svataḥ; kathamasya jñānādbhedaḥ tasyaiva svato'vabhāsalakṣaṇatvāt ? yat svataḥ prasiddham na tajjñānādbhidyate yathā jñānasvarūpam, svataḥ prasiddhañca jñānātpūrvaṃ pravartamānaṃ prameyatvenābhimataṃ vastviti
atha parataḥ; tanna; pramāṇād vyatiriktasya prameyavyavasthāhetoḥ parasyā'saṃbhavāt

atha pramāṇameva tasya tadvṛttitvaṃ prakāśayati; tanna; tasya svayaṃ tatkāle'sataḥ tatprakāśakatvā'yogāt, yad yatkāle nāsti na tattasya prakāśakam yathā svotpādātpūrvakālavṛttipadārthakāle'san pradīpo na tatprakāśakaḥ, nāsti ca pūrvakālaviśiṣṭasya prameyasya kāle jñānamiti

samakālatve tu jñānajñeyayoḥ savyetaragoviṣāṇavat grāhyagrāhakabhāvābhāvaḥ, na ca jñāne nīlādyākārānurāgapratītyanyathānupapattyā tadanurañjako bahirarthopyastītyabhidhātavyam; svapnāvasthāyāṃ tadabhāve'pi tadanurāgapratīteḥ, na hi taddaśābhāvini karituragādipratyaye'nurañjako bahirartho'sti, svapnetarapratyayānāmaviśeṣaprasaṅgāt
ato buddhirevārthanirapekṣā svasāmagrīto vicitrākārachāyāchuritā yathā'trotpadyate tathā'nyatrāpi
nanu evamapi ekasyā buddheḥ vicitrākārarūpatayā pratibhāsamānāyāḥ kathamekatvaṃ yuktam ? ityapyacodyam; aśakyavivecanatvataḥ tasyāstadavirodhāt

atra devendravyākhyā– citrajñāne hi yo nīlādiḥ pratyavabhāsate jñānopādhiḥ jñānaviśeṣaṇa anubhavasvātmabhūta iti yāvat, sa eva eko'nandhabhāk tajjñānasvabhāvatvāt anyamartha jñānavadeva na bhajate, tādṛśaśca sannasau taccitradarśanapratibhāsī tadanyapītādipratibhāsavivekena na kevala śakyate dṛṣṭu tasmin pratibhāsamāne sarveṣāmeva tajjñānatayā tadanyeṣāmapi niyogata pratibhāsanāt

tasmād yadaivaika nīlādikamākāraṃ tadanyebhya pītādibhyo ayaṃ nīla iti jānāntareṇa vivecayati pramātā, tadaiva tathā vivecayannasau na tajjñānamāmṛśati atadrūpatvāttasya, kiṃ tarhi ? arthe patati, artha eva tajjñānaṃ pravṛttaṃ bhavatītyartha
tasmādekasminnapyākāre pratibhāsamāne sarvamābhāti, na vā kiṃcidapi iti aśakyo vivekato darśane nīlādipratibhāsa iti
citrapratibhāsāpyekaiva buddhiḥ bāhyacitravilakṣaṇatvāt, śakyavivecanaṃ hi bāhyaṃ citram aśakyavivecanāstu buddhernīlādaya ākārā iti
nanu citrapaṭyādau citrarūpatā pratīyate tasyā kuto jñānadharmateti cet ? arthadharmatvānupapatteḥ

tathāhi–citrapaṭyādikamekamavayavirūpaṃ niraṃśaṃ vastu syāt, tadviparītaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe nīlabhāge gṛhyamāṇe pītādibhāgānāmagrahaṇaṃ na syāt, teṣāṃ tato bhedaprasaṅgāt, yasmin gṛhyamāṇe yanna gṛhyate tat tato bhinna yathā sahye gṛhyamāṇe vindhyaḥ, gṛhyamāṇe nīlabhāge na gṛhyate ca pītabhāgādikamiti
tathā ca avayavino'pyekarūpatānupapattiḥ viruddhadharmādhyāsāt, yasya viruddhadharmādhyāso na tasyaikarūpatā yathā jalā'nalāde, grahaṇā'grahaṇalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsaśca avayavinaḥ iti
yad yadātmakam tasyā'grahe tadapi na gṛhyate yathā pītāderagrahe na tatsvarūpam, pītādyātmakañca nīlamiti
tadviparītatve tu citrapaṭyāde siddhaḥ svayameva citratāpāya vibhinnāśrayavṛttinīla-pītādivat
tannārthadharmaścitratā kintu jñānadharma, svakāraṇakalāpād vijñānamupajāyamānam anekākārakhacitamevopajāyate anubhūyate ca
ataḥ tathābhūtaṃ jñānameva ekaṃ tattvam, iti citrādvaitasiddhi

atha acetanasya sukhāderjñānambarūpatāvirahāt kathaṃ citrapratibhāsaṃ jñānamevaikaṃ tattva syāt yataścitrādvainaṃ siddhyeta ityucyate, tadapyuktimātram, yata sukhāderapi jñānā'bhinnahetujatvena jñānātmakatvopapatte
yattāvaduktam–sākāraṃ nirākāraṃ vā jñāna bahirarthasadbhāve pramāṇaṃ syāt ityādi, tatra nirākārameva jñānaṃ tatsadbhāve pramāṇam sākārapakṣasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
na ca nirākārasaṃvedanasya sarvatrā'viśepāt pratikarmavyavasthāhetutvābhāva; yogyatāto nirākāratve'pi taddhetutvasya samarthayiṣyamāṇatvāt
yadapyuktam–prameyāt pūrvakālabhāvi pramāṇam ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; prakāśakasya pūrvāparasahabhāvaniyamā'bhāvāt
tathāhi–kvacit pūrvaṃ vidyamānaḥ paścādbhāvināṃ prakāśako bhavati, yathā ādityaḥ samutpadyamānānām
kvacicca pūrvaṃ satāṃ prakāśyānāṃ paścādbhavan prakāśakaḥ yathā pradīpaḥ apavarakāntarvarttighaṭādīnām
kvacittu sahabhāvināṃ prakāśakaḥ, yathā kṛtakatvādiḥ anityatvādīnām
ataḥ pramāṇaṃ pūrvāparasahabhāvaniyamanirapekṣaṃ vastu prakāśayati, prakāśakatvāt, ādityādivat
sākāravādapratikṣepeṇa nirā- kārādeva pratyayāt pratikarmavyavasthopapatte pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt
nirākāratve kuto viṣayaniyama iti cet, svahetuprayuktādeva śaktiniyamāditi brūma
kvacidupalabdhihetuḥ pūrvaṃ paścād upalabdhiviṣayo yathā ādityasya prakāśaḥ utpadyamānānām
kvacit pūrvamupalabdhiviṣaya paścādupalabdhihetu yathā avasthitānā pradīpaḥ
kvacidupalabdhiheturupalabdhiviṣayaśca saha bhavatī yathā dhūmena agnergrahaṇamiti
yaccānyaduktam–svapnāvasthāyāṃ bahirarthābhāve'pi nīlādyanurāgaḥ pratīyate ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; svapnajñāne anantarameva mādhyamikamatavicārāvasare bāhyārthaviṣayatvasya prasādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt

yadapyuktam–citrākāratayā pratibhāsamānasyāpi jñānasya aśakyavivecanatvādekatvam iti; tatra kimidam aśakyavivecanatvaṃ nāma–jñānā'bhinnatvam, sahotpannānāṃ nīlādīnāṃ jñānāntaraparihāreṇa tajjñānenaivā'nubhavaḥ, bhedena vivecanā'bhāvamātraṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe sādhyasamo hetuḥ, yaduktaṃ bhavati jñānādabhinnā nīlādayaḥ tato'bhinnatvāt, tadevoktaṃ bhavati aśakyavivecanatvāt iti
dvitīyapakṣe tu anaikāntikatvam, sacarācarasya jagataḥ sugatajñānena sahotpannasya jñānāntaraparihāreṇa tajjñānenaiva grāhyasya tena sahaikatvā'bhāvāt
ekatve vā sugatasya saṃsāritvam, saṃsāriṇāṃ vā sugatatvaṃ syāt, saṃsāretararūpatā caikasya brahmavādaṃ samarthayate
jñānarūpatvātteṣāṃ tatsiddhau ca anyonyāśrayaḥ–jñānarūpatvasiddhau hi teṣāṃ jñānāntaraparihāreṇa tajjñānenaivā'nubhavasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca jñānarūpatvasiddhiriti
na cetthaṃ vivecyamānayorapyanayoḥ vivecanāpahnavo yuktaḥ; sarvāpahnavaprasaṅgataḥ sakalaśūnyatānuṣaṅgāt
ebhireva vikalpaiścitrajñānasya khaṇḍanam prameyakamalamārtaṇḍe pṛ॰ 25 pū॰ prakārāntareṇa ca tattvārthaśloka bā॰ pṛ॰ 35
nyāyavini॰ ṭā॰ pṛ॰ 240 pū॰ ityādiṣu ca draṣṭavyam
aśakyavivecanatvaṃ sādhanamasiddhamuktaṃ nīlatadvedanayo aśakyavivecanatvāsiddhe antarbahirdeśatayā vivekena pratīte
kiñca, antastattvasya anekākārākrāntasyāpi aśakyavivecanatvād ekatvā'virodhe bahistattvasyāpi avayavyādeḥ ata eva ekatvā'virodho'stu viśeṣā'bhāvāt
buddhyā tatsvarūpavivecanam anyatrāpyaviśiṣṭam, citrajñāne'pi nīlādyākārāṇām anyonyadeśaparihāreṇa sthitatvā' viśeṣāt
ekadeśatve ca ekākāre evāśeṣākārāṇāmanupraveśaprasaṅgata tadvailakṣaṇyā'bhāvāt taccitratā viruddhyet
yadekadeśaṃ na tasya ākāravailakṣaṇyam yathā ekanīlākārasya, ekadeśāśca citrajñāne nīlādyākārā iti
tathā, yatra ākārā'vailakṣaṇyam na tatra citrarūpatā yathā ekanīlajñāne, ākārā'vailakṣaṇyañca ekadeśatayā'bhimatānāṃ nīlādyākārāṇāmiti
kiñca, ete ākārā citrajñāne sambaddhā santastadvyapadeśahetava, asambaddhā vā ? na tāvadasambaddhā, atiprasaṅgāt
atha sambaddhāḥ, ki tādātmyena, tadutpattyā vā ? na tāvattadutpattyā, samasamayavarttināṃ nārīnayanayugmavat tadasabhavāt
yadanekākārā'vyatiricyamānasvarūpaṃ tadanekam yathā anekākārasvarūpam, anekākārā'vyatiricyamānasvarūpañca citrajñānasvarūpamiti
yadekasmādavyatiriktaṃ na tadanekam yathā tasyaiva jñānasya svarūpam, ekasmājjñānasvarūpādavyatiriktāśca anekatvenābhimatā nīlādaya ākārā iti
kiñcaite nīlādyākārā citrajñāne sambaddhā santa tadvyapadeśahetava asambaddhā vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 177

yadapyuktam–grahaṇā'grahaṇalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsānnārthadharmaścitratā iti, tadapyasundaram; pratyakṣavirodhe'numānā'pravṛtteḥ, bāhyārthadharmatayā hi abādhitādhyakṣapratyaye citrākāraḥ pratibhāsate, na tasya jñānadharmatā yuktā atiprasaṅgāt
yo yaddharmatayā pratīyate na sa tato'nyadharmā yathā agnidharmatayā pratīyamānā bhāsvaroṣṇatā na jaladharma, bāhyārthadharmatayā pratīyate ca citrateti
kathaṃ taddharmatve grahaṇā'grahaṇayorupapattiḥ iti cet ? citrapratipatte anekavarṇapratipattinibandhanatvāt, pratipanne'pi nīlabhāge pītādibhāgā'pratipattau citratā'pratipattirupapannaiva

virodhaśca jñānadharmatve'pi citratāyā tulya eva, tathāhi–jñānamekamanekākāram, tadviparītaṃ vā ? na tāvadādyavikalpo yukta, parasparavyāvṛttatvenā''kārāṇām ekatrānaṃśe jñāne vṛttyanupapatte, yeṣāṃ parasparavyāvṛtti na teṣāmekatrā'naṃśe vṛtti yathā gavāśvādīnām, parasparavyāvṛttiśca nīlādyākārāṇāmiti
na caikasyā'naṃśasyā'sya parasparaviruddhākāraistādātmya yuktam, tāvaddhā tasyāpi bhedaprasaṅgāt
prayoga–yad ekamanaṃśaṃ na tasya parasparaviruddhākārai saha tādātmyam yathā utpannasya kṣaṇasya utpattyanutpattibhyāṃ sattva-vināśābhyāṃ vā, ekamanaśañca citrajñānaṃ bhavadbhira bhipretamiti

tattādātmye ca ākārāṇāṃ bhedavārtā'pi durlabhā iti kathaṃ taccitratā ? atha nīlādyākāravat tajjñānamapyanekamiṣyate, tadā'pi kiṃ kathañcit, sarvathā vā ? yadi sarvathā; tadā tajjñānānāṃ parasparamatyantabhedāt citrapratipattiḥ svapne'pi na prāpnoti
yeṣāṃ parasparamatyantabhedo na teṣāṃ citrapratipattiḥ yathā santānāntarajñānānām, parasparamatyantabhedaśca ākāravat tajjñānānāmiti

kathañcidabhede tu jñānavad bahirarthasyāpi svākārairvicitraiḥ kathañcittādātmyamanubhavataḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇena pratīyamānasya citrasvabhāvatā iṣyatām, ki durāgrahagrahābhiniveśena ākṣepa–samādhānayoḥ bahirantarvā citratāyāṃ samānatvāt ?
tathāhi–tadekaṃ vā sadanekākāra tadviparītaṃ vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 177
atha nīlādyākāravat tajjñānamapyanekamiṣyate tadāpi kiṃ kathañcit, sarvathā vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 178

yadapyabhihitam–jñānātmakāḥ sukhādayaḥ, jñānā'bhinnahetujatvāt ityādi; tatra ki sarvathā jñānābhinnahetujatvaṃ teṣāmabhipretam, kathañcidvā ? prathamapakṣe asiddho hetuḥ; sukhādīnāṃ sadasadvedyodaya-sragvanitādinimittanibandhanatvāt, jñānasya ca jñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśama-indriyādikāraṇakalāpaprabhavatvāt
vibhinnasvarūpatvācca amīṣāṃ sarvathā'bhinnahetujatvamanupapannam; yeṣāṃ vibhinnasvarūpatvaṃ na teṣāṃ sarvathā'bhinnahetujatvam yathā jalānalādīnām, vibhinnasvarūpatvañca jñānasukhādīnāmiti
na cedamasiddham; sukhādeḥ āhlādanādyākāratvāt, jñānasya ca prameyānubhavasvabhāvatvāt
sukhādīnāṃ vijñānābhinnahetujatvena vijñānatvādaśakyaṃ vyāvarttanamiti cet, na; abhinnahetujatvā'– siddheḥ
na khalu yaiva candanasparśajñānasyotpattau sāmagrī saiva sukhasyāpīti
atra śākyāścodayantijñānarūpā sukhādayaḥ tadabhinnahetujatvāditi; tadidamanupapannam; pratyakṣaviruddhatvāddhetoḥ
nacānayorvijñānābhinnahetujatvam, jñānasya arthākārādutpatteḥ, tasmācca vāsanāsahāyāt sukhaduḥkhayorutpādāt anyathā upekṣājñānābhāvaprasaṅgāt
kathamanyathā nyāyaviniścaye sahabhuvo guṇā ityasya–sukhamāhādanākāraṃ vijñānaṃ meyabodhakam
uktañca syādvādamahārṇave iti kṛttvā nyāyavi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 230 u॰
śaktiḥ kriyānumeyā syād yūnaḥ kāntāsamāgame || 1 || iti
atha kathañcid vijñānā'bhinnahetujatvaṃ vivakṣitam; tad rūpā''lokādinā'naikāntikam, yathaiva hi tato vijñānasyotpattiḥ tathā rūpā''lokādikṣaṇāntarasyāpi

kiñca, upādānakāraṇāpekṣayā sukhādīnāṃ vijñānā'bhinnahetujatvamucyate, sahakārikāraṇāpekṣayā vā ? tatrādyavikalpe kimeṣāmabhinnamupādānam-ātmadravyam, jñānakṣaṇo vā ? na tāvadātmadravyam; anabhyupagamāt

abhyupagame vā kimetepāmupādānāpekṣayā abhedaḥ sādhyate, svarūpāpekṣayā vā ? yadyupādānāpekṣayā, tadā siddhasādhanam cetanadravyārthādeśāt sukhādīnāmabhedābhyupagamāt, sukhajñānādipratiniyataparyāyārthādeśādeva amīṣāmanyonyaṃ bhedā'bhyupagamāt
svarūpāpekṣayā tu abhedā'bhyupagame ghaṭādibhirvyabhicāra, na hyabhinnopādānānāṃ ghaṭa-ghaṭī-śarāvodañcanādīnāṃ svarūpato'bhedo'sti

atha jñānakṣaṇopādānatvaṃ vijñānābhinnahetujatvamabhipretam; tadasiddham, ātmadravyopādānatvātteṣām, na khalu paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyāntarotpattau upādānatvaṃ kvacid dṛṣṭam dravyasyaiva antarvahirvopādānatvopapatte
ātmadravyasiddhiśca santānavicārāvasare prasādhitā, jīvasiddhyavasare prasādhayiṣyate ca
atha sahakārikāraṇāpekṣayā vijñānābhinnahetujatva sukhādīnāṃ vivakṣitam, tadapi vivakṣāmātram, tasya cakṣurādibhiranaikāntikatvapratipādanāt
yadi ca sukhādayo jñānāt sarvathā'bhinnāḥ tarhi tadvadeva eṣāmapyarthaprakāśakatvaṃ syāt, na cātra tadasti svarūpaprakāśaniyatatvātteṣām

jñānaṃ hi svaparaprakāśaniyatam, sukhādikaṃ tu svaprakāśaniyatam iti pratiprāṇi prasiddham, ato viruddhadharmādhyāsāt kathamatrā'bhedaḥ ? yatra viruddhadharmādhyāso na tatrā'bhedaḥ yathā jalā'nalādau, viruddhadharmādhyāsaśca jñānasukhādāviti
tadevaṃ sukhādīnāṃ jñānarūpatvā'prasiddheḥ nīlasukhādivicitrapratibhāsāpi ekaiva buddhiḥ, aśakyavivecanatvāt ityetadvaca sattyam abhiprāyamātrameva sūcayatīti
asya citrādvaitavādasya samarthanapara pramāṇavārtikasya tṛtīyaparicchede citraikatvasiddhāntākhya prakaraṇaṃ draṣṭavyam
savedanamātrameva ālambanapratyayarahita vāstava tattvam iti bauddhaikadeśimādhyamikasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu citrajñāne nīlādyākārapratibhāsasya avidyāśilpikalpitatvādavāstavatvameva, jñānasyaivānubhavapathaprāptasya ekasya madhyakṣaṇasvabhāvasya vāstavatvam, tato nīlādyākārāṇāmabhede'nekatvavirodhāt, bhede pratibhāsā'saṃbhavāt, saṃbhave vā saṃvedanāntaratvāpatte kathaṃ taccitratā syāt ? taduktam–
kiṃ syāt sā citrataikasyā na syāttasyā matāvapi
yadīdaṃ svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 210 iti

atra devendravyākhyā–yadi nāma ekasyā matau na sā citratā bhākta syāt, ki syāt–ko doṣa syāt ? tathā ca bhāvataḥ citrayā matyā bhāvā api citrāḥ siddhyanti, tadvadeva ca satyā bhaviṣyantīti praṣṭurabhiprāya

śāstrakāra āha–na syāttasyāṃ matāvapi iti, vyāhatametat–ekā, citrā ca iti, ekatve hi satyanānārūpāpi vastuto nānākāratayā pratibhāsate, na punarbhāvataste tasyā ākārā santi iti balādeṣṭavyam ekatvahāniprasaṅgād

na hi nānātvaikatvayoḥ sthiteranya kaścidāśraya, anyatra bhāvikābhyāmākārabhedā'bhedābhyām, tatra yadi buddhi bhāvato nānākārā ekā ceṣyate tadā sakalaṃ viśvamapyekaṃ dravyaṃ syāt, tathā ca sahotpattyādidoṣa, tasmānnaikā anekākārā, kintu yadīdaṃ svayamarthānā rocate atadrūpāṇāmapi satāṃ yadetat tādrūpyeṇa prakhyānam tadetad vastuta eva sthitaṃ tattvam, tatra ke bayaṃ niṣeddhāra evamastu ityanumanyate iti
na ca jñāne citrarūpatāpāye tatsvarūpapratipattiḥ viruddhyate; tadapāye'pi svarūpasya svato gaterūpapatteḥ, saṃvedanamātratāpāye eva tadvirodhāt
na ca anekatvapratibhāso vāstavā'nekatve satyevopapadyata ityabhidhātavyam; svapnāvasthāyāṃ tadabhāve'pi tadṛrśanāt

ataḥ saṃvedanamātrameva ālambanapratyayarahitaṃ vāstavaṃ tattvam sakalapratyayānāṃ nirālambanasvabhāvatvāt, tatsvabhāvatvañcaiteṣāṃ pratyayatvena hetunā prasādhyate, svapnādau pratyayatvasya nirālambanatvenā'vinābhāvapratipatteḥ
tathā ca prayogaḥ–sarve pratyayā nirālambanāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnendrajālādipratyayavat iti
nacā'nubhūyamānamadhyakṣaṇarūpasaṃvidvyatirikte'rthe kiñcitpramāṇaṃ kramate; samakālasya bhinnakālasya vā tatra tasya pravṛttyanupapatteḥ
saiva paramārthasatī madhyamā pratipattiḥ sarvadharmanirātmatā sakalaśūnyatā cocyate
tathāhi–ye ekānekasvarūpavicārā'sahāḥ na te paramārthasantaḥ yathā kharaviṣāṇādayaḥ, ekā'nekasvarūpavicārā'sahāśca paraparikalpitā ātmādayo bhāvā iti
ātmādibhāvānāṃ hi ekarūpatayopagatānāṃ kramavadvijñānādikāryopayogitvā'bhyupagame tāvaddhā bhedaprasaṅgāt naikarūpatā'vatiṣṭhate, anekarūpatā tu nityaikarūpatayopagatatvāt nitarāṃ nāvatiṣṭhate
ato bhāvā yathā yathā vicāryante tathā tathā plavanta eva kevalam iti siddhaṃ teṣāṃ tadvicārā'sahatvam
uktañca– bhāvā yena nirūpyante tadrūpaṃ nāsti tattvataḥ
yasmādekamanekaṃ ca rūpaṃ teṣā na vidyate
tathāhi–na svato bhāvā samutpadyante kāraṇanairapekṣyeṇotpadyamānānāṃ deśādiniyamā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
parato'pi sata, asata, sadasadrūpasya votpattiḥ syāt ? na tāvat sataḥ, kāraṇavat tathāvidhasyotpattivirodhāt
ata eva sarve pratyayā anālambanāḥ pratyayatvāt svapnapratyayavaditi pramāṇasya pariśuddhi
bhūtakoṭiśca saiveyaṃ tathyatā saiva śūnyatā || iti
madhyatā saiva śūnyatā syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 181
prayoga–yadekānekasvabhāvaṃ na bhavati na tat sattvena grāhyam prekṣāvatā yathā vyomotpalam ekānekasvabhāvarahitāśca parābhimatāḥ pṛthivyādaya iti vyāpakānupalabdhi
bhāvā yena nirūpyante tadrūpaṃ nāsti tattvataḥ
yasmādekamanekaṃ ca rūpaṃ teṣā na vidyate || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 360
yathā yathārthā vidyante vivicyante tathā tathā
yathā yathā'rthāścintyante viśīryante tathā tathā || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 209 iti
na svato nāpi parataḥ na dvābhyā nāpyahetutaḥ
utpannā jātu vidyante bhāvāḥ kvacana kecana || mādhyamikavṛ॰ pratyayapa॰ kāri॰ 1 iti
etena sthitibhaṅgāvapi cintitau, tayorapi svataḥ parato vā ityādiprakāreṇa sadbhāvābhyupagame uktadoṣānuṣaṅgāt
yathā māyā yathā svapno gandharvanagaraṃ yathā
yathā māyādaya svabhāvena anutpannā avidyamānā māyādiśabdavācyā māyādivijñānagamyāśca lokasya
evamete'pi lokaprasiddhimātreṇa utpādādaya svabhāvena avidyamānā api bhagavatā tathāvidhavineyajanānugrahacikīrṣuṇā nirdiṣṭā iti
ata evoktam samāvirājasūtre 'yathaiva gandharvapuraṃ marīcikā yathaiva māyā supinaṃ yathaiva
svabhāvaśūnyā tu nimittabhāvanā tathopamān jānatha sarvavarmān
yattūktaṃ bhagavatā māyopamā dharmā yāvat nirvāṇopamā iti
tathotpādastathā sthāna tathā bhaṅga udāhṛtaḥ || mādhyamikavṛ॰ saskṛtaparī॰ kāri॰ 34 iti
yadyevam asatāṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ pratibhāsaḥ iti cet ? anādyavidyāvāsanāprabhāvāt, karituragādīnāmasatāṃ mantrādyupaplavasāmarthyāt mṛcchakalādau keṣāñcit pratibhāsavat
uddhṛtañcaitat–siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 57 pū॰, 165 u॰, 216 u॰
tathā grāhya-grāhakabhāvādirapi avidyāvinirmita eva, tadaviparyāsitadarśanānāṃ tathāpratibhāsā'bhāvāt
ravikiraṇasaṃspṛṣṭanīhāranikaravat tattvajñānāt nikhilāvidyāvilāsavilaye tu grāhya-grāhakabhāvādyakhiladharmavikalaṃ saṃvitsvarūpamātramābhāsate
abhinno'pi hi buddhyātmā iti pāṭhāntareṇa bṛhadāraṇyakabhā॰ bā॰ 4
buddhyā yo'nubhūyate sa nāsti para, yathā anyo'nubhāvyo nāsti tathā niveditam
tasyāḥ tarhi paro'nubhavo buddherastuḥ na, tatrāpi grāhyagrāhakalakṣaṇābhāva
paraṃ hi saṃvedanasvarūpe avasthitaṃ kathaṃ parasyānubhavaḥ sākṣātkaraṇādikaṃ pratyākhyātam
tatsaṃvedanānupraveśe ca tayorekatvameva syāt tathā ca svayaṃ saiva prakāśate na tata para iti sthitam
nānyonubhāvo svayameva prakāśate iti pāṭhāntareṇa nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 540
grāhyagrāhakavaidhuryāt svayaṃ saiva prakāśate || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 327 iti

yattāvaduktam–nīlādyākārapratibhāsasya avidyāśilpikalpitatvādavāstavatvam ityādi; tatra kuto'yaṃ nīlādipratibhāso'vidyāprabhavaḥ bādhyamānatvāt, tadgocarasyārthakriyākāritvā'bhāvādvā ? prathamapakṣe na sarvatra jala-nīlādipratibhāsasyā'vidyāprabhavatvasiddhiḥ, yatra hi asau bādhyamānaḥ tatraivā'vidyāprabhavaḥ yathā marīcikāyāṃ jalapratibhāsaḥ śuktikāśakale ca rajatapratibhāsaḥ, na punaḥ satye jale jalapratibhāsaḥ rajate vā rajatapratibhāsa iti

kiñca, atra bādhakaṃ madhyakṣaṇarūpaṃ saṃvinmātrañcet, kutastatsiddhi ? nīlādipratibhāsānāmavāstavatvāccet; itaretarāśrayatvam–siddhe hi madhyakṣaṇarūpe saṃvinmātre tattve tatpratibhāsānāmavāstavatvasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca tathāvidhasaṃvinmātratattvasiddhiriti
anyacca yat saṃvinmātraprasādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ tat prāgevā'pāstam

tadgocarasya arthakriyākāritvābhāvastu asiddha, jalānalādestadgocarasya snānapānādyarthakriyākāritvena sadā suprasiddhatvāt, tasyāśca anarthakriyātve kā'parā arthakriyā syāt ? svarūpānubhavanaṃ sā iti cet, tadapi jñānagatānāṃ nīlādyākārāṇāmastyeva, nahi nirākārasya madhyakṣaṇarūpasya saṃvinmātrasyānubhavanaṃ kadācidapyasti, bahirantarvā'nekākārasyaivārthasya anubhavanāt
kuto'yaṃ nīlādyākārapratibhāso'vidyānibandhanaḥ–kiṃ bādhyamānatvāt, gocarasya arthakriyākāritvābhāvādvā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 183

atha nīlādyanekākārānubhavo mithyā; nanu saṃvit-nīlādyākārayo ekānekasvabhāvayo pratibhāsā'viśeṣe'pi kuto vāstavetaratvapraviveka ? ekākārasya anekākāreṇa virodhāttasya avāstavatve kathamekākārasyaivā'vāstavatvaṃ na syāt ? svapnajñāne anekākārasyā'vāstavasya prasiddhe citrajñāne'pi tasya avāstavatve keśādau ekākārasyāpyavāstavasya prasiddheḥ anyatrāpyekākārasyaiva avāstavatvaṃ kinna syāt ? yathā ca anekākārasya ekākārādabhede'nekatvaṃ viruddhyate, bhede tu savedanāntaratvamanuṣajyate; tathā ekākārasyāpi anekākārādabhede'nekatvam, bhede tu saṃvedanāntaratvamanuṣajyata iti
yadi ca ekasyā'nekākāratā neṣyate tadā pratyākāraṃ jñānasya santānāntaravadbheda syāt, teṣāñcākārāṇāṃ nīlākāreṇā'nupalambhata tadvadevā'sattvaṃ syāt

nīlāṃśasyāpi pratiparamāṇu bhedāt nīlāṇusaṃvedanai parasparaṃ bhinnairbhavitavyam, teṣāñca ekanīlāṇusaṃvedanenā'nupalambhādasattvam, ekanīlāṇusaṃvedanasyāpyevaṃ vedya-vedaka-saṃvidākārabhedāt tritayena bhavitavyam, vedyākārādisavedanatrayasyāpi pratyekamaparasvavedyākārādisaṃvedanatrayeṇa ityanavasthā, ato neṣṭatattvasiddhi syāt
tata pratītito vastuvyavasthāmabhyupagacchadbhi bahirantarvā ekānekapratibhāsāt tathāvidhaṃ vastu prekṣādakṣai pratipattavyam

kathamekānekākārayo pratibhāsā'viśeṣe'pi vāstavetaratvapraviveka ekākārasya anekākāreṇa virodhāt tasya avāstavatve kathamekākārasyaiva avāstavatva na syāt ? svapnajñāne anekākārasya avāstavasya prasiddhe citrajñāne'pi tasya avāstavatva yukta kalpayitubhiti cet, keśādāvekākārasyāpi avāstavatvasiddhe tatrāvāstavatva kathamayuktam ? aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 76

nanveva nīlavedanasyāpi pratiparamāṇubhedāt nīlāṇusavedanaiparaspara bhinnai bhavitavya tatra ekanīlaparamāṇusavedanasyāpyevaṃ vedyavedakasavidākārabhedāt tritayena bhavitavya vedyākārādisavedanatrayasyāpi pratyekamaparasvavedyādisaṃvedanatrayeṇa iti parāparavedanatrayakalpanādanavasthānāt na kvacidekavedanasiddhi saṃvidadvaitvidviṣām
yaccānyaduktam–sarve pratyayā nirālambanāḥ ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; jāgratpratyayānāṃ svarūpavyatiriktasthirasthūlasādhāraṇastambhakumbhādyarthodyotakatvena pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ
tathā ca aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ityādivat pratyakṣabādhitapakṣanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭaṃ pratyayatvam
asiddhañca; pratyayebhyo vyatiriktasya pratyayatvasya bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt, teṣāmeva ca hetutve pratijñārthaikadeśā'siddhatā
svarūpāsiddhatā ca; hetusvarūpagrāhakapratyayasyāpi ata eva nirālambanatvān
atha etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā pakṣādiprasiddhaye tadgrāhakapratyayasya sālambanatvamaṅgīkriyate, tarhi tenaiva pratyayatvamanaikāntikam

viruddhañca; sālambanatve satyeva hi pratyayānāṃ pratyayatvamupapadyate, yataḥ pratīyate svarūpaṃ pararūpaṃ vā yaiḥ te pratyayāḥ tadbhāvaḥ pratyayatvam, tat kathaṃ nirālambanatvaviruddhena sālambanatvena na vyāpyeta yato viruddhaṃ na syāt ?
tatrādyo devatāviśeṣakṛto dharmā'dharmakṛto vā kaścit sākṣādarthā'vyabhicārī, yaddeśakālā''kāratayā svapne pratipanno'rthaḥ taddeśakālākāratayā jāgraddaśāyāṃ tasya prāptiprasiddheḥ
kaścittu paramparayā; rājādidarśanena svapnādhyāyanigaditārthasya kuṭumbavarddhanādeḥ prāptihetutvāt anumānavat, kvacidvyabhicārasya anumāne'pi samatvāt

yo'pi vātapittādyudrekajanito'satyatvena prasiddhaḥ svapnaḥ so'pi nārthamātravyabhicārī, na hi kiñcijjñānaṃ sattāmātraṃ vyabhicarati tasyānutpattiprasaṅgāt, viśeṣaṃ tu yata eva vyabhicarati ata eva asatyaḥ iti
na ca svapnādau bauddhena bodho'bhyupagamyate iti kasya dṛṣṭāntatā ? abhyupagame vā sādhyasādhanadharmagrāhakapratyayasya nirālambanatve sādhyasādhanobhayavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasyā'nuṣa jyate
dṛṣṭāntagrāhakasya ca pratyayasya nirālambanatve dṛṣṭāntasyaivā'sattvād ananvayatvam
dharmidharmobhayapratyayānāṃ nirālambanatve vā aprasiddhaviśeṣyaḥ aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ aprasiddhobhayaśca pakṣaḥ syāt
pratijñā-hetvorvirodhaśca; sarvapratyayānāṃ nirālambanatve sādhye hetūpādāne tatpratyayatvasya sālambanatvā'bhyupagamāt, anyathā kisādhanaḥ sādhyamayaṃ sādhayet ?

tatra satyo devatākṛtaḥ syāt dharmādharmakṛto vā kasthacit sākṣād vyavasāyātmakaḥ prasiddha svapnadaśāyā yaddeśakālākāratayā artha pratipannaḥ punarjāgraddaśāyāmapi taddeśakālākāratayaiva tasya vyavasīyamānatvāt
kaścin satyaḥ svapnaḥ paramparayā arthavyavasāyī svapnādhyāyanigaditārthaprāpakatvāt taduktam– vastu paśyati rāvyante rājānaṃ kuñjaraṃ hayam
suvarṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ gāñca kuṭumbaṃ tasya varddhate
kiñca, svapnadṛṣṭāntena akhilapratyayānāṃ bahirmithyātvābhyupagame svarūpe'pi tatprasaṅgaḥ
tathāhi–yat pratibhāsate tanmithyā yathā arthaḥ, pratibhāsate ca vijñānasvarūpamiti
pratibhāsā'vi śeṣe'pi pratītita svarūpapratibhāsasya satyatvābhyupagame pratyayatvā'viśeṣe'pi jāgraddaśābahirarthapratyayānāṃ pratītita satyatvaṃ kinnābhyupagamyeta viśeṣābhāvāt ?
yāni ca ekā'nekasvarūpavicārā'sahatvāt ityādyanumānāni upanyastāni, tānyapi pakṣa-hetu-dṛṣṭāntadoṣairetaireva prativyūḍhāni pratipattavyāni
na hi kramavadvijñānādikāryopayogitvam ātmāde bhedaprasādhakam, tatsāmarthyabhedasyaiva ata prasiddheḥ

nanu sāmarthyasya svabhāvabhūtasya bhede kathanna tadvato bheda ? ityapyasamīcīnam, svabhāvabhedasya bhāvabhedaṃ pratyanaṅgatvāt, kathamanyathā citramekaṃ jñānaṃ syāt ? tadanabhyupagame ca sakalaśūnyatā prāgeva pratipāditā
kathaṃ vā grāhyākāravivekarūpatayā parokṣatāṃ saṃvidrūpatayā ca pratyakṣatāṃ vibhrato jñānasya svabhāvabhedasaṃbhavād ekatvaṃ syāt ?

kṣaṇasthāyina kasyacideva grāhyagrāhakākāravaiśvarūpyānabhyupagame'pi saṃviditajñānasya grāhyagrāhakākāravivekaṃ parokṣaṃ vibhrāṇasya sāmarthyaprāpte aṣṭaśa॰ savedanasyaikasya pratyakṣaparokṣākāratayā vaiśvarūpyasiddhe

yadapyuktam–utpādādidharmarahitāścārthā ityādi, tadapyasāmpratam; dravyarūpatayā satāṃ paryāyarūpatayā cā'satāṃ teṣāmutpādādidharmasadbhāvopapatte, na hi sarvathā sato'sato vā taddharmāṇāmupapattiḥ iti yathāsthānaṃ nivedayiṣyāmaḥ
yadi ca utpādādidharmāḥ sarvathā na santi, tadā cinmātrasya asattvamanuṣajyate kāryakāritvā'bhāvāt khapuṣpavat, nityatvaṃ vā syāt sadakāraṇavattvādākāśādivat
teṣāmasattve ca kathaṃ viśadapratibhāsagocaratā ? yatsarvathāpyasanna tadviśadapratibhāsagocaraḥ yathā khapuṣpam, sarvathā'pyasantaśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitā utpādādayo dharmā iti
tadgocaratve vā sarvathāpyasattvānupapattiḥ, yadviśadapratibhāsagocaraḥ na tat sarvathāpyasat yathā saṃvitsvarūpam, viśadapratibhāsagocarāśca utpādādayo dharmā iti
na cedamasiddham, suvarṇādau kaṭakādyutpādāde ābālaṃ viśadapratibhāsagocaracāritayā suprasiddhatvāt

tatra teṣāṃ sarvathā'sattve ca saṃvedanamātramapi na prāpnoti, yad yatra sarvathāpyasat na tattatra saṃvedyate yathā du khe sukham nīlākāre vā pītākāra, sarvathā'pyasantaścotpādādayo dharmā artheṣviti
nanu marīcikācakre jalasyā'sattve'pi saṃvedanasaṃbhavāt anekāntaḥ, ityapyasat; tatra tasya sarvathā'sattvasyā'saṃbhavāt
dravyakṣetrakālākāratayā hi asattvaṃ sarvathā'sattvamucyate, taccāsya atra nāsti vīcītaraṅgādyākāreṇa sadṛśātmanā tatra tasya sattvāt, anyathā kāṣṭhapāṣāṇādivat taccakre'pi tatsaṃvedanotpattirna syāt

astu vā asatāmapyeṣāṃ saṃvedanam, tathāpi mukhyam, gauṇaṃ vā tat syāt ? tatrādyapakṣo'yukta; jñānasyaiva hi svātmabhūto'sādhāraṇo dharmo mukhyaṃ saṃvedanam, tatkatham ajñānarūpāṇāmutpādādīnāṃ syāt ? prayoga–yadajñānarūpaṃ na tasya mukhyaṃ saṃvedanam yathā śaśaśṛṅgasya, ajñānarūpāśca asattvenopagatā utpādādayo dharmāstadupalakṣitāścārthā iti
dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapanna; yataḥ svākāranirbhāsijñānotpādanameva gauṇaṃ saṃvedanamucyate, tacca aśvaviṣāṇavadasatāmutpādādīnāmayuktam sarvasāmarthyavirahalakṣaṇatvādasattvasya
yat sarvasāmarthyavirahitaṃ na tasya gauṇaṃ saṃvedanam yathā aśvaviṣāṇasya, sarvasāmarthyavirahitāśca asattvenābhimatā utpādādayo dharmāḥ tadvantaścārthā iti
kiñca, utpādādīnāṃ jñānena sārddhaṃ kaḥ sambandhaḥ yena tasmin saṃvedyamāne niyamena te saṃvedyeran–ki tādātmyam, tadutpattirvā ? na tāvattādātmyam; jñānavat teṣāmapi sattvaprasaṅgāt
nāpi tadutpattiḥ; utpādādyākārāṇāṃ nīrūpatve janyatvasya janakatvasya cā'saṃbhavāt

ataḥ sambandhā'bhāvāt kathaṃ tena teṣāṃ saṃvedanam ? yasya yena sambandho nāsti tasmin saṃvedyamāne niyamena sa na saṃvedyate yathā jñānātmani saṃvedyamāne vandhyāsutaḥ, nāsti ca tādātmya-tadutpattilakṣaṇaḥ sambandho jñānena saha asattvabhūtānāmutpādādyākārāṇāmiti
asti caiteṣāṃ jñāne saṃvedyamāne niyamena saṃvedanam, ato'sti kaścit teṣāṃ tena sambandhaḥ, sa ca paramārthasattvamantareṇa na saṃbhavatīti siddhaṃ teṣāṃ paramārthasattvam
yasmin saṃvedyamāne yanniyamena saṃvedyate tat tena sambaddham paramārthasacca yathā jñāne saṃvedyamāne tatsvarūpam, saṃvedyante ca jñāne saṃvedyamāne niyamenotpādādayaḥ tadvantaścārthā iti

iṣṭatvānna tatprasaṅgo doṣāya iti cet; nanu keyaṃ sakalaśūnyatā nāma yadiṣṭirdoṣāya na syāt-sakalapadārthā'bhāvamātram, grāhyagrāhakabhāvādirahitaṃ saṃvinmātraṃ vā syāt ? prathamavikalpe kiṃ tasyāḥ sadbhāvāvedakaṃ kiñcitpramāṇamasti, na vā ? yadi nāsti; kathaṃ tatsiddhiḥ pramāṇanibandhanatvād vastusiddheḥ
atha asti; kathaṃ sakalaśūnyatā pratyakṣādipramāṇasya tajjanakasyendriyādeśca sadbhāve sakalaśūnyatāvirodhāt ?
śūnyatā vidyate tvatra tasyāmapi sa vidyate
abhūtaparikalpo hi grāhyagrāhakarahitaḥ śūnya iti na sarvathā svabhāvato nāsti

kiñca, sakalaśūnyatā pramāṇaprameyayoḥ grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt, anupalabdheḥ, vicārāt, prasaṅgādvā syāt ? prathamapakṣe ko'yaṃ tadgrāhakapramāṇā'bhāvaḥ–duṣṭendriyaprabhavapratyayāḥ saṃśayādayaḥ, jñānānutpādo vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; saṃśayādisadbhāvābhyupagame sakalaśūnyatāhāniprasaṅgāt
jñānānutpādo'pi jñātaḥ sarvābhāvaṃ gamayati, ajñāto vā ? na tāvadajñātaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt
yo'bhāvaḥ sa jñāto'nyābhāvaṃ gamayati yathā kvacid dhūmā'bhāvo'gnyabhāvam, abhā vaścāyaṃ jñānānutpāda iti
atha jñātaḥ; kutastajjñaptiḥ—anyataḥ pramāṇābhāvāt, svato vā ? prathamapakṣe anavasthātaḥ prakṛtā'bhāvā'pratipattiḥ
svatastajjñaptau sarvā'bhāvasyāpi svato jñaptiprasaṅgāt pramāṇābhāvo vyarthaḥ syān
astu, kā no hāniriti cet ? sakalaśūnyatāvyāghātaḥ tathābhūtasyāsyaiva pramāṇa-prameyarūpatvaprasaṅgāt
pramāṇa-prameyapadā'vyapadeśyaḥ sarvā'bhāvaḥ iti cā'yuktam; svataḥ svarūpaṃ pratitīyataḥ tadrūpapratiṣedhavirodhāt
tathāhi—yatpramāṇaprameyapadāvyapadeśyam tannāsti yathā kharaviṣāṇam, tatpadāvyapadeśyaśca sarvā'bhāva iti
kiñca, sakalaśūnyatā pramāṇaprameyayoranupalabdhitaḥ, vicārāt, prasaṅgasādhanādvā syāt
yasyāphīṣṭaṃ na nirṇītaṃ kvacittasya na saṃśayaḥ
nāpyanupalabdheḥ pramāṇaprameyayorabhāvāt sakalaśūnyatāsiddhiḥ; pratijñā-hetvorvirodhāt siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgācca, pradhvastā'nutpannānāmasattvābhyupagamāt

kālātyayāpadiṣṭatā ca; dharmihetudṛṣṭāntānāṃ sattve anupalabdheḥ tajjñaptisādhanairnirastaviṣayatvāt, tatsattvā'nabhyupagame āśrayāsiddhatādidoṣānupaṅgāt kathaṃ sakalaśūnyatāsiddhiḥ ? abhāvadharmatvādanupalabdheḥ āśrayāsiddhatādyanupapattiḥ; ityapyasundaram; anupalabdherabhāvadharmatve pramāṇā'bhāvāt

kiñca, anupalabdhiḥ svarūpeṇādhigatā anyapratītaye prayujyate, anadhigatā vā ? na tāvadanadhigatā; jñāpakatvāt, yaj jñāpakaṃ tat svarūpeṇādhigatamanyapratītaye prayujyate yathā dhūmādi, jñāpikā ca anupalabdhiḥ sarvābhāvasyeti
nāpyadhigatā; tatsvarūpādhigame pratyakṣasya anumānasya vā pramāṇasya pravṛttau sakalaśūnyatāvirodhānuṣaṅgān
na ca liṅgatvena svayamaniścitāyāḥ dṛṣṭānte kvacidapratipannapratibandhāyāstasyāḥ svasādhyasiddhau gamakatvaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt

atha vicārāt sarvābhāvaḥ prasādhyate; nanu vicāro vastubhūto'sti, na vā ? yadyasti; kathaṃ sakalaśūnyatā ? nāsti cet; kutaḥ sarvā'bhāvaḥ siddhyet ? atha prasaṅgasādhanāt tadabhāvaḥ sādhyate; na; sarvā'sattvavādinaḥ svaparavibhāgā'saṃbhave prasaṅgasādhanasyaivā'saṃbhavāt, parasyeṣṭyā'niṣṭāpādanalakṣaṇatvāttasya

kathañca pramāṇaprameyaprapañcaṃ pratītibhūdharaśikharārūḍhamanabhyupagāya svapnepyapratīyamānaṃ sarvā'bhāvamabhyupagacchan prāmāṇikaḥ syāt ? svapne karituragādivat midhyaiva tatprapañcaḥ pratibhātīti cet; kva idānīṃ satyatā syāt ? ghaṭādipadārthā'sattve cet; kutastasya satyatā ? bādhārahitapratibhāsāccet; taditaratra samānam
yathaiva hi kvaciddeśe kāle vā padārthānāmasattve bādhārahitapratibhāso'sti, tathā sattve'pi
yadi ca prāk-pradhvaṃsābhāvavat madhye'pyarthā nāmasattvaṃ syāt; tadā sthitikāle'pi gaurayam śuklaḥ calati iti jāti-guṇa-kriyāvyapadeśo na syāt asataḥ tadvyapadeśā'saṃbhavāt
asti cāyaṃ vyapadeśaḥ, ato madhyāvasthāyāṃ padārthānāmasadrūpādarthāntaraṃ sadrūpaṃ pratipattavyam
nahi vicārasyābhāve kasyacid vicāreṇānupapaniḥ śavayā vaktuṃ nāpi śūnyavādinaḥ kiñcinniṇīṃtamasti yadāśritya kvacidanyatra aniṇīte'rthe vicāraḥ pravartate tasya sarvatra vipratipatteḥ
tathā coktaṃ tattvārthaślokavārtike pṛ॰ 80 ślo॰ 140kiñcinniṇīṃtamāśritya vicāro'nyatra vartate

atha grāhya-grāhakabhāvādiśūnyaṃ saṃvinmātraṃ sā ityucyate; nanu sā tathāvidhā kutaḥ siddhā—abhyupagamamātrāt, pratītervā ? prathamapakṣe kuto'pratipakṣā pakṣasiddhiḥ sarvasya sveṣṭatattvasiddheḥ tathā saṃbhavāt ? dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ; yato grāhya-grāhakabhāvādiśūnyasya saṃvinmātrasya kadācidapyapratītitaḥ kathaṃ tallakṣaṇā tacchūnyatā pratītitaḥ siddhyet ? pratītyā ca vastuvyavasthāṃ kurvatā bahirantarvā'nekāntātmakaṃ vastu urarīkartavyam, bāhyādhyātmikārthānāṃ grāhyaprāhakādyanekākārākrāntatayaiva pratītau pratibhāsanāt
na ceyaṃ mithyā vādhakā'bhāvāt, viparītārthopalambho hi vādhakaḥ, na cātra so'sti, tadviparotasya madhyakṣaṇasthāyinaḥ saṃvinmātrasya svaprepyupalambhā'bhāvāt

asatā'pi vādhākalpane nitya-niraṃśa-vyāpiparavrahmopalambhenā'satāpi madhyakṣaṇasthāyisaṃvinmātrasya bādhā kinna syād viśeṣābhāvāt ? tataḥ pratītinibandhanāṃ vastuvyavasthāmabhyupagacchatā bahirantarvā anekāntātmā'rthaḥ pramāṇagocaraḥ pratipattavyaḥ, iti siddho bāhyo'pyarthaḥ pramāṇasya gocara iti
asya ca śūnyavādasya nirālambanavādaḥ bāhyārthaniṣedhavādaḥitvādirūpeṇa pratividhānaṃ nimragrantheṣu draṣṭavyam—mīmāṃsāsūtra 1
etena brahmādvaitavādyapi bāhyamarthamapalapan pratyākhyātaḥ, brahmaṇaḥ sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt
nanu kiṃrūpasya brahmaṇaḥ sadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvaḥ—śabdasvabhāvasya, paramātmarūpasya vā ? dvividhaṃ hi brahma, śabda-paramabrahmavikalpāt
tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; śabdasvabhāvabrahmasadbhāve pratyakṣasya anumānasya ca pramāṇasya sadbhāvāt

tathāhi—sakalaṃ yogajamayogajaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ śabdavrahmollekhyevā'vabhāsate bāhyādhyātmikārthepūtpadyamānasyā'sya śabdānuviddhatvenaivotpatte, tatsaṃsparśavaikalye pratyayānāṃ prakāśamānatāyā durghaṭatvāt
bāgrūpatā hi śāśvatī pratyavamarśinī ca, tadabhāve teṣāṃ nāparaṃ rūpamavaśiṣyate
dve vidye veditavye śabdabrahma parañca yat
na sosti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte
sarva śabdena vartate tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 68
sarvaṃ śabdena jāyate anekāntajaya॰ pṛ॰ 41 u॰
anuviddhamiva jñāna sarvaṃ śabdena gamyate nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 532
anuviddhamiva jñāna sarvaṃ śabdena gṛhyate mīmā॰ ślo॰ ṭī॰ pratyakṣasū॰ ślo॰ 176
vāgrūpatā ced vyutkrāmet sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 380
na hi bodha prakāśeta syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 89
vāprūpatāyā ca satyāṃ utpanno'pi prakāśo viśeṣavāgrūpatāmasvīkurvan prakāśakriyāsādhanatāyā na vyavatiṣṭate
sā hi vāgrūpatā hi pratyavamarśa savikalpakajñānaṃ tatmampādikā ityartha
na prakāśaḥ prakāśeta sā hi pratyavamarśinī || vākyapa॰ 1 | 124-25 | iti
sakalavyavahāro'pi śabdānuviddha evā'nubhūyate, na hi bhokṣye, dāsyāmi ityādyanullikhitaśabdaḥ kaścidapi svayaṃ kāryanirvarttanāya yatate, paraṃ vā dehi ityādiśabdaṃ vinā pravartayati

jīvetararūpāvirbhāvo'pi śabdāyatta eva; tathāhi–suptāvasthāyāmanullikhitaśabdarūpatvāt mṛtānna kaścidviśiṣyate, taduttarakālaṃ tu kutaścicchabdāt prabuddhaḥ puruṣaḥ śabdenaivā'ntarjalpātmanā ātmānamanudadhāno jīvitamupayāti, tadupahitajīvitāt sakalā śabdabhāvanāḥ ahamidamanutiṣṭhāmi ityādirūpā vivartante, tāśca nānāviṣayā vivartamānāḥ svasvaviṣayānarthān āvirbhāvayanti
yadā tu puruṣeṇoccārita śabdaḥ samāvirbhūya tirobhavati tadā svagranthibhūtamarthamapi tirobhāvayati jyotsnāmiva śaśāṅkaḥ
nanu ca advayarūpe tattve kathamāvirbhāva-tiro bhāvādirūpo bhedaprapañcapratibhāsaḥ syāt ? iti na cetasi vidheyam; avidyātaḥ tatra tatpratibhāsā'virodhād ākāśavat

yathaiva hi timiropahatalocano jano viśuddhamapyākāśaṃ vicitrarekhānikarakarambitamiva manyate tathā anādinidhanamabhinnasvabhāvamapagatanikhilabhedaprapañcamapi śabdabrahma avidyātimiropahato janaḥ āvirbhāvādibhedaprapañcānvitamiva pratipadyate
sakalā'vidyāvilāsavilaye tu yoginaḥ tatprapañcānanvitaṃ yathāvattatsvarūpaṃ pratipadyante

yathā ca vīcītaraṅgabudbudaphenarūpo nīravikāraḥ sārabhūtamamalaṃ jalam āvirbhāva-tirobhāvārthamapekṣate, tathā vyāvahārikaḥ sthūlo'yamakārādiśabdabhedaprapañcaḥ paramasūkṣmapratibhāsamātraikarūpaṃ sarvaśabdaviṣayavijñānaprasavanimittaṃ kvāpi aniyamitaikanijasvabhāvaṃ śabdamayaṃ brahmāpekṣate
iti ca na cetasi nirdhayam ba॰, ja॰
kaluṣatvamivāpannaṃ bhedarūpaṃ prapaśyati || bṛhadā॰ bhā॰ bā॰ 3 | 5 | 43, 44 | iti
bhedarūpaṃ prakāśate bṛhadā॰ bhā॰ bā॰ pṛ॰ 1246
tathedamamṛtaṃ brahma bhedarūpaṃ vivartataḥ tattvasaṃ॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 72
bhedarūpaṃ tu paśyati syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 91

evamadhyakṣataḥ pratīyamānamapi śabdabrahma ye avidyātimiropahatacetasaḥ tathā iti nābhyupagacchanti viparyasyanti ca, tān prati idamucyate–ye yadākārānusyūtāḥ te tanmayāḥ yathā ghaṭaśarāvodañcanādayo mṛdvikārā mṛnmayāḥ, śabdākārānusyūtāśca sarve bhāvā iti
na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ; pratyakṣata evā'śeṣārthānāṃ śabdākārānvayaprasiddhe pratipāditatvāt
tatsiddhau ca teṣāṃ tanmayatvaṃ siddhameva tanmātrabhāvitvāttasya

tadvyatirekasya ca pramāṇabādhitatvāt; tathāhi–na śabdād vyatiricyate'rthaḥ, tatpratītāveva pratīyamānatvāt, yatpratītāveva yatpratīyate na tattato vyatiricyate yathā śabdasyaiva svarūpam, śabdapratītāveva pratīyate cārtha, ataḥ tato na vyatiricyata iti

yattāvaduktam–śabdasvabhāvabrahmasadbhāve ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yatastatsadbhāva kimindriyaprabhavapratyakṣata pratīyet, atīndriyāt, svasaṃvedanādvā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yukta; yata sakaladeśakālārthākāranikarakarambitasvabhāvaṃ śabdabrahma bhavadbhirabhipretam

tathāvidhasya cāsya sadbhāvaḥ śrotraprabhavapratyakṣāt, itarendriyajanitādhyakṣādvā pratīyet ? na tāvat śrotraprabhavapratyakṣāt; tasya śabdasvarūpamātragocaracāritayā agocareṇa tadākāranikareṇānvitatvasya tadbrahmaṇi pratipattumasamarthatvāt
yad yadagocaro na tattenānvitatvaṃ kasyacit pratipattuṃ samartham yathā cakṣurjñāna rasena, agocaraśca tadākāranikaraḥ śrotrajñānasyeti
tadagocareṇāpi tena tadanvitatvapratipattau atiprasaṅga, sarvasya sarveṇānvitatvapratipattiprasakteḥ
etena indriyāntarajanitā'dhyakṣādapi tatpratipatti pratyuktā; śabdā'gocaratayā tasyāpi tatpratipattāvasamarthatvāt
tanna indriyapratyakṣān pratiniyatarūpādiviṣayavyatirekeṇa aparaṃ śabdabrahma pratīyate
yogināṃ yogajaṃ tatsaṃbhavatīti cet, na; yogi-yoga-tatprabhavapratyakṣāṇāṃ sabhave advaitā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
na tatprasaṅga yogyavasthāyām ātmajyotīrūpasyāsya svaya prakāśanāt, ityapi manorathamātram; tadavasthā-rūpa-prakāśanatrayasadbhāve advaitā'bhāvasya tadavasthatvāt

kiñca, yogyavasthāyā tasya tadrūpaprakāśanena tataḥprāk tadrūpaṃ prakāśate, na vā ? yadi prakāśate, tadā'yatnasiddhaḥ sarvadā sarveṣāṃ mokṣa syāt, vyotiḥsvabhāvabrahmaprakāśo hi mokṣa, sa ca ayogyavasthāyāmapi evaṃ prasajyeta
atha na prakāśate; tadā tatkimasti, na vā ? yadi nāsti, kathaṃ tannityam kādācitkatvāt ? yat kādācitkam na tannityam yathā avidyā, kādācitkañca jyoti svarūpa brahmaṇa iti
tadanityatve ca śabdabrahmaṇo'pyanityatvaprasaṅga tanmayatvāttasya, ato dvaitasiddhirapratihataprasarā prasajyate, advaitavināśe dvaitasiddhera vaśyambhāvitvāt
athāsti; kasmānna prakāśate–grāhakābhāvāt, avidyābhibhūtatvādvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapanna, brahmaṇa eva tadgrāhakatvāt, tasya ca nityatayā sadā sattvāt
yadyevaṃ prāgayogitvāvasthāyā kiṃ tasya rūpamiti vācyam ? yadi sadaiva jyotīrūpaṃ tadā tarhi na kadācidayogitvāvasyā'sti sadaiva ātmajyotīrūpatvād brahmaṇa

sā hi brahmaṇo vyatiriktā, avyatiriktā vā ? yadi vyatiriktā; kimasau vastu, avastu vā syāt ? na tāvadavastu; arthakriyākāritvād brahmavat, tatkāritve'pyasyāḥ avastu iti nāmāntarakaraṇe nāmamātrameva bhidyeta

atha arthakriyākāritvamapyasyā neṣyate tatkathaṃ vastutvāpattiḥ ? kathamevam avidyayā kaluṣatvamivāpannam ityādivaco ghaṭeta ? ākāśe ca vitathapratibhāsahetubhūtaṃ vāstavameva timiraṃ prasiddham, avidyāyāśca avāstavatvena vicitrapratibhāsahetutvā'nupapattito dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayoḥ sāmyā'saṃbhavāt yathā viśuddhamākāśam ityādyapi durghaṭameva
na cā'nādheyā'praheyātiśayasya brahmaṇaḥ tadvaśāt tathāpratibhāso yukto'tiprasaṅgāt
athā'vyatiriktā; tarhi brahmaṇo'pi mithyātvaprasaktiḥ, mithyārūpāyāḥ avidyāto'vyatiriktatvāt tatsvarūpavat, iti lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ syāt

avidyāyā vā satyatvaprasaṅga; satyasvabhāvād brahmaṇo'vyatiriktatvāt tatsvarūpavat, ataḥ kathamasyāḥ mithyāpratītihetutvam ? yat satyam na tanmithyāpratītihetuḥ yathā brahma, satyā ca brahmaṇo'vyatiriktatvenā'vidyeti

astu vā yathākathañcidavicāritaramaṇīyasvabhāvā avidyā, tathāpi na tayā tatsvabhāvasyāsya abhibhavaḥ; durbalasya hi balavatā'bhibhavo dṛṣṭaḥ yathā savitrā tārānikarasya, na cā'vidyāyā balavattvamasti avastutvāt vājiviṣāṇavat
tatra tadrūpa>syāsyā'sattve ca yogyavasthāyāṃ kutaḥ sattvaṃ syāt yato'tīndriyapratyakṣāt tatpratīyeta ?
sā hi śabdabrahmaṇa sakāśād bhinnā bhavedabhinnā vā ? bhinnā cet kimasau vastu, avastu vā syāt ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 99
ākāśe ca vitathapratibhāsahetubhūtaṃ vāstavamevāsti nimiramiti na dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayo sāmyam
atha vyatiriktā'vidyā aṅgīkriyate evamapi nityatvād anādheyātiśayasya brahmaṇa sā na tat kiñcit karoti iti na yuktam avidyāvaśāt tathā pratibhāsanam

etena svasaṃvedanādapi tatpratipattiḥ pratyākhyātā; ātmajyotiḥsvabhāvasyāsya svapne'pi saṃvedanā'gocaratvāt, tadgocaratve vā anupāyasiddha eva akhilaprāṇināṃ mokṣaḥ syāt, tathāvidhasya hi śabdabrahmaṇaḥ svasaṃvedanaṃ yat tadeva mokṣo bhavatāmabhimataḥ
na ca ghaṭādiśabdo'rtho vā svasaṃviditasvabhāvaḥ, yatastadanvitatvaṃ svasaṃvedanataḥ siddhyat, asvasaṃviditasvabhāvatayaivāsya pratiprāṇi prasiddhatvāt
syādetat– svasaṃvedanapratyakṣata eva tatsiddhaṃ jñānātmarūpatvāt; tathāhi–jyoti tadeva śabdātmakatvāt caitanyarūpatvācca iti, tadetat svasaṃvedanaviruddham… tattvasaṃ॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 73

kiñca, śabdārthayoḥ sambandhe sati śabdenānvitatvamarthasya kutaścita pramāṇāt pratīyeta, asati vā ? na tāvadasati; atiprasaṅgāt, yad yenāsambaddhaṃ na tattenā'nvitam yathā sahyena vindhyaḥ, asambaddhaśca arthena śabdaḥ ityanumānavirodhānuṣaṅgācca

atha sati sambandhe; nanu ko'yaṃ tasya tena sambandhaḥ–saṃyogaḥ, tādātmyam, viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ, vācyavācakabhāvo vā ? na tāvat saṃyogaḥ; vibhinnadeśatvāt, yayorvibhinnadeśatvaṃ na tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ yathā malaya-himācalayoḥ, vibhinnadeśatvañca śabdā'rthayoriti
na cedamasiddham; śabdasya śrotrapradeśe arthasya ca purodeśe pratibhāsamānatvāt, tatsambandhābhyupagame ca anayordravyāntaratvasiddhiprasaṅgāt kathaṃ tadadvaitasiddhiḥ syāt ?
tādātmyābhyupagamo'pyayuktaḥ; vibhinnendriyagrāhyatvāt, yayorvibhinnendriyagrāhyatvaṃ na tayostādātmyam yathā rūpa-rasayoḥ, vibhinnendriyagrāhyatvañca śabdārthayoriti
na cedamasiddham; śabdākārarahitasya ghaṭādeḥ locanavijñāne pratibhāsanāt tadrahitasya tu śabdasya śrotrajñāne
śabdātmakatve cārthānāṃ śabdapratītau saṅketā'grāhiṇo'pi arthe sandeho na syāt tadvat tasyāpi pratipannatvāt, anyathā tattādātmyānupapattiḥ
yo yatsādhyaprayojanaṃ na nirvartayati nāsau tena tādāmyamanubhavati yathā rūpeṇa rasaḥ, na nirvartayati ca arthasādhyaprayojanaṃ dāhādikaṃ śabda iti
tathā, nāsti śabdārthayostādātmyaṃ vibhinnadeśa-kāla-ākāratvāt, yat tathāvidhaṃ na tatra tādātmyam yathā ghaṭa-paṭādau, tathāvidhau ca śabdārthāviti
na ca vibhinnadeśatvaṃ tatrāsiddham; prāk prasādhitatvāt
nāpi vibhinnakālatvam; ghaṭādyarthānāṃ tacchabdebhyaḥ prāgapi sattvapratīteḥ
nanu tattādātmyāsambhave kathamato'rthapratītiḥ ? ityapyasāmpratam; tadabhāve'pyasyāḥ saṅketasāmarthyādupapadyamānatvāt
na ca śabdasya arthaviśeṣaṇatvena pratītestadātmakatā; deśabhedena śabdārthayoḥ upalabdheḥ
yadāhurbhadrabāhusvāmipādāḥ–abhihāṇaṃ abhiheyāu hoi bhiṇṇaṃ abhiṇṇaṃ ca
navi cheo navi dāho ṇa pūraṇaṃ teṇa bhinnaṃ tu
vācyavācakabhāvastu śabdārthayoḥ bhedameva prasādhayati, tamantareṇa anayoḥ tadbhāvā'nupapatteḥ
tadevaṃ śabdārthayoḥ advaitāvirodhinaḥ sambandhasya kasyacidapi vicāryamāṇasyā'nupapatteḥ na śabdenānvitatvamarthasya ghaṭate
pratītyā ca śabdānvitatvaṃ jñāne parikalpyate, sā cedanyatrāpyasti tadapi parikalpyatnāmaviśeṣāt, tathā ca na so'sti pratyayo loke ityādyayuktam
prasādhitañca locanādyadhyakṣe śabdasaṃsparśābhāve'pi svārthaprakāśakatvaṃ savikalpakasiddhipraghaṭṭake ityalamatiprasaṅgena
yadapyuktam–sakalavyavahāro'pi ityādi; tadapyayuktam; śābdavyavahārasyaiva tadanuviddhatvena anubhavāt, na cakṣurādiprabhavasya
yaccānyaduktam–suptāvasthāyām ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; advaite supretarāvasthāyā evā'saṃbhavāt, tatsaṃbhave advaitavirodhāt
avidyātastatra tadavirodhaḥ; iti śraddhāmātram; avidyāyā bhedapratibhāsahetutvasya prāgeva kṛtottaratvāt
yadapyuktam–ye yadākārānusyūtāḥ ityādi; tadapyasāram; śabdākārānusyūtatvasya asiddheḥ
pratyakṣeṇa hi nīlādikaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ pratipattā śabdākārānanvitameva pratipadyate, kalpitatvācca asyā'siddhiḥ
śabdākārānvitarūpādhārā'rthābhāve'pi hi te tadanvitatvena tvayā kalpyante, tathābhūtācca hetoḥ kathaṃ pāramārthikaṃ brahma siddhyet
sādhya-sādhanavikalaśca dṛṣṭāntaḥ; ghaṭādīnāmapi sarvathaikamayatvasya ekānvitatvasya cā'siddheḥ
na khalu bhāvānāṃ sarvathaikarūpānugamo'sti, sarvārthānāṃ samānā'samānapariṇāmātmakatvāt
yadapyabhihitam–na śabdād vyatiricyate'rthaḥ ityādi; tatra pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhā, śabdād deśādibhedenārthasya pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ
tatpratītāveva pratīyamānatvāt iti hetuścā'siddhaḥ; locanādijñānena śabdā'pratītāvapi arthasya pratīyamānatvāt
kathamanyathā badhirasya cakṣurādiprabhavapratyakṣād rūpādyarthapratītiḥ syāt ? tanna śabdasvabhāvasya brahmaṇaḥ sadbhāvaḥ kutaścitpramāṇād ghaṭate

astu vā; tathāpi śabdapariṇāmatvāt jagataḥ śabdamayatvaṃ syāt mṛtpariṇāmatvād ghaṭasya mṛṇmayatvavat, śabdādutpattervā yathā annamayāḥ prāṇā iti hetau mayaṅ vidhānāt ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; pariṇāmasyaivātrā'nupapatteḥ
śabdātmakaṃ hi brahma nīlādirūpatāṃ pratipadyamānaṃ svābhāvikaṃ śabdarūpaṃ parityajya pratipadyeta, aparityajya vā ? prathamapakṣe asyā'nādinidhanatvavirodha, paurastyasvabhāvavināśāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu nīlādisaṃvedanasamaye badhirasyāpi śabdasavedanaprasaṅga nīlādestadavyatirekāt
yad yadavyatiriktaṃ tan tammina saṃvedyamāne saṃvedyate yathā nīlādisaṃvedanāvasthāyāṃ tasyaiva nīlāderātmā, nīlādyavyatiriktaśca śabda iti
anyathā viruddhadharmādhyāsāt tasya tato bhedā'nuṣaṅga, na hi ekasyānaśasyaikadā ekapratipatrapekṣayā grahaṇamagrahaṇañca yuktam virodhāt
kiñca, śabdātmā pariṇāma gacchan pratipadārthaṃ bhedaṃ pratipadyeta, na vā ? tatrādyavikalpe śabdabrahmaṇo'nekatvaprasaṅga, vibhinnānekasvabhāvā'rthātmakatvāt tatsvarūpavat
dvitīyavikalpe tu sarveṣāṃ nīlādīnāṃ deśa-kāla-mbabhāva-vyāpārā-'vasthābhedā'bhāva pratibhāsabhedā'bhāvaścānupajyate, ekambabhāvāt śabdabrahmaṇo'bhinnatvāt tatsvarūpavat
atra kadācit śabdapariṇāmarūpatvādvā jagataḥ śabdamayatvaṃ sādhyatvena iṣṭam, kadācicchabdādutpattervā yathā annamayāḥ prāṇāḥ iti hetau mayaṅ vithānāt
tathāhi–śabdātmakaṃ brahma nīlādirūpatāṃ pratipadyamānaṃ kadācinnijaṃ svābhāvikaṃ śabdarūpaṃ parityajya pratipadyeta, aparityajya vā ? tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 68
iti sañcakṣate ye'pi te vācyā kimida nijam
na vā tatheti yadyādya pakṣa saśrīyate tadā
asyā'vittau hi nīlāderapi na syāt pravedanam
nahi ekasya ekadā ekapratipatrapekṣayā grahaṇamagrahaṇañca yuktam ekatvahāniprasaṅgāt
sa hi śabdātmā pariṇāmaṃ gacchan pratipadārtha bhedaṃ vā pratipadyate, na vā ? tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 70
nāpi śabdādutpatte, tasya nityatvena avikāritvāt, avikāriṇaśca krameṇa kāryotpādakatvānupapatteryugapadevā'khilakāryāṇāmutpattiprasaṅga

kāraṇavaikalyāddhi kāryāṇi vilambante nānyathā, taccedavikalam, kimaparaṃ tairapekṣyam yena yugapanna bhaveyuḥ ? tadevaṃ śabdabrahmaṇaḥ sadbhāvagrāhakapramāṇasya jagatprapañcaracanānimittatvasya cā'siddheḥ na tadabhyupagamena abādhabodhādhirūḍhasyārthasyāpalāpo yuktaḥ
evamapi śabdasya nityatvena avikāritvāt tata krameṇa kāryodayo na prāpnoti sarveṣāmavikalāpratibaddhasāmarthyakāraṇāt yugapadeva utpāda syāt
kāraṇavaikalyāddhi kāryāṇi pravilambante, taccedavikala tat kimaparamapekṣyeran yena yugapanna bhaveyu ? tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 71
śabdabrahmavādasya vividhabhaṅgyā khaṇḍanaṃ nimnagrantheṣu prekṣaṇīyam–mīmāsāślo॰ pratyakṣasū॰ ślo॰ 176

nanu sarva khalvidaṃ brahma chāndogyo॰ neha nānāsti kiñcana vṛhadā॰ ārāmaṃ tasya paśyanti na taṃ paśyati kaścana vṛhadā॰ ityādyupaniṣadvākyāt paramabrahmaṇaḥ sadbhāvasiddheḥ cetanā'cetanapariṇāmena jagatprapañcaracanānimittatvamupapadyate
cetano hi pariṇāmo'sya karmātmānaḥ, avipratipattyā tatra sarveṣāṃ caitanyānvayaprasiddheḥ, acetanastu pṛthivyādimahābhūtarūpaḥ

na caikatve brahmaṇaḥ kathamayaṃ nānārūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ ? ityabhidhātavyam; suvarṇa-kṣīrāderekatve'pi kaṭaka-dadhyādivicitrapariṇāmoṣalambhāt, tadevedaṃ suvarṇa kaṭakādirūpatayā pariṇatam, tadevedaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhībhūtam iti pratīteḥ

kṣīradadhnostādātmye kinna yugapatpratibhāsaḥ kaṭakasuvarṇavat nīlapītādyākāraikavastuvadvā ? ityapyayuktam; deśacitrasyaivā'rthasya yugapatpratibhāsārhatvāt, kālacitrasya tu svātmabhūtenaiva krameṇāvaṣṭabdhatvānna yugapatpratibhāsa
sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma tajjalāniti śānta upāsītātha chāndogyopa॰ 3
mṛtyo sa mṛtyumāpnoti ya iha nāneva paśyati
mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyuṃ gacchati ya iha nāneva paśyati

sākṣācca ekamevādvitīyam neha nānāsti kiñcana mṛtyo sa mṛtyumāpnoti ityādibhi bahubhiḥ vacomiḥ brahmātiriktasya prapañcasya pratiṣedhāt cetanopādānameva jagat bhujaṅga ivāropito rajjūpādāna iti siddhānta
ārāmamasya paśyanti na taṃ paśyati kaścana bṛhadā॰ 4
tasmādekasyāpi brahmaṇo vicitraśaktiyogāt kṣīrādivat vicitrapariṇāma upapadyate brahmasū॰ śāṃ॰ bhā॰
nanvekasya kathaṃ krama ? anekasya katham ? na hi ghaṭapaṭādīn vihāya anyaḥ kaścitkramo' sti
sa hi teṣāṃ svarūpam, dharmo vā syāt ? svarūpañcet; kimekaikaśaḥ, anekeṣāṃ vā ? yadi ekaikaśa; ghaṭapratītāvapi kramapratītiḥ syāt
anekeṣāṃ cet; tarhi yugapatpratibhāsānāmapi anekārthānāṃ kramapratītiḥ syāt
atha dharmaḥ; sa kiṃ kāraṇāntarādhīnaḥ, pramātṛkalpanāya tto vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yukta; tadutpattau jñānavyatirekeṇa kāraṇāntarasyā'nupalabhyamānatvāt
pramātṛkalpanāyattatve tu ekatve'pyasau na virodhamadhyāste, sarvatra tatkalpanānusāreṇaiva krameṇaite pratibhātā, yugapadete pratibhātāḥ ityādivyavahāraprasiddhe
nanu caikatve brahmaṇo deśakālacitratā viruddhyate, tasyāṃ vā tadekatvamiti cet, na, citrapaṭādīnāṃ deśa-kālavaicitrye'pi ekatvopalambhāt
pratibhāsabhedo'pi ekasya na virodhamāskandati, niścitaikatvamyāpi pādapasya dūrāsannapuruṣāpekṣayā vibhinnapratibhāsaviṣayatvapratīte
sāmarthyabhedo'pi ekatvaṃ na viruṇaddhi, jalanidherekasyāpi vīcī-taraṅga-budbuda-phenādyanekakāryakaraṇe sāmarthyabhedādhyavasāyāt
na ca teṣāmitaretarabhāvānāpattāvapi samudrātmano'nyatvaṃ bhavati evamihāpi
na ca parasmādbrahmaṇo'nyatva bhaviṣyati brahmasū॰ śā॰ bhā॰ 2
na caikatve tasya vicitrasṛṣṭividhānam utkṛṣṭā'pakṛṣṭaprāṇyutpādanam nairghṛṇyahetukaniratiśayanarakādidu khakaraṇañcā'nupapannam; sāpekṣasya kartṛtvāt
sa hi karmātmānuṣṭhitadharmāvarmasahāyo vicitrāṃ sṛṣṭimutpādayati, karmātmāno hi vihita-niṣiddhakarmānuṣṭhātṛtvena pratiprāṇi prasiddhāḥ
yadyapi ekarūpabrahmavivartā te, tathāpi avidyayā bhedamivāpāditā karmaṇāṃ kartṛtvena tatphalānāñca bhoktṛtvena avadhāryante
atastān puṇyā'puṇyopetān sārvajñyajñānenā''kalayya uktaprakāraṃ sargamārabhamāṇasyāsya na nairghṛṇyādyupālambho jyāyān
svabhāvādeva vā urṇanābha ivāṃśūnāṃ kāraṇāntaranirapekṣaṃ brahma jagadvaicitryasya kāraṇam
sāpekṣatvāt, yadi hi nirapekṣa kevala īśvaro viṣamā sṛṣṭi nirmimīte syātāmetau doṣau vaiṣamyaṃ nairghṛṇyañca, na tu nirapekṣasya nirmātṛtvamasti, sāpekṣo hi īśvaro viṣamā sṛṣṭi nirmimīte
kimapekṣata iti cet ? dharmādharmāvapekṣata iti vadāma
ata sṛjyamānaprāṇidharmādharmāpekṣā viṣamā sṛṣṭi iti nāyamīśvarasyāparādha

īśvarastu parjanyavad draṣṭavya evamīśvaro devamanuṣyādisādhāraṇa kāraṇaṃ bhavati, devamanuṣyādivaiṣamye tu tattajjīvagatānyeva asādhāraṇāni karmāṇi kāraṇāni bhavanti tathāhi darśayati śruti–eṣa hyeva sādhukarma kārayati taṃ yamebhyo lokebhya unninīṣata eṣa u evāsādhukarma kārayati ta yamadho ninīṣate kau brā॰ 3
puṇyo vai puṇyena karmaṇā bhavati pāpa pāpena bṛhadā॰ 3
smṛtirapi prāṇikarmaviśeṣāpekṣameva īśvarasya anugṛhītṛtvaṃ nigṛhītṛtvañca darśayati ye yathā mā prapadyante tāstathaiva bhajāmyaham bhagavadgī॰ 4
yathorṇanābhi sṛjate gṛhṇate ca yathā pṛthivyāmauṣadhaya sabhava nta
yathā sata puruṣāt keśalomāni tathā'kṣarāt saṃbhavatīha viśvam

sa yathorṇanābhiḥ tantūnuccaret yathāgne kṣudrā visphuliṅgā vyuccarantyevameva asmādātmanaḥ sarve lokā sarve devā sarvāṇi bhūtāni vyuccaranti, tasya upaniṣatsatyasya satyamiti prāṇā vai satyaṃ teṣāmeṣa satyam
ya- stūrṇanābha iva tantubhi pradhānajai svabhāvata
deva eka svayamāvṛṇoti sa no dadhātu brahmāvyayam
evamīśvarasyāpi anapekṣya kiñcit prayojanāntaraṃ svabhāvādeva kevala līlārūpā pravṛttirbhaviṣyati

tantunābhaśca svata eva tantūn sṛjati, balākā cāntareṇaiva śukaṃ garbha dhatte, padminī cānapekṣya kiñcit prasthānasādhanaṃ saro'ntarāt saro'ntaraṃ pratiṣṭhate, eva cetanamapi brahma anapekṣya bāhyaṃ sādhanaṃ svata eva jagat srakṣyati

yadi cārthānāṃ bhedo nā'vidyākṛtaḥ kintu vāstavaḥ, tadā tatra pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam–tacca pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvatpratyakṣam; vyāvṛttirūpe bhede'sya pravṛttyanupapatteḥ, parasparavyavacchedo hi bheda ayam ayaṃ na bhavati, 'asmādayaṃ bhinnaḥ iti
sa ca pratyakṣasyā' viṣaya, vidhiviṣayatvāttasya, āhurvidhātṛ pratyakṣaṃ na niṣeddhṛ vipaścitaḥ ityabhidhānāt
yaducyate kecit ? āhurvidhātṛ brahmasū॰ bhāskarabhā॰ pṛ॰ 99

kiñca, arthānāṃ bhedaḥ krameṇa gṛhyeta, yaugapadyena vā ? na tāvad yaugapadyena; tasya pratiyogigrahaṇasāpekṣatvāt, na ca pratiyogyagrahaṇe tadgrahaṇāpekṣo bhedo arthasvarūpagrahaṇamātrād grahītuṃ śakyaḥ, atiprasaṅgāt
na ca āśraya-pratiyoginoryugapad grahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati; pratiyogipratipatteḥ bhedāśrayārthasvarūpapratipattipūrvakatvāt, tadapratītau ayamasmād bhinnaḥ iti pratīteranupapatteḥ
nāpi krameṇa; itaretarāśrayatvaprasaṅgāt–ghaṭapratipattau hi tadvyavacchedena paṭādipratipattiḥ, tatpratipattau ca paṭādivyacchedena ghaṭapratipattiriti
sambandhapratipattipūrvakaṃ hi anumānaṃ pravartate, na cā'viṣaye pratyakṣāt sambandhapratipattiryuktā
na ca sukha-duḥkhādipratītyanyathānupapattyā ātmāderbhedānumānaṃ yuktam; tasyā mithyārūpatvāt, ato bhedo'pyapāramārthika eva ātmādeḥ siddhyenna vāstavaḥ

kiñca, asau bhedaḥ padārthebhyo bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā syāt, ubhayarūpaḥ, anubhayarūpo vā ? yadyādyaḥ pakṣaḥ; tatrāpi kimasau svato bhidyate, bhedāntareṇa vā ? yadi svataḥ; arthaiḥ kimaparāddham yenaiṣāṃ svato bhedo neṣyate ? atha bhedāntareṇa, tadā anavasthā, tasyāpyaparabhedāntareṇa arthebhyo bhedaprasaṅgāt
atha abhinna; tadā arthamātraṃ bhedamātraṃ vā syāt
nāpyubhayarūpaḥ; ubhayapakṣanikṣiptadoṣānuṣaṅgāt, bhedā'bhedayoḥ parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇatvena ekatraikadā saṃbhavā'bhāvācca
kiñca, akhilārthānām eka eva bheda, pratyartha bhinno vā ? yadyeka eva; tarhi tasyā'bhedāt teṣāmapyabheda eva syāt
atha pratyartha bhinna, ki svata, bhedāntareṇa vā ? pakṣadvaye'pi prākpratipāditameva doṣadvayaṃ draṣṭavyam
tato bhedā''grahaṃ parityajya abhinnamekaṃ paramabrahmalakṣaṇaṃ pāramārthikaṃ tattvaṃ pratipattavyamiti
brahma cet pūrva cidrūpaṃ parityajya ākāśādisvarūpaṃ svīkurute, tadā brahmarūpataivā'nena parityaktā syāt, cidānandamayaṃ hi brahma ucyate
atha svarūpā'parityāgenaiva ākāśādirūpatayā tat pariṇamate, tanna, itthambhūtasya pariṇāmasya kvacidapyapratipatte
kāryameva hi tena itthamarthāntarabhūtamutpāditaṃ syāt, tathā ca upādānāntarasiddhi tadvyatirikeṇa tadanupapatte ityadvaitahāni, brahmopādānakāraṇaṃ jagat iti svavacanavyādhātaśca

kiñca, kṣīra-suvarṇāde pariṇāmina kālaparivāsa-suvarṇakārakaravyāpārādisahakārisavyapekṣasya pariṇāme pravṛttirdṛṣṭā, brahmaṇaśca sahakāryabhāvāt kathaṃ tatra pravṛtti, pariṇāmasya niṣpattirvā ? tatsadbhāve vā advaitahāniḥ
atha itarapariṇāmipadārthavilakṣaṇatvāttasya na doṣo'yam, idameva hi tasya māhātmyam–yadanyānapekṣamapi tat tathāvidha pariṇāmaṃ pratipadyate, tanna; dṛṣṭānusāreṇaiva adṛṣṭārthakalpanopapatte
ya kasyacit kadācidapi pariṇāmina svabhāvo na dṛṣṭa so'syāsti iti kenāvaṣṭambhena kalpyate ? upādānāntarasyā'nupapatteriti cet, na; tadupapatterniṣedhā'saṃbhavāt, dadhyādau kṣīrāderupādānatvapratīteḥ
yadi ca anyadupādānāntaraṃ nāsti tathāpi brahmaṇo yat pramāṇenā'nupapannaṃ rūpaṃ tat kathaṃ ghaṭeta ? svabhāvataścāsya pariṇāme pravṛttau tadanuparatiprasaṅga, sadaikarūpapariṇāmaśca syāt
brahmaṇaśca viśvaprapañcaracane ki kiñcit prayojanamasti, na vā ? yadi nāsti; tadā nāsya prekṣāpūrvakāritā, prekṣāpūrvakārī hi na prayojanamanuddiśya kadācidapi pravarteta, anyatra jaḍāt

tatra jaḍapravṛttiḥ nityaṃ parāyattaiva, na hi yāvatsvaprayojanamuddiśya na cetanena preryate tāvajjaḍaḥ kvacitpravartate, na ca brahmaṇo jaḍatvamaṅgīkriyate, prerakasyā'nyasya prasaṅgataḥ advaitahāniprasaṅgāt
nanu cetanasyāpi svāpādidaśāyāṃ tadantareṇa pravṛttirdṛśyate; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; pūrvā'bhyastasvaprayojanapravṛttinibandhanatvāt tatpravṛtteḥ, anyathā anabhyaste'pi viṣaye tadā pravṛttiḥ syāt
prayojanavattve ca brahmaṇa sākāḍkṣatvāt kṛtārthatā na syāt
prayojanaṃ hi iṣṭaṃ sādhyamucyate, sarvathā kṛtārthasya ca sādhyā'bhāvāt tadviruddhyate
prekṣāpūrvakāripravṛtte prayojanavattayā vyāptatvāt ata kimarthamayaṃ puruṣo jagadracanāvyāpāramīdṛśaṃ karotīti vaktavyam
kiñca, brahma sāvayavam, niravayavaṃ vā ? na tāvat sāvayavam; cidrūpatvāt, nahi cito' vayavānāṃ sambhavo'sti, tatsaṃbhave vā asyā kāryatvaprasaṅgāt nityatvakṣatiḥ

niravayavatve ca sarvātmanā prathamameva ākāśādipariṇāmaṃ pratipannasya svarūpapracyutito jaḍatvaprasakte lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ pariṇāmāntarā'saṅkramaśca syāt, na hi jaḍasyāsya ākāśarūpatāṃ gatasya kenacidapreritasya ato vyāvṛtya pariṇāmāntare vṛttirghaṭate, na cānyastadvyatiriktaḥ kaścit prerako'sti dvaitaprasaṅgāt

tato'yuktamidaṃ sṛṣṭikramakathanam–brahmaṇaḥ prathama ākāśalakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmaḥ, tasmādvāyu, tatasteja, tato jalam, tataḥ pṛthivī, tato nānāvidhauṣadhayaḥ, tato jarāyujāṇḍajodbhedajādibhedena nānāvidha śarīrādisarga viṣayasargaśca iti
bhogyabhoktṛbhāvaśca eteṣāmanupapannaḥ; karmātmāno bhoktāraḥ, bhūtāni bhogyāni iti
na hi tasmātteṣāmabhede viruddhasvabhāvadvayasaṃbhava, tatsaṃbhave vā viruddhadharmā'dhyāsād brahmaṇo naikatvam
tasmādvā etasmādātmana ākāśa saṃbhūtaḥ, ākāśādvāyu, vāyoragni, agnerāpa, adbhyaḥ pṛthivī, pṛthivyā auṣadhaya, auṣadhibhyo'nnam, annāt puruṣaḥ taitti॰ 2

yadapyuktam–suvarṇa-kṣīrāderekatve'pi kaṭaka-dadhyādivicitrapariṇāmavadatrāpi sarvaṃ ghaṭate; tadapyuktimātram, tasya anekasvabhāvatve kathañcidutpatti-vināśavattve ca sati vicitrapariṇāmatvopapatteḥ sarvathaikasvabhāvasya anutpatti-vināśadharmaṇaścārthasyaivā'saṃbhavāt kharaviṣāṇavat
tatra yugapadbhāvināṃ deśapratyāsattirūpo deśakrama, yathā vṛddhā ete krameṇopaviṣṭāḥ ityādipratītyārūḍhaḥ
kālapratyāsattiviśiṣṭārthānāṃ tu kālakramaḥ, krameṇotpadyante varṇāḥ krameṇotpadyante sthāsa-kośādayaḥ ityādipratītisamadhigamya
yugapatpratibhāsamānānekārthānāṃ kinna kramapratītiriti cet ? kālasya upādherabhāvāt
yannibandhanā hi yā pratītiḥ sā tadabhāve na bhavati yathā deśanibandhanā kramapratītiḥ deśābhāve kālanibandhanā ceyaṃ pratītiriti
citrapaṭa-dūrāsannapādapā-'mbhonidhi prabhṛtīnāmapi sarvathaikasvabhāvatvamasiddham, citrarūpatvāt viśadetarapratibhāsaviṣayatvāt sāmarthyabhedāccātra kathañcid bhedaprasiddhe

citrapaṭādidravyamekasvabhāvamapi cakṣurādikaraṇasāmagrībhedāt rūpādivilakṣaṇākāraṃ tadanuvidhānāt dūrāsannānām ekatra vastunyupanibaddhanānādarśanānāṃ puruṣāṇā nirbhāsabhedāt tadviṣayasyāpi vastunaḥ svabhāvabhedo'stu
kiñca, brahmaṇaścitrarūpatva vibhinnapratibhāsaviṣayatvaṃ sāmarthyabhedaśca avasthānāṃ bhede sati syāt, abhede vā ? na tāvadabhede, ekasyāmapyavasthāyāṃ tatprasaṅgāt
bhede cet, tarhi tāsāmanyonyaṃ bhedaprasādhanāya itaretarābhāvādirapyāyāta iti suṣṭhu prasādhitamadvaitam tatsvarūpasya vidhirūpatvena pratiṣedhasādhakatvā'yogāt
astu vā yathākathañcittāsāmanyonyaṃ bheda; tathāpi avasthāvata tā bhinnā, abhinnā, ubhayam, anubhayaṃ vā ? bhede tasya avasthāḥ iti vyapadeśo na syādanupakārāt, upakāre vā anavasthā

abhede, krimavasthātādātmyena avasthātā sthita, avasthātṛtādātmyena avasthā vā ? prathamapakṣe avasthāturekatvānupapatti tadvattasyāpi bhedaprasaṅgāt, na hi bhinnatādātmyenāvasthitaṃ tatsvarūpavadabhinnaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu avasthātaiva nā'vasthā, na hi abhinnatādātmyenāvasthitaṃ tatsvarūpavad bhinnaṃ bhavitumarhati tatsvarūpasyāpi bhedaprasaṅgāt
anubhayapakṣastvayukta; vidhi-pratiṣedhadharmayo ekatarapratiṣedhe anyataravidheravaśyambhāvitvena ekatraikadā ubhayapratiṣedhānupapatte
yo'pi avasthāvato'vasthā padārthantarabhūtā nānumanyate tasyāpi kathamavasthābhedād avasthāvato bhedo na syāt avasthānā vā kathamabhedo na bhavet tadarthāntaratvābhāvāt āptaparī॰ pṛ॰ 21
yadapi–karmātmānuṣṭhitakarmasahāyasya kartṛtvāt ityādyuktam, tadapyayuktam; yata karmātmanāṃ karmaṇāñcotpāda tadāyatta eva, tadvyatirekeṇā'nyasyā'nabhyupagamāt

tatra kiṃ prathamaṃ karmātmano nirmāya karmabhiryojayati, karmāṇi votpādya karmātmana sṛjati ? na tāvat prathamam anuṣṭhātrabhāvāt karmāṇi sraṣṭuṃ śakyante, karmasambandhañca vinā nā'nuṣṭhātāro bhinnā kalpayituṃ śakyante iti itaretarāśnayatvānna kasyacit sṛṣṭi syāt
avidyayā bhedamivāpāditā ityādi cātīva durghaṭam, tasyāstato vyatirekā'vyatirekapakṣayoranupapatte, tathā tadanupapattiśca śabdādvaitanirākaraṇapraghadṛke prapañcata pratipāditā ityalamatiprasaṅgena
kiñca, ajñānasvabhāvā'vidyā jñānasvabhāvaṃ brahma ca, na ca jñānā'jñānayo bhāvā'bhāvayoriva kvacittādātmyaṃ dṛṣṭam

na ca itthamanirvacanīyā'vidyā ityabhidhātavyam, vastuno bhedā'bhedābhyāṃ vicāryamāṇatvopapatteḥ, na cāvastutvamasyā saṃgacchate, sakalabhedaprapañca niṣpādayantyā yadi avastutvamavidyāyā tadā brahmaṇo'pyavastutvaṃ syāt
kiñca, brahmasvarūpā'pravedanaprabhavo'vidyāprādurbhāva, avidyāprādurbhāvaprabhavaṃ vā brahmasvarūpā'pravedanam ? na tāvadādyaḥ pakṣa; nityoditatvena brahmaṇa svarūpā'pravedanā'saṃbhavāt
nāpi dvitīya, nityodite tasmin prakāśamāne madhyandināvasthita ivā'rke tasyāstamastulyāyā prādu rbhāvābhāvāt
anāditvāttasyā nāyaṃ doṣaścet; na; evamapi tamaḥ-prakāśayoriva brahmā-'vidyayoḥ sahāvasthānā'nupapatteḥ

karmātmanāñca avidyāsvabhāvatve kathamayaṃ vicārātmako vivekaḥ avidyātmano vidyātmakavicāravirodhāt ? kutaścāsyotpattiḥ–avidyāta eva, anyato vā ? na tāvadanyataḥ; avidyāvyatirekeṇa anthasyānabhyupagamāt
atha avidyaiva evaṃvidhavidyopāyaḥ; tanna; virodhāt, na hi tamaḥ tejaḥprakāśopāyaḥ pratīyate

yaccānyaduktam–svabhāvādeva vā ūrṇanābha ivāṃśūnāṃ kāraṇāntaranirapekṣaṃ brahma jagadvaicitryakāraṇam; tadapyuktimātram; ūrṇanābhasya tantūtpādane antarbahiḥkāraṇāpekṣāpratīteḥ tatra tadanapekṣatvāsiddheḥ, tataḥ kathaṃ taddṛṣṭāntāvaṣṭambhena brahmaṇastadanapekṣasya svabhāvato jagadvaicitryahetutvaṃ prasādhayituṃ śakyam ? sa hi prāṇihiṃsālāmpaṭyato vaṃśakuḍyādikaṃ bahiḥkāraṇakalāpaṃ samāsādya antargataṃ lālārūpaṃ pudgalapracayaṃ prāṇibhakṣaṇaprayojanamurarīkṛtya dīrghīkurvannupalabhyate
tataḥ sahakāri-prayojanānapekṣasya upādānarūpasya brahmaṇo jagadvaicitryamabhyupagacchannayam upekṣaṇīya eva, dṛṣṭahāneḥ adṛṣṭaparikalpanāyāścā'nuṣaṅgāt
prāṇināṃ bhakṣaṇāccāpi tasya lālā pravartate mī॰ ślo॰ pṛ॰ 652

yadapyuktam–bhede pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vā pramāṇaṃ varteta ityādi; tatra pratyakṣata eva bhedaḥ pratīyate, akṣavyāpārānantaraprabhavapratyaye anyonyāsaṃsṛṣṭasya nīlādeḥ pratibhāsanāt, parasparā'saṅkīrṇatāpratibhāsa eva ca bhedapratibhāsaḥ
na ca anyonyavyāvṛttirbhedaḥ kintu padārthasvarūpam, taddhi svakāraṇaparamparātaḥ trailokyavilakṣaṇasvabhāvamevotpannam
tathābhūtañca tat cetanātmakam ahaṅkārāspadaṃ grāhakākāramantaḥ pratibhāsate nīlādikaṃ tu grāhyākāraṃ bahiḥ
nahi tadubhayaṃ muktvā advaitaṃ kasyacitsvapne'pi kiñcitpratibhāsate

nanu yadi padārthasvarūpameva bhedaḥ tarhi prathamā'kṣasannipāte tatsvarūpapratipattau ayamasmād bhinnaḥ iti kimiti na pratīyate iti cet ? padārthāntaragrahaṇasāpekṣatvād abhedavat, yathaiva hi prathamā'kṣasannipāte pratīto'pi satsāmānyalakṣaṇo'bhedaḥ arthāntarā'pratītau sat sat iti anugatātmanā nollikhati, tathā bhedo'pi
astu vā anyonyābhāvarūpo bhedaḥ; tathāpi asya pratyakṣataḥ pratītiḥ na viruddhyate, satsvarūpeṇeva asatsvarūpeṇāpyarthānāṃ pratyakṣe pratibhāsanāt
na khalu svarūpeṇa sattvameva arthānāṃ pratyakṣe pratibhāsate na punaḥ pararūpeṇā'sattvam, tadapratītau tepāmapyapratītiprasaṅgāt svapararūpopādānāpohāpādyatvād vastuno vastutvasya
anyarūpaniṣedhamantareṇa tatsvarūpaparicchedasyāpyasampatteḥ pītādivyavacchinaṃ hi nīlaṃ nīlamiti grahītaṃ bhavati netarathā
tathā cāha–tatparicchinnaṃ tvanyad vyavacchinatti iti bhāvavadabhāvamapi grahītuṃ prabhavati pratyakṣam nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 529
yaccānyaduktam–krameṇāsau gṛhyate yugapadvā ityādi; tadapyetenaiva pratyuktam; uktanyāyena yugapadbhedapratibhāsasaṃbhavāt

pratiyogyapratipattau kathaṃ bhedaḥ tatsāpekṣa pratīyate ? ityapyasundaram; yato bhedavyavahāra eva parāpekṣo na tatsvarūpam, taddhi svakāraṇakalāpāt pratiyogigrahaṇanirapekṣamevotpannam, kathamanyathā abhede'pi itaretarāśrayo na syāt–bhedāpekṣā hi sāmānyasiddhi, tadapekṣā ca bhedasiddhiriti ? saṅkocitaprasāritāṅgulyādau ca prāk-pradhvaṃsābhāvarūpaḥ kramabhāvī bheda krameṇaiva suspaṣṭamābhāsate

yaccoktam–akhilārthānām eka eva bhedaḥ pratyarthaṃ bhinno vā ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; ekatvavirodhalakṣaṇatvād bhedasya, yatra hi aikyavirodhaḥ tatra bhedaśabda prayujyate yathā nīlād bhinnaṃ pītam ityādau
sa ki dharmiṇo bhinno'bhinno vā ityādivikalpasaṃhatirapi anekāntasamāśrayaṇāt pratyākhyātā, na khalu dharma-dharmiṇoḥ sarvathā bhedo'bhedo vā saṃbhavati ityagre vakṣyate

kathañcaivaṃvādinaḥ abhedaḥ siddhyet bhinnā'bhinnādivicārasya tatrāpi kartuṃ śakyatvāt ? tathāhi–ayamabhedaḥ bhedebhyo bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā syāt ? yadyabhinna, tadā'sya abhedarūpatā'nupapattiḥ bhedasvātmavattāvaddhā bhedaprasaṅgāt
atha bhinnaḥ; tanna; bhedebhyo bhinnasya abhedasyā'pratīteḥ, anyathā vipratipattyabhāvaprasaṅga, na hi ghaṭāt paṭe bhinne pratīyamāne kaścid vipratipadyate

kiñca, asau tato bhinna pratyakṣeṇa pratīyeta, anumānena vā ? pratyakṣeṇa cet, kiṃ bhedasvarūpagrāhiṇā, anyena vā ? na tāvadanyena, tathābhūtasyāsya asaṃvedyamānatvāt, na hi antarbahirvā bhedasvarūpā'navabhāsipratyakṣaṃ svapne'pi savedyate nīlasukhādibhedasvarūpāvabhāsina evāsya sadā saṃvedanāt

bhedasvarūpagrāhiṇā'pi tena yugapata, krameṇa vā abheda pratīyeta ? na tāvad yugapat, dvayapratīterabhāvāt, na khalu sarvathā bhinnau bhedā'bhedau yugapat kvacidapi pratyakṣe pratibhāsete ityanekāntasiddhyavasare pratipādayiṣyate
nāpi krameṇa, pratyakṣasya ekakṣaṇasthāyitayā krameṇāpyataḥ tatpratipatterasabhavāt
nāpyanumānata, pratyakṣā' bhāve tasyāpyanupapadyamānatvāt tatpūrvakatayā tasya bhavadbhirabhyupagamāt

kiñca, abhedo nāma dvitīyāpekṣa, tadagrahe kathamasau grahītuṃ śakyo'tiprasaṅgāt, yo yadapekṣo dharmaḥ nāsau tadagrahe grahītuṃ śakya yathā daṇḍāgrahe daṇḍitvam, dvitīyāpekṣaśca abhedalakṣaṇo dharma iti
yathāpratīti abhedasiddhyabhyupagame ca bhedasiddhirapi tathaivā'bhyupagantavyā iti siddhaḥ pratyakṣata śarīrādibhedavad ātmano'pi bheda

ātmano'bhedābhyupagame ca ekasmin sukhite sarva jagat sukhitaṃ syāt, duḥkhite ca duḥkhitam, baddhe baddham, mukte muktam, pravṛtte pravṛttam, nivṛtte ca nivṛttam, na caivamasti, ato'sti ātmano vāstavo bhedaḥ
anyathā sa eva sukhī duḥkhī baddho mukta pravṛtto'pravṛttaśca iti prāpnoti, na caitad yuktam, parasparaviruddhavarmāṇāṃ nityaniraṃśaikarūpe vastuni asaṃbhavāt

na ca kalpitākāśabhedavad ātmanyapi kalpitabhedāt sarvamidamupapatsyate ityabhidhātavyam; ākāśasyā'bādhitapramāṇaprasiddhasvarūpasya vāstavapradeśaprasiddheḥ ghaṭākāśam, paṭākāśam ityādivyavahāro yuktaḥ, brahmaṇastu kutaścidapi pramāṇādaprasiddheḥ khapuṣpavat na kalpito'pi bhedaḥ saṃbhavet

yo'pi sarva khalvidaṃ brahma ityādyāgamaḥ tatpratipādakaḥ pratipāditaḥ; so'pi dvaitavipayatvād bhedameva prasādhayati, nahi vācya-vācaka-pratipādya-pratipādakānāṃ madhye anyatamasyāpyapāye pramāṇabhūtā''gamasattā upapadyate
kiñca, sakalaśarīreṣu ātmana ekatve śarīrabhede'pi pratisandhānaprasaṅgaḥ, yathaiva hi ekasmin śarīre pradeśabhede'pi ekatvādātmanaḥ pratisandhānam, evaṃ śarīrabhede'pi syāt

na ca kalpitabhedānāṃ jīvānāṃ bhinnatvāt kalpitapradeśabhedavat pratisandhānā'bhāvaḥ; yataḥ pradeśānāṃ bhede yadyapi anyonyaṃ pratisandhānaṃ nāsti tathāpi tadvartipradeśyapekṣayā tadasti, evaṃ jīvānāṃ bhede parasparapratisandhānā'bhāve'pi tadanusyūtā''tmāpekṣayā tat syāditi
tataḥ advaitādyāgrahagrahābhiniveśaṃ parityajya abādhavodhādhirūḍho bāhyārtho yathāpratīti abhyupagantavyaḥ, anyathā aprāmāṇikatvaprasaṅga
brahmādvaitavādasya naikavidhatayā paryālocanā nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyā–mīmāṃsāślo॰ sambandhākṣepapari॰ ślo॰ 82
āptamī॰, aṣṭaśa॰, aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 157, dvi॰ pari॰
nanu ca indriyāṇāmaviśeṣata pudgalātmakatvamayuktam, atyantabhinnajātīyebhyaḥ pṛthivyādibhyo'tyantabhinnajātīyānāṃ cakṣurādīnāmāvirbhāvavibhāvanāt
tathā ca nyāyabhāṣyam–pṛthivyaptejovāyūnā ghrāṇarasanacakṣuḥsparśanendriya bhāvāt bhāvaḥ iti

amumevārthamanumānataḥ samarthayate– pārthivaṃ ghrāṇam rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu gandhasyaivā'bhivyañjakatvāt, yad yattathāvidham tattat pārthivaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā nāgakarṇikāvimardakakaratalādi, rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu gandhasyaivā'bhivyañjakañca ghrāṇam, tasmāt pārthivamiti
āpyaṃ rasanam rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu rasasyaivā'bhivyañjakatvāt lālāvat
vāyavyaṃ sparśanaṃ rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu sparśasyaivā'bhivya ñjakatvān toyaśītasparśavyañjakavāyvavayavivat

śrotrasya tu pudgalātmakatvam atīvā'nupapannam; śabdasya svasamānajātīyaviśeṣaguṇavataiva indriyeṇa grāhyatvopapatteḥ; tathāhi–śabdaḥ svasamānajātīyaviśeṣaguṇavatā indriyeṇa gṛhyate, sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati bāhyaikendriyapratyakṣatvāt, bāhyaikendriyapratyakṣatve sati anātmaviśeṣaguṇatvādvā rūpādivaditi

dṛṣṭo hi vāyvādīnā bhūtānā guṇaviśeṣābhivyaktiniyam, vāyu sparśavyañjaka, āpo rasavyañjikā, tejo rūpavyañjakam, pārthivaṃ kiñcid dravya kasyacid dravyasya gandhavyañjakam, asti cāyamindriyāṇā bhūtaguṇaviśeṣopalabdhiniyama tena bhūtaguṇaviśeṣopalabdhermanyāmahe bhūtaprakṛtīnīndriyāṇi nāvyaktaprakṛtīnīti nyāyabhā॰
yajjātīyamindriya bhavati tasya yo guṇaviśeṣa itaretarabhūtavyavacchedahetu gandhādi sa tenaivendriyeṇa gṛhyate ityayaṃ niyama
pārthiva ghrāṇa rūparasagandhasparśeṣu niyamena gandhasya vyañjakatvāt vāhyapārthivavaditi, yathā mṛgamadagandhavyañjakā kukkuṭoccārādaya pārthivā ityartha
dravyatve sati rūpādimadhye gandhasyaiva vyañjakatvāt gandhayuktadravyavat
pārthivatve'pi rūpādiṣu mavye gandhasyaiva abhivyañjakatva pramāṇam kuṅkumagandhābhivyañjakaghṛtavat praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 35
rasanamindriyamāpya gandhādiṣu madhye niyamena rasasya vyañjakatvāt dantāntarasyandamānodakavinduvat nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 530
taijasaṃ cakṣu rūpādiṣu mavye niyamena rūpasya vyajñakatvāt pradīpādivat
vāyavīyaṃ tvagindriya gandhādiṣu madhye sparśasyaiva vyañjakatvāt svedodaṣinduśītasparśavyañjakavyajanapavanavat
yadapyuktam–pārthivaṃ ghrāṇam ityādi; tadapyasamīcīnam; hetordinakarakiraṇaiḥ udakasekena cā'nekāntāt
dṛśyate hi tailābhyaktasya ādityaraśmibhirgandhābhivyaktiḥ, bhūmestu udakasekeneti
āpyaṃ rasanam ityādyapyayuktam; hetorlavaṇena vyabhicārāt, tasyā'nāpyatve'pi rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu rasasyaivā'bhivyañjakatvaprasiddheḥ
cakṣustaijasam ityādyapyanupapannam; hetoḥ māṇikyādyudyotenā'naikāntikatvāt, sa hi rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśako na ca taijasa iti
vāyavyaṃ sparśanam ityādyapyasāmpratam; karpūrādinā hetorvyabhicārāt, sa hi salilādau rūpādiṣu sannihiteṣu śītasparśasyaivā'bhivyañjako na ca vāyavya iti
rasanasya ca āpyarasābhivyañjakatvād apkāryatvavat pṛthivīrasābhivyañjakatvāt pṛthivīkāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ
śabdaḥ svasamānajātīyaviśeṣaguṇavatā ityādyapi svagṛhaprakriyopadarśanamātram; śabde nabhoguṇatvasya pratiṣetsyamānatvāt
sarvametad akṣaraśa prameyakamalamārttaṇḍe pṛ॰ 62 syādvādaratnākare ca pṛ॰ 345 varttate
etena āhaṅkārikatvamapi indriyāṇāṃ sāṅkhyaparikalpitaṃ pratyākhyātam; tatrāpi pramāṇā' bhāvā'viśeṣāt, pramāṇabādhāsadbhāvācca
tathāhi–nāhaṅkārikāṇi indriyāṇi, acetanatve sati karaṇatvād vāsyādivat, indriyatvādvā karmendriyavat
nāpi bhāvendriyā'nindriyairvyabhicāraḥ; acetanatve sati iti viśeṣaṇāt
