tathā, nāhaṅkārikāṇi indriyāṇi pratiniyatajñānavyapadeśanimittatvād rūpādivat, pratiniyata viṣayaprakāśakatvādvā pradīpavat
yathaiva hi–rūpajñānam, rasajñānam ityādipratiniyatajñānavyapadeśahetavo rūpādaya nāhaṅkārikā tadvat cakṣurjñānam rasanajñānam ityāditadvyapadeśahetutvāccakṣurādīndriyāṇyapi

yathaiva hi darpaṇādaya paudgalikairbhasmapāpāṇādibhi kriyamāṇā'nugrahopadhātāśrayabhūtā nāhaṅkārikā kintu paudgalikāḥ tathā añjanādibhi paudgalikai kriyamāṇānugrahopaghātāśrayabhūtāni cakṣurādīndriyāṇyapi
tataḥ pratiniyatendriyayogyapudgalārabdhatvaṃ dravyendriyāṇāṃ pratipattavyam iti siddhaṃ pudgalātmakatvaṃ teṣāmityalamatiprasaṅgena
ekāhaṅkāraprakṛtitve tu ekaṃ vā sarvārthaṃ sarvāṇi vā sarvārthāmi syuḥ
bhotikatve tu bhūtānā bhedāt niyataguṇotkarṣayogitvāt niyataviṣayagrāhyendriyaprakṛtitva tathā ca pradīpāditejorūparasādyanekaviṣayasannidhāne'pi rūpasyaiva prakāśi bhavitumarhati
tadepa viṣayaniyama prakṛtiniyamakārita indriyāṇām iti bhautikāni indriyāṇi nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 480

anena khalu āhaṅkārikāṇi indriyāṇīti yadāhu sākhyā tannirākṛtam, nirākaraṇahetumāha–aikātmya iti śliṣṭaṃ padam, sākhyānā kila rāddhānte kāraṇātmaka kārya tacca kāraṇam indriyāṇām ahaṅkāra iti aikātmyam ekakāraṇatvam, tathā ca aikātmyam ekatva ghrāṇādīnām ityaniyama syāt nyāyavā॰ 1
atīndriyaśaktisadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt iti vadato naiyāyikasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu ca atīndriyaśaktisadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt kathaṃ labdhirūpaṃ bhāvendriyaṃ vyavatiṣṭheta ? tathāhi–antyatantusaṃyogānantaramupajāyamānaḥ paṭaḥ aṅgulyagnisaṃyogānantarañca dāho nādhikakāraṇāpekṣaḥ, tasya tāvanmātrānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvena anyahetukatvā'nupapatte

na ca atīndriyaśaktimantareṇa pipāsāpanodo jalāt nānalāt śītāpanodo' nalāt na punarjalāt iti niyamā'nupapatte, tadupapattaye sā'bhyupagantavyā ityabhidhātavyam; svarūpa-sahakāriśaktiprasādādeva tanniyamoṣapatte
tatra svarūpaśaktiḥ tantvādīnāṃ tantutvādirūpā, caramasahakārirūpā tu sahakāriśaktiḥ; na hi santo'pi tantavaḥ antyatantusaṃyogaṃ vinā paṭamārabhante

tathā ca, analatvā'bhisambandhād anala eva śītāpanodaṃ vidadhāti na jalaṃ tadabhāvāt, jalatvā'bhisambandhācca jalameva pipāsāmapanudati natvanalaḥ, tayoḥ pratiniyatasāmānyāśrayatvena anyonyakāryotpādaṃ prati anaṅgatvāt

prayogaḥ–dahanādayo nijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇameva sāmarthyamudvahanti asati pratibandhake kāryotpādakatvāt, yad asati pratibandhake kāryamutpādayati tannijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇameva sāmarthyaṃ vibharti, yathā karma vibhāgena nivṛtte pūrvasaṃyoge uttarasaṃyogotpādikāṃ nijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇāmeva śaktim, tathā ca dahanādayaḥ, tasmātte'pi tathā iti

na caivaṃ pratibandhakamaṇyādisannidhāne'pyagneḥ sphoṭādikāryakāritvaprasaṅgaḥ nijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇāyāḥ śakteḥ sadbhāvāt ityabhidhātavyam; tadutpattau karatalā'nalasaṃyogavat pratibandhakamaṇyādyabhāvasyāpi sahakāritvāt
na cā'bhāvasya avastutvāt kāraṇatvā'bhāvaḥ; yato darśanaṃ naḥ pramāṇam; dṛśyate ca nāsti iti jñāne pramāṇa-prameyā'bhāvasya kāraṇatvam, pratyavāye nityā'karaṇasya, patanakarmaṇi saṃyogā'bhāvasya ca
na tāvat mīmāṃsakavadatīndriyā śaktirasmā bhirabhyupeyate kintu kāraṇānāṃ svarūpa vā sahakārisākatyaṃ vā
saiveyaṃ dvividhā śaktirucyate ava sthitā, āgantukā ca
nahi no darśane śaktipadārtha eva nāsti, ko'sau tarhi ? kāraṇatvam
ki tat ? pūrvakālaniyatajātīyatvam, sahakārivaikalyaprayuktakāryābhāvavattvaṃ vetianugrāhakatvasāmyāt sahakāriṣvapi śaktipadaprayogāt nyāyakusu॰ 1

utkṣepaṇādikaṃ hi karma vibhāgena nivartite pūrvasaṃyoge uttarasaṃyogotpāde svarūpalakṣaṇāyāḥ pūrvasaṃyogapradhvaṃsalakṣaṇasahakārirūpāyāśca dṛṣṭaśakteratiriktaśaktibhāk na bhavatyeva syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 286
yadapi viṣadahanasannidhāne satyapi mantraprayogāt tatkāryā'darśanaṃ tadapi na śaktipratibandhanibandhanamapi tu sāmagryantarānupraveśahetukam nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 42

na mantrādisannidhau kāryānutpatti adṛṣṭa rūpamākṣipati, yathā anvayavyatirekābhyām avadhṛtasāmarthyovahirdāhasya kāraṇam tathā pratibandhakamantrādiprāgabhāvo'pi kāraṇam bhāvasya bhāvarūpakāraṇaniyatatvadarśanāt abhāvakāryatvaṃ nāstīti cenna, nityānā karmaṇāmakaraṇāt pratyavāyasya utpādāt, anyathā nityākaraṇe prāyaścittānuṣṭāna na syād vaiyarthyāt
maṇyādyabhāvaviśiṣṭavahyāde dāhādikaṃ prati svātantryeṇa maṇyabhāvādereva vā hetutvam, anenaiva sāmañjasye anantaśaktitatprāgabhāvapradhvasābhāvakalpanānaucityāt muktāvalī kā॰ 2
kiñca, asau śaktiḥ nityā, anityā vā ? yadi nityā; tadā sarvadā kāryotpādaprasaṅgaḥ tasyāḥ sadā sattvāt

nanu tannityatve'pi sahakāriṇāṃ kādācitkatvāt kārye kādācitkatvaṃ yuktaṃ tadapekṣayā tasyāḥ kāryakāritvapratijñānāta; ityapyayuktam; śaktikalpanāvaiyarthyā'nuṣaṅgāt, svarūpasyaiva sahakārikāraṇāpekṣasya kāryotpādakatvopapatteḥ

anityatve tu padārthasvarūpamātrasampādyā'sau, nijā''gantukalakṣaṇasāmarthyotpādyā, atīndriyaśaktyantaraniṣpādyā vā ? prathamapakṣe padārthasvarūpasya śāśvatikatvena śaśvacchakterutpādaprasaṅgāt sa eva sadā sātatyena kāryotpādaprasaṅgaḥ
nijāgantukasāmarthyasampādyatve tu śakteḥ kāryameva tatsampādyamastu, alamaprātītikā'tīndriyaśaktikalpanayā

kiñca,śaktirabhyupagamyamānā padārthasvarūpavannityā abhyupagamyeta, kāryā vā ? nityatve sarvadā kāryodayaprasaṅgaḥ,sahakāryapekṣāyā tu svarūpasyaiva tadapekṣā astu kiṃ śaktyā ? kāryatve tu śakte padārthasvarūpamātrakāryatvaṃ vāsyāt, sahakāryādisāmagrīkāryatva vā ?nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 42
tasyā sattvāt ā॰, ba॰, ja॰, bhā॰
tathā pratikāryam ekā śaktiḥ, anekā vā ? na tāvadekā; tadbhedāt kāryabhedāśrayaṇāt
atha anekā, kimasau śaktimato bhinnā, abhinnā vā ? bhede apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaḥ
abhede tu ki śaktibhyaḥ tadvānabhinna, tadvato vā śaktayaḥ ? prathamavikalpe śaktisvarūpavat śaktimato'pyanekatvamatīndriyatvañca syāt
tattādātmye tasyāpi tāvaddhā bhedāt atīndriyasvarūpasvīkārācca, anyathā tattādātmyā'nupapattiḥ
dvitīyavikalpe tu śaktimatsvarūpavat śaktīnāmapyekatvānuṣaṅgaḥ, ekasmādabhinnānāṃ tatsvarūpavad anekatvā'nupapatteḥ kuta kāryanānātvasaṃbhava iti ?

pratiniyataṃ hi kāraṇaṃ kāryañcopalabhyate paṭa tantubhyo na vīraṇādeḥ dāha kṛśāno na jalāde, seyaṃ vyavasthā paridṛśyamānapadārthasvarūpādanupapadyamānā tadatiriktaṃ tadgatameva dharmāntaratva raṃ sva siddhyarthamākṣipati

nanu ceyaṃ vyavasthā tadvyatirekeṇāpi anvaya-vyatirekābhyāṃ paṭaṃ prati tantūnāmeva utpādanasāmarthyā'dhyavasāyāt siddhyati ityabhidadhato'pi svarūpātirekiṇī śaktireva śaraṇam, tadanabhyupagame dravyasvarūpā'viśeṣāt sarvasmāt sarvasaṃbhavo durnivāra
svabhāvabhedānna sarvasmāt sarvasaṃbhavaścet tarhi svo bhāva kāryaniyamaheturviśiṣṭaṃ svarūpam ityaṅgīkṛtā sakalārthāśritā bhedavatī vicitrā śaktiḥ

yadapyuktam–svarūpa-sahakāriśaktiprasādādeva ityādi, tadapyuktimātram, svāśrayajanyakāryanirapekṣatayā sāmānyasya sthitatvāt, svānāśrayabhūtakāraṇāntarajanyakārya prati sādhāraṇatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvapratiniyamavyavasthāpakatvā'saṃbhavācca
agnitvaṃ hi sphoṭavad vijātīya kāraṇajanyakāryeṣvapi tulyarūpam
na hi sphoṭaṃ pratyeva agneragnitvam yathā putrāpekṣaṃ pituḥ pitṛtvam, bhṛtyāpekṣaṃ vā svāminaḥ svāmitvam, api tu sarvaṃ pratyeva agniḥ agnireva
na hi kāryāntarāṇi prati agniḥ anagnirbhavati, ato dāhavat pipāsādyapanodamapi vidadhyāt

nanu asādhāraṇaṃ svarūpaṃ vyavasthānimittam, tathābhūtañcedam agnitvamagneḥ anagnibhyo vyāvṛttinimittatvāt, dāhatvamapi adāhād dāhasya vyāvṛttihetutvāt, ataḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvapratiniyamasya dṛṣṭenaiva upapatternā'dṛṣṭakalpanā upapannā; tadayuktam; anagnivyāvartakatayā tulyasvarūpatvā'bhāvepi agnitvasya pratiniyatakāryotpādakatvavyavasthāpakatvā'nupapatteḥ tasyāpi sarvakāryāṇi prati sādhāraṇatvāt, na hi kāryāntareṣvapi agnitvasyāgneḥ anagnibhyo vyāvartakatvaṃ nāsti yenā'sya tajjanakatvaṃ na syāt, jalādikāraṇāpekṣayā hi agnitvasyā'sādhāraṇasvarūpatā na jalādikāryāpekṣayeti
evaṃ jalasyāpi śaityādijanakatve pratiniyamo na ghaṭate; tanniyamanimittasya ca jalatvasya dāhādāvapi sādhāraṇatvāt, ato jalamapi dahed analo'pi pipāsāmapanudedaviśeṣāt
svam agnitvasāmānyaṃ tasya āśrayo'gni tajjanyaṃ kārya sphoṭādi

atha dāhasyā'gnijanyatve dāhatvajātervyavasthānimittatvāt kṣityādīnāmadāharūpatayā agnijanyatvā'prāptiḥ, śaityādīnāñca jalādijanyatve tajjāteḥ prayojakatvāt tadrahitatvena dāhasya kathamiva jalādijanyatvaprasaṅga ? tadasamīcīnam; dāhatvajāte śaityādyapekṣayā atulyatve'pi jalādikāraṇāntarāpekṣayā tulyatvānna pratiniyatakārya-kāraṇabhāvavyavasthāhetutvam

nanu yat sāmānyaṃ yatra samavetaṃ tadeva tatra kāryakāraṇabhāvavyavasthāhetuḥ, na cā'gnitvaṃ jalādau samavetaṃ nāpi dāhatvaṃ śītādau, ityapyasundaram; evamapyagnitvādeḥ kāraṇatvādivyavasthāpakatvā'yogāt, yaddhi akāraṇādervyāvṛttaṃ kāraṇādāvanuvṛttaṃ tad asādhāraṇatvāt kāraṇatvaṃ vyavasthāpayati, agnitvādikaṃ ca akāraṇebhyo na vyāvṛttaṃ bhūtabhāviṣu agniviśeṣeṣvavi ṣvapi vi dyamānatvena akāraṇeṣvapi gatatvāt
na ca asattvena bhūta-bhaviṣyatorvahniviśeṣayoḥ vahnitvāśrayatvānupapattiḥ; vahnitvāvacchedena āsīd vahniḥ, bhaviṣyati vahniḥ iti pratyayadvayā'nutpattiprasaṅgāt

astu vā sattvaviśeṣitaviśeṣāśrayatvam; tathāpi na vahnitvasya vipakṣād vyāvṛttiḥ vivakṣitavahniviśeṣajanyadhūmaṃ prati vahniviśeṣāntarasyā'kāraṇatvāt, tajjanyañca prati anyasyā'kāraṇatvāt, ataḥ akāraṇe'pi vipakṣe vahnitvasyopalambhānna svāśrayakāraṇatvaprayojakatvam

kiñca, anagnirūpā'rthebhyo vyāvartamānamagnitvam agnijanyakāryaṃ prati anagnirūpārthānāṃ kāraṇatvamapākarotu, nikhilā'gnivyaktīnām anyonyakāryajananaṃ prati kāraṇatvasaṅkaraprasaṅgaṃ kathaṃ pariharttumutsahate, atastatparihāre kiñcinniyāmakaṃ vaktavyam–tacca sāmānyam, viśeṣaḥ, dvayam, śaktirvā syāt ? na tāvatsāmānyam, vyaktyantare'pyanaṃpyanugamāt
nāpi viśeṣaḥ; yato na viśeṣāntarajanyakāryaṃ prati viśeṣo viśeṣarūpatāṃ parityajati
nāpi dvayam; ata eva, ata śaktereva tanniyāmakatvamaṅgīkarttavyam

svarūpa-sahakāriśaktestanniyāmakatve ca lokapratītivirodha, pratīyate hi loke svarūpa-sahakāriśaktiyuktaṣvapi valīvarda-manuṣyādiṣu ayamatra kārye samartha, ayañcā'samartha alpasāmarthyovā ityādivyavahāra pratītiśca
tatsiddhaṃ tannimittaṃ svarūpa-sahakāriśaktivyatiriktaṃ sāmarthyam, anyathā ayaṃ vibhāgo na syāt, sarveṣāṃ samānameva kāryakāritva tadakāritvaṃ vā syāt

kiñca, sahakārilābhamātrāt padārthāḥ kārya kurvanti, svabhāvabhede sati sahakārilābhādvā ? prathamapakṣe tallābhe satyapi svarūpasyā'viśiṣṭatvāt mṛtpiṇḍād ghaṭasyeva paṭasyāpyutpatti syāt, svabhāvabhedaśca śaktibhede satyeva syāt ityuktam

kiñca, agne svarūpasahakārisannidhimātrāt kāryakāritvā'bhyupagame pratibandhakamaṇyādisannidhāne'pi tatprasaṅga, na hi tadā'gnitvasya karatalā'nalasaṃyogasya vā sahakāriṇo vināśo'nyatvaṃ vā'sti, tatsvarūparayā'vikalasya pratyabhijñāyamānatvāt
tato dṛṣṭarūpāt kāraṇādanudbhavat kārya tadatiriktaṃ kiñcinnimittāntara parikalpayati, sā ca śakti

nanu tanmaṇyādisannidhau sāmagryabhāvād vahne kāryā'karaṇatvādakāraṇatvam, karatalā'nalasaṃyogavad dāhotpattau tanmaṇyādyabhāvasyāpi sāmagrītvāt, tadasat, yata ko'tra abhāva sahakārī–ki pratibandhakamaṇyāde prāgabhāva, pradhvasa, anyonyābhāva, atyantā'bhāva, abhāvamātra vā ? yadi prāgabhāva, tadā vidyamāne'pyekasminmaṇau maṇyantaraprāgabhāvā'pekṣayā dāhotpatti syāt
atha tasyaiva prāgabhāvaṃ prāpya asau dāhaṃ vidhatte, tarhi tatpradhvaṃse, satyapi vā asmin uttambhakamaṇisannidhau dāhotpattirna syāt
etena pradhvaṃsasya sahakāritvaṃ pratyuktam, tatprāgabhāve, tatsattve'pi vā uttambhakamaṇyupanipāte dāhā'nutpattiprasaṅgāt
nāpyanyonyābhāva, pratibandhakamaṇyādisadbhāve'pyasya saṃbhavāt dāhodayānuṣaṅgāt, tatprāk-pradhvasābhāvasaṃbhave tadanudayaprasaṅgācca
tata pratibandhakamaṇyādyabhāvo na dāhādau kāraṇam anvaya-vyatirekaśūnyatvāt, yad yatrānvaya-vyatirekaśūnyaṃ na tattatra kāraṇam yathā paṭe kumbhakāraḥ, tathā cāyam, tasmāttatheti
kaścāsyābhāva kāryotpattau sahakārī syāt–kimitaretarābhāva, prāgabhāvo vā syāt, pratvaso vā, abhāvamātraṃ vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 52 pū॰

kiñca, yadi tanmantrādyabhāvo dāhahetuḥ tadaikatanmantrādivyaktisadbhāve'pi anyatanmantrādivyaktīnāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānānāṃ taddeśe tatkāle ca abhāvāḥ santīti dāhotpattiḥ kinna syāt ? na ca ekavyaktyabhāvo nāsti iti vyaktyantarābhāvaiḥ svakāryaṃ na karttavyam, na hi bhāvavyaktyantarāṇi na santi iti ekā bhāvavyaktiḥ svakāryanna karoti iti prātītikam
na ca anantānāṃ sambhūya kāryakāritvaṃ kvāpi pratipannam
na caika evāyamabhāvaḥ tanmantrādijāterekatvāt ityabhidhātavyam; jāteḥ abhāveṣu bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt, anyathā abhāvānāṃ dravya-guṇa-karmānyatamarūpatāprasaṅgo jātestatraiva parisamāptatvāt
kiñca, maṇyādimātrā'bhāvo dāhahetuḥ, pratibandhakā'bhāvo vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; maṇyādimātrā'bhāve dāhā'darśanāt
na ca viśiṣṭamaṇyādyabhāvaḥ kāraṇam, tadvaiśiṣṭyasya kāryaikasamadhigamyasya nāmāntareṇa śakterevā'bhidhānāt
atra hi pratibandhakena rasābhāvaḥ kriyate; atiśayāntaraṃ vā ? na tāvadrasābhāvaḥ; nīrasatvasya viṣe'nupalambhāt, rasasya tatra pratyabhijñāyamānatvāt

yadi cā'tiśayaḥ kaścidatīndriyaḥ kalpyeta tadā śaktikalpane ko vidveṣaḥ ? tato nirākṛtametat–dahanādayo nijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇameva sāmarthyamudvahanti ityādi; nijasahakārisannidhilakṣaṇasāmarthyād uktaprakāreṇa teṣāṃ kāryakāritvānupapatteḥ
tallakṣaṇasāmarthyāt tadutpattyabhyupagame ca bījāderapyata eva aṅkurādikāryotpattiprasaṅgāt, sragvanitādeśca sukhādyutpattyanuṣaṅgāt atīndriyasyeśvarasya adṛṣṭādeśca kalpanā'nupapattiḥ

yacca pratibandhakamaṇyādisannidhāne kāryā'karatvādakāraṇatvam ityuktam; tatra kimidaṃ kāryā'karatvaṃ nāma–ki kāryapratiyogitvam, pratibaddhatvaṃ vā ? pratiyogitve punastato dāhotpattirna syāt jalādivat

kiñca, sāmānyarūpā śaktiḥ pratibandhakena pratibaddhyate, dravyasvabhāvā, guṇarūpā vā ? pratibandhaścāsyā pradhvaṃsaḥ, abhibhavo vā ? tatra na tāvat sāmānyarūpāyāḥ śakteḥ pradhvaṃsa lakṣaṇaḥ pratibandho ghaṭate; nityatvāt
nāpi dravyarūpāyāḥ; tasyā samavāyikāraṇavināśād asamavāyikāraṇavināśādvā vināśā'bhyupagamāt
nāpi guṇarūpāyā, tasyā virodhiguṇaprādurbhāvād āśrayavināśādvā vināśapratijñānāt
abhibhavalakṣaṇastu pratibandho'nupapannaḥ; pratibandhakamaṇyādisannidhāne'pi sāmānyādisvarūpāyā nija-sahakāriśakte anabhibhūtāyāḥ pratīte
kiñca, dve api śaktī ki kāraṇajanye, uta ekā janyā anyā nityā ? prathamapakṣo'nabhyupagamānna yukta
dvitīyapakṣe tu ekāṃ śakti pratibandhako hanti, aparāṃ pālayati iti mahattasya vaicitryam
tato mantraupadhādyairacintyaprabhāvai atīndriyāyā śaktereva pratibandha pratipattavyaḥ
ka puna śakte pratibandha iti cet ? abhibhava, vināśo vā
nanu prāpya śakti pratibandhaka pratibadhnāti, aprāpya vā ? na tāvat prāpya, śaktimato maṇimantrādinā'prāptau tenā'syā prāpterayogāt, na hi hastena paṭā'prāptau tadgatarūpāde prāptiḥ saṃbhavati
aprāptasya pratibandhe ca ekasmādeva maṇimantrāde sarvasyā śakte pratibandha syāt; ityapyanupapannam, yogyatālakṣaṇasambandhavaśād yogyāyā evā'syā tena pratibandhopapatte cumbakavat
na khalu cumbakasya ayasa yogyatāto'nya sannikarṣādi sambandho'sti, nāpyayogyasya ākarṣaṇam, trailokyodaravartino'pi ayasa tenaikenaiva ākarṣaṇaprasaṅgāt
nanu vinaṣṭāyāḥ śakte kuta puna prādurbhāva yato dāhādikāryotpatti syāditi cet ? śaktyantarayuktādvahnikṣaṇādeva, na cā'navasthānuṣaṅgo doṣāya; bījāṅkurādivat tatkāryakāraṇapravāhasyā'nāditayeṣṭatvāt

tāścaivambhūtā śaktayo'rthānām anekarūpā santi pratikṣaṇamanekakāryakāritvāt, kathamanyathā kañcit prati pratibaddho'pyagniḥ tadaivā'nyasya dāhādikaṃ vidadhyāt, viṣa vā pratibaddhamāraṇaśaktikaṃ vyādhyupaśamaṃ kuryāt ? na caikasya anekasvabhāvatvavirodha, pramāṇata pratipannasya avirodhāspadatvāt
tata kāryakāraṇabhāvapratiniyamaṃ pratijānadbhi pratipadārthaṃ svātmabhūtamatīndriyaṃ kāryaikasamadhigamyaṃ vicitraṃ rūpāntaraṃ śaktyaparābhidhānaṃ prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam
tattvasaṅgrahakārastu–tatra śaktātirekeṇa na śaktirnāma kācana ślo॰ 1607 ityādinā padārthasvarūpāmeva śaktimabhyupagacchati
idānī sannipāta ityādi vyācaṣṭe yogyatā ityādinā
tayoḥ viṣayaviṣayiṇoḥ anantaraṃ bhūtamutpannam, anena anantaraśabdaḥ sākṣāt sannipātaśabdastu sāmarthyād vyākhyātaḥ
nakhalu tayoḥ yogyadeśādyavasthānalakṣaṇasannipātā'saṃbhave pūrvamiva tadanantaraṃ kasyacit prādurbhāvo yukto'tiprasaṅgāt
arthasya anantaroktasya grahaṇam na punaḥ svarūpagatā'rthākāramātrasya, jñānasya arthākāratayā svapne'pyapratīteḥ
ghaṭāderbahirdeśasambaddhasya antardeśasambaddhena jñānena ahamahamikayā pratīyamānena pratiprāṇi pratibhāsapratīteḥ
nanu yadyarthādutpannaṃ tadākārānukāri ca tanna syāt kathaṃ tarhi niyatārthagrāhakam ? ityatrāha–yogyatālakṣaṇam
yogyatā niyatārthagrahaṇasāmarthyam lakṣaṇam svarūpaṃ yasya tattathoktamiti
atra sautrāntikamatāvalambī prāha–jñānam arthasya grāhakaṃ bhavat ki sambaddhasya grāhakaṃ bhavet, asambaddhasya vā ? na tāvadasambaddhasya; atiprasaṅgāt
atha sambaddhasya; ki tādātmyena, tadutpattyā vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; yogācāramataprasaṅgāt
tadutpattirapi na samasamaye saṃbhavati; savyetaragoviṣāṇavat samasamayavartinoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvā'bhāvāt, minnasamaye ca arthasya vinaṣṭatvāt nā''kāramantareṇa grahaṇaṃ ghaṭate
taduktam– bhinnakālaṃ katha grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ viduḥ
tathā, yad yasya grāhakaṃ tattadākāram yathā ravarūpagrāhakaṃ jñānaṃ svarūpākāram, nīlādyarthasya grāhakañca jñānamiti
bhinnakālaṃ katha grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ viduḥ

kiñca, atītā'nāgataviṣayajñānānāṃ keśoṇḍukādijñānānāñca bāhyārthasya grāhyasyā'bhāvāt kathamiva ākāramantareṇa tadgrahaṇam ? yad yadākāraṃ na bhavati na tat tasya grāhakam yathā śuklasaṃvedanaṃ nīlasya, grāhakañcārthasya jñānamiti

nirākāratvābhyupagame ca jñānasya svarūpasyāpyapratyakṣatvaprasaṅga, utpadyamānaṃ hi jñāna nīlamidam, pītamidam ityādyākāreṇaiva pratīyate, tadabhāve kathamiva asya pratyakṣatā syāt ? nirākāratve ca jñānānāmanyonya bhedo'pi sudurlabha, nīlādyākāro hi saṃvida saṃvidantarād vyāvartaka rūpam, tadabhāve kuta ki vyāvartteta ? tasmād yato nīlasyedaṃ vijñānam, pītasyedam ityadhigatirniyatakarmmikā sampadyate tadeva rūpamasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇam, savida saṃvidantarācca bhedakam
na ca artharūpatā'tyaye nīlasyeyaṃ buddhi iti buddherarthena ghaṭanā ghaṭate, tathāvidhāyāścāsyāḥ sarvārtha pratyaviśeṣāt pratikarmavyavasthā'pi durghaṭā

tathā ca tatsvarūpaṃ pratipadārtha nirākāratayā' prāptabhedaṃ sad vyavahartṝṇāmarthakriyārthināṃ niyatārthapratītyahetutayā kathaṃ niyate'rthe pravṛtteraṅgaṃ myāt ? taduktam– arthena ghaṭayatyenā na hi muktvārtharūpatām
na ca kāraṇatvā'viśeṣāt arthavat cakṣurāderapyākārānukaraṇaṃ jñāne kinna syādityabhidhātavyam ? tadaviśepe'pi apatyena pitrākārānukaraṇavat niyatasyaivā''kārānukaraṇopapatte

tato yad yadākāraṃ svajñānena ālambyate tattadākārameva pratipattavyam yathā sāsnādimadā kāraḥ svajñānenā''lambyamāno gauḥ sāsnādimān, arthākārañcā'rthajñānaṃ svajñānenā''lamvyane iti siddhā sākāratā jñānasyeti
yathā cirakālīnādhyayanādisinnasya utpitasya nīlalohitādiguṇaviśiṣṭa keśoṇḍrikākhyaḥ kaścinnayanāgre parisphuṭati, athavā karasammṛditalocanaraśmiṣu yeyaṃ keśapiṇḍāvasthā sā keśoṇḍrikaḥ
tadākāra hi savedanamartha vyavasthāpayati nīlamiti pītañceti
yathā ca ākārayogitā jñānasya tathottaratra pratipādayiṣyāma
kimartha tarhi sārūpyamiṣyate pramāṇam ? kriyākarmavyavasthāyāstalloke syānnibandhanam
sārūpyato'nyathā na bhavati nīlasya karmaṇa savitti pītasya veti kriyākarmapratiniyamārthamiṣyate pramāṇavā॰ ala॰ pṛ॰ 119
bhāvyaṃ tenā''tmanā yena pratikarma vibhajyate || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 302 iti
arthena ghaṭayatyenā anyatsvabhedo jñānasya bhedako'pi kathañcana
tasmāt prameyādhigateḥ pramāṇa meyarūpatā || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 305 iti
pitrostadekamākāra dhatte nānyasya kasyacit || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 369 iti

yattāvaduktam–jñānamarthasya sambaddhasya asambaddhasya vā grāhakam ityādi; tatra sambaddhasyaiva tad grāhakam, sambandhaśca jñānārthayo yogyatālakṣaṇo na punaḥ tadutpattilakṣaṇaḥ arthājjñānotpatternipetsyamānatvāt
tathā ca arthākāraṃ jñānam arthakāryatvāt ityatra asiddho hetuḥ
tallakṣaṇasambandhaśca ndhācca jñānamarthasya samakālasya bhinnakālasya vā grāhakaṃ na viruddhyate, ataḥ bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyam ityādyayuktam

kiñca, svāgamā gama prasiddhaṃ jñānamāśritya sākāratā prasādhyate, anubhavaprasiddhaṃ vā ? tatrādyavikalpe svāgamaprasiddhasyā'vikalpakajñānasya ākāśakuśeśayaprakhyatvāt na tatsākāretaracintayā'smākaṃ kiñcit prayojanam
yadeva hi pravṛttinivṛttyādikāraṇaṃ pramāṇabhūtam āvālamanubhavaprasiddhaṃ savikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ tadeva nirākāratayā prasādhayitumupakrāntam
na khalu svākāro jñānānāṃ viṣayaḥ iti pratiyanti laukikāḥ, anātmabhūtārthonmukhatayā taistepāmarthaparicchedakatvapratijñānāt
na ca lokavyavahārātikrameṇa arthavyavasthā yuktā; prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahāreṇa pramāṇavā॰ 2
pratyakṣādivirodhaprasaṅgācca, tathāhi– pratyakṣeṇa tāvat viṣayākārarahitameva jñānaṃ pratipuruṣamahamahamikayā ghaṭādigrāhakamanubhūyate, na punardarṣaṇādivat pratibimbākrāntam
anumānena ca; tathāhi–yad yena svātmano'rthāntarabhūtaṃ vedyate tattena atadākāreṇa yathā stambhāderjāḍyam, vedyate ca svātmano'rthāntarabhūtaṃ jñānena nīlādikamiti
sambandho hi yogyatāsvabhāva eva jñānārthayo grāhyagrāhakabhāvāṅgam na tu tādātmyādi

kā ceyaṃ jñānasya sākāratā nāma–svasaṃvidrūpatā, vaiśadyādisvabhāva, arthākārollekhaḥ, arthākāradhāritvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyavikalpatraye siddhasādhyatā; jñāne tattrayasyāpi sadbhāvāt, tadanyatamāpāye jñānasya jñānarūpatvasyaivā'nupapatteḥ vaiśadyādirūpatayā svaparavyavasāyasvabhāvatvāttasya
tathāhi–nīlādyākāro jñāne na saṅkrāmati jaḍasyaiva dharmatvāt, yo jaḍasyaiva dharmaḥ sa jñāne na saṅkrāmati yathā jaḍatā, jaḍasyaiva dharmaśca nīlādyākāra iti
na ca sattvādinā vyabhicāraḥ; tasya jaḍasyaiva dharmatvā'sabhavāt ajaḍasukhādāvapyasya saṃbhavāt
kimidamardhākāratvaṃ vedanānā yadvaśāt pratiniyatārthapariccheda syāt kim arthākārellekhitvam, arthākāra dhāritva vā ? ratnākarāva॰ 4
kiñca, arthena saha jñānasya sarvātmanā sārūpyam, ekadeśena vā ? sarvātmanā sārūpye jaḍatvādarthasya jñānamapi jaḍameva syāt
yasya sarvātmanā arthena sārūpyaṃ tajjaḍam yathā uttaro'rthakṣaṇa, sarvātmanā sārūpyañca arthena jñānasyeti
pramāṇarūpatāvirodhānuṣaṅgaśca tadvadevāsya syāt prameyarūpatā'nukaraṇāt, na caitad yuktam, pramāṇaprameyayorbahirantarmukhā''kāratayā bhedena pratibhāsamānatvāt

atha etaddopaparijihīrṣayā ekadeśena sārūpyamiṣyate, tarhi tenā'jaḍākāreṇa jaḍatāpratipatterabhāvāt kuta tadviśiṣṭatā'rthasya pratīyate ? yad yena yatra na pratīyate na tena tatra tadviśiṣṭatā pratyetuṃ śakyā yathā rūpajñānena apratipannena rasena viśiṣṭatā mātuliṅgādau, na pratīyate ca ajaḍākāreṇa nīlādijñānena arthajaḍateti
jaṅatā'pratītau ca kathaṃ nīlatā'pi pratīyeta ? anyathā'nayorbheda syāt
yasmin apratīte'pi yat pratīyate tattata anyad yathā ghaṭe'pratīyamāne'pi pratīyamāna paṭa, apratīyamānāyāmapi jaḍatāyāṃ pratīyate ca nīlateti
sugatena cāsyā pratītyabhāve kathaṃ sattvam ? sattve vā kathaṃ tasya aśeṣajñatā ?
arthena sarvātmanā tatra svākārādhāne jñānasya jaḍatāprasakte uttarārthakṣaṇavat

pararāgādivedane ca asya yadi tadākāratā syāt tarhi parakīyasakalakalpanājālā'nukaraṇāt kathaṃ vītarāgatā vidhūtakalpanājālatā ca syāt ? atha tadākārānukaraṇe'pi madīyā ete rāgādaya iti buddherabhāvānnā'ya doṣa, kathaṃ tarhi parasya te ? tadbuddhisadbhāvāditi cet; nanu tena tadbuddhyākārā'nukaraṇe ayameva doṣo'nuṣajyate
atha etaddoṣād bibhyatā atadākāreṇa jñānena jaḍatādikaṃ pratīyate ityabhyupagamyate, tarhi nīlādyākāro'pi atadākāreṇaiva jñānena pratīyatām alamākārā''grahagrahā'bhiniveśena
atha nīlatāṃ tat tadākāratayā pratipadyate jaḍatāṃ tvatadākāratayā, tadidam ardhajaratīyanyāyā'nusaraṇam
musa na kāmayante aṅgāntara tu kāmayante jaratyā
ardhaṃ mukhamātraṃ jaratyāḥ vṛddhāyā vāmayate nāṅgānīti so'yamardhajaratīnyāya
nahi kuvakuṭāderekadeśo bhogāya pacyate ekadeśastu prasavāya kalpyate brahmasū॰ śā॰ bhā॰ ānandagi॰ 1
anya nyāyasya viśeṣasvarūpa vividhasthalanirdeśapurassaraṃ laukikanyāyāñjalyā pṛ॰ 7 draṣṭavyam
kiñca, ekadeśena sārūpyāt nīlārthavad aśeṣārthānāmapi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ sattvādimātreṇāsya sarvatra sārūpyā'viśeṣāt
atha tadaviśeṣe'pi nīlādyākāravailakṣaṇyāttepāmagrahaṇam; tarhi samānākārāṇāmaśeṣāṇāṃ grahaṇā'nuṣaṅgaḥ
atha yata eva utpadyate tasyaiva ākārānukaraṇe grāhakam na sārūpyamātreṇa; evamapi samanantarapratyayasya tad grāhakaṃ syāt

kiñca, paramāṇavaḥ pratyekaṃ paramāṇvātmanā ātmīyamākāraṃ jñāne samarpayanti, saṅghātātmanā vā ? tatra prathamaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; paramāṇūnāṃ svarūpeṇā'pratibhāsanāt, tadviparītasya anekāvayavātmano'vayavinaḥ sthira-sthūlasya pratibhāsanāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ; teṣāṃ samuditānāmapi svarūpā'parityāgataḥ tathābhūtā'vayavisvarūpeṇa pratibhāsā'nupapatteḥ
na khalu samuditāste aṇutvā-'nekatve parityajanti paramatapraveśā'nuṣaṅgāt
na cā'nyathābhūtānāṃ teṣām anyathā vijñānajanakatvaṃ yuktam; pramāṇavirodhāt
tathāhi–paramāṇavo na sthūlādyākāreṇa jñānaṃ svarūpayanti, tadrūparahitatvāt, yad yadrūparahitaṃ na tat tenā''tmanā jñānaṃ svarūpayati yathā nīlaṃ pītātmanā, sthūlādyākārarahitāśca paramāṇava iti
tatsadṛśatve ca jñānasya aṇuvat tadapi mūrttam, sūkṣmatvādapratyakṣañca syāt

atha samuditānāṃ teṣāmapi pratyakṣatā iṣyate; tarhi samuditaparamāṇuvat jñānasyāpi tricaturasra-dīrgha-hrasva-parimaṇḍala-sama-viṣamādirūpaprasaṅga, jaladhāraṇā''haraṇādyarthakriyākāritvaṃ bāhyendriyapratyakṣatā ca syāt
kiñca, ākāro jñānādabhinnaḥ, bhinno vā ? bhede jñānaṃ nirākārameva syāt
svato'bhinnasya ca ākārasya jñānagrāhyatve arthe dūrā'tītādivyavahāro na syāt
yat svato'bhinnaṃ gṛhyate na tatra dūrādivyavahāraḥ yathā svarūpe, svato'bhinnaṃ gṛhyate ca parvataprāsādādikamiti
asti ca arthe dūrādivyavahāraḥ dūre parvataḥ, nikaṭe prāsāda, atīto rājā ityādivyavahārasyā'skhaladrūpasya pratīteḥ
na ca ākārādhāyakasya dūrā'tītatvāt tathā vyavahāraḥ ityabhidhātavyam; jāgraccetaso dūrā'tītatvena pravodhacetasi tathā vyavahāraprasaṅgāt

atha bhrānto'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ atyantanikaṭe'pi jñānākāre anyathātvena vyavahārāt; nanu jñānākāre iti kutaḥ ? asya bhrāntatvāccet; anyonyā śraya–asya bhrāntatvasiddhau hi jñānākāre ityasya siddhi, tatsiddhau cā'sya bhrāntatvasiddhiriti
anumānañca śabdāderanityatvādikamadhigacchad yadi tadākāraṃ tarhi dharmarūpataiva asya syāt nānumānarūpatā
atha atadākāram; kathamanena tatpratipatti, pratipattau vā kimanyatrāpi sākāratāprasādhanaprayāsena ?
ālokena na mandena dṛśyate'to bhidā yadi

kiñca, arthena sādṛśyamātmana tadeva jñānaṃ pratipadyate, jñānāntaraṃ vā ? yadi jñānāntaram, tatkim jñānā'rthau pratipadya tayo sādṛśyaṃ pratipadyeta, apratipadya vā ? na tāvadapratipadya, sādṛśyapratipatte tadvatpratipattināntarīyakatvāt, na hi yamalakayorapratipannayo sādṛśya pratipattuṃ śakyam
atha pratipadya; kutastatpratipatti–kimekaramādevā'to jñānāntarāt, dvābhyāṃ vā ? tatra prathamapakṣo'sāmprata, tayorbhinnakālatayā ekatra jñāne pratibhāsā'nupapatte
yau bhinnakālau na tayorekatra jñāne pratibhāsa yathā udayā'stamanayoḥ, bhinnakālau ca jñānā'rthāviti
na cā'nayoḥ bhinnakālatvamasiddham; jñānā'rthayo kāryakāraṇabhāvata samasamayavṛttitvasya bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt
ye atyantavilakṣaṇe jñāne na te kasyacit sādṛśyaṃ pratipattu samarthe yathā devadatta-yajñadattajñāne, atyantavilakṣaṇe ca jñānā'rthaviṣaye jñānāntare iti
na cedamasiddham, jñānādutpannasya jñānākārasya jñānasya arthotpannā'rthākārajñānādatyantavailakṣaṇyasya bhinnasāmagrīprabhavatayā bhinnaviṣayatayā ca prasiddhatvāt
yayorbhinnasāmagrīprabhavatā bhinnaviṣayatā ca tayoratyantavailakṣaṇyam yathā rūpasparśajñānayoḥ, bhinnasāmagrīprabhavatā bhinnaviṣayatā ca jñānā-'rthajñānayoriti
astu vā tābhyāṃ tatsādṛśyapratipatti, tathāpi anayorapi artha-jñānābhyāṃ sādṛśyam anyataḥ pratipattavyam, tasyāpi arthajñānajñānai sādṛśyam anyata ityanavasthā
atha tadeva jñānam ātmano'rthena sādṛśyaṃ pratipadyate; tanna; tatkāle arthasyā'sattvāt
yatkāle yannāsti na tena tad ātmana svata eva sādṛśyaṃ pratipattuṃ samartham yathā putrakāle'satā pitrā putra, nāsti ca jñānakāle artha iti
tato jñāne arthasārūpyasya vicāryamāṇasyā'nupapatte yad yadākāraṃ na bhavati na tattasya grāhakam ityādyayuktam
yadapyabhihitam–nirākāratve jñānasya svarūpasyāpyapratyakṣatvaprasaṅga ityādi, tadapyabhidhānamātram, svaparaprakāśakatvaṃ hi buddherākāra na punarnīlādyākāra, asya arthadharmatvāt
na cā'nyākāreṇa anyasya pratyakṣatā yuktā; atiprasaṅgāt, kintu svākāreṇa, tathābhūtena cā'' kāreṇa asyāḥ pratyakṣatvam nīlamahaṃ vedmi ityādyullekhena suprasiddhameva
vyāvṛttirapi saṃvidaḥ saṃvidantarāt pratiniyatārthagrāhakatvasvarūpeṇaiva, na punarnīlādisvarūpeṇa asya grāhyadharmatvāt
padārthānāṃ hi svagatadharmeṇaiva anyonyaṃ vyāvṛttiryuktā nānyadharmeṇa atiprasaṅgāt, tathā ca tatrānubhavamātreṇa ityādyanupapannam
anubhavamātreṇa jñānasya sārūpye'pi pratiniyatā'rthānubhavaprakāreṇa prativiṣayaṃ viśeṣasaṃbhavāt
na khalu nīlagrahaṇasvabhāva eva asya pītagrahaṇasvabhāvo bhavitumarhati, tathābhūtena ca svabhāvena pratyarthaṃ sambandhasaṃbhavāt arthena ghaṭayatyenām ityādyapi analpatamovilasitam
kiñca, ghaṭayati iti sambandhayati ityabhipretam, arthasambaddhaṃ niścāyayati iti vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; artharūpatāyā jñānasyā'rthe sambandhakāraṇatve tādātmyā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
yayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ na tayostādātmyam yathā agnidhūmayoḥ, kāryakāraṇabhāvaśca arthasambaddhajñānā-'rtharūpatayoriti

yasya yena sambandhaḥ kvaccinna pratipannaḥ na tasya tanniścayahetutvam yathā sahyasya vindhyena kvacidapratipannasambandhasya na vindhyaniścayahetutvam, kvacitsambandhā'pratītiśca arthasambaddhajñānena artharūpatāyāḥ, iti kathamasau arthasambaddhaṃ jñānaṃ niścāyayet ? na ca viśiṣṭaviṣayotpādādanyo jñānasya arthe sambandho ghaṭate, sa ca svasāmagrītaḥ eva sampanna iti artharūpatāprasādhanaprayāso vyarthaḥ
yatoghaṭayati sambandhayati vivakṣitaṃ jñānamarthasambaddhamartharūpatā niścāyayati vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 28 pū॰
nanu nirākāratve jñānasya sarva sarvasya grāhakaṃ syādaviśeṣāt; ityapyasamīcīnam; purovarttinyevā'rthe jñānasya svakāraṇairniyamitatvāt pradīpavat
na khalu pradīpaḥ ghaṭādīnām ākāramanukurvan teṣāṃ prakāśakaḥ pratīyate; pratyakṣavirodhāt
nāpyākārarahitasya prakāśakatve sakalaghaṭādīnāṃ prakāśakatvaṃ prasajyate; gṛhādyantarvartināmeva pratiniyatānāṃ teṣāṃ pratiniyatasāmagrīprabhavatayā pratiniyatasāmarthyamāsādayatā tena prakāśanāt

sākāratayāpi arthaprakāśakatvābhyupagame ekasya ghaṭajñānasya trailokyodaravartināṃ nikhilaghaṭānāṃ prakāśakatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti codye bhavato'pi pratiniyatasāmagrīprabhavapratiniyatayogyatāto nānyaduttaram
tadevaṃ sākāratāpakṣasya anekadoṣa duṣṭatvānna svākāramātrālambana jñānam
yadvijñānaṃ yadvilakṣaṇapratibhāsaṃ na tattadālambanam yathā rūpavilakṣaṇapratibhāsaṃ rasajñāna na rūpālambanam, svākārād vilakṣaṇapratibhāsañca ghaṭādijñānamiti
na cāyamasiddho hetu, antarmukhā''kāratayā pratibhāsamānajñānākārād bahirmukhākāratayā pratibhāsamānaghaṭādijñānasya vilakṣaṇapratibhāsatvaprasiddheriti
sākāratve'pi cāyaṃ paryanuyoga samānasanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 460
asya ca sākāravādasya vividhabhaṅgyā khaṇḍanaṃ nimragranyeṣu draṣṭavyam
kathaṃ tadanantaraṃ tad bhūtam ? ityāha–sanmātram iti
ki tat ? darśanam āloka iti yāvat
uttaram svottarakālabhāvina pariṇāmam vikāram pratipadyate yat darśanam iti sambandha
tasya viṣayaḥ avāntaro manuṣyatvādijātiviśeṣa tasya vyavasthāpanam saṅkara-vyatikaravyatirekeṇa niyatarūpeṇa yojanam, tasmai vikalpaḥ nirṇayātmā yasya sa tathokta tam iti

punaḥ avagrahottarakālam, avagraheṇa viṣayīkṛta avagrahīkṛtaḥ avāntaramanuṣyatvādijātiviśeṣa tasya viśeṣaḥ karṇāṭa-lāṭādibheda tasya ākāṅkṣaṇam bhavitavyatāpratyayarūpatayā grahaṇābhimukhyam īhā bhavati
nanu darśanādīnāmanyonyaṃ bhedaikānte kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgād apasiddhāntaprasakti, abhedaikānte punaḥ anyatamasyaiva prasaṅgād vyapadeśabhedo durlabhaḥ syāt, ityatrāha–kathañcid ityādi
kathañcit na sarvātmanā darśanādīnām abhede'pi ekatve'pi na kevalaṃ bhede pariṇāmaviśeṣād vyapadeśasya śabdasya bhedaḥ nānātvaṃ sughaṭameveti
paricchinnasya vastuno'vicyuti-smṛti-vāsanārūpaṃ taddharaṇaṃ punardhāraṇā bruvate ? āva॰ ni॰ hari॰ pṛ॰ 10
mahodaye ca kālāntarāvismaraṇakāraṇaṃ hi dhāraṇābhidhānaṃ jñānaṃ
anantavīryo'pi–tathā nirṇītasya kālāntare tathaiva smaraṇahetu saṃskāro dhāraṇā iti
smṛtiheturdhāraṇā saṃskāra iti yāvat, yata evaṃ tat tasmāt matijñānam avagrehāvāyadhāraṇābhedena caturvidham
smṛteḥ anubhūtavastuviṣayāyāḥ tacchabdaparāmṛṣṭāyāḥ pratīteḥ hetuḥ dhāraṇā bhāvanā saṃskāra iti yāvat

nanu ca īhā ceṣṭā prayatna ityarthaḥ, dhāraṇā ca saṃskāraḥ, tayośca jñānādatyantabhedaḥ, buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmā'dharmasaṃskārāḥ ityabhidhānāt, tatkathamanayoḥ pratyakṣatā ? ityāśaṅkyamānaṃ prati āha–īhā ityādi
īhā-dhāraṇayorapi na kevalam avagrahā-'vāyayoḥ jñānātmakatvamunneyam abhyupagantavyam
tathāhi–avagrahasya īhā, avāyasya ca dhāraṇā vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ, na ca cetanopādāno vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ acetatano yukto'tiprasaṅgāt
athavā īhā-dhāraṇayoḥ sambandhī upādeyatvena yaḥ upayogaviśeṣaḥ avāya-smṛtilakṣaṇaḥ tasmāt iti grāhyam
na vai khalu cetanam acetanopādānaṃ yuktam; cārvākamatānupraveśaprasaṅgāt
idānī svasaṃvidāmapi bahvādibhedamavagrahādikam, avagrahādīnāñca pūrvapūrvasya pramāṇatve phalatvamuttarottarasya darśayannāha–
vivṛtiḥ–paramārthaikasaṃvitteḥ vedyavedakākārayoḥ pramāṇaphalavyavasthāyāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgāderapi pratyakṣatvaṃ prasajyeta
tataḥ kim ? gṛhītagrahaṇāt saṃvṛtivat tadanumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ na syāt; tadanayoḥ samāropavyavacchedā'viśeṣāt saṃvṛterapi pramāṇāntaratvaṃ syāt
sarvasyaiva nirvikalpakajñānasya samāropavyavacchedākāṅkṣiṇaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt tataḥ saṃvyavahārā'bhāvāt
arthakriyārthī hi pramāṇam apramāṇaṃ vā anveṣate, rūpādikṣaṇakṣayādisphuṭapratibhāsā'viśeṣāt khaṇḍaśaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ yadapekṣaṃ tadeva phalaṃ yuktam; tattvataḥ tatkṛto na bhavati
tattvataḥ tat tato na bhavati ityapi pāṭha
bhāve vā nirṇītiḥ akhaṇḍaśaḥ kuto na bhavet ? bahubahuvidhakṣiprā'nisṛtā'nuktadhruvetaravikalpānām avagrahādeḥ svabhāvabhedānna viruddhyate

pratibhāsabhede'pi svabhāvabhedā'bhāvakalpanāyāṃ kramavṛttidharmāṇāmapi tathābhāvāt kutaḥ kramaḥ sukha-duḥkhādibhedo vā paramārthataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyeta sahapratibhāsavat ? tadayam ekamanekā''kāraṃ kṣaṇikajñānaṃ kutaścit pratyāsatteḥ pratibhāsabhedānām upayan kramavarttināmapi tathaikatvaṃ pratipattumarhati harṣaviṣādādīnām
bahu ādiryasya bahuvidhādeḥ sa tathokta tena, avagrahādīnām aṣṭacatvāriśat bahvādyavagrahādyaṣṭacatvāriṃśat
etaduktaṃ bhavati–bahvādibhi dvādaśaprabhedai avagrahādayaścatvāro guṇitā aṣṭacatvāriśad bhavanti
caśabdo'tra samuccayārtha lupto draṣṭavya, tena arthagrahaṇamanuvartamānaṃ caśabdena labdhatāpariṇāmaṃ sambaddhyate

tathā cāyamarthaḥ sthita–na kevalam arthagrahaṇasya api tu svasaṃvidāñca bahvādyavagrahādyaṣṭacatvāriśad bhavati bhavanti, anyathā tāsāṃ śrutādāvantarbhāvo vaktavya, jñānaṣaṭkatvañcā'nuṣajyeta matau anantarbhāvāt avagrahādyātmakatvāttasyāḥ

nanu ca arthe bahubahuvidhādidharmāṇāṃ saṃbhavād yukto bahvādyavagrahādiḥ na punarjñānasvarūpe, tatra tadasaṃbhavāt, na hi jñānasvarūpe bahu-bahuvidhādidharmāḥkadācidapi pratīyante bahirarthe eva teṣā sarvadā pratīteḥ; ityāpyapeśalam, bahvādidharmagrāhakatvasya jñānasvarūpagatasya svasaṃvedanaviṣayatopapattitaḥ tatsvarūpe'pi bahvādyavagrahādisaṃbhavā'virodhāt
ki punarjñānasya svasavedanaṃ nāma ? iti ceducyate–
prayoga–svagrahaṇātmakaṃ jñānam arthagrahaṇātmakatvāt, yat puna svagrahaṇātmakaṃ na bhavati na tad arthagrahaṇātmakam yathā ghaṭādi, arthagrahaṇātmakañca jñānam, tasmāt svagrahaṇātmakamiti
jñāne svabhaṃviditatvaṃ pramāṇaviruddham iti jaiminīyasya pūrvapakṣaḥ–

nanu jñāne svasaṃviditatvaṃ pramāṇaviruddham karmatvenā'pratīyamāne tasmin parokṣatvasyaivopapatteḥ; tathāhi–jñānaṃ parokṣam karmatvenā'pratīyamānatvāt, yat punaḥ pratyakṣaṃ tat karmatvena pratīyamānaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā arthaḥ, karmatvenā' pratīyamānañca jñānam, tasmāt parokṣamiti

na cā'yamasiddho hetuḥ; karmatvenā'pratīyamānatvasya jñānākhye dharmiṇi vidyamānatvāt, na khalu ghaṭādyarthavat karmatvena jñānaṃ svapne'pi pratibhāsate, pratibhāsane vā karaṇātmano jñānāntarasya parikalpanā prasajyeta, tasyāpi pratyakṣatve karaṇātmakaṃ jñānāntaramaparaṃ parikalpyeta ityanavasthā
tasyāpratyakṣatve'pi karaṇatve prathame ko'paritoṣaḥ yenā'sya tathā karaṇatvaṃ neṣyate ? na ca ekasyaiva jñānasya parasparaviruddhakarma-karaṇākārābhyupagamo yuktaḥ; anyatra tathā pratītyabhāvāt
tasmādetaddoṣaparijihīrṣayā jñānasya pratyakṣarūpatā''grahaṃ parityajya pratītyanatikrameṇa parokṣarūpataivā'bhyupagantavyā
indriyā'rthasamprayogādisāmagrīto hi kriyāsvabhāvam ātmani jñānamutpadyamānaṃ nityaparokṣarūpameva utpadyate
nanūtpannāyāṃ buddhau jñāto'rtha ucyate nānutpannāyām, ataḥ pūrvaṃ buddhiḥ utpadyate paścājjñāto'rthaḥ ? satyam; pūrvaṃ buddhirutpadyate na tu pūrvaṃ jñāyate
bhavati hi kadācidetad yajjñāto'pyarthaḥ sannajñāta ityucyate
na ca arthavyapadeśamantareṇa buddheḥ rūpopalambhanam, tasmānna vyapadeśyā buddhiravyapadeśyañca na pratyakṣam
asmanmate jñātatāliṅgakānumānenaiva buddhergrahaṇāṅgīkārāt, tasya ca arthagrahaṇottarakālīnatvāt na pratibandhakābhāvamātreṇa arthagrahaṇasamaye buddhergrahaṇaṃ bhavitumarhati
saṃvittayaiva hi saṃvit saṃvedyā na saṃvedyatayā
keyaṃ vāco yuktiḥ saṃvedyā na saṃvedyeti ? iyamiyaṃ vāco yuktiḥ nāsyāḥ karmabhāvo vidyate ityarthaḥ
karma ca saṃvedyābhidheyaṃ na saṃvit, tasmānna pṛthak saṃvedyatayā grahītuṃ śakyate
na cā'saṃvedyaiva saṃvit tanmūlatvāt sarvabhāvānāṃ saṃvedyabhāvasya
kiṃ tarhi ? ānumānikam, phalameva hi pramāṇam iti pramāṇavido manyante pṛ॰ 64 kimasaṃvedyameva vijñānam ? bāḍhamasamvedyaṃ na tvaprameyam
kaḥ punaḥ prameyasaṃvedyayorviśeṣaḥ ? yatra hi viṣayasya svarūpaṃ paricchidyate tatsaṃvedyamityucyate ataḥ saṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣamiti pramāṇavidaḥ asambedanā ca pramitiḥ jñāne ākārāntarāgrahaṇāt
kṣaṇikatvāccāsya pratyakṣatā na saṃbhavatipṛ॰ 65 tasmānna buddhiviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam, arthaviṣayaṃ hi tat ataḥ siddhamānumānikatvaṃ buddheḥ phalataḥ pṛ॰ 67 bṛhatī 1
atha arthajñānamityucyate; tadapi notpattimātreṇa liṅgam prakaraṇapaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 63

na cāsya nityaparokṣarūpatve grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvād abhāvo'nuṣajyata ityabhidhātavyam; pratyakṣato hi tatpratītyabhāvānnityaparokṣarūpatā, na punarmūlato'pi grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt, arthāpattyākhyasyatadgrāhakapramāṇasya sadbhāvāt

tathāhi–kriyā na kācit niṣphalā saṃbhavati iti jñānakriyā prakaṭanākhyaṃ phalam arthe prādurbhāvayati, tasmācca phalāt pratiprāṇi suprasiddhāt anyathā'nupapadyamānād ātmani ahampratyayagrāhye nityaparokṣaṃ kriyārūpaṃ jñānamupakalpyata iti
uktañca–apratyakṣā no buddhiḥ pratyakṣo'rthaḥ, sa hi bahirdeśasambaddhaḥ pratyakṣamanubhūyate, jñāte tvanumānādavagacchati buddhim

pravṛttyanyathānupapattyā ca jñānamanumīyate, ajñāte pravṛttiviṣaye pravṛttyanupapatte, prayojanārthī hi puruṣa kadācit pravartate kadācinna pravartate ityatra na jñānādanyat tadā tatpravṛtte kāraṇamasti

na hi iṣṭasādhano'pyartha svarūpeṇaiva pravṛttiheturghaṭate sarvadā pravṛttiprasaṅgāt, na caivam, ata kādācitkatvāt pravṛtte arthā' tiriktam anyadapi kiñcitkāraṇamasti ityavagamyate yasmin sati arthaḥ pravṛttiyogyatāmāpadyate, tacca jñānamiti
arthāpatti jñānasya pramāṇam, sā ca arthasya jñātatvānyathānupapattiprabhavā
jñāte tvarthe paścāttajjñātatvānupapattyā arthāpattipramāṇamupajāyate mīmā॰ ślo॰ ṭī॰ sū॰ 1
jñānakriyā hi sakarmikā karmabhūte'rthe phala janayati pākādivat
tacca phalamaindriyakajñānajanyamāpārokṣyam liṅgādijñānajanya tu pārokṣyamityucyate tadeva ca phalaṃ kāryabhūtaṃ kāraṇabhūta vijñānamupakalpayatīti siddhyatyapratyakṣamapi jñānam
athavā jñānakriyādvārako ya karttṛbhūtasya ātmana karmabhūtasya ca arthasya paraspara sambandho vyāptṛvyāpyatvalakṣaṇa sa mānasapratyakṣāvagato vijñāna kalpayati
na āgantukakāraṇamantareṇa ātmano'rtha prati vyāptṛtvamutpattumarhati, tacca kāraṇa loke jñānaśabdena abhidhīyate śāstradī॰ 1
yattāvaduktam–karmatvenā'pratīyamānatvāt iti; tad ātmanā phalajñānena cā'naikāntikam tayo karmatvenā'pratīyamānayorapi pratyakṣatvenā'bhyupagamāt
atha anayo karmatvenā'pratītāvapi kartṛtvena phalatvena ca pratīte pratyakṣatā iṣyate, tarhi pramāṇā'bhimatajñānasya karmatvenā'pratītāvapi karaṇatvena pratīte pratyakṣatā iṣyatām aviśeṣāt

atha karaṇatvena pratīyamānaṃ jñāna karaṇameva syānna pratyakṣam, tarhi kartṛpha larūpatayā pratīyamānayoḥ ātma-phalajñānayoḥ kartṛ-phalarūpataiva syānna pratyakṣatā ityapyastu tulyākṣepasamādhānatvāt
kathañcit pratibhāsate ca karma ca na bhavatīti vyādhātasya pratipāditatvāt
kabhañcāyaṃ phalajñāna karmatvenā'pratibhāsamānamapi pratyakṣamupayan karaṇajñānaṃ tathā nopaiti ? tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 46

kiñca, sakalapramāṇāpekṣayā jñānasya karmatvā'prasiddhiḥ, svarūpā'pekṣayā vā ? yadi sakalapramāṇāpekṣayā; tadā sattvamapyasya atidurlabham; tathāhi–yat sarvapramāṇāpekṣayā karma na bhavati na tat sat yathā kharaviṣāṇam, sarvapramāṇāpekṣayā na bhavati ca karma vivakṣitaṃ pramāṇābhimataṃ jñānamiti

evaṃ pramāṇāntareṣvapyayameva nyāyaḥ ityakhilapramāṇānāmasattvaprasaṅge prameye kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ pramāṇanibandhanatvāt prameyavyavasthāyāḥ ? iti pūtkurvato'pi dvijasya sakalaśūnyatāpātaḥ syāt, taṃ parijihīrṣatā jñānasya apratyakṣatve'pi pramāṇāntarāt pratītirabhyupagantavyā iti karmatvenā'pratīyamānatvāt ityasyā'siddhatvam
astu nāma asya pramāṇāntarāt pratīyamānatvaṃ na tu karmatvam; iti cā'yuktam; pratīyamānasya akarmatvavirodhāt, pratīyamānatvaṃ hi grāhyatvamucyate, tadeva ca karmatvamiti
sākṣāt pratīyamānatvaṃ hi viṣayīkriyamāṇatvaṃ viṣayatvameva ca karmatvam

atha svarūpāpekṣayā karmatvā'prasiddhiḥ; tadapyanubhavaviruddhatvādayuktam; suprasiddho hi ghaṭagrāhijñānaviśiṣṭamātmānaṃ svato'hamanubhavāmi ityanubhava, tatprasiddhatvācca jñāne karmatvaprasiddhiriti ddheriti kathaṃ svarūpāpekṣayā tatra karmatvasyā'prasiddhi anubhavena na viruddhyate ? pratītisiddhasyāpyatra pratyakṣatvasya karmatvasya cā'pahnave arthe tatsadbhāve kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ iti kathaṃ tasya vyatirekadṛṣṭāntatā syāt ? prasaṅga-viparyayābhyāñcāsya pratyakṣatāsiddhiḥ; tathā hi– yat parokṣaṃ na tat svopadhānena anyamupalambhayati yathā indriyam, parokṣañca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaṃ jñānam iti prasaṅgaḥ
viparyayastu–yat svākāropahitam ākārāntaramupalambhayati tat parokṣaṃ na bhavati pratyakṣaṃ vā bhavati, yathā pradīpādyālokaḥ, upalambhayati ca jñānaṃ svākāropahitaṃ nīlādikam iti
sādhyasādhanayorvyāpyavyāpakabhāvasiddhau hi vyāpyābhyupagamo vyāpakābhyupagamanāntarīyako yatra pradarśyate tatprasaṅgasādhanam
kiñca, buddhe svasaṃvedanapratyakṣā'gocaratve kutaḥ tatsattvaṃ siddhyet ? pramāṇāntarāccet–ki pratyakṣarūpāt, anumānarūpādvā ? na tāvat pratyakṣarūpāt; matāntarānupraveśaprasaṅgāt
tasya khalu utpattiḥ liṅgād bhavati, na ca jñānena avinābhūta kiñcilliṅgaṃ saṃbhavati

taddhi indriyam, artha, tadatiśaya, tatsambandha, tatra pravṛttirvā bhavet ? yadi indriyam, tadā tadapi ki nirviśiṣṭam, viśiṣṭaṃ vā taddhetu syāt ? yadi nirviśiṣṭam, tarhi supta-matta-mūrcchitā-'nyatragatacittāvasthāsvapi buddhe anumānaprasaṅga indriyasadbhāvasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt

atha viśiṣṭamindriyaṃ taddhetu, taccātra nāsti tenā'yamadoṣa, nanu kena viśeṣeṇa indriyasya viśiṣṭatvam–anāvaraṇatvena, praguṇamanaḥsahakṛtatvena vā ? na tāvadanāvaraṇatvena, asya pratyakṣata pratyetumaśakyatvāt, apratipannasya ca hetuviśeṣaṇatve viśeṣaṇā' siddho hetu syāt
viśeṣyāsiddhaśca, tathāhi–śaktiḥ indriyam, śaktiśca adhyakṣata pratyetumaśavayā iti
viṣayaparicchittyā anāvaraṇendriyasiddhau anyonyāśraya, tathāhi–viṣayaparicchitti buddhi, tatsiddhau anāvaraṇatvopetamindriyaṃ siddhyati, tathābhūtendriyasiddhau ca viṣayaparicchitti siddhyatīti
etena praguṇamana sahakṛtatvamapi pratyākhyātam, manaso'tīndriyasya praguṇatvadharmopetasya viṣayaparicchitteranyataḥ pratyetumaśakyatvā'viśeṣāt, tatra ca itaretarāśrayadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt
taddhi arthajñaptirindriyāthau tatsahakāripraguṇaṃ mano vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 32 u॰
atha artho liṅgam, so'pi ki sattāmātreṇa liṅgam, jñātatvaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo vā ? prathamapakṣo'nupapanna, tathābhūtasyāsya vyabhicārāt
na khalu yatra yadā sattāviśiṣṭo'rtha tatra tadā buddhi anumātu śakyā, tāmantareṇā'pi asya saṃbhavata avinābhāvā'bhāvāt
yasya tu yena avinābhāva na tat tadabhāve saṃbhavati yathā'gnerabhāve dhūma, saṃbhavati ca buddherabhāve'pyartha iti
sattāmātreṇa cā'numāpakatve sarvārthasattāyā sarvapuruṣān prati aviśiṣṭatvāt sarvabuddhyanumāna syāt
atha etaddopād bibhyatā jñātena artho viśiṣyate jñāto'rtha tatkalpaka iti, atrāpi jñātatvena artho jñāta, ajñāto vā tatkalpaka syāt ? ajñātasya kalpakatve sarva sarvasya kalpakaṃ syād aviśeṣāt
atha jñātaḥ; ki tata eva jñānāt, tadantarādvā ? tata eva jñāptau anyonyāśraya–siddhehi jñātatvaviśiṣṭe'rthe tato jñānasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca arthasya jñātatvasiddhiriti

na ca ajñāte jñāte jñātaviśiṣṭatā'rthasya ghaṭate, tathāhi–yo yadviśeṣaṇapūrvaka pratyaya sa tasmin viśeṣaṇe jñāte satyeva prādurbhavati, yathā daṇḍaviśeṣaṇapūrvako daṇḍī iti pratyayaḥ, jñāta-viśeṣaṇapūrvakaśca jñāto'rtha iti pratyaya, tasmāt jñāta-viśeṣaṇe jñāte satyeva upapadyata iti
tajjñaptau ca sa eva paramatapraveśa anavasthā ca
na ca jñātatvaviśiṣṭasyā'rthasya jñānena vinā'nupapadyamānatvāt jñānakalpakatvamityabhidhātavyam, anupapadyamānatāmātrasyā'gamakatvāt
na hi dhūmādayo'nupapadyamānatāmātreṇa gamakāḥ; nālikeradvīpā''yātaṃ pratyapi teṣāṃ gamakatvaprasaṅgāt
ki tarhi ? jñātāḥ santaḥ, tathā artho'pi jñātatvaviśiṣṭatayā jñāta eva jñānasya gamako yuktaḥ iti

atha arthātiśayo liṅgam, nanu ko'yam arthasya atiśayo nāma ? prākaṭyam iti cet; tat kiṃ jñānam, jñānaviṣayatvam, prakāśatāmātraṃ vā ? yadi jñānam; tadā tasyā'siddhatvāt kathaṃ liṅgatvam ? na ca ātmasiddhau ātmana eva liṅgatvaṃ kvāpi pratipannam yenā'trāpi tathā kalpyeta
atha jñānaviṣayatvam; tadapi jñānā'siddhau na siddhyati ityuktam

atha prakāśatāmātram; tadapi jñānadharmaḥ, arthadharmaḥ, ubhayadharmaḥ, svatantraṃ vā syāt ? yadi jñānadharmaḥ; tarhi jñānaṃ prakāśate ityetāvadeva prāpnoti, na punaḥ arthaḥ prakāśate iti, anyadharmasya anyatra vyapadeśā'hetutvāt
yo yaddharmona bhavati na sa tatra tathā vyapadeśahetuḥ yathā paṭaraktatā rajate, na bhavati ca jñānadharmatayā prakāśamānatā arthasya dharmaḥ, tasmānna arthaḥ prakāśate iti vyapadeśaheturiti
atha arthadharmaḥ; sa ki sādhāraṇaḥ, asādhāraṇo vā ? prathamapakṣe sarvadā sarvān prati aviśeṣeṇaiva artho'vabhāseta na tu kadācit kañcana prati, prakāśarūpatāyāḥ sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭatvāt
na khalu pradīpaḥ prakāśarūpatāmāpannaḥ kiñcitprakāśate kiñcinna iti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ
atha yadindriyeṇa upakṛtaḥ asādhāraṇataddharmo'rthaḥ sampannaḥ tasyaiva prakāśate nānyeṣām
nanu indriyāṇāṃ svārthaprakāśakajñānajananāt nā'paraṃ tadupakārakatvaṃ pratīyate, etacca tajjñānasya arthadharmatve sarvān prati aviśiṣṭam
na hi nīlatādyarthadharmaḥ yenaiva janyate tasyaiva prakāśate iti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ

kiñca, arthaprakāśāt nityaparokṣe jñāne'numīyamāne jñānaṃ mama abhūta ityanumānaṃ syāt tasya tatprakāśāt pūrvakālabhāvitvāt, tathābhūtasya ca jñānasyā'numāne sva-parasambandhitvavibhāgo durlabhaḥ syāt
kiñca, mukhyataḥ arthasya prakāśamānatā dharmaḥ, upacārato vā syāt ? na tāvanmukhyataḥ; jñānā'napekṣayā tatra tatsiddhiprasaṅgāt

yatra hi yatsvarūpaṃ mukhyataḥ prasiddham tatra tat parā'napekṣam yathā vahnau bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśasvarūpam, mukhyato'bhyupagamyate ca arthe prakāśamānatādharmaḥ, tasmāt jñānā'napekṣa eva syāt, na caivam, jñāne satyeva sarvadā tatra tatpratīteḥ
upacārataḥ tatra taddharmā'bhyupagame tu na kiñcidaniṣṭam, mukhyato hi prakāśamānatā jñānasya dharmaḥ, sā tadviṣayatvād arthe upacaryate
kutaḥ punarjñānasyotpadyamānasya svaparaprakāśatā bhavatīti cet ? svābhāvyāt divākarasya karasampattivat, na hi divākarasya karasampattiḥ kenacit kriyate, tathā atra svaparaprakāśatā iti
tathā ca asya svasaṃviditatvasiddhe, tatastasya anumeyatā'nupa patti
ubhayadharmapakṣe tu pramāṇa-prameyavyavahārābhāvaprasaṅga dvayoḥ prakāśadharmatayā tulyatvāt

jñānakṛtā hi arthasya tatparicchidyamānatayā prameyatā, dvayośca prakāśamānasvarūpayo tulyatve ki kena kriyate ? prayoga–yad yato yena vapuṣā na vyatiricyate na tat tasya tathārūpatve vyāpriyate yathā ghaṭo ghaṭāntarasya pṛthubudhnodarākāratayā, na vyatiricyate ca jñānam arthāt prakāśarūpatayā iti
svātantrye ca prakāśatāyāḥ jñānāpekṣā'nupapatti, svātantryasya pāratantryaparihāreṇā'vasthitatvāt
yad yatra svatantraṃ na kartṛtra na tattatra paramapekṣate yathā rājā svakārye, svatantrā ca arthānāṃ prakāśamānatā iti
kiñca, iyaṃ prakāśamānatā arthādabhinnā, bhinnā vā syāt ? yadyabhinnā, tadā artha eva sā, tasya ca sadā sattvāt tasyā api sadā sattvaprasaṅgāt sarvaṃ jagat sarvadā sarvajñamakiñcijjñaṃ vā syāt

atha bhinnā, tadā'sau tatra sambaddhā, asambaddhā vā ? yadyasambaddhā, katham arthasya iti vyapadiśyeta ? yad yenā'sambaddhaṃ na tat tasya iti vyapadiśyate yathā sahyasya vindhya, arthenā'sambaddhā ca prakāśamānatā iti
atha sambaddhā, ki tādātmyena, tadutpattyā, saṃyogena vā ? na tāvattādātmyena, bhedapakṣasya aṅgīkṛtatvāt, bheda-tādātmyayośca anyonyaṃ virodhāt
nāpi tadutpattyā; yataḥ arthāt ki prakāśatā utpadyate, tato vā'rthaḥ ? na tāvadarthāt prakāśatā utpadyate, jñānāt tadutpattipratijñānāt
nāpi prakāśatāto'rthaḥ, svakāraṇakalāpāt prakāśatāta pūrvamapi asyotpannatvāt
nāpi saṃyogena prakāśatā arthe sambaddhā, tasya dravyavṛttitvena adravyarūpāyāṃ prakāśatāyāṃ saṃbhavā'bhāvāt
astu vā kenacit sambandhena sambaddhā'sau, tathāpi arthamātreṇa asau sambaddhā, arthaviśeṣeṇa vā ? arthamātreṇa sambandhe, sa eva aśeṣasya jagato'śeṣajñatvasya akiñcijjñatvasya vā prasaṅga
ghaṭasya āsīdatra prakāśatā, idānī tu paṭasya iti pratiniyatadeśa-kālaviśiṣṭe pratiniyate'rthe tadvyapadeśā'bhāvaśca syāt
atha arthaviśeṣeṇa, nanu ko'yam arthasya viśeṣaḥ–jñānajanakatvam, ālambanatvaṃ vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ, jñānajanakatvasya arthe nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
dvitīyavikalpe'pyanyonyāśnaya–arthasya ālambanatvasiddhau hi prakāśatāyāḥ arthaviśeṣe sambandhasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca arthasya ālambanatvasiddhiriti
nāpi tatsambandha, tasya sambandhijñānapūrvakatvāt, sambandhinau cā'tra indriyā'rthau jñānā'rthau atiśayā'rthau vā na jñātuṃ śakyete, yathā caiṣāṃ jñātumaśaktiḥ tathā pratipāditameva
atha pravṛttyā jñānamanumīyate, tarhi nivarttakasya jñānasya kathaṃ pratipatti syāt ? pravṛttyā hi pravarttakameva jñānamanumīyate na nivarttakam
atha pravṛtti-nivṛttībhyāṃ jñānamupakalpyate; tarhi tayorabhāve udāsīnasya upekṣamāṇārthavijñānaṃ kathaṃ kalpyeta ?
astu vā kiñcilliṅgam; tathāpi agṛhītapratibandhaṃ tat na parokṣāṃ buddhimanumāpayituṃ samartham, sarvatrā'sya gṛhītapratibandhasya svasādhyā'numāpakatvapratīteḥ
na ca jñānam, tena cā'vinābhūtaṃ kiñcilliṅgaṃ kenacit pramāṇena pratipannaṃ yataḥ sambandhagrahaṇapurassaramanumānaṃ pravarteta

na ca aparokṣasya svayaṃ prakāśasvabhāvasya ātmanaḥ kriyā nityaparokṣā yuktā; tathāhi–yā'sau svayaṃ prakāśamānasyā''tmanaḥ prakāśakriyā sā nityaparokṣā na bhavati, prakāśakriyātvāt, pradīpādeḥ prabhābhārakriyāvaditi
kiñca, jñānamutpadyamānaṃ svā'nubhavena tadanubhavavyāvṛttaṃ saṃvedyate, arthaścāsya viṣayabhāvamāpanna eva saṃvedyate arthamahaṃ jānāmi iti pratīteḥ
nityā'numeyatve ca jñānasya ubhayamapi durghaṭam, artho hi prakāśamānaḥ sarvān prati sādhāraṇaḥ iti jñānasya parokṣatve mama prakāśate iti nirnibandhanā vyavasthitiḥ
tasmāduktadoṣebhyo bibhyatā jñānasya parokṣatā''grahagrahā'bhiniveśaṃ parityajya svasaṃvidrūpatā abhyupagantavyā iti
jñāna jñānāntaravedya prameyatvāt iti vadato neyāyikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu jñānasya svasaṃviditatvamayuktaṃ jñānāntaravedyatvasyaivātropapannatvāt; tathā ca anumānam– jñānaṃ jñānāntaravedyaṃ prameyatvāt ghaṭādivat
nāpi īśvarajñānena anaikāntikaḥ, asmadādijñānāpekṣayā jñānāntaravedyatvā'bhyupagamāt, īśvarajñānasya ca asmadādijñānād viśiṣṭatvāt
na ca viśiṣṭe dṛṣṭaṃ dharmam aviśiṣṭe'pi yojayan prekṣāvattāṃ labhate, aśeṣārthagrāhitvasyā'pi aśeṣajñānānāṃ tadvat prasaṅgāt

nanu svasaṃviditasvabhāvam arthajñānaṃ pratyakṣata eva pratīyate, tataḥ pratyakṣabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭa evā'yam; ityapyasāmpratam; jñānasya svasaṃviditasvabhāvatvā'saṃbhavāt, arthagrahaṇasvabhāvatayaivāsya vyavasthitatvāt
yadyevam artha-jñānayoḥ krameṇotpannayoḥ tathaivopalambhaḥ syāditi cet; na, anayo kramabhāve'pi āśuvṛttyā utpalapatraśatacchedavad yaugapadyā'bhimānato bhedenā'nupalambhasaṃbhavāt

na ca arthajñānasya jñānāntarapratyakṣatve tasyāpi aparajñānapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgād anavasthā syādityabhidhātavyam, arthajñānasya dvitīyena asyāpi tṛtīyena grahaṇād arthasiddheḥ aparajñānakalpanā'narthakyato'navasthāsaṃbhavā'bhāvāt
arthajijñāsāyāṃ hi arthe jñānamutpadyate jñānajijñāsāyāṃ tu jñāne, pratīteravaṃvidhatvāt
ye ye pratyayā te sarve pratyayāntaravedyāḥ yathā na pratyayāntareṇaiva vedyā ?
tathā ca vijñānasya svasavedane tadeva tasya karma kriyā ceti viruddhamāpadyeta
yatpratyayatvaṃ vastubhūtamavirodhena vyāptaṃ tadviruddhavirodhadarśanāt svasavedanānnivarttamānaṃ pratyayāntaravedyatvena vyāpyate iti pratibandhasiddhi
tathā ca na svasaṃvedanaṃ jñānamiti siddham
atha tadeva jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ prameyaṃ phalañceti; tanna, anyatra tritayasyābhedādarśanāt, bhede tvanekaṃ daṇḍādyudāharaṇam
ato na jñāne karaṇakarmaṇorabhedaḥ svasaṃvedyatvam, nāpi kriyākarmaṇoriti

ye tu svasavedanasvabhāvaṃ tad abhyupagacchanti te praṣṭavyā–ki svena saṃvedanaṃ svasaṃvedanam, svakīyena vā ? yadi svakīyena, tadā siddhasādhanam, svakīyena anantarottarajñānena prāktanajñānasya saṃvedanā'bhyupagamāt
atha svena ātmanaiva saṃvedanaṃ svasavedanam, tadayuktam, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt, na hi sutīkṣṇo'pi khaṅga ātmānaṃ chinatti, suśikṣito'pi vā baṭuḥ svaskandhamārohati
tathā cedamayuktam–jñāna svaprakāśātmakam arthaprakāśakatvāt pradīṣavat iti
svaprakāśātmakatvañca bodharūpatvam, bhāsurarūpasambandhitva vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ pradīpe bodharūpatvasyā'sabhavāt
atha bhāsurarūpasambandhitvam, tasya jñāne'tyantā'sattvāt kathaṃ sādhyatā ? anyathā pratyakṣabādhā
svātmani vṛttivirodhāt, na hi tadeva aṅgutyagraṃ tenaiva aṅgutyagreṇa spṛśyate, saivā'sidhārā tayaivā'sivārayā chidyate
tatra yadi prakāśaktva bodharūpatva vivakṣita tadā sādhanavikalamudāharaṇam, pradope bodharūpatvasyāsaṃbhavāt
atha prakāśakatva bhāsvararūpasambandhitva tadvijñāne nāstyato jñānāntarasya tadviṣayasyotpāda eva jñānasya pariccheda iti

kiñca, ki yenaiva ātmanā jñānam ātmānaṃ prakāśayati tenaivā'rtham, svabhāvāntareṇa vā ? yadi tenaiva, kathaṃ jñānā'rthayo bheda abhinnasvabhāvagrahaṇagrāhyatvāt tadanyatarasvarūpavat ? atha svabhāvāntareṇa, tadā tau svabhāvau tato'bhinnau, na vā ? yadyabhinnau; tatrāpi ki tābhyāṃ jñānam abhinnam, jñānādvā tau ? tatrādyavikalpe tau eva na jñānam, tasya tatraivā'nupraveśāt tatsvarūpavat

dvitīyavikalpe tu jñānameva na tau, tayoratraivā'nupraveśāt, tathā ca katha jñānaṃ svā'rthayoḥ prakāśakaṃ syāt ? atha bhinnau; tatrāpi kiṃ tau svasaṃviditau, svāśrayajñānaviditau vā ? prathamapakṣe svasaṃviditajñānatrayaprasaṅgaḥ, tatrāpi pratyekaṃ svaparaprakāśasvabhāvadvayātmakatve sa eva paryanuyogaḥ anavasthā ca
dvitīyapakṣe'pi sva-paraprakāśahetubhūtayoḥ tayoryadi jñānaṃ tathāvidhena svabhāvadvayena prakāśakam; tarhi anavasthā
yattāvaduktam–prameyatvāt iti sādhanam; ataḥ kim asmadādijñānasya jñānāntaravedyatvaṃ prasādhyate, jñānasāmānyasya vā ? yadi jñānasāmānyasya; tadā īśvarajñānena anekāntaḥ

hṛnniviṣṭaṃ tad iti cet; kathaṃ kośapānādṛte ayamarthaḥ pratīyate ? astu vā, tathāpi tat kiṃ pakṣasya viśeṣaṇam, hetorvā ? yadi pakṣasya; tadā īśvarajñānam apakṣo'stu, hetustu tatra pravartamānaḥ kena niṣiddhyate yena anaikāntiko na syāt ?

kiñca, īśvarajñānaṃ svasaṃviditatvād anena vyavacchidyate, sarvadā parokṣatvāt, sadā'prameyatvādvā ? svasaṃviditatvāccet; kutastasya tatsiddhiḥ–yuktitaḥ, abhyupagamamātrādvā ? abhyupagamamātrāt tatsiddhau sarvaṃ sarvasya iṣṭaṃ siddhyet
atha yuktitaḥ; kā'tra yuktiḥ ? arthagrahaṇātmakatvam, jñānatvaṃ vā ? dvayamapi cedam asmadādijñāne'styeva ityubhayatra svasaṃviditatvaṃ siddhyet na vā kvacidapi aviśeṣāt

nanu ca īśvarajñānasya asmadādijñānād viśiṣṭatvāt tatraiva svasaṃviditatvaṃ yuktam nānyatra, na hi viśiṣṭe dṛṣṭaṃ dharmam aviśiṣṭe'pi yojayan prekṣāvattāṃ labhate; ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; jñānatvasya arthagrahaṇātmakatvasya ca īśvarajñāne viśiṣṭe dṛṣṭasya dharmasya asmadādijñāne pratiṣedhaprasaṅgāt

nanu jñānatvasya arthagrahaṇātmakatvasya cā'bhāve kathaṃ tat jñānaṃ syāt tasya tatsvabhāvatvāt ? ityanyatrāpi samānam, na hi svasaṃviditatvasvabhāvasyāṣyabhāve jñānasya jñānatā yuktā; tasyāpi tatsvabhāvatvā'viśeṣāt
na hi īśvarajñāne jñānatva-arthagrahaṇātmakatvābhyāmiva svasaṃviditatvenāpi vinā jñānasvabhāvatā dṛṣṭā evamanyatrāpi
na ca svabhāva prādeśiko yukta ālokasya svaparaprakāśatāvat
na khalu svaparaprakāśatā ādityālokamyaiva svabhāva na pradīpādyālokasya, ubhayatrāpyaviśeṣatastatpratīteḥ
atha asmadādijñānasya īśvarajñānavat svaparavyavasāyātmakatve tadvat nikhilārthāvabhāsitvamapi syāt; tadasamīcīnam; yogyasyaivā'vabhāsanāt pradīpavat
na hi pradīpasya ādityavat svaparaprakāśasvabhāvatve'pi tadvannikhilārthasya prakāśakatva dṛṣṭam, yogyasyaiva niyatadeśārthasya anena prakāśanāt, evamatrāpi
na hi tadabhāve viṣayagrahaṇatāratamya teṣāṃ ghaṭate ityagre prasādhayiṣyate
asmadādijñānāpekṣayā arthajñānasya jñānāntaravedyatvaṃ prameyatvahetunā sādhyate, tato neśvarajñānena vyabhicāraḥ tasya asmadādijñānād viśiṣṭatvāt
na hi viśiṣṭe dṛṣṭaṃ dharmamaviśiṣṭe'pi ghaṭayan prekṣāvattāṃ labhate
nāpi sarvadā parokṣatvāt, mīmāṃsakamatānupraveśaprasaṅgāt, na hi naiyāyikaiḥ sarvadā parokṣaṃ kiñcijjñānamiṣyate
tatparokṣatve ca katham īśvarasya sarvajñatvam ? tato'nyasyā'śeṣārthasya grahaṇāta tattvam, ityapyayuktam, jñānasyā'grahaṇe tena arthagrahaṇā'yogāt
nahi asavedyamānā'nubhavād artho'nubhūto nāma, ātmāntarapratyakṣato'pi arthapratyakṣatāprasaṅgāt, na khalu tatra asvasaṃviditatvād anyad apratyakṣatākāraṇamasti
yad yatra samavetaṃ tat tatra pratyakṣatākāraṇam na puna svasaṃviditatvam, ityapi manorathamātram, samavāyā'siddhau samavetatvā'siddhe
sadā' prameyatvā'bhyupagame ca īśvarajñānasya sarvadā'sattvaprasaṅga, yat sarvadā'prameyaṃ na tat kadācit sat yathā khapuṣpam, sarvadā'prameyañca īśvarajñānamiti
tata tasya sattvam arthagrahaṇañca icchatā mbasaviditasvabhāvatvamabhyupagantavyam, tadvadanyadapi
atha hetuviśeṣaṇam asmadādijñānatve sati prameyatvāt iti, tarhi sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭānta, tathābhūtasya hetoḥ ghaṭādidṛṣṭānte'saṃbhavāditi
yadapyuktam–arthagrahaṇaṃ buddhiścetanā ityādi, tadapyayuktam; svasaṃviditasvabhāvā'bhāve jñāne'rthagrahaṇasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
taddhi tatra arthādutpatte, cetanāto vā syāt ? tatra yadi arthādutpatterjñāne'rthagrahaṇamiṣyate, tarhi ghaṭe'pi tadiṣyatām cakrādyarthāt tadutpatterapyaviśeṣāt
atha cetanāta, nanu kuto jñānasya cetanāsiddhi–arthagrahaṇāt, cetanātmaprabhavatvādvā ? arthagrahaṇāccet; anyonyāśraya–siddhe hi arthagrahaṇe cetanāsiddhi, tatsiddheśca arthagrahaṇasiddhiriti
atha cetanātmaprabhavatvāt, nanu ātmano'pi kutaścetanatvaṃ siddhyet–cetanāsamavāyāt, svato vā ? yadi svata, jñānasyāpi tathā tadastu viśeṣā'bhāvāt
atha cetanāsamavāyāt; ayamaparo'nyonyāśraya–cetanāsamavāyāddhi ātmā cetana, tatprabhavatvācca buddhiścetanā iti
arthagrahaṇatva hi jñāne arthādutpatte cetanāsvarūpatvato vā bhavet ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 224

kiñca, arthagrahaṇa buddhiḥ ityatra kim arthasyaiva grahaṇaṃ buddhi ityavadhāryate, kiṃ vā arthasyāpi ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'dhyakṣaviruddhaḥ; nīlam ityullekhena arthagrahaṇavat aham ityullekhena ātmagrahaṇasyāpyanubhavāt
na hi nīlādisaṃvedanād bhinnakālaṃ tadātmasaṃvedanamanubhūyate; tatsaṃvedanasamakālameva antaḥ parisphuṭarūpasyā'nubhavāt
ato'rthasaṃvedanasya ātmasaṃvedanādabhinnasvabhāvatvāt tatsaṃvedane tadapi saṃviditam iti svasaṃvedanasiddhiḥ
yad yasmād abhinnasvabhāvaṃ tasmin gṛhyamāṇe tad gṛhītameva yathā nīle gṛhyamāṇe tasyaiva svarūpaṃ sanniveśādi, svarūpasaṃvedanād abhinnasvabhāvañca arthasaṃvedanamiti
atha arthasyāpi grahaṇam ityayaṃ pakṣaḥ kakṣīkriyate; tadā siddhasādhanaṃ svasaṃvedanā'pratikṣepāt
yadi ca jñānamasvasaṃviditasvabhāvam iṣyate; tadā tat ki parokṣaṃ syāt, jñānāntaravedyaṃ vā ? na tāvat parokṣam, matāntaraprasaṅgāt, tenā'pratyakṣeṇa arthapratyakṣa tāvirodhācca
tathāhi– yad avyaktavyaktikaṃ na tad vyaktam yathā kiñcit kenacid ajñānam, avyaktavyaktikañca nīlādikaṃ vastu iti
vyaktirhi jñānam, sā yadā avyaktā; tadā katham arthavyaktatopapannā, santānāntarajñānādapi arthavyaktatvā'nuṣaṅgāt
tasyāpi ca parokṣatve pratyakṣo'rtho na siddhyati

atha jñānāntaravedyaṃ tadiṣyate; tatrāpi kisahasambhūtajñānasaṃvedyam, uttarakālīnajñānasaṃvedyaṃ vā syāt ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; yugapajjñānānāmasaṃbhavāt, anyathā yugapajjñānā'nutpattirmanaso liṅgam nyāyasū॰ 1
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ; vicchinnapratibhāsā'bhāvāt, na khalu prāgarthajñānam, paścāttajjñānajñānam iti sāntarā pratītiranubhūyate
tataḥ grahaṇañca arthajñānasya ekātmasamavetā'nantarajñānena ityādi pratyākhyātam
kiñca, uttarakālīnajñānakāle tat prāktanajñānam anuvartate, na vā ? yadyanuvartate; sa eva jñānayaugapadyaprasaṅgaḥ, akṣaṇikatvā'nuṣaṅgaśca syāt

atha nā'nuvartate; kasya tarhi tad grāhakam grāhyasya prāgeva vilīnatvāt ? kiñca, indriyajaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pravartamānaṃ sambaddhe vartamāne ca viṣaye pravartate, atītakṣaṇavartinaśca jñānasya na vartamānatvam manolakṣaṇendriyasannikarṣo vā saṃbhavati, na ca asambaddhe avartamāne cā'rthe pravartamāna jñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yuktam, tatkathaṃ tatra mānasapratyakṣavārtā'pi syāt ? arthād utpannañca jñānam arthagrāhakam, na ca vinaṣṭasya janakatvam; asattvāt
na ca vinaśyadavasthasya janakatvaṃ yuktam; tathābhūtasya kārakatvā'darśanāt, na hi mriyamāṇasya pituḥ putraṃ prati kārakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam

kiñca, arthajñānotpattau niyamena tadgrāhakaṃ jñānamutpadyate, na vā ? prathamapakṣe na puruṣāyuṣeṇā' pi arthāntare jñānasya sañcāra jñānajñānotpattāveva ājanma manamo vyāpārāt, tathā ca anavasthāto nārtha arthajñānaṃ vā sidhyet
na ca apratyakṣeṇa arthajñānajñānena arthajñānasya, tena ca arthasya pratyakṣatā yuktā, santānāntarajñānādapi tatprasaṅgāt

atha tadutpattāvapi niyamena tannotpadyate, arthajijñāsāyāṃ hi arthe jñānamutpadyate, jñānajijñāsāyāṃ tu jñāne; tadapyasundaram, jñānasya jijñāsāprabhavatvā'saṃbhavāt, naṣṭāśvasya aśvadidṛkṣāyāṃ satyāmapi aśvadarśanā'nutpatte, asatyāmapi ca godidṛkṣāyāṃ taddarśanotpatteḥ
kiñca, arthajijñāsāyā satyām ahamutpannam iti tajjñānameva pratipadyate, jñānāntaraṃ vā ? prathamavikalpe jainamatasiddhi, tathā pratipadyamānaṃ hi jñāna svārthaparicchedakaṃ syāt
dvitīyavikalpe tu anavasthā–tatrāpi jijñāsāprabhavatvasya anyata pratīte

astu vā tatprabhavatayā tṛtīyādijñānā'nutpatti, tathāpi–arthajñānam ajñātameva mayā arthasya paricchedakam iti jñānāntaraṃ pratipadyate, na vā ? pratipadyate cet; tarhi deva tadevasva-paraparicchedakaṃ siddham

na pratipadyate cet, kathaṃ tathā pratipattiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? kiñca, arthajñānam artham ātmānañca pratipadya ajñātameva mayā jñānam arthaṃ jānāti iti jñānāntaraṃ pratīyāt, apratipadya vā ? prathamapakṣe triviṣayatvamasya prasajyate
dvitīyapakṣe tu atiprasaṅga ajñātameva mayā aṇudvayaṃ dvyaṇukamārabhate ityapi tat pratīyāditi
jñānasya jñānāntaragrāhyatve ca ajñānataivāsya syāt prakāśasya prakāśāntarāpekṣāyām aprakāśatāvat, na hi svasiddhau paramukhaprekṣitvaṃ vihāya anyaj jaḍasya lakṣaṇam
kiñcā'rthajñānamarthamātmānaṃ ca pratipadya yuktyanuśā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 9

kiñca, arthasaṃvedanāt tatsavedanasya bhede tathaiva upalambha kuto na syāt ? āśuvṛttyā utpalapatraśatacchedavad yaugapadyābhimānāditi cet; kathamevaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ na syāt ekatvādhyavasāyasya atrāpi āśuvṛttipravṛttatvāt iti bauddhenāpi abhidhātu śakyatvāt ? mūrtānāñca utpalapatrāṇāṃ mūrtena śū sūcyagreṇa cheda krameṇaiva yukta, yugapatprāptyabhāvāt

prayogaḥ–yo'yam auttarādharyakramāvasthitānāṃ mūrtānāmutpalapatrāṇāṃ mūrtena ekapuruṣavyāpārāt kṛtaḥ chedaḥ saḥ kramabhāvyeva, yathā tathābhūtānāṃ tāmrapatrāṇāṃ mūrtena sūcyagreṇa ekapuruṣavyāpārāt kṛtaśccheda iti

ātmanastu svaparaprakāśanasvabhāvasya avikalendriyasya aprāptārthaprakāśakasya amūrtasya yugapat svaviṣayaprakāśane ko virodhaḥ yato yugapajjñānotpattirna syāt ? na ca utpalapatraśatavat parasparaparihārasthitāni indriyāṇi sūcyagravanmūrtasya manasaḥ yugapatprāptumasamarthatvānna tathā tadutpattiḥ ityabhidhātavyam; bhavatkalpitasya manasaḥ ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāvasare nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
yadapyuktam–svena-ātmanaiva saṃvedanam svasaṃvedanam; tadayuktam; svātmani kriyāvirodhāt ityādi; tadapyasāram; īśvarajñānena pradīpādyālokena ca anekāntāt
na hi īśvarajñānaṃ svaprakāśane jñānāntaramapekṣate svaparāvabhāsakamekaṃ nityajñānaṃ jagatkarttuḥ ityabhyupagamāt
kā ca kriyā jñānasya svātmani viruddhyate–kim utpattirūpā, parispandātmikā, dhātvarthasvabhāvā, jñaptilakṣaṇā vā ? yadi utpattilakṣaṇā; sā viruddhyatām
na hi jñānam ātmānamutpādayati iti asmākamabhyupagamaḥ, svasāmagrītaḥ tadutpattipratijñānāt
nāpi parispandātmikā; tasyā dravyavṛttitvena adravyarūpe jñāne sattvasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
kā puna svātmani kriyā viruddhā, parispandarūpā, dhātvartharūpā vā ? tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 42
dhātvartharūpā'pi–akarmikā, sakarmikā vā kriyā svātmani viruddhyate ? na tāvadakarmikā; vṛkṣastiṣṭhati ityādau tasyāḥ svātmanyeva pratīteḥ
atha pratītitaḥ asyāstatrā'virodhaḥ; tarhi jñānaṃ prakāśate ityādyakarmakakriyāyāḥ jñānasvarūpe'pyavirodho'stu, pratīteḥ ubhayatrāpyaviśiṣṭatvāt

atha jñānam ātmānaṃ jānāti iti sakarmikā kriyā svātmani viruddhā, tato'nyatraiva karmatvapratīteḥ ityucyate; tadapyuktimātram; ātmā ātmānaṃ hanti, pradīpaḥ svātmānaṃ prakāśayati ityāderapi virodhā'nuṣaṅgāt

etena jñaptikriyāyāḥ svātmani virodhaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; svarūpeṇa kasyacid virodhā'siddheḥ, anyathā pradīpasyāpi svaparaprakāśanavirodhaḥ syāt, na caivam, ato yathā pradīpaḥ svakāraṇakalāpāt svaparaprakāśanasvabhāvo jāyamāno na virodhamadhyāste tathā jñānamapi
atha jñaptikriyā karmatayā svātmani viruddhyate tato'nyatraiva karmatvasya pratīteḥ; tarhi prakāśanakriyāpi pradīpasvarūpe tathā viruddhyatām svarūpādanyatraiva asyā api pratītyaviśiṣṭatvāt
svasāmagrītaḥ svapara prakāśanasvabhāvasya asyotpatte tasyāstatrā'virodha, ityanyatrāpi samānam

yadi caikatra dṛṣṭo dharma sarvatra vidhīyate pratiṣiddhyate vā, tarhi rathyāpuruṣe asarvajñatvopalambhāt maheśvare'pi tatprasaṅga, dvicandrādijñāne ca prāmāṇyapratiṣedhapratīteḥ ekacandrādijñāne'pi tatpratiṣedhaprasaṅga
atra vastuvaicitryasaṃbhave jñānena kimaparāddhaṃ yena tat tatra neṣyate ?
kiñca, jñānāntarāpekṣayā tatra karmatvavirodha, svarūpāpekṣayā vā ? prathamapakṣe maheśvarasya asarvajñatvam, ekātmasamavetā'nantarajñānagrāhyam arthajñānam
jñānāntarāpekṣayā tatra tasyā'virodhe ca svarūpāpekṣayāpi avirodho'stu, sahasrakiraṇavat svaparodyotanasvabhāvatvāttasya
karmatvavacca jñānakriyāto'rthāntarasyaiva karaṇatvasya pratīte tasyāpi tatra virodha syāt, tathā ca jñānena ahamarthaṃ jānāmi iti jñānasya karaṇatayā pratītirna syāt

atha arthavat jñāne jñānasvarūpasyā'pratīterna svata pratyakṣatā, nanu arthavat iti ko'rtha– ki yathā artho vahirdeśasambaddhaḥ pratīyate na tathā jñānam, ki vā yathā arthonmukhaṃ jñānaṃ na tathā svonmukham iti ? prathamavikalpe siddhasādhyatā, ghaṭādyartha-tajjñānayorbahirantardeśasambaddhatayā avabhāsanāt
ghaṭādyarthadeśasambaddhatayā jñānasyā'pratibhāsanād apratyakṣatve ghaṭādyarthasyāpi jñānadeśasambaddhatayā'pratibhāsanād apratyakṣatā syāt
dvitīyavikalpo'pyanupapanna, ghaṭam aham vedmi iti trayasyāpi pratibhāsanāt

kiñca, jñānasvarūpatā'pratibhāse kathaṃ tasya arthonmukhatvam anyadvā vyavasthāpayituṃ śakyam asya idam iti sambandhapratipatteḥ sambandhipratipattināntarīyakatvāt ? atha jñānāntareṇa jñāna pratītya arthonmukhatvamasya pratīyate; tadā āvṛttyā arthapratītiprasaṅgaḥ–prathamaṃ hi prathamajñāne'rthapratīti tato jñānāntare, kathamanyathā arthonmukhametat iti pratītiḥ syāt ? tato jñāne arthonmukhatvapratibhāsavat svonmukhatvapratibhāso'pyabhyupagamyatām alaṃ pratītyapalāpena

kaśca kriyāyā svātmā yatra asyā virodha pratipādyate–ki tasyā svarūpam, kriyāvadātmā vā syāt ? tatra ādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; svarūpasyāvirodhakatvāt, anyathā sarvabhāvānāṃ svarūpe virodhā'nuṣaṅgāt ni svarūpatvaprasaṅga syāt
virodhasya dviṣṭhatvācca na asyāḥ svarūpe virodho yukta

dvitīyavikalpo'pyanupapannaḥ; kriyāvatyeva akhilakriyāṇāṃ pratīte, anyathā sarvadravyāṇāṃ niṣkriyatvaṃ kriyāṇāñca nirāśrayatvaṃ syāt, na caivam, kartṛsthāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ karttari karmasthāyāśca karmaṇi pratīyamānatvāt
svātmā hi kriyāyā svarūpaṃ kriyāvadātmā vā ? āptaparī॰ pṛ॰ 47

yadapyabhihitam–prakāśatvaṃ bodharūpatvam, bhāsurarūpasambandhitvaṃ vā ityādi; tadapya bhidhānamātram; yataḥ arthaprakāśakatvam arthodyotakatvam ucyate tacca kvacid bodharūpatayā kvacid bhāsurarūpatayā vā na virodhamadhyāste

yaccānyaduktam–yenaivā''tmanā jñānamātmānaṃ prakāśayati tenaivārtham ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; svabhāva-tadvatoḥ bhedā'bhedaṃ prati anekāntāt, jñānātmanā hi svabhāvatadvato abhedaḥ, svaparaprakāśasvabhāvātmanā ca bhedaḥ, iti jñānameva abhedaḥ, tatsvabhāvau eva bhedaḥ ityuktadoṣā'navakāśaḥ
kalpitayostu bhedā'bhedayoḥ taddūṣaṇapravṛttau svābhiprāya eva pratiṣiddhaḥ syānna vastusvarūpam
na caivaṃ kasyacid iṣṭatattvavyavasthā ghaṭate; tathā tatpravṛtteḥ sarvatra saṃbhavāt
sva-paragrahaṇasvabhāvau ca jñānasya tatprakāśanasāmarthye, tadrūpatayā ca asya parokṣatā, tatprakāśanalakṣaṇakāryā'numeyatvāt tayoḥ, ityuktadoṣā'navakāśaḥ iti
svabhāvatadvato bhedābhedaṃ pratyanekāntāt prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 38 pū॰
etena sāṅkhyo'pi jñānasya jñānāntaravedyatvaṃ pratipādayan pratyākhyātaḥ
acetanatvāt na jñāna svavyavasāyātmakam iti sākhyasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu jñānaṃ svavyavasāyātmakaṃ na bhavati acetanatvāt paṭādivat
na cāsya acetanatvamasiddham; tathāhi–acetanaṃ jñānam pradhānapariṇāmatvāt tadvadeva
yat punaścetanam tanna pradhānapariṇāmaḥ yathā ātmā, pradhānapariṇāmaśca jñānam iti
pradhānasya hi jagatprapañcaracanāyāṃ pravartamānasya prathamato mahān eko vyāpako viṣayādhyavasāyasvarūpa āsargapralayasthāyī bhavati āsargapralayādekā buddhiḥ ityabhidhānāt
sa ca asmādṛ śāmasaṃvedyasvabhāva, tatastu yā pratiprāṇi vibhinnā indriya-manovṛttidvāreṇa buddhivṛttayo nissaranti tā pramāṇāntareṇa saṃvedyasvabhāvāḥ
pratipuruṣaṃ hi indriyavṛtti prathamato viṣayākāreṇa pariṇamate tato manovṛttidvāreṇa, buddhivṛtti ekata saṅkrāntaviṣayākārā anyataśca saṅkrāntacicchāyā viṣayavyavasthāpikā
na khalu buddhau ādarśasthānīyāyāṃ viṣayākārā'saṅkrame puruṣeṇa arthaścetayituṃ śakyaḥ buddhyadhyavasitamartha puruṣaścetayate ityabhidhānāt
mahān buddhiḥ matiḥ prajñā saṃvitti khyāti citi smṛtirāsurī hariḥ hara hiraṇyagarbha iti paryāyāḥ
bāhyendriyāṇyālocya manase samarpayanti manaśca saṅkalpya ahaṅkārāya ahaṅkāraścābhimatya buddhau sarvādhyakṣabhūtāyām
sarva pratyupabhogaṃ yasmāt puruṣasya sādhayati buddhi
saiva ca viśinaṣṭi puna pradhānapurupāntara sūkṣmam
buddhirhi puruṣasannidhānāt tacchāyāpattyā tadrūpeva sarvaviṣayopabhoga puruṣasya sādhayati
indriyapraṇālikayā arthasannikarṣeṇa liṅgajñānādinā vā ādau buddherarthākārā vṛttirjāyate
buddhidarpaṇe puruṣapratibimbasaṅkrāntireva buddhipratisaveditvaṃ pusa tathā ca dṛśicchāyāpannayā buddhyā saṃsṛṣṭā śabdādayo bhavanti dṛśyā ityartha

nanu buddhivyatiriktasya caitanyasya kadācidapyapratīteḥ kathaṃ tatra cicchāyāsaṅkrāntiḥ ? ityapyasamīcīnam; sato'pyanayorvivekasya saṃsargaviśeṣavaśād vipralabdhena avadhārayitumaśakteḥ ayogolaka-vahnivivekavat
na ca ayogolaka-vahnyorapi abheda eva ityabhidhātavyam; anayoḥ anyonyā'saṃbhavisaṃsthāna-rūpa-sparśaviśeṣapratītita anyonyaṃ bhedapratīte
yayoranyonyā'saṃbhavī saṃsthāna-rūpa-sparśaviśeṣaḥ pratīyate tayoranyonyaṃ bhedaḥ yathā ghaṭa-paṭayoḥ, anyonyā'saṃbhavī saṃsthāna-rūpa-sparśaviśeṣaśca ayogolaka-vahnyoriti
na cā'yamasiddha, ayogolakavṛttasanniveśā'bhāsurarūpā'nuṣṇasparśebhyo vahnibhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśayo pratyakṣata eva viśeṣaḥ pratīyate
ato yathā'tra anyonyapradeśā'nupraveśalakṣaṇasaṃsargād vipralabdho bhedaṃ nāvadhārayati evaṃ buddhicaitanyayorapi
acetanā'pi hi buddhiḥ cetanāsaṃsargāt cetanāyamānā pratibhāsate iti
yasmāccetanasvabhāva puruṣa tasmāt tatsaṃyogādacetana mahadādi liṅga adhyavasāyābhimānasaṅkalpālocanādiṣu vṛttiṣu cetanāvat pravarttate
ko dṛṣṭānta ? tadyathā– anuṣṇāśīto ghaṭa śītābhiradbhi sasṛṣṭa śīto bhavati agninā sayukta uṣṇo bhavati evaṃ mahadādiliṅgamacetanamapi bhṛtvā cetanāvad bhavati
yattāvaduktam–na svavyavasāyātmakaṃ jñānam acetanatvāt iti; tatra kimidamacetanatvaṃ nāma–asvasaṃviditatvam, arthākāradhāritvam, jaḍapariṇāmatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe sādhyā'viśiṣṭo hetuḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tu sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ, na khalu paṭādayo darṣaṇādivat arthākāradhāriṇaḥ pratīyante
svarūpā'siddhañca itthambhūtamacetanatvam; amūrte jñāne mūrtasyā'rthasya ākāradhāritvā'nupapatteḥ
tathāhi–na viṣayākāradhāri jñānam amūrtatvāt, yadamūrtam tad viṣayākāradhāri na bhavati yathā ākāśam, amūrtañca jñānamiti
taddhāritve vā amūrtatvamasya viruddhyate; tathāhi–yad viṣayākāradhāri tanmūrtam yathā ādarśādi, viṣayākāradhāri ca jñānamiti
tathāhi–jñānapariṇāmavān ātmā dṛṣṭṛtvāt, yastu na tathā sa na dṛṣṭā yathā ghaṭādiḥ, dṛṣṭā ca ātmā, tasmāt jñānapariṇāmavān iti
tathā cāsya acetanatvasamarthanārthaṃ yaduktam–pradhānapariṇāmatvāt iti sādhanam; tadapyasiddhameva; asya ātmapariṇāmatvasamarthanāt
na ca ātmanaḥ anityajñānapariṇāmātmake anityatvāpattiḥ; pradhāne'pi tatprasaṅgāt
vyaktā'vyaktayorabhede'pi vyaktameva anityaṃ pariṇāmatvāt, na tu avyaktaṃ pariṇāmitvāt ityanyatrāpi samānam
āsargapralayasthāyitvaṃ vyāpitvañca buddheḥ atīvā'nupapannam; tatpariṇāmasya tadvirodhāt
tathāhi–na buddhiḥ vyāpikā nityā ca pradhānapariṇāmatvāt paṭādivat
na ca ākāśādinā anekāntaḥ, tasya tatpariṇāmatvā'siddheḥ
atha tatpariṇāmatvā'viśeṣe'pi kiñcid āsarga-pralayasthāyi vyāpakañca anyad anyathā; tarhi tadaviśeṣe'pi jñānaṃ svasaṃviditaṃ paṭādikañca anyathā iti kinneṣyate aviśeṣāt ?
pradhānasya cā'nityād vyaktādanarthāntarabhūtasya nityatāṃ pratīyan puruṣasyāpi jñānādaśāśvatādanarthāntarabhūtasya nityatvamupaitu sarvathā viśeṣābhāvāt
kiñca, ayaṃ prathamo buddhirūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ prakṛteḥ kutaḥ syāt–svabhāvataḥ, puruṣārthakarttavyatātaḥ, adṛṣṭādvā ? yadi svabhāvataḥ; tarhi sadā asya sattvaprasaṅgaḥ svabhāvasya sadā sattvasaṃbhavāt
yat svābhāvikaṃ na tat kādācitkam yathā triguṇātmakatvam, svābhāvikaśca prakṛterādyo buddhipariṇāma iti

atha puruṣārthakarttavyatāhetuḥ, ātmano hi bhogo mayā sampādanīyaḥ ityanusandhāya prakṛtiḥ mahadādibhāvena pariṇamate iti; tadapyasundaram; jaḍasvabhāvāyāstasyāḥ puruṣārtho mayā sampādanīyaḥ ityanusandhānānupapatteḥ

tathāhi–prathamasṛṣṭikāle prakṛtiḥ anusandhānaśūnyā anutpannabuddhivṛttitvāt, yadā'sau anutpannabuddhivṛttiḥ tadā anusandhānaśūnyā yathā saṃhṛtasṛṣṭyavasthāyām, anutpannabuddhivṛttiśca prakṛtiḥ prathamasṛṣṭikāle iti

utpannāyāṃ buddhivṛttau saṅkrāntāyāñca cicchāyāyāṃ bhavati anusandhānam, prathamasṛṣṭikāle ca prakṛterjaḍatvāt puruṣasya ca nirabhilāṣatvāt puruṣārthamahaṃ pravartte iti kasya idamanusandhānaṃ syāt ? cicchāyāsaṅkrāntiśca puruṣasya buddhau pratibimbanam yathā mukhasya darpaṇe, na ca vyāpino'sya kvacit pratibimbanaṃ yuktam
yad vyāpakaṃ na tat kvacit pratibimbati yathā ākāśam, vyāpakaśca ātmā iti

kiñca, asvacchasvabhāvasya mukhādeḥ svacchasvabhāve darpaṇe pratibimbanamucitam, buddhau tu triguṇātmakatvena atyantamlānasvabhāvāyāṃ kathamatyantasvacchasvabhāvaḥ puruṣaḥ pratibimbet ? yat svacchasvabhāvaṃ na tad asvacchasvabhāve pratibimbati yathā darpaṇo mukhe, svacchasvabhāvaśca cinmayaḥ puruṣa iti
pratibimbane vā asya asmādṛśāmasaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitatvāt na tatpratibimbapratipattiḥ syāt
yad asaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitaṃ na tasya kvacit pratibimbitasyāpi pratibimbagrahaṇam yathā paramāṇoḥ, asaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitaśca asmādṛśām ātmā iti
tadgrahaṇe vā mukha-darpaṇayoriva prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ vivekena avadhāraṇāt tannimittaḥ sarvasya sarvadā mokṣaḥ syāt, tato na kaścit śāstraśravaṇa-manana-nidadhyāsanādiṣu prayateta

nāpi adṛṣṭāt; cakrakaprasaṅgāt–siddhe hi cicchāyācchuritabuddhivṛttisadbhāve sukhasādhanapratipattipūrvakamadṛṣṭasādhanānuṣṭhānam, tadanuṣṭhānād adṛṣṭasyotpattiḥ, tadutpattau ca prathamasṛṣṭikāle tathāvidhabuddhivṛttisadbhāvasiddhiriti
yadapyuktam–tasmāttatsaṃsargādacetanaṃ cetanāvadiva liṅgam iti; tatra ko'yaṃ saṃsargaśabdārthaḥ–pratibimbanam, bhogyabhoktṛbhāvo vā ? na tāvat pratibimbanam; tasya pratiṣiddhatvāt
na ca asminnirabhilāṣe prakṛterbhogyatā tasya vā bhoktṛtā upapadyate; nirabhilāṣasya sukha-duḥkhasaṃvillakṣaṇabhogā'bhāve bhogya-bhoktṛbhāvā'nupapatteḥ

cetanāvat ityasya ca bhāṣitasya ko'rthaḥ–kim acetanaṃ cetanaṃ sampadyate ityarthaḥ, tacchāyācchuritaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'sāmprataḥ; anyasannidhāne anyasya anyadharmasvīkārā'saṃbhavāt, anyathā akartṛtvādidharmopetā''tmasannidhānāt prakṛterapi akartṛtvādidharmasvīkāraḥ syāt, tathā ca prakṛtermahān ityādi jagatprapañcaprarūpaṇā viśīryeta
atraivā'rthe prayogaḥ–cetanā buddhau tadvyapadeśaheturna bhavati ātmadharmatvāt, yo yaḥ ātmadharmaḥ sa so'nyatra tadvyapadeśaheturna bhavati yathā prakṛtau akartṛtvādiḥ; ātmadharmaśca cetanā iti

atha caitanyasannidhāne buddhiḥ tacchāyācchuritā bhavati ityucyate; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; tatsannidhānasya sadaiva sadbhāvāt, ato buddheḥ āsarga-pralayasthāyinyāḥ sadaiva tacchāyācchuritatvā'nuṣaṅgāt sadā saṃvittiḥ syāt, tathā ca asmādṛśām asaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitaḥ iti vaco viruddhyate
na cāsyā vāstavacaitanyā' bhāve viṣayavyavasthāpanaśaktiryuktā, na khalu māṇavakasya agnyupacārād dāhādijananaśaktirdṛṣṭā
yad yatropacaritaṃ na tattatra mukhyaprayojanaprasādhakam yathā māṇavake agnyādi, upacaritañca buddhau caitanyamiti

kiñca, mukha-ādarśavat buddhi-caitanyayorbhede siddhe sati anyasyā'nyatra pratibimbanaṃ yuktam, na cāsau siddhaḥ, saṃvidrūpasyaikasyaiva harṣa-viṣādādyanekā''kārasya viṣayavyavasthāpakatvena anubhavaprasiddhatvāt
tasyaiva ete caitanyam, buddhiḥ, adhyavasāyaḥ, jñānam, saṃvittiḥ iti paryāyāḥ
tathā ca caitanyaṃ jñānameva tadvācakaiḥ pratipādyamānatvād bodhavat
prasiddhohi loke cetayate, jānīte, buddhyate, adhyavasyati, paśyati iti ekārthe prayogaḥ
tasyā sannidhānādayaskāntamaṇikalpā buddhi tatpratibimbodgrāhitayā caitanyarūpatāmāpannā iva arthākārapariṇatā artha cetayate
tena yo'sau nīlākāraḥ pariṇāmo buddhe sa jñānalakṣaṇā vṛttirityucyate
ātmapratibimbasya tu buddhisaṅkrāntasya yo buddhyākāranīlasambandha sa ātmano vyāpāra ivopalabdhi ātmano vṛttirityākhyāyate
tadidaṃ buddhi tattvaṃ jaḍaprakṛtitayā indumaṇḍalamiva svayamaprakāśaṃ caitanyamārttaṇḍamaṇḍalachāyāpattyā prakāśate, prakāśayati cārthān, iti tannirākaraṇāya paryāyopanyāsa buddhirupalabdhi
samānaṃ bhavati puruṣaścetayate buddhirjānīte ityatrāpi artho na bhidyate nyāyabhā॰ 3
ya eva buddhyate jānāti adhyavasyati sa eva paśyati cetayate ca, na khalvatra vasturūpabhedaṃ paśyāmaḥ

yadapyabhihitam–saṃsargaviśeṣavaśādvipralabdho buddhi-caitanyayorvivekaṃ nāvadhārayati ityādi, tadapyabhidhānamātram; vahni-ayogolakayorapi anyonyaṃ bhedā'bhāvāt, ayogolakadravyaṃ hi pūrvākāraparityāgena agnisannidhānād viśiṣṭarūpa-sparśaparyāyā''dhāramekameva utpannamanubhūyate āmā''kāraparityāgena pākākārādhāraghaṭadravyavat
evamihāpi ekasmin sva-paraprakāśātmakaparyāye anubhūyamāne anyasadbhāvo nā'bhyupagantavyaḥ, anyathā na kvacid ekatvavyavasthā syāt
sakalavyavahārocchedaprasaṅgaśca, aniṣṭaparihāreṇa iṣṭe vastunyekasmin anubhūyamāne'pi anyasadbhāvā''śaṅkayā kvacit pravṛttyādyanupapatteḥ

tataḥ avādhitaikatvapratibhāsād anyaparihāreṇāvabhāsamāne vastuni ekatvavyavasthāmicchatā anubhavasiddhakartṛtvabhoktṛtvādyanekadharmā''dhāracidvivartasyāpi ekatvenā'nubhūyamānasya ekatvamabhyupagantavyam, na punaḥ tadvyatiriktā tena saṃsṛṣṭā buddhiḥ
prayogaḥ–yad yato vyatirekeṇa nopalabhyate na tat tadvyatirekeṇa abhyupagantavyam yathā pṛthubudhnodarādyākāravyatirekeṇa ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca caitanyavyatirekeṇa buddhiriti
yadapi–indriyamanovṛttidvāreṇa ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; indriyādivṛtteḥ prāgeva apāstatvāt
astu vā'sau; tathāpi etaddvāreṇa pratiprāṇi prasṛtānāṃ buddhivṛttīnāṃ jñānāntaravedyatve yaugapakṣoktā'śeṣadoṣā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

saṅkrāntaviṣayā''kāratvañcā''tmanaḥ buddhirevāvagacchati, ātmā vā ? na tāvad buddhireva; svayaṃ svātmano'pratipattau ahamanena samānā iti pratipatterayogāt, tathā tatpratipattau tu siddhaṃ svasaṃviditatvam
svayaṃ jñānāntareṇa vā buddherarthasārūpyapratipattau vā bauddhapakṣanikṣiptā'śeṣadoṣā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

ātmā'pi buddhyarthau pratipadya tatsārūpyaṃ pratipadyeta, apratipadya vā ? na tāvadapratipadya; arthasya buddheśca apratipattau tatpratipatteranupapatteḥ, dvayorhi svarūpapratipattau ayamanena samānaḥ iti sārūpyapratipatiryuktā, na punastadapratipattau
atha buddhyarthau pratipadyate'sau; kiṃ svataḥ, buddhyantareṇa vā ? svatastatpratipattau buddhikalpanāvaiphalyam
kriyāyāḥ karaṇamantareṇā'nupapatteḥ tatsāphalyam; ityapi śraddhāmātram; indriyā'ntaḥkaraṇayoreva tatra karaṇatvopapatteḥ

na ca prāktanabuddhikāle buddhyantaramasti; jñānayaugapadyā'nabhyupagamāt, ataḥ kathaṃ tenāpi tatkāle svayamasatā tatpratipattiḥ syāt ? sākāratā'bhyupagame ca dūrā'tītādivyavahārā'bhāvo bauddhapakṣoktaḥ atrāpi draṣṭavya iti
asya ca pradhānapariṇāmātmakabuddhivādasya paryālocanaṃ nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam–nyāyasū॰, bhāṣya, vārttika, tā॰ ṭīkā 1
etena na jñānaṃ svasaṃviditam bhūtapariṇāmatvāt ghaṭādivat ityācakṣāṇaścārvāko'pi pratyākhyātaḥ; jñānasya jñānāntaravedyatāyāṃ yauga-sāṅkhyapakṣoktā'śeṣadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt
na svasaṃvedyaṃ jñānaṃ kāyākārapariṇatabhūtapariṇāmatvāt pittādivat pramāṇaparī॰ pṛ॰ 62
avagrahādīnāṃ prāk pratipāditavijñānaviśeṣāṇāṃ madhye pūrvasya pūrvasya pramāṇatvam syāt bhavet uttaraparicchittiviśeṣaṃ prati sādhakatamatvāt
tad yadyā yathā avagrahasya pramāṇatve īhā phalam, evam uttaratrāpi yojyam
nanu cāstu uktaprakāreṇaiṣāṃ pramāṇa-phalavyavasthā; tatprāmāṇyaṃ tu svataḥ abhyupagantavyam, paratastadabhyupagame anekadoṣopanipātāt
tathāhi–pramāṇasya bhāvaḥ arthaparicchedikāśaktiḥ, karma vā arthaparicchedaḥ prāmāṇyam
na hi tat svātmani svavyāpāre vā tadutpādakasāmagrīvyatiriktaṃ kiñcidadhikaṃ guṇādikamapekṣate; tasya vidhimukhena kāryamukhena cā'pratīteḥ anumānavat
na hi anumāne jñānotpādakaṃ trairūpyā'tiriktaṃ kāraṇāntaraṃ prāmāṇyotpādakamupalabhyate; anvaya-vyatirekābhyāṃ tata eva tadutpattipratīteḥ
kiñca, arthatathātvaparicchedikā śaktiḥ prāmāṇyam, śaktayaśca bhāvānāṃ svata eva āvirbhavanti na utpādakakāraṇādhīnāḥ
na hi svato'satī śaktiḥ karttumanyena pāryate || mīmāṃsāślo॰ sū॰ 2 ślo॰ 47
