nacaitat satkāryadarśanasamāśrayaṇād abhidhīyate, kintu yaḥ kāryagato dharmaḥ kāraṇe samasti sa kāryavat tata evotpadyate, yathā mṛtpiṇḍe vidyamānā rūpādayo ghaṭe'pi mṛtpiṇḍādupajāyamāne mṛtpiṇḍarūpādidvāreṇa utpadyante
ye tu kāryadharmāḥ kāraṇeṣvavidyamānā na te tata evotpadyante kintu svata eva, yathā tasyaiva udakāharaṇaśaktiḥ
evaṃ vijñāne'pi arthatathātvaparicchedaśaktiḥ cakṣurādiṣvavidyamānā tebhyo nodayamāsādayati kintu svata eva āvirbhavati
na caitatsatkāryadarśanasamāśrayaṇādabhidhīyate; kintu yaḥ prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 39 u॰
tattvasaṃgrahe tu pūrvapakṣe kumārilakartṛkatayā pṛ॰ 756 upalabhyate
labdhātmanāṃ svakāryeṣu pravṛttiḥ svayameva tu || mī॰ śno॰ sṛ॰ 2 śno॰ 48
ghaṭo hi mṛtpiṇḍādika svajanmanyeva apekṣate nodakāharaṇe'pi
tathā jñānamapi svotpattau guṇavat itaradvā kāraṇamapekṣatā nāma svakārye tu viṣayaniścaye anapekṣameva
nāpi arthaparicchedalakṣaṇe svavyāpāre svagrahaṇam, agṛhītaprāmāṇyādapi pramāṇād arthaparicchedapratīteḥ

yadi puna savādakajñānāt guṇajñānāt arthakriyājñānādvā prāmāṇyaniścaya syāt, tadā anavasthādidoṣā'nuṣaṅga–saṃvādajñānasya saṃvādajñānāntarā'pekṣaṇāt, guṇajñānasya guṇajñānāntarāpekṣaṇāt, arthakriyājñānasya ca taditarā'pekṣaṇāt
prathamajñānasya dvitīyāt, dvitīyasya ca prathamāt prāmāṇyaniścaye anyonyāśraya
saṃvādādijñānasya savādādyanapekṣasyaiva tanniścaye prathamasya tathā tadbhāve pradveṣa kinnibandhana ? uktañca– yathaiva prathama jñāna tatsaṃvādamapekṣate
mīmāsāślo॰ sū॰ 2 ślo॰ 76 savādasyātha pūrveṇa saṃvāditvāt pramāṇatā
etatkārikātrayaṃ nimragrantheṣu uddhṛta varttate–prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 40 pū॰
pūrve dve kārike tattvasaṃgrahe pūrvapakṣe kumārilakartṛkatayā pṛ॰ 757 upalabhyete
prathamasya tathābhāve pradveṣaḥ kena hetunā || mīmāsāślo॰ sū॰ 2 ślo॰ 76
aprāmāṇyaṃ tu parata, tat khalu utpattau jñānotpādakakāraṇā'tiriktaṃ doṣākhyaṃ kāraṇāntaramapekṣate, nivṛttyākhye ca svakārye svagrahaṇam

tatra ajñānasya jñānā'bhāvasvarūpatayā svata siddhatvānna tatra kācidapekṣā, saśaya-viṣaryayayostu utpattau pramātṛdoṣā kṣudādaya, manodoṣā apraṇidhānādayaḥ, indriyadoṣā timirādaya, viṣayadoṣā calatvādaya, yathāsabhava kāraṇatvena anumanyante
nivṛttyākhye svakārye svajñaptyape kṣā ca; utpannamātre jñāne pratītimātre ca sādhāraṇe na tāvat puruṣaṃ nivarttayati yāvat kāraṇadoṣajñānādinā tat mithyātvena nā'vadhāryate

na ca prāmāṇyamapi utpattau guṇākhyaṃ kāraṇāntaramapekṣate atastadapi parataḥ ityabhidhātavyam; guṇānāṃ kutaścidapyaprasiddheḥ, siddhau vā na tadutpattau vyāpāraḥ doṣāpasāraṇe eva teṣāṃ caritārthatvāt

evaṃvidhameva hi padārthānāṃ svarūpam–yat svayaṃ saṃbhavantaḥ svapratipakṣamunmīlayanti, guṇāśca doṣapratipanthinaḥ, ataḥ tairapasāriteṣu teṣu svarūpata eva kāraṇāni vyāpriyamāṇāni pramāṇabhūtameva jñānaṃ janayanti
yadi punaḥ niṣpanne'pi jñāne svavyāpārakaraṇasāmarthyaṃ svato na syāt tadā tatsvarūpameva aniṣpannaṃ syāt
nahi aprakāśakatvadharmopete vahnau niṣpanne prakāśakatvādayo dharmāḥ kāraṇāntareṇa uttarakālamādhīyante iti prātītikam

astu vā guṇānāṃ pramāṇabhūtajñānotpādane vyāpāraḥ; tathāpi na prāmāṇyasya parato bhāvaḥ, prāmāṇyaṃ hi bodhakatvam, tacca jñānasya anyā'napekṣasya janmasamakālañcet saṃvṛttam tadā siddhā svataḥ prāmāṇyaprasiddhirapratihataprasarā
evañca sarveṣāmeva jñānānāmautsargike bodhakatvalakṣaṇe prāmāṇye sthite yatra bādhakapratyayaḥ kāraṇadoṣajñānañca utpadyate tatra aprāmāṇyaṃ parato niścīyate iti
tasmād yasya ca duṣṭa kāraṇaṃ yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ sa eva asamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānyaḥ

yattāvaduktam–arthaparicchedikā śaktiḥ prāmāṇyam; tatra kim arthamātraparicchedikā śaktiḥ prāmāṇyasvarūpaṃ syāt, yathārthaparicchedikā vā ? prathamapakṣe saṃśaya-viṣaryaya-svapnādijñānaiḥ tallakṣaṇavyabhicāraḥ, teṣāmaprāmāṇye'pi arthamātraparicchedikāyāḥ śakte sadbhāvāt

dvitīyapakṣe tu parataḥ prāmāṇyaprasiddhiḥ, vijñānamātrotpādikāyāḥ cakṣurādisāmagrīto yathārthaparicchedasāmarthyalakṣaṇaprāmāṇyasyānutpatteḥ, guṇayuktāyā eva tatsāmagryāḥ tadutpādane sāmarthyasaṃbhavāt
nanu guṇānāṃ vidhimukhena kāryamukhena vā pratītyabhāvāt kathaṃ tadadhīnā tasyotpattiḥ ? ityasamīkṣitābhidhānam; teṣāṃ sakalajanasākṣikatvena pratītibhūdharādhirūḍhatvāt

na hi cakṣurādigatā nairmalyādayaḥ, viṣayagatāśca āsanna-niścalatvādayaḥ, manogatāḥ praṇidhānādayaḥ, ātmagatāḥ santṛptatvasvasthatādayaḥ, prakāśagatāḥ sphuṭatvādayaḥ guṇā na santi ityabhidadhāno lokapratītyā na bādhyate
nanu nairmalyādi cakṣurādeḥ svarūpam na punarguṇaḥ
atha kuto'sya tatsvarūpatāsiddhiḥ–tadyu ktasyaiva utpādāt, tadvyatirekeṇa anupalabhyamānatvādvā ? prathamapakṣe rūpādibhirvyabhicāraḥ, ghaṭādeḥ tadyuktasyaibotpāde'pi teṣāṃ tadguṇatvapratīteḥ

kathañcaivaṃvādinaḥ kācakāmalādeḥ doṣatā siddhyet jātataimirikasya tadyuktasyaiva cakṣurāderutpādāt ? etena dvitīyapakṣo'pi pratyuktaḥ; kācakāmalāde cakṣuṣa rūpādeśca ghaṭāderbhedenā'nupalabhyamānasyāpi doṣa-guṇatvapratīteḥ
kaścātra svarūpaśabdārthaḥ– tādātmyam, tanmātratvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyavikalpe nairmalyāderna guṇatvaniṣedhaḥ tādātmyasya tadapratidvanditvāt, anyathā rūpāderapi guṇatvā'bhāvaḥ syāt
dvitīyavikalpastu ayuktaḥ; cakṣurādau anuvartamāne'pi asya nivartamānatayā tanmātratvā'nupapattiḥ

yasminnanuvartamāne'pi yannivartate na tat tanmātrameva, yathā'nuvartamāne'pi paṭe nīlādisaṃyogānnivartamānaḥ śuklādiguṇaḥ, anuvartamāne'pi cakṣurādau nivartate ca kāmalinaḥ kupitādervā nairmalyādikamiti
yadi ca guṇā cakṣurādau neṣyante tarhi tatpaṭutvatāratamyasadbhāvo na prāpnoti, asti cāyam– ayaṃ paṭvindriyaḥ aya paṭutarendriya ityādipratīteḥ

kathaṃ vā guṇā'nabhyupagame guṇebhyo doṣāṇāmabhāvaḥ mīmāsāślo॰ sū॰ 2 ślo॰ 65 ityādi sthāne sthāne guṇasadbhāvā''vedako vārttikakārodgāra śobhate ? na ca guṇo nāma na kaścidasti doṣā'bhāvamātre tadvyavahārāt ityabhidhātavyam, doṣasyāpyevam asattvā'nuṣaṅgāt tatrāpi guṇā'bhāvamātre doṣavyavahāraḥ ityabhidadhato na vaktraṃ vakrībhavati

naimarlyādermalā'bhāvarūpatayā aguṇatve ca kathaṃ taddarśane lokasya idaṃ guṇavaccakṣu iti vyavahāraḥ syāt ? añjanādinā ca cakṣuṣo guṇātiśayādhānaṃ supratītameva, kathamanyathā vahalāndhakārāyāṃ niśīthinyāṃ vyāghrādinetracūrṇāñjanād rūpaviśeṣopalambha, śiśumāravasāñjanāt jalāntaritārthasya grahaṇaṃ vā ? na ca sattve'pi guṇānāṃ doṣāpasāraṇe vyāpāreṇa prāmāṇyā'hetutvāt svatastat ityabhyupagantavyam; aprāmāṇyasyāpyevaṃ svataḥ sattvaprasaṅgāt doṣāṇāṃ guṇāpasāraṇahetutvena aprāmāṇyā'janakatvāt
tasmād ubhayaṃ svataḥ, parato vā abhyupagantavyaṃ samānā''kṣepasamādhānatvāt

na ca utpannāyāḥ jñānavyakteḥ paścāt kāraṇāntarāt prāmāṇyamutpadyate vastrasya lākṣāde raktatādivat ityabhyupagamyate, yena utpattyanantarameva vijñānasya pradhvaṃsāt kimāśrayaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ityayaṃ doṣo'vakāśaṃ labhet, svasāmagrīta arthānyathātvaparicchedasāmarthyalakṣaṇā'prāmāṇyavat arthatathābhāvaparicchedasāmarthyalakṣaṇaprāmāṇyasyāpi utpattyabhyupagamāt
yadapyuktam–anumānaprāmāṇyotpattau trairūpyātiriktaṃ guṇāntaraṃ nopalabhyate ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; tadutpattau sādhyā'vinābhāvitvasyaiva guṇasya sadbhāvāt
nanu sādhyā'vinābhāvitvaṃ hetoḥ svarūpasākalyaṃ kathaṃ guṇaḥ ? tarhi tadavinābhāvitvā'bhāvo'pi hetoḥ svarūpavaikalyam na punardoṣaḥ, ityaprāmāṇyamapi anumāne doṣebhyo'saṃbhāvyam
atha svarūpavaikalyamevā'tra doṣaḥ; tarhi tatsākalyameva guṇo'stu viśeṣā'bhāvāt
āgamaprāmāṇyotpattau tu vidhirūpasya yathārthadarśanāderguṇasya vyāpāraḥ suprasiddhaḥ, ayathārthadarśanāderdoṣasya iva tadaprāmāṇyotpattau
anumānotpādakahetostu sādhyāvinābhāvitvameva guṇo yathā tadvaikalyaṃ doṣa

yadapyuktam–ātmalābhe tu bhāvānām ityādi; tadapyayuktam; aprāmāṇyasyāpyevaṃ svato bhāvā'nuṣaṅgāt, yathaiva hi yathārthaprakāśanaśaktiḥ prāmāṇyarūpā cakṣurādikāraṇeṣu avidyamānā jñāne bhavantī svato'bhidhīyate tathā ayathārthaprakāśanaśaktirapi aprāmāṇyarūpā'bhidhīyatām aviśeṣāt, na hi sāpi tadvat tatra vidyate
tathāca vastutvād dvividhasyātra saṃbhavo duṣṭakāraṇāt mīmā॰ ślo॰ sū॰ 2 ślo॰ 54 ityasya virodhaḥ

kiñca, utpattau, jñaptau, svakārye vā svataḥ pramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ? tatra na tāvadutpattau; tathāhi–prāmāṇyaṃ pramāṇotpādakakāraṇakalāpātiriktakārakotpādyaṃ tadanuvṛttāvapi vyāvarttamānatvāt, yad yaditthaṃ tat tattathā yathā ghaṭānuvṛttāvapi vyāvarttamānaḥ tadvyatiriktaḥ saṃyogādiḥ, tathā cedam, tasmāttatheti
na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ; mithyājñāne prāmāṇyāśrayabodhasadbhāve'pi prāmāṇyā'nutpatteḥ
kiñca, ayaṃ svaśabdaḥ ātmā-ātmīya-jñāti-dhaneṣu madhye atra kasminnarthe pravarttamāno gṛhyate ? tatra jñāti–dhanayoḥ atrā'saṃbhavāt ātmā-ātmīyau evā'vaśiṣyete

tatrāpi svataḥ kāraṇamantareṇa ātmanaiva prāmāṇyamutpadyate ityarthaḥ syāt, ātmano vā sakāśāt, ātmīyāyāḥ sāmagrīto vā ? prathamapakṣe nirhetukasyā'sya deśa-kālaniyamā'yogāt sarvatra sarvadā tatprasaṅgaḥ

dvitīyavikalpe'pi svataḥ iti prāmāṇyaviśeṣaṇam, pramāviśeṣaṇaṃ vā ? prāmāṇyaviśeṣaṇatve prāmāṇyaṃ prāmāṇyād ātmalābhamanubhavati ityāyātam; tacca ayuktam; ekasya vastunaḥ svātmāpekṣayā utpādyotpādakatvadharmāpratīteḥ
anupapatteśca; tathāhi–prāmāṇyaṃ svātmana eva notpadyate kāryatvād aprāmāṇyavat ghaṭādivadvā
svo jñātāvātmani svaṃ triṣvātmīye svo'striyā dhane
ātmīyā ca sāmagrī–vijñānamātrotpādikā, viśiṣṭā vā ? viśiṣṭā cet; siddhasādhanam, svasāmagrīviśeṣāt nikhilārthānāmutpattyabhyupagamāt
tathā ca aprāmāṇyasya akhilārthānāñca svata eva siddhi syāt tadvat, viśiṣṭatvañca tatsāmagryā prāgeva pratipāditam
vijñānamātrotpādikā ityapi śraddhāmātragamyam; pramāṇā'pramāṇavyaktivyatiriktasya jñānamātrasya kvacit kadācidapyanupalambhāt dhavādivyaktivyatiriktavṛkṣamātravat

jñānamātrasya ca vṛkṣamātravat sāmānyarūpatvāt, tasya ca bhavanmate kutaścidanutpatteḥ kathaṃ tadutpādikā kācit sāmagrī syāt ? vijñānamātrotpādakasāmagrītaḥ prāmāṇyotpattyabhyupagame ca saṃśayādāvapi tadutpattiprasaṅga tasyāḥ tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
atha saṃśayādau śuddhā vijñānasāmagrī nāsti, ata kathaṃ tadutpāda ? yadyeva vijñānasyā'pyutpādo na syāt tatsāmagryā aśuddhatvena aparipūrṇatvāt

nanu paripūrṇaiva sāmagrī, param adhikakācakāmalādidoṣā'nupraveśa, tarhi adhikakāraṇānupraveśāt tajjanyamaprāmāṇyamapi upajāyatām, prāmāṇyaṃ tu vijñānasāmagrīprabhavaṃ vijñānavat prādurbhavad durnivāram
atha doṣā'bhāvaviśiṣṭāyāḥ sāmagrīta prāmāṇyamutpadyate nānyasyā, siddhaṃ tarhi parata prāmāṇyam, vijñānakāraṇā'tiriktadoṣā'bhāvākhyakāraṇāt tadutpattiprasiddhe
na hi doṣā'bhāvo vijñānakāraṇam; tamantareṇāpi mithyājñāne vijñānotpattipratīteḥ, prāmāṇyotpattau tu bhavatyeva asau kāraṇam anvayavyatirekopapatte

kiñca, doṣai cakṣurādīnāṃ ki kriyate yena te tatsannidhāne prāmāṇyaṃ notpādayanti ? tadutpādikā śaktiścedapanīyate, nanu yaiva vijñānamātrotpādane teṣāṃ śaktiḥ saiva prāmāṇyotpādane'pi, anyā vā ? saiva cet; tarhi tadapagame katha teṣāṃ tanmātrotpādane'pi vyāpāra syāt ? atha anyā, kathanna parata prāmāṇyam ? tannotpattau svata prāmāṇyaṃ ghaṭate
tathāhi–yat kādācitkaṃ tanna nirnimittam yathā ghaṭādi, kādācitkaśca prāmāṇyaniścaya iti
nimittañcāsya–svarūpam, anyadvā syāt ? na tāvat svarūpam; asvasaṃviditatvopagamāt

yacca anyannimittam tat ki pratyakṣam, uta anumānam anyasyātrā'nadhikārāt ? pratyakṣañcet; na, asya indriyasambaddhe viṣaye vyāpārāt, na ca indriyāṇām arthasaṃvedanena saha sambandho'sti yenāsya yathārthaparicchedasvabhāva prāmāṇyaṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyeta, pratiniyate rūpādau tadvati cā'rthe teṣāṃ sambandhāt
arthaprākaṭyaṃ liṅgamiti cet; ki yathārthaviśeṣaṇam, nirviśeṣaṇaṃ vā ? na tāvad yathārthaviśeṣaṇam; prāmāṇyaniścayāt prāg arthaprākaṭyasya yathārthatvaviśeṣaṇā'siddheḥ
nirviśeṣaṇasya cāsya prāmāṇyaniścāyakatve mithyājñāne'pi tanniścāyakatvaprasaṅgaḥ aviśeṣāt
sanimittatve kiṃ svanimittā anyanimittā vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 42 u॰
taddhi phalaṃ nirviśeṣaṇaṃ vā svakāraṇasya jñātṛvyāpārasya prāmāṇyamanumāpayed, yathārthatvaviśiṣṭaṃ vā ? nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 168
nāpi svakārye; yataḥ asya kārya puruṣapravṛttiḥ, arthaparicchedo vā ? tatra puruṣapravṛttihetutvaṃ prāmāṇyasya niścitasyaiva yuktam nivṛttihetutvavadaprāmāṇyasya

na hi arthitvamātreṇa prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ pravartante, rasāyanādau upayoginyauṣadhe jarā-mṛtyuharaṇādisāmarthyopete tathātvenā' niścite prakṛṣṭāyāmapyarthitāyāṃ teṣāṃ pravṛttyabhāvāt, niścayāpekṣā eva hi sarve dharmāḥ pravṛttihetavaḥ
nāpi arthaparicchedākhye svavyāpāre prāmāṇyaṃ svagrahaṇā'napekṣam; yato'sya arthaparicchedamātraṃ kāryam, yathārthaparicchedo vā ? na tāvad arthaparicchedamātram; tasya aprāmāṇye'pi saṃbhavāt
yathārthaparicchedaśca nā'gṛhītaprāmāṇyāt pramāṇāt saṃbhavati, tataḥ pramāṇā'pramāṇasādhāraṇasya arthaparicchedamātrasyaivotpatteḥ
na ca tadgrahaṇe anavasthādidoṣā'nuṣaṅgaḥ; abhyāsāvasthāyāṃ svataḥ prāmāṇyaniścayataḥ saṃvādādyapekṣā'bhāvataḥ anavasthādyanavatārāt

nahi abhyāsakroḍīkṛte jale jalajñānam ātmano'rthatathābhāvaparicchedasamarthasvabhāvatāpratipattau saṃvādādikamapekṣate, nirārekasya idamitthameva ityadhyavasāyātmano'sya pratiprāṇi prasiddhatvādaprāmāṇyavat

na khalu svabhyaste viṣaye marīcikādau jalādipratibhāsaḥ svātmano'rthānyathātvaparicchedasamarthasvabhāvatāpratipattau visaṃvādādikamapekṣate, tatsvabhāvatayā asyātra svataḥ sarveṣāṃ suprasiddhatvāt ityubhayaṃ tatra svataḥ siddhamabhyupagantavyam
na caivamanavasthā, tasya abhyastaviṣayatvena svataḥ prāmāṇyaprasiddhyā pramāṇāntarā'napekṣaṇāt
anabhyastaviṣaye hi jalapratibhāse arthakriyājñānād dardurā''rāvaudakāharaṇādiliṅgotthā'numānādvā jalāvinābhāvitvena asakṛnniścayata svataḥ siddhaprāmāṇyāt prāmāṇyaṃ niścīyate
ābhyāsikaṃ yathā jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ gamyate svata
nahi bauddhaiḥ eṣāṃ caturṇāmekatamo'pi pakṣo'bhīṣṭaḥ aniyamapakṣasya iṣṭatvāt; tathāhi–ubhayamapyetat kiñcit svataḥ kiñcit parata iti pūrvamupavarṇitam
tatrābhyāsāt pramāṇatvaṃ niścitaṃ svata eva naḥ
nanu ca arthakriyājñānamapi arthā'bhāve'pi svapnāvasthāyāṃ dṛśyate, tat ko'sya pūrvajñānād viśepa ? ityapyasundaram, jāgraddaśāyāṃ tadvisaṃvādā'darśanāt

na khalu yathā jāgraddaśāyāmarthajñānam arthamantareṇāpyupalabhyate tathā arthakriyājñānamapi, yena asyāpi tadā vyabhicārā''śaṅkayā arthakriyājñānāntarāt prāmāṇyaṃ niścīyate, taddaśāñcāśritya pramāṇādicintā pratanyate
ato na svapnadaśopalabdhena jāgraddaśopalabdhasya sāmyā''śaṅkāpi śreyasī
nahi prekṣāpūrvakārī svapnadaśāsamānāṃ jāgraddaśāṃ manyate, taddṛṣṭāntenaiva aśepapratyayānāṃ nirālambanatvā'nuṣaṅgato bahirarthā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt kva kasya prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ vā syāt ?
na ca tasya pramāṇatvaṃ taddhetoḥ prathamasya ca
naiva bhrāntā hi sāvasthā sarvā bāhyānibandhanā

nanu ca arthakriyājñānāt pūrvajñānasya prāmāṇye maṇiprabhāyāṃ maṇibuddhe kūṭe'pi drame tadbuddheśca prāmāṇyaprasaṅga, tanna, evambhūtā'rthakriyājñānāt pūrvajñāne aprāmāṇyasyaiva prasiddheḥ tena saṃvādā'saṃbhavāt

kuñcikāvivaramthāyāṃ hi maṇiprabhāyāṃ maṇijñānam, apavarakāntardeśasambaddhe tu maṇau arthakriyājñānam iti bhinnadeśārthagrāhakatvena bhinnaviṣayayo tayoḥ kathamavisaṃvāda timirādyāhitavibhramajñānavat ? kūṭe ca drame ki kūṭajñānam, dramajñānam, kharakajñānaṃ vā pramāṇamāpadyeta ? tatrādyapakṣadvaye siddhasādhanam
tṛtīyapakṣastvayukta; tatsādhyārthakriyāsaṃvādā'saṃbhavāt, sampūrṇacetanā rṇavetana lābho hi kharakadramasya arthakriyā na katipayacetanā yavetana lābha
karmaṇyā tu vidhā bhṛtyā bhṛtayo bharma vetanam
bharaṇyaṃ bharaṇa mūlyaṃ nirveśa paṇa ityapi
kvacitkūṭe'pi jayatuṅge jñāna pramāṇa katipayārthakriyādarśanāt, tatra kūṭe kūṭajñāna pramāṇameva akṛṭajñāna tu na pramāṇaṃ tatsavādābhāvāt
sampūrṇacetanālābho hi tasyārthakriyā na katipayacetanālābha iti

yaccoktam–prāmāṇyaṃ hi bodhakatvam ityādi, tatrāpi ki bodhakatvamātraṃ prāmāṇyam, uta arthabodhakatvam ? tatrādyapakṣo'sabhāvya; bodhakatvamātrasya kvacijjñāne pratītyabhāvāt, sakalajñānānāṃ vahirantaḥ svārthāvabodhakatvenaiva adhyavasāyāt
dvitīyapakṣe'pi arthamātrabodhakatvaṃ tat syāt, avitathārthabodhakatvaṃ vā ? na tāvad avitathārthabodhakatvam; asya viśiṣṭakāraṇakalāpādhīnatvapratipādanāt
nāpi arthamātrabodhakatvam; dvicandrādivedanasyāpi prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt, tathā ca tadvedyasya dvicandrādernā'satyatvam
yat khalu pramāṇabhūtavedanavedyaṃ tannā' matyam yathā sukhādi, pramāṇabhūtavedanavedyañca dvicandrādīti

pramāṇabhūtatvañca dvicandrādivedanasya bodharūpataiva prāmāṇyam ityabhidadhatāṃ nāsiddham; prayogaḥ–yad yato na vyatiricyate tat tatsvarūpamātrā'nubandhi yathā śākhādimattvādavyatiricyamānaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ tanmātrānubandhi, na vyatiricyate ca bodharūpatātaḥ prāmāṇyamiti

nanu ca anutpannabādhakasya bodhasya pramāṇabhūtatvaṃ svarūpam, atra ca bādhakamutpadyate, ata eva asmābhiḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ parataḥ aṅgīkriyate; tadapyasundaram; bodhasya kila svarūpasamakālabhāviprāmāṇyam, tasmin sthite kutaḥ parato'prāmāṇyasyā'vakāśaḥ ?
apare tu anyathā pratijñārthaṃ varṇayanti–bodhātmakatvaṃ nāma prāmāṇyam tadetadasamyak, yatona bodhātmakatvameva prāmāṇya yukta viparyayajñāne'pi sabhavāt
bodhaviśepa prāmāṇyamiti cet; na tarhi vaktavyam–tacca jñānānā svābhāvikameva na guṇakṛtam

kiñca, idamaprāmāṇyaṃ ki prāmāṇyasyā'bhāvaḥ, vastubhūto vā dharmaḥ ? prathamapakṣe prāmāṇyābhāvo jñānatvā'bhāva eva uktaḥ syāt, jñānatvameva hi prāmāṇyam iti bhavatāṃ pakṣaḥ, tathā ca parataḥ jñānasya jñānatvā'bhāvaḥ iti na kiñcit saṅgatam
yaddhi yādṛgrūpaniyataṃ tad atādṛgrūpaṃ nānyato bhavati yathā ghaṭaḥ pṛthubudhnodarādyākāraḥ, pramāṇarūpaniyatañca jñānam, iti na bādhakajñānād aprāmāṇyaṃ yuktam
kiñca, kāraṇadoṣajñānaṃ vādhakajñānañcā'pravartamānaṃ kathamatītajñānasya prāmāṇyā'bhāvamāpādayituṃ śaknoti ? na hi pūrvajñānakāle tadasti, tatkāle vā pūrvajñānamiti
svasminneva kāle tena tasya apramāṇatāsampādane atiprasaṅgaḥ ghaṭajñānasyāpi paṭajñānakāle'prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt

atha vastubhūto dharmaḥ aprāmāṇyam; sa vaktavyaḥ kau'sau iti ? saṃśaya-viparyayau iti cet; nanu tayorjñānātmakatvāt nā'pramāṇatā yuktā; tathāhisaṃśayaviparyayau nā'pramāṇaṃ jñānatvāt pramāṇatvābhimatajñānavaditi

kiñca, sarvatra jñāne autsargike prāmāṇye sati kutaḥ saṃśaya-viparyayalakṣaṇadharmasaṃbhavaḥ ? sa hi jñānasya svata eva āyātaḥ, viṣayāt, sahakāribhyaḥ, pramātuḥ, jñānāntaraprabhāvāt, indriyādeḥ, ādhārasambandhādvā ? prathamapakṣe sarvadā tasya tathātvaprasaṅgaḥ; prayogaḥ–yad yasya svarūpata eva bhavati tat tasya na kadācidapi nivarttate yathā nīlasya nīlatā, tathā ca jñānasya saṃśayā dirūpateti
dvitīyapakṣe'pi viṣayamātrasya saṃśayādirūpotpattau vyāpāraḥ, viśiṣṭasya vā viṣayasya ? viṣayamātrasya cet; sarvajñānaṃ saṃśayādirūpaṃ syāt
viśiṣṭasya cet; nanu kimidaṃ viṣayasya viśiṣṭatvam–avivecitatvam, sādṛśyopahatatvaṃ vā ? avivecitatve viṣayamātrameva aṅgīkṛtaṃ syāt, tatra ca ukto doṣa

atha sādṛśyopahato viṣayo viruddhaviśeṣasmaraṇadvāreṇa viparyayajñānaṃ janayati, ubhayaviśeṣasmaraṇadvāreṇa ca saṃśayajñānam, tadapyacāru; sarvasyaiva viṣayasya avaśyaṃ kenacit sādṛśyasaṃbhavāt sarvadaiva tathāvidhajñānotpattiḥ syāt
gṛhītaṃ sādṛśyaṃ tathā karoti iti cet; sannihite'pi kuryāt
viśeṣā'grahaṇamapi tatkāraṇam, sannihite ca tadabhāvāt tanna karoti iti cet; nanu sato viśeṣasya agrahaṇamapi kutaḥ ? adṛṣṭāccet; tanna; adṛṣṭasya avikalasāmagryāṃ kāryapratibandhakatvā'darśanāt

tadvaśāddhi kadācit sāmagrī eva na saṃyujyate, saṃyuktā vā vijātīyena yujyate yena sāmagryantaratāmāsādayati, atra ca indriyādisāmagrī nānyathābhūtā nāpyasaṃyuktā iti kathaṃ viśeṣā'grahaṇam ? kiñca, viśeṣā'grahaṇavat prāmāṇyā'prāmāṇyotpādane' pi adṛṣṭasya vyāpāra kinna syād yato'prāmāṇyavat prāmāṇyamapi parato na syāt ?
etena tṛtīyapakṣo'pi pratyākhyātaḥ, sahakāribhi adharmādibhiḥ aprāmāṇyaṃ saṃśayādirūpamāpādyate, dharmādibhistu prāmāṇyam avitathārthaniścayasvarūpamiti
nāpi pramātrā tatra tadrūpamāpādyate; pratītivirodhāt, na hi kasyacit pramātuḥ īdṛśī pratīti saṃśayavānahaṃ bhūyāsam iti
abhyupagame vā nāsya jñānasyā'prāmāṇyahetutvam; tathāhi–saṃśayo me syāt iti jñānaṃ nā'prāmāṇyakāraṇaṃ jñānatvāt ghaṭaṃ jānīyām ityādijñānavat

atha jñānāntaraprabhāvād āvirbhūto'sau viśeṣaḥ; tatrāpi ki svakīyāt, parakīyādvā tadantaraprabhāvādasau āvirbhavet ? yadi svakīyāt; tadā svakāle sato jñānasya tenā'sau viśeṣo vidhīyate, asato vā ? na tāvat sataḥ, jñānāntarakāle prāktanajñānasyā'saṃbhavāt, anyathā yugapajjñānadvayā'nabhyupagamavirodha

svakāle'sataśca kathaṃ tenā'sau vidhātuṃ śakyaḥ bhinnakālatvāt, yad yato bhinnakālaṃ na tena tasya viśepo vidhātuṃ śakya yathā bhūta-bhaviṣyatkālabhāvijapāpuṣpeṇa vartamānakālīnasphaṭike, bhinnakālañca idaṃ jñānāntaramiti
nāpi parakīyāt tataḥ saṃśayādyutpatti, tathā pratītyabhāvāt
nanu caitasya saṃśayamutpādayāmi iti pramātrantarāṇāṃ pratītirasti; tanna, sārvatrikasaṃśaye pramātrantarajñānasya niyatasadbhāvā'saṃbhavāt
yat khalu yatra kāraṇaṃ tat tatra niyatasadbhāvam yathā antyadaśāprāptaṃ vījamaṅkurasya, na ca pramātrantarajñānaṃ niyatasadbhāvaṃ saṃśayādikārye iti

atha ādhārasambandhāttatra tadutpatti, nanu tatsambandhaḥ pramāṇataḥ pratipannaḥ, na vā ? pratipannaścet; kathaṃ saṃśayaviparyā sakāriṇamādhāraṃ jānāno'dhitiṣṭhed aprāmāṇikatvaprasaṅgāt ? apratipannaścet, kathaṃ tatkṛtā jñāne saṃśayādirūpatā iti pratipattiḥ ?

kiñca, idaṃ saṃśayādirūpamaprāmāṇyaṃ bodhasvarūpādatiriktam, anatiriktaṃ vā ? anatireke katham atiriktakāraṇāpekṣā ? atireke tadvad yathārthaniścayasvarūpaprāmāṇyasyāpi ato'tirekaprasiddheḥ siddhamubhayasya vijñānakāraṇātiriktakāraṇājjanma, ityalamatiprasaṅgena
tataḥ parato labdhapramāṇabhāvasya avagrahādeḥ īhādikaṃ phalam iti yuktamuktam
svata prāmāṇyavādasya vividharītyā samīkṣā nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyā– tattvasaṃ॰ svataḥprāmāṇyaparī॰ pṛ॰ 744

paramārthena akalpitarūpeṇa ekā niraṃśā yā saṃvittiḥ tasyāḥ yo vedyākāraḥ vedyasya nīlāderākāra iva tadākāraḥ yaśca vedakākāraḥ vedyākāragrāhakā''kāraḥ tayoryā pramāṇaphalavyavasthā vedyākārasya pramāṇavyavasthā sārūpyamasya pramāṇam nyāyavi॰ 1
19 ityabhidhānāt, vedakākārasya ca phalavyavasthā adhigatiḥ phalam iti vacanāt

tasyāmaṅgīkriyamāṇāyām kṣaṇabhaṅgāderapi kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ ādiryasya, ādiśabdo'yaṃ prakāravācī tena kṣaṇabhaṅgaprakāraḥ sarvo niraṃśatvādisvabhāvo liṅgādabhinno gṛhyate, tasyāpi na kevalaṃ sattvādihetoḥ pratyakṣatvaṃ pratyakṣaviṣayatvam prasajyeta
tataḥ tasmāt tatpratyakṣatvāt kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ syād iti cet, atrāha–gṛhīta ityādi
gṛhītasya darśanaviṣayīkṛtasya grahaṇāt tadanumānaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgādyanumānaṃ pramāṇaṃ na syāt saṃvṛtivat pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvivikalpavat
nanu gṛhīte'pi kṣaṇabhaṅgādau viparītāropavyavacchedaphalatvāt nānumānam apramāṇamiti cet, atrāha–tat ityādi
tayoḥ pramāṇā'pramāṇatayā aṅgīkṛtayoḥ anayoḥ saṃvṛti-anumānayormadhye na kevalaṃ pratyakṣād anumānasya api tu saṃvṛterapi tābhyāṃ pramāṇāntaratvaṃ syāt

yathaiva hi anumānāt kṣaṇavivekaniścaye niścaya-āropamanasorbādhyabādhakabhāvāt bhāvī samāropo na jāyate iti tadvyavacchedakaṃ tat, tathā saṃvṛtyā nīlāderniścaye anīlādirūpo'sau na jāyate iti sāpi tadvya vacchedikā'stu
bhavatvevam, ko doṣaḥ iti cet ? atrāha–sarvasyaiva ityādi
sarvasya caturvidhasyāpi pratyakṣasya prāmāṇyaṃ na syāt na kvacit nīlādau kṣaṇakṣayādau vā prāmāṇyaṃ syāt iti evakārārtha
kasya ? nirvikalpakajñānasya, kathambhūtasya ? samāropavyavacchedā''kāṅkṣiṇaḥ samāropavyavacchedahetutvāt kṣaṇakṣayādau anumānam, nīlādau ca saṃvṛtiḥ tadvyavaccheda tam ākāṅkṣati ityevaṃśīlasya
ayamarthaḥ–yathā kṣaṇabhaṅgādau tadapekṣasya nirvikalpakapratyakṣasya na prāmāṇyam anumānasyaiva tatra prāmāṇyāt tathā nīlādāvapi tatrāpi saṃvṛtereva prāmāṇyāt
pūrvaphakkikayā pramāṇāntaram, anayā puna iṣṭatyāpi pratyakṣapramāṇasya abhāvaṃ darśayati
pravarttakañca abhyāsadaśāyāṃ nirvikalpaka jñānam, anabhyāsadaśāyā tu anumānam
na ca anyā daśā samasti yasyāṃ vikalpakajñānaṃ pravartakatvātpramāṇaṃ syāt, ityatrāha–tataḥ ityādi
tataḥ nirvikalpakajñānāt abhyāse saṃvyavahārasya pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇasya abhāvāt
svavittirvā pramāṇaṃ tu sārūpyaṃ yogyatāpi vā
syānmatam–sakalapratyayānāṃ bhrāntatvā'bhyupagamata pratyakṣasyāpi prāmāṇyā'nabhyupagamāt katham saṃvṛterapi pramāṇāntaratvaṃ syāt ityuktaṃ śobheta ? ityatrāha–arthakriyārthī hi ityādi
sakalapramāṇā'bhāvavādinā arthyate abhilaṣyate iti arthaḥ sakalapramāṇābhāva, tasya kriyā upādānam tadarthī hi pramāṇamanveṣate
kimiva ? apramāṇaṃ vā apramāṇamiva pramāṇā'bhāvavat ityartha, nahi pramāṇamantareṇa tadabhāva siddhyati ityukta mādhyamikaṃ prati bahirarthasiddhipraghaṭṭake
arthakriyāthā hi sarva prekṣāvān pramāṇamapramāṇa vā'nveṣate
yadi vā, arthaḥ heya upādeyaśca tasya kriyā prāptiḥ parihāraśca tadarthī hi yasmāt pramāṇaṃ yatastayo prāpti-parihārau sta apramāṇaṃ vā yatastayoḥ tau na bhavataḥ iti anveṣate
na ca nirvikalpakāt tau bhavata iti tātparyārtha
anveṣate eva tarhi pramāṇamiti cet, atrāha– rūpādi ityādi

rūpam ādiḥ yasya rasādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ, kṣaṇakṣaya ādiḥ yasya niraṃśatvāde so'pi tathokta, tayo sphuṭasya viśadasya pratibhāsasya aviśeṣataḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ prāmāṇyam rūpādau na kṣaṇakṣayādau yadapekṣam yam svārthaniścayam apekṣate, yasmin vā apekṣā yasya tad yadapekṣam tadeva nā'dhigatimātram phalaṃ yuktam upapannam
atha iṣyate eva nirṇayaḥ phalam yatraiva janayedenā tatraivā'sya pramāṇatā ityabhidhānāt
sa tu nirvikalpakāt iti cet, atrāha–tatkṛtaḥ ityādi
tena nirvikalpakena kṛta tatkṛtaḥ niścayaḥ tattvataḥ paramārthato na bhavati kalpanayā kevalaṃ bhavati ityarthaḥ
tattvataḥ tat tato na bhavati iti ca kvacit pāṭhaḥ
tat nirṇayaphalam tato nirvikalpakāt na bhavati iti
yathā ca tat tato na bhavati tathā savikalpakasiddhau pratipāditameva
abhyupagamyāpi ato nirṇayaṃ dūṣaṇamupadarśayannāha–bhāve vā ityādi

bhāve vā utpattau vā tato nirṇayasya nirṇītiḥ svārthavyavasāyaḥ akhaṇḍaśaḥ rūpādāviva kṣaṇakṣayādāvapi kuto na bhavet parisphuṭatayā pratibhāsasya abhayatrā' viśeṣāt, darśanapāṭavādikamapi anaṃśasya darśanasya ubhayatrā'vaśiṣṭam ityuktaṃ savikalpakasiddhau
nanu yathā paramārthaikasaṃvido vedya-vedakākārayoḥ pramāṇa-phalavyavasthā viruddhyate tathā avagrahāderapi, sāmānyavad viśeṣasyāpi avagraheṇaiva grahaṇāt; anyathā gṛhītetararūpe dve vastunī syātām
yathā ca avikalpakapratyakṣasya anupalakṣyamāṇatvādaprāmāṇyam tathā avagrahāderapi, tasyāpi anupalakṣaṇā'viśeṣāt; ityāśaṅkya āha–bahubahuvidha ityādi
bahu-bahuvidhakṣipra-anisṛta-anukta-dhruvāḥ, itare ca abahvādayaḥ ye vikalpāḥ bhedāḥ teṣāṃ sambandhī yaḥ avagrahādiḥ tasya na viruddhyate, pramāṇaphalavyavasthā iti sambandhaḥ
kuta etat-iti cet ? atrāha–svabhāvabhedāt iti, svaḥ ātmīyaḥ avagrahāderbhāvaḥ yo grāhyo'rthaḥ tasya kathañcidbhedāt
athavā svabhāvabhedāt avagrahādeḥ svarūpabhedāt iti grāhyam
pratibhāsasya svarūpasaṃvitteḥ bhede'pi nānātve'pi, avagrahādeḥ svabhāvabhedā'bhāvakalpanāyāṃ svabhāvasya svarūpasya yo bhedaḥ tasya abhāvakalpanāyām advayajñānakalpanāyām
krameṇa vṛttiḥ vartanaṃ yeṣām upādānopādeyarūpāṇāṃ darśanasmaraṇādīnāṃ teṣām api na kevalam avagrahādīnām tathābhāvāt tena svabhāvabhedā'bhāvakalpanāprakāreṇa bhāvāt kāraṇāt
kutaḥ pramāṇāt, na kutaścit kramaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sukhaduḥkhādibhedo vā ādiśabdena harṣanīlādiparigrahaḥ paramārthataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyeta vyavasthāpyeta ? puruṣādvaitaṃ syāt iti bhāvaḥ
nanu yadi avagrahādeḥ pratibhāsabhedaḥ kathamekatvam ? ityatrāha–sahapratibhāsavat iti
sahapratibhāsā buddhernīlādaya ākārāḥ teṣāmiva tadvat iti

tad ityādinā uktārthopasaṃhāramāha– yata evaṃ tat tasmāt ayaṃ saugataḥ ekam abhinnam anekākāram citrākāram kṣaṇikajñānam pūrvottarakoṭiviviktamadhyakṣaṇavedanaṃ kutaścit kasyāścid abhinnayoga-kṣemalakṣaṇāyāḥ aśakyavivecanatālakṣaṇāyā vā pratyāsatteḥ naikaṭyāt

pratibhāsabhedāḥ buddhernīlādaya ākāraviśeṣāḥ teṣām upayan abhyupagacchan, kramavartināmapi krameṇa varttituṃ śīlānāmapi tathā aśakyavivecanatvapratyāsattiprakāreṇa, kevalasya abhinnayoga-kṣemapratyāsattiprakārasya santānāntarajñānairvyabhicārāt ekatvaṃ pratipattumarhati
ataḥ asmāt tadekatvāt anekāntasiddhiḥ pratyeyā, pratyeyam ityanena vakṣyamāṇena jātaliṅgapariṇāmena sambandhāt
pratikṣaṇa viṣayaparicchedalakṣaṇo yoga, tadarthakriyā'nuṣṭhānalakṣaṇaśca kṣema paripālanarūpa
nanu pramāṇaphalayo kramabhāvinorbhedāt santānāntaravat tadbhāvo na prāpnoti iti cet, atrāha–pramāṇa ityādi
ataḥ ityanuvartate ato nyāyāt pramāṇaphalayoḥ avagrahehayoḥ īhā'vāyayo avāyadhāraṇayo kramabhāve'pi tādātmyam kathañcidekatvam

nanu pramāṇaphalayostādātmyamanupapannam pramāṇavirodhāt, tathāhi–pramāṇam ātmavyatiriktakriyākāri kārakatvāt, yat kārakaṃ tad ātmavyatiriktakriyākāri pratipannam yathā kuṭhārādi, kārakañca pramāṇam, tasmād ātmavyatiriktakriyākāri iti
tathā, pramāṇa svato vibhinnaphalavidhāyi karaṇatvāt, yat karaṇaṃ tat svato vibhinnaphalavidhāyi prasiddham yathā vāsyādi, karaṇañca pramāṇam, tasmāt svato vibhinnaphalavidhāyi iti

na cāyaṃ sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭānta, na hi karaṇaṃ vāsyādi svātmani kriyāṃ kurvad dṛṣṭam, na ca akurvatakaraṇatvaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt, tasmāt svato vibhinnaṃ phalaṃ karttari karmaṇi vā kurvat karaṇaṃ pratipattavyam
viruddhā ca pramāṇasyaiva phalarūpatā; na hi ekasya ekadā svātmāpekṣayā karaṇarūpatā phalarūpatā copapannā viruddhayordharmayoḥ sakṛdekatra samāveśā'saṃbhavāt, ataḥ pramāṇaphalayorbheda eva jyāyān

viśeṣaṇajñānaṃ hi pramāṇaṃ viśeṣyajñānaṃ phalam, tayośca kathamabhedaḥ ? vibhinnasāmagrīprabhavatayā vibhinnaviṣayatayā ca bhedasyaivopapatte; yayorvibhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvaṃ vibhinnaviṣayatvañca tayorbhedaḥ yathā ghaṭapaṭajñānayoḥ, vibhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvaṃ vibhinnaviṣayatvañca viśeṣaṇa-viśeṣyajñānayoriti
nacāyamasiddho hetuḥ; vibhinnā hi viśepaṇajñānotpattau viśepaṇā'kṣasannikarṣalakṣaṇā sāmagrī, vibhinnā ca viśeṣyadravyādijñānotpattau tadindriyasannikarṣalakṣaṇā sāmagrī
viṣayabhedastu tajjñānayoḥ suprasiddha eva, anyonyavilakṣaṇayoḥ viśepaṇa-viśeṣyayostadālambanatvāt
yadā sannikarṣastadā jñāna pramitiḥ, yadā jñānaṃ tadā hānopādānopekṣābuddhaya phalam

tatra sāmānyaviśeṣeṣu svarūpālocanamātraṃ pratyakṣa pramāṇam pramiti dravyādiviṣaya jñānam athavā sarveṣu padārtheṣu catuṣṭayasannikarṣādavitathamavyapadeśya yajjñānamutpadyate tatpratyakṣa pramāṇam pramiti guṇadoṣamādhyasthyadarśanamiti
sarvañca pramāṇa svaviṣaya prati bhāvasādhana pramiti pramāṇam iti, viṣayāntara prati karaṇasādhanaṃ pramīyate'nena iti pramāṇam
yadi bhāvasāvana pramāṇaśabda kiṃ phalaṃ viṣayasyādhigatatvāt ? uktaṃ phala hānādibuddhaya iti

na ca kriyaiva kvacit karaṇa bhavati, kriyāyā sādhyāyā kāraka kiṃmapi karaṇamucyate yathā dātreṇa caitra śālistambaṃ lunāti iti kartṛkarmakaraṇāni kriyāto bhinnānyupalabhyante tathehāpi cakṣuṣā ghaṭaṃ paśyatīti darśanakriyāta pṛthagbhāva eva teṣā yukto na darśanaṃ karaṇameva iti
pramā pramāṇamiti tu phale pramāṇaśabdasya sādhutvākhyānamātram kṛti karaṇamitivat tena cakṣurāde jñānakriyāmupajanayata karaṇatvaṃ-jñānasya phalatvameveti yuktaḥ tathāvyapadeśa nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 70
svātiriktetyādinā śaṃkarasvāmī pramāṇayati–svātiriktakriyākāri pramāṇaṃ kārakatvata vāsyādivat
yadā nirvikalpaka sāmānyaviśeṣajñānaṃ pramāṇam tadā dravyādiviṣayaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ pramiti ityartha

yadā nirvikalpaka sāmānyaviśeṣajñānamapi pramārūpamarthapratītirūpatvāt tadā tadutpattāvavibhaktamālocanamātraṃ pratyakṣamviśeṣyajñānaṃ hi viśeṣaṇajñānasya phalam viśeṣaṇajñānaṃ na jñānāntaraphalamyadā nirvikalpakaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣajñānaṃ phalaṃ tadā indriyārthasannikarṣa pramāṇam, yadā viśeṣyajñānaṃ phalaṃ tadā sāmānyaviśeṣālocanaṃ pramāṇam ityuktaṃ tāvat
samprati hānādibuddhīnā phalatve viśeṣyajñānaṃ pramāṇamityāha praśa॰ kandalī pṛ॰ 199

yattāvat–pramāṇaphalayoḥ bhede sādhye kārakatvāt iti sādhanamuktam; tadasamīcīnam; yato'taḥ kimanayoḥ kathañcidbhedaḥ sādhyeta, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit; siddhasādhyatā, ajñānanivṛtteḥ pramāṇadharmatayā hānopādānādeśca tatkāryatayā pramāṇāt kathañcidbhedā'bhyupagamāt
dvividhaṃ hi pramāṇasya phalam–tato bhinnam, abhinnañceti
yo yaddharmaḥ sa tato'bhinnaḥ yathā pradīpāt sva-paraprakāśaḥ, pramāṇadharmaśca ajñānanivṛttiḥ svapararūpavyāmohavicchedalakṣaṇā iti

na hi sarvathā bhede abhede vā dharma-dharmibhāvo ghaṭate virodhāt; tathāhi–yayoḥ sarvathā bheda na tayordharma-dharmibhāva yathā sahya-vindhyayo, sarvathā bhedaśca dharma-dharmiṇoḥ bhavadbhirabhipreta iti
tathā, yatra sarvathā'bheda na tatra dharma-dharmibhāvaḥ yathā dharmadharmiṇoranyatarasvarūpe, sarvathā'bhedaśca dharma-dharmiṇorbhavadbhiriṣṭa iti
ata sarvathābhedā'bhedapakṣe tayo tadbhāvā'nupapatte kathañcidbheda eva jyāyān, sādhakatamasvabhāvatayā hi jñānasya pramāṇatā ajñānanivṛttyātmakatayā ca phalarūpatā iti
sādhakatamasvabhāvatā ca asya svaparagrahaṇavyāpāra eva tadgrahaṇā'bhimukhyalakṣaṇa
jñānaṃ hi svakāraṇakalāpādupajāyamānaṃ svārthagrahaṇavyāpāralakṣaṇopayogarūpaṃ sat svārthavyavasāyarūpatayā pariṇamate
itthaṃ kathañcidabhede'pi anayo kāryakāraṇabhāvo na viruddhyate

tathā ca ekasya ekadāsvātmāpekṣayā karaṇarūpatā phalarūpatā cānupapannā ityādyayuktam, ekasyāpi apekṣābhedād anekakārakarūpatopapatte, yathā vṛkṣastiṣṭhati, vṛkṣeṇa kṛtam, vṛkṣādapetam, vṛkṣaṃ paśya ityādau, evaṃ pramāṇasyaikasyāpi sādhakatama-svapararūpavyāmohavicchedalakṣaṇa-ajñānanivṛttisvabhāvā'pekṣayā pramāṇarūpatā phalarūpatā ca na virodhamadhyāste

nanu ca ajñānanivṛtti jñānameva, na ca tadeva tasyaiva kārya yuktaṃ virodhāt, ataḥ kathamasyā pramāṇaphalatvaṃ syāt ? ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, yataḥ ajñānanivṛtteḥ svārthavyavasāyapariṇatilakṣaṇāyā svārthagrahaṇavyāpāralakṣaṇa-upayogarūpapramāṇena kāryatvā'virodhāt, sādhakatamāṃśasya itarāṃśāt kathañcidbhedapratipādanāt

kiñca, dharmarūpatām, dharmirūpatāṃ vā abhyupagamya ajñānanivṛttiḥ jñānameva ityabhyupagamyeta ? yadi dharmirūpatām, tatrāpi kimapekṣayā ajñānanivṛtte dharmitvaṃ parikalpyeta–jñānāpekṣayā, dharmāntarā'pekṣayā vā ? prathamapakṣe tannivṛtte dharmitvam, jñānasya tu dharmatvam iti vaiparītyamāyātam, na caitadyuktaṃ tasyāḥ tadāśritatvāt

yad yadāśritaṃ na tasya svāśrayāpekṣayaiva dharmitvaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā sukha-rūpāde, jñānāśritā ca ajñānanivṛttiḥ iti, ataḥ kathasyā dharmitvam ? niyamena asyā parāśritāyāḥ dharmasvabhāvatvasyaiva upapatteḥ tallakṣaṇatvāttasya

atha dharmāntarāpekṣayā; tadā jñānāpekṣayā kimasyā syāt ? dharmarūpatā cet; kathamevam jñānameva ajñānanivṛtti iti abhedā'bhidhānaṃ yujyate ? jñānasya ajñānanivṛttiḥ dharmaḥ iti bhedā'bhidhānasyaiva upapannatvāt, na khalu upacārādanyatra dharma-dharmiṇorabhedā'bhidhānaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, asau kāryā, akāryā vā syāt ? yadi akāryā; sarvatra sarvadā sattvaprasaṅgāt sarva sarvadarśī syāt, deśādiniyatakāraṇādhīnatayā hi bhāvānāṃ deśādiniyamaḥ nānyathā
atha kāryā asau; kuto jāyeta–pramāṇābhimatajñānāt, anyato vā ? yadi anyataḥ; pramāṇābhimatajñānotpatteḥ prāguttarakālañca tadutpattiprasaktiḥ, na hi tadakāryasya tatsattākāle eva ātmalābho yuktaḥ
prayogaḥ–yad yadakāryaṃ na tad ātmalābhe tatsattāmapekṣate yathā ghaṭā'kāryaḥ paṭo nātmalābhe ghaṭasattām, pramāṇā'kāryā ca ajñānanivṛttiḥ anyata utpattimattvena iti
atha pramāṇādeva asau utpadyate; siddhaṃ tarhi pramāṇaphalatvamasyāḥ, tathā ca jñānameva ajñānanivṛttiḥ iti durghaṭam

sughaṭatve'pi vā, kiṃ jñānamātrameva ajñānanivṛttiḥ, viśiṣṭaṃ vā jñānam ? prathamapakṣe anadhyavasāyādeḥ datto jalāñjaliḥ–jñānamātradharmatayā ajñānanivṛtteḥ svapararūpavyāmohavicchedalakṣaṇāyāḥ tatrāpi sattvaprasaṅgāt

vyāmoho hi anadhyavasāyādisvabhāvaḥ, sa kathaṃ tadvipakṣabhūtayā ajñānanivṛttyā kroḍīkṛte jñānamātre avakāśaṃ labheta ? yatra yatsattāmātranivandhano yadviparītadharmasadbhāvaḥ na tatra tatsaṃbhavaḥ yathā ātmasattāmātranibandhanena amūrttacetanatvādidharmeṇa kroḍīkṛte ātmani na mūrta-acetanatvādidharmasaṃbhavaḥ, jñānasattāmātranibandhanena ajñānanivṛttidharmeṇa anadhyavasāyādivirodhinā kroḍīkṛtañca jñānamiti

atha viśiṣṭajñānadharmatā ajñānanivṛttiḥ iṣyate; nanu kimidaṃ jñānasya viśiṣṭatvaṃ nāma–svapararūpayoḥ vyāmohavicchedahetutvam, abādhitatvam, saṃskārajananayogyatā, viśiṣṭakāraṇakalāpādātmalābho vā ? prathamavikalpe asmanmatasiddhiḥ, syādvādibhiḥ anadhyavasāyādilakṣaṇavyāmohavicchedahetoḥ jñānaviśeṣasya ajñānanivṛttidharmāśrayatvā'bhyupagamāt

uttaravikalpatrayamapi asmanmatameva avagāhate, svapararūpayoḥ vyāmohavicchedaṃ kurvato jñānaviśeṣasya abādhitasya saṃskārajananayogyasya viśiṣṭakāraṇakalāpādāvirbhāvamābibhrataḥ ajñānanivṛttidharmādhāratvopapatteḥ
tataḥ sūktam–pramāṇadharmatvād ajñānanivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ phalaṃ pramāṇādabhinnam, hānopādānādikaṃ tu bhinnam

nanu yathā svārthagrahaṇābhimukhyalakṣaṇopayogarūpaṃ jñānaṃ svaparapramitirūpa-ajñānanivṛttirūpatayā pariṇamate tathā hānādirūpatayāpi, tatkathamasya bhinnaphalatvamiti cet ? tadvyavahitatvāt, samutpanne hi ajñānanivṛttilakṣaṇe phale hānopādānādilakṣaṇaṃ phalamutpadyate iti ajñānanivṛttilakṣaṇena phalena asya vyavadhānād bhinnatvam, ajñānanivṛttestu apareṇa svapne'pi avyavadhānādabhinnatvam
tanna kārakatvalakṣaṇād hetoḥ pramāṇa-phalayoḥ sarvathā bhedaḥ siddhyati
yadapyabhihitam–viśeṣaṇajñānaṃ pramāṇam viśeṣyajñānaṃ phalam ityādi; tadapyapeśalam; viśeṣaṇa-viśeṣyayorvibhinnajñānālambanatvā'bhāvāt
ekameva hi jñānaṃ tadālambanam, na hi śukla paṭa, daṇḍī puruṣa ityādau viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorjñānabhedo'nubhūyate; pratītivirodhāt

na ca viṣayabhedāt jñānabhedaḥ; pañcāṅgulāderviṣayasya anekasyāpi ekajñānā'lambanatvāt, kathamanyathā sadasadvarga kasyacid ekajñānālambanam anekatvāt pañcāṅgulavat ityatra asya dṛṣṭāntatā ? kathaṃ vā avayavinaḥ siddhiḥ, ūrdhvā-'dho-madhyabhāgānāmapi ekajñānālambanatvā'bhāvaprasaṅgata tadvyāpitvena asya siddhyanupapatteḥ ?
yā'pi viśepaṇākṣasannikarpādilakṣaṇā vibhinnā sāmagrī pratipāditā; sāpi anupapannā, sannikarṣasya prāgeva pratikṣiptatvāt
sati ca kāryabhede kāraṇabhedaḥ kalpayituṃ yuktaḥ, na cātra tadbhedo'sti ityuktam
tata sūktam–pramāṇaphalayoḥ kramabhāve'pi tādātmyam abhinnaviṣayatvañca pratyeyam iti
nirmūlya lakṣaṇamathānyamataprarūḍham, pratyakṣalakṣaṇamidaṃ gaditaṃ pramāyā | tārāprabhāprakaṭitaṃ khalu vastujātam, indu prakāśayati tatra kimasti citram || 1
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre pratyakṣapariccheda prathama | graṃ–4500
samyagviṣayavatā hi pramāṇena bhavitavyam, samīcīnaśca viṣayaḥ pramāṇasya yādṛśo bhavati, taṃ darśayan prakṛtamarthañcopasaṃharannāha–
nāntarbahirvā svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā parasparā'nātmakaṃ prameyaṃ yathā manyate paraiḥ; dravyaparyāyātmano'rthasya buddhau pratibhāsanāt
na kevalaṃ sākṣātkaraṇam ekānte na saṃbhavati, api tu–
yato'vagrahādīnāṃ pramāṇa–phalabhūtānāṃ kramabhāve'pi tādātmyam abhinnaviṣayatvañca tat tasmāt arthaḥarthakriyāsamarthaḥ pramāṇagocaro bhāvaḥ dravyaparyāyātmakaḥ bahiḥ ghaṭādiḥ ityarthaḥ
kalpanātaḥ sa tathāvidhaḥ syāt, ityatrāha– tattvataḥ paramārthataḥ
bheda ityādinā tad vyācaṣṭe–bhedā'bhedaikāntayoranupalabdheḥ kāraṇāt arthasya siddhiḥ niṣpattiḥ nirṇītirvā anekāntāt anekāntena hetunā, taṃ vā āśritya
nahi bhedaikānte vaiśeṣikābhyupagate ṣaṭpadārthalakṣaṇe, naiyāyikābhyupagate vā ṣoḍaśapadārthalakṣaṇe arthasya siddhiḥ ghaṭate; pramāṇato'prasiddhasvarūpāṇāṃ teṣāmarthasiddhinibandhanatvā'nupapatteḥ
yat pramāṇato'prasiddhasvarūpaṃ na tad arthasiddhinibandhanam yathā gaganendīvaram, pramāṇato'prasiddhasvarūpāśca yaugābhyupagatāḥ padārthā iti

nanu vaiśepikairabhyupagatā dravya-guṇa-karma-sāmānya-viśeṣa-samavāyākhyāḥ ṣaṭ padārthāḥ abhāvākhyaśca saptama, te ca anyonyā'saṃbhavilakṣaṇalakṣitatvena anyonyamekāntato bhinnā pramāṇata suprasiddhā eva
tathā ca sūtram–kriyāvad guṇavat samavāyikāraṇaṃ dravyam vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
abhāvasya ca samānatantrasiddhasyā'pratiṣiddhasya nyāyadarśane mānasendriyatāsiddhivadatrāpyavirodhāt abhyupagamasiddhāntasiddhatvāt
pṛthivyāpastejovāyurākāśa kālo digātmā mana iti dravyāṇi

tacca ida dravyalakṣaṇa kevalavyatirekyanumānam, tathāhi–dravyam itarebhyo bhidyate dravyatvābhisambandhāt kriyāvadguṇavatsamavāyikāraṇatvādvā, yat punaḥ itarebhyo na bhidyate na tattathā yathā guṇādi, tathā ca tat, tasmād itarebhyo bhidyate
vyavahāro vā sādhya–vivādāspadībhūtaṃ vastu dravyam iti vyavaharttavyam prāktanādeva heto, yattu naivaṃ vyavahriyate na tat tathā yathā guṇādi, tathā cedam, tasmāt dravyam iti vyavaharttavyam

evaṃ śeṣalakṣaṇānyapi, pṛthivītvābhisambandhāt pṛthivī praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 20 aptvābhisambandhād āpaḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 35 tejastvābhisambandhāt tejaḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 38 vāyutvābhisambandhād vāyuḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 44 ityetāni boddhavyāni
ākāśa-kāla-diśāṃ tu ekaikatvāt tallakṣaṇabhūtā' parasāmānyā'bhāve'pi pāribhāṣikāḥ kya tisraḥ saṃjñā lakṣaṇam–ākāśam, kāla, dik iti

tathāhi–ākāśam itarebhyo bhidyate, vivādāspadībhūtaṃ dravyam ākāśam iti vyavaharttavyam, anādikālapravāhā''yāta-ākāśaśabdavācyatvāt, yattu itarebhyo na bhidyate na ca ākāśam iti vyavahriyate na tad anādikālapravāhā''yātā''kāśaśabdavācyam yathā rūpādi, tacchabdavācyañcedam, tasmāduktasādhyamiti
ātmatvā'bhisambandhād ātmā praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 69 manastvābhisambandhāt manaḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 89 ityatrāpi pūrvavat kevalavyatirekyanumānaṃ draṣṭavyam
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānām iha iti pratyayaheturyaḥ sambandhaḥ sa samavāya iti
tathāhi–pṛthivyādīni itarasmād bhidyante dravyāṇīti vā vyavaharttavyāni dravyatvayogāt
ākāśakāladiśāmekaikatvādaparajātyabhāve pāribhāṣikyastisraḥ saṃjñā bhavanti ākāśa kālo digiti
rūparasagandhasparśā saṃkhyā parimāṇāni pṛthaktva saṃyogavibhāgau paratvāparatve buddhaya sukhaduḥkhe icchādveṣau prayatnāśca guṇā
iti kaṇṭhoktā saptadaśa, caśabdasamuccitāśca gurutvadravatvasnehasaṃskārādṛṣṭaśabdā sapta ityevaṃ caturviśatirguṇā
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānāṃ yaḥ sambandha ihapratyayahetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ
yattāvaduktam–pṛthivyaptejovāyavo dvividhāḥ ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; paramāṇurūpāṇāṃ teṣāṃ sadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt
nanvidamasti–dvyaṇukādikāryaṃ svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇakāraṇā''rabdhaṃ kāryatvāt ghaṭādivat; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; kāryasya svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇakāraṇārabdhatvaniyamā'saṃbhavāt
tathāhi–ki kāryamātraṃ tadāravdha prasādhyeta, dravyatvaviśiṣṭaṃ vā kāryam ? prathamapakṣe buddhyādibhirvyabhicāraḥ, teṣāṃ kāryatve satyapi svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇakāraṇārabdhatvaniyamā'saṃbhavāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu bhasmādinā anekāntaḥ, tasya dravyatve sati kāryatve satyapi tato'lpapa rimāṇakāraṇārabdhatvā'pratīte
na khalu kāryaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇameva dravyaṃ kāraṇam iti sarvatra vyāpti, kintu kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ vinā na bhavati iti vyāptiḥ, kāryaparimāṇād adhikasya nyūnasya samasya vā dravyasya kāraṇatvapratīteḥ

tatra mahataḥ palālakūṭāt praśithilāvayavakārpāsapiṇḍācca nyūnaparimāṇasya bhasmanaḥ nibiḍā'vayavakārpāsapiṇḍasya ca prādurbhāvaḥ pratīyate, alpaparimāṇācca bījāt mahāparimāṇasya vṛkṣādeḥ, samaparimāṇācca dugdhāde samaparimāṇasya dadhyāde iti

na ca kiñcit kāryadravyaṃ svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇakāraṇapūrvakamupalabhya sarvaṃ kāryadravyaṃ tathā sādhayituṃ yuktam, śabda-vidyut-pradīpādīnāṃ kṣaṇikatvamupalabhya sakalārthānāṃ sattvāde kṣaṇikatvasādhanaprasaṅgāt
dṛṣṭāntamātrasadbhāve'pi atra sākalyena vyāpterabhāvānna tatsādhakatvam ityanyatrāpi samānam
ataḥ paramāṇūnāṃ sadbhāvasya kutaścit pramāṇādaprasiddhe paramāṇurūpāḥ pṛthivyādayo nityā sadakāraṇavattvāt ityatra hetorviśeṣaṇā'siddhatvam
tathā kāryādalpaparimāṇaṃ samavāyikāraṇam tasyāpyanyad alpaparimāṇam ityādyaṃ kāryaṃ niratiśayaparamāṇuparimāṇairārabdhamiti jñāyate
kaścit parimāṇādaṇuparimāṇakāraṇapūrvaka kaścit mahāparimāṇakāraṇapūrvaka kaścit samānakāraṇārabdha
viśeṣyā'siddhatvañca skandhabhedapūrvakatvāttepām, tathāhi–paramāṇava skandhā'vayavidravyavināśakāraṇakā tadbhāvabhāvitvāt ghaṭavināśapūrvakakapālavat
vibhāga eva tadvināśājjāyate nāṇava; ityayuktam; skandhasyāpyevamahetukatvaprasaṅgāt
śakyate hi vaktum–saṃyoga eva aṇusaṅghātājjāyate na skandhaḥ iti

sarvadā svatantraparamāṇūnāṃ tadvināśamantareṇā'pi sadbhāvasaṃbhavād bhāgā'siddho hetu; ityapi manorathamātram, teṣāmasiddhe, vivādāpannā paramāṇava skandhabhedapūrvakā eva tattvāt dvyaṇukādibhedapūrvakaparamāṇuvat ityanumānavirodhācca

nanu paṭottarakālabhāvitantūnāṃ paṭabhedapūrvakatve'pi tatpūrvakālabhāvināṃ teṣāmatatpūrvakatvavat paramāṇūnāmapi askandhabhedapūrvakatvaṃ keṣāñcit syāt, ityapyasundaram, teṣāmapi praveṇībhedapūrvakatvena skandhabhedapūrvakatvaprasiddhe

nanu paramāṇūnāṃ grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvato bhavadbhireva abhāvapratipādanāt na teṣāṃ skandhabhedapūrvakatvapratijñā śreyasī, ityapyanupapannam, bhavatāmeva anavadyatatsādhakapramāṇā'bhāvataḥ tadabhāvapratipādanāt, asmākantu niravadyatatsādhakā'numānasya sadbhāvataḥ teṣāṃ sadbhāvopapatte tadbhe dapūrvakatvapratijñā upapannaiva
yatra ca asya viśrāntiḥ te paramāṇavaḥ, iti na teṣāṃ sadbhāvā'saṃbhavaḥ
tathā ghaṭādikāraṇakāraṇeṣu alpatarādibhāvaḥ kvacidviśrāntaḥ taratamaśabdavācyatvāt mahāparimāṇavat, yatra viśrāntaste paramāṇava iti
aṇuparimāṇatāratamyaṃ kvacidviśrāntaṃ parimāṇatāratamyatvāt mahatparimāṇatāratamyavat, yatreda viśrāntaṃ yataḥ paramāṇurnāsti sa paramāṇu

nityaikarūpatāyā eva asaṃbhavāt, tadrūpatāyāṃ teṣāṃ krama-yaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvā'nupapatteḥ; tathāhi–ekāntato nityasvabhāvāḥ santaḥ paramāṇavaḥ sarvadā kāryā'jananasvabhāvā iṣyante, tadviparītā vā ? prathamavikalpe dvyaṇukādikāryasya sarvadā'sattvaprasaṅgaḥ sarvadā tadajananasvabhāvebhyaḥ tebhyaḥ tadutpattyanupapatteḥ; yad yadajananasvabhāvam na tatastadutpattiḥ yathā śālibījād yavāṅkurasya, dvyaṇukādikāryā'jananasvabhāvāśca sarvadā bhavadbhiḥ parikalpyante paramāṇava iti
tathā ca paramāṇūnāmapi asattvameva syāt, kāryā'kāritvāt, yat kāryā'kāri na tat sat yathā gaganendīvaram, kāryā'kāriṇaśca sarvadā tadajananaikasvabhāvatayā bhavanmate paramāṇava iti

atha sarvadā kāryajananaikasvabhāvāste'bhyupagamyante tatrāpi–kim ekākinaste tajjananaikasvabhāvā iṣyante, sahakārisamanvitā vā ? yadi ekākinaḥ; tadā tatprabhavakāryāṇāṃ sakṛdeva utpattiḥ syāt, avikalakāraṇatvāt, ye avikalakāraṇāḥ te sakṛdeva utpadyante yathā samānasamayotpādā vahavo'ṅkurāḥ, avikalakāraṇāśca jananaikasvabhāvā'ṇukāryatvena abhimatāḥ sarve bhāvā iti
nityatve sakalā sthūlā jāyeran sakṛdeva hi
yadi parvatādīnā sthūlānā kāraṇabhūtāḥ paramāṇavo nityā santītyabhyupagamyante tadā tatkāryāṇā sthūlānāmavikalakāraṇatvāt sakṛdevotpattiprasaṅgaḥ
prayogaḥ– ye samagrā'pratibaddhakāraṇā te sakṛdeva bhavanti, yathā vahavo'ṅkurāstulyotpādā
nanu samavāyi-asamavāyi-nimittabhedāt trividhaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryajanmani vyāpriyate
yatra hi kārya samavaiti tat samavāyikāraṇam yathā dvyaṇukasya aṇudvayam
yacca kāryaikārthasamavetaṃ kāryakāraṇaikārthasamavetaṃ vā kāryamutpādayati tad asamavāyikāraṇam yathā paṭārambhe tantusaṃyogaḥ, paṭa samavetarūpādyārambhe paṭotpādakatanturūpādi ca
tatra saṃyogāderapekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt avikalakāraṇatvaṃ teṣāmasiddham; ityapi śraddhāmātram; saṃyogādinā anādheyā'tiśayatvenā'ṇūnāṃ tadapekṣā'nupapatteḥ
atha saṃyoga eva amīṣāmatiśaya, sa kiṃ nityaḥ, anityo vā ? nityaścet; sarvadā kāryotpatti syāt tadatiśayabhūtasya saṃyogasya sadā sattvāt
atha anityaḥ, tadā tadutpattau ko'tiśaya syāt–saṃyoga eva, kriyā vā ? saṃyogaścet; ki sa eva, saṃyogāntaraṃ vā ? na tāvat sa eva, asya adyāpyasiddhe, svotpattau svasyaiva vyāpāravirodhācca
nāpi saṃyogāntaram; nasya anabhyupagamāt, abhyupagame vā tadutpattāvapi aparasaṃyogātiśayakalpanāprasaṅgād anavasthā syāt
kiñca, adṛṣṭāpekṣād ātmā'ṇusaṃyogāt paramāṇuṣu kriyā utpadyate iti bhavatā'bhyupagamāt, ātma-paramāṇusaṃyogotpattāvapi aparo'tiśayaḥ kalpanīyaḥ tatra ca tadeva dūṣaṇam, iti aparā'navasthā
syādetat trividhaṃ kāraṇami samavāyikāraṇamasamavāyikāraṇaṃ nimittakāraṇaṃ catatra apekṣaṇīyasya saṃyogāderasannihitatvāt samagrakāraṇatvamasiddham ato'siddho hetu, ityāśaṃkyāha–saṃyogādīti
yadi hi saṃyogādinā kaścid viśeṣo'ṇūnāmādhīyeta tadā te tamapekṣeran
yāvat parairanādheyaviśeṣā evāṇavo nityatvāt tatkathaṃ sayogādi teṣāmapekṣyaṃ syāt
sarvānmagatavṛttilabdhā'dṛṣṭāpekṣebhya tatsayogebhya pavanaparamāṇuṣu karmotpattau praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 48
sarvātmagatāśca vṛttilabdhāścu adṛṣṭāśca tānapekṣante ye tatsayogā ātmāṇusayogā tebhyaḥ pavanaparamāṇupu rkmāṇyutpadyante
pavanaparamāṇava samavāyikāraṇam, labdhavṛttyadṛṣṭavadātmaparamāṇusaṃyogaḥ asamavāyikāraṇam, adṛṣṭa nimittakāraṇam

kiñca, asau saṃyogo dvyaṇukādinirvarttaka kiṃ paramāṇvāśrita, tadanyāśrita, anāśrito vā ? tatra ādyapakṣe tadutpattau āśrayaḥ utpadyate, na vā ? yadi utpadyate; tadā aṇūnāmapi kāryatā'nupaṅga asaṃyogarūpatāparityāgena saṃyogarūpatayā pariṇamanāt

atha notpadyate, kathaṃ tarhi asau tadāśritaḥ syāt, viruddhadharmā'dhyāsata tatastasya atyantabhedaprasaṅgāt ? tathābhūto'pyasau tatsambaddhatvāt tadāśrita iti cet; kena puna sambandhena asau tatsambaddhasamavāyena, saṃyogena, kāryakāraṇabhāvena vā ? na tāvat samavāyena; asyā'sattvāt, tadasattvañca agre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt siddham
nāpi saṃyogena; saṃyoge saṃyogasyā'saṃbhavāt guṇatvena asya dravyavṛttitvāt
nāpi kāryakāraṇabhāvena; saṃyogaṃ prati aṇūnāṃ kāraṇatvā'bhāvāt, tadabhāvaśca anatiśayatvāt
anyāśritatve tu saṃyogamya paramāṇvatiśayatvā'nutpatti tatsambandhā'bhāvāt, yatraiva hi asau āśrita tasyaiva atiśaya nānyasya atiprasaṅgāt
anāśritatvaṃ tu tasya anupapannam, guṇatvāt, yo guṇaḥ nāsau anāśritaḥ yathā rūpādi, guṇaśca bhavadbhirabhipreta saṃyoga iti
anāśritatve vā guṇatvā'nupapatti; yadanāśritam na tad guṇa yathā ākāśādi, anāśritaśca paramāṇvatiśayarūpatayā bhavatkalpita saṃyoga iti
kiñca, asau saṃyogaḥ teṣāṃ sarvātmanā, ekadeśena vā syāt ? yadi-sarvātmanā; piṇḍo'ṇumātraḥ syāt
nāpi sahakārisamanvitānām; yataḥ teṣāṃ sahakāriṇaḥ svagatā'tiśayaviśeṣā eva, vastvantarāṇi vā ? prathamapakṣe prāgukta-aśeṣadoṣā'nuṣaṅgaḥ
dvitīyapakṣe'pi vastvantarāṇi aṇūnāmupakāraṃ kurvanti, na vā ? kurvanti cet; ki bhinnam, abhinnaṃ vā ? yadi abhinnam; tadā teṣāṃ kāryatvam
atha bhinnam; tadā tata eva kāryaniṣpatteḥ paramāṇūnāmakārakatvaṃ syāt
atha tatkṛtopakārasahakāriṇaste kārakā; nanu upakārasya tatsahakāritvam upakārāntareṇa, sattāmātreṇa vā ? tatra ādyavikalpe anavasthā upakārāntarasyāpi upakārāntarakāritvenaiva sahakāritvaprasaṅgāt
dvitīyavikalpe tu atiprasaṅgaḥ, sattāmātreṇa sarvasya sarvaṃ prati sahakāritvaprasakteḥ

kiñca, ete sahakāriṇaḥ parasparopakāryopakārakabhāvena aṇūnupakurvanti, anyathā vā ? yadi upakāryopakārakabhāvena; tadā punarapi upakārasya tebhyo bhedā'bhedapakṣayoḥ prāguktā'śeṣadoṣopanipātaprasaṅgaḥ

atha sahakāriṇaḥ aṇūnāṃ parasparasya vā na kiñcit kurvanti, kāryasyaiva militvā taiḥ nirvartanāt; etadapyayuktam; yataḥ pratyekaṃ samarthāḥ santo'ṇavaḥ sahakāribhiḥ saha militvā kāryaṃ kurvanti, asamarthā vā ? yadi samarthāḥ; tadā pratyekaṃ teṣāñca kāryajanakatvaprasaṅgāt tāvaddhā kāryasya bhedaprasaṅgaḥ, sahakāryapekṣāvaiyarthyañca syāt

atha pratyekamasamarthāste; tarhi tatsannidhāne kutasteṣāṃ sāmarthyaṃ syāt ? sahakāribhya eva iti cet, nanu taistebhyo'bhinnam, bhinnaṃ vā sāmarthyaṃ vidhīyate ? yadi abhinnam; tadā teṣāṃ kāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ
atha bhinnam; tadā teṣāṃ tena sambandhā'nupapattiḥ samavāyāderasaṃbhavāt, tata eva kāryotpattiprasaktitaḥ aṇūnāmakārakatvañca syāt

astu vā yathākathañcit teṣāṃ sāmarthyam; tathāpi yena rūpeṇa ekaṃ kāryaṃ paramāṇavo janayanti tenaiva kāryāntaram, rūpāntareṇa vā ? yadi tenaiva; tadā sakalakāryāṇāmekatvaprasaṅgaḥ, ekasvabhāvakāraṇakāryatvāt, yat ekasvabhāvakāraṇakāryam tad ekam yathā vivakṣitakāryam, tathābhūtāni ca paramāṇukāryatayā'bhimatāni akhilakāryāṇi iti

atha rūpāntareṇa; tadā tatkāle prāktanaṃ tadrūpaṃ nivarttate, na vā ? yadi nivarttate; tadā aṇūnāmanityatvaprasaṅgaḥ, svarūpapracyutilakṣaṇatvāttasya, yasya svarūpapracyutiḥ tadanityam yathā ghaṭādi, prāktanasvarūpapracyutiśca rūpāntarotpattisamaye'ṇūnāmiti

atha na nivarttate; tadā kathaṃ teṣāṃ rūpāntarasaṃbhavaḥ ? yatra prāktanaṃ rūpaṃ na nivarttate na tatra rūpāntarasya sabhava yathā'nivarttamānasaṅkocitarūpāyāmaṅgulyāṃ prasārinarūpasya, na nivartate ca uttarakāryajananasvarūpasamaye prāktanaṃ kāryajananasvarūpaṃ paramāṇūnām iti
tatsamaye teṣā tatsambhave vā yugapat sakalakāryajananasāmarthyasaṃbhavād yugapadeva akhilakāryāṇāmutpāda syāt
tadevamekāntato nityaikasvabhāvatāyāṃ paramāṇūnā kāryakāritvā'nupapatte prāktana-ajanakasvabhāvaparityāgena viśiṣṭasaṃyogapariṇāmapariṇatānāṃ janakasvabhāvasabhavāt siddha kathañcidanityatvam
prayoga–ye kramavatkāryahetavaḥ te anityāḥ yathā kramavadaṅkurādinirvarttakā vījādaya, tathābhūtāśca paramāṇava iti
kiṃ yena svabhāvena ādyāmarthakriyāṃ karoti kiṃ tenaiva uttarāṇi kāryāṇi, samāsāditasvabhāvāntara karoti ? tattvopa॰ pṛ॰ 126
nāpi tadārabdhaṃ dvyaṇukādyavayavidravyam, siddhe hi kārya-kāraṇabhāve tadārabdhatvaṃ dvyaṇukāde vaktuṃ śakyeta, na ca bhavanmate asau siddha vicāryamāṇasya asya atrā'nupapadyamānatvāt

tathāhi–yaugamate tāvat kimida dvyaṇukādyavayavidravyasya kāryatvaṃ nāma–svakāraṇasattāsamavāya, abhūtvābhāvitvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe ki kāryasya svakāraṇai sattayā ca samavāyaḥ, ki vā svakāraṇānāṃ sattayā samavāya, āhosvit sattayā yuktastatsamavāya iti ? tatra ādyapakṣe ki kāryasya utpannasya tai tayā ca samavāya, anutpannasya, ubhayarūpasya, anubhayarūpasya vā ? yadi utpannasya; anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi svakāraṇasattāsamavāye kāryasya utpattisiddhi, tatsiddhau ca tatsamavāyasiddhiriti

tatsamavāyanirapekṣasya cā'sya svātantryeṇotpattau tatsamavāyakalpanānarthakyam, yat svātantryeṇa prasiddham na tat kvacidanyatra samavaiti yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭe, svātantryeṇa prasiddhañca bhavanmate kāryamiti
kāraṇavārttā cātra atidurlabhā, padārthātmalābhe hi vyāpriyamāṇasya vastuna kāraṇatvaṃ vyapadiśyate nānyasya atiprasaṅgāt
niṣpannaniṣpattyarthañcāmya vyāpāre sarvadā'nuparatiprasaṅgāt na kadācit kāryasya svarūpasiddhiḥ syāt

anutpannasya cāsya ākāśakuśeśayaprakhyatvāt kathaṃ svakāraṇai sattayā ca samavāyaḥ syāt ? utpannā'nutpannatvañca ekasyaikadā'tidurghaṭam, na hi ekatraikadā parasparaviruddhau dharmau ekāntavādino ghaṭete
anubhaya rūpatā tu asya anupapannā; vidhipratiṣedhadharmayormadhye ekataraniṣedhe anyataravidheravaśyaṃbhāvitvāt
kāraṇānāṃ tu sattayā samavāye kāryasya kimāyātam ? nahi ghaṭasya sattayā samavāye paṭasya kiñcid bhavati
svakāraṇe samavāya, prāgasata sattāsamavāyo vā kāryatvamityeke, tadayuktam pravase tadabhāvāt, tasmāt kāraṇādhīnaḥ svātmalābha kāryatvam
kimida kāryatva nāma ? svakāraṇasattāsambandha, tena sattā kāryamiti vyabahārāt

kiñca, kāryasvarūpamapekṣya kāraṇasya kāraṇavyapadeśo bhavati, na ca aśvaviṣāṇaprakhyasya kāryasya kiñcidrūpaṃ paśyāmaḥ yadapekṣya asya kāraṇatvaṃ syāt, akāraṇatve cāsya kathaṃ kāryaniṣpādakatvam ? atha sattayā sahitaḥ tatsamavāya eva kāryasya kāryatvam; tanna; samavāyasyāsiddhasvarūpatayā tallakṣaṇatvā'yogāt, tadasiddhasvarūpatā cāsya agrenirākariṣyamāṇatvāt suprasiddhā
astu vā'sau; tathāpi asya nityatayā ātmādivat kāryatvā'yogaḥ, tattvevā nityatvā'nupapattiḥ; yat kāryam na tannityam yathā ghaṭādi, kāryaśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaḥ samavāya iti
sattāyuktasamavāyasya ca kāryalakṣaṇatve tathāvidhasyāsya sarvatra sarvadā sarvān pratyaviśeṣāt ākāśādīnāmapi kāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ
kiñca, ayaṃ samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ, sambandhaśca sambandhikāryaḥ sambandhyāśritaśca bhavati yathā saṃyogaḥ

kāryabhūtasya ca sambandhino'niṣpannatvāt na tatkāryatvaṃ tadāśritatvaṃ vā samavāye ghaṭate, tanniṣpattau vā yutasiddhatvena tatra saṃyoga eva syāt na samavāyaḥ, tasya ayutasiddhasambandhyāśritatvena yogaiḥ abhyupagamāt
atha vilakṣaṇo'yaṃ sambandhaḥ yadasiddhe'pi sambandhini syāt; tadasat; yataḥ sambadhnāti sambandhinau iti sambandhaḥ, sa ca asati sambadhini kathaṃ syāt ? anyathā vandhyāyāḥ tatsute sambandhaḥ syāt
pradhvaṃsasya ca sattāsamavāyā'bhāvataḥ akāryatvaprasaṅgāt tadutpattaye mudgarādikāraṇavaiyarthyam

atha abhūtvābhāvitvaṃ kāryatvam; tadapi kasya ? yo'bhūtvā bhavati tasya iti cet; nanu cātra abhavane bhavane ca kasya kartṛtvam ? kāryasya tāvat śaśaviṣāṇaprakhyatvāt na kartṛtvam, bhavanaṃ hi svarūpasvīkāraḥ, sa ca asato durghaṭaḥ

nāpi kāraṇatvam; taddhi kāryamātraniṣpādakatvam, niyatakāryaniṣpādakatvaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ syāt tanmātraniṣpādakatvasya sarvatra saṃbhavāt, iti na niyatakāryārthī kaścit niyatakāraṇopādānaṃ kuryāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu kāryasya aśvaviṣāṇaprakhyatvāt kathaṃ kāraṇasvarūpaṃ tena avacchidyeta ? vāstavaṃ hi rūpaṃ satā eva avacchidyate
asatā avacchede ca kāraṇasyāpi asattvaprasaṅgaḥ asan ghaṭaḥ iti yathā
vikalpamātrakalpitena tena tasya avacchede tu kāraṇatvamapi tādṛgeva syāt, nahi kalpitena avacchede vastuno vāstavaṃ rūpaṃ siddhyati, yathā siho māṇavaka iti
kiñca, kāraṇānāṃ kāryālambanā pravṛttiḥ, anālambanā vā ? yadi anālambanā; na kvacittāni virameyu, tataśca kharavipāṇādīnāmapi udbhava syāt
atha kāryālambanā; tadā'sya sattā aṅgīkṛtā syāt, iti kāraṇavyāpāravaiphalyam

nanu kāraṇānāṃ na vyāpāravaśena kāraṇatvam, kintu yadbhāvā'bhāvābhyāṃ yasya bhāvā'bhāvau tat tasya kāryam itarat kāraṇam iti vyapadiśyate, tadasatyam, evaṃ sati yathā tadabhāve na bhavati ityatra na kaścid vyāpāraḥ kāraṇagata tathā tadbhāve bhavati iti kāraṇasadbhāvamātraṃ pratipāditaṃ syāt, na kāryaviṣaye kiñcitkaratvam
kathañcaivaṃvādina gaganāde kvacit kāraṇatvasiddhiḥ tasya nityatva-vyāpitvābhyāṃ deśakālakṛtavyatirekā'saṃbhavāt

kiñca, tasmin sati bhavati iti tacchabdena yo nirdiṣṭa bhavati ityanena ca, tayorupakāryopakārakabhāvā'bhāve saṃbhavati sa bhavati iti mṛdarthamātrapratipādanameva kṛta syāt, tataśca parāpekṣāpratilabdhakarmādyabhidhānapravṛttadvitīyādivibhaktivācyatā na kvacit syāt, iti svarūpasattāmātreṇaiva arthāḥ pratipāditā syuḥ na sāmarthyabhāktvena
kāraṇe kārye ca tacchabdanirdeśena tammin mṛllakṣaṇe'rthe sa bhavati iti mṛllakṣaṇa evārtho bhavatīti ayamartha syāt na ghaṭo bhavati ityarthaḥ
atha pūrvakālabhāvitvamātraṃ kāraṇatvam na tu vyāpāraḥ kaścit, tarhi sarvepāṃ pūrvakālabhāvināṃ jagadudaravartināṃ kāraṇatvaprasaṅgādatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt
atha niyamena pūrvakālabhāvitvam, tarhi mervāderapi paṭaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ syāt tadaviśepāt
nanu naiva mervādiḥ pūrvameva bhavati uttarakālamapi anuvṛtte, ityanyatrāpi samānam, nahi tantava paṭotpattyuttarakālaṃ nānuvarttante pratītivirodhāt

nanu niyatakāla eva kāryakāraṇabhāva antyatantusaṃyogopalakṣitāyā sāmagryā eva paṭaṃ prati kāraṇatvāt, paṭasyāpi svasattālābhakṣaṇe eva kāryatvam, anyathā avikalakārakasāmagrīsannidhāne punaḥ paṭāntarotpattiḥ syāt
nanvevaṃ pūrvakṣaṇabhāvini kāraṇe anantarakṣaṇabhāvini ca kārye svakālaniyate sahabhāvā'bhāvāt itaretarasavyapekṣaṃ yat kāryatvaṃ kāraṇatvañca tad durghaṭam

kiñca, asati vyāpāre niyamena pūrvakālabhāvitvamātreṇa kāraṇatvakalpane vījapūrakādirūpotpattau tadavayavagatānāṃ rasādīnāmapi kāraṇatvaṃ syāt, tathā rasādyutpattau tadavayavagatarūpasyāpi, ataśca rūpādīnāṃ niyamena sajātyārambhakatvaṃ na syāt
tadevaṃ paramate kāryakāraṇabhāvasya vicāryamāṇasya anupapadyamānatvāt dvyaṇukādyavayavirūpā pṛthivyādayo'nityāḥ utpattimattvāt ityādyayuktam; hetoḥ svarūpā'siddhatvāt
utpattimattvaṃ hi kāryatvamucyate, tacca uktaprakāreṇa bhavanmate sarvathā'siddham
ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyām avayava-avayavinau atyanta bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvādibhya iti yaugānā pūrvapakṣa–

nanu ato'numānāt tasya tebhyaḥ sarvathā vibhinnasya prasiddhiḥ–avayava-avayavinau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ghaṭapaṭavat, ghaṭapaṭādau hi bhinnapratibhāsitvamatyantabhede satyeva upalabdham iti avayava-avayavinoḥ tad upalabhyamānaṃ kathannātyantabhedaṃ prasādhayet ? anyatrāpi asya tadaprasādhakatvaprasaṅgāt

naca viruddhadharmādhyāso'pyanayoḥ asiddhaḥ; paṭo hi paṭatvajātisambandhī vilakṣaṇā'rthakriyāsampādakaḥ atiśayena mahattvayuktaḥ, tantavaḥ tantutvajātisambandhinaḥ alpaparimāṇādidharmopetāśca, iti kathannā'to bhidyante ? vibhinnakartṛkatvācca ghaṭa-paṭavat, tantavo hi cātra praveṇī-raṇḍākaravyāpārād ātmalābhaṃ pratipadyante, turi-tantu-vema-śalākā-tantuvāyavyāpārāttu paṭa iti
vibhinnaśaktikatvācca viṣa-agadavad avayava-avayavinorbheda eva, pūrvottarakālabhāvitvācca pitā-putravat, vibhinnaparimāṇatvācca badara-āmalakavat

pratibhāsabhede viruddhadharmādhyāsādau ca satyapi anayorabhede padārthasaṅkaraḥ syāt sarvatra bhedavyavahārocchedaprasaṅgāt, nahi pratibhāsabhedādikaṃ vihāya anyat tadvyavahāranibandhanamutprekṣāmahe

tādātmyā'bhyupagame ca avayavā'vayavinoḥ pratibhāsabhedādikamatidurlabham; tādātmyaṃ hi ekatvamucyate, tasmin sati kathaṃ pratibhāsabhedo viruddhadharmādhyāsādikaṃ vā syāt vibhinnaviṣayatvāt tayoḥ ? yadi ca tantvādyavayavebhyo nārthāntaraṃ paṭādyavayavī; tarhi tantavo'pi svāṃśubhyo nā'rthāntaram te'pi svā'vayavebhyaḥ iti evaṃ tāvat yāvanniraṃśāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, tebhyaśca abhede sarvasya kāryagrāmasya anupalambhaḥ syāt
tasmād arthāntarameva avayavebhyaḥ avayavī pratipattavya iti

na ceyamasiddhā; tathāhi–arthāntarabhūtaḥ paṭādyavayavī tantvādyavayaveṣu ekadeśena vartteta, sarvātmanā vā ? na tāvad ekadeśena; avayavavyatirekeṇa avayavino'paradeśā'bhāvāt, bhāve vā teṣvapi anena itthaṃ varttitavyam iti anavasthā syāt
sarvātmanā vṛttau; ekatraiva avayave sarvātmanā'sya vṛttatvād anyeṣāmavayavānāmavayaviśūnyatāprasaṅgaḥ, yāvanto vā'vayavāḥ tāvanto'vayavinaḥ syuḥ pratyavayavaṃ tasya sarvātmanā parisamāptatvāt
tadapyasamīcīnam; yata avayavino nirāse svatantramidaṃ sādhanam, prasaṅgasādhanaṃ vā ? yadi svatantram; dharmi-sādhyapadayo vyāghāta yathā idañca, nāsti ca iti
na ca vṛttyā sattvaṃ vyāptam, samavāyavṛtteranabhyupagame'pi bhavatā rūpādeḥ sattvābhyupagamāt
ekadeśena sarvātmanā vā avayavino vṛttipratiṣedhe viśeṣapratiṣedhasya śeṣābhyanujñāviṣayatvāt prakārāntareṇa vṛttirabhyupagatā syāt, anyathā na vartate ityeva abhidhātavyam
vṛttiśca samavāyaḥ, tasya sarvatra ekatvāt niravayavatvācca kārtsnyaikadeśaśabdā'viṣayatvam, kārtsnyaikadeśaśabdayorbhedaviṣayatvācca abhinne'vayavini pravṛttirayuktā
kṛtsnam iti hi anekatve sati aśeṣasyā'bhidhānam, ekadeśa iti ca anekatve sati kasyacidabhidhānam
tau etau kārtsnya-ekadeśaśabdau bhede satyeva pratipannatvād ekasmin avayavini anupapannau
tathā hi vṛttyanupapatterasattvamiti kimidaṃ svatantrasādhanamuta prasaṅgasādhanamiti
yadi svatantrasādhanam, avayavī dharmīṃ, nāstīti sādhyamiti pratijñāvākyapadayo vyādhāta yathā ida nāsti ceti
tathā svamate rūpādīnā sattva na ca vṛttirasti iti vyabhicāra samavāyānabhyupagamāt
na ca parasya vṛttyā sattva vyāptam
kiṃ pratyavayava kṛtsno'vayavī varttate athaikadeśena iti nopapadyate praśna
tāvimau kṛtsnaikadeśaśabdau bhedaviṣayo naikasminnavayavini upapadyete bhedā'bhāvāt
atha prasaṅgasādhanam parasyeṣṭyā aniṣṭā''pādanāt; nanu pareṣṭiḥ pramāṇam, apramāṇaṃ vā ? yadi pramāṇam, tarhi tayaiva vādhyamānatvād anutthānaṃ viparītā'numānasya
na ca anenaiva asyā bādhā, tāmantareṇa asyā'pakṣadharmatayā prāmāṇyasyaiva asaṃbhavāt
atha apramāṇaṃ sā; tarhi pramāṇaṃ vinā prameyasyā'siddhi ityetadeva abhidhātavyam, kimanumānopanyāsā''yāsena iti ?
atha paravyāptyā parasya aniṣṭāpādanamiti tatra yadi pareṇa pramāṇāt pratipanna tenaiva vādhyamānatvādanutthānaṃ viparītānumānasya
na cānenaiva tasya bādhāt tadantareṇa pakṣadharmatvāditi
athāpramāṇena pratipanna tarhi pramāṇaṃ vinā prameyasyāsiddhiriti vācya kimanumānopanyāsena tasya apakṣadharmatayā'pramāṇatvāt ? praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 46
avayava-avayavibhedaviṣayiṇī carcā ca–nyāya sū॰, bhā॰, vā॰, tā॰ ṭī॰ 2
yattāvaduktam–bhinnapratibhāsatvāt iti sādhanam, ata avayavaavayavino ki kathañcidbheda sādhyate, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit, tadā siddhasādhanam tayo kathañcidbhedasya asmābhirapi iṣṭatvāt
atha sarvathā, tadā pakṣasya adhyakṣavādhā, kathañcittādātmyāpannayoreva anayoḥ avādhā'dhyakṣe pratibhāsanāt
yad yathā abādhā'dhyakṣe pratibhāsate tat tathaiva abhyupagantavyam yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā, abādhā'dhyakṣe pratibhāsete ca kathañcittādātmyena avayava-avayavinau iti
na ca tatpratibhāsino'dhyakṣasya abādhatvaviśeṣaṇamasiddham; tadbādhakasya kasyacidapi pramāṇasya asaṃbhavāt
na khalu pratyakṣaṃ tadbādhakam; atyantatadbhedasya atrāpratibhāsamānatvāt

anumānamapi bhinnapratibhāsatvād hetorāvirbhūtaṃ tadbādhakaṃ syāt, bhinnārthakriyākāritvāt, bhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvāt, bhinnakālatvāt, viruddhadharmādhyāsāt, vibhinnaśaktikatvāt, vibhinnapariṇāmatvādvā ? na tāvad bhinnapratibhāsatvād āvirbhūtādanumānād avayavā'vayavinoḥ ātyantiko bhedaḥ siddhyati; pratyakṣabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena asya anuṣṇo'gniḥ dravyatvāt ityādivat kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt, dūrā''sannapuruṣapratibhāsinā pādapādyarthena anaikāntikatvācca

nāpi bhinnārthakriyākāritvāt; nartakyādinā vyabhicārāt, ekā'pi hi nartakī karaṇa-aṅgahāra-bhrūbhaṅgaakṣivikṣepādyanekakriyāṃ prekṣakajanānāṃ harṣa-viṣādādyanekārthakriyāñca parasparavilakṣaṇāṃ vidadhātīti
bhinnakālatvādapi raṇḍākaraṇḍāvasthatantubhyaḥ paṭasya bhedaḥ prasādhyate, paṭāvasthatantubhyo vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanam, tebhyaḥ tadbhedasya asmābhirapyabhyupagamāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu asiddho hetuḥ; paṭāvasthatantūnāṃ paṭād bhinnakālatvasyā'saṃbhavāt
nahi ekatra narttakyādikṣaṇe yugapadupanibaddhadṛṣṭīnā prekṣakajanānāṃ vividhaṃ karma buddhivya padeśasukhādikāryamasiddhaṃ yena svabhāvā'bhede'pi vividhakarmatā na bhavet
viruddhadharmādhyāso'pi dhūpadahanādinā anaikāntikatvānna tadatyantabhedaprasādhakaḥ; na khalu hastalagna-itarapradeśayoḥ śīta-uṣṇasparśalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmā'dhyāse'pi dhūpadahanāderbhedo'sti
na ca hastalagnetarapradeśayoreva śītoṣṇasparśādhāratā na dhūpadahanādyavayavinaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; pratyakṣavirodhāt
bhinnaśaktitvād bhinnapariṇāmatvācca tantu-paṭādīnāṃ kathañcidavasthābheda eva siddhyenna punaḥ ātyantiko bhedaḥ, tatra ca siddhasādhanam
ato bhinnapratibhāsatvāderapi avayavā'vayavinoḥ kathañcidbhedasyaiva prasiddheḥ siddhaṃ kathañcittadabhedagrāhiṇo'dhyakṣasya abādhatvaviśeṣaṇam
yad yadrūpatayā pramāṇato na pratīyate tat tadrūpaṃ na bhavati yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭarūpatayā, na pratīyate ca atyanta bhedarūpatayā avayavā'vayavinau iti
tantvādyavayavānāṃ hi avasthāviśeṣa svātmabhūtaḥ śītāpanodādyarthakriyākārī paṭādyavayavī pratibhāsate na puna tebhyo'tyantamarthāntarabhūta, tathāvidhasya asya svapne'pyapratibhāsanāt

tathāhi–kecittantavo viśiṣṭāvasthāprāptā śītāpanodanādyekārthakriyāsamarthā bhavanti nāpare ye yoṣitkarttṛkā tatraikārthakriyopayoginastantūn viśiṣṭān pratipādayitu paṭa ityekā śruti viniveśyate vyavaharttṛbhi

tathā tadapratibhāsana hi adṛśyasvabhāvatvāt, samavāyāt, kāryakāraṇabhāvāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvādvā ? na tāvad adṛśyasvabhāvatvāt; bhūyo'vayavagrahaṇe sati avayavino grahaṇam ityabhyupagamavyāghātaprasaṅgāt
nāpi samavāyāt, kathañcittādātmyavyatirekeṇa aparasya samavāyasya samavāyaniṣedhe niṣetsyamānatvāt

tantvādyavayavānāṃ paṭādyavayavinaṃ prati samavāyikāraṇatvāttatraiva abhedapratibhāsaḥ, ityapyasundaram, samavāyā'siddhau samavāyikāraṇatvasyāpyasiddheḥ, nahi kathañcittādātmyamantareṇa anyaḥ samavāya, tathāpariṇāmitvavyatirekeṇa vā anyat samavāyikāraṇaṃ kvāpi prasiddham
nāpi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāt; daṇḍa-puruṣayorapi abhedapratibhāsaprasaṅgāt, yathaiva hi paṭaviśiṣṭāstantava iti tantupaṭayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvo'sti tathā daṇḍa-puruṣayorapi
ataḥ avayavebhya avayavino'tyantabhede sati anupalambhakāraṇā'bhāvāt tathaiva asau upalabhyeta, na ca upalabhyate, ato nā'sau tato'tyantabhinna iti
yad yataḥ atyantabhedena bhinnaṃ nopalabhyate na tat tato'tyantabhinnam yathā avayavinaḥ svarūpam, avayavebhyo'tyantabhedena bhinno nopalabhyate ca avayavīti

yadapyuktam–svatantrasādhanaṃ prasaṅgasādhanaṃ vā ityādi, tadapyasāram; yato bhavatu prasaṅgasādhanaṃ svatantraṃ vā, kimetāvatā bhavataḥ ? yadapi svatantrasādhane dharmi-sādhyapadayorvyādhātaḥ ityādyuktam, tadapyayuktam, yato nā'vayavina sadbhāvanirāsārthamidamucyate, ki tarhi ? tadatyantabhedasya

nahi avayavebhyo'tyantabhinno'vayavī kutaścidapi pratīyate ityuktam, yastu pratī tisiddhaḥ tantvādyavayavānāmā''tānavitānībhāvādipariṇatānām ātmabhūto'vasthāviśeṣaḥ paṭādyavayavī nā'sau nirasyate, tatra vṛttivikalpādidūṣaṇā'navatārāt
arthāntarabhūtaṃ hi vastu vartamānam ekadeśena sarvātmanā vā vartate ityādidoṣamāskandati, na punaḥ svātmabhūtam tasya tathāpariṇāmāt
yat svātmano'rthāntare varttate tat sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā, yathā kuṇḍe bilvādi anekā''saneṣu devadattādi ca, svātmano'rthāntareṣvavayaveṣu vartate ca avayavīti
svātantryeṇa ityādinā śaṃkarasvāmina parihāramāśaṅkate–svātantryeṇa prasaṅgena sādhanaṃ yatpravarttate
svaya tadupalabdhau hi satya sagacchate na tu
na ca kārtsnyaikadeśābhyā vṛtti kvacana lakṣitā
atha tasminnadṛṣṭau tu bhede praśno na yujyate
nairaṃśyenāsya kiṃ vṛttiḥ ki vā tasyānyathaiva sā
yaccānyaduktam–vṛttiśca samavāyaḥ ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; samavāyasya nirmūlamunmūlitatvena ākāśakuśeśayavat kasyacit kvacid vṛttitvā'nupapatteḥ

yadapyabhihitam–kārtsnyaikadeśaśabdayorbhedaviṣayatvād abhinne'vayavini pravṛttirayuktā ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; anekā' vayaveṣu ekasyā'naṃśasya arthāntarabhūtasyā'vayavino vartamānasya apratīteḥ, kārtsnyaikadeśañca parityajya prakārāntareṇa vṛtterapyapratīteḥ
yat khalu yatra vartate tad ekadeśena yathā sthūṇāsu vaṃśaḥ, sarvātmanā vā yathā kuṇḍe dadhīti
ataḥ prakāradvayā'nabhyupagame'vayavino'vayaveṣu vṛttyanupapattiḥ, tadvyāpakayoḥ ekadeśa-sākalyayorabhāvāt, tadanupapattau ca asya ataḥ sarvathā bhedā'bhāvaḥ

tathāhi–tantvādyavayavebhyo na sarvathā bhinnaḥ paṭādyavayavī, kārtsnyaikadeśā'vṛttitvāt, yattu yataḥ sarvathā bhinnam na tatra tasya kārtsnyaikadeśā'vṛttiḥ yathā kuṇḍādau dadhyādeḥ, kārtsnyaikadeśā'vṛttiśca avayaveṣu avayavina iti
niraṃśaikasvabhāvatve ca avayavinaḥ sakṛdanekā'vayavavyāpitvā'nupapattiḥ; tathāhi–yat niraṃśaikasvabhāvaṃ dravyam tanna sakṛdanekadravyavyāpi yathā paramāṇuḥ, niraṃ śaikasvabhāvañca avayavidravyamiti
na ca ākāśādinā'nekāntaḥ; tasya anantādipradeśatayā niraṃśatvā'siddheḥ
yadi vā, yad anekaṃ dravyaṃ tanna sakṛnniraṃśaikadravyavyāptam yathā kaṭakuḍyādi paramāṇunā, anekadravyāṇi ca avayavā iti
niraṃśatve ca avayavinaḥ kopīnādinā śarīrasya ekadeśā''varaṇe sakalaśarīramāvriyate, na vā ? yadi āvriyate; tarhi vivakṣitā'vayavavat sakalasyā'sya anupalabdhiprasaṅgaḥ
athocyate–tadāvaraṇe'pi na śarīrasyāvaraṇam avayavā''vārakadravyasaṃyogasya tadāvaraṇe sāmarthyā'bhāvāt, na khalu yāvānavayavadravyasaṃyogo'vayavamāvṛṇoti tāvāneva avayavinam tasya mahattvāt
yadyevam, pradeśataḥ tadāvaraṇam asti, na vā ? asti cet, na; anaṃśasya pradeśā'bhāvataḥ tathā tadāvaraṇā'nupapatteḥ, upapattau vā anaṃśatāvyāghātaḥ viruddhadharmasasargāt
yad viruddhadharmasaṃsargi na tad anaṃśam yathā jalā'nalādi, viruddhadharmasasargi ca āvṛtā'nāvṛtasvabhāvatayā avayavisvarūpam iti
viruddhadharmasaṃsarge'pi asya abhede sarvatra bhedavārtocchedaḥ, viśvasya viśvarūpatve'pi ekadravyatvaprasaṅgāt

atha avayavā''vārakadravyasaṃyogena avayavinaḥ pradeśato'pi nāstyāvaraṇam; tarhi tatpradeśe'pyasya upalabdhiprasaṅgāt samagro'pyavayavī upalabhyeta aviśeṣāt, nahi avayavā''varaṇe anāvaraṇe vā avayavina kaścid viśeṣo'sti ubhayatrā'syā'nāvṛtatvā'bhyupagamāt
nanu samagra-asamagraśabdayorbhedaviṣayatvāt abhinne'vayavini pravṛttirayuktā, ityapi prāgeva kṛtottaram, avayavinaḥ kathañcid bhedapratipādanāt
avayavā''varaṇe'pi avayavino'nāvaraṇe ca tasya tatra vṛttivirodha, yat khalu yatra varttate tasyā''varaṇe tadapi āvriyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā kuṇḍā''varaṇe dadhi, vartate ca avayaveṣu avayavīti
tathā, yadupalabdhipūrvikā yasyopalabdhiḥ na tasya anupalabdhau tadupalabdhi yathā tryasrādisaṃsthānā'nupalabdhau saṅghāṭakāde, avayavopalabdhipūrvikā ca avayavina upalabdhi iti
atha āvṛtāvayavapradeśe tasya anupalabhyatvamiṣyate, kathamevam asyaikatvaṃ syāt upalabhyā'nupalabhyatvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ kathañcidbhedaprasiddhe ?
rakte ca rāga ekasmin sarva rajyeta raktavat
yo viruddhadharmasasargavān nāsāveka yathā ghaṭādirartha, viruddhadharmādhyāsavāśca sthūlo nīlādirartha iti
tathāhi–āvṛte ekasmin pāṇyādau sthūlasyārthasya āvṛtānāvṛtarūpe yugapad bhavantau viruddhadharmadvayasayogamasya āvedayata
raktā'raktatvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāsācca, tathāhi–ekasmin tantvādyavayave rajyamāne paṭadyayavī rajyate, na vā ? yadi rajyate, kṛtsne'pyavayavini raktapratyayaprasaṅga

nanu ca avayavino raktatvaṃ kuṅkumādidravyeṇa saṃyogaḥ, sa ca avyāpyavṛttiḥ, nahi rūpādivat svāśrayamasau vyāpnoti avayavāntare tadupalabdhāvapi anupalabhyamānatvāt, tat kathamekatra rāge sarvatra rāgaprasaṅgaḥ ? ityapyasāmpratam; niraṃśe'vayavini saṃyogasya avyāpyavṛttitvā'nupapatteḥ

tasyā'vyāpyavṛttitvaṃ hi sarvadravyā'vyāpakatvam, niyatapradeśe varttamānatvam, avayavāntare'vayavinyupalabhyamāne'pi anupalabhyamānatvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; dravyasyaikasya sarvaśabdaviṣayatvā'nabhyupagamāt, niraṃśatve cāsya kathaṃ tatsayogena sākalyataḥ tadavyāptiḥ ? tathā tadavyāptau vā niraṃśatvavirodhaḥ
dvitīyavikalpastu upapanno yadi avayavino niyatapradeśatvamabhyupagamyeta, tadabhyupagame ca apasiddhāntaprasaṅgaḥ, yogaistasyā'pradeśatvapratijñānāt
tṛtīyavikalpo'pyetena pratyākhyātaḥ; tasya niyatapradeśatvā'nabhyupagame avayavāntare'vayavinyupalabhyamāne tatsaṃyogasyā'nupalabhyamānatvā'nupapatte

tannāsya avyāpyavṛttitvamupapadyate, tadupapattau vā siddho viruddhadharmā'dhyāsaḥ, tatkathamasya sarvathaikatvaṃ syāt ? atha tasmin rajyamāne'pi asau na rajyate; tadapyayuktam; dṛṣṭeṣṭavirodhāt, nahi tantvādyavayave rajyamāne paṭo na rajyate iti kenacid dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā
rāgadravyasaṃyogo raktatvam, araktatvañca tadabhāva, ubhayañcaikatra bhavatyeva saṃyogasya avyāpyavṛttibhāvāt
nanu ca ityādinā śaṃkarasvāmina parihāramāśaṅkate–nanu cāvyāpyavṛttitvāt saṃyogasya na raktatā
śaṃkarasvāmī atrāha–vastrasya rāga kuṅkumādidravyeṇa saṃyoga ucyate
sa cāvyāpyavṛtti, tata ekatra rakte na sarvasya rāga, na ca śarīrāderekadeśāvaraṇe sarvasyāvaraṇaṃ yuktamiti
yadi sarva dravyaṃ na vyāpnotītyartha; tadayuktam; dravyasya sarvaśabdāviṣayatvābhyupagamāt

niraṃśatve ca avayavinaḥ citrarūpapratipattyanupapattiḥ, nīlādicitrā''kārāṇāṃ vibhinnapratibhāsa-viruddhadharmā''krāntānāmekatvā'yogāt, nahi nīlam pītam iti śakyaṃ vaktum, tathābhūtānāmapyeṣāmaikye nānekaṃ jagat syāt

nanu na nīlādīni tatra rūpāṇi citram iti vyapadiśyante teṣāṃ vibhinnapratibhāsāditayā citrajñānā'gocaratvāt, kintu ekameva tat citrasaṃjñakaṃ rūpam, tadyogāt avayavī citraḥ yathā śuklayogāt śukla iti; atrāpi ki śuklādiviśeṣaśūnyaṃ rūpamātraṃ citram, śuklādaya eva vā samuditāḥ, śuklādirūpavilakṣaṇaṃ vā tadrūpam ? tatra na tāvad rūpamātram; viśeṣaśūnyasya sāmānyasya kvacidapyanupalabdheḥ
nāpi nīlādaya eva samudināḥ; pratyekaṃ teṣāṃ citratvā'bhāvāt, nahi nīlaṃ citram pītaṃ citram ityekaikaśaḥ teṣāṃ citrarūpatvamasti
samuditānāṃ tad bhaviṣyati; ityapyasambhāvyam; samuditā hi bahavaḥ ucyante, citram ityekam, na ca bahūnāmaprāptāvasthāviśeṣāṇāmekaṃ rūpaṃ bhavitumarhati
acitrāṇi rūpāṇi saṃhatya paṭe citraṃ rūpamutpādayantīti pakṣa āśrīyate
iṣyata eva asmābhiryathā avayavasamavetaiḥ sitaharitalohitādibhiḥ asamavāyikāraṇaiḥ avayavini citraṃ rūpamārabhyata iti
taccārabhyamāṇaṃ vividhakāraṇasvabhāvānugamāt śyāmaśuklaharitātmakameva syāt citramiti ca vyapadiśyate
kiñca, ete nīlādayaḥ kim āśrayavyāpina, ekadeśavṛttayo vā ? yadi āśrayavyāpinaḥ; tadā ekenaiva nīlena āśrayasya vyāptatvād anyepāṃ niravakāśatā
ekadeśavṛttitvañca ayuktam; nahi āśrayasya deśāḥ santi niraṃśatvādavayavina
atha avayavānāmeva tāni rūpāṇi, tarhi avayavī nīrūpa syāt, tathā ca asyā'pratyakṣatvam, nīrūpasyāpi pratyakṣatve gaganāderapi pratyakṣatāprasaṅgaḥ

atha śuklādirūpavilakṣaṇaṃ tat citraṃ rūpam; tarhi paridṛśyamānanīlādiviśeṣavyatirekeṇa vilakṣaṇaiva pratītiḥ syāt, na punastatra pratyabhijñāyamānā nīlādaya pratibhāseran, na hi śuklādivilakṣaṇe pītādau pratibhāsamāne śuklapratyabhijñānamasti
śuklādīnā vahūnāmekatra sadbhāve kimāśrayavyāpitvaṃ pradeśavartitvaṃ vā ? praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 221
kiñca, ete nīlādyupādhayaḥ avayavino'pakārakā, upakārakā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yukta; apakārakāṇāmupādhitvā'yogāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu samastopakārakopādhyagrahaṇe tadupakāryatvena upādhimato'pyagrahaṇāt sarvā'grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ
niyatopādhyupakāryatvena asya pratīterna tatprasaṅgaścet; tarhi tadupakāryatvena asya pratītau samastopādhyupakāryarūpatvāt tadupakāryatvenāpyasya grahaṇaprasaṅgāt sarvagrahaṇā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

atha ekopādhyupakāryatvena asya pratipattau tadupādhiviśiṣṭatvenaiva grahaṇāt upādhyantaraviśiṣṭatvenā'grahaṇānna sarvagrahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ; tarhi ekasyāvayavino gṛhītā'gṛhītarūpadvayaprasaṅgāt niraṃśatvavyāghātaḥ
nahi tasya ekopādhyupakāryatvameva rūpam, api tu samagropādhyupakāryatvam, tacca akhilopādhyapratipattau pratyetuṃ na śakyate

nanu pratyupādhyupakāryā tasya śaktayo bhinnā, tatra ekopādhyupakāryaśaktiviśiṣṭasya upādhimato grahaṇe'pi upādhyantaropakāryaśaktiviśiṣṭasya agrahaṇāt na samagragrahaṇamiti, atrāpi upādhimato' śeṣaśaktyātmakatvād ekaśaktiyuktasya grahaṇe aśeṣaśaktiyuktasya grahaṇaprasaṅgāt upādhivargasyāpyaśeṣasya grahaṇā'nuṣaṅgata samagragrahaṇamanivāryam
yenaiva hi rūpeṇa asau ekāṃ śakti vibhartti tenaiva aparām, tatrāpi rūpāntaravikalpane'navasthā niraṃśā'vayavipratijñākṣatiśca

kiñca, hastaākāśavibhāgād yadaiva śarīra-ākāśavibhāga tadaiva pāda-ākāśasaṃyogaja śarīra-ākāśa saṃyoga, iti eka eva avayavī ekenaivā''kāśena ekadaiva saṃyukto viyuktaśca iti anyonyaviruddharūpadvayā''krānta kathamekāntena ekatvabhāg bhavet ? yad anyonyaviruddharūpadvayā''krāntam na tad ekāntenaikam yathā prasāritetarāṅgulisvarūpam, anyonyaviruddharūpadvayā''krāntaśca ākāśādinā saṃyuktetararūpa śarīrādyavayavīti
evaṃ calā'calādilakṣaṇaviruddhadharmadvaye'pi ekāntena ekatvapratikṣepo draṣṭavyaḥ, pāṇyādyavayave hi calati tatpradeśe śarīrā'vayavinaḥ calatvam anyatra ca acalatvamiti

tato na avayavebhyo'tyantabhinno niraṃśo'vayavī pratipattavyaḥ, ki tarhi ? tantvādyavayavānāmeva ātānavitānībhūtādyavasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭānāṃ kathañcidekatvapariṇatilakṣaṇo'vasthāviśeṣaḥ paṭādyavayavī pratipattavyaḥ, tasyaiva yamahamadrākṣam etarhi tameva saṃspṛśāmi iti pratīteriti
tatra pāṇyādāvekasmin kampamāne sthūlo'rtha sakampaniṣkampe rūpe yugapat pratipadyamāna katha viruddhadharmasaṃsargavānna syāt? avayavinirā॰ pṛ॰ 81
prāsaṅgika rūpādivyatirikto nāsti avayavī iti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu rūpādivyatiriktasya avayavinaḥ kutaścit pramāṇādapratīteḥ kathaṃ tadabhyupagamaḥ prekṣāvatāṃ yuktaḥ ? tathāhi–tadvyatiriktaḥ avayavī pratyakṣataḥ pratīyeta, anumānato vā ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ; cakṣurādīndriyaprabhavapratyaye hi rūpādikameva avabhāsate nāparo'vayavī, tasyaiva avayavitvavyapadeśe na kiñcidaniṣṭam, saṃjñāmātrabhedāt

yadi hi kadācit pratyakṣato'vayavī pratipannaḥ syāt, tena ca avinābhūtaṃ kiñcilliṅgam; tadā kvacit dhūmādagnivat taddarśanādasau anumīyeta, na ca rūpādivyatirekeṇa svapne'pyasau pratyakṣe pratibhāsate, ataḥ asya grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvād abhāva eva jyāyān
yadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ nāsti tadasat yathā kharaviṣāṇam, nāsti ca avayavino grāhakaṃ kiñcit pramāṇamiti
nanu ityata prāk ādarśe likhitaḥ bauddha iti śabda ṭippaṇīgata eveti pratibhāti
tadutpattau kāraṇā'nupapatteśca; yadutpattau kāraṇaṃ nopapadyate tat nāsti yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, nopapadyate ca avayavyutpattau kiñcitkāraṇamiti
nacedamasiddham; dvyaṇukādyavayavyutpattau hi kāraṇaṃ paramāṇusaṃyogaḥ, sa ca teṣāṃ sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā nopapadyate
sarvātmanā hi paramāṇūnāṃ saṃyoge piṇḍasyā'ṇumātratvaprasaṅgād datto'vayavine jalāñjaliḥ
nāpyekadeśena; aṇūnāṃ deśā'saṃbhavāt, tatsaṃbhave teṣāṃ paramāṇutvā'nupapatteḥ digbhāgabhedataḥ paramāṇuṣaṭkena yugapat saṃyujyamānānāṃ teṣāṃ ṣaḍaṃśatāpatteḥ
na ca avayavidravyā'nabhyupagame anyonyā'sambaddheṣu ayaḥśalākākalpeṣu aṇuṣu sthūlaikākārapratipattirna syādityabhidhātavyam; keśeṣu taimirikopalabdhivat tatra tatpratipattyu papatteḥ
yathaiva hi taimirikasya sthūlaikākāraradviteṣvapi keśeṣu tadākārā pratītirbhavati evamasmadāde paramāṇuṣyapi, nahi ekaikaśaḥ taimirikeṇa keśāḥ kadācidapi pranīyante
ekadeśena cāniṣṭā naiko vā na kvacicca sa
kiñca, anekā'vayavavyāpitvaṃ rūparasādyātmakatvañca avayavino bhavadbhiriṣyate, tañca asyā'khilāvayavagrahaṇe satyeva grahītuṃ śakyam nānyathā

tadgrahaṇañca arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa syāt, parabhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhiṇā, ubhayapratyakṣeṇa vā ? na tāvad arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhiṇā, tasya parabhāgabhāvyavayavavārttā'nabhijñatvāt, na ca vyāpyā'grahaṇe tadvyāpitvaṃ grahītuṃ śakyam atiprasaṅgāt
yad yena rūpeṇa pratibhāsate tat tathaiva sadvyavahāraviṣayaḥ yathā nīlaṃ nīlarūpatayā'vabhāsamānaṃ tathaiva sadvyavahāraviṣaya, arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitayā pratibhāsate ca avayavīti

tathā ca arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisyarūpāt parabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitatsvarūpasya viruddhadharmā'dhyāsato bhedasaṃbhavāt kathaṃ nikhilā'vayavānāmekenā'vayavinā vyāptiḥ siddhyena ? tatsambandhitvalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmā'dhyāse'pi asyā'bhede bhedavārttocchedaḥ syāt

tathā yasmin pratibhāsamāne yanna pratibhāsate tat tato bhinnam yathā ghaṭe pratibhāsamāne'pratibhāsamāna paṭa, na pratibhāsate ca arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisvarūpe pratibhāsamāne parabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhyavayavisvarūpama, iti pratibhāsabhedādapi asya bheda
nāpyubhayapratyakṣeṇa, tasyā'sa bhavāt, nahi arvāk-para-madhyabhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhi ekaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kadācit pratīyate

rūparasādyātmakatvamapi asya etenaiva prativihitam; nahi rūpagrāhiṇā rasagrāhiṇā ubhayagrāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa tadgrahaṇamupapadyate, rūpagrāhiṇaścākṣupapratyakṣasya rase'pravṛtte, tadgrāhiṇaśca rāsanapratyakṣasya rūpe'pravṛtte, ubhayagrāhi ca pratyakṣaṃ na svapne'pi pratibhāsate iti
tatpratividhānapurassarā avayavebhya kathañcidabhinnasya ekā'nekātmakasya avayavina siddhi–

yattāvaduktam cakṣurādīndriyaprabhavaprabhavapratyaye ityādi, tatra ki tatprabhavapratyaye ghaṭādivyapadeśārha rūpam ekatvapariṇativiśiṣṭam urdhvādhomadhyabhāgātmaka viśiṣṭā''kāropetaṃ pratibhāsate, anyonyavilakṣaṇā'naśaparamāṇupracayarūpaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamavayavidravyasya tatprabhavapratyaye'pratibhāsa, tadbhāgātmikāyā viśiṣṭākārānvitāyā tatpapariṇatereva avayavitvāt ? rūpādyatiriktasyā'vayavina pratibhāsābhāvād asattvā'bhyupagame rūpāderapyasattvaprasaṅgaḥ, tadvyatirekeṇa asyāpyapratibhāsanāt
yad yadrūpatayā nirbādhabodhe pratibhāsate tat tadrūpameva pratipattavyam yathā nīlaṃ nīlarūpatayā, pratibhāsate ca ekatvapariṇatyādilakṣaṇa-ava yavirūpatayā tatra vilvā''malakādirūpamiti
na ca tatpratibhāsino bodhasya nirbādhatvaviśeṣaṇamasiddham; tadbādhakasya kasyacidapi pramāṇasyāsaṃbhavāt
na hi pratyakṣādipramāṇaṃ tadbādhakam; śataśo vicārayato'pi ekatvādyātmanaiva arthānāmavabhāsanāt

nanu ca avayavasaṃyogapūrvikā ekatvādipariṇatirbhavati, na ca avayavānāṃ saṃyogaḥ sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā ghaṭate ityuktam; tadayuktam; yasmādevaṃ vadato bhavataḥkiṃ tatra sambandhā'bhāvo'bhīṣṭaḥ, kārtsnyaikadeśaṃ parityajya prakārāntareṇa vā sambandho'bhipreta iti ? tatra ādyavikalpe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, arthānāmavayavasambandhasya pratyakṣe pratibhāsanāt, tadasambandhe rajju-vaṃśadaṇḍādeḥ ekadeśā''karṣaṇe tadanyā''karpaṇaṃ na syāt
yad yenāsambaddham na tasyā''karṣaṇe tadanyasyā''karṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā kumbhā''karṣaṇe kuḍyasya, asambaddhaśca bhavanmate rajju-vaṃśadaṇḍādeḥ arvāgbhāgaḥ parabhāgena iti
