atha kārtsnyaikadeśaṃ parityajya prakārāntareṇa anyonyamavayavānāṃ sambandho'bhipretaḥ; tad yuktam; snigdharūkṣatvalakṣaṇaprakārāntareṇaiva arthānāṃ arthānāṃ sambandhopalabdheḥ, nahi saktu-tauyādau tatparityajya anyatprakārāntaraṃ sambandhahetuḥ pratīyate
kāryakāraṇāderabhedaikānte vāraṇākarṣaṇādaya paramāṇūnā saṃghāte'pi mābhūvan vibhāgavat
sarvātmanaikadeśena vā'ṇūnāmasambandhāt, sambandhasya ca pratīteḥ prakārāntareṇa eṣāṃ sambandha iti kalpanā yuktiyuktaiva
yāpi aṇūnāṃ ṣaḍaṃśatāpattiḥ uktā; sā kim ārambhakadeśāpekṣayā, saṃyogahetubhūtasvabhāvā'pekṣayā vā ? tatra prathamapakṣe parasparavirodhaḥ–paramāṇavaḥ ṣaḍaṃśārabdhāśca iti
paḍaṃśārabhyatve hi teṣāṃ svāvayavāpekṣayā adhikaparimāṇatvasaṃbhavāt kathaṃ paramāṇutvam ? yasya hi niratiśayamalpaṃ parimāṇaṃ sa paramāṇuḥ

dvitīyapakṣastu na doṣāya, digbhāgabhedena aṇusaṃyogahetubhūtasvabhāvalakṣaṇa-aṃśānāṃ paramāṇuṣvabhipretatvāt, kathamanyathā jaladhāraṇāharaṇādyarthakriyākāriṇo ghaṭāderniṣpattiḥ ? na khalu paramāṇavaḥ ayaḥśalākākalpāstatkāriṇaḥ, parasparamasambaddhatvāt, ye parasparamasambaddhāḥ na te jaladhāraṇādyarthakriyākāriṇaḥ yathā vibhinnadeśāḥ paramāṇavaḥ, parasparamasambaddhāśca ghaṭādivyapadeśārhā bhavanmate paramāṇava iti
atha deśapratyāsattiviśiṣṭāste tatkāriṇo nānye, tanna; avayavino'nabhyupagame deśapratyāsatterapyanupapatteḥ deśasyāpyavayavitvāt

etena anyonyavilakṣaṇā'naṃśaparamāṇupracayarūpaṃ ghaṭādisvarūpam akṣaprabhavapratyaye pratibhāsate iti pakṣaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; nahi yathopavarṇitasvabhāvāḥ paramāṇavaḥ akṣaprabhavapratyaye kasyacidapi avabhāsante, sthira-sthūla-sādhāraṇasvarūpasyaivā'rthasya akhilaprāṇināṃ tatra pratibhāsanāt

taimirikopalabdhivat tatra tatpratibhāsaḥ; ityapyasamīcīnam; nahi taimirikasyāpi anyonyamasambaddhā keśā kadācidapi upalabdhiviṣayā, saṃyogaviśeṣalakṣaṇasamūhāvasthāpannānāmeva teṣāṃ tadviṣayatvapratīte
svaviṣayānatikrameṇendriyasya paṭumandabhāvād viṣayagrahaṇasya tathābhāvo nāviṣaye pravṛtti
kiñca, avayavino'nabhyupagame ghaṭādipratyayo nirviṣaya, saviṣayo vā rayāt ? na tāvannirviṣaya, ghaṭamahaṃ jānāmi ityādyullekhena asya viṣayasaṃvedakatvāt, tannirviṣayatve pramāṇā'bhāvācca
sarve pratyayā nirālambanā pratyayatvāt svapnādipratyayavat ityādi ca tannirviṣayatvaprasādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ vāhyārthasiddhau vistarata prativyūḍham

atha saviṣaya; ko'sya viṣaya ? paramāṇusamūhaścet; kaḥ punarayaṃ paramāṇusamūho nāma–ki paramāṇava eva, taddharmo vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; paramāṇūnāmatyantamaṇutvena atīndriyatvataḥ pratyakṣaviṣayatvā'nupapatte, tathā ca sarvā'grahaṇaprasaṅgāt na kvacit pratyakṣavyavahāra syāt, guṇakarmasāmānyāderapi avayavyātmakasyaiva pratyakṣaviṣayatvapratīteḥ gauḥ śuklaḥ calati ityādivat
atha taddharmaḥ saṃyogarūpa tatsamūhaśabdavācyaḥ; tanna, aṇūnāṃ saṃyogā'bhyupagame avayavipratyākhyānā'nupapatte nyāyasya samānatvāt, yenaiva hi nyāyena ayameko'nekatra varttate tenaiva avayavyapi
kiñca, ayaṃ tatsaṃyogaḥ vāstava, avāstavo vā ? yadyavāstava; kathaṃ pratyakṣaviṣaya ? yadavāstavam na tat pratyakṣaviṣayaḥ yathā gaganendīvaram, avāstavaśca bhavadbhirabhipreto'ṇusaṃyoga iti

vāstavatve'pi asya asmadādipratyakṣaviṣayatvamayuktam, niratiśayaparimāṇadravyasaṃyogatvāt, yo niratiśayaparimāṇadravyasaṃyoga sa na asmadādipratyakṣaviṣaya yathā ākāśaparamāṇusaṃyogaḥ, niratiśayaparimāṇadravyasaṃyogaśca aṇūnāmanyonyasaṃyoga iti
no cet piṇḍo'ṇumātra syānna ca te buddhigocarā
–tvaṃ na yuktam ba॰, ja॰, bhā॰, śra॰
nanu na tatsaṃyogaḥ asmadādipratyakṣaviṣayaḥ, ki tarhi ? sañcitāḥ paramāṇava eva; ityapi ayuktam; paramāṇupratyakṣatāpakṣasya kṛtottaratvāt
sañcitatvañcāmīṣāṃ deśapratyāsatti, saṃyogaviśiṣṭatvaṃ vā syāt ? ubhayatrāpi avayavisiddhiḥ, deśasya svayamavayavitvāt, saṃyoge ca samānanyāyāt
yadi ca paramāṇavastadviṣayā; tadā mahān eko ghaṭaḥ ityādipratyayo na syāt, teṣāṃ mahattvā'bhāvād vahutvācca
sañcayamātra viṣaya iti cenna; sañcayasya saṃyogabhāvāttasya cātīndriyasyāgrahaṇādayuktam
sanniveśasteṣā deśapratyāsatti, sayogaviśeṣo vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 886

atha senā-vanapratyayavat tatrāsau ghaṭate, yathaiva hi senāṅgepu vanāṅgeṣu bahuṣu dūrādagṛhyamāṇapṛthaktveṣu ekaṃ vanam, ekā senā iti ekapratyayaḥ prādurbhavati evaṃ paramāṇuṣvatyantapratyāsanneṣu pṛthaktvasyā'grahaṇāt mahān eko ghaṭaḥ ityādipratyayaḥ prādurbhavatīti; tadasāmpratam; paramāṇūnāmatīndriyatvenā'nupalabdhau tatpratyayaviṣayatvā'nupapatteḥ, upalabhyamānānāṃ hi rathādisenāṅgānāṃ dhavādivanāṅgānāñca ekā senā ityādyabhedapratyayaviṣayatvaṃ dṛṣṭam nā'nupalabhyamānānām
na ca avayavyanabhyupagame senā-vanapratyayavat iti dṛṣṭānto ghaṭate; senā-vanāṅgānāmavayavitvena anupapattau senā-vanapratyayasyāpyanupapatteḥ

yadi ca ekā'vayavyanapekṣaḥ tadvad avayaveṣu ekapratyayaḥ syāt; tadā deśabhede grahaṇabhedopalambhaḥ syāt, yatra ekā'vayavyanapekṣo'bhedasvarūpamātranibandhanaḥ abhedapratyayaḥ tatra deśabhede grahaṇabhedo dṛṣṭaḥ yathā senāvanāṅgeṣu, ekāvayavyanapekṣaśca avayaveṣu abhedapratyayo bhavatā iṣṭa iti
suprasiddho hi senā-vanāṅgeṣu deśabhedād grahaṇabhedaḥ dūrād ekatvagrahaṇasya āsanne'nekatvagrahaṇasya ca avabhāsanāt, nacaivaṃ deśavikalpe grahaṇavikalpopapattirghaṭādāvasti

kiñca, tadaṅgeṣu ekā'vayavyabhāve'pi deśapratyāsatteḥ saṃyuktasaṃyogasya vā ekasya nimittasya sadbhāvāt ekā senā ityādyabhedapratyayo yuktaḥ, paramāṇuṣu tu kasyacidapyekasya nimittasyā'saṃbhavāt kathamasau yuktaḥ ?
yaccānyaduktam–sthūlādipratītirbhrāntā atasmiṃstadgrahaṇarūpatvāt ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; atasmiṃstatpratyayasya mukhyopalambhamantareṇa anupapatteḥ
nahi aprasiddhamukhyapuruṣasya sthāṇāvapuruṣe puruṣapratyayo dṛṣṭaḥ, na ca sthaulyādikaṃ mukhyato bhavataḥ kvacit prasiddham avayavisiddhiprasaṅgāt
yadapyabhihitam–arvāgbhāgabhāvyavayavagrāhiṇā ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; pratyakṣasmaraṇādisahāyena ātmanā arvāk-parabhāgabhāvyavayavavyāpakatvasya avayavino grahaṇopapatteḥ
nahi asmābhiḥ pratyakṣādijñānaparyāya eva arthagrāhako'bhipretaḥ yenā'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt, ki tarhi ? tatpariṇata ātmā, tatsadbhāvaśca santānavicārā'vasare prasādhitaḥ

arvāk-parabhāgabhāvyavayavasambandhitayā ca viruddhadharmādhyāsāt pratibhāsabhedācca avayavinaḥ kathañcidbhedaḥ prasādhyeta, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit; tadā siddhasādhanam, na khalu tatsambandhino'vayavino yaugavat niraṃśatvam asmābhirabhipretam, pratisambandhaṃ sambandhinaḥ kathañcidbhedā'bhyupagamāt
sarvathā tatastadbhedasādhane tu rūpādikṣaṇena anekāntaḥ, tasya rūpa-rasādikṣaṇāntaraṃ prati upādāna-sahakāriśaktilakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāse'pi abhedā'bhyupagamāt
nahi rūpakṣaṇasya rūpakṣaṇāntaraṃ prati upādānaśaktireva rasādikṣaṇāntaraṃ prati sahakāriśaktiḥ; rasāderapi rūpatvaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi–raso rūpasvabhāvaḥ rūpeṇa upādānaśaktyā utpādyamānatvāt uttararūpakṣaṇavat
tathāhi–rasasahabhāvi rūpaṃ rasasvabhāvam prāktanarūpeṇa sahakāriśaktyā utpādyamānatvāt rasavat

atha kalpitatvāt tatra tadbhedo'vāstavaḥ, tanna; asya avāstavatve kāryakāraṇabhāvasyāpi avāstavatvaprasaktito rasād rūpāderavyabhicāriṇo'numānasya anupapatte katham ekasāmagryardhānasya rūpādaresato gatiḥ pramāṇavā॰ 1
yadapyuktam–rūparasādyātmakatvamapi ityādi, tadapyasaṅgatam; yamahamadrākṣam etarhi tameva spṛśāmi ityanusandhānapratyayād avayavino rūpādyātmakatvaprasiddhe
nahi dvābhyāmindriyābhyāṃ rūpasparśādhāraikārthagrahaṇamantareṇa anusandhānapratyayo ghaṭate, rūpasparśayośca pratiniyatendriyagrāhyatvād asau na saṃbhavati
tadevaṃ prasiddhasadbhāvasya avayavino nā'pahnavo yukta, tadapahnave paramāṇumātratvasyāpi apahnavaprasaṅgāt, tamantareṇa anyasya tadvyavasthāpakopāyasyāsattvāt

yat kārya tat svaparimāṇādalpaparimāṇakāraṇārabdham yathā paṭaḥ, kāryañca dvyaṇuka iti etasmāt, alpaparimāṇaṃ kvacit paramakāṣṭhāmāpannam prakṛṣyamāṇatvāt mahāparimāṇavat ityato vā tadvyavasthāpane; kathanna avayaviprasādādeva tadvyavasthāpanaṃ syāt ? kathañca avayavino'pahnave sakalānumānocchedo na syāt, dharmi-hetu-dṛṣṭāntānāmavayavisvabhāvānāṃ bhavato'prasiddheḥ ? tatprasiddhau vā kathaṃ tadapahnavaḥ teṣāmaparamāṇurūpāṇāmeva prasiddheriti ?
tata siddhaḥ svāvayavebhya kathañcidabhinno vāstavo ghaṭādirekā'nekasvabhāvaḥ avayavī
ataḥ pṛthivyaptejovāyavo dvividhā nityā'nityabhedāt ityādi pratyuktam, uktaprakāreṇa paraparikalpitasya paramāṇvādidravyasya avyavasthiteḥ

kutaśca asya dravyatvaṃ siddhyet ? dravyatvayogāccet, nanu dravyasya bhāvo dravyatvam, tacca dravye jñāte jñāyate, dravyatvañca vinā na dravyajñaptiḥ, vaiśeṣikai jātidvāreṇaiva dravyādipratipattyabhyupagamāt, ityanyonyāśrayaḥ
kiñca, sāmānyaṃ saṃsthānādinā kenacid vyajyate yathā gotvaṃ khura-kakudādisaṃsthānena, ghṛtatailādīnāṃ vā taptānāṃ gandhena, na ca iha kiñcid vyañjakamasti
kriyāvattvaṃ guṇavattvaṃ samavāyikāraṇatvam atrā'sti, iti cet; tat ki vyastam, samastaṃ vā vyañjakam ? na tāvad vyastam; kriyāvattvasya ākāśādidravyavyaktiṣu asaṃbhavāt
labdhātmalābho hi avayavī guṇotpattau samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati, iti sadyaḥ samutpanne paṭe guṇābhāvo bhavadbhireva iṣṭaḥ, iti yogināṃ tatra dravyabuddhirna syāt
nāpi samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ tadvyañjakam; tasyāpi sarvadā'saṃbhavāt, nahi sarvaḥ sarvadā samavāyikāraṇam, iti asya lakṣaṇasya sarvatrā' vyāptidoṣaḥ

kiñca, yadā kāraṇaṃ tadā na samavāyi, yadā samavāyi na tadā kāraṇam, kāryāddhi pūrvasmin kṣaṇe kāraṇam na ca tadā kāryamasti yena kāryasamavāyi syāt, yadā ca kāryasamavāyi tadā niṣpannatvāt kāryasya na kāraṇam iti asaṃbhavo lakṣaṇadoṣaḥ
yad yatra saṃbhavati tat tatra lakṣaṇam ityatrāpi sadyaḥ samutpanne ghaṭādau asaṃbhava eva taddoṣaḥ, tatra kasyacidapi tallakṣaṇasyā'saṃbhavāt
samuditānāṃ tallakṣaṇatve'pi avyāptireva, sadyaḥ samutpanne ghaṭādau tritayasyāpyabhāvāt, ākāśādau tu kriyāvattvasya iti
na ca lakṣaṇamapyeka pṛthivyādiṣu pañcasu kriyāvatsveva kriyāvadguṇavatsamavāyikāraṇamiti dravyalakṣaṇasya bhāvāt
tatra tāvad guṇāśrayo dravyamityalakṣaṇaṃ yata–'avyāpterativyāpterdravyaṃ naiva guṇāśraya

yadapi dravyam itarebhyo bhidyate dravyatvā'bhisambandhāt ityādyanumānam; tadapyasāmpratam; anumānaṃ khalu ubhayavādiprasiddhe dharmiṇi parvatādau sati pravartate, anyathā hetūnāmāśrayā'siddhatā syāt, dṛṣṭānte ca ubhayavādisampratipanne, sādhyadharme vahnau sādhyadharmiṇi sandigdhe, anyathā aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ pakṣaḥ syāt; dharmiṇi ca ubhayavādisampratipanne sādhanadharme dhūme, anyathā asiddho hetuḥ syāt
na ca iha navadravyaprakāro dharmī kasyacit kenacitpramāṇena prasiddhaḥ, nāpi tatra pravarttamānaṃ dravyatvādisādhanam, bhedākhyaśca sādhyadharmaḥ iti

bhedo hi itaretarābhāvaḥ, sa ca pratiyogisavyapekṣa eva pratīyate, pratiyoginaśca dravyavyatirekiṇo'nantāḥ, te ayogināṃ kasya pramāṇasya grāhyāḥ iti cintyam ? kiñca, pratiyogino gṛhyamāṇāḥ ki dravyādbhinnā gṛhyante, abhinnā vā ? prathamapakṣe bhedagrāhakapramāṇenaiva dravyasya anyebhyo bhedaḥ prasiddhaḥ iti idamanumānamanarthakam
dvitīyapakṣe tu parasparasaṅkīrṇeṣu gṛhyamāṇeṣvartheṣu kasya kasmād bhedaḥ iti aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ pakṣaḥ syāt

kiñca, kevalavyatirekī hetuḥ sa ucyate yasya pakṣavyāpakatve sati kevalo vyatirekaḥ nānvaya syāt, tataśca yatra bhedākhya sādhyadharmo nāsti tatra dravyatvamapi nāsti iti vyatireko'nayordhamayo asati pratibandhe kathaṃ niścetuṃ śakyate ? ki bhedā'bhāvāt tatra dravyatva nāsti vastvantarā'sattvādvā iti sandehaḥ
yatra hi pratibandhapratipattiḥ tatra ekā'bhāve dvitīyo nāsti iti yuktam, yathā agnidhūmayoḥ pratyakṣā'nupalambhādipramāṇena pratipanne kāryakāraṇabhāve agnyabhāve dhūmo nāsti iti

iha puna sādhyasādhanadharmayoḥ uktaprakāreṇa svarūpato'siddhatvāt kenacitpramāṇena avinābhāvasyā'gṛhītatvāt na sādhyā'bhāve sādhanā'bhāvapratipatti, iti kevalavyatirekiṇo'numānasya ananumānatvāt na tena itarebhyo bhedaḥ vyavahāro vā śakyate vyavasthāpayitum
etena pṛthivītvābhisambandhāt ityādi kevalavyatirekyanumānaṃ pratyākhyātam; uktadoṣāṇāmatrāpyaviśeṣāt
kiñca, pṛthivyādīnāmanyonyam atyantamarthāntaratve siddhe sati etadvaktuṃ śakyate, na ca tat siddham pudgalātmanā'nyonyaṃ teṣāṃ kathañcidabhedāt
pudgalātmakatve pṛthivyādīnā na pratiniyatagandhādiguṇādhāratāniyama iti yaugānā pūrvapakṣa–

nanu ekapudgalātmakatve teṣāṃ pratiniyatagandhādiguṇādhāratāniyamo na prāpnoti pudgalānāmaviśeṣato rūpa-rasa-gandha-sparśātmakatvā'bhyupagamāt, ataḥ tadātmakatve pṛthivyādīnāṃ caturṇāmapi aviśeṣeṇaiva gandhādipratītiḥ syāt, na caivam, caturṣvapi eteṣu gandhādiguṇacatuṣṭayasya pratiniyamenaiva ādheyatvapratīteḥ
uktañca–gandhaḥ pṛthivyāmeva, apsu rasaḥ, tejasi rūpam, vāyau sparśaḥ
pṛthivītvādipratiniyatajātisambandho'pi teṣāmekatve durghaṭaḥ, anyonyaṃ hi teṣāṃ tattvāntaratvābhāvenābhinnajātīyatve abādīnāmapi aviśeṣataḥ pṛthivītvādyabhisambandhaḥ syāt

na khalu ghaṭa-ghaṭī-śarāva-udañcanādīnāṃ tathā'bhinnajātīyatve'viśeṣata pṛthivītvā'bhisambandho na dṛṣṭa, na ca teṣāmaviśeṣataḥ tatsambandho'sti, pṛthivyāmeva pṛthivītvābhisambandhapratīte, abādāveva aptvādisambandhapratīteḥ iti
katha tarhi ime guṇā viniyoktavyā iti ? ekaikaśyena uttarottaraguṇasadbhāvāduttarāṇā tadanupalabdhi

yattāvaduktam–ekapudgaladravyātmakatve ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; yata pratiniyatagandhādiguṇādhāratāniyamastatra tatsattāpekṣayā, tadabhivyaktyapekṣayā vā syāt ? tatrādyavikalpo'yukta; pṛthivīvat jalādāvapi gandhādiguṇacatuṣṭayasadbhāvataḥ tadādhāratāpratiniyamā'nupapatteḥ

kutaḥ pramāṇāt tatra tatsadbhāvaḥ siddha iti cet ? anumānāt iti brūmaḥ; tathāhi–jalādayo gandhādimantaḥ sparśavattvāt, yat sparśavat tad gandhādimat prasiddham yathā pṛthivī, sparśavantaśca jalādaya iti
yat punargandhādimanna bhavati na tat sparśavat, yathā ātmādi iti vipakṣe bādhakaṃ pramāṇam
atha gandhādiguṇānām abhivyaktyapekṣayā pṛthivyādau tadādhāratāpratiniyamo'bhidhīyate; abhidhīyatām, tathāpi na tāvatā tatra dravyāntaratvasiddhiḥ, jala-kanakādisaṃyuktā'nalena anekāntāt
nahi anabhivyaktabhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśo jala-kanakādisaṃyuktā'nalaḥ abhivyaktabhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśādanalād dravyāntaraṃ bhavatāṃ prasiddhaḥ, dravyasaṃkhyāvyāghātaprasaṅgāt

evaṃ pṛthivyādirapi anabhivyaktenāpyaviśiṣṭaguṇena upetatvāt nā'nyonyam atyantadravyāntaratvena arthāntaram; yad aviśiṣṭaguṇopetam na tad anyonyam atyantadravyāntaratvena arthāntaram yathā ātmādi, aviśiṣṭarūpādiguṇopetañca pṛthivyādi iti
yathaiva hi ātmanāṃ buddhyādimattvā'viśeṣāt nā'nyonyam atyantatattvāntaratvenā'rthāntaratvam tathā pṛthivyādīnāmapi rūpādimattvā'viśeṣāt na tathā tattvāntaratvam

yadapyuktam–pṛthivītvādipratiniyatajātisambandha ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; avāntarajātisambandhasya sarvathā tattvabhedā'prasādhakatvāt, vyaktibhedameva hi asau prasādhayati na tattvabhedam, anyathā kṣatriyatvādyavāntarajātisambandhāt ātmanāmapi tattvāntaratvaprasaṅgāt tatsaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ syāt

jātibhedena anyonyaṃ pṛthivyādīnāmātyantikabhedā'bhyupagame ca upādānopādeyabhāvo na syāt; yepāṃ jātibhedena ātyantiko bhedaḥ na teṣām upādānopādeyabhāvaḥ yathā ātma-pṛthivyādīnām, tathā tadbhedaśca pṛthivyādīnāṃ bhavadbhiriṣṭa iti
tantupaṭādyupādānopādeyabhāvena vyabhicāraparihārārtham ātyantikaviśeṣaṇam, nahi tatra ātyantikaḥ tadbhedo'sti pṛthivītvādisāmānyasya abhinnasyāpi saṃbhavāt

nanvevaṃ dravyatvādinā pṛthivyādīnāmapi abhedasaṃbhavāt tadbhāvo'stu; ityapyayuktam; ātma-pṛthivyādīnāmapyevaṃ tadbhedā'bhāvād upādānopādeyabhāvaḥ syāt, tathā ca ātmā'dvaitaprasaṅgāt pṛthivyādidravyaprapañcāya datto jalāñjaliḥ
tanna ātyantikabhedā'bhyupagame pṛthivyādīnāṃ tadbhāvo ghaṭate; asti cāsau, candrakāntājjalasya jalādeśca muktāphalāderutpattipratīteḥ
ato na tepāṃ sarvathā tattvāntaratvena bhedaḥ; yeṣām upādānopādeyabhāvaḥ na teṣāmanyonyamatyantatattvāntaratvena bhedaḥ yathā tantupaṭādīnām, upādānopādeyabhāvaśca pṛthivyādīnāmiti
candrakāntādyantarbhūtāt jalādidravyādeva jalāderutpattiḥ; ityapyanupapannam; tatra tatsadbhāvā''vedakapramāṇā'bhāvāt

vijātīyād vijātīyasyotpattau tattvavyavasthā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, tadantarbhūtāt taddravyādeva tadutpattiḥ ityabhyupagame mṛtpiṇḍādyantarbhūtād ghaṭādereva ghaṭādyutpattiḥ ityapyabhyupagamyatāmiti sāṃkhyadarśanasiddhiḥ

tato mṛtpiṇḍādau ghaṭādivat candrakāntādau jalāderapratītito'bhāvāt, ātyantikabhede ca upādānopādeyabhāvā'nupapatteḥ paryāyabhedena anyonyaṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ bhedaḥ, rūpa-rasa-gandhasparśātmakapudgaladravyarūpatayā ca abheda iti prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam
tanna nityādisvabhāvam ātyantikabhedabhinnaṃ paraparikalpitaṃ pṛthivyādicatuḥprakāraṃ dravyaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate
ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyā śabdaguṇakam ākāśam iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu tatsadbhāve śabdaliṅgaprabhavamanumānamastyeva pramāṇam; tathāhi–śabdaḥ kvacidāśritaḥ guṇatvāt rūpādivat
na cāsya guṇatvamasiddham, guṇaḥ śabdaḥ dravya-karmānyatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt, yad yadevaṃvidham tat tad guṇa yathā rūpādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
na ca dravyakarmā'nyatvamasiddham; tathāhi–śabdo dravyaṃ na bhavati ekadravyatvāt rūpādivat
kiñciddhi dravyam adravyaṃ bhavati nityatvāt yathā ātmādi, kiñcittu anekadravyam kāryatvāt yathā ghaṭādi, na tu ekadravyam
śabdasya ekadravyatvaṃ kutaḥ siddhamiti cet ? ekadravyaṃ śabda sāmānya-viśeṣavattve sati bāhyaikendriyapratyakṣatvāt rūpādivat ityato'numānāt
atra ca sāmānyaviśeṣavattvāt ityucya māne paramāṇvādibhirvyabhicāraḥ syāt, tannivṛttyartham indriyapratyakṣatvāt ityuktam
ekendriyapratyakṣatvāt ityucyamāne ātmanā vyabhicāraḥ; tannivṛttyartha bāhyaviśeṣaṇam
rūpatvādinā vyabhicāraparihārārthañca sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati iti viśeṣaṇam
tathā, karmā'pi na bhavatyasau saṃyoga-vibhāgā'kāraṇatvāt rūpādivadeva
itaśca na dravyaṃ na karma śabdaḥ, anityatve sati niyamena acākṣuṣapratyakṣatvāt, yad yad evam tat tat tathā yathā rasādi, tathā ca śabda, tasmāttathā iti
ātmanā vyabhicāranivṛttyartham anityatve sati iti viśepaṇam
tathāpi acākṣuṣapratyakṣapratīyamānadravya-karmabhyāṃ vyabhicāraḥ; tatparihārārtham niya mena iti viśeṣaṇam, tayoḥ śabdādivad acākṣuṣapratyakṣatvaniyamā'saṃbhavāt
tathā śabdo na dravyaṃ na karma, vyāpakadravyasamavetatvāt, yad yadittham tat tat tathā yathā sukhādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
tataḥ siddhaṃ dravyakarmānyatve sati iti viśeṣaṇam
dravyakarmānyatvāt ityucyamāne sāmānyādinā vyabhicāraḥ; tannivṛttyarthaṃ sattāsambandhitvāt ityuktam
prasaktayo dravyakarmaṇo pratiṣedhe sāmānyādāvaprasaṅgācca guṇa evāvaśiṣyate śabda
kathaṃ puna na dravya śabda ? ekadravyatvāt
adravya vā bhavati dravyam ākāśaparamāṇvādi, anekadravya vā dvyaṇukādikāryadravyam, ekadravyaṃ tu śabda ekākāśāśritatvāt
sattāśabdatvādisāmānyasambandhācca sāmānyāditrayaprasaṅgo'sya nāsti iti pāriśeṣyād guṇa eva śabda
guṇa śabda dravyakarmānyatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt rūpādivat
śabdo guṇa jātibhattve sati asmadādibāhyācākṣuṣapratyakṣatvād gandhavat
yaśca asyā''śrayaḥ tat pāriśeṣyād ākāśam; tathāhi–na tāvat sparśavatāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ viśeṣaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ; asmadādipratyakṣatvāt kāryadravyarūpādivat

nāpi kāryadravyāṇāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ viśeṣaguṇo'sau; kāryadravyāntarā'prādurbhāve'pyupajāyamānatvāt sukhādivat, akāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvād icchādivat, ayāvaddravyabhāvitvāt, asmadādipuruṣāntarapratyakṣatve sati puruṣāntarā'pratyakṣatvācca tadvat, āśrayād bheryādeḥ anyatropalabdheśca
sparśavatāṃ hi pṛthivyādīnāṃ yathoktaviparītā guṇāḥ pratīyante iti
nāpyātmaviśeṣaguṇaḥ; ahaṅkāreṇa vibhaktagrahaṇāt, bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt, ātmāntaragrāhyatvācca, buddhyādīnāñca ātmaguṇānāṃ tadvaiparītyopalabdheḥ
ataḥ pṛthivyādivyatiriktāśrayā''śrito'sau tadvṛttibādhakapramāṇasadbhāve sati guṇatvāt, yastu evaṃ na bhavati nā'sau tathā yathā rūpādiḥ, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāt tadvyatiriktāśrayā''śrita iti
śabdaliṅgā'viśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgā'bhāvācca ekaṃ vibhu ca, niratiśayaparimāṇā'dhikaraṇatvācca paramāṇuvat nityaṃ siddham
kāryāntarasya svāvayavakāryasajātīyasya aprādurbhāvād ananubhavāt arthāt bheryādau
ayaṃ bhāvaḥ–yathā bheryādau rūpādayo viśeṣaguṇāḥ svāvayavarūpādisajātīyā anubhūyante tathā svāvayavaśabdasajātīya śabdaḥ bheryādau nopalabhyate
śabdaḥ pratyakṣatve sati akāraṇaguṇapūrvakatvāt, ayāvaddravyabhāvitvāt, āśrayādanyatropalabdheśca na sparśavadviśeṣaguṇaḥ
samavāyikāraṇeṣu guṇāḥ kāraṇaguṇāḥ te pūrva kāraṇaṃ yasya guṇasya asau kāraṇaguṇapūrvaka yathā paṭarūpādi tanturūpādipūrvaka iti
svāśrayasya yat samavāyikāraṇaṃ tadguṇapūrvaḥ śabdo na bhavati paṭarūpādivadāśrayotpattyanantaramanutpādāt ata sukhādivat sparśavatāṃ viśeṣaguṇo na bhavati
yāvaddravyaṃ śabdo na bhavati satyeva āśraye śaṅkhādau tadvināśāt
asmadādipuruṣāntarāṇāṃ samīpadeśavarttināṃ pratyakṣatve'pi puruṣāntarāṇā dūradeśavartināmapratyakṣatvaṃ śabdasya
sa ca tasmādanyatra dūre karṇaśaṣkulīdeśe samupalabhyate
na cānyaguṇasya anyatra grahaṇamasti tasmānna sparśavadviśeṣaguṇaḥ
anyatraśabdo vinārthaḥ tena āśrayaṃ vinā upalabdhiyogyatvāt ityarthaḥ ayogyāśrayakatvāditi yāvat
paratra samavāyāt pratyakṣatvācca nātmaguṇo na manoguṇaḥ
talliṅgabhūtasya ca śabdasya utpattiprakriyā pradarśyate; tathāhi–saṃyogād vibhāgāt śabdācca śabda utpadyate
tatra saṃyogāt tadutpattau ākāśaṃ samavāyikāraṇam, bheryādyākāśasaṃyogaḥ asamavāyikāraṇam, bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogaḥ nimittakāraṇam

vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇānāṃ saṃyoganimittānāṃ saṃyogā'samavāyikāraṇatvā'vyabhicārāt, prayogaḥ–saṃyoganimittā vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇāḥ saṃyogā'samavāyikāraṇāḥ, saṃyoganimittatve sati vibhudravyaviśeṣaguṇatvāt, yad yadittham tat tathā yathā buddhyādayaḥ, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
tathā vibhāgādapi śabdotpattau ākāśaṃ samavāyikāraṇam, vaṃśadala-ākāśavibhāgo' samavāyikāraṇam, vaṃśadalavibhāgaḥ nimittakāraṇam

nanu vaṃśadalavibhāgottarakālaṃ śabdotpattidarśanāt yuktaṃ tasya tannimittatvam, na punaḥ vaṃśadala-ākāśavibhāgasya asamavāyikāraṇasya, tatsadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt; iti ca na cetasi nidheyam; śabdanimittānāmanekadravyaguṇānāṃ samānajātīyā'samavāyikāraṇasamanvitānāṃ śabdārambhakatvapratīteḥ

prayogaḥ–vibhāgaḥ svasamānajātīyena asamavāyikāraṇena sahita śabdamārabhate, anekadravyaguṇatve sati śabdārambhakatvāt, yo ya evam sa sa tathā yathā bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogaḥ, tathā ca vibhāgaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
śabdāt śabdotpattau tu ākāśaṃ samavāyikāraṇam, prāktanaḥ śabdaḥ asamavāyikāraṇam, adṛṣṭādikaṃ nimittakāraṇamiti
śabdasya ākāśaguṇatvābhāvaprasādhanapūrvikā dravyatvasiddhi, ākāśasya sarvathā nitya-niravayavatvanirasanapurassarā yugapannikhilārthāvagāhanahetutayā siddhiśca–

yattāvaduktam–śabda kvacidāśritaḥ ityādi; tadasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; yata kim ato'numānāt śabdasya āśrayamātrāśritatvaṃ prasādhyate, nityaikavyāpi-āśrayā''śritatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamato nabhodravyasiddhiḥ āśrayamātrasyaiva siddhiprasaṅgāt ? tatra ca siddhasādhyatā, śabdasya pudgalapariṇāmatayā tadāśritatvā'bhyupagamāt
nityaikavyāpi-āśrayā''śritatve tu sādhye sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; rūpādīnāṃ tadviparītāśrayā''śritatvāt
yadi sāmānyena āśritatvamātramepā sādhyate śabdānā tadā siddhasādhyatā
yadapi dravyakarmā'nyatve sati sattāsambandhitvāt iti tatprasādhakaṃ sādhanamupanyastam; tadapi viśeṣaṇaikadeśā'siddhatvāt na tatprasādhakam
karmā'nyatve satyapi hi śabdasya dravyānyatvamasiddham; dravyalakṣaṇalakṣitatvena asya dravyatvopapatteḥ, guṇa-kriyāvattvaṃ hi dravyalakṣaṇam, tacca avikalaṃ śabde'stīti
ataḥ dravyaṃ śabdaḥ guṇa-kriyāvattvāt, yad guṇakriyāvat tad dravyam yathā vāṇādi, guṇa-kriyāvāṃśca śabda iti
tathāhi–guṇavān śabdaḥ sparśa-alpatva-mahattvaparimāṇa-saṃkhyā-saṃyogā''śrayatvāt, yad evaṃvidham tad guṇavat tathā badara-āmalakādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
dravyaṃ śabdaḥ sparśālpatva prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 164 pū॰
tatra na tāvat sparśā''śrayatvamasya asiddham; tathāhi–sparśavān śabdaḥ svasambaddhā'rthāntarā'bhighātahetutvāt, yad ittham tad ittham yathā mudgarādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
na ca śabdasahacaritena vāyunā atra abhighāta ityabhidhātavyam; śabdānvaya-vyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt, tathābhūtasyāpyasya anyahetutvakalpane na kvacid hetu-phalabhāvapratiniyamaḥ syāt
guṇatvena asya nirguṇatvataḥ sparśā'bhāvāt tadabhighātā'hetutve cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ–guṇatvaṃ hi adravyatve siddhe siddhyet, tadapi asparśavattve, tadapi guṇatve iti
tathā sparśavān śabdaḥ sparśavatā'rthena abhihanyamānatvāt tṛṇādivat ityato'pi anumānād asya sparśavattvasiddheḥ
karṇaśaṣkulyāṃ kaṭakaṭāyamānasya prāyaśa pratighātahetorbhavanādyupaghātinaḥ śabdasya prasiddhiḥ asparśatvakalpanāmastaṅgamayati
nāpi alpatva-mahattvaparimāṇāśrayatvam; alpa-mahattvapratītiviṣayattvāt, yat tatpratītiviṣayaḥ tat tatparimāṇāśrayaḥ yathā badara-āmalakādi, tatpratītiviṣayaśca śabda iti
na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ; alpaḥ śabdaḥ, mahān śabdaḥ iti tatpratītiviṣayatayā asya ābālaṃ suprasiddhatvāt
tathābhūtasyāpyasya tatpratītiviṣayatvā'pahnave badarādāvapi tatpratītiviṣayatvāpahnavaprasaṅgāt sarvatra tatparimāṇābhāvaḥ syāt
atha badarāderdravyatvāt tatparimāṇaprasiddhiryuktā na śabde viparyayāt; tadapyasat; anyonyāśrayā'nuṣaṅgāt–siddhe hi śabdasya adravyatve tatparimāṇā'bhāvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca adravyatvasiddhiriti

tatra tatparimāṇā'nabhyupagame ca kinnibandhanā śabde tatpratītiḥ syāt ? kāraṇagatā'lpatvamahattvaparimāṇanibandhanā cet; badarādāvapi asau svakāraṇā'lpatvamahattvaparimāṇanibandhanā'stu, tathā anyatrāpyevam iti na kvacit mukhyato'lpamahattvaparimāṇanibandhanā tatpratītiḥ syāt, pratītivirodhaḥ anyatrāpyaviśiṣṭaḥ
nāpi saṃkhyāśrayatvam; ekaḥ śabdaḥ, dvau śabdau, bahavaḥ śabdāḥ iti pratītyā ghaṭādivat śabde saṃkhyāvattvaprasiddhe

atha upacārāt śabde saṃkhyāvattvapratītiḥ; nanu kigatā saṃkhyā tatra upacaryyate–kāraṇagatā, viṣayagatā vā ? yadi kāraṇagatā, tatrāpi ki samavāyikāraṇagatā, kāraṇamātragatā vā'sau tatra upacaryeta ? tatrādyapakṣe eka śabdaḥ iti sarvadā vyapadeśaprasaṅgaḥ gaganalakṣaṇatatsamavāyikāraṇasya ekatvāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu bahavaḥ śabdā iti sadā vyapadeśaḥ syāt tanmātrasya bahutvāt
viṣayasaṃkhyopacāre tu gagana-ākāśa-vyomādiśabdāḥ bahuvyapadeśabhājo na syuḥ tadviṣayasya ekatvāt, paśvādīnāñca bahutvāt eko gośabdaḥ iti vyapadeśaḥ svapne'pi durlabhaḥ
yathā'virodhaṃ saṃkhyopacāraḥ; ityapyayuktam; svayaṃ saṃkhyāvattve eva avirodhasaṃbhavāt

kiñca, viparītopalambhasya bādhakasya sadbhāve sati upacārakalpanā syāt agnirmāṇavakaḥ ityādivat, na ca agnirahitamāṇavakasya iva ekatvādisaṃkhyārahitaśabdasya upalambho'sti, iti katham upacāratastatra tatkalpanā syāt ? tathāpi tattathātvakalpane anupacaritameva na kiñcit syāt

kathamevaṃ bhavatāmapi ekaṃ rūpam ityādiguṇeṣu saṃkhyāvyapadeśaḥ ? ityapyayuktam, yanmate hi saṃkhyāyā guṇatvam tanmate eva asyāstatrā'sabhavataḥ tadvyapadeśā'bhāvaprasaṅga, nā'smākam prameyatvavastutvādivat taddharmatayā tasyā abhyupagamāt
dharmāṇāñca guṇādau bhāvo na viruddhyate, anyathā teṣāmaprameyatvādiprasaṅgaḥ
kathamanyathā ṣaṭ padārthāḥ ityādivyapadeśa syāt ? tanna saṃkhyā''śrayatvamapi asya asiddham
nāpi saṃyogā''śrayatvam; vāyvādinā abhihanyamānatvāt, yad vāyvādinā'bhihanyamānam tat saṃyogāśrayaḥ yathā pāṃśvādi, tena abhihanyamānaśca śabda iti

na cedamasiddham; devadattaṃ prati āgacchataḥ śabdasya prativātādinā pratinivarttanapratīteḥ, yatra yena pratinivarttanaṃ pratīyate tatra tena abhighāto'sti yathā pāṃśvādau, prativātādinā pratinivarttanaṃ pratīyate ca śabde iti

tatpratinivartanapratītiśca anyadigavasthitasya asya anyadigavasthitena grahaṇādavasīyate, yad anyadigavasthitam anyadigavasthitena gṛhyate tatra pratinivarttanamasti yathā tṛṇādau, tathābhūtaḥ tathābhūtena gṛhyate ca śabda iti

nanu gandhādayo devadattaṃ pratyāgacchantaḥ tena pratinivartyante, na ca tepāṃ tena saṃyogaḥ nirguṇatvād guṇānām; ityapyacodyam; tadvato dravyasyaiva anena pratinivarttanāt, kevalānāṃ teṣāṃ niṣkriyatvena āgamanapratinivarttanā'nupapatteḥ
ata siddhaṃ śabdasya saṃyogā''śrayatvam; kṣakārādau akṣarasaṃyogapratīteśca
jātyantarasya asyotpattau sarvatra saṃyogavārttocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, daṇḍyāderapi jātyantarasyaiva utpattiprasakteḥ
nāpi kriyāvattvam; pūrvadeśatyāgena deśāntare samupalabhyamānatvāt, yad itthaṃ deśāntare samupalabhyate tat kriyāvad dṛṣṭam yathā bāṇādi, tathā tatra samupalabhyate ca śabda iti
na cedamasiddham; vaktṛmukhapradeśatyāgena śrotṛśrotrapradeśe śabdasyopalabdheḥ sakalajanaprasiddhatvāt

nanu na ādya eva ākāśatacchaṅgramukhasaṃyogādeḥ samavāyi-asamavāyi-nimittakāraṇājjātaḥ śabdaḥ śrotreṇa āgatya sambaddhyate yenāsya kriyāvattvaṃ syāt, kintu vīcītaraṅganyāyena aparāpara eva ākāśaśabdādilakṣaṇāt samavāyi-asamavāyi-nimittakāraṇājjātaḥ anya eva, ataḥ kathamasya kriyāvattvasabhāvanā ? ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; sarvatra evaṃ kriyocchedaprasaṅgāt, bāṇādayo'pi hi pūrvapūrvasamānajātīyakṣaṇaprabhavā lakṣyapradeśavyāpinaḥ na punaḥ te eva iti kalpayato na vaktraṃ vakrībhavet
pratyabhijñānād atra sthāyitvasiddheḥ naivaṃ kalpanā, ityanyatrāpi samānam– upādhyāyoktaṃ śṛṇomi śiṣyoktaṃ śṛṇomi iti ekatvagrāhiṇaḥ pratyabhijñānasya śabde'pi pratīteḥ
śrotraśabdayoḥ gamanāgamanābhāvāt aprāptasya grahaṇaṃ nāsti pariśeṣāt santānasiddhi
yathāhi mahata pāṣāṇādyabhighātādupajātā vīcī vīcyantaramārabhate sā'pi punarvīcyantaramiti santānāḥ tadvacchabdasantānā

nanu pratyabhijñānasya bhavanmate darśana-smaraṇakāraṇakatvāt, atra ca tadabhāvāt kathaṃ tadutpattiḥ ? na khalu upādhyāyādyukte śabde darśanavat smaraṇaṃ saṃbhavati asya pūrvadarśanādyāhitasaṃskāraprabodhanibandhatvāt, na ca kāraṇā'bhāve kāryasya utpattiryuktā atiprasaṅgāt; ityapyanupapannam; sambandhitāpratipattidvāreṇa atra ekatvasya pratīteḥ, sambandhitāyāñca darśana-smaraṇayoḥ sadbhāvasaṃbhavāt pratyabhijñānasya utpattiraviruddhā

tathāhi–pratyakṣānupalambhato'numānato vā tatkāryatayā tatsambandhinaṃ śabdaṃ pratipadya idānī taddarśanasmṛtiprabhavaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ tatsambandhitayā śabdaṃ pratipadyamānam ekatvaviśiṣṭameva pratipadyate vyajanā'nilavat, kathamanyathā upādhyāyoktaṃ śṛṇomi ityādi pratītiḥ syāt ? taduktodbhūtaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ śabdāntaraṃ śṛṇomi iti pratītiprasaṅgāt
atha lūna-punarjātanakha-keśādivat sadṛśa-aparāparotpattinivandhanametat pratyabhijñānam naikatvanibandhanam; tadetad bāṇādāvapi samānam, iti aśeṣā'rthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgāt saugatamatasiddhiḥ syāt

nanu śabdaḥ tīvratama-tīvratara-tīvra-manda-mandatara-mandatamalakṣaṇaṣaḍvidhabhedabhinnaḥ pratīyate na bāṇādiḥ, ataḥ tatra tadbhedapratītyanyathā'nupapattyā kṣaṇikatvaṃ parikalpyate, na bāṇādau viparyayāt, tatkathaṃ saugatamatasiddhiḥ syāt ? ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; tadbhedapratīteḥ kṣaṇikatvā'prasādhakatvāt, anyathā vāyorapi kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgaḥ, vyajanādikāraṇakalāpaprabhavasya asyāpi pratyāsannatamādipuruṣaiḥ tīvratamādibhedena pratīyamānatvā'viśeṣāt
bāṇāderapi caivaṃ tatprasaṅgaḥ lakṣyapradeśe prakṣiptasya asyāpi tathāvidhaistaiḥ tadbhedena pratīyamānatvasaṃbhavāt
atha atra tīvratamādisvabhāvakriyānibandhanaḥ tadbhedapratibhāsaḥ; tadetat śabde'pi samānam

atha atra bādhakasadbhāvāt kṣaṇikatvakalpanā'yuktā na brāṇādau viparyayāt; nanu atra kiṃ bādhakam–pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā ? pratyakṣañcet; kim ekatvaviṣayam, kṣaṇikatvaviṣayaṃ vā ? na tāvad ekatvaviṣayam; samaviṣayatvena tadanukūlatvāt
nāpi kṣaṇikatvaviṣayam; śabde anyatra vā tadviṣayasya asya asiddhatvāt

atha anumānaṃ tadviṣayaṃ tadbādhakam; tathāhi–kṣaṇikaḥ śabdaḥ asmadādipratyakṣatve sati vibhudravya viśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhādivat; tadapi manorathamātram; ekaśākhāprabhavatvavat kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvād hetoḥ

vīcītaraṅganyāyena ca śabdasya utpattyabhyupagame prathamato vaktṛvyāpārād ekaḥ śabdaḥ prādurbhavet, aneko vā ? yadyekaḥ; kathaṃ nānādikkā'nekaśabdotpattiḥ sakṛt syāt ? sarvadikkatālvādivyāpārajanitavāyvākāśasaṃyogānāma samavāyikāraṇānāṃ samavāyikāraṇasya ca ākāśasya sarvagatasya bhāvāt sakṛt sarvadikkā'nekaśabdotpattyavirodhe śabdasya ārambhakatvā'nupapattiḥ

yathaiva hi ādyaḥ śabdo na śabdenā''rabdhaḥ tālvādyākāśasaṃyogādeva asamavāyikāraṇādutpatteḥ, tathā sarvadikkaśabdāntarāṇyapi tālvādivyāpāraprabhavavāyvākāśasaṃyogebhya eva asamavāyikāraṇebhyaḥ tadutpattisaṃbhavāt
tathā ca saṃyogādvibhāgāt śabdācca śabdotpattiḥ vai॰ sū॰ 2

atha śabdāntarāṇāṃ prathamaḥ śabdaḥ asamavāyikāraṇaṃ tatsadṛśatvāt, anyathā tadvisadṛśaśabdāntarotpattiprasaṅgo niyāmakā'bhāvāt; nanvevaṃ prathamasyāpi śabdasya anyasmācchabdād asamavāyikāraṇādutpattiḥ tasyāpi anyasmāt pūrvaśabdāt iti anāditvāpattiḥ śabdasantānasya syāt

atha prathamaḥ śabdaḥ pratiniyataḥ pratiniyatād vaktṛvyāpārādeva utpannaḥ svasadṛśāni śabdāntarāṇi ārabhate; tarhi kim ādyena śabdena asamavāyikāraṇena kalpitena ? pratiniyatavaktṛvyāpārāt tatprabhavapratiniyatavāyvākāśasaṃyogebhyaḥ svasadṛśa-aparāparaśabdotpattisaṃbhavāt
śaṅkhamukhasaṃyogādākāśe śabdaḥ prādurbhavan eka eva prādurbhavedaneko vā ? tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 421
na ca anekaḥ tālvādyākāśasaṃyogaḥ sakṛd ekasya vaktuḥ saṃbhavati; prayatnasya ekatvāt
na ca prayatnabhedamantareṇa tālvādikriyāpūrvakaḥ anyatarakarmajastālvādyākāśasaṃyogo ghaṭate yato'nekaḥ śabdaḥ syāt
astu vā kutaścid ādyaḥ śabdo'nekaḥ; tathāpi asau svadeśe śabdāntarāṇyārabhate, deśāntare vā ? na tāvat svadeśe; deśāntare śabdopalambhā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt

atha deśāntare; tatrāpi tatra gatvā, svadeśastha eva vā deśāntare tānyasau janayet ? yadi svadeśastha eva; tarhi adṛṣṭamapi śarīradeśasthameva deśāntaravartimaṇimuktāphalādyākarṣaṇaṃ kuryāt, tathā ca dharmā'dharmau svāśrayasaṃyukte āśrayāntare karma ārabhete ityasya virodhaḥ
śrotṛśrotrapradeśe vā tataḥ śabdotpatteḥ tadviṣayavijñānotpattervā prasaṅgād antarālaśabdānāṃ śrotre prāpyakāritvasya ca kalpanā'narthakyam
na ca vīcītaraṅgādau aprāptakāryadeśatve sati ārambhakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam, yena atrāpi tathā kalpyeta adhyakṣavirodhāt
atha taddeśe gatvā; siddhaṃ tarhi śabdasya kriyāvattvam
dharmādharmau ca svāśrayasamavete sukhaduḥkhe parāśraye tu kriyāmārabhete
ākāśaguṇatve ca asya asmadādipratyakṣatā'nupapattiḥ, tasya atyantaparokṣatvāt, yaḥ atyantaparokṣaguṇiguṇaḥ nāsau asmadādipratyakṣaḥ yathā paramāṇurūpādiḥ, tathā ca pareṇa abhyupagataḥ śabda iti
tatpratyakṣatve vā; asya atyantaparokṣa-ākāśaviśeṣaguṇatvā'yogaḥ, yad asmadādipratyakṣam tanna atyantaparokṣaguṇiguṇaḥ yathā ghaṭarūpādayaḥ, tathā ca śabda iti
na tāvadamūrttadravyaguṇaḥ śabdaḥ guṇaguṇinoravibhaktapradeśatvena ekavedanavedyatvād amūrttadravyasyāpi śravaṇendriyaviṣayatāpatteḥ

yaccoktam–sattāsambandhitvāt iti; tatra ki svarūpabhūtayā sattayā sambandhitvaṃ vivakṣitam, arthāntarabhūtayā vā ? prathamavikalpe sāmānyādibhirvyabhicāraḥ, teṣāṃ dravya-karmā'nyatve sati tathābhūtayā sattayā sambandhitve'pi guṇatvā'bhāvāt
dvitīyavikalpastu ayuktaḥ; svato'satāmarthānām arthāntarabhūtasattātaḥ sattvasya svato'rthāḥ santu sattāvat ityatra nipetsyamānatvāt

yaccānyaduktam–śabdo dravyaṃ na bhavati ekadravyatvāt iti; tatra ekadravyatvasādhanamasiddham; yato guṇatve gagane eva ekadravye samavāyena varttane ca siddhe tat siddhyet, tacca uktanītyā apāstamiti kathaṃ tatsiddhiḥ ?

yadapi ekadravyatve sādhanamuktam–ekadravyaḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati bāhyaikendriyapratyakṣatvāt iti; tadapi pratyanumānabādhitam; tathāhi–anekadravyaḥ śabdaḥ asma dādipratyakṣatve sati sparśavattvāt ghaṭādivat
vāyunā anekāntaśca; sa hi sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati bāhyaikendriyapratyakṣo'pi anekadravyaḥ, cakṣuṣaikena pratīyamānaiścandrā'rkādibhiśca
asmadādivilakṣaṇaiḥ bāhyendriyāntareṇa tatra pratītiḥ, śabde'pi samānā, atra tathā'nupalambhaḥ anyatrāpi tulyaḥ
yadapi anityatve sati niyamena acākṣupapratyakṣatvāt ityuktam; tadapyayuktam; vāyunā anaikāntikatvāt, sa hi anityatve sati niyamenā'cākṣuṣapratyakṣo'pi dravyam iti
yadapi–vyāpakadravyasamavetatvāt ityabhihitam; tadapyabhidhānamātram; asiddhatvāt, siddhe hi guṇatve tatra asya samavetatvaṃ siddhyet, na ca tatsiddham uktaprakāreṇa nirastatvāt
yaccānyaduktam–na tāvatsparśavatāṃ paramāṇūnām ityādi; tat siddhasādhanam, tadguṇatvasya śabde'nabhyupagamāt
yathā ca asmadādipratyakṣatve śabdasya paramāṇuviśeṣaguṇatvavirodhaḥ tathā ākāśaviśeṣaguṇatvavirodho'pi
nahi asmadādipratyakṣatvaṃ paramāṇuviśeṣaguṇatvameva nirākaroti śabdasya na ākāśaviśeṣaguṇatvam abhayatrā'viśeṣāt
yathaiva hi paramāṇuguṇo rūpādiḥ asmadādyapratyakṣaḥ tathā ākāśaguṇo mahattvādirapi
yadapi–āśrayād bheryāderanyatropalabdheḥ ityādyuktam, tadapyayuktam; bheryādeḥ śabdā''śrayatvā'siddheḥ tasya tannimittakāraṇatvāt
yā'pi śabdotpattau prakriyā–ākāśaṃ samavāyikāraṇam ityādikā; sā'pi etena nirastā; śabdasya ākāśaguṇatvaniṣedhe ta prati asya samavāyikāraṇatvā'nupapatteḥ
yadi vā, ākāśaṃ niravayavaṃ śabdasya samavāyikāraṇaṃ syāt; tarhi tadvat tasyāpi vyāpitvaprasaṅgaḥ
deśakṛtaṃ hi naiyatyam avyāpitvamucya te, tacca ākāśasya tatsamavāyikāraṇasya adeśatve atidurghaṭam
yo niṣpradeśadravyaguṇaḥ nāsau svāśrayā'vyāpakaḥ yathā tanmahattvam, paramāṇurūpādirvā, niṣpradeśasya ākāśasya guṇaśca bhavadbhi parikalpitaḥ śabda iti

tasya avyāpyavṛttitve vā kathaṃ tadādhārasya ākāśasya sāvayavatvaṃ na syāt pradeśavṛttirguṇaḥ, niṣpradeśādhāraśca iti ko'nyo jaḍātmano brūyāt ? yadi ca sāvayavaṃ nabho na bhavet tadā śrotrasamavetasyeva brahmāṇḍavartino'pi śabdasya asmadādibhirupalambhaḥ syāt niravayava-ekākāśalakṣaṇaśrotrasamavetatvāt

atha dharmā'dharmābhisaṃskṛtakarṇaśaṣkulyavaruddha ākāśadeśa eva śrotram; tatra brahmāṇḍavarttinaḥ śabdasya asamavāyāt na asmadādibhirupalambhaḥ; na nvayam andhasarpabila praveśanyāyena sāvayavatvā'ṅgīkāra eva parihāraḥ, śrotrā''kāśadeśāt brahmāṇḍavartiśabdā''dhārākāśadeśasya anyatvāt
avyāpyavṛttitvañcāsya paryudāsarūpam, prasajyarūpaṃ vā syāt ? ādyapakṣe ekadeśavṛttitvameva uktaṃ syāt, ākāśaṃ hi vyāpya śabdo na varttate iti bruvatā tadekadeśe vartate ityabhyupagataṃ syāt
vyāpyavṛttitvaṃ hi sāmastyavṛttitvam, tatpratiṣedhe ca ekadeśavṛttitvaṃ syāt, tacca ākāśasya niṣpradeśatve atidurghaṭam ityuktam
prasajyapakṣe tu vṛttipratiṣedhamātrameva uktaṃ syāt; na caitadupapannam
śabdasya guṇatvena dravyāśritatvataḥ tatpratiṣedhavirodhāt, tatpratiṣedhe vā guṇatvā'nupapattiḥ
yasya sarvathā vṛttipratiṣedhaḥ nāsau guṇaḥ yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, sarvathā vṛttipratipedhaśca śabdasya iti
samavāyasya tatra tadvṛtterabhyupagamāt na ekadeśena sāmastyena vā ityādidoṣaḥ; ityapi śraddhāmātram; tasya agre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
tanniravayavatve ca santānavṛttyā śabdasyā''gatasya śrotreṇa upalabdhirna syāt; aparāpara-ākāśadeśotpattidvāreṇa asya śrotrasamavetatvā'nupapatteḥ
vīcītaraṅganyāyena hi aparāpara-ākāśadeśe śabdotpattikalpane kathannāsya sāvayavatvaṃ siddhyet ? tanna sarvathā ākāśasya anavayavatvaṃ yuktam
nāpi sarvathā nityatvam; tadvat śabdasyāpi nityatvaprasaṅgāt
tasya hi vināśaḥ āśrayavināśāt, virodhiguṇaprādurbhāvāt, tannimittā'dṛṣṭā'bhāvādvā ? na tāvad āśrayavināśāt; tasya sarvathā nityatvapratijñānāt
nāpi virodhiguṇaprādurbhāvāt; yataḥ ko virodhī guṇaḥ–tanmahattvam, saṃyogādirvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; tanmahattvasya ekārthasamavetatvena virodhitvā'siddheḥ
tatsiddhau vā śravaṇasamaye'pi tadabhāvaprasaṅgaḥ anutpattireva vā, sadāpi tanmahattvasya sadbhāvāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ; saṃyogādeḥ śabdotpādaṃ prati kāraṇatvena virodhitvā'nupapatteḥ
nāpi tannimittādṛṣṭā'bhāvāt tadabhāvaḥ; tucchābhāvasya aśeṣasāmarthyaśūnyatvena aśvaviṣāṇavat tadvināśā'hetutvāt
tathāhi–paudgalikaḥ śabdaḥ, guṇa-kriyāvattve sati asmadādibāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt, yadevam tadevam yathā ghaṭādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
tataḥ śabdasya ākāśaguṇatvā'siddheḥ nā'sau talliṅgam, iti nātaḥ tatsadbhāvasiddhiḥ

nanvevam ākāśadravyāpahnave kathaṃ bhavatāṃ nā'pasiddhāntaḥ syāt ? ityapyasāram; paraparikalpitasyaiva sarvathā nityaniraṃśasvabhāvasyā'sya asmābhiḥ pratikṣepāt na tadviparītasya, asya uktadoṣā'gocaracāritvāt
puṭṭhesu tesu jāyadi saddo uppādago ṇiado
kutastatsadbhāvasiddhiḥ bhavatāmapīti cet ? yugapannikhiladravyā'vagāhakāryāt iti brūmaḥ
tathāhi–yugapannikhilāvagāhaḥ sādhāraṇakāraṇā'pekṣaḥ, yugapannikhilāvagāhatvāt, ya evaṃvidho'vagāha sa evaṃvidhakāraṇā'pekṣo dṛṣṭaḥ yathā ekasaraḥsalilāntaḥpātimatsyādyavagāha, tathāvagāhaścāyamiti

nanu sarpiṣo madhunyavagāha, bhasmani jalasya, jale aśvāderyathā, tathaiva āloka-tamaso aśeṣārthāvagāho bhaviṣyati, ataḥ kathamasmād ākāśasiddhiḥ ? ityapyasundaram, anayorapi ākāśā'bhāve avagāhā'nupapatteḥ
savvesi jīvāṇaṃ sesāṇa tahaya puggalāṇaṃ ca
jaṃ dedi vivaramakhilaṃ taṃ loe havai āyāsam

nanu nikhilārthānāṃ yathā ākāśe'vagāhaḥ tathā tasyāpi anyasminnadhikaraṇe avagāhena bhavitavyam ityanavasthā, tasya svarūpe'vagāhe sarvā'rthānāṃ svātmanyavagāhaprasaṅgāt katham ākāśasya ataḥ siddhi ? ityapyapeśalam, ākāśasya vyāpitvena svāvagāhitvopapattita anavasthā'nupapatteḥ, anyeṣāmavyāpitvena svāvagāhitvā'yogācca, nahi kiñcidalpaparimāṇaṃ vastu svā'dhikaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭam aśvāderjalādyadhikaraṇatvapratīte
kathamevaṃ dikkālātmanām ākāśe'vagāhaḥ vyāpitvāt ? ityapyasāmpratam, teṣāṃ vyāpitvā'siddhe, tadasiddhiśca digdravyasyāsattvena kālātmanośca asarvagatadravyatvena vakṣyamāṇatvāt siddhā
nanvevamapi amūrttatvena kāla-ātmano pātā'bhāvāt kathaṃ tadādheyatā ? ityapyayuktam; amūrttasyāpi jñānādeḥ ātmani ādheyatvaprasiddhe

atha dharmādīnāmanya ādhāra kalpyateākāśasyāpi anya ādhāra kalpya tathā satyanavasthāprasaṅgaḥ iti cennaiṣa doṣa, nākāśādanyadadhikaparimāṇaṃ dravyamasti yatrākāśa sthitamityucyate sarvato'nantaṃ hi tat
etena amūrttatvāt nā''kāśaṃ kasyacidadhikaraṇam ityapi pratyuktam; amūrttasyāpyātmano jñānādhikaraṇatvapratīteḥ

samasamayavartitvāt nikhilārthānāṃ nādhārā''dheyabhāvaḥ, anyathā ākāśāduttarakālaṃ teṣāṃ bhāva syāt; ityapyasamīcīnam; samasamayavartināmapi ātmaamūrttatvādīnāṃ tadbhāvapratīteḥ, na khalu pareṇāpi atra pūrvā'parībhāvo'bhyupagamyate nityatvā'bhāvā'nuṣaṅgāt
tanna paraparikalpitam ākāśadravyaṃ ghaṭate; nāpi kāladravyam
yugapadbhāvināmapi ādhārādheyabhāvo dṛśyate ghaṭe rūpādaya śarīre hastādaya iti
prāya anayaiva prakriyayā ākāśadravyasya carcā–tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 431, prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 163 u॰, tattvārthabhā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 358, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 670, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 941, ityādiṣu draṣṭavyā
parā'parādipratyayālliṅgāt asti nitya eka vimuśca kāla iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣaḥ–

nanu kāladravyasya parā'parādipratyayalakṣaṇālliṅgāt prasiddheḥ kathamaghaṭamānatā ? tathāhi– digdeśakṛtaparāparādipratyayaviparītāḥ parāparādiviśiṣṭapratyayāḥ viśiṣṭakāraṇapūrvakāḥ, viśiṣṭapratyayatvāt, yo viśiṣṭapratyayaḥ sa viśiṣṭakāraṇapūrvako dṛṣṭaḥ yathā daṇḍī ityādipratyayaḥ, viśiṣṭāśca ete parā-'para-yaugapadyā-'yaugapadya-cira-kṣiprapratyayā iti

parā'parayorhi dig-deśakṛtayorvyatikaro'tra dṛśyate–yatraiva hi dig-deśabhāge sthite pitari utpannaṃ paratvam tatraiva sthite putre'paratvam, yatra ca sthite putre'paratvamutpannam tatraiva sthite pitari paratvamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭam iti
ataḥ digdeśābhyām anyannimittāntaram atra pratyaye abhyupagantavyam, tadantareṇa tadvyatikarā'nupapatteḥ
na ca parā'parādipratyayānām ādityādikriyā valipalitādikaṃ vā nimittaṃ yuktam; tatpratyayavilakṣaṇatvāt paṭādipratyayavat
tathā ca sūtram– aparāsmin paraṃ yugapadayugapacciraṃ kṣipram iti kālaliṅgāni vai॰ sū॰ 2
talliṅgā'viśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgā'bhāvācca ākāśavat tasya ekatva-nityatva-vibhutvādayo dharmāḥ pratipattavyāḥ

tathābhūtasya ca kāladravyasya itarasmād bhede kālaḥ iti vā vyavahāre sādhye parā'parādipratyaya eva liṅgam; tathāhi–kālaḥ itarasmād bhidyate, kālaḥ iti vā vyavaharttavyaḥ, parā'parādipratyayaliṅgatvāt, yastu na itarasmādbhidyate kālaḥ iti vā na vyavahriyate nā'sau uktaliṅgaḥ yathā pṛthivyādiḥ, tathā ca kālaḥ, tasmāttathā iti
yatra hi digvivakṣayotpannaṃ paratva tatraivāparatvaṃ yatraivāparatvaṃ tatraiva paratvamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭam
kāla itarasmād bhidyatevyavahāro vā sādhyate vivādāpannaṃ kāla iti vyavaharttavyam parāparavyatikarādiliṅgatvāt

yattāvaduktam–parā'para ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ ato liṅgāt kālaḥ kim ekadravyasvarūpaḥ, anekadravyasvarūpo vā sādhyeta ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; nityaniraṃśaikarūpatayā vicāryamāṇasya asyānupapadyamānatvāt
yad yadrūpatayā vicāryamāṇaṃ nopapadyate na tat tadrūpatayā abhyupagantavyam yathā jagat brahmādyadvaitarūpatayā, nityaniraṃśaikarūpatayā vicāryamāṇo nopapadyate ca kāla iti
na cedamasiddham; tatra tadrūpatāyāḥ parasparavilakṣaṇaparā'parapratyayādikāryabhedā'nupapattyā atītāditadrūpabhedā'nupapattyā ca anupapadyamānatvāt

nahi sarvathā nityasya niraṃśasya ekasvabhāvasya ca arthasya anitya-vibhinnadeśānekasvabhāvakāryakāritvaṃ ghaṭate; brahmaṇo'pyevaṃvidhasya anekagrāmārāmādi kāryakartṛtvā'nuṣaṅgata tadadvaitasiddhiprasaṅgāt
vicitrasahakārivaśāt tathāvidhasyāpi tatkartṛtvā'virodhaḥ ityapi anyatrā'viśiṣṭam, avidyādeḥ sahakāriṇo brahmaṇyapi saṃbhavāt
na ca svarūpamabhedayatāṃ sahakāritvaṃ saṃbhavati ityuktam īśvaraparamāṇuvicāraprakrame

ato'tra yaugapadyādipratyayā'nutpattireva, yat khalu kāryajātam ekasmin kāle kṛtam tad yugapatkṛtam ityucyate, kālasya ca nityaikatvādirūpatve tadutpādyatvena kāryāṇām ekadaivotpattiprasaṅgānna kiñcid ayugapatkṛtaṃ syāt
cira-kṣipravyavahārā'bhāvaśca, yaddhi bahunā kālena kṛtaṃ tat cireṇa kṛtam ityucyate, yacca svalpena kṛtaṃ tat kṣipraṃ kṛtam iti, taccaitadubhaya kālasya sarvathā nityādirūpatāyāṃ durghaṭam

nanu kālasya tadrūpatāyāṃ satyāmapi upādhibhedād bhedopapatterna yaugapadyādipratyayābhāva, taduktam– māṇivat pācakavadvā upādhibhedāt kālabhedaḥ iti, tadapyasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; yata atra upādhibheda kāryabheda eva, sa ca yugapatkṛtam ityatrāpyastyeva iti kimityayugapatpratyayo na syāt ? atha kramabhāvī kāryabheda kālabhedavyavahārahetu; atha ko'sya kramabhāva ? yugapadanutpādaścet; nanu yugapadanutpāda ityasya bhāpitasya ko'rtha ? ekasmin kāle'nutpādaścet; nanvayam itaretarāśraya–yāvaddhi kālasya bhedo na siddhyati na tāvat kāryāṇāṃ bhinnakālotpādalakṣaṇa krama siddhyati, yāvacca kāryāṇāṃ tathāvidha kramo na siddhyati na tāvat kālasya upādhibhedād bheda siddhyati
tata svarūpata eva kālasya bhedo'bhyupagantavya, tathā ca ekakālamidam, cirotpannam, anantarotpannam ityādivyavahāra sughaṭa, nānyathā
yathā maṇe svarūpāparityāgenaiva upādhibhedādupacaryate nānātvaṃ pīto rakta itiyathā vā svarūpāparityāgenaiva puruṣasya nānākriyāvaśāt pācakādibheda tadvadihāpi
etena parāparavyatikaro'pi cintita, sarvathā nityādimbabhāve kāle tasyāpyanupapadyamānatvāt

yathaiva hi bhūmyavayavai ālokā'vayavairvā bahubhirantaritaṃ vastu viprakṛṣṭam, param iti ca ucyate svalpaistu antarita sannikṛṣṭam, aparam iti ca, tathā bahubhi kṣaṇaiḥ ahorātrādibhiśca antaritam viprakṛṣṭam, param iti ca ucyate svalpaistu antaritam sannikṛṣṭam, aparam iti ca
bahu-alpabhāvaśca gurutva-parimāṇādivad apekṣānibandhana kālaikatve sarvathā durghaṭaḥ
yat parāparādipratyayahetu tad anekam yathā bhūmyādipradeśā, parā'parādipratyayahetuśca kāla iti
nahi yaugapadyādipratyayā talliṅgabhūtā svarūpato'nyonyamaviśiṣṭā, parasparasvarūpaviviktatayā teṣāṃ pratyakṣata pratīte
pratyekamapi ca eṣāṃ viśiṣṭatā'nubhūyata eva, nahi yugapadbhuktāḥ yuga patsuptāḥ sthitā gatā vā ityādau tatpratyayānāmaviśeṣo'sti pratītivirodhāt
astu vā tatpratyayā'viśeṣaḥ; tathāpi ataḥ kālasyaikatvā'bhyupagame gurutvādipratyayā'viśeṣāt gurutvaparimāṇāderapi ekatvaprasaṅgaḥ tulyā''kṣepasamādhānatvāt
tato gurutva-parimāṇādeḥ anekaguṇarūpatāvat kālasya anekadravyarūpatā abhyupagantavyā

nitya-niraṃśaikadravyarūpatve cāsya arthānāṃ bhūta-bhaviṣyat-vartamānatvaṃ durghaṭam, atītā'nāgata-varttamānakālabhedā'bhāvāt, siddhe hi tadbhede tatsambandhādarthānāṃ tathā vyapadeśaḥ syāt, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
na cāsya tatsiddhirghaṭate, nitya-niraṃśaikarūpatvāt, yad evaṃvidham na tatra atītādisvarūpabhedaḥ yathā paramāṇau, nityaniraṃśaikarūpaśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaḥ kāla iti
astu vā tatra tadbhedaḥ; tathāpi asau svataḥ, aparā'tītādikālasambandhāt, atītādikriyāsambandhādvā syāt ? na tāvat svataḥ; niraṃśatva-bhedarūpatvayorvirodhāt
nāpyaparā'tītādikālasambandhāt; tasya ekarūpatayā aparakālasyaiva asaṃbhavāt, saṃbhave vā anavasthā, tadatītatvāderapi aparā'tītādikālasambandhenaiva upapatteḥ
atha atītādikriyāsambandhāt tasya atītāditvam; nanu kriyāṇāṃ kutaḥ atītādirūpatāsiddhiḥ–aparā'tītādikriyāsambandhāt, tathāvidhakālasambandhādvā ? prathamavikalpe anavasthā
dvitīyavikalpe tu anyonyāśrayaḥ– siddhe hi kriyāṇāmatītāditve tatsambandhāt kālasya atītāditvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tatsambandhāt tāsāṃ tatsiddhiriti
taddhi kim aparātītādikālasambandhāt, tathābhūtapadārthakriyāsambandhādvā syāt, svato vā ? prathamapakṣe anavasthā
bhavatu vā kutaścit tatra atītādibhedasiddhiḥ; tathāpi kālasya sarvathaikatvapratijñāne svavacanavirodhaḥ, svavācaiva asya atītādirūpatayā bhedapratipādanāt
lokavirodhaśca, na khalu laukikā atītādirūpasya pūrvāhṇa-madhyāhna-aparāhṇasvabhāvasya śīta-uṣṇa-varṣāsvarūpasya ca kālasya ekatvaṃ pratipadyante, pratyekaṃ tasya tairbhedā'bhyupagamāt
anumānavirodhaśca; tathāhi–yat sūkṣmetaradharmā'dhyastaṃ dravyam tadanekam yathā pṛthivyādi, sūkṣmetaradharmā'dhyastañca kāladravyam iti

yathaiva hi pṛthivyādidravyāṇāṃ paramāṇu-itararūpatayā, jīvadravyāṇāñca kunthugajādijīvadravyaprabhedasvabhāvatayā sūkṣmetaradharmā'dhyastatvād anekadravyatvam, tathā kāladravyasyāpi samaya-muhūrttāditadviśeṣā'pekṣayā taddharmādhyastatvasaṃbhavāt anekadravyatvaṃ pratipattavyam
mukhyetaravikalpasaṃbhavācca; na hi samaya-āvalikādivyavahārakālo mukhyakāladravyamantareṇa upapadyate yathā mukhyasattvamantareṇa kvacidupacaritaṃ sattvam

samayādīnā kriyāviśeṣāṇā samayādibhirnirvartyamānānā ca pākānā samaya pāka ityevamādisvasaṃjñārūḍhisadbhāve'pi samaya kāla odanapākakāla ityadhyāropyamāṇa kālavyapadeśaḥ tadvyapadeśanimittasya mukhyasya kālasya astitvaṃ gamayati
sa ca mukhyakāla anekadravyam, pratyākāśapradeśaṃ vyavahārakālabhedā'nyathānupapatteḥ
anekadravyatve sati kimasya pramāṇam ? ukta ca–loyāyāsa payese te kālāṇū asakhadavvāṇi
śvetāmbarāṇā kāladravyaviṣaye matabheda, tathāhi–kālaśca ityeke tattvārthasū॰ 5
eke tu ācāryā vyācakṣate kālo'pi dravyamiti
tuśabdo viśeṣaparigrahārtha, sa ca viśeṣo bhedapradhāno naya tadbalena kālo'pi, apiśabda caśabdārtha kālaśca dravyāntaramāgame nirūpitam iti kathayanti
'kati ṇaṃ bhante davvā paṇṇattā ? goyamā chaddavvā paṇṇattā, taṃ jahā dhammatthikāe adhammatthikāe āgāsatthikāe puggalatthikāe jīvatthikāe addhā samaea

kasya vyāvarttaka ? dharmāstikāyādipañcakā' vyatiriktakālapariṇativādino dravyanayasya iti yata tatpratidvandinayānusārisūtramaparamāgame astikimida bhante kālotti pauccadi ? goyamā–jīvā ceva ajīvā ceva
idaṃ hi sūtram astikāyapañcakā' vyatiriktakālapratipādanāya tīrthakṛtopādeśi jīvājīvadravyaparyāya kāla iti sūtrārtha
kāladravyasya noktaṃ pradeśaparimāṇaṃ tatra tadvivakṣayā tu idamucyate–so'nantasa maya
hemacandrācāryāstu digambaramatamevānusaranti, tathāhi–lokākāśapradeśasthā bhinnā kālāṇavastu ye
bhāvānā parivarttāya mukhya kāla sa ucyate
uktamatāntarāṇā viśeṣapariśīlanāya– dharmasaṃ॰, dravyānuyogata॰ a॰ 10 ślo॰ 10–18, yuktiprabo॰ gā॰ 23
loyāgāsapayese ekkike je ṭhiyā hu ekkikā
rayaṇāṇaṃ rāsīviva te kālāṇū muṇeyavvā || iti
pramāṇāpekṣa eva ayam atītādivyavahāra na tu kālakṛta iti kāladravyā'bhāvavādina pūrvapakṣa–
nanu kāladravyasya vicāryamāṇasya svarūpata eva asaṃbhavāt kasya ekadravyatvapratikṣepeṇa anekadravyatvaṃ pratipādyate

nahi atītādibhedabhinnaḥ kālaḥ saṃbhavati yatsambandhādarthānāmatītāditvaṃ syāt; svataḥ parato vā asya tadbhedā'nupapatteḥ ? svato hi kālasya atītāditve arthānāmapi svata eva tadastu alaṃ kālakalpanayā
parato'pi atītādikālāntarābhisambandhāt, atītādikriyābhisambandhādvā tasya atītāditvā'bhyupagame prāguktadopā'nuṣaṅga
ata pramāṇā'pekṣa evāyamatītādivyavahāra; pramāṇena hi yugapadanubhūyamānaṃ vastu varttamānam ityucyate, ayugapadanubhūyamānaṃ tu pūrvakṣaṇabhāvi bhūtam uttarakṣaṇabhāvi tu bhaviṣyat iti
viśiṣṭasamaya paurvāparyādidinotpanneṣvartheṣu pūrvāparādisaṃketaḥ tadudbhūto manaskāra ābhoga sa nibandhanamasyeti tattathoktam

yattāvaduktam–kāladravyasya ityādi; tadavicāritaramaṇīyam; yataḥ kuto'sya svarūpata eva asaṃbhavaḥ–grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt, atītādibhedā'saṃbhavādvā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; parā'parādipratyayaliṅgaprabhavā'numānasyaiva tatsadbhāvā''vedakapramāṇasya sadbhāvāt
nahi tatpratyayā nirnimittāḥ kādācitkatvāt, nāpyaviśiṣṭanimittā viśiṣṭapratyayatvāt, nāpi dig-guṇa-jātinimittāḥ; tajjanyapratyayavailakṣaṇyena utpatteḥ
tathā hi–aparadigvyavasthite'praśaste'dhamajātīye sthavirapiṇḍe paro'yam iti pratyayo dṛśyate, paradigvyavasthite ca uttamajātīye praśaste yūni piṇḍe aparo'yam iti
tathā cādhamajātīye digvivakṣayā parasmin sthavirapiṇḍe valipalitādisānnidhyamapekṣamāṇasya utkṛṣṭajātīyaṃ yuvānamavadhiṃ kṛtvā itarasmāt paro'yaṃ viprakṛṣṭo'yamiti buddhirbhavati
atha ādityādikriyā tannimittam–janmano hi prabhṛti ekasya ādityaparivartanāni bhūyāṃsi iti paratvam, anyasya ca alpīyāṃsi iti aparatvam

nanvevaṃ kathaṃ yaugapadyādipratyayaprādurbhāvaḥ syāt kālā'tiriktasya nimittasya atra vicāryamāṇasya anupapadyamānatvāt ? taddhi ādityaparivartanaṃ syāt, kriyāviśeṣaḥ, kartṛkarmaṇī vā ? na tāvad ādityaparivarttanam; ekasminnapi ādityaparivarttane sarveṣāmutpādāt
ādityasya hi parivarttanaṃ meruprādakṣiṇyena paribhramaṇam ahorātramabhidhīyate, tasminnekasminnapi yaugapadyādipratītiviṣayabhūtānāmarthānāmutpādaḥ pratīyate eva
tathāvyapadeśā'bhāvācca; yugapatkālaḥ iti hi vyapadeśaḥ, na punaḥ yugapadādityaparivartanam iti
janmana prabhṛtyekasya ādityaparivarttanāni bhūyāsi iti paratvam anyasya cālpīyāsītyaparatvam, athādityaparivarttanamevāstu kiṃ kāleneti cet; na, yugapadādipratyayānumeyatvāt
vyapadeśābhāvācca, yugapatkāla iti hi vyapadeśo na yugapadādityaparivarttanamiti
na ca kriyaiva kāla iti vācyam; yugapadādipratyayābhāvaprasaṅgāt
kriyāviśeṣo'pi–ādityaparivarttanarūpaḥ, ghaṭikādau udakasañcārādirūpo vā ? tatra ādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; prāguktadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt
dvitīyavikalpo'pyanupapannaḥ; tasya tadanumāpakatvāt; tathāhi–etāvati tadghaṭikāyām udakasañcāre etāvān kālaḥ iti kriyāviśeṣaḥ kālā'numāpakaḥ, na punaḥ sa eva kālaḥ

kiñca, tatkriyāyāḥ kriyārūpatayā tadanyakriyāvat kriyāpratyayahetutvaṃ syāt na puna yugapadādipratyayahetutvam, yugapat tadudakasañcāraḥ, krameṇa tadudakasañcāra iti kriyāviśeṣo'pi kālopādhika eva pratīyate tadanyakriyāvat tatkathaṃ sa eva kāla syāt ? tasya ca uktakāryanirvarttakasya kālasya kriyā iti nāmāntarakaraṇe nāmamātrameva bhidyet
kriyāmātrameva kālaḥ tadvyatirekeṇānupalabdheriti cenna; tadabhāve kālābhidhānalopaprasaṅgāt
yadi ca karttṛkarmavyatiriktā viśiṣṭapratyayasampādikā kriyā syāt sajñābhedamātram

atha kartṛ-karmaṇī eva yaugapadyādipratyayasya nimittam; tadayuktam, yato yaugapadyam bahūnāṃ kartṝṇāṃ kārye vyāpāraḥ yugapad ete kurvanti iti pratītisamadhigamyaḥ, bahūnāṃ ca kāryāṇāmātmalābha yugapad etāni kṛtāni iti pratyayādhirūḍha; na cātra kartṛmātraṃ karmamātraṃ vā ālambanam atiprasaṅgāt, yatra hi krameṇa kārya jāyate tatrāpi kartṛ-karmaṇoḥ sadbhāvāt syādetadvijñānam, na caivam
bahūnā kartṝṇā kāryakaraṇam bahūnā kāryāṇāmātmalābha iti
tathāhi–yugapadete kurvantīti kartrālagvana jñānaṃ yugapadetāni kṛtāni iti kāryālambanaṃ ca dṛṣṭam
tathāhi yatra krameṇa kārya tatrāpi kartṛkarmaṇo sadbhāvāt syādetadvijñānam
na cāsti, katarasmād ? viśiṣṭa karttāraṃ kāryaṃ vā''lambya utpadyate vijñānametaditi jñāyate
etena ayugapatpratyayo'pi cintita, na hi so'pi ayugapad ete kurvanti, ayugapad etatkṛtam ityādirūpo'viśiṣṭaṃ kartṛkarmamātramālambate atiprasaṅgādeva

ata tadviśeṣaṇaṃ kālo'bhyupagantavya, kathamanyathā cira-kṣipravyavahāro'pi syāt ? eka eva hi karttā kiñcitkārya cireṇa karoti vyāsaṅgād anarthitvādvā, kiñcittu kṣipram arthitayā, tatra cireṇa kṛtam, kṣipraṃ kṛtam iti pratyayau viśiṣṭatvāt viśiṣṭaṃ nimittamākṣipataḥ iti kālasiddhi
tathaika eva karttā kiñcitkārya cireṇa karoti vyāsaṅgādanarthitvādvā, kiñcit kṣipraṃ tadarthitayā
tatra cireṇa kṛtaṃ kṣipraṃ kṛtamiti pratyayo vilakṣaṇatvād vilakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇamākṣipati
nāpi atītādibhedā'saṃbhavāt; svarūpata evāsya atītādibhedasaṃbhavāt, svapararūpayo atītādisvarūpe svarūpato niyatatvena asya tatra parāpekṣā'nupapatteḥ
yad yatra svarūpato niyatam na tat tatra paramapekṣate yathā svapararūpaprakāśe pradīpa, svapararūpayo atītādisvarūpe svarūpato niyataśca kāla iti
na caivam arthānāmapi svata eva atītādisvarūpabhedo'stu ityabhidhātavyam, pratiniyatasvabhāvatvād bhāvānām
na hi ekasya svabhāva sarvasya āpādayituṃ yukta, pradīpasya svata eva svaprakāśopalambhato ghaṭādīnāmapi tathā tatprasaṅgāt, tathā ca pratiniyatārthasvarūpavyavasthāvilopaḥ syāt

yaccānyaduktam–pramāṇā'pekṣa eva ityādi; tatra kimidaṃ pramāṇena yugapadanubhūyamānatvaṃ nāma ? pramāṇena saha ekakālatayā'nubhūyamānatvamiti cenna; svavacanavirodhā'nuṣaṅgāt, evaṃ vadatā hi bhavatā svavacanenaiva kālaḥ pratipāditaḥ, tadanabhyupagame ekakālatayā ityabhidhātumaśakteḥ, pūrvakṣaṇabhāvi bhūtam ityādivacanā'nupapatteśca, kālasyaiva kṣaṇā'paraparyāyeṇa abhidhānāt
ataḥ kālopādhikameva idaṃ bhāvānāṃ varttamānatvādikaṃ svarūpa pramāṇā'pekṣayā vyavahriyate deśopādhikadūra-nikaṭādisvarūpavat

kālā'nabhyupagame lokapratītivirodhaśca; loke vasantādikālapratītisadbhāvāt, pratīyante hi pratiniyata eva kāle pratiniyatā vanaspatayaḥ puṣyanti ityādivyavahāraṃ kurvanto nikhilavyavahāriṇaḥ, yathā vasantādisamaye eva pāṭalādayaḥ iti
evaṃ kāryāntareṣvapi abhyūhyam prasavanakālamapekṣate iti vyavahārāt, samayamuhūrttādivyavahārācca tatsiddhiḥ
tanna paraparikalpitaṃ kāladravyamapi vyavatiṣṭhate, nāpi digdravyam
vasantasamaya eva pāṭalādikusumānāmudbhavo na kālāntara ityevaṃ kāryāntareṣvapyūhya prasavakālamapekṣate iti vyavahārāt kāraṇatvaṃ kālasya
pūrvā'parādipratyayaliṅgāt pratīyamānā asti dik pṛthag dravyam iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanvasya kālakṛtaparāparādipratyayaviparītapūrvā'parādipratyayaliṅgāt pratīyamānatvāt kathamavyavasthitiḥ ? tathāhi–mūrtteṣveva dravyeṣu mūrttadravyamavadhikṛtvā idam ataḥ pūrveṇa, dakṣiṇena, paścimena, uttareṇa, pūrvadakṣiṇena, dakṣiṇā'pareṇa, aparottareṇa, uttarapūrveṇa, adhastāt, upariṣṭāt iti amī daśa pratyayā yato bhavanti sā dik iti
tathā ca sūtram–ata idam iti yataḥ taddiśo liṅgam
prayogaḥ–yadetat pūrvā'parādijñānaṃ tat mūrttadravyavyatiriktapadārthanibandhanam tatpratyayavilakṣaṇatvāt sukhādipratyayavat
tathā, digdravyam itarebhyo bhidyate, dig iti vā vyavahartta vyam pūrvādipratyayaliṅgatvāt, yattu na tathā na tat pūrvādipratyayaliṅgam yathā kṣityādi, tathā cedam, tasmāttathā iti
na ca asyā ekatve prācyādibhedavyavahāro durghaṭaḥ; saviturmerupradakṣiṇamāvarttamānasya lokapālaparigṛhītadikpradeśai saṃyogāt tasya sughaṭatvāditi

mūrttadravyamavadhiṃ kṛtvā mūrtteṣveva dravyeṣvetasmādidaṃ pūrveṇa dakṣiṇena paścimena uttareṇa pūrvadakṣiṇena dakṣiṇāpareṇa aparottareṇa uttarapūrveṇa cādhastādupariṣṭācceti daśa pratyayā yato bhavanti sā digiti
prakṛtapāṭhastu–prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 170 pū॰, sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 669
meruṃ pradakṣiṇamāvarttamānasya bhagavata saviturye saṃyogaviśeṣā lokapālaparigṛhītadikpradeśānāmanvarthā prācyādibhedena daśavidhā sajñā

yattāvaduktam–mūrtteṣveva dravyeṣu ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yato'mī pratyayāḥ kāryabhūtāḥ santaḥ ki kāraṇamātrasyā'numāpakāḥ, digdravyalakṣaṇakāraṇaviśeṣasya vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamato digdravyasya siddhiḥ kāraṇamātrasyaiva siddhe ? tatra ca siddhasādhyatā tepām ākāśalakṣaṇakāraṇapūrvakatvā'bhyupagamāt, tasyaiva dig iti nāmāntarakaraṇe nāmni eva vivādaḥ nā'rthe, diśaḥ tato dravyāntaratvā'siddhe

etena dvitīyavikalpo'pi pratyākhyātaḥ; digdravyasya hi śaśaviṣāṇavat sarvathā'saṃbhave kathaṃ tatpūrvakatvaṃ tatpratyayānāṃ syāt yataste tasyā'numāpakāḥ syu ? na ca tadasaṃbhave kva prācyādivyavahāraḥ syāt ityabhidhātavyam ? ākāśapradeśaśreṇiṣveva ādityodayādivaśāt prācyādivyavahāropapatteḥ, tathā ca eṣāṃ na nirhetukatvam nāpyaviśiṣṭapadārthahetukatvaṃ syāt

tathābhūtaprācyādidiksambandhācca mūrttadravyeṣu pūrvā'parādipratyayaviśeṣasya utpatteḥ na parasparāpekṣayā mūrttadravyāṇyeva taddhetava, yena ekatarasya pūrvatvā'siddhau aparasya aparatvā'siddhiḥ, tadasiddhau ca ekatarasya pūrvatvā'siddhiḥ iti itaretarāśrayatvena ubhayā'bhāvaḥ syāt
ata kāraṇamātre sādhye siddhasādhyatā viśeṣeṇa sādhye anumānavādhā
diśo'pi ākāśe'ntarbhāva ādityodayādyapekṣayā ākāśapradeśapaṅktiṣu ita idamiti vyavahāropapatte
nanu mūrttadravyeṣu pūrvādipratyayasya ākāśapradeśaśreṇihetutve tatra tatpratyayasya ki hetutvaṃ syāditi cet ? svarūpahetutvameva iti brūmaḥ

tatpradeśaṣaṅkteḥ sva-pararūpayoḥ pūrvā'parādipratyayahetusvarūpatvāt, prakāśasya svapararūpayoḥ prakāśahetusvarūpavat, kathamanyathā dikpradeśeṣvapi tatpratyayotpattiḥ syāt ? tatra hi pūrvā'parādipratyayotpattiḥ–svabhāvataḥ, digdravyāntarā'pekṣayā, parasparā'pekṣayā vā syāt ? yadi svabhāvataḥ; tadā tatpratyayaparāvṛttirnasyāt, yatra hi dikpradeśe pūrvapratyayahetutvaṃ tatra tadeva na aparapratyayahetutvaṃ syāt, yatra ca tat na tatra pūrva pratyayahetutvamiti
asti ca tatparāvṛttiḥ, yatra hi dikpradeśe vivakṣitapradeśā'pekṣayā pūrvapratyayahetutvaṃ dṛṣṭam tatraiva aparapradeśā'pekṣayā aparapratyayahetutvam
taduktam– prāgbhāgo yaḥ surāṣṭrāṇāṃ mālavānāṃ sa dakṣiṇaḥ
digdravyāntarā'pekṣayā tatra tatpratyayahetutve tu anavasthā–tatrāpi tatpratyayahetutvasya aparadigdravyahetutvaprasaṅgāt
saviturmerupradakṣiṇamāvarttamānasya ityādinyāyena digdravye prācyādivyavahāropapattau tatpradeśaṣaṅktiṣvapi ata eva tadvyavahāropapatteḥ alaṃ digdravyakalpanayā
vyatyayadarśanācca, yaivaikatra pūrvā dik saivānyatra dakṣiṇā iti gṛhyate prāgbhāgo yaḥ surāṣṭrāṇāṃ mālavānā sa dakṣiṇa iti
prāgbhāgo yaḥ surāṣṭrāṇāṃ mālavānāṃ sa dakṣiṇaḥ
anyathā deśadravyasyāpi kalpanāprasaṅgaḥ, ayamataḥ pūrvo deśaḥ ityādipratyayasya deśadravyamantareṇāpyanupapatteḥ, tathā ca nava dravyāṇi iti dravyasaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ syāt
pṛthivyādireva deśadravyamityanupapannam; tasya pṛthivyādipratyayahetutvena ayamataḥ pūrvo deśaḥ ityādipratyayahetutvā'nupapatteḥ
atha pūrvādidikkṛtaḥ pṛthivyādiṣu pūrvadeśādipratyayaḥ; tadetanmanorathamātram; diśaḥ gaganapradeśapaṅkteḥ uktanyāyena arthāntaratvā'siddheḥ

nanvevam ādityodayādivaśādeva ākāśapradeśapaṅktiṣviva pṛthivyādiṣvapi pūrvāparādipratyayasiddheḥ ākāśapradeśaśreṇikalpanāpi aphalā; ityapyasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; pūrvasyāṃ diśi pṛthivyādayaḥ iti ādhārā''dheyavyavahāropalambhataḥ pṛthivyādyadhikaraṇabhūtāyāḥ tatpradeśapaṅkteḥ parikalpanasya saphalatvāt, prasādhitañca ākāśaṃ sudṛḍhapramāṇena prāk ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
etena yadetatpūrvā'parādijñānam ityādyanumānam; tatpratyuktam; tajjñānasya mūrttadravyavyatirikta-ākāśapradeśapaṅktilakṣaṇapadārthanibandhanatayā digdravyanibandhanatvā'nupapatteḥ
ato digdravyasya kutaścitpramāṇādaprasiddheḥ digdravyam itarebhyo bhidyate ityādi vandhyāsutasaubhāgyavyāvarṇanaprakhyamityupekṣate
nāpi ātmadravyam; tasyāpi sarvagatatvādidharmopetasya kutaścit pramāṇādaprasiddheḥ
astyātmā vyāpaka śarīraparimāṇatve doṣasaṃbhavāt sa ca pratiśarīrabhinna iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣaḥ–
tathāhi–ātmā vyāpakaḥ, aṇuparimāṇā'nadhikaraṇatve sati nityadravyatvāt, yad yadevam tat tathā yathā ākāśam, tathā ca ātmā, tasmāttathā iti
na cāsya aṇuparimāṇānadhikaraṇatvamasiddham; tathāhi–aṇuparimāṇā'nadhikaraṇa ātmā asmadādipratyakṣaviśeṣaguṇā'dhikaraṇa tvāt ghaṭādivat
yadi vā, nitya ātmā kṣaṇikaviśeṣaguṇā''dhāratvāt ākāśavat

yadi ca ātmā vyāpako na syāt, tadā devadattāṅganāṅgasya dvīpāntaravarttimaṇimuktāphalādeśca devadattopakārakasya utpādo na syāt, tasya tadguṇapūrvakatvāt, tathāhi–devadattā'ṅganādyaṅgaṃ devadattaguṇapūrvakam kāryatve sati tadupakārakatvāt grāsādivat

kāryadeśe ca sannihitaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryajanmani vyāpriyate nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt, ata tadaṅganāṅgādiprādurbhāvadeśe tatkāraṇavat tadguṇasiddhi, yatra ca guṇāḥ pratīyante tatra tadguṇyapi anumīyate tamantareṇa tepāmanupapatteḥ
devadattaviśeṣaguṇapreritabhūtakāryā tadupagṛhītāśca śarīrādaya kāryatve sati tadupabhogasādhanatvāt gṛhavaditi
svāśrayasaṃyogā'pekṣāṇāmāśrayāntare karmā''rambhakatvopapatteśca; tathāhi–adṛṣṭaṃ svāśrayasaṃyukte āśrayāntare karma ārabhate ekadravyatve sati kriyāhetuguṇatvāt prayatnavat

na cāsya kriyāhetuguṇatvamasiddham; agnerūrdhvajvalanaṃ vāyostiryakpavanam aṇu-manasośca ādyaṃ karma devadattaviśepaguṇakāritam kāryatve sati tadupakārakatvāt pāṇyādiparispandavat ityanumānataḥ tatprasiddhe
ekadravyatvāt ityucyamāne rūpādibhirvyabhicāraḥ; tannivṛttyarthaṃ kriyāhetuguṇatvāt ityuktam
kriyāhetuguṇatvāt ityucyamāne ca hastamuśalasaṃyogena svāśrayā'saṃyuktastambhādikriyāhetunā'nekāntaḥ; tatparihārārtha ekadravyatve sati iti viśeṣaṇam
ekadravyatve sati kriyāhetutvāt ityucyamāne ca svāśrayā'saṃyuktalohādikriyāhetunā ayaskāntena anekāntaḥ; tannivṛttyarthaṃ guṇatvāt ityuktam
tathā dharmādharmayo ātmaguṇatvāt tadāśrayasya avyāpakatve na syāt agnerūdrdhvajvalana vāyostiryaggamanamaṇumanasostvādyaṃ karma iti tayo svāśrayasaṃyogāpekṣitvāt
yathā prayatno hastakarmaṇi ātmasayogāpekṣa tathā dharmādharmau ātmasaṃyogaṃ vinā na karma kuryātām ātmaguṇatvāt
naca tatrānyat kāraṇamasti iti svāśrayasaṃyogāpekṣo'dṛṣṭa eva kāraṇam ato vyāpakatvācca paramamahattvam

kiñca, ātmano'sarvagatatve dig-deśāntarvarttibhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ yugapatsaṃyogābhāva, ataśca ādyakarmā'bhāva, tadabhāvād antyasayogasya tannimittaśarīrasya tena tatsambandhasya ca abhāvāt anupāyasiddha sarvadā sarveṣāṃ mokṣaḥ syāt
astu vā yathākathañcit śarīrotpatti; tathāpi sāvayavaṃ śarīraṃ pratyavayavamanupraviśan ātmā sāvayavaḥ syāt, sāvayavatve cāsya paṭādivat kāryatvaprasaṅgaḥ
kāryatve cāsau samānajātīyaiḥ, bhinnajātīyairvā kāraṇairārabhyeta ? na tāvad bhinnajātīyaiḥ; vijātīyānāmanārambhakatvāt
atha samānajātīyaiḥ; nanu samānajātīyatvaṃ teṣām ātmatvābhisambandhādeva syāt, tathā ca ātmabhiḥ ātmā ārabhyate ityāyātam, etaccāyuktam; ekatra śarīre anekātmanām ātmārambhakāṇāmasaṃbhavāt
saṃbhave vā pratisandhānā'nupapattiḥ, na hi anyena dṛṣṭam anyaḥ pratisandhātumarhati atiprasaṅgāt
tadārabhyatve cāsya ghaṭavad avayavakriyāto vibhāgāt saṃyogavināśād vināśaḥ syāt
śarīraparimāṇatve ca ātmano mūrttatvā'nupaṅgāt śarīre'nupraveśo na syāt mūrttasya mūrtte'nupraveśavirodhāt, tato nirātmakameva akhilaṃ śarīramanuṣajyate

kathaṃ vā tatparimāṇatve tasya bālaśarīraparimāṇasya sato yuvaśarīraparimāṇasvīkāraḥ syāt–tatparimāṇaparityāgāt, aparityāgādvā ? yadi parityāgāt; tadā śarīravat tasyānityatvaprasaṅgāt paralokādyabhāvā'nuṣaṅgaḥ
atha aparityāgāt; tanna; pūrvaparimāṇā'parityāge śarīravat tasya uttaraparimāṇotpattyanupapatteḥ

atha śarīraparimāṇatvādasiddhamātmana paramamahatvaṃ tathā ca alpaśarīre alpo mahati ca mahānātmānanvetasmin pakṣe saṅkocavikāśadharmakatvāt bālaśarīre'pyātmano vināśe vṛddhāvasthāyāṃ nānātmā sampadyate ityanyatve smaraṇaṃ na syāt
na ca pūrvaparimāṇasyānivṛttau uttaraparimāṇena śakyaṃ bhavitumiti pūrvaparimāṇasya āśrayavināśādeva nivṛttiḥ
śarīraparimāṇatāyāṃ ca satyāṃghaṭādivadanityatvamātmana prasajyetasamāna eṣa ekasminnapi janmani kaumārayauvanasthāvireṣu doṣa
yattāvaduktam–ātmā vyāpakaḥ ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; pratyakṣabādhitapakṣanirdeśā'nantaraprayuktatvena hetoḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt
sukhī aham ityādipratyakṣeṇa hi ātmā gṛhyamāṇaḥ svaśarīre eva gṛhyate, na paraśarīre nāpyantarāle, anyathā sarvasya sarvadarśitvāpattiḥ bhojanādivyavahārasaṅkaraśca syāt
na cāsya tadupetatvamupapadyate pratyakṣavirodhāt; pratyakṣeṇa hi ātmā

nanu ca avyāpakatvena ātmanaḥ pratipattau pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhā yuktā anuṣṇatve sādhye agneruṣṇatvena pratipattivat, na cāsya tathā pratipattirasti niyatadeśā'vacchedā'bhāvāditi; tadayuktam; yataḥ ko'yaṃ tadavacchedābhāvo nāma–niyatadeśānanubhavaḥ, tadullekhiśabdāprayogo vā ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; niyatadeśā'nubhavasya ātmani pratīyamānatvāt, sukhyaham ityādipratyayena hi ātmā sukhādyātmakaḥ śarīrapradeśe evā'nubhūyate, ghaṭo'yam itipratyayena purodeśe pṛthubudhnodarādyākāraghaṭavat
na khalu pratyakṣeṇa vastu niyatadeśakālākārānubhavavyatirekeṇa anubhavituṃ śaktam atiprasaṅgāt

dvitīyavikalpo'pyayuktaḥ; yato yadi nāma niyatade śollekhiśabdā'prayogaḥ tathāpi kathaṃ pratyakṣeṇa tadananubhavaḥ ? nahi śabdānuviddhatvaṃ pratyakṣasya svarūpam, yena tadabhāve tasya arthasvarūpavivecakatvā'bhāvaḥ syāt, tatra tadanuviddhatvasya prāgeva kṛtottaratvāt

ataḥ anubhavottarakālīna eva sarvatra śabdaprayogaḥ, anubhūte hi anekadharmādhyāsite vastuni yatrāṃśe anubhavaprabodhanibandhanaṃ saṅketasmaraṇamupajāyate tatraiva śabdaprayogaḥ nānyatra, tatkathaṃ tadaprayogāt tadanubhavā'bhāvaḥ ? niyatadeśollekhiśabdā'prayogāt deśanaiyatyasya ananubhave ca kāla-ākāranaiyatyasyāpyananubhavaḥ syāt, nahi ghaṭo'yam, sukhyaham ityādibahirantaḥpratītau deśa-kāla-ākāranaiyatyollekhinām atra-idānīm-īdṛśaśabdānāṃ prayogo'sti
ataḥ atra pratītau pratiniyatasya vastusvarūpasya kasyacidapi pratibhāsā'bhāvāt khapuṣpapratītito nā'syāḥ kaścidviśeṣaḥ syāt

astu vā'sau; tathāpi paramāṇvākāśapratītitaḥ kiṃkṛto'syā viśeṣaḥ syāt ? sphuṭatva-asphuṭatvapratibhāsakṛtaḥ iti cenna; niyatadeśakālā''kāragrahaṇā-'grahaṇavyatirekeṇa sphuṭatvā'sphuṭatvapratibhāsasyaiva asaṃbhavāt
tataḥ pratyakṣapratīteḥ itarapratītito viśeṣamicchatā deśādinaiyatyena pratibhāsaḥ tacchabdā'prayoge'pi abhyupagantavyaḥ, iti siddhā pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhā hetośca kālātyayāpadiṣṭatā
kiñca, aṇuparimāṇā'nadhikaraṇatvam tatparimāṇādhikaraṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ, sa kiṃ paryudāsarūpaḥ, prasajyarūpo vā syāt ? yadi paryudāsarūpaḥ; tadā'sau bhāvāntarasvīkāradvāreṇa pravarttate
bhāvāntarañcā'tra–paramamahāparimāṇā'dhikaraṇatvam, avāntaraparimāṇā'dhikaraṇatvaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe viśeṣaṇā'siddho hetuḥ, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ anityatve sati bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt iti
dvitīyapakṣe tu viruddhaviśeṣaṇaḥ, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ nityatve sati bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt iti
prasajyapakṣe tu asiddhatvam; tucchasvabhāvā'bhāvasya abhāvavicārā'vasare pramāṇā'gocaracāritayā pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt
siddhau vā kimasau sādhyasya svabhāvaḥ, kāryaṃ vā syāt ? yadi svabhāvaḥ; tadā sādhyasyāpi tadvat tuccharūpatā'nuṣaṅgaḥ tucchasvabhāvā'bhāvādabhinnasvabhāvatvād gaganendīvaravat
atha kāyam; tanna; tucchasvabhāvasyāsya kāryatvā'nupapatteḥ yat tucchasvabhāvaṃ tanna kāryam yathā khapuṣpam, tucchasvabhāvaśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpito'ṇuparimāṇapratiṣedha iti
kāryatve cāsya kādācitkatvaprasaṅgāt tadutpatteḥ prāk ātmano'ṇuparimāṇādhikaraṇatvaṃ syāt
kāryatvañcāsya–svakāraṇasattāsamavāyaḥ, kṛtam iti buddhiviṣayatvaṃ vā syāt ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'yuktaḥ; abhāvasya bhavatā svakāraṇasattāsamavāyā'nabhyupagamāt, anyathā bhāvarūpataiva asya syāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ; tucchasvabhāvābhāvasya tadviṣayatvā'nupapatteḥ, yasya hi pramāṇā'gocaratvaṃ tasya kathaṃ kṛtabuddhiviṣayatvaṃ syāt ? tanna ātmano vicāryamāṇo'ṇuparimāṇapratiṣedho ghaṭate
tucchasvabhāvasya tadvi– ā॰, ba॰, ja॰, bhāṃ॰

yadapi tatsiddhaye asmadādipratyakṣaviśeṣaguṇā'dhikaraṇatvāt iti sādhanamuktam; tadapyayuktam; tatpratiṣedhe proktāśeṣadoṣānuṣaṅgāt, siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgācca; aṇuparimāṇapratiṣedhamātrasya ghaṭādivad ātmanyapi abhyupagatatvāt
nityadravyatvañca ātmanaḥ kathañcid vivakṣitam, sarvathā vā ? kathañciccet; ghaṭādinā anekāntaḥ, tasya aṇuparimāṇā'nadhikaraṇatve kathañcinnityadravyatve ca satyapi vyāpitvā'bhāvāt
atha sarvathā; tadasiddham; sarvathā nityasya vastuno'rthakriyākāritvā'bhāvataḥ kharaviṣāṇavat sattvasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
etena asparśavaddravyatvam ātmano nityatvasādhanāya yaduktam tadapi pratyuktam; ato hi tasya kathañcinnityatvasādhane siddhasādhyatā
sarvathā tatsādhane hetorananvayatvam, ākāśādīnāmapi sarvathā nityatvasya pratiṣiddhatvāt
etena kṣaṇikaviśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatvāt ityapi pratyuktam; vidyudādinā anaikāntikatvācca; kṣaṇikabhāsurarūpādilakṣaṇaviśeṣaguṇādhikaraṇatve'pi asya sarvathā nityatvā'saṃbhavāt
atha bhāsurarūpādeḥ kṣaṇikaviśeṣaguṇatvaṃ nāsti vahnyādau tasya akṣaṇikatvapratīteḥ; tarhi buddhyāderapi tadviśeṣaguṇatvaṃ mābhūd īśvare tasya akṣaṇikatvapratīteḥ

yadapyuktam–devadattāṅganādyaṅgam ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; yataḥ tatkāraṇatvenā'bhipretā jñānadarśanādayo devadattātmaguṇāḥ, dharmā'dharmau vā ? prathamapakṣe kālātyayāpadiṣṭo hetuḥ; jñānādīnāṃ devadattāṅganāṅgādijanmani avyāpriyamāṇānāṃ taddehe eva pratyakṣāditaḥ pratīteḥ
atha dharmā'dharmau; tarhi tadaṅgādikāryaṃ tannimittam asmābhirapi iṣyata eva, tadātmaguṇatvaṃ tu tayorneṣyate acetanatvāt śabdādivat
na ca sukhādinā hetorvyabhicāritā; asya acetanatvā'bhāvāt, tadviruddhena svasaṃvedanalakṣaṇacaitanyena asya vyāptatvāt
nāpyasiddhatā; tathāhi– acetanau tau svagrahaṇavidhuratvāt ghaṭādivat
prasādhayiṣyate ca karmaṇāṃ paudgalikatvaṃ mokṣavicārā'vasare ityalamatiprasaṅgena
yato devadattāṅganāṅgādikāryasya kāraṇatvenābhipretā jñānadarśanādayo devadattātmaguṇā dharmādharmau vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 171 u॰
astu vā tayostadguṇatvam; tathāpi na tadaṅgādiprādurbhāvadeśe tatsadbhāvasiddhiḥ
na khalu kāryadeśe sannihitameva sakalaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryajanmani vyāprityate iti niyamo'sti, añjanatilaka mantrādeḥ ākṛṣyamāṇā'ṅganādideśe'sato'pi ākarpaṇādikāryakartṛtvopalambhāt

kāryatve sati iti viśeṣaṇañca kimartham ? kāla-īśvarādinā vyabhicāranivṛttyarthamiti cet; tarhi kālaīśvarādikam atadguṇapūrvakamapi yadi tadupakārakam kāryamapi kiñcid anyapūrvakamapi tadupakārakaṃ bhaviṣyati iti sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikatvād anaikāntiko hetuḥ, sarvajñatvā'bhāve sādhye vaktṛtvādivat
grāsādivat iti dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhyavikalaḥ; tatra hi ātmanaḥ ko guṇaḥ abhipretaḥ– dharmādiḥ, prayatno vā ? yadi dharmādiḥ; sādhyavat prasaṅgaḥ

atha prayatnaḥ; nanu ko'yaṃ prayatno nāma ? ātmanaḥ tadavayavānāṃ vā hastādyavayavapratiṣṭhānāṃ parispandaḥ, sa tarhi calanalakṣaṇā kriyā kathaṃ guṇaḥ ? anyathā gamanāderapi guṇatvānupaṅgāt kriyāvārttocchedaḥ syāt
sādhyāvakalaṃ cedaṃ nidarśanaṃ grāsādivaditi tatra hi ātmanaḥ
etena adṛṣṭaṃ svāśrayasaṃyukte āśrayāntare karma ārabhate ityādi pratyākhyātam; adṛṣṭasya uktaprakārato guṇatvā'siddheḥ, ato viśeṣyā'siddho hetuḥ

taddhi kim ekasmin dravye saṃyuktatvāt, samavāyena varttanāt, anyato vā syāt ? na tāvat saṃyuktatvāt; saṃyogasya guṇatvena dravyāśrayatvāt adṛṣṭasya ca adravyatvāt, anyathā guṇavattvena asya dravyatvā'nuṣaṅgāt kriyāhetuguṇatvāt iti vaco vighaṭate
samavāyena varttanañca samavāye siddhe siddhyet, sa cāsiddho nipetsyamānatvāt

kriyāhetutvamapyasyā'siddham; tathāhi–devadattaśarīrasaṃyuktātmapradeśe varttamānamadṛṣṭaṃ dvīpāntaravartiṣu maṇimuktāphaleṣu devadattaṃ prati upasarpaṇavatsu kriyāhetuḥ ut dvīpāntaravarttidravyasaṃyuktātmapradeśe, kiṃ vā sarvatra ? tatra ādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; ativyavahitatvena tatrāsya sabandhā'bhāvataḥ kriyāhetutvā'nupapatteḥ
atha svāśrayasaṃyogasambandhasaṃbhavāt tadabhāvo'siddhaḥ; tadayuktam; tasya sarvatra sadbhāvataḥ sarvasya ākarṣaṇaprasaṅgāt
yadadṛṣṭena yat janyate tadadṛṣṭena tadeva ākṛṣyate na sarvam ityapyayuktam; devadattaśarīrārambhakaparamāṇūnāṃ tadadṛṣṭā'janyatayā ākarṣaṇā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, tathāpyākarṣaṇe atiprasaṅgaḥ
atha yadadṛṣṭena yajjanyate prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 172 u॰

dvitīyavikalpe'pi yathā vāyuḥ svayamupasarpaṇavān anyeṣāṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ taṃ prati upasarpaṇahetuḥ tathā adṛṣṭamapi svayaṃ taṃ prati upasarpad anyeṣāmupasarpaṇahetuḥ, dvīpāntaravarttidravyasaṃyuktātmapradeśasthameva vā ? prathamapakṣe svayameva adṛṣṭaṃ taṃ prati upasarpati, adṛṣṭāntarādvā ? svayamevāsya taṃ prati upasarpaṇe dvīpāntaravarttidravyāṇāmapi tathaiva tatprasaṅgāt adṛṣṭakalpanā'nartha kyam, yad devadattaṃ pratyupasarpati tad devadattaguṇākṛṣṭam taṃ prati upasarpaṇāt iti hetuśca anaikāntikaḥ syāt
adṛṣṭāntarāttasya taṃ prati upasarpaṇe anavasthā, tasyāpi adṛṣṭāntarāt taṃ prati upasarpaṇaprasaṅgāt

atha dvīpāntaravarttidravyasaṃyuktātmapradeśasthameva tat teṣāṃ taṃ prati upasarpaṇahetuḥ; na; anyatra prayatnādau ātmaguṇe tathā'nabhyupagamāt, na khalu prayanno grāsādisaṃyuktātmapradeśastha eva grāsādeḥ devadattamukhaṃ prati upasarpaṇahetuḥ antarālaprayatnavaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
sarvatra ca adṛṣṭasya vṛttau sarvadravyakriyāhetutvaṃ syāt, yadadṛṣṭaṃ yad dravyamutpādayati tadadṛṣṭaṃ tatraiva kriyāṃ karoti ityatrāpi śarīrārambhakaparamāṇuṣu kriyā na syāt ityuktam
kālātyayāpadiṣṭaścāyaṃ hetuḥ; pratyakṣabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvāt, adṛṣṭasya hi āśrayaḥ ātmā, sa ca dvīpāntaravartidravyairviyuktameva ātmānaṃ svasaṃvedanapratyakṣataḥ pratipadyate iti
tadviyuktatvena atastatpratītāvapi ātmanastadadravyaiḥ saṃyogā'bhyupagame ghaṭādīnāṃ mervādibhiḥ saṃyogaḥ kinna syāt yataḥ sāṃkhyadarśanaṃ na syāt ? pramāṇabādhanam ubhayatra samānam

kiñca, dharmā'dharmayoḥ dravyāntarasaṃyogasya ca ātmā eka āśrayaḥ, sa ca bhavanmate niraṃśaḥ, ato dharmeṇa adharmeṇa ubhābhyāṃ vā sarvātmanā'sya āliṅgitatanutvānna tatsaṃyogādestatrāvakāśaḥ, tena vā na dharmādeḥ iti
atha tadāliṅgitatatsvarūpaparihāreṇa dravyāntarasaṃyogādiḥ tatra pravarttate; tarhi ghaṭādivad ātmanaḥ sāvayavatvaṃ svārambhakāvayavārabhyatvamanityatvañca syāt
etena etannirastam–devadattaṃ prati upasarpantaḥ paśvādayo devadattaguṇākṛṣṭāḥ taṃ prati upasarpaṇavattvāt grāsādivat iti; teṣāṃ tadguṇākṛṣṭatve proktāśeṣadoṣānuṣaṅgāt

devadattaśabdena cātra ko'rthaḥ abhipretaḥ–śarīram, ātmā, tatsaṃyogaḥ, ātmasaṃyogaviśiṣṭaṃ śarīram, tatsaṃyogaviśiṣṭa ātmā, śarīrasaṃyukta ātmapradeśo vā ? yadi śarīram; tarhi taṃ prati upasarpaṇāt tadguṇākṛṣṭāḥ paśvādayaḥ ityātmaviśeṣaguṇākṛṣṭatve sādhye śarīraguṇākṛṣṭatvasya sādhanād viruddho hetuḥ
atha ātmā; tasya samākṛṣyamāṇā'rthadeśakālābhyāṃ sarvadā'bhisambandhāt na taṃ prati kiñcid upasarpeta, nahi atyantā''śliṣṭakaṇṭhaṃ kāminī kāmukamupasarpati
anyadeśo hi arthaḥ anyadeśamarthaṃ prati upasarpati yathā lakṣyaṃ prati bāṇādiḥ, anyakālaṃ vā prati anyakālaḥ yathā aṅkuraṃ prati aparā'paraśaktipariṇāmalābhena bījādiḥ
na caitadubhayaṃ nitya-vyāpitvābhyām ātmani sarvatra sarvadā sannihite saṃbhavati
ato devadattaṃ prati upasarpantaḥ iti dharmiviśeṣaṇam devadattaguṇākṛṣṭāḥ iti sādhyadharmaḥ taṃ prati upasarpaṇavattvāt iti sāvanadharma parasya kalpanāśilpikalpita eva syāt
tatra devadattaśabdavācyaḥ ko'rthaḥ ? śarīramātmā tatsaṃyogo vā''tmasaṃyogaviśiṣṭaṃ śarīraṃ vā śarīrasaṃyogaviśiṣṭa ātmā śarīrasaṃyukta ātmapradeśo vā
śarīrātmasaṃyogasya ca devadattaśabdavācyatve taṃ prati caiṣāmupasarpaṇe tadguṇākṛṣṭāste ityāyātam, na ca guṇeṣu guṇāḥ santi nirguṇatvātteṣām
ātmasaṃyogaviśiṣṭaṃ śarīraṃ tacchabdavācyam; ityatrāpi tadeva viruddhatvaṃ draṣṭavyam

śarīrasaṃyogaviśiṣṭa ātmā tacchabdavācyaḥ; ityatrāpi ātmapakṣabhāvī doṣa syāt, tathāvidhasyāpyasya nitya-vyāpitvena sarvatra sarvadā sannidhānā'nivāraṇāt, na khalu ghaṭasaṃyuktamākāśaṃ mervādau na sannihitam

atha śarīrasaṃyukta ātmapradeśaḥ tacchabdena ucyate, sa ki kālpanikaḥ, pāramārthiko vā ? kālpanikatve kalpitātmapradeśaguṇā''kṛṣṭāḥ paśvādayaḥ tallakṣaṇā''tmānaṃ prati upasarpaṇavattvāt iti tadguṇānāmapi kālpanikatvaṃ prasādhayet, tathā ca saugatasya iva tadguṇakṛtaḥ pretyabhāvo na pāramārthikaḥ syāt
nahi kalpitasya agne rūpādayo dāhādikāryaṃ vā pāramārthikaṃ dṛṣṭam
atha pāramārthikaḥ, sa kim ātmanaḥ abhinnaḥ, bhinno vā ? yadi abhinnaḥ; tadā ātmaiva asau iti noktadopaparihāra
atha bhinnaḥ; tarhi tadviśeṣaguṇākṛṣṭāḥ paśvādayaḥ ityetat tasyaiva ātmatvaṃ prasādhayati, iti anyātmakalpanā'narthakyam
kalpane vā sāvayavatvena kāryatvam anityatvañca syāt ityuktam

yadapyabhihitam–ātmano'sarvagatatve digdeśāntaravarttibhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; yad yena saṃyuktaṃ taṃ prati tadeva upasarpati iti niyamā'saṃbhavāt, ayaskāntaṃ prati ayasaḥ tenā'saṃyuktasyāpi ākarṣaṇopalambhāt
yasya cātmā sarvagataḥ tasya ārabdhakāryaiḥ anyaiśca paramāṇubhiryugapat saṃyogāt tathaiva taccharīrārambhaṃ prati ekamukhībhūtānāṃ teṣām upasarpaṇaprasaṅgānna jāne kiyatparimāṇaṃ taccharīraṃ syāt

atha ye tatsaṃyogāḥ tadadṛṣṭā'pekṣā te eva svasaṃyogināṃ paramāṇūnāmādyaṃ karma āracayanti nānye ityucyate, nanu keyaṃ teṣāṃ tadadṛṣṭāpekṣā nāma–ekārthasamavāyaḥ, upakāraḥ, saha ādyakarmajananaṃ vā ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ, sarvaparamāṇusaṃyogānāṃ devadattā''tmani adṛṣṭena saha ekārthasamavāyasaṃbhavāt
saha ādyakarmajananam; ityapyasat; aviśeṣataḥ sarvatra tajjananasyāpi prasaṅgāt, tatsaṃyogā'dṛṣṭayoranyatarasya kevalasyaiva tajjananasāmarthye parāpekṣā'nupapatteśca
yadi punaḥ svahetoreva adṛṣṭa-saṃyogayo sahitayoreva kāryajananasāmarthyamiṣyate; tarhi tata eva adṛṣṭasyaiva svāśraya saṃyoganirapekṣasya tatsāmarthyamiṣyatām
dṛśyate hi hastādyāśrayeṇa ayaskāntādinā svāśrayā'saṃyuktasya bhūbhāgasthitasya lohādeḥ ākarṣaṇam
syādevaṃ yadi yadyena sayukta taṃ prati tadevopasarpati iti niyama syāt, na cāstyayaskānta pratyayasa tenāsayuktasyāpyupasarpaṇopalambhāt
yaccānyaduktam–sāvayavaṃ śarīramanupraviśannātmā ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; sāvayavatvena bhinnā'vayavārabdhatvasya ghaṭādāvapyasiddheḥ
na khalu ghaṭādiḥ sāvayavo'pi prākprasiddhasamānajātīyakapālasaṃyogapūrvako dṛṣṭaḥ, kumbhakārakarādivyāpārānvitāt mṛtpiṇḍāt prathamameva pṛthubudhnodarādyākārasyā'sya utpattipratīteḥ
dravyasya hi pūrvākāraparityāgena uttarākārapariṇāmaḥ kāryatvam, tacca bahiriva antarapyanubhūyata eva
na ca paṭādau svāvayavasaṃyogapūrvakakāryatvopalambhāt sarvatra tathābhāvo yuktaḥ; kāṣṭhe lohalekhyatvopalambhāt vajre'pi tathābhāvaprasaṅgāt, pramāṇabādhanam ubhayatrāpi tulyam
na ca uktalakṣaṇakāryatvābhyupagame'pi ātmano'nityatvā'nuṣaṅgāt pratisandhānā'bhāvo'nuṣajyate; kathañcidanityatve satyeva asya upapadyamānatayā vakṣyamāṇatvāt
etena bālaśarīraparimāṇa ityādi pratyuktam; yuvaśarīraparimāṇā'vasthāyām ātmano bālaśarīraparimāṇaparityāge'pi sarvathā vināśā'saṃbhavāt viphaṇāvasthātyāgena utphaṇāvasthotpāde sarpavat
ataḥ kathaṃ paralokābhāvo'nuṣajyate paryāyataḥ tasya anityatve'pi dravyato nityatvāt ?
yuvaśarīraparimāṇāvasthāyāmātmano vālaśarīraparimāṇaparityāge sarvathā vināśāsaṃbhavāt viphaṇāvasthotpāde sarpavat iti kathaṃ paralokābhāvo'nuṣajyate
yadapyuktam–śarīracchede tasyāpi chedaprasaṅgaḥ iti; tadapyapeśalam; kathañcit tacchedasya iṣṭatvāt
śarīrasambaddhātmapradeśebhyo hi tatpradeśānāṃ chinnaśarīrapradeśe avasthānam ātmanaśchedaḥ, sa cātra astyeva; anyathā śarīrāt pṛthagbhūtā'vayavasya kampopalabdhirna syāt

na ca chinnāvayavā'nupraviṣṭasya ātmapradeśasya pṛthagātmatvaprasaṅgaḥ; tatraiva anupraveśāt, kathamanyathā chinne hastādau kampāditalliṅgasyādarśanam ? na ca anyatra gatatvāttasya tatra talliṅgā'nupalabdhirityabhidhātavyam; ekatvādātmanaḥ śeṣasyāpi tena saha gamanaprasakteḥ
nāpi tadavasthitasya asya tatraiva vinaṣṭatvānna tadupalabdhiḥ ityabhidhātavyam; śeṣasyāpi ekatvena tadvad vināśaprasakteḥ
na caikatra santāne aneka ātmā; anekā'rthapratibhāsijñānānāmekapramātrādhāratayā pratibhāsā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt śarīrāntaravyavasthitā'nekajñānāvaseyā'rthasaṃvittivat
ataḥ anyatrā'gateḥ tatrā'sattvāt avinaṣṭatvācca tatraiva tadanupraveśo'numīyate
kathaṃ chinnā'chinnāvayavayoḥ saṅghaṭanaṃ paścāditi cet; na; ekāntena chedā'nabhyupagamāt padmanālatantuvad acchedasyāpyabhyupagamāt, tathābhūtā'dṛṣṭavaśācca tatsaṅghaṭanamaviruddhameva
nanu kathaṃ chinnāchinnayo saṅghaṭana paścāt ? na, ekāntena chedānabhyupagamāt padmanālatantuvadavicchedasyāpya bhyupugamāt
