yadapyuktam–śarīraparimāṇatve mūrttatvā'nuṣaṅgāt ityādi; tatra kimidaṃ mūrttatvaṃ nāma yad ātmano'nuṣajyeta–asarvagatadravyaparimāṇatvam, rūpādimattvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo na doṣāvahaḥ, abhīṣṭatvāt, nahi iṣṭameva dopāya jāyate
dvitīyapakṣastu anupapanna; vyāptyabhāvāt, nahi yad asarvagataṃ tat niyamena rūpādimat iti avinābhāvo'sti, manaso'sarvagatatve'pi tadasaṃbhavāt
ato na ātmana śarīre'nupraveśā'nupapatti yato nirātmakaṃ tat syāt, asarvagatadravyaparimāṇalakṣaṇamūrttatvasya manovat tadapratibandhakatvāt
rūpādimattvalakṣaṇamūrttatvopetasyāpi hi jalāde bhasmādāvanupraveśo na pratibadhyate, ātmanastu tadrahitasyāpi tatra asau pratibadhyate iti mahaccitram !
tatra keya mūrttirnāma asarvagatadravyaparimāṇaṃ rūpādimattva vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 174 pū॰

tato yad yathā nirbādhabodhe pratibhāsate tat tathaiva paramārthata sadvyavahāramavatarati yathā puraḥ pratiniyatadeśa-kāla-ākāratayā ghaṭa, śarīrānta pratiniyatadeśakālākāratayā nirbādhabodhe pratibhāsate ca ātmā iti
na cāyamasiddho hetuḥ; śarīrād bahiḥ tatpratibhāsā'bhāvasya pratipāditatvāt
uktaprakāreṇa ca anavadyasya bādhakapramāṇasya kasyacidapyasaṃbhavāt na viśeṣaṇā'siddhatvam

tathā, ātmā vyāpako na bhavati, sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati asmadādipratyakṣatvāt, yad yad evaṃvidha tat tat tathā yathā ghaṭādi, sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati asmadādipratyakṣaśca ātmā, tasmād vyāpako na bhavatīti
nāpi manodravyam; nityādisvabhāvasya asyāpi kutaścit pramāṇādaprasiddhe
yugapajjñānā'nutpatte asti mana pṛthag dravyam tacca nitya paramāṇurūpa pratyātmabhinna ca iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu kāryatvā'nupapatteḥ nityasvabhāvatā manasaḥ siddhaiva, tadanupapattiśca tadārambhakakāraṇā'bhāvāt suprasiddhā
tasya hi ārambhakaṃ kāraṇaṃ vijātīyam, sajātīyaṃ vā syāt ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapanna; vijātīyasya ārambhakatvā'bhāvāt, vijātīyānāmanārambhakatvam ityabhidhānāt

dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ, yataḥ manaḥprādurbhāve manasa eva sajātīyatvam, tathā ca ekamanaḥprādurbhāve kāraṇabhūtā'nekamanaḥsadbhāvaprasaṅgaḥ ekasya dravyāntarotpattau akāraṇatvāt, dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhate rabhante vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
na caikaśarīre anekamanaḥsadbhāvo'sti pratiśarīramekaikatayā teṣāṃ sthitatvāt, anyathā pratiśarīraṃ yugapadeva jñānotpattiḥ syāt
na ca pratiniyataśarīrāvaruddhatvena anyonyaṃ teṣāṃ saṃyogaḥ saṃbhavati, nāpyasaṃyuktānāṃ tajjanakatvam; atiprasaṅgāt
atha muktamanasāṃ tadavaruddhatvā'bhāvato'nyonyaṃ saṃyogasaṃbhavāt tajjanakatvamiṣyate; tadayuktam; dharmā'dharmānadhiṣṭhitānāṃ teṣāṃ tajjanakatvā'nupapatteḥ
sadbhāvasiddhistu yugapajjñānā'nutpattiliṅgāt, yugapatsvaviṣayasambaddheṣu hi sarveṣvapi indriyeṣu yadeva manasā preryate tadeva svaviṣaye buddhimutpādayatīti
tathā, indriyā'rthā yugapatsannihitāḥ svakārye kramavatkāraṇāpekṣāḥ, itarasāmagrīsadbhāve'pi krameṇa kāryakartṛtvāt, hastādyapekṣa-ayaskārādivat
cakṣurādikaṃ kramavatkāraṇāpekṣam, kāraṇāntarasākalye satyapi anutpādyotpādakatvāt, vāsī-karttaryādivat
sukhādijñānam indriyārthasannikarṣajam, pratyakṣatve sati jñānatvāt, cakṣurādiprabhavarūpādijñānavat ityādyanumānācca
tacca āśusañcāritvena askhaladgatitvād asparśam, asparśatvādeva ākāśavannityam, krameṇa arthaparicchedakatvādavyāpakam, adṛṣṭaviśeṣavaśācca pratyātmabhinnam iti
cakṣurādayo vā kramavatkāraṇāpekṣā sadbhāve'pi krameṇa kāryajanakatvātyathā vāsīkarttaryādi hastam
ātmendriyārthā kāraṇāntarāpekṣā sadbhāve'pi anutpādyotpādakatvāt, ye hi sadbhāve'pi kāryamanutpādya paścādutpādayanti te sāpekṣā yathā tantvādaya antyasaṃyogāpekṣā iti

rūpādigrahaṇāni cakṣurādivyatirekeṇa adhiṣṭhāyakāntarāpekṣāṇi ayugapadutpatte, tadyathā–anekaśilpaparyavadātasya puruṣasya anekaṃ vāsyādi yugapat sannidhānenopasthitaṃ hastādyadhiṣṭhāyakāpekṣaṃ na yugapadanekarathakriyāṃ nirvartayati, tathā cakṣurādi na yugapadanekaṃ jñānaṃ karoti tasmāttadapi adhiṣṭhāyakāntaramapekṣate iti cakṣurādīndriyaṃ ātmapravṛttāvadhiṣṭhāyakāntarāpekṣaṃ ayugapatpravṛtte vāsyādivat

yattāvaduktam–tasya ārambhakaṃ kāraṇaṃ sajātīyaṃ vijātīyaṃ vā ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ kimapekṣya kāraṇasya sajātīyetaracintā pratanyate–pṛthivyādidravyamapekṣya, avāntarasāmānyaṃ vā ? yadi avāntarasāmānyam; tadā tantupaṭādīnāmapi kāryakāraṇabhāvo na prāpnoti teṣāmanyonyā'saṃbhavi-avāntarasāmānyādhāratayā tada pekṣayā sajātīyatvā'nupapatteḥ, nahi tantutvāpekṣayā paṭasya sajātīyatvaṃ saṃbhavati paṭatvāpekṣayā tantūnāṃ vā
atha pṛthivyādidravyamapekṣya, tarhi tadapekṣayā yathā tantupaṭādīnāṃ sajātīyatvasaṃbhavāt kāryakāraṇabhāva, tathā pudgaladravyāpekṣayā aṇvādinā manasaḥ sajātīyatvasaṃbhavāt sa syāt

nanu cakṣurādīnāṃ pratiniyatarūpādivyañjakatayā pratiniyatabhūtakāryatā pratipannā, manasastu aviśeṣato nikhilarūpādivyañjakatayā tatkāryatvā'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ taddṛṣṭāntena tasya pudgalakāryatā syāt ? ityapi manorathamātram; teṣāṃ pratiniyatabhūtakāryatvasya dravyendriyaṃ pudgalātmakam ityatra prapañcataḥ pratikṣiptatvāt
ekasyaiva rūpādimata pudgalasya ete cakṣurādaya paryāyāḥ, ato na dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyam
yadi cakṣurādīnāṃ pratiniyatarūpādivyañjakatvāt pratiniyatabhūtakāryatā iṣyate, tadā manasaḥ sakalarūpādivyañjakatvāt sakalabhūtakāryatā iṣyatām aviśeṣāt
tadā tantupaṭādīnāmapi kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt teṣāmanyonyāsabhavyavāntarasāmānyāvāratayā tadapekṣayā sajātīyatvāsaṃbhavāt
yadapyuktam–nityādisvabhāvasya manasaḥ sadbhāvasiddhistu yugapajjñānā'nutpattiliṅgāt ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; paramāṇurūpasya manasaḥ cakṣurādyadhiṣṭhāyakatvā'nupapatteḥ
anekaraśmirūpaṃ hi cakṣuḥ pārthivādyavayavasvabhāvañca ghrāṇādi, tat ki manasā yugapad adhiṣṭhīyate, krameṇa vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapanna, ekaparamāṇurūpeṇa anena yugapadanekā'dhiṣṭhānā'nupapatte
yad ekaparamāṇurūpa na tad yugapadanekā'dhiṣṭhātṛ yathā ekaparamāṇuḥ, tadrūpañca bhavatkalpitaṃ mana iti

āśusañcāritvāt kramapratītāvapi yugapatpratītibhrama, ityapyapeśalam; avayavipratīterapi bhrāntitvaprasaṅgāt, anekasminnapi hi purovarttinyarthe krameṇa ekaikaraśmijanitaṃ jñānaṃ krameṇa ekaikameva arthagṛhṇīyāt, yugapadakhilā'vayaveṣu ekākārā pratītistu bhrāntā syāt, dhattūrakapuṣpavad ādau sūkṣmāṇāmapi ante mahattvam iti ca vighaṭeta, nahi kramapravṛttaparamāṇūnāṃ tathātvaṃ dṛṣṭam
asiddhā ca yugapajjñānā'nutpatti, dīrghaśaṣkulībhakṣaṇādau yugapadapi rūpādijñānapañcakotpattipratīteḥ
kramabhāve'pi āśuvṛttyā tajjñānānāṃ yaugapadyapratītiḥ; ityapyacāru; nikhi labhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅgāt akṣaṇikatvādhyavasāyasya sarvatra āśuvṛttipravṛttatvāt, pratyakṣabādhā ubhayatra tulyā

athātra yaugapadyapratīterbhrāntatayā pratyakṣatvā'nupapatterna kramapratītibādhakatvam; nanu kuto'syā bhrāntatāsiddhiḥ ? ekamanaḥpūrvakatvena tadyaugapadyā'nupapatteḥ iti cet; cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ–tatpratīterbhrāntatāsiddhau hi pratyakṣatvā'nupapattisiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca kramapratīterabādhyatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca ekamanaḥsiddhiriti
yaccānyaduktam–indriyārthāḥ ityādi; tadapyetena pratyuktam; krameṇa kāryakartṛtvasya eṣāmasiddhatvāt, dīrghaśaṣkulībhakṣaṇādau yugapadapi jñānapañcakakartṛtvapratipādanāt
manasā anaikāntikañcedam; taddhi itarakārakasākalye'pi krameṇa kāryakartṛ na ca kramavatkaraṇāpekṣam anavasthāprasaṅgād apasiddhāntaprasaṅgācca

etena anutpādyotpādakatvāt ityapi prativyūḍham; bhavadabhyupagatena manasaiva anekāntāt, na khalu kārakāntarasākalye'nutpādyotpādakamapi manaḥ kramavatkaraṇāntarā'pekṣam anavasthāyā apasiddhāntasya ca prasaṅgāt
kiñca, anutpādyotpādakatvamasya krameṇa, yugapadvā vivakṣitam ? yadi krameṇa; tadā asiddho hetuḥ, dīrghaśaṣkulībhakṣaṇādau yugapadapi jñānotpattipratipādanāt
atha yugapat; tadā viruddhaḥ, tathotpādakatvasya akramikakaraṇā'dhīnatvāt prasiddhasahabhāvyanekakāryakārisāmagrīvat
yadapyabhihitam–sukhādijñānam ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; hetoḥ aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvāt, nahi sukhādijñānasya pratyakṣatvaṃ siddham
indriyāśritaṃ hi pratyakṣaṃ bhavanmate, na ca tajjñāne kiñcidindriyaṃ kāraṇabhūtamasti yadāśritatvena asya pratyakṣatā syāt
ata eva tatsiddhau anyonyāśrayaḥ–manaḥsiddhau hi tajjñānasya tadāśritatvena pratyakṣatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca saviśeṣaṇahetusiddhermanaḥsiddhiriti

ata eva āśrayā'siddhaścāyam; nahi ghaṭādivat sukhādi aviditasvarūpaṃ pūrvamutpannaṃ punarindriyeṇa sambaddhyate tato jñānaṃ grahaṇañca iti loke pratītirasti, prathamameva iṣṭā'niṣṭaviṣayā'nubhavā'nantaraṃ svaprakāśātmano'sya udayapratīteḥ

kiñca, yatra saṃyuktaṃ manaḥ tatra samavete jñānamutpādayati ityabhyupagame sakalātmasamavete sukhādau tat jñānamutpādayatu, nityavyāpitvena manasā teṣāṃ saṃyogā'viśeṣāt, tathā ca pratiprāṇi bhinnaṃ mano'ntaraṃ vyartham
yasya yanmanaḥ tat tatsamavāyini jñānahetuḥ ityapi śraddhāmātram; pratiniyatātmasambandhitvasyaiva atrāsiddhe
taddhi tatkāryatvāt, tadupakriyamāṇatvāt, tatsaṃyogāt, tadadṛṣṭapreritatvāt, tadātmapreritatvādvā syāt ? na tāvat tatkāryatvāt; apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt, nityatvavirodhā'nupaṅgācca
nāpi tadupakriyamāṇatvāt; sarvathā nityatayā anādheyā'praheyā'tiśaye tasyāpi anupapadyamānatvāt
nāpi tatsaṃyogāt; sarvatrāpyasya aviśeṣata sarvasambandhitvā'nuṣaṅgeṇa aviśeṣata tatsamavāyini jñānajanakatvaprasaṅgāt

nāpi yadadṛṣṭapreritaṃ pravarttate nivarttate vā tattasya ityabhidhātavyam; acetanasya adṛṣṭasya aniṣṭanarakādiparihāreṇa iṣṭe svargādau tatpreraṇā'saṃbhavāt, anyathā īśvarākhyacetanādhiṣṭhātṛparikalpanā'narthakyam
tasya adṛṣṭapreraṇe vyāpārāt nā'narthakyam ityabhyupagame manasa evā'sau prerako'stu alamanayā paramparayā
tasya sarvasādhāraṇatvācca ato na tanniyamo yuktaḥ
na ca adṛṣṭasyāpi pratiniyamaḥ siddha; tasya ātmano'tyantabhinnatvāt
tatastadatyantabhede'pi samavāyāt pratiniyamasiddhiḥ, ityapyasundaram; tasya asiddhasvarūpatvāt sarvasādhāraṇatvācca
yena ātmanā yanmana preryate tattasya ityapyasāram, anupalabdhasya prerayitumaśakyatvāt, tathāvidhasyāpi preraṇe adṛṣṭa-paramāṇvāderapi preraṇaprasaṅgāt īśvarakalpanāvaiyarthyam
tanna manasaḥ kutaścit siddhiḥ, siddhau vā na saṃyoga, niraṃśayoḥ ātma-manasoḥ ekadeśena saṃyoge sāṃśatvam, sarvātmanaikatvam ubhayavyāghātakāri syāt
bauddhā khalu 'ṣaṇṇāmanantarātīta vijñāna yaddhi tanmana abhidha॰ ko॰ 1
17 ityādinā manaso jñānarūpatvamevāmananti, paraṃ yogācāradarśane tu ṣaḍvijñānavyatirikto'pyasti manodhātu
tadevaṃ paraparikalpito dravyapadārtho vicāryamāṇo na ghaṭāmaṭāṭyate
nāpi guṇapadārthaḥ, tasyāpi vicāryamāṇasya yathābhyupagatasvarūpasya avyavasthiteḥ
dravyāśrasyaguṇavān ityādisāmānyalakṣaṇalakṣitā rūpādayaścaturviśatirguṇā' iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu guṇapadārthasya asmābhirabhyupagataṃ svarūpaṃ dravyāśritatvādi, tasya ca pramāṇataḥ tathaiva pratīyamānatvāt kathamavyavasthitiḥ ? tathā ca tallakṣaṇasūtram– dravyāśrayyaguṇavān saṃyoga-vibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣaḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
dravyam āśrayo yasya asau dravyāśrayī dravyatantra, aguṇavān nirguṇa, saṃyogavibhāgeṣvakāraṇamanapekṣa eteṣu karttavyeṣu sāpekṣaṃ kāraṇatvamasya ityarthaḥ
anena ca lakṣa ṇena lakṣitāḥ śuklaḥ paṭaḥ, madhuramāmram, sugandhirmṛgamadaḥ, śītalaṃ jalam ityādiviśiṣṭapratyayā yād dravyādarthāntaratvena prasiddhā rūpādayaścaturviśatireva guṇāḥ
uktañca sūtrakṛtā–rūparasa-gandha-sparśāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇāni pṛthaktva saṃyoga-vibhāgau paratvā-'paratve buddhayaḥ sukha-duḥkhe icchā-dveṣau prayatnaśca guṇāḥ vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
6 iti sūtrasaṅgṛhītāḥ saptadaśa, caśabdasamuccitā gurutva-dravatva-sneha-saṃskāra-dharma-adharma-śabdāśca sapta iti

guṇāśca rūparasagandhasparśasaṃkhyāparimāṇapṛthaktvasaṃyogavibhāgaparatvāparatvabuddhisukhadukhecchādveṣaprayatnāśceti kaṇṭhoktā saptadaśa, caśabdasamuccitāśca gurutvadravatvasnehasaṃskārādṛṣṭaśabdāḥ saptaivetyevaṃ caturviśatirguṇāḥ
praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 104 raso rasanendriyagrāhyaḥ, pṛthivī-udakavṛttiḥ
praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 105 gandho ghrāṇagrāhyaḥ, pṛthivīvṛttiḥ
praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 105 sparśaḥ tvagindriyagrāhyaḥ, pṛthivī-udaka-jvalana-pavanavṛttiḥ

praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 106 ete ca rūparasagandhasparśāḥ pārthivaparamāṇuṣvanityāḥ pāvakasaṃyogāttatra pākajarūpādyutpatteḥ, aptejovāyvaṇuṣu yathāsaṃbhavaṃ nityāḥ kutaścitteṣāṃ tatra anyaprakāreṇa anutpatteḥ, pārthivādikāryadravyeṣu anityāḥ

pārthivaparamāṇuṣu rūpādīnāṃ pākajotpattividhānam–ghaṭāderāmadravyasya agninā sambaddhasya agnyabhighātānnodanādvā tadārambhakeṣvaṇuṣu karmāṇyutpadyante, tebhyo vibhāgā, vibhāgebhyaḥ saṃyogavināśā, saṃyogavināśebhyaśca kāryadravyaṃ vinaśyati
tasmin vinaṣṭe svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu agnisaṃyogādauṣṇyāpekṣāt śyāmādīnāṃ vināśaḥ, punaranyasmādagnisaṃyogādauṣṇyāpekṣāt pākajā jāyante
tadanantaraṃ bhogināmadṛṣṭāpekṣādātmā'ṇusaṃyogādutpannapākajeṣvaṇuṣu karmotpattau teṣāṃ parasparasaṃyogād dvyaṇukādikrameṇa kāryadravyamutpadyate, tatra ca kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa rūpādyutpattiḥ
apsu tejasi vāyau ca nityā dravyanityatvāt
saṃkhyā tu ekādivyavahārahetuḥ ekatvādilakṣaṇā, ekadravyā ca anekadravyā ca
tatra ekasaṃkhyā ekadravyā, anekadravyā tu dvitvādisaṃkhyā
sā ca pratyakṣata eva siddhā, viśeṣabuddheśca nimittāntarā'pekṣatvād anumānato'pi
tatra ekatvasaṃkhyā nityadravyeṣu nityā, kāryadravyeṣu anityā
dvitvādisaṃkhyā tu parārddhāntā apekṣābuddhijanyā sarvatra anityā
parimāṇavyavahārakāraṇaṃ parimāṇam, mahad, aṇu, dīrgham, hrasvam iti caturvidham
nityam ākāśa-kāla-dig-ātmasu paramamahattvam, anityaṃ dvyaṇu tryaṇu kādidravyepu
paramāṇumanastu pārimāṇḍalyalakṣaṇaṃ nityam, anityaṃ dvyaṇuke eva

nanu dvyaṇuke aṇutva-hrasvatvayorvarttamānayoḥ tryaṇukādau ca mahattva-dīrghatvayornā'nyonyaṃ kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti cā'yuktam, mahatsu dīrgham ānīyatām, dīrgheṣu mahad ānīyatām iti vyavahārabhedapratītito mahatva-dīrghatvayo parasparata pratiprāṇi bhedaprasiddhe

taccaturvidham atha tryaṇukādiṣu varttamānayo mahattvadīrghatvayo parasparata ko viśepa dvyaṇukeṣu cāṇutvahasvatvayoriti ? tatrāsti mahattvadīrghatvayo parasparato viśeṣa mahatsu dīrghamānīyatām dīrgheṣu ca mahadānīyatāmiti viśiṣṭavyavahāradarśanāt
saṃyuktamapi dravyaṃ yadvaśāt atra ida pṛthag iti apoddhriyate tad apoddhāravyavahārakāraṇaṃ pṛthaktvam
tacca ekatvasaṃkhyāviśepitam ekatvavat nityam anityañca boddhavyam
aprāptipūrvikā prāpti saṃyoga, prāptipūrvikā ca aprāptirvibhāga
tau ca dravyepu yathākramaṃ saṃyukta-vibhaktapratyayajanakau anityāveva
ida param, idamaparam iti yato'bhidhāna-pratyayau bhavataḥ tad yathākramaṃ paratvam aparatvañca, tacca anityameva
tacca pṛthivī-tejaso rnaimittikamanityam, apāṃ sāṃsiddhikam, āpyā'ṇuṣu nityam āpyadvyaṇukādau tu anityam
sa ca āpyā'ṇuṣu nityaḥ, dvyaṇukādau anityaḥ
tatra vegākhyaḥ pṛthivī-ap-tejovāyu-manassu mūrttadravyeṣu prayatna-abhighātaviśeṣāpekṣāt karmaṇaḥ samutpadyate, niyatadikkriyāprabandhahetuḥ sparśavaddravyasaṃyogavirodhī ca
bhāvanākhyaḥ punaḥ ātmaguṇaḥ jñānajo jñānahetuśca, dṛṣṭa-anubhūta-śruteṣvartheṣu smṛti-pratyabhijñānakāryonnīyamānasadbhāvaḥ

mūrtimaddravyaguṇaḥ sthitasthāpakaḥ ghanā'vayavasanniveśaviśiṣṭaṃ svamāśrayaṃ pratyatnato'nyathāsthitamapi pūrvavat yathāsthitaṃ sthāpayati iti kṛtvā, dṛśyate ca tālapatrādeḥ prabhūtatarakālasaṃveṣṭitasya prasāryamuktasya punastathaiva avasthānaṃ saṃskāravaśāt, evaṃ dhanuḥ-śākhā-vastrādau kāryamasya draṣṭavyam
sa ca trividho'pyayaṃ saṃskāraḥ anitya eva
yattāvaduktam–dravyāśrayī ityādi guṇānāṃ lakṣaṇam; tadasamīcīnam; bhavatkalpite dravye pratiṣiddhe teṣāṃ tadāśritatvā'nupapatteḥ

astu vā teṣāṃ tadāśritatvādikaṃ lakṣaṇam; tathāpi tallakṣaṇalakṣitā rūpādayaścaturviśatireva guṇāḥ ityavadhāraṇamanupapannam; anekadhā guṇānāṃ śravaṇāt–loke hi śaurya-audāryādayo anekadhā guṇāḥ śrūyante
vaiyākaraṇamate tu viśeṣyaṃ dravyam, viśeṣaṇaṃ guṇaḥ iti prasiddham
yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt dravye śabdaniveśaḥ tadabhidhāne tvatalau pāta॰ mahābhā॰ 5

sāṃkhyāḥ punaḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ guṇatvaṃ pratipannāḥ, iti kathaṃ teṣāmiyattā'vadhārayituṃ śakyā ? kiñca, ete rūpādayaḥ ekasmin ghaṭādyavayavini niraṃśaikasvabhāvā bhavatā'bhyupagamyante, tathā ca kuñcikāvivarapradeśādinā upalabhyamāne ghaṭādau yāvaddravyavartino rūpāderbahirantaśca upalabdhiḥ syāt, anyathā niraṃśaikarūpatāvyāghātaḥ
evaṃ jalasekādinā pṛthivyāṃ kvacid abhivyajyamāne gandhe samagrabhūgolā'vayavigatasya gandhasya abhivyaktiḥ syāt, anyathā abhivyaktetaraviruddhadharmādhyāsād avayavivyāpī na kaścid eko guṇa syāt
agnisaṃyogāt pākajarūpotpattau tu vipratipattyabhāva eva asmābhirapi abhyupagamāt
gururlaghuḥ snigdharūkṣau tīkṣṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ sthiraḥ saraḥ
sthūlaḥ sūkṣmo dravaḥ śuṣkaḥ āśurmandaḥ smṛtā guṇāḥ
sattvaṃ laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamupaṣṭambhakaṃ calaṃ ca rajaḥ
bhuva ekadeśe jalena gandhasya abhivyaktau pradeśāntare'pi abhivyaktyupalabdhyo prasaṅga
apekṣābuddhito dvitvādisaṃkhyā utpadyate ityetattu ayuktam; tasyāḥ padārtheṣu svabhāvasiddhatvāt ekatvavat

tadvyavahāra eva hi apekṣābuddhijanyaḥ na svarūpam, badarāmalakādau sthūlādivyavahāravat, yathaiva hi svakāraṇakalāpāt sthūlatvādidharmopeteṣu utpanneṣu badarādiṣu tadvyavahāraḥ apekṣābuddhito jāyate evamatrāpi
na ca apekṣābuddhito'rthānāmutpattiḥ iti prāmāṇiko vakti; icchāmātrādarthaniṣpattau sarvasyaiva abhipretārthasiddhiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, ekasyāṃ buddhau pratibhāsamānā ekaikaguṇā kathaṃ kadācid dvitvamutpādayanti kadācicca bahutvam ? nahi teṣāmekatve kaścidviśeṣaḥ
na ca yau dvau ekaikaguṇau tau dvitvasaṃkhyāmutpādayataḥ, ye ca bahavaḥ te bahutvasaṃkhyām ityabhidhātavyam; dvitvādisaṃkhyotpatteḥ prāk teṣu dvitvasya bahutvasya cā'saṃbhavāt
guṇatvañcāsyā na saṃbhāvyam; guṇeṣvapi sadbhāvāt, suprasiddho hi ekaṃ jñānam, dve jñāne, caturviśatirguṇāḥ, ṣaṭ padārthāḥ ityādipratītito guṇeṣu saṃkhyāsadbhāvaḥ
skhaladgatitvaṃ hi bhāktapratyayasya lakṣaṇam māṇavake agnipratyayavat
yathāhi–ekaṃ jñānaṃ dve jñāne ityādau saṃkhyāmantareṇāpi ekādibuddhirbhavati evaṃ ghaṭādiṣvapi

yadapi–mahad, aṇu, dīrgham, hrasvam iti caturdhā parimāṇaṃ pratipāditam, tadapi analpatamovilasitam; vastusaṃsthānaviśeṣavyatirekeṇa tadbhedasyāsaṃbhavāt kasya guṇarūpatā upavarṇyeta ? tadviśeṣasyāpi tadrūpatopavarṇane vartula-tryasra-caturasrāderapi guṇarūpatopavarṇanā'nuṣaṅgānna taccaturvidhatvopavarṇanaṃ śobheta

yadapyuktam–badarāmalakādiṣu bhākto'ṇuvyavahāraḥ ityādi; tadapyayuktam; tatra gauṇatvapratipatteḥ kasyacidapyabhāvāt, na khalu yathā sihamāṇavakādiṣu mukhya-gauṇavivekapratipattiḥ sarveṣāmavigānena asti, tathā dvyaṇuke eva aṇutva-hrasvatve mukhye anyatra gauṇe iti tadvivekapratipattiḥ
āpekṣikatvācca parimāṇasyāguṇatvam, nahi rūpādeḥ sukhādervā guṇasya āpekṣikatvaṃ dṛṣṭam
yo'pi nīla-nīlatarādeḥ sukha-sukhatarādervā āpekṣiko vyavahāraḥ, so'pi tatprakarṣā'pakarṣanibandhano na punarguṇasvarūpanibandhanaḥ

yadapi–apoddhāravyavahārakāraṇaṃ pṛthaktvam ityādyuktam; tadapi na yuktam; apoddhāravyavahāro hi bhedavyavahāraḥ, sa ca sarvārthānāṃ svagatā'sādhāraṇabhedakarmanibandhanaḥ iti ki tatra pṛthaktvalakṣaṇaguṇāntarakalpanayā ? anyathā apṛthaktvamapi abhedavyavahārakāraṇaṃ guṇāntaraṃ kalpyatāmaviśeṣāt
nairantaryeṇa pariṇatā hi padārthāḥ saṃyuktavyavahāragocaratāṃ pratipadyante
nairantaryarūpasaṃyogasya ca guṇatve sāmīpya-dūratvāderapi guṇatvaprasaṅgād guṇasaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ
vibhāgo'pi saṃyogā'bhāvamātram, na tu vibhaktā'rtheṣu guṇāntarotpattiḥ, vibhāgaguṇaśūnye'pi ca sahya-vindhyādau vibhaktapratyayo dṛśyate
prāptipūrvikā aprāptirvibhāgaḥ praśa॰ bhā॰ pṛ॰ 151 ityabhidhānāt
na cā'sau pratyayo bhāktaḥ; vailakṣaṇyā'bhāvāt, nahi meṣau vibhaktau, sahya-vindhyau vibhaktau ityanayoḥ pratyayayorvailakṣaṇyamavadhāryate dvayoraskhaladgatitvā'viśeṣāt
sannikarṣaviprakarṣayoreva hi parā'parapratyayahetutvopapatterna kiñcit paratvā'paratvābhyāṃ prayojanam

kiñca, ayaṃ parā'parādivyavahāraḥ sattādravyatvādāvapyasti, sa cet saṅketavaśāt svarūpamātranibandhanaḥ anyatrāpyevamastu, ki tatrāpi paratvā'paratvaguṇanibandhanatvasādhanaprayāsena ? kiñca, evaṃ sati madhyatvamapi guṇaḥ syāt kālakṛtasya dikkṛtasya ca madhyavyavahārasya darśanāt parā'paravyavahāravat
gurutvañca patanā'numeyam ityayuktam; karatalasthite suvarṇapiṇḍādau patanaṃ vinā'pi daśapalo'yam, pañcapalo'yam iti pratīteḥ
kiñca, gurutvaṃ nāma dravyasya patanaśaktiḥ, śaktayaśca pratidravyaṃ svasyāṃ svasyāmarthakriyāyāṃ nānāvidhāḥ, tā kiyatyaḥ saṃkhyātuṃ śakyante
pradhānabhūtā hi paṭkārakaśaktayo'rthānāṃ tadbhedaprabhedāśca anantāḥ, te cenna gaṇyante ki gurutvaparigaṇanayā ? kiñca, gurutvasya guṇatve laghutvamapi guṇaḥ syād aviśeṣāt
gurutvā'bhāvarūpatvāt tasya na guṇatvamiti cet; gurutvamapi laghutvā'bhāvaḥ kinna syāt ? nanu gurutvasya abhāvarūpatve tāratamyaṃ na syāt, ityanyatrāpi samānam
na ca patanakarmakāriṇyeva gurutvavyavahāraḥ; madīyo guruḥ iti ārādhye, mastriguruḥ iti varṇadharme ca gurutvavyavahāradarśanāt

kiñca, yadi gurutvaṃ guṇaḥ syāt tadā kāraṇagatairguṇaiḥ kārye guṇāḥ prārabhyante rūpādivat ityabhyupagamāt tantugatena daśapalaparimāṇena gurutvena paṭe gurutvamārabhyamāṇaṃ sātiśayaṃ syāt parimāṇavat, tathā ca tulānamanātiśayaḥ syāt, na caivamasti
tatkriyotpattau viśiṣṭā śaktireva hi dravatvam, na ca arthagatāḥ śaktayaḥ parisaṃkhyātuṃ śakyante ityuktam
suvarṇādau ca taijasatvamasiddham, siddhau vā yat tatra dravatvamupalabhyate tat saṃyuktasamavāyāt pārthivameva rasādivat
na ca pṛthivyāmapi sarvasyāṃ dravatvaṃ saṃbhavati śuṣkakāṣṭhādiṣvabhāvāt

etena snehaguṇo'pi pratyākhyātaḥ; nahi so'pi sāmarthyaviśeṣādanyaḥ apāṃ viśeṣaguṇo vā ghaṭate, ghṛtatailādiṣu pārthiveṣu upalambhāt apsu cā'nupalambhāt, nahi śuddhābhiradbhiḥ snāte puruṣe snigdhapratyayo dṛṣṭa
ghṛtāderapi loke vaidyakaśāstre ca tnigdhatvena prasiddhatvāt
yo'pi saṃskārastrividha; so'pyanupapannaḥ; na khalu kriyāṇāṃ sātatyenotpādanasāmarthyādanyaḥ kaścid vegākhyo guṇaḥ kutaścitpramāṇāt pratīyate
kathaṃ tarhi vegena gacchati iti pratītirna viruddhyate ? iti cet; śīghrakriyāṇāṃ sātatye vegena gacchati iti pratīteravirodhaḥ
ataḥ pratītervegākhyaguṇasadbhāve ca vegena śāstraṃ jānāti, vegena paṣṭikāḥ pacyante ityatrāpi vegaguṇasadbhāvaḥ syāt
santānena āgacchati iti pratīteśca santāno'pi guṇaḥ syāt
etena sthitasthāpako'pi saṃskāraḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; nahi so'pi yathā'vasthitavastusthāpanasāmarthyādaparaḥ pratibhāsate
na cāsau niyamena yathā'vasthitaṃ vastu sthāpayati ākṛṣyamāṇe śākhādau aniyatadiktvena śākhādergamanasya sthānasya ca darśanāt
na ca kriyāto'rthāntara vega asyā śīghrotpādamātre vegavyavahāraprasiddheḥ
dharmā'dharmāvapi nātmaguṇau pratipādayituṃ śakyau; tatra vipratipatteḥ

asmanmate hi paudgalikau tau, sāṃkhyamate buddhidharmau, mīmāṃsakakṛtānte dravyādikaṃ śreyaḥsādhanatvaśaktiviśiṣṭaṃ tacchabdavācyam, bauddharāddhānte jñānasyaiva vāsanākhyaṃ śaktirūpaṃ karma iti prasiddham
tathāhi–jaināḥ paudgalikaṃ taṃ pratijānanti, mīmāṃsakā nityadravyam, śikṣākārā mīmāṃsakaviśeṣāḥ vāyavīyam, sautrāntikāḥ paramāṇurūpam, vaiyākaraṇāḥ sphoṭātmakam, sāṃkhyāḥ prakṛtipariṇāmam iti
tathā ca śikṣākārā āhuḥ–vāyurāpadyate śabdatāmiti; naitadevam
tanmātrāpañcakāntargataḥ śabda prakṛtipariṇāmarūpaḥ etadarthaṃ sāṃkhyakā॰ 24 draṣṭavyā
utkṣepaṇādīni pañca karmāṇi iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu karmaṇo guṇalakṣaṇād vibhinnalakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt kathaṃ tatpratyākhyānena asya pratyākhyānam ? tasya hi lakṣaṇam–ekadravyamaguṇaṃ saṃyogavibhāgeṣvanepakṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ karma
ekadravyam āśrayo asyāstīti ekadravyam, na asya guṇāḥ santi svayaṃ ca guṇo na bhavati iti aguṇam, saṃyogavibhāgepu ca karttavyeṣu na kiñcit kāraṇamapekṣate iti anapekṣam
tacca anena lakṣaṇena lakṣitaṃ karma pañcaprakāraṃ bhavati, tathā ca sūtram–utkṣepaṇam apakṣepaṇam ākuñcanaṃ prasāraṇa gamanamiti karmāṇi vai॰ sū॰ 1
tacca utkṣipyate hastaḥ, apakṣipyate pādaḥ, ākuñcyate pāṇiḥ, prasāryate aṅguliḥ ityādiviśiṣṭapratyayād dravyādarthāntaram

tatra utkṣeṣaṇam–yad ūrdhvā'dhaḥpradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgakāraṇaṃ karma utpadyate, yathā śarīrā'vayave tatsambaddhe ca musalādau ūrdhvadigbhāvibhiḥ ākāśādyarthaiḥ saṃyogakāraṇam adhodigbhāvibhyaśca vibhāgakāraṇaṃ gurutva-prayatna-saṃyogavaśāta karma utpadyate

ṛjuno dravyasya kuṭilatvakāraṇaṃ karma ākuñcanam, tadyathā ṛjuno bāhvādidravyasya agrā'vayavānāmaṅgulyādīnāṃ taddeśaiḥ svasaṃyogibhirākāśādyairvibhāge sati mūlapradeśaiśca saṃyoge yena karmaṇā avayavī kuṭilaḥ sampadyate tad ākuñcanam
tadviparyayeṇa tu saṃyogavibhāgotpattau yena karmaṇā avayavī ṛjuḥ sampadyate tat karma prasāraṇam
ata eva pañcaiva karmāṇi bhavanti bhramaṇa-syandana-recanādīnāṃ gamane eva antarbhāvāditi
svotpattyanantarotpattikabhāvabhūtānapekṣam ityartha, tena samavāyikāraṇāpekṣāyāṃ pūrvasaṃyogābhāvāpekṣāyā ca nāsiddhatvam
utkṣepaṇādīnāṃ pañcānāmapi lakṣaṇāni kiñcicchabdabhedena praśastapādabhāṣye pṛ॰ 291-92 draṣṭavyāni
ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyā tathoktakarmapadārthanirasanapurassara deśāddeśāntaraprāptihetu parispandātmaka pariṇāmo'rthasya karma iti vyavasthāpanam–
yattāvaduktam–ekadravyam ityādi karmaṇo lakṣaṇam; tadasamīcīnam; bhavatparikalpite dravye pratipiddhe tasya tallakṣaṇatvā'nupapatteḥ

astu vā tad dravyam; tathāpi etad gantṛsvabhāvam, agantṛsvabhāvam, ubhayarūpam, anubhayarūpaṃ vā karmaṇa āśrayaḥ syāt ? gantṛsvabhāvaṃ cet, tarhi tadvyatiriktakarmakalpanāvaiyarthyam, tatsvabhāvasyāpi tatkalpane anavasthāprasaṅgāt
kiñca, sarvadā tat tatsvabhāvam, kadācidvā ? prathamapakṣe na kadācit tadavatiṣṭhet sarvadā gantṛsvabhāvatvāt vāyuvat
atha kadācit; tadā pūrvam agantṛsvabhāvaṃ tat paścād gantṛsvabhāvam ityāyātam
tatra ca pūrvā'gantṛsvabhāvaparityāgena tad gantṛsvabhāvatāṃ svīkuryāt, aparityāgena vā ? yadi parityāgena; tadā aṇvādidravyasya anityatāpattiḥ, svabhāvapracyutilakṣaṇatvāt tasyāḥ
atha aparityāgena, tanna, aparityaktā'gantṛsvabhāvasya himācalādivat gantṛsvabhāvasamāveśā'nupapatteḥ
nāpi agantṛsvabhāvasya; ākāśādivat tathāvidhasya asya tadāśrayatvavirodhāt, pūrvamagantṛsvabhāvasya uttarakālaṃ gantṛsvabhāvatāyāṃ satyāṃ tasya tadāśrayatve tu uktadopā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

kiñca, asya ubhayasvabhāvatā yugapat, krameṇa vā syāt ? na tāvad yugapat; gantṛtvā'gantṛtvasvabhāvayorvibhinnakālanibandhanatvāt, yayorvibhinnakālanibandhanatvam na tayoryugapadbhāvaḥ yathā prasāritetarāṅgulisvabhāvayoḥ, tatkālanibandhanatvañca tatsvabhāvayoriti
yugapattadbhāve ca aṇvādeḥ viruddhadharmā'dhyāsato bhedaprasaṃgād ekasvarūpatāvyāghātaḥ
krameṇa tadbhāvā'bhyupagame agantṛrūpatyāgena atyāgena vā gantṛrūpotpāde prāguktā'śepadopā'nuṣaṅgaḥ
anubhayarūpatā tu virodhānna yuktā; vidhipratiṣedhadharmayoḥ ekatarapratiṣedhe anyataravidheravaśyaṃbhāvitvāt
tataḥ sarvathaikasvabhāve vastuni karmaṇo'nupapadyamānatvānna pareṣāṃ karmapadārtho ghaṭate
astu vā'sau; tathāpi deśād deśāntaraprāptihetuḥ parirapandātmakaḥ pariṇāmo'rthasya karma ityetāvataiva paryāptatvāt na tatpañcaprakāratopavarṇanaṃ yuktam, utkṣepaṇādīnāmatraivā'ntarbhāvāt
atra antarbhūtānāmapi kañcidviśepamādāya bhedenā'bhidhāne bhramaṇa-recanādīnāmapi ato bhedenā'bhidhānā'nuṣaṅgāt kathaṃ pañcaprakārataiva asya syāt

kiñca, utkṣepaṇādikarmaṇo bhedaḥ svarūpanibandhanaḥ, jātinibandhano vā syāt ? svarūpanibandhanaścet–ki svarūpamātranibandhanaḥ, viśiṣṭasvarūpanibandhano vā ? na tāvat svarūpamātranibandhanaḥ; tanmātrasya sarvepāmaviśiṣṭatvāt
aviśiṣṭasyā'pi bhedakatve ekatadvyakterapi bhedakatvaprasaṅgānna kvacidekatvavyavahāraḥ syāt
viśiṣṭasvarūpanibandhanaścet; kiṃkṛtaṃ tadvaiśiṣṭyam ? jātikṛtamiti cet; tarhi jātinibandhanastadbhedaḥ ityāyātam
tatrāpi utkṣepaṇatvādijātiḥ abhivyaktā, anabhivyaktā vā tatkarmaṇo bhedaṃ vidadhyāt ? na tāvadanabhivyaktā; sarvatra sarvadā tadbhedā'bhivyañjakatvaprasaṅgāt
abhivyaktā cet; kutastadabhivyaktiḥ–tatkarmabhedāt, anyato vā ? na tāvadanyataḥ; vijātīyavyaktīnāmabhivyañjakatve karkādibhyo gotvā'bhivyaktiprasaṅgāt
tatkarmabhedasya ca abhivyañjakatve anyo'nyāśrayaḥ– siddhe hi tatkarmaṇo bhede tataḥ tajjātīnāmabhivyaktisiddhiḥ, tatsiddheśca tatkarmaṇo bhedasiddhiriti

kiñca, āsāṃ tatkarmakṣaṇo vyañjakaḥ, tatsamudāyo vā ? na tāvat tatkṣaṇaḥ; prathamakṣaṇe samutpannasya tatkarmakṣaṇamātrasya durlakṣyatayā utkṣepaṇatvādijātyabhivyañjakatvā'yogāt, nahi kṣaṇamātrabhāvi karma utkṣepaṇam apakṣepaṇaṃ vā asmadādibhirlakṣyate, yena ataḥ tajjātibhedo'bhivyaktaḥ syāt, tasya atisūkṣmatvena yogināmeva pratyakṣatvāt
nāpi tatsamudāyo vyañjakaḥ; karmaṇāṃ kṣaṇikatvena samudāyasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
buddhiparikalpitaḥ so'stītyapyayuktam; vastu bhūtārthakriyāyāṃ kālpanikasya sāmarthyā'saṃbhavāt
sarvathā arthādarthāntarasya ca asya grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvād asattvam
yad yataḥ sarvathā arthāntaraṃ pramāṇato na pratīyate na tat tathā'bhyupagantavyam yathā sāmānyādeḥ svarūpasattvam, sarvathā arthādarthāntaraṃ na pratīyate ca kutaścitpramāṇāt karma iti
tato yathoktasvarūpameva karma pratītibhūdharaśikharārūḍhaṃ prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam
utkṣepaṇatvādijātyabhivyañjakaḥ karmakṣaṇaḥ tatsamudāyo vā syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 950
sayoga eva karma iti bhūṣaṇamatasya nirākaraṇam–

nanu sālokā'vayavidravyasaṃyoga-vibhāgavyatirekeṇa nā'paraṃ kiñcit karma pratīyate, ūrdhvapradeśā''lokādyavayavidravyasaṃyoga-vibhāgaparamparā hi utkṣepaṇam ucyate, evam apakṣepaṇādāvapi vaktavyam ityanyaḥ, so'pi pratītyapalāpitvād aprāmāṇikaḥ; nahi saṃyoga-vibhāgau calati ityādipratīterālambanatāṃ pratipadyete saṃyuktaḥ, viyuktaḥ iti pratītigocaracāritvāttayoḥ, yathāviṣayam avitathapratyayapravṛtte, anyathā paṭapratyayo'pi ghaṭālambana syāt

saṃyoga-vibhāgālambanatve cāsya tiṣṭhatyapi calati iti pratyayaḥ syāt, na caivam, na khalu nadīmadhyasthite sthāṇau jalapravāheṇa śyenena vā saṃyogavibhāgeṣu pravarttamāneṣvapi sthāṇuścalati iti svapne'pi kasyacit pratītirasti
nirantarañca saṃyoga-vibhāgaśreṇidarśanāt devadattavad bhūmāvapi calati iti pratītiḥ syāt
nahi saṃyoga-vibhāgayoḥ ubhayatra vṛttyaviśeṣe devadatte eva tatpratītirbhavati na bhūmau iti nirnibandhanā vyavasthitiryuktā, svecchācāritvaprasaṅgāt
atha devadattakriyayaiva tau janyete na bhūmikriyayā ataḥ tatraiva tatpratītimutpādayataḥ na bhūmau, yadyevam, kriyānvaya-vyatirekā'nuvidhāyitvāt tatpratīte siddhaṃ kriyālambanatvameva
saṃyoga-vibhāgā'grahaṇe'pi ca nirālambe vihāyasi viharati vihaṅgame calati iti pratyayapratīteśca
nanu vitatā''lokāvayavī ākāśaḥ, tena ca patatrisaṃyogaḥ asmadāde pratyakṣa eva, ityapyasundaram; samandhakāre khadyoto gacchati iti pratyayābhāvaprasaṅgāt
nahi tatra ālokā'vayavī vidyate, yatsaṃyoga-vibhāgagrahaṇanibandhano'yaṃ pratyayaḥ syāt
nāpi andhakāralakṣaṇaṃ kiñcid bhavanmate vastvasti, ālokābhāvastamaḥ ityabhyupagamāt
bhūkampo tpāte ca jāte calati vasumatī iti pratītirdṛśyate, na ca tatra utpātahetunā saṃyoga-vibhāgau gṛhyete
tasmānna saṃyogādyālambanā calati iti pratītiḥ, kintu kriyālambanaiva
kandalyā tu bhābhāva iti sūtrapāṭhabheda pṛ॰ 10
tasmādrūpaviśepo'yaṃ atyantaṃ tejo'bhāve sati sarvata samāropita tama
dravyaṃ tama iti bhāṭṭā vedāntinaśca bhaṇanti… ālokajñānābhāva iti prābhākaraikadeśina
kiñca, imau saṃyoga-vibhāgau ahetukau, sahetukau vā syātām ? ahetukatve sarvadā sattvamasattvaṃ vā syāt

sahetukatve kastayorhetuḥ–padārthasvarūpamātram, tadviśiṣṭapariṇāmo vā ? prathamapakṣe sthire'pyarthe aparā'parapradeśā'vayavidravyasaṃyoga-vibhāgotpādaprasaṅgaḥ tatsvarūpamātrasya tatrāpyaviśiṣṭatvāt
viśiṣṭapariṇāmahetukatve tu nāmamātrabhedaḥ, karmaṇa eva tatpariṇāmaśabdena abhidhānāt, tadvyatirekeṇa aparā'parapradeśā'vayavidravyasaṃyoga-vibhāgahetoḥ padārthānāṃ viśiṣṭapariṇāmasya asaṃbhavāt
ataḥ karma saṃyoga-vibhāgābhyāṃ devadattādeśca arthāntaram vibhinnapratyayagrāhyatvāt ghaṭa-paṭavat
na cedamasiddham; saṃyoga-vibhāgayoḥ saṃviddvayapratiṣṭhatayā saṃvedanāt, karmaṇastu ekasaṃvinniṣṭhatayā
tathā, devadattaḥ calattiṣṭhadavasthāyāṃ devadattapratyayavedyaḥ, karma punaḥ caladavasthāyāmeva calati iti pratyayavedyam, ataḥ tato bhinnam; sarvatra bhedavyavasthāyāḥ saṃvidbhedanibandhanatvāt
nanu kṣaṇamātrasthāyitayā arthānāṃ deśāddeśāntaraprāptyasaṃbhavāt naitallakṣaṇamapi karma upapannam; ityapi manorathamātram; kṣaṇikatvasya arthānāṃ nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
dravyādibhyo'rthāntaraṃ parā'parabhedāt dvividhaṃ sāmānyam iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu dravya-guṇa-karmā'nimittā'bādhyamānā'nugatajñānanimittaṃ sāmānyam, tatsvarūpasya cāsya kathaṃ vicāryamāṇasyā'nupapattiḥ ? tadrūpatayā'sya pratyakṣādigocaracāritayā samarthayiṣyamāṇatvāt
tatra paraṃ mahāviṣayaṃ sattākhyam, tacca samasteṣu dravyaguṇakarmasu anuvṛttipratyayasyaiva hetutvāt sāmānyameva, na viśeṣaḥ

aparaṃ tu dravyatva-guṇatva-karmatvādilakṣaṇam, tacca svāśrayeṣvanuvṛttipratyayahetutvāt sāmānyam ityucyate, vijātīyebhyaḥ svāśrayasya vyāvṛttapratyayahetutvācca sāmānyamapi sat viśeṣaḥ ityabhidhīyate
tathāhi–guṇādiṣu adravyam aguṇaḥ ityādikā yeyaṃ vyāvṛttabuddhirutpadyate tāṃ prati eṣāmeva dravyaguṇatvādīnāṃ hetutvaṃ pratīyate nānyasya
na caikasya asya sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo viruddhyate ityabhidhātavyam; apekṣābhedāt tatra tadbhāvasya avirodhāt
tatsadbhāve ca pratyakṣameva tāvatpramāṇam, vibhinnagavādivyatiriktasya anugatasyaika syāsya gauḥ gauḥ ityādi anugatendriyaprabhavapratyaye pratibhāsamānatvāt
nahi idam anugataikākāravastvālambanamantareṇa upapadyate, nirhetukatvena sarvadā sattvasya asattvasya vā prasaṅgāt, khaṇḍādivat anyatrāpi vā niyāmakā'bhāvataḥ pravṛttyanuṣaṅgāt
na ca vyaktyālambanatvādayamadoṣaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; vyaktīnāṃ vyāvṛttarūpatayā anugataikākārapratyayālambanatvā'yogāt
anyākārapratyayasya anyālambanatve sarvatrā'nāśvāsānna kvacit pratiniyatārthasiddhiḥ syāt
tacca vyāvṛtterapi hetutvād sāmānyaṃ sad viśeṣākhyāmapi labhate

tathā, anumānamapi tatsadbhāvāvedakatvena pravarttate; tathāhi–go-aśva-mahiṣa-varāhādiṣu gavādyabhidhāna-jñānaviśeṣāḥ samaya-ākṛti-piṇḍādivyatiriktasvarūpānurūpasaṃsarginimittāntaranibandhanāḥ gavādiviṣayatve sati piṇḍādisvarūpābhidhāna-jñānādvyatiriktābhidhāna-jñānaviśeṣatvāt, yathā teṣveva gavādiṣu savatsā dhenuḥ, bhārākrānto mahiṣaḥ, saśalyo varāha, sāṅkuśo mātaṅga ityabhidhāna-jñānaviśeṣā nimittāntarasaṃbhavāḥ, ye ca piṇḍādisvarūpavyatiriktanimittāntaranimittā na bhavanti na te tadvyatiriktā'bhidhāna-jñānaviśeṣāḥ yathā piṇḍādipratyayā iti
tathā, yadvastvākāravilakṣaṇo yaḥ pratyayaḥ sa tadvyatiriktanimittāntaranibandhana yathā vastrādipu raktādipratyayaḥ, tathā cāyaṃ piṇḍādiṣu gavādipratyaya iti
gavādipu anuvṛttipratyayaḥ piṇḍādivyatiriktanimittanibandhanaḥ, viśiṣṭapratyayatvāt, nīlādipratyayavat iti
piṇḍādarthāntaraṃ gotvam, tasya iti vyapadeśāt, caitrasya turaṅgamavat

gauḥ gauḥ ityabhinnā'bhidhāna-pratyayau anuvṛttavastunibandhanau, abhāvasāmānyābhidhānapratyayānyatve sati anuvṛttā'bhidhānapratyayatvāt, carma-vastrādiṣu nīlīdravyasambandhāt nīlam nīlam ityabhidhānapratyayavat
yathā parasparaviśiṣṭeṣu carmavastrakambalādiṣu nīlīdravyābhisambandhāt nīla nīlamiti pratyayānuvṛttiḥ tathā parasparaviśiṣṭadravyaguṇakarmasu satsaditi pratyayānuvṛtti sā cārthāntarādbhavitumarhati
yattāvaduktam–dravyaguṇakarmā'nimitta ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; bhavatkalpitadravyādīnāmuktavidhinā niṣedhe sati sāmānyasya tadāśritasya tatra anugatajñānanimittatvā'nupapatteḥ

anugatajñānanimittam ityasya ca bhāṣitasya ko'rthaḥ–kim anugatasya jñānasya nimittam anugatajñānanimittam, anugataṃ vā sat jñānanimittam iti ? prathamapakṣe jñāne anugamaḥ kiṃkṛtaḥ–svarūpakṛtaḥ, sāmānyakṛto vā ? na tāvatsvarūpakṛtaḥ; arthānāmapi svarūpata eva anugamaprasaṅgataḥ sāmānyakalpanā'narthakyā'nuṣaṅgāt
atha sāmānyakṛtaḥ, pratibhāsyā'nusāreṇa hi jñānasya anuvṛttiḥ nānyathā; tarhi anugataṃ sat jñānanimittam ityayaṃ pakṣo'ṅgīkṛtaḥ syāt

tatrā'pi asya anugatatvam– jñānā'rthayoḥ sādhāraṇasvabhāvā''dhāratvam, nityaikatve sati anekatra vyatiriktayā vṛttyā varttamānatvaṃ vā ? ādyavikalpe saṃyogena anekāntaḥ, tasya jñānā'rthayoḥ sādhāraṇasvabhāvatvena anugatasya sato jñānanimittatve'pi sāmānyarūpatvā'bhāvāt
nahi tasya yenaiva svabhāvena svajñānaviṣayatvaṃ tenaiva svasambandhini varttamānatvamasiddham, sāmānyavat niraṃśatvena asyāpi svabhāvabhedā'bhāvāt
dvitīyapakṣastu ayuktaḥ; sāmānye nityaikatvasya samavāyavṛttyā ca anekatra varttamānatvasya adyāpyasiddheḥ
anugataścāsau pratyayaśceti anugatapratyayaḥ, kiṃ vā anugate vastuni pratyaya iti
tathāhi kimidaṃ sāmānyaṃ kimanuvṛttapratyayakāraṇamutānuvṛttapratyayapramāṇakamathavā anuvṛttatvamāhosvinnityatve satyanuvṛttatvamathavā nityamekamanekasamavetatvam

yadapyuktam–tatsadbhāve ca pratyakṣameva ityādi; tatra pratyakṣaṃ gotvādisāmānyasya paricchedakaṃ nirvikalpakam, savikalpakaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvannirvikalpakam; tasya parāmarśaśūnyatvena gauḥ gauḥ ityādyullekhena anuvṛttavastuparāmarśakatvā'yogāt
tattve vā na yathopavarṇitasvarūpaṃ varṇaākṛti-akṣarākāraśūnyaṃ nityaikavyāpisvabhāvaṃ tat tatra pratibhāsate vipratipattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
na khalu svarūpeṇa pratibhāsamāne'rthe kaścid vipratipadyate vyaktivat
nāpi savikalpakam; tasya nirvikalpakapṛṣṭhabhāvitayā tatpratipanne eva arthe pravṛtteḥ
na ca sāmānyaṃ nirvikalpakapratipannam ityuktam, pratipattau vā gṛhītagrāhitayā nitarāmasyā'prāmāṇyam
tatra kiṃ nirvikalpakāt savikalpakādvā tatpratipatti syāt

kīdṛśaścāyamanugatapratyayaḥ–kiṃ yo'yaṃ gauḥ so'yaṃ gauḥ, kiṃ vā ayamapi gauḥ ayamapi gauriti ? prathamapakṣo'yuktaḥ; nahi śābaleya-bāhuleyayoḥ pratibhāsamānayoḥ ya evā'yaṃ gauḥ sa evā'yaṃ gauḥ iti pratibhāsaḥ; tayoraikyaprasaṅgāt
dvitīyapakṣastu yuktaḥ; ayam ityanena anyonyavilakṣaṇaśābaleyādiviśeṣaṃ parāmṛśya gauḥ ityanena sadṛśapariṇāmaparāmarśāt

svakāraṇādeva hi tādṛśaṃ rūpamutpannaṃ yat tathāvidhāṃ buddhimutpādayati, natu vyaktivyatiriktaṃ nityādisvabhāvaṃ sāmānyam tadagrahe'pi tadgrahaṇaprasaṅgāt ? yathaiva hi ghaṭād vyatiriktaḥ paṭaḥ ghaṭā'grahe'pi gṛhyate tathā sāmānyamapi viśeṣād vyatiriktaṃ viśeṣā'grahe'pi gṛhyeta, na ca tadagrahe tad gṛhyate tasmāt na tat tato vyatiriktam
ki ya evāyaṃ gauḥ sa evāyamapi, kiṃ vā'yamapi gauḥ ayamapi gauḥ; kiṃ vā gaurgau iti sāmānyeneti

atha tāsā tadvyañjakatvānna tadvyatirekeṇa tatpratibhāsaḥ, tarhi pradīpādivat prathamaṃ tāsāṃ pratibhāsa syāt; na caivam, prathamaṃ sāmānyaṃ gṛhyate paścād vyaktiḥ ityabhyupagamāt, nā'gṛhītaviśeṣaṇā viśeṣye buddhiḥ ityasya virodhā'nuṣaṅgācca
vyakteśca vyañjakatve vijātīyavyakterapi tat syāt vyaktitvā'viśeṣāt
na ca svavyaktereva vyañjakatvam ityabhidhātavyam, sāmānyā'siddhau svavyaktereva nirūpayitumaśakyatvāt

astu vā svavyaktereva tat, tathā'pi vyaktetararūpatayā kathaṃ tasya aikyam ? khaṇḍādayaśca asya vyañjakā yadi svabhāvataḥ tajjananasamānaśaktiyogāt; tarhi tāvataiva sāmānyaprayojanasiddheḥ ki tena siddhopasthāyinā ?
vyañjakabhūtāyā vyakte prāgeva vyaṅgyabhūtasya sāmānyasya grahaṇarūpa

kiñca, upakāraṃ kurvatī vyaktiḥ sāmānyaṃ vyanakti, akurvatī vā ? kurvatī cet; ko'nayā tasya upakāra kriyate–tajjñānotpādanayogyatā, tajjñānaṃ vā ? tadyogyatā cet; sā tato bhinnā, abhinnā vā vidhīyate ? bhinnā cet, tatkaraṇe sāmānyasya na kiñcit kṛtam iti tadavasthā asya anabhivyaktiḥ
abhinnā cet; tatkaraṇe sāmānyameva kṛtaṃ syāt, tathā cāsyā'nityatvam

tajjñānaṃ cet, kathamataḥ sāmānyasiddhiḥ anugatajñānasya vyaktibhya eva āvirbhāvāt ? tatsahāyasya asyāpi atra vyāpāraḥ ityapi śraddhāmātram; yato yadi ghaṭotpattau daṇḍādyupetakumbhakāravat vyaktyupetaṃ sāmānyamanugatajñānotpattau vyāpriyamāṇaṃ pratīyeta, syādetat, tacca na pratīyate tatkathaṃ tatsahāyasya asya tatra vyāpāra syāt ? na kiñcitkurvatyāśca vyañjakatve vijātīyavyakterapi vyañjakatvaprasaṅgaḥ

nanu vyaktīnāṃ yadi anugatamekaṃ sāmānyaṃ neṣyate tadā kathaṃ tatra anugatapratyayaḥ abhinnaśabdaniveśaśca syāt ? nahi ghaṭa-paṭādīnāṃ vibhinnasvabhāvānāmasau dṛṣṭa; ityapyasādhīyaḥ; sāmānyeṣu tadabhāve'pi sāmānyam sāmānyam ityanugatapratyayasya ekaśabdaniveśasya ca upalambhāt
na ca yadabhāve'pi yad bhavati tat tannibandhanam atiprasaṅgāt
atha sāmānyeṣu asau samavāyanivandhanaḥ; kuta etat ? tatra aparasāmānyā'pratīteścet; ki punaḥ khaṇḍādipu aparaṃ sāmānyaṃ pratīyate ? ata eva pratyayāt tatpratītau sāmānyeṣvapi pratīyatām
samavāyasya atra kāraṇatve ca khaṇḍādiṣvapi anugatapratyaye sa eva kāraṇamastu alaṃ sāmānyakalpanayā

yathaiva hi yenaiva samavāyena gotvaṃ khaṇḍādiṣu samavetaṃ tenaiva aśvatvaṃ karkādiṣu, ataḥ ekasamavāyavaśāt sāmānyepu sāmānyapratyayaḥ, tathā yenaiva samavāyena khaṇḍaḥ svāvayavepu vartate tenaiva muṇḍādirapi iti gauḥ gauḥ ityapi pratyayaḥ samavāyanibandhana eva syāt
kiñca, svayaṃ samānepu tat tatpratyayahetuḥ, asamāneṣu vā ? prathamapakṣe tata eva tadutpatteḥ sāmānyaṃ siddhopasthāyi
asamānepu ca tadutpattau karkādiṣvapi gotvād gopratyayotpattiḥ syāt, sarvagatatvena tasya samavāyasya ca sarvatra sadbhāvāt
kiñca, samānānāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānyam, samānatvañca teṣāṃ ki sāmānyasambandhāt, svabhāvādvā ? tatra ādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; nahi anena anye samānā bhavanti, tadvanto hi tathā syuḥ
svabhāvāt cet; tarhi tata eva evambhūtāṃ buddhiṃ te kariṣyanti ityalaṃ sāmānyaparikalpanayā
tannibandhanatve cāsyāḥ prathamamekavyaktidarśane'pi sā syāt, indriyasambandhā'viśeṣāt vyaktivat
atha dvitīyādivyaktigrahaṇamapi asyāḥ sāmagrī tataḥ prathamavyaktipratibhāse na pratibhāsaḥ; kathamevaṃ savikalpapratyayasyāsya anusandhānātmanaḥ pravṛttiḥ agṛhīte'rthe tadapravṛtteḥ ?
kiñca, idaṃ sāmānyaṃ vyaktibhyo bhinnam, abhinnaṃ vā ? yadyabhinnam; tarhi tadvadeva asya utpatti-vināśaprasaṅgaḥ
bhinnaṃ cet; tad vyaktyutpattau utpadyate, na vā ? yadyutpadyate; tadvadeva anityatvam
notpadyate cet; tad utpattipradeśe vidyate, na vā ? yadi vidyate, vyaktyutpatteḥ pūrvamapi gṛhyeta
vyaktyāśritatvānna tadabhāve grahaṇam ityapyasat; āśrayāśrayibhāvasya upakāryopakārakabhāve satyeva kuṇḍabadarādivat saṃbhavāt

badarāṇāṃ hi gurutvād adhaḥpatatāṃ tatpratibandhalakṣaṇopakārakartṛtvena kuṇḍam ādhāraḥ, sāmānyasya tu niṣkriyatvena patanā'bhāvānna kaścid ādhāraḥ saṃbhavati iti anāśritatvāt prāk ūrdhvamapi upalambhaḥ syāt
atha taddeśe tat nāsti, utpanne tu vyaktiviśepe vyaktyantarād āgacchati; nanu tataḥ tad āgacchat pūrvavyakti parityajya āgacchati, na vā ? prathama pakṣe tasyā tadrahitatvaprasaṅgaḥ
atha aparityajya; tatrāpi ki vyaktyā sahaiva āgacchati, ki vā kenacidaśena tatraiva tiṣṭhati kenacidāgacchati ? prathamavikalpe śābaleye'pi bāhuleyo'yam iti pratītiḥ syāt

dvitīyavikalpastvayuktaḥ; niraṃśatvena asya aṃśavattayā pravṛttyasaṃbhavāt, yatra hi yasya vṛttinibandhanaṃ nāsti sa na tatra varttate yathā ekaparamāṇuḥ sahya-vindhyayoḥ, nāsti ca bhinnadeśavyaktipu yugapadvṛttinibandhanaṃ sāmānyasya aṃśā iti
na yāti na ca tatrāsīdasti paścānna cāṃśavat

sarvagatatvāttasya yugapat sarvatra vṛttiḥ ityapi sarvasarvagatatvam, svavyaktisarvagatatvaṃ vā aṅgīkṛtya ucyeta ? sarvasarvagatatve khaṇḍādyantarāle karkādau ca gotvopalambhaprasaṅga, dṛśyasya sato'sya sarvatra sadbhāvā'viśeṣāt
svavyaktīnāṃ vyañjakatvāt tatraiva asya upalambha ityapi āsāṃ vyañjakatvaniṣedhāt kṛtottaram
svavyaktisarvagatatve'pi ki prativyakti sarvātmanā varttate, ekadeśena vā ? sarvātmanā vṛttau sarvavyaktīnāmekatvam, tasya vā vyaktivat nānātvaṃ syāt
prayogaḥ–yad yatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sat nopalabhyate tat tatra nāsti yathā kvaciddeśe ghaṭa, nopalabhyate ca indriyasambandhe satyapi piṇḍeṣu paraparikalpitaṃ sāmānyamiti
tanna vyaktibhyaḥ sarvathā bhinnasvarūpamapi sāmānyaṃ ghaṭate
nahi sāmānyaṃ tadādhāravyaktigatameka sabhavati vyaktyantarāle'pi tadupalambhaprasaṅgāt nyāyavi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 345 pū॰
vṛttiśca kṛtsnāśavikalpato na māna ca nānantasamāśrayasya

yadapi–gavādyabhidhānajñānaviśeṣā ityādyanumānaṃ tatsadbhāvā''vedakamuktam; tatrāpi piṇḍādivyatiriktaṃ nimittāntaramātraṃ sādhyate, sāmānyaṃ vā ? nimittāntaramātre siddhasādhanam, sadṛśapariṇāmasya nimittāntarasya iṣṭatvāt
nityādisvabhāvasāmānyasādhane tu sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasya, tatra sāmānyasya nimittāntarasyāsaṃbhavāt
yadvastvākāravilakṣaṇo yaḥ pratyayaḥ ityādyapyanumānam etaddūṣaṇairduṣṭatvānna sāmānyasadbhāvaprasādhakam
tadevaṃ paraparikalpitasāmānyasya kutaścit pramāṇādaprasiddheḥ tad dvividham ityādinā tadbhedopavarṇanaṃ vandhyāsutasaubhāgyavyāvarṇanatulyamityuparamyate
sāmānyapadārthaparīkṣāyā vijātīyavyāvṛttireva anuvṛttapratyayanibandhanam iti saugatamatanirasanapurassaraṃ tasya vāstavikasadṛśapariṇāmanibandhanatvaprasādhanam–
astu tarhi vijātīyavyāvṛttireva anuvṛttapratyayanibandhanam, nityaniraṃśaikarūpasāmānyasya uktaprakāreṇa tannibandhanatvā'saṃbhavāt
kathaṃ punaḥ sāmānyamantareṇa karkadiparihāreṇa khaṇḍādiṣveva gopratyayaprādurbhāvaḥ iti cet ? vijātīyavyāvṛtteḥ iti brūmaḥ, sā hi yatrāsti tatraiva tatpratyayamutpādayati nānyatra
nanu bāhyārthā'viṣayatve kathamataḥ pratyayāt tatra pravṛttiḥ ? ityapyacodyam; dṛśya-vikalpyayorekatvādhyavasāyāt tadupapatteḥ
ekatvādhyavasāyaśca darśanānantaramupajāyamānasya vikalpasya darśanena saha bhedā'grahaṇam
tato bhedā'grahaṇād vikalpavyāpāratiraskāreṇa mayā gṛhītamidam ityadhyavasāyāt pravarttate
samyaṅmithyāviveko'pi ata eva; yo hi vastusambandhadarśanabhāvī vikalpaḥ sa satyaḥ, anyo'nyathā iti
tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; nityādisvabhāvasāmānyasya tannibandhanatvā'bhāve'pi sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇasyāsya pratyakṣādipramāṇataḥ prasiddhasvarūpasya tannibandhanatvopapatteḥ
na khalu samānadharmayogitvasvarūpa sadṛśapariṇāmaḥ artheṣu pratyakṣato na pratīyate; sarvato vilakṣaṇasvalakṣaṇasya svapne'pyapratīteḥ
pratyayaprasādādeva hi sarvatra arthavyavasthā, pratyayaścātra vilakṣaṇeṣvapi śābaleyādiṣu gaurgauḥ ityanugatākāreṇa upalabhyate
na ca anyākāre'pi vastuni anyākāreṇa prathanam ityabhidhātavyam; nīle pītapratibhāsaprasaṅgataḥ pratiniyatavastuvyavasthāvilopaḥ syāt

vyāvṛttiviṣayatve cāsya gauḥ gauḥ ityullekhena vidhipradhānatayā pravṛttirna syāt, yathā ca vijātīyaparāvṛttaṃ vastunaḥ svarūpaṃ tathā sajātīyaparāvṛttamapi, tathā ca darśanānantarabhāvivikalpānāṃ vijātīyavyāvṛttyā kārollekhitve tadabhedāt sajātīyavyāvṛttyākārollekhitvamapi syāt
na ca sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttyoḥ svalakṣaṇasya ca bhedaḥ, vastutvāt niraṃśatvācca

kiñca, asamānākāravyāvṛttyā samānākāralakṣaṇaṃ sajātīyatvaṃ kalpyate, tatra ca svayamasamānākārasya samānatvaṃ kalpyeta, samānākārasya vā ? tatra svayamasamānākārasya kathamanyato vyāvṛttāvapi samānākāratā, gavāśvayorapi mahiṣyādivyāvṛttyā samānākāratvaprasaṅgāt ? mūrttācca ghaṭād yathā vyāvarttate jñānam tathā paṭo'pi, ato mūrttatva dvayo samāno dharmaḥ syāt
anyonyāśrayaśca–anyato vyāvṛttyā hi samānākāratvam, tataśca anyato vyāvṛttiriti
svayaṃ samānākārasya tu anyato vyāvṛttyā samānākāratvakalpanāvaiphalyam

sajātīyatvañca arthānām–ekārthakriyākāritvāt, ekapratyavamarśajanakatvāt, ekavyāvṛttyādhāratvādvā syāt ? na tāvad ekārthakriyākāritvāt; vāha-dohādikriyāyā prativiśeṣaṃ bhidyamānatvena ekatvā'saṃbhavāt, tasyāśca kādācitkatvāt tāmakurvataḥ sajātīyatvā'bhāvāt, cakṣusambaddhe'pi vyaktiviśepe gauḥ gauḥ ityanugatapratyayo na syāt
ekārthakriyākāritvañca yadi sarvasvalakṣaṇepu ekamanusyūtamabhyupagamyate, tadā siddhaṃ tadeva aśepaviśeṣaniṣṭhaṃ sāmānyam
vikalpāropitaṃ cet, na, tasya nirviṣayatvena arthā'gocaratvataḥ tatra svārthakriyākāritvasya ekatvena āropaṇā'sāmarthyāt

nāpi ekapratyavamarśajanakatvāt, pratyavamarśasya tajjanakatvasya ca prativyakti bhedena ekatvā'nupapatte, na khalu ya eva śāvaleye gopratyavamarśaḥ tajjanakatvañca, sa eva bāhuleye'pi tayoḥ ekavyaktivad bhedā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
tatra vyāvṛtterbāhyatve sakala vyakti vyāpitve ca sāmānyarūpatāprasaṅga
āntaratve tu tasyā vahirarthādhāratvā'bhāvata kathamato bāhyārthasya sajātīyatvasiddhi, kathaṃ vā bahīrūpatayā avabhāsanam ?

nāntarbahirvā ityapi svābhiprāyamātram; tathābhūtaṃ hi vyāvṛttisvarūpaṃ kiñcit, na kiñcidvā ? na kiñciccet; katha sajātīyatvanibandhanam ? kiñciccet, nūnam antarbahirvā tena bhavitavyam, tatra ca ukto doṣaḥ

nanu yayā pratyāsattyā kecana bhāvāḥ svayaṃ sadṛśapariṇāma bibhrati tayaiva svayamatadātmakā tathā kinnā'vabhāseran ? ityapyaparīkṣitābhidhānam; cetanetarabhedā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, yayaiva hi pratyāsattyā cetanetarasvabhāvān bhāvāḥ svīkurvanti tayaiva svayamatadātmakāḥ tathā'vabhāseran ityapi vadato brahmādvaitavādino na vaktraṃ vakrībhavet
nīlasukhādivyatiriktasya asya asattvāt kathaṃ tathā'vabhāsanam ? ityanyatrāpi samānam, nahi sadṛśetarapariṇāmarahitaṃ svalakṣaṇamapyasti yat tathā'vabhāseta
na caikasya anekātmakatvavirodhānna sadṛśetarātmakatvam; citrākāravat vikalpetarākāravacca ekasya tadātmakatvā'virodhāt
tataḥ sadṛśetarātmakatvaṃ vastuno vāstavamabhyupagantavyam, purovyavasthitasya khaṇḍādyarthasya tathaiva pratibhāsanāt
na khalu jñānajñeyayorapi cetanetararūpatayā vailakṣaṇyapratītireva; nīlasadādinā sādṛśyasyāpi pratīteḥ, anyathā tayoranyataradeva sat syāt, sārūpyavādaśca hīyeta
nāntarna bahiriti tu bhaṇitibhaṅgimātram, tattādṛśaṃ kiñcit na kiñcidvā kiñciccet nūnamantarbahirvā tena bhavitavyameva
na ca anuvṛttapratīternirhetukatvāt ki sadṛśapariṇāmādikāraṇacintayā ityabhidhātavyam; nirhetukatve tasyā deśādiniyamā'yogāt
vāsanāhetukatve ca arthāpekṣā na syāt, nahi anyahetuko'rthaḥ anyadapekṣate dhūmāderjalāpekṣāprasaṅgāt
kiñca, vāsanā'pi anubhūtārthaviṣayaiva upajāyate, na ca atyantā'sattvena bhavanmate sāmānyānubhavasaṃbhavaḥ
kiñca, asau tathābhūtaṃ pratyayaṃ viṣayatayā utpādayati, kāraṇamātratayā vā ? yadi viṣayatayā; tadā sakalaviśeṣānugatā vastubhūtā grāhyākārā nāmāntareṇa jātireva uktā
kāraṇamātratayā ca tajjanane viṣayo vaktavyaḥ, nirviṣayasya jñānasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
na ca sadṛśapariṇāmavyatirekeṇa anyaḥ tadviṣayo ghaṭate; uktadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt

na cāsya vāsanāprabhavatve pramāṇamasti, yena hi pramāṇena vāsanāyā vikalpaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ pratīyate tasyāpi vikalparūpatayā bāhyārthaviṣayatvā'saṃbhavataḥ vāsanāprabhavo'yaṃ vikalpaḥ ityavagantumaśakyatvāt
nanu tannimittatve sadṛśo'yam iti pratyayaḥ syāt, na punaḥ sa evā'yaṃ gauḥ iti
kasya punaḥ sa evā'yaṃ gauḥ iti pratyayaḥ ? nahi dhavalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śabalaṃ paśyataḥ sa evā'yaṃ dhavalo gauḥ iti pratyayaḥ prādurbhavati, aviparyastasya śabale dhavalapratītivirodhāt

ki tarhi ? gauḥ gauḥ iti pratyayaḥ, so'pyaviruddhaḥ katham ? iti cet; sadṛśapariṇāmaviśeṣe gośabdasaṅketāt, sakalasamānadharmeṣu hi sadṛśaśabdasaṅketāt tatpradhānatayā sadṛśo'yam iti pratyayaḥ pravarttate, tadviśeṣeṣu punaḥ gavāśvādiviśeṣaśabdasaṅketāt tatpradhānatayā gauḥ aśvaḥ ityādipratyayāḥ

kathamanyathā sāmānyeṣu sāmānyam sāmānyam iti pratyayaḥ ṣaṭpadārtheṣu vā padārthaḥ padārthaḥ iti ? nahi sāmānyeṣu anugatasvabhāvasvarūpaṃ ṣaṭpadārtheṣu ca atyantavibhinnalakṣaṇalakṣitatvalakṣaṇañca sadṛśapariṇāmaṃ vihāya anyannimittāntaramasti
pravṛttiśca dṛśya-vikalpyayorekatvādhyavasāyāt; ityapi śraddhāmātram; tadekatvādhyavasāyasya savikalpakasiddhau nirastatvāt
nāpi viśeṣapadārtha; tatrāpi anavadyalakṣaṇasya grāhakapramāṇasya cāsaṃbhavāt
sāmānyapadārthasya vividhabhaṅgajālena khaṇḍana citsukhyā pṛ॰ 190 draṣṭavyam
nityadravyavṛttayo'ntyā viśeṣā, te ca tulyajātiguṇakriyādhāreṣu nityadravyeṣu atyantavyāvṛttibuddhihetava iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu viśeṣāṇāṃ tāvat lakṣaṇamanavadyaṃ vidyata eva; tathāhi–nityadravyavṛttayo'ntyā viśeṣāḥ
nahi tulyajāti-guṇa-kriyādhārāṇāṃ nityadravyāṇāmatyantavyāvṛttabuddhihetubhūtān viśeṣān vihāya anyat tadvyāvṛttibuddhernivandhanaṃ bhavitumarhati
tathā antyā; paramāṇūnāṃ hi jagadvināśa-ārambhakoṭibhūtatvāt, muktātmanāṃ muktamanasāñca saṃsāraparyantarūpatvād antatvam, teṣu bhavā antyā iti, teṣu sphuṭataramālakṣyamāṇatvāt
vṛttistu eṣāṃ sarvasminneva paramāṇvādau nityadravye vidyate, ata eva nityadravyavṛttayaḥ, antyāḥ iti ubhayapadopādānam
te ca parasparamatyantavyāvṛttabuddhihetutvāt svāśrayamanyato viśeṣayantīti viśeṣāḥ ityucyante

te ca anantāḥ svāśrayavannityā yogināṃ pratyakṣā, asmadādīnā tu anumeyā; tathāhi–tulyajātiguṇakriyādhārā paramāṇava vyāvarttakadharmasambandhina vyāvṛttapratyayaviṣayatvāt muktāphalarāśyantargatakṛtacihnamuktāphalavat
na cedamasiddham, tathāhi–paramāṇava vyāvṛttapratyayaviṣayāḥ sattāsambandhitvāt badarāmalakavat
ato na grāhakapramāṇā'bhāvādapi amīṣāmabhāvaḥ siddhyati, pratyakṣā'numānayostadgrāhakayoḥ pratipāditatvāditi
etatsarva viśeṣapadārthavivaraṇaṃ praśa॰ bhāṣye pṛ॰ 311-12 draṣṭavyam

yattāvaduktam–nityadravya ityādi viśeṣāṇāṃ lakṣaṇam, tadasamīcīnam, yataḥ tadāśrayadravyāṇāṃ sarvathā nityatvam, kathañcid vā abhipretam ? prathamapakṣe lakṣaṇasya asaṃbhavadoṣaduṣṭatā; nahi sarvathā nityaṃ kiñcid dravyamasti, tasya dravyaparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake pratikṣiptatvāt

antyatvamapi eṣāmasaṃbhavi eva asiddhatvāt, na khalu sato jagataḥ mahāpralayasvabhāvaḥ sarvathā vināśa, sarvathā'sataśca punarutpatti kutaścit pramāṇāt prasiddhā, yataḥ paramāṇūnāṃ jagadvināśārambhakoṭibhūtatvād antatvam, tadbhavatvena ca viśeṣāṇāmantyatvaṃ syāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu ativyāptirlakṣaṇadoṣaḥ, tulyajā tyādyādhārāṇāṃ muktāphalādīnāmatyantavyāvṛttibuddhihetau cihne'viśeṣarūpe'pi asya lakṣaṇasya gatatvāt
nahi tadāśrayadravyasya kathañcinnityatvamasiddham; sarvasya vastuno dravyarūpatayā nityatvāt
astu vā sarvathā nityaṃ dravyam; tathāpi ye tatra varttante te na kadācanā'pi nityadravyaṃ parityajanti
teṣāṃ viśeṣarūpatve ātmatvādisāmānyaiḥ pārimāṇḍalyādibhiśca vyabhicāraḥ; tānyapi hi nityadravyeṣveva varttante na ca viśeṣavyapadeśaṃ pratipadyante

nanu samastanityadravyeṣveva varttamānānāṃ viśeṣarūpatvapratijñānāt, ātmatvādīnāñca niyatanityadravyavṛttitvāt na tairanekāntaḥ; ityapyayuktameva; niratiśayaparimāṇena anekāntāt, taddhi samasteṣveva nityadravyeṣu varttate, viśeṣaṇatvācca svāśrayamanyasmād vyāvarttayati na ca viśeṣarūpamiti
ye puna kalpitā ete viśeṣā antyabhāvina
kiñca, arthānāṃ svasvabhāvādeva anyonyavyāvṛttabuddhijanakatvopapatternaviśeṣaiḥ sādhyaṃ kiñcit prayojanam

nityadravyāṇi hi svarūpeṇa vyāvṛttāni viśeṣairvyāvarttante, avyāvṛttāni vā ? yadi avyāvṛttāni; kathamanyasambandhādapi vyāvṛttatāmanubhaveyuḥ ? yaddhi svarūpeṇā'vyāvṛttaṃ tat nānyasambandhe'pi vyāvṛttatāmanubhavati yathā ekavyaktisvarūpam, svarūpeṇā'vyāvṛttāni ca nityadravyāṇi iti
atha vyāvṛttāni; tadā kiṃ viśeṣaiḥ sādhyam ? yat svarūpeṇa vyāvṛttaṃ na tatra vyāvṛttihetavo vyatiriktaviśeṣāḥ santi yathā viśeṣasvarūpe, svarūpato vyāvṛttāni ca nityadravyāṇi iti
svarūpeṇa vyāvṛttānāmapi amīṣāṃ tatkalpane viśeṣāṇāmapi svarūpato vyāvṛttānāṃ viśeṣāntarakalpanāprasaṅgādanavasthā syāt
atha arthavyāvṛttyā viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāvṛttiḥ tadvyāvṛttyā ca arthānām; tadapyasāmpratam; anyo'nyāśrayā'nuṣaṅgāt

nanu yathā pradīpādīnāṃ svata eva bhāsurarūpatā tatsvabhāvatvāt na ghaṭādisambandhāt, ghaṭādīnāṃ tu tatsambandhāt, evaṃ viśeṣeṣu svata eva vyāvṛttapratyayahetutvaṃ tatsvabhāvatvāt na paramāṇvādisambandhāt, paramāṇvādau tu tadyogāt; ityapyasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; yataḥ pradīpādisambandhād ghaṭādayo bhāvāḥ parityaktaprāktana-abhāsurasvabhāvā anye eva bhāsurarūpatayā utpadyante, iti yuktaṃ teṣāṃ tatsambandhād bhāsurarūpatvam; na ca paramāṇvādiṣu etat saṃbhavati teṣāṃ sarvathā nityatvā'bhyupagamataḥ prāktana-aviviktarūpatyāgena aparaviviktarūpatayā'nutpatteḥ

nanu para māṇvādau aviviktarūpasyaivā'sabhavāt kasya parityāgena te viviktarūpāḥ syuḥ, nityaikarūpāṇāṃ teṣāṃ sarvadā viśeṣapadārthā''liṅgitatvena sadā viviktarūpasyaiva saṃbhavāt ? ityapi śraddhāmātram; nityaikarūpatvasya paramāṇuvicārā'vasare nirākṛtatvāt
iha atadātmakeṣvanyanimittaḥ pratyayo bhavati yathā ghaṭādiṣu pradīpāt na tu pradīpe pradīpāntarāt

yadapyabhihitam–te ca yogināṃ pratyakṣāḥ ityādi, tadapyasāmpratam; yato'ṇvādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ svabhāvata parasparā'saṅkīrṇam, saṅkīrṇa vā ? prathamapakṣe kathamato viśepasiddhiḥ, parasparā'saṅkīrṇa-aṇvādisvarūpādeva yogināṃ tatra vailakṣaṇyapratītiprasiddheḥ ? dvitīyapakṣe tu tatpratyayasya bhrāntatāprasaṅgaḥ, svarūpato'nyonyamavyāvṛttasvarūpepu aṇvādipu vyāvṛttākāratayā pravarttamānasya asya atasmistadgraharūpatvāt, tathā ca etatpratyayayoginaste ayogina eva syuḥ
svarūpato'vyāvṛttānāmapyepāṃ viśepākhyapadārthavaśāt vyāvṛttānāṃ grahaṇāt nāyogitvaṃ teṣām; ityapyanupapannam; svarūpeṇa vyāvṛtteṣu avyāvṛtteṣu vā viśeṣāṇāṃ vyāvarttakatvapratiṣedhāt

anumānabādhitaśca vyatiriktaviśeṣebhyaḥ tatpratyayaprādurbhāvaḥ; tathāhi–vivādāpanneṣu bhāveṣu vilakṣaṇapratyayaḥ tadvyatiriktaviśeṣanibandhano na bhavati, vilakṣaṇapratyayatvāt, viśeṣeṣu vilakṣaṇapratyayavaditi
vilakṣaṇapratyaya tadvyatiriktaviśeṣanibandhano na bhavati prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 182 u॰
yadapi tulyajātiguṇakriyādhārā ityādyanumānamuktam, tatra aṇūnāṃ vyāvarttakadharmasambandhitvamātrasādhane siddhasādhanam, vyatiriktaviśeṣasambandhitvasādhane tu prāguktā'śeṣadopā'nuṣaṅga iti
ayutasiddhānām ityādilakṣaṇalakṣita sambandha samavāya, sa ca eko nityaśca' iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu ca ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānām ihedampratyayaheturya sambandhaḥ sa samavāya ityanavadyatallakṣaṇasadbhāvāt tadabhāvo'siddhaḥ
na ca iha grāme vṛkṣā iti ihedampratyayahetunā antarālā'bhāvena anekānta; sambandhagrahaṇāt
nāpi iha ākāśe śakuniḥ iti pratyayahetunā saṃyogena; ādhārādheyabhūtānām ityukteḥ, nahi ākāśasya vyāpitvena adhastādeva bhāvo'sti; śakuneḥ uparyapi bhāvāt
nāpi iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti pratyayahetunā; ayutasiddhā nām ityabhidhānāt, dadhikuṇḍādayaśca yutasiddhāḥ
na cāsau tantupaṭādipu asti tantūn vihāya paṭasya anyatrā'vṛtteḥ

na ca iha ākāśe vācye vācakaḥ ākāśaśabdaḥ iti vācyavācakabhāvena iha ātmani jñānam iti viṣaya-viṣayibhāvena ca vyabhicāraḥ, atra ayutasiddheḥ ādhārādheyabhāvasya ca bhāvādityabhidhātavyam; ubhayatra avadhāraṇāśrayaṇāt, anayośca yutasiddheṣu anādhārādheyabhūteṣvapi ca bhāvāt ghaṭa-tacchabda-jñānavat
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānā ya sambandha ihapratyayahetu sa samavāyaḥ

ihapratyayahetutvamantarālādarśanasyāpi iti sambandhagrahaṇam, tathāhi–dūrād grāmārāmayo antarālamapaśyatām iha grāme vṛkṣāḥ iti jñānaṃ dṛṣṭam ityādi sarva padakṛtyam praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 107-108, kandalī pṛ॰ 14
pūrvapakṣarūpeṇa ca āptaparī॰ pṛ॰ 26, prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 182 u॰

nanveṣam ayutasiddhānāmeva ityavadhāraṇe'pi vyabhicārā'bhāvāt ādhārādheyabhūtānām ityabhidhānamanardhakam, ādhārādheyabhūtānāmeva ityavadhāraṇe ayutasiddhānām ityabhidhānavat; ityapyasundaram; ekārthasamavāyināṃ rūparasādīnāmayutasiddhānāmapi anyonyaṃ samavāyā'saṃbhavāt iti ekārthasamavāyasambandhavyabhicāranivṛttyartham uttarāvadhāraṇam, nahi ayaṃ vācyavācakabhāvādivad yutasiddhānāmapi saṃbhavati
tathā uttarāvadhāraṇe satyapi ādhārādheyabhāvena saṃyogaviśeṣeṇa sarvathā'nādhārādheyabhūtānāmasaṃbhavatā vyabhicāro mābhūta ityevamarthaṃ pūrvā'adhāraṇam

ata idamucyate–tantupaṭādayaḥ sāmānyatadvadādayo vā saṃyuktā na bhavanti iti vyavaharttasyam, niyamena ayutasiddhatvād adhārādheyabhūtatvācca, ye tu saṃyuktā na te tathā yathā kuṇḍavadarādayaḥ, tathā caite, tasmāt saṃyogino na bhavanti iti
yadi vā, tantupaṭādisambandhaḥ saṃyogo na bhavati, niyagena ayutasiddhasambandhatvāt, jñāna-ātmanorviṣayaviṣayibhāvavaditi
sadbhāve tu samavāyasya pratyakṣameva pramāṇam; patyakṣato hi tantusambaddha eva paṭaḥ pratibhāsate rūpādayaśca paṭādirāmbaddhāḥ

avayavāvayavino guṇaguṇinau kriyākiyāvantau jātijātigantau ca mitha sambaddhāvanubhūyeteḥ nānyathā tantuṣu paṭa iti śuklaḥ paṭa iti paṭaḥ prarapandata iti ca paṭo dravyamiti ca buddhivyapadeśau syātām
tathā anumānato'pi asau pratīyate; tathāhi–iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādi ihapratyayaḥ sambandhakāryaḥ, abādhyamāna-ihapatyayatvāt, iha kuṇḍe dadhi ityādipratyayavat
nāpi tantuhetukaḥ paṭahetuko vā; tantavaḥ, paṭaḥ iti vā pratyayaprasaṅgāt
pūrvajñānasya tatkāraṇatve tadapi kuta syāt ? tatpūrvavāsanātaścet; anavasthā
jñānavāsanayoḥ anāditvād ayamadopaścet; naivam, nīlādi-santānāntara-svasantāna-saṃvidadvaitādisiddherapi abhāvā'nupaṅgāt, anādivāsanāvaśādeva nīlādipratyayasya svato'vabhāsasya ca saṃbhavāt
nāpi tādātmyahetuko'yam, tādātmya hi ekatvamucyate, tatra ca sambandhā'bhāva eva syāt dviṣṭhatvāttasya
nāpi sayogahetuka, yutasiddheṣveva artheṣu saṃyogasya saṃbhavāt
na cātra samavāyapūrvakatva sādhyate yena dṛṣṭānta sādhyavikala hetuśca viruddha syāt, nāpi saṃyogapūrvakatvaṃ yena abhyupagamavirodhaḥ syāt
ki tarhi ? sambandhamātrapūrvakatvam, tasmiśca siddhe pariśeṣāt samavāya eva tajjanaka setsyati
veśeṣikamate tu atīndriyaḥ anumeyaśca; tathāhi–ata evātīndriyatasmādihabuddhyanumeyaḥ samavāya iti
iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādi ihapatyayaḥ sambandhakāryaḥ, abādhyamānehapatyayatvāt, iha kuṇḍe dadhīti patyayavat
na cātra samavāyapūrvakatva sādhyate sādhyavikalatāprasaṅgāt, nāpi sayogapūrvakatvam, kiṃ tarhi sambandhamātrakāryatvam
yacca idam–vivādāspadam idamiha iti jñānaṃ na samavāyapūrvakam abādhita-ihajñānatvāt iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti jñānavat iti viśepaviruddhānumānam, tat sakalānumānocchedakatvād anumānavādinā na prayoktavyam

yaccocyate–idam iheti jñānaṃ na samavāyālambanam; tatsatyam; viśiṣṭādhāraviṣayatvāttasya, nahi iha tantuṣu paṭa ityādi ihapratyayaḥ kevalaṃ samavāyamālambate tadviśiṣṭatantupaṭālambanatvāt, vaiśiṣṭyañcānayo sambandha
na cāsya sayogavannānātvam; iheti pratyayā'viśepāt viśepaliṅgā'bhāvācca satpratyayā'viśeṣāt talliṅgā'bhāvācca sattāvat
na ca sambandhatvameva viśepaliṅgam, asya anyathāsiddhatvāt, nahi saṃyogasya sambandhatvena nānātvaṃ sādhyate api tu pratyakṣeṇa bhinnāśrayasamavetasya krameṇa utpādopalabdheḥ
samavāyasya ca anekatve sati anugatapratyayotpattirna syāt, saṃyoge tu saṃyogatvabalāt nānātve'pi syāt
na caitat samavāye saṃbhavati, samavāyatvasya samavāye samavāyā'saṃbhavāt, anyathā anavasthā syāt
saṃyogasya ca guṇatvena dravyeṣveva saṃbhavāt, saṃyogatva punaḥ sayoge samavetam
na ca anugatapratyayajanakatve sāmānyādasya abheda; bhinnalakṣaṇayogitvāt
na ca sayogavannānātva bhāvavat liṅgāviśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgābhāvācca
tasmād bhāvavat sarvatra eka samavāya iti
yaccānyat samavāye bādhakamucyate–'niṣpannayoḥ aniṣpannayorvā samavāyaḥ syāt ? na tāvadaniṣpannayoḥ, sambandhinoranutpāde sambandhā'saṃbhavāt
tathā svasambandhibhyāmasau sambaddhaḥ, asambaddho vā ? na tāvadasambaddhaḥ, tayorayaṃ sambandhaḥ iti vyapadeśā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
sambaddhaścet; ki svataḥ, parato vā ? na tāvat svataḥ; saṃyogādīnāmapi tathā tatprasaṅgāt
na ca guṇādīnāmādheyatvaṃ yuktam; niṣkriyatvāt, gatipratibandhakaśca ādhāraḥ jalāderghaṭādivaditi
tadapyuktimātram; yato na niṣpannā'niṣpannayorvā samavāyaḥ; svakāraṇasattāsambandhasyaiva niṣpattitvāt, nahi niṣpattiranyā samavāyaścānyaḥ yena paurvāparyyaṃ syāt
nāpi samavāyasya sambandhāntareṇa sambandhaḥ yena anavasthā syāt; sambandhasya samānalakṣaṇasambandhena sambaddhasya kvacidadṛṣṭeḥ
atha niṣpannayo sambandha samavāya tarhi yutasiddhi syāt
avibhāgino vṛttyātmakasya samavāyasya nānyā vṛttirasti tasmāt svātmavṛtti
eva asya sambandho yuktaḥ svata eva sambandharūpatvāt, na saṃyogādīnāṃ tadabhāvāt
na hi ekasya svabhāvo'nyasyāpi, anyathā svato'gneruṣṇatvadarśanāt jalādīnāmapi svata eva tat syāt

prayogaḥ–samavāyaḥ sambandhāntaraṃ nāpekṣate svataḥ sambandhatvāt, ye tu sambandhāntaramapekṣante na te svataḥsambandhāḥ yathā ghaṭādayaḥ, na cā'yaṃ na svataḥ sambandhaḥ, tasmāt sambandhāntaraṃ nāpekṣate iti
yaccoktam–niṣkriyatvāt teṣāmanādheyatvam iti; tadasat; saṃyogidravyavilakṣaṇatvād guṇādīnām, saṃyogināṃ sakriyatvenaiva, teṣāṃ niṣkriyatve'pi ādhārādheyabhāvasyādhyakṣeṇa pratīteśca iti
yattāvaduktam–ayutasiddhānām ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; samavāyināmasaṃbhave samavāye etallakṣaṇalakṣitatvā'nupapatteḥ, tadasaṃbhavaśca prāgeva pratipāditaḥ

dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣarūpā hi pañca padārthāḥ samavāyitvena bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitāḥ, te ca tatparīkṣāvasare prapañcataḥ pratikṣiptāḥ, tatkatham ayutasiddhatvādilakṣaṇasaṃbhavaḥ yatastallakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ padārthāntaraṃ siddhyet ? kiñca, idamayutasiddhatvaṃ śāstrīyam, laukikaṃ vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; tantupaṭādīnāṃ śāstrīyā'yutasiddhatvasyāsaṃbhavāt

vaiśeṣikaśāstre hi prasiddham–apṛthagāśrayavṛttitvam ayutasiddhatvam, tacca iha nāstyeva; tantūnāṃ svāvayavāṃ'śuṣu vṛtteḥ paṭasya ca tantuṣu iti pṛthagāśrayavṛttitvasiddheḥ apṛthagāśrayavṛttitvamasadeva
lokaprasiddhaikabhājanavṛttirūpaṃ tu ayutasiddhatvaṃ yutasiddhayordugdhā'mbhasorapyasti iti kathaṃ tallakṣaṇam ?
yutasiddhiḥ pṛthagavasthitiḥ ubhayorapi sambandhino parasparaparihāreṇa pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ sā yayornāsti tāvayutasiddhau

nanu yathā kuṇḍadadhyavayavākhyau pṛthagbhūtau dvau āśrayau, dvau ca dadhikuṇḍāvayavyākhyau āśra yiṇau na tathā tantupaṭādiṣu, tantoreva svāvayavāpekṣayā āśrayitvāt paṭāpekṣayā ca āśrayatvāt, ataḥ pṛthagāśrayavṛttitvaṃ yutasiddhi ityasya yutasiddhilakṣaṇasya abhāvādayutasiddhatvaṃ teṣām, ityapyasat, dik-kāla-ākāśa-ātmanāṃ yutasiddhyabhāvaprasaṅgāt teṣāṃ pṛthagāśrayā''śrayitvā'bhāvāt
nityānāṃ ca pṛthaggatimattvam ityapi tallakṣaṇaṃ tatra asambhāvyam; vyāpitayā anyatarapṛthaggatimattvasya ubhayapṛthaggatimattvasya vā tepāmasaṃbhavāt
itaretarāśrayaśca–samavāyasiddhau hi pṛthagāśrayasamavāyitvalakṣaṇā yutasiddhi siddhyet, tatsiddhau ca tanniṣedhena ayutasiddhānāṃ samavāyaḥ siddhyatīti
nanu lakṣaṇaṃ vidyamānasya anyato bhedena avasthāpakam, na tu sadbhāvakārakam, tenā'yamadoṣa; tadayuktam; jñāpakapakṣe sutarāmitaretarāśrayaprasakteḥ
tathāhi–nā'jñātāyāṃ yutasiddhau tatpratiṣedhena ayutasiddhānāṃ samavāyo jñātuṃ śakyate, ajñātaścāsau na pṛthagāśrayasamavāyitvalakṣaṇāṃ yutasiddhimavasthāpayitumutsahate iti
na ca pramāṇato'prasiddhasya asya lakṣaṇamātrāt siddhiryuktā; yat pramāṇato'prasiddham na tasya tanmātrāt siddhi yathā ātmā'dvaitāde, pramāṇato'prasiddhaśca bhavatkalpitaḥ samavāya iti
siddhe hi kutaścit lakṣyasadbhāve tadanusāri lakṣaṇaṃ pratīyate na punarlakṣaṇabalādeva tatsiddhiḥ; sarvasya sveṣṭatattvasiddhiprasaṅgāt, tanmātrapraṇayanasya sarvatra sulabhatvāt
anyonyāśrayaśca–siddhe hi samavāye tasya idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ siddhyet, tatsiddhau ca samavāyasiddhiriti
sā puna dvayoranyatarasya vā pṛthaggatimattvam iyaṃ tu nityānām
ityapi na vibhudravyeṣu sabhavati, taddhi pṛthaggatimattvaṃ dvidhā
atra kecidasaddūṣaṇamudbhāvayanti–samavāyā'siddhau yuteṣvāśrayeṣu samavāyo na yutasiddhi tadetadasaddūṣaṇam; lakṣaṇasya vidyamānavyavacchedakatvāt
yadi hi avidyamānaṃ lakṣaṇena utpādyeta bhavedetad dūṣaṇam na caitat lakṣaṇasya jñāpakatvāt iti

kiñca, yutasiddherabhāva ayutasiddhiḥ, siddhiśabdena cātra ki jñāpti, utpattirvā abhipretā ? yadi jñapti, tadā sāmānyatadvadādīnāmapi yutasiddhiprasaṅga, anuvṛttavyāvṛttādirūpatayā teṣāmanyonyaṃ pṛthageva svarūpasaṃvedanasaṃbhavāt
atha utpatti; tadā na yutasiddhiḥ ayutasiddhi, apṛthagutpatti ityāyātam, tadapi jāternityatvā'bhyupagamād durghaṭam

atha yutasiddherabhāvamātramayutasiddhi, sā ca jātāvasti tenāyamadoṣa; na; ittham ākāśādīnāmapi ayutasiddhiḥ syāt, tathā utpanne paṭe rūpādayaḥ pṛthageva utpadyante, siddheṣu ca pṛthak tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityato'trāpi yutasiddhatvaṃ syāt
tatpunarayutasiddhatvamapṛthagdeśatva vā, apṛthakkālatvaṃ vā, apṛthaksvabhāvatva vā ? sarvathāpi nopapadyate

kiñca, iyamayutasiddhiḥ abhinnadeśāśrayatvena, abhinnakālāśrayatvena, abhinnadharmyāśrayatvena, abhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvena, abhinnasvarūpatvena vā syāt ? na tāvad abhinnadeśāśrayatvena; asiddhatvāt, nahi ya eva tantūnāṃ deśāḥ ta eva paṭasyāpi, tantavo hi svāṃśupu sthitāḥ paṭastu teṣu iti
nāpi abhinnakālatvena; ata eva, nahi ya eva tantūnāṃ kālaḥ sa eva paṭasyāpi, pratītivirodhāt

kāryakāraṇabhāvā'bhāvaprasaṅgācca; kāraṇena hi kāryasya samakālatvamanyataḥ siddhasya syāt, siddhecāsmin ki kurvat tat kāraṇaṃ syāt ? nāpi abhinnadharmyāśrayatvena; asya atrā'saṃbhavāt, nahi avayava-avayavyādīnāṃ kvacidekasmin dharmiṇi āśritatvamasti, pratītivirodhād apasiddhāntaprasaṅgācca
abhinnadeśe vṛttiḥ, abhinnakālatā, abhinnadharmitā, abhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvam, abhinnasvarūpatvaṃ vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 965

abhinnasvarūpatve tu anayoḥ kasya kimapekṣā ayutasiddhiḥ kutra vā kasya samavāyaḥ syāt ? abhinnasvarūpatvañca anyasya anyasvarūpāpattiḥ, ekalolībhāvena ātmalābho vā ? prathamapakṣe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, na khalu jātyādervyaktyādisvarūpāpattiḥ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate
ekadravyāśrayāṇāṃ rūparasādīnāmapi ca evaṃvidhā'yutasiddhisaṃbhavād anyonyaṃ samavāyaprasaṅgaḥ
teṣāmāśrayāśrayibhāvā'bhāvāt na tatprasaṅgaḥ; ityapyacāru; tathāpariṇativyatirekeṇa anyasya āśrayāśrayibhāvasya tantupaṭādāvapyasaṃbhavāt, tadanyasya asya pṛthaksiddheṣu kuṇḍabadarādiṣveva saṃbhavāt

yadapyuktam–ubhayatra avadhāraṇāśrayaṇāt ityādi; tadapyayuktam; ubhayatra avadhāraṇāśrayaṇe'pi vipakṣaikadeśavṛtterlakṣaṇasya vyabhicāritvāt, iṣṭañca vipakṣaikadeśādavyāvṛttasya sarvairapi anaikāntikatvam, śabdasya prayatnānantarīyakatve sādhye nityatvavat
yaccoktam–tantupaṭādayaḥ saṃyogino na bhavanti ityādi; tatsatyam; tatra tādātmyopagamāt
yat punaruktam–pratyakṣata eva samavāyaḥ pratīyate ityādi; tadapi śraddhāmātram; tadasādhāraṇasvarūpā'vyavasthiteḥ, sthite hi ghaṭādīnāmasādhāraṇe svarūpe pratyakṣatā siddhā, na cāsya tatsiddham
taddhi kimayutasiddhasambandhatvam, sambandhatvamātraṃ vā syāt ? na tāvadayutasiddhasambandhatvam; uktaprakāreṇa asya avyavasthiteḥ
na ca ekasya sāmānyātmakaṃ svarūpaṃ yuktam; samānānāmabhāve sāmānyasyā'saṃbhavāt gagane gaganatvavat
nāpi sambandhatvamātraṃ samavāyasya asādhāraṇaṃ svarūpam; saṃyogādāvapi saṃbhavāt

kiñca, tadrūpatayā asau sambandhabuddhau pratibhāsate, ihedam ityanubhave, samavāyaḥ iti pratyaye vā ? tatra ādyavikalpe ko'yaṃ sambandho nāma yadbuddhau asau pratibhāseta–kiṃ sambandhatvajātiyukta sambandhaḥ, anekopādānajanitaḥ, anekāśrita, sambandhabuddhyutpādakaḥ, tadbuddhiviṣayo vā ? na tāvat sambandhatvajātiyuktaḥ, samavāyasya asambandhatvaprasaṅgāt, samavāyāntarā'sattvena atra sambandhatvajāterapravarttanāt
atha saṃyogavad anekopādānajanita; tarhi samavāyasya asambandhatvaprasaṅga tasya nityatvā'bhyupagamata tadasaṃbhavāt, paṭādeśca tatprasaṅga tatsaṃbhavāt
nāpi sambandhabuddhiviṣaya, sambandha-sambandhinoḥ ekajñānaviṣayatve sambandhino'pi tadrūpatā'nupaṅgāt, na ca prativiṣayaṃ jñānabhedaḥ mecakajñānā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
kiṃ sambandhabuddhyā'dhyavasīyate, ahosvidihabuddhyā, samavāyavuddhyā vā ? tattvopa॰ pṛ॰ 10
kiṃ sambandhajātiyukta sambandhaḥ, āhosvidanekopādānajanita, anekāśrito vā, sambandhabuddhiviśeṣo vā, sambandhabuddhyutpādako vā, sambandhākāro vā ? tattvopa॰ pṛ॰ 10
atha ihedam iti anubhave samavāya pratibhāsate; na, asya ādhārādheyabhāvalakṣaṇasambandhākārollekhitvāt, na ca anyākāre'rthe pratīyamāne anyākāro'rthaḥ kalpayituṃ yukta atiprasaṅgāt
atha kuṇḍabadarādau tatsambandhaḥ sambandhāntarapūrvako dṛṣṭa, ataḥ avayavaavayavyādāvapi asau sambandhāntarapūrvaka eva siddhyati iti samavāyasiddhi
nanvevam anavasthā syāt; dadhikuṇḍādisambandhasya sambandhāntarāt tatparatantratopalambhād avayavā'vayavyādisambandhasyāpi tadantarāt tatparatantratāprasaṅgāt
atha samavāyabuddhyā asau pratīyate; tanna; tadbuddhe kasyacidapi asaṃbhavāt, na hi ete tantavaḥ, ayaṃ paṭa, ayaṃ ca samavāya iti tritayamanyonyaviviktaṃ kasyacit svapne'pi pratibhāsate
ayaṃ tantu, ayaṃ paṭa, ayamanayo samavāya iti na jātu jānate janā
na dharmadharmitvamatīva bhede vṛttyāsti cenna tritayaṃ cakāsti
ihedamityasti matiśca vṛttau na gauṇabhedo'pi ca lokabādha
nahi tasya pratyakṣāt pratipatti paṭatantuvyatirekeṇa tadanirṇayāt
yacca iha tantuṣu paṭa ityādi tatsadbhāvāvedakamanumānamuktam, tadapyasāmpratam; anekadoṣaduṣṭatvāt
tathāhi–tāvad āśrayā'siddho'tra hetuḥ; tadasiddhatvañca iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayasya dharmiṇo'siddhatvāt
aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaścāyam; paṭe tantavaḥ, vṛkṣe śākhāḥ ityādirūpatayā pratīyamānapratyayena iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ ityādipratyayasya bādhyamānatvāt
svarūpā'siddhaśca; tantu-paṭapratyaye ihapratyayatvasya anubhavā'bhāvāt paṭo'yam ityādirūpatayā asya anubhavāt
anaikāntikaścāyam; iha prāgabhāve'nāditvam, iha pradhvaṃsā'bhāve pradhvaṃsā'bhāvā'bhāvaḥ iti abādhyamāna-ihapratyayasya sambandhapūrvakatvā'bhāvāt
na ca atra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ sambandho vācyaḥ; sambandhāntaramantareṇa tadbhāvasyaiva asaṃbhavāt, anyathā sarvaṃ sarvasya viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyañca syāt
vṛkṣe śākhā śilāścāga ityeṣā laukikī mati
kiñca, ato'numānāt tantu-paṭādau sambandhamātraṃ prasādhyate, tadviśeṣo vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhyatā, tādātmyalakṣaṇasambandhasya iṣṭatvāt

nanu tantu-paṭayoḥ tādātmye sati anyataradeva syāt, tathā ca sambandhinorekatve kathaṃ sambandhaḥ syād asya dviṣṭhatvāt ? ityapyayuktam; yo hi dviṣṭhaḥ sambandhaḥ tasya itthamabhāvo yuktaḥ, yastu tatsvabhāvatālakṣaṇaḥ kathaṃ tasya abhāvaḥ ? tantūnāṃ svātmabhūto'vasthāviśeṣa eva hi paṭaḥ nā'rthāntaram, ātānavitānībhūtatantuvyatirekeṇa deśabhedādinā tasyānupalabhyamānatvāt
atha sambandhaviśeṣaḥ sādhyate; ki saṃyogaḥ, samavāyo vā ? saṃyogaścet; abhyupagamabādhā
atha samavāyaḥ; dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyavikalatā, pakṣasya ca aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇatvaṃ samavāyasya kvacidapyaprasiddheḥ

atha na saṃyogaḥ samavāyo vā sādhyate kintu sambandhamātram, tatsiddhau ca pariśeṣāt samavāyaḥ siddhyati ityucyate; nanu ko'yaṃ pariśeṣo nāma ? prasaktapratiṣedhe'vaśiṣṭapratyayahetuḥ saḥ; iti cet; sa ki pramāṇam, apramāṇaṃ vā ? yadi apramāṇam; kathaṃ prakṛtapratītihetuḥ atiprasaṅgāt ? atha pramāṇam; ki pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā ? na tāvat pratyakṣam; tasya prasaktapratiṣedhadvāreṇa abhipretasiddhau asamarthatvāt

atha kevalavyatirekyanumānaṃ pariśeṣaḥ; tarhi prakṛtā'numānasya ānarthakyam, tasmin satyapi pariśeṣamantareṇa abhipretasiddherabhāvāt, sa tu pramāṇāntaramantareṇā'pi tatsiddhau samarthaḥ iti sa eva ucyatām, na cā'sau uktaḥ, tatkathaṃ samavāyaḥ siddhyet ?

yaccānyaduktam–viśeṣaviruddhā'numānaṃ sakalānumānocchedakatvānna vaktavyam ityādi; tat kim anumānābhāsocchedakatvānna vācyam, samyaganumānocchedakatvādvā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; nahi kālātyayāpadiṣṭahetūtthānumānocchedakasya pratyakṣādeḥ anumānavādinā upanyāso na kriyate atiprasaṅgāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ; nahi dhūmādisamyaganumānasya viśeṣaviruddhā'numānasahasreṇā'pi pratyakṣādibhirapahṛtaviṣayeṇa bādhā vidhātuṃ pāryate
na ca viśeṣaviruddhānumānatvādeva idamavācyam; yato na viśeṣaviruddhānumānatvam asiddhādivat hetvābhāsanirūpaṇapraghaṭṭake doṣo nirūpitaḥ, yena anumānavādibhiḥ tad asiddhatvādivat na prayujyeta
tato yad duṣṭamanumānaṃ tadeva viśeṣavighātāya na vaktavyam, yathā ayaṃ pradeśaḥ atratyena agninā agnimānna bhavati dhūmavattvāt mahānasavad ityādikam
yataḥ tena yo viśeṣo nirākriyate sa pratyakṣeṇaiva taddeśopasarpaṇe pratīyate, na caitat samavāye sabhavati pratyakṣādyagocaratvena asya pratipāditatvāt
yat punaruktam–na cāsya saṃyogavat nānātvam ityādi; tadapyasamīcīnam, tadekatvasya anumānabādhitatvāt
tathāhi–anekaḥ samavāyaḥ bhinnadeśakālākārārtheṣu sambandhabuddhihetutvāt, yo ya evaṃ saḥ so naika yathā saṃyogaḥ, tathā cāyam, tasmādaneka iti
nibiḍaḥ sayogaḥ, śithilaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti pratyayabhedāt asya bhedābhyupagame nityaṃ samavāyaḥ, kadācit samavāyaḥ iti pratyayabhedāt samavāyasyāpi bhedo'stu aviśeṣāt

samavāyinornityatva-kādācitkatvābhyāṃ samavāye tatpratyayotpattau saṃyoginornibiḍatva-śithilatvābhyāṃ sayoge tathā pratyayotpatti syāt na puna saṃyogasya nibiḍatvādisvabhāvasaṃbhavāt, iti ekaṃ sandhitsoḥ anyat pracyavate

nahi saṃyoga prativiśeṣya viśiṣṭo nānā na bhavati daṇḍapuruṣasayogāt paṭadhūpasayogasya abhedā'pratītetadvat samavāyo'neka pratipadyatām śithila saṃyogo nibiḍa saṃyogaḥ iti pratyayo yathā saṃyoge tathā nitya samavāya kadācit samavāya iti samavāye'pi
tathā nānā samavāya ayutasiddha-avayava-avayavyādyāśritatvāt saṃkhyāvat ityato'pi asya anekatvasiddhiḥ
na cedamasiddham; tadanāśritatve hi samavāyasya paṇṇāmāśritatvamanyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ

atha na paramārthataḥ samavāyasya āśritatva kintu upacārāt, nimittaṃ tu upacārasya samavāyiṣu satsu samavāyajñānam, tattvato hi āśritatve asya āśrayavināśe vināśaprasaṅgo guṇādivat; ityapyasundaram, āśritatvasāmānyasya hetutvāt
digādīnāmapyevam āśritatvāpatteśca, mūrttadravyeṣu upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpteṣu digliṅgasya idamataḥ pūrveṇa ityādipratyayasya kālaliṅgasya ca paratvā'paratvādipratyayasya sadbhāvāt
tathā ca anyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ ityasya virodhaḥ
anumānaviruddhañca paramārthato'sya anāśritatvam; tathāhi–āśrita paramārthataḥ samavāya sambandhatvāt saṃyogādivaditi
tathā ca ihetipratyayā'viśeṣād viśeṣaliṅgā'bhāvācca ekaḥ samavāyaḥ ityayuktam, viśeṣaliṅgā'bhāvasya anantarapratipāditaliṅgasadbhāvataḥ asiddhatvāt
iheti pratyayā'viśeṣo'pi a siddhaḥ; iha ātmani jñānam, iha paṭe rūpādikam iti iheti pratyayasya viśeṣāt, viśeṣaṇā'nurāgo hi pratyayasya viśiṣṭatvam
na ca anugatapratyayāt samavāyasya ekatvaṃ siddhyati; gotvādisāmānyeṣu ṣaṭpadārtheṣu ca anugatasyaikatvasyā'bhāve'pi sāmānyaṃ sāmānyam padārthaḥ padārthaḥ iti anugatapratyayapratīteḥ
sattāvad iti dṛṣṭānto'pi sādhyasādhanavikalaḥ; sarvathaikatvasya satpratyayā'viśeṣasya ca asiddhatvāt, tadasiddhatvañca agre kathañcit tadanekatvasya tadviśeṣasya ca pratipādayiṣyamāṇatvāt siddham
yadapyuktam–svakāraṇasattāsambandhasyaiva niṣpattitvāt ityādi; tadapyacarcitā'bhidhānam; ātmalābhasya svakāraṇasattāsamavāyaparyāyatāyāṃ nityatvaprasaṅgāt
nirastañca svakāraṇasattāsamavāyalakṣaṇaṃ kāryatvaṃ prāk ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
yaccoktam–agneruṣṇatādivat ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; yataḥ pratyakṣasiddhe vastusvabhāve svabhāvairuttaraṃ vaktumucitam jalā'nalavat
na ca samavāyasya svataḥ sambandhatvam, saṃyogādīnāṃ tu parataḥ iti pratyakṣasiddham; tatsvarūpasya adhyakṣā'gocaratvapratipādanāt
samavāyo'nyena sambandhyamāno na svataḥ sambaddhyate sambaddhyamānatvāt rūpādivat ityanumānavirodhācca
yadapyabhihitam–samavāyaḥ sambandhāntaraṃ nāpekṣate svataḥ sambandhatvāt ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; hetorasiddheḥ, nahi samavāyasya svarūpā'siddhau svataḥ sambandhatvaṃ tatra siddhyati
saṃyogena anekāntācca; sa hi svataḥ sambandhaḥ sambandhāntarañca apekṣate
na khalu svato'sambandhasvabhāvatve saṃyogādeḥ parataḥ tad yuktam; atiprasaṅgāt
ghaṭādīnāñca sambandhitvāt na parato'pi sambandhatvam, ityayuktamuktam–na te svataḥ sambandhāḥ iti
nāpi parataḥ; yataḥ parataḥ ki saṃyogāt, samavāyāntarāt, viśeṣaṇabhāvāt, adṛṣṭādvā sa syāt ? na tāvat saṃyogāt; tasya guṇatvena adravyasvabhāve samavāye saṃbhavā'bhāvāt
nāpi samavāyāntarāt; tasya ekarūpatayā abhyupagamāt, anyathā tattvaṃ bhāvena vai॰ sū॰ 7
kiṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvena, saṃyogena, samavāyena vā ? aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 215
nāpi viśeṣaṇabhāvāt; sambandhāntareṇa sambaddhārtheṣveva asya pravṛttipratīteḥ daṇḍaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ ityādivat, anyathā sarvaṃ sarvasya viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyañca syāt
na ca samavāya samavāyināṃ sambandhāntarasambaddhatvaṃ saṃbhavati anabhyupagamāt

kiñca, viśeṣaṇabhāvo'pi etebhyaḥ atyanta bhinnaḥ kutastatraiva niyamyeta ? samavāyāccet; itaretarāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi samavāyaniyame tato viśeṣaṇabhāvaniyamasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca samavāyaniyamasiddhiriti
kiñca, ayaṃ viśeṣaṇabhāvaḥ ṣaḍpadārthebhyo bhinna, abhinno vā ? bhinnaścet; ki bhāvarūpaḥ, abhāvarūpo vā ? na tāvad bhāvarūpa; ṣaḍeva padārthāḥ iti niyamavighātaprasakte
atha abhinna; ki dravyasvarūpaḥ, guṇādisvabhāvo vā bhavet ? na tāvat dravyasvarūpaḥ; guṇādyāśritatvā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt
yugapadanekasamavāyiviśeṣaṇatve ca asyānekatvaprāptiḥ, yad yugapadanekārthaviśeṣaṇaṃ tadanekam yathā daṇḍakuṇḍalādi, tathā ca samavāya, tasmādaneka iti
na ca sattādinā anekānta; tasyāpi anekasvabhāvatvaprasādhanāt
karmabhi karmāṇi na tadvanti guṇaiśca guṇā na tadvanta
sambandho hi dviṣṭho bhavatā'bhyupagata, adṛṣṭaśca ātmavṛttitayā samavāya-samavāyinoratiṣṭhan kathaṃ dviṣṭho bhavet ? ṣoḍhāsambandhavāditvavyāghātaśca
yadi ca adṛṣṭena samavāyaḥ sambaddhyate tarhi guṇa-guṇyādayo'pi ata eva sambaddhā bhaviṣyanti iti alaṃ tatrāpi samavāyādisambandhakalpanayā
atha sambaddhaḥ; kutaḥ iti vaktavyam ? samavāyāccet, anyonyāśrayaḥ
iha ātmani jñānam; ityādi sambandhabuddhiḥ na sambandhyasambaddhasambandhapūrvikā sambandhabuddhitvāt daṇḍapuruṣasambandhabuddhivat ityanumānavirodhānuṣaṅgācca
kiñca, ayaṃ samavāyaḥ samavāyinoḥ parikalpyeta, asamavāyinorvā ? yadyasamavāyinoḥ; tarhi ghaṭapaṭayorapi tatprasaktiḥ
atha samavāyinoḥ; kutastayo samavāyitvam–samavāyāt, svato vā ? samavāyāccet, anyonyāśraya–siddhe hi samavāyitve tayoḥ samavāyasiddhi, tasyāśca tattvasiddhiriti
svata eva tu samavāyinoḥ ki samavāyena ? na ca saṃyoge'pyetat sarva samānam ityabhidhātavyam, saṃśliṣṭatayotpannavastuvyatiriktasya asyāpyasaṃbhavāt, bhinnasaṃyoginostanniyame tu samānamevaitat

yaccānyaduktam–saṃyogidravyavilakṣaṇatvād guṇādīnām ityādi; tadapyapeśalam; yato niṣkriyatve'pyeṣām ādheyatvam alpaparimāṇatvāt, tatkāryatvāt, tathāpratibhāsādvā ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'saṅgataḥ; sāmānyasya mahāparimāṇaguṇasya ca anādheyatvaprasaṅgāt
nahi anyatra kuṇḍādāvadhikaraṇe badarādīnāmādheyānāṃ tathā sattvamasti
artha rūpādīnāmādheyatve satyapi yutasiddherabhāvāt uparitanatayā pratibhāsā'bhāvaḥ; na; yutasiddhatva-ayutasiddhatvayoḥ uktaprakāreṇā'vyavasthitayoḥ tathāpratibhāsā'nibandhanatvāt
na ca yutasiddhatvasya uparitanatvapratītihetutvam; ūrdhvādhaḥsthitavaṃśādeḥ kṣīranīrayośca tadabhāvāt
tasmānna sambandhibhyaḥ sambandhaḥ sarvathārthāntarabhūto vicāryamāṇo ghaṭate
ityayukta sa sambandho na yuktaḥ samavāyibhiḥ
nāpi saṃyogasya samavāyasya vā sambandhivyatirekeṇa astitve kiñcit pramāṇamasti
na sambandhabuddhirvāstavī tadvyatiriktasya sambandhasya asattvāt ityādinā sambandhamātra nirākurvato bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu siddhe sambandhe tasya sambandhibhyo'rthāntaratvam anarthāntaratvaṃ vā kalpayituṃ yuktam, na cāsau siddhaḥ tatsvarūpā'navadhāraṇāt; tathāhi–sambandho'rthānāṃ pāratantryalakṣaṇaḥ, rūpasaṃśleṣasvabhāvaḥ, parāpekṣāsvarūpo vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe kimasau sambandhinorniṣpannayoḥ, aniṣpannayorvā syāt ? na tāvadaniṣpannayoḥ svarūpasyaivā'sattvāt śaśaviṣāṇabandhyāstanandhayavat
nāpi niṣpannayoḥ tathāvidhayostayoḥ sahya-vindhyavat pāratantryā'bhāvataḥ sambandhānupapatteḥ
pāratantryaṃ hi sambandhaḥ siddhe kā paratantratā
tasmāt sarvasya bhāvasya sambandho nāsti tattvataḥ
tayoraikye vā sutarāṃ sambandhā'bhāvaḥ, sambandhinorabhāve sambandhā'yogāt dviṣṭhatvāttasya
atha nairantarya tayoḥ sambandhaḥ; na; asya antarālā'bhāvatvena atāttvikatvataḥ sambandhatvā'nupapatteḥ, nirantaratāyāśca sambandhatve sāntaratā'pi sambandhaḥ syādaviśeṣāt
kiñca, anayoḥ rūpaśleṣaḥ sarvātmanā, ekadeśena vā ? sarvātmanā tatsaṃśleṣe piṇḍo'ṇumātraḥ syāt
taddeśāśca tebhyo'bhinnāḥ, bhinnā vā ? yadyabhinnāḥ; tadā teṣāmabhāvāt kathamekadeśena tatsaṃśleṣaḥ syāt
atha bhinnāḥ tadā tairapi aṇūnāṃ sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā saṃśleṣe sa eva paryanuyogo'navasthā ca syāt
uktañca– rūpaśleṣo hi sambandhaḥ dvitve sa ca kathaṃ bhavet
atha parāpekṣāsvarūpo'sau sambandhaḥ; astvetat; tathāpi bhāva svayaṃ san, asan vā paramapekṣeta ? na tāvadasan; tathābhūtasya asya aśvaviṣāṇavat apekṣādharmāśrayatvavirodhāt
tathā coktam– parāpekṣā hi sambandhaḥ so'san kathamapekṣate
kiñca, sambandha sambandhibhyo bhinna; abhinno vā syāt ? yadyabhinnaḥ; tadā sambandhināveva sambandha eva vā syāt

atha bhinnaḥ; tadā sambandhinau kevalau katha sambaddhau syātām ? astu vā tābhyāmarthāntaramasau; tathāpi tenaikena sambandhena saha dvayo sambandhinoḥ kaḥ sambandhaḥ ? yathā sambandhinoryathoktadoṣānna kaścit sambandhaḥ tathā atrāpi, tena saha anayoḥ sambandhāntarābhyupagame ca anavasthā syāt tatrāpi sambandhāntarā'nuṣaṅgāt
