sattve vā dvau sambandhinau sambandhaśca ityanyonyamamiśrāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ svasvarūpavyavasthitāḥ paramārthataḥ sthitāḥ, tān itthambhūtānapi bhāvān kalpanā anyonyaṃ miśrānivādarśayatīti
rūpaśleṣo hi sambandhaḥ dvitve sa ca kathaṃ bhavet
uddhṛtañcaitat–tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 148, prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 149 pū॰, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 813
tataḥ–tau ca bhāvau tadanyaśca sarve te svātmani sthitāḥ
ityamiśrāḥ svayaṃ bhāvāḥ tān miśrayati kalpanā
tau ca bhāvau tadanyaśca sarve te svātmani sthitāḥ
ityamiśrāḥ svayaṃ bhāvāḥ tān miśrayati kalpanā || ityādi
anayaiva prakriyayā pūrvapakṣa prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 149 pū॰, syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 812 draṣṭavya
yattāvaduktam–pāratantrya ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; ekatvapariṇatilakṣaṇapāratantryasya arthānāṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇaprasiddhatvena nihnotumaśakyatvāt
yat pratyakṣādipramāṇaprasiddhaṃ na tannihnotuṃ śakyam yathā nīlādi, tatpramāṇaprasiddhañca ekatvapariṇatilakṣaṇaṃ pāratantryaṃ vāhyādhyātmikārthānāmiti

dravya-kṣetra-kāla-bhāvakṛtā hi pratyā sattiḥ ekatvapariṇatisvabhāvā pāratantrya-aparanāmā sambandho'rthānāmabhipreto jainaiḥ, sa ca ābālaṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇe pratibhāsate, bahirekāvayavidravyagatānāṃ rūpādīnām antaśca ekātmadravyagatānāṃ jñāna-sukhādīnāṃ lolībhūtānāmadhyakṣata eva avabhāsanāt
tathā ekakṣetravarttināṃ kṣīra-nīrādīnāmekalolībhāvena ekatvapariṇatilakṣaṇaṃ kṣetranibandhanaṃ pāratantryaṃ pratyakṣata eva pratīyate
kālanibandhanamapi tat tathāvidham āmrarasādīnāṃ bālādyavasthaśarīrāvayavopacayādīnāṃ vā pratyakṣata eva pratīyate
bhāvanibandhanamapi tat saṃyogināṃ dravya-paryāyādīnāñca pratīyata eva, ghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ saṃyogātmanā pariṇateḥ ātmasukhādīnāñca caitanyādisvabhāvatayā iti
ekaikapradhānatayā ca evaṃvidhā pratyāsattiḥ pradarśitā na punaranyavyavacchedena; dravyādipratyāsattau kṣetrādipratyāsatterapyanivāraṇāt
na hi kasyacit kenacit sākṣāt paramparayā vā sambandho nāstīti nirupākhyatvaprasaṅgāt
yadapyuktam–niṣpannayoraniṣpannayorvā ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; kathañcinniṣpannayoḥ sambandhinoḥ pāratantryābhyupagamāt
dravya-paryāyātmakatve hi vastuno dravyarūpatayā niṣpannasya aniṣpannaparyāyapāratantryamupapadyate tadrūpatayā tasya pariṇamanāt
paṭo hi tantudravyarūpatayā niṣpanna eva, anvayino dravyasya paṭapariṇāmotpatteḥ prāgapi sattvāt, svarūpeṇa tu aniṣpannaḥ
tantudravyamapi svarūpeṇa niṣpannam paṭapariṇāmarūpatayā tu aniṣpannam
tathā aṅgulyādidravyaṃ svarūpeṇa niṣpannam saṃyogapariṇāmātmanā tvaniṣpannam, iti sarvaṃ vastu syānniṣpannaṃ syādaniṣpannaṃ pāratantryabhāk bhavatīti pratipattavyam

kiñca, pāratantryasyābhāvād bhāvānāṃ sambandhābhāve tena vyāptaḥ kvacit sambandhaḥ prasiddhaḥ, na vā ? prasiddhaścet kathaṃ sarvatra sarvadā sambandhābhāvaḥ virodhāt ? atha na prasiddhaḥ; kathamavyāpakā'bhāvād avyāpyasyābhāvasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt ?
pāratantryasyābhāvād bhāvānāṃ sambandhābhāvamabhidadhānāḥ tena sambandhaṃ vyāptaṃ kvacit pratipadyante na vā
yaccānyaduktam–rūpaśleṣo hi ityādi; tadapi ekāntavādināmeva dūṣaṇaṃ nāsmākam, kathañcit sambandhinorekatvāpattisvabhāvasya rūpaśleṣalakṣaṇasambandhasyābhyupagamāt
aśakyavivecanatvaṃ hi sambandhino rūpaśleṣaḥ, asādhāraṇarūpatā ca tadaśleṣaḥ, sa ca anayorna dvitvaṃ viruṇaddhi tathāpratīteḥ citrākāraikasaṃvedanavat
te hi kathañcidekatvāpattiṃ sambandhino rūpaśleṣaṃ sambandhamācakṣate
yadapyabhihitam–sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; prakārāntareṇaiva asyābhyupagamāt, kārtsnyaikadeśābhyāṃ hi tasyāsambhavāt aparaprakārasya ca saṃbhavāt

yanmate hi vibhinnau sambandhinau apracyutā'nutpannapūrvā'parasvarūpau anyonyaṃ sambaddhyete tanmate ayamanantarodito doṣo bhavatyeva, asmanmate tu viśliṣṭarūpatāparityāgena saṃśliṣṭarūpatayā ekalolībhāvalakṣaṇayā pariṇatiḥ saktutoyādīnāṃ sambandho'bhipretaḥ, tatkathamuktadoṣāṇāṃ leśato'pyavakāśaḥ syāt ? tathāvidhasambandhā'nabhyupagame ca kathaṃ citrasaṃvedanasiddhi syāt ? nahi citrasaṃvidaḥ tathābhūtapariṇativyatirekeṇa anyo nīlādyanekākārai sambandha saṃbhavati, sarvātmanā ekadeśena vā tasyāstaiḥ sambandhe proktā'śeṣadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt
sa ca evaṃvidhaḥ sambandho'rthānāṃ kvacinnikhilapradeśānāmanyonyapradeśānupraveśato bhavati yathā saktutoyādīnām, kvacittu pradeśasaṃśliṣṭatāmātreṇa yathā aṅgulyādīnām
na ca antarbahirvā sāṃśavastuvādina sāṃśatvā'nuṣaṅgo doṣāya iṣṭatvāt
na caivamanavasthā, tadvataḥ tatpradeśānāmatyantabhedā'bhāvāt, tadbhede hi teṣāmapi tadvatāṃ pradeśāntarai sambandha ityanavasthā syānnānyathā

nanvevaṃ paramāṇūnāmapi sāṃśatvaprasaṅga; ityapyacodyam, yato'tra aśaśabdaḥ svabhāvārthaḥ, avayavārtho vā'bhipreta ? yadi svabhāvārtha, na kaścid doṣa, teṣāṃ vibhinnadigbhāgavyavasthitā'nekāṇubhiḥ sambandhā'nyathā'nupapattyā tāvaddhā svabhāvabhedopapatte
nanu svabhāvabhedasaṃbhave'ṇūnāṃ kathamavibhāgitvapratijñā na viruddhyeta ? ityapyanupapannam; yato'vibhāgitvaṃ teṣāṃ bhedayitumaśakyatvamucyate na punaḥ nisvabhāvatvam
aṃśaśabda svabhāvārtha avayavārtho vā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 152 u॰
yatpunaruktam–parāpekṣā hi ityādi; tadanabhyupagamādeva parihṛtam, nahi jinapatimatā'nusāribhiḥ parāpekṣālakṣaṇa sambandho'bhyupagamyate kathañcidekatvapariṇateḥ tattvā'bhyupagamāt

parāpekṣatvāt sambandhasvabhāvo mithyā arthānām, asambandhasvabhāvārthāpekṣo hi sambandhasvabhāvo'rthānām, ityapyanalpatamovilasitam; yataḥ kva tasya parāpekṣatvam–ātmalābhe, sambandhavyavahāre vā ? na tāvad ātmalābhe; parānapekṣāt svakāraṇakalāpādeva ekatvapariṇatilakṣaṇasambandhasya ātmalābhapratīteḥ

tadvyavahāre parāpekṣatvaṃ tu na tasya mithyātvaṃ prasādhayati; paramārthasattvā'pratidvanditvāt, na khalu yatra parāpekṣo vyavahāraḥ tatra aparamārthasattvam iti vyāptirasti, itarathā itarajñānāpekṣayā sugatajñāne viśadatarādivyavahārataḥ tasya aparamārthasattvaprasaṅgato lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ syāt

kathañcaivaṃvādino asambandhasvabhāvo'pyarthānāṃ vāstavaḥ siddhyet, tasyāpyāpekṣikatvā'viśeṣāt ? pratyakṣabuddhau pratibhāsamānaḥ so'nāpekṣika eva, tatpṛṣṭhabhāvinā tu vikalpena adhyavasīyamāno yathā āpekṣikaḥ tathā'vāstavo'pi; ityanyatrāpi samānam, na khalu sambandho'dhyakṣe na pratibhāsate yato'nāpekṣiko'sau na syāt, antarbahiśca ekatvapariṇatirahitasya arthasya svapne'pyapratibhāsanāt

yaccoktam–dvayorekābhisambandhāt ityādi; tadapyekāntavādināmeva dūṣaṇam, taireva sambandhasambandhināmekāntato bhedā'bhyupagamāt nā'smākam, ekalolībhāvādanyasya sambandha-sambandhibhāvasyaivānabhyupagamāt, tathābhūtaśca tadbhāvaḥ pratyakṣagocaracāritayā prarūpitaḥ
ityayuktamuktam–ityamiśrāḥ svayaṃ bhāvāḥ tān miśrayati kalpanā iti
tato'vayavā'vayavyādau uktaprakārasyaiva sambandhasya prasiddherna paraparikalpitaḥ samavāyapadārtho'pi ghaṭate
tadevaṃ vaiśeṣikamate kaṇādapraṇītaṣaṭpadārthānāṃ vicāryamāṇānāmavyavasthiteḥ na tallakṣaṇe bhedaikānte arthasya siddhirghaṭate
mābhūt tatra tatsiddhiḥ; akṣapādapraṇīte tu ṣoḍaśapadārthalakṣaṇe tasmin sā bhaviṣyati, vibhinnalakṣaṇalakṣitatvena eṣāmatyantabhedabhinnānāṃ pramāṇata upapadyamānatvāt

tatra sāmānyena uddiṣṭānāmeṣāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇāni vidhātuṃ pāryante iti uddeśataḥ ṣoḍaśapadārthān sūtre nirdiśati– pramāṇa-prameya-saṃśaya-prayojana-dṛṣṭānta-siddhānta-avayava-tarka-nirṇaya-vāda-jalpa-vitaṇḍā-hetvābhāsa-chala-jāti-nigrahasthānānā tattvajñānānniḥśreyasādhigatiḥ
evaṃ pramāṇaiścaturbhirupadiṣṭe pratyakṣānumānayuktiśabdākhyai carakasaṃ॰ sūtrasthā॰ pṛ॰ 69
tatra ātmā sarvasya sukha-duḥkhasādhanasya dṛṣṭā, sarvasyāśca sukhādisavitterāśrayatvena bhoktā, tasya bhogāyatanaṃ śarīram, bhogasādhanāni indriyāṇi, bhoktavyā indriyārthāḥ, bhogo buddhiḥ
sarvārtho palabdhau nendriyāṇi prabhavanti iti sarvaviṣayaṃ manaḥ
utpannaśarīrendriyabuddhivedanābhisambandhasya punaḥ anyaiḥ śarīrādibhiḥ ātmanaḥ sambandha pretyabhāvaḥ
21 tasya ca yatnena parihāryatvāt phalāt pṛthagupādānam
śarīrādinā ekaviśatibhedabhinnena duḥkhena ātyantiko viyogaḥ apavargaḥ
tatra ātmā sarvasya dṛṣṭā, sarvasya bhoktā, sarvajñaḥ, sarvānubhavī

tasya bhogāyatanaṃ śarīram, bhogāyatanāni indriyāṇi, bhoktavyā indriyārthā, bhogo buddhiḥ, sarvārthopalabdhau nendriyāṇi prabhavantīti sarvaviṣayamantakaraṇaṃ mana, śarīrendriyārthabuddhisukhavedanānāṃ nirvṛtikāraṇaṃ pravṛttirdoṣāśca
utpannasya kvacit sattvanikāye mṛttvā yā punarutpatti sa pretyabhāva
pravṛttidoṣajanakaṃ sukhadu khātmakaṃ mukhyaṃ phalam, tatsādhanaṃ tu gauṇam
phalagrahaṇākṣiptamapi pīḍanasvabhāva duḥkham adu khasammatasyāpi duḥkhatvabhāvanārthamupadiśyate
ata eva phalatve'pi sukhamiha na nirdiṣṭam
duḥkhāni śarīraṃ ṣaḍ indriyāṇi ṣaḍviṣayā ṣaḍbuddhaya sukha duḥkhaṃ ca ityekaviṃśati
nānārthavimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ, samānā'nekadharmoṣapatteḥ upalabdhyanulabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣo vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ
sa ca vārtikakāramate tredhā; tathāhi–samānā'nekadharmoṣapatte upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣo vimarśa saṃśayaḥ

sa ca samāno dharma upalabhyamāno na kevalaḥ saṃśayahetuḥ kintu upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣa, upalabdhyanupalabdhya vyavasthāto viśeṣāṃśe sādhaka-bādhakapramāṇā'bhāvāt viśeṣāpekṣaḥ sthāṇurvā puruṣo vā iti vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ

tathā, samānajātīyam asamānajātīyañca anekam, anekasmād vyāvṛtto dharmaḥ anekadharmaḥ, tadupapatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā śabde vibhāgajatvadarśanāt kimayaṃ guṇo dravyaṃ karma vā iti ? nahi vibhāgajatvaṃ sajātīye kvacid guṇe vijātīye vā dravye karmaṇi ca varttate, ataḥ saṃśayahetuḥ–kibhūtasya asya vibhāgajatvamiti

tathā, vipratipatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā asti ātmā ityeke, nāstyātmā ityapare, na ca sadbhāvā'sadbhāvau samamekatra bhavataḥ tasmāttattvā'navadhāraṇam asti ātmā, nāsti vā iti saṃśayaḥ
samānānekadharmoṣapatte vipratipatte upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthātaśca viśeṣāpekṣo vimarśa saṃśaya
atra ca vimarśa saṃśaya iti saṃśayasāmānyalakṣaṇam
viruddhārthāvamarśo vimarśa, syāṇurvā puruṣo vetīyatā ca sajātīyasaṃśayapañcakānugataṃ vijātīyebhya pramāṇādibhyo vyavacchinnaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati
tatra samānadharmoṣapatte anekadharmoṣapatte vipratipatteśca trividha eva saśaya
tatra upalabdhyanupalabdhyostāvat pṛthak saṃśayakāraṇatvaṃ na bhavatīti
yadi ca upalabdhyanupalabdhī na vyavasthite bhavata iti
yadi viśeṣākāṅkṣā bhavati samānadharmamupalabhate, upalabdhyanupalabdhī na vyavatiṣṭhete idantayā vā'nidantayā vā, viśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ ca satyāmarthasandeho bhavatīti
samānāsamānajātīyaviśeṣakatvāt samānajātīyamasamānajātīyañcānekam, tasmād viśeṣo viśeṣako dharma anekasmādviśeṣo'nekadharma iti
vyāhatārthapravādo vipratipattiśabdasyārtho vyāhatārthapravādaviṣayatvamupalabhamānasya upalabdhyanupalabdhyoścāvyavasthāne sati tadgataviśeṣānusmṛtau ca satyā saṃśayo bhavatīti

bhāṣyakāramate tu upalabdhyanupalabdhī pṛthak saṃśayakāraṇam iti pañcadhā saṃśayaḥ; tathāhi– upalabdhyupapatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā sad udakamupalabhyate, marīcikāsu ca asat, idānīṃ kvacid udakopalabdhau tattvavyavasthāpakapramāṇasyānupalabdheḥ sadvā udakam asadvā iti saṃśayaḥ

tathā, anupalabdhyupapatteḥ upalabdhyanupalabdhyavyavasthāto viśeṣāpekṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ, yathā san mūlakīlakādi nopalabhyate, asacca anutpannaṃ niruddhaṃ vā, idānīṃ piśāco' pi san nopalabhyate asan vā iti saṃśayaḥ
samāno'nekaśca dharmo jñeyasthaḥ, vipratipattiupalabdhi-anupalabdhayo jñātṛsthā iti bhedaḥ
ataḥ kvacidupalabhyamāne tattvavyavasthāpakasya pramāṇasyānupalabdheḥ kiṃ sadupalabhyate athāsat iti saṃśayo bhavati
anupalabdhyavyavasthātaḥ sacca nopalabhyate mūlakīlakodakādi, asaccā'nutpannaṃ niruddhaṃ vā
tata kvacidupalabhyamāne saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sannopalabhyate utāsanniti saṃśayo bhavati
vārtikakārastu jñeyasthatayā samānā'nekadharmayoḥ kāraṇatvaṃ nānumanyate–samāno'nekaśca dharmo jñeyasthaḥ ityetadapi na buddhyāmahe
samānānekadharmajñānaṃ tu saṃśayakāraṇam, tacca jñātari varttate iti nāsti bheda
yamartham prāptavyaṃ hātavyañca adhyavasāya pravarttate tat prayojanam
yamarthamāptavyaṃ hātavyaṃ vā'vyavasāya tadāptihānopāyamanutiṣṭhati prayojana tad veditavyam
tathā ca sūtram–laukikaparīkṣakāṇā yasminnarthe buddhisāmya sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ
25 naisargikaṃ vainayikaṃ ca atiśayamaprāptā laukikāḥ, tadviparītāḥ parīkṣakāḥ
25 teṣāṃ sādhyasādhanādhikaraṇatvena tadrahitatvena vā buddhisāmyaviṣayo'rtho dṛṣṭāntaḥ
tatra dṛṣṭānto nāma yatra mūrkhaviduṣā buddhisāmyam
dṛṣṭāntavacana hi yatra pṛthagjanānāmāryāṇāñca buddhisāmyaṃ tadā vaktavyam
tantram–śāstram adhikaraṇaṃ yeṣāmarthānāṃ te tantrādhikaraṇāḥ, teṣām abhyugamasaṃsthitiḥ–itthambhāvaniyama siddhāntaḥ
28 sarveṣāṃ sampratipattiviṣayaḥ; yathā pramāṇāni prameyasādhanāni, ghrāṇādīni indriyāṇi, gandhādayastadarthāḥ ityādi
29 yathā bhautikāni indriyāṇi yaugānām, abhautikāni sāṃkhyānām

30 hetoryasya siddhau anyasya prakriyamāṇasya pratijñārthasya siddhiḥ so'dhikaraṇasiddhāntaḥ, yathā kāryatvādeḥ kṣityādau buddhimatkāraṇasāmānyasiddhau anyasya tatkaraṇasamarthasya nityajñānecchāprayatnā''dhārasya tatkāraṇasya siddhiriti
31 yat kiñcidvastu aparīkṣitamabhyupagamya viśeṣaḥ parīkṣyate so'bhyupagamasiddhāntaḥ
yathā astu dravyaṃ śabdaḥ, sa tu kiṃ nityo'nityo vā iti śabdasya dravyatvamabhyupagamya nityā'nityatvaviśeṣaḥ parīkṣyate
siddhānto nāma yaḥ parīkṣakairbahuvidha parīkṣitaṃ hetubhi sādhayitvā sthāpyate nirṇaya sa siddhāntaḥ
āha–siddhāntadharmā kiyanta ? atrocyate cattvāra–sarvasama, ādau sama, paścādbhinna, ādau bhinna paścātsamaśca
tantram–itaretarābhisambaddhasya arthasamūhasyopadeśa śāstram abhyupagamasaṃsthiti anavadhāritārthaparigraha tadviśeṣaparīkṣaṇāya abhyupagamasiddhānta
tantramadhikaraṇaṃ yeṣāmarthānā bhavati te tantrādhikaraṇā teṣāmabhyupagamasasthiti itthambhāvavyavasthā dharmaniyama siddhānto bhavatīti
kimukta bhavati ? yo'ryo na śāstrita tasyābhyupagamo na siddhānta iti
sarvatantrasiddhānto nāma santi nidānāni santi vyādhaya santi siddhyupāyā sādhyānāmiti
svaśāstre ya upadiṣṭo'rtha sarvaśāstrāviruddhaśca sa sarvatantrasiddhānta
adhikaraṇasiddhānto nāma yasmin yasminnadhikaraṇe saṃstūyamāne siddhāni anyānyapi adhikaraṇāni bhavanti

tena yasminnarthe jñāyamāne tadanuṣaṅgiṇo'rthāḥ tadantarbhāvena jñāyante so'rthaḥ sākṣādadhikriyamāṇaḥ tadanuṣaṅgiṇāñcādhāraḥ tadāśrayatvāttatsiddheḥ, sa pakṣo vā bhavatu heturvā tena rūpeṇa adhikaraṇasiddhāntaḥ
atra hi pṛthivyādigatena utpattimattvena upalabdhimatpūrvakaṃ tadgataṃ sādhyamānaṃ svasiddhyantargatānuṣaṅgisarvajñatvādyupetatvameva siddhyati
yatra kiñcidarthajātamaparīkṣitamabhyupagamyate–astu dravyaṃ śabdaḥ; sa tu nityaḥ athā'nityaḥ ? iti dravyasya sato nityatā'nityatā vā tadviśeṣaḥ parīkṣyate so'bhyupagamasiddhāntaḥ
yo'rthaḥ sūtreṣu nopanibaddhaḥ śāstre cābhyupagataḥ so'bhyupagamasiddhānta iti
yathā naiyāyikānāṃ mana indriyamiti, vaiśeṣikāṇāṃ naiyāyikānāñca śrotramākāśamiti
sādhanīyasyārthasya yāvati śabdasamūhe siddhiḥ pari samāpyate tasyaikadeśā pañca
33 jñāpanīyena dharmeṇa viśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ parigrahavacanaṃ sādhyanirdeśaḥ, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti
34 udāharaṇena sādharmyāt sādhyadharmasya prajñāpanaṃ hetuḥ, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpattidharmakatvāt ghaṭavaditi
35 udāharaṇavaidharmyāt sādhyasādhanaṃ hetuḥ, yathā nedaṃ nirātmakaṃ jīvaccharīram aprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāt loṣṭhādivat

36 sādhyena sādharmyam–samānadharmatā tasmāt taddharmabhāvī–tasya sādhyasya dharmaḥ, sādhyaśabdena cātra sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmī gṛhyate, tasya bhāva sādhyadharmabhāva sa yasmin dṛṣṭānte asti sa taddharmabhāvī, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpattidharmakatvāt ghaṭavat iti sādharmyodāharaṇam
tadviparyayāt–sādhyavaidharmyāt ataddharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpattidharmakatvāt, yattu nityaṃ tad utpattidharmakaṃ na bhavati yathā paramāṇvādi iti
udāharaṇāpekṣaḥ tathā ityupasaṃhāro na tathā iti vā sādhyasya upanayaḥ
38 udāharaṇāpekṣaḥ–udāharaṇādhīnaḥ, sādhyasādharmyayukte udāharaṇe tathā ca śabda utpattidharmakaḥ iti sādhyasya śabdasya utpattidharmakatvamupasaṃhriyate
sādhyavaidharmyayukte tu ākāśādidravyamanutpattidharmakaṃ nityam na ca tathā śabdaḥ ityanutpattidharmakatvasya upasaṃhārapratiṣedhena utpattidharmakatvamupasaṃhriyate
39 yathodāharaṇaṃ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vā hetau upasaṃhṛte yat pratijñāyāḥ punarabhidhānaṃ tat nigamanam
sādhanīyārthasya yāvati śabdasamūhe siddhiḥ parisamāpyate tasya pañcāvayavāḥ pratijñādayaḥ samūhamapekṣya avayavā ucyante
tathā ca sūtram ityaya pāṭha sarvāsu pratisu avayavāḥ ityasyā'nantaramupalabhyate
parañca upalabdhanyāyasūtrānurodhāt asmābhi pañca ityasyānantaraṃ sthāpita
pratijñā nāma sādhyavacanam, yathā nitya puruṣa iti
udāharaṇena sāmānyāt sādhyasya dharmasya sādhanam– prajñāpana hetu
sādhye pratisandhāya udāharaṇe ca pratisandhāya tasya sādhanatāvacana hetu utpattidharmakatvāditi, utpattidharmakamanitya
katham ? anitya śabda utpattidharmakatvāt, anutpattidharmakaṃ nityaṃ yathā ātmādidravyamiti
udāharaṇamanitya śabda iti bhāṣyam, etattu na samañjasamiti paśyāma, prayogamātrabhedāt, prayogamātraṃ hi bhidyate nārtha iti
udāharaṇamātrabhedācca, udāharaṇamātraṃ kevalaṃ bhidyate ātmā ghaṭa iti
udāharaṇaṃ tu nedaṃ nirātmakaṃ jīvaccharīram aprāṇādimattvaprasaṅgāditi
sādhyena sādharmyaṃ samānadharmatā, sādhyasādharmyāt kāraṇāt taddharmabhāvī dṛṣṭānta iti
sādhyaṃ ca dvividham dharmiviśiṣṭo vā dharma śabdasyānityatvam, dharmaviśiṣṭo vā dharmī anitya śabda iti
iha uttara tadgrahaṇena gṛhyate tasya dharma taddharma taddharmasya bhāva taddharmabhāva sa yasmin dṛṣṭānte varttate sa dṛṣṭānta sādhyasādharmyāt taddharmabhāvī bhavati sa codāharaṇamiṣyate
yatra prayojyaprayojakabhāvena sādhyasā vanadharmayorastitva khyāpyate sa sādharmyadṛṣṭānta
dṛṣṭāntaudāharaṇam iti prakṛtam, sādhyavaidharmyādataddharmabhāvī dṛṣṭānta udāharaṇam
dṛṣṭānte prasiddhāvinābhāvasya sādhanasya dṛṣṭāntopamānena pakṣe vyāptikhyāpakaṃ vacanamupanaya
sādhyadharmayukte udāharaṇe 'sthālyādidravyamutpattidharmakamanitya dṛṣṭaṃ tathā śabda utpattidharmaka iti sādhyasya śabdasya utpattidharmakatvamupasaṃhriyate
sādhyavaidharmyayukte punarudāharaṇe ātmādidravyamanutpattidharmakaṃ nityaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na ca tathā śabdaḥ ityanutpattidharmakatvasya upasahārapratiṣedhena utpattidharmakatvamupasaṃhriyate
sādharmyokte vā vaidharmyokte vā yathodāharaṇamupasaṃhriyate, tasmādutpattidharmakatvādanityaḥ śabdaḥ iti nigamanam
sandigdhe'rthe anyatarapakṣe anukūlakāraṇadarśanāt tasmin saṃbhāvanāpratyayaḥ tarkaḥ
tathā ca sūtram–avijñātatattve'rthe kāraṇopapattitaḥ tattvajñānārthamūhaḥ tarkaḥ
40 avijñātatattve–sandigdhe'rthe ūrdhvatālakṣaṇe kāraṇopapattitaḥ puruṣasadbhāve bāhyālī vāhakeli pradeśo'nukūlaṃ kāraṇam, tasya pratītitaḥ puruṣeṇa anena bhavitavyam ityūhaḥ tarkaḥ
tarkaviviktaṃ hi viṣayaṃ pramāṇāni paricchindanti iti pramāṇā'nugrāhakastarka

avijñātatattve sāmānyato jñāte dharmiṇi ekapakṣānukūlakāraṇadarśanāt tasmin saṃbhāvanāpratyayo bhavitavyatāvabhāsa taditarapakṣaśaithilyāpādane tadgrāhakapramāṇamanugṛhya tān sukhaṃ pravarttayan tattvajñānārthamūha tarkaḥ
yathā vāhakelipradeśe ūrdhvatvadarśanāt puruṣeṇānena bhavitavyamiti sambhāvanāpratyayaḥ
tarko na pramāṇasagṛhīto na pramāṇāntara pramāṇānāmanugrāhaka tattvajñānāya kalpate
kathaṃ punarayaṃ tattvajñānārtho na tattvajñānameveti ? anavadhāraṇāt–anujānātyayamekataraṃ dharmaṃ kāraṇopapattyā, na tvavadhārayatievamevedamiti
kathaṃ tatvajñānārtha iti ? tattvajñānaviṣayābhyanujñālakṣaṇādūhāt bhāvitāt prasannādanantara pramāṇasāmarthyāt tattvajñānamutpadyate ityeva tattvajñānārtha
pramāṇaviṣayamanena vivinakti, ayamartho yukta iti, pramāṇāni puna pravarttamānāni tarkaviviktamarthaṃ tathābhūtamavagamayantīti
41 vimṛśya–anityaḥ śabdo nityo vā iti sandihya, pakṣa-pratipakṣāśritatvāt sādhanopālambhau pakṣapratipakṣau ityuktau tābhyām, arthasya sādhyasya anitya evāyam kṛtakatvāt ityavadhāraṇaṃ nirṇaya
pakṣaśabdena pakṣaviṣaya sādhanamucyate, pratipakṣaśabdena pakṣaviṣayasya sādhanasya upālambha, tābhyā sādhanopālambhābhyā yadarthāvadhāraṇa sa nirṇaya iti
tathā ca sūtram–pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhaḥ siddhāntā'viruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vādaḥ
vastu dharmau ekādhikaraṇau viruddhau ekakālau anavasitau pakṣapratipakṣau
vastudharmau vastuno viśeṣau, yathā astyātmā nāstyātmā iti vā
adhikaraṇam āśrayaḥ, ekam adhikaraṇaṃ yayostau vicāraṃ prayojayata na nānādhikaraṇau, viruddhāvapi yathā nitya ātmā anityā buddhiriti
aviruddhāvapi vicāraṃ na prayojayataḥ yathā kriyāvad dravyaṃ guṇavacca iti, bhinnakālāvapi na vicārārhau dvayoḥ pramāṇopapatteḥ yathā kriyāvad dravyaṃ niṣkriyaṃ ca kālabhede sati
tathā avasitau vicāraṃ na prayojayataḥ nirṇayottarakālaṃ vivādā'bhāvāt
tau evaṃvidhaviśeṣaṇau dharmau pakṣa-pratipakṣau, tayoḥ parigrahaḥ itthambhāvaniyama evaṃdharmā ayaṃ dharmī naivaṃdharmā iti ca
tatra vādo nāma yat paraspareṇa saha śāstrapūrvaṃ vigṛhya kathayati, sa vādo dvividha saṃgraheṇa jalpo vitaṇḍā ca
yatra vītarāgo vītarāgeṇaiva saha tattvanirṇayārthaṃ sādhanopālambhau karoti sā vītarāgakathā vādasaṃjñayocyate
vādo nāma vītarāgayo pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahapūrvaka pramāṇatarkapūrvakasādhanopālambhaprayoge kriyamāṇe ekapakṣanirṇayāvasāno vākyasamūha
apare vāsubāndhavā tu svaparapakṣayo siddhyasiddhyartha vacana vāda
ekādhikaraṇasthau viruddhau dharmau pakṣapratipakṣau pratyanīkabhāvāt astyātmā nāstyātmā iti, nānāvikaraṇasthau viruddhau na pakṣapratipakṣau yathā nitya ātmā anityā buddhiriti
vastudharmau iti vastuviśeṣau vastuna nānādhikaraṇau vicāra na prayojayata ubhayo pramāṇopapatte tadyathā anityā buddhirnitya ātmeti
aviruddhāvapyevam, yo viruddho tau vicāra prayojayata nāviruddhau, tadyathā kriyāvaddravya guṇavacceti
ekakālāviti, bhinnakālayo na vicāraprayojakatva pramāṇopapatte, yathā kriyāvaddravya niṣkriyañca kālabhede sati
anavasitāviti, aniścitau vicāraṃ prayojayato nāvasitāviti, nirṇayottarakāla vicārābhāvāt
tāvetau viruddhāve- vaṃviśeṣaṇau dharmau prakṣapratipakṣau, tayo parigraha itthaṃbhāvaniyama evaṃdharmā'yaṃ dhamī naivadharmeti
pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahaśca jalpa-vitaṇḍayorapyaviśiṣṭaḥ, ataḥ pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambha iti tadviśeṣaṇam, pramāṇaiḥ tarkeṇa ca sādhanam upālambhaśca yasmin sa tathoktaḥ
pramāṇaśabdena pramāṇamūlāḥ pratijñādyavayavā vyapadiśyante, tato vāde pramāṇabuddhiparigṛhītayoreva sādhanopālambhayoḥ prayogaḥ
tarkaśabdena ca bhūtapūrvagatinyāyena vītarāgakathātvajñāpanād udbhāvananiyamo labhyate

tena vāde pramāṇabuddhyā pareṇa chalajātinigrahasthānāni prayuktāni na nigrahabuddhyā udbhāvyante, kintu nivāraṇabuddhyā, tattvajñānāya āvayoḥ pravṛttiḥ, na ca sādhanābhāso dūṣaṇābhāso vā tattvajñānanimittam, ato na tatprayogo yuktaḥ
upālambhaśravaṇāt samastanigrahasthānānuṣaṅgaḥ iti cenna; uttarayoḥ padayorniyamārthatvāt
tena siddhāntāviruddhaḥ ityanena apasiddhāntaḥ, pañcāvayavopapannaḥ ityanena ca pañcagrahaṇāt nyūna-adhike, avayavagrahaṇāt hetvābhāsapañcakañca ityaṣṭāveva nigrahasthānāni vāde niyamyante

kasmāditi cet ? gurvādinā saha vādopa deśāt, yasmād ayaṃ tattvaṃ bubhutsurgurvādinā saha saṃśayaviccheda-ajñātārthāvabodha-adhyavasitābhyanujñālakṣaṇaṃ trividhaṃ phalamākāṅkṣan vādaṃ karoti, tano'sya tattvabubhutsāvataḥ tāvad anena sādhana vaktavyaṃ yāvadasau tattvaṃ pratipadyate apratidvanditvāt
iha tu na pramāṇaśabdena pratyakṣāderanumānam api tu pramāṇamūlā avayavā ucyante taiśca siddhyupālabdhī kriyete
upālambhagrahaṇāt samastanigrahasthānaprasaktau sajñābhedamātram na, uttarayo niyamārthatvāt
bhāṣyakāramatena–siddhāntāviruddha iti padena viruddha eva hetvābhāso'bhyanujñāta nyāyabhā॰ 1
1 vārtikakāramatena ca siddhāntāviruddha iti padena apasiddhāntanigrahasthānasyābhyanujñā

tathāhi–siddhāntāviruddha iti padena viruddho hetvābhāso labhyate tanna, anyato'dhigatepañcāvayavopanna iti pañcagrahaṇāt nyūnādhike labhyete avayavagrahaṇāt tadābhāsā labhyante iti labhyamānārthasya punarabhidhāne piṣṭaṃ piṣṭaṃ syāt
atha kimidaṃ padaṃ siddhāntāviruddha ityanarthakameva ? nānarthakam, apasiddhāntāvarodhāt
ayaṃ tu viśeṣa jatpe kasyāñcidavasthāyā buddhipūrvakamapi chalādiprayoga kriyate vāde tu vṛthā teṣā prayoga
gurvādinā saha vādopadeśāt, yasmādayaṃ tattvabubhutsu gurvādibhi saha trividha phalamākāṅkṣan vādaṃ karoti
anadhigatatattvāvabodha saśayanivṛtti adhyavasitābhyanujñānam iti phalāni trīṇi
tato'sya tattvabubhutsāvata tāvatsādhanaṃ vaktavyaṃ yāvadanena jñātavyamapratidvanditvāt

2 yathoktopapannagrahaṇena pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhamātramupalakṣyate, na samastaṃ vādalakṣaṇam, siddhāntā'viruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ iti uttarapadadvayasya nigrahasthānaniyamanibandhanasya atra abhisambandhā'saṃbhavāt, jalpe samastanigrahasthānānāṃ saṃbhavāt

nanu chalajātinigrahasthānasādhanopālambha ityayuktam, chalādīnāmasaduttaratvena sādhanadūṣaṇatvā'nupapatte; tadayuktam; pramāṇai kriyamāṇayoḥ sādhanopālambhayo chalādīnāmaṅgabhāvo rakṣaṇārthatvāt na svatantrāṇāṃ sādhanadūṣaṇabhāva; nahi tāni svayaṃ sādhanatvena dūṣaṇatvena vā prayujyante, kintu samyaksādhane prayukte para chalajātyādinā pratyavatiṣṭhamānaḥ chalaṃ jātiḥ nigrahasthānaṃ vā tvayā prayuktam ityevaṃ tadudbhāvanadvāreṇa nirasyate, niraste tasmin svapakṣa parirakṣito bhavati
pareṇa vā sādhane prayukte sahasā doṣamapaśyan svaya jātyādinā pratyavatiṣṭhate
jātyādyākulitaśca prativādī uttaramapratipadyamāno jīyate, jite tasmin apratipakṣā svapakṣasiddhiriti
hṛdayasthapramāṇopapannatattvajñānasaṃrakṣaṇāya kvacid vītarāgasyāpi upayujyante chalā dīni, anyathā prāñjalamatirduṣṭatārkikaparikalpitadūṣaṇāḍambareṇa tattvādhyavasāyāt pracālyeta
yathā ekasya pakṣa punarbhavo'stīti nāstītyaparasya, tau ca hetubhi svasvapakṣaṃ sthāpayata parasparamudbhāvayata eṣa jalpa
yatra vijigīṣu vijigīṣuṇā saha lābhapūjākhyātikāmo jayaparājayārthaṃ pravarttate sā vijigīṣukathā vijigīṣukathā jalpavitaṇḍāsaṃjñoktā
2 majarī pṛ॰ 594 kārayormatena yathoktopapanna padena samasta vādalakṣaṇamatidiśyate
athavā yathoktopapannena upapanna yathoktopapannopapanna iti prāpte gamyamānatvādekasya upapannaśabdasya lopa yathā goratha iti
kena punarayaṃ gamyate iti ? uktaṃ sāmarthyeneti
pramāṇai sādhanopālambhayo chalajātinigrahasthānānāmaṅgabhāva svapakṣarakṣaṇārthatvāt na svatantrāṇā sādhanabhāva
3 sa yathokto jalpaḥ pratipakṣasthāpanāhīnatayā viśeṣito vitaṇḍātvaṃ pratipadyate
vaitaṇḍikasya ca svapakṣa eva sādhanavādipakṣāpekṣayā pratipakṣaḥ hastipratihastinyāyena, tasmin pratipakṣe vaitaṇḍiko na sādhanaṃ vakti, kevalaṃ parapakṣapratiṣedhāyaiva pravarttate iti
yathā prativādina pakṣo vādipakṣāpekṣayā pratipakṣaḥ, evaṃ vādipakṣo'pi prativādipakṣāpekṣayā pratipakṣa iti ubhayapakṣasthāpanāhīnā
uttarapakṣavādī vaitaṇḍikaḥ prathamavādiprasādhyamānapakṣāpekṣayā hastipratihastinyāyena pratipakṣa ityucyate
5 vyabhicāraḥ aniyamaḥ, tena saha yo varttate sa savyabhicāraḥ, anaikāntikaḥ–ekasmin ante bhavaḥ aikāntikaḥ tadviparyayād anaikāntikaḥ, yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prameyatvāt iti
vyabhicāraḥ ekatrā'vyavasthāekasminnante vidyate ityaikāntiko viparyayādanaikāntikaḥ ubhayāntavyāpakatvāditi

6 siddhāntaśabdo dharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi prasiddho'pi iha sādhyaviṣayo grahītavyaḥ, tena sādhyadharmamabhyupagamya yastaṃ viruṇaddhi-viparyayaṃ sādhayati sa viruddhaḥ, yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt iti
sapakṣe sattvaṃ yasya nāsti vipakṣe ca vṛttirasti sa sādhyaviparyayasādhanād viruddho bhavati
siddhāntaśabdo yadyapi dharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi vyākhyātatathāpīha tadekadeśasādhyadharmaviṣayo lakṣyate
prakaraṇasamasya lakṣaṇam–yasmāt prakaraṇacintā sa nirṇayārthamapadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇasamaḥ

7 vicāryamāṇau pakṣapratipakṣau prakaraṇam, tasya cintā saṃśayāt prabhṛti ānirṇayāt yadyapi bhavati, tathāpi iha vimarśātmikaiva gṛhyate, sā ca viśeṣā'nupalambhādeva bhavati, sa eva ca viśeṣā'nupalambho yadā nirṇayārthamapadiśyate tadā tat prakaraṇamanativarttamānatvāt prakaraṇasamo bhavati
yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ anityadharmā'nupalabdheḥ ākāśavat iti ekena ukte dvitīyaḥ prāha–anityaḥ śabdaḥ nityadharmānupalabdheḥ ghaṭavat, na ca dvyātmakāni vastūni yujyante
viśeṣā'grahaṇāt prakaraṇe saṃśayo bhavati, nityaḥ śabdo'nityaḥ śabdo veti
tadeva viśeṣāgrahaṇaṃ bhrāntyā hetutvena prayojyamānaṃ prakaraṇasamo hetvābhāso bhavati

vimarśādhiṣṭhānau pakṣapratipakṣau ubhau prakaraṇam, tasya cintā vimarśāt prabhṛti prāṅ nirṇayāt yat samīkṣaṇam sā jijñāsā yatkṛtā sa nirṇayārthaṃ prayuktaḥ ubhayapakṣasāmyāt prakaraṇamanativarttamānaḥ prakaraṇasamo nirṇayāya na prakalpate
sa eva viśeṣānupalambho yadi nirṇayārthamupadiśyate tat prakaraṇamanativarttamānatvāt prakaraṇasamo bhavati
8 prativādinaṃ prati sādhayituṃ yad upādīyate tat sādhyam, tadaviśiṣṭo hetuḥ sādhyasamaḥ
kathaṃ hetoḥ sādhyena tulyatā iti cet ? sādhyatvāt, yathā mīmāṃsakaṃ prati anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt ghaṭavat iti
anyataravādiprasiddhamanyataraṃ prati yatsādhayitumupādīyate tatsādhyamtadaviśiṣṭo hetuḥ sādhyasamaḥ, kathaṃ sādhyena tulyatā ? iti cedāha–sādhyatvāditi
9 hetoḥ prayogakālaḥ pratyakṣāgamā'bādhitapakṣaparigrahād anantaraḥ, tam atītya yo heturapadiśyate sa kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ
yathā anuṣṇaḥ tejo'vayavī kṛtakatvāt ghaṭavat, brāhmaṇena surā pātavyā dravadravyatvāt kṣīravat iti
atītakālaṃ nāma yat pūrvaṃ vācyaṃ tat paścāducyate tat kālātītatvādagrāhyaṃ bhavati

hetorapadeśasya hi sādhyasandehaviśiṣṭaḥ kālaḥ,yatra ca pratyakṣānumānāgamavirodhaḥsa sarvaḥ pramāṇato viparītanirṇayena sandehaviśiṣṭaṃ kālamatipatati, so'yaṃ kālasyātyayena apadiśyamānaḥ kālātīta iti
hetoḥ prayogakālaḥ pratyakṣāgamānupahatapakṣaparigrahasamaya evauṣṇo na tejo'vayavī kṛtakatvāt ghaṭādivat
dṛḍhatarapramāṇabādhito hi hetuḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭo bhavati, yathā brāhmaṇena surā peyā dravadravyatvāt kṣīravaditi
10 vacanavighātaḥ na mukhapidhānena api tu arthavikalpopapattyā, vakturanabhipretamarthaṃ tadukte vacasi samāropya chalavādī tanniṣedhaṃ karoti kalpyamānaghaṭanayā iti sāmānyalakṣaṇam
11 tat sāmānyalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ chalaṃ vākchalādibhedena trividhaṃ bhavati
vakturanabhipretamarthāttadukte vacasi samāropya tanniṣedhaṃ chalavādī karotivikalpyamānārthaghaṭanayā
12 aviśeṣābhihite–aviśeṣeṇa śabde prayukte sati vakturabhipretamarthamapahnutya parikalpya tanniṣedhavacanaṃ vāci nimittabhūtāyāṃ chalaṃ vākchalam

yathā navakambalo devadattaḥ ityukte navaḥ kambalo'sya, nava kambalā asya iti ca samāsapadam arthadvaye'pyaviśiṣṭam, tatra abhinavakambalayogaṃ vakturabhipretaṃ pramāṇopapannañca apahnutya navasaṃkhyāsambandhamadhyāropya tatpratiṣedhena paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–kuto'sya nava kambalāḥ ? iti
vākchalaṃ nāma yathā kaścid brūyāt–navatantro'yaṃ bhiṣag iti
paro brūyāt nāhaṃ bravīmi navatantrāṇi taveti api tu navābhyastaṃ hi te tantramiti
bhiṣag brūyāt na mayā navābhyastaṃ tantram, anekadhā abhyastaṃ mayā tantramiti

sāmānyacchalaṃ nāma yathā vyādhipraśamanāyauṣadhamityukte paro brūyāt sat satpraśamanāyeti bhavānāha, san hi roga sadauṣadham, yadi ca sat satpraśamanāya bhavati san hi kāsa san kṣaya, satsāmānyāt kāsaste kṣayapraśamanāya bhaviṣyati iti
yathā kaścidāha–yo mayā parihita sa navakambalaḥ atra dūṣaṇaṃ vadet yadbhavatā parihitaṃ tadekameva vastraṃ kathaṃ naveti
atra prativadet mayā nava ityuktaṃ tathā ca navaḥ kambala na tu naveti
atra dūṣayet kathaṃ nava ? navalomairnirmitatvānnava ityukte prativādī vadet tattvato'parimitāni lomāni kathaṃ navalomānītyucyate ? atrāha–nava iti mayā pūrvamuktaṃ na tu navasaṃkhyā
atra dūṣaṇaṃ tadvastraṃ yuṣmākameveti jñātaṃ kasmādetanna va kathyate
atrottaram-mayā nava ityuktaṃ kintu na va iti noktam
atra dūṣaṇam–bhavataḥ kāyaṃ kambalo vasta iti pratyakṣametat, kathamucyate na va kambala
aparañca vākchalam, yathā girirdahyate ityukte dūṣaṇam–tattvata tṛṇataravo dahyante kathaṃ girirdahyata ityuktam

13 ati–vyāpakaṃ sāmānyam atisāmānyam, tadyogāt kvacid vyaktau arthasya kasyacit saṃbhavato vyaktyantare saṃbhāvyamānaniṣpatteḥ vaktrā'bhihitasya sato yad asadbhūtārthakalpanayā pratyavasthānam tat sāmānyanimittatvāt sāmānyachalam
yathā saṃbhavati brāhmaṇe vidyācaraṇasampat ityukte chalavādyāha–na, vrātyena anekāntāt, tadayuktam; hetutvena anupanyāsāt, na hi brāhmaṇatvaṃ vidyācaraṇasampattau hetutvena upanyastam
vyaktau ca tattvasya kasyacit sambandhe vyaktyantare bhā॰

ati vyāpaka sāmānyamatisāmānyam, tadyogāt tatsabhavāt kvacid vyaktārthasya kasyacit saṃbhavata sabhāvyamānaniṣpatte vaktrā'bhihitasya sato yā'sadbhūtārthakalpanā tayā ca pratyavasthāna tat sāmānyanimittaṃ chalaṃ sāmānyachalamiti

aho nu khalvasau brāhmaṇa vidyācaraṇasampanna yadi brāhmaṇe vidyācaraṇasampat sabhavati brātye'pi sabhavetasya pratyavasthānam– avivakṣitahetukasya viṣayānuvāda praśasārthatvāt sampadviṣayo brāhmaṇatvaṃ na sampaddhetu
api ca chala dvividha pūrvavat sāmānyañceti
yathā saskṛtā dharmā śūnyā ākāśavadityukte dūṣaṇam–ubhayorapi śūnyatvamabhāvaśca tadā ni svabhāvā dharmā ākāśatulyā iti sāmānyachalam

14 dharmaḥ krośanādi, tasya vikalpaḥ upacāra, tena nirdeśe mañcāḥ krośanti gāyanti ityādiprayoge kṛte yo'rthasadbhāvapratiṣedha mukhyārthapratiṣedha–katham acetanā mañcāḥ krośānti ? ki tarhi ? puruṣāstatrasthā krośanti na mañcā, iti upacāranimittaṃ chalam upacāracchalam
taccāyuktam; yathāvaktrabhiprāyamapratiṣedhāt, abhidhānaprayogo hi loke gauṇo mukhyaśca prasiddha iti

atra samādhi–prasiddhe prayoge vakturyathābhiprāyaṃ śabdārthayoranujñā pratiṣedho vā na chandata, pradhānabhūtasya śabdasya bhāktasya ca guṇabhūtasya prayoga ubhayorlokasiddha, siddhaprayoge yathā vakturabhiprāya tathā śabdārthāvanujñeyau pratipedhyau vā na chandata
yadi vaktā pradhānaśabdaṃ prayuṅkte tathābhūtasyābhyanujñā pratiṣedho vā na chandata
atha guṇabhūtaṃ tadā guṇabhūtasya, yatra tu vaktā guṇabhūtaṃ śabdaṃ prayuṅkte pradhānabhūtamabhipretya para pratipedhati, svamanīṣayā pratiṣedho'sau bhavati na paropālambha iti
pratikūlam ava sthānam pratyavasthānam, sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vā yat pratyavasthānaṃ hetupratibimbanaprāyaṃ sā jātiḥ iti
tatra jātirnāma sthāpanāhetau prayukte ya pratirodhāsamartho hetu
yadeva prakāraṃ pratyavasthānaṃ hetuprativimbavartmanā kriyate sā jāti

yadi khaṇḍanametat trividhadoṣopetaṃ tadā nigrahasthānamviparītakhaṇḍanaṃ daśavidham–sādharmyakhaṇḍanam, vaidharmyakhaṇḍanam, vikalpakhaṇḍanam, aviśeṣakhaṇḍanam, prāptyaprāptikhaṇḍanam, ahetukhaṇḍanam, upalabdhikhaṇḍanam, saṃśayakhaṇḍanam, anuktikhaṇḍanam, kāryabhedakhaṇḍanam
pṛ॰ 12 asatkhaṇḍanaṃ trividham–avarṇya vyañjaka khaṇḍanam, arthāpatti vyañjaka khaṇḍanam, pratidṛṣṭārtha vyañjaka khaṇḍanañca
pṛ॰ 28 samyakkhaṇḍanaṃ pañcavidham–iṣṭārthadūṣaṇam, aniṣṭārthavyakti, prasaṅgavyaktiḥ, viṣamārthavyakti, sarvanyāyasiddhilābhavyakti

eṣāṃ viśatividhānāṃ sāro dvividhaḥ sādharmyaṃ vaidharmyañcaevaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ viṃśatividham yathā–utkarṣasamam, apakarṣasamam, bhedābhedasamam, praśnabāhulyamuttarālpatā, praśnālpatottarabāhulyam, hetusamam, kāryasamam, vyāptisamam, avyāptisamam, kālasamam, prāptisamam, aprāptisamam, viruddham, aviruddham, saṃśayasamam, asaṃśayasamam, pratidṛṣṭāntasamam, śrutisamam, śrutibhinnam, anupapattisamañceti praśnottaradharmā viṃśatidhā
samīkaraṇārtha prayoga samaḥ, sādharmyameva samaṃ vaidharmyameva samamiti samārthaḥ samīkaraṇārthaḥ prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ
viśeṣahetvabhāvo vā samārtha na bhavatā viśeṣahetuḥ kaścid apadiśyata iti
niyamenaiva jātivādī asadvādī bhavati, vādināṃ tu sadasadvāditve'niyama iti
2 sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vā sādhanamabhidhāya sisādhayiṣitapakṣopasaṃhāre sādhanavādinā kṛte sādhyadharmaviparyayopapādanāya sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ sādharmyasamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ

yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnānantarīyakatvāt, yat prayatnānantarīyakaṃ tadanityam yathā ghaṭaḥ iti sādharmyeṇa hetau prayukte jātivādī sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavatiṣṭhate–nityaḥ śabdaḥ niravayavatvāt, yanniravayavaṃ tat nityaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti, na cātra viśeṣaheturasti ghaṭasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvād anitya śabdaḥ na ca ākāśasādharmyāt niravayavatvāt nitya iti

vaidharmyeṇa vā pratyavatiṣṭhate–nityaḥśabdo niravayavatvāt, yat punaranityaṃ tat sāvayavaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa, na cāsti viśeṣahetuḥ ghaṭasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvāt anitya śabda na puna ghaṭavaidharmyāt niravayavatvāt nitya iti
sādharmyeṇopasaṃhāre sādhyadharmaviparyayopapatte sādharmyeṇaiva pratyavasthānamaviśiṣyamāṇaṃ sthāpanāhetutaḥ sādharmyasamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ

atha sādharmyasama–kriyāvān loṣṭha kriyāhetuguṇayukto dṛṣṭa tathā cātmā tasmāt kriyāvān iti, na cāsti viśeṣahetu kriyāvadvaidharmyāt niṣkriyo na puna kriyāvatsādharmyāt kriyāvāniti viśeṣahetvabhāvāt sādharmyasama

vaidharmyahetāvapi sādhanavādinā prayukte anitya śabda prayatnānantarīyakatvāt yat punaranityaṃ na bhavati tat prayatnānantarīyakamapi na bhavati yathā ākāśam ityatrāpi etenaiva pūrvoktaprayogadvayena pratyavasthāna vaidharmyasama iti
vaidharmyeṇokte hetau tadviparītavaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ sādharmyeṇokte hetau tadviparītavaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ vaidharmyasama
4 yatra dṛṣṭāntadharmaṃ sādhyadharmiṇi asantamapi āropayattu payan utkarṣeṇa pratyavasthāna karoti sā utkarṣasamā jātiḥ

yathā anitya śabda prayatnānantarīyakatvāt ghaṭavat ityukte para prāha–yadi prayatnānantarīyakatvāt ghaṭavad anitya śabda tarhi tadvadeva mūrtto'pyastu, atha na mūrttaḥ tarhi anityo'pi mābhūt aviśeṣāt iti
asantamadhyāropayannutkarṣeṇa pratyavasthānaṃ yatkaroti sa utkarṣasama pratiṣedha
dṛṣṭāntadharmavikalpanenaiva sādhyadharmiṇi siddhasyāpi dharmasya apakarṣeṇa pratyavasthānam apakarṣasamā jāti
yathā asminneva prayoge ghaṭaḥ prayatnānantarīyakaḥ aśrāvaṇo dṛṣṭa śabdo'pi tathāstu, anyathā anityo na syād aviśeṣāt iti

khyāpanīyo varṇya sādhyadharmidharma, tadviparyayādavarṇyo dṛṣṭāntadharmaḥ, tau varṇyā'varṇyau viparyasyan itaram itareṇa samīkurvan pratyavasthānaṃ karoti–yadi śabdo'nityatvena varṇyate–sādhyate tadā ghaṭo'pi varṇyatām-sādhyatām iti varṇyasamā
ghaṭaścenna varṇyate–na sādhyate tarhi śabdo'pi na varṇyatām iti avarṇyasamā
khyāpanīyo varṇya viparyayādavarṇya, tāvetau sādhyadṛṣṭāntadharmau viparyasyato varṇyā'varṇyasamau bhavataḥ

yathā atraiva sādhane prayukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–prayatnānantarīyakaṃ kiñcin mṛdu dṛśyate praveṇyādi, kiñcit kaṭhinaṃ karparādi, evaṃ prayatnānantarīyakaṃ ghaṭādi anityaṃ bhaviṣyati śabdādi tu nityamiti
sādhanadharmayukte dṛṣṭānte dharmāntaravikalpāt sādhyadharmavikalpaṃ prasajato vikalpasama

yathā atraiva sādhane prayukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–yadi yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā śabdaḥ tarhi yathā śabdaḥ tathā ghaṭo'stu, śabdaśca anityatayā sādhyaḥ iti ghaṭo'pi sādhya eva syāt, kathamanyathā tena tulyatā ?
hetvādyavayavayogī dharma sādhya, taṃ dṛṣṭānte prasajata sādhyasama

hetau sādhanavādinā prayukte prativādī āha–ayaṃ hetuḥ prāpya sādhyaṃ sādhayet, aprāpya vā ? yadi prāpya; tarhi dvayorlabdhasvarūpayoryugapat saṃbhavāt kathamekasya sādhyatā anyasya hetutā viśeṣā'bhāvāt ? iti prāptisamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
atha aprāpya hetuḥ sādhyaṃ sādhayet; tarhi sarvaṃ sādhyaṃ kinna asau sādhayed aviśeṣāt ? nahi aprāpya pradīpa prakāśyaṃ prakāśayati iti aprāptisamaḥ
prāpya sādhyamaprāpya vā heto prāptyā'viśiṣṭatvādaprāptyā'sādhakatvācca prāptyaprāptisamau
hetu sādhyaṃ prāpnoti, na vā ? yadi sādhyaṃ prāpnoti tadā'sādhaka, atha hetusādhyaṃ na prāpnoti tadāpyasādhakaḥ
9 yathā prāktane eva sādhane ghaṭāderdṛṣṭāntasya anityatāyāṃ ki kāraṇam ? na ca tadantareṇa sādhyasiddhiḥ atiprasaṅgāt hetvantarānveṣaṇe cānavasthā iti prasaṅgasamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
sādhanasyāpi sādhanaṃ vaktavyamiti prasaṅgena pratyavasthānaṃ prasaṅgasama
yathā prayatnānantarīyako ghaṭādiḥ anityo dṛṣṭaḥ, tathā ākāśaṃ prayatnānantarīyakaṃ nityaṃ dṛśyate, tadvat śabdo'pi nityaḥ syāt
kaḥ punaḥ ākāśasya prayatnānantarīyakatvaṃ vadet ? kūpakhananādinā ākāśasya kāryatāṃ manvānaḥ kaścid eva brūyāt

na caivaṃ vyabhicārodbhāvanametat samyaguttaraṃ na asaduttaraprakāro jātiprayogaḥ ityabhidhātavyam, yato na hetoranaikāntikatvam udbhāvayannasau sādhuriva jātivādī pratyavatiṣṭhate, api tu dṛṣṭāntabalena nityatvameva sādhayan utthita iti
pratidṛṣṭāntabalāt sādhanam, etaducyate pratidṛṣṭānta vyañjaka khaṇḍanam
sādhuriva jātivādī pratyavatiṣṭhate api tu dṛṣṭāntabalena nityatvameṣa sādhayannutthita iti

12 yathā atraiva prayoge jātivādī āha–pūrvamanutpanne śabdākhye dharmiṇi prayatnānantarīyakatvaṃ dharmaḥ kva varttatām, alabdhapakṣavṛttiśca kathamanityatvaṃ sādhayet ? asiddhe ca anityatve śabdasya balāt nityatvameva siddhyet
athavā śabdotpādakakāraṇābhāvād anutpanne śabde nirāśrayo heturiti

14 yathā atraiva prayoge paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–ghaṭena anityena prayatnānantarīyakatvaṃ śabdasya sādharmyam, sāmānyena ca nityena aindriyakatvam, tataḥ ki prayatnānantarīyakatvād anityaḥ śabdaḥ syāt kimvā aindriyakatvāt nityaḥ iti ?
sādharmyavaidharmyasamā jātiryā pūrvamudāhṛtā saiva saśayenopakriyamāṇā saṃśayasamā
saśayasamo nāmā'heturya eva saṃśayahetu sa eva saśayacchedahetu yathā ayamāyurvedaikadeśamāha kintvayaṃ cikitsaka syānnaveti saṃśaye paro brūyāt–yasmādayamāyurvedaikadeśamāha tasmāccikitsako'yamiti
na ca saṃśayahetuṃ viśeṣayati, eṣa cā'hetu

16 yathā asminneva prayoge anityasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvāt kaścidanityatāṃ sādhayati, aparaḥ punaḥ nityākāśasādharmyāt niravayavatvāt nityatām iti, ataḥ pakṣe vipakṣe ca prakriyā samānā siddhā iti
ubhayena nityena cānityena sādharmyāt pakṣapratipakṣayo pravṛttiḥ prakriyāprakaraṇānativṛttyā pratyavasthānaṃ prakaraṇasama
dvitīyapakṣotthāpanabuddhyā prayujyamānā saiva sādharmyasamā vaidharmyasamā jāti prakaraṇasamā bhavati

tatra prakaraṇasamo nāmā'hetu yathā anya śarīdātmā nitya iti pakṣe brūyāt–yasmādanya śarīrādātmā tasmānnitya, śarīraṃ hyanityamato vidharmiṇā cātmanā bhavitavyamityeṣa cā'hetu, na hi ya eva pakṣaḥ sa eva hetu
18 yathā samyak sādhane prayukte dūṣaṇamapaśyan jātivādī āha–'sādhyāt pūrvaṃ vā sādhanam, uttaraṃ vā, sahabhāvi vā syāt ? na tāvat pūrvam; asatyarthe tasya sādhanatvā'nupapatteḥ
nāpyuttaram; asati sādhane pūrvaṃ sādhyasya sādhyasvarūpatvā'saṃbhavāt
nāpi sahabhāvi; svatantratayā prasiddhayo sādhya-sādhanabhāvā'saṃbhavāt sahyavindhyavat iti ahetusamatvena pratyavasthānam ahetusamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
hetu sādhanaṃ pūrva paścāt saha vā bhavetiti heturahetunā na viśiṣyate, ahetunā sādharmyāt pratyavasthānamahetusama
prativādī prāha–ki hetu sādhyātpūrva paścād yugapadvā ? tarkaśā॰ pṛ॰ 18
21 yathā prāktana eva sādhane prayukte jātivādī āha–yadi ghaṭasādharmyāt prayatnānantarīyakatvād anityaḥ śabdaḥ tadā arthādāpadyate–niravayatvāt ākāśasādharmyāt nityaḥ iti
arthādāpadyate pratipakṣasiddhirityevaṃ kriyamāṇa pratiṣedha arthāpattisamo bhavati

23 yathā atraiva sādhane prayukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–yadi śabda-ghaṭayoḥ eko dharmaḥ prayatnānantarīyakatvamasti iti tayoḥ anityatvā'viśeṣo'bhidhīyate, tarhi sarvārtheṣu sattvadharmasya upapatteḥ anityatvā'viśeṣaḥ syāt iti
25 yathā asminneva sādhane prayukte jātivādī pratyavatiṣṭhate–yadi anitye kāraṇaṃ prayatnānantarīyakatvamasti iti anityo'sau tadā nityatve'pi asya kāraṇaṃ niravayavatvam asti iti nityo'stu iti
ubhayasya anityatvasya nityatvasya ca kāraṇopapattyā pratyavasthānamupapattisama
nanu saiveyaṃ sādharmyādisamā prakaraṇasamā vā jātirna bhedāntaram, maivam, udbhāvanaprakāreṇa bhedāt
parapakṣopamardabuddhyā sādharmyādisamā jāti prayujyate, pakṣāntarotthāpanāsthayā prakaraṇasamā, apratipattiparyavasāyitvāśayeneyamupapattisameti
27 nirdiṣṭasya sādhyadharmasiddhikāraṇasya abhāve'pi sādhyadharmoṣalabdhyā pratyavasthānam upalabdhisamaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ
yathā atraiva sādhane prayukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–śākhādibhaṅgaje śabde vidyudādau ca prayatnānantarīyakatvābhāve'pi anityatvamasti iti

29 yathā prāguccāraṇād avidyamāna śabdaḥ asatyāvaraṇe'nupalabdheḥ, āvaraṇā'sattvañca anupalabdheḥ siddham, yasya tu darśanāt prāg vidyamānasya anupalabdhiḥ na tasya āvaraṇā'nupalabdhiḥ yathā paṭādyāvṛtasya ghaṭāde, āvaraṇā'nupalabdhiśca śravaṇāt prāk śabdasya ityukte jātivādī āha–tadanupalabdhe śabdāvaraṇā'nupalabdherapyanupalambhād abhāvasiddhiḥ āvaraṇā'nupalabdhirnāsti anupalabdheḥ iti, tadviparītopapatteḥ śabdasya abhāvaviparītatvena bhāvasyopapatteḥ anupalabdhisama pratiṣedhaḥ

32 yathā asminneva prayoge paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate–yadi śabdasya anityena ghaṭena sādharmya prayatnānantarīyakatvamasti iti anityatvaṃ syāt, tadā sarvabhāvānāṃ sattvādinā ghaṭena sādharmyamasti iti anityatvaṃ syāditi
aviśeṣasamaiveyaṃ jātiriti cet; tatra hi sattāyogāt sarvabhāvanāmaviśeṣa āpādita iha tu ghaṭasādharmyādeva anityatvamāpāditamiti udbhāvanabhaṅgibhedācca jātinānātvamiti
aviśeṣasamāto'nityasamā na bhidyate tatrāpi sarvāviśeṣa ihāpīti

35 yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityukte jātivādī anityatvākhyasādhyadharmasvarūpavikalpanena śabdasya nityatvamāpādayati; tathāhi–kimidam anityatvaṃ śabdasya nityam, anityaṃ vā ? yadi nityam; tarhi dharmasya nityatvāt tadāśrayasyāpi śabdasya nityamanityabhāvād anityadharmādhāratayā'sattvāt nityatvam
atha anityam; tatrāpi anityatve anitye siddhaṃ nityatvaṃ śabdasya iti

37 yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatnānantarīyakatvāt ityukte paraḥ prayatnakāryā'nekatvopanyāsena pratyavatiṣṭhate–prayatnasya kāryavaividhyamupalabhyate, kiñcid asadeva prayatnena abhinirvartyate yathā ghaṭādi, kiñcit sadeva āvaraṇāpanayanadvāreṇa abhivyajyate yathā kāṇḍapaṭādyāvṛtaṃ ghaṭādi, iti kathamataḥ śabdasya anityatā iti ?
na ceyaṃ saṃśayasamā jāti, hetvarthavikalpanena iha pratyavasthānāt
kāryabhedāt ghaṭavacchabda iti na vaktavyam, etat kāryabhedakhaṇḍanamucyate
19 viruddhā kutsitā vā pratipattiḥ vipratipattiḥ, tattvapratipatterabhāvo'pratipattiḥ iti sakalanigrahasthānānāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamidam

tāni ca dvāviśatiprakārāṇi bhavanti–pratijñāhāniḥ, pratijñāntaram, pratijñāvirodhaḥ, pratijñāsannyāsaḥ, hetvantaram, arthāntaram, nirarthakam, avijñātārtham, apārthakam, aprāptakālam, nyūnam, adhikam, punaruktam, ananubhāṣaṇam, ajñānam, apratibhā, vikṣepaḥ, matānujñā, paryyanuyojyopekṣaṇam, niranuyojyānuyogaḥ, apasiddhāntaḥ, hetvābhāsāśca nigrahasthānāni
tatra ananubhāṣaṇam, ajñānam, apratibhā, vikṣepaḥ, paryanuyojyopekṣaṇam iti apratipattyā saṅgṛhītāni, śeṣāṇi vipratipattyā
viparītā kutsitā vā pratipattiḥ vipratipattiapratipattistu ārambhaviṣaye'pyaprārambha–pareṇa sthāpitaṃ vā na pratiṣedhati pratiṣedhaṃ vā noddharati
tasmādekasya prakṛtasiddhereva parasya nigraho na prakārāntareṇa
nigrahasthānaṃ nāma tribhirabhihitasya vākyasyāparijñānaṃ pariṣadi vijñānavatyām, yadvā ananuyojyasya anuyoga anuyojyasya cānanuyoga
pratijñāhānirabhyanujñā kālātītavacanamahetavo nyūnamatiriktam vyarthamapārthaka punarukta viruddha hetvantaramarthāntaraṃ nigrahasthānam
mañjarīkṛtā tu ananubhāṣaṇamajñānamapratibhā vikṣepa paryanuyojyopekṣaṇam iti pañcaiva apratipattirūpeṇa gaṇitāni nyāyama pṛ॰ 639, nyāyakali॰ pṛ॰ 22 prakṛte tu mañjarīkṛtāmeva mataṃ samādṛtam
2 pratijñāsiddhaye vādinā sādhane abhihite prativādinā ca tatra dūṣaṇe, tṛtīye vacasi varttamāno vādī yadi pratidṛṣṭāntadharma svadṛṣṭānte anujānāti tadā asya pratijñā hīyate iti pratijñāhāniḥ

yathā anitya śabdaḥ aindriyakatvāt ghaṭavat ityukte paraḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate– sāmānyam aindriyakaṃ nityaṃ dṛṣṭam ityanaikāntiko'yaṃ hetu ityukte sādhanavādī āha–yadi sāmānyam aindriyakaṃ nityam, kāmaṃ ghaṭo'pi tathāstu iti
sādhyadharmapratyanīkena dharmeṇa pratyavasthite pratidṛṣṭāntadharma svadṛṣṭānte abhyanujānan pratijñā jahā tīti pratijñāhāni

bhāṣyakārīyavyākhyāne vārtikakārasya matabheda, tathāhi– etattu na buddhyāmahe kathamatra pratijñā hīyate iti ? hetoranaikāntikatvaṃ sāmānyadṛṣṭāntena pareṇa codite tasyānaikāntikadoṣoddhāramanuktvā svadṛṣṭānte nityatā pratipadyate
nityatāpratipatteścāsiddhatā dṛṣṭāntadoṣo bhavati, so'ya dṛṣṭāntadoṣeṇa sādhanadoṣeṇa vā nigraho na pratijñāhāni
katha tarhi idaṃ sūtram–pratidṛṣṭāntadharmābhyanujñā svadṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniriti ? dṛṣṭaścāsau ante vyavasthitaśca iti dṛṣṭānta, svaścāsau dṛṣṭāntaśceti, svadṛṣṭāntaśabdena pakṣa eva abhidhīyate
etadukta bhavati–parapakṣasya yo dharmasta svapakṣa evānujānāti eṣā pratijñāhāni
pratijñāhānirnāma sā pūrvapratigṛhītā pratijñā paryanuyukta parityajati

3 pratijñātārthasya anityaḥ śabdaḥ ityādeḥ aindrikatvasya hetorvyabhicārapradarśanena pratiṣedhe kṛte taṃ doṣamanuddharan dharmavikalpaṃ karoti–kimayam asarvagataḥ śabdaḥ ghaṭavat, ki vā sarvagataḥ sāmānyavat ? yadi asarvagataḥ ghaṭavat; tarhi tadvadveva anityo'stu, iti so'yam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pūrvapratijñātaḥ asarvagataḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāntaraṃ kurvan nigṛhyate sādhanasāmarthyā'parijñānāt iti
anitya śabda iti pūrvā pratijñā, asarvagata iti dvitīyā pratijñā pratijñāntaram
tatkatha nigrahasthānamiti ? na pratijñāyā sādhanaṃ pratijñāntaraṃ kintu hetudṛṣṭāntau sādhanaṃ pratijñāyā, tadetadasādhanopādānamanarthakamiti ānarthakyānnigrahasthānamiti
4 yatra pratijñā hetunā viruddhyate heturvā pratijñayā sa pratijñāvirodhaḥ
yathā guṇavyatiriktaṃ dravyam rūpādibhyo bhedenānupalabdheḥ iti
yatra pratijñā hetunā viruddhyate hetuśca pratijñayā sa pratijñāvirodho nāma nigrahasthānam
etenaiva pratijñāvirodho'pyuktaḥ, yatra pratijñā svavacanena viruddhyate yathā śramaṇā garbhiṇī
5 yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyakatvāt ghaṭavat ityukte pūrvavat sāmānyena anaikāntikatve hetorudbhāvite pratijñāsannyāsaṃ karoti–ka evam āha anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti
ya pratijñātamartha pratiṣedhe kṛte parityajati sa pratijñāsannyāso veditavya
6 yathā ekaprakṛti idaṃ vyaktam parimāṇāt ghaṭādivat

parimitatvaṃ hi ghaṭādeḥ ekamṛtpūrvakasya dṛṣṭam, tat mahadādivikārajāteḥ pratīyamānam ekaprakṛtipūrvakatvaṃ sādhayati, ityasya hetoḥ vyabhicāreṇa pratyavasthānam–ekaprakṛtīnāṃ nānāprakṛtīnāñca dṛṣṭaṃ parimāṇam ityasya hetorahetutve niścite'pi ekaprakṛtisamanvaye sati vikārāṇāṃ parimāṇāt iti tatparijihīrṣayā viśeṣaṇamāha

7 yathoktalakṣaṇe pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahe hetunā sādhyasiddhau prakṛtāyāṃ prakṛtaṃ hetuṃ pramāṇasāmarthyena ahamasamartha samarthayitum ityavasyannapi kathāmaparityajan arthāntaraṃ bravīti–nityaḥ śabda asparśavattvāt iti, hetuśca hinoterdhātoḥ tupratyaye kṛdantaṃ padam, padañca nāma-ākhyāta-upasarga-nipātāḥ iti prakṛtya nāmādīni vyācaṣṭe iti
yathoktalakṣaṇe pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahe hetuta sādhyasiddhau prakṛtāyā brūyāt nitya śabda asparśatvāditi hetu, heturnāma hinoterdhāto tuni pratyaye kṛdantapadam
arthāntara nāma yathā jvaralakṣaṇe vācye pramehalakṣaṇamāha
yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ jabagaḍadatvāt ghaṭadhavat iti
sādhanamanupādānādajñānameva bruban na sādhyaṃ jānīta iti na sādhya na sādhanañcopādatte iti nigṛhyate
anarthaka nāma yadvacanamakṣaragrāmamātrameva syāt pañcavargavat, na cārthato gṛhyate
yadā vāda iṣṭa tadā mantrabhāṣaṇamiti nirarthakam

9 yat sādhanavākya dūṣaṇavākyaṃ vā trirabhihitamapi pariṣadā prativādinā ca na jñāyate aprasisiddhaprayogam atidrutoccāritam ityevaṃ prakāram asāmarthyasaṃvaraṇāya dhūrttairāśrīyate tad avijñāta nāma nigrahasthānam
yadvākya pariṣadā prativādinā ca tribhirabhihitamapi na vijñāyate śliṣṭaśabdamapratītaprayogamatidrutoccāritamityevamādinā kāraṇena tadavijñātārtham
nirarthake sarveṇa sarvamarthaśūnyatā, iha tu bhavannapyartho nāvagamyate drutatoccāraṇādivyatikaravaśāditi
10 pūrvāpa rā'saṅgatapadakadamboccāraṇād apratiṣṭhitavākyārtham apārthakaṃ nāma nigrahasthānam
yathā daśa dāḍimāni, ṣaḍ apūṣāḥ, kuṇḍam, ajā'jinam, palalapiṇḍaḥ ityādi
yatrānekasya padasya vākyasya vā paurvāparyeṇa anvayayogo nāsti ityasambaddhārthatvaṃ gṛhyate, tatsamudāyārthasyāpāyādapārthakam
nirarthakādapārthakaṃ na bhidyate tatrāpyartho na gamyata ihāpīti, bhidyate iti brūma, tatra hi varṇamātram, iha tu padānyasambaddhāni
yathā daśa dāḍimāni ṣaḍapūpā kuṇḍamajājinam palalapiṇḍa ardhorukametat kumāryā sphayaikṛtasya pitā apratiśīna iti
11 avayavānāṃ pratijñādīnāṃ viparyāsena yathākramollaṅghanena prayujyamānam anumānavākyam aprāptakālaṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati
12 pañcāvayave vākye prayoktavye tadanyatamenāpi avayavena hīnaṃ prayuñjānasya nyūnaṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati
13 ekenaiva hetunā dṛṣṭāntena vā pratipādite'rthe hetvantaraṃ dṛṣṭāntāntaraṃ vā prayuñjānasya adhikaṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati
14 śabdasya arthasya ca abhihitasya punarabhidhānaṃ punaruktaṃ nāma nigrahasthānam anuvādaṃ varjayitvā
tatra śabdapunaruktam–anityaḥ śabdaḥ, anitya śabdaḥ iti
anuvāde paunaruktyaṃ na doṣāya, yathā hetvapadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanaṃ nigamanamiti
15 punaruktam–yathā utpattidharmakam anityam ityabhidhāya arthādāpannasya arthasya yo'bhidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ tena svaśabdena brūyāt nityam anutpattidharmakam iti
16 pariṣadā viditasya vādinā triruccaritasyāpi yad apratyuccāraṇaṃ tad ananubhāṣaṇaṃ nāma nigrahasthānaṃ bhavati, apratyuccārayan kimāśrayaṃ dūṣaṇamabhidadhyāt iti ?
paripadā vijñātāyā pratijñāyāḥ trirabhihitāyā api yadi kaścitpratyuccāraṇāsamartha tadā'nanubhāṣaṇam
17 pariṣadā vijñātasyāpi vādivākyasya prativādinā yad avijñānaṃ tad ajñānaṃ nāma nigrahasthānam
18 parapakṣapratiṣedhaḥ uttaram, tad yadā na pratipadyate tadā nigṛhīto veditavyaḥ
yadi parasya pratijñā nyāyavadīkṣate dūṣaṇe cāsamarthastadā'pratibhā

19 vādamupakramya sisādhayiṣitasyārthasya aśakyasādhyatāmavasāya kālayāpanārthaṃ yatra karttavyaṃ vyāsajya kathāṃ vicchinatti–idaṃ me karaṇīyaṃ parihīyate tasminnavasite paścāt kathayāmi iti, sa vikṣepo nāma nigrahasthānam
svapratijñāyā doṣa jñātvā vyājai parihāra kāryāntarakathanam
20 yaḥ pareṇa āpāditaṃ doṣamanuddhṛtya abhyupagamya ca bravīti–bhavatpakṣe'pyayaṃ doṣaḥ samānaḥ iti saḥ paramatānujñānāt matānujñā nāma nigrahasthānam āpadyate
yathā cauro bhavān puruṣatvāt prasiddhacauravat ityukte sa āha–bhavānapi cauraḥ puruṣatvā'viśeṣāt iti
ya pareṇa coditaṃ doṣamanuddhṛtya bhavato'pyaya doṣa iti bravīti sā matānujñā, paramata svamate'nujānāti
sa ta prati brūyāt–bhavānapīti, so'bhyupagamya doṣaṃ parapakṣe'bhyanujānātīti nigṛhīto veditavya
21 paryyanuyojyo nāma nigrahopapattyā codanīyaḥ–idaṃ te nigrahasthānam āyātam ato nigṛhīto'si iti vacanīyaḥ, taṃ yaḥ upekṣate nā'nuyuṅkte, sa paryyanuyojyopekṣaṇāt nigṛhyate
etacca kasya parājayaḥ iti anuyuktayā pariṣadā vacanīyam, na khalu nigrahaprāptaḥ sva kaupīnaṃ vivṛṇuyāditi
yadi kaścinnigrahasthānaṃ prāpnuyāt, tasya nigrahāpattyanudbhāvanaṃ tadadūṣaṇecchayā tu dūṣaṇasthāpanam
tadarthe ca hīne ki prayojanaṃ dūṣaṇena ? asiddhametat dūṣaṇam
etacca kasya parājaya ityanuyuktayā pariṣadā vacanīyam, na khalu nigraha prāpta svaṃ kaupīnaṃ vivṛṇuyāditi
22 upapannavādinam anigrahārhamapi nigṛhīto'si iti yo brūyāt sa abhūtadoṣodbhāvanāt nigṛhyata iti
23 yaḥ pūrvaṃ kañcana siddhāntamabhyupagamya kathāyaṃ pravṛttaḥ sisādhayiṣitārthasamarthanarabhasena dūṣaṇoddharaṇarabhasena vā svasiddhāntaviruddhamabhidhatte sa apasiddhāntena nigṛhyate
yathā nityān pratijñāya śabdādīn punaḥ anityān brūte iti
pūrvaṃ caturvidhe siddhānte svayamaṅgīkṛte'pi paścāccedyathāsiddhāntaṃ na brūyādayamapasiddhānta
yathā pūrvamuktā trividhā asiddho'naikāntiko viruddhaśceti hetvābhāsā
eteṣā nigrahasthānānā viśeṣavivaraṇaṃ tattannyāyasūtrīyabhāṣyavārtika-tātparyaṭīkāsu, nyāyasāre pṛ॰ 23-28, nyāyamañjaryyā pṛ॰ 638-659 nyāyakalikāyāñca pṛ॰ 22-27 draṣṭavyam
prakṛte ca nyāyamañjaryyeva viśeṣato granthakṛtā anusṛtā
ṣoḍaśapadārthānā viśadatayā pratividhānam, dharmā'dharmadravyayo gatisthitisādhāraṇahetutayā pṛthak dravyatvasiddhiśca–
yattāvaduktam–pramāṇa ityādi; tadavicāritaramaṇīyam; bhavatparikalpitānāṃ pramāṇādiṣoḍaśapadārthānāṃ svarūpataḥ pramāṇena vicāryamāṇānāmaghaṭamānatvena tattattvajñānāt niśreyasaprāptyanupapatteḥ

yat svarūpataḥ pramāṇena vicāryamāṇaṃ nopadyate na tattattvajñānāt niḥśreyasaprāptiḥ yathā tathāvidhād indudvayasvarūpajñānāt, nopapadyante ca svarūpeṇa pramāṇato vicāryamāṇā bhavatparikalpitā ṣoḍaśapadārthā iti

na ca svarūpataḥ pramāṇena vicāryamāṇānāṃ teṣāmaghaṭamānatvamasiddham; tathāhi–yattāvad bhavadbhiḥ sakalapadārthānāṃ gariṣṭhatvāt prathamataḥ pramāṇapadārthaḥ pratipāditaḥ, sa yathā svarūpataḥ pramāṇena vicāryamāṇo nopapadyate tathā pratyakṣapramāṇasvarūpanirūpaṇāvasare prapañcitam, anumānādipramāṇasvarūpanirūpaṇapraghaṭṭake prapañcayiṣyate ca

ato bhavatparikalpitapramāṇapadārthasya avyavasthiteḥ kathaṃ tatparicchedyatvena ātmādiprameyatattvaṃ vyavatiṣṭhate ? yathā ca ātmā nityavyāpitvādirūpo bhavatparikalpito na vyavatiṣṭhate tathā ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake pratipāditam
bhautikāni prāpyakārīṇi indriyāṇi, buddhyantaravedyā buddhiḥ, aṇu manaśca iti tritayamapi prāgeva apāstam
kiñca, asya dvādaśavidhatvāvadhāraṇaṃ tāvatyeva pramāṇavyāpāraparisamāpteḥ, prayojanaparisamāptervā syāt ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapanna; dik-kāla-ākāśa-pṛthivyādiprapañce'pi pramāṇavyāpārapratīte
na ca tatprapañcasya atraiva antarbhāvaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tato'sya atyantavilakṣaṇatvāt
yad yato'tyantavilakṣaṇam na tata tatra antarbhavati yathā jale'nalaḥ, atyantavilakṣaṇāśca ākāśādayo bhāvā bhavatparikalpitadvādaśavidhaprameyapadārthāt iti
tathāvidhānāmapyeṣāmatrānnarbhāve ātmanyeva aśeṣapadārthānāmantarbhāvāt brahmā'dvaitaprasaṅgato gatā ṣoḍaśapadārthaparikalpanā

dvitīyapakṣe'pi kasya prayojanasya atraiva parisamāpti–laukikasya, apavargalakṣaṇasya, prayojanamātrasya vā ? na tāvallaukisya, tatprayojanaprasādhakānāṃ ghaṭa-paṭa-mukuṭaśakaṭa-annapānādīnāmatrā'saṅgrahāt
tato'yuktametat– jñāna taṃ samyagasamyagvā yanmokṣāya bhavāya vā
nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 427 satyetarajñānaparicchedyasya akhilasya prameyarāśe dvādaśavidhe prameye saṅgṛhītumaśakyatvāt
api cāsya dvādaśavidhatvāvadhāraṇaṃ tāvatyeva pramāṇavyāpāraparisamāpte prayojanaparisamāptervā syāt
jñāna taṃ samyagasamyagvā yanmokṣāya bhavāya vā
nyāyapravṛttyaṅgatvāt tasyaiva parigaṇane anugrahecchā-parābhibhavābhilāṣa-lābha-pūjā-khyātyāderapi pariga ṇanaprasaṅgaḥ tatpravṛttyaṅgatvā'viśeṣāt
kiñca, jarannaiyāyikaiḥ pratijñādyavayavapañcakavat jijñāsā, saṃśayaḥ, śakyaprāptiḥ, prayojanam, saṃśayavyudāsaḥ ityanye'pi avayavāḥ pañca pratijñātāḥ
teṣāñca madhye bhavatā kimiti saṃśaya-prayojane eva gṛhyete ?
daśāvayavāneke naiyāyikā vākye sañcakṣate–jijñāsā, saṃśaya, śakyaprāpti, prayojanam, saṃśayavyudāsa iti
jijñāsāprayojanasaṃśayārthaprāptīnāṃ vādamārgajñānādhigamyapadārtharūpatayā ullekhaḥ carakasaṃhitāyāmapi pṛ॰ 262 dṛśyate
tataścāsya pṛthagabhidhāne sarveṣāmapi avayavānāṃ pṛthagabhidhānaprasaṅgaḥ aviśeṣāt
sarvaireva hi śāstrakāraiḥ apasiddhāntaṃ bruvāṇo nigṛhyate, na ca siddhāntalakṣaṇaṃ pratijñātaḥ pṛthak taiḥ kriyate, tasyā eva siddhāntatvena sarveṣāṃ suprasiddhatvāt
avayavānāñca padārthasaṃkhyāyāṃ parigaṇane anumānasyāpi pṛthak parigaṇanaprasaṅgaḥ
tasya pramāṇāntargatatvāt pṛthagaparigaṇane avayavānāmapi anumānātmakatvānna pṛthak parigaṇanaṃ syāt
pradhānabhūtañca anumānaṃ pramāṇāntargatatvānna pṛthagupādīyate tadantarbhūtāstu avayavāḥ pṛthagupādīyante iti mahatī prekṣāpūrvakāritā
upādāne'pyeṣām iyattā'vadhāraṇamayuktam; yāvadbhirvivakṣitārthapratipattirbhavati tāvatāmeva upādānārhatvāt, sā ca kvacit kiyadbhirbhavatīti

tarkasya ca pramāṇaviṣayapariśodhakatvam–tattirodhāyakādyapanetṛtvam, saṃśayādivyavacchedena tanniścāyakatvam, tadgrahaṇe pravṛttasya pramāṇasya agresaratayā tatsvarūpavivecanamātraṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe pratītivirodhaḥ; ghaṭāditirodhāyakasya andhakārādeḥ tarkād apanayanā'pratīteḥ
dvitīyatṛtīyapakṣe'pi apramāṇātmako'sau tathā tanniścayaṃ tadvivecanamātrañca kuryāt, pramāṇātmako vā ? na tāvad apramāṇātmakaḥ; pramāṇaviṣayasya apramāṇātmanā tena pariśodhanā'nupapatteḥ
yad apramāṇaṃ na tat pramāṇaviṣayapariśodhakam yathā mithyājñānam prameyo vā'rthaḥ, apramāṇañca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaḥ tarka iti
tatpariśodhakatve vā asya pramāṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ; yat pramāṇaviṣayapariśodhakam tat pramāṇam yathā anumānādi, pramāṇaviṣayapariśodhakaśca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaḥ tarka iti
astu tarhi pramāṇātmaka evāsau iti cet; na; catvāri eva pramāṇāni iti saṃkhyāvyāghātaprasakteḥ
tacca pramāṇaviṣayatirodhāyakāpanetṛtvam, saṃśayādivyavacchedena tanniścāyakatvam, tadgrahaṇe pravṛttasya pramāṇasya agresaratayā tatsvarūpavivecanamātraṃ vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 977
nirṇayaśca pramāṇaphalam, tacca sati pramāṇe avaśyaṃ bhavati iti na kiñcit tasya pṛthagupādāne prayojanam, anyathā hāna-upādānāderapi pṛthagupādānaprasaṅgaḥ pramāṇaphalatvā'viśeṣāt
yadapi vītarāgakathā ityādi vādasya lakṣaṇam; tadapyanupapannam, tasya vītarāgaviṣayatvā'saṃbhavāt; tathāhi–vādo na avijigīpuviṣaya nigrahasthānavattvāt jalpa-vitaṇḍāvat
satāmapyeṣāṃ nigrahabuddhyā udbhāvanā'bhāvāt na vāde vijigīṣuviṣayatā, ityapyasāmpratam, jalpa-vitaṇḍayorapi tathodbhāvanā'bhāvaprasaṅgato'vijigīpuviṣayatāprasakte

tatra chalādiprayogasaṃbhavāt na tathodbhāvanābhāvaḥ iti cet; nanu vāde kutastatprayogā'bhāva ? tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthatvarahitatvāccet, jalpavitaṇḍe hi tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthe ata tayoreva tatprayogo na vāde iti, tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; chalādīnāmasaduttaratayā tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇahetutvā'nupapatteḥ
parasya tūṣṇībhāvanimittatvāt teṣāṃ taddhetutvamupapannam, ityapyasat, tathā parasya tūṣṇībhāvā'saṃbhavāt, asaduttarāṇāmānantyāt

tathāhi–vāda eva tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthaḥ, pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhatve siddhāntā'viruddhatve pañcāvayavopapannatve ca sati pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahavattvāt, yastu na tathā sa na tathā yathā ākrośādiḥ, yathoktaviśeṣaṇaśca vāda, tasmāt tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārtha iti
na cāyamasiddho hetu, pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhaḥ siddhāntā'viruddhaḥ pañcāvayavopapannaḥ pakṣapratipakṣaparigraho vādaḥ
pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahavattvāt ityucyamāne jalpasyāpi tathātvaprasaṅgād avadhāraṇavirodhaḥ syāt, tatparihārārtha pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhatvaviśeṣaṇam
nāpi vitaṇḍā tathā'nupajyate, jalpasyaiva vitaṇḍārūpatvāt, sa pratipakṣasthāpanāhīno vitaṇḍā
tata pramāṇatarkasādhanopālambhatvaviśeṣaṇasya pakṣapratipakṣaparigrahasya jalpa-vitaṇḍayorabhāvāt siddhaṃ vādasyaiva tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthatvam

tattvasya adhyavasāyo hi niścayaḥ, tasya saṃrakṣaṇam–nyāyabalāt nikhilabādhakanirākaraṇam, na puna tatra bādhakamudbhāvayato yathākathañcit nirmukhīkaraṇam lakuṭacapeṭādibhistannyakkārasyāpi tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇārthatvā' nuṣaṅgāt
na ca jalpavitaṇḍābhyāṃ nikhilabādhakanirākaraṇaṃ karttuṃśakyam chalādyupakramaparatayā tābhyāṃ saṃśayasya viparyayasya vā jananāt
tattvādhyavasāye satyapi hi paranirmukhīkaraṇapravṛttau prāśnikāḥ tatra saṃśerate viparyasyanti vā–kimasya tattvādhyavasāyo'sti kivā nāsti iti, nāstyeva iti vā
tato vāda eva ekaḥ kathāviśeṣaḥ tattvādhyavasāyasaṃrakṣaṇaphalaḥ lābhapūjākhyātihetuḥ niḥśreyasaśāstre abhyupagantavyaḥ na punarjalpavitaṇḍe tadviparyayāt
etacca prameyakamalamārttaṇḍe saprapañcaṃ prapañcitam iha draṣṭavyam
tattvarakṣaṇārtha sadbhirupaharttavyameva chalādi vijigīpubhiriti cet, nakhacapeṭaśastraprahārādīpanādibhirapīti vaktavyam, tasmānna jyāyānayaṃ tattvarakṣaṇopāya
hetvābhāsāśca asmākamabhimatā eva, kintu taiḥ mokṣaśāstre nirdiṣṭaiḥ na kiñcit prayojanam, anyathā pratyakṣādyābhāsānāmapi nirdeśaprasaṅgāt ṣoḍaśapadārthasaṃkhyākṣatiprasaṅgaḥ
pratyakṣādipramāṇanirdeśasāmarthyādeva tadābhāsānāṃ labdhatvādanirdeśe avayavanirdeśasāmarthyādeva hetvābhāsānāmapi labdhatvādanirdeśo'stu aviśeṣāt
chalāni tu bālakrīḍāprāyāṇi na prāmāṇikānāṃ niḥśreyasārthināmavalambayitumucitāni
jātayastu dūṣaṇābhāsā hetvābhāsaireva saṅgṛhītāḥ kimiti ataḥ pṛthagucyante, na ca etāsāmiyattā karttuṃpāryate, yuṣmābhirapi āsāmānantyena abhyupagamāt
yadāha bhāṣyakāraḥ– satyapi ānantye jātīnāmasaṃkīrṇodāharaṇavivakṣayā caturviṃśatiprakārā ucyante na sakhyāniyamaḥ kriyate
parasparavivekena upalakṣaṇārthaṃ tarhi tāsāmupādānam; ityapyayuktam; upāttānāṃ parasparavivekena upalakṣaṇe'pi anupāttānāmupalakṣaṇā'saṃbhavāt
katipayatatprakārāṇāṃ tadvivekena upalakṣaṇārtha tallakṣaṇapraṇayane ca mithyottaraṃ jātiḥ nyāyavini॰ 2
nyāyamañjaryāṃ tu pṛ॰ 622 satyapyānantye jātīnāmasaṃkīrṇodāharaṇavivakṣayā caturviśatiprakāratvamupavarṇitaṃ na tu tatsaṃkhyāniyama kṛtaḥ ityasti
evaṃ nigrahasthānānāmapi anantatvāt na iyattā kartuṃ śakyā
tadānantyaṃ ca bhavadbhireva abhipretam–vipratipattyapratipattiprakārasya bahutve'pi dvāviśatirnigrahasthānāni pradarśyante iti bhāṣyakāravacanāt
yacca chalajātinigrahasthānānāṃ pratyekaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tat prameyakamalamārttaṇḍe saprapañca prapañcitam iha draṣṭavyam
tadevaṃ ṣoḍaśapadārthānāṃ vicāryamāṇānāmavyavasthiterna yaugānā ṣaṭpadārthaniyamavat ṣoḍaśapadārthaniyamo'pi upapanna
asaṃkīrṇodāharaṇavivakṣayā ca dvāviṃśatibhedasakīrttanam avāntarabhedaistu jātivadānantyameva teṣāmiti
nigrahasthānānā khaṇḍana tu vādanyāye'pi pṛ॰ 78-142 dṛṣṭavyam
kuta pramāṇāt tatsiddhiriticet ? anumānāt iti brūma
tathāhi–vivādāpannā sakalajīvapudgalāśrayāḥ sakṛdgatayaḥ sādhāraṇavāhyanimittāpekṣāḥ yugapadbhāvigatitvāt ekasarassalilādinā anekamatsyādigativat
yat tatsādhāraṇaṃ nimittam sa dharma adharmaśca, tābhyāṃ vinā tadgatisthinikāryā'nutpatte
udayaṃ jaha macchāṇaṃ gamaṇāṇuggahayaraṃ havadi loe
dhammatthikāe ṇaṃ jīvāṇaṃ āgamaṇagamaṇabhāsummesamaṇajogā vaijogā kāyajogā je yāvanne tahappagārā calā bhāvā savve te dhammatthikāe pavattaṃti
jaha havadi dhammadavvaṃ taha taṃ jāṇeha davvamadhamakkhaṃ
ahamatthikāeṇaṃ jīvāṇaṃ ṭhāṇanisīyaṇatuyaṭṭaṇamaṇassaya egattībhāvakaraṇatā je yāvanne tahappagārā thirā bhāvā savve te ahamatthikāe pavattaṃti

gatisthitipariṇāmina eva arthāḥ parasparaṃ taddhetavaścet; na; anyonyāśrayā'nuṣaṅgāt– siddhāyā hi tiṣṭhatpadārthebhyo gacchatpadārthānāṃ gatau tebhyaḥ tiṣṭhatpadārthānāṃ sthitisiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca gacchatpadārthānāṃ gatisiddhiriti

sādhāraṇanimittarahitā eva akhilārthagatisthitayaḥ pratiniyatasvakāraṇapūrvakatvāt iti cet; kathamidānīm īśvara aṅkurādikāryotpattau, narttakīkṣaṇo vā nikhilaprekṣakajanānāṃ nānātadvedanotpattau sādhāraṇaṃ nimitta syāt ? tallakṣaṇasādhāraṇanimittamantareṇa tadupapattyanupapatte iti cet; tadetad anyatrāpi samānam, nahi sakalārthagatisthitayo'pi sakṛdbhāvinyo dharmā'dharmalakṣaṇasādhāraṇanimittamantareṇa upapadyante, sakṛdbhāvikāryatvāt, yat sakṛdbhāvi kāryam tanna sādhāraṇanimittamantareṇa upapadyate yathā aṅkurādi, tathābhūtāścaitā sakalārthagatisthitaya iti
īśvara eva āsāṃ sādhāraṇanimittamastu, ityapya yuktam; tatra gatisthitīnāmasaṃbhavāt, bhūmyādau taddarśanāt
tarhi sa eva tāsāṃ tannimittamastu ityapyanupapannam; gaganavartipadārthagatisthitīnāṃ tadasaṃbhavāt
tarhi nabhaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ nimittamāsāmastu sarvatra tatsaṃbhavāt; ityapyapeśalam; tasya avagāhanimittatvapratipādanāt

tasya ekasyaiva anekakāryanimittatāyām anekasarvagatapadārthaparikalpanā'narthakyaprasaṅgaḥ; kāla-ātmadik-sāmānya-samavāyakāryasyāpi yaugapadyādipratyayasya, buddhyādeḥ, idamataḥ pūrveṇa ityādi pratyayasya, anvayajñānasya, ihedam iti pratyayasya ca nabhonimittatvopapatteḥ tasya sarvatra sarvadā sadbhāvāt
kāryaviśeṣāt kālādinimittabhedavyavasthāyāṃ tata eva dharmā'dharmādinimittabhedavyavasthā'pyastu sarvathā viśeṣā'bhāvāt
bhūmijalādīnyeva tatprayojanasamarthāni nārtho dharmādharmābhyāmiti cenna, sādhāraṇāśraya iti viśiṣya uktatvāt
dharmādharmayo ya upakāra sa ākāśasya yukta sarvagatatvāt iti cettadayuktam; tasya anyopakārasadbhāvāt
ye yadātmoṣabhogyāḥ pudgalāḥ tadgatisthitayaḥ tadātmā'dṛṣṭanimittāścet; tarhi asādhāraṇaṃ nimittamadṛṣṭaṃ tāsām, pratiniyatātmā'dṛṣṭasya pratiniyatadravyagatisthitihetutvaprasiddheḥ
na ca tadaniṣṭam; bhūmyādivat tadasādhāraṇakāraṇasya adṛṣṭasyāpi iṣṭatvāt, sādhāraṇaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tāsāṃ dharmā'dharmau, iti siddhaḥ kāryaviśeṣāt tayoḥ sadbhāvaḥ
tato yaugopakalpitapadārthānāṃ svarūpataḥ iyattāvadhāraṇataśca pramāṇato vicāryamāṇānāmanupapatterna tatparikalpitabhedaikānte'rthasya siddhirghaṭate
nāpi cārvākaparikalpitabhedaikānte tatparikalpitatattvānāmapi svarūpataḥ saṃkhyātaśca vicāryamāṇānāmanupapadyamānatvā'viśeṣāt
pṛthivyaptejovāyuriti tattvāni tebhyaścaitanyam ityādinā nāsti kāyākārapariṇatabhūtavyatirikta ātmā ya paralokī syāt' iti cārvākasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu cārvākamate pṛthivī-ap-tejo-vāyurūpāṇi catvāryeva tattvāni anyonyā'saṃbhavilakṣaṇalakṣitāni śarīra-indriya-viṣayalakṣaṇārthakriyāsampādanasamarthāni pratyakṣapramāṇādhigatasvarūpāṇi upapadyanta eva, pṛthivyaptejovāyuriti tattvāni tatsamudāye śarīrendriyaviṣayasaṃjñāḥ
na khalu pratyakṣam ākāśādisadbhāve pravarttate tasya rūpādau tadvati cārthe pravṛttipratīteḥ, na ca ākāśādau etat saṃbhavati arūpidravyatayā'syābhyupagamāt
nanu grāhakasya ātmano'bhāve kathaṃ caturṇāmapi tattvānāṃ sadbhāvasiddhiḥ pramātradhīnatvāt prameyavyavasthāyā ityāśaṅkya āha–tebhyaścaitanyam
atra kecit abhivyajyate iti kriyābhisambandha pratipadyante, anye tu prādurbhavati iti
ataḥ paraparikalpito jīva anādijñānasantāno vā tatpramātā iti pratyākhyātam; tatsadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt
tatprameyatvasya ca pramātṛmātreṇa avinābhāvaprasiddheḥ caitanyameva pramātṛ bhaviṣyati
tebhya eva tathā jñāna jāyate vyajyate'thavā
tebhyaścaitanyamiti, tatra kecid vṛttikārā vyācakṣate–utpadyate tebhyaścaitanyam, anye abhivyajyate iti
nanu vibhinnebhya pṛthivyādibhyaḥ kathamabhinnaṃ caitanyam abhivyaktimāvirbhāvaṃ vā bibhradaviruddham ? ityāha–madaśaktivad vijñānam
yathaiva hi madyāṅgānāṃ kiṇvādīnāṃ deśa-kāla-avasthāviśeṣe madaśaktilakṣaṇāvasthāviśeṣaḥ prādurbhavati evaṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ tadviśeṣe viśiṣṭaṃ pratiniyataghaṭādigrāhakaṃ jñānamiti

na ca pratiniyatasukha-duḥkhādikāryavaicitryasya niyāmakamantareṇa anupapatteḥ tanniyāmakasya pūrvabhavopārjitasya adṛṣṭasya prasiddhe tatkartturātmana pūrvabhave'pyastitvasiddhi; yataḥ jalabudbudavat jīvāḥ

yathaiva hi samudrādau niyāmakā'dṛṣṭarahitā padārthasāmarthyavaśād vaicitryabhājo budbudāḥ prādurbhavanti tathā sukhadukhavaicitryabhājo jīvā, na punaḥ kāyākārapariṇatabhūtavyatiriktā nityādisvabhāvāḥ tatsadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt

tatra hi pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā pravartate ? na tāvat tadvyatiriktātmasadbhāve pratyakṣaṃ pravarttate, tasya pratiniyatendriyasambaddharūpādigocaracāritayā tadvilakṣaṇe jīve pravṛttyanupapatteḥ
na ca ghaṭamahaṃ vedmi ityahaṃpratyaye jñānakartṛtayā ātmā tathāvidhaḥ pratibhāti ityabhidhātavyam; tasyāpi sthūlo'haṃ kṛśo'ham ityādivat śarīraviṣayatvasyaiva upapatteḥ
na khalu tatpratyayasya ātmālambanatvamasti tatra sthaulyādidharmā'saṃbhavāt
tathā ghaṭamahaṃ vedmi ityādi pratyayasyāpi, nahi tasyāpi śarīrādanyo bhavatparikalpitaḥ kaścid ātmā ālambanatvena svapne'pi pratīyate
na ca apratītasadbhāvasya kartṛtvaṃ yuktam; khapuṣpāderapi tatprasaṅgāt
tata pramāṇaprasiddhasvarūpatvāt śarīrasyaiva caitanyaṃ prati kartṛtvamupapannam
tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvācca, yat khalu yasya anvaya-vyatirekau anukaroti tat tasya kāryam yathā ghaṭo mṛtpiṇḍasya, śarīrasya anvayavyatirekau anukaroti ca caitanyam iti
anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyo hi sarvatra kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, tau cātra vidyete–sati śarīre caitanyasyopalabdhiḥ tadabhāve cānupalabdhiḥ
deha eva cetanaśca ātmā ceti pratijānate hetuñcācakṣate śarīre bhāvāditi
yaddhi yasmin sati bhavati asati ca na bhavati tattaddharmatvena avyavasīyate
pramāṇatve vā hetoḥ pratyakṣabādhitapakṣanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt; śarīravyatirikta-ātmapakṣo hi pratyakṣeṇaiva bādhyate
na cātra kiñcilliṅgaṃ svasādhyena avinābhāvo vā kvacit tasya prasiddhaḥ, sukhādyupalabdheśca bhūtakāryatayā teṣveva avinābhāvasaṃbhavāt
tataśca ātmanaḥ sadbhāve pramāṇā'saṃbhave tannityatvādikaṃ khapuṣpasaurabhaprakhyaṃ kaḥ sudhīḥ śraddadhīta ? ato garbhādimaraṇaparyantabhūtakāryameva caitanyaṃ pratipattavyam tadabhivyaṅgyaṃ vā
nanu kṣityādeścaitanyābhivyaktau śarīravat ghaṭādiṣvapi tadabhivyaktiḥ syāt ityāśaṅkya āha–caitanyā'nabhivyaktirghaṭādiṣu kāraṇāntarābhāvāt pāsvādiṣu anabhivyaktamadaśaktivat

caitanyā'bhivyakterhi kāraṇaṃ kṣityādeḥ kāyākārapariṇatatvam madaśaktau piṣṭodakaguṇadhātakyādipariṇatatvavat, tacca ghaṭādau nāsti iti tatra tadabhivyaktyabhāvaḥ pāṃsvādau piṣṭādipariṇāmā'bhāvāt madaśaktyabhāśaktyabhivyaktyabhāvavat
na caivaṃ mṛtaśarīre'pi caitanyopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ tatpariṇāmā'viśeṣāt ityabhidhātavyam; kāraṇavaikalyāt tatra tadanupalambhopapatteḥ
kāraṇaṃ hi caitanyāvasthiteḥ tvagasthipiśitaśoṇitādipariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ, tasya śastraprahāra-rogādinā vaikalye caitanyasya anavasthānādanupalambhaḥ śarīrākāraviśeṣavat
evañca ākāraviśeṣavat caitanyasya śarīradharmatvasiddheḥ siddhaḥ–paralokino'bhāvāt paralokā'bhāvaḥ
yasya hi śāstrārthāvagama-anuṣṭhāna-phalopabhogaiḥ sambandhaḥ sa paralokī, tasya ca uktaprakāreṇāprasiddheḥ aprayatnaprasiddha eva paralokapratiṣedhaḥ
yattāvaduktam–pṛthivyaptejovāyuḥ ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ catvāryeva tattvāni ityavadhāraṇaṃ tattvāntarā'bhāve siddhe siddhyet
tadabhāvaśca asiddha; jīvalakṣaṇatattvāntarasya svasaṃvedanapratyakṣataḥ gaganādeśca āgamānumānābhyāṃ sadbhāvaprasiddheḥ
prāmāṇyañcānayoḥ pratyakṣameva ekaṃ pramāṇam ityasya pratiṣedhā 'vasare prarūpitam
nanu jīvasya tattvāntaratvamasiddham, cetanālakṣaṇasyāsya bhūtakāryatayā ghaṭādivat tatraivāntarbhāvāt; ityasamīkṣitā'bhidhānam; bhūta-caitanyayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvā'nupapatteḥ
tathāhi–na bhūtakārya caitanyam teṣu satsvapi abhāvāt sarvadā'nupalabdhivat
yathaiva hi pṛthivyādibhūteṣu satsvapi sarvadā'nupalabdherabhāvāt nā'sau tatkāryā tathā caitanyamapi aviśeṣāt
na khalu bhūteṣu mṛtkāya-ghaṭādyanekāvasthāviśiṣṭeṣu sadā satsvapi caitanyaṃ sadā upalabhyate

tantupaṭādivat pūrvāparībhāvā'bhāvācca atra kāryakāraṇabhāvā'bhāvaḥ, nahi caitanyarahitastatpariṇāma kāya prathamata pratīyate, paścāt caitanyam iti, ata sahasiddhatvena anayorupalambhāt jalā'nalavat na kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ
svasavedya sa bhavati nāsāvanyena śakyate dṛṣṭuṃ nāsāvanyena śakyate dṛṣṭuṃ kathamasau nirdiśyeta asau puruṣa svayamātmānamupalabhate na cānyasmai śaknoti darśayitum śāvarabhā॰ 1
astu vā'sau; tathāpi bhūtānāṃ caitanyaṃ prati upādānabhāvena kāraṇatvaṃ syāt, sahakāribhāvena vā ? na tāvad upādānabhāvena; teṣu vikriyamāṇeṣvapi asya avikriyamāṇatvāt
yasmin vikriyamāṇe'pi yanna vikriyate na tat tasyopādānam yathā goḥ aśvaḥ, vikriyamāṇeṣvapi kāyākārapariṇatabhūteṣu na vikriyate ca caitanyamiti
na cedamasiddham; anyatragatacittānāṃ vāsīcandanakalpānāṃ śastrasampātādinā śarīravikāre'pi caitanyasyāvikāraprasiddheḥ

sahakāribhāvena tu teṣāṃ tajjanakatve tato'nyat tasya upādānamasti, na vā ? yadi nāsti; kathamanupādānasyāsya utpattiḥ syāt ? yad anupādānaṃ na tasyotpattiḥ yathā kharaviṣāṇasya, anupādānaṃ bhavadbhiḥ parikalpyate ca caitanyamiti
atha asti; tatkiṃ caitanyena vijātīyam, sajātīyaṃ vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ; vijātīyād vijātīyasyotpattau jalāderapi analādyutpattiprasaṅgataḥ tattvacatuṣṭayābhāvā'nuṣaṅgāt
atha sajātīyam; yuktametat, sarvatra sajātīyasyaiva upādānatvopapatteḥ

tathāhi–yad yasya upādānaṃ tat tena sajātīyam yathā rūpādimato ghaṭasya tathāvidho mṛtpiṇḍaḥ, upādānañca svasaṃvitsvabhāvasya caitanyasya iṣṭaṃ bhavadbhiḥ kiñcittattvam, ataḥ pṛthivyādibhyo'rthāntaraṃ tatsvabhāvameva tad yuktam ityātmatattvasiddhiḥ
bhūtāni kimupādānakāraṇaṃ caitanyasya sahakārikāraṇaṃ vā ? yuktyanuśā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 78
na ca yasya vikāre'pi yanna vikriyate tattatkāryaṃ yuktamatiprasaṅgāt
kāye tasmānna te tasya pariṇāmā sukhādayaḥ
yadavikāre'pi yasya vikārāpādana sabhavati na tattadupādānam
anupādānaṃ ca bhavadbhiḥ parikalpitaṃ cai– śra॰
anupādānaṃ ca svasaṃviditasvabhāvasya caitanyasya iṣṭaṃ bhavadbhiḥ parikalpyate caitanyamiti ba॰, ja॰
sūkṣmabhūtaviśeṣa caitanyena vijātīyaḥ sajātīyo vā ? tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 29
kiñca, bhūtāni nirviśiṣṭāni caitanyaṃ prati kāraṇabhāvaṃ pratipadyante, viśiṣṭāni vā ? yadi nirviśiṣṭāni; sarvatra sarvadā tajjanakatvaprasaṅgaḥ
atha viśiṣṭāni, kutasteṣāṃ vaiśiṣṭyam–samudāyāt, kāyākārapariṇateḥ, avasthāviśeṣāt, sahakāryantarādvā ? yadi samudāyāt; adhiśrayaṇādeḥ odanapākavat caitanyotpattiprasaṅgaḥ, tatra tatsamudāyā'viśeṣāt
atha kāyākārapariṇateḥ; nanu kutasteṣāṃ saiva sampannā–ki nirhetukā, svarūpamātraprabhavā, adṛṣṭanimittā vā syāt ? nirhetukatve sadā sattvamasattvaṃ vā syāt
svarūpamātraprabhavatve sarvatra sarvadā teṣāṃ tatpariṇatiprasaṅgaḥ svarūpamātrasya sarvatra sarvadā'viśiṣṭatvāt

atha adṛṣṭakṛtā; tattu adṛṣṭaṃ tadbhavaprabhavam, bhavāntaraprabhavaṃ vā taddhetuḥ syāt ? tatra ādyavikalpe cakrakaprasaṅga–śarīrasyotpattau hi satyāṃ caitanyasyotpattiḥ, tadutpattau ca hitā'hitavivekapūrvakamadṛṣṭasādhanānuṣṭhānād adṛṣṭasya utpattiḥ, tataśca śarīrasyotpattiḥ iti
bhāvāntaraprabhavatve ca paralokinaḥ prasiddheḥ paralokino'bhāvāt paralokā'bhāvaḥ itīdamasaṅgataṃ syāt
astu vā kāyākārapariṇatiḥ yathākathañcit teṣām; tathāpi asyāścaitanyahetutve mṛtaśarīre'pi caitanyotpattiprasaṅgo viśeṣā'bhāvāt
atha avasthāviśeṣo'pi taddhetu tadabhāvānna tatra tatprasaṅgaḥ, tadākārapariṇatāni hi bhūtāni avasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭāni taddhetutvaṃ pratipadyante iti

nanu kimidaṃ teṣāṃ tathāvidhānāmavasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭatvaṃ nāma–caitanyopetatvam, viśiṣṭā'dṛṣṭāśliṣṭatvam, dhātuviśeṣopacitatvam, vayoviśeṣānvitatvaṃ vā ? na tāvat caitanyopetatvam; ādyacaitanyotpattau teṣāṃ hetutvā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, tadā teṣāṃ tadupetatvā'bhāvāt

atha tadāpi teṣāṃ tadupetatvamiṣyate; tatki tenaiva caitanyena, tataḥ pūrveṇa vā syāt ? tenaiva ced anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi ādyacaitanye teṣāṃ tadviśiṣṭatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca ādyacaitanyasiddhiriti

atha tataḥ pūrveṇa; kathaṃ paralokino'pahnavaḥ garbhacaitanyāt pūrvamapi caitanyaprabandhaprasakteḥ ? atha viśiṣṭā'dṛṣṭā'' śliṣṭatva teṣāṃ tadviśiṣṭatvamucyate; tadapi mṛtkāye kasmāt nāsti–caitanyā'bhāvāt, tatsādhakā' nuṣṭhānā'bhāvāt, tāvatsthitikatvena upārjitatvādvā ? prathamapakṣe na viśiṣṭā'dṛṣṭā''śliṣṭatvasya caitanyasādhakatvam caitanyasyaiva tatsādhakatvaprasaṅgāt
etena dvitīya-tṛtīyapakṣāvapi pratyākhyātau; adṛṣṭaviśeṣasādhakā'nuṣṭhānasya tāvatsthitikatvena upārjitatvasya ca caitanyaviśeṣā''dhīnatvāt
nāpi dhātuviśeṣopacitatvam avasthāviśeṣaviśiṣṭatvaṃ teṣāṃ yuktam; suṣuptāvasthāyā tadupacite'pi śarīre caitanyotpattyapratīte
vayoviśeṣānvitatvaṃ tadviśiṣṭatvam ityapi etena prativyūḍham, suṣuptāvasthāśarīrasya mṛtaśarīrasya ca bālādivayoviśeṣānvitatve'pi caitanyā'nutpādakatvāt
nāpi sahakāryantarād bhūtānāṃ vaiśiṣṭyam, tattvacatuṣṭayavyatirekeṇa aparasya sahakāryantarasyānabhyugamāt
abhyupagame vā cattvāryeva tattvāni ityavadhāraṇavirodhaḥ, ātmasiddhiśca syāt, tasyaiva ātmatvāt
kiñca, sarva kārya sāśrayaṃ bhavati, ataḥ caitanyasya kāryatve kaścid āśrayo vaktavyaḥ
sa ca śarīram, bhūtāni, indriyāṇi, mana, viṣayo vā syāt ? na tāvat śarīram, bhautikatvād bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt mūrttatvācca ghaṭādivat
etena bhūtānāmapi caitanyāśrayatvaṃ pratyākhyātam, sarvatra sarvadā tatsadbhāvā'nuṣaṅgācca tadāśrayabhūtānāṃ teṣāṃ sarvatra sarvadā avikalānāṃ sadbhāvā'viśeṣāt
astu tarhi indriyāṇāṃ tadāśrayatvam, anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tasya tatpūrvakatvaprasakteḥ, ityapi notsṛṣṭamanena, bhautikatvādyanumānavirodhasya atrāpyaviśeṣāt
kiñca, vyastānām, samastānāṃ vā teṣāṃ tadāśrayatvaṃ syāt ? yadi vyastānām, tadā ekasmin śarīre anekacetanasantānaprasaṅgāt ekasantāne'pi anekasantānavad anusandhānā'bhāva syāt

kathañca andhāde indriyā'pāye rūpādismaraṇam, svapnādyavasthāyāṃ rūpa-rasādijñānam, prasuptikādirogeṇa ca indriyopaghāte sukhaduḥkhādijñāna syāt ? na ca yasya vikāre yanna vikriyate tat tasya kāryam; atiprasaṅgāt
sāmastyapakṣo'pi etenaiva samutsāritaḥ, nahi ekasyāpi indriyasyāpāye sāmastyaṃ ghaṭate, tathā ca andhādeḥ jñānaleśo'pi notpadyeta
nahi kṣityādeḥ anyatamasyāpyapāye sāmastyam aṅkurotpattirvā dṛṣṭā
na śarīrendriyamanasāmajñatvāt, na śarīrasya caitanyaṃ ghaṭādivad bhūtakāryatvāt mṛte cā'saṃbhavāt
na śarīrasya jñānādiyoga pariṇāmitvāt, rūpādimattvāt anekasamūhasvabhāvatvāt sanniveśaviśiṣṭatvāt
te ca paramāṇava pratyeka vā hetava syu, samuditā vā ? tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 527
nāsikādyekāṅgavaikalye'pi manasāmanutpādāpatteprasuptikādirogādinā kāyendriyāṇāmupaghāte'pi manodhīravikṛtā ekāmavikalā sattāmanubhavati

manastarhi tadāśrayo'stu uparateṣvapi indriyeṣu antaḥsaṅkalparūpasya jñānasya avabhāsanāt iti cet; nanu tat nityam, anityaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvannityam; tattvasaṃkhyāvyāghātānuṣaṅgāt paramatapraveśaprasaṅgācca
atha anityam; tat ki bhūtahetukam, anyahetukaṃ vā ? na tāvadanyahetukam; anabhyupagamāt
nāpi manasa kāraṇāntarānapekṣitve yugapadālocanasmṛtiprasaṅgāt svayaṃ karaṇabhāvācca
"astu tarhi manoguṇo jñānam, yugapajjñeyānupalabdheśca na manasa
kiñca, tanmanaḥ cetanaṃ sat ki kāraṇāntaranirapekṣam arthapratibhāsaṃ janayati, tatsāpekṣaṃ vā ? yadi nirapekṣam; sakṛdeva akhilārthapratibhāsaprasaṅgāt sarvaḥ sarvadarśī syāt

atha kāraṇāntarasāpekṣam; tat ki kāraṇāntaram–manaḥ, anyadvā ? manaścet; tat cetanam, acetanaṃ vā ? na tāvad acetanam; tasya cetanāśrayatayā cetanatvapratijñānāt, anyathā prathamasyāpi acetanatvāpattiḥ syāt
atha cetanam; tarhi idamapi kāraṇāntarāpekṣamarthapratibhāsaṃ janayati ityanavasthā syāt
tato dehād vyatirikto jñānasya ātmaiva āśrayo'bhyupagantavyaḥ iti siddho'sau tattvāntaram

kathamanyathā tadaharjātabālakasya stanādau pravṛtternibandhanamabhilāpādikaṃ siddhyet ? na ca asyāḥ tannibandhanatvamasiddham; tathāhi–tadaharjātabālakasya stanādau pravṛttiḥ abhilāṣapūrvikā tattvāt madhyadaśāpravṛttivat
abhilāṣo'pi smaraṇapūrvaka, smaraṇamapi anubhavapūrvakam, tattvāt tadvadeva
na ca garbhādau tadanubhavādikamasti iti pūrvabhavā'nubhavasiddhiḥ

sa hi kṣutpīḍitaḥ stanādikaṃ tatpratipakṣabhūtaṃ sukhasādhanatvena smṛtvā abhilāṣāt tatra pravarttate, tacca alabhamāno rodanamārabhate, prāpya ca apagataruditaḥ tatpānādikaṃ karoti, prapātādiduḥkhānusmaraṇabhītaśca vāna rādiśiśu māturatīva kroḍamāśliṣyati praṣātasthānañca pariharati, nahi ananubhūta-iṣṭā'niṣṭasādhanaphalā tāni niyamena upāditsante jihāsanti ca atiprasaṅgāt
yasya ca pūrvabhavā'nubhavasiddhi so'tra ātmā tattvāntarabhūta
tasya apūrvairdehendriyādibhi abhisambandho janma, na puna asata prādurbhāvaḥ, tannirodhaśca maraṇam na tu sarvathā vināśa iti

yena sukhasādhanaṃ stanādikamanvicchati, taccālabhamāno rodanamārabhate prāpya ca vyapagataruditaḥsadyojāto'pi vānarādiśiśuḥ avapātapatanaprabhavaduḥkhānmaraṇabhīto māturatīva kroḍamāśliṣyati prapātādisthānaṃ ca pariharatīti
yacca–madaśaktivad vijñānam ityuktam, tadapyayuktam; madyāṅgapariṇāmād anyatrāpi dhattūrakakodravādau madaśakteḥ pratītito bhūtapariṇāmaviśeṣāt tasyā prādurbhāvā'virodhāt
cicchaktestu bhūtapariṇāmaviśeṣe ghaṭādau svapne'pi apratītiḥ tadvirodhāt

yaccānyat jalabudbudavat jīvāḥ ityuktam, tadapyasāmpratam; dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayo sāmyā'saṃbhavāt, jalabudbudānāṃ jalādatyantavailakṣaṇyā'bhāvatastaddhetukatvopapatte tataḥ tadvaicitryamupapannam, bhūtacaitanyayoḥ puna atyantavailakṣaṇyata kāryakāraṇabhāvasyaivāsaṃbhavāt na adṛṣṭamantareṇa sukhadu khādivaicitryaṃ śarīrādivaicitryaṃ vā upapannam, kathamanyathā sevā-kṛṣyādau samamīhamānānāṃ samamadhīyānānāṃ vā keṣāñcideva phalayoga anyeṣāñca naiṣphalyaṃ syāt ? tato dṛṣṭakāraṇavyabhicārāt adṛṣṭakāraṇaprasiddhe siddham–adṛṣṭavaicitryāt sukhādivaicitryam
tathāhi–sataḥ caitanyasya vyakti, asata, sadasadrūpasya vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe paralokasiddhi avivādāt, kāyākārapariṇatabhūtebhya prāgapi caitanyasya sattvaprasakteḥ
