prāgasato vyaktistu pratītiviruddhā, sato hi ghaṭādeḥ dīpādinā prakaṭīkaraṇamātram abhivyakti prasiddhā na puna asataḥ
atha sadasadrūpasya, ki sarvathā, kathañcidvā ? na tāvat sarvathā; virodhāt
atha kathañcit; jainamatasiddhi, dravyata sataḥ paryāyataśca asata caitanyasya kāyākārapariṇatapṛthivyādipudgalebhyo'bhivyakte jainairabhīṣṭatvāt, iti siddho'nādyananto'yam ātmā
caitanyaśaktiṃ satīmeva, prāgasatīmeva vā abhivyañjayeyu, sadasatīṃ vā ? yuktyanu॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 75

yadapyabhihitam–tatsadbhāve pramāṇā'bhāvāt ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; pratyakṣasyaiva ātmasadbhāve pramāṇasya sadbhāvāt, tathāhi–sukhamahamanubhavāmi ityanyonyaviviktajñeya-jñātṛjñānollekhī pratiprāṇi svasaṃvedya pratyayo jāyamāna saṃvedyate
na ca itthambhūtasya asya anālambanatvaṃ yuktam; rūpādipratyayasyāpi anālambanatvaprasaṅgāt
nāpi śarīrālambanatvam; bahiḥkaraṇanirapekṣa-antaḥkaraṇavyāpāreṇa utpatteḥ, na khalu śarīram itthaṃbhūta-ahampratyayavedyam bahiḥkaraṇaviṣayatvāt
ataḥ śarīrātiriktaḥ kaścid etasya ālambanabhūto jñānavān artho'bhyupagantavyaḥ tasyaiva jñātṛtvopapatteḥ, na tu śarīrasya bhūtārabdhatvāt ghaṭādivat, nahi bhūtārabdhasya ghaṭādeḥ tad dṛṣṭam
na ca bhūtārabdhatvā'viśeṣe'pi śarīrasya ahampratyayagrāhyatā bhaviṣyati ityabhidhātavyam; mṛtaśarīreṇa vyabhicārāt
yā'pi sthūlo'ham ityādi pratītiḥ sā'pi ātmoṣakārakatvena śarīre jāyamānā aupacārikī atyantopakārake bhṛtye ahameva ayam iti pratītivat
tathā ca sukhyaha dukhyahamicchāvānahamiti pratyayo dṛṣṭa nāpi viparyayajñānametat avādhyamānatvāt
na śarīrālambanam antaḥkaraṇavyāpāreṇa utpatte; tathāhi–na śarīramanta karaṇaparicchedyam bahirviṣayatvāt praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 391
ahaṃ sukhīti saṃvittau sukhayogo na vigrahe
upācārastu nimittaṃ vinā na pravarttate ityātmoṣakārakatvaṃ nimittaṃ kalpyate
tathā anumānenāpyātmā pratīyate–rūpādijñānaṃ kvacidāśritam guṇatvāt rūpādivat
na ca śarīre tadāśritatvasya tadupādānatvasya ca iṣṭatvāt siddhasādhanam ityabhidhātavyam; tatra tadāśritatva-tadupādānatvayoḥ prāk prabandhena prativyūḍhatvāt

tadevam ātmadravyasya pṛthivyādibhyaḥ tattvāntarasya prasiddheḥ kathaṃ cattvāryeva tattvāni ityavadhāraṇamupapadyate ? anyonyaṃ tattvāntarabhāvasya ca eṣāṃ pṛthivyādicaturvidhadravyapratiṣedhā'vasare pratiṣiddhatvāt nitarāṃ tadavadhāraṇā'nupapattiḥ
yathā yantrapratimāceṣṭitaṃ prayokturastitvaṃ gamayati tathā prāṇāpānādikarmāpi kiyāvantamātmānaṃ sādhayati
karaṇai śabdādyupalabdhyanumitaiḥ śrotrādibhi samadhigama kriyate vāsyādīnāṃ karaṇānāṃ karttṛprayojyatvadarśanāt śabdādiṣu prasiddhyā ca prasādhako'numīyate
ātmadravyasya siddhi ṭippaṇīnirdiṣṭatattadgrantheṣu aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 63, siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pari॰ 4, ityādiṣu ca vistarato draṣṭavyā
tato yauga-cārvākopakalpitabhedaikāntasya vicāryamāṇasya ākāśakuśeśayasya iva anupapatte na tatra arthakriyāsiddhivārttā'pi saṅgacchate
bauddhopakalpite bhedaikānte yathā tatsiddhirnopapadyate tathā anantarakārikāyāṃ pratipādayiṣyate
nāpyabhedaikānte; sarvathā abhedarūpasya brahmādvaitaikāntasya prāgeva pratikṣiptatvāt
prakṛtermahān ityādinā pacaviṃśatitattva varṇayata sākhyasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu mābhūt brahmādvaitaikāntarūpatayā parikalpite sarvathā vicārā'sahe abhedaikānte arthakriyāsiddhi, prakṛtirūpe tu bhaviṣyati tasya vicārasahatvāt
sāṃkhyā hi nistaraṅgamahodadhiprakhyaṃ pradhānaṃ jagatprapañcaracanāyāṃ kāraṇam ityācakṣate
tacca saṅkṣepataḥ trividham– śaktiḥ karaṇa kāryam iti tredhā jagatsthitam
kārya bhūtāni karaṇa khāni śaktiḥ guṇatrayam
tatsadbhāvāvedakaṃ tu– bhedānā parimāṇāt samanvayāt śaktitaḥ pravṛtteśca

parimitatvaṃ hi ekakāraṇapūrvakasyaiva pratipannam, yathā ghaṭa-śarāva-udañcanāde ekadravyapūrvakasya, parimitañca idaṃ vyaktam–ekā buddhi, eko'haṅkāra, pañca tanmātrāṇi, ekādaśa indriyāṇi, pañca bhūtāni
ato yat tadekaṃ kāraṇaṃ tat pradhānameva iti tadastitvasiddhi
samanvayācca, yajjātisamanvitaṃ hi yat tat tadātmakakāraṇakāryam yathā ghaṭādayo viśeṣā mṛjjātisamanvitā mṛdātmakakāraṇakāryā, sattva-raja-tamojātisamanvitañca idaṃ mahadādivyaktam
sattvasya hi prasāda-lāghava-uddharṣa-prītyādi kāryam, rajasa tāpa-śoṣa-upaṣṭambha-udvegādi, tamasaḥ viṣāda-dainya-bībhatsa-gaurava-āvaraṇādi

śaktitaḥ pravṛtteśca; yo hi yasminnarthe pravarttate sa tatra samarthaḥ yathā tantuvāyaḥ paṭakaraṇe, pravarttate ca pradhānaṃ vyaktakaraṇe, ato'sti tasya śaktiḥ yayā vyaktamutpādayati, sā ca nirādhārā na saṃbhavati iti tadastitvasiddhiḥ
kāraṇa-kāryavibhāgācca; na hi kāraṇamantareṇa mahadādikāryavibhāgo ghaṭate mṛtpiṇḍamantareṇa ghaṭādivat, asti cā'yam, ataḥ kāryadarśanāt kāraṇāstitvasiddhiḥ

avibhāgācca vaiśvarūpyasya; vaiśvarūpyaṃ hi mahadādiprapañco'bhidhīyate, tacca pralayakāle kvacid avibhāgaṃ gacchati, bhūtāni hi tanmātreṣu līyante, tanmātrāṇi indriyāṇi ca ahaṅkāre, ahaṅkāro buddhau, buddhiḥ prakṛtau iti
evaṃ pramāṇataḥ prasiddhasattākā prakṛtiḥ anena krameṇa tattvasṛṣṭau pravarttate– prakṛtermahān tato'haṅkāraḥ tasmād gaṇaśca ṣoḍaśakaḥ

prathamaṃ hi prakṛtermahān eko vyāpakaḥ viṣayādhyavasāyarūpaḥ āsargapralayasthāyī prabhavati, sa ca asmādṛśāmasaṃvedyasvabhāvaḥ, tatastu yāḥ pratiprāṇi vibhinnā buddhivṛttayo niḥsaranti tāḥ saṃvedyasvabhāvāḥ

tataśca ahaṅkārastathāvidho jalanidhiriva pratiprāṇi vibhinnaiḥ taistaiḥ sthūlo'ham surūpo'ham ityādyahaṅkārataraṅgaviśeṣaiḥ prasarati, sa ca ahaṅkāraḥ vaikārikaḥ, bhūtādiśca iti prathamato dviprakāraḥ prasarati

tatra vaikārikāt sattvapradhānāt prakāśarūpa ekādaśavidha indriya gaṇa–pañca buddhīndriyāṇi śrotra-tvak-cakṣu-jihvā-ghrāṇalakṣaṇāni buddhaye buddhimabhivyaktum indriyāṇi iti, pañca karmendriyāṇi–vāk-pāṇi-pāda-pāyu-upasthasaṃjñāni karmaṇe karma abhivyaktum indriyāṇi iti, mana saṅkalparūpam–grāme'haṃ prasthita, suvarṇasya prāptirbhaviṣyati dravyasya vā ityādi saṅkalpavṛttirmana
bhūtādestu pañcatanmātrāṇi nityādisvabhāvāni, tato'pi mahābhūtāni tathāvidhāni iti
śaktiḥ karaṇa kāryam iti tredhā jagatsthitam
kārya bhūtāni karaṇa khāni śaktiḥ guṇatrayam
kārya ca tasya daśadhā''hārya dhārya prakāśya ca
sattva laghu prakāśakamiṣṭamupaṣṭambhaka calaṃ ca raja

upaṣṭambhaka prerakam unnāḍi ityartha, yathā mattavṛṣo vṛṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā uddhato bhavati tadvatyadā gurūṇi agāni bhavanti indriyāṇi alasāni svaviṣayagrahaṇāsamarthāni bhavanti tadānīṃ mantavyaṃ etattama utkaṭatvena varttate
trailokyaṃ pañcasu mahābhūteṣvavibhāgaṃ gacchati pañcamahābhūtāniṃ tanmātreṣu
tasmādapi ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni || sākhyakā॰ 22 iti
brahma avyaktaṃ bahudhātmakaṃ māyā iti paryāyā
tasyā prakṛtermahān ekaḥ utpadyate–mahān buddhi matiḥ prajñā saṃvittiḥ khyātiḥ citi smṛtirāsurī hari hara hiraṇyagarbha iti paryāyā
tato'haṅkāraḥtasya ime paryāyā vaikṛtaḥ taijaso bhūtādiḥ abhimāno'smitā iti

catu ṣaṣṭivarṇai svarādivaikharīparyantai yatkimapyabhidhīyate buddhyā samarthya tatsakalam ādyantākārahakāravarṇadvayagrahaṇena uparisthitapiṇḍīkṛtānukāriṇā bindunā bhūṣitaḥ pratyāhāranyāyena ahaṅkāra ityabhidhīyate
tatra katarasmādahaṅkārāt indriyāṇi utpadyante katarasmādvā tanmātrāṇīti ? atrocyate–sāttvika ekādaśaka pravarttate vaikṛtādahaṅkārāt
yadā sattvamutkaṭaṃ bhavati ahaṅkāre, tena ca sattvena rajastamasī abhibhūte syātāṃ tadā sātviko'haṅkāra ucyate
tasya sāttvikasya vaikṛtika iti pūrvācāryai saṃjñā kṛtā
sa vaikṛtiko bhūttvā ahaṅkāra ekādaśendriyāṇi utpādayatibhūtāde tamobāhulyāt gauṇībhūtasattvarajasa bhūtādināmnaḥ pūrvācāryairnirūpitādahaṅkārāt tanmātraḥ śabdādipañcako gaṇo jāyate
abhibhūtasattvatamaso rājasāt taijasābhidhānādahaṅkārāt pravṛttikarmaṇa ubhayaṃ prakāśātmakam ekādaśendriyakaṃ mohātmakaṃ tanmātrikaṃ cāsīditi sambandhaḥ
tamaśca mūḍhatvādakriyam asamarthaṃ vinā raja sṛṣṭimutpādayitum
ata ubhe sattvatamasī sṛṣṭiviṣaye rajasā'nugṛhīte aindriyakaṃ tanmātrikaṃ ca gaṇadvayaṃ janayata iti tātparyārtha
in iti viṣayāṇā nāma, tān ina viṣayān prati dravantīti indriyāṇi
śabdasparśarūparasagandhān budhyanta iti buddhīndriyāṇi karma kurvanti kārayanti ca karmendriyāṇi

evaṃ tattvasṛṣṭi vidhāya bhūtasṛṣṭau yadā prakṛtiḥ pravarttate tadā prathamato brahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ, tasya ca mahattattvāt yojanaśataparimāṇā buddhirni sarati, ahaṅkāratattvācca ahaṅkāraḥ ekādaśa indriyāṇi, tanmātrebhya sūkṣmadehārambhakāṇi bhūtāni, tadupari prabhūtebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ pratiprākārasthānīya sthūlo deha sāṃsiddhika kalalādikramamantareṇa jhaṭiti utpadyate, evaṃ manvādīnāmapi
anyeṣāṃ tu sūkṣmabhūtārabdha śarīram āsargapralayasthāyi, pratiprākārasthānīyaṃ tu manuṣyādīnāṃ mātāpitṛjam, deva-nāraka-kṣudrajantūnāṃ ca aupapādakam iti
ayañca mahadādiprapañcaḥ prakṛtau sanneva kutaścid āvirbhāva pratipadyate– asadakaraṇādupādānagrahaṇāt sarvasaṃbhavā'bhāvāt
yadi hi kāraṇe kāryamasat syāt tadā nīrūpatvāt khapuṣpavat tat karttuṃ na śakyeta

yadi ca asadeva kāryam tarhi niyatopādānaṃ na syāt, yathaiva hi tantuṣu ghaṭasya asattvaṃ tathā mṛtpiṇḍe'pi ato mṛtpiṇḍavat tantavo'pi ghaṭārthinā upādīyeran, pūrva kāryāpe kṣayā doṣaḥ ayaṃ tu kāraṇāpekṣayā
yadi ca asat kāryam sarvaṃ sarvasmāt jāyeta asattvā'viśeṣāt, tataśca mṛtpiṇḍādapi ghaṭa-paṭotpattiḥ tantubhyaśca syāt iti, ayaṃ kāraṇāpekṣayaiva atiprasaṅgo doṣaḥ
śaktasya ca śakyakaraṇaṃ nyāyyam, na ca asataḥ kāryasya ākāśakuśeśayavat śakyakriyatvam, nāpi tatra kāraṇasya sāmarthyam, ayañca kāryakāraṇayordharmāpekṣayā doṣaḥ

kāraṇabhāvācca satkāryam; kāraṇabhāvo hi kāraṇatvam, tacca nityasambandhitvāt kāryasambandhamapekṣate, na ca asatā gaganāmbhojaprakhyeṇa kāraṇasya kaścit sambandhaḥ, ataḥ kāraṇe kāryaṃ tādātmyena varttate
kathamevaṃ tayorbhedaḥ ? iti cet; hetumadanityamavyāpi sakriyamanekamāśritaṃ liṅgam
vyaktameva hetumat–hetuḥ kāraṇam asyā'stīti, pradhānena hi hetumatī buddhiḥ, buddhyā ahaṅkāraḥ, ahaṅkāreṇa ṣoḍaśakogaṇaḥ, pañcatanmātraiḥ pañcamahābhūtāni, na tu pradhānaṃ tatkāraṇā'sattvāt

cidrūpaśca puruṣo na jaḍasya kāraṇam atyantavilakṣaṇatvāt, jaḍānāṃ sā sūkṣmatarāvasthā, na ato avasthāntaraṃ sūkṣmatamamasti tena jaḍasya ajaḍasya vā pradhānaṃ prati kāraṇatvā'bhāvāt siddhamasyāhetumattvam
ata eva tat nityam, tadviparyayāt mahadādyanityam
kāraṇācca kāryeṇa alpaparimāṇena bhavitavyam iti kāraṇāpekṣayā mahadādeḥ avyāpakatvam, viparyayāt pradhānasya vyāpakatvam
kriyā ca parispandātmikā mūrttasyaiva mahadāderbhavati iti sakriyaṃ tat, etadviparyayāt niṣkriyaṃ pradhānam, pariṇāmātmikā tu kriyā dvayorapyasti
bahūnām īśvarāṇāṃ parasparamatabhedena kāryārambhe yathā kācapacyāt kāryā'niṣpattiḥ tathā bahūnāṃ pradhānānāmapi iti ekaṃ tat, vyaktaṃ tu mahadādibhedād anekam
āśritañca vyaktam, yad yasmādutpadyate tasya tadāśritatvāt, na tu evamavyaktam tasya akāryatvāt
liṅgañca; līnaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svakāraṇaṃ gamayati, layaṃ gacchati iti vā
ghanībhūtā'vayavayogāt sattvādi-aṅgā'ṅgibhūtā'vayavayogācca sāvayavaṃ vyaktam, tadviparyayāt niravayavamavyaktam
na caivamanayoḥ ātyantiko bheda eva; triguṇamaviveki viṣayaḥ sāmānyamacetanaṃ prasavadharmi
vyaktaṃ tathā pradhānaṃ tadviparītastathā ca pumān
ime sattvādayo guṇāḥ, idaṃ vyaktā'vyaktam iti prathakkarttumaśakyatvāt aviveki
tathā dvayamapi viṣayaḥ bhogyasvabhāvatvāt, viṣiṇoti bhogyatayā badhnāti indriyāṇi iti viṣayaḥ
viṣayatvādeva ca acetanaṃ tat, cetanasya evaṃrūpatvā'nupapatte

prasavadharmi ca dvayamapi prasavaḥ kāryajananaṃ dharmo'sya iti; tathāhi–pradhānaṃ buddhiṃ janayati, buddhirapi ahaṅkāram, ahaṅkāro'pi tanmātrāṇi indriyāṇi ca ekādaśa, tanmātrāṇi mahābhūtāni janayantīti
puruṣastu sāmānyadharmeṇa sarūpa anyaistu dharmaiḥ virūpa, yathā hi pradhāna bhogyatvena sarvabhoktṛsādhāraṇam tathā puruṣo'pi bhoktṛtvena sarvabhogyasādhāraṇa iti
mama yonirmahad brahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmyaham
mama svabhūtā madīyā māyā triguṇātmikā prakṛti yoni sarvabhūtānā sarvakāryebhyo mahattvāt bharaṇācca svavikārāṇā mahad brahma iti yonireva viśiṣyate
tasmin mahati brahmaṇi yonau garbhaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasya janmano vījaṃ sarvabhūtajanmakāraṇa vīja dadhāmi nikṣipāmi
sūkṣmā mātāpitṛjā sahaprabhūtai tridhā viśeṣā syu
sūkṣmāstāvat paca tanmātrakā taireva ādisarge sūkṣmaśarīrāṇi trayāṇā lokānā prārabdhāni
tat sūkṣmaśarīram ṛtukāle māturudaraṃ praviśatitairārabdhaṃ sūkṣmaśarīramasmin sthūlaśarīre patati
śaktasya śakyakaraṇāt kāraṇabhāvācca satkāryam || sākhyakā॰ 9 iti
sāvayavaṃ paratantraṃ vyaktaṃ viparītamavyaktam || sākhyakā॰ 10 iti
vyaktaṃ tathā pradhānaṃ tadviparītastathā ca pumān || sāṃkhyakā॰ 11 iti
pūrvapakṣe nidiṣṭānā sākhyakārikāṇā viśeṣavyākhyānaṃ māṭharavṛttau tattvakaumudyā ca draṣṭavyam
yattāvaduktam–prakṛtisadbhāvā''vedakaṃ bhedānāṃ parimāṇāt ityādihetupañcakam, tad āśrayā'siddhidoṣaduṣṭatvād ayuktam, prakṛteḥ asavedyasvabhāvatayā svarūpeṇa asiddhatvāt
vyadhikaraṇā'siddhatvācca, parimitatvādika hi sādhanaṃ bhedeṣu varttate astitvaṃ tu sādhya prakṛtau iti

atha mahadādibhedānāmeva atra ekakāraṇapūrvakatvaṃ prasādhyate tena uktadoṣadvayā'bhāva, tanna; pradhāna-puruṣairanekāntāt, tatra ekatva-anekatvasaṃkhyayā mahāparimāṇena ca parimitatve'pi ekakāraṇapūrvakatvā'saṃbhavāt
kiñca, parimita ca syāt ekakāraṇapūrvakañca na syāt ki viruddhyet ? ekakāraṇapūrvakatve ca īśvara kālādirvā eka kāraṇa bhaviṣyati iti viruddhatvam
na hi ekaṃ kiñcit janaka pratīyate, sahakāri-itarakāraṇaprabhavatvāt kāryāṇām
mṛtpiṇḍasyāpi anekāvayavasamudāyātmakatvāt na sarvathaikatvam, mṛddravyasyāpi pratiparyāya bhedāt
samanvayāt ityapi anaikāntikam; prakṛti-puruṣāṇāmekakāraṇapūrvakatvā'bhāve'pi nityavyāpitvādidharmai samanvayasaṃbhavāt, puruṣāṇāñca bhoktṛtvādidharmai iti
bhinnajātīnāṃ ca jalā' nalādīnāmekopādānaprabhavatvaṃ durupapādam, padārthajātibhedasya kāraṇaikatvavirodhitvāt

asiddhañcedam; nahi samagrabhūtagrāmasya sukhaduḥkhamohamayatvena pradhānānvitatvasiddhirasti sukhādīnāmanta saṃvidrūpatayā pratibhāsato bāhyārthānāṃ tanmayatvā'nupapatteḥ, na hi kaścit bāhyaṃ srakcandanādika sukham iti pratipadyate, sukhajanakatvena ābālaṃ tatprasiddhe
na ca kāryakāraṇayoḥ ekatvam anaupacārikaṃ prāmāṇikai ādriyate
pradhānasattvasya ca adyāpyaprasiddhe tasyaiva śaktitaḥ pravṛtteḥ tadastīti ki kena saṅgatam, anyathā khapuṣpamasti tasyaiva śaktitaḥ pravṛtteḥ ityapi syāt

śakteśca vyatireka-avyatirekaikānte anupapatteḥ kathaṃ tataḥ kasyacit pravṛttiḥ ? kāraṇakāryavibhāgācca tatsattvasiddhiḥ kharavipāṇasattvasiddhimanvākarṣati, na khalu kharaviṣāṇavat pradhānasya sattvaṃ kutaścit prasiddham
pralayakālasya cāprasiddheḥ avibhāgo'pi vaiśvarūpyasya uktaprakāro'prasiddha eva
śaktita pravṛtte ityanena yadyavyatiriktaśaktiyogikāraṇamātraṃ sādhyate tadā siddhasādhyatā
atha vyatiriktavicitraśaktiyuktamekaṃ nityaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadā'naikāntikatā heto

astu vā tatastatsiddhiḥ, tathāpi prakṛtiḥ tattvasṛṣṭau bhūtasṛṣṭau ca pravarttamānā svabhāvataḥ pravarttate, kiñcinnimittamāśritya vā ? svabhāvataḥ pravṛttau naiyatyena pravṛttiḥ pravṛttivirāmaśca na syāt, caitanyaśūnyasya etāvatyeva tattvasṛṣṭiḥ, idamasyaiva ca upakārakaṃ bhavatu ityanusandhānavikalasya tadasaṃbhavāt

nimittañca ki puruṣapreraṇam, puruṣārthakarttavyatā vā syāt ? na tāvat puruṣapreraṇam; nirabhilāṣasya udāsīnatayā iṣṭasya idamasmād bhavati iti anusandhānā'bhāvataḥ pratiniyatāyāṃ prasavakriyāyāṃ tatpreraṇā'saṃbhavāt
nāpi puruṣārthakarttavyatā; puruṣasya nirabhilāṣatayā arthasyaiva asaṃbhavāt

nahi puruṣeṇa anabhilaṣitaḥ puruṣārtho nāma, loke hi asya idamabhilaṣitam iti tadvacanādanyato vā kutaścinniścitya asya abhilaṣitamahaṃ sampādayāmi yenāyaṃ mama tuṣyati iti anusandhāya ca pravṛttiḥ pratīyate

atha asyāḥ svabhāvastādṛśaḥ yena kenacidaprayuktā'pi asyābhilāṣaṃ pūrayāmi ityanusandhānaśūnyā'pi evaṃvidhaṃ viśvaprapañcamāracayatīti; nanvayaṃ svabhāvavādaḥ pramāṇapratipanne vastuni upapannaḥ yathā agnyākāśayordahanetarasvabhāvatāyām, tadapratipanne'pi tadabhyupagame vandhyāsutāderapi jagadvaicitryavidhāne svabhāvā'bhyupagamaḥ kinna syāt ? tataḥ pradhānasya pariṇāmaprasarā'nupapatteḥ ayuktam–prakṛtermahān ityādi tatprasarakramanirūpaṇam
tacca kevalaṃ pradhānaṃkimapekṣya pravartate nirapekṣya vā ? prameyaratnamā॰ 4

kiñca, ayaṃ mahadādiprapañcaḥ prakṛterbhinnaḥ, abhinno vā ? abhede dvayorapyaviśeṣataḥ kāryatvaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ vā syāt, tathā ca prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvameva, bhūtendriyalakṣaṇaṣoḍaśakagaṇasya kāryatvameva, buddhi-ahaṅkāra-tanmātrāṇāṃ pūrvottarāpekṣayā kāryatvaṃ kāraṇatvañca iti pratijñātaṃ viruddhyeta
nahi yad yasmādavyatiriktaṃ tattasya kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vā yuktaṃ bhinnalakṣaṇatvāt kāryakāraṇayoḥ
ṣoḍaśakaśca vikāro na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ || sākhyakāri॰ 3 iti

yacca prakṛtau mahadādiprapañcasya sattvasādhane asadakaraṇāt ityādi sādhanamupanyastam; tatra ko dharmī, kiñca sādhyam ? yadi kārya dharmī, prāgutpatteḥ sat iti sādhyam; tadā vyadhikaraṇā'siddho hetu, sattva hi sādhya mahadādikārye varttate asadakaraṇaṃ tu sādhanaṃ khapuṣpādau akārye iti
atha asadakaraṇam sataḥ karaṇāt ityatra paryavasyati; tadā sādhyā'viśiṣṭatvam

atha kriyamāṇatvaṃ hetu, prāgutpatte kāryamasti kriyamāṇatvāt, asadakaraṇāt iti tu vyatirekakathanam–yadasat tanna kriyate yathā gaganakusumam iti, tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; sataḥ karaṇavirodhāt, yaddhi niṣpannaṃ svātmasattāṃ prati anyanirapekṣaṃ tat sat ityucyate, tasya ca kathaṃ karaṇam ? prayoga–yat sarvātmanā sat tanna kenacitkartu śakyam yathā prakṛti puruṣo vā, sacca sarvātmanā paramate kāryamiti
ataḥ aniṣpannasyaiva karaṇamupapannam, niṣpannatva-aniṣpannatvayośca viruddhadharmayoḥ ekatra dharmiṇi ekāntavādina samāveśā'saṃbhavāt ato viruddho'yaṃ hetu, kriyamāṇatvasya asattve satyeva saṃbhavāt
yat sarvākāreṇa sanna tat kenacijjanyam yathā prakṛti caitanyaṃ vā ? tattvasa॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 25
asatkāryavādā'nabhyupagame ca kathaṃ kāraṇe'santo hetumattvādayo dharmāḥ kārye bhavitumarhanti ? na khalu te vyaktavad avyakte santi

kālātyayāpadiṣṭaśca, pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanāt, na khalu utpatte prāk kārya svatantraṃ kāraṇātmakaṃ vā pratyakṣata pratīyate, sato hi kṣīrādau viśiṣṭākārasasthānarasādyupetasya dadhyādeḥ pratyakṣeṇa avaśyaṃ bhāvyam, dadhyādyarthina kṣīrādau pravṛttyā ca

atha na sākṣād vyaktībhūtā dadhyādyavasthā tatra sādhyate, kintu śaktyātmanā tatra vyavasthitaṃ dadhyādi vyaktībhavati iti, nanu keyaṃ śaktyātmakatā nāma–dadhyādeḥ sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇa avasthānam, kṣīrādestajjananasāmarthya vā ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'yuktaḥ, nahi padārthasya dve rūpe sta sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ ca, niṣpannatā hi padārthasya svarūpaprāpti, sā cedasti ki sthūla-sūkṣmabhedena ? dvitīyapakṣe tu na satkāryavāda samarthitaḥ, nahi sāmarthyameva kārya yuktam
kiñca idaṃ kārya nāma–kimasataḥ prādurbhāvaḥ, aṅgāṅgibhāvagamanam, dharmiṇaḥ pūrvadharmatyāgena dharmāntarasvīkāro vā ? prathamapakṣe svamatavirodhaḥ

dvitīyapakṣe tu kaḥ aṅgāṅgibhāvārthaḥ ? guṇapradhānabhāvaścet; tathāhi–yatra sattvam aṅgi rajastamasī aṅge tatra sāttvikaḥ pariṇāma sukhātmā srakcandanādi, yatra raja aṅgi sattvatamasī aṅge tatra rājaso duḥkhātmā ahikaṇṭa kādiḥ, yatra tamaḥ aṅgi sattvarajasī aṅge tatra tāmasaḥ andhakārādiḥ iti; tadasatyam; srakcandanādeḥ sukhādyātmakatvasya prāk pratiṣedhāt

aṅgāṅgitā ca sattvādeḥ pūrvarūpavailakṣaṇye, availakṣaṇye vā syāt ? availakṣaṇye aṅgitā vā aṅgataiva vā syāt ? vailakṣaṇye tu dharmiṇaḥ pūrvadharmatyāgena dharmāntarasvīkāra eva svīkṛtaḥ syāt sattvādeḥ sūkṣmarūpatyāgena sthūlarūpatopādānāt
pūrvadharmasya ca tyāge nāśaḥ tirobhāvaḥ, nāśābhyupagame svamatakṣatiḥ
tirobhāvaśca atirobhāvavināśamantareṇa nopapadyate, tadabhyupagame ca pūrvadharmavināśa eva abhyupagamyatām kimanena antargaṅunā ? tathā ca paramatapraveśaḥ
dharmāntarasvīkāro'pi tadutpādaḥ, abhivyaktirvā ? na tāvat tadutpādaḥ; satkāryavādakṣatiprasaṅgāt

abhivyaktirapi jñānadharmaḥ, arthadharmo vā syāt ? yadi jñānadharmaḥ; arthasya kimāyātaṃ yena so'pyabhivyaktaḥ syāt ? yajjñānadharmaścāsau tajjñānamapi tatkālotpannam, pūrvakālasthitaṃ vā ? pūrvakālasthitatve pūrvamapi upalambhaḥ syāt
arthadharmatve'pi arthasya sadā sattvena asyāḥ sadā sattvā'nuṣaṅgāt sadaiva abhivyakto'rthaḥ syāt, tadā'sattve vā asya asatkāryavādaprasaṅgāt sa eva paramatapraveśā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

abhivyakteśca pūrvaṃ yathā anyasyāṃ dāhādikriyāyāṃ vastu asamartham tathā abhivyaktāvapi, tatkathaṃ tatsaṃbhavaḥ ? kathañca apratyakṣasvabhāvasya pradhānasya pratyakṣasvabhāvo bhāvaprapañcaḥ syāt, nīrūpasvabhāvasya ca rūpavān ? nīrūpādapi ato rūpavadbhāvaprapañcasaṃbhave cetanādātmano acetano jagatprapañcaḥ kinna syāt yato brahmādvaitasiddhirna syāt ?

na ca satkāryavāde kārakāṇāṃ sāphalyam, prāgasatkiñcidapi akurvatāṃ kārakavyapadeśasyāpi asaṃbhāvyamānatvāt; prayogaḥ–yad avidyamānasādhyaṃ na tat kārakam yathā caitanyam, avidyamānasādhyaśca paramate kārakatvenābhimataḥ padārtha iti
na ca abhivyaktau teṣāṃ vyāpāraḥ; tatrāpi sattvā'sattvapakṣayoḥ karaṇā'saṃbhavāt, na khalu sāpi vidyamānā karttuṃ yuktā karaṇā'nuparamaprasaṅgāt
kārakāṇi ca upādānasahakāribhedena vibhinnāni, tatra kva kuṭādikāryasya sūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇa anabhivyaktasya avasthānam ? upādāne mṛtpiṇḍādau cet; daṇḍādīnāmakārakatvam
sāpyabhivyakti prāk pravṛtte satī āho'satī iti pūrvavat prasaṅga
etena upādānagrahaṇāt ityapi pratyuktam; vyadhikaraṇā'siddhatvāderdoṣasya atrāpyaviśe ṣāt
kiñca, anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, yacca yasmād anvayavyatirekābhyāmupajāyamānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadarthibhi tad upādīyate na sarvam, tathā ca prāk kāryasadbhāvāṅgīkārovyartha
tadaṅgīkāre mūlata eva upādānagrahaṇā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, nahi vidyamānavastusiddhyarthaṃ kaścidupādānaṃ gṛhṇāti, pradhāna-puruṣayorapi siddhyarthamupādānagrahaṇānuṣaṅgāt
sarvasaṃbhavā'bhāvopi etena cintitaḥ, sarvasaṃbhavā'bhāvo hi niyatasya niyatāt janma ucyate, tacca satkāryavāde durghaṭam
naiyatyañca anvayavyatirekābhyāmeva avagamyate, yaddhi yasmādupajāyamānaṃ pramāṇataḥ paricchinnaṃ tat kathamanyato'pi syāt ? śaktasya śakyakaraṇāt, kāraṇabhāvācca ityapi etena kṛtottaram

kimarthañca śiṣyān prati bhavata śāstrapraṇayanaṃ hetūpanyāsaśca ? saṃśayocchitti-niścayotpattyarthamiti cet; tau yadi saṃśaya-niścayau śiṣyabuddhisthau svarūpeṇa āsāte kathaṃ taducchittyādikam ? atha saṃśayasya tirobhāvamātraṃ tena kriyate na atyantamuccheda nā'bhāvo vidyate sataḥ
16 ityabhyupagamāt, niścayasyāpi abhivyaktimātram; ityapi manorathamātram; puna saṃśayā''virbhāvaprasaṅgāt, tathā ca samprajñātayogāya datto jalāñjaliḥ, atyantasaśayocchedasya kasyacidapi asaṃbhavāt
abhivyaktiśca satī, asatī vā na saṃbhavati ityuktam
atha śāstra-sādhanaprayogasāphalyārtham asata utpatti sato vināśaśca aṅgīkriyate, tarhi tenaiva asadakaraṇāt ityādervyabhicāra iti
tadevaṃ pradhānasadbhāvasya tatra mahadādisadbhāvasya ca kutaściddhetoraprasiddhitaḥ prakṛte tattvasṛṣṭiprakriyā bhūtasṛṣṭiprakriyāvat khapuṣpasaurabhavyāvarṇanaprakhyā ityupekṣate
cidarthaśūnyā ca jaḍā ca buddhi śabdāditanmātrajamambarādi
na bandhamokṣau puruṣasya ceti kiyajjaḍairna grathitaṃ virodhi
svalakṣaṇaṃ saugatakalpitam sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ brahmādyadvaitavādi-sāṃkhyaparikalpitam prameyam, na iti sambandhaḥ
anyonyamatyantabhinnam svalakṣaṇaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ vā na prameyam iti sambandhaḥ
kathaṃ na prameyam ? ityāha– yathā ityādi
yathā yena prakāreṇa manyate paraiḥ iti
tarhi bhedā'bhedaikāntavyatirekeṇa anyasya asaṃbhavānna kiñcit prameyaṃ syādityatrāha–dravya ityādi
dravyaparyāyau uktalakṣaṇau ātmā svabhāvaḥ yasya arthasya tasya buddhau pratyakṣādipratītau pratibhāsanāt sa eva asyāḥ prameyaḥ siddhaḥ
dravyaparyāyau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ityādinā sarvathā bhedamupavarṇayato yaugasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu dravyaparyāyayoḥ bhinnapratibhāsatvādinā anyonyamatyantaṃ bhinnatvāt kathaṃ tadātmāpyarthaḥ prameyaḥ syāt ? tathāhi–dravyaparyāyau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ghaṭapaṭādivat
ghaṭapaṭādau hi bhinnapratibhāsatvamatyantabhede satyeva upalabdham, tad dravyaparyāyayorupalabhyamānaṃ kathannātyantabhedaṃ prasādhayet ? anyatrāpyasya tadaprasādhakatvaprasaṅgāt
na cānayorbhinnapratibhāsatvamasiddham; tantvādidravyapratibhāsasya paṭādiparyāyapratibhāsavailakṣaṇyena akhilaprāṇināṃ suprasiddhatvāt

nacānayoḥ tadadhyāso'siddhaḥ; paṭo hi paṭatvajātisambandhī vilakṣaṇārthakriyāsampādakaḥ atiśayena mahattvayukto'nubhūyate, tantavastu tantutvajātisambandhino'lpaparimāṇādidharmopetāśca, iti kathanna bhidyante ? tādātmyañca ekatvamucyate, tasmiṃśca sati pratibhāsabhedo viruddhadharmādhyāsaśca na prāpnoti vibhinnaviṣayatvāttayoḥ
tathā tantupaṭādīnāṃ tādātmye paṭa tantavaḥ iti saṃjñābhedaḥ, vacanabhedaḥ, paṭasya bhāvaḥ paṭatvam iti ṣaṣṭhī, taddhitotpattiśca na prāpnoti

tathā tattādātmye tatpuruṣa-bahuvrīhi-dvandasamāsā api na prāpnuvanti, sati hi bhede tatpuruṣo dṛṣṭaḥ yathā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ evaṃ tantūnāṃ paṭaḥ iti, bahuvrīhiśca yathā citraguḥ evaṃ tantukāraṇakaḥ paṭaḥ iti, dvandaśca yathā plakṣa-nyagrodhau evaṃ tantupaṭau iti

kiñca tādātmyam ityatra ki sa paṭaḥ ātmā yeṣāṃ tantūnām teṣāṃ bhāvaḥ tādātmyam iti vigrahaḥ, te vā tantavaḥ ātmā yasya paṭasya, sa ca te ca ātmā yasya iti vā ? tatra ādyavikalpe paṭasya ekatvāt tantūnāmapi ekatvaprasaṅgaḥ, anyathā tattādātmyā'nupapattiḥ
dvitīyavikalpe tu tantūnāmanekatvāt paṭasyāpi anekatvā'nuṣaṅgaḥ, anyathā tattādātmyaṃ na syāt
tṛtīyavikalpastu avicāritaramaṇīyaḥ; tadvyatiriktasya vastuno'saṃbhavāt, nahi tantu-paṭavyatiriktaṃ kiñcid vastvantaramasti yasya tantupaṭātmatā ucyate
etena guṇaguṇinoḥ kriyātadvatoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ bhāvā'bhāvayośca tādātmyaṃ pratyākhyātam; bhinnapratibhāsatvasya viruddhadharmādhyāsādeśca tadbādhakasya atrāpyaviśeṣāt
guṇaguṇyādīnāñca ākāranānātve'pi anyonyamanānātve bahirantarvā nānātvavārttocchedaḥ syāt

kiñca, ekaṃ nityaṃ niravayavaṃ vyāpi ca sāmānyasvarūpam tadviparītasvabhāvāśca viśeṣāḥ, tatra yadi vastunaḥ sāmānyasvabhāvatā urarīkriyate kathaṃ tatra viśeṣarūpatā syāt virodhāt ? atha viśeṣarūpatā asya aṅgīkriyate, tadā sāmānyasvabhāvatā tatra na syāt tata eva
bhāvā'bhāvātmakatvañca arthānāṃ chāyātapavad virodhād atīva durghaṭam
kiñca, bhāvopamardanātmakatvamabhāvasya svarūpam, tena ca yadi bhāvarūpatā grāsīkṛtā tadā abhāvarūpataiva tatra syāt iti bhāvarūpatāyā nāmā'pi na śrūyeta
uttarapadārthe ca niścite sarvatra nañaḥ prayogaḥ abrāhmaṇādivat, ekāntaśca yadi kvacit niścitaḥ kathaṃ sarvamanekāntātmakaṃ syāt ?
tadātmakatve ca arthānāṃ saṃśayādidoṣopanipāta, tathāhi–kena svarūpeṇa tantu-paṭādīnāṃ bhedaḥ, kena ca abheda iti saśayaḥ
tathā yatra abhedaḥ tatra bhedasya virodhaḥ, yatra ca bhedaḥ tatra abhedasya śītoṣṇasparśavat iti virodha
tathā abhedasya ekatvasvabhāvasya anyadadhikaraṇam bhedasyānekatvasvabhāvasya anyat iti vaiyadhikaraṇyam
tathā ekāntena ekātmakatve yo doṣaḥ anekasvabhāvatvā'bhāvalakṣaṇa, anekāntātmakatve ca ekasvabhāvatvā'bhāvalakṣaṇaḥ so'trāpyanuṣajyate ityubhayadoṣa
tathā yena svabhāvena arthasya ekasvabhāvatā tena anekasvabhāvatvasyāpi prasaṅga yena ca anekasvabhāvatā tena ekasvabhāvatvasyāpi iti saṅkaraprasaṅga
tathā yena svabhāvena anekatvaṃ tena ekatvaṃ prāpnoti yena ca ekatvaṃ tena anekatvam iti vyatikara
tathā yena rūpeṇa bheda tena kathañcidbheda yena ca abheda tenā'pi kathañcidabhedaḥ ityanavasthā
evaṃ sattvādyabhyupagame'pi ete doṣā draṣṭa vyāḥ
tathā anekānte mukto'pi amukta eva syāt, amukto'pi ca mukta eva vā, anyathā anekāntakṣatiḥ syāditi
na hyekasmin dharmiṇi yugapatsadasattvādiviruddhadharmasamāveśa sabhavati śitoṣṇavat

ya ete sapta padārthā nirdhāritā etāvanta evaṃrūpāśceti te tathaiva vā syu naiva vā tathā syu, itarathā hi tathā vā syu itarathā vā ityanirdhāritarūpaṃ jñāna saśayajñānavadapramāṇameva syāt avaktavyāśca ucyeran, ucyante ca avaktavyāśceti vipratiṣiddham ucyamānāśca tathaivāvadhāryante nāvadhāryante iti ca

tathā tadavadhāraṇaphala samyagdarśanamasti vā nāsti vāevaṃ jīvādiṣu padārtheṣu ekasmin dharmiṇi sattvāsattvayo viruddhayordharmayorasabhavāt, sattve caikasmin dharme asattvasya dharmāntarasyāsabhavāt asattve caivaṃ sattvasyā'sabhavādasaṃgatamidamārhata matam
atha puna dravyaparyāyayo sammūrcchitatvāt narasiṃhavadeka śabalarūpatvāt dvirūpamucyate, tadayuktam, narasiṃhasya śabalarūpatvā' siddhe āha ca–dravyaparyāyarūpatvāt dvairūpyaṃ vastuna kila
na caiva gamyate tena vādo'yaṃ jālmakalpitaḥ
tathāhi nityānityayo vidhipratiṣedharūpatvāt abhinne dharmiṇi abhāva evaṃ sadasattvāderapi
tathā muktāvapyanekānto na vyāvarttate iti mukto na muktaśceti syāt
evaṃ ca sati sa eva muktaḥ saṃsārī ceti prasakte
tatpratividhānapurassaraṃ dravyaparyāyayo kathañcid bhedā'bhedātmakatvaprasādhanam, anekānte saśayādidoṣaparihāraśca–

yattāvaduktam–dravyaparyāyau atyantaṃ bhinnau bhinnapratibhāsatvāt ityādi; tatra bhinnapratibhāsatvaṃ bhinnapramāṇagrāhyatvamabhipretam, bhinnākārā'vabhāsitvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe ātmādinā anekāntaḥ, pratyakṣādibhinnapramāṇagrāhye'pi asmin bhedā'saṃbhavāt

dvitīyapakṣe'pi kathañcit tayorbhinnākārāvabhāsitvaṃ vivakṣitam, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit; tadā kathañcideva ataḥ tayorbhedaḥ siddhyet tenaiva asya avinābhāvasaṃbhavāt, na punaḥ sarvathā tadviparyayāt, tathā ca hetorviruddhatvam sādhyaviparyayasādhanāt
sarvathā tadbhedasādhane tu kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvam; pratyakṣabādhitakarmanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvāt anuṣṇo'gniḥ dravyatvāt ityādivat

yad yadrūpatayā pramāṇato na pratīyate na tat tadrūpatayā abhyupagantavyam yathā ghaṭaḥ paṭarūpatayā, pramāṇato na pratīyante ca atyantabhedarūpatayā dravyaparyāyādayaḥ ityanumānabādhitapakṣanirdeśānantaraṃ prayuktatvādvā
kiṃ bhinnapramāṇagrāhyatvāt bhinnākārāghabhāsitvādvā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 738
dūrapādapādinā anaikāntikatvañca; nahi dūra-āsannadeśavarttipratipatṝṇāmaspaṣṭetarapratyayagrāhyatayā bhinnapratibhāsatve'pi tasya bhedaḥ saṃbhavati

nanu ca atra tatpratyayabhedāt viṣayabhedo'styeva; tathāhi–prathamaṃ dūradeśavarttino vijñānam atra ūrdhvatāsāmānyaviṣayam, uttarakālaṃ tu taddeśopasarpaṇe śākhādiviśeṣaviṣayamiti; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; evaṃ viṣayabhedā'bhyupagame yamahamadrākṣaṃ dūrasthitaḥ pādapam etarhi tameva paśyāmi iti ekatvādhyavasāyā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt, spaṣṭetarapratibhāsānāṃ sāmānya-viśeṣaviṣayatvena ghaṭa-paṭādipratibhāsavad bhinnaviṣayatvāt

atha pādapāpekṣayā teṣāmekaviṣayatvamiṣyate sāmānyaviśeṣāpekṣayā tu viṣayabhedaḥ; kathamevam ekāntābhyupagamo na viśīryeta, dravyaparyāyādāvapi tadvat kathañcidbhedā'bhedaprasiddheḥ ? atha sarvathā tayorbhinnākārāvabhāsitvaṃ vivakṣitam; tadasiddham; kathañcit tādātmyāpannayoreva dravyaparyāyayoḥ abādhā'dhyakṣe'vabhāsamānatvāt
yad yathā abādhādhyakṣe'vabhāsate tat tathaiva abhyupagantavyam yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā, abādhādhyakṣe'vabhāsete ca kathañcittādātmyena dravyaparyāyāviti
na ca tathā tadavabhāsino'dhyakṣasya abādhatvamasiddham; tadbādhakasya kasyacidapi pramāṇasyāsabhavāt
anumānamapi etadeva, anyadvā tadbādhakaṃ syāt ? na tāvad etadeva; asya adhyakṣabādhitaviṣayatayā utthānasyaivāsaṃbhavāt

bhrāntatvānna tadviṣayasyānena bādhā; iti cet; kutastadbhrāntatvam ? anena bādhanāccet cakrakaprasaṅga, tathāhi–abādhitaviṣayatayā asyotthāne'dhyakṣasyānena bādhā, tasyāñca satyāṃ tasya bhrāntatvam, tasmin sati abādhitaviṣayatayā asyotthānamiti

kathañcaivam anuṣṇo'gni sattvāt jalavat ityasyāpi abādhitaviṣayatayā pravṛttirna syāt bhinnapratibhāsatvasyeva atrāpi pratibandhasya sapakṣe pratyakṣata pratīteraviśeṣāt ? pakṣasya pratyakṣabādhanād asyāgamakatvamanyatrāpi aviśiṣṭam
anumānāntareṇa tadbādhane asya vaiyarthyam, sādhyasyāpi ata eva prasiddheḥ

na ca tadbādhakaṃ tadantaramasti, tatkhalu bhinnārthakriyākāritvāt, bhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvāt, bhinnakālatvāt, viruddhadharmādhyāsādvā liṅgādāvirbhūtaṃ tadbādhakaṃ syāt ? tatra ādyapakṣo'yukta, narttakyādinā'nekāntāt, ekā'pi hi narttakī karaṇa-aṅgahāra-bhrūbhaṅga-akṣivikṣepādilakṣaṇāṃ prekṣakajanānāṃ harṣaviṣādādilakṣaṇāṃ vā anekāmanyonyavilakṣaṇāmarthakriyāṃ karoti iti

atha bhinnopādānakāraṇaprabhavatvaṃ bhedakam na bhinnakāraṇaprabhavatvamātram, tacca iha nāsti tena ayamadoṣaḥ, kathamevaṃ guṇaguṇyādīnāmapi bheda syāt bhinnopādānakāraṇaprabhavatvasya tatrāpyasaṃbhavāt ?

bhinnakālatvādapi aprāptapaṭāvasthebhyaḥ prāktanā'vasthāviśiṣṭebhyaḥ tantubhya paṭasya bhedaḥ sādhyeta, prāptapaṭāvasthebhyo vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhyatā; pūrvottarāvasthayoḥ sakalabhāvānāṃ bhedā'bhyupagamāt, na khalu yaiva arthasya pūrvāvasthā saiva uttarāvasthā bhavitumarhati pūrvākāraparityāgenaiva uttarākārotpādapratīteḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tu asiddho hetuḥ; paṭāvasthatantūnāṃ paṭād bhinnakālatvasyāsaṃbhavāt
viruddhadharmādhyāso'pi dhūpadahanādinā anaikāntikaḥ, na khalu hastalagnetarapradeśe śītoṣṇasparśalakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhyāse'pi dhūpadahanāderbhedaḥ pratīyate
na ca hastalagnetarapradeśayoreva śītoṣṇasparśādhāratā na dhūpadahanādyavayavina ityabhidhātavyam; pratyakṣavirodhāt
ato'tyantabhedasyaiva tādātmyavirodhitayā viruddhadharmādhyāsānnivṛttiḥ na tu kathañcidbhedasya, yathā rajjo granthayaḥ, hastasya saṅkocaprasāraṇe, sarpasya kuṇḍalībhāvaḥ ityatra
bhedo hi padārthānāṃ pratītito'bhyupagamyate, sā ced avasthātadvatoḥ kathañcidbhede'pi asti tadā asāvapi kimiti nā'bhyupagamyate ? na ceyaṃ rājājñā yad ekasya nānāvasthātmakatvaṃ nāsti iti

yadi eko'pi kramabhāvinīnāmavasthānām uktavidhinā tādātmyena anusyūto varteta tadā kathaṃ tatra kathañcidekatvavirodhaḥ ? pramāṇaṃ hi yathāvidhaṃ vastusvarūpaṃ prakāśayati tathāvidhameva tad abhyupagantavyam, yatra atyantabhedaṃ tat prakāśayati tatra atyantabhedaḥ yathā ghaṭa-paṭādau, yatra tu kathañcidbhedaṃ tatra kathañcidbhedaḥ yathā rajjugranthyādau
tadevam anekadoṣaduṣṭatvāt bhinnapratibhāsatvādisādhanaṃ na dravyādīnāmatyantabhedaprasādhakaṃ ghaṭate
dṛṣṭānto'pi sādhyavikalaḥ; ghaṭapaṭādīnāmapi atyantabhedā'saṃbhavāt, tadasaṃbhavaśca sattvādinā anyonyaṃ teṣāmabhedāt suprasiddhaḥ
sādhanavikalaścāyam; visphāritākṣasya ekasminnapi adhyakṣe ghaṭādīnāṃ pratibhāsasaṃbhavāt
na ca prativiṣayaṃ vijñānabhedo'bhyupagantavyaḥ; avayavisiddhyabhāvaprasaṅgāt, ūrdhva-adho-madhyabhāgeṣu tadbhedasya atrāpi kalpayituṃ suśakatvāt, pratītibādhā anyatrāpi na kākairbhakṣitā

yadi ca dṛṣṭānte atyantabhedena asya vyāptyupalambhāt dravya-paryāyādīnāmapi atyantabhede sādhye gamakatvamiṣyate; tadā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattvāt ghaṭādivat ityāderapi gamakatvamiṣyatām, sapakṣe ghaṭādau sattvādeḥ aśrāvaṇatvādinā pratibandhapratipatteḥ atrāpyaviśeṣāt
yadapyuktam–tantavaḥ paṭaḥ iti saṃjñābhedaḥ ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; avasthābhedanibandhanatvāttasya, ataḥ tameva asau prasādhayati na punaḥ tadatyantabhedam
anaikāntikaścāyam; gaganam ākāśam ityādau atyantabhedā'bhāve'pi saṃjñābhedasya, jalam āpaḥ ityādau tu saṃjñābhedasya vacanabhedasya ca saṃbhavāt
ananvayavastuviṣayo hi saṃjñādibhedo vastuno'tyantabhedaprasādhakaḥ nānyaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt
prayogaḥ–yaḥ aparityaktānvaye vastuni saṃjñādibhedaḥ nā'sau atyantabhedaprasādhakaḥ yathā jalam āpaḥ ityādisaṃjñādibhedaḥ, tathābhūte vastuni saṃjñādibhedaścāyam tantavaḥ paṭaḥ ityādiriti
nanvevaṃ gaganākāśādivat tantupaṭādāvapi paryāyaśabdatāprasaktiḥ iti cet; evametat, tacchabdānāmavasthāviśeṣavācitvāt
yoṣidādikaravyāpārotpannā hi tantavaḥ kuvindādivyāpārāt pūrvaṃ śītāpanodādyarthā'samarthāḥ tantuvyapadeśaṃ labhante, tadvyāpārāttu uttarakālaṃ viśiṣṭāvasthāprāptāḥ tatsamarthāḥ paṭavyapadeśam

yaccānyaduktam–paṭasya bhāvaḥ ityādi; tadapyayuktam; ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāmastitvam ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ vargaḥ ityādau bhedā'bhāve'pi ṣaṣṭhyādyutpattipratīteḥ, na khalu bhavatā ṣaṭpadārthātiri ktam astitvādi iṣyate

nanu sat sata jñāpakapramāṇaviṣayasya bhāvaḥ sattvam sadupalambhakapramāṇaviṣayatva nāma dharmāntaraṃ ṣaṇṇāmastitvamiṣyate, ato nā'nena anekāntaḥ; ityapyanupapannam, ṣaṭpadārthasaṃkhyāvyāghātaprasaṅgāt tatsattvadharmasya tebhyo'rthāntaratvāt
nanu dharmirūpā eva ye bhāvāḥ te ṣaṭpadārthā proktāḥ dharmarūpāstu tadvyatiriktā iṣṭā eva, tathā ca padārthapraveśakagrantha–evaṃ dharmairvinā dharmiṇāmeva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ
astvevam, tathāpi astitvāderdharmasya ṣaṭpadārthai sākaṃ kaḥ sambandhaḥ yena tat teṣāṃ dharma syāt–saṃyoga, samavāyo vā ? na tāvat saṃyoga; asya guṇatvena dravyāśrayatvāt
kiñca, astitvāde aparā'stitvā'bhāvāt kathaṃ tatra vyatirekanibandhanā vibhaktirbhavet ? atha tatrāpi aparamastitvamaṅgīkriyate, tadā anavasthā syāt
aparāparadharmasamāveśena ca sattvāderdharmirūpatvā'nuṣaṅgāt paḍeva dharmiṇaḥ ityasya vyāghātaḥ
ye dharmirūpāḥ ta eva ṣaṭtvenāvadhāritāḥ, ityapyasāram; guṇa-karma-sāmānya-viśeṣa-samavāyānāmanirdeśā'nuṣaṅgāt
nahi eṣāṃ dharmirūpatvameva; dravyāśritatvena dharmarūpatvasyāpi saṃbhavāt
tathā khasya bhāva khatvam ityādau bhedā'bhāve'pi taddhitotpatterupalambhānna sā'pi bhedapakṣamevāvalambate
yadapyabhihitam–tatpuruṣa ityādi, tadapyabhidhānamātram, yataḥ senāgaja, kānanavṛkṣā ityādau bhedā'bhāve'pi tatpuruṣo dṛśyate, mattagajā vīrapuruṣā senā ityādau bahuvrīhiśca

yadapyuktam–tādātmyam ityatra ki sa paṭaḥ ātmā ityādi; tatra ittha vigraho draṣṭavya– tasya vastunaḥ ātmānau dravyaparyāyau sattvā'sattvadharmau vā tadātmānau, tacchabdena vastuna parāmarśāt, tayorbhāva tādātmyam–bhedā'bhedādyātmakatvam
vastuno hi bheda paryāyarūpataiva, abheḥ dastu dravyarūpatvameva, bhedā'bhedau tu dravyaparyāyasvabhāvau eva

na khalu dravyamātra paryāyamātraṃ vā vastu; ubhayātmana samudāyasya vastutvāt, dravyaparyāyayostu na vastutvam nāpi avastutā, kintu vastvekadeśatā, yathā samudrāṃśo na samudraḥ nāpyasamudra kintu samudraikadeśaḥ
taduktam– nā'ya vastu na cā'vastu vastvaśaḥ kathyate budhaiḥ
nā'samudraḥ samudro vā samudrāśo yathaiva hi
sa paṭa ātmā yeṣām ityapi vigrahe na doṣaḥ, avasthāviśeṣāpekṣayā tantūnāmekatvasya iṣṭatvāt

tarhi te tantava ātmā yasya iti vigrahe tantūnāmanekatve paṭasyāpi anekatvaṃ syāditi cet; nanu kimidaṃ tasya anekatvaṃ nāma–kim anekā'vayavātmakatvam, pratitantu tatprasaṅgo vā ? prathamapakṣe sidhyasādhyatā; ātānavitānībhūta-anekatantvādyavayavātmakatvāttasya
ātānavitānībhāvalakṣaṇo hi teṣāṃ pariṇāmaviśeṣaḥ paṭaḥ, sa ca samuditānāmeva amīṣāṃ pratīyate nānyathā, tathābhūtāśca te paṭasya ātmā iti ucyante
dvividho hi vastunaḥ pariṇāmaḥ–pratyekāvasthāyām samudāyāvasthāyāñca, kṣorādivat dadhyādivacca
evaṃ dravyaparyāyavat guṇaguṇyādīnāmapi kathañcit tādātmyaṃ pratipattavyam, pratibhāsabhedasya viruddhadharmādhyāsasya ca sarvathā bhedā'prasādhakatvapratipādanāt
tasya vastuna ātmānau tadātmānau tayo bhāva tādātmya bhedābhedasvabhāvatvam
nā'ya vastu na cā'vastu vastvaśaḥ kathyate budhaiḥ
nā'samudraḥ samudro vā samudrāśo yathaiva hi || tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 118 iti
yaccānyaduktam–guṇaguṇyādīnāñca ākāranānātve'pi ityādi; tadapyacāru; kathañcidbhedā'bhedātmanā guṇaguṇyādivat nikhilārthānāṃ grahaṇā'saṃbhavato anyato'nyasya anyatvopapatteḥ
tādātmyākāravailakṣaṇye hi teṣāṃ bhedā'bhedau, tathāvabhāsanameva ca ubhayātmanā grahaṇam, tacca anyatra nāsti iti kathaṃ bahirantarvā nānātvavārttocchedaḥ syāt ?
yadapyuktam–ekaṃ nityam ityādi; tadapi śraddhāmātram; sāmānyasya aneka-anitya-sāvayava-avyāpisvarūpatvapratipādanāt
ato viśeṣapariṇāmavat sādṛśyalakṣaṇasāmānyapariṇāmo'pi arthānāṃ prativyakti vibhinna eva

tathāvidhasadṛśetaradharmādhāratayā ca amīṣāṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ kathaṃ sāmānyasvabhāvatorarīkāre viśeṣarūpatā'ṅgīkāro viruddhyeta ? dharmadharmiṇośca na sarvathā bhede abhede vā tadbhāvo ghaṭate sahyavindhyavat tadanyatarasvarūpavacca, kintu kathañcidbhede
bhedo hi dharma-dharmiṇau eva, abhedastu tayoḥ dravyāntaraṃ netumaśakyatvalakṣaṇam aśakyavivecanatvam
na khalu ghaṭapaṭādīnāmiva anayoḥ tallakṣaṇam aśakyavivecanatvaṃ na saṃbhavati; ghaṭādidharmiṇo mithaśca bhinnānāmapi sadṛśetarapariṇāmādyaśeṣadharmāṇāṃ mṛdādidravyeṇa ekenaiva anuvedhāt
eva dharmiṇo dravyasya rasādidharmāntararūpeṇa rūpādibhyo bheda dravyarūpeṇa cā'bheda
tathā avayavina svarūpeṇa avayavairabhedaḥ avayavāntareṇa tu avayavāntarai bheda ityūhanīyam
tatra yathā dīrghahrasvādīnāṃ viruddhasvabhāvānāmapyapekṣābhedāt ekatrāpyaviruddhatvaṃ pratītibalādaṅgāṃkriyate tathā bhedābhedayorapi draṣṭavyaṃ pratītyaviśeṣāt
dharmiṇo dharmāṇāmekāntato bhedā'bhyupagame ca niḥsvabhāvartāpattiḥ, svabhāvasyāpi dharmatayā tato bhedāt, tathā ca asyāsattvam
yanniḥsvabhāvam tadasat yathā gaganendīvaram, niḥsvabhāvaśca bhavadbhirabhipreto dharmī iti
evañca dharmāṇāmapyabhāvaḥ nirāśrayāṇāṃ teṣāṃ sadbhāvā'saṃbhavāt, ataḥ sakalaśūnyatāpattiḥ parasya pūtkurvato'pi āyātā
na ca niḥsvabhāvasyāpyasya tadāśrayatvaṃ yuktam; kharaviṣāṇāderapi tatprasaṅgāt
bhinnasyāpi svabhāvasya dharmiṇi samavāyānna niḥsvabhāvatā ityapyasundaram; samavāyasya prāgeva asattvapratipādanāt
sarvathā abhede hi tayoḥ dharmamātra dharmimātraṃ vā syāt iti anyatarasvabhāvā'bhāvaḥ
kalpitatvāt tadbhāvasya na tadabhāvo doṣāya, ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; nirbījāyā kalpanāyā eva anupapatte
na cāsyā nirbījatvamasiddham; bahirantarvā vastunaḥ ekāntaikasvabhāvatve tatkāraṇatvā'nupapatteḥ

nahi ekāntaikasvabhāvamanekakalpanābījaṃ yuktam; vibhinnaśaktiśūnyasya vibhinnakāryahetutvā'nupapatteḥ, yad vibhinnaśaktiśūnyam tanna vibhinnakāryahetuḥ yathā nityābhimataṃ vastu, vibhinnaśaktiśūnyaṃ ca svalakṣaṇābhimataṃ vastu

ataḥ kathametat dharmadharmikalpanālakṣaṇakāryadvayahetu syāt ? vibhinnasvabhāvavyāvṛttivaśāt vibhinnaśaktiśūnyādapi ravalakṣaṇād vibhinnakāryotpattiraviruddhā; ityapyacarcitā'bhidhānam; tasyāstato bhinnāyā saṃbhavā'bhāvāt, avasturūpatayā kharaviṣāṇavat vibhinnasvabhāvatvā'nupapatteśca
tadupapattau vā na avastutvamasyā syāt iti apohavicārāvasare vakṣyate
tadbhede ca vastunyeva bhedo'stu tatra tasyā'virodhāt, avastu bhidyate vastu na bhidyate iti kimapi mahādbhutam
vyāvṛttibhedābhyupagame ca siddho dharmabhedaḥ vyāvṛttīnāmapi dharmatvāt
yadapyuktam–bhāvā'bhāvātmakam ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; tadātmakatvasya artheṣu upalabhyamānatvena virodhā'siddheḥ
virodho hi anupalambhasādhyaḥ yathā vandhyāyāṃ stanandhayasya, na ca svarūpādinā vastuna sattve pararūpādinā asattvasya anupalambho'sti
na khalu vastuna sarvathā bhāva eva svarūpam; svātmanā iva parātmanā'pi bhāvaprasaṅgāt sarvasya sarvātmakatvā'nuṣaṅgataḥ sattādvaitaṃ syāt, tacca prāgeva kṛtottaram
nāpyabhāva eva; pararūpeṇa iva svarūpeṇā'pi abhāvaprasaṅgataḥ khapuṣpaprakhyatvānuṣaṅgāt sakalaśūnyatānuṣaṅgato nikhilavyavahārocchedaḥ syāta kvacidapi pravṛttyādyabhāvāt
prativihitā ca tacchūnyatā prāg ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
nanu viruddhau bhedābhedau kathamekatra syātām ? na virodha, saha darśanāt
yadi hi idaṃ rajataṃ nedaṃ rajatamiti vat parasparopamardena bhedābhedau pratīyetā na tu tayo parasparopamardena pratīti
iyaṃ gauriti buddhidvayamaparyāyeṇa pratibhāsamānamekaṃ vastu dvyātmakatvaṃ vyavasthāpayati
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ hi abhedamāpādayati aparyāyatvañca bhedam ata pratītibalādavirodha, apekṣābhedācca; tathāhi
svarūpādiva pararūpādapi sattve cetanāderacetanāditvaprasaṅgāt tatsvātmavat, pararūpādiva svarūpādapyasattve sarvathā śūnyatāpatte

na ca svarūpādinā sattvameva pararūpādinā asattvam, pararūpādinā'sattvameva ca svarūpādinā sattvamityabhidhātavyam; tadapekṣaṇīyanimittabhedāt, svadravyādikaṃ hi nimittamapekṣya arthe sattvaṃ vyavasthāpyate paradravyādikaṃ tu apekṣya asattvam, ato vibhinnanimittanibandhanatvāt sattvā'sattvayorbhedaḥ
yasya vibhinnanimittanibandhanatvaṃ tasya bhedaḥ yathā ekatvādisaṃkhyāyāḥ, vibhinnanimittanibandhanatvañca sattvā'sattvayoriti
nāpi dṛṣṭāntasya sādhyasādhanavaikalyam; ekatra dravye svarūpamātrāpekṣa-ekatvasaṃkhyātaḥ dravyāntarāpekṣadvitvādisaṃkhyāyā vibhinnanimittanibandhanatvasya bhedasya ca suprasiddhatvāt
sarvathā abhedetu anayoḥ tannibandhanatvānupapattiḥ, yat sarvathā'bhinnam na tatra vibhinnanimittanibandhanatvam yathā sattve asattve vā, sarvathā'bhedaśca sattvā'sattvayorbhavadbhiriṣṭaḥ iti
abhinnanimittanibandhanatve ca tatpratyayayoḥ sarvatra hetubhedāt phalabhedaḥ ityabhyupagamo viruddhyeta

pratiniyatavastuvyavasthāvilopaśca sattvā'sattvayoḥ sarvathā'bhede; ghaṭo hi yathā svadravyādinā san naivaṃ paradravyādinā'pi tatsattvā'vyatiriktatvāt tadasattvasya, tena asattve vā svadravyādināpi asattvaṃ syāt tadasattvā'vyatiriktatvāt sattvasya, ataḥ pratiniyatavastusvarūpā'vyavasthiteḥ siddhaḥ pratiniyatavastuvyavasthāvilopaḥ
vastusattvameva anyaviviktatāviśiṣṭaṃ tadvyavasthāhetuḥ; ityapi andhasarpavilapraveśanyāyānusaraṇam; asattvasyaiva viviktatā iti nāmāntarakaraṇāt
tataḥ svapararūpābhyāṃ sadasadātmakāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ pratipattavyāḥ, pratiniyatarūpavyavasthā'nyathā'nupapatteḥ, pratiniyatakāryakāritvānyathā'nupapattervā
atha itaretarā'bhāvavaśāt tadvyavasthā bhaviṣyati ityucyate; nanu kisvabhāvo'yam itaretarābhāvaḥ–svatantraḥ, bhāvadharmo vā ? na tāvat svatantraḥ; tathāvidhasyāsya agre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt

atha bhāvadharma; kasya punaḥ bhāvasya dharmo'sau–ghaṭasya, bhūtalasya, ubhayasya vā ? yadi ghaṭasya; tatrāpi ki ghaṭasvarūpasya niṣedhakaḥ, na vā ? niṣedhakaścet; ki ghaṭe eva, bhūtale vā ? prathamapakṣe kathaṃ ghaṭadharmo'sau dharmiṇa eva asattvāt ? kathaṃ vā bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti pratīti ghaṭe eva tatpratītiprasaṅgāt ? dvitīyapakṣe tu asmanmatasiddhiḥ, ghaṭābhāvasya ghaṭadharmasyaiva sato bhūtale ghaṭasvarūpapratiṣedhakatvena asmābhirabhyupagamāt
atha aniṣedhakaḥ; tadā bhūtale'pi ghaṭa svarūpaprasaṅgād abhāvakalpanāvaiyarthyam

atha bhūtaladharmo'sau; tanna; ghaṭo nāsti iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena pratyayapravṛttito ghaṭadharmatvasya atra upapatteḥ bhāvavat, yathaiva hi ghaṭo'sti iti sāmānādhikaraṇyapratīteḥ bhāva ghaṭadharma tathā abhāvo'pi
abhāvasya ādhāradharmatve'pi ādheyasāmānādhikaraṇyā'virodhe bhāvasyāpi taddharmatve'pi tadavirodho'stu, iti ubhayadharmaśūnyo ghaṭādiḥ khapuṣpāt na viśiṣyeta
etena ubhayadharmatā'pi asattvasya pratyuktā, sattvasyāpi taddharmatāprasaṅgāt
yaccedaṃ svadeśādiṣu sattvaṃ paradeśādiṣvasattvamiṣyata eva itaretarābhāvā'bhyupagamāt

yadapyuktam–bhāvarūpatā grāsīkṛtā ityādi; tatra kimidam abhāvarūpatayā grāsīkaraṇaṃ nāma–svarūpāpahāra, ekāśrayapratiṣedho vā ? na tāvat svarūpāpahāra, sattvā'sattvayoḥ tulyabalatayā anyonyasvarūpāpahārakatvā'yogāt
nāpi ekāśrayapratiṣedhaḥ; svapararūpābhyāṃ bhāvā'bhāvayo ekatrāpyāśraye sadbhāvapratipādanāt
yaccānyaduktam–uttarapadārtha ityādi; tatsatyam; nayapratītyā niścite eva ekānte nañaḥ prayogā'bhyupagamāt
na caivaṃ sarvamanekāntātmakam ityabhyupagamavirodha, pramāṇaviṣayāpekṣayā sarvasya tadātmakatvapratijñānāt, nayagocarāpekṣayā tu ekāntātmakasyāpi abhyupagamāt
anekānte tadabhāvādavyāpti iti cenna, tatrāpi tadupapatte
yadapyabhihitam–tadātmakatve saṃśayādidoṣa ityādi, tadapi manorathamātram, vastuna sadasadādyanekadharmātmakatvena pratītau saṃśayā'nupapatteḥ
yad yaddharmātmakatvena pratīyate na tasya tadātmakatve saṃśaya yathā svagatadharmātmakatvena pratīyamānasya sthāṇu-puruṣadvayasya, sadasadādyanekadharmātmakatvena pratīyante ca sarve bhāvā iti
na cāyamasiddho hetu, tadātmakatvena tatpratīte prāk pratipāditatvāt
nāpi dṛṣṭānta sādhyavikalaḥ, sthāṇutvādidharmapratītau svapne'pi sthāṇvādau saṃśayā'pratīteḥ, tadapratītāveva tatra taddarśanāt
calitā ca pratītiḥ saṃśayaḥ, na ca sadādyātmakatvena pratīti tathā
na khalu vastuna svapararūpābhyāṃ sadasadrūpatayā pratītiḥ kasyacidanupahatacetaso dolāyate
atha anupajāyamāno'pi saṃśayaḥ atra balādāpādyate; nanvevaṃ kasyacidapi pratiniyatarūpavyavasthā na syāt, sarvatra tasya āpādayituṃ suśakatvāt
ghaṭāderapi hi ghaṭādirūpatā ki niraṃśā'vayavirūpasya, kṣaṇikaparamāṇvātmanaḥ, jñānapracayasvabhāvasya, paramātmasvarūpasya vā syāt ityādi saśayasabhavāt na siddhyet
tato ghaṭādeḥ pratiniyatarūpavyavasthāmicchatā nānupajāyamāno'pi saṃśayo'tra balādāpādyaḥ

nāpi virodhaḥ; sattvā'sattvayostatra bhinnanimittanibandhanatvāt, yayorbhinnanimittanibandhanatvaṃ na tayoḥ ekatra dharmiṇi virodhaḥ yathā ekatvā'nekatvayoḥ sūkṣmatvasthūlatvayorvā, bhinnanimittanibandhanatvañca ekatra dharmiṇi sattvāsattvayoriti
yat khalu yatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sat nopalabhyate tat tatra viruddham yathā turaṅgamottamāṅge śṛṅgam, na ca svarūpādinā vastuni sattvopalambhe pararūpādinā asattvasya anupalambho'sti iti
tatra upalabhyamānayorapi anayoḥ virodhā'bhyupagame svasvabhāvenāpi vastuno virodhā'nuṣaṅgāt niḥsvabhāvatāpattiḥ syāt

yadi caikatra vidhipratiṣedhātmakatvaṃ viruddhyate tadā katham anuvṛttavyāvṛttapratyayahetuśaktidvayātmakatvaṃ sāmānyaviśeṣaraya syāt, ekā'nekasvabhāvātmakatvaṃ mecakasya vā ? kathañca ekasya narasihatvam umeśvaratvaṃ vā syāt ? jātyantaratvānna doṣaḥ ityanyatrāpi samānam
tadeva ca syānna tadeva ca syāt tathāpratītestava tatkathañcit | vṛhatsvayaṃ॰ ślo॰ 42
na naraḥ siṃharūpatvāt na siho nararūpataḥ
na naro nara eveti na sihaḥ siha eva vā

na nara siṃharūpatvāt na naro nara eveti ime dve kārike anekāntavādapraveśaṭippaṇake pṛ॰ 15 na nara siṃharūpatvāt iti ca tattvārthabhāṣyavyākhyāyām pṛ॰ 377 saṃjñāvijñānakāryāṇām iti pāṭhabhedena ca jainatarkavā॰ vṛttau pṛ॰ 116 uddhṛtā'sti
yathā narasyākāro prastya ? sihasyākāraḥ śirobhāgaḥ tadubhayābhedagateḥ narasiṃha ityucyate
bhāge siṃho naro bhāge yo'rtho bhāgadvayātmakaḥ
narasiṃhasya dṛṣṭāntarūpeṇa ullekha tatvārtharājavā॰ pṛ॰ 225, mīmāsāślo॰ pṛ॰ 881, vākyapa॰ dvi॰ kāṇḍa pṛ॰ 121, tattvasa॰ pṛ॰ 122, hetuvi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 105 ityādiṣu varttate
unmajjanti nimajjanti jalakallolavat jale || siddhivi॰ pṛ॰ 174 iti
kiñca, virodhaḥ avikalakāraṇasya ekasya bhavataḥ dvitīyasannidhāne'bhāvād avasīyate śītāgnivat
na ca sattvasannidhāne asattvasya tatsannidhāne vā sattvasya abhāvaḥ kadācidapyanubhūyate

api ca anayorvirodhaḥ sahā'navasthānalakṣaṇaḥ, parasparaparihārasthitisvabhāvaḥ, badhyaghātakasvarūpo vā syāt ? na tāvat sahā'navasthānalakṣaṇaḥ; anyonyā'vyavacchedena ekasmin ādhāre sattvā'sattvayoḥ pratīyamānatvāt, yayostathā pratīyamānatvaṃ na tayo tathā virodha yathā rūparasayo, tathā pratīyamānatvañca sattvā'sattvayoriti
parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇastu virodhaḥ sahaikatra āmraphalādau rūparasayoriva anayo saṃbhavatoreva syāt, na punarasaṃbhavatoḥ śaśāśvaviṣāṇavat, saṃbhavadasaṃbhavatorvā vandhyā-stanandhayayoriva
dvividho hi padārthānā virādha–avikalakāraṇasya bhavato'nyabhāve abhāvād virodhagati śītoṣṇasparśavat
kiñca, ayaṃ virodhaḥ dharmayoḥ, dharmadharmiṇorvā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanam, etallakṣaṇatvād dharmāṇām
na ca evaṃvidhavirodhākrāntānā teṣāmekādhikaraṇatvavirodha, tathāvidhānāmapyeṣāṃ tadadhikaraṇatayā pratīte mātuliṅge rūpādivat
dharmadharmiṇostadvirodhe dharmiṇi dharmāṇāṃ pratītireva na syāt, na caivam, abādhabodhādhirūḍhapratibhāsatvāt tatra teṣām
badhyaghātakarūpo'pi virodha phaṇinakulayoriva valavadabalavadabalavato pratīta sattvā'sattvayostulyabalatvāt nā''śaṅkanīya

astu vā kaścidvirodhaḥ; tathāpyasau sarvathā, kathañcidvā syāt ? na tāvat sarvathā; śītoṣṇasparśādīnāmapi sattvādisvarūpā'vyavacchedataḥ tadrūpatayā virodhā'siddheḥ, yat yatsvarūpā'vyavacchedaka na tat tadrūpatayā viruddham yathā ghaṭatvādinā ghaṭādi, sattvādisvarūpā'vyavacchedakāśca śītoṣṇasparśādaya iti
ekādhāratayā pratīyamānatvācca; yad ekādhāratayā pratīyate na tat sarvathā viruddham yathā rūparasādi ekatulāyāṃ nāmonnāmādi vā, ekādhāratayā pratīyate ca dhūpadahanādau śītoṣṇasparśādaya iti
kathañcidvirodhastu rūpādāvapi samānaḥ iti ekasya sadasadrūpatāvat rūpādisvabhāvatā'pi na syāt, na caitad yuktam pratītivirodhāt
kiñca, bhāvebhyo bhinno virodha, abhinno vā ? yadi abhinna; kathaṃ virodhako nāma svātmabhūtatvāt tatsvarūpavat ? atha bhinna; tathāpi na virodhakaḥ tata eva arthāntaravat

atha arthāntantarabhūto'pi virodho virodhaka bhāvānāṃ viśeṣaṇatvāt, na tu arthāntaram viparyayāt; tadapyayuktam, virodho hi tuccharūpo'bhāvaḥ, sa yadi śītoṣṇadravyayorviśeṣaṇam tarhi tayoḥ adarśanāpattiḥ
tadeva ca virodhi syāt yasyāsau viśeṣaṇaṃ nānyat, nacaikatra virodho nāma asya dviṣṭhatvāt anyathā sarvatra sarvadā tatprasaṅgaḥ

atha viruddhyamānatva-virodhakatvāpekṣayā kartṛ-karmastho'pi virodho virodhasāmānyāpekṣayā ubhayaviśeṣaṇatvāt dviṣṭho'bhidhīyate; nanvevaṃ rūpāderapi virodhakatvāpattiḥ tatsāmānyasyāpi dviṣṭhatvā'viśeṣāt, tathā ca virodhakalpanāvaiyarthyam

yadi ca ṣaṭpadārthavyatiriktatvāt padārthaviśeṣo virodhaḥ anekastho virodhya-virodhakapratyayaviśeṣaprasiddhaḥ samāśrīyate; tadāpyasya asambaddhasya dravyādau viśeṣaṇatvaṃ syāt, sambaddhasya vā ? na tāvad asambaddhasya; atiprasaṅgāt, daṇḍādau tathā'pratīteśca, na khalu puruṣeṇa asambaddho daṇḍaḥ tasya viśeṣaṇaṃ pratītaḥ yena atrāpi tathābhāvaḥ syāt
atha sambaddhaḥ; kiṃ saṃyogena, samavāyena, viśeṣaṇabhāvena vā ? na tāvat saṃyogena; asya adravyatvena saṃyogā'nāśrayatvāt
nāpi viśeṣaṇabhāvena; sambandhāntareṇā'sambaddhe vastuni tasyā'saṃbhavāt, anyathā daṇḍa-puruṣādau saṃyogādisambandhā'bhāve'pi sa syāt ityalaṃ saṃyogādisambandhakalpanāprayāsena
tato virodhasya vicāryamāṇasya anupapadyamānatvāt nā'sau sattvā'sattvayoryuktaḥ
nāpi vaiyadhikaraṇyam; ekādhāratayā nirbādhabodhe tayoḥ pratibhāsamānatvāt
na khalu sattvā'sattvayorbhedā'bhedayorvā anyonyanirapekṣayoḥ ekatvaṃ jinapatimatā'nusāribhiriṣṭam yena ayaṃ doṣaḥ syāt; tatsāpekṣayoreva tadabhyupagamāt, tathāpratīteśca
nāpi saṅkara-vyatikarau; svasvarūpeṇaiva arthe tayoḥ pratīyamānatvāt
nāpyanavasthā; dharmāṇāmaparadharmā'saṃbhavāt, dharmiṇo hyanantarūpatvaṃ na dharmāṇāṃ kathañcana
abhāvadoṣastu dūrotsārita eva; sadasadādyanekāntātmano'rthasya adhyakṣādipramāṇataḥ prasiddheḥ

saṃśayādyaṣṭadoṣāṇāṃ parihāro nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyaḥ–udayasthitisaṃhāralakṣaṇasya sataḥ pratibhāsādibhedābhedābhyāṃ bhedābhedaprasiddhiḥ ātmapratibandhena tathāpariṇāmāt; saṃśayavirodhavaiyadhikaraṇyobhayadoṣaprasaṅgānavasthāsaṅkarābhāvakalpanāmanyonyāvivekapratītiratiśete
na ca svabhāvabhedopalambhe'pi nānātvavirodhasaṅkarā'navasthānuṣaṅgaḥ cetasi grāhyagrāhakākāravat
yadapyuktam–mukto'pyamukta ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; yataḥ dvividho hi anekāntaḥ–akramā'nekānta, kramā'nekāntaśca
tatra jñānasukhādyanekā'kramidharmāpekṣayā akramā'nekānta, yugapadapi ekatrātmani saṃbhavāt
tathā ca ya eva ātmā pūrvamamukta sa eva uttarakālaṃ mukta iti na kiñcid viruddhyate anekāntakṣatirvā prasajyate
ekarūpatve ca ātmano bandha-mokṣā'bhāva, baddhasya hi muktatvam, na ca sarvathaikarūpasya avasthādvayayogo yuktaḥ virodhāt
tadevaṃ nityatvādyekāntalakṣaṇagocarasya pratyakṣagrāhyatvena ātmasamarpaṇā'bhāvāt na sākṣātkaraṇaṃ saṃbhavati
na kevalam ityādinā atraiva dūṣaṇāntaramatidiśannāha–na kevalaṃ sākṣātpharaṇam adhyakṣīkaraṇam ekānte nityatvaikānte anityatvaikānte ca na saṃbhavati, api tu–
saṃbhavati yata eva sākṣātkaraṇaṃ saṃbhavati na kevalaṃ bhā॰, śra॰

vivṛtiḥ–arthakriyāsamarthaṃ paramārthasat iti aṅgīkṛtya svapakṣe punaḥ arthakriyāṃ svayameva nirākurvan kathamanunmattaḥ ? svabhūtimātramarthakriyāṃ vipakṣe'pi kathannirasyeta, mithyāvyavahāraṃ vā ? saṃvitterabhede'pi viṣayākārasyaiva viṣayasādhanatvaṃ nākārāntarasya
arthasya jñānasya anyasya vā kriyā karaṇam na yujyeta na ghaṭeta
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yata eva arthasākṣātkaraṇaṃ tadekānte na saṃbhavati ata eva pratyakṣā'nupalambhasādhana kāryakāraṇabhāvo'pi na saṃbhavati

kiñca, arthakriyā kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vyāptā, na ca nityaikānte kṣaṇikaikānte vā krama-yaugapadye saṃbhavataḥ; tathāhi–pūrvamekaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtvā puna anyasya karaṇaṃ krama, tena nityasya na tāvat kāryakartṛtvaṃ yuktam
yena hi svabhāvena tat pūrvaṃ kārya karoti tenaiva yadi pāścātyam; tarhi dvayorapi kāryayoḥ ekakālatā syāt, tathā ca pāścātyamapi kārya pūrva kāryakālameva syāt pūrvakālakāryajananasvabhāvajanyatvāt
yad yat tathāvidhasvabhāvajanyam tat tat pūrvakāryakālam yathā tatkālābhimataṃ kāryam, pūrvakālakāryajananasvabhāvajanyañca nityaikarūpasya vastunaḥ pāścātyaṃ kāryamiti
atha yena svabhāvena uttaraṃ kāryaṃ tat karoti tenaiva pūrvam; tarhi pūrvamapi kārya pāścātyakāryakālameva syāt pāścātyakālakāryajananasvabhāvajanyatvāt pāścātyakālakāryavat
anyasya vā kriyā karaṇaṃ bhā॰, śra॰
yena hi svabhāvena ādyāmarthakriyā karoti tenaiva uttarāṇi kāryāṇi samāsāditasvabhāvāntara karoti
atha tajjananasvabhāvajanyatvā'viśeṣe'pi tattatsahakārikramāt tatra kāryakramo'bhyupagamyate; sahakārikṛtameva tarhi tat kāryaṃ syāt
nityasyāpi tatra sannidhānānna doṣo'yamiti cet; kim akiñcitkarasannidhānena ? anyathā ghaṭotpattau rāsabhasyāpi sannidhānāt tasya tatkṛtatvaprasaṅgaḥ
kiñcitkaratve vā kācapacyaprasaṅgaḥ, nityaṃ hi vastu kāryaṃ pūrvakālameva kartumicchati sahakāriṇastu uttarakālam iti

atha pūrvamanyena svabhāvena tat tajjanayati pāścātyañca anyena; nanu tatsvabhāvadvayaṃ tasya sadā saṃbhavati, kāryavadvā krami syāt ? prathamapakṣe sa eva doṣaḥ; pūrvakāryakāle pāścātyam tatkāle vā pūrvaṃ syāt iti

dvitīyapakṣe tu tataḥ svabhāvadvayam abhinnam, bhinnaṃ vā ? abhede'pi ki nityād vastunaḥ svabhāvadvayam abhinnam, tato vā nitya vastu ? ādyavikalpe tasya nityatvaprasaktiḥ nityādabhinnasvabhāvatvāt, yat nityādabhinnasvabhāvaṃ tat nityaṃ dṛṣṭam yathā nityasvātmā, nityādabhinnasvabhāvañca svabhāvadvayamiti

dvitīyavikalpe tu nityasya anityatvaprasaktiḥ anityādabhinnasvarūpatvāt, yadanityādabhinnasvarūpam tadanityaṃ pratipannam yathā anityasvātmā, anityāt svabhāvadvayād abhinnasvarūpañca nityatvābhimataṃ vastu iti
atha svabhāvadvayaṃ tato bhinnamiṣyate tenāyamadoṣaḥ; kathamevaṃ tasya idaṃ svabhāvadvayam iti vyapadeśaḥ sambandhā'saṃbhavāt, samavāyādeśca pratiṣiddhatvāt ? tanna krameṇa nityasya kāryatvaṃ ghaṭate
na bhavanti sthirā bhāvā ni sattvāste tato matāḥ
na tāvat sthirasya bhāvasya krameṇārthakriyā yukteti darśayati–kāryāṇi hi vilambante kāraṇāsannidhānataḥ
athāpi ityādinā parasyottaramāśaṅkate–athāpi santi nityasya kramiṇa sahakāriṇa
sādhvityādinā pratividhatte–sādhvetat kintu te tasya bhavanti sahakāriṇaḥ
yogyarūpasya hetutve sa bhāvaḥ tai kṛto bhavet
sa cāśakyakriyo yasmāt tatsvarūpaṃ sadā sthitam
nāpi yaugapadyena; ekasminneva kṣaṇe sakalakāryotpattiprasaṅgato dvitīyādikṣaṇe tasya ana rthakriyākāritvena ākāśakuśeśayavad asattvaprasakteḥ
yat kramā'kramābhyāmarthakriyākāri na bhavati na tad vastu yathā gaganendīvaram, na bhavati ca kramā'kramābhyāmarthakriyākāri sarvathā nityam ātmaparamāṇvādikam, tasmānna vastu iti
nāpi yaugapadyena iti darśayati– yaugapadyaṃ ca naiveṣṭaṃ tatkāryāṇāṃ kṣayekṣaṇāt
kiñca, asya sarvadā tatkāritvasvabhāvatā, kadācidvā ? prathamapakṣe sarvadaiva ataḥ sakalakāryāṇāmutpatti syāt sadaiva teṣāmavikalakāraṇatvāt
yad yadā avikalakāraṇaṃ tat tadā utpattimat prasiddham yathā samānasamayotpādā bahavo'ṅkurāḥ, avikalakāraṇāni ca sarvadā kāryakāritvasvabhāvanityārthakāryatayā abhimatāni akhilakāryāṇi iti
atha kadācit, tarhi pūrva kāryotpādanā'samarthasvabhāvaṃ sat tat paścāt samarthasvabhāvaṃ bhavati ityāyātam
tatrāpi tadutpattisamaye tad asamarthasvabhāva tyajati, na vā ? yadi na tyajati; tarhi sarvadā kāryā'nutpādakatvaprasaṅga

yat khalu yadutpādane aparityakta-asamarthasvabhāvam na tatastadutpatti yathā yavabījāt śālyaṅkurasya, kāryotpādane aparityakta-asamarthasvabhāvañca pūrvamiva tadutpattisamaye'pi nityābhimataṃ vastu iti
tatsaṃbhave vā asya nityaikarūpatāvyāghātaḥ, yat parityaktapūrvasvabhāvaṃ na tad ekarūpam yathā aṅgulyādi, parityaktapūrvā'samarthasvabhāvañca nityaikarūpatayā abhimataṃ vastu iti

ata kathaṃ tasya nityaikarūpatā ? pariṇāmitvasyaiva upapatte asamarthasvabhāvaparityāgena samarthasvabhāvasvīkārasya tadantareṇa anupapatte, na khalu nityaikarūpe vastuni pūrvāpararūpatyāgopādāne ghaṭete
yatra pūrvāpararūpatyāgopādāne sta tat pariṇāmi yathā kuṇḍaletarāvasthākroḍīkṛtaṃ sarpādi, asāmarthyetaralakṣaṇapūrvā'pararūpatyāgopādāne staśca nityatayā'bhimate vastuni iti

nityaikarūpo'pyartha sahakārisahitaḥ kārya karoti na sarvadā ityabhidadhatā'pi pariṇāmitvameva samarthitam, asāhityarūpatyāgena sāhityarūpopādānāt, iti krameṇa yugapadvā anekadharmātmakasyaiva arthasya arthakriyākāritvaṃ pratipattavyam

yugapadaśeṣāṇi kāryāṇi kṛtvā sa kiṃ tasyārthakriyāsamartha svabhāvo nivarttate ahosvidanuvarttate ? tatra yadi nivarttate iti pakṣa tadā tasya kṣaṇabhaṅgitvaṃ siddhamtadrūpasyānuvṛttau tu kāryamutpādayet puna
pratyekañca ātmādinityadravyāṇāṃ prakṛteśca apariṇāmitve evam arthakriyākāritvābhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ
yathā ca eṣāṃ tathābhūtānāṃ tatkāritvaṃ na ghaṭate tathā ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ prakṛtiparīkṣāyāñca vistarata pratipāditam
prāgeva kārakābhāva kva pramāṇa kva tatphalam

yat yat tathāvidham tat tat kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāri na bhavati yathā kharaviṣāṇam, ekakṣaṇasthāyitayā niraṃśatayā ca pūrvāparasvabhāvatyāgopādānavikalaṃ sakṛdanekaśaktirahitañca paraparikalpitam ekāntakṣaṇikaṃ vastu iti
pratiṣiddhañca santānapratiṣedhā'vasare sarvathā kṣaṇikasya arthakriyākāritvam, pratiṣetsyate cāgre
kiñca, pramāṇaniṣṭhā prameyavyavasthā bhavati, na ca kṣaṇikatve kiñcit pramāṇamasti
sattvādihetubhya sarve bhāvā kṣaṇikā tatraiva ca arthakriyā saṃbhavati na nitye iti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu idamasti–yat sat tat sarvaṃ kṣaṇikam yathā ghaṭaḥ, santaśca bhāvāḥ iti

sattvaṃ hi arthakriyākāritvamiti, arthakriyā ca kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vyāptā, sā ca akṣaṇike na saṃbhavati tadvyāpakayoḥ kramayaugapadyayoḥ asaṃbhavāt, tadasaṃbhavaśca asya sarvadā ekarūpatvāt, ataḥ arthakriyā'pi anena sadaiva karttavyā na vā kadācid aviśeṣāt

krameṇa asya arthakriyākāritvasaṃbhave vā ki yena rūpeṇa ekaṃ kāryaṃ karoti tenaiva aparam, rūpāntareṇa vā ? tenaiva cet; tarhi dvitīyakṣaṇasādhyakāryasya prathamakṣaṇa eva utpādaprasaṅgaḥ tadutpādakasvarūpasya prāgapi bhāvāt
rūpāntareṇa cet; tarhi pūrvarūpasya nivṛttatvāt kṣaṇikatvam

atha tattatkramavatsahakārisannidhimapekṣya nityaṃ tattatkāryaṃ karoti; nanu te sahakāriṇaḥ tasya upakāraṃ kurvanti, na vā ? kurvanti cet; ki tato vyatiriktam, avyatiriktaṃ vā ? yadi avyatiriktam; tadā tadeva kurvanti ityāyātam, tasya ca pūrvameva niṣpannatvānna kiñcit sahakāribhiḥ kriyeta
atha vyatiriktam; tadā tasya iti vyapadeśā'bhāvaḥ asambandhāt, sambandhāntarakalpane ca anavasthā
nāpi yugapat; ekadaiva akhilakāryotpādakasvabhāvatayā prathamakṣaṇa eva akhilakāryotpādanāt kṣaṇāntare tadutpādyakāryā'bhāvataḥ anarthakriyākāritvena aśvaviṣāṇavat asattvaprasaṅgāt

kiñca, utpāditā'śeṣakāryagrāmasya, kimasya asau svabhāvo nivarttate, na vā ? yadi na nivarttate; tadā prathamakṣaṇavat dvitīyādikṣaṇe'pi tatsvabhāvā'nivṛtteḥ samastasya utpāditasyāpi utpādanaprasaṅgāt piṣṭapeṣaṇā'nuṣaṅgaḥ

nivarttate cet; tarhi tannivṛttau tasyāpi nivṛttiḥ tasya tato'bhinnatvāt, ataḥ kathamasyā'kṣaṇikatvam ? tasya tato bhede vā tasya iti vyapadeśā'nupapatti sambandhā'bhāvāt, tadbhāve vā anavasthā tasyāpi aparasambandhaparikalpanaprasaṅgāt
kiñca, kāryotpādanasamaye teṣāṃ prāktanā''kārasvabhāvatyāgaḥ asti, na vā ? nāsti cet; pūrvavat tadāpi ataḥ kāryā'nutpādaprasaṅgaḥ
asti cet; kṣaṇikatvam, pratikṣaṇaṃ pūrvasvabhāva vināśena uttarotpādena ca anyatvāt
prayoga–ye akṛtvā kurvanti kārya te pratikṣaṇaṃ naikarūpā yathā bījādaya, akṛtvā kurvanti ca nityatvenā'bhimatāḥ padārthāḥ kāryāṇi iti
tathā ca eṣāṃ kṛtakatvaprasiddhe tato'pi kṣaṇikatvaṃ siddham; tathāhi–yat kṛtakaṃ tat kṣaṇikam yathā vidyut-pradīpādi, kṛtakāśca vivādāpannāḥ padārthā iti
svahetuto hi bhāvāḥ samutpadyamānā vināśasvabhāvaniyatā eva utpadyante ata śiśapātva-vṛkṣatvayoriva kṛtakatva-anityatvayoḥ tādātmyasiddhiḥ
na ca hetusāmarthyaprabhavatvā'viśeṣe'pi kecit nityāḥ kecid anityā bhāvā bhaviṣyanti iti nā'nayo tādātmyasiddhi ityabhidhātavyam; kāraṇasāmarthyā'bhedāt pāvakādivat

na khalu pāvakotpādakakāraṇakalāpaḥ kaścit prakāśoṣṇasparśasahitaṃ pāvakamutpādayati kaścit tadviparītam iti tatsāmarthyabheda pratītigocaraḥ, yena atrāpi nitya-anityasvabhāvabhāvotpādakatvena kāraṇānāṃ sāmarthyabheda kalpyeta
ato bhāvaṃ bhāvāḥ prādurbhāvayanto vināśasvabhāvameva āvirbhāvayanti, iti siddhaṃ kṛtakatva-anityatvayostādātmyam
tatra ye kṛtakā bhāvāste sarve kṣaṇabhaṅgina

tadevaṃ vināśaṃ prati anyāpekṣāmasāmarthyavaiyarthyābhyā taddhetvayogena kṛtakatvalakṣaṇasya sattvasya pūrvācāryapradarśitā pratipādya yathāsau viparyaye bādhakapramāṇamanubhavati taddarśayannāha–tasmād vināśa

nanu vinaśvarasvabhāvatve'pi arthānāṃ naikakṣaṇasthāyitvena vināśaḥ, yadaiva hi taddhetūpanipātaḥ tadaiva asau bhaviṣyati; ityapyayuktam; naśvarasyāpi pratikṣaṇam anāśe kālāntare'pyaviśeṣato nāśānupapatte, na hi prakāśasya pratikṣaṇam aprakāśatā tasyāṃ vā punaḥ kālāntare prakāśatā dṛṣṭā
ante ca arthānāṃ nāśopalambhāt nāśitve prakāśasya prakāśatvavat siddhaḥ svarūpamātrā'nurodhī vināśa avilambena ādāvapi aviśeṣāt
atha mṛtyorapakrānta tasya cet prathama kṣaṇa

kiñca, śata-sahasrakṣaṇasthitisvabhāvo bhāvaḥ prathamakṣaṇe jātaḥ dvitīyādikṣaṇe tathaiva āste, na vā ? yadi āste; tadā antyakṣaṇe'pi asya tathaiva astitvaprasaṅgānna kadācit nāśotpattiḥ syāt, tatra tatsvabhāvatyāge vā siddhaṃ kṣaṇikatvam pratikṣaṇaṃ svabhāvabhedalakṣaṇatvāt tasya
kiñca, akṣaṇikatvaṃ nāma arthasya anekakṣaṇasthāyinī sattā, anekakṣaṇayogitvañca asya anekakālakṣaṇā'pratipattau duravabodham

na ca vartamānārthendriyasambandhasāmarthyaprabhavaṃ pratyakṣaṃ varttamānakālasambandhitāvyatirekeṇa arthasya anekakālakṣaṇavyāpitvaṃ pratipattuṃ samartham, yadi hi anekakālakṣaṇaiḥ sakṛdeva arthasya sambandhaḥ syāt tadā tatsāmarthyaprabhavamapi pratyakṣaṃ tasya tadvyāpitvaṃ pratipadyeta, na cā'sau sakṛt saṃbhavati pūrvā'parakālakṣaṇānāṃ kramabhāvitvāt

yadapyuktam–vināśahetūpanipāte sa bhaviṣyati iti; tatra vināśahetuḥ vinaśvaraṃ bhāvaṃ vināśayati, avinaśvaraṃ vā ? tatra anaśvarasya vināśahetuśatopanipāte'pi nāśā'nupapattiḥ, na hi svabhāvo bhāvānāmanyathā kartuṃ pāryate
naśvarasya ca nāśe taddhetūnāṃ vaiyarthyam, na hi svakāraṇādeva avāptasvabhāvasyārthasya tadartha arthāntaravyāpāraḥ phalavān tadanuparatiprasaṅgāt

itaśca nāśahetūnāmakiñcitkaratvaṃ vaktavyam; tathāhi–bhāvaḥ svahetorutpadyamānaḥ kadācit prakṛtyā svayaṃ naśvarātmaiva utpadyate, anaśvarātmā vā ? yadi naśvaraḥ; na tasya kiñcinnāśahetunāathānaśvarātmeti pakṣa; tadāpi nāśaheturakiñcitkara eva, tasya kenacit svabhāvānyathābhāvasya karttumaśakyatvāt

kiñca, bhāvāt bhinno nāśaḥ nāśahetutaḥ syāt, abhinno vā ? yadyabhinnaḥ; tadā bhāva eva taddhetubhiḥ kṛtaḥ syāt, tasya ca svahetoreva utpatteḥ kṛtasya ca karaṇā'yogāt tadeva taddhetuvaiyarthyaṃ kāraṇabhedā'nupapattiśca

atha bhinnaḥ; tadā'sau bhāvasamakālabhāvī, prākkālabhāvī, taduttarakālabhāvī vā syāt ? tatra sahabhāvitve yugapad bhāvā'bhāvayorupalambhaḥ syād avirodhāt, virodhe vā abhāvena kroḍīkṛtatvād bhāvasyopalambhaḥ svārthakriyākāritvañca na syāt
prākkālabhāvitve bhāvasyaiva abhāvāt kasyāsau syāt ? sato hi vināśaḥ, alabdhasattākasya ca vināśaḥ iti mahaccitram
nirhetukatve vastūtpattyanantaramātmānamāsādayati tadayuktam; atra pañca pakṣā bhavanti–vastūtpatteḥ pūrvam, saha vā, anantaraṃ vā, kālāntare vā bhavanam, na vā bhavanam
taduttarakālabhāvitve ghaṭādeḥ kimāyātaṃ yenā'sau svopalambhādilakṣaṇāmarthakriyāṃ na kuryāt ? nahi tantvādibhyaḥ samutpanne paṭe ghaṭaḥ tāṃ kurvan kenacit pratiṣeddhuṃ śakyaḥ
nanu paṭasya avirodhitvānna tadutpattau ghaṭasya svārthakriyākāritvābhāvaḥ, abhāvasya tu tadviparyayāt sa syāt
atha kimidaṃ virodhitvaṃ nāma–nāśakatvam, nāśarūpatvaṃ vā ? nāśakatvaṃ cet; tarhi mudgarādivat nāśotpādadvāreṇa anena ghaṭādirunmūlayitavyaḥ, nāśāntare'pi ca ayameva paryanuyogaḥ ityanavasthā
nāśarūpatvaṃ cet; nanu kathamarthāntarabhūto'yaṃ tasya nāśaḥ, anyathā paṭo ghaṭasya nāśaḥ syāt ? virodhitvāccet; cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ
arthāntaratvā'viśeṣācca kathaṃ ghaṭasyaiva asau syāt, aviśeṣāt anyasyāpi kasmānnocyeta ? na ca yena sambandhaḥ tasyāsau ityabhidhātavyam, bhedā'viśeṣataḥ sambandhasyāpi sarvatra prasaṅgāt

atha mudgarādinā ghaṭādeḥ prāktanarūpavilakṣaṇaṃ rūpāntaraṃ bhaṅguratvākhyaṃ vidhīyate tenāsau tasya ityucyate; tat ki svātmani tenaiva rūpeṇa avasthitasya asya vidhīyate, vinaṣṭasya vā ? tatra tenaiva rūpeṇa avasthitasya virodhānna rūpāntaraṃ yuktam; nahi avasthitāyāṃ nīlarūpatāyāṃ pītarūpatā kartu śakyā
vinaṣṭasya ca asattvāt kathaṃ rūpāntarotpatti śaśaviṣāṇavat ? cakrakaprasaṅgaśca; ghaṭādervinaṣṭatve sati rūpāntarotpattiḥ, satyāṃ tasyāṃ vināśasambandha, sati tasmin vinaṣṭatvam iti
na ca prasajyapratiṣedhātmano bhāvasya kāryatvadharmādhāratā; vasturūpatāpatteḥ

vastuno hi kāraṇasāmagrīto bhāvaḥ arthakriyākāritvañca svarūpam, abhāvo'pi cet tata utpadyeta paronmūlanalakṣaṇāñca arthakriyāṃ kuryāt tadā ko'sya bhāvād viśeṣaḥ syāt ? tuccharūpasya ca abhāvasya abhāvanirākaraṇaprakaraṇe viśeṣato nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt alamiha atiprasaṅgena

paryudāsapratiṣedhe tu ghaṭāderanyaḥ kapālādiścet tadabhāvaḥ; tasya sahetukatvaṃ kena pratiṣiddham ? mudgarādīnāṃ visadṛśasantānotpattau vyāpārasya asmābhirabhyupagamāt, ghaṭādayastu svotpattikṣaṇānantaramasthānaśīlāḥ svakāraṇādeva saṃjātā na kālāntaramanuvarttante
atha kriyāniṣedho'yaṃ bhāva naiva karoti hi
tathāhi–prasajyapratiṣedhe sati naña karotinā sambandhād abhāva karoti bhāva na karoti iti kriyāpratiṣedhād akarttṛtva nāśaheto pratipāditam
vivakṣāvaśāddhi kutaścana bhāvādvilakṣaṇo bhāva eva abhāva ityākhyāyate, tatra ca vyatirekādivikalpe prāktano doṣa punarāvarttate

tataḥ siddham–yo yadbhāvaṃ prati anyā'napekṣaḥ sa tatsvabhāvaniyataḥ yathā antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryotpādanaṃ prati, vināśaṃ prati anyā'napekṣāśca sarve bhāvāḥ ityato'pyanumānāt udayānantaramasthāyitvaṃ bhāvānām
tathā, yad yathā'vabhāsate tata tathaiva sat ityabhyupagantavyam yathā nīlakuvalayaṃ nīlatayā'vabhāsamānaṃ tenaiva rūpeṇa sat, kṣaṇaparigatenaiva rūpeṇa avabhāsante ca sarve bhāvā ityanumānato'pi
varttamānatāgrahaṇaṃ hi kṣaṇikatāgrahaṇamucyate, tacca asti pratyakṣe, nahi pūrvā'parakālaparigatenātmanā bhāvāḥ pratyakṣādinā gṛhītuṃ śakyante ityuktaṃ prāk iti
uktarītyā bahirantaśca kṣaṇikatvamupavarṇayataḥ sautrāntikasya vistarataḥ pratividhānam–
yattāvaduktam–yat sat ityādi, tatra kimidaṃ sattvaṃ nāma–sattāsambandhaḥ, pramāṇaviṣayatvam, arthakriyākāritvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe bhāgā'siddhatvam, sattāsambandhasya sāmānyādiṣvasaṃbhavāt
pramāṇaviṣayatvamapi pratipadārthaṃ bhidyate, na vā ? yadi bhidyate; tadā arthasvarūpavad vibhinnasvarūpatvāt naikapratyayaviṣayam, ataḥ ananvayāt na hetutvaṃ syāt
atha na bhidyate; tadā pratīyate, na vā ? yadi na pratīyate; kathamasti ? pratīyate cet; tarhi nāmāntareṇa sattaiva uktā syāt, tatsambandhe ca uktadoṣā'nuṣaṅgaḥ
svataḥ sattve arthānāmapi svata eva tadastu kiṃ tataḥ tatkalpanayā ? viruddhañcedam– pramāṇaviṣayatvalakṣaṇaṃ hi sattvamakṣaṇikasamastavastuviṣayaṃ prasiddham tacca akṣaṇikatvameva prasādhayati iti
tatra asiddhatvaṃ tāvat–arthakriyākāritvaṃ hi arthakriyāhetutvamucyate, tacca asatyāmarthakriyāyāṃ duravabodham
nahi bhāvānāṃ nānāvidhaśaktiyuktānāṃ darśanamātrādeva tattatkāryakaraṇaśaktiyuktatvaṃ gṛhītuṃ śakyam
yogyatā-kṣaṇikatve gṛhīte'pi vastusadbhāve na śakyete niścetum iti bhavadbhireva abhyupagamāt

nanu saṃbhāvanāmātreṇa atrārthakriyākāritvamavagamyate, saṃbhāvyate hi etat kariṣyati ayamarthakriyām iti; nanu saṃbhāvanā'pyatra kenāvaṣṭambhena pravarttate ? tatsajātīyasya arthakriyāyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāmiti cet; tatrāpi tulyaḥ paryyanuyogaḥ, tatrāpi tatsajātīye'rthakriyādarśanāt tatkāritvā'vagame'navasthā
bhavaddarśane ca arthānāmatyantabhedāt sajātīyatvavārttā'pi durlabhā ityuktaṃ sāmānyaparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake
nahi kṣaṇiko'rthaḥ krameṇa arthakriyāṃ karttuṃ kṣamaḥ deśakālasvabhāvakṛtakramā'saṃbhavāt

eka eva hi padārthaḥ kiñcit kāryaṃ vidhāya punarapekṣitasahakārisannidherupāttasāmarthyāntaro deśakālabhedena kāryāntaraṃ kurvāṇaḥ krameṇa karoti iti yuktam, kṣaṇamātrasthāyitve cārthasya evaṃvidhaṃ kramakāritvamayuktam
niraṃśatvena yugapadanekaśaktyātmakatvābhāvataḥ tasya anekakāryāṇāṃ yugapatkaraṇamapi atidurlabham, etacca santānabhaṅgāvasare prapañcataḥ prapañcitam
tataḥ arthakriyāvyāpakayoḥ krama-yau gapadyayoḥ kṣaṇike virodhāt yat kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāri tad akṣaṇikameva iti siddhamasya viruddhatvam
kṣaṇikeṣvapi ityādinā bhadantayogasenamatamāśaṅkate– kṣaṇikeṣvapi bhāveṣu nanu cārthaṃkriyā katham
sa hi āha–kṣaṇikatve'pi bhāvānā kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyāvirodha eva
yataste svayaṃ samarthā bhaveyurasamarthā vā ? tattvasa॰
yadapyuktam–sahakāriṇaḥ tasya upakāraṃ kurvanti na vā ityādi; tadasat; upakārakāṇāmeva sahakāritvā'bhyupagamāt, anyonyasannidhāne teṣāmatiśayotpatteḥ
na ca bhede tasyaiva janakatvāt tadvato'janakatvam; atyantabhedā'prasiddheḥ
dharmadharmitayā hi tayorbheda, aśakyavivecanatvena ca abhedaḥ, buddhi-tadākāravat
na ca yo yadarthameva kalpitaḥ sa tasyaiva bādhaka, buddhe arthagrāhakatvā'bhāvaprasaṅgāt ākārasyaiva arthagrāhakatvā'nuṣaṅgāt

nanu pratyekaṃ teṣāṃ sāmarthye kimanyāpekṣayā ? ityapyanupapannam; yāvatāṃ sadbhāve kāryamupalabhyate abhāve ca nopalabhyate tāvatāṃ tatra kāraṇatvā'vadhāraṇāt, kāraṇasāmarthyā'sāmarthyayoḥ kāryabhāvā'bhāvā'vaseyatvāt
kathañca itthaṃ kṣaṇikasya arthakriyākāritvaṃ ghaṭate ? sa hi sahakārisāpekṣaḥ, nirapekṣo vā tatra samarthaḥ ? yadi nirapekṣaḥ; tarhi kuśūlastho'pi bījakṣaṇaḥ aṅkuraṃ janayet
atha pūrvapūrvakṣityādikṣaṇaparamparayā āhitātiśayaḥ antya eva bījakṣaṇa tajjanakaḥ; tarhi siddhaṃ sāpekṣasyā'sya janakatvam, tadvat nityasyāpyastu aviśeṣāt

atha svotpattau eva asau sahakāriṇo'pekṣate na kārye; tanna; svotpatterapi anyeṣāṃ kāryatvāt, tatastairapi anapekṣaiḥ svakārye bhavi tavyam, evamanyairapi iti kuśūlasthasyāpi bījasya aṅkurajanakatvaprasaṅgaḥ
bhūtikṣaṇe eva ca akhilasya nirapekṣatayā utpādaprasaṅgāt sakalasantānocchedaḥ syāt

kāraṇe vinaṣṭe kāryasyotpādāt na taducchedaḥ iti cet; nanvevaṃ kathaṃ tat tasya kāraṇaṃ syāt, yatsadbhāve yannotpadyate abhāve tu utpadyate tasya tatkāraṇatvā'yogāt ? tataḥ tattatsahakārisannidhāne kāraṇaṃ tattatkāryaṃ karoti iti prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam
atrocyate–na sattvaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhau aṅgam asādhāraṇatvāt sandigdhavyatirekitvādvā
tathāhi–kramākamābhyā vyāpta sattvaṃ tadanupalambhena akṣaṇikād vyāvarttate evaṃ tadeva sāpekṣatvānapekṣatvābhyā vyāptaṃ tadanupalambhena kṣaṇikādapi vyāvarttate
antakṣaṇaprāptāni kṣitipavanapāthastejovījāniparasparānapekṣāṇi vā janayeyu sāpekṣāṇi vā ?nyāyavā॰ tā॰ ṭī॰ 3
kṣaṇikasyāpi bhāvasya sattvaṃ nāstyeva so'pi hi
nanvapekṣate eva kintu svotpāde na puna svakārye
tatra tasya anapekṣatvamupeyate na tu svotpāde

nanu svotpattāvapi asya jāgartti svasantānavartī pūrva eva nirapekṣaḥ kṣaṇa evaṃ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ svasantānapatita eva anapekṣo jāgarttyupajanana iti kuśūlanihitavīja eva syāt kṛtī kṛṣīvala kṛtamasya kṛṣikarmaṇā
yacca–dvitīyādikṣaṇasādhyakāryasya prathamakṣaṇe eva utpādaḥ syāt ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; sāmagrībhedāt, nahi dvitīyakṣaṇādisāmagrī prathamakṣaṇasāmagrī bhavati
ekasvabhāvena ca kāryakāritvamasiddham, kāraṇasvabhāvabhedamantareṇa kāryāṇāṃ bhedā'sambhavāt
na caivaṃ pratisvabhāvaṃ tadvato bhedaprasaṅgāt kṣaṇikatvaṃ syādityabhidhātavyam; anusyūtasya ekasya anekasvabhāvātmakatve virodhā'saṃbhavāt

na ca viruddhadharmādhyāsa eva ekasya anekasvabhāvātmakatvaṃ viruṇaddhi; yato virodhaḥ anupalambhasādhyaḥ, na ca ekasmin anekātmakatvā'nupalambho'sti citrajñānasya ekasyāpi anekātmakatvopalambhāt, sahakārītarabhāvena ca ekasyāpi rūpādikṣaṇasya anekasvabhāvatvavibhāvanāt
nahi rūpaṃ yenaiva svabhāvena rūpakṣaṇaṃ janayati tenaiva rasakṣaṇam, tasyā'pi rūpatvaprasaṅgāt rūpasya vā rasatvā'nuṣaṅgāt
apekṣyamāṇabhedādatra tadavirodhe akṣaṇikasyāpi ata eva so'stu
api ca yena rūpeṇa rūpasya rūpaṃ pratyupādānakāraṇatā tenaiva yadi rasaṃ prati sahakārikāraṇatā tadā punarapi rūparasayoraviśeṣaḥ
atha anyena rūpeṇa rūpopādānatā anyena ca rasasahakāriteti tarhi svabhāvabhedānnānātvam
yugapacca ekasya anekasvabhāvātmakatvā'virodhe krameṇā'pi tadavirodho'stu avicchinnapratīteraviśeṣāt
tathā cāyaṃ hetuḥ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ kṣaṇikapakṣasya pratyakṣabādhitatvāt aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti pakṣavat

na ca anenā'pi kṣaṇa eva anubhūyate, pūrvā'parakṣaṇavivekā'bhāvataḥ tatra akṣaṇikatvapratītiḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tasya anubhavavicchedā'nupalakṣaṇāt, anekakṣaṇasthāyī hi tasya arthādhyavasāyo'vicchinnarūpo'nubhūyate
na khalu jñānena ekakṣaṇasthāyinaiva bhavitavyam iti niyamo'sti, sa hi tathāpratīternānyato bhavitumarhati, sā ca anekakṣaṇasthāyitve'pi samānā
na ca bhinnakālasambandhitayā tatra tāvaddhā bhedasaṃbhavāt sthāyitvā'nupapattiḥ ityabhidhātavyam; ekānubhavasambandhino yāvadanubhavānuvṛtteḥ kālasya ekatvāt
tathā pratyabhijñānenā'pi kṣaṇikapakṣabādhā sphuṭataraiva anubhūyate; sa evā'yam ityākāreṇa pravarttamānasyā'sya atītavarttamānakālaparigatatvena arthā'vabhāsakatvāt

nanu ca atītadeśakālayoratīndriyatvena indriyasambandhā'bhāvāt kathaṃ tadviśiṣṭatvam ato'rthasya pratīyeta ? ityapyayuktam, pratyabhijñānasya indriyajatvā'saṃbhavāt smṛtipratyakṣaprabhavatvāttasya, ataḥ atītagrahaṇasamarthasya atra smaraṇasya vidyamānatvāt yuktameva atītaviṣayatayā saḥ iti grahaṇam, varttamānagrahaṇasamarthakasya pratyakṣasya sadbhāvācca ayam iti varttamānatayā, ataḥ atītatve'pi deśakālayoḥ tatsambandhino devadattasya idānīntanadeśakālasambandhitayā grahaṇamaviruddham
prācīnasāmpratikakālaviśiṣṭatayā bhedo'pi na sarvathā devadattasvarūpabhedakaḥ; ya eva mayā pūrvaṃ pratipanno devadattaḥ sa eva idānī pratīyate iti tatsvarūpaikatvapratīteḥ
api ca pratyabhijñāsarvato jājvalīti kastasyāṃ satyāṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgino bhāvānabhidadhyāt
sarvaṃ cedaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanaṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭaṃ pratyabhijñāpratyakṣeṇa pratītasya punaḥ pratīteḥ

kiñca, abhijñākṣaṇāt pratyabhijñākṣaṇaṃ yāvat arthasyāsthāyitve pratyabhijñānasyāpravṛttireva syāt, nahi nīlābhāve nīlajñānasya pravṛttirasti, pravarttate cedam, ataḥ arthānāṃ sthāyitvasiddhiḥ, anyathā nīlajñānāt nīlāderapi siddhirna syāt, prāmāṇyañcāsya agre prasādhayiṣyate
yadi ca kālavyāpitvaṃ deśavyāpitvañca arthasya na pratīyate kimetāvatā tasyābhāvaḥ ? sarvadarśino hi darśananivṛttiḥ bhāvā'bhāvaṃ prasādhayati na arvāgdṛśa atiprasaṅgāt
artho hi svātmanā bhavan na jñānena anyathākarttuṃ pāryate, nahi jñānānāmarthānyathātvakaraṇe tathātvakaraṇe vā sāmarthyam, tatsvarūpaprakāśanamātre teṣāṃ vyāpārāt

niyatasāmagrītaḥ samutpadyamānāni hi jñānāni yadi arthaṃ sarvātmanā paricchettumasamarthāni tadā teṣāmeva ayamaparādhaḥ nā'rthasya, na khalu pradīpo rasaṃ na prakāśayati iti rasasya aparādhaḥ abhāvo vā
yadi ca arthakriyātaḥ arthānāṃ sattvaṃ syāt tadā arthakriyāyāḥ kathaṃ sattvaṃ syāt–arthakriyāntarāt, svato vā ? arthakriyāntarāccet; anavasthā
svataścet; arthānāmapi svata eva tadastu ki tatastatkalpanayā ? kiñca, arthakriyākāritvameva sattvam, arthakriyākāritvena vā ? prathamapakṣe bhedā'bhāvāt yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasat
iti sattvaarthakriyākāritvayoḥ lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo na syāt, bhede satyeva asya saṃbhavāt
atha arthakriyākāritvena sattvam yo hi tāṃ karoti tasya sattvam iti; tarhi anyad arthakriyākāritvam, anyat sattvam ityāyātam, tathā ca sattvaṃ hi arthakriyākāritvam ityuktaṃ viruddhyate
sattve yo hi tāḥka– ba॰, ja॰

mābhūd dṛṣṭāntaḥ kiṃ tena sādhyam, hetorvipakṣe bādhakapramāṇād gamakatvopapatteḥ ? nanu bādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ kiṃ vipakṣā'bhāvamavabodhayati, hetostato vyatirekam, pratibandhaṃ vā prasādhayati ? prathamapakṣe asantaḥ akṣaṇikāḥ padārthāḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvarahitatvāt khapuṣpavat ityatra bādhakā'numāne hetoḥ āśrayāsiddhatvam
vikalpārūḍhasya āśrayatve na kaściddhetuḥ āśrayā'siddhaḥ syāt sarvatra tathā tatsiddhisaṃbhavāt
nāpi vipakṣād vyatirekastena prasādhayituṃ śakyaḥ; apratipanne dharmiṇi tadāśrayavyatirekasya gṛhītumaśakyatvāt
yadi ca vyatirekaḥ kadācit kutaścit pramāṇāt pratipannaḥ syāt, tadā tadavinābhāviliṅgadarśanāt asau prasādhayituṃ yuktaḥ agnidhūmavat, na ca tatpratipattiḥ kutaścidasti
sā hi pratyakṣataḥ, anumānato vā syāt ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ; vyatirekasya vyāvṛttirūpatayā avastutvena tadahetutvataḥ tadagocaratvāt
tadgocaratve vā taddhetutvena vastutvāpattau arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇasattvasya tatra akṣaṇike'pi gatatvāt anaikāntikatvam
na khalu vyāvṛtteḥ bhavatā'pi kṣaṇikatvam iṣṭam, svalakṣaṇasyaiva tatpratijñānāt
sattva-kṣaṇikatvayoḥ pratibandho'pi vyatirekagrahaṇapūrvaka eva, na ca agṛhīte'pi vipakṣe tadvyatireko gṛhītuṃ śakyate atiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, kṣaṇikatvasya anumānagamyatve vastutvaṃ na syāt; anumānasya vyāvṛttiviṣayatvāt, tasyāśca avastutvāt

kiñca, idaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ nīlādanyatra arthāntare varttate, na vā ? yadi na varttate; kathaṃ tasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ ? varttate cet; tadvat nīlamanuvarttate, na vā ? nā'nuvarttate cet; kathaṃ nīlādasyā'bhedaḥ ? anuvarttate cet; tarhi tadapi nīlameva syāt iti vastuvyavasthāvilopaḥ
na ca vṛkṣaśiśapādāvapi ayaṃ doṣaḥ tulyaḥ; sāṃśavastuvādinaḥ kenacid rūpeṇa śiśapādito vṛkṣādeḥ anuvṛttervyāvṛtteśca upapadyamānatvāt

kiñca, kṣaṇa-lava-muhūrttādayaḥ kālaviśeṣāḥ, na ca bauddhaiḥ kālo'bhyupagamyate iti viśeṣaṇasya asiddhatvāt kathaṃ kṣaṇo'syāsti iti kṣaṇikaḥ arthaḥ syāt ? parikalpitena ca kṣaṇena kṣaṇikatvaṃ na vāstavaṃ syāt, kṣaṇikatvasya ca avāstavatve akṣaṇikatvameva vāstavaṃ syāt prakārāntarā'saṃbhavāt
saṃjñāmātreṇa kālasyābhyupagamāt, na ca sajñāmātraṃ vastu viśeṣaṇatvena yuktamiti
kiñca idaṃ kṣaṇikatvam–kṣaṇasthāyitvam, kṣaṇānantaramabhāvo vā ? yadi kṣaṇasthāyitvam; tad akṣaṇike'pyastyeva, tadapi hi kṣaṇamāste, anyathā akṣaṇikameva tanna syāt
atha kṣaṇā'nantaramabhāva, tadā aśabdārthatvam, nahi kṣaṇānantaramabhāva kṣaṇaśabdavācyaḥ, yatastena tadvattā syāt, kṣaṇānantaramabhāvaśca arthānāṃ pratyakṣādiviruddha ityuktam
yadapyuktam–utpāditā'śeṣakāryagrāmasya ityādi, tatra utpādite kārye tadutpādakasvabhāvaḥ asya vyāvarttate eva, aparakāryotpādasvabhāvasvīkārāt
na caivamasya kṣaṇikatvaprasaṅga; svabhāvabhede'pi tadvata abhedapratyayaviṣayatvena akṣaṇikatvapratipādanāt
yacca kṛtakatva kṣaṇikatve sādhanamuktam; tatrāpi pakṣādidoṣa pūrvavad draṣṭavya

kṛtakatvañca kāryatvamucyate, kṣaṇakṣayaikānte ca kāryakāraṇabhāvasya santānaniṣedhā'vasare pratikṣiptatvāt kathaṃ tat siddhyet ? astu vā tatra tadbhāva, tathāpi atra kimekasmāt kāraṇāt ekaṃ kāryamutpadyate, ki vā anekasmādekam, utasvit ekasmādanekam, āhosvin anekasmādanekam iti ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapanna, ekasmāt pradīpādikāraṇāt daśānanadāha-tailaśopa-andhakārāpanayanādyanekakāryodayadarśanāt

rūpā''lokādyanekakāraṇakalāpāt jñānādilakṣaṇaikakārya saṃbhavati, ityapyapeśalam; kāraṇabhedopanītasvabhāvanānātvayogataḥ tasya ekatvā'nupapatte, arthena hi nīlādyākāra, samanantarapratyayena svasaṃvidrūpanā, ālokena spaṣṭatā, cakṣurādinā rūpādiniyatatā jñāne samarpyate iti

tadupanītavividhaviruddharmādhyāse'pi asya ekatve nānākālaboge'pi ekatvaṃ kinna syāt aviśeṣāt ? etena tṛtīyapakṣo'pi pratyukta; anekaṃ kārya sahakārītarasvabhāvena ekasya utpādayataḥ viruddhadharmādhyāsena ekatvā'nupapatte, tadupapattau vā anekakṣaṇayoge'pyasya ekatvamupapadyatāṃ viśeṣā'bhāvāt
na ca kṣaṇikatve sati kāryakāraṇabhāvo ghaṭate
kṣaṇikatvapakṣe kimekasmādekotpāda, uta bahubhya ekotpattiḥ, atha ekasmādanekaniṣpattiḥ, āho bahubhya bahusabhava iti parīkṣaṇīyam

nīlābhāsasya hi cittasya nīlādālambanapratyayānnīlākāratā, samanantarapratyayāt pūrvavijñānād bodharūpatā, ālokāt sahakāripratyayāddheto spaṣṭatārthatā, cakṣuṣo'dhipatipratyayād rūpagrahaṇapratiniyamaḥ
