atha caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ samāśrīyate–rūpādikṣaṇapracayarūpā hi pūrvā sāmagrī santānavṛttyā pravarttamānā svarūpāmuttarottarāṃ sāmagrīmārabhate vijātīyakāraṇā'nupraveśe tu virūpām iti; tadapyasundaram; yataḥ samagrebhyo'bhinnā sāmagrī, bhinnā vā syāt ? na tāvadbhinnā; apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt

atha abhinnā; tarhi samagrā eva sāmagrī, tatra ca pūrvasamudāyena uttarasamudāyārambhe tadantargataṃ samudāyinam ekaikam ekaika eva utpādayet, sarve saṃbhūya vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'saṅgataḥ; ekasmād ekotpatteḥ pratiṣiddhatvāt, anekasmād anekotpattipratijñākṣatiprasaṅgācca
atha keyaṃ sāmagrī nāma ? na samagrebhyo bhinnā pṛthaganupalambhād, avyatireke tu samagra eva sāmagrī
tatra pūrvasamudāyena uttarasamudāyārambhe tadantargataṃ samudāyinam ekameva eka utpādayet, ekaṃ vā saṃbhūyeti
ekaikamekaika eva utpādayet sarve saṃbhūya vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 766

dvitīyapakṣo'pyayuktaḥ; yataḥ ekaikasamudāyiniṣpattau sarvasamudāyināṃ krameṇa vyāpāraḥ syāt, yugapadvā ? kramapakṣe kṣaṇikatvakṣatiḥ, ye hi tatra pañcaṣāḥ samudāyinaḥ kṣaṇā varttante te ekatamaṃ samutpādya punaḥ aparamutpādayanti punaḥ anyam iti tāvatkālamavasthānāt kathaṃ kṣaṇikāḥ ? atha yugapadeva sarvaniṣpattau sarve vyāpriyante; tarhi nikurumbarūpaṃ kāryaṃ nikurumbarūpāt kāraṇādutpannam iti kāraṇapravibhāganiyamā'bhāvāt idaṃ rūpam eṣa rasaḥ ityevaṃ rūpādikāryapravibhāgo na syāt, sarvaṃ rūpaṃ raso vā syāt ekasmānnikurumbaviśeṣādutpannatvāt
atha nikurumbāt nikurumbasya utpattāvapi na rūpādīnāṃ svarūpasaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ pūrvasāmagrībhūtaiḥ rūpādikṣaṇaiḥ upādānasahakāribhāvena uttarasāmagrībhūtarūpādikṣaṇānāmutpādanāt

yadi hi rūpakṣaṇo rūpavat rasādikṣaṇāntaraṃ prati upādānaṃ syāt tadā syād rasasyāpi rūparūpanā iti; tadapyacāru; upādāna-sahakāribhāvasya upādānetaraśaktibhede satyeva upapatteḥ, tadbhedaśca niraṃśasvalakṣaṇe na saṃbhavati ityuktam
atha ekaikaphalasamudāyiniṣpattau sarvasamudāyinaṃ vyāpārayet krameṇa, yaugapadyena vā ? nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 454
ye hi tatra paṃca daśa samudāyinaḥ kṣaṇaṃ tatra varttante
tarhi nikurumbarūpādeva kāraṇādutpannamiti kāraṇavivekaniyamābhāvād rūparasādipravibhāgo na syāt
tataḥ kṣaṇakṣayaikānte kāryakāraṇabhāvā'nupapatteḥ asiddhaṃ tatra kṛtakatvam
na ca kṛtakena svasattākṣaṇānantarameva naṣṭavyam iti niyamaḥ, kṛtakañca syāt kālāntare ca naśyet virodhā'bhāvāt iti sandigdhā'naikāntikatvam

nā'naikāntikatvam, kṛtakatvā'nityatvayoḥ tādātmyena anityatvā'vyabhicāritvāttasya; ityapyasundaram; anityatvā'vyabhicāritve'pi kālāntarabhāvi-anityatvā'vyabhicāritvaṃ bhaviṣyati na tu utpattyanantarabhāvi-anityatvā'vyabhicāri tvam, kṛtakatvasya anityatvamātreṇaiva avinābhāvasaṃbhavāt
kutaśca anayostādātmyapratibandhasiddhiḥ ? na tāvat pratyakṣāt; tasya avicārakatva-sannihitārthaviṣayatvataḥ sārvatrikapratibandhagrahaṇe sāmarthyā'saṃbhavāt
nānaikāntikatvam iti nāsti ā॰, bhāṃ॰, śra॰

yaccā'nyaduktam–kāraṇasāmarthyā'bhedāt ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; yataḥ kāraṇānāṃ sāmarthyā'bhedaḥ ki vinaśvaramātrasvabhāvabhāvajanane, udayānantarāsthānaśīlā'rthotpādanamātre vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanam; yaḥ kaścit kāraṇairjanyate tasya anityatāmātrasvabhāvatayā iṣṭatvāt

vicitrā hi kāraṇasāmagrī–kācit udayānantarameva ayatnasādhyavināśāliṅgitaṃ vidyudādibhāvam āvirbhāvayati, kācit punaḥ kālāntare prayatnasādhya-abhāvakroḍīkṛtaṃ ghaṭādirūpam, anyā tu pracuratarakāle prayatnasahasrato'pi asmadādibhyo'nāsāditavināśopetaṃ parvatādikam
vidyudādeḥ khalu udayā'nantaramabhāvo na pratītito'nyataḥ siddhyati, sā ca anyatrāpi bhavantī kinna tatsadbhāvaṃ prasādhayet ? na khalu mudgarādivyāpārāt prāk kalaśāderabhāvaḥ pratīyate

yadapyuktam–ante vināśopalambhāt ityādi; tadapyayuktam; ante dṛṣṭadharmasya ādāvapi abhyupagame ante santānocchedopalambhād ādāvapi taduccheda syāt, avidyātṛṣṇāprakṣayasya ca ante darśanāt ādāvapi tatsiddhiprasaṅgataḥ sugatasya mārgā'bhyāso vyartha syāt
yadi ca svahetoḥ vināśasvabhāvo bhāvaḥ samutpannaḥ tarhi mudgarādiprahāranirapekṣaḥ tathā'vabhāseta
na hi pradīpādiḥ prakāśātmakatayā utpanna paramapekṣya tadrūpatayā avabhāsate
na ca mudgarādiprahārā'bhāve ghaṭādipradhvaṃsaḥ svapne'pi pratīyate, ataḥ kādācitkaḥ san anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ mudgarādihetuka eva asau vyavatiṣṭhate
na ca visadṛśasantānotpādane eva tadvyāpārasya caritārthatvam ityabhidhātavyam; ghaṭāvināśe kapālasantaterapi anupapatte
nahi vidyamāne ghaṭe kapālasantati upalabhyate, ataḥ tadvināśadvāreṇaiva sā utpa dyate iti ubhayoḥ tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānāviśeṣāt vināśe'pi tajjanyatāstu
kṛtakānāṃ dhruvabhāvitvād vināśasya na hetvantarāpekṣā; ityapi kapālasantānena anaikāntikam, sa hi dhruvabhāvī na ca mudgarādihetvantarā'napekṣaḥ
na ca nirhetukatva yuktam, bhāva iva abhāve'pi anvayavyatirekābhyā hetorvyāpāropalambhāt
nirhetukatve ca asya kim ākāśādivat sadā sattvameva syāt, bandhyāstanandhayādivat asattvameva vā ? prathamapakṣe bhāvā'bhāvayoryugapadupalambhaḥ syāt, tayorvirodhā'bhāvataḥ sahāvasthānasaṃbhavāt
virodhe vā bhāvadarśanamanavasarameva prāpnoti, tadvirodhino'bhāvasya sadā sattvāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu ghaṭādernityatvameva syāt, tatpradhvaṃsasya ahetukatvena sadā'sattvāt
na ca bhāvakāraṇakatvamabhāvasya upapadyate; tatkāraṇabhedapratīteḥ, anyadeva hi mudgarādikaṃ ghaṭavināśe kāraṇam anyadeva ca mṛtpiṇḍādikaṃ tadutpāde
bhāvakāraṇakatve ca abhāvasya bhāvakāle eva abhāvo'pi syāt, tathā ca prāgiva bhāvopalambho durlabhaḥ syāt
tadā tadabhāve vā na bhāvakāraṇako'sau syāt, nahi ekakāraṇotpannā'rthānāṃ kālakrameṇa utpattiḥ pratīyate
atha dvitīyakṣaṇamapekṣya asya prādurbhāvāt na tadaiva utpattiḥ; kathamevam ahetukatvam apekṣasyaiva apekṣyasyaiva hetutvāt ? ahetuko hi na kiñcidapekṣate

vināśaheturnāstīti bruvāṇa paryanuyoktavyaḥ–kimakāraṇatvād vināśo nāsti, uta akāraṇatvānnitya iti ?yadyakāraṇatvānnityo vināśa; kāryasya utpādo na prāpnoti vināśena sahā'vasthānamiti ca doṣaḥatha asan vināśa; evamapi sarvanityatvaṃ vināśābhāvāt

atha bhāvakāraṇaiḥ tathābhūtasvabhāva eva utpādito'sau yena bhāvasattānantaraṃ bhavati iti; nanu tatsattā ki kṣaṇānantaradhvaṃsinī, rūpāntarayuktā vā ? tatra ādyapakṣe pratyakṣādibādhā; dvitīyādikṣaṇe'pi bhāvasattāyāḥ pratyakṣādipramāṇataḥ pratīyamānatvāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu kathamarthānāṃ kṣaṇikatā anekakṣaṇasthāyisattānantarabhāvināśasya akṣaṇikatve eva upapatteḥ ? na ca aparaṃ sattāmātraṃ kiñcidasti, yadanantarabhāvī sa syāt
asau ekakṣaṇasaṅgatā vā bhavet anekakṣaṇaparigatā vā ? sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 389
ahetukatvañcāsya arthodayānantarabhāvitvāt, vyatirekā'vyatirekavikalpābhyāṃ tajjanyatvā'saṃbhavādvā ? na tāvad udayānantarabhāvitvāt; uktadoṣā'nuṣaṅgāt
vyatirekā'vyatirekavikalpābhyāñca asya mudgarādyahetutā siddhyet na tu utpādānantarabhāvitā
yadā hi asau dṛśyate tadaiva ahetuko'bhyupagantuṃ yuktaḥ, na ca mudgarādivyāpārāt prāk upalabdho ghaṭādīnāṃ vināśaḥ
na ca tathā'nupalabhyamānopyasti iti abhidhātuṃ yuktam; upalambhanibandhanatvād vastuvyavasthāyāḥ
pratīyamānañca kālāntare hetuvyāpārād vināśasya janmānabhyupagamya apratīyamānamudayānantaramahetukatvamabhyupagacchato'sya mahatī prekṣāpūrvakāritā syāt !
kiñca udayānantaradhvaṃsitvaṃ bhāvānāṃ bhinnābhinnavikalpābhyāmanyena dhvaṃsasyābhāvādavasīyate, pramāṇāntarādvā ? prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 145 pū॰
kathañca utpādo'pi evamahetuko na syāt ? nahi so'pi kāryasya svayamutpadyamānasya anutpadyamānasya vā, tathā tato bhinno'bhinno vā kāraṇairvidhātuṃ pāryate
yathā ca mudgarādibhyo ghaṭādyabhāvo nopapadyate tathā svarūpato'pi
sa hi svarūpato bhavan svayaṃ naśvarasya anaśvarasya vā, vyatirikto'vyatirikto vā ityādivikalpān nā'tikrāmati
yathā vināśaṃ pratyanapekṣaṃ vinaśvaram tathā sthitiṃ pratyanapekṣa sthāsnu tadhetorakiñcitkaratvāt, tad vyatiriktā'vyatiriktā'karaṇād ityādi sarvaṃ samānam
nanu nā'smākaṃ darśane bhāvasya kiñcid bhavati, kevalam ekakṣaṇasthitidharmā svasvakāraṇājjātaḥ kṣaṇānantare na bhavati iti vyapadiśyate, taduktam–na tasya kiñcid bhavati na bhavatyeva kevalam
nanvevaṃ naṣṭaśabdasya kaścidartho'sti, na vā ? nāsti cet, ki tenoktena ? asti cet; ki sattvād bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā ? bhedapakṣo'yuktaḥ; sambandhā'bhāvāt anabhyupagamācca
yadyabhinnaḥ; tadā asti-nāstiśabdayoḥ tatpratītyośca paryāyatā syāt

tathā ca kṣaṇakṣayiṇo bhāvā niranvayavināśāḥ, na tasya kiñcidbhavati, na bhavatyeva kevalam ityevaṃvidhavacanaviśeṣā na sattvā'tirekiṇaṃ kamaṣyarthamabhidadhyuḥ ityeṣāmuccāraṇavaiyarthyam, sattve vipratipattyabhāvāt
tasmād bhāvasya yathā svakāraṇādavāptajanmanaḥ pramāṇaparicchedyā sadrūpatā tathā asadrūpatā'pi
naṣṭaśabdasya kaścidartho'sti na vā ? syā॰ ratnā॰ pṛ॰ 790

kīdṛśaśca ayaṃ vināśo nirhetukatvena abhipretaḥ–kiṃ vinaśanaṃ vināśaḥ abhāvamātraṃ prasajyapratiṣedharūpam, vinaśyatīti vā vināśa anavasthāyibhāvasvarūpaṃ paryudāsapratiṣedharūpaṃ vā ? na tāvat prasajyapratiṣedharūpasya asya ahetukatvam; tadrūpā'bhāvasyaiva bhavatā'nabhyupagamāt
nāpi paryudāsapratiṣedharūpasya; anavasthāyibhāvasvarūpasya asya ahetukatvena kaiścidapi anabhyupa gamāt
tato vināśaṃ prati anyā'napekṣatvam asiddhaṃ bhāvānām; mudgarādeḥ taṃ prati tairapekṣaṇāt
yo yadbhāvaṃ prati anyā'napekṣaḥ iti ca anaśvaratve'pi samānam

tathā ca trilocana prakīrṇakekiṃ vinaśyatīti vināśaḥ anavasthāyibhāvasvabhāva paryudāsapratiṣedharūpa, kiṃ vā vinaśanaṃ vināśaḥ abhāvamātraṃ prasajyapratiṣedharūpam ? nādyaḥ kalpa; anavasthāyibhāvasvabhāvasya ahetukatvena kenāpyanabhyupagatatvena asiddhatvāt

kiñca, atra anyā'napekṣatvamātraṃ hetuḥ, tatsvabhāvatve sati anyā'napekṣatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe yavabījādibhiḥ anekāntaḥ, śālyaṅkurotpādanasāmagrīsannidhānāvasthāyāṃ tadutpādane anyā'napekṣāṇāmapi eṣāṃ tatsvabhāvaniyatatvā'bhāvāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu viśeṣyā'siddho hetuḥ; tatsvabhāvatve satyapi arthānāṃ vināśaṃ prati anyā'napekṣatvā'bhāvapratipādanāt
bhāge viśeṣaṇā'siddhañca tatsvabhāvatve sati anyānapekṣatvam; dravyādīnāṃ vināśasvabhāvā'bhāvāt

dṛṣṭāntaśca sādhanavikalaḥ; antyakāraṇasāmagryāḥ svakāryotpādane dvitīyakṣaṇā'pekṣayā anapekṣatvā'saṃbhāvāt, na hi antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryotpādanasvabhāvā'pi dvitīyakṣaṇā'napekṣā tadutpādayati pratītivirodhāt
kica anyānapekṣatvamātraṃ hetuḥ, tatsvabhāvatve sati prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 145 pū॰

yadapi śata-sahasrakṣaṇasthāyi ityuktam; tadapyayuktam; yataḥ svakāraṇakalāpataḥ prathamakṣaṇādantyakṣaṇaṃ yāvat śatasahasrakṣaṇasthāyī jāto'rthaḥ dvitīyādikṣaṇe'pi tatsvabhāvaṃ na parityajati antyakṣaṇaṃ yāvat
yadapyabhihitam–yad yathā'vabhāsate ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; hetorasiddheḥ, nahi nīlamavabhāsamānaṃ kṣaṇikatvena avabhāsate, anyathā nīlavat kṣaṇiko'yam ityapi ullekhaḥ syāt
yadeva vikalpena parāmṛśyate tadeva adhyakṣagocaraḥ ityabhyupagamāt
na ca nīlāvabhāsa eva kṣaṇikā'vabhāsaḥ; pratyayavailakṣaṇyāt
tadvailakṣaṇye'pi asya kṣaṇikatvā'vabhāsasvabhāvatve akṣaṇikatvā'vabhāsasvabhāvatvamapi astu viśeṣā'bhāvāt, na hi anyākāram anyaparicchede samartham atiprasaṅgāt
na ca varttamānatāgrahaṇameva kṣaṇikatāgrahaṇam; animepalocanasya akṣaṇikatāyāmapi varttamānatāgrahaṇasya pratipādanāt

tadevaṃ kṣaṇikatvasya vicāryamāṇasya anupapatteḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ viśarāravo rūparasagandhasparśaśabdaparamāṇavaḥ jñānañca iti sautrāntikamatamapāstam, jñānamātrameva kṣaṇasthitidharmakaṃ tattvam iti yogācāra-mādhyamikamatañca; bahirarthasiddhyā ātmāditattvāntarasiddhyā ca pratyekataḥ tanmatanirākaraṇaṃ prāgeva viśeṣato vihitamiti neha punarabhidhīyate
vaibhāṣikamataṃ tu kṣaṇabhaṅganirākaraṇāt nirākṛtamapi tanmataprakriyāṃ pradarśya viśeṣato nirākriyate

vibhāṣām saddharmapratipādakagranthaviśeṣaṃ ye adhīyate te vaibhāṣikāḥ, te ca pratītyasamutpādam aṅgīkṛtya viśvavaicitryamācakṣate; tathāhi–pratītya anyonyaṃ hetūkṛtya tāṃ tāṃ sāmagrīmāśritya hetupratyayabhāvena yasmin saṃghātebhyaḥ saṃghātāḥ prabhavanti pradhāna-īśvarādikārakanirapekṣāḥ saḥ pratītyasamutpāda

tasya ca dvādaśa aṅgāni hetuphalabhāvena vyavasthitāni; tathāhi–avidyāpratyayaḥ saṃskāraḥ, saṃskārapratyayaṃ vijñānam, vijñānapratyayaṃ nāmarūpam, nāmarūpapratyayaṃ ṣaḍāyatanam, ṣaḍāyatanapratyayaḥ sparśaḥ, sparśapratyayā vedanā, veda nāpratyayā tṛṣṇā, tṛṣṇāpratyayam upādānam, upādānapratyayo bhavaḥ, bhavapratyayā jātiḥ, jātipratyayaṃ jarāmaraṇamiti
vibhāṣayā dīvyanti caranti vā vaibhāṣikā, vibhāṣā vā vidanti vaibhāṣikā
hetūn pratyayān pratītya samāśritya ya skandhādīnāmutpāda sa pratītyasamutpāda
tatra ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya hetūpanibandha katama yadidam–avidyāpratyayā saskārā yāvajjātipratyayaṃ jarāmaraṇamiti
tadyathoktamāryaśālistambasūtre–evamukte maitreyo vodhisattvo mahāsattva āyuṣmantaṃ śāriputrametadavocat
yo bhikṣava pratītyasamutpāda paśyati sa dharma paśyati
yo dharmaṃ paśyati sa buddha paśyati

yadidamavidyāpratyayā saskārā, saskārapratyayaṃ vijñānam, vijñānapratyaya nāmarūpam, nāmarūpapratyayaṃ paḍāyatanam, ṣaḍāyatanapratyaya sparśa, sparśapratyayā vedanā, vedanāpratyayā tṛṣṇā, tṛṣṇāpratyayamupādānam, upādānapratyayo bhava, bhavapratyayā jāti, jātipratyayā jarāmaraṇaśokaparidevadu khadaurmanasyādaya

tatrāvidyā katamā–eteṣāmeva ṣaṇṇā dhātūnā yaikasajñā piṇḍasaṃjñā nityasajñā dhruvasajñā śāśvatasaṃjñā sukhasajñā ātmasajñā sattvasajñā jīvasajñā jantusajñā manujasajñā mānavasaṃjñā ahaṅkāramamakārasajñā evamādivividhamajñānamiyamucyate avidyā
evamavidyāyā satyā viṣayeṣu rāgadveṣamohā pravarttante, tatra ye rāgadvepamohā viṣayeṣu amī avidyāpratyayā saskārā ityucyante
catvāri mahābhūtāni ca upādānāni rūpam aikavyarūpam, vijñānasabhūtāścatvāro'rūpiṃṇa skandhā nāma, tannāmarūpam
evam avidyāyā satyāṃ trividhā saskārā abhinirvartante–puṇyopagā apuṇyopagā ānejyopagāśca ima ucyante avidyāpratyayāḥ saskārā iti
tatra puṇyopagānā saskārāṇā puṇyopagame ca vijñānaṃ bhavati, apuṇyopagānā saskārāṇām apuṇyopagame ca vijñāna bhavati, ānejyopagānā saskārāṇām ānejyopagame ca vijñānaṃ bhavati
nāmarūpavivṛddhyā ṣaḍabhi āyatanadvārai kṛtyakriyā pravarttate, tat nāmarūpapratyayaṃ ṣaḍāyatanamucyate
kleśaḥ trīṇi dvayaṃ karma saptavastu phalaṃ tathā

avidyā-tṛṣṇā-upādānāni trīṇi kleśa, saskāra-bhavau karma, vijñānanāmarūpaṣaḍāyatanasparśavedanājātijarāmaraṇāni vastūbhūtānyeva aṃgāni phalabhūtānyapiādimayoḥ avidyāsaṃskārayo hetusajñā, antyayoḥ jātijarāmaraṇayoḥ phalasajñā ca
tatra rūpaskandhaḥ–pañcendriyāṇi, pañca tadarthāḥ, avijñaptiśca ityekādaśadhā
tatra avijñaptiḥ prāṇināṃ śarīropādānabhūtā śubha-aśubha-anubhayācaraṇājjātā kañcukaprakhyā, sā ca ayogināmapratyakṣatvād avijñaptiḥ iti anvarthena ucyate
tadarthāḥ pṛthivyādibhūtāni bhavanti bhāvayanti ca anugraha-upatāparūpatayā iti bhūtāni
ākāśaṃ ca chidram, tacca āloka-tamaḥparamāṇubhyo nā'nyat iti na pṛthak parigaṇyate
tāni ca pṛthivīdhātuḥ ityādi saṃjñāntaramapi pratipadyante, utpattisthānatvāt tāmrādidhātuvat
padārthānāṃ nimittodgrahaṇaṃ saṃjñāvimarśaḥ, yathā rūpaṇāt rūpam, dhāraṇāt dhātavaḥ, arthakriyāyāṃ ghaṭanāt ghaṭaḥ ityādiranekaprakārā

vijñānaṃ tu nāmarūpaśabdavācyamapi skandhaśabdena ucyate, rāśībhūtatvasya pañcānāmapyaviśeṣāt; tathāhi–rūpam ekādaśātmako rāśiḥ, vedanā tryātmakaḥ, saṃjñā saṃskāraśca anekātmakaḥ, vijñānaṃ ṣaḍātmakaḥ iti
rūpabhinnā catvāraḥ skandhāḥ vedanāsaṃjñāsaskāravijñānābhidhāḥ nāma iti padena vyavahriyante
sāśravāste eva kāraṇabhūtāḥ samudayaḥ, āśravati saṃsāro yebhyaḥ te āśravāḥ avidyārāgādayaḥ taiḥ saha varttante iti sāśravāḥ
tatra duḥkhādīni āryasatyāni pratisaṃkhyāyante yathāvanniścīyante yena prajñāviśeṣeṇa tena yaḥ prāpyo nirodhaḥ avidyādyucchedaḥ saḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ
cakṣurādīndriyāṇi ṣaḍāyatanāni āyaṃ tanvanti iti āyatanāni sarvasya āgacchataḥ upāyāḥ ityarthaḥ
cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ paśyāmi ityādi viṣayendriyavijñānasannipātaḥ samūhaḥ sparśaḥ
pratisaṃkhyā hi prajñā tayā hetubhūtayā'yaṃ nirodho bhavatīti pratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ
dharmāṇāmutpatteratyantaṃ virodhī yo'nyaḥ svarūpaviyogaḥ sa apratisaṃkhyānirodhaḥ
tajjāḥ ṣaḍ vedanāḥ paṃca kāyikī caitasī parā
itthaṃ narakadvīpabhedasaṃgraheṇa 8 4 = dvādaśa ṣaḍ devalokāḥ = 18 preta tiryaṃca = sarvaṃ viṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ kāmadhātuśabdavācyāḥ
tatra pṛthak pṛthak ekaikasmin dhyāne trayo lokāḥ; tadyathā–prathamadhyāne brahmakāyika-brahmapurohita–mahābrahmalokāḥ
caturṣu dhyāneṣu saptadaśa lokāḥ saptadaśa sthānāni
ārūpyadhātau tṛtīye antime ca sthānabhedo nāsti
atra ca ārūpyadhātau cittasantāno vijñānasantānaḥ nikāye sabhāgatāyāṃ jīvitendriye ca niśritaḥ āśrito bhavati yatastatra śarīrāderabhāvaḥ

yattāvaduktam–pratītyasamutpādam ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ pratītyasamutpāde avidyādidvādaśāṅgāni mumukṣūṇāmupayogitvāt pradarśitāni, kiṃ vā etāvantyeva saṃbhavantīti ? na tāvad iyantyeva ityavadhārayituṃ śakyam; jagatparyāyavaicitryasya ānantyena vyāptatvāt

nāpi mumukṣūṇām etāvantyeva upayujyante; mithyājñānalakṣaṇā'vidyāvat viparītaśraddhāna-ācaraṇasvarūpayoḥ mithyādarśana-cāritrayorapi saṃsārahetvoḥ heyatayā samyagjñānādeśca mokṣahetoḥ upādeyatayā teṣāmupayogāt
prasādhayiṣyate ca jñānāditrayasyaiva asamyagrūpasya saṃsārahetutā, samyagrūpasya ca mokṣahetutā mokṣavicārāvasare prapañcataḥ

na ca avidyāyāmeva teṣāmantarbhāvaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tato'tyantavilakṣaṇatayā tatra teṣāmantarbhāvāsaṃbhavāt, yad yato'tyantavilakṣaṇaṃ na tat tatra antarbhavati yathā jale'nalaḥ, atyantavilakṣaṇāśca avidyāto mithyādarśanādaya iti
tatra eṣāmantarbhāve vā parigaṇitadvādaśāṅgopadeśo'nupapannaḥ; caturāryasatyeṣveva aśeṣasya antarbhāvāt tadupadeśasyaiva mumukṣūṇāmupapatteḥ
yacca avidyāyāḥ kṣaṇika ityādilakṣaṇamuktam; tadayuktam; kṣaṇikādijñānasyaiva avidyārūpatvāt
atattve tattvajñānaṃ hi avidyā, sarvathā kṣaṇikatvaṃ nairātmyañca arthasyā'svarūpaṃ pramāṇā'nupapannatvāt sarvathā nityatvavat

yadapi–saṃskārā rāgādayaḥ ityuktam; tadatīvā'saṅgatam; yato rāgādīnāṃ saṃskārarūpatā laukiketarayoḥ tadrūpatayā prasiddhatvād abhidhīyate, vyutpattimātreṇa vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; loke śāstre ca vegādisvabhāvasyaiva saṃskārasya prasiddheḥ

dvitīyapakṣo'pyapeśalaḥ; saṃskriyante iti saṃskārāḥ iti vyutpattimātreṇa rāgādivat nikhilārthānāṃ saṃskāratvaprasaṅgāt, tathā ca avidyāta eva akhilārthānāṃ tadrūpatayā utpattiprasaṅgāt pradarśitatatkāraṇabhedaprakriyā viśīryeta
puṇyādiprakāratā caiṣāmatīva durghaṭā; nahi rāgādīnāṃ puṇyādivyapadeśo loke śāstre vā kvacit prasiddhaḥ, sukhādisādhanasya dharmādereva tatra tatprasiddheḥ
tatkāryatvāt teṣāmapi tadvyapadeśaḥ; ityapyasāmpratam; puṇyāde rāgādikāraṇatvā'saṃbhavāt, ācaraṇaviśeṣanibandhanatvāttasya
paramparayā tannibandhanatvāt tasya tadvyapadeśe avidyāderapi tadvyapadeśaprasaṅgāt pratiniyatavyavasthāvilopaḥ syāt

yadapi saṃskārapratyayaṃ vijñānam ityuktam; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; rāgādīnāṃ vijñānapratipakṣabhūtatayā tallakṣaṇasaṃskārebhyaḥ prādurbhāvā'saṃbhavāt, tatpratipakṣabhūtatā caiṣāmanyairapi uktā– andhādayaṃ mahānandho viṣayāndho kṛtekṣaṇaḥ
cakṣuṣā'ndho na jānāti viṣayāndho na kenacit
ṣaṭprakāratā cāsya khapuṣpaprakhyā; bhavatparikalpitasya indriyaprabhavajñānasya vikalpajñānasya ca savikalpakasiddhau pratyākhyātatvāt
cakṣuṣā'ndho na jānāti viṣayāndho na kenacit || ātmānuśā॰ ślo॰ 35 iti
yadapi–vijñānapratyayaṃ nāmarūpam ityuktam; tadapi mahādbhutam; rūpādiskandhacatuṣṭayalakṣaṇanāmarūpasya vijñānaprabhavatvā'saṃbhavāt, vijñānasyaiva tatprabhavatvopapatte
taddhi anena upādānabhāvena janyate, sahakāribhāvena vā ? na tāvad upādānabhāvena; indriyatadarthānāmatyantavilakṣaṇatayā tadupādānatvā'sabhavāt
yad yato'tyantavilakṣaṇaṃ na tasya tad upādānam yathā jalasya analaḥ, atyantavilakṣaṇañca vijñānād indriyādikamiti
nāpi sahakāribhāvena, indriyādibhyo vijñānasyaiva tathotpattipratīte, sarvairiṣṭatvācca
sarveṣāmapi ca aṅgānāṃ sahakāribhāvena vijñānādutpattisaṃbhavānna nāmarūpameva vijñānapratyayaṃ syāt
yā ca avijñapti kañcukaprakhyā pratipāditā, sā ki cidrūpā, acidrūpā vā syāt ? na tāvaccidrūpā, anabhyupagamāt
atha acidrūpā; na kiñcidaniṣṭam, kārmāṇaśarīrasya tathā nāmāntarakaraṇāt

yadapi nāmarūpapratyayaṃ ṣaḍāyatanam ityabhihitam; tadapyaparyālocitā'bhidhānam; rūpaskandhe eva asya antarbhūtatvena pṛthagabhidhāne prayojanā'bhāvāt, tatrā'ntarbhūtasyāpyasya pṛthak pratipādane pratipādayituḥ aprekṣāpūrvakāritvaprasaṅgaḥ

pratipādyānāṃ saṃkṣepa-vistararucitvāt tathā tatpratipādane ki tatparigaṇanena, tadrucīnāmānantyasadbhāvāt ? viṣayendriyavijñānasamūhaḥ sparśaḥ ityādi tu ṭhakabhāṣāmātreṇa svaprakriyāpradarśanamātra na kvacid upayujyate ityupekṣate
yadapi pṛthivyādidhātucatuṣṭayaṃ pratipāditam; tadapyavivādāspadameva; pratītisiddhasya pṛthivyāde anekaprakārā'rthotpattisthānatayā tadvyapadeśe vivādā'bhāvāt

yā tu tadutpattau prakriyā–paramāṇu utpadyamāno'ṣṭadravyaka utpadyate, aṣṭau dravyāṇi–cattvāri mahābhūtāni, cattvāri ca upādānarūpāṇi rūpa-rasa-gandha-spṛṣṭavyāni, yathā hi sāṃkhyasya eka eva śabdādi sattvarajastamomayo jāyate, evam asmanmate aṣṭadravyaka paramāṇu iti, sā atīvā'saṅgatā; paramāṇūnāmekaikaśo rūpādisaṃbhave'pi pṛthivyādimahābhūtā'saṃbhavāt

tāni hi tatra śaktirūpatayā parikalpyante, skandharūpatayā vā ? yadi śaktirūpatayā, tadā anantadravyako'pi para māṇuḥ kinna syāt, tatra anantadravyārambhakaśaktīnāmapi saṃbhavāt ? atha skandharūpatayā; tanna; ekaikaśaḥ paramāṇūnāṃ skandhapariṇāmā'saṃbhavāt, tatsamūhasādhyatvāttasya
kāmadhātau śabdāyatanarahita aśabda indriyapraveśā'narhaśca aṣṭadravyako bhavati
aṣṭau dravyāṇi catvāri mahābhūtāni pṛthivyaptejovāyava catvāri bhautikāni gandharasarūpasparśā aśabda kāyendriya-kāyāyatanapraveśārha paramāṇu navadravyaka tatra navama dravyaṃ spraṣṭavyam
aśabdo'kāyendriyaḥ cakṣurādyanyatamendriyapraveśārha paramāṇu tadindriyeṇa saha daśadravyaka
32 vitarko hi cittasya sthūlo vimarśaḥ, vicāraḥ sūkṣmaḥ
na ca indriyotthajñānānāṃ vitarkavicārasambhave nirvikalpakatvaṃ viruddhyate; nirūpaṇa-anusmaraṇa-vikalparahitatvena avikalpakatvāt teṣām
33 nirūpyate hi anena iti nirūpaṇam vācakaḥ śabdaḥ, anusmaraṇaṃ vikalpaḥ
cittasya audārya sthūlāvasthā vitarka, sūkṣmāvasthā vicāra
tau vyagrā mānasī prajñā sarvaiva mānasī smṛti
mānasī prajñā yā asamāhitā sā eva nirūpaṇavikalpaḥ
sarvā eva mānasī smṛtiḥ samāhitā asamāhitā vā anusmaraṇavikalpaḥ
manaśca vijñānāt nā'nyat ṣaṇṇāmanantarā'tītaṃ vijñānaṃ yaddhi tanmanaḥ

ete eva sapta, rūpaskandhadhātavaśca ekādaśa iti aṣṭādaśa ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; bhavatkalpitavijñānadhātūnāṃ savikalpakatvasiddhau pratyākhyātatvāt, rūpaskandhasya ca kṣaṇaviśarāroḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaprasādhanādeva pratiṣedhāt
tato vaibhāṣikopakalpitadvādaśāṅgātmakapratītyasamutpādasya yathopavarṇitasvarūpatayā vicāryamāṇasya avyavasthiteḥ nā'sya jagatprapañcaracanālakṣaṇā'rthakriyākāritvaṃ ghaṭate
tadevaṃ saugatamatasya caturvidhasyāpi kṣaṇikasvabhāvasya vicāryamāṇasya anupapatteḥ na kṣaṇike'pyarthe arthakriyā ghaṭate
matāḥ te dhātavaḥ sapta ṣaḍvijñānānyatho mana
cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇajihvākāyamanovijñānānāṃ anantaramatītaṃ pūrvakālikaṃ ca yadvijñānaṃ tadeva mana ityucyate
cakṣurvijñānādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ santi cakṣurādayaḥ pañca āśrayā
ṣaṣṭasya manovijñānasya tu na kopyāśrayaḥ prasiddhaḥ tadarthaṃ manaso grahaṇam
aṣṭādaśadhātava parigaṇyante ṣaṭ cakṣurādīni indriyāṇi, ṣaṭ cakṣurvijñānādīni, ṣaṭ rūpādayo viṣayāḥ
na ca tadabhāve bhāvānāṃ sattvamupapadyate ityupadarśayati–bhāvānām ityādi
bhāvānām paramārthasatām arthānām sā arthakriyā lakṣaṇatayā matā saugatasya, tadabhāve teṣāṃ paramārthasattvameva na bhavet ityartha
kārikāyāḥ sugamatvāt vyākhyānamakṛtvā paropahasanavyājena bhāvānām ityādi samarthayamānaḥ arthakriyā ityādyāha
arthasya svajñānasya anyasya vā dāhādeḥ kriyā niṣpattiḥ tasyām samarthaṃ yogyam paramārthasat yadevārthakriyākāri tadeva paramārthasat
aṅgīkṛtya urarīkṛtya svapakṣe punaḥ paścāt tatraiva aśaktaṃ sarvam
iti vacanāt arthakriyāṃ svayameva ātmanaiva nirākurvan saugata kathamanunmattaḥ syāt pūrvāparaviruddhavacanatvāt madirādyunmattavat ?
atra aparaḥ prāha–na uttarakāryotpattilakṣaṇā arthakriyā bhāvalakṣaṇam virodhāt
nahi anyad anyasya lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati atiprasaṅgāt
tasmāt saṃvitteḥ svasaṃviditāyāḥ ātmalābhaḥ arthakiyā ityāha–sva ityādi
svaśabdena svasavedanamadvayaṃ parāmṛśyate tasya bhūtiḥ ātmalābhaḥ saiva tanmātram–nottarakāryam, tadeva arthakriyāṃ vipakṣe'pi puruṣādvaitamate'pi kathaṃ nirasyeta ? na kathañcit tatrāpi tadaviśeṣāt
nanu puruṣādvaite nagaragrāmādibhedavyavahāraḥ katham ? saṃvidadvaite'pi katham ? iti samānam
tatra ayaṃ mithyā iti cet; taditaratra samānam ityāha–mithyā ityādi

mithyā bhrānto yo nagaragrāmādivyavahāraḥ tam vā vipakṣe kathannirasyeta ? tanna nitya-kṣaṇikapakṣayoḥ kācid arthakriyā iti kutaḥ sākāram anyadvā jñānaṃ tatra pramāṇaṃ syāt ? astu vā tattatra, tathāpi dūṣaṇamāha–saṃvitteḥ ityādi

saṃvitteḥ arthākārajñānasya abhede'pi niraṃśatve'pi viṣayākārasyaiva nīlādyākārasyaiva viṣayasādhanatvaṃ nīlādiviṣayavyavasthāpakatvam nā''kārāntarasya viṣayādyākārādanyaḥ saṃvedanādyākāraḥ tadantaraṃ tasya na viṣayasādhanatvam sarvatra tadaviśeṣāt iti bhāvaḥ
vivṛtiḥ–paramārthaikatve'pi mithyāvyavahārabhedāt jñānasya anekārthaṃkriyākāriṇaḥ pratibhāsāḥ parasparārthasaṃvedinaḥ tattvaṃ bhedā'bhedātmakaṃ sādhayanti
evakāro bhinnaprakramaḥ na ityasya anantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, vāśabdaḥ ivārthaḥ, tato'yamarthaḥ sampannaḥ–abhede'pi ekatve'pi naiva viruddhyeta
keva ? ityāha vikriyeva, vividhā nānā prakārā kriyā kāryakaraṇaṃ sā iva
avikriyaiva vā iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ, tatra ayamarthaḥ– avikāro'pi na viruddhyeta iti
paramārthaikatve'pi ityādinā vikriyaiva vā ityetadvyācaṣṭe, śeṣasya sugamatvāt

paramārthena ekatve'pi abhinnasvabhāvatve'pi, kasya ? jñānasya kathambhūtasya ? anekā'rthakriyākāriṇaḥ, anekārtho nīlādiḥ tasya kriyā paricchittiḥ tatkāriṇaḥ, kutaḥ ? mithyāvyavahārabhedāt, mithyā kalpanākalpito vyavahāraḥ anīlādyākāravyāvṛttyā nīlādyākārasāmānyaparikalpanalakṣaṇaḥ tasya bhedāt nānātvāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yadeva jñānam anīlavyāvṛttyā nīlākāraṃ sat tatparicchedakaṃ tadeva apītādivyāvṛttyā pītādyākāraṃ sat pītādeḥ paricchedakam iti
tasya ke ki kurvanti ? ityāha–pratibhāsāḥ nīlādyākārāḥ tattvaṃ bhedā'bhedātmakaṃ sādhayanti
tathāhi–ya eva pratibhāso nīlaṃ savetti sa eva pītaṃ raktaṃ śuklam, tathā ya eva pītaṃ sa eva nīlaṃ raktaṃ śuklam, evam anyatrā'pi yojyam
anyathā yugapad ahaṃ nīlādikaṃ vedmi iti pratīteranupapatteḥ, evamarthañca anekā'rthakriyākāriṇaḥ ityuktam
ataḥ siddho varttamānā'rthagrāhī pratibhāsaḥ atītā'nāgatārthagrāhī, tadgrāhī ca varttamānārthagrāhakaḥ svavyāpakajñānāpekṣayā

tathā ca yadi varttamānagrahaṇagrāhyam atītamanāgataṃ ca tarhi tad varttamānameva syāt tadgrahaṇagrāhyatvāt prasiddhavarttamānavat iti, tannirastam; nīlādigrahaṇagrāhyasya pītāderapi nīlāditvaprasaṅgāt
tathāhi–pītādikaṃ nīlaṃ nīlagrahaṇagrāhyatvāt abhimatanīlavat, pramāṇabādhanam ubhayatra tulyam
evaṃ tāvat sautrāntikamatam anekāntanāntarīyakaṃ pradarśya sāmprataṃ yogācāramataṃ tannāntarīyakaṃ pradarśayannāha–

vivṛtiḥ–citranirbhāsinaḥ tattvam avibhāgajñānasya dṛśyaṃ yadi krameṇā'pi sadasadātmakaṃ vivartteta tataḥ siddham–dravyaparyāyātmakam utpāda-vyaya-dhrauvyayuktaṃ vastu tattvam antarvahiśca prameyam, ekāntasya anupalabdheḥ tadanekāntātmā arthaḥ iti
vahirmukhākāratayā hi jñānaṃ mithyā, saccetanādyākāratayā tu satyam ityeke
mithyā ca itaraḥ ca ātmā yasya tattathoktam
grāhyākārāt tasya viveka sa tu tasmin pratibhāsamāne'pi na pratibhāsate bhrānteḥ ityapare
ki tat ? cittam jñānaṃ kartṛ ekaṃ tattvaṃ jīvādi sadasadātmakaṃ bhāvetararūpaṃ sādhayati, svataḥ ātmanā iti
citraḥ śabalaḥ mithyetarādisvabhāvā'pekṣayā yo nirbhāsaḥ sa yasya asti tasya tattvaṃ svarūpam
kasya ? avibhāgajñānasya dṛśyam upalabhyaṃ yadi krameṇā'pi na kevalam akrameṇa sadasadātmakaṃ vivartteta tattvam iti sambandhaḥ
yata evaṃ tataḥ tasmāt siddhaṃ niścitam dravyaparyāyātmakaṃ vastutattvaṃ prameyam
sattāsamavāyāt sattvam iti nirākaraṇapurassara utpādāditrayayogādeva sattvavyavasthāpanam–
nanu utpāda-vyaya-dhrauvyayuktatvena jīvādivastunaḥ sattve pratyekam utpādāderapi aparotpādādiyogāt sattvena bhavitavyam, evaṃ ca anavasthā

svataḥ tasya sattve vastuno'pi svata eva sattvamastu alaṃ tadyogāt sattvakalpanayā; etadapyasamīcīnam; yataḥ sakalaśūnyatām, vastuno'nyataḥ sattvaṃ vā abhipretya evaṃ paryanuyujyeta ? tatra ādyaḥ pakṣo'yuktaḥ; sakalaśūnyatāyāḥ prāgeva prapañcataḥ apāstatvāt

dvitīyapakṣe'pi utpādāderanyataḥ sattāsambandhāt, arthakriyātaḥ, tatkāritvāt, tatkaraṇayogyatātaḥ, pramāṇasambandhādvā vastunaḥ sattvaṃ syāt ? tatra na tāvat sattāsambandhāt; avyāpakatvāt tasya, sāmānya-viśeṣa-samavāyeṣu hi tatsambandhā'bhāve'pi sattvaṃ saṃbhavatyeva
na ca yadabhāve'pi yad bhavati tat tadvyāpyam yathā aśvā'bhāve'pi bhavan rāsabhaḥ na tadvyāpyaḥ, sattāsambandhā'bhāve'pi bhavati ca sāmānyādiṣu sattvamiti
tathā vastu na cet kena anavasthādi nivāryate
sattāsambandha iṣṭaśced vastūnā lakṣaṇa na tat
na ca sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; tatsambandhā'bhāve'pi parai tatra sattvasyā'bhyupagamāt
na khalu sattāsambandhād yaugaiḥ sāmānyādau sattvamiṣṭam triṣu padārtheṣu satkarī sattā iti kṛtāntavyāghātā'nuṣaṅgāt

na ca tatsattvāt dravyādisattvaṃ vilakṣaṇam ataḥ tadeva sattāsambandhanibandhanam nānyadityabhidhātavyam; yataḥ kimidaṃ tatsattvasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ nāma–vilakṣaṇapratyayagrāhyatvam, abādhitatvam, gauṇatvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; tataḥ tasya vilakṣaṇapratyayagrāhyatayā svapne'pi pratītyabhāvāt

na khalu yathā gavādibhyo mahiṣyādeḥ vilakṣaṇapratyayagrāhyatayā pratiprāṇi pratītiḥ prasiddhā, tathā dravyādisattvāt sāmānyādisattvasyāpi, bhavatastu tathāpratītiḥ svasiddhāntā''grahagrahā'bhiniveśanibandhanā na vastudarśanabalapravṛttā ghaṭādeḥ puruṣādyadvaitarūpatāpratātivat
dvitīyavikalpo'pyanupapannaḥ; abādhitatvasya ubhayatrāpyaviśeṣāt, nahi sāmānyādisattvavat dravyādau sattvaṃ kenacit pramāṇena bādhyate tasyā'sattvaprasaṅgāt

atha gauṇatvam sāmānyādisattvasya dravyādisattvād vailakṣaṇyam; nanu gauṇatvameva asya kutaḥ siddham ? bhinnaviśeṣaṇatvā'bhāvāccet; nahi yathā dravyādau sattālakṣaṇabhinnaviśeṣaṇanimittaṃ sattvam tathā sāmānyādau
na ca abhinnaviśeṣaṇasya mukhyatvaṃ yuktam bhinnaviśeṣaṇa mukhyam abhinnaviśeṣaṇaṃ gauṇam
ityabhidhānāt; ityapyasat; anyonyāśrayaprasaṅgāt–siddhe hi sāmānyādisattvasya sattālakṣaṇabhinnaviśeṣaṇanibandhanatvā'bhāve gauṇatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tannibandhanatvā'bhāvasiddhiriti

etena dravyādau sattvasya mukhyatvamapi cintitam; itaretarāśrayā'viśeṣāt; tathāhi–siddhe dravyādau sattvasya mukhyatve sattālakṣaṇabhinnaviśeṣaṇanibandhanatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tanmukhyatvasiddhiriti
na ca kaścidabāliśaḥ svarūpanibandhanaṃ sattvamupacaritam, arthāntarabhūtasattānibandhanaṃ tu mukhyam iti manyate
nahi yaṣṭau yaṣṭitvamupacaritam, puruṣe tu mukhyam iti prekṣāvān manyate

kiñca, sattā svayaṃ satī anyasya sattvahetuḥ syāt, asatī vā ? yadi asatī; kathaṃ svasambandhena anyasya sattvahetuḥ ? yad asat na tat svasambandhena anyasya sattvahetuḥ yathā kharaviṣāṇam, asatī ca sattā iti

atha satī; kiṃ svataḥ, sattāntarasambandhādvā ? yadi svataḥ; tarhi vastuno'pi svata eva sattvamastu, ki tatsambandhāt sattvakalpanāprayāsena ? yat sat tat svātmabhūtenaiva sattvena yathā sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyāḥ, santi ca dravyādīni iti

nanu ca anavasthāyā bādhikāyāḥ sadbhāvādeva sāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyeṣu svataḥ sattvamiṣyate dravyādau tu parataḥ tatra tadabhāvāt, na khalu dravyādau parataḥ sattve anavasthā avatarati–sattāto hi dravyādīnāṃ sattvaṃ sattāyāstu svataḥ iti; tada pyavicāritaramaṇīyam; dravyādīnāmapi parataḥ sattve yat sat tatsvātmabhūtenaiva sattvena ityādyanumānabādhasya pratipāditatvāt

atiprasaṅga-vaiyarthyalakṣaṇabādhaprasakteśca; tathāhi–svarūpeṇa sataḥ sattāsambandhāt sattvaṃ syāt, asato vā ? na tāvad asata; atiprasaṅgāt, yat svarūpeṇa asat na tatra sattāsambandhaḥ tatsambandhāt sattvaṃ vā yathā gaganendīvare, svarūpeṇa asacca parairiṣṭaṃ dravyādi ityanumānabādhaprasaṅgācca
atha svarūpeṇa sata; tarhi sattāsambandhavaiyarthyam, yat svayaṃ sat na tatra sattāsambandhāt sattvam yathā sattāyām, svayaṃ sacca sattāsambandhāt prāgapi sakalaṃ vastu iti
svayaṃ sato'pi tatsambandhāt sattvakalpane sattāyāmapi tatkalpanaprasaṅgāt saiva anavasthā

atha na tatra svayaṃ sattvaṃ kintu sattāsambandhādeva, nanu ki tathaiva sattayā sambandhāt tatra sattvaṃ syāt, tadantareṇa vā ? yadi tathaiva, tadā anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi tasya sattve sattayā sambandhasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca sattvasiddhiriti
tadantarāt sattvasiddhau ca anavasthā; tathāhi–sattāntareṇā'pi sambandha vastunaḥsattve siddhe siddhyet, tatsattvasiddhiśca aparasattāntareṇa sambandhāt iti
dravyaguṇakarmaṇā svarūpasattvopagame sattāsamavāyasya vaiyarthyāt sāmānyādivat, sāmānyādīnā vā sattāsambandhaprasaṃgād dravyādivat
yad yato bhinnaṃ na tataḥ tasya sattvaṃ siddhyati yathā ghaṭāt paṭasya, arthebhyo bhinnā ca arthakriyā iti
na ca arthebhyo'syā bhinnatvamasiddham; pūrvottarakālabhāvitvena asyāḥ tato bhedaprasiddheḥ
pūrvasiddha eva hi bhāvo yatra kutracid arthakriyāyāṃ vyāpriyate
anyonyāśrayaśca–siddhe hi pūrvam arthasya sattve uttarakālabhāvinyāḥ tasyāḥ siddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tathāvidhasyā'rthasya sattvasiddhiriti

etena arthakriyākāritvāt tatsattvaṃ pratyākhyātam; yataḥ arthakriyākāritvam arthakriyāhetutvamucyate, tacca sata eva yuktamityanyonyā''śrayaḥ–siddhe hi sattve arthakriyākāritvasiddhi, tataśca sattvasiddhi iti
niranvayavināśitve cārthānām arthakriyākāritvaṃ prapañcataḥ prāgeva pratyuktam
tatkaraṇayogyatā'pi etena prativyūḍhā; pratikṣaṇavināśinyarthe arthakriyākāritvā'sambhave tatkaraṇayogyatāyāḥ nitarāmasaṃbhavāt
kiñca, arthakriyādikaṃ svayaṃ sat anyasya sattvahetuḥ, asadvā ? pakṣadvaye'pi sattvā'sattvapakṣoktadoṣā draṣṭavyāḥ
nāpi pramāṇasambandhāt; bhāvavad abhāve'pi asya gatatvāta tataśca abhāvasyāpi bhāvavat sadrūpatāprasaṅgaḥ tatsambandhā'viśepāt

atha tadaviśeṣe'pi yasya pramāṇasambandhena sattvaṃ bodhyate sa eva san nā'nyaḥ; kathamevaṃ pramāṇasambandhaḥ sattvalakṣaṇam ? kiñca, yadi tatsambandhāt prāgapi arthānāṃ sattvaṃ siddhaṃ syāt, tadā syādayaṃ parihāraḥ na ca tatsiddham; tatsambandhena arthānāṃ sattvakalpanāvaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt

kiñca, tatsambandhaḥ svayaṃ san, asan vā ? yadi asan; kathaṃ tatsambandhāt kasyacit sattvam atiprasaṅgāt ? atha san; kiṃ svataḥ, aparapramāṇasambandhāt, anyato vā kutaścit ? yadi svataḥ; padārthaiḥ kimaparāddhaṃ yena eṣāṃ svataḥ sattvaṃ neṣyate ? aparapramāṇasambandhāttu tatsattve anavasthā
anyato'pi–prameyasambandhāt, nimittāntarādvā tatsattvaṃ syāt ? yadi prameyasambandhāt; itaretarāśrayaḥ
atha nimittāntarāt; tarhi sarvatra tasyaiva avyabhicāriṇaḥ sattvahetutvamastu kiṃ pramāṇasambandhakalpanayā ? tacca utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktatvāt nānyad bhavitumarhati

kiñca, siddhe adhyakṣādirūpe pramāṇe tatsambandhena arthānāṃ sattvasiddhiryuktā, tatsiddhiśca indriyārthasambandhādisāmagrīto bhaviṣyati, evañca cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ; tathāhi–siddhe pratyakṣādipramāṇe tatsambandhena indriyārthānāṃ sattvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca satyāṃ tatsambandhādipramāṇasāmagrīsiddhiḥ, tasyāṃ satyāṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhiriti

kiñca, pramāṇasambandhena arthānāṃ sattvaṃ kriyate, jñāpyate vā ? na tāvat kriyate; tataḥ prāgapi arthānāṃ labdhātmalābhatvāt, yataḥ prāgapi yat labdhātmalābhaṃ na tasya sattvaṃ tena kriyate yathā putrātprāgapi labdhātmalābhasya pituḥ putreṇa, pramāṇāt prāgapi labdhātmalābhāśca ghaṭādayo bhāvā iti
atha jñāpyate; na kiñcidaniṣṭam, pramāṇasādhyatvāt prameyavyavasthāyāḥ, nahi pramāṇamantareṇa prameyavyavasthā yuktā atiprasaṅgāt
tadevam anyato vastunaḥ sattvā'nupapatteḥ utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktatvenaiva asya sattvaṃ pratipattavyam
na ca utpādādayo vastuno bhinnāḥ yena teṣāmapi aparotpādādiyogataḥ sattvena bhavitavyam ityanavasthā syāt, tattādātmyena teṣāṃ vyavasthitatvāt

dravyaṃ hi nityamākṛtiranityāsuvarṇaṃ kayācidākṛtyā yuktaṃ piṇḍo bhavati, piṇḍākṛtimupamṛdya rucakāḥ kriyante, rucakātikṛmupamṛdya kaṭakāḥ kriyante, kaṭakākṛtimupamṛdya svastikāḥ kriyante, punarāvṛttaḥ suvarṇapiṇḍaḥ punaraparayā ākṛtyā yuktaḥ khadirāṅgārasadṛśe kuṇḍale bhavataḥ, ākṛtiranyā anyā ca bhavati dravyaṃ punastadeva, ākṛtyupamardena dravyamevāvaśiṣyate
na nāśena vinā śoko notpādena vinā sukham
sthityā vinā na mādhyasyaṃ tena sāmānyanityatā

atha bhinnāratarhi pratyeka sthityādīnāṃ trilakṣaṇatvaprasaṅga sattvāt, anyathā tadasattvāpatte, tayā cānavasthānānna samīhitasiddhiriti kaścit, so'pi anālocitapadārthasvabhāva, pakṣadvayasyāpi kathañcidiṣṭatvāt, tatra tata kathaśidabhedopagame sthityādīnā sthitireva utpadyate sāmarthyād vinaśyati ca, vināśa eva tiṣṭhati sāmarthyād utpadyate ca, utpattireva naśyati sāmarthyāttiṣṭhatīti ca jñāyate trilakṣaṇājjīvādipadārthādabhinnānā sthityādīnā trilakṣaṇatvasiddhe
kutaḥ puna utpādādyanekāntātmakameva vastu prameyam ? ityāha–ekāntasya anulapabdheḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt anekāntātmā arthaḥ

yenā'śepakutarkavibhramatamo nirmūlamunmṛlitam, sphārāgādhakunītisārthamarito ni śeṣanaḥ śopitā | syādvādā'pratimaprabhūtakiraṇai vyāpta jagat sarvataḥ, sa śrīmān akalaṅkabhānurasamo jīyāt jinendraḥ prabhuḥ || 1
sa śrīmān akalaṅkabhānurasamo jīyāt jinendraḥ prabhuḥ || 1
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre dvitīyaḥ paricchedaḥ mamāpna | pra॰ 4300
anayā kārikayā matiḥ smṛti saṃjñā cintā'bhinibodha ityanarthāntaram tattvārthasū॰ 1
tulanā–matismṛtyādayaḥ śabdayojanamantareṇa na bhavantītyekānto na yatastatrasaṃkīryeran
tadekānte punarna kvacit syuḥ tannāmasmṛterayogāt, anavasthānādeḥ
anantavīryavidyānandābhayadevādyācāryābhiprāyeṇa śabdayojanāt prākkālabhāvinā matismṛtyādīnā matijñāne'ntarbhāvaḥ taduttarakālabhāvinā tu teṣā śrute'ntarbhāvaḥ iti

tathā ca teṣā granthāḥ–nanu matyādikaṃ sarvamabhighānapurassarameva svārthaṃ pratyeti iti śabdaśruta evāntarbhāvo'sya, tathā ca taccintane evāsya cintā bhaviṣyatīti pṛthagiha cintanamanarthakamiti cedatrāha–śabdayojanam ityādi
matismṛtyādayaḥ śabdayojanamantareṇa na bhavanti kintu tadyojane sati bhavanti ityevamekānto na, yata eva ekāntāt tatra antarbhāvyeran ityarthaḥ
yata iti vā ākṣepe naiva saṃkīryeran
sa cāsau ekāntaśca tasmin aṅgīkriyamāṇe punaḥ na kvacit vahirantarvā syuḥ matismṛtyādayaḥ
yasya nāmno yojanāt matismṛtyādayaḥ tat tannāma ityucyate tasya smṛterayogāt
na so'sti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte

atrākalaṅkadevā prāhu–jñānamādya smṛtiḥ tatreda vicāryate–matijñānādādyādābhinibodhikaparyantāccheṣa śruta śabdānuyojanādevetyavadhāraṇam, śrutameva śabdānuyojanāditi vā ? yadi śrutameva śabdānuyojanāditi pūrvaniyamaḥ tadā na kaścidvirodha, śabdasasṛṣṭajñānasya aśrutajñānatvavyavacchedāt
atha śabdānuyojanādeva śrutamiti niyamaḥ, tadā śrotramatipūrvakameva śruta na cakṣurādimatipūrvakamiti siddhāntavirodha syāt
sāvyavahārika śābda jñāna śrutamityapekṣayā tathāniyame tu neṣṭabādhā'sti cakṣurādimatipūrvakasyāpi śrutasya paramārthato'bhyupagamāt svasamayapratipatte
athavā na sosti pratyayo loke ya śabdānugamādṛte
ityekānta nirākartu prāgnāmayojanādādyamiṣṭa na tu tannāmasasṛṣṭamiti vyākhyānamākalakamanusarttavyam
atra ca yat śabdasayojanāt prāk smṛtyādikamavisavādivyavahāranirvartanakṣama pravartate tanmati, śabdasayojanāt prādurbhūta tu sarvaṃ śrutamiti vibhāgaḥ
vivṛtiḥ–avisavādasmṛteḥ phalasya hetutvāt pramāṇaṃ dhāraṇā, smṛtiḥ saṃjñāyāḥ pratyavamarśasya, saṃjñā cintāyāḥ tarkasya, cintā'bhinibodhasyānumānādeḥ

tulanā–dhāraṇāsvarūpā ca mati avisavādasvarūpasmṛtiphalasya hetutvāt pramāṇam, smṛtirapi tathābhūtapratyavamarśasvabhāvasajñāphalajanakatvāt, sajñāpi tathābhūtatarkasvabhāvacintāphalajanakatvāt, cintāpi anumānalakṣaṇābhinibodhaphalajanakatvāt, so'pi hānādibuddhijanakatvāt
tulanā–prāk śabdayojanāt matijñānametat śeṣamanekaprabheda śabdayojanādupajāyamānamaviśadaṃ jñāna śrutamiti kecit –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 553
yat prathamakārikāyāṃ śeṣam aviśada jñānamityuktam, tat kim ? §śrutam avispaṣṭatarkaṇam § śrutamavispaṣṭatarkaṇam ityabhidhānāt
kiṃ yat nāmayojanājjāyate'viśadaṃ jñānaṃ tadeva śrutam, utānyadapi ? ityāha– prāṅ nāmayojanāt
nāmnaḥ abhidhānasya yojanāt pūrvamupajāyate yadaspaṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ tacchutam nāmayojanājanitārthā'spaṣṭajñānasādharmyādityabhiprāyaḥ
cintā ca ityatra caśabdo bhinnaprakrama śabdānuyojanāt ityasyānantara draṣṭavyaḥ
tena na kevalaṃ nāmayojanāt pūrvaṃ yadaspaṣṭa jñānamupajāyate tadeva śrutaṃ kintu śabdānuyojanācca yadupa jāyate tadapi śrutam iti saṃgṛhītaṃ bhavati
cintā ca ityayaṃ caśabdaḥ punarbhinnaprakramaḥ matiḥ ityasyānantaraṃ smṛtisamuccayārtho draṣṭavyaḥ
indriyaprabhavaṃ matijñānaṃ tu deśato vaiśadyasaṃbhavāt sāṃvyavahārikaṃ pratyakṣamityuktam
tasya śrutasya ki kāraṇam ? ityāha –jñānamādyaṃ kāraṇam
pūrvapūrvapramāṇatve phalaṃ syāduttarottaram laghī॰ kā॰ 7 ityanena adhikāṃ kārikāṃ kṛtvā vyācaṣṭe– avisaṃvāda ityādinā
na vidyate visaṃvādo yasyāḥ sā cāsau smṛtiśca tasyāḥ
kathambhūtāyāḥ ? phalasya phalabhūtāyāḥ hetutvāt pramāṇaṃ dhāraṇā saṃskāraḥ
udghṛtamidam –siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 101B tulanā–matipūrvaṃ tato jñeya śrutamaspaṣṭatarkaṇam

nanu smṛteḥ svarūpato viṣayataśca vicāryamāṇāyā anupapatteḥ kasyā'visaṃvādaḥ prārthyeta, tathāhi–smṛtiśabdavācyasyārthasya svarūpaṃ jñātā, jñānaṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, pūrvottarajñānavyatiriktasya jñātu kasyacidapyasaṃbhavāt
dvitīyapakṣe'pi jñānamātram, anubhūtaviṣayaṃ vā jñānaṃ tacchabdavācyaṃ syāt ? prathamavikalpe pratyakṣāderapi smṛtirūpatāprasaṅgāt tadvyatiriktapratyakṣādipramāṇabhedavārttocchedaḥ syāt

atha yenaiva yadeva pūrvamanubhūtaṃ vastu punaḥ kālāntare tasyaiva tatraivopajāyamānaṃ jñānaṃ smṛtirityucyate, tadapyuktimātram, dhārāvāhipratyakṣasyāpi smṛtitvaprasaṅgāt, uktaprakriyāyāstatrāpyavikalatvāt
tulanā–nanu ko'ya smṛtiśabdavācyo'rthaḥ jñānamātram, anubhūtārthaviṣaya vā vijñānam ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 336
kiñca, anubhūte jāyamānam ityetat kena pratīyate–anubhavena, smṛtyā, ubhābhyāṃ vā ? na tāvadanubhavena, tatkāle smṛterevā'saṃbhavāt
yad asanna tat viṣayīkarttuṃ śakyaṃ yathā kharaviṣāṇam, asatī caanubhavakāle smṛtiriti
yad yatra yena na viṣayīkriyate na tasya tattatropajāyate iti pratītiryuktā yathā suptenā'viṣayīkṛte nīlasukhādiviṣaye jāgratpuruṣapratyaye, anubhavenā'viṣayīkṛtā ca atītārthe smṛtiriti
nāpi smṛteḥ; anubhavā'rthayora viṣayīkaraṇe anubhūte'hamutpannā ityanayā pratyetumaśakyatvāt
yadi ca anubhūtatā pratyakṣagamyā syāt tadā smṛtirapi jānīyāt anubhūte'hamutpannā iti, anubhavānusāritvāttasyāḥ
nacāsau pratyakṣagamyā, anubhūyamānatāmātra eva asya paryavasānāt
tulanā–nanu anubhūte jāyamānamityetat kena pratīyatām ? na tāvadanubhavena, tatkāle smṛterevāsattvāt –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 336
nāpi viṣayataḥ, tasyā hi viṣayaḥ arthamātram, anubhūtatāviśiṣṭo vā'rthaḥ ? na tāvadarthamātram, sakalapramāṇānāṃ smṛtitvaprasaṅgāt
nāpyanubhūtatāviśiṣṭaḥ, devadattānubhūte'rthe yajñadattajñānasya dhārāvāhivijñānasya ca smṛtitvaprasaṅgāpādanāt
yadavidyamānaviṣayaṃ na tat pramāṇam yathā khe keśapāśajñānam, avidyamānaviṣayañca anubhūtārthaviṣayatayā'bhipretaṃ smaraṇajñānamiti
na ca smṛtau asadarthaviṣayatvena etatsaṃbhavati, ataḥ kathamasau pramāṇamiti ?
tulanā–loke ca pūrvamupadarśitamartha prāpayan savādaka ucyate, tadvajjñānamapi svaya pradarśitamarthaṃ prāpayatsavādakamucyate
tathāhi–na jñāna janayadarthaṃ prāpayati api tvarthe puruṣa pravartayatprāpayatyartham
pravartakatvamapi pravṛttiviṣayapradarśakatvameva, na hi puruṣa haṭhāt pravartayitu śaknoti vijñānam arthakriyārthibhiścārthakriyāsamarthārthaprāptinimitta jñānaṃ mṛgyate
yacca tairmṛgyate tadeva tena śāstre vicāryate
yattāvaduktam–jñātā jñānaṃ vā ityādi, tadasamīcīnam, jñānasyaiva smṛtiśabdavācyatvapratijñānāt
nacaivaṃ sarvasya jñānasya smṛtitvamanuṣajyate, smṛtitvasya jñānamātraprayuktatvābhāvāt
jñānaviśepa eva hi saṃskāraviśepaprabhavaḥ tadityākāro'nubhūtārthaviṣayaḥ smṛtirityucyate
tatra kāraṇabheda– smṛteḥ paṭutarasaṃskārakāraṇakatvāt, pratyakṣādīnāñca cakṣurādihetukatvāt
smṛtirapi icchāvat pūrvajñānasadṛśa vijñāna pūrvavijñānaviṣaya vā smṛtirityucyate
tairevendriyairya paricchinno viṣayo rūpādistaṃ yat kālāntareṇa vinaṣṭamapi smarati tat smṛtijñānam
yadapyuktam–anubhūte smṛtirityetannānubhavena smṛtyobhābhyāṃ vā pratīyate ityādi, tadapyanalpatamovilasinam; trikālānuyāyinā pramātrā tatpratīteḥ karttu śakyatvāt
pūrvottarajñānavyatirikto na kaścit pramātā; ityapyayuktam; tadvyatiriktasyāsya santānaniṣedhāvasare prapañcataḥ prasādhitatvāt

nanvevaṃ pramātuḥ pratyakṣeṇa arthe'nubhūyamānatānubhave anubhūtatā'nubhavo'pi syāt tatsadbhāvā'viśeṣāt, tathāca gṛhītagrāhitvāt smṛterna prāmāṇyam; ityapyasat, atītakālanibandhanatayā anubhūyamānatākāle anubhūtatāyāḥ saṃbhavābhāvāt, pramātṛsadbhāvamātrasya tatpratipatti pratyanaṅgatvācca
smṛtisahāyo hi pramātā arthe'nubhūtatāṃ pratipadyate, pratyakṣasahāyastu anubhūyamānatāmiti

evaṃ kāraṇa-svarūpa-viṣayabhedena adhyakṣādibhyaḥ smṛterbhedasaṃbhave'pi aprāmāṇye kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam–tacca gṛhītagrāhitvam, paricchittiviśeṣābhāvaḥ, asatyatītārthe pravartta mānatvam, arthādanutpadyamānatvam, visaṃvādakatvam, samāropāvyavacchedakatvam, prayojanāprasādhakatvaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe kasya gṛhītasyārthasya smṛtyā grahaṇam–jñānasya, jñeyasya, jñānaviśiṣṭasya jñeyasya, tadviśiṣṭasya vā jñānasya ? na tāvajjñānasya; tadvyatiriktajñeyasya smṛtau pratibhāsanāt

atha jñeyasya, astu nāmaitat, tathāpi adhigatārthādhigamamātreṇa smṛternā'prāmāṇyam, anumānenādhigate'gnau taduttarakālabhāvino'dhyakṣasyāpyaprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt, pratyabhijñānā'numānayorapi kenacidaśena adhigatārthādhigamasabhavena aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgācca

atha adhigatārthādhigame'pyatra apūrvasyāpyarthāṃśasyā'dhigamasaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyam, kathamevaṃ smṛteraprāmāṇyaṃ tatrāpi hi varttamānakālāvacchedenā'dhigatasyārthasya atītakālāvacchedenā'dhigaterapūrvārthāśādhigamoṣapatteḥ ? prayogaḥ-smṛtiḥ pramāṇam, pramāṇāntaraprati panne'pyarthe kenacidaṃśenā'pūrvārthaparicchedakatvāt, yadyattathāvidhaṃ tattatpramāṇam yathā anumānādhigatārthe pratyakṣādi, tathā ca smaraṇam, tasmāt pramāṇamiti

tulanā–amuṣyāprāmāṇyaṃ kuto'yamāviṣkurvīta–kiṃ gṛhītārthagrāhitvāt, paricchittiviśeṣābhāvāt, asatyatīte'rthe pravartamānatvāt, arthādanutpadyamānatvāt, visavādakatvāt, samāropāvyavacchedakatvāt, prayojanāprasādhakatvādvā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 486
yad gṛhītagrāhi na tatpramāṇaṃ yathā smṛtiḥ
smṛtirhi tadityupajāyamānā prācī pratītimanuruddhyamānā na svātantryeṇārtha paricchinattīti na pramāṇam
na ca smṛti pramā, lokādhīnāvadhāraṇo hi śabdārthasambandha
ata eva na pramāṇa tasyā pūrvānubhavaviṣayatvopadarśanenārtha niścinvatyā arthaparicchede pūrvānubhavapāratantryāt
etadukta bhavati–sarve pramāṇādayo'nadhigatamartha sāmānyataḥ prakārato vā'dhigamayanti, smṛti punarna pūrvānubhavamaryādāmatikrāmati tadviṣayā vā tadūnabiṣayā vā natu tadadhikaviṣayā
jainatarkavārtikakārā hi arthāvinābhāvābhāvātsmaraṇasyāprāmāṇya svīkurvanti, tathāhi– evaṃ manyate vārtikakāra–arthāvinābhāvina eva jñānasya prāmāṇyamucita na smṛte arthamantareṇāpi tasyā bhāvāt
pratyakṣādestu avyabhicāranimittābhidhānāt kasyacid vyabhicāre'pi na dopaḥ, natveva smṛteravyabhicāranimittamasti
anubhavādutpadyamānā smṛtirarthamantareṇa bhavantī katha nīlādyākārā ? –pramāṇavārtikāla॰, manoratha॰ 2
bāhyendriyāṇā ca smṛtijanmani pratyeka vyabhicārādanta karaṇasya vyāpāro niścīyate
na ca tasya svātantryeṇa vahirviṣaye vyāpāra sambhavatītyanarthajatvameva nyāyyam tasmānnirviṣayatvameva
kasmāt smaraṇajñānamapramāṇamiti cet ? rajjusarpādijñānavat bhrāntatvāditi brūma
smṛtyā svārthaṃ paricchidya pravṛttau na ca bādhyate
tulanā–anumānenādhigate vahnau taduttarakālabhāvina pratyakṣasyāpyaprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 486

kiñcedaṃ jñeyasya jñānaviśiṣṭatvaṃ nāma–tatra saṃyogaḥ, samavāyaḥ, viśeṣaṇībhāvo vā ? tatra ādyapakṣadvayamanupapannam; jñeye jñānasyā'dravyatayā saṃyogā'saṃbhavāt, ātmani samavetatayā ca samavāyasyāpyanupapatteḥ
jñeyaviśiṣṭajñānapakṣastu na yuktaḥ, tatpratibhāsasya smṛtau svapne'pyasaṃbhavāt
nahi jñānaṃ nirviśeṣaṇaṃ saviśeṣaṇaṃ vā smṛtau pratibhāsamānaṃ kenacidiṣṭam, bahirvastuna eva tatra pratiprāṇi pratibhāsapratīteḥ
nāpyasatyatītārthe pravarttamānatvāt; yato'tītasyā'rthasya svakāle'sattvam, smṛtikāle vā ? na tāvat svakāle, tadā tasya vidyamānatvāt
smṛtikāle tu tadgrāhyasyā'sattvaṃ nā'prāmāṇyaṃ pratyaṅgam, pratyakṣasyāpi aprāmāṇyaprasakteḥ, tatkāle tadgrāhyasyāpyasattvā'viśeṣāt
bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ viduḥ
tulanā–yato'tītasyārthasya svakāle'sattvam, smṛtikāle vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 487
bhinnakālaṃ kathaṃ grāhyamiti ced grāhyatāṃ viduḥ
= prāgbhāvitvād bhinnakālaṃ vastu katha grāhyamiti cet ? hetutvameva jñāne ākārasya svānurūpasya arpaṇakṣama grāhyatā yuktijñā viduḥ
nimnagrantheṣu samuddhṛteyam–hetutvameva tadyuktaṃ jñānā –nyāyavā॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 153
arthādanutpadyamānatvañca adhyakṣe'pyaviśiṣṭam, jñānaṃ prati arthe kāraṇatvasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
yadyatrā'visavādakaṃ tattatra pramāṇam yathā pratyakṣādyarthe pratyakṣādi, avisaṃvādikā ca svapratipanne'rthe smṛtiriti
avisaṃvādo hi gṛhīte'rthe prāptiḥ, pramāṇāntaravṛttirvā syāt
yatra tu visaṃvādaḥ sā smṛtyābhāsā pratyakṣādyābhāsavat
tulanā–tasyāśca prāmāṇya yuktam, na hi tayā'rthaṃ paricchidya pravarttamāno'rthakriyāyā visaṃvādyate
samāropāvyavacchedakatvānna smṛtiḥ pramāṇam, ityapyasamīcīnam, tadgṛhīte'rthe viparītāropānanupraveśataḥ tadvyavacchedasabhavāt
yat samāropavyavacchedakaṃ tat pramāṇam yathā anumānam, samāropavyavacchedikā ca svapratipanne'rthe smṛtiriti
prayojanāprasādhakatvāt smṛteraprāmāṇyam, ityapyasundaram, anumānapravṛttilakṣaṇasya tatsādhyaprayojanasya sadbhāvāt
sādhyaprabindhaśca sattāmātreṇa tatpravṛtteraṅgam, parijñātaḥ san, smṛtikroḍīkṛto vā ? prathamapakṣe nālikeradvīpāyātasya apratipannāgnidhūmasambandhasyāpi dhūmadarśanādagnipratipattiḥ syāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu vālāvasthāyāṃ pratipannāgnidhūmasambandhasya punarvṛddhāvasthāyāṃ vismṛtatatsambandhasyāpi dhūmadarśanādagnipratipattiprasaṅgaḥ
tṛtīyapakṣe tu kathaṃ smṛteḥ prāmāṇyapratipedhaḥ anumānapravṛtteraṅgatvāt ? yadanumānapravṛtteraṅgaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ yathā pratyakṣam, tathā ca smaraṇam, tasmāt pramāṇamiti
tadevaṃ smṛteḥ kāraṇasvarūpaviṣayabhedāt pratyakṣādibhyo bhedaprasiddheḥ, svaviṣaye'visaṃvādaprasiddheśca sūktam–avisaṃvādasmṛteḥ phalasya hetutvāt pramāṇaṃ dhāraṇā iti
asyāḥ paryāyamāha–pratyavamarśasya sa evāyam, tena sadṛśo'yam iti vā ekatvasādṛśyābhyāṃ padārthānāṃ saṅkalanaṃ pratyavamarśaḥ
sādhyapratibandhaśca heto sattāmātreṇa anumānapravṛtteraṅgam, parijñāto vā, smṛtikoṭīkṛto vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 488
etaddvīpavāsino hi nālikeraphalamattvā tajjalañca nipīya jīvana yāpayanti, atastai pākārthamupayuktau agnidhūmau na dṛṣṭacarau
tulanā–ko hi smṛtipūrvakamanumānamabhyupagamya punastā nirākuryāt anumānasyāpi nirākaraṇānuṣaṅgāt
tulanā–pūrvamajñāsiṣamartha tamimaṃ jānāmīti jñānayo samāne'rthe pratisandhijñānaṃ pratyabhijñānam
pratyabhijñānaṃ hi nāma ādyapratyakṣanirodhe dvitīyadarśane prāgāhitasaṃskārābhivyaktau smṛtipūrvaṃ tṛtīyaṃ darśanam
anye manyante smaryamāṇapūrvajñānaviśeṣitārthagrāhitvāt tadviśeṣaṇasya cārthasya bāhyendriyagrāhyatvānupapatte stambhādāvapi mānasī pratyabhijñeti
loke hi sa evāyaṃ caitra iti pratisandhānenābhimukhībhūte vastuni jñāna pratyabhijñeti vyavahriyate
13 saṃjñājñānaṃ nāma yattairevendriyairanubhūtamarthaṃ prāk punarvilokya sa evāya yamahamadrākṣaṃ pūrvāhṇa iti saṃjñājñānametat
viruddhadharmādhyāsāt kāraṇābhāvādviṣayābhāvataśca nāsti pratyabhijñānasya prāmāṇyamiti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu pramāṇaprarūpaṇāvasare pratyabhijñāyāḥ prarūpaṇamayuktam; viruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ kāraṇābhāvācca asyāḥ svarūpasyaivā'saṃbhavāt, viṣayābhāvataḥ prāmāṇyānupapatteśca
tathāhi–pūrvaṃ jñātasya punaḥ kālāntare sa evāyam ityādijñānaṃ pratyabhijñā
na cāsyā ekatvaṃ yuktam, viruddhadharmādhyāsāt, yatra viruddhadharmādhyāsaḥ na tatraikyam yathā jalānalādau, viruddhadharmādhyāsaśca pratyabhijñāyāmiti
tathāhi–saḥ ityākāraḥ smaraṇarūpatayā pratyabhijñāyāmaspaṣṭaḥ, ayam iti cādhyakṣarūpatvāt spaṣṭa
sa evāyamiti pratyaya utpadyamānonaikatve pramāṇam ekatvasyāgrahaṇāt dṛṣṭasyaiva tasya pratipatteḥ
ekatvaṃ hi pūrveṇa saha gṛhyamāṇamekatā vivādaviṣayatāṃ svīkaroti
pūrvapratyayena cāsau truṭyadavastha eva pūrvatayā ca gṛhyate
tata punaranusandhīyamānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ gṛhītaṃ tathābhūtameva vā'nusandhātavyam
tasmād bheda eva pratyabhijñāne sati bhāsate iti kathamanena kṣaṇikatvānumānabādhā ? yadvā vastuna pūrvakālasambandhitvamidānīmasadeva pūrvakālābhāvāt
sattve vāsya varttamānakālasambandhitvameva syānna pūrvakālasambandhitva virodhādityuktam
tasmātpūrbakālasambandhitvasyāsato grāhaka sa iti jñānāśo bhūnta, anyathā vastuna spaṣṭabālādyavasthāgrāhaka syāt, na ca bhavati
tasmāt bhrāntāt pūrvadṛṣṭarūpāropeṇa sa evāyam iti jñānāt kathamanumānabādhā ? vistaratastvaya pratyabhijñābhaṅgavicāro nairātmyasiddhau kṛta iti tatraivāvadhārya
sā kiṃ smṛtyanubhavarūpa jñānadvayam, ekamevavā vijñānamaśe smṛtiraṃśe cānubhava, uta smṛtireva, āhosvidanubhava eva ? –khaḍanakhaṃḍa॰ pṛ॰ 156
prayogaścaiva ya pratyabhijñāpratyaya sa tattvato naikālambana yathā lūnapunarjātatṛṇādiṣu, pratyabhijñāpratyayaścāya tadeveda nīlādīti pratyaya iti viruddhavyāptopalabdhi

kiñca, sa evāyam ityākāradvayaṃ kiṃ tatra parasparānupraveśena pratibhāsate, ananupraveśena vā ? prathamapakṣe anyatarākārasyaiva pratibhāsa syāt, dvitīyākārasya tato'viviktasvarūpatvāt, yad yato'viviktasvarūpaṃ na tattano bhedena pratibhāsate yathā tasyaiva svarūpam, ekasmādākārādaviviktasvarūpañca dvitīyākārasvarūpamiti

dvitīyapakṣe tu parasparavibhinnapratibhāsadvayaprasaṅgaḥ, anyonyānanupraveśena ākāradvayasyāvasthānāt, yayoḥ anyonyānanupraveśena avasthānaṃ tayoḥ parasparavibhinnapratibhāsaḥ yathā rūparasayoḥ, anyonyānanupraveśenā'vasthānañca sa evāyam ityākāradvayasya iti
na ca pratibhāsadvayamekādhikaraṇametat ityabhidhātavyam; parokṣāparokṣākārayo pratibhāsayorekādhikaraṇatvānupapatteḥ, anyathā sarvasavidāmekādhikaraṇatvaprasakteḥ puruṣādvaitasiddhiḥ syāt
kintu jñānadvayametat–sa ityākārasya smaraṇarūpatvāt idamaśasya ca pratyakṣātmakatvāditi bhāva
kāraṇābhāvācca, tathāhi–tatkāraṇam indriyam, pūrvānubhavajanita saṃskāraḥ, tadubhayaṃ vā ? na tāvadindriyam, tasya varttamānārthāvabhāsajanakatvāt
astu vā; tathāpi na tat pramāṇam, viṣayābhāvāt
tasya hi viṣayaḥ–pūrvajñāne pratibhātameva vastu, tadatirikta vā ? tatrādyavikalpe na tat pramāṇaṃ gṛhītagrāhitvāt dhārāvāhijñānavat

dvitīyavikalpe'pi kikṛtastasya atirekaḥ–svarūpabhedakṛtaḥ, kāladvayasambandhakṛtaḥ, tatsambandhe aikyapratipattikṛto vā ? yadi svarūpabhedakṛtaḥ, tadā jñānavat jñeyasyāpi pratikṣaṇaṃ svarūpabhedaprasiddheḥ saugatamataprasaṅgaḥ
–yadeva hipramitikriyāsiddhau prakṛṣṭamupakaraṇa tadeva sādhakatamaṃ kārakaṃ pramāṇamucyate
yadi ca pratyabhijñā pūrvapramāṇagṛhītārthaviṣayā syāt tadā niṣpannapramitikriye'rthe pravṛttyā'sādha katamatvāt kathamiva pramāṇatāmaśnuvīta ? anyathā hi smṛterapi prāmāṇya syāt

atha kāladvayasambandhe devadattasya aikyaṃ pratīyate, ataḥ pūrvajñāne pratibhātasya vastunaḥ pratyabhijñānena ādhikyagrahaṇānna gṛhītagrāhitvena aprāmāṇyamityabhidhīyate; tadapyabhidhānamātram; yataḥ kimidamaikyaṃ nāma– ekatvasaṃkhyā, sthāyitvaṃ vā ? yadi ekatvasaṃkhyā; tadāsyāḥ pūrvameva pratipannatvāt kathamādhikyaparicchedaḥ pratyabhijñāyāḥ ? atha sthāyitvam, tat kiṃ devadattasvarūpād bhinnam, abhinnaṃ vā ? yadyabhinnam; tadā tatsvarūpavat tadapi pūrvajñānenaiva pratipannam
yadyato'bhinnaṃ tasmin pratīyamāne tadapi pratīyate yathā tasyaiva svarūpam, abhinnañca pratyabhijñāviṣayatvenā'bhipretaṃ vastunaḥ sthāyitvamiti

atha bhinnam; tat kiṃ pūrvamapyutpannam, atha pratyabhijñānasamaya evotpadyate ? yadi pūrvamapyutpannam, tadā pūrvajñānenaiva asya paricchedāt kathaṃ pratyabhijñānena ādhikyaparicchedaḥ ? kenacidaṃśena ādhikyaparicchedābhyupagame vā anavasthāto na prakṛtatattvasiddhiḥ
atha pratyabhijñānasamaya eva utpadyate, tarhi tasya pūrvamapratipannatvāt kathaṃ pratyabhijñāviṣayatvam ? pūrvapratipannasyārthasya punaḥ kālāntaregṛhyamāṇasya pratyabhijñāviṣayatvābhyupagamāt
tatsamaye sthāyitvasya utpattau ca kṣaṇikatvānuṣaṅgāt kathaṃ tadviśiṣṭārthānāmakṣaṇikatvaṃ syāditi
sa aṃśa vastusvarūpād bhinno'bhinno vā ? abhede vastusvarūpavat pūrvameva pratipatti
bhede kimasau pūrvamevotpanna, atha pratyabhijñāsamaya evotpadyate ? ityādirūpeṇa granthāvartanarūpā'navasthā

tatra kiṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmiṇā saha virodhaḥ, paraspara vā ? na tāvat dharmiṇā, tatra teṣāṃ pratīyamānatvāt, yadyatra pratīyate na tattatra viruddham yathā citrajñāne nīlādyākārāḥ, pratīyate ca pratyabhijñāne sa evāyam ityākāradvayam, tasmānna tattatra viruddhamiti
yat punaryatra viruddhaṃ na tattatra kadācidapyulabhyate, yathā turaṅgamottamāṅge śṛṅgam, upalabhyate ca pratyabhijñāne prāguktamākāradvayamiti
tanna dharmiṇā saha dharmāṇāṃ virodho yuktaḥ
parasparavirodhe tu dharmiṇaḥ kimāyātaṃ yenāsya viruddhadharmādhyāsād bhedaḥ prārthyeta ? dharmāṇāṃ hi parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇavirodhasabhave teṣāmeva anyonyaṃ bhedo yuktaḥ
tulanā–tatra yadi nāma darśanasmaraṇalakṣaṇayorākārayorvirodha, tathāpi dharmiṇa pratyabhijñānasya kimāyātaṃ yenāsya viruddhagharmādhyāsād bheda prārthyeta
kiñca, viruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ kāraṇabhūtāmyāṃ darśanasmaraṇākārābhyāṃ pratyabhijñānasya bheda sādhyeta, svabhāvabhūtābhyāṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣe siddhasādhanam
na khalu kāraṇasvarūpameva sarvathā kāryasvarūpam iti syādvādino manyante
dvitīyapakṣe'pi kathañcittadbhedaḥ sādhyeta, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit, tadā siddhasādhanameva, ākāratadvatoḥ kathañcidbhedābhyupagamāt
yo yatsvabhāvaḥ na tasya tadvata sarvathā bhedaḥ yathā citrajñānāt nīlādyākārasya, svabhāvaśca pratyabhijñānasya sa evāyam ityākāradvayamiti
taddhi pratyakṣa-smaraṇasāmagrītaḥ samupajāyamānaṃ kroḍīkṛtā''kāradvayamevopajāyate citrapaṭyādisāmagrīta citrākāraikajñānavat, pratyakṣādisāmagrīto nirvikalpetarākāraikavikalpavadvā
tulanā–viruddhābhyā darśanasmaraṇākārābhyā kāraṇabhūtābhyā svabhāvabhūtābhyā vā pratyabhijñānasya bheda sādhyeta ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 493
tulanā–yadi pārokṣyāpārokṣyadharmabhedāt pūrvāparāvasthāparāmarśajñāna bhidyeta, hanta bho, tadityapi vikalpo bhidyeta
tasmādviṣayabhedādavirodha iti cet, nanvihāpi tadevaika vijñāna tasyaivekasya vastuna pūrvadeśakālasambandhe parokṣam, aparokṣañcāparadeśakālasambandha iti ko virodha ? –nyāyavā॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 140
vikalpo hi svarūpe nirvikalpakamartharūpe ca savikalpakamiti saugatamatam

yadapyuktam–ākāradvayaṃ kiṃ parasparānupraveśena pratibhāsate ityādi; tatra ko'yamasya anupraveśo nāma–parasparasvarūpasāṅkaryam, ekasminnādhāre vṛttirvā ? prathamavikalpo' nupapannaḥ; pratītivirodhāt
dvitīyavikalpe tu nahi kiñcidaniṣṭam, ekasmin pratyabhijñākhye jñāne tadākāradvayasya nirbādhapratītau pratibhāsamānatvāt
yadyathā nirbādhāyāṃ pratītau pratibhāsate tattathaivābhyupagantavyam yathā nīlaṃ nīlatayā, pratibhāsate ca tathāvidhāyāṃ pratītau ākāradvayānvitatvenaikaṃ jñānamiti
na ca pramāṇaprasiddhe vastusvarūpe mithyāvikalpasaṃhati kiñcitkarttu samarthā sakalaśūnyatāderapi siddhiprasaṅgāt

kathañcaivaṃvādinaḥ citrajñānādeḥ siddhiḥ ? nīlādipratibhāsānāṃ hi parasparānupraveśe sarvepāmekarūpatāprasaṅgāt kutaścitratā ekanīlākārajñānavat ? teṣāṃ tadananupraveśe bhinnasantatinīlādipratibhāsānāmiva atyantabhedasiddheḥ nitarāmacitratā
ekajñānādhikaraṇatayā teṣāṃ pratyakṣataḥ pratīteḥ pratipāditadoṣānavakāśaḥ pratyabhijñāne'pyaviśiṣṭaḥ
darśanasmaraṇarūpamākāradvayaṃ parasparamanupraveśena'nanupraveśena vā pratibhāsate ityevaṃ vādina saugatasya
devadattasya nīlajñānaṃ yajñādattasya patijñāna indradattasya ca raktajñānaṃ yathā parasparato'tyantabhinnaṃ sat citraikarūpatā na pratipadyante tathaiva
kathaṃ vibhinnaviṣayayoḥ viminnākārayoścānayoḥ tatkāraṇateti cet ? tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt
yad yadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyi tat tatkāraṇakam yathā vījādyanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyī aṅkuraḥ tatkāraṇakaḥ, darśanasmaraṇānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinī ca pratyabhijñeti
na khalu vījādeḥ aṅkurakāraṇatāyāṃ citrapaṭyādeḥ citrajñānakāraṇatāyāṃ vā tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānādanyannibandhanamasti
yatpunaruktaṃ sāmagrībhedāt viruddhadharmasasargācca pratyabhijñājñānasya ekatvānupapattiriti; tadayuktam, samprayogasaskārayo sambhūyasāmagrītvāt
na cānyatra samprayogasaṃskārayo pratyekamanyonyanirapekṣayo kāraṇatvādekajñānakāraṇatānupapatti, yasmāt anyatra liṅgendriyayoranyonyanirapekṣayo dṛṣṭa sambhūyakāritvaṃ viśiṣṭānumitiṃ prati
idamākārollekhi hi darśanam tadākārollekhi ca smaraṇam

kiñca, idaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ kāryam, kāryañca pratīyamānaṃ kāraṇasadbhāvamavabodhayati, ataḥ kathamasya kāraṇābhāvo jyāyān ? tathāhi–yat kāryaṃ tat kāraṇapūrvakam yathā ghaṭādi, kāryañcedaṃ pratyabhijñānamiti

yadapyuktam–sato'pi pratyabhijñānasya na prāmāṇyam ityādi, tadapyasamīkṣitā bhidhānam, yato viṣayābhāvāt, gṛhītagrāhitvāt, vādhyamānatvādvā'sya aprāmāṇyaṃ syāt ? na tāvadviṣayābhāvāt, pūrvottaravivarttavarttyekadravyasya tadviṣayasya sadbhāvāt
yasya yataḥ svarūpavailakṣaṇyaṃ tasya tato viṣayavailakṣaṇyamapyasti yathā pratyakṣāt smaraṇasya, asti ca svarūpavailakṣaṇyaṃ pratyabhijñānasyeti
suprasiddhaṃ hi pratyakṣasmaraṇayoḥ spaṣṭetararūpatayā atītavarttamānaviṣayaparāmarśarūpatayā ca svarūpavailakṣaṇyād atītavarttamānakālāvacchedena viṣayavailakṣaṇyam, evamatrāpi
pratyakṣasya hi varttamānakālāvacchinno viṣayaḥ, smaraṇasya tu atītakālāvacchinnaḥ, pratyabhijñānasya tu ubhayakālāvacchinno dravyaviśeṣo viṣayaḥ
na cā'śeṣārthānāṃ pratikṣaṇa kṣaṇikatvāt dravyaviśepasya kasyacidapyasabhavāt kasya tadviṣayatā prārthyate ityabhidhātavyam, kṣaṇabhaṅgapratiṣedhena dravyasiddheḥ prāgeva prapañcato vihitatvāt
tulanā–tadaprāmāṇya hi gṛhītagrāhitvāt, smaraṇānantarabhāvitvāt, śabdākāradhāritvādvā, vādhyamānatvādvā syāt ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 343
pratyakṣe smaraṇe ca pratyekamiha tu yugapaditi viśeṣa –ā॰ ṭi॰
pratīyate tāvadetasmādvijñānāt pūrvāparakālāvacchinnameka vastutattvam, tadapyasya viṣayo na bhavatīti savidviruddham
grahaṇasmaraṇe ca naika viṣayamālambyete tasmādekameveda vijñāna pratītisāmarthyādubhayaviṣayamāstheyam
sa hi pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyeta, smaraṇena, pramāṇāntareṇa vā ? na tāvat pratyakṣeṇa, tasya varttamānavivarttamātragocaracāritayā atītavarttamānavivarttavarttino dravyasya grahaṇe sāmarthyā'sabhavāt
tadubhayasaṃskārajanitaṃ kalpanājñānamastīti cet, na, tasyaiva pratyabhijñānatvāt

tulanā– na hi tadviṣayabhūtameka dravya smṛtipratyakṣagrāhya yena tatra pravartamānaṃ pratyabhijñāna gṛhītagrāhi manyeta, tadgṛhītātītavartamānavivartatādātmyāt dravyasya kathañcidapūrvārthatve'pi pratyabhijñānasya tadviṣayasya nāpramāṇatva laigikāderapyapramāṇatvaprasagāt tasyāpi sarvathaivāpūrvārthatvāsiddhe
tulanā– pratyakṣasmaraṇajanitakalpanājñānamastīti ceta, na, tasyaiva pratyabhijñānatvenāsmābhirabhyupagamāt

nanu yadi pratyakṣasmaraṇayoḥ dravyamaviṣayaḥ tarhi kathaṃ tābhyāṃ tatra tajjanyeta ? yad yasya viṣayo na bhavati na tattatra jñānamutpādayati yathā cakṣū rase, aviṣayaśca ekatvaṃ pratyakṣasmaraṇayoriti; tadapyasundaram; vikalpotpādakā'vikalpakādhyakṣeṇa anekāntāt, tasya sāmānyāgocarasyāpi sāmānye vikalpotpādakatvapratīteḥ
vikalpavāsanāsahāyaṃ svāviṣaye'pi tatra tat tamutpādayati ityuttaram anyatrāpi tulyam, pratyakṣasyāpi smaraṇasahāyasya ekatve pratyabhijñānajanakatvapratīteḥ, sahakāriṇāmacintyaśaktitvāt
kathamanyathā asarvajñajñānam abhyāsaviśeṣasahāyaṃ sarvajñajñānaṃ janayet ? ekatvaviṣayatvañca pratyakṣasyāpi akṣaṇikatvasiddhau samarthitam
anyathā nirviṣayatvameva asya syāt, ekāntena anityatvamya kadācanāpyapratīteḥ
kevalaṃ tena ekatvaṃ pratiniyatavarttamānaparyāyādhāratayā arthe pratīyate, smaraṇasahāyapratyakṣaprabhavapratyabhijñānena tu smaryamāṇā'nubhūyamānaparyāyādhāratayeti viśeṣaḥ

ataḥ kathañcidapūrvārthatvasiddheḥ na gṛhītagrāhitvamasya yato'prāmāṇyaṃ syāt, anyathā anumānāderapi aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgaḥ sarvathā'pūrvārthaviṣayatvā'saṃbhavāt, tadviṣayasya deśādiviśiṣṭapāvakādivyaktiviśeṣasya sambandhagrāhijñānaviṣayāt sādhyasāmānyāt kathañcidabhinnasya kathañcit pūrvārthatvaprasiddheḥ
nirvikalpakaṃ ca paramārthasatsvalakṣaṇajanyatvāt vastuviṣayaṃ savikalpakaṃ tu buddhikalpitasāmānyagocaratvādavastuviṣayakaṃ prasiddham

tato yathā nirvikalpakaṃ sāmānyamajānadapi sāmānyaviṣayaṃ vikalpamutpādayati tathaiva atītavartamānobhayavivartavartinamekatvamajānatyapi pratyakṣasmaraṇe tadviṣayakaṃ pratyabhijñānamutpādayatāmiti bhāva
tasya hi bādhakaṃ pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvat pratyakṣam; tasya tadviṣaye pravṛttyabhāvāt
yad yadviṣaye na pravarttate na tattasya bādhakam yathā rūpajñānasya rasajñānam, na pravarttate ca pratyabhijñāviṣaye pratyakṣamiti
nāpyanumānam, tadviṣaye tasyāpyapravṛtteḥ, pravṛttau vā saṃvādakatvānna tadvādhakatvam

nanu lūnapunarjātanakhakeśādau bādhyamānaṃ tat pratītameva ataḥ kathaṃ tat pramāṇamiti cet ? yadi nāma tatra tattathā pratītam, anyatra kimāyātam ? anyathā śuktiśakale rajatābhāsapratyakṣasya bhrāntatvopalambhāt satyarajatepyasya bhrāntatvaprasaṅgaḥ
na hi pratyakṣaṃ tadbādhakaṃ tasya tadviṣaye pravṛttyasabhavāt, sādhakatvavad bādhakatvavirodhāt
tulanā–na ca lūnapunarjātanakhakeśādivat sarvatra nirviṣayā pratyabhijñā –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 342
tasminneva nakhe keśe vā sa evāya nakhādiriti pratyabhijñānaṃ kathaṃ bādhyamānamiti bhāva
nāpi sādṛśyapratyabhijñānasya; anumānānutpattiprasaṅgāt–yenaiva hi pūrvaṃ dhūmasahito'gnirdṛṣṭaḥ tasyaiva uttarakālaṃ pūrvadhūmasadṛśadhūmadarśanāt agnyanumānotpattiryuktā, nānyasya anyadarśanāt
na ca pratyabhijñānamantareṇa teneda sadṛśam iti pratipattirghaṭate, pūrvapratyakṣeṇa uttarasya tatpratyakṣeṇa ca pūrvasya dhūmādivastuno'pratipatte
na ca dvayā'pratipattau dviṣṭhaṃ sādṛśyaṃ pratipattuṃ śakyamatiprasaṅgāt
yad dviṣṭhaṃ tad dvayapratipattāveva pratīyate yathā sambandhaḥ, dviṣṭhañca sādṛśyamiti
tataḥ sidvā ekatvollekhinī sādṛśyollekhinī ca pratyabhijñā pramāṇam
anumānānutpattiprasaṅgāt, yenaiva hi pūrvaṃ dhūmo'gne –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 496
etadevāha–saṃjñā pramāṇa cintāyāḥ phalasya hetutvāt iti sambandhaḥ
kaḥ punarayaṃ tarko nāma iti cet ? vyāptijñānam
tadgrāhi jñānaṃ tarko'bhidhīyate, tatra tasyaiva pramāṇyātprāmāṇyāta, jñānāntarāṇāṃ tadgrahaṇe sāmarthyā'saṃbhavataḥ tatra prāmāṇyānupapatteḥ
cintājñānamāgāmino vastuna eva niṣpattirbhavati anyathā neti, yathaiva jñānāditrayasamanvite tatraiva paramasukhāvāptiranyathā netyetaccintājñānaṃ manojñānameva
yena tarka sa savādāt pramāṇa tatra gamyate
idamasmin satyeva bhavatyasati tu na bhavatyeveti ca

avijñātatattve sāmānyato jñāte dharmiṇi ekapakṣānukūlakāraṇadarśanāt tasmin saṃbhāvanāpratyayo bhavitavyatāvabhāsaḥ taditarapakṣaśaithilyāpādane tadgrāhakapramāṇamanugṛhya tān sukha pravartayan tattvajñānārthamūhastarka
vyāpakābhāvavattvena nirṇīte vyāpyasyāhāryāropādyo vyāpakasyāhāryāropa sa tarka
sambandho vyāptiripṭātra liṅgadharmasya liṅginā –mī॰ ślo॰ anu॰ ślo॰ 4
sāhacaryya tu sambandha iti no hadayaṅgamam
tasmin satyeva bhavane na vinā bhavanaṃ tata
tasmād yo vā sa bā'stu sambandha, kevalaṃ yasyāsau svābhāviko niyata sa eva gamako gamyaścetara sambandhīti yujyate
yathoktam–vyāptirvyāpakasya tatra bhāva eva vyāpyasya ca tatraiva bhāvaḥ pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 3
tatra vyāpye sati vyāpakasyāvaśyambhāvastasya vyāpti, vyāpyasya ca vyāpaka eva sati bhāvo nāma tasya vyāpti
tasya pakṣadharmasya sato vyāptiryo vyāpnoti yaśca vyāpyate vyāpyavyāpakadharmatayā pratīteḥ
yadā vyāpakadharmatayā vivakṣyate tadā vyāpakasya gamyasya bhāva eveti sambandhaḥ
tenāyamarthaḥ–yatra dharmiṇi vyāpyamasti tatra sarvatra vyāpakasya bhāva eveti vyāpakadharmo vyāptiḥ
natvevamavadhāryate vyāpakasyaiva tatra bhāva iti, hetvabhāvaprasaṅgāt, avyāpakasyāpi mūrtatvādestatra bhāvāt
yadā tu vyāpyadharmatā vyāptervivakṣitā tadā yatra dharmiṇi vyāpako'sti tatraiva vyāpyasya bhāvo nānyatra
atrāpi vyāpyasyaiva tatra bhāva ityavadhāraṇam hetvabhāvaprasaktereva nāśritam avyāpyasyāpi tatra bhāvāt
nāpi vyāpyasya tatra bhāva evetyavadhāryate, sapakṣaikadeśabṛtterahetutvaprāpteḥ, sādhāraṇasya ca hetutvaṃ syāt prameyatvasya nityeṣvavaśyambhāvāditi
vyāpakasya tatra bhāva ityanena cānvaya ākṣipto vyāpyasya vā tatraiva bhāva ityanena vyatireka ākṣipta

nanu vyāptisvarūpasyaivā'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ tatra tarkaḥ pramāṇam ? tathāhi–vyāptiḥ sambandho'rthānām, sā ca deśata kālato vā kasyacit kenacitsyāt ? na tāvad deśataḥ, yato vyomni dhūma, bhūmau agniḥ, upari deśe vṛṣṭi, adhodeśe nadīpūraḥ
nāpi kālataḥ, na hi vṛṣṭikāle nadīpūraḥ kṛttikodayakāle rohiṇyudayo vā'sti

tulanā–kiñca, sādhyasādhanayo vyāptiḥ ki yatra yatra sādhana tatra tatra sādhyamiti deśarūpā nirūpyeta, ki vā yadā yadā sādhana tadā tadā sādhyamiti kālarūpā, yugapadubhayasvabhāvā vā ? – hetubiḍa॰ pṛ॰ 4B
tulanā– deśavyāptimātrāṅgīkāre samagrajāgratprāmāṇikamānye dhūmānumāne'pi satyatābhimāno'bhimānaśālinā katha pṛthāpathamānīyate, tatra ca deśavyāpte svapnadaśāyāmapi vibhāvanābhāvāt
tathāhi–gaganamaṇḍalatalāvalambī dhūma parbatākharvanitambasambandhī ca dhūmadhvaja iti kva deśavyāptiriti

tulanā–udgato nabhaścandro jalacandrodayadarśanāt, āsītpūrvamasmin deśe vṛṣṭi uttaratra tathāvidhavāripūravilokanāt, bhaviṣyati vā vāribāhavṛṣṭiḥ tādṛgvārivāhavibhāvanāt, udeṣyati rohiṇī kṛtikodayāt, udeṣyati śva savitā adyatanādityodayadarśanāt, udaguḥ muhūrttātpūrva pūrvāphālgunī uttaraphālgunīnāmudayopalabdheḥ ityādi mānānāmanekeṣā deśakālobhayebhyo viprakṛṣṭānā kāryakāraṇapūrvacarottaracarahetuviśeṣāṇā deśakālobhayai kvāpi vyāptyanupapatterahetutvaprāpteḥ

kiñca, kasya kenāyamavinābhāvaḥ–kiṃ sāmānyasya sāmānyena, kiṃ vā sāmānyasya viśeṣaiḥ, uta viśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣai ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhyatā, nityatva-vibhutvābhyāṃ sakaladeśakālasambandhitayā agnitva-dhūmatvayoḥ suprasiddhatvāt
dvitīyapakṣe'pi deśakālānavacchinne viśeṣamātre sāmānyasyāvinābhāva, tadavacchinne vā ? yadyanavacchinne, tadā siddhasādhanameva
nahi mahānasasthadhūmasāmā nyasya parvatasthena agniviśeṣeṇā'nugamo'sti, parvatasthasya vā mahānasasthena
nāpi viśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣairniyamaḥ, sa hi dṛṣṭānāṃ dṛṣṭaiḥ, adṛṣṭānāmadṛṣṭaiḥ, dṛṣṭānāṃ vā adṛṣṭaiḥ syāt ? yadi dṛṣṭānāṃ dṛṣṭaiḥ, tadā siddhasādhanam, apūrvavyaktidarśane ca anumānānupapattiḥ
atha adṛṣṭānāmadṛṣṭaiḥ; tatrāpi sambandhagrahaṇābhāvādanugamābhāvācca kathamanumānam ? nāpi dṛṣṭānāmadṛṣṭaiḥ; pūrvoktadoṣaprasaṅgāt
tulanā–ito'pi avinābhāvasambandhagrahaṇānupapattiḥ–ki sāmānyayo sambandhāvadhāraṇam, āho svalakṣaṇayo, sāmānyasvalakṣaṇayorvā ? – tattvopa॰ pṛ॰ 65, 83

tathāhi-vyāptirbhavantī ki sādhanasādhyavyaktyorbobhoti, utāho sādhanatvasādhyatvajātyorvā, āhosvit sādhanavatsādhyavato, kiṃ vā sādhanatvavatsādhyatvavato, uta sāghanavattvasādhyavattvayo iti pakṣapañcatayī –hetubiḍa॰ pṛ॰ 4A
tulanā– kiṃ cānumāna pramāṇamupetyokta vastutastu na tanmānamityāha–viśeṣa iti
–vyaktyorvā vyāpti, jātyorvā, tadākrāntaviśeṣayorvā, dhūmavattvavahnimattvayorvā ? nādya, sarvopasahārāsiddhe
pratyakṣasiddhai pratyakṣasiddhasya avinābhāve siddhe'pi na kiñcitphalam, sādhya-sādhanayo pratyakṣatvāt, tathā ca nānumānaprāmāṇyamiti bhāva
kiñca, avinābhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa ca sambandhigrahaṇapūrvakaḥ, sambandhinau ca dvau dvau viśeṣau, ataḥ kathaṃ sarvopasaṃhāreṇa vyāptirgrahītuṃ śakyā ?
api tu yau dvau sambandhinau mahānasīyadhūmāgnī pratyakṣaviṣayau syātām tayoreva sambandho gṛhīta syāt na sakalasādhyasādhanavyaktīnām
kiñca, ayamavinābhāvaśabdaḥ sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvaṃ vadatīti vyatirekamātravacanaḥ, na sambandhavacanaḥ
kiñca, agnyabhāve dhūmo nopapadyate iti dhūmānupapatteḥ agnyabhāvo viśeṣaṇam
pāramārthikatve avidyamānatvāt dhūmasya na tadāśritā vyāptirgrahītuṃ śakyā, nahi agṛhyamāṇe āśraye tadāśritaṃ grahītuṃ śakyamatiprasaṅgāt
apāramārthikatve tu upādheḥ tadupahitāyā dhūmānupapatterapi §apāramārthikatvaṃ syāt, tathā cā'numānasyāpi § apāramārthikatvameva āyātam

athaivamucyate–agnyabhāvaśced dhūmasadbhāvasyānupapattiḥ, agnyabhāvasya dhūmābhāvena vyāptatvāt; tadapyanupapannam; vidyamānā gṛhītā ca vyāptiḥ anumānāṅgam na prasajyamānā, tasyāḥ sattvenāpyaniścitatvāt
saṃbhāvanājñānaṃ caitat, na ca tad vastuparicchedakam yathā bhūmiścennābhaviṣyad apatiṣyan parvatāḥ iti
agnyabhāvaścet syāt dhūmasadbhāvasyānupapatti syāt ityākāraka pūrvoktaṃ jñānam
kiñca, ekasya kasyacidagnerabhāve dhūmo nopapadyate, sarvasya vā ? na tāvadekasya; asyābhāve'pi agnyantare dhūmasadbhāvasyopapadyamānatvāt
dhūmānupapatteśca aśeṣāgnyabhāva evopādhiḥ, na cāsau sarvāgniṣvagṛhīteṣu grahītuṃ śakyate, abhāvagrahaṇasya pratiyogyāśrayagrahaṇasavyapekṣatvāt
kasyacidekasya agnerabhāvepi aśeṣāgnyabhāvaviśiṣṭo dhūmābhāva ityākārakaviśiṣṭagrahaṇasya anupapatteritibhāva
yasyābhāva kriyate sa pratiyogī yathā aśeṣāgnyabhāve karttavye aśeṣāgni pratiyogī, yasmin abhāva kriyate sa āśraya, yathā trikāle triloke ca aśeṣāgnyabhāve prastute kālatraya trilokaśca āśraya
mānasa nāstitājñāna jāyate'kṣānapekṣayā –mī॰ ślo॰ abhā॰ ślo॰ 27 ityabhidhānāt
api ca kvacidagnyabhāvābhāve'pi dhūmābhāve dhūmasadbhāvasya virodho dṛṣṭaḥ, ato nāgnyabhāvo dhūmabhāvavirodhasya upādhiḥ, kintu dhūmābhāva eva

ato na vyāptirvicāryamāṇā dhaṭate, tatkathaṃ tadgrāhiṇaḥ tarkasya tatprabhavānumānasya vā prāmāṇyam ? astu vā vyāptiḥ, tathāpi avinābhāve satyapi na dhūmād vahnipaiṅgalyamanumīyate vahnereva dhūmena anumīyamānatvāt
tathā niyatatvāviśeṣe'pi dhūma eva gamako na tadgatāḥ śyāmatvādaya iti
tulanā–api ca yatsadbhāva eva yasya nivṛtti tenaiva tasya virodha, tadiha dhūmābhāva eva sati dhūmasya nivṛttirdṛśyata iti dhūmābhāvenaiva asya virodho natvagnyabhāvena

yadi hi agnyabhāva dhūmābhāvasya upādhi syāt tadā upādhyapāye upādhimato'bhāvāt iti nyāyena aṅgārāvasthāgnimatpradeśe agnyabhāvasya abhāvo vidyate atastatra dhūmābhāvasyāpi abhāva prāpnoti, na ca tatra dhūmābhāvasyābhāva dhūmasadbhāvarūpa samasti
ata nāgnyabhāva dhūmābhāvasya viśeṣaṇam api tu dhūmanivṛttireva

yattāvaduktam–vyāptisvarūpasya ityādi, tadasamīcanam, yataḥ svarūpaprayuktasyā'vyabhicārasya vyāptitvapratijñānāt kathaṃ tasyāḥ svarūpāsaṃbhavaḥ ? svarūpaṃ hi sādhyasādhanayoḥ svadharmakalāpakalitam agnitvaṃ dhūmatvañca, taddhi anyato deśakālākārādervyāvarttya prakarṣeṇa sambandham ātmanyeva yojayati
madadhīnāmeva vyāptiṃ budhyasva budhyasva ityātmasambandhitvenaiva vyāptiṃ vyavasthāpayat svaprayuktāmeva vyāptiṃ boddhāraṃ bodhayati
yadapyuktam–deśataḥ kālato vā'vinābhāvo na saṃbhavati' iti, tadapyetena pratyuktam; tadvataḥ tadvatā avinābhāvasya nirbādhabodhādhirūḍhapratibhāsatvāt
tulanā–dhūmo hi yatra yatreti sāmanyenaiva gṛhyate
deśakālī paripatya svarūpamātreṇaiva dhūmāderagnyādinā sahāvinābhāvasya nirvādhabodhādhirūḍhatvāt
tulanā–yo yathā niyato yena yādṛśena yathāvidha

yaccānyaduktam–kasya kena vyāptiḥ iti; tatra yasya yena avyabhicāraḥ tasya tena vyāptiḥ, sāmānyaviśeṣavataśca dhūmādeḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavatā'gnyādinā'vyabhicārāt tasya tenaiva vyāptiḥ, ataśca uktadoṣānavakāśaḥ
na ca kevalau sāmānyaviśeṣau gamyagamakarūpatayā anubhūyete, jātyantararūpasyaiva ubhayātmanaḥ tadrūpatayā'vabhāsanāt
yo yasya deśakālābhyā samo nyūno'pi vā bhavet
sa vyāpyo vyāpakastasya samo vā'bhyadhiko'pi vā
yadapyabhihitam–avinābhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa ca sambandhigrahaṇapūrvakaḥ ityādi; tadapyanenaiva pratyākhyātam; sāmānyopalakṣitaviśeṣayorvyāpteḥ sarvopasaṃhāreṇaiva saṃbhavāt

yadyapi agniviśeṣā dhūmaviśeṣāścānantyenāvasthitā tathāpi teṣvavasthitamagnitva dhūmatvañca sāmānyamupagrāhakamastīti tadupagrāhakavaśāt bhūyodarśanabalādagnidhūmayordeśādivyabhicāre'pyavyabhicāragrahaṇam –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 570
yāvān kaściddhūma sa kālāntare deśāntare ca agnijanmaiva anagnijanmā kadāpi na bhavatītyevaṃ prakāreṇa
yaccocyate–avinābhāvaśabdo vyatirekamātravacano na sambandhavacanaḥ; tadapyuktimātram; yato'vinābhāvaśabdo na vyatirekamātre paryavasyati ghaṭādyabhāve'pi tatpravṛttiprasaṅgāt, kintu niyame
sa ca niyamaḥ tathopapatti-anyathānupapattiprakārābhyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ, ataḥ tāvubhāvapi avinābhāvaśabdena ucyete, yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatrāgniḥ, yatrāgnirnāsti tatra dhūmo'pi nāsti iti

nanu yatrāgnirnāsti tatra dhūmo'pi nāsti ityetat kuto'vagamyate iti cet ? agnyabhāve dhūmasya niyamena apratīyamānatvāt tatsadbhāvaniyata evā'sau, anyathā yathā dhūmābhāve'pi kvacidagnirupalabhyate tathā agnyabhāve dhūmo'pi kvacidupalabhyeta
yasya yena vinā nānupapattirna sa tena niyataḥ yathā dhūmābhāvepyupapadyamāno'gnirna dhūmena niyataḥ, agninā vinā'nupapattiśca dhūmasya, tasmādasau tanniyata iti
tulanā–avinābhāva eva hi niyama, sādhyaṃ vinā na bhavatīti kṛtvā

yadapyuktam–agnyabhāvasya pāramārthikatve dhūmasyāvidyamānatvānna tadāśritā vyāptirgrahītu śakyā iti, tadapyasamīcīnam, yato yatraiva deśe kāle vā vāstavo'gnyabhāvaḥ tatraiva dhūmasya avidyamānatvaṃ na sarvatreti kathaṃ tadāśritā vyāptiḥ pratyetumaśakyā ?

yadapi–ekasyāgnerabhāve dhūmo nopapadyate sarvasya vā ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam, yato vyāptiḥ sarvākṣepeṇa pratīyate yaḥ kaścid dhūmaḥ sa sarvo'gnyabhāve'nupapannaḥ iti, na punaḥ ekaikadharmyullekhena parvate gṛhe araṇye vā dhūmo'gnyabhāve'nupapannaḥ iti
tathā tatpratipattau anantenāpi kālena vyāptipratipattirna syāt dharmiṇāmānantyāt
anumānavaiphalyaprasaṅgācca, agnidhūmavatāmaśepāṇāṃ dharmiṇāṃ vyāptigrahaṇakāla eva gṛhītatvāt
tulanā–tatra sarvasyeti brūma, yato dhūmānupapatti sarvākṣepeṇa pratīyate yāvān kaścid dhūma sa sarva sarvasyāgnerabhāve'nupapanna –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 506
pratiniyatadharmivyaktinirdeśena vyāptipratītau ānantya bādhakam tadāha tatheti

na ca sarvāgniṣvagṛhīteṣu dhūmānupapatterviśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ tadabhāvo grahītumaśakya ityabhidhātavyam, yataḥ tadabhāvaḥ tadanyadeśādisvabhāvaḥ, bhāvāntarasvabhāvatvādabhāvasya, tucchasvabhāvā'bhāvasya nirākaripyamāṇatvāt
sa cākhilāgnivivikto deśādiḥ pratyakṣata eva pratīyate
vyavahāra eva hi pratiyogigrahaṇasavyapekṣaḥ na svarūpapratipattiḥ, kathamanyathā ghaṭāderapi pratipatti syāt tatsvarūpasyāpi trailokyavilakṣaṇatayā trailokyāpratipattāvapratipattiprasaṅgāt ?
atra ghaṭābhāva atra agnyabhāva iti vyavahāra

yacca–agnyabhāvābhāve'pi kvacid dhūmābhāve dhūmasadbhāvasya virodho dṛṣṭaḥ ityādyabhihitam, tadapyabhidhānamātram; agnyabhāve sati dhūmasadbhāvasya niyamena nivarttamānatvāt tadvirodhe svābhāvasyeva agnyabhāvasyāpi nimittatvopapatteḥ
yad yasmin sati niyamena nivarttate tattadvirodhanimittam yathā uṣṇasparśasadbhāve śītasparśaḥ, niyamena nivarttate cāgnyabhāve dhūmasadbhāva, tasmād dhūmavirodhasyāsau nimittamiti
nanu agnyabhāve dhūmasya niyabhena nivarttamānatvamasiddham, gopālaghaṭikādau tadabhāve'pi tatsadbhāvapratīteḥ, ityapyasat; tatrāpi tatsadbhāva eva tadbhāvasaṃbhavāt

dhūmasya hi bhāvaḥ ātmalābhaḥ, sa ca agnau satyeva saṃvṛttaḥ, tatkathaṃ tatra agnyabhāve dhūmasadbhāvāśaṅkāpi ? tarhi parvatādāviva gopālaghaṭikādāvapi dhūmo'gniṃ gamayet; ityapyayuktam; parvatādidhūmādasya vailakṣaṇyāt
vahnisamānasamayasattāko hi parvatādidhūmo bahalapatākāyamānasvarūpo'nubhūyate, na cāyaṃ tathā, ato nāsya agnyanumāpakatvam
tulanā–tasmāt yatsadbhāve yasya niyamena nivṛtti tena tadviruddhameva, agnyabhāve ca sati dhūmasya niyamena nivartamānatvāt dhūmābhāveneva tenāpi tasya virodha
tathāhi yasmin sati yanniyamena nivartate –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 507
vahnisamānasamayasattāko hi parvatādidhūmo vahala patākāyamānasvarūpo'nubhūyate –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 507

yadapyuktam–avinābhāve satyapi na dhūmāt paiṅgalyamanumīyate ityādi; tadapyasaṅgatam; yato vyāptyanusāreṇa anumānaṃ vidhīyate, vyāptiśca agnitva-dhūmatvadvāreṇaivāvasīyate na paiṅgalyādidharmadvāreṇa, teṣāmānantyāt vyabhicārācca
paiṅgalyaṃ hi haritālakāñcanādau vyabhicaradupalabhyate, bhāsuratvaṃ sūrya-tārakā-taḍidādau, dravyatvaṃ navasvapi dravyeṣu, ūrdhvagatitvaṃ vātyādau, iti agnigatānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ vyabhicāraḥ
tathā dhūmagatānāmapi; tathāhi–śyāmatvaṃ nīlāñjanādau, kaṭukatvaṃ trikaṭukādau, akṣivikārakāritvaṃ kaṭutailādau, kaṇṭhagrāhitvam apakvajambūphalādau, ūrdhvagatitvaṃ vāṣpādau sādhāraṇaṃ dṛśyate
ato yena ekenaiva rūpeṇa trailokyodaravarttinyo vahnivyaktayo dhūmavyaktayaḥ taddharmāśca saṃgṛhyante tadeva rūpaṃ vyāptiṃ niyamena vyavasthāpayati, tacca agnitvadhūmatve muktvā nānyad bhavitumarhati
na khalu yathā vastvantarasādhāraṇāḥ paiṅgalyādayaḥ tathā agnitva-dhūmatve
tadvācake coccarite śabde pratipatrā trailokyavilakṣaṇaḥ svadharmakalāpakalito'gniḥ dhūmaścārthaḥ saṃgṛhyate iti siddhā taddvāreṇa vyāptiḥ sādhyasādhanayoḥ
tulanā–yato vyāptyanusāreṇānumānaṃ vidhīyate, vyāptiścāgnitvadhūmatvadvāreṇaivāvamīyate – syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 507
trayāṇā kaṭūnāṃ śuṇṭhīmarīcapippalīnā samāhāra trikaṭukam viśvopakulyā marica traya trikaṭu kathyate
kaṭutrayaṃ tu trikaṭu vyūṣaṇa vyoṣa ucyate
nanu yadi anayoḥ vastuto vyāptirasti tarhi prathamadarśanakāle kasmānnollikhatīti cet ? grāhakābhāvāt
yatkāle yadgrāhakaṃ nāsti tatkāle tanna pratibhāsate yathā rūpadarśanakāle rasaḥ, agnidhūmayoḥ prathamadarśanakāle nāsti ca vyāptigrāhakaṃ jñānamiti
na ca grāhakābhāvāt tadā vyāpterapyabhāvaḥ, tadā grāhakābhāvasya anyathāsiddhatvāt, anyathā dūre rūpadarśanakāle rasasyāpyabhāvaḥ syādaviśeṣāt
tadā vyāpterabhāve ca katha paścāt pratibhāseta khapuṣpavat ?
tulanā–vyāptijñānasya hi kāraṇamupalambhānupalambhau, na ca prathamadarśanakāle tau sta
atha anvayavyatirekavaśāt pratibhāseta, nanu anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sā kiṃ janyate, jñāpyate vā ? na tāvajjanyate, tau hi pramāṇam, na ca pramāṇa prameyamutpādayati
atha jñāpyate, tatrāpi kiṃ tatkāle satī sā jñāpyate, prāgapi vā ? tatkāle cet, na, anvayavyatirekakāla eva vyāpte sattve kāraṇābhāvāt
atha prāgapi satī jñāpyate; siddhaṃ tarhi prathamadarśanakāle'pi vyāpteḥ sattvamiti kathaṃ sā tadgrāhakatarkaśca apahnūyeta ? pratīyamānasyāpyapahnave rūpādeḥ tadgrāhakajñānasya vā'pahnavaḥ syāt
anvayavyatirekagrāhiṇau upalambhānupalambhāveva atra anvayavyatirekaśabdena vivakṣitau viṣayayidharmasya viṣayepyupacārāt
kuta etat ? śeṣam aspaṣṭaṃ yataḥ, śabdānuyojanāt ityetanmadhye karaṇāt anena ca sambadhyate
tadyojanāt yat pūrvam arvāg aspaṣṭam tadyojanācca yaccheṣamaspaṣṭa tat sarvaṃ śrutajñānamitiṃ
nanu vyāptipratītyarthaṃ tarkalakṣaṇapramāṇābhyupagamo'nupapannaḥ, pratyakṣato'numānato vā tasyāḥ pratītisiddheḥ ityāśaṅkāṃ nirākurvannāha–
kayā ? avikalpadhiyā nirvikalpakapratyakṣeṇa saugatābhipretena, yāvān kaściddhūma sa sarvopyagnijanmaiva anagnijanmā vā na bhavatītyetāvadvikalpavikalatvāttasya anyathā savikalpakatvāpatte
prathamānumānāt dvitīyānumāne vyāptinirṇaya iti cet, soya parasparāśrayadoṣa
tannānumānamapi vyāptigrāhakamiti tadgrāhakaṃ pramāṇāntara tarkākhyam āñjasaṃ pāramārthika na mithyāvikalpātmakamabhyupagantavyam, anyathā anumānaprāmāṇyāyogāt
vivṛtiḥ–nahi pratyakṣaṃ yāvān kaściddhūmaḥ kālāntare deśāntare ca pāvakasyaiva kāryaṃ nārthāntarasya iti iyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samarthaṃ sannihitaviṣayabalotpatteravicārakatvāt
nahi sākalyena liṅgasya liṅginā vyāpterasiddhau kvacit kiñcidanumānaṃ nāma
tanna apratyakṣam anumānavyatiriktaṃ pramāṇam ityayuktam; liṅgapratipatteḥ pramāṇāntaratvāt
