na hi kasyacit sākalyena vyāptijñānaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kvacit kadācid bhavitumarhati sannihitaviṣayabalotpatteravicārakatvāt
yathāhu– na hīdamiyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samarthaṃ sannihitaviṣayabalenotpatteravicārakatvāt
tulanā–sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭayo sākalyenedantayā nedantayā vā vyavasthāpayitukāmasya tarka paraṃ śaraṇam
liṅgaṃ hi sādhyena sādhanasya avinābhāvo'bhidhīyate, tasmin satyeva liṅgasya liṅgatvopapatteḥ

tasya pratipattiḥ kiṃ pratyakṣāt, anumānato vā syāt ? pratyakṣāccet; kim asmadādisambandhina, yogisambandhino vā ? prathamapakṣe kiṃ svasaṃvedanāt, indriyajāt, mānasādvā tato'sau pratīyeta ? na tāvat svasaṃvedanāt; tasya svarūpamātraviṣayatayā bahirarthavārttānabhijñatvāt
indriyamanaḥprabhavādapi pratyakṣāt savikalpāt, nirvikalpādvā avinābhāvaḥ pratīyeta ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; savikalpakapratyakṣasya saugataiḥ prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt
tadabhyupagame'pi na tattatra samartham, ityāha–na pratyakṣam ityādi
pratyakṣaṃ saugatayaugakalpitaṃ mānasendriyalakṣaṇam tanna yāvān kaścid dhūmaḥ kālāntare deśāntare ca pāvakasyaiva kāryaṃ nārthāntarasya iti iyato vyāpārān karttuṃ samartham
sannihitaḥ aviprakṛṣṭadeśakālo yo viṣayaḥ agnidhūmādiḥ sādhyasādhanavyaktilakṣaṇaḥ tasya balaṃ sāmarthyaṃ tena utpatteḥ
etena nirvikalpakamapi na tat tataḥ tatra samarthamiti pratipattavyam
na vidyate vicāraḥ yāvān kaścid dhūmaḥ sa sarvo'gnereva kārya nārthāntarasya iti parāmarśo yasya nirvikalpakapratyakṣasya tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
kathamasyā'vicārakatvamiti cet ? kasyacit parokṣatvāt, aparasya jñānāntaravedyatvena anavasthānāt, anyasya kṣaṇikatvavadakiñcitkaratvāt
yathā hi kṣaṇikāśe nirvikalpaka sañjātamapi na tanniścinoti ata kṣaṇikāśe akiñcitkara nirvikalpaka tathaiva nīlādyaśe'pi
prathamapratyakṣe'pi agnisambandhitvenaiva dhūmasya pratibhāsanāt tadgato niyamo'pi pratibhāsata eva
na ca tatrāpyanyato'pi, anyata eva veti saśayaviparyayau staḥ, agnereva ayam iti tatsambandhitvenaiva asyā'vasāyāt
itthaṃ prathamapratyakṣeṇa vyāptau pratipannāyām anvayavyatirekau bhūyasopalabhyamānau tasyaiva jñānasya dārḍhyamutpādayataḥ
nanu yadi prathamapratyakṣeṇaiva vyāptiḥ pratīyate tarhi kimityayamanena niyata ityevaṃrūpā tadānīmeva vyāptipratītirnotpadyate iti cet ? sāmagryabhāvāt
anusandhānañca sakṛdekena sahitasya grahaṇe anu paścād apareṇa sahitasyaiva grahaṇam
anekasahacāridarśane hi prayojake sandehaḥ–ki dhūmatvaprayukto'yaṃ niyamaḥ, ki vā tārṇatvaśyāmatvādiprayuktaḥ ? iti
tatra tārṇatvādayaḥ sambandhino vyabhicāriṇaḥ, śyāmatvādayastu dhūmāpekṣāḥ, iti dhūmasya agnisambandhitve dhūmatvameva prayojakam

tasmin sati na kadācidagnitvaṃ vyabhicaratīti bhūyodṛṣṭānvayavyatirekavato visphāritākṣasya anuparatendriyavyāpārasya aparokṣākāratayā upajāyamānatvāt viśiṣṭadaṇḍyādipratyayavat pratyakṣamevedaṃ vyāptijñānamiti
tatrānyatopyanyata eveti ā॰, tatrāpyanyata eveti ba॰
aya dhūma kimagnerjāta uta anyasmādapi karaṇāt iti saśaya
dhūmo'yam agnivyatiriktādanyasmādeva kasmāccit kāraṇājjāta iti viparyaya
evaṃ mānāntaraviditasambandhiṣu mānāntarāṇyeva yathāsva bhūyodarśanasahāyāni svābhāvikasambandhagrahaṇe pramāṇānyunnetavyāni
tadanena anvayavyatirekāveva bhūyodarśanasahacāriṇau tadgrahaṇopāya iti darśitam
tathāhi–maṇiryaiyairviṣayaistattadvyavahāraviṣayo bhavati dhārayitu tattatphalasampādakaśconnīyate te sūkṣmaviśeṣā parīkṣakeṇa bhūyobhireva darśanairunnīyante tathātrāpi
prathama hi kākatālīyavyudāsāya tata sātatyordhvagamanaviśepaniścayāya tataścopādhinirāsāya
sahabhāvadarśanajasaskārasahakāriṇā nirastapratipakṣaśakena caramapratyakṣeṇa dhūmasāmānyasya agnisāmānyena svabhāvamātrādhīnaṃ sahabhāva niścitya idamanena niyatamiti niyama niścinoti
yadyapi prathamadarśane'pi sahabhāvo gṛhīta tathāpi na niyamagrahaṇam
na hi sahabhāvamātrānniyama api tu nirupādhikasahabhāvāt
nirupādhikatvañca tasya bhūyodarśanābhyāsāvajñeyamityetena bhūya sahabhāvagrahaṇabalabhuvā savikalpakapratyakṣeṇa so'dhyavasīyate
tadvirahaśca kvacidvipakṣabādhakatarkāt kvacit svata siddha eva

yattāvaduktam–pratyakṣeṇaiva avinābhāvaḥ pratīyate ityādi; tatra kim aindriyam, mānasaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ tadgrahaṇe pravartteta ? na tāvad aindriyam, taddhi yenārthena pratiniyatadeśakālādinā indriyaṃ sambadhyate tameva avabhāsayati na tu vyāptim, tasyāḥ sakaladeśakālakalāparigatārthākṣepeṇa avasthitatvāt
yato vyāpanaṃ vyāptiḥ, sarvāsāṃ vyāpyavyaktīnāṃ vyāpakavyaktīnāñca vyāpyarūpatayā vyāpakarūpatayā ca kroḍīkaraṇam
na ca tatra indriyasya sambandho grahaṇasāmārthya vā sabhavati; varttamāne niyata evārthe tatsaṃbhavāt
na ca viśvodaravarttinyo vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ tena sambaddhā varttamānā vā, tatkathaṃ pratyakṣatastatra vyāptipratipattiḥ ?
tulanā–tatra kimaindriya mānasa vā pratyakṣaṃ vyāptigrahaṇe pravartate
yena hi pramāṇena sarvadeśeṣu ca dhūmādīnāmagnyādisambandho'vagamyate, tena teṣā sambandhaniyamo'vagamyate

kiñca, pratyakṣamātram, bhūyodarśanasahāyam, anvayavyatirekasahakṛtaṃ vā pratyakṣaṃ vyāptigrahaṇe prabhavet ? na tāvat pratyakṣamātram; bhūbhavanavarddhitotthitamātrasya prathamā'gnidhūmavyaktidarśane'pi vyāptipratipattiprasaṅgāt

yadapyuktam–prathamapratyakṣepi agnisambandhitvenaiva dhūmasya pratibhāsanāt tadga to niyamo'pi pratibhāsate' ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; yataḥ purodṛśyamāne niyatāgni sambandhitvena dhūmastatra pratibhāseta, aniyatākhilāgnisambandhitvena vā ? prathamapakṣe katha prathamadarśane vyāptipratipattiḥ ? pratiniyatavyaktau vyāpterevā'saṃbhavāt, tasyā sarvākṣepeṇa paryavasānāt

dvitīyapakṣe tu āstāṃ prathamapratyakṣam, pratyakṣaśatairapi na vyāptiḥ pratyetuṃ śakyā, teṣāṃ sambaddhavarttamānārthagocaracāritayā yāvān kaścid dhūma sa sarvo'gnau eva iti sarvākṣepeṇa avinābhāvapratipattāvasamarthatvāt
tulanā–yata purodṛśyamānāgnisambandhitvena ghūma prathamapratyakṣe pratibhāseta, sakalāgnisambandhitvena vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 510
satyeva bhavati agnyabhāve tu kadācidapi na bhavatītyadhyāhāryam
etena bhūyodarśanasahāyamādyapratyakṣaṃ vyāptiṃ pratipadyate ityayamapi pakṣaḥ pratyuktaḥ

nāpyanvayavyatirekasahakṛtaṃ tat tāṃ pratipattuṃ samartham, yata tatsahasrakṛtasyāpyasya yatraiva svayaṃ pravṛttiḥ tatraiva tatpratipattirghaṭate na punaḥ yatra yatra dhūmaḥ tatra tatra agniḥ, yatra agnirnāsti tatra dhūmo'pi nāsti iti sarvākṣepeṇa, tatra ca vyāptipratipattervaiyarthyam

anumānārthaṃ hiṃ sā iṣyate, pratyakṣeṇa ca pratipanne sādhyasādhanavyaktiviśepe kimanumānena ? anvayavyatirekasahakṛtatvañcāsya svaviṣayātikrameṇa arthāntare pravṛttiḥ, svaviṣaye pravarttamānasya atiśayādhānaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe pratyakṣavirodhaḥ, svārthātikrameṇa arthāntare pravṛttilakṣaṇasahakāritvasya kvacidapyapratīteḥ
na khalu pradīpasahakṛtaṃ cakṣū rasādau pravarttamānaṃ pratīyate
svaviṣaye pravarttamānasyātiśayādhānañca adhyakṣasya vyāptiviṣayatve siddhe siddhyet
na ca tatsahakṛtasyāpīndriyajādhyakṣasya kaścanotkarṣo jāyate, yena svaviṣayātikrameṇāpyarthān gṛhṇīyāt
tulanā–anvayavyatirekasahakṛtatva hi pratyakṣasya svaviṣayātikrameṇa arthāntare pravṛtti, svaviṣaye pravarttamānasya anvayavyatirekābhyāmatiśayādhānaṃ vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 511
etena bhūyodarśanāvagatā'nvayavyatirekasahakṛtendriyaprabhavaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vyāptiṃ pratipadyate iti pratyuktam
kiñca, indriyaviṣaye vidyamānatvāt tatprabhavapratyakṣeṇa vyāptiḥ pratīyate, svaviṣayatvādvā ? na tāvad vidyamānatvāt; rasāderapi cākṣuṣatvānuṣaṅgāt, vyāptivad dhūmādau tatsattvasyāpyaviśeṣāt
aniyataviṣayā hi vyāptiḥ, tāṃ kathaṃ niyataviṣayamindriyaprabhavaṃ pratyakṣaṃ pratipadyeta ?
tulanā–kiñca, indriyaviṣaye vidyamānatvāt tatprabhavapratyakṣeṇa vyāpti pratīyate, svaviṣayatvādvā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 511
yathā dhūmādiṣu vyāptirasti evamāmrādau rasāditvamapi –ā॰ ṭi॰
tulanā–aniyataviṣayā hi vyāptiriti kathaṃ niyataviṣayendriyaprabhavapratyakṣatā pratipadyeta –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 511

yadapyabhihitam–anusandhānena hi vyāptirullikhyate, tacca bhūyodarśanādarśanaireva utpadyate ityādi; tadupapannameva, upalambhānupalambhaprabhavasyaiva jñānasya asmābhiḥ vyāptipratipattau sāmarthyasya samarthayitumupakrāntatvāt
taddhi indriyādisāmagrīkaṃ sambaddhavarttamānārthaviṣayañca prasiddham, nacedaṃ tathā iti kathaṃ pratyakṣarūpatāṃ pratipadyeta ?

nanu sāmānyasya vyāptipratipattau prayojakatvāt, tasya ca indriyeṇa sambaddhatvāt varttamānatvācca kathanna vyāptijñāna pratyakṣam ? ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, yataḥ kiṃ sāmānyasya sāmānyena vyāptiḥ, uta tadupalakṣitaviśepāṇāṃ tadupalakṣitaviśeṣaiḥ ? tatra ādyapakṣe na kiñcid vyāptipratipattiprayojanam sāmānye siddhasādhanato'numānavaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
tadupalakṣitaviśepāṇāṃ tu ānantyāt kathaṃ sambaddhavarttamānatā yato vyāptijñānasya pratyakṣatā syāt ?
saṃyuktasamavāyasambandhasadbhāvāt, cakṣuḥsaṃyukte agnau dhūme ca agnitvasya dhūmatvasya ca samavāyāt
etena bhūyodṛṣṭānvaya ityādi pratyuktam; viśiṣṭadaṇḍyādipratyayasya hi sambaddhavarttamānārthagocaracāritayā pratyakṣatā yuktā, na tu vyāptijñānasya tadviparyayāt ityasakṛdāveditam
atha asya apratyakṣatve katham indriyāpekṣā ityucyate ? tatkāraṇakāraṇatvāt iti brūmaḥ
vyāptijñānasya hi kāraṇaṃ pratyakṣānupalabhbhau tayośca indriyamiti
nāpi mānasam, manaso bāhyendriyanirapekṣasya bahirarthe pravṛttyabhāvāt
vyāptiśca bahirarthadharmatvād bahirarthaḥ, yo bahirarthadharma sa bahirarthaḥ yathā rūpādi, bahirarthadharmaśca vyāptiriti
bhavatkalpitasya manasaḥ ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ pratiṣedhato'sattvācca kathaṃ tadbhavaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ pratīyāt
sattve vā na aṇusvabhāvasyāsya aśeṣārthaiḥ sakṛt sambandhasaṃbhavaḥ, yadaṇusvabhāvaṃ na tat sakṛdaśepārthaiḥ sambadhyate yathā paramāṇuḥ, aṇusvabhāvañca bhavatkalpitaṃ mana iti

atha sākṣāt manaso'śeṣārthai sambandhābhāve'pi paramparayā'sau bhaviṣyati; tathāhi–manasā sākṣāt sayujyate ātmā tena ca saṃyuktā sarve'gnyādayo dhūmādayaśca sādhyasādhanavyaktiviśeṣā iti; tadapyapeśalam, evaṃ sarvasya sarvajñatāprasaṅgāt, sādhyasādhanavyaktivat sarvārthānāṃ manasā sambaddhasabaṃ sambandhasambandhasa bhavāt
pratyakṣānupalambhābhyāmanalasahacaritamanagneśca vyāvarttamānaṃ dhūmamupalabhya vibhāvasau niyato dhūma iti manasā pratipadyate
manaśca sarvaviṣayaṃ kena vā nābhyupeyate asannihitamapyarthamavadhārayitu kṣamam
dhūmamagnisahacaritamindriyeṇopalabhyānagneśca jalādervyāvartamānamanupalambhena jñātvā manasā niścinoti dhūmo'gninna vyabhicaratīti
na cātītānāgatānā vyaktīnā manasā saṅkalanamiti nyāyyam, manaso bahirarthe svātantrye andhavadhirādyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
manaścedvahirviṣaye kāraṇāntaranirapekṣaṃ pravarteta tadā sarva sarvadarśī syādaviśeṣāt
paramparāsambandha, mana saṃyukta ātmā tena ca sayuktā sarve'rthā iti

kiñca, asau sambandhasambandho'pi manasaḥ sadbhireva arthaiḥ syāt nā'sadbhiḥ, tatkathaṃ tatra vyāptipratipatti ? na cātmano vyāpitvaṃ siddham, tasya ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ prapañcataḥ pratiṣedhāt, tatkathaṃ sambandhasambandhagandho'pi syāt ? ato dṛṣṭānta eva sādhyasādhanayoḥ bhavatā vyāptiḥ pratipattavyā, tathā ca anumānānutthāna sādhyadharmiṇi sādhyadharmeṇa hetorvyāptyaniścayāt
tanna saugatamate yaugamate vā aindriyaṃ mānasa vā pratyakṣaṃ vyāptipratipatteraṅgamiti sthitam
tulanā–kiñcāsau sambaddhasambandho'pi sadbhirevārthai nāsadbhiratītānāgatai tatkatha tatra vyāptipratipatti ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 512
etena yogipratyakṣasyāpi avinābhāvapratipattyaṅgatvaṃ pratyākhyātam, tasyāpyavicārakatayā kāraṇabhūtapratiniyatasannihitārthagocaracāritayā caitāvato vyāpārān karttumasamarthatvābiśeṣāt

astu vā tataḥ tatpratipattiḥ, tathāpi–yogī pratyakṣato vyāptiṃ pratipadya svārthamanumānaṃ vidadhyāt, parārtha vā ? na tāvat svārtham, sakalasādhyasādhanavyaktiviśeṣāṇāṃ pratyakṣataḥ parisphuṭatayā pratipannatvena asya aphalatvāt
yat pratyakṣataḥ parisphuṭatayā pratipannam na tatra anumānaṃ phalavat yathā pratyakṣasvarūpe, pratyakṣataḥ parisphuṭatayā pratipannāśca yogino nikhilāḥ sādhyasādhanavyaktiviśepā iti
na ca tathā tatpratipanneṣvapyeteṣu samāropavyavacchedārthaṃ saphalamevānumānamityabhidhātavyam, yogino vidhūtakalpanājālatayā samāropasyaivā'saṃbhavāt

atha parārthaṃ yogino'numānam, nanu gṛhītavyāptikam, agṛhītavyāptikaṃ vā paraṃ parārthānumānena yogī pratipādayet ? yadi gṛhītavyāptikam; kutastena gṛhītā vyāptiḥ ? na tāvat svasaṃvedanendriyamanovijñānaiḥ; teṣāṃ tadaviṣayatvapratipādanāt
tanna kutaścidapi pratyakṣāt sādhyasādhanayorvyāptiḥ pratipattuṃ śakyā
tulanā–anye tu vyāptigrahaṇakāle pratipatturyogina ivāśeṣaviṣaya parijñānamastīti bruvate
anyathā hi sarvo dhūmo'gni vinā na bhavatīti vyāptismaraṇa na syāt
vivekena cāpratibhāsa samānābhivyāhārāt yathā dhānyarāśikṣiptāyā dhānyavyakteriti
yāvān kaściddhūma sa sarvopyagnijanmā anagnijanmā vā na bhavatītyetāvata
tulanā–tarhi yogī parārthānumānena gṛhītavyāptikamagṛhītavyāptikaṃ vā paraṃ pratipādayet
etadanantaraṃ ba॰ pratau avikalpaghiyā iti kārikā'pi likhitā samasti
na vidyate vikalpaḥ svaparavyavasāyo yasyāḥ sā cāsau dhīśca tayā parokṣayā jñānāntarānubhavaniścayātmikayā ca na kiñcit svabhāvaviṣayaṃ kāryādiviṣayaṃ vā liṅgam avinābhāvaḥ sampratīyata iti

tarhi anumānāt tatsampratīyate ityatrāha–na anumānāt liṅgāt liṅgini jñānam ityevaṃ lakṣaṇāt tatsampratīyate; tathāhi–prathamānumānaṃ hetoḥ avinābhāvāvasāye samartham, anumānāntaraṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; tadanumānasya asiddhatvāt
ata eva tatsiddhau anyonyāśraya– siddhe hi hetoravinābhāve tatastadutpattisiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca hetoravinābhāvasiddhiriti
nāpyanumānāntaram; yataḥ tadapi pratipannā'vinābhāvāt hetorutpadyate, tatpratipattiśca tatra pratyakṣataḥ, anumānādvā syāt ? tatrādyapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha–sarvatra ityādi
sarvatra prathamānumānavat dvitīyepyanumāne aviśeṣāt, na pratyakṣam ityāderdopasya abhedāt
anumānato'pi tata eva, anyato vā tatpratipattiḥ syāt ? yadi tata eva, anyonyāśrayaḥ
mā bhūt, kiṃ tayā ? ityatrāha–nahi ityādi
na khalu sākalpena liṅgasya liṅginā vyāpterasiddhau kvacid anityatvādau vahnyādau vā sādhye vyavahāre paramārthe vā kiñcit svabhāvaliṅgajaṃ kāryādiliṅgajaṃ vā anumānannāma
idamatra tātparyam–yathā anumānamantareṇa na kiñcit sādhyaṃ siddhyati iti tadarthamanumānamiṣyate tathā talliṅgaliṅgivyāptisiddhimantareṇa tadapi na siddhyati iti tadarthā sāpi iṣyatāmaviśeṣāt

yata evaṃ tat tasmāt na apratyakṣaṃ parokṣam anumānavyatiriktaṃ pramāṇamasti kintu anumānameva' ityayuktam, liṅgapratipatteḥ avinābhāvapratipatteḥ tarkākhyāyāḥ pramāṇāntaratvād aliṅgajā'viśadasvabhāvatayā pramāṇadvayānantarbhūtatvāt
siddhāyā hi vyāptipratipattau anumānotthānam, sati ca anumānātmalābhe vyāptipratipattiriti

sādhyāvinābhāvābhinibodhaikalakṣaṇāt, sādhyena iṣṭāvādhitāsiddharūpeṇa saha avinābhāvo'nyathānupapattiniyama tasya abhito deśakālāntaravyāptyā nibodho nirṇaya sa eka pradhāna lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpa yasya tattathokta tasmālliṅgādutpadyamānā liṅgidhīranumānamityartha
nanvasya tarkaphalatvātkatha pramāṇatvamityāśakyāha– tatphalaṃ hānādibuddhaya, hānaṃ parihāra ādiśabdena upādānamapekṣā ca gṛhyate
tāsā buddhayo vikalpā tasya anumānasya phala bhavanti, tata phalahetutvādanumānaṃ pramāṇa pratyakṣavadityabhiprāya
tatra svārthaṃ trirūpālliṅgād yadanumeye jñānaṃ tadanumānam
vivṛtiḥ–nahi tādātmyatadutpattī jñātuṃ śakyete vinā'nyathānupapattivitarkeṇa tābhyāṃ vinaiva ekalakṣaṇasiddhiḥ
nahi vṛkṣādiḥ chāyādeḥ svabhāvaḥ kāryaṃ vā
sādhyena iṣṭā'bādhitā'siddhaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭena avinābhāvo vyāptiḥ, tasya abhi samantāt nibodho niścayaḥ ekaṃ pradhānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasmāt suniścitā'nyathānupapattiniyamaniścayaikalakṣaṇāt ityarthaḥ
liṅgini sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi prayujyamāne gamyamāne vā dhīḥ jñānam anumānam
tulanā–pakṣa prasiddho gharmī prasiddhaviśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭatayā svayaṃ sādhyatvenepsita, pratyakṣādyaviruddha iti vākyaśeṣa
nyāyamukhaprakaraṇe tu svayaṃ sādhyatvenepsita pakṣo viruddhārtho'nirākṛta iti pāṭhāt –pramāṇavārtikālaṃ pari॰ 4
nanu prayujyamāne sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭe dharmiṇi ityayuktam; pakṣasya prayojanābhāvataḥ prayogānupapatteḥ, sarvatra gamyamāna evāsmin sādhanāt sādhyasampratipattyupapatteḥ
atha tatprayogasya sādhyārthapratipādanalakṣaṇaprayojanasaṃbhavāt tadasaṃbhavo'siddhaḥ; tanna, tasya tatpratipādanāsaṃbhavāt
sa hi kevalaḥ sādhyamarthaṃ pratipādayet, hetūpanyāsasamanvito vā ? yadi kevalaḥ; hetūpanyāso vyarthaḥ, pratijñāprayogamātrādeva tatpratipatteḥ sañjātatvāt
atha hetūpanyāsasamanvitaḥ; tarhi hetoreva tatra sāmarthyopapatteḥ kiṃ tatprayogeṇeti ?
sādhyasyaivābhidhānena pāramparyeṇa nāpyalamnanu–akhyāpite hi viṣaye hetuvṛtterasaṃbhavāt
athavā tasyaiva sādhanasya yannāṅgaṃ pratijñopanayanigamanādi tasyāsādhanāṅgasya sādhanavākye upādānaṃ vādino nigrahasthānaṃ vyarthābhidhānāt
nanu ca viṣayopadarśanāya pratijñāvacanamasādhanāṅgamapyupādeyameva; na; vaiyarthyāt asatyapi pratijñāvacane yathoktāt sādhanavākyād bhavatyevepṭārthasiddhirityapārthakaṃ tasyopādānam
yataśca sādhanaṃ sādhyadharmapratibaddhaṃ tādātmyatadutpattibhyā pratipattavyaṃ dvayorapi prayogayo tasmāt pakṣo'vaśyameva na nirdeśya

atha yadi pakṣo na nirdeśya kathamanirdeśyasya lakṣaṇamuktam ? na sādhanavākyāvayavatvādasya lakṣaṇamuktamapi tu asādhyaṃ kecit sādhyaṃ sādhyaṃ cāsādhyaṃ pratipannāḥ, tatsādhyāsādhyavipratipattinirākaraṇārthaṃ pakṣalakṣaṇamuktam

atrocyate–pakṣasya sādhyasiddhipratibandhitvādaprayogaḥ; prakrabhāt tatsaṃsiddheḥ, prayojanā'prasādhakatvāt, hetūpanyāsāpekṣasya tatprasādhakatvādvā ? na tāvat tatsiddhipratibandhitvāt; vādinā samyak sādhanāt svapakṣasiddhilakṣaṇe kārye kriyamāṇe tadvipakṣāprasādhakatvataḥ tatprayogasya tatpratibandhakatvānupapatteḥ

yat yasmin kārye kriyamāṇe tadvipakṣāprasādhakam na tattasya pratibandhakam yathā dhūme kāṣṭhādikam, samyak sādhanataḥ svapakṣasiddhilakṣaṇe kārye kriyamāṇe tadvipakṣāprasādhakaśca pratijñāprayoga iti
kathanna punarasyāḥ sādhanāṅgatvaṃ kiṃ sarvathaiva kathāsvanupayogāt, athopayuktasyāpyanyathaiva parigrahāt ? –praśa॰ kira॰ pṛ॰ 335
nahi śabdasya anityatvapratijñāne kṛtakatvādihetuḥ ghaṭādidṛṣṭāntaśca prakramānna siddhyati
tathāvidhasyāpyasyābhidhāne pakṣeṇa ko'parādhaḥ kṛtaḥ yenāsya tathāvidhasyābhidhānaṃ neṣyate ?
tatra yo mandamatiḥ na tasya prakṛtārthapratipattiviśepaḥ pratijñāprayogamantareṇopapadyate, nāpi naiyāyikādeḥ pañcāvayavaprayoge pratipannasaṅkatasyāsaṅketasyāmandamaterapi

tīvramatestu tatprayogamantareṇāpi hetuprayogamātrāt prakṛtārthapratipattipratītestasya vaiyarthye hetuprayogasyāpi vaiyarthyaṃ syāt, niścitā'vipratārakapuruṣavacanād agniratra ityādipratijñāprayogamātrarūpādeva kasyacit prakṛtārthapratipattidarśanāt
tulanā– avipratārakatāniścitapuruṣavacanamātrādapi agniratra ityādirūpāt kvacit prameyo'rthaḥ siddhyatīti hetorapyasādhanatāprasaṅgāt tadviraheṇāpi sādhyasiddheḥ
etena hetūpanyāsāpekṣasya prayojanaprasādhakatvāt' ityapi pratyākhyātam, niyamābhāvāt
kiñca, hetugocarasya pakṣasyānirdeśe hetoranaikāntikatvādidoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ, tamantareṇa tatra vāstavaguṇadoṣavivekasya karttumaśakyatvāt

yathaiva hi lakṣyanirdeśaṃ vinā dhānuṣkasya iṣuṃ pratikṣipato guṇo'pi doṣatayā doṣo'pi guṇatayā tatprekṣakajanānāṃ vyāmohāt pratibhāti, tannirdeśe tu tadguṇo lakṣyavedhaprāvīṇyalakṣaṇaḥ tadviparītatvalakṣaṇaśca doṣaḥ teṣāṃ yathāvat pratibhāti, evaṃ pakṣā'nirdeśe vyāmohāt samyaghetāvapi kimayaṃ hetuḥ sādhye eva varttate tadabhāve vā ityāśaṅkākalaṅkitatvādanaikāntikaḥ, vipakṣa eva varttiṣyate iti viparītāśaṅkā'nivṛtteḥ viruddho vā syāt
pakṣanirdeśe tu lakṣyanirdeśe dhānuṣkavat yathāvattadguṇadoṣayoḥ pratipattyupapatteḥ na kaścid doṣaḥ

tataśca samyaghetāvapi vipakṣe evāyaṃ varttate iti vyāmohād viruddhadūṣaṇamabhidadhīta, pakṣopanyāsāttu nirṇītahetugocarasya naiṣa doṣaḥ syādityabhiprāyayathā lakṣyanirdeśaṃ vinā dhānuṣkasyepu prakṣipato yau guṇadoṣau tau taddarśijanasya viparyastāvapi pratibhāta–guṇopi doṣatayā, dopo'pi vā guṇatayā, tathā pakṣanirdeśaṃ vinā hetumupanyasyato vādino yau svabhipretasādhyasādhanasamarthatvāsamarthatvalakṣaṇau guṇadoṣau tau prāśnikaprativādyādīnā viparītāvapi pratibhāta iti bhāvārthaḥ
yadapyabhihitam–kevalasyaiva pakṣasya sādhyapratipādanasāmarthye hetūpanyāso vyarthaḥ iti, tadapyabhidhānamātram, ekākinaḥ kāraṇasya kāryakāritvāpratīteḥ
na khalu bījādeḥ kevalasyaiva aṅkurādikāryakaraṇe sāmarthya dṛṣṭam

kathañcaivaṃ hetoḥ kevalasyaiva sādhyasiddhau sāmarthye tatsamarthanasya upanayādeśca vaiyarthyanna syāt ? pakṣasya arthasiddhau hetvapekṣaṇānna tatsiddhinibandhanatvam, ityapyasundaram, bhavatkalpitā'vikalpakādhyakṣasyāpyarthasiddhinibandhanatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt tatsiddhau tasya vikalpāpekṣaṇāt
atha tatpratipannamevārthaṃ vikalpo vyavasthāpayati ityucyate, tarhi pakṣapratipāditamevārthaṃ hetuḥ pratipādayati, tatpratipāditañca pramāṇāntaraṃ samarthayata ityapyucyatāmaviśeṣāt
idameva ca pakṣasya svarūpam–yad hetvapekṣasya arthapratipādakatvaṃ nāma
pacyate komalīkriyate hetunā sukumāraprajñānāṃ sādhyadharmānvitatvena vyaktatāmāpādyate iti pakṣa iti vyutpatteḥ
tulanā–tatra ca yaddūṣaṇamuktam–tarhi hetoreva tatra sāmarthyopapatte kiṃ pakṣavacaneneti, tadayuktam, eva hi heto samarthanāpekṣasya sādhyasiddhinivandhanatvopapatte tadvacanamapi na syāt
yadi ca pakṣo neṣyate kathaṃ tarhi sapakṣavipakṣavyavasthā syāt tatpūrvakatvāttasyāḥ ? tadabhāve ca trirūpasya hetorapyanupapatteranumānocchedaḥ syāt
kiñca, pratijñāyā prayogānarhatve śāstrādāvapyasau na prayujyeta aviśepāt
nahi śāstre'niyatakathāyāṃ vā pratijñā nābhidhīyate agniratra dhūmāt, vṛkṣo'yaṃ śiṃśapātvāt ityādyabhidhānānāṃ tatropalambhāt
parānugrahapravṛttānāṃ śāstrakārāṇāṃ pratipādyāvabodhanādhīnadhiyāṃ śāstrādau pratijñāprayogo yuktimāneva upayogitvāttasya ityabhyupagame vāde'pi so'stu tatrāpi teṣāṃ tādṛśatvāditi

nahi śāstre pratijñā nābhidhīyata eva aniyatakathāyā vā, agniratra dhūmāt, vṛkṣo'ya śiṃśapātvāt ityādivacanānā śāstre darśanāt, viruddho'ya heturasiddho'yam ityādipratijñāvacanānāmaniyatakathāyā prayogāt

tulanā–parānugrahapravṛttānā śāstrakārāṇā pratipādyāvabodhanādhīnadhiyā śāstrādau pratijñāprayogo yuktimāneva upayogitvāttasyeti cet, vāde'pi so'stu, tatrāpi teṣā tādṛśatvāt, vāde'pi vijigīṣupratipādanāya ācāryāṇā pravṛtte
prakārāntareṇa pakṣaprayogasamarthana nimnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 601
nanu liṅgasya sādhyāvinābhāvaikalakṣaṇatvamayuktam, tasya pakṣadharmatvādilakṣaṇatrayānvitatvena ekalakṣaṇatvāyogāt
nahi pakṣadharmatvābhāve asya asiddhatvavyavacchedaḥ, sapakṣe sattvābhāve ca viruddhatvavyudāsa, vipakṣe'sattvābhāve ca anaikāntikatvaniṣedhaḥ karttuṃ śakya iti
kiṃ punastrairūpyam ? pakṣadharmatvam, sapakṣe sattvam, vipakṣe cāsattvamiti
trairūpya punaḥ liṅgasyānumeye sattvameva, anumeya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇam, tasmilligasya sattvameva niścitameka rūpam, tatra sattvavacanena asiddha cākṣuṣatvādi nirastam
evakāreṇa pakṣaikadeśā- siddho nirasto hetu, yathā cetanāstarava svāpāt iti
pakṣīkṛteṣutaruṣu patrasaṃkocalakṣaṇa svā pa ekadeśena siddha
na hi sarve vṛkṣā rātrau patrasaṃkocabhāja, kintu kecideva
sattvavacanasya paścātkṛtena evakāreṇa asādhāraṇo dharmo nirastaḥ
yadi hi anurmeya eva sattvamiti kuryāt śrāvaṇatvameva hetu syāt
sapakṣaeva sattvam, sapakṣo vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇa, tasminneva sattvaṃ niścitaṃ dvitīyaṃ rūpam
ihāpi sattvagrahaṇena viruddho nirasta, sa hi nāsti sapakṣe
evakāreṇa sādhāraṇānaikāntika, anitya śabda prameyatvāt, sa hi na sapakṣa eva vartate kintūbhayatrāpi
sattvagrahaṇāt pūrvāvadhāraṇavacanena sapakṣavyāpisattākasyāpi prayatnānantarīyakasya hetutvaṃ kathitam
paścādavadhāraṇe tvayamartha syāt–sapakṣe sattvameva yasya sa heturiti prayatnānantarīyaka na hetu syāt
niścitavacanena sandigdhānvayo'naikāntiko nirasta, yathā sarvajñaḥ kaścid vaktṛtavāt, vaktṛtvaṃ hi sapakṣe sarvajñe sandigdham
asapakṣe cāsattvameva niścitam, asapakṣo vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇa, tasmin asattvameva niścitaṃ tṛtīya rūpam
tatrāsattvagrahaṇena viruddhasya nirāsa, viruddho hi vipakṣe'sti
evakāreṇa sādhāraṇasya vipakṣaikadeśavṛtternirāsa, nitya śabda kṛtakatvāt khavat
prayatnānantarīyakatve sādhye hi anityatva vipakṣaikadeśe vidyudādāvasti ākāśādau nāsti tato niyamenāsya nirāsa
asattvavacanāt pūrvasminnavadhāraṇe'yamarthaḥ syāt–vipakṣe eva yo nāsti sa hetu
tathā ca prayatnānantarīyakatvaṃ sapakṣe'pi sarvatra nāsti tato na hetu syāt, tata pūrvaṃ na kṛtam
asya vyākhyāyata evaṃ tena kāraṇena hetostriṣvapi rūpeṣu pakṣadharmānvayavyatirekeṣu niścayo varṇita ācāryadignāgena pramāṇasamuccayādiṣu asiddhastu dvayorapi sādhanam ityādinā

atrocyate–na pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayaṃ hetorlakṣaṇam, vipakṣe'pyasya varttamānatvāt, yad vipakṣe'pi varttate na tat lakṣaṇam yathā sattvam agneḥ, vipakṣe'pi hetvābhāsalakṣaṇe varttate ca pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayamiti
yadeva hi vipakṣāsādhāraṇaṃ svarūpaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇatayā loke prasiddham, yathā bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśavattvam agneḥ
na cedaṃ pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayaṃ tathāvidha tatputratvādau tadābhāse'pi gatatvāt pañcarūpatvādivat

atha anyathānupattiniyamavattrairūpyaṃ tallakṣaṇa na trairūpyamātram, tathāvidhañca tat tadābhāse nāstīti, tadapyasaṅgatam, eva sati trairūpyakalpanā'narthakyaprasaṅgāt tanniyamādevāsya gamakatvopapatteḥ
asādhāraṇo hi svabhāvo bhāvalakṣaṇamavyabhicārādagnerauṣṇyavat, na ca trairūpyasyāsādhāraṇatā taddhetau tadābhāse'pi tasya samudbhavāt
tulanā–yadeva hi lakṣyāsādhāraṇaṃ svarūpaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇatayā loke pratītamavyabhicāritvāt, yathā bhāsurarūpoṣṇasparśabattvamagne
lakṣaṇaṃ tathā loke ā॰, tallakṣaṇatayā loke śra॰
tulanā–na ca sapakṣe sattva pakṣadharmatva vipakṣe cāsattvamātra sādhanalakṣaṇam, sa śyāma tatputratvāt itaratatputravadityatra sādhanābhāse tatsadbhāvasiddhe

sapakṣe hītaratra tatputre tatputratvasya sādhanasya śyāmatvavyāptasya sattva prasiddham, vivādādhyāsite ca tatputre pakṣīkṛte tatputratvasya sadbhāvāt pakṣadharmatvam, vipakṣe vā'śyāme kvacidanyaputre tatputratvasyābhāvāt vipakṣe'sattvamātra ca
na khalu kṛtikodayāt śakaṭodayādyanumāne pakṣadharmatā samavati

atha kālākāśādiḥ bhaviṣyacchakaṭodayādimān kṛtikodayādimattvāt pūrvopalabdhakālādivat itītthamatra pakṣadharmatā'bhidhīyate, tarhi na kaścidapakṣadharmako hetu syāt, kākakārṣṇyāderapi prāsādadhāvalye sādhye jagato dharmitvena pakṣadharmatvasya kalpayituṃ suśakatvāt, tathāhi– jagat prāsādadhāvalyayogi kākakārṣṇyayogitvāt
tulanā–na hi śakaṭe dharmiṇi udeṣyattāyā sādhyāyā kṛtikāyā udayo'sti tasya kṛtikādharmatvāt tato na pakṣadharmatvam
nanvevamapi śva udeṣyati savitā adyatanādityodayāt, jātā samudravṛddhi śaśāṅkodayadarśanāt ityādiprayogeṣu heto pakṣadharmatvābhāve'pi gamakatvopalabdherna pakṣadharmatva tallakṣaṇam
tathā na candrodayāt samudravṛddhyanumāna candrodayāt pūrva paścādapi tadanumānaprasaṅgāt

candrodayakāla eva tadanumāna tadaiva vyāptergṛhītatvāditi cet, yadyeva tatkālasambandhitvameva sādhyasādhanayo, tadā ca sa eva kālo dharmī tatraiva ca sādhyānumāna candrodayaśca tatsambandhīti kathamapakṣadharmatvam ? –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1

yadi punarākāśa kālo vā dharmī tasyodeṣyacchakaṭavattva sādhya kṛtikodayasādhana pakṣadharma eveti matam, tadā dharitrīdharmiṇi mahodaghyādhārāgnimattva sādhya mahānasadhūmavattva sādhana pakṣadharmo'stu tathā ca mahānasadhūmo mahodadhau agni gamayediti na kaścidapakṣadharmo hetu syāt
yadi syātpakṣadharmatva cākṣuṣatvaṃ na kiṃcanau kiṃ dhvanau –jainatarkavā॰ vṛ॰ pṛ॰ 140
nāpi sapakṣe satvam, anityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt, sarvaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ sattvāt ityādeḥ sapakṣe sattvābhāve'pi gamakatvapratīteḥ
vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇabalāt antarvyāptisiddherasya gamakatve bahirvyāptikalpanā'narthakyam, ata eva sarvatra gamakatvopapatteḥ
tanna pakṣadharmatvaṃ sapakṣe sattvaṃ vā hetorlakṣaṇam
sapakṣe sattvarahitasya ca śrāvaṇatvāde śabdānityatve sādhye gamakatvapratīte
pakṣīkṛta eva sādhanasya sādhyena vyāptirantarvyāpti, anyatra tu bahirvyāpti
yathā anekāntātmakaṃ vastu sattvasya tathaivopapatteḥ, agnimānayaṃ deśo dhūmavattvāt, ya evaṃ sa evaṃ yathā pākasthānam
vipakṣe punarasattvameva niścitaṃ sādhyā'vinābhāvaniyamaniścayasvarūpameva, atastadeva pradhānaṃ hetoḥ lakṣaṇamastu alaṃ lakṣaṇāntareṇa
na ca sapakṣe sattvābhāve hetorananvayatvānuṣaṅgaḥ; antarvyāptilakṣaṇasya tathopapattirūpasya anvayasya sadbhāvāt anyathānupapattirūpavyatirekavat
nahi 'dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇyeva anvayo vyatirekaśca pratipattavya iti niyamo yuktaḥ; sarvasya kṣaṇikatvādisādhane sattvāderahetutvaprasaṅgāt
nahi niranvayaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ kvacidapi prasiddham, śabda-vidyut-pradīpādāvapi vipratipatteḥ
tulanā– sādhyābhāve vipakṣe tu yo'sattvasyaiva niścayaḥ
yadapyuktam–pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayāsaṃbhave hetorasiddhatvādidoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, anyathānupapattiniścayalakṣaṇatvādeva asya asiddhatvādidopaparihārasiddheḥ

tathāpi avinābhāvaprapañcatvāt pakṣadharmatvādeḥ asiddhādi ddhatvādi vyavacchedārthamabhidhāne niścitatvasyāpi rūpāntarasya ajñātāsiddhatāvyavacchedārtham, abādhitaviṣayatvādeśca bādhitaviṣayatvādivyavacchittaye abhidhānaprasaṅgaḥ
tasya ca asiddhe vyabhicāriṇi viruddhe ca hetāvasaṃbhāvanīyatvāt
triṣu rūpeṣu cedrūpaṃ niścitatvaṃ na sādhane

nāpi yaugopakalpitaṃ pañcarūpatvam, pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayasya prāgeva pratyākhyātatvāt, sādhyā'vinābhāvavyatirekeṇā'parasya abādhitaviṣayatvāderapyasaṃbhavāt, atastadeva pradhāna hetorlakṣaṇamastu kiṃ pañcarūpakalpanayā ? nahi anuṣṇo'gnirdravyatvāt jalavat ityādāvapi avinābhāvābhāvādanyad bādhitaviṣayatvaṃ nāma pratīyate, bādhitaviṣayatva-avinābhāvayoḥ virodhāt
sādhyasadbhāva eva hetoḥ dharmiṇi sadbhāvaḥ avinābhāva, tadabhāve eva ca tatra tatsaṃbhavo viṣayabādheti
tatra parokṣo'rtho liṅgyate gasyate'neneti liṅgam, tacca pañcalakṣaṇam
pañcasu vā caturpu vā rūpeṣu hetoravinābhāva parisamāpyatetasmādabādhitatvāsatpratipakṣitatvarūpadvayasasūcanāya nigamanamiti –nyāyavā॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 302
tathāhi–satyapyavinābhāve yathokte bādhāsambhava manyamānairabādhitaviṣayatva rūpāntaramucyate, sā ceya tatsambhāvanā na sabhavati bādhāyā avinābhāvena virodhāt sahānavasthānalakṣaṇāt
satyeva hi sādhyadharme bhāvo hetoravinābhāva ucyate, pramāṇabādhā tu tasminnasati

yadi hi satyeva tasmiṃstadabhāvaviṣaya pramāṇa pravarteta tadāsya bhrāntatvādapramāṇataiva syāditi kuto bādhā ? tata sa hetustallakṣaṇa sādhyāvinābhāvī dharmiṇi syāt atra ca sādhyadharma kathanna bhavet yato bādhāvakāśa syāt
tasmādavinābhāvasya pramāṇabādhāyāśca sahānavasthānam, avinābhāvenopasthāpitasya ca tadabhāvasya parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇatayā virodhena ekatra dharmiṇyasabhavāditi
kiñca, abādhitaviṣayatva niścitam, aniścitaṃ vā hetorlakṣaṇaṃ syāt ? na tāvadaniścitam, atiprasaṅgāt, ajñāyamānasya jñāpakahetvanaṅgatvācca
tannibandhanaṃ hi anupalambhaḥ, saṃvādaḥ, anyadvā kiñcit ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ, sarvātmasambandhino'nupalambhasya asiddhā'naikāntikatvāt
taduttarakālaṃ tatsiddhyabhyupagame tvanyonyāśrayaḥ, tathāhi–anumānāt pravṛttau saṃvādasiddhiḥ; tataśca abādhitaviṣayatvasiddheranumānapravṛttiriti
athānyat kiñcit, tat kiṃ tadviṣayaṃ pramāṇāntaram, avinābhāvāvagamo vā ? tatra pramāṇāntarāt kutaścidabādhitaviṣayatvāvagame hetorakiñcitkaratvaṃ sādhyasyāpi ata evāvagamāt
na hyasati sādhyasadbhāvāvagame tadvādhāviraho niścetuṃ śakyaḥ
athāvinābhāvāvagamāt tadavagamaḥ; tanna; pañcarūpayogini hetāvavinābhāvaparisamāptivādinām abādhitaviṣayatvasyā'navagame avinābhāvā'vagamasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
tulanā– kiñcāvādhitaviṣayatva niścitamaniścita vā hetorlakṣaṇa syāt ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 358
sarvasambandhino'nupalambhasya sarvajñatvamantareṇa jñātumaśakyatvādasiddhatvam, ātmasambandhino'palambhastu paracetovṛttiviśeṣādinā vyabhicārī

tadāpyakiñcitkaratva heto, yathaiva hi hetorviṣayasya bādhāsadbhāvaniścaye tatsādhanāsamarthatvādakiñcatkaratva tathaiva bādhāvirahaniścaye kutaścittasya sadbhāvasiddhestatsādhanāya pravartamānasya siddhasādhanādapi iti
nāpyasatpratipakṣatvam, yataḥ pratipakṣaḥ tulyabalaḥ, atulyabalo vā sattvena pratiṣidhyeta ? tulyabalatve bādhyabādhakabhāvānupapattiḥ
yayostulyabalatvaṃ na tayorbādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ yathā rājñoḥ, tulyabalatvañca pakṣapratipakṣayoriti
atulyabalatva tu anayoḥ kiṃkṛtam–pakṣadharmatvādibhāvābhāvakṛtam, anumānabādhājanitaṃ vā ? na tāvat prathamapakṣo yuktaḥ, pakṣadharmatvāderubhayorapyaviśeṣāt
nahi mūrkhatve sādhye tatputratvādeḥ pakṣadharmatvādikaṃ na saṃbhavati, śāstravyākhyānaliṅgasyaiva vā saṃbhavati
nahi dvayoḥ pakṣadharmatvādyaviśeṣe ekasya bādhyatvam aparasya ca bādhakatvaṃ yuktam, aviśeṣeṇaiva tatprasaṅgāt
ata āha tulye lakṣaṇe hi ityādi

śaṅkyamānapratihetunā tulya lakṣaṇa darśanādarśanamātranimittāvinābhāvarūpa yasya tasmin, dṛṣṭa pratiyogina pratihetorbādhakasya sabhava sa yeṣāmapi tattulyalakṣaṇānā pratiyogī na dṛśyate teṣvapi śakā pratihetusambhavaviṣayāmutpādayati
na hi tasyetareṇa kaścidviśeṣo'sti yatastatsabhavo na śaṃkyeta
atha viśeṣa pratibandhalakṣaṇo'vinābhāvaniścāyako dṛṣṭapratihetoradṛṣṭapratiyogina iṣyate, yata pratiyogisabhavāśakā'stamupaiti tadā sati vā viśeṣe sa viśeṣo hetorlakṣaṇam
nanu cāsya niṣphalatvāt kiṃ tatsvarūpanirūpaṇaprayāsena ? phalavatā hi pramāṇena bhavitavyam nānyena atiprasaṅgāt, ityāśaṅkāpanodārthaṃ tatphalam ityādyāha
tasya anumānasya phalaṃ hānam ādiryasya upādānānāde tasya vuddhayaḥ

nanu na kiñcid vāstava pramāṇamasti nāpi tatphalam anyatrā'vidyāvāsanāviśeṣāt, ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, tadubhayasadbhāvasya vāstavasya pūrvapūrvapramāṇatvaṃ phalaṃ syāduttarottaram laghī॰ kā॰ 7 ityatra prapañcataḥ prarūpitatvāt
avinābhāvasya tādātmyatadutpattibhyāmeva niyatatvāt kāryasvabhāvahetāveva tatsamā vaneti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa
atra saugataḥ prāha–yaduktaṃ sādhyāvinābhāva ityādi, tatsūktam, avinābhāvabalenaiva sarvatra hetoḥ gamakatvapratīte, satvavinābhāvaḥ tādātmyatadutpattiniyatatvāt kāryasvabhāvahetāveva avatiṣṭhate
tadātmyena hi svabhāvahetoḥ avinābhāvaḥ parisamāpyate, tadutpattyā tu kāryahetoḥ
na ca anyalliṅgamasti, anupalabdherapi svabhāvahetau antarbhāvāt
sa ca pratibandha sādhye'rthe liṅgasya vastutastādātmyāt sādhyādarthādutpatteśca
te ca tādātmyatadutpattī svabhāvakāryayoreveti tābhyāmeva vastusiddhi

yat eva pratibandhavaśād gamakatvāttasmāt kāryakāraṇabhāvādvā niyāmakāt sādhyasādhanayoravyabhicārasādhakāt svabhāvādvā tādātmyalakṣaṇānniyāmakāt kāryasya svabhāvasya ca ligasyāvinābhāva sādhyadharma vinā na bhāva ityartha –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1
ime sarve kāryānupalabdhyādayo daśānupalabdhiprayogā svabhāvānupalabdhau sagrahamupayānti –nyāyabi॰ pṛ॰ 55
svabhāvānupalabdhistu svabhāvahetāvantarbhābiteti tasyā tādātmyalakṣaṇa eva pratibandha
yasmādekajñānasasargiṇo pratyakṣeṇa ekasya grahaṇameva anyasyāgrahaṇam, tadagrahaṇameva ca tasyābhāvagrahaṇam, bhāve hi tasyāgrahaṇāyogāt
tatpratipattiśca ūhajñānāt; ityapi śraddhāmātram, kāryahetoravinābhāvasya pratyakṣā nupalambhapañcakena pratipatteḥ

tathāhi–agnidhūmavyatirikteṣu upalabhyamāneṣvapi bhūtalādyartheṣu prathamam agnidhūmayoranupalambhaḥ ekaḥ, anantaram agnerupalambhaḥ tato dhūmasya ityupalambhadvayam, paścādagneranupalambho'nantaraṃ dhūmasyāpyanupalambhaḥ iti dvāvanupalambhau, iti pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakena ekasyāmapi vyaktau kāryakāraṇabhāvāvagamo bhavati agneḥ kārya dhūmaḥ
yadi tena niyato na syāt tarhi nirapekṣatvāt nityaṃ sattvamasattvaṃ vā syāt
yaśca niyataḥ sa niyāmakavān, tadabhāve svātantryāt nityaṃ sattvāsattvayoḥ punaḥ prasaṅgaḥ syāt

tataścāyamarthaḥ sampannaḥ–yo yasmādutpadyamānaḥ sakṛdapyupalabdhaḥ sa tasmādeva nānyasmāt, ahetostadutpattau sarvasmāt sarvasyotpattiḥ, iti pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakena svabhāvahetudvayena ca kāryahetoḥ sārvatrikī vyāptiḥ pratīyate

"yastu agnidhūmavyatiriktadeśe prathama dhūmasyānupalambha eka, tadanantaramagnerupalambha tato dhūmasyetyupalambhadvayam, paścādagneranupalambho'nantara dhūmasyāpyanupalambha iti dvāvanupalambhāviti pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakād vyā ptigraha ityeṣā siddhānta
svabhāvahetostu vipakṣe bādhakapramāṇena, yathā sattvasya kṣaṇikatvena
tathāhi– arthakriyākāritvalakṣaṇaṃ sattvam, arthakriyā ca kramayaugapadyābhyāṃ vyāptā, te cā'kṣaṇikānnivarttamāne svavyāpyāmarthakriyāmādāya nivarttete, sā ca sattvam
kasmāt punaḥ akṣaṇikāt kramayaugapadyayorvyāvṛttiriti cet ? nānārūpatvāt

kālataḥ paurvāparya hi kramaḥ tadviparītaṃ yaugapadyam, itthañca te nānārūpe, akṣaṇikatvañca ekarūpatā, ekarūpatānānārūpate ca ekāśrite viruddhe, ataḥ akṣaṇikānnivarttamānaṃ sattvaṃ kṣaṇika eva avatiṣṭhate prakārāntarāsaṃbhavāt
nahi kṣaṇikā'kṣaṇikavyatiriktastṛtīyaḥ prakāro'sti yatastatra asya vṛttirāśaṅkyeta
san śabda kṛtako vā, yaścaiva ya sarvo'nitya yathā ghaṭādiriti
yadi na sarvaṃ sat kṛtaka vā pratikṣaṇavināśi syādakṣaṇikasya kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyā'yogādarthakriyāsāmarthyalakṣaṇamato nivṛttamityasadeva syāt
yaugapadyamapi tasyāparairvījādikāyai sāhitya prakārāntarañcāṅkurāde, tadubhayāvasthāvirahe'pyanyathābhavanam –hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 143B
svabhāvānupalabdhiśca svabhāvahetuḥ, tasya ca tādātmyameva pratibandhaḥ
tatpratividhānapurassara tādātmyatadutpattyamāve'pi avinābhāvasambhāvanāta kṛtti kodayādihatūnā gama katvapradarśanam–

yattāvaduktam–avinābhāvastādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ niyataḥ ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, nahi tādātmyam avinābhāvaniyamanimittam; tasmin sati bhedābhāvena sambandhābhāve avinābhāvānupapatteḥ, bhedādhiṣṭhānatvāt sambandhasya
na cānaśārthavādina tādātmyabhedau manāgapi upapadya dye te

tādātmyaṃ hi tatsvabhāvatā, tena sādhyena sādhanasyaikyam, na caikye bhedaḥ saṃbhavati, bhede vā naikyam, ataḥ kathaṃ tadātmatayā śiṃśapā vṛkṣaṃ gamayet ? tādātmyena ca gamakatve hetugrahaṇavelāyāmeva tadavyatirekitayā sādhyasya pratipannatvāt nānumānasya sāphalyam
gṛhītau ca yadi liṅgapratītau na liṅgī pratibhāset tadā kathaṃ tayostādātmyam ? pratibhāse tu siddhamanumānasya vaphavaiphalyam, pratijñārthaikadeśatā ca heto

viparītasamāropavyavacchedārthatvāttasya sāphalyañcet, nanu tatsva rūpe pratipanne, apratipanne vā viparītasamāropaḥ syāt ? tatra pratipanne ko'vasaro viparītasamāropasya ? na hi śiraḥpāṇyādiviśeṣopalambhe sthāṇusamāropaḥ samāviśati
api ca tādātmye katha gamyagamakabhāva, na hi tadeva karma kartṛ ceti yuktam, tasya bhedāśrayatvāt
na ca tādātmye gamyagamakatā ghaṭate ekasya sakṛjjñātatvājñātatvāyogāt
tādātmye ca yadanumāna tadapi na sādhīya, siddha hi liṅga sādhya laiṅgikam, na siddhasya sādhyasya ca tādātmyamupapadyate
na ca tādātmye gamyagamakabhāvavyavasthā yuktā, tasyā bhedāśrayatvāt
yadi śiṃśapātve gṛhyamāṇe vṛkṣamagṛhīta kva tādātmyam ? gṛhīta cet kvānumānam ? –praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 207
api ca yadi tādātmya gamakatvāgamiṣyate tadā sādhyasādhanayorbhedābhāvena sambandhābhāvādavinābhāvānupapatti –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 533
tulanā–tādātmye tāvad gamakatvāṅge hetusādhyayoravyatireke gamyagamakabhāva eva durupapāda
tatra liṅgabuddhau liṅga liṅgī pratibhāsate na vā ? apratibhāse tadbuddhyā tadagrahaṇāt katha tasya tadātmakatvam
pratibhāse tu liṅgavat pratyakṣa eva so'rtha iti kimanumānena ? –nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 113
tādāmyena ca gamakatve hetupratipattibelāyāmeva sādhyasyāpi pratipannatvānnānumānasya sāphalyam
sādhyasādhanayo vṛkṣatvaśiṃśapātvayo tādātmye hi pratijñaikadeśabhūta yat vṛkṣatva sādhya tattādātmyāpanna śiṃśapātvameva ca hetu iti sādhyasya asiddhatvāt hetorapyasiddhatvamiti bhāva

na hi śira pāṇyādiviśeṣadarśane sati sthāṇusamāropa pravartate, tatra tadbhedādupapadyetāpi, na hi śira pāṇyādaya eva puruṣa iti, tadgrahaṇe'pyapuruṣāropa kāma bhavet, iha vṛkṣatvaśiṃśapātvayorabhedāt śiṃśapātvagrahaṇe sati kā kathā vṛkṣetarasamāropasya
śiṃśapātvalakṣaṇe hetusvarūpe prapipanne hi tadabhedād vṛkṣatvamapi pratītameveti viparītasya vṛkṣatvetaratvasya āropa katha syāt ?
kiñca, vṛkṣatvagrahaṇe sati sāmānyagrahaṇād viśeṣāgrahaṇāt syāt kadācidaśiśapātvasamāropaḥ, natu śiṃśapātvagrahaṇe sati avṛkṣatvasamāropaḥ
śiśapātvaṃ hi yasya pratyakṣaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ na tasyā'pratyakṣam
tulanā–api ca vṛkṣasya grahaṇe sati sāmānyadharmagrahaṇādviśeṣānadhyavasāyāt kadācidaśiṃśapāsamāropa syānna tu śiṃśapātvagrahaṇe sati avṛkṣatvasamāropo yukta
pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃ vṛkṣatvaṃ tasyāpratyakṣatvam śra॰, ba॰

kiñca, sādhyasādhanayoravyatireke yathā śiśapātvena vṛkṣatvamanumīyate, tathā vṛkṣatvenāpi kinna śiṃśapātvaṃ tādātmyā'viśeṣāt ? atha śiśapātvameva vṛkṣatve pratibaddhaṃ na vṛkṣatvaṃ śiṃśapātve, na tarhi tādātmyād gamakatvam, apitu avinābhāvādeva
tulanā–tathobhayostādātmyāviśeṣe'pi śiṃśapātvena vṛkṣasya pratipattivat vṛkṣatvena śiṃśapātvapratipattirapi syāt
kiñca sādhasādhanayoravyatirekād yathā śiṃśapātvena vṛkṣatvamanumīyate tathā vṛkṣatvenāpi śiṃśapātvamanumīyeta tādātmyāviśeṣāt
tataśca sapakṣavyāptyavyāptibhyā kṛtakatvapratyatnānantarīyakatvayoryo bheda ukta sa hīyeta
nanu cānya sambandha anyaśca prativandha, dviṣṭha sambandha, pratibandhastu parāyattatvalakṣaṇa

tatra śiṃśapātva vṛkṣatve pratibaddha na vṛkṣatva śiṃśapātve, prayatnānantarīyakatvamapi anityatve niyata na tvanityatva tatreti, tathā dhūmasyāgnau pratibandha na tvagnerdhūme, satyamevam, kintvevamucyamāne niyama evāṅgīkṛto bhavenna tādātmyam

tādātmye hi yathā śiṃśapā śiṃśapā vinā na dṛśyate tathā vṛkṣatvamapi śiṃśapārahita na dṛśyeta, dṛśyate ca khadirādau śiṃśapārahitaṃ vṛkṣatvam, vidyudādau ca prayatnānantarīyakatvarahitamanityatvamupalabhyata iti kathamabheda ? vinā sādhanadharmeṇa sādhyadharmā'yamasti hi
nāpi tadutpattau; vahnyutpanneṣvapi dhūmadharmeṣu śyāmatvādiṣu avinābhāvasyā'nupalabdheḥ

na ca sāmānyayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kintu viśeṣayoḥ, yayoścā'nayormahānasādau kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vagataḥ na tayorgamyagamakabhāvaḥ, yayostu parvatasthayoḥ gamyagamakabhāvaḥ na tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vagataḥ
na cānavagate tasmin tayoravinābhāvo grahītuṃ śakyaḥ
tadānīṃ grahaṇe tu hetupratipattisamaya eva sādhyapratipatterjātatvāt kimanumānena ?
tulanā–kāryaheturapi na sabhavati, bhavatāṃ hi kṣaṇayorvā kāryakāraṇabhāvo bhavet, santānayorvā ? yadi dhūma kāryatvādanalamanumāpayet kaṭumalinagaganagāmitvādidharmairapi tasya gamako bhavet
na ca kathañcittatkāryatva kathañcidatatkāryatvañca dhūmasyopapannam, sarvātmakasya tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyiprabhavatvāt
tādātmyatadutpattibhyām avinābhāvapratiniyame ca kathaṃ kṛttikodaya-śakaṭodayayoḥ candrodaya-samudravṛddhyośca gamyagamakabhāvastatra tādātmyatadutpattyorabhāvāt
tulanā–eva sarvatra deśakālāvinābhūtamitarasya liṅgam, śāstre kāryādigrahaṇa nidarśanārthaṃ kṛ ta nāvadhāraṇārtham
tadyathā adhvaryurośrāvayan vyavahitasya hoturliṅgam, candrodaya samudravṛddhe kumudavikāśasya ca, śaradi jalaprasādo'gastyodayasyeti
na ca tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇapratibandhābhyupagame rūpadarśanāt sparśānumānam, udayādastamayapratipatti, kṛttikodayācca rohiṇyanumāna na syāt tādātmyatadutpattyabhāvāt
api ca rasādanyadrūpa rasasamānakālamanumimate'numātāra, na cānayorasti kāryakāraṇabhāvastādātmya vā

api cādyatanasya saviturudayasya hyastanena saviturudayena candrodayasya ca samānakālasya samudravṛddhyā madhyanakṣatradṛṣṭyā cāṣṭamāstamayodayasya na kāryakāraṇabhāvastādātmya bā, atha ca dṛṣṭo gamyagamakabhāva

yadapyuktam–avinābhāvasya pratyakṣānupalambhapañcakena pratipatteḥ ityādi, tadapyasāmpratam, pratyakṣasya avikalpakatayā anupalambhasyāpi arthāntaropalambhasvabhāvasya tathābhūtatayā śataśo'pi pravṛttasya vyāptigrahaṇe sāmarthyāsaṃbhavāt
nahi nirvikalpakam idamasmin satyeva bhavati ato'nyathā na bhavatyeva ityetāvato vyāpārān karttu samarthaṃ sannihitaviṣayabalotpatteravicārakatvācca ityuktamanantarameva
nāpi tatprabhavo vikalpaḥ, tasya bhavatā prāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt

yo hi tādātmyatadutpattisvabhāva prativandha iṣyate sa kiṃ vastudharmo vikalpāropitākāradharmo vā ? tatra nāyamāropitadharmo bhavitumarhati, vastu vastunā janyate vastu ca vastusvabhāva bhavet tasmādvastudharma prativandha
vikalpaiśca vastu na spṛśyate tatpratibandhaśca niścīyata iti citram
idañca svabhāṣitam vastuno pratibandhastādātmyādi gamyagamakatvañca vikalpāropitayorapohayo
tadevamanyatra prativandha anyatra tadgrahaṇopāya anyatra pratīti anyatra pravṛttiprāptī iti sarvaṃ kaitavam
vikalpairgrahaṇa tasya ko brūyāt saugatāt paraḥ || nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 117
yadapi–svabhāvahetorvipakṣe bādhakapramāṇena vyāptiḥ pratīyate ityādyuktam, tadapyu ktimātram; yato vipakṣe vādhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ kramayaugapadyānupalambhalakṣaṇamanumānam
vyāptiśca tatrāpyanumānāntareṇa pratīyate, prathamānumānena vā ? anumānāntareṇa cet; anavasthā
ato'numānamicchatā bhavatā vyāptigrāhī tarkaḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ pratipattavyaḥ, pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ tadgrahaṇānupapatteḥ iti
tat sādhyam ātmā yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tādātmyam, tasmāt sādhyād ātmalābhaḥ tadutpattiḥ, punaranayoḥ itaretarayogalakṣaṇo dvandvaḥ
nanu svantatvāt tadutpattiśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ prāpnoti; tanna; asya lakṣaṇasya lakṣaṇahetvoḥ kriyāyāḥ jainendravyā॰ 2
te tādātmyatadutpattī nahi naiva jñātuṃ śakyete
sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā yā anupapattiḥ aghaṭanā sādhanasya tasyāḥ sambandhī grāhakatvena tarkaḥ tena vinā

tadevaṃ vṛkṣatvaśiṃśapātvādau tādātmyādeḥ sadbhāve'pi avinābhāvavalenaiva śiṃśapātvādereva vṛkṣādikaṃ prati gamakatvam na vṛkṣatvādeḥ śiśapādikaṃ prati iti pratipādya, idānīṃ tadabhāve'pi tadvalenaiva gamakatvaṃ pratipādayannāha–tābhyām ityādi
tābhyāṃ tādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ vinaiva ekalakṣaṇasya avinābhāvasya siddhiḥ niṣpattiḥ nirṇītirvā
chāyādeḥ atrāpi ādiśabdena rūpādisvīkāraḥ, svabhāvaḥ vṛkṣādichāyādyoḥ deśādivibhedāt, kāryaṃ vā sahabhāvāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
su iti sajñā jainendravyākaraṇe pāṇinivyākaraṇasya dhi sajñāyā sthāne prayujyate
atra hi hetuśabda svantastathāpi nāsya pūrvanipāta
vṛkṣādi chāyāderna svabhāva deśādibhedāt, na ca kāryaṃ sahabhāvāt –ā॰ ṭi॰
nanu ca āsvādyamānāt rasāt vṛkṣācca sāmagrī anumīyate tato rūpasya chāyāyāścā numānam anumitānumānāt, ityapyasat; tathā vyavahāgabhāvāt
nahi āsvādyamānād rasād vyavahārī sāmagrīmanuminoti; varttamānarūpāderapratītiprasaṅgāt
tathā ca idamāmraphalam evaṃvidharūpam evaṃvidharasatvāt ityanumānam, pāvakarūpadarśanāt tatsamakāloṣṇasparśānumānam, tadarthinaḥ tatra pravṛttiśca na prāpnoti
vyavahārānusāreṇa ca bhavatā pramāṇacintā pratanyate prāmāṇya vyavahāreṇa pramāṇavā॰ 2
sāmagrīto rūpānumāne ca kāraṇāt kāryānumānapramaṅgāt liṅgasaṃkhyāvyādhātaḥ syāt
tarhi vyabhicāro'tra bhaviṣyati ityatrāha– naca ityādi
naca naiva vṛkṣādeḥ chāyādyanumāne visaṃvādo vyabhicāge'sti tatprāptipratīteḥ

yā ca rasato madhurādikāt rūpāde, ādiśabdāt gandhasya sparśasya ca ekasāmagryādhīnasya rasādinā saha ekasāmagryāyattasya gati, sā kathamityāha hetudharmānumānena rasakāraṇasya dharmo rasādisahacararūpajanakatva tadanumānena rasād rūpādigati
na hi kārya rasa kāraṇamantareṇa, kāraṇañcāsya rasasahakārirūpajanaka puñjāt puñjotpatte
tenāyamartho rasāt sakāśāt taddheto rasasamānakālabhāvirūpajanakatvanniścīyate, eva hi tasya rasasamānakālabhāvirūpajanakatva niścīyate
yadi samānakālabhāvino rūpasyāpi niścaya syāt tenātītaikakālānāmekaiva gati kāryaliṅgajā
tulanā–samānakṣaṇayorgamyagamakabhāvopalabdheḥ; tayāhi–nyakṣaṇāt samānakāla sparśo'numīyate na pūrva, tatra ekamāmagyadhīnatvāmabhapa eva
na ca rūpasparśayoḥ parasparotpattau kāraṇatve pramāṇamasti itarānvayamyetarayānupalavye
na prāpnotītyartha kintu idamāmūphalamevabivasāgagrīkamiti prāpti –ā॰ ṭi॰
rūpādī na pravṛtti prāpnoti kintu sāmavyām –ā॰ ṭi॰

tulanā–tathā ca rasāt kāryāttatkāraṇa rūpamanumātavya tataścānumitādrūpāt kāraṇāt tatkārya rasamamānakāla rūpamanumātavya tathā ca kāraṇāt kāryānumāna tādātmyatadutpattibhyāmanyaditi nābhyāmeva pratibandhasiddhi
yadi sāmagrī kāraṇa rūpādayastu kārya tadā svabhāvaliṅga kāryaliṅga kāraṇaliṅgamiti payaprasakte –ā॰ ṭi॰
candra ādiryasya ādityāderasau candrādi tasmāt kāraṇabhūtāt, jale svacchāmbhasi candrāde candrādipratibimbasya pratipattiravavodho'numā anumānamanugantavyamavyabhicārāt
vivṛtiḥ–na hi jalacandrādeḥ candrādiḥ svabhāvaḥ kārya vā
candra ādiryasya ādityāde sa tathoktaḥ, tasmāt, jalacandra ādiryasya jalādityādeḥ so'pi tathoktaḥ tasya pratipattiḥ tathā anyathā' nupapattiprakāreṇa anumā anumānam
nahi naiva jalacandrādeḥ candrādiḥ svabhāvaḥ kāryaṃ vā, atha ca ataḥ tatra avyabhicāriṇī pratipattiḥ pratīyate iti
jalādau na ādityādeḥ pratibimbaṃ kintu svadeśastha eva ādityādi tatra pratibhāsate iti pratibimbābhāvavādina kumārilabhaṭṭasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu jalādau na pratibimbaṃ nāma vastvantaraṃ saṃbhavati, tatsaṃbhave bimbasannidhānāt prāgapi tatra tadupalambhaprasaṅgāt
atha bimbasannidhāna eva tadutpadyate ato na prāgapi tatprasaṅgaḥ, nanu tatsannidhāne guṇarūpam, dravyarūpaṃ vā tadutpadyeta ? na tāvad guṇarūpam; dravyatvena pratibhāsamānatvāt
atha dravyarūpam; tatkiṃ niravayavadravyarūpam, sāvayavadravyarūpaṃ vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; tatra avayavapratibhāsanāt
yadi sāvayava pratibimbamarthāntarabhūta jale samutpanna tadā tasya sparśādibhi pṛthagbhūtairbhavitavyam, na caitatsabhavati, jalīyasparśādyātmakatvāt pratibimbasparśādīnām
sparśavantaśca paramāṇavaḥ sparśavaddravyasyārambhakā bhavanti, tatra cāsya kiṃ jalādiparamāṇava eva ārambhakāḥ, anye vā ? na tāvadanye, sparśavadavayavideśe teṣāṃ tadārambhakatvāsaṃbhavāt
atha jalādiparamāṇava eva tadārambhakāḥ; tanna, jalamayatvena asyā'pratibhāsanāt
jalarūpavailakṣaṇyapratīteśca, śuklaṃ hi rūpaṃ jalasya, na ca mukhādipratibimbe tadasti
na ca bimbarūpameva tadārambhakamityabhidhātavyam; nimittakāraṇagatasya pṛthagdeśāvasthitasya rūpasya kāryadravyarūpānārambhakatvāt
āśrayadravyasya ca ādarśādeḥ parimāṇagauravayorutkarṣaḥ syāt, nacaitadasti
ato na pratibimbaṃ kiñcid vastvantaraṃ yuktam
nanu yadi tannāsti kathaṃ jalādau sūryādipratibimbapratibhāsaḥ ? ityapyayuktam; tatra tatpratibhāsā'saṃbhavāt, svadeśasthasyaiva ādityāde tatra pratibhāsanāt
yatraiva pradeśe ādarśarūpa dṛśyate pratibimbakañca tatraiva
na caikatra pradeśe rūpadvayasyāsti sahabhāva sapratighatvāt, ata sahaikatra dvayo rūpayo sattva na prāpnoti

atraike pratibimbodayavādinaḥ paryanuyuñjate–yadi svapradeśastha eva savitā upalabhyate na pratibimbāni, kasmāttarhi nopari eva dṛśyate ? nahi anyatrasthaḥ anyatra draṣṭuṃ pāryate sarvadā tathādarśanaprasaṅgāt
prāṅmukhaśca darpaṇaṃ paśyan pratyaṅmukhaśca kathaṃ syāt ? yadi ca bahirniṣkrāntamindriyaṃ tatraiva bodhayedarthaṃ tata etadevaṃ bhavet, śarīre tu tadvodhakamiti
svadeśastha eva ādityādistatra pratibhāsata iti –ā॰ ṭi॰
anye tu codayantyatra pratibimbodayaipiṇaḥ | sa eva cet pratīyeta kasmānnopari dṛśyate ?
vyākhyā–jalādipu yathaiko'pi nānātmā savitekṣyate–ityasya hetuvyabhicāraviṣayatvenoktasyāsiddhiṃ manyamānā pratibimbamarthāntaramicchantaścodayanti
yadi sa eva evādityo dṛśyate na pratibimba tatkimiti upariṣṭādasya darśana na bhavati ? eva hi tasya darśana bhavet yadi deśāvasthitasvarūpa gṛhaṇīyāt nānyathā, anyathā hi atiprasaṅga
kiñca, kūpādiṣu ca dūrādha maviṣṭasyārkāde katha grahaṇa bhavet yadi tatra pratibimba notpanna syāt ? na hi tatra tathārkādivyabisthiti
api ca prāṅmukho darpaṇamavalokayan kathamiva pratyaṅmukho bhavati ? na hi tasya tadā pṛṣṭhābhimukha mukhamupajāta dṛśyate
eva manyate yadi vahirnigatamindriyamāditya bodhayettata etatsyāt uparisthitameva paśyennādhastāditi
yāvatā dharmādharmavaśīkṛte śarīre eva tadindriya grāhakamipyate noparistham
kūpādipu kuto'dhastāt pratibimbādvinekṣaṇam | prāṅmukhodarpaṇaṃ paśyan syācca pratyaṅmukhaḥ katham ?
tatraiva vodhayedartha vahiryāta yadīndriyam | tata etadbhavedeva śarīre tattu bodhakam
atrocyate–jale sūryādidarśināṃ dvedhā cakṣuḥ sarvadā pravarttate, ekamūrdhvam, aparañca adhastāt
tatra nordhvāśaprakāśitaṃ sūryam ātmā pratipadyate adhiṣṭhānā'nṛjutvāt, avāgvṛtyā tu taṃ budhyate pāramparyārpitaṃ santam adhiṣṭhānarjutvāt, avāgiva ca manyate
ūrdhvavṛttitadekatvāt, tena kāraṇena adhastādeva ādityaḥ sāntarālaḥ pratīyate

evaṃ darpaṇādau nāyano raśmiḥ pratihato vyāvṛttya svakīyameva mukhaṃ prāṅmukharaśmeḥ samarpayati, tataśca prāgnatayā nāyanaraśmivṛttyā mukha buddhyamānaḥ pratipattā pratyak tadvṛttisamarpitaṃ pratyag ityavagacchati
apsūryadarśinā nityaṃ dvedhā cakṣuḥ pravarttate | ekamūrdhvamadhastācca tatrordhvāśaprakāśitam
ūrdhvavṛttiradhovṛttyai namarpayati sā ca ātmana iti
ka punarurdhvavṛtteradhovṛttyā sambandho yena samarpayati ata āha ūrdhveti
ekasyaiva hi tāvaśau tenāsyordhvavṛttestayā vṛttyā dharmirūpeṇaikyamiti adhovṛttyā'vavudhyamānastadānuguṇyādavāgiva mūrya manyata iti
yattu prāṅmukho darpaṇa paśyan katha pratyaṅmukho dṛśyata ityukta tatrāha– evamiti
tatrāpi pratyagvṛttiprakāśita mukham adhiṣṭhānānārjavānnātmā pratipadyata iti, kintu pratyagvṛtti prāgvṛttyai samarpayati tayā ca samarpita prāgvṛttyā budhyamāna tadānuguṇyena pratyagiti budhyate

nanvatra darpaṇasthameva mukha gṛhyate na jalapātreṣviva adha sāntarāla tatkasya heto ? atrāpi sāntarālameva pratyagvṛttyā prakāśita prāgvṛttyai samarpita tathaiva grahītavyam, ucyate-vastusvabhāvasyāparyanuyojyatvādadoṣa
taijaseṣu hi darpaṇādiṣu tadgatameva mukha gṛhyate jale tu sāntarālamiti kimatrapṛcchyate iti
ye hi jalapātre jala sūryañca paśyanti teṣāmapsūryadarśināmekameva cakṣurūrdhvamadhaśca dvidhā bhāgaśa pravartate
pāramparyeṇa tu saureṇa tejasā vṛtterarpitamādityamavāgvṛttyā kāraṇabhūtayā budhyate
tathāhi–kila saura tejastejasvina vṛtterarpayati vṛttiścakṣuṣaścakṣurātmana ityetat pāramparyārpaṇa sūryasya tejasvina iti
ādityamūrdhvavṛttim uparisthañca tamādityamavāgiva adha sthitamiva manyate
tasmādanantaroditenaiva cakṣuṣo vṛttivaśena sāntarālo'dhastātkūpādiṣu sūryo dṛśyate jalādipātrabhedācca
anyathā kathamabhedena grahaṇa syāt ? prathama kila cakṣūraśmayo mukhamādāya nirgacchanti yāvadādarśādideśam, sā prāṅnatā vṛttirucyate
te ca tatrādarśādau pratihatā nivarttamānā svamukhameva yathāvasthitamāgacchanti
tatra prāṅnatā vṛttirmukha pratyagvṛtterarpayati, pratyagvṛttiścātmana, tata ātmā pratyagvṛttisamarpitamavagacchan mukha bhrāntyā pratyaṅmukha yāsyāmīti manyate
adhiṣṭhānānṛjutvācca nātmā sūrya prapadyate | pāramparyārpitaṃ santamavāgvṛttyā nu budhyate
ūrdhvavṛttitadekatvāt avāgiva ca manyate | adhastādeva tenārkaḥ sāntarālaḥ pratīyate
evaṃ prāgnatayā vṛttyā pratyagvṛttisamarpitam | budhyamāno mukhaṃ bhrāntaḥ pratyagityavagacchati

kiñca, yadi pratibimbamarthāntaraṃ bimbādutpannaṃ tadā kathaṃ bimbe calati niyamena tadapi calet, tiṣṭhati ca tiṣṭhet ? nahi daṇḍe calati tiṣṭhati ca tato'rthāntarabhūto ghaṭaḥ niyamena calati tiṣṭhati ceti pratītam
pratīyate ca vimbasya calācalatve niyamena pratibimbasya calācalatvam, ato na tat tato'rthāntaram
§ yadi ca tattato'rthāntaraṃ § syāt tadā darpaṇādau bimbāpāye kuto nopalabhyate ? vinaṣṭatvāccet; na; nimittakāraṇāpāye kāryasya apāyā'pratīte
na khalu daṇḍādernimittakāraṇasyāpāye ghaṭādeḥ kāryasya vināśaḥ svapne'pi pratīyate
astu vā tadapāye tadvināśaḥ; tathāpi pratibimbavināśe pṛthak tadavayavopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ dhaṭavināśe kapālopalambhavat, na caivamasti
tato na vāstavaṃ jalādau pratibimbamabhyupamantavyam, kintu tena pratihatā raśmayo vyāvṛtya mukhādibimbameva jalādau darśayantītyabhyupagantavyamiti
na khalu pratibimbanāśe paścāttruṭitā avayavā samupalabhyante

yattāvaduktam–jalādau na pratibimbaṃ nāma vastvantaraṃ maṃbhavati ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, yato'sya asaṃbhavaḥ grāhakapramāṇāsaṃbhavāt, utpādakakāraṇābhāvādvā syāta ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ, nikhilapramāṇajyeṣṭhasya pratyakṣapramāṇasyaiva tatra tatmadbhāvāvedakasya saṃbhavāt
nirmale hi jalādau candrādipratibimba paśyāmi iti pratīti pratiprāṇi prasiddhā
nahi iyaṃ candra paśyāmi inyebaṃ rūpopajāyate, nāpi jalama
na ceyaṃ pratītirbhrāntā; marvatra sarvadā marveṣām ekādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa upajāyamānatvāt
yat sarvatra sarvadā sarvepāmekādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa upajāyate na tad bhrāntam yathā ghaṭādisaṃvedanam, tathābhūtā ceyaṃ pratibimbapratīti, tasmānna bhrānnā iti
nahi bhrāntaṃ śuktikādau rajatādisaṃvedanaṃ sarvatra sarvadā sarvepām erkādṛśenaiva rūpeṇa upajāyate, duṣṭendriyayogināmeva puṃsāṃ tadutpattipratīte, aduṣṭendriyayogināṃ tepāṃ tadanupapatteḥ
tulanā–na hi dṛṣṭājjyeṣṭha gariṣṭhamiṣṭam –aṣṭaśa॰, aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 80
na hi dṛṣṭād gariṣṭha pramāṇamasti –nayaca॰ vṛ॰ pṛ॰ 18
kiñca, yatra jñāne samutpanne vāvakapratyayaḥ kāraṇadopajñānaṃ vā prādurbhavati tad bhrāntaṃ bhavati, yathā śuktikāyāṃ rajatādijñānam
na ca ādarśādau pratibimbapratītau naitadevam ityevarūpo bādhakapratyayaḥ kadācidapyāvirbhavati
na ca bādhakābhāve'pyasya bhrāntatvaṃ vācyam, atiprasaṅgāt
pratibimbapratīte khalu kāraṇam ātmamanaścakṣurādilakṣaṇam, na ca tatra doṣāḥ pratīyante
nahi kṣudādirātmano doṣaḥ nidrādirmanasaḥ kācakāmalādiścakṣupaḥ tatpratītyutpattau pratīyate; santṛptasya nidrādyanupahatacetaso nirmalanetrasyāpi pratipattu pratibimbapratipatteḥ pratīyamānatvāt
tadeva siddhamabhrāntamidaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bimbāt pratibimbasya arthāntaratvaprasādhakam
tulanā–tasmāt yasya ca duṣṭa kāraṇam, yatra ca mithyeti pratyaya sa evāsamīcīna pratyaya nānya iti
tathāhi– yad yato vilakṣaṇapratītigrāhyaṃ tat tato bhinnam yathā mudrātaḥ pratimudrā, jala-candrādibimbābhyāṃ vilakṣaṇapratītigrāhyañca candrādipratibimbamiti
na caitadasiddham, bimbākārānukāritayā hi bimbaṃ prati ābhimukhyena yad varttate tat pratibimbam, yathā mudrākārānukāriṇī pratimudrā
tatpratītau ca kathaṃ tato vilakṣaṇapratītigrāhyatvamasya asiddham
na caitad bimbasyaiva grahaṇamityabhidhātavyam; jalādau dṛkpātānantarameva candrādibimbamapaśyataḥ tatpratītidarśanāt
na cātra vilakṣaṇā pratītiḥ pratīyamānāpi asya tato bhedaṃ na prasādhayatīti vācyam; sarvatra bhedavārttocchedaprasaṅgāt, sarvatra asyāḥ pratītibhedanibandhanatvāt

kathamanyathā yadvastu kadācidapi na pratītaṃ tasminnaparidṛśyamāne vyavahite'pi tadbimbāvarakābhāve tatpratibimbapratītiḥ syāt ? tadvimbe darśanasya smaraṇasya pratyabhijñānasya vā sarvathā'saṃbhavāt
tulanā– tathā yadyato vilakṣaṇapratītigrāhya tattato bhinna yathā mudrāta pratimudrā –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 863
bimbasya āvaraṇa yadi syāt tadā pratibimbasyotpattireva na syāt ata āha tadvimbāvārakābhāve
nāpyutpādakakāraṇābhāvāt; tadutpādakakāraṇasya upādānarūpasya nimittabhūtasya cātra saṃbhavāt
pratibimbotpattau hi jalādikamupādānakāraṇam candrādikaṃ tu nimitta kāraṇam, gaganatalāvalambinaṃ candraṃ nimittīkṛtya jalādestathāpariṇāmāt

pṛ॰ 865 asya soddharaṇa khaṇḍanamittham–yadapi prabhācandra prāha–pratibimbotpattau hi jalādikamupādānakāraṇa candrādika ca nimittakāraṇa gaganatalāvalambina candra nimittīkṛtya jalādestathā pariṇāmāt iti, tadasyātyantārjavavijṛmbhitam, yathā hi tejo'bhāvamapekṣya te patrādeśchāyāpudgalā pṛthivyādāvāśraye chāyādravyarūpatayā pariṇamante tathātrāpi yadi vadanādibimbasya chāyāpudgalā darpaṇādiprasannadravyasāmagrīmapekṣya pratibimbarūpatayā pariṇamante tadā kinnāma kṣūṇa syāt asyāpi chāyābiśepasvabhāvatvāt
tathā cāgama–sāmā udiyā chāyā'bhāsuragayā nisimmi kālābhā

tacca cintyam–ā॰ bādidevasūrimatena hi mukhādibimbasya chāyāpudgalā mukhādbinirgacchanta darpaṇādau svacchatādisamāgrīvaśāt pratibimbamārabhante asmanmate tu svaccha evādarśādau bimbasannidhāne tadgatachāyāpudgalasakramāt pratibimbamutpadyate syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 864 iti svayamabhidhānāt
tatreda vicāraṇīya yat–mukhādibhya chāyāpudgalavinirgamana kinnibandhanam ? yadi teṣā svabhāvoya yatte sadaiva viniryānti tadā cakṣuṣo raśmivinirgamana naiyāyikādibhi ukta katha pratikṣipyate
yadi hi abhāsvarānmukhāt ghaṭārdevā chāyāpudgalavini sṛti yuktipathaprasthāyinyabhimanyate tadā bhāsvararūpaśālicakṣuṣo raśmibiniryāṇa tu nyāyānubhavasaṅgata sutarāmeva syāt
ata- ścakṣuṣo raśmivinirgamana pratikṣipadbhi mukhādibimbāt chāyāpudgalavini sṛti svīkriyamāṇā svabadhāya kṛtyotthāpanameva pratibhāti

syā॰ ratnākarasya 698 pṛṣṭhe tu ebhireva prameyakamalamārtaṇḍamanusaradbhi spaṣṭamuktam yat–svacchatāviśeṣāddhi jaladarpaṇādayo mukhādityādipratibimbākāravikāradhāriṇa sampadyante iti, atraiva ca cakṣuṣo raśminirgamanasya pratiṣedhāt jñāyate yattatprakaraṇe tu vādidevasūraya prabhācandramarthata śabdataśca anusaranti, atra tu tatkhaṇḍanābhilāṣeṇa pūrvāparabirodhamapi na paśyantīti citrametat
yadapyuktam–tatsannidhāne guṇarūpam dravyarūpaṃ vā tadutpadyeta ityādi; tadapyayuktam; dravyarūpasyaivāsya tatsannidhāne tatrotpādābhyupagamāt
yadapi–niravayavadravyarūpaṃ sāvayavadravyarūpaṃ vā tat syāt ityādyuktam, tadapyuktimātram; asmadādīndriyagrāhyadravyasya niravayavatvā'siddheḥ

yatpunaruktam–nāpi sāvayavaṃ jalādisparśāt pṛthak tatsparśopalambhā'sabhavāt iti, tadapyasāmpratam; yato jalādisparśāt pṛthak tatsparśopalambhastadā syāt yadā jalādeḥ tatpratibimbamarthāntarabhūtaṃ dravyaṃ syāt, yadā tu jalādikameva tathā pariṇamate tadāsya tato'rthāntaratvāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ pṛthak tatsparśopalambhasyāśaṅkā'pi syāt ?
etena jalādiparamāṇava evāsya ārambhakā anye vā ityādi pratyuktam; jalaparamāṇūnāmeva uktaprakāreṇa tadārambhakatvapratijñānāt
pratibimbe jalarūpād vilakṣaṇarūpapratīteḥ katha te tadārambhakāḥ ? ityapyanupapannam; pudgalānāṃ vicitrarūpādipariṇāmasāmagrīsannidhāne vicitrarūpādipariṇatyupapatteḥ
dṛśyate hi mukhādibimbe'pi tatsannidhāne vicitrā rūpapariṇatiḥ, kopād raktatayā lajjātaḥ kṛṣṇatayā harpāt sukāntimattayā mukhādeḥ pariṇāmapratīteḥ
ato mukhacandrādibimbasannidhāne jalādervicitro rūpādipariṇāmo na virodhamadhyāste

etena idamapi prativyūḍham–dvayoḥ sāvayavayoḥ samānākāśadeśatvānupapattiḥ, āśrayadravyasya cādarśādeḥ parimāṇagauravayorutkarṣaḥ syāt iti, dvayoḥ sāvayavadravyayoḥ atrā'saṃbhavāt, ekasyaiva jalādidravyasya svasāmagrīviśeṣavaśāt tathāpariṇāmāt
naca samānākāśadeśatvaṃ sāvayavayoḥ viruddham; jalabhasmanoḥ vātātapayorvā sāvayavayorapi tatpratīteḥ
uṣṇajale hi jalāgnyo dvayo sāvayavayo samānadeśatā jātā na ca parimāṇagauravayorutkarṣa, tathā taptasuvarṇe suvarṇāgnyo sāvayavayo sambandhe'pi na tayorutkarpa sandṛśyate iti bhāva
yaccānyaduktam–apsūryadarśināṃ nityaṃ dvedhā cakṣuḥ pravarttate ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; raśmirūpasya cakṣuṣaḥ kutaścidapi pramāṇādaprasiddheḥ
tulanā–svapradeśasthatayā saviturgrahaṇāsiddhe cākṣuṣa teja pratistrota pravartitamiti cātīvāsagata pramāṇābhāvāt…
cākṣuṣa teja pratistrota pravartitamiti cātīvāsaṅgatam, pramāṇābhāvāt
na hi cakṣustaijāsi jalenābhisambandhya puna savitāra prati pravṛttāni pratyakṣādipramāṇata pratīyante
yathā ca nāyanaraśmīnā viṣaya prati pravṛttirnāsti tathā cakṣuṣo'prāpyakāritvapraghaṭṭake pratipāditamityalamatiprasaṅgena

nanu pratibimbodayavādināṃ mate bimbānukāriṇā pratibimbena bhavitavyam tatkathaṃ savyadakṣiṇaviparyayeṇa pratibimbasya pratītiḥ; ityapyacodyam; svasāmagrītaḥ tasya savyadakṣiṇasvabhāvatayaiva utpatteḥ
bimbābhimukhena hi pratibimbena bhavitavyam, ābhimukhyañca savyadakṣiṇaviparyāsavyatirekeṇa asya nopapadyate iti tathaiva asyotpattirupapannā, anyathā pratibimbam iti vyapadeśo'sya anupapannaḥ syāt
tulanā–tadapi pratibimbaśabdaniruktyaiva kṛtottaram, para mithyābhiniveśānna cetayate bhavān
tacca savyadakṣiṇapārśvaviparyāsavyatirekeṇāsya nopapadyate iti tathaivotpattispapannā, anyathā tu pratibimbamiti vyapadeśa evāsyānupapanna syāt
kiñca, yanmate pratibimbamarthāntaraṃ tasya savyadakṣiṇaviparyāso guṇa eva, yata eva bimbadharmaviparītadharmayogo'ta eva asya ato'nyatvam

yadi ca pratibimbamanyanna syāt, ādarśādinā pratihatairnāyanaraśmibhirvyāvṛtya deśaviparyāsena mukhādereva ādarśādau prakāśanāt, tadā kuḍyādinā'pi pratihatāste vyāvṛtya kimiti kuḍyādau mukhanna prakāśayanti viśepābhāvāt ? nacātra svacchatā upayoginī, raśmipratīdhātamātrasyaiva tatropayogāt, tacca ubhayatrāpyaviśiṣṭam, pratyuta kuḍyādinā ghanadravyeṇa atiśayavān pratīghāto vidhīyate, ataḥ tatra atiśayavatā tatpratibhāsena bhāvyam
kāraṇātiśayāddhi kāryātiśayo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā pittātiśayāt śaṅkhādiṣu pītatvāvabhāsātiśayaḥ
asmanmate tu nirmale svaccha eva ādarśādau bimbasannidhāne pratibimbamutpadyate na punaḥ kuḍyādau tadviparīte, atastatra tatpratibhāsābhāvaḥ
tulanā–kiñca, yanmate pratibimbamarthāntara tasya savyadakṣiṇapārśvayorviparyāso guṇa eva
ādarśatalādiṣu prasannadravyeṣu mukhādicchāyā tadvarṇādipariṇatopalabhyate itaratra pratibimbamātrameva
atrāha–viparītagrahaṇa kuta prāṅmukhasya pratyaṅmukhā chāyā dṛśyate iti ? prasannadravyapariṇāmaviśeṣāda bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? nayananirgatena raśminā dhanadravyāt pratihatanivṛttena svamukhasyaiva grahaṇamiti, tadayuktam, viparyāsagrahaṇābhāvaprasaṅgāt kuḍyādiṣu atiprasaṅgāt grahaṇaśaktyabhāvācca
viparyāsagrahaṇābhāvaprasaṅgastāvat yadi pratinivṛttena nayanaraśminā svaśarīrasyaiva grahaṇa prāṅmukhasya prāṅmukhameva grahaṇa syāt viparyāsahetvabhāvāt
kuḍyādiṣu vā'tiprasaṅga syāt, nayanaraśme pratidhātasya tatrāpi sadbhāvāt

katha punardarpaṇatalādiṣu pratibimba mukhādīnā sammukhameva chāyākāreṇa pariṇamate na parāṅmukham ? katha vā kaṭhinamādarśamaṇḍala pratibhidya mukhato vinirgatā pudgalā pratibimbamājihata iti ? yattāvaducyate sammukhameva pratibimbamudeti nānyato mukhamiti, tatra pariṇāma sa tādṛśa pudgalānām, nahi tadviṣaya paryanuyoga karttuṃ śakya –tattvārthabhā॰ vyā॰ pṛ॰ 364
tulanā–yadi cādarśādipratihatā raśmaya mukha prakāśayanti tadā śilātalādipratihatā api te tatprakāśayeyu viśeṣābhāvāt –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 864
kiñca, ādarśādinā pratihatā raśmayaḥ vyāvṛtya yadi bimbameva prakāśayanti, tadā mahato hastyāde svaparimāṇānatikrameṇaiva pratītiprasaṅgāt laghutvapratītirna syāt
ataḥ pratibimbameva tatra tathābhūtamutpanna pratibhāsate ityabhyupagantavyam
svaparimāṇānusāritayā hi darpaṇādinā pratibimbamārabhyate, ato mahato laghutvapratipattiraviruddhā
yadi ca kṛpāṇādau kācādau cāśraye pratihatāste vyāvṛttya bimbameva prakāśayanti; tadā āyata-śyāmamukhapratītirna syāt
asmanmate tu āśrayasya āyatatvāt śyāmatvācca tadārabdhasya pratibimbasyāpi āyatatva śyāmatvañcopapannam
tulanā–tadā mahato hastyāde svaparimāṇānatikrameṇaiva pratītiprasaṅgālladhutvapratītirna syāt
tulanā–api ca yadi kācakṛpāṇādau pratihatāste vyāvṛttya bimbameva prakāśayanti tadā tatrāyataśyāmamukhapratītirna syāt

yadapyuktam–yadi pratibimbamarthāntaramutpannam ityādi; tadapyacarcitābhidhānam; arthāntarasyāsyotpattāvapi niyamena nimittakāraṇakriyānukāritayā tatkriyāyāṃ niyamena kriyāvattvopapatteḥ pradīpaprakāśavat, chatrachāyāvadvā
yathaiva hi pradīpe chatre ca calati prakāśaśchāyā ca niyamena calati sthire tu sthirā bhavati, evaṃ bimbe calati niyamena pratibimbaṃ calati tiṣṭhati tu tiṣṭhati
na khalu ghaṭe niyamena nimittakāraṇakriyānuvidhānaṃ na dṛṣṭam ityetāvatā sarvatra tanniṣeddhrumucitam, pradīpaprakaśādāvapi tanniṣedhaprasaṅgāt
ghaṭe ca tadvad bhāsurarūpādikamapi nopalabdham ataḥ pradīpaprakāśādāvapi tanniṣiddhyatāmaviśepāt
tulanā–arthāntarasyotpattāvāpi niyamena pariṇāmakāraṇakriyānukāritayā tasmiṃścalati calanasya tiṣṭhati sthānasya ca tatropapatte
yaccānyaduktam–nimittakāraṇāpāye kāryasyāpāyāpratīteḥ ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; pradīpachatrādernimittakāraṇasyā'pāye prakāśachāyayorapāyapratīteḥ
tulanā–na khalu mṛdādyapāye kalaśādāvapāyo nopalabdha iti
etena pratibimbavināśe pṛthak tadavayavopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ ityādi pratyuktam; pradīpādervināśe'pi tadapratīteḥ
na khalu pradīpavidyudādidravyāṇāṃ vināśe'pi pṛthak tadavayavāḥ kvacit kadācit kasyacit pratītipathaprasthāyino bhavantīti
sāmpratam atītaikakālānāṃ gatiḥ nā'nāgatānāṃ vyabhicārāt pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 1

vyākhyā–tatrāpi rasāde rūpādyanumāne atītānāmekakālānāñca gati rasopādānasamānakālabhāvino'tītā liṅgabhūtarasasahabhāvina ekakālā teṣāṅgati nānāgatānām vartamānena liṅgenānumāna vyabhicārāt, anāgataṃ hi kāraṇāntarapratibaddhaṃ tatra pratibandhavaikalyasaṃbhavānna bhavedapi
yaccādyodayāt śva sūryodayādyanumānanna tadanumāna niyāmakaliṅgābhāvāt, adya gardabhadarśanāt śva sūryodayānumānavat
śva āditya udeteti grahaṇaṃ vā bhaviṣyati || 14
śakaṭa rohiṇī dharmī muhūrttānte bhaviṣyadudeṣyaditi sādhyadharma, kuta ? kṛttikodayāditi sādhanam
na khalu kṛttikodaya śakaṭodayasya kāryaṃ svabhāvo vā, kevalamavinābhāvabalād gamayatyeva svottaramiti pratipadyeta anumanyeta sarvo'pi jana iti
tathā śva prāta āditya sūrya udetā udeṣyati adyādityodayāditi pratipadyeta
tathā śvo grahaṇaṃ rāhusparśo bhavaṣyati evavidhaphalakāṅkāditi vā pratipadyeta sarvatrā'vyabhicārāt –ladhī॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 33
pratibandhaparisakhyāyām udeṣyati śakaṭa kṛttikodayāditi kiṃ pramāṇam ? –siddhibi॰ pṛ॰ 317B
vivṛtiḥ–tadetad bhaviṣyadviṣayamavisaṃvādakaṃ jñānaṃ pratibandhasaṃkhyāṃ pramāṇasaṃkhyāñca pratiruṇaddhi
tathā śvaḥ prātaḥ āditya udetā iti pratipadyeta adya ādityodayāt iti gamyate
grahaṇaṃ vā bhaviṣyati iti pratipadyeta, kutaścit phalakāṅkādeḥ
tasmād ekalakṣaṇānvitāddhetoḥ etad bhaviṣyadviṣayaṃ bhāviśakaṭodayādigocaram avisaṃvādakaṃ jñānaṃ siddham
tan kiṃ karoti ? ityāha–pratibandhasaṃkhyāṃ pratiruṇaddhi tādātmyatadutpattyoratrā'saṃbhavāt
atha kṛttikodayādeḥ śakaṭodayādikāryatvādayamadoṣaḥ; tanna; atītakṛttikodayādeḥ śakaṭodayāt pratītyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
anyacca tat kiṃ karoti ? ityāha–pramāṇasaṃkhyāñca pratiruṇaddhi paraparikalpitasya pratibandhasya pakṣadharmatvādeścā'bhāve'pi kṛttikodayādyanumānasya bhāvāt
tanna kāryasvabhāvānupalabdhiliṅgaprabhavaṃ trividhameva anumānam ityanumānapramāṇasaṅkhyāniyamaḥ saugatānāṃ vyavatiṣṭhate prāguktaliṅgaprabhavānumānānāṃ tato'rthāntaratvaprasiddheḥ
prajñākaraguptasya bhāvikāraṇatābhūcakaṃ matamittham–bhāvena ca bhāvo bhāvinā'pi lakṣyata eva mṛtyuprayuktamariṣṭamiti loke vyavahāraḥ
yadi mṛtyurna bhaviṣyanna bhavadevambhūtamariṣṭamiti tasmādanāgatasyāpi kāraṇatvamavyabhicārāditi yuktametat
kṛttikodayānumāne siddhe sati tataḥ śakaṭodayānumānam, tasmācca kṛttikodayānumānamiti
etena naiyāyikopakalpitaḥ pañcadhaivānumānamityanumānasaṅkhyāniyamaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; pūrvoktānumānānāṃ pañcasvanumāneṣu anantarbhāvāt
kāraṇādayaḥ pañca hetava eva gamakāḥ iti vaiśeṣikasya pūrvapakṣaḥ–
nanu asyedaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃyogi samavāyi virodhi ceti laiṅgikam vaiśe॰ sū॰ 9

2 iti sūtropāttā eva pañca hetavo laiṅgikāṅgam avinābhāvasya atraiva parisamāpteḥ, tatkathaṃ naiyāyikānāmanumānasaṃkhyāniyamo na vyavatiṣṭheta ? atra kāraṇāt kāryānumānam; yathā jvaladindhanadarśanāt bhaviṣyati bhasma iti
kāryaṃ kāraṇapūrvakatvenopalambhādupalabhyamānaṃ sad gamakam, yathāhi–viśiṣṭanadīpūropalambhādupariṣṭād vṛṣṭo deva iti

tathā ca vahalasvarūpaphenaphenilaparṇakāṣṭhādivahanaviśiṣṭasya nadīpūrasya vṛṣṭikāryatvena pūrvamupalambhāt punastadupalambhe sati yuktamanumānam– aya nadīpūro vṛṣṭikāryo viśiṣṭanadīpūratvāt pūrvopalabdhanadīpūravaditi
kāraṇamiti kāryajanakatvena pūrvamupalabdhespalabhyamāna talliṃga yathā ca viśiṣṭamedhonnatirvarṣakarmaṇa
tathā dhūmo'gne sayogī samavāyī ca uṣṇasparśo vāristha tejo gamayatīti
tatpratividhānapurassaraṃ kṛttikodayādīnāṃ pūrvacarādihetūnāmapi pṛthak rūpeṇa gamakatvapradarśanam–
yattāvaduktam–sūtropāttā eva pañca hetavo laiṅgikāṅgam ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tadatiriktānāṃ kṛttikodayādihetūnāṃ tadaṅgatvapratipādanāt
avinābhāvasya tu sakalahetukalāpavyāpitvāt tadābhāsebhyo vyāvṛttatvācca tadvaśādeva hetorgamakatvaṃ pratipattavyam
nahi tadvyatirekeṇa kvacidapi hetorgamakatvaṃ pratīyate, sarvatra gamakatvasya avinābhāve satyeva upapatteḥ
kāryakāraṇabhāvasya ca paṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ prapañcataḥ pratiṣiddhatvāt paramate kāryakāraṇaliṅgayorasiddhiḥ
nahi kamaṇḍalunā chātrānumānam, nāpi rūpāde pṛthivyādyanumānam, nāpi rūpādrasānumānamiti

yacca viruddhasyānumānasyodāharaṇa bhūta varṣaṇakarma abhūtasya vāyvabhrasayogasyānumāpaka tathā'bhūta varṣaṇakarma bhūtasya vāyvabhrasayogasyānumāpakamiti, tadanupapannam, bhāvābhāvayorhyatra gamyagamakatā, na ca tayorvirodho'sti tasmāt kāryakāraṇabhāvādaya eva sambandhā yasya yena niyatā avyabhicāriṇa sa heturiti –praka॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 68
kāraṇādirūpatāmātrasya kṛttikodayādihetuṣu avyāpti, dhūmādisādhya prati vyabhicāritvāddhatvābhāsabhūteṣu agnyādiṣu sadbhāvāccātiprasaga
prakṛtivirodhirdaśanāt tadvirodhyantarānumānam, yathā na varṣiṣyati valāhaka pratyanīkapavanayogitvāt
vadhyadhātānumānam, yathā saharṣanakuladarśanāt ghātito'nena sarpaḥ iti jñānam
ādigrahaṇāt saṃyogyanumānam, yathā samudāyavartini parivrājake kaḥ parivrājakaḥ iti saṃśaye tridaṇḍadarśanāt parivrājako'yam iti jñānamiti
tadapyetenaiva pratyākhyātam, kṛttikodayādihetūnāṃ naiyāyikopakalpitahetubhya iva atopyarthāntarabhāvā'viśeṣāt
vidyuta kādācitkatvena kāryatvāt kenāpi kāraṇena bhavitavyamiti –ā॰ ṭi॰
tulanā–etena saptabidha sambandha iti pratyuktam –nyāyavā॰ pṛ॰ 57
athedānīm dṛśyānupalabdhireva gamikā, nānyā saṃśayahetutvāt iti niyama nirākurvannāha–
pratiṣedhasiddhirapi yathoktāyā evānupalabdhe, sati vastuni tasyā asabhavāt, anyathā cānupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpteṣu deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭeṣu ātmapratyakṣanivṛtterabhāvaniścayābhāvāt
pṛ॰ 42 viprakṛṣṭaviṣayānupalabdhi pratyakṣānumānanivṛttilakṣaṇā saśayahetu pramāṇanivṛttāvapi arthābhāvāsiddheriti
apiśabdo'tra draṣṭavya, tena laukikā gopālādayo'pi kiṃ puna parīkṣakā ityartha
kam ? abhāvam asattām, kasya ? adṛśyaparacittāde parepāmāturāṇā citta caitanyamādiryasyāsau paracittādi, adṛśyaścāsau paricittādiśca sa tathoktastasya
kuta ? tadityādi, tasya paracittāde kāryabhūto'vinābhāvī ākāra uṣṇasparśādilakṣaṇa tasya vikāro'nyathābhāva ādiryasya vacanaviśeṣārogyāde tasyānupapattita asabhavāt
vivṛtiḥ–adṛśyānupalabdheḥ saṃśayaikānte na kevalaṃ paracittābhāvo na siddhyati api tu svacittabhāvaśca, tadanaṃśatattvasya adṛśyātmakatvāt
tathā ca kutaḥ paramārthasataḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ ? tadviparītasya abhedalakṣaṇasyaiva syāt
adṛśyaścāsau paracittādiśca, ādiśabdena bhūtagrahavyādhiparigrahaḥ, tasyā'bhāvaṃ laukikā viduḥ
tena adṛśyaparacittādinā sahabhāvī śarīragata uṣṇasparśādilakṣaṇa ākāraḥ tadākāraḥ tasya vikāraḥ anyathābhāva ādiryasya vacanaviśeṣasya tasya anyathānupapattitaḥ
abhāvaparicchede abhāvapramāṇasyaiva vyāpāra na bhāvarūpāṇāṃ pratyakṣādīnāmiti abhāvasya prathakpṛthak prāmāṇyavādino mīmāsakasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu sarvatra abhāvaparicchede abhāvapramāṇasyaiva vyāpāraḥ, paracittābhāvaśca abhāvaḥ tasmād abhāvasyaiva paricchedyaḥ

tacca abhāvapramāṇam pratyakṣādibhyo bhinnam, tadbhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvāt bhinnaviṣayatvāt bhinnaphalasādhakatvācca, yad yato bhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ tat tato bhinnam yathā pratyakṣādanumānādi, tathābhūtañcedam, tasmāt pratyakṣādibhyo bhinnamiti
na cāsya tadbhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvamasiddham; tathāhi–indriyārthasannikarṣarūpāyāḥ pratyakṣādisāmagrītaḥ tāvadabhāvapramāṇaṃ notpattumarhati, abhāvena saha indriyāṇāṃ sannikarṣābhāvāt
na hi tatra teṣāṃ saṃyogalakṣaṇaḥ sannikarpaḥ saṃbhavati; abhāvasya adravyatvāt
viśeṣaṇaṃ hi saṃyuktaṃ samavetaṃ vā bhavati yathā daṇḍo guṇādiśca, na cābhāvaḥ kvacit saṃyuktaḥ samaveto vā ityuktam
mā bhūt sayogata, sayuktaviśeṣaṇatvād gahyatāmiti cet, na, asati sambandhe viśeṣaṇatvāyogāt
astyeva sambandha iti cet, ko'sau ? na tāvatsayoga, adravyatvāt
abhyupagame vā sayuktasamavāyādeva grahaṇāt tadviśeṣaṇatvamavaktavya syāt
tanna tāvad bhavatāmasti sannikarṣa asmāka tu asti sayuktasamavāya
bhāvāṃśenaiva sambandho yogyatvādindriyasya hi || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 18
yadi nendriyādisāmagrītastadutpadyate, kutastarhi tadutpadyeta iti cet ? upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptapratipedhyārthānupalabdhi-bhūtalādyāśrayopalabdhi-pratiṣedhyaghaṭādismaraṇalakṣaṇasāmagrīviśepāt
yamyābhāva kripate na pratiyogī yathā ghaṭābhāve ghaṭa
mānasa nāstitājñānaṃ jāyate'kṣānapekṣayā || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 27
sātmano'pariṇāmo vā vijñāna vā'nyavastyuni || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 11
yo'yamātmano ghaṭādiviṣaya pratyakṣādijñānambaspa pariṇāma tadabhāvamātramevānutpattirabhāva iti bodhyate
tacca ghaṭādyabhāvaviṣaya nāsti, buddhijanakatayā indriyādivat pramāṇa nāsti iti
sā pratyakṣāderanutpatti nipedhyābhimatadhaṭādipadārthajñānarūpeṇāpariṇata sāmyāvasthamātmadravyamucyate, ghaṭādivivipatabhūtalajñāna vā –tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 471
ātmana svarūpasyāpariṇāma iti prasajya iti pratipedha –ā॰ ṭi॰
yadi hi upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptārthānupalabdhirna syāt tadā bhūtalādyāśrayopalabdhāvapi abhāvapratītirna syāt
yadi ca bhūtalādyāśrayapratītirna syāt tadā bhūtalādyavacchedena ghaṭādyabhāvapratītirna syāt
na ca sāmānyena ghaṭādyabhāvapratītirupajāyate, kintu bhūtale
tathā, yadi praniyogismaraṇa na syāt narhi nāsti ityevaṃrūpā pratītiḥ syāt natu ghaṭo nāsti iti
tathā anumānasāmagrīto'pi, tasya hi sāmagrī liṅgādilakṣaṇā, na ca abhāvenā 'vinābhūtaṃ kiñcilliṅgamasti
anupalabdhirastīti cet, nanvasau gṛhītavyāptikā, agṛhītavyāptikā vā abhāvamanumāpayet ? na tāvadagṛhītavyāptikā, atiprasaṅgāt
nāpi gṛhītavyāptikā; yato vyāptigrahaṇaṃ dhūmāgnivad ubhayadharmagrahaṇapūrvakam

vyāptigrahaṇavelāyāñca kutaḥ abhāvākhyadharmagrahaṇam–ata eva anumānāt, tadantarādvā ? yadi ata eva; anyonyāśrayaḥ; tathāhi–ato'numānādabhāvasiddhau anupalabdherabhāvena avinābhāvitvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau cā'to'numānādabhāvasiddhiriti
sa cānyena grahītavyo gṛhīte hi liṅgatā
kiñca, anupalabdhyākhyaṃ liṅgamapi upalabdhyabhāvasvabhāvam, ataḥ tatsvarūpapratipattāvapi uktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ

nāpi arthāpattyupamānāgamasāmagrīsamutthatā; prāk pratipāditāyā abhāvapramāṇasāmagryāḥ arthāpattyādisāmagrīto'nyathānupapadyamānārtha-upamānopameyagatasādṛśyagrahaṇaśabdādilakṣaṇāyāḥ sarvathā bhinnatvāt
nāpi bhinnaviṣayatvam; tathāhi–iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti pratyayaḥ na tāvad bhāvaviṣayaḥ, tadvailakṣaṇyena pratiprāṇi saṃvedyamānatvāt
bhāvaviṣayatve cāsya ghaṭo viṣayaḥ, bhūtalam, tatsaṃsargo vā ? prathamapakṣe sati ghaṭe ghaṭasattāpratyayavat abhāvapratyayo'pi syād ālambanasya vidyamānatvāt
dvitīpapakṣe tu saghaṭe'pi bhūtale abhāvapratyayaprasaṅgaḥ vipayabhūtasya bhūtalasya vidyamānatvāt
nāpi tatsaṃsargaḥ; ghaṭasaṃyukte'pi bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti pratyayaprasaṅgāt
atha ghaṭaviviktaṃ bhūtalam asya viṣayaḥ; nanu tadvaiviktyaṃ kiṃ bhūtalasvarūpamātram, ✢tadvyatiriktaṃ vā ? yadi bhūtalasvarūpamātram;✢ tarhi vidyamāne'pi ghaṭe tatpratyayaprasaṅgaḥ
atha 'tadvyatiriktam; tarhi nāmamātraṃ bhidyate nārthaḥ, viviktatāśabdena abhāvasyaiva abhidhānāt
ataḥ siddho bhāvādarthāntaram abhāvapramāṇasyaiva paricchedyo'bhāvaḥ, pratyakṣādīnāṃ bhāvaviṣayatayā abhāvagocaracāritvābhāvāt
na bhūtalam, satyapi ghaṭe prasaṅgāt –śāstradī॰ pṛ॰ 325
ko'ya ghaṭaviveka ? yadi bhūtalarūpameva, ghaṭavatyapi prasaṅga

yadi cābhāvaḥ pratyakṣaparicchedyaḥ syāt, kathamindriyeṇā'sannikṛṣṭaḥ paricchidyeta ? yadā hi kenacid apavarakaḥ svarūpeṇa gṛhītaḥ jijñāsā'bhāvād devadatto'tra nāsti iti na niścitam, paścād dūradeśamasau gataḥ, yadā kenacitpṛṣṭaḥ kiṃ tatra devadatta āsīnna vā iti ? prativacanañcāsau tadaiva taddeśamanusmṛtya devadattābhāvaṃ pratipadya prayacchati nāsīt iti
nahi tatra indriyasannikarṣo'sti iti kathaṃ tatra pratyakṣasaṃbhavaḥ ? tato na pratyakṣaparicchedyo'bhāvaḥ

yadā hi kaścit prāta kāle kañciddeśamadhyāsonastatra vyāghrādikamadṛṣṭvā tadasmaraṇācca tadabhāvamapyagṛhītvā deśamātra dṛṣṭvā deśāntaragato madhyandine pṛcchyate kaścittasmindeśe prāta kāle vyādhro gaja siṃha pārthivo vā samāgata ? iti
sa tadā ta deśamavagatatvātsmarannapi tatra deśe'nyeṣā vyādhrādīnāmabhāba prāgagṛhīta tadaiva gṛhaṇāti
na ca madhyandine samaye prāta kālikasyābhāvasyānindriyasannikṛṣṭasya sabhavati pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam, tasyendriyasannikṛṣṭavartamānaviṣayatvāt
ataḥ pāriśeṣyād abhāvapramāṇagocara eva abhāva iti nāsiddhaṃ bhinnaviṣayatvam
vyākhyā–ocaka umbeka tveva vyāsyātavān yatra ghaṭākhye vastuni pratyakṣādi sadbhāvagrāhaka nopajāyate tasya nāstitā bhūpradeśādhikaraṇābhāvapramāṇasya prameyā –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 279
tatra sadasadrūpeṇobhayātmake vastuni vyavasthite yasmin vasturūpe vastvaśe'sadrūpākhye pramāṇapañcakamarthāpattiparyanta na jāyate
vastusattāvabodhārtha tatrābhāvapramāṇatā || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 1
ataḥ pratyakṣādibhyo vilakṣaṇasya pratipedhyādhāragrahaṇādisāmagrīprabhavasya nañarthaviṣayasya nañarthasaṃvittiphalasya abhāvapramāṇasya pramāṇāntaratvamabhyupagantavyam
na ca avastuviṣayatvādasya aprāmāṇyam; abhāvasya pramāṇena paricchidyamānatayā avastutvānupapatteḥ
yat pramāṇena paricchidyate na tadavastu yathā bhāvaḥ, pramāṇena paricchidyate ca abhāva iti
avastutve cāsya bhedo durghaṭaḥ, yadavastu na tasya bhedaḥ yathā khapuṣpādeḥ, asti ca prāgabhāvādibhedo'bhāvasya iti
tadavastutve ca arthānāṃ sāṅkarya syāt, dadhyādeḥ kṣīrādyavasthāyāṃ prāgabhāvāderavastutayā'sāṅkaryā'hetutvāt, tathā ca pratiniyatavyavahāravārttocchedaḥ syāditi
na ca syādvyavahāro'yaṃ kāraṇādivibhāgataḥ | prāgabhāvādibhedena nābhāvo yadi bhidyate
vyākhyā–yat khalu dadhirūpa prāgabhūtvā bhavati tadupādeya kāryam, yacca prāgavasthita kṣīrarūpa paścānna bhavati tadupādānakāraṇam, so'ya kāryakāraṇavibhāga
tathā gauraśvo na bhavati, aśvo na bhavati gau, viṣāṇaśūnya śaśa ityādi vyavahāro'satyabhāvasya prāgabhāvādirūpabhede nopapadyata iti
yadvā'nuvṛttivyāvṛttibuddhigrāhyo yatastvayam | tasmād gavādivadvastu prameyatvācca gṛhyatām
tatraiva hetvantaramāha prameyeti –mī॰ ślo॰ nyāyara॰ pṛ॰ 475
abhāvo vastu iti pakṣa, anuvṛttivyāvṛttibuddhigrāhyatvāt prameyatvācceti hetudvaya gavādivaditi dṛṣṭānta
na cāvastuna ete syuḥ bhedāḥ tenāsya vastutā | kāryādīnāmabhāvaḥ ko bhāvo yaḥ kāraṇāditaḥ nā
vyākhyā–na hyavastuno bhedo yukta vastvadhiṣṭhānatvāttasya tasmādabhāvo vastu
kṣīrāde kāraṇasya yo bhāva sa eva dadhyāde kāryasyābhāva, kāryasya dadhyāderyo bhāva sa eva kṣīrāde kāraṇasyābhāva ityetadabhāvavastutvam
ko bhāvo ya kāraṇādi na –sanmati॰ ṭī॰
vastvasaṅkarasiddhiśca tatprāmāṇyaṃ samāśritā | kṣīre dadhyādi yannāsti prāgabhāvaḥ sa ucyate
vyākhyā–pratyakṣādibhi sadrūpeṇa pramīyamāṇamapi ghaṭādikamasadrūpeṇa abhāvasya prameyam, asakaro'sadrūpamabhāva iti yāvat
vyākhyā–kṣīramṛdādau kāraṇe dadhidhaṭādilakṣaṇa kārya nāstītyeva yatpratīyate loke sa prāgabhāva ucyate
yadi tu prāgabhāvo na bhavet kṣīrādau dadhyādi kārya bhavedeva
eva dadhni kṣīrākhyasya yannāstitvamaya pradhvasābhāva, anyathā dadhni kṣīra bhavedeva
yasmāttasya gavāde pararūpamaśvādisvabhāvo nāsti tasmāttayoranyonyābhāva ucyate
anyathā gavādau bhavedaśvādi yadyanyonyābhāvo na bhavet
śaśaśiraso'vayavā nimnā anunnatā vṛddhikāṭhinyābhyā rahitā viṣāṇādirūpeṇa atyantamasanta atyantābhāva ucyate
yadi tvatyantābhāvo na bhavet śaśe śṛṅga bhavedeva
nāstitā payaso dadhni pradhvaṃsābhāvalakṣaṇam | gavi yo'śvādyabhāvastu so'nyonyābhāva ucyate
śiraso'vayavā nimnā vṛddhikāṭhinyavarjitāḥ | śaśaśṛṅgādirūpeṇa so'tyantābhāva ucyate
unnatā atha ca vṛddhimantaḥ kaṭinā avayavā viṣāṇatvena vyapadiśyante, yadā ca śaśaśiraso'vayavāḥ nimnāḥ anunnatā atha ca vṛddhikāṭhinyavirahitāḥ tadā ta eva śṛṅgābhāvarūpeṇa vyapadeśārhāḥ
kṣīraṃ dadhi bhavedevaṃ dadhni kṣīraṃ ghaṭaṃ paṭaḥ | śaśe śṛṅgaṃ pṛthivyādau caitanyaṃ mūrttirātmani
apsu gandho ssaścāgnau vāyau rūpeṇa tau saha | vyomni saṃsparśarśitā te ca na cedasya pramāṇatā
ete'ṣṭāvapi ślokāḥ nimnagrantheṣu uddhṛtāḥ –tattvasaṃ॰, tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 471–473
na ca syādvya iti ślokaṃ vinā sapta ślokāḥ –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 281–83
yattāvaduktam–abhāvapramāṇaṃ pratyakṣādibhyo bhinnam ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tadviṣayasya pratyakṣādibhiḥ paricchidyamānatayā tasya tato bhedānupapatteḥ
