tatra yo deśādyaviprakṛṣṭārthasambandhyabhāvaḥ sa pratyakṣata eva paricchidyate, indriyavyāpārādanantaram aghaṭaṃ bhūtalam ityādipratyayapratīteḥ

apratyakṣatvañca abhāvasya indriyeṇā'sambaddhatvāt, arūpitvāt, asadrūpatvādvā ? na tāvadasambaddhatvāt; rūpasyāpyapratyakṣatvaprasaṅgāt, aprāpyakāriṇā hi cakṣuṣā yathā rūpasya asambaddhasya grahaṇaṃ tathā abhāvasyāpi
nanu cāsambaddhasyāpyabhāvasya cakṣuṣā grahaṇe deśāntaravarttino'pi grahaṇaprasaṅgaḥ aviśeṣāt; ityapi rūpeṇa kṛtottaram
nahi tasya asambaddhasya grahaṇe'pi sakaladeśakālavarttino grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam
atha rūpe cakṣuṣaḥ saṃyuktasamavāyasambandhasadbhāvādasambaddhatvamasiddham; tanna, cakṣuṣo'prāpyakāritvasya prāgeva pratipādanāt
tatsambandhāt tasya tena graharṇa ca rasāderapi grahaṇaprasaktiḥ tadaviśeṣāt
abhāvo'pyanumānameva, yathotpannaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇasadbhāve liṅgam, evamanutpannaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇāsadbhāve liṅgam
tulanā–pratyakṣādinaivābhāvasya pratīteḥ, tathā cākṣavyāpārādiha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti jñānamaparokṣamutpadyamānaṃ dṛṣṭam –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 592

etaduktambhavati–dhaṭagrāhakatvasya bhūtalagrāhakatvasya caikajñānasaṃsargitvāt yadā bhūtalagrāhakameva tajjñānaṃ bhavati tadā ghaṭagrāhakatvābhāvaṃ niścāyayatīti pratītipratyakṣasiddhaiva ghaṭānupalabdhiḥ
na cābhāvasyāsattvaṃ pratyakṣādipramāṇairvyavasīyamānatvāt; tathāhi–iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti jñānamindriyabhāvavyatirekānuvidhānādindriyajam
sayuktasamavāyāviśeṣāt 'cakṣu sayuktamāmrādika tatra ca rasasya samavāyāt
kiñca, āśrayagrahaṇasāpekṣam abhāvagrahaṇam, āśrayaśca sannihita eva gṛhyate, tatkathaṃ deśāntarādisthasya abhāvasya grahaṇasambhāvanā'pi ? tannendriyeṇāsambaddhatvādasya apratyakṣatā yuktā
tulanā–nacāsambaddhatvāviśeṣāddeśāntarādiṣu sarvābhāvagrahaṇamāśaṅkanīyam, āśrayagahaṇasāpekṣatvādabhāvapratīte, āśrayasya ca sannihitasyaiva pratyakṣatvāt
nāpyarūpitvāt; tasya pratyakṣatāṃ pratyanaṅgatvāt, nahi rūpitvarūpitvaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ pratyaṅgam, paramāṇūnāṃ rūpitve'pi apratyakṣatvāt
guṇa-karma-sāmānyena anekāntācca; na khalu rūpādiguṇasya gamanādikarmaṇaḥ gotvādisāmānyasya ca rūpitvamasti, atha ca pratyakṣatvaṃ tatra vidyate
asadrūpatvamapi na pratyakṣatāṃ pratihanti; asadrūpasya hi sadrūpatayā pratyakṣatvamanupapannaṃ na punarasadrūpatayā, svasvabhāvena arthānāṃ pratyakṣatvā'virodhāt
nahi ghaṭasya paṭātmanā pratyakṣatvavirodhe svātmanāpi tadvirodho yuktaḥ, sarvatra pratyakṣavyavahārocchedaprasaṅgāt
nanu tathāpi abhāvasya kathaṃ pratyakṣatā virodhāditi cet ? bhāvasya katham ? pratyakṣagrāhyatvāccet; itaratra samānam
tathāhi–unmīlite cakṣuṣi bhūtalaṃ ghaṭābhāvaśca pratibhāsate, na nimīlite

ataḥ samāne tadbhāvabhāvitve kathaṃ bhūtalajñānameva pratyakṣaṃ na ghaṭābhāvajñānamiti niyamavibhāgo yuktaḥ ? prayogaḥ–yaccakṣurbhāvā'bhāvānuvidhāyi tat pratyakṣam yathā bhūtalādijñānam, tadanuvidhāyi ca ghaṭādyabhāvajñānamiti
apratyakṣatve cāsya ālokāpekṣāpi atidurdhaṭā, āloko hi cakṣuṣa eva upakārakatvena prasiddhaḥ
tadupakṛtacakṣuḥprabhavatvānabhyupagame ca ghaṭādyabhāvajñānasya, andhasyāpi tadutpattiḥ syāt
pratyakṣaścet kathamabhāva, abhāvaścet katha pratyakṣa iti virodha

nanu ghaṭādyabhāvajñāne locanānvayavyatirekānuvidhānam anyathāsiddham rūpajñānānantarabhāvisparśasaṃvedanavat, yathaiva hi dūradeśasthitajvalajjvalanajvālārūpopalambhānantarabhāvini tadga toṣṇasparśasaṃvedane locanānvayavyatirekānuvidhānam anyathāsiddhaṃ tathā bhūtalopalambhānantarabhāvini ghaṭādyabhāvajñāne'pi; ityapyasāmpratam; iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti jñānasya bhedā'siddheḥ
siddhe hi jñānabhede tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhānasya anyathāsiddhatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktam rūpasparśajñānavat
na cātra tadbhedo'sti, iha kuṇḍe dadhi ityādijñānavat iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti ityādijñānasyāpi ekasya ubhayāṃśāvalambinaḥ anuparatanayanavyāpāre pratipattari pratīteḥ
astu vā tadbhedaḥ, tathāpi indriyānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvena ubhayasyopalambhā'viśeṣe kathamekasya pratyakṣatvamanyasyā'pratyakṣatvaṃ vaktuṃ yuktaṃ svecchākāritvaprasaṅgāt ?

tulanā– na ca dūravyavasthitahutavaharūpadarśanapūrvakasparśānunānavadidamanyathāsiddha tadbhāvabhāvitvam; tatra hi bahuśaḥ sparśadarśanakauśalaśūnyatvamavadhāritaṃ cakṣuṣaḥ, sparśaparicchedi ca kāraṇāntaraṃ tvagindriyamavagatam
avinābhāvitā ca purā tathāvidhayo rūpasparśayorupalabdhetyanumeya evāsau sparśa iti yuktaṃ tatrānyathāsiddhatvaṃ cakṣurvyāpārasya, prakṛte tu nedṛśaḥ prakāraḥ samasti

yattu bhūpradeśagrahaṇajanmanyeva akṣāṇāmupayogitvādakṣāpekṣitvamanyathāsiddhamabhāvajñānasyetyuktam; tadanupapannam; na khalu jñānadvayaṃ krameṇotpadyamānamidamanubhūyate prathamamindriyajaṃ bhūpradeśajñānaṃ tataḥ pratiyogismaraṇe sati mānasamindriyānapekṣaṃ nāstitājñānaṃ ca

tulanā– tathā ceha ghaṭo nāstīti jñānamekamevedamiha kuṇḍe dadhīti jñānavad ubhayālambanamanuparatanayanavyāpārasya bhavati, tatra bhūpradeśamātra eva nayanajaṃ jñānimataratra pramāṇāntarajamiti kutastyo'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ
taddhi nirvikalpakapratyakṣānantaraṃ śabdārthasambandhasmaraṇe sati ghaṭoyam ityādyākāramupajāyate
tathāvidhasyāpyasya indriyānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā pratyakṣatve ghaṭādyabhāvapratyayasyāpi tadastu aviśeṣāt

na caivaṃ rūpopalambhānantarabhāvisparśasaṃvedane'pi cākṣuṣatvaprasaṅgaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; sparśagrahaṇayogyatāśūnyatvāccakṣuṣaḥ sparśanasyaiva tadgrahaṇayogyatāsadbhāvāt, anyathā upahatatvagindriyasyāpi sparśasavittiḥ syāt

tasmādānumānikameva idaṃ vijñānaṃ yad rūpavat tat sparśavat, yadi vā, yadevaṃvidharūpavat tadevaṃvidhasparśavat iti sāmānyato viśeṣataśca pratipannā'vinābhāvahetusāmarthyena utpatteḥ, yaditthamutpadyate tadanumānameva yathā yad dhūmavat tadagnimat, yadvā yadevaṃvidhadhūmavat tadevaṃvidhāgnimat ityādyavagatāvinābhāvahetuprabhavaṃ vijñānam, pratipannāvinābhāvahetusāmarthyenotpadyate ca rūpopalambhānantarabhāvisparśavijñānamiti
yastu deśādiviprakṛṣṭārthasambandhyabhāvaḥ so'numānādeḥ; tatra deśaviprakṛṣṭasya kamalākarakamalādeḥ sambandhī vikāsādyabhāvaḥ dinakarodayādyabhāvādavasīyate
kālaviprakṛṣṭasya ca śakaṭādeḥ muhūrttānte udayābhāva aśvinyudayāt pratīyate
svabhāvaviprakṛṣṭasya ca caitanyasya śavaśarīre sattvābhāvaḥ vyāpāravyāhārākāraviśeṣābhāvādanumīyate
na khalu evaṃvidhābhāvaḥ evaṃvidhaliṅgādanyataḥ kutaścit pratipattuṃ śakya

tulanā–kaścitpunarasannikṛṣṭadeśavṛttiranumeyo'pi bhavatyabhāva yathā santamase saliladhārāvisarasiktasasyamūlamabhivarṣati deve dhanapavanasayogābhāvo'numīyate, yathā vā'rthāpattābudāhṛta gṛhabhāvena caitrasya vahirabhāvakalpanamiti

etena yaduktam–yadyabhāvaḥ pratyakṣaparicchedyaḥ syāt kathamapavarakādau indriyeṇā'sannikṛṣṭo devadattādyabhāvaḥ paricchidyeta ityādi; tadapi prativyūḍham; nāsīdapavarake devadattaḥ ityādipratīteḥ smṛtitvāt āsīt tatra ghaṭaḥ ityādipratītivat
apavarakagrāhiṇā hi pratyakṣeṇa tatrā'sannihitārthānāmabhāvā yugapatpratipannāḥ tatra sannihitārthasadbhāvavat
taduttarakālañca saṃskāraprabodhavaśāt tadbhāvābhāvaviṣayā pratītiḥ udayamāsādayantī smṛtitvanna jahātīti

na caitad vaktavyam–sakṛdanubhūteṣu sakalapadārthābhāveṣu sahasaiva smṛtiḥ syāt iti, anubhūtatvamātrasya smṛtyakāraṇatvāt, anubhūteṣvapi hi bhāvābhāvasvabhāveṣu nikhilārtheṣu yasya yasya saṃskārodbodhanimittā praśnādisāmagrī sampadyate tasya tasya rūpasya smṛtiḥ prādurbhavati idaṃ tatrāsīt, idaṃ nāsīt iti
yadyapi pūrvaṃ hastī nāstītyādi savikalpaka jñāna notpannaṃ tathāpi hastyādyabhāvaviśiṣṭe devakule nirvikalpaka jñānamutpannam
anyathā hi yadāha devakulamadrākṣa na tadā ta samīpavartina hastinamiti praśnānantara smaraṇa na syāt
yasya vastuna pūrva nābhāva paricchinnastatra parapraśnānantara saśete na nirīkṣita mayā kiṃ tatra devadattostyuta hastī iti
na cedānīmabhāva niścinoti ata pūrvameva hastyādyabhāvasya pratīteryuktametat smaraṇaṃ na mayā tatra hastī dṛṣṭa ityādi
yeṣāmarthānā sadbhāva teṣā sadbhāvatayā yepāñca devadattādīnāmabhāvasteṣāmabhāvarūpeṇa
tulanā–nanu mecakabuddhyā sakalābhāvagrahaṇe sahasaiva sakalābhāvasmṛtirupa- jāyeta, maivam, yatraiva praśnādi smaraṇakāraṇamasya bhavati tadeva smarati na sarvam avidyamānasmaraṇanimittam
anyatra tu yugapadupalabdheṣvapi varṇeṣu yugapadantyavarṇānubhavasamanantara smaraṇam
anyatra tu yugapadupalabdhe'pi krameṇa smaraṇa bhaviṣyatīti na mecakabuddhāvaya doṣa
yadapi–abhāvapramāṇotpattau bhūtalādyāśrayagrahaṇarūpā sāmagrī ityādyuktam, tadapyasāram, āśrayagrahaṇasya pratyakṣe'pyaviśiṣṭatvāt
na khalu bhūtale ghaṭo'sti iti pratyakṣa bhūtalagrahaṇādṛte ghaṭate
na cāndhakāra eva āśrayaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; prakāśābhāvamātratayā bhavatā tasya iṣṭeḥ, sa eva ca pradīpābhāva iti nāśrayasya tadvyatiriktasya kasyacittatra grahaṇam
tathā gandho nāsti ityapi pratītiḥ āśrayagrahaṇanirapekṣaivotpadyate, nimīlitākṣasyāpi hi ghrāṇendriyavyāpārādanantaraṃ gandhābhāvapratītiḥ utpadyate
na ca tatra ghrāṇendriyeṇa āśrayasya dravyasya grahaṇaṃ sambhavati, darśana-sparśanābhyāmeva dravyasya grahaṇasambhavāt
tathā nāsti śabdaḥ iti śrotravyāpārādeva āśrayagrahaṇanirapekṣādbhavati abhāvapratītiḥ
na hi śrotrendriyeṇa śabdasya āśrayo grahītu śakyaḥ, tasya atyantaparokṣasya anumānenaivāvasāyāt

anupraviśatu vā, tathāpi āśrayasya grahaṇa kiṃ niṣedhyābhāvasahitasya, kevalasya vā ? pratiyogino'pi smaraṇam–kim abhāvākrāntasya, tadviparītasya vā ? tatra abhāvaviśepitayoḥ āśrayapratiyoginoḥ grahaṇasmaraṇapathaprāptayoḥ tatkāraṇatvābhyupagame abhāvajñānādeva abhāvajñānam ityuktaṃ syāt
na ca svātmāśrayasya kasyacit siddhiryuktā atiprasaṅgāt
cakrakapraṅgaśca–abhāvapramāṇotpattau hi pratiyogyabhāvapratipattiḥ, tatpratipattau ca tadviśeṣitayoḥ āśrayapratiyoginoḥ pratipattiḥ, tasyāñca satyām abhāva pramāṇotpattiriti
abhāvanirapekṣatayā ca āśraye pratiyogini ca gṛhyamāṇe yadyabhāvapratītiḥ syāt tadā sadhaṭe'pi bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti pratītiḥ syād viśepābhāvāt
tato yathoktasāmagryā vicāryamāṇāyā anupapatteḥ cakṣurādisāmagrīta eva abhāvapramāṇasya utpattiḥ svaparātmanā sadasadrūpaghaṭādyarthaviṣayatā cābhyupagantavyā

nanu parātmanā ghaṭāderasattvaṃ pratīyamānaṃ na svātmatayā pratipannaṃ syāt, yacca svātmatayā na pratīyate kathaṃ tattasya rūpam atiprasaṅgāt ? ityapyasundaram; yataḥ parātmanā'pi pratīyamānamasattvaṃ ghaṭādereva pratīyate natu parasya, ghaṭo hi paṭo na bhavati ityevaṃ nañarthaḥ pratīyate, natu paṭaḥ paṭo na bhavati ityevam
ataḥ parātmanā pratīyamāno'pi nañarthaḥ ghaṭādereva pratīyate iti tasyaiva tadrūpeṇa asattvamiti vyapadiśyate
tulanā–tatra niṣedhyādhāro vastvantara pratiyogisasṛṣṭa vā pratīyate, asasṛṣṭa vā ? pratiyogino'pi smaraṇa vastvantarasasṛṣṭasya asasṛṣṭasya vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 203

yaccānyaduktam–ghaṭaviviktatvaṃ kiṃ bhūtalasvarūpamātram, tadvyatiriktaṃ vā ityādi, tadapyayuktam, yataḥ tadviviktatvaṃ taddharmatayā tataḥ kathaṃñcid vyatiriktaṃ pṛcchyate, padārthāntaratayā vā ? tatra taddharmatayaiva tat kathañcidbhinnamupapannaṃ na punaḥ padārthāntaratayā

svahetuto hi bhāvāḥ parasparā'saṅkīrṇasvabhāvaviśiṣṭāḥ samutpannāḥ, tadviparītā vā ? prathamavikalpe siddhameṣāṃ svakāraṇakalāpādeva anyā'saṃsṛṣṭasvabhāvatvam, ato vaiyarthyamarthāntarabhūtābhāvaparikalpanāyāḥ
yat svarūpato viviktasvabhāvaṃ na tatra arthāntarabhūtā'bhāvaparikalpanā phalavatī yathā prāgabhāvādau, svarūpato viviktasvabhāvāśca bhāvāḥ svahetutaḥ samutpannā iti
yat svabhāvato'viviktasvarūpam na tatra arthāntarabhūtābhāvena vivekaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ yathā ekavyaktau, svabhāvato'viviktasvarūpāśca paramate padārthā iti
dvividhā hi viviktatā–dharmadharmirūpeṇa kathañcidviviktatā yathā jñānātmano, padārthāntararūpeṇa sarvathā yathā ghaṭapaṭayo
tulanā–sarve hi bhāvā svasvarūpasthitayo nātmāna pareṇa miśrayanti tasyāparatvaprasaṅgāt –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
nāpyeṣā parasparābhinnānāmabhāvena bheda śakyate karttum, tasya bhinnābhinnabhedakaraṇe'kiñcitkaratvāt
nāpi parasparabhinnānāmabhāvena bheda kriyate, svahetubhya eva bhinnānāmutpatte
nāpi bhedavyavahāra kriyate, yato bhāvānāmātmātmīyarūpeṇotpattireva svato bheda, sa ca pratyakṣapratibhāsanādeva bhedavyavahārahetu
yata svakāraṇakalāpāt svasvabhāvavyavasthitayo bhāvā samutpannā nātmāna pareṇa miśrayanti tasyā'paratvaprasaṅgāt –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 208
kiñca, abhāvaṃ vinā bhāvānāṃ vivekā'sabhave kathamabhāvānāmanyonyaṃ bhāvāntarācca viveka syāt ? tatrāpi taddhetorabhāvāntarasyā'bhyupagame anavasthāprasaṅgaḥ
atha abhāvāntaramantareṇāpi asya vilakṣaṇasvabhāvatvādeva anyato vivekaḥ, tarhi vaiyarthyam arthāntarābhāvaparikalpanāyā, ghaṭāderapi vilakṣaṇasvabhāvatayaiva anyato vyāvṛttiprasiddheḥ
tathāhi–ghaṭādeḥ anyato vyāvṛttiḥ vilakṣaṇasvabhāvanibandhanaiva, anyato vyāvṛttitvāt, yā anyato vyāvṛttiḥ sā vilakṣaṇasvabhāvanibandhanaiva yathā abhāvasya, anyato vyāvṛttiśca ghaṭāderiti
atha svarūpeṇa bheda, tathā bhāvānāmapi sa syāditi kimabhāvena kalpitena
yadi cetaretarābhāvavaśāt ghaṭa paṭādibhyo vyāvartteta tarhi itaretarābhāvo'pi bhāvādabhāvāntarācca prāgabhāvāde kiṃ svato vyāvartteta, anyato vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 208
ghaṭo bhūtala na bhavati bhūtalañca ghaṭo na bhavatīti itaretarābhāvādeva vilakṣaṇasvabhāvādeva ghaṭasya bhūtalād vyāvṛttirna punarabhāvāditi bhāva –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, āśrayabhedena itaretarābhāvaḥ tāvanna bhidyate sarvatraiva asya ekatvenā'bhyupagamāt
tatra hi itaretarābhāva, abhāvāntara vā nibandhana syāt ? itaretarābhāvaścet, kiṃ sa eva, anyo vā ? na tāvat sa eva, ato ghaṭādervyāvarttamānatvāt
yat yato vyāvarttate na tasmādeva tasya vyāvṛttiḥ yathā paṭād vyāvarttamānasya ghaṭasya na paṭādeva vyāvṛttiḥ, vyāvarttate ca itaretarābhāvād ghaṭa iti
itaretarābhāvāntarābhyupagame ca asya ekatvakṣatiḥ anavasthā ca syāt

atha abhāvāntaramasya tato vyāvṛtternibandhanam, tanna, itaretaravyāvṛtteḥ abhāvāntaranibandhanatvānupapatteḥ, upapattau vā abhāvacatuṣṭayakalpanā'narthakyam, ekasmādeva abhāvāt idamataḥ prāṅ nāsīt, itarad itaratra nāsti ityādipratīterupapatteḥ
atha ghaṭasya itaretarābhāvād vyāvṛttireva neṣyate tatkathamaya doṣaḥ ? tarhi itaretarābhāvo'pi ghaṭaḥ syāt
yasya yato vyāvṛttirnāsti na tasya tato bhedaḥ yathā ghaṭasvarūpād ghaṭasya, nāsti ca itaretarābhāvād vyāvṛttirghaṭasya iti
ghaṭa-itaretarābhāvayo vyāvṛttirna taditaretarābhāvanibandhanā tasmādeva tasya vyāvartamānatvāt
gavyaśvābhāvo'śve ca gorabhāva itaretarābhāva, sa ca sarvatraiko nitya eva piṇḍavināśe'pi sāmānyavat piṇḍāntare pratyabhijñānāt
yathā sāmānyamadṛṣṭavaśādupajāyamānenaiva piṇḍena saha sambaddhyate nityatvañca svabhāvasiddham, tathetaretarābhāvo'pi
dvitīyetaretarābhāvasya vyāvṛttyartham tṛtīya itaretarābhāva kalpanīya tadvyāvṛttyarthañca caturtha iti
itaretarābhāvād bhinna kaścit prāgabhāvādirūpa abhāva abhāvāntaram
yadapi–abhāvasya vastutvamabhihitam, tadapi vastudharmasyaivopapannaṃ na punaḥ sarvathā tucchasvabhāvasya, tathāvidhasyāsya vastutvānupapatteḥ
yat sarvathā tucchasvabhāvaṃ na tadvastu yathā gaganendīvaram, sarvathā tucchasvabhāvaśca parairabhyupagato'bhāva iti

astu vā asya vastutvam; tathāpi tat kena gṛhyatām–kimabhāvākhyena pramāṇena, pramāṇāntareṇa vā ? prathamapakṣe kiṃ tadvastutvaṃ bhāvaḥ, abhāvo vā ? yadi bhāvaḥ, kathamabhāvagrāhyaḥ tasya tadviṣayatvā'nabhyupagamāt ? tucchasvabhāvābhāvasya bhāvasvarūpavastutvāśrayatvavirodhācca
yat tucchasvabhāvaṃ na tad bhāvasvabhāvavastutvāśrayaḥ yathā śaśaviṣāṇam, tucchasvabhāvaśca paraiḥ parikalpito'bhāva iti
atha abhāvaḥ, tanna, vastutvasya abhāvarūpatve nīlādāvapi tasya abhāvarūpatvaprasaṅgād bhāvavārttocchedaḥ syāt
atha pramāṇāntareṇa gṛhyate tat; tanna, pramāṇāntarāṇāmabhāvagrāhakatvānabhyupagame tadga tavastutvagrāhakatvābhyupagamavirodhāt
tanna abhāvapramāṇasya sāmagrīvad viṣayo'pi vicāryamāṇo vyavatiṣṭhete
kiñca, siddhe svarūpe kāraṇaviṣayaphalavyavasthā vaktuṃ yuktā

nanu sadupalambhakapramāṇapañcakānutpattilakṣaṇam abhāvapramāṇasvarūpaṃ pratiprāṇi prasiddhatvāt kathamapahnotuṃ śakyam ? ityapyanupapannam; yataḥ keyaṃ tadanutpattiḥ–ki niṣedhyaviṣayajñānarūpatayā ātmano'pariṇāmaḥ, anyavastuvijñānaṃ vā ? tatra apariṇāmasya abhāvasvabhāvatvāt kathaṃ tathāvidhajñānajanane sāmarthya syāt ? kathaṃ vā prāmāṇyam ? prameyaparicchedakasya hi prāmāṇyaṃ prasiddham, yacca svarūpeṇa na kiñcit tatkathaṃ kasyacitparicchedakamatiprasaṅgāt ? yat svarūpeṇā'kiñcidrūpam na tat kasyacitparicchedakaṃ yathā vandhyāstanandhayaḥ, svarūpeṇākiñcidrūpañca paraparikalpitamabhāvapramāṇamiti
tataśca pramāṇābhāvaḥ pramāṇañca iti pratijñā-padayoḥ virodhaḥ, yathā idañca, nāsti ca iti
na yujyate prameyasya sā hi savittilakṣaṇā
yatprameyādhigatirūpa na bhavati na tatpramāṇa yathā ghaṭādi, prameyādhigatiśūnyaścābhāva iti vyāpakānupalabdhi
yata pramāṇapañcakābhāvo nirupārūyatvāt katha prameyābhāva paricchindyāt paricchitterjñānadharmatvāt
pratyakṣādyanutpattirūpatayā abhāvapramāṇa pramāṇābhāvātmakam, atha ca abhāvaparicchedakatvena paricchedakatvadharmādhārabhūta pramāṇātmakañceti virodha
anyavastuvijñānapakṣe'pi kimanyasmin vastumātre, ghaṭābhāvāśraye vā jñānamabhāvaparicchedakaṃ syāt ? tatrādyapakṣe yatra kutracid yasya kasyacid abhāvasya jñānaṃ syāt
atha ghaṭābhāvāśrayasya; nanvetat ghaṭābhāve siddhe siddhyet, na cāsau bhavatpakṣe siddhaḥ
pratiyogitāpi etena pratyākhyātā; siddhe hi ghaṭābhāve ayamasya āśraya, ayañca pratiyogī iti siddhyet
tato'bhāvapramāṇasya yathābhyupagatasvarūpasāmagrīviṣayaphalānāmavyavasthiteḥ vastudharma evābhāva pratyakṣādipramāṇasiddhaśca bhāvavadabhyupagantavya iti
na bhāvasvarūpavyatirikta kaścidabhāva pratyakṣānumānagrāhya, iti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–
atra sugatamatāvalambinaḥ prāhuḥ–na bhāvasvarūpavyatiriktaḥ kaścidabhāvaḥ pratyakṣato'numānato vā pratīyate
pratyakṣasya hi sa viṣayo bhavati yo janakatve sati ākārasamarpakaḥ, abhāvasya ca janakatvamākārasamarpakatvañcātidurghaṭam
yad abhāvarūpaṃ na tat kasyacijjanaka svākārasamarpakañca yathā khapuṣpam, abhāvarūpaścābhāvo bhavadbhiriṣṭa iti
yat svākāramarpayat jñāna janayati tad bhāvasvabhāvameva yathā ghaṭādi, svākāramarpayan jñānaṃ janayati ca abhāva iti
yat khalu kutaścidutpannaṃ kenacidrūpeṇa pratibhāsamānaṃ kāñcidarthakriyāṃ karoti tad bhāvasvarūpamucyate
evammanyate–abhāvo nāma nāstyeva kevala mūḍhasya bhāvaviṣayameva pratyakṣamanyābhāva vyavahārayati
ekajñānasasargivastvantara tadupalabdhiścānupalabdhirvivakṣitā upalabdheranyatvādabhakṣyā'sparśanīyavat, sa evābhāva, tadatiriktasya vigrahavato'bhāvasyābhāvāt

yathā bhakṣyābhakṣyaprakaraṇe vivakṣitād bhakṣyādanyatvādabhakṣyo grāmyakukkuṭo bhakṣyo'pi san tadanyasyocyate, yathā ca sparśanīyā'sparśanīyādhikāre vivakṣitāt sparśanīyādanyatvādasparśanīyaścāṇḍālādistadanyasya sparśanīyo'pi sannucyate tadvadupalabdhirevānupalabdhirmantavyā tasmāt pratiṣedhyād ghaṭāde svabiṣayavijñānajananayogyād yo'nya upalambhajananayogya eva na tadviparīta svabhāvo ghaṭaviviktapradeśarūpa sa eva cātra anupalabdhiśabdenocyate
tasyānyasya pradeśasya kevalasya yat tat kaivalyam ekākitvamasahāyatā tadevāparasya pratiyogino ghaṭādervaikalyamabhāva iti
tasmādanyabhāva eva bhāvāśa eva tvadabhimatastadabhāva pratiyogyabhāvāśo na tata pṛthagbhūta dharmāntaramityucyate sugatasutai
na hyabhāva kaścidvigrahavān ya sākṣātkarttavya api tu vyavaharttavya
abhāva kasyacijjanaka svākārasamarpakaśca na bhavati abhāvarūpatvāt
abhāvo bhāvasvarūpa eva svākārārpakatve sati jñānajanakatvāt

kiñca, abhāvākārasya jñāne'nupraveśe tasyāpi asattvaprasaṅgāt kutaḥ kiṃ pratīyatām ? na ca iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti ityevaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatsadbhāve pramāṇamityabhidhātavyam, śabdasaṃsargeṇopajāyamānasyāsya vikalparūpatayā pratyakṣatvānupapatteḥ

pratibandhaśca sādhyasādhanayoḥ pratyakṣataḥ, anumānato vā pratīyate ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ; abhāvasya uktaprakāreṇa pratyakṣā'gocaratve tato'sya kenacit liṅgena saha pratibandhapratipatteranupapatteḥ
anumānataḥ tatpratītau anavasthā, tatrāpi anumānāntarāt tatpratītiprasaṅgāt
yattāvaduktam–na bhāvasvarūpavyatirikto'bhāvaḥ ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; bhāvasvarūpā'tiriktasyā'bhāvasya pratītibhedāt svarūpabhedāt sāmagrībhedāt arthakriyābhedācca bhedasiddhiḥ
yasya yataḥ pratītyādibhedaḥ tasya tato bhedaḥ yathā ghaṭāt paṭasya, pratītyādibhedaśca bhāvādabhāvasya iti
na cāyamasiddhaḥ; tathāhi–bhāvā'bhāvayostāvat pratītibhedaḥ suprasiddha eva idamatrāsti, idaṃ nāsti iti
nahi pratīyamānāpītthaṃ bhedena abhāvapratītirapahnotuṃ yuktā; bhāvapratīterapyapahnavaprasaṅgāt

nanu nirvikalpakasāmarthyena idamihāsti, nāsti iti vikalpadvayamutpadyate, na ca tadvaśādarthavyavasthā, vikalpānāmarthe prāmāṇyā'bhāvāt, ityapi śraddhāmātram; savikalpakasiddhau nirvikalpakasya prāmāṇyapratiṣedhataḥ savikalpakasyaiva antarbahirvā vastuvyava sthāpakatvena prāmāṇyopapatteḥ pratipāditatvāt

atha pratyakṣādeva bhāvasiddhiḥ, abhāvasiddhau tat kiṃ kākairbhakṣitam ? prathamaṃ hi indriyādisāmagrītaḥ samutpannaṃ pratyakṣam anekabhāvābhāvopādhikhacitamupādhimantaṃ pratipadyate, tataḥ śabdārthayoḥ pratipannapratibandhaḥ pratipattā arthadarśanottarakālaṃ yasya yasya vivakṣā bhavati tattadvācaka śabda smṛtvā idamihāsti, idaṃ nāsti iti vikalpavyāpāraṃ darśayati
yadi ca te'bhāvaviśeṣāḥ pratyakṣato na pratipannāḥ tadā pratiyogismaraṇamapi anupapannameva syāt
nahi apratipanne ghaṭābhāve ghaṭasya pratiyogitayā smṛtiryuktā atiprasaṅgāt
tulanā–ida tāvatsakalaprāṇisākṣika savedanadvayamupajāyamāna dṛṣṭam iha ghaṭo'sti iha nāstīti
tulanā–tatra vikalpamātrasavedanamanālambanamātmāśālambana vetyādi yadabhilapyate tannāstitājñāna iva astitvajñāne'pi samānamato dvayorapi prāmāṇya bhavatu dvayorapi vā mā bhūt
aneke bhāvā abhāvāśca upādhaya viśeṣaṇāni tai khacita śabalita citritam upādhimanta viśeṣyabhūtamartham
na ca iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti iti viśiṣṭāyāḥ pratīteḥ viśeṣaṇamantareṇopapattiryuktā
yā viśiṣṭā pratītiḥ nāsau viśeṣaṇamantareṇa upapadyate yathā daṇḍītyādipratītiḥ, viśiṣṭā ca iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti ityādipratītiriti

atha bhāva abhāvapratīternibandhanam ataḥ sa evāsyā viśeṣaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, evañca bhavato na kiñcidiṣṭaṃ siddhyet; ityapyasāmpratam; yataḥ kiṃ niṣidhyamāno ghaṭādirbhāvaḥ asyā nibandhanamabhyupagamyate, tadāśrayo bhūtalādirvā ? prakṣamapakṣo'yuktaḥ, bhāvā'bhāvapratītyornirbādhatayā pratīyamānayorvailakṣaṇyasya viṣayavailakṣaṇyavyatirekeṇa anupapatteḥ
yannirbādhatayā pratīyamānayoḥ pratītyorvailakṣaṇyaṃ tad viṣayavailakṣaṇyapūrvakam yathā rūpādipratītivailakṣaṇyam, vailakṣaṇyañca nirbādhatayā pratīyamānayoḥ bhāvā'bhāvapratītyoriti
na ca tatpratītyornirbādhatā vailakṣaṇyena pratīyamānatvañcā'siddham; tadbādhakasya karsyacidapyabhābhāvāt, parasparā'saṅkīrṇasvabhāvatayā'nubhūyamānatvācca
nahi kaścidabāliśo bhāvameva abhāvatayā pratipadyate, anyā hi bhāvapratītiḥ anyā cābhāvapratītiriti
yadi ca bhāva eva abhāvaḥ syāt, tarhi tatsattākṣaṇe taddeśe cā'bhāvapratītiḥ syāt
na caivam, nahi svadeśakālaniyatāṃ bhāvasattāmeva abhāvatayā kaścit pratipattumarhati
iha bhūtale ghaṭo nāstīti pratīti viśeṣaṇagrahaṇapūrvikā viśiṣṭapratītitvāt
tulanā–nahi viṣayavailakṣaṇyamantareṇa vilakṣaṇāyā buddherastyudaya, nāpi vyavahārabhedasya sabhava

atha nipidhyamānadhaṭādyāśrayatayā'bhiprataḥ bhūtaladibhāvaḥ tadabhāvapratīternivandhanam; tatrāpi ki bhūnalamātraṃ ghaṭābhāvapratīternibandhanam, viśiṣṭa vā ? prathamavikalpe saghaṭe'pi bhūtale ghaṭābhāvavyavahāraḥ syāt tadaviśeṣāt
dvitīyapakṣe'pi kiṅkṛtamasya vaiśiṣṭyam–svarūpakṛtam, ghaṭasaṃsargarahitatvakṛtaṃ vā ? na tāvat svarūpakṛtam; saghaṭe'pi bhūtale abhāvapratītiprasaṅgāt svarūpasattvasya tatrāpyaviśiṣṭatvāt
ghaṭasasargarahitatvanibandhanatve tu nāmni vivādaḥ ghaṭābhāvasya ghaṭasaṃsargarahitatvaśabdena abhidhānāt
tulanā–ta ida praṣṭavyā nāstīti savida kimālambanam ? yadi na kiñcit, datta svahasto nirālambana vijñānamicchatā mahāyānikānām
atha bhūtalamālambanam, kaṇṭakādimatyapi bhūtale kaṇṭako nāstīti savitti tatpūrvakaśca ni śaka gamanāgamanalakṣaṇo vyāpāro durnivāra

kevalabhūtalaviṣayaṃ nāstīti savedanam, kaṇṭakasadbhāve ca kaivalyaṃ nivṛttamiti pratipattipravṛtyorabhāva iti cet, nanu kiṃ kaivalya bhūtalasya svarūpameva, kimuta dharmāntaram ? tatsvarūpa tāvat kaṇṭakādisavedane'pyaparāvṛttamiti sa eva pratipattipravṛttyoravirāmo dopa
nacaitadvaktavyam–abhimānamātramevāyaṃ nāsti iti vyavahāraḥ, sadvyavahārānudaya eva tatsaṃbhavāditi; yataḥ pratīyamānasya vādhārahitasyāsyābhimānikatve asti ityādivyavahārasyāpyābhimānikatvaprasaṅgaḥ
yadi ca sadvyavahārānudaya eva nāstītivyavahārasya aṅgam, tadā suṣuptāvasthāyāmapi nāstītivyavahāraḥ syāt sadvyavahārānudayasya tatrāpyaviśepāt
apramīyamāṇatvameva hi nāstitva nā'param na cāpramīyamāṇataiva prameyam, yasmāttadarthāsasṛpṭānubhavayuktataivātmana tamyārthasyāpramīyamāṇatā, sā cāvasthā ātmana svanaviditaiva

tasmād bhāvagrāhakapramāṇānanuvṛttirevā'bhāvāvagamaṃ pramūte pṛ॰ 119 abhāvasya tu svarūpāvagatirnāsti iti na pramāṇābhāvādanya prameyābhāva, pramāṇābhāvo'pi ca svarūpāntarānavagamādeva na bhāvāntarapramiterbhidyate, bhāvāntarapramitiśca svayaṃprakāśarūpā na prameyatāmanubhavatīti prameyamabhāvākhyasya pramāṇasya nopapadyate
tulanā–jñānābhāve jñānabhrama vyavahārābhāve vyavahārabhrama ālokādarśane andhakārabhramavat, na, supuptyādyavasthāsu prasaṅgāt
–athāpi vaiyātyāducyate na ca tattvato nāstīti buddhivyavahārau sta, kintu caipadarśanābhāve caitro nāstīti jñāna bhrama caitrocitavyavahārābhāve ca tadabhāve vyavahārabhrama
yadi hi jñānavyavahāsyorabhāve tadvibhram suṣuptyādyabasthāsyapi tathāprasaṅga
pramitasya hi bhāvasya pramita eva bhāve samāropabhrāntirna punaramato jñānākārasya nāpyagraha ityupapādina vibhamavipeke, atrāpi sacayipyati
svarūpabhedācca, abhāvasya hi bhāvapratiṣedhakatva svarūpaṃ netarasya
svarūpabhede'pi anayorabhede bhedavārttocchedaprasaṅgaḥ, parasparato bhedasya sarvatra ghaṭapaṭādau svarūpabhedādanyato'prasiddheḥ
tulanā–svarūpabhedasyopapatte, yathāhi kāraṇādutpadyamānāḥ rūpādaya paraspara svarūpabhedād bhidyante tathā'bhāvo'pi bhāvāditi
asti ca dravyādiṣaḍlakṣaṇā'lakṣitatva bhāvaparatantreṇa gṛhyamāṇatvamabhāvasya rūpamiti
tathāhi–ghaṭādibhāvamutpādayitukāmaḥ tadutpādanānukūlāmeva mṛtpiṇḍādisāmagrīmupādatte, vināśayitukāmastu tadvilakṣaṇāṃ mudgarādisāmagrīmiti
nanu mudgarādisāmagrī parasparā'sasṛṣṭakapālotpāda eva vyāpriyate nā'bhāve, na ca tadutpādavat tadabhāvopyata eva bhaviṣyatītyabhidhātavyam, yataḥ sarvo'pi kāryabhedaḥ kāraṇabhedena vyāptaḥ
na ca abhāva-kapālalakṣaṇakāryabhede kāraṇabhedo'sti, mudgaralakṣaṇasyaikasyaiva kāraṇasya pratīteḥ
na ca tasyaikasyaiva anyonyaviruddhakāryadvayajanakatvaṃ yuktaṃ virodhāt, ityapyasamīcīnam, pratītivirodhānuṣaṅgāt
tathāhi–mudgarādivyāpārānantaraṃ laukiketarayoḥ anena vināśito ghaṭaḥ iti pratītiḥ, na punaḥ kapālāni utpāditāni iti
na khalu viṣādinā śatruvadhe vahnyādinā ca paṭadāhe pravṛttasya śatrupaṭavināśādṛte anyat kiñcittatra utpādayāmi iti hantuḥ paṭavināśakasya vā anusandhānamasti
nāpi pārśvasthānām anyat kiñcidanenotpāditam iti pratītiḥ, kintu tadvināśa eva anena kṛtaḥ ityakhilajanānāṃ pratītiḥ
nanu bhāvānāṃ svabhāvato vināśasvabhāvaniyatatayā vināśasya ahetukatvānna mudgarādeḥ taddhetutvam; ityapyapeśalam; teṣāṃ tatsvabhāvaniyatatvasya akṣaṇikatvasiddhau nirākṛtatvāt
tasmāt svarasato nivartate kāṣṭhādi, agnyādibhyastu aṅgārādijanma ityeva bhadrakam
tadayamatra samudāyārtha– mudgaravyāpārānantara dvaya pratīyate, ghaṭanivṛtti kapālañca
tatkāryatvena tu tatpratītirbhrāntireva, kāryatve vāsyā na ghaṭanivṛttirūpatva syāt ghaṭasambandhitvena kṛtakatvāt, vināśarūpatayā ca na pratīti syāt ghaṭasya sattvāt

nirhetuke tu vināśe svarasato nivartamāna eva ghaṭo mudgarādisahakārī kapālajanakatvena sadṛśakṣaṇānārambhakatvāt mudgaravyāpārānantara ghaṭanivṛtte kapālasya ca sadbhāvāt tathorvināśarūpatayā vināśasya ca sahetukatvena mandamatīnāmavasāyo yujyata eva
prayogastu ye yadbhāva pratyanapekṣāste tadbhāvaniyatā tadyathā'sambhavatpratibandhā kāraṇasāmagrī kāryotpādane, anyānapekṣaśca kṛtako bhāvo vināśa iti svabhāvahetu
mudgarādivyāpārānantara kāryotpādavat kāraṇavināśasyāpi pratīte vinaṣṭo ghaṭa utpannāni kapālāni iti vyavahāradvayasadbhāvāt
yadapyuktam–kāryabhedaḥ kāraṇabhedena vyāptaḥ ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; ekakāraṇasya ekakāryotpādakatvena avinābhāvā'bhāvāt, pradīpāderekasyāpi anekakāryotpādakatvapratīteḥ
tathā ca ghaṭābhāvotpādakasāmagrīto bhāvotpādakasāmagryā bhedasiddheḥ siddho bhāvā'bhāvayorbhedaḥ
arthakriyābhedācca, suprasiddho hi bhāvā'bhāvayoḥ pravṛttinivṛttilakṣaṇo'rthakriyābhedaḥ, jalādyarthinaḥ tatsadbhāvasya pravṛttihetutvāt, tadabhāvasya ca nivṛttihetutvāt
pramodādyarthakriyākāritvācca anayorbhedaḥ; tathā hi śatruvināśaḥ kṛtaḥ śruto vā paraṃ pramodamādhatte, tatsadbhāvastu viṣādam
yadapyuktam–abhāvo'pi yadi kutaścidutpadyeta kāñcidarthakriyāṃ kuryāt tadā bhāva eva sa syāt ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam; yato bhāvapratītiviṣayatvaṃ bhāvatvam, na punaḥ arthakriyākāritvādi
abhāvo hi svakāraṇakalāpād bhāvavilakṣaṇatayotpannaḥ arthakriyāñca kurvāṇaḥ padārthatayā pratīyate na punarbhāvatayā
tulanā–satpratyayagamyo hi bhāva iṣyate asatpratyayagamyastvabhāva iti
yaccānyaduktam–yadi abhāvaḥ svākāraṃ jñāne samarpayet tadā jñānasyāpyabhāvarūpatā syāt ityādi; tadapyasundaram; arthākāratayā jñānasya arthaprakāśakatvapratikṣepāt
nirākārameva hi jñānaṃ yogyatayā yogyadeśasthaṃ yogyañcārthaṃ prakāśayati ityuktaṃ pratyakṣaprarūpaṇaprastāve
na cā'vastutvādabhāvasya kiṃ prasādhanaprayāsenetyabhidhātavyam; pramāṇataḥ pratīyamānatvādisādhanāt tasya vastutvaprasiddheḥ
tathāhi–abhāvo vastu, pramāṇataḥ pratīmānatvāt, yat pramāṇataḥ pratīyamānaṃ tad vastu yathā bhāvaḥ, pramāṇataḥ pratīyamānaścā'bhāva iti
tathā, yat kāraṇādutpadyate tadvastu yathā ghaṭādi, kāraṇādutpadyate cā'bhāva iti
tathā, yadarthakriyākāri tadvastu tathā pradīpa, arthakriyākārī cā'bhāva iti
tathā, yad avāntarabhedena bhidyate tadvastu yathā rūparasādi, prāgabhāvādyavāntarabhedena bhidyate cā'bhāva iti
tata siddho bhāvavad abhāvo vāstavo vastudharmaḥ prameya iti
pramāṇaṃ tu tatparicchedakam abhāvākhyaṃ pratyakṣādibhyo bhinnaṃ vāstavaṃ na prasiddham, pratyakṣādito'pi tatparicchedasiddheḥ
yat pramāṇāntarādapi paricchidyate na tatra pramāṇaniyamaḥ yathā vahnyādau, pramāṇāntarādapi paricchidyate cā'bhāva iti
yat punaḥ yatprakārapramāṇāntarānna paricchidyate tatra tatprakārapramāṇaniyamo yathā rūparasādāviti
caturvidha ityanye itaretarābhāva, atyantābhāvaśca tau ca dvau
ṣaṭprakāra ityanye–apekṣābhāv sāmarthyābhāvaśca te ca catvāra iti
abhāvaparicchedaka pṛthagabhāvākhya pramāṇa nāsti pratyakṣādipramāṇāntarādapi tasya paricchidyamānatvāt
raso yathā rūpagrāhicākṣuṣapratyakṣānna paricchidyate ata tadgrahaṇāya rāsanapratyakṣasya niyamo bhavati, nacaivamabhāve pratyakṣādibhi paricchidyamāne pramāṇāntaratvaniyama
tataḥ sūktam–adṛśyasyāpi paracittaviśeṣasya abhāvaḥ tadākāravikārāderanyathānupapattitaḥ iti
sarvatra hi gamakatvaṃ anyathānupapattiprasādādeva, sā ca adṛśyānupalabdhāvapyasti iti kathaṃ nāsyā gamakatvam ?
adṛśya ityādinā vyatirekamukhena kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe–adṛśyānupalabdheḥ sakāśāt saṃśayaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe na kevalaṃ paricittābhāvo na siddhyati saugatasya api tu svacittabhāvaśca na siddhyati
tasya svacittasya yad anaśaṃ tattvaṃ sajātīryavijātīyavyāvṛttaṃ madhyakṣaṇasvarūpaṃ tasya adṛśyātmakatvāt
tataḥ kiṃ jātam ? ityatrāha tathā ca ityādi
tathā ca tena ca svacittabhāvā'siddhiprakāreṇa kutaḥ na kutaścit paramārthasato mānād bhāvasya kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ dharmihetudṛṣṭāntāderasiddhe
na khalu bahirantarvā anaṃśatattvasya adṛśyātmatayā'siddhau dharmyādeḥ siddhiryuktā, tadasiddhau ca kutaḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgādeḥ siddhiḥ syāt ? kasya tarhi kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ syāt ? ityāha–tad ityādi
tasmād anaṃśatattvād viparītaṃ sāśaṃ tattvaṃ tasya
kathambhūtasya ? abhedalakṣaṇasya yugapat krameṇa vā anekasvabhāvātmakasya syād bhavet kṣaṇabhaṅgasiddhiḥ nānyasya iti evakārārthaḥ
anekaparyāyeṣu anugatākāratayā vyāpina abhedalakṣaṇasya dravyasyeti yāvat, athavā anekāvayaveṣu kathañcittādātmyatayā vyāpina abhedalakṣaṇasya skandhasyeti
nanu cābhedalakṣaṇatattvasya savikalpakapratyakṣeṇa sarvātmanā pratipannatvāt kiṃ tatra kṣaṇabhaṅgādyanumānena ? ityāśaṅkāpanodārthamāha–
vīkṣyamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpta sthūla tasyāṇava sūkṣmā bhāgā avayavāsteṣā pārimāṇḍalyaṃ vartulatvam anyonyavivekaḥ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bhaṅga kṣaṇabhaṅgaḥ samaya prati nāśa ityartha
sa ādiryasya kāryakāraṇasāmarthyāderasau tathokta, vīkṣyāṇupārimāṇḍalya ca kṣaṇabhagādiśca tattathoktam, tasyā'vīkṣaṇa pratyakṣeṇānupalambho'śakti

na khalu sāvyavahārikapratyakṣeṇa kṣaṇabhaṅgādirvīkṣyate tena sthirasthūlasādhāraṇākārasyaiva vīkṣaṇāt, yogipratyakṣasyaiva tadvīkṣaṇasāmarthyādityartha, sattvātprameyatvādarthakriyākāritvādityādihetūnā kathañcidanekānityādidharmavyāpyatvāttadavinābhāvaprasiddhe
svasavit svasavedanaṃ tasyā viṣayākāro ghaṭādyākārastasmādviveko vyāvṛttistasyānupalambha pratyakṣeṇāgrahaṇa tadvat

yathā jñānasya svarūpapratibhāsane bahirarthākāranivṛttirvidyamānenāpi na pratibhāsate saugatānā tasya tādṛk sāmarthyābhāvāt tathā vahirantaścāṇupārimāṇḍalyādi pratyakṣeṇa na pratibhāsate tathāśaktyabhāvāt
vivṛtiḥ–sthūlasyaikasya dṛśyātmana eva pūrvāparakoṭyoranupalambhāt abhāvasiddheranityatvaṃ buddheriva vedyavedakākārabhedasya paramārthasattvam, na punaḥ parimaṇḍalādeḥ vijñānānaṃśatattvavat
nāpi kṣaṇikaparimaṇḍalādeḥ avibhāgajñānatattvasya vā jātucit svayamupalabdhiḥ tathaivāpratibhāsanāt

vīkṣyam, upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sthūlamekaṃ grāhyam, tasya ye aṇavaḥ atisūkṣmā bhāgāḥ teṣāṃ pārimāṇḍalyaṃ vartulatvaṃ yacca kṣaṇabhaṅgādi ādiśabdena kāryakāraṇasāmarthyādiparigrahaḥ tasyā'vīkṣaṇam agrahaṇam
svasaṃvido bauddhakalpitaniraṃśabuddheryaḥ viṣayākārasya sthūlādyākārasya vivekaḥ nibṛttiḥ tasya anupalambhavat
nahi tasyāṃ pratibhāsamānāyāṃ viṣayākāravivekaḥ pratibhāsate sthūlādyākārabhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
yatra yadā vāstavo yadākāraḥ pratīyate na tatra tadā tadviparītākārasya pratītirasti yathā nīle pratīyamāne na pītasya, pratīyate ca viṣayākāravivekaḥ saugatakalpitāyāṃ saṃvidi iti
nityaṃ paramāṇumana su tattu pārimāṇḍalyam, parimāṇḍalyamiti tasya nāma, tathāhi–parimaṇḍalāni paramāṇumanāsi teṣā bhāva pārimāṇḍalya tatparimāṇameva

yadi hi savidi grāhyādyākārā pratibhāseran, tadaiva tasyā pratibhāsamānasya sthūlādyākārasya bhrāntatva śakyeta kalpayitum, yadā ca savitti grāhyādyākāraśūnyaivāsti tadā katha tatra bhrāntatvenāpi sthūlādyākāra pratibhāseta ?
savidi na bhrāntatayā'pi sthūlādyākārapratibhāsa, vāstavasya grāhyādyākārarahitatvasya tatra pratibhāsamānatvāt
sthūlasya mahataḥ ekasya kramā'kramānekavivarttavyāpina pratipāditaprakāreṇa dṛśyātmana eva upalabhyasvabhāvasyaiva anityatvaṃ siddhyati nānyasya iti sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? anupalambhāt hetoḥ tasyaiva pūrvāparākārakoṭyoḥ abhāvasiddheḥ

tathā ca yaduktaṃ pareṇa–yad yatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpta sannopalabhyate tat tatra nāsti yathā kvacit pradeśaviśepe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyate ca upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāpto madhyakṣaṇaḥ pūrvāparakoṭyoḥ iti; tadayuktam, yataḥ kathañcittatra tadabhāvasādhane siddhasādhanam
sarvathā tatsādhane pakṣasya pratyakṣavādhanaṃ hetoścā'siddhiḥ, tathā tatra tadanupalambhā'siddheriti
nanu cāstu sthūlādisvabhāvasyārthasya anityatvaṃ na tu paramārthasatvam marīcikājalādivadasattvāt, ityāśaṅkyāha–buddheḥ ityādi
prayogaḥ–yad anekasvabhāvaṃ tadeva paramārthasat yathā vedyavedakādyanekasvabhāvā saṃvit, anekasvabhāvañca antarvahirvā jainābhyupagataṃ vastu iti
nanu nā'nekasvabhāvasyārthasya anityatvaṃ paramārthasattvaṃ vā api tu paramāṇvāde, ityatrāha–napunaḥ ityādi
na punaḥ naiva parimaṇḍalasambandhāt parimaṇḍalaḥ paramāṇuḥ ādiryasya yaugakalpitā'vayavyādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasyā'nityatvaṃ paramārthasattvañca
vijñānasya yad anaṃśaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ tasya iva tadvaditi
nanu bahirantaśca anaṃśasyaiva tattvasya upalambhaḥ atastasyaiva paramārthasattvam, anupalambhācca pūrvāparakoṭyorasattvaṃ siddhyati iti yauga-saugatāḥ; tatrāha–nāpi ityādi
nāpi naiva kṣaṇikāḥ parimaṇḍalāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ādayo yasya avayavyādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya avibhāgavijñānatattvasya vā jātucit kadācidapi svayam ātmanā upalabdhiḥ
atha bahirantastattvasya kṣaṇikā'naṃśādisvabhāvatayā apratibhāsane'pi saccetanādirūpatayā pratibhāsanādayamadoṣaḥ; atrāha–tatkathañcid ityādi
tasya bahirantastattvasya kathañcit na sarvātmanā tatsvabhāvapratibhāse saccetanādisvarūpapratibhāsane aṅgīkriyamāṇe anekāntasiddhiḥ ekasya dṛśyetarasvabhāvasiddheḥ
yadi nāstīti tattoya gṛhṇīyān mūḍha eva sa
nāstīti cāpi moho'ya sati mohe na mucyate
tadeva ni svabhāvānā marvabhāvānā kuto yathoktaprakārasiddhi
tasmāllīkika viparyāsamabhyupetya sāvṛtānā padārthānā marīcikājalakalpānāmida pratyayatāmātrābhyupagamenaiva prasiddhirnānyena
yaugānā mate anta anaśasya niravayavasya vyāpina ātmana upalambha, bahiśca niraśāvayavina
saugatamate ca svalakṣaṇasya pūrvāparakṣaṇayoranupalambhāt abhāva, madhyamakṣaṇa eva ca sthāyitā
evaṃ parasya anupalabdhiṃ nirākṛtya adhunā svabhāvādihetuṃ nirākurvannāha–
yat saugataiḥ parikalpita bahiracetanam antaścetanam, niraśam, aśā dravyakṣetrakālabhāvavibhāgā tebhyo niṣkrāntaṃ niraṃśaṃ tadapratyakṣaṃ pratyakṣāviṣaya
na khaludravyādivibhāgarahita cidacidvā tattva pratyakṣabuddhau pratibhāsate, tatra nityānityādyanekāśavyāpitvena vastuna pratīte
tatastasya niraṃśasya pratyakṣato'siddhasya svabhāvo dharma ko heturliṅga syāt, na ko'pi ityarthaḥ
tasya kāryañca kinnu hetu syāt, sarvathā niraṃśasyāpariṇāmina kāryakaraṇāyogāt yato'numā bhavedityākṣepavacana na kuto'pītyartha
kastatsvabhāvo hetuḥ syāt kiṃ tatkārya yato'numā || 17
na cātra pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ prabhavaḥ kāryavyatirekopalakṣitā vā kāraṇaśaktiḥ
bhāve bhāvini tadbhāva bhāva eva ca bhāvitā
yaugasaugatakalpitaṃ yad anaṃśaṃ tattvam, kva ? bahirantaśca
kuta etad ? ityatrāha–tadapratibhāsanāt tasya anaṃśatattvasya apratīteḥ
kaḥ, na kaścit tasya anaṃśasya svabhāvo hetuḥ syāt
kiṃ na kiñcit tasya anaśasya kāryaṃ hetuḥ
kāryagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam, tena sādhyād bhinnānāṃ saṃyogisamavāyyādīnāṃ nirāsa siddho bhavati, ato na paramate kiñcit liṅgaṃ ghaṭate yato'numā syāt
sākṣāt svabhāvaṃ svarūpam apradarśayato bhāvasya yat niraṃśaṃ tattvaṃ svarūpaṃ-tasya anumitau kriyamāṇāyāṃ svabhāvahetorasaṃbhavaḥ
kiñca, siddhe kāryakāraṇabhāve kāryahetoḥ pratipattiryuktā, na cātra so'sti ityāha–naca ityādi
naca naiva atra yauga-saugatakalpite ekānte pratyakṣānupalambhau sādhanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ
kaḥ ? prabhavaḥ, kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ prabhavati prabhavati asmāt iti ca vyutpatteḥ
yathā ca tatkalpitaikānte prabhavo na ghaṭate tathā viṣayaparicchade prapañcitam
nanu na sarvatra pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ prabhavaḥ, kintu kvacit indriyaśaktivat kāryavyatirekasādhano'pi, so'tra syāt; ityāśaṅkya āha–kārya ityādi
kāryasya vyatirekaḥ vivakṣitakāraṇavyatiriktakāraṇasākalye'pi anutpādaḥ tena upalakṣitā vā
niraṃśayoḥ kāryakāraṇayo mūlato'pyadarśane kāraṇavyatirekataḥ kāryavyatirekā'siddhi ityabhiprāyaḥ
naca pramāṇāntaramantareṇa kāraṇaśaktyaṅgīkaraṇaṃ yuktam ityāha–tadaṅgīkaraṇam ityādi
tasyāḥ kāraṇaśakteḥ aṅgīkaraṇam kāryavyatirekataḥ sadbhāvasvīkaraṇaṃ pramāṇāntaramantareṇa ūhākhyapramāṇaṃ vinā anupapannam
prasiddhe hi kāryakāraṇabhāve kāryavyatirekataḥ kāraṇaśaktiparikalpanā syāt
naca pratyakṣānumānayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvādisambandhapratipattau sāmarthyamityuktam–avikalpadhiyā liṅgaṃ na kiñcit sampratīyate laghī॰ kā॰ 11 ityatra

svayam ātmanā upalabdhasya madhyadaśāyāṃ dṛṣṭasya prāgūrdhvañca yā tasyaiva anupalabdhiḥ svayameva adarśanaṃ tasyā yat siddhaṃ kṛtakatvaṃ kāryatvaṃ tasmād anityatvaṃ śabdādeḥ siddhyet nānyathā na prakārāntareṇa
naca pratyakṣamanumānaṃ location unknown vā tathā pratyetuṃ samarthamityūhasyaiva atra vyāpāra iti manyate
prabhavati yatkāryamiti kāryavyutpatti, prabhavati kāryaṃ yasmāt kāraṇāt iti kāraṇavyutpatti –ā॰ ṭi॰
prabhavati asmāt iti vyu– ba॰, śra॰

nanu sarvo'yaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'numānānumeyabhāvo vā kalpanāśilpikalpito na pāramārthikaḥ tatkathaṃ pramāṇāntaraprasaktiḥ ? ityapyanupapannam; yato vikalpabuddhau siddhāyāṃ tatkalpi to'khilo'yaṃ vyavahāraḥ syāt
na ca tatsiddhiḥ svataḥ parato vā ghaṭate ityāvedayati–
tathā cānumānānumeyavyavahāro'ya sarvo hi buddhiparikalpito buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmibhedenetyuktam
sarva eveti yatrāpi sādhyasādhanayoragnidhūmayorvāstavo bheda tatrāpi svalakṣaṇena vyavahārāyogāt

anumīyate'nenetyanumānaṃ liṅgam anumeya sādhyadharmī sādhyadharmaśca teṣā vyavahāro nānātvapratirūpa, buddhyārūḍhena dharmadharmiṇorbhedastena buddhipratibhāsagatena bhinnena rūpeṇa bhedavyavahāra iti yāvat
punarapi kathambhūtā ? vikalpāvikalpātmā, vikalpo vyavasāya avikalpo'vyavasāya tāvātmānau yasyā sā tathoktā
kva ? bahirantaśca, atra yathāsakhyamabhisambandha karttavya, vahirghaṭādiviṣaye vikalpātmā, anta svarūpe nirvikalpātmā ceti
kuto na siddhyet ? svata svasavedanāt, tasya nirvikalpakatvena vikalpāviṣayatvāt
na kevalaṃ svata, api tu parato'pi
kiṃ puna siddhyati ? parasmādvikalpāntarādapi na siddhyatītyartha
tadapi vikalpāntarataḥ, svato na siddhyati agocaratvāt tatrāpi tatsiddhyarthaṃ vikalpāntaraṃ kalpanīyamiti kvacidapyanuparamāt
tato'numānasyāsiddhe kathaṃ vauddhakalpita pramāṇasakhyāniyamo ghaṭata iti bhāva

vivṛtiḥ–sarvavijñānānāṃ svasaṃvedanaṃ pratyakṣamavikalpaṃ yadi, niścayasyāpi kasyacit svata eva aniścayāt, niścayāntaraparikalpanāyāmanavasthānāt kutastatsaṃvyavahārasiddhiḥ ? tataḥ svārthe'pi kathañcidabhilāpasaṃsargayogyāyogyavinirbhāsaikajñānaṃ pratipattavyaṃ svarūpavat
sukhādaya eva sphuṭānubhavatvāt svasaviditā nānyā cittāvasthetyetadāśaṅkānivṛttyartha sarvagrahaṇa kṛtam
nāsti sā kāciccittāvasthā yasyāmātmanaḥ savedana na pratyakṣa syāt
yena hi rūpeṇātmā vedyate tadrūpamātmasavedanaṃ pratyakṣam
tulanā–svata eva vikalpasavidāṃ nirṇaye svalakṣaṇaviṣayo'pi vikalpaḥ syāt, parataścedanavasthānādapratipatti
dhīḥ buddhiḥ, kathambhūtā ? niścayātmā vikalpabuddhiḥ ityarthaḥ
vikalpo vyavasāyaḥ, avikalpo nirvikalpakaḥ, tau ātmānau yasyāḥ sā tathoktā
kva ? bahirantaśca; vahirvikalpātmā antaśca avikalpātmā iti
sā kim ? ityatrāha– kiṃ punaḥ siddhyet ? naiva siddhyet
yat nirvikalpakena gṛhyate na tatsiddhyati yathā kṣaṇakṣayasvargaprāpaṇasāmarthyādi, nirvikalpena gahyate ca vikalpasvarūpamiti
tarhi vikalpāntarāt tat setsyati, ityatrāha–parataḥ ityādi
na kevalaṃ svataḥ api tu parataḥ vikalpāntarādapi kiṃ punaḥ siddhyet iti no siddhyet iti sambandhaḥ
kuta etat ? ityāha–anavasthiteḥ anavasthānāt vikalpāntarasyāpi tadantarāt siddhiprasaṅgāt
sarvavijñānānāṃ vikalpetarajñānānāṃ svasaṃvedanam ātmagrahaṇaṃ pratyakṣam avikalpakaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ yadi cet iṣyate
niścayasyāpi na kevalam aniścayasya kasyacid anumānānumeyavyavahārahetoḥ svata eva svasaṃvedanādeva aniścayāt niścayābhāvāt
prakṛtānniścayād anyo niścayaḥ tadantaram tasya kalpanāyām anavasthānāt
kutaḥ, na kutaścit, tasmāt saṃvyavahārasya kāryakāraṇabhāvādilakṣaṇasya siddhiḥ
astu tarhi dhīḥ niścayātmā bahiriva antarapi ityatrāha–tataḥ ityādi

tataḥ tasmād uktadoṣāt svārthe'pi svasya buddheḥ artho grāhyaṃ bahiḥsvalakṣaṇa tatrāpi na kevalaṃ sāmānye kathañcit na sarvātmanā, abhilapyate anena abhilapyate iti ca abhilāpau śabdajātyādī tayoḥ saṃsargaḥ asyedaṃ vācakam, asyedaṃ vācyam iti yojanaṃ tasya yogyayogyauyogyāyogyau nirbhāsau tayorekaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ jñānaṃ pratipattavyam saugataiḥ
evaṃ paraṃ prati tarkādika pramāṇāntaraṃ pratipādya idānīmupamānasya pramāṇāntaratvaniyamaṃ vidhurayannāha–

prasiddhapramāṇena niścito'rtho gorūpastena sādharmyāt sādṛśyāt upajāyamāna sādhyasya jñeyasya tatsādṛśyaviśiṣṭasya gavayalakṣaṇasya sādhana gosadṛśo gavaya iti jñāna yadyupamāna pramāṇāntaramabhyupagamyate tadā tadvaidharmyāt prasiddhārthabaisādṛśyādupajāyamāna sādhyasādhana govilakṣaṇo mahiṣa iti jñāna kiṃ pramāṇa syāt ? tasya kinnāmetyākṣepa
tathā sajñino vācyasya pratipādana ca vivakṣitasaṃjñāviṣayatvena saṃkalanaṃ yathā vṛkṣo'yamiti
sādṛśyañcet prameyaṃ syāt vailakṣaṇyanna kiṃ tathā
vivṛtiḥ–prasiddhārthasādharmyam anyathānupapannatvena nirṇītañcet liṅgameva tataḥ pratipattiḥ anyathā na yujyate
pratyakṣe'rthe saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipatteḥ pramāṇāntaratve vṛkṣo'yam iti jñānaṃ vṛkṣadarśinaḥ pramāṇāntaram, gavayo'yam iti yathā gavayadarśinaḥ prasiddhārthasādharmyāt sādhyasiddherabhāvāt
gauriva gavayaḥ iti śrutvā gavayadarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattivat pratyakṣeṣu itareṣu tiryakṣu tasyaiva punaragavayaniścayaḥ kinnāma pramāṇam ? hānopādānopekṣāpratipattiphalaṃ nāpramāṇaṃ bhavitumarhati
prasiddho'rtho gauḥ tena sādharmyaṃ sādṛśyaṃ yad gavayasya tasmāt sādhyasya sādṛśyaviśiṣṭasya viśeṣasya tena vā viśiṣṭasya sādṛśyasya sādhanaṃ siddhiḥ upamānaṃ pramāṇam

tena prasiddhārthena vaidharmyaṃ vaisadṛśyaṃ yanmahiṣyādeḥ tasmāt sādhyasādhanaṃ govilakṣaṇā ete mahiṣyādayaḥ iti pratītiḥ, tat kiṃ pramāṇam kimabhidhānaṃ tatpramāṇam ? tasya kiñcinnāma karttavyaṃ yat pratyakṣādiṣu na saṃbhavati
tathā ca saptamapramāṇaprasaṅgāt ṣaḍeva pramāṇāni iti saṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ

nanu upamānapramāṇānabhyupagame kuto gavayadarśanād asannikṛṣṭe arthe buddherutpattiḥ ? yena hi pratipatrā gaurupalabdhā na gavayaḥ, na ca atideśavākyaṃ śrutaṃ gauriva gavayaḥ iti, tasya araṇye paryaṭato gavayadarśanānantaram anena sadṛśo gauḥ ityevamākāraṃ parokṣe gavi yat sādṛśyajñānamutpadyate tadupamānam
atra ca viprakṛṣṭasādṛśyapratītau sannikṛṣṭaṃ sādṛśyaṃ karaṇam
upamānamapi sādṛśyamasannikṛṣṭe'rthe buddhimutpādayati, yathā gavayadarśanaṃ gosmaraṇasya
sādṛśyadarśanotthaṃ jñānaṃ sādṛśyaviṣayakamupamānam, dṛṣṭagoḥ puruṣasya gavayaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ paśyato yad goviṣayakaṃ gavayasadṛśajñānaṃ tadupamānam
pūrvadṛṣṭe smaryamāṇārthe dṛśyamānārthasādṛśyajñānamupamānam, yāsāvasmābhirnagare dṛṣṭā gauḥ sā'nena sadṛśīti
yadyapi gauranena prāgeva upalabdhaḥ, sādṛśyañcedānīṃ pratyakṣata eva gavaye dṛśyate, tathāpi gavayasadṛśo gauḥ iti prāgapratipatteḥ anadhigatārthādhigantṛtvam
tarhi idānīmeva goḥ smṛtyā sādṛśyasya ca adhyakṣato'dhigamāt adhikaprameyābhāvācca adhigatārthādhigantṛtvamasya, ityapyayuktam, tadviśiṣṭatvasya tatra tābhyāmanadhigateḥ
yadyapi pratyakṣeṇa sādṛśyaṃ pratipanna gauśca smṛtyā, tathāpi sādṛśyaviśiṣṭasya gopiṇḍasya smṛtyā pratyakṣeṇa ubhābhyāṃ vā'pratīteḥ tadviṣayatvena upamānasya anadhigatārthādhigantṛtvāt prāmāṇyam
pratyakṣe'pi hi pradeśādau dharmiṇi smṛtyā cāgnau pratipanne'pi agniviśiṣṭapradeśādiviṣayatvena anumānasya prāmāṇyaṃ tadvadupamānasyāpi
tasmādyatsmaryate tatsyāt sādṛśyena viśeṣitam | prameyamupamānasya sādṛśyaṃ vā tadanvitam
vyākhyā–yasmādeva pratyakṣe gavaye na kiñcidupamānasya prameyamasti tasmātsamaryamāṇaiva gaurgavayasādṛśyaviśiṣṭā tadviśiṣṭa vā sādṛśyamupamānasya prameyamiti
nanu gavaye sādṛśya pratyakṣa gṛhīta gau smaryate kimanyadupameyamata āha–pratyakṣeṇeti
pratyakṣeṇāvabuddhe'pi sādṛśye gavi ca smṛte | viśiṣṭasyānyato'siddherupamānapramāṇatā
pratyakṣe'pi yathā deśe smaryamāṇe ca pāvake | viśiṣṭaviṣayatvena nānumānā'pramāṇatā
nanu astu upamānaṃpramāṇam, natu pratyakṣādibhyo bhinnaṃ tadanyatamasvabhāvatvāttasya; ityapyanupapannam; tadanyatamasvabhāvatvasya tatrā'saṃbhavāt
tathāhi–na tāvat pratyakṣarūpaṃ tat, parokṣe gavi indriyārthasamprayogābhāve'pi utpadyamānatvāt
nāpi smaraṇamevedami tyabhidhātavyam; pratyakṣapratipanne eva arthe smaraṇasya āvirbhāvāt
na ca gopratyakṣakāle tatpratyakṣeṇa gavayāpratipattau tatsādṛśyaṃ pratyetuṃ śakyam
tadidamupamāna na pratyakṣam, tirohite gavi cakṣusannikarṣātivartini jāyamānatvāt
bhūyo'vayavasāmānyayogo yadyapi manyate | sādṛśyaṃ tasya nu tu jñāptiḥ gṛhīte pratiyogini
atra hi liṅgam–sādṛśyaṃ parikalpyeta, paridṛśyamāno gavayo vā ? yadi sādṛśyam, tatkiṃ gogatam, gavayagataṃ vā liṅgaṃ syāt ? na tāvad gogatam; gavayadarśanāt prāk tasya asiddhatvāt
pratijñārthaikadeśatvaprasaṅgācca, gogatatvena hi sādṛśyaṃ prameyam tadeva ca liṅgamiti
gavayagataṃ tattarhi liṅgamastu uktadoṣadvayāsaṃbhavāditi cet; na, atrāpi vyadhikaraṇāsiddhatvaprasakteḥ
nanu ca jñātasambandhitā tulyā, sā cātra lakṣaṇam, tatra vānyatra veti kvedamupayujyate ? bāḍhamupayujyate, ekadeśadarśanāditi hi tatra lakṣaṇam, jñātasambandhasyeti viśeṣaṇam
kiñca asakṛd dṛṣṭasambandho hyanumānasya hetu asajātīyavyāvṛttisavyapekṣaśca, dvayamatra nāstīti pramāṇāntaram
sādhya hi gavigata sādṛśya liṅgañca gavayagata sādṛśyamiti vyadhikaraṇāsiddha –ā॰ ṭi॰
gavayo hi vanavartī sādṛśyañca gavi sādhyamiti vyadhikaraṇāsiddhatā
na caitasyānumānatvaṃ pakṣadharmādyasaṃbhavāt | prāk prameyasya sādṛśyaṃ dharmatvena na gṛhyate
vyākhyā–ye tu śākyā pramāṇadvayavādina sākhyā vā pramāṇatrayavādino'syānumānāntarbhāvaṃ manyante tān pratyāha na ceti
prameyo gau tadgata tāvatsādṛśya na liṅga tasya prāgupamānāttaddharmatvenā'grahaṇāditi
gavayagatamapi sādṛśyaṃ gavi prameye na pakṣadharma ityāha gavaye iti
gogatasya ca pratijñārthaikadeśatvādapi na liṅgatā, tadeva hi gogataṃ prameyamityāha–pratijñeti
sādṛśyaviśiṣṭo gavayo'pi pakṣadharmatvābhāvādeva na liṅgamityāha gavaye iti
nanu tatsambandhitāmātrameva taddharmatva na sayogasamavāyāveva, asti gavayasya gosambandha tasyāsau sadṛśa, tatra kathamapakṣadharmatvamata āha–sādṛśyamiti
nahi gavayagataṃ gosādṛśya gogatena gavayasādṛśyenānvitaṃ dṛṣṭam, idānīmeva gavayasādṛśya gṛhyate
nanu yugapad gavayaṃ gāñca paśyato'nyadvā'rthadvayaṃ parasparasadṛśaṃ yena yatsadṛśa tadapi tena sadṛśamiti śakyamevānvayagrahaṇa karttum ata uktaṃ sarveṇeti
satyaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na tu sarveṇa gavaya dṛṣṭvā tatsādṛśya gṛhṇataivamanvayo gṛhīto bhavatīti
asti cādṛṣṭasadṛśadvayasyāpyekameva gāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva vane dvitīyaṃ gavayaṃ paśyatastadaiva sādṛśyaviśiṣṭe pratyaya ityāha –ekasminniti
gavaye gṛhyamāṇañca na gavārthānumāpakam | pratijñārthaikadeśatvād gogatasya na liṅgatā
gavayaścāpyasambandhānna goliṅgatvamṛcchati | sādṛśyaṃ na ca sarveṇa pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadanvayi
vyadhikaraṇatvāt, sambandhe hi gamako gamya gamayati –ā॰ ṭi॰
na ca tadanvayi gavayagata sādṛśya pūrva dṛṣṭa kintu gavayadarśanakāla eva sarvasyāpi pramāturudīyate, anenānadhigatārthādhigantṛtva prāmāṇyabījamupamānasya jñāpitam –ā॰ ṭi॰
ekasminnapi dṛṣṭe'rthe dvitīyaṃ paśyato vane | sādṛśyena sahaivāsmistaṃdaivotpadyate matiḥ
prāggogata hi sādṛśya na dharmatvena gṛhyate
yattāvaduktam–anena sadṛśo gauḥ ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, tathāvidhāyāḥ pratīterevā'sabhavāt

tathāhi–aśrutātideśavākyo nāgarakaḥ kānane paryaṭan adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ gosadṛśaṃ paśuṃ paśyan evaṃ buddhyate bravīti ca–gavā sadṛśa eva kaścit paśuḥ iti, natu anena sadṛśo gauḥ ityevaṃvidhajñānamabhidhānaṃ vā kasyacittadānīmastīti
astu vā, tathāpi asya pratyabhijñārūpatvānna pramāṇāntaratvam

nanu anubhūte'rthe pratyabhijñā pravarttate darśanasmaraṇanibandhanatvāttasyāḥ, na ca purovarttigavayāvacchinnasādṛśyopādhitayā pūrvaṃ gopiṇḍo'nubhūtaḥ, gavayāgrahaṇe tadavacchinnasādṛśyaviśeṣitasya gopiṇḍasya grahītumaśakteriti, tadayuktam, yataḥ kasya anubhavābhāvaḥ–gavayāvacchedasya, sādṛśyasya vā ? prathamapakṣe sa evāyam ityādi pratīterapi pratyabhijñānatā na syāt uttaraparyāyāvacchedasya pūrvamananubhavāt

athātra avacchedakasya uttaraparyāyasya pūrvamananubhave'pi avacchedyasya anvitadravyasya anubhavāt pratyabhijñānatā; tadanyatrāpi samānam– avacchedakasya gavayasya tadānadhigame'pi sādṛśyasya avacchedyasya adhigamāt

kathamapratītasya gavayasya sādṛśyaviśeṣaṇateti cet ? kadā tadapratītiḥ–godarśanasamaye, uttarakālaṃ vā ? prathamavikalpe uttaraparyāyasyāpi dravyaviśeṣaṇatvābhāvaprasaṅgaḥ, pūrvaparyāyapratītisamaye tasyāpyapratīteḥ
atha uttarapratyakṣeṇa pratītasya tasya tadviśeṣaṇatā; tadetadanyatrāpyaviśiṣṭam
gavā gavayapiṇḍasya na tu yukto viparyayaḥ
tathāhi –aśrutātideśako nāgaraka kānane paribhramannadṛṣṭapūrvaṃ gosadṛśa prāṇinamupalabhamāna eva buddhyate bravīti ca, aho nu gavā sadṛśa eṣa kaścana prāṇīti
natvanena sadṛśo gauriti jñānamabhidhāna vā tadānī kasyacidastīti ata pramiterevābhāvāt kiṃ pramāṇacintayā
mīmāsakābhimatopamānasya praśastapādabhāṣyādiṣu āgamasmaraṇayorapyantarbhāvaḥ prādarśi, tathāhi–āptenāprasiddhasya gavayasya gavā gavayapratipādanādupamānamāptavacanameva
kiñca smṛtisvabhāvatvādvā na pramāṇamupamāna smṛtyantaravateva tu yujyate tatra gorūpāvayavai saha
bhavatu vaiṣā buddhiranena sadṛśo gau tathāpi smṛtitvānna pramāṇaphalam
tassād gavayagrahaṇe sati asannihitagopiṇḍāvalambinī sādṛśyapratīti sadṛśadarśanābhivyaktasaskārajanyā smṛtireva na pramāṇāntaram

sādṛśyajñānasya cotpattāvaya krama–pūrvaṃ tāvat gogavayayorviṣāṇitvādisādṛśya gavi pratyakṣata pratipadyate, paścād gavayadarśanānantara yadetad viṣāṇitvādisādṛśya piṇḍe'sminnupalabhyate mayā tad gavyapyupalabdham iti smarati tadanantara viṣāṇitvādisādṛśyapratisandhāna jāyate anena piṇḍena sadṛśo gau iti
evañca smārtametad jñāna katha pramāṇāntara bhavet ? –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 582
anvitadravyasthānīyamatra gogavayagata sādṛśya vivakṣitam, atrāpi gavayapratyakṣeṇa pratītasya sādṛśyasya goviśeṣaṇatvopapatteriti tātparyam –ā॰ ṭi॰
nāpi sādṛśyasya; taddhi asannihitatvānnānubhūyate, pratibandhakasadbhāvādvā ? na tāvadasannihitatvāt, sannihitapadārthavṛttitvena sannihitatvā'siddheḥ
nāpi pratibandhakasadbhāvāt tasyānupalambhaḥ; gopiṇḍopalambhavat sādṛśyopalambhe'pi pratibandhakasya kasyacidapyanupalambhāt
nanu ubhayavṛttitvāt sādṛśyasya kathamekapiṇḍopalambhasamaye pratiyogigrahaṇamantareṇopalambhaḥ syāt ? ityapyasundaram; ekaikatra asya samāptatayā pratiyogigrahaṇamantareṇāpi upalambhopapatteḥ
idamanena sadṛśam iti sādṛśyavyavahāra eva hi pratiyogigrahaṇāpekṣo na punaḥ tatsva rūpapratipattiḥ

pratipattā hi gavayamupalabhya pūrvānubhūtaṃ gopiṇḍasaṃsthānaviśeṣam avahitacetasā paribhāvya tayoḥ sādṛśyavyavahāraṃ pravarttayati saṅkalayati caivam–mayā rpūvameva gauḥ anena prāṇinā ✢tulyasasthānaḥ pratipannaḥ, tatastāṃ✢ tulyasaṃsthānatāṃ smṛtvā sādṛśyaṃ vyavaharāmi iti
tato yaḥ saṅkalanātmakaḥ pratyayaḥ sa pratyabhijñānameva yathā sa evāyam iti pratyayaḥ, saṅkalanātmakaśca anena sadṛśo gauḥ iti pratyaya iti
saṅkalanaṃ hi pūrvottarasamayasamadhigatayoḥ vasturūpayoḥ ekadharmayogitayā sadṛśādidharmayogitayā vā pratyavamarśanam
anena sadṛśo goriti pratyaya pratyabhijñānātmaka saṅkalanātmakatvāt
nanu cāsya pratyabhijñānatve smṛtipratyakṣaprabhavatvaprasaṅgaḥ tatsāmagrīta evāsya āvirbhāvāt, na cātra sāsti, gavayapratyakṣādisāmagrīmātrāttadutpatteḥ
na ca vilakṣaṇasāmagrīprabhavaṃ jñānaṃ pratyabhijñānaṃ yuktamatiprasaṅgāt; ityapyasāmpratam; atrāpi tatsāmagryā vidyamānatvāt
tathāhi–smaraṇāpekṣaṃ gavayapratyakṣam evaṃvidhaṃ jñānamupajanayati, anapekṣaṃ vā ? tatra anapekṣasya janakatve aprasiddhagopiṇḍasyāpi etat syāt
atha smaraṇāpekṣaṃ janakatvam, tatrāpi kiṃ smaraṇamātrāpekṣam, gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣa vā tattajjanayet ? yadi smaraṇamātrāpekṣam, tadā aśvādismaraṇe'pi tat tajjanayet

atha gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣam, tatrāpi kiṃ gopiṇḍasmṛtimātrāpekṣam, sādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣa vā ? prathamapakṣe mahiṣyādismaraṇe'pi tasya tajjanakatvaprasaṅgaḥ, sādṛśyāpratipatteḥ ubhayatrāpyaviśeṣāt
gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣitve tu siddha pūrvameva sādṛśyānunubhava, tadasiddhau saṃskāraviśeṣābhāvataḥ tatsmaraṇasyaivā'nupapatteḥ
pūrvaṃ tadananubhave ca gopiṇḍasaṃsthānaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ nipuṇanirūpaṇamanarthakameva syāt
tathāvidhasmṛtisahāyañca gavayapratyakṣam anena sadṛśo gauḥ iti jñānamutpādayatīti siddhamasya smṛtipratyakṣaprabhavatvam

ataḥ nopamānaṃ pratyabhijñānād bhidyate, abhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvāt, yadabhinnasāmagrīprabhavaṃ tadabhinnam yathā avinābhāvalakṣaṇalakṣitahetutaḥ samupajāyamānaṃ kāryasvabhāvādyanumānam, smṛtipratyakṣalakṣaṇā'bhinnasāmagrīprabhavañca pratyabhijñānopamānalakṣaṇaṃ jñānadvayamiti
tulanā–tatra kiṃ smaraṇāpekṣamindriyameva jñāna janayati anapekṣa veti ? anapekṣasya jñānajanakatve aprasiddhagopiṇḍasya smaraṇe'pyetat syāt
atha gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnasmaraṇāpekṣa janakam, tatrāpi yadi smaraṇamātramapekṣeta, gajādismaraṇe'pi syāt
atha gopiṇḍasmaraṇāpekṣam, tatrāpi kiṃ gopiṇḍamātrasmaraṇamapekṣate, gavayasādṛśyāvacchinna gopiṇḍasmaraṇa veti ? gopiṇḍamātrasmaraṇe aśvādipiṇḍasmaraṇe'pi syāt
yena hi saṃskārotpattau smaraṇānmadīyayā gavā sadṛśo'ya gavaya iti jñāna syāt

pūrvaṃ ca gavayasādṛśyāvacchinnagopiṇḍe'nubhavaprasiddhau gavayopalambhāt madīyā gauranena sadṛśī iti kathametat smaraṇa na syāt ? tathā pṛṣṭo bravīti etatsadṛśī mayopalabdhā na tu pramāṇāntara nirdiśati
yathā hi mahiṣyādismaraṇe na gosādṛśya pratīyate tathā gopiṇḍasya smaraṇamātre'pi na sādṛśyasya pratipatti

yadapyuktam–viprakṛṣṭasādṛśyapratītau sannikṛṣṭaṃ sādṛśyaṃ karaṇam' ityādi, tatra kimidaṃ sannikṛṣṭasādṛśyasya karaṇatvam–tadanumāpakatvam, tatsmārakatvam, tadupamāpakatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe pūrvāparavirodhaḥ–pūrvaṃ tasya tadanumāpakatvapratiṣedhāt iha cābhyupagamāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu sannikṛṣṭasādṛśyasya viprakṛṣṭasādṛśyasmṛtihetutvāt upamānahetutvānupapattiḥ, smṛteḥ upamānatvā'saṃbhavāt
tatsmṛtisahāyaṃ tu tat teddhatuḥ syāt na kevalam, tathā ca dṛśyamānād yadanyatra ityādi durdhaṭam
etena tṛtīyapakṣo'pi pratyākhyātaḥ; kevalasya tatsādṛśyasya tadupamāpakatvāsaṃbhavāt
na ca sādṛśyasya jñānajanakatvaṃ saṃbhavati; arthe jñānajanakatvasya agre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
ataḥ sadṛśavastuviṣayābhyāṃ darśanasmaraṇābhyāṃ go-gavayayoḥ sādṛśyaparāmarśi pratyabhijñānā'paraparyāyabhupamānaṃ janyate ityabhyupagantavyam
kathamasyānumānatvamiti cet ? ucyate smaryamāṇo gopiṇḍo vivakṣitagavayāvacchinnasārūpyamān, tena avacchidyamānatvāt, yad yadevam tattattathā yathā sannihito gavayapiṇḍaḥ, tathā cāyam, tasmāttatheti
yadi vā, avilakṣaṇaviṣāṇādyavayavayogitvāditi hetuḥ, sādhya-dṛṣṭāntau tau eva
gosadṛśatva hetu, gavayaśrutigocaratvaṃ sādhyadharma, saṃketagrahaṇakāle vikalpabuddhipratibhāsī buddhistho gavayo dṛṣṭānta dṛśyamāno gavayo dharmī
smaryamāṇo gau dharmī etatsadṛśa iti sādhyo dharma etadavayavasāmānyayogitvāt sannihitadvitīyagavayapiṇḍavat
yatra yadavayavasāmānyayogitva tatra tatsādṛśya yathā yamayoriti

yadā ca pratyakṣeṇa pratiyannapi gavāśvādau bhūyo'vayavasāmānyayogaṃ tadviyogaṃ vā vyāmūḍhaḥ sadṛśāsadṛśavyavahāra na pravarttayati tadā viṣayadarśanena viṣayiṇo vyavahārasya sādhanāt trairūpyasadbhāvādanumānapramāṇatā samastyeva
tathāhi–gavāśvādau viṣāṇādyavayavasāmānyayoga tadviyogo vā prāgupalabdha idānī smaryamāṇa iti nāsiddhatā heto –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 583
sajñāsaṃjñisambandhajñānaphalasya upamānasya pṛthak prāmāṇyavarṇayato naiyāyikasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu mābhūt mīmāṃsakābhyupagatamupamānaṃ pratyabhijñānādeḥ pramāṇāntaram, naiyāyikairabhyupagataṃ tu bhaviṣyati

tatra prasiddhañca tatsādharmyañca, prasiddhena vā gavā sādharmyaṃ gavayasya, prasiddhaṃ vā sādharmyaṃ yasya sa prasiddhasādharmyo gavayaḥ tasmāt, tamāśritya sādhyasya sajñāsaṃjñisambandhasya sādhanaṃ bodhanam upamānam
śrutātideśavākyasya hi pramātuḥ aprasiddhe piṇḍe prasiddhapiṇḍasārūpyajñānaṃ yad indriyajaṃ saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattiphalaṃ tadupamānaṃ pratipattavyam
śrutātideśavākyo hi nāgarakaḥ kānane paribhraman gosadṛśaprāṇidarśanānantaram āṭavikavacaḥ yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavayaḥ iti smṛtvā pratipadyate ayaṃ sa gavayaśabdavācyaḥ iti
nāpyāgamasya tatphalam; na khalu nāgaraka pratipattā āraṇyakavākyādeva araṇyasthaprāṇinaṃ gavayaśabdavācyatayā pratipadyate, kintu sārūpyaṃ prasiddhena gavā tasya paśyan
nahi gavayādarśane ayaṃ sa gavayaśabdavācyaḥ iti saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratītiryuktā atiprasaṅgāt
tadṛrśane tu tadeva śrutātideśavākyasya hi ityādyuktaprakāreṇa tatpratītiphalamupamānamucyate iti
kiṃ punaratra upamānena kriyate ? yadā khalvaya gavā samānadharma pratipadyate tadā pratyakṣatastamarthaṃ pratipadyate iti samākhyāsambandhapratipattirupamānārtha ityāha
yathā gaureva gavaya ityupamāne prayukte gavā samānadharmamartham indriyārthasannikarṣādupalabhamāno'sya gavayaśabda sajñeti sajñāsaṃjñisambandha pratipadyata iti
yathā mudgastathā mudgaparṇī yathā māṣastathā māṣaparṇī ityupamāne prayukte upamānāt sajñāsarjñisambandhaṃ prapipadyamānastāmauṣadhī bhaiṣajyāyāharati
prasiddhasādharmyāditi–prasiddha sādharmyaṃ yasya, prasiddhena vā sādharmyaṃ yasya so'ya prasiddhasādharmyo gavayastasmāt sādhyasādhanamiti samākhyāsambandhapratipattirupamānārtha
yadā hyanena śruta bhavati yathā gaureva gavaya iti, prasiddhe gogavayasādharmye punargavā sādharmya paśyato'sya bhavati aya gavaya iti samākhyāsambandhapratipatti
prasiddhasādharmyāt ityatra prasiddhirubhayī śrutimayī pratyakṣamayī ca
pratyakṣamayī ca yathā gosādṛśyaviśiṣṭo'yamīdṛśa piṇḍa iti
śrutātideśavākyo hi nāgaraka kānane paribhraman gosadṛśa prāṇinamavagacchati, tato vanecarapuruṣakathita yathā gaustathā gavaya iti vacanamanusmarati, smṛtvā ca pratipadyate aya gavayaśabdavācya iti
tatkāla sajñino nāsti gavayasya hi darśanam
gavayārthī hi nāgarakaḥ anavagatagavayasvarūpaḥ tadabhijñamāraṇyakaṃ pṛcchati kīdṛśo gavaya iti ? sa taṃ pratyāha–yādṛśo gauḥ tādṛśo gavayaḥ iti
tadetadvākyam aprasiddhasya gavayasya prasiddhena gavā sārūpyamabhidadhat taddvārakam aprasiddhasya paśoḥ gavayasaṃjñābhidheyatvaṃ jñāpayati ityupamānamucyate iti
gavayārtho hi nāgarako'navagatagavayasvarūpa tadabhijñamāraṇyakaṃ pṛcchati kīdṛggavaya iti, sa tamāha yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavaya iti
tadetadvākyamaprasiddhasya prasiddhena gavā sādṛśyamabhidadhat taddvārakamaprasiddhasya gavayasajñābhidheyartva jñāpayatītyupamānamucyate

yattāvadabhinavanaiyāyikairabhihitam–śrutātideśavākyasya ityādi; tatra kiṃ sākṣāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattyaṅgasya upamānatā ucyeta, paramparayā vā ? prathamapakṣe na mīmāṃsakopavarṇitopamānādasya kaścidviśeṣaḥ, atastatpakṣoktadūṣaṇagaṇaprasaṅgo'trāpyanivāritaprasaraḥ pratipattavyaḥ
na khalu bhavatkalpitam aprasiddhapiṇḍe prasiddhapiṇḍasārūpyajñānamindriyaprabhavaṃ sākṣāt tatpratipatteraṅgaṃ bhavitumarhati

taddhi kevalaṃ tadaṅgaṃ bhavet, saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhasmṛtisahāyaṃ vā ? yadi kevalam; tadā aśrutātideśavākyasyāpi dṛṣṭagoḥ nāgarakasya aṭavyāṃ gavayaṃ paśyataḥ prasiddhapiṇḍasārūpyajñānaṃ tatsambandhapratipattiṃ vidadhyāt
atha tadvākyaśravaṇasahāyasyaivāsya tatpratipattijanane sāmarthyaṃ na kevalasya, tenāyamadoṣaḥ, tarhi śrutavismṛtātideśavākyasyāpi pratipattuḥ tat tatpratipattiṃ vidadhyāt

atha tatsmṛtisahāyaṃ sat tat tatpratipatteraṅgam; tarhi pratyabhijñānaprasādādeva sākṣāt tatpratipattiraṅgīkṛtā syāt, tasyaiva gogavayayoḥ sādṛśyaparāmarśadvāreṇa saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattihetutvopapatteḥ
tatsmṛtisahāyena hi gavayapratyakṣeṇa upalabdhopalabhyamānayoḥ gogavayayoḥ sārūpyaparāmarśipratyabhijñākhyaṃ jñāna janyate anyatastatparāmarśāyogāt
nahi gavayapratyakṣaṃ gosmaraṇamubhaya vā tatparāmraṣṭu samarthamityuktaṃ mīmāṃsakopakalpitopamānavicārāvasare
tena ca tatparāmarśaṃ kurvatā saṃjñāsajñisambandhapratipattirvidhīyate iti

etena paramparayā tatpratipattyaṅgasya upamānatā ityapi pratyuktam; sākṣāt tatsambandhapratipattyaṅgapratyabhijñānajanakatvena prasiddhasārūpyajñānāderapi upacāreṇa upamānatābhyupagame siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgāt
tataḥ taddhi indriyajanitamapi ityādi pratyākhyātam; pratyabhijñānasyaiva indriyāgocarasaṃjñāsajñisambandhapratipattiprasādhanāt pramāṇāntaratvopapatteḥ
sākṣātsambandhabodhakāraṇa yat pratyabhijñāna tasya janakatvena, kāraṇe kāryopacārādityartha
yadapyuktam–nāpyāgamasya tatphalam ityādi, tatra siddhasādhanameva, tatsambandhajñānasya pratyabhijñānaphalatvāt

kiñca, śabdādanutpadyamānatvādvāsya āgamā'phalatvam, tatpratītāvupāyasya aparasyopadeśāt, vācyasavittyapekṣaṇādvā ? tatrādyapakṣe kiṃ sāmānyato'tideśavākyāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhajñānānutpattiḥ, viśeṣato vā ? yadi sāmānyataḥ; tadā ayamasau gavayaḥ yasya mayā pūrvaṃ saṃjñā śrutā ityevamākārā pratipattiratidurdhaṭā syāt, atideśavākyoccāraṇavaiyarthyaṃñca

yat yatpratipattyarthinaḥ tadviṣayāṃ pratipattiṃ manāgapi notpādayati na tattaṃ prati prekṣāvadbhiḥ prayujyate yathā jalapratipattyarthino'nalavākyam, notpādayati ca gavayapratipattyarthinaḥ tatpratipattiṃ manāgapi atideśavākyamiti
atha viśeṣataḥ; tadā āgamapramāṇāya datto jalāñjaliḥ, tasya pratyakṣavat deśakālākāraviśeṣataḥ kvacidapi viṣaye vijñānajanakatvāsaṃbhavāt, sāmānyata evāgamāt sarvatra saṃvittisaṃbhavāt
tulanā–yādṛśo gaustādṛśo gavaya iti śrutātideśavākyasya vane gavayamupalabhamānasyāya gavaya iti pratītirupamānaphalamucyate
tatra tāvad gosadṛśo gavaya iti prathamāvagati puruṣavākyamātraprabhavā nopamāna bhavati
yadapi vanagatasya gavaye tadgate ca gosādṛśye jñāna tadapi pratyabhijñāpratyakṣam
yasya śabdasya yatra prayoga tasya tadvācyatayā sambandhaniyamo'vagata
vane ca sañjñinamupalabhyaitasyaiva sā mayā sañjñā'vagateti tajjñāna smaraṇameveti nopamānasyāvakāśa
tathā gosadṛśo gavaya iti saṅketakāle gosadṛśa-gavayābhidhānayo vācyavācakasambandha pratipadya punargavayadarśanāttatpratipatti pratyabhijñeti kinneṣyate ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 347

atha tatpratītyupāyasya aparasyopadeśānnāsya āgamaphalatvam, yatra hi śabdapratyayādeva arthatathātvam upāyāntaranirapekṣamavadhāryate sa āgamaḥ, yatra tu puruṣaḥ arthapratītau upāyāntaramaparamupadiśati tatra tata evopāyāt prasiddhasādharmyādilakṣaṇāt saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhādyavadhāraṇam, upāyamātrāvagama eva tu śabdavyāpāra iti; tadasāmpratam; śabdavyāpāraprabhavasyāpyasya etāvatā viśeṣeṇa yadyāgamāt pramāṇāntaratvamiṣyate, tadā pramāṇānāmānantyaprasaṅgāt naiyāyikasya catvāri pramāṇāni iti saṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ syāt

tathāhi–yaḥ siṃhāsanādhirūḍhaḥ sa rājā, payo'mbubhedī haṃsaḥ, ṣaṭpādaiḥ madhupaḥ, saptaparṇairviṣamacchadaḥ ityevamādivākyairjanitasaṃskārasya yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭa rājādikaṃ paśyataḥ ayamasau rājā ityevamādiryā sajñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattirutpadyate sā bhavanmate pramāṇacatuṣṭayānantarbhūtatvāt pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt

nanu śabdasvabhāvatvādasyāptopadeśaḥ śabda ityanena gatārthatvānneda pramāṇāntara bhavetucyate–yatra śabdapratyayādeva tatpraṇetṛpuruṣapratyayādeva vā arthatathātvamupāyāntarānapekṣamavagamyate sa āgama eva tatastadarthapratīte
yatra tu puruṣaḥ pratītyupāyamaparamupadiśati tatra tata evopāyāttadarthāvadhāraṇam
upāyamātrāvagame tu śabdavyāpāra, yathā parārthānumāne agnimānaya parvato dhūmavattvānmahānasavaditi
atra hi na puruṣopadeśaviśvāsādeva śailasya kṛśānumattā pratipattā nimittāntaranirapekṣa pratipadyate api tu tadavabodhakadhūmākhyaliṅgasāmarthyādeva
tadiha yadyāṭaviko nāgarakāya gavayārthine tadavagamopāya prasiddhasādharmya nābhyadhāsyattarhi tadupadeśa āgama eva antarabhaviṣyat
tadupadeśāttu tata eva tadarthāvagama iti satyapi śabdasvabhāvatve pramāṇāntaramevedam

nanu cāptopadeśāt pratipādyasya tatsajñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattirāgamaphalameva tato'pramāṇāntaramiti cet; tarhi āptopadiṣṭopamānavākyādapi tatpratipattirāgamajñānamebeti nopamāna śrutātpramāṇāntaram

sihāsanastho rājā, mañcake mahādevī, suvarṇapīṭhe saciva, etasmātpūrvata etasmāduttarata etasmāddakṣiṇata etannāmāṇavayaṃ nnāmakamida grāmavānaka grāmadhānaka mityādivākyāhitasaṃskārasya punastathaiva darśanāt so'yaṃ rājetyādi saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipatti, ṣaḍānano guhaścaturmukho vrahmā tuṅganāso bhāgavata kṣīrāmbhovivecanatuṇḍo hasaḥ saptacchada ityādivākyāhitasaskārasya tathāpratipattirbā yadyāgamajñāna tadā tadvadevopamānamavaseya viśeṣābhāvāt
ityevamādiśabdaśravaṇāttathāvidhāneva marālā- dīnavalokya tathā satyāpayati yadā tadā tatsaṅkalanamapi pratyabhijñānamukta darśanasmaraṇakāraṇatvāviśeṣāt
etena vācyasaṃvittyapekṣaṇāt ityapi prativyūḍham, uktapratītestadapekṣaṇe'pi āgame antarbhāvā'bhyupagamāt

nanu upāyāntarādarthapratītāvapi upamānasya āgame'ntarbhāvābhyupagame agnimānayaṃ parvato dhūmavattvāt mahānasavat ityādeḥ parārthānumānasya kutastatrāntarbhāvo na syāditi cet ? anumānakāraṇakāryatvāt iti brūmaḥ
tathāhi–pratipādakasvārthānumānakāryatvāt pratipādyasvārthānumānakāraṇatvācca vacanarūpasyāpi parārthānumānasya anumānatā na virudhyate
na khalu upadiṣṭaprasiddhasādharmyalakṣaṇopāyādarthapratītiṃ vihāya anyadupamānaṃ kiñcid bhavataḥ prasiddhamasti yatkāraṇakāryatayā asya upadeśaprabhavasyāpyupamānatā syāditi
tathāhi–sādṛśyavākyasyāyamartho yo gosadṛśa sa gavaya ityeva vyavaharttavya
sa ca vākyādupalabdhasaṅketa sādṛśyāvacchinna piṇḍamupalabhamāna para vyavaharati ayaṃ gavaya iti
upamāna tāvat yathā gaustathā gavaya iti vākyam, tajjanitā dhīrāgama eva
etena vṛddhanaiyāyikairyaduktamupamānalakṣaṇam–prasiddhetarayoḥ sārūpyapratipādakamatideśavākyameva upamānam iti; tadapi pratyākhyātam, atideśavākyātmano'sya āgamasvabhāvatayā upamānatvāyogāt
tato gogavayayoḥ sārūpyaparāmarśātmakaṃ jñānameva pratyabhijñākhyaṃ mukhyataḥ upamānaṃ yuktaṃ nānyaditi prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyam, atra uktadoṣāṇāṃ leśatopyavakāśāsaṃbhavāt
kārikāyāmanuktamapi dūṣaṇaṃ prasiddha ityādinā darśayannāha–prasiddhārthasādharmyam anyathānupapannatvena sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa nirṇītaṃ cet yadi tarhi liṅgameva tallakṣaṇatvāt liṅgasya
atha tathātvena tadanirṇītaṃ tatra dūṣaṇamāha–tataḥ ityādi
tataḥ prasiddhārthasādharmyāt pratipattiḥ sādhyasaṃvittiḥ anyathā anyathānupapannatvanirṇayābhāvaprakāreṇa na yujyate

pratyakṣa ityādinā prathamaṃ kārikārddhaṃ vyācaṣṭe–pratyakṣe darśanena viṣayīkṛte arthe gavayalakṣaṇe gavayaḥ iti saṃjñā tasyā gavayalakṣaṇo'rtha saṃjñī tayorvācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ tasya pratipatteḥ gavayo'yam iti saṃvitteḥ pramāṇāntaratve aṅgīkriyamāṇe dūṣaṇamāha–vṛkṣa ityādi
ayaṃ dṛśyamāno bhāvaḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti yat jñānaṃ tat pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ
ayaṃ gavayaḥ iti jñānaṃ yathā gavayadarśinaḥ upamānākhyaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ tathā prakṛtamapi tadantaraṃ syāt
upamānaṃ kasmāt tanna bhavatīti cet ? atrāha–prasiddha ityādi
prasiddhārthasādharmyād yā sādhyasiddhiḥ tasyā abhāvāt tatpramāṇāntaram
kathaṃ tajjñānamutpadyata iti cet ? ucyate vṛkṣānabhijño yadā kaścit kañcit pṛcchati kīdṛśo vṛkṣaḥ iti ? sa taṃ pratyāha–śākhādimān vṛkṣaḥ iti
tadvākyāccāhitasaṃskāraḥ praṣṭā punaḥ śākhādimantaṃ padārthaṃ paśyan ayaṃ vṛkṣaḥ iti pratipadyate
anena ca tadvaidharmyāt tatpratipattivailakṣaṇyāt ityayamartho vyākhyātaḥ
tulanā–yo'pyaya gavayaśabdo gosadṛśasya vācakaḥ' iti pratyaya so'pyanumānameva
yo hi śabdo yatra vṛddhai prayujyate so'sati vṛttyantare tasya vācaka yathā gośabdo gotvasya, prayujyate caiva gavayaśabdo gosadṛśe iti tasyaiva vācaka iti tajjñānamanumānameva
tathā'paramapi pramāṇāntaraṃ parasya āpādayitu gauriva ityādyāha
asyāyamarthaḥyadā kaścidāṭavikaḥ nagarasthena kīdṛśo gavayaḥ iti pṛṣṭaḥ idamāha–gauriva gavayaḥ iti
tadā tasya nāgarakasya gauriva gavayaḥ ityevaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā paryaṭato gavayadarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattivat
tacchabdena dṛṣṭo gavayaḥ parāmṛśyate, tasya gavayaḥ iti nāma tasya pratipattiḥ seva tadvaditi

pratyakṣeṣu darśanaviṣayīkṛteṣu itareṣu prasiddhārthavisadṛśeṣu tiryakṣu mahiṣyādiṣu tasyaiva gauriva gavayaḥ iti vākyaṃ śrutavataḥ punaḥ paścād agavayo'yam iti niścayaḥ kinnāma kimabhidhānaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt ? sāmānyena niścayavacanam aśābdasya mīmāṃsakasambandhinaḥ śābdasya ca naiyāyikasambandhino niścayasya saṅgrahārtham, tena mīmāṃsakaṃ prati yad vyākhyānaṃ tadapi saṅgṛhītam, itarathā agavayanāmaniścayaḥ iti brūyāt
atha agavayajñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ na bhavatītyucyate; atrottaramāha–hānopādāna ityādi
hānopādānopekṣāpratipattiḥ phalaṃ yasya agavayajñānasya tanna apramāṇaṃ bhavitumarhati kintu pramāṇameva taditi pramāṇeyattāvyāghātaḥ
yathā tannāmapratipattirbhavata pramāṇāntara tathā gavaye dṛṣṭe'rthapratipatti pramāṇāntara prāpnoti iti bhāva –ā॰ ṭi॰
mīmāsakā hi sādṛśyajñānamupamānakathayanti atasteṣāmupamāna na śabdātmakam
naiyāyikāstu sajñāsajñisambandhajñānamupamāna varṇayanti atasteṣāmabhiprāyeṇa tacchābdabodhātmaka bhavati
kā ? sambandhapratipat sambandhasya vācyavācakabhāvasya pratipat jñapti

ki viśiṣṭā ? pratyakṣārthāntarāpekṣā, prakṛtāt śabdalakṣaṇādarthādanyo'rtho'rthāntara pratyakṣa ca tadarthāntarañca pratyakṣārthāntara vṛkṣādi tattathoktam, tasyāpekṣā yasyā sā pratyakṣārthāntarāpekṣā
tajjñāna ced yadi na pramāṇa syāttadā tarhi sarvaṃ naiyāyikamīmāsakādikalpitamupamāna kuta pramāṇa syādaviśeṣāt
na hi sādṛśyasambandhajñāna pramāṇa na punarvācyavācakasambandhajñānamiti viśeṣo'sti
tata sajñāsajñisaṅkalanamapi pramāṇāntarameva bhaviṣyatīti kuta pramāṇasakhyāniyama ? – laghī॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 40
vivṛtiḥ–āgamāhitasaṃskārasya tadarthadarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattiḥ sākalyena pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ vā na punarupamānameva
yathā etasmāt pūrvaṃ paścimamuttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vā grāmadhānakametannāmakamityāhitasaṃskārasya punastaddarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattiḥ
kaścāyaṃ niścayaḥ saṃjñāsaṃjñisampratipattisādhanameva samakṣe'rthe pramāṇāntaraṃ na punaḥ saṃkhyādipratipattisādhanamiti ?
pratyakṣañca tadarthāntarañca tasya apekṣā yasyāṃ sā tathoktā
kāsau ? ityāha– sambandhapratipat vācyavācakayoḥ yaḥ sambandhaḥ tasya pratipattiḥ yataḥ yasmāt jāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ, tatpramāṇam
na cet pramāṇaṃ sarva mīmāṃsaka-naiyāyikakalpitam upamānam kutaḥ ? na kutaścit pramāṇamiti sambandhaḥ tathā tena tadaprāmāṇyaprakāreṇa

yo yasya avisaṃvādakaḥ puruṣaḥ sa tasya āptaḥ tasya vacanam āgamaḥ tena āhitaḥ saṃskāro yasya tadarthadarśina āgamārthadarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattiḥ āgamārthābhidhānapratipattiḥ sākalyena anavayavena yā kācit tadarthadarśinaḥ tannāmapratipattiḥ sā pramāṇamapramāṇaṃ vā ? syāt ityadhyāhāraḥ
atha apramāṇam; tarhi upamānamapyapramāṇaṃ syādaviśeṣāt, ataḥ sa eva tatsaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ
nanu tasya tatpratipattirupamānameva tacca pramāṇamiṣṭameva ityuktadoṣānavakāśa ityāśaṅkyāha–na punaḥ ityādi

yathā ityudāharaṇapradarśane, etasmā- nnagarādeḥ pūrva paścimamuttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ vā grāmadhānakaṃ grāmaviśeṣasyeyaṃ saṃjñā etannāmakaṃ etadanirdiṣṭaṃ nāma yasya tattathoktam ityevamāhitasaṃskārasya puṃsaḥ punastaddarśino yat tat etasmāt ityanena grāmadhānakam ityanena coktam tatpaśyatītyevaśīlasya tannāmapratipattiḥ grāmadhānakanāmapratipattiḥ
etasmāt ityanena apekṣaṃ pratyakṣārthāntaramuktam pūrvam ityādinā tu tadapekṣaṃ grāmadhānakam
bhavatu iyaṃ pramāṇaṃ ko doṣaḥ iti cet ? atrāha–kaśca ityādi
kaśca ? na kaścid ayam pareṇocyamāno niścayo'vaśyaṃbhāvaḥ
ko'sau ? ityāha–saṃjñāsaṃjñisampratipattisādhanameva samakṣe'rthe pramāṇāntaraṃ na punaḥ saṃkhyādipratipattisādhanamiti kintu tadapi syāditi bhāvaḥ
āpta khalu sākṣātkṛtadharmā yathādṛṣṭasyārthasya cikhyāpayiṣayā prayukta upadeṣṭā
dvitvādisaṃkhyāyā api apekṣābuddhijanyatvāt pramāṇāntaratvaprasaktiriti bhāva –ā॰ ṭi॰
tasyollekhamāha– idamasmādalpam, idamasmānmahat, idamasmādāsannam, idamasmātprāśu dīrghañca, idamasmānna prāśu iti
kuta ? vyapekṣāta, viruddhasya pratipakṣasyāpekṣā kathañcidajahadvṛtti tata iti

tulanā–ekaviṣāṇī khaṅgaḥ saptaparṇo viṣamacchadaḥ ityāhitasaṃskārāṇāṃ punastatpratyakṣadarśināmabhijñānaṃ kinnāma pramāṇaṃ syāt ? tathā stryādilakṣaṇaśravaṇāt tathādarśinaḥ samabhijñānaṃ saṃkhyādipratipattiśca pūrvāparanirīkṣaṇāt paśyatāñca nāmayojanā upamānavat sarvaṃ pramāṇāntaram
arthāpattiḥ <q>anumānāt ✢ pramāṇāntaraṃ na vā</q> iti kinnaścintayā sarvasya parokṣe'ntarbhāvāt✢
tatsamañjasaṃ pratyakṣaṃ parokṣañceti dve eva pramāṇe anyathā tatsaṃkhyānavasthānāt

tulanā–teṣāṃ dvyādisaṃkhyājñānaṃ pramāṇāntaram, gaṇitajñasaṃkhyāvākyāhitasaṃskārasya pratipādyasya punardṛyādiṣu saṃkhyāviśiṣṭadravyadarśanādetāni dvyādīni tānīti saṃjñāsaṃjñisambandhapratipattirdvyādisaṃkhyājñānapramāṇaphalamiti pratipattavyam
tathottarādharyajñānaṃ sopānādiṣu sthaviṣṭhajñānaṃ parvādiṣu mahattvajñānaṃ svavaṃśādiṣu, saṃsthānajñānaṃ tryasrādiṣu, vakrarjvādijñānañca kvacitpramāṇāntaramāyātam
tulanā–anumānopamānāgamārthāpattisaṃbhavābhāvānyapi pramāṇānīti kecinmanyante tatkathametaditi ? atrocyate–sarvāṇyetāni matiśrutayorantarbhūtāni indriyārthasannikarṣanimittatvāt

vikalpaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate, idamalpamiti vikalpaḥ, idaṃ mahaditi vikalpaḥ, idaṃ dūramiti vikalpaḥ, idamāsannamiti vikalpaḥ, idaṃ prāṃśu iti vikalpaḥ, tathā alpaṃ neti vikalpaḥ mahanneti, dūraṃ neti, āsannaṃ neti, prāṃśu neti
āmalakāpekṣayā bilvaṃ mahat devadattasamīpakūpāpekṣayā parvatādikaṃ dūram, evamanyatrāpi yojyam
idamalpamityādigrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam, tena adharottarādivikalpasya dvitvādivikalpasya ca grahaṇam
dṛṣṭeṣu pratyakṣeṣu artheṣu parasparam anyonyaṃ vyapekṣālakṣaṇaṃ yasya tattathoktam
kiṃ tat ? alpamahattvādijñānam, ādiśabdena dūrādi gṛhyate
evaṃ naiyāyikamīmāṃsakayoḥ pramāṇāntarasamplavaṃ tadabhimatapramāṇasaṃkhyāniyamanāśaka nirūpya idānīṃ mīmāṃsakābhitā'rthāpatti vicintayannāha–arthāpattiḥ ityādi

mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 1 ityetallakṣaṇalakṣitā mīmāṃsakaiḥ parikalpitārthāpattiḥ sā anumānāt pramāṇāntaraṃ navā iti kinnaścintayā ? ayamabhiprāyaḥ–arthāpattyutthāpakārthasya sādhyābhāve niyamenā'nupapadyamānasya avinābhāvasvabhāvaliṅgalakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt liṅgatvamevopapapannam
ṣaḍda॰ samu॰ ślo॰ 72 ? iti kumārilasya vadataḥ pramāṇasakhyāvyāghātaḥ, prabhākarasya ca abhāvaṃ pratyakṣaviśeṣaṃ vadataḥ pañca pramāṇāni iti
ekatra prameye bahūnā pramāṇānā pravṛtti samplava

vyākhyā–yatra deśakālādau pratyakṣānumānopamānaśābdārthāpattyabhāvalakṣaṇai ṣaḍbhi pramāṇai paricchinno'rtho'nyathā nopapadyate yadyevambhūto'rtho na bhavedityeva yā parokṣārthaviṣayā kalpanā sā'rthāpatti pramāṇamudāhṛtā śabarasvāminā
adṛṣṭaṃ kalpayedanya sārthāpattirudāhṛtā || mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 1
na cediti ba॰, na ceti śra॰
arthāpattirabhāvaśca ṣaṭpramāṇāni jaimineḥ || ṣaḍda॰ samu॰ ślo॰ 72 ?
pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghāta iti sambandha, tasya catvāri eva syuḥ –ā॰ ṭi॰
arthāpatti anumānādatirikta pramāṇamiti vadato mīmāsakasya pūrvapakṣa–

nanu cārthāpatteḥ svarūpādibhedāt pratyakṣādibhyo bhedaprasiddheḥ kathaṃ pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ ? tathā ca prayogaḥ–arthāpattiḥ pratyakṣādibhyaḥ pramāṇāntaram, vibhinnasvarūpatvāt, yadyato vibhinnasvarūpaṃ tattataḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ yathā pratyakṣādanumānam, pratyakṣādibhyo vibhinnasvarūpā cārthāpattiriti
naca vibhinnasvarūpatvamasiddham, tathāhi–tasyāḥ svarūpam–dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā' rtho'nyathā nopapadyate ityadṛṣṭārthakalpanā
tatra dṛṣṭaḥ pratyakṣādibhiḥ pañcabhi pramāṇairupalabdhaḥ, śrutaḥ laukikād vaidikādvā vākyādavagataḥ tasmādanupapadyamānād yā arthāntarakalpanā sā arthāpattiḥ
arthāpattirapi dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vārtho'nyathā nopapadyate ityarthakalpanā, yathā jīvati devadatte gṛhābhāvadarśanena bahirbhāvasyādṛṣṭasya kalpanā
pramitasyārthasya arthāntareṇa vinā'nupapattimālocya tadupapattaye yā'rthāntarakalpanā sā'rthāpatti
dṛṣṭaśabdena yadyapyupalabdhamātramucyate tathāpi śrutaśabdasannidhānāt gobalīvardanyāyena śabdapramitavyatiriktamucyate
pratyakṣeṇa hi pratipanne pratibandhe anumāna pravarttate
na ca śakteratīndriyatvena adhyakṣāgocaratve tataḥ kenacilliṅgena saha asyāḥ pratibandhapratipattiryuktā

nāpyanumānāt pratibandhapratipattiḥ, taddhi idameva, anyadvā tatpratipattau pravarteta ? na tāvadidameva, cakrakaprasaṅgāt–sati hi pratibandhagrahaṇe anumānapravṛttiḥ, tadgrahaṇañca śaktiprati pattau, tatpratipattiścānumānapravṛttau, tatpratipatti tatpravṛtti śca pratibandhagrahaṇe iti

athānyato'numānāttatpratibandhapratipattiḥ; nanu tadapi pratibandhapratipattau satyāṃ pravarttate, tatra ca pratibandhapratipattiḥ prathamānumānāt, tadantarādvā syāt ? prathamapakṣe'nyonyāśraya– siddhe hi dvitīyānumāne tataḥ prasiddhapratibandhālliṅgāt prathamānumānasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca ataḥ prasiddhapratibandhālliṅgād dvitīyānumānasiddhiriti
nahi tat pratibandhapratittiṃ vinā svasādhyasiddhaye prabhavati
śabdopamānayostu śaktipratipattau saṃbhāvanaiva nāsti; śabdasādṛśyābhyāṃ vinaiva tatpratipattipratīteḥ

bīje satyaṅkurotpattidarśanād bījakāraṇatvamavagamyate, satyapi tasmin mūṣikāghrāte aṅkurānutpatterakāraṇatva tadida kāraṇākāraṇatvavyāghātaparijihīrṣayā śaktikalpanam, sambandhajñānānapekṣatvānnānumānam itaśca nānumānamityāha –dṛṣṭveti sārddhena
sambandhigrahaṇapūrvaka hi sambandhagrahaṇam, na ca śakte pratyakṣagrahaṇa sambhavati ato'vaśya sambandhagrahaṇavelāyā śaktigrahaṇamabhyupagantavyam
tathā śabdasādhanārthāpratipattyanyathānupapattyā śabdasya vācakaśaktimavagamya tadanyathānupapattyā tasya nityatvakalpanā arthāpattipūrvikā'rthāpattiḥ
pīno devadatto divā na bhuṅkte iti vākyaśravaṇāt rātrau bhojanakalpanā śrutārthāpattiḥ
nahīdaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ vākyameva tatpratipattinibandhanam; pīnādipadānāṃ svārthapratipādanaparatayā rātribhojanalakṣaṇārthapratipādanasāmarthyānupapatteḥ
atha padasamudāyāt tatpratipattiḥ; tanna; asya anyārthapratipādanaparatvāt

śrūyamāṇena hi padasamudāyena devadattasya pīnasya rasāyanādyabhāve divābhojananiṣedha eva pratipādyate na tu rātri bhojanavidhiḥ, vidhipratiṣedhayoḥ parasparaparihārasthitilakṣaṇavirodhato mithaḥ saṃsargābhāvāt
na cānanvitasya padārthasamudāyasya vākyārthatā dṛṣṭeṣṭā vā, pratītivirodhāt
ataḥ arthāpattita eva rātribhojanalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ pratīyate iti pramāṇāntaraṃ śrutārthāpattiḥ siddhā
na hyanekārthatā yuktā vākye vācakatā tathā
na bhedo yena tadvākya tasya syāt pratipādakam
nānumāna na ceda hi dṛṣṭa tena saha kvacit
śrutasyaiva śabdasya tatpratipādakatva kecitkalpayanti, anye tu śabdāntarameva tatpratipādakamiti, tatrānantarapakṣa nirākaroti na tāvaditi
kiñca yadi vākyaṃ vācakaṃ syāt syādapyanekārthatā na tu vākyaṃ vācakamityāha vācakateti
kimiti rātribhojana divāvākyasyārtho na bhavatyata āha –na rātrīti
na hi rātryādipadārthā divāvākyapadairabhidhīyante, te kathamanvitarūpatayā tadvākyārthībhaveyuriti
yadyapadārtho'pi rātribhojana divādipadānā sasargo bhedo vā syāttato'pi tasyaiva vākyasyārtha syāt na tu tadastītyāha na diveti
yadyapi cānekārthatā, tathāpi ekasmin prayoge vyāpṛtasya nārthāntara sabhavatītyāha –anyārtheti
tasmādvākyāntarasyaiva kalpitasyāyamartho na tu śrutasyetyāha tasmāditi
tasya tu vākyasya kiṃ pramāṇamiti vicāraṇīyamityāha –tasyeti
yacca tadarthāntara tadā yadyapi vākyārthatvādāgamika na niṣpramāṇaka tathāpi tadeva vākya kiṃ pramāṇakamiti cintyamiti
tatrārthāpattireva pramāṇamiti vaktu pūrveṣā tāvadasambhava darśayitumāha na hīti
mā bhūtsasarga ko doṣa ityāha –ā॰ ṭi॰
tatra pratyakṣato jñātāddāhād dahanaśaktitā | bahneranumitāt sūrye yānāttacchaktiyogitā
śabde vācakasāmarthyāt tannityatvaprameyatā | abhidhā nānyathā siddheriti vācakaśaktitā
tasya śabdasya nityatvena prameyatva paricchedyatvam –ā॰ ṭi॰
sā śabdasya anyathā–vācakaśaktyā vinā na siddhyedityeva bodhakaśaktatām, avagamya budadhvā, tadananyagate tasyā bodhakaśakteranyā gatirnāsti śabdanityatvamantareṇeti
arthāpattyāvagamyaiva tadanyatva dananya gateḥ punaḥ | arthāpattyantareṇaiva śabdanityatvaniścayaḥ
ekayā arthāpattyā vācakaśaktimavagamya anyayā śabdasya nityatva niścinuyāt pramātā –ā॰ ṭi॰
darśanasya parārthatvādityasminnabhidhāsyate | mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 3–7
pīno divā na bhuṅkte cetyevamādivacaḥ śrutau | rātribhojanavijñānaṃ śrutārthāpattirucyate

vyākhyā–pratyakṣāde pramāṇasyābhāvena nivṛttyā nirṇīto niścito yaścaitrābhāvaḥ tena viśeṣitād gehāt iha gṛhe caitro nāstītyata caitrasya jīvane sati yā bahirbhāvasiddhi bahiścaitro vidyate ityevaṃ niścayarūpā, iha bhāṣye varṇitā śabarasvāminā, tadanyāsāmarthāpattīnāmupalakṣaṇārthamudāhateti yāvat
yathā jīvati devadatte gṛhe'darśanena bahirbhāvasya adṛṣṭasya kalpaneti
tāmabhāvotthitāmanyāmarthāpattimudāharet | mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 8–9 iti
