jīvato hi caitrasya-gṛhe'bhāvamavagamya tadanyathānupapattyā bahirbhāvakalpanā abhāvapūrvikā arthāpattiḥ
atha dṛṣṭena adṛṣṭasiddheḥ anumānameveyamityucyate, tanna, tatsāmagryabhāvāt
pakṣadharmatādisāmagryā hi yadvijñānaṃ janyate tadanumānaṃ prasiddham, sā ceha nāsti

tathāhi–bahirbhāvaviśiṣṭe caitre caitraviśiṣṭe vā bahirbhāve anumeye kasya hetutvam–kiṃ gṛhābhāvaviśiṣṭasya caitrasya, caitrābhāvaviśiṣṭasya vā gṛhasya, gṛhe caitrābhāvasya vā, gṛhe caitrādarśanasya vā ? tatra naiteṣāṃ madhye anyatamo'pi heturghaṭate; pakṣadharmatvābhāvāt
tadabhāvaviśiṣṭa tu gṛha dharmo na kasyacit
gamyate tu gṛha tatra na ca caitraḥ pratīyate
gṛhagato hyabhāvo na devadattasya bahirdeśasya vā dharma, abhāvaviśiṣṭaṃ tu gṛha na kasyaciddharma ityāha gṛhābhāveti
caitragrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam, gṛhameva gamyate na caitro bahirdeśo vā
yadi tu caitrādarśana heturityucyate ata āha na ceti
yathā hyabhāve'numeye liṅgatvamabhāvasya na sabhavati tathā'trāpi pakṣadharmatvābhāvādeva
adarśanādabhāve'vagate paścādupajāyamānā bahirbhāvamatirnādarśananimittā bhavitumarhatīti nābhāvasya liṅgatva na ca tasya pakṣadharmatā ityāha caitrābhāvasyeti
kiñca, prameyānupraveśaprasaṅgāt neyamanumānam; tathāhi–āgamāvagatajīvanasya caitrasya gṛhābhāvena bahirbhāvaḥ kalpyate, anyathā mṛtena anekāntaḥ syāt
abhāvaśca gṛhītaḥ, san bahirbhāvamavagamayati nāgṛhīto dhūmavat
iha ca sadupalambhakamastyeva jīvanagrāhyāgamākhyaṃ pramāṇam, sati tasmin kathamabhāvagrahaṇaṃ pravartteta iti ? pravarttamānameva etatsadupalambhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pṛthagviṣayamavasthāpayati
jīvanaṃ hi astitvam, āgamāt sāmānyato yattasya pratipannaṃ tad gṛhe'bhāva paricchindatā pramāṇena svaviṣayādanyatra saṅkocyate bahirasya bhāvaḥ gṛhe tvabhāva iti
tena jīvato gṛhe'bhāvalakṣaṇasādhanapratipatteḥ bahirbhāvalakṣaṇasādhyapratipattipūrvakatvasiddheḥ siddhaḥ prameyānupraveśaḥ, ataḥ neyamanumānam
nahi vahnyādyanumāne dhūmādiliṅgagrahaṇasamaye anumeyapratipattiḥ pratītā, dhūmādigrahaṇottarakāla tatpratipattipratīteḥ

nanu arthāpattāvapi prameyānupraveśo doṣaḥ samāna eva, satyameva tat; tathāpi pramāṇadvayasamarpitaikavastuviṣayabhāvābhāvasamarthanārthaṃ pravarttamānā arthāpattiḥ parāmṛśatyeva prameyadvayam, anyathā tatsaṅghaṭanāyogāt
ataśca yeyam āgamādaniyatadeśatayā kvacidastīti savittirabhūt saiveyaṃ gṛhābhāve gṛhīte bahirasti iti saṃvit saṃvṛttā
prameyasya sādhyasya hetugrahaṇakāla eva anupraveśa jñānam
yena bahirbhāvena viśiṣṭaścaitro'numātavya, sa pakṣīkṛtajīvaccaitradharmatayā gṛhābhāvasyātmalābhāya tatpratītivelāyāmevānupraveśita iti

nanvarthāpattāvapi tulyo'ya doṣa, tatrāpi hi gṛhābhāvamātra maraṇenāpyupapanna na bahirbhāva kalpayati, vidyamānatvasasṛṣṭastu kalpayet, sa tvanavagate bahirbhāve na śakyate'vagantum, nacānavagata kalpako bhavati, tadabagame ca prameyābhāva syādata āha –anyatheti
anyathānupapattirūpe pramāṇāntare yo'ya vidyamānatvasasṛṣṭagehābhābabuddhāveva prameyasya bahirbhāvasyānupraveśa sa na doṣa

īdṛgrūpameva hi etatpramāṇa yadarthañca yasyāsatyarthāntare mitha pratighātenāsambhavamālocya arthāntarakalpanayā pratighāta parihṛtya sambhavatītyata eva vilakṣaṇasāmagrītvena pramāṇāntaratvam anupapattiriti cāvagatasyārthāntareṇa pratighātaścocyata iti
na hi nirviṣaya pramāṇa bhavati, eva ca bhāvo gṛhīto nābhāvastatkatha sa hetuḥ, bhāvavadadyāpi sādhyatvāt –ā॰ ṭi॰
jīvati caitra iti āgamākhya pramāṇam, gṛhe ca nāstītyabhāvapramāṇam, tatsamarthanārthaṃ bahirastītyarthāpatti pravarttate anyathā pramāṇadvayasya pravṛttirna syāt –ā॰ ṭi॰

āgamapramāṇena hi caitrasya bhāvo viṣayīkṛtaḥ abhāvapramāṇena ca tasyābhāva iti, ata caitraviṣayakasadbhāvābhāvayoḥ avirodhasthāpanārtham arthāpattiḥ pravartate, sā ca caitro gṛhe nāsti bahirasti iti prameyadvaya parāmṛśati

bhāvābhāvau hi na yugapad vahni-dhūmavad ekatrendriyaprabha vapratyaye pratibaddhatayā boddhuṃ śakyau, gṛhābhāvasya hi vyāpyatve bahiḥsadbhāvo vyāpakaḥ, sa ca pratyakṣeṇa arvāgdarśibhiḥ sākṣātkarttumaśakyaḥ anantadeśavṛttitvāt

nanu kaścid dvāri sthitaḥ kasyacid devadattādeḥ bhāvābhāvau gahṇāti–yadā etasya gṛhe'bhāvaḥ tadā anyatra sadbhāvaḥ ityevaṃ vyāptigrahaṇottarakālaṃ caitrāderniścitajīvanasya gṛhe'bhāvād bahiḥsadbhāvo niścīyate, satyam; tathāpyanumānādasyā vailakṣaṇyam–tatra hi sāmānyena aniyatadeśena vyāpakena sambandhagrahe sati uttarakālaṃ pakṣadharmatāniścayasamaye vyāpakasya niyatadeśatayā pratipattiḥ, atra tu vaiparītyam
yādṛśa eva hi vyāptikāle tādṛśa eva prayogakāle'pyaniyatadeśo'sau pratīyate
api tu bahiḥ yatra kutrāpyasti ityaniyatarūpeṇa
kiñca, gṛhadvāravarttino gṛhe'bhāvasya bahiḥsadbhāvena sambandhagrahe gṛhe caitrasadbhāvena bahistadabhāvasādhane kathaṃ sambandhagrahaḥ syāt ? taduktam–
bhāvenābhāvasiddhau tu kathamaṣa bhaviṣyati || nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 38
na khalu gṛhe caitrasya sadbhāvā'nyathānupapattyā deśāntareṣu tannāstitvāvasāye gṛhe tatsadbhāvasya deśāntare tannāstitvena adhyakṣataḥ sambandhagraho ghaṭate, deśāntarāṇāmānantyāt
kathamevaṃ dhūmasya anagnivyatirekaniścayaḥ iti cet ? kiṃ tena gṛhītena prayojanam ? dhūmajvalanayoḥ anvayagrahaṇasaṃbhave vyatirekagrahaṇe tātparyā'saṃbhavāt

nahi bhūyodarśanasulabhaniyamajñānasampādyamānasādhyādhigamanirvṛttacetasām anagnivyatirekaniścayena kiñcit prayojana sādhyādhigamasya sampannatvāt ? iha punaḥ anvayādhigamasamaya eva gamyadharmasya duradhigamatvamuktam anantadeśavṛttitvāt
atha anupalabdhyā tanniśrayaḥ; tanna; gṛhavyatiriktasakaladeśavartinaḥ tadabhāvasya niyatadeśayā anupalabdhyā niścetumaśakyatvāt
teṣu teṣu deśāntareṣu gatvā anupalabdhyā tadabhāvaḥ; ityaṣyasundaram yataḥ–

ya khalu vastvantareṣu vipakṣeṣu liṅgasyābhāvāvadhāraṇamanumānāya prārthayate tasyaiva doṣa, vaya tu dvitricatureṣu avagatāgnisāhacaryād dhūmādvipakṣādarśanamātreṇa sahacāriṇamagnimanumimānā na sarvavipakṣeṣu dhūmābhāvāvadhāraṇaṃ prārthayāmahe
yatra nopalabhyane tatra nāsti caitra –ā॰ ṭi॰
gatvā gatvā tu tān deśān yadyartho nopalabhyate
gatvā gatvāpi tān deśān nāsya jānāsi nāstitām
ato niyatadeśopalabhyamānaparimitaparimāṇapuruṣaśarīrā'nyathānupapattyaiva taditassakaladeśanāstitvā'vadhāraṇaṃ tasya ityarthāpattyaiva tatra tadabhāvaniścayaḥ iti

yattāvaduktam–dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā ityādi; tatra dṛṣṭaḥ śruto vā'rthaḥ svasādhyena sambaddhaḥ, asambaddho vā taṃ kalpayani ? yadi asambaddhaḥ; kathaṃ tatkalpanākāraṇam ? nahi yatkiñcid dṛṣṭvā yaḥ kaścidarthaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyaḥ atiprasaṅgāt

atha sambaddhaḥ; tarhi ato jāyamānā pratītiḥ anumānameva, tathāhi–dṛṣṭāt śrutādvā'rthād arthāntare pratītiḥ anumānameva, avinābhāvabalena upajāyamānatvāt, yad yad avinābhāvabalenopajāyate tattadanumāneva yathā dhūmādagnivijñānam, avinābhāvabalenopajāyate cārthāpattyabhimatā pratītiriti
anyathā nopapadyate ityukte satyebopapadyata iti labhyate
yatra yatra dvayorvastunorekataradvastu pratiṣidhyate tatra tatra dvitīyābhyanujñā dṛṣṭā, yathā divā na bhuṅkte ityabhidhānāt rātrau bhuṅkte iti gamyate
na cārthāpattiranumānato bhidyate, loke tadasaṅkīrṇodāharaṇābhāvāt, prakārāntarābhāvācca
sabhavādeśca yo hetu so'pi liṅgānna bhidyate
kiñca, asau tatsambaddho'pi tadrūpatayā jñātaḥ, ajñāto vā tatkalpanānimittaṃ syāt ? na tāvadajñātaḥ, bālāderapi ato'dṛṣṭārthakalpanāprasaṅgāt

atha jñātaḥ; tatrāpi ki sādhyapratipattikāle tatsambaddhatayā asau jñātaḥ, pūrva vā ? prathamapakṣe ki pramāṇāntarāt tatsambaddhatayā tadā'sau jñātaḥ, tata eva vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; tatpratipattikāle tatsambandhagrāhiṇaḥ pramāṇāntarasyāsaṃbhavāt, saṃbhave vā sādhyasyāpi ata eva siddheḥ kimarthāpattyā ?

astu vāsau, tathāpi–anumānānna bhidyate; tathāhi–arthāpattiḥ anumānameva, pramāṇāntarāvagatasādhyasambandhād hetorupajāyamānatvāt, yadyatpramāṇāntarāvagatasādhyasambandhād hetorupajāyate tattadanumānameva yathā dhūmād vahnivijñānam, pramāṇāntarāvagatasādhyasambandhāddhetoḥ upajāyate cārthāpattyabhimataṃ jñānamiti
atha tata eva sādhyasambaddhatayā asau jñātaḥ; tadā anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhāyāṃ hi arthāpattau tadutthāpakārthasya tatsambaddhatayā jñaptisiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca arthāpattisiddhiriti
atha pūrvaṃ tatsambaddhatayā'sau jñātaḥ ki sādhyadharmiṇyeva, dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi vā ? prathamavikalpe arthāpattervaiyarthyam tatsādhyasya prāgeva prasiddhatvāt
mīmāsakā hi arthāpattau sambandhāvagama dṛṣṭānte na svīkurvanti arthāpattyanumānayorbhedābhāvaprasaṅgāt
na prāgavadhṛtetyeva satyapyeṣā na kāraṇam mī॰ ślo॰, arthā॰ ślo॰ 30 ityabhidhānāt
dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi ced dṛṣṭa śruto vārtha pūrva pratipanna tadā sādhyadharmiṇi kimāyātam –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, tatrāsau sādhyasambaddhatayā bhūyodarśanāt, vipakṣe'nupalambhāt, arthāpattya ntarādvā pratīyeta ? na tāvad bhūyodarśanāt, śakteratīndriyatayā bhūyodarśanā'saṃbhavāt
katha tarhi sādhyasādhanayoḥ sambandhapratipattirbhavato'pīti cet ? ūhākhyapramāṇāntarāt

asmākaṃ tadabhyupagame ko doṣaḥ iti cet ? pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ, tathā pratyakṣeṇa hi pratipanne pratibandhe anumānaṃ pravarttate ityādigranthavirodhaśca, sarvatra ūhākhyapramāṇādeva sambandhapratipattiprasiddheḥ
na khalu tasya kaścidagocaro'sti yena śakteratīndriyatayā kenacillaṅgena saha sambandhā'pratipatteḥ anumānato'pratipatti syāt
tulanā–atha pramāṇāntarāttadavagama, tatki bhūyodarśana vipakṣe'nupalambho vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 194
vipakṣā hi anagnideśādyā anantā eva–ā॰ ṭi॰
tulanā–bhūyodarśanagamyā ca vyāpti –mī॰ ślo॰ anu॰ ślo॰ 12

yadapi–pratyakṣapratipannadāhākhyakāryānyathānupapattyā ityādi pratyakṣapūrvikārthāpatterlakṣaṇamuktam, tatra anupapattisvarūpa vaktavyam–kiṃ sādhyena vinā sphoṭāderabhāvaḥ anupapattiḥ, pramāṇavirodho vā ? prathamapakṣe tena vinā nopapadyate iti vyatirekabhaṇitiḥ, vyatirekaśca pratīyamānaḥ tasmin sati upapadyate ityanvayamākṣipati, anvayavyatirekau ca liṅgasyaiva gamakasya dharmāviti kathamarthāpattiranumānādatiricyeta ? pramāṇavirodho'pi bādhyabādhakabhāvānnānyaḥ
tathā ca śuktikāyāṃ rajatatadabhāvagrāhiṇorvijñānayoḥ bādhyabādhakabhāve sati rajatānyathānupapattyā arthāntarakalpanānuṣaṅgaḥ syāt, tallakṣaṇāyā anupapatteratrāpyaviśeṣāt

tulanā–tena vinā nopapadyate iti ca vyatirekabhaṇitiriyam, vyatirekaśca pratīta tasmin satyupapadyate ityanvayamākṣipati, anvayavyatirekau ca gamakasya liṅgasya dharma iti ca kathamarthāpattirnānumānam
kiñca, pramāṇayoḥ parasparapratibandhakatve sati arthāpattiḥ pravarttate, te ca vaktavye

nanu kimatra vaktavyaṃ suprasiddhatvāt ? tathāhi–sphoṭasvarūpaṃ tāvad adhyakṣaṃ paricchinatti, na ca tasya dṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ sabhavati, kāraṇāntarañca nopalabhyate, kāraṇābhāve ca kāryābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ, ataḥ kāraṇābhāvākhyaliṅgaprabhavānumānāt tasyābhāvaḥ prāptaḥ ityevaṃ pramāṇadvayavighaṭanāyāṃ tatsaṅghaṭanātmikā tayorviṣayabhedaṃ darśayantī arthāpattiḥ pravarttate

sphoṭajñānaṃ hi sphoṭaviṣayam, kāraṇābhāvānumānañca paridṛśyamānakāraṇanibandhanakāryābhāvaviṣayamiti, tadapyasamīcīnam, yataḥ kāraṇābhāvo'tra kāryābhāvaniścaye liṅgam, sa ca niścitaḥ, aniścito vā talliṅga syāt ? na tāvadaniścitaḥ, vāṣpāderapi dhūmādi tayā sandigdhasya liṅgatāprasaṅgāt

atha niścitaḥ; kutastanniścayaḥ ? kāraṇānupalabdheścet; sā kiṃ dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ, adṛśyānupalabdhirvā ? yadyadṛśyānupalabdhiḥ; kathamato'bhāvasiddhiḥ, paramāṇupiśācādinā anekāntāt ? atha dṛśyānupalabdhiḥ; tarhi ataḥ kāraṇābhāvasiddheḥ kathamarthāpatteḥ kāraṇasadbhāvāvedikāyāḥ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt ? cakrakaprasaṅgācca na kāraṇābhāvasya liṅgatā; tathāhi–kāryakāraṇayoḥ sambandhagrahaṇe sati kāraṇābhāvākhyamanumānaṃ pravarttate, sambandhagrahaṇañca kāraṇagrahaṇe sati, kāraṇagrahaṇañca arthāpattitaḥ, arthāpattiśca kāraṇābhāvānumāne sati, tacca sambandhagrahaṇe sati iti
na ca arthāpattita eva sphoṭādau kāraṇasadbhāvasiddhiḥ; anumānato'pi tatsiddheḥ
tathāhi– sphoṭādi kāraṇapūrvakam, kāryatvāt, yat kāryaṃ tat kāraṇapūrvakam yathā dhūmādi, kāryañcedaṃ sphoṭādi, tasmāt kāraṇapūrvakamiti

sphoṭa pratyakṣeṇa tāvatsphoṭasadbhāva āvedita, śaktirūpakāraṇābhāvānumānena tu sphoṭābhāvo'numita itisphoṭaviṣaye pratyakṣānumāne vighaṭete, atastayorviṣayabhedaṃ pradarśayantī arthāpatti saghaṭanakāriṇī bhavati
tulanā–upamānasya tu smaraṇādabhede tatpūrvikā'rthāpattiranumānameva, vyāpte pūrvaṃ grahaṇāt
tathā ca sādṛśyāvacchinno gopiṇḍo vāhādisamarthaḥ gopiṇḍatvāt pūrvopalabdhaivaṃvidhagopiṇḍavat
yāpi śabdanityatvasiddhau arthāpattipūrvikārthāpattiruktā; sāpyayuktā; śabdasyānityatve'pi vācakatvasyopapatteḥ, tadanityatvañca agre prasādhayiṣyāmaḥ
yāpi pīno devadato divā na bhuṅkte ityādi śrutārthāpattiruktā; sāpyanumānameva, kāryataḥ kāraṇapratipatteḥ

asati hi rasāyanādyupayoge pīnatvaṃ svātmani anyatra ca bhojanakāryatvena avagatam, tacca devadattākhye dharmiṇi āptavākyāt kālaviśeṣe bhojananiṣedhena niścīyamānaṃ pratiṣidhyamānakālavyatiriktakāle'pratiṣiddhe svoṣapādakasya kāraṇasya sattāmavagamayati
nahi kāraṇaṃ vinā kāryasyodayo ghaṭate, ahetukatvena sadā sattvasya asattvasya vā prasaṅgāt

prayogaḥ–rātribhuktimān devadattaḥ, rasāyanādyupayāgābhāve divābhuktirahitatve ca sati pīnatvāt, yo yo rasāyanādyupayogābhāve divābhuktirahitatve ca sati pīna sa sa rātribhuktimān yathā naktañcara, rasāyanādyupayogābhāve divābhuktirahitatve ca sati pīnaśca devadattaḥ, tasmād rātribhuktimāniti
tato nahīda vākyameva tatpratipattinibandhanam ityādyayuktamuktam, yathoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya pīnatvalakṣaṇaliṅgasyaivāto vākyāt pratipatteḥ, tatpratipannācca liṅgāt rātribhojanapratipattisiddhiriti
tulanā–śrutārthāpattirapi varākī nānumānād bhidyate, vacanaikadeśakalpanāyā anupapannatvādarthasya ca kāryaliṅgasya sattvāt
yathā kṣitidharakandharādhikaraṇa dhūmamavalokya tatkāraṇamanalamanuminoti bhavān evamāgamātpīnatvākhya kāryamavadhārya tatkāraṇamapi bhojanamanuminotu ko'tra viśeṣa – nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 45
pīno divā na bhuṅkte iti vākyaśravaṇādrātribhojanakalpanā'numitānumānam, liṅgabhūtena vākyena anumitāt pīnatvāt tatkāraṇasya rātribhojanasya anumānāt
devadatto rātrau bhuṅkte divā'bhojitve sati pīnatvāditi
yāpyabhāvapūrvikā'rthāpattiḥ sāpyanumānameva, jīvataścaitrasya gṛhābhāvena liṅgena bahirbhāvāvagamāt
tathāhi–jīvataścaitrasya gṛhe'bhāva bahirbhāvena tadvān, jīvanmanuṣyagṛhābhāvatvāt, pūrvopalabdhaivaṃvidhagṛhābhāvavat, yathā dhūmo'gnimān dhūmatvāt pūrvopalabdhadhūmavat
tathāhi–devadatto bahirdeśasambandhī jīvanasambandhitve sati gṛhe'nupalabhyamānatvāt viṣṇumitravat
caitrasya gṛhābhāvo dharmī bahirbhāvena tadvāniti sādhyo dharma jīvanmanuṣyagṛhābhāvatvāt pūrvopalabdhaivavidhagṛhābhāvavat
tadapyanumānameva, yadā khalu sannekatra nāsti tadā'nyatrāsti, yadā vā'vyāpaka ekatrāsti tadā'nyatra nāsti, so'ya svaśarīra eva vyāptigraha sukara
tathā ca sato gehābhāvadarśanena liṅgena bahirbhāvadarśanamanumānam

yatpunaḥ prameyānupraveśo dūṣaṇamuktam; tadapi na yuktam; yataḥ kiṃ prameyamatrā'mipretam–kiṃ sattāmātram, bahirdeśaviśeṣita vā sattvam ? tatra sattāmātra tāvad āgamādevā'vagatamiti na pramāṇāntaraprameyatāmavalambate
bahirdeśaviśeṣitaṃ tu sattva bhavati prameyam, na ca tasya tadānīmanupraveśaḥ
gṛhe caitrābhāvagrāhakaṃ hi pramāṇa tatraiva tatsadbhāvāvedakaṃ pramāṇamapākaroti na punaḥ bahistatsadasattvacintāṃ karoti
tulanā–kiṃ prameyamabhimatamatra bhavatā kiṃ sattāmātramuta bahirdeśaviśeṣita sattvam
mṛtasya jīvato dūre tiṣṭhataḥ prāṅgaṇe'pi vā
mṛtasya jīvato vā dūre prāṅgaṇe'pi vā
gṛhābhāvaparicchede na viśeṣosti kaścana || nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 43
na ca viśeṣaṇagrahaṇameva prameyagrahaṇam; yato jīvanamanyad anyacca bahirbhāvākhyaṃ prameyamiti
atha matam–jīvanaviśiṣṭagṛhābhāvapratītireva bahirbhāvapratītiriti; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; yato jīvanaviśiṣṭagṛhābhāvapratīterbahirbhāvapratītirbhavati, na tu tatpratītireva bahirbhāvapratītiḥ

atha dhūmādanyo dahanaḥ tenātra tatpratītibhedo yuktaḥ; tadetadanyatrāpi samānam–gṛhābhāva-jīvanābhyāṃ tadbahirbhāvasyāpi anyatvāt, tatkathamatrāpi tatpratītyorabhedaḥ syāt ? yathā ca parvata-vahnyoḥ siddhatvāt mattvarthamātraṃ tatra apūrvamanumeyamevamiṣṭam, evamihāpi bahirdeśamātram apūrvamanumeyamastu
yadi tu tadadhikaṃ prameyamiha neṣyate, tadā gṛhābhāvajīvanayoḥ svapramāṇābhyāmavadhāraṇād ānarthakyameva arthāpatteḥ
arthāpattāvapi ca tulya evāyaṃ doṣaḥ, tatrāpi arthādarthāntarakalpanābhyupagamāt
tasya tasmāt pratītiriti yatra vyavahāraḥ tatrāvaśyaṃ tatpratītau tadanupraveśadoṣo'nuṣajyate, svabhāvahetāviva tadbuddhisiddhyā tatsiddheḥ pramāṇāntaravaiphalyāt
tulanā–jīvanaviśiṣṭagṛhābhāvapratīte bahirbhāva pratīta na tatpratītireva bahirbhāvapratīti

na hi dahanādhikaraṇadhūmapratītireva dahanapratītiḥ, kintu dhūmādanya eva dahana, ihāpi gṛhābhāvajīvanābhyāmanya eva bahirbhāva, parvatahutavahayossiddhatvānmattvarthamātra tatrāpūrvamanumeyam, evamihāpi bahirdeśayogamātramapūrvamanumeyam
tulanā–arthāpattāvapi ca tulya evāya doṣa, tatrāpyarthādarthāntarakalpanābhyupagamāt
dṛṣṭa śruto vārtho'nyathā nopapadyate ityarthakalpanetyeva granthopanibandhāt
tasya tasmātpratīriti tatra vyavahārastatrāvācya ? tatpratītau tadanupraveśo doṣa eva
tasya sādhyasya tasmāt sādhanāt pratīriti vyavahāraśca anumāna ivārthāpattāvapyasti –ā॰ ṭi॰
yathā svabhāvahetau śiṃśapābuddhyaiva vṛkṣabuddhau jātāyā pramāṇāntareṇa na kāryam, tathātrāpi gṛhābhāvenaiva liṅgena bahirbhāvasyāvagatatvānnārthāpattyā kāryam –ā॰ ṭi॰

nanu cābhāvo niścito liṅgaṃ bhaviṣyati, sadasattvagrāhiṇośca pramāṇayoḥ virodhe kathaṃ tanniścayaḥ ? ato yāvadāgamasya bahirbhāvaviṣayatā na pratīyate tāvanna gṛha evā'bhāvaniścaya iti, tasya niścaye prameyānupraveśadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ, arthāpattistu pramāṇadvayavirodhe satyeva pravarttate iti kathaṃ tadanupraveśaḥ ? tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; sadasattvajñānayoḥ asamānaviṣayatayā virodhā'siddheḥ
āgamena hi deśaviśeṣānavacchinnasya caitrasya sattā pratipādyate na gṛhe bahirvā, pratyakṣeṇa tu gṛhāvacchinnasya caitrasyābhāva iti
samānaviṣayatve tu tayorananyathāsiddhā'dhyakṣabādhyatvena āgamajajñānasya mithyājñānasyeva nā'rthāntarakalpanākāraṇatvam
ya eva jīvanato gṛhābhāvaniścaya sa eva bahirbhāvaniścaya iti, ato gṛhābhāvākhyo hetu prameya bahirbhāvākhyamanupraviṣṭa iti bhāva –ā॰ ṭi॰
tulanā–tathāhi–sattvamātra vā virudhyate caitrasya gehābhāvena gehasattva vaikatrāsya

na tāvadyatra kvacana sattvasyāsti virodha gehe'sattayā samānaviṣayatvābhāvāt gṛhābhāvāvacchinnābhāvena gṛhasattva viruddhatvātpratiṣidhyate na tu sattvamātram tatra tasyaudāsīnyāt, tasmād gṛhābhāvena siddhena sato bahirbhāvo'numīyata iti yuktam
etena viruddhayo pramāṇayoravirodhāpādana viṣayavyavasthayā arthāpattiviṣaya parāsta, avacchinnā'navacchinnayoravirodhāt
atha matam–anumāne gamakaviśeṣaṇam anyathānupapannatvaṃ bahniṃ vinā dhūmo nopapadyate iti, arthāpattau tu viparyayaḥ gamakaṃ vinā gamyo nopapadyate

gamyo hi bahirbhāvaḥ, sa jīvato gṛhābhāvaṃ vinā nopapadyate, gṛhānnirgato jīvan bahirastītyevaṃ gamyagamakayoranupapadyamānatve viparyayāt pramāṇāntaramanumānādarthāpattiriti, tadapyasaṅgatam, sādhyāvinābhāvino liṅgāt liṅgini jñānamanumānam ityanumānalakṣaṇam
na hi tadutthāpakārthasya sādhyena avinābhāvo'siddhaḥ; tataḥ tatsiddhyabhāvaprasaṅgāt

sa cāvinābhāvaḥ anyathānupapannatvāparaparyāyaḥ ubhayaniṣṭhatvāt gamakaviśeṣaṇaṃ vāstu gamyaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā naitāvatā arthāpattyanumānayoḥ bhedaḥ, anyathā sūryasya gamanaśaktirasti gatimattvā'nyathānupapatteḥ iti pakṣadharmatvasahitāyā arthāpatteḥ vahnerdāha śaktirasti sphoṭānyathānupapatteḥ iti tadrahitārthāpattiḥ pramāṇāntaraṃ syāt, tathā ca pramāṇasaṃkhyāvyāghātaḥ
niyamavato'rthād arthāntarapratipatteraviśeṣāttayorabhede svasādhyāvinābhāvino'rthād arthāntarapratipattaretrāpyaviśeṣāt kathamanumānādarthāpatterbhedaḥ syāt ?
yadi yadyena vinā nopapadyate tadevāvagamaka syāt, iha tu yannopapadyate tadevāvagamyate
kiṃ cātra nopapadyate ? jīvato gṛhābhāvadarśanāt anyatrābhāvo nopapadyate
na hi gṛhābhāvadarśanena vinā bahi bhāva upapadyate
deśena hi vinā bhāvo na kadācana dṛśyate

tulanā–etadapi granthavaiṣamyopapādanamātram na tu nūtanaviśeṣatotprekṣaṇam; gamye tāvadagṛhīte sati tadgatamanupapadyamānatva kathamavadhāryeta, gṛhīte tu gamye kiṃ tadgatānupapadyamānatvagrahaṇena sādhyasya siddhatvāt –nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 44
śaktirvahnau sphoṭaśca karatalādau iti na sphoṭasya pakṣadharmatā –ā॰ ṭi॰
asiddhañcātra avinābhāvasya gamyaviśeṣaṇatvam; gṛhe caitrābhāve eva bahistatsadbhāvagamake tasyaviśeṣaṇatvasambhavāt
nahi tasya tadviśeṣaṇatve kaściddoṣaḥ sambhavati yena gamyaviśeṣaṇatā kalpyeta
na ca sarvasyāmarthāpattau gamyaviśeṣaṇatā avinābhāvasya sambhavati, pratyakṣādiprabhavā'rthāpattau gamakasyaiva sphoṭādeḥ avinābhāvaviśeṣaṇatvasaṃbhavāt
na khalu tatra gamyāyāḥ śakteḥ sphoṭaṃ vinā'nupapattiḥ sambhavati; tamantareṇāpi asyāḥ sadbhāvābhyupagamāt

yaccānyaduktam–pakṣadharmatāniścayasamaye sādhyasya niyatadeśatayā atrā'pratīteḥ anumānādvailakṣaṇyam ityādi; tadapyuktimātram, gṛhābhāvākhyadharmyavacchedena bahirbhāvasya pratīteḥ, dharmī eva hi deśaśabdena ucyate, tadavacchedaśca atrāstyeveti na tatastadvailakṣaṇayam
yadapi sambandhagrahaṇābhāvācca ityādyuktam, tadapi na; yataḥ sarvatra sambandhagrahaṇasya ūhākhyapramāṇaprasādādeva prasiddheḥ ityuktam
ataśca deśāntarāṇāmānantyānna na tatra nāstitvena sambandhagrahaḥ ityādyayuktam, aniyatasādhyasādhanavyaktisambandhagrahaṇasvabhāvatvāttasya
kathamanyathā dhūmasya anagnivyatirekaniścayaḥ tatrāpi asya doṣasyā'viśeṣāt ? na ca bhūyodarśanāvagamyamānā'nvayamātreṇa gamako'sau yuktaḥ, aniścitavyatirekasya sādhyaniścayā'hetutvāt
na ca sattāmātreṇāsau taddhetuḥ, anvayavad vyatirekasyāpi niścitasyaiva anumānāṅgatopapatteḥ
tulanā– anagnivyatirekaniścaye ca dhūmasya bhavatā kā gati
yā tatra vārttā saivehāpi no bhavipyati
na ca bhūyodarśanāvagamyamānānvayamātraikaśaraṇatayā yasya vastvantarābhāvo gamyastasyaiva duṣyati
mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 40 iti kathayitumucitam, aniścitavyatirekasya sādhyaniścayābhāvāditi pakṣadharmānvayavyatireko'pi nāgṛhīto'numānāṅgam

kiñca, asarvagatadravyasya caitrādeḥ niyatadeśavṛtteḥ tadanyadeśe pratiniyate pratyakṣataḥ, apratiniyate cānumānato'bhāvasiddheḥ kathamuktadopānuṣaṅgaḥ ? taccānumānam–deśāntarāṇi caitraśūnyāni caitrādhiṣṭhitadeśavyatiriktatvāt tatsamīpadeśavat
na ca deśāntarāṇi caitrayuktāni tatsamīpadeśavyatiriktatvāt caitrādhiṣṭhitadeśavat iti pratyanumānopahatametadityabhidhātavyam; tatpakṣasya pratyakṣādibādhitatvāt
dṛṣṭametat– avyāpakaṃ dravyamekatrāsti tadanyatra nāstīti yathā prācīpratīcyorekatropalabhyamāna savitā'nyatra na bhavatītīdaṃ darśanabalenaivamavadhāryate
etadukta bhavati–na tāvaddeśāntarāṇi caitraśūnyāni tatsayuktadeśavyatiriktadeśatvāditi hetu sabhavati, sandigdhatvāt, deśāntarāṇyapi tatsayuktāni na vetyetāvadeva vicāryate

yadi paramevamucyate–yamevādhunā caitro'dhiṣṭhito'pavarakadeśa tadvyatiriktatvāditi, eva vidhaścāprayojako hetu, itarathā hi śakyate–caitrayukta deśāntara tatsamīpavyatiriktadeśatvāt tadaghiṣṭhitadeśavaditi
nanu bhavatāmapyeva pramāṇasaṃkhyāniyamavirodhastulyaḥ upamānādeḥ pradipāditapramāṇaprapañcasya pratyakṣaparokṣābhyāmarthāntaratvā'viśeṣāt ityārekāpanodārthamāha–sarvasya ityādi
sarvasya anantaroktasya upamānādipramāṇaprapañcasya parokṣe'ntarbhāvāt nā'smāka kaściddoṣaḥ
kasmāt tasya tatrāntarbhāva iti cet ? tallakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt
yasya yallakṣaṇalakṣitatvaṃ tasya tatrāntarbhāvaḥ yathā rūpasukhādisaṃvedanasya pratyakṣe, parokṣalakṣaṇalakṣitatvañca upamānāderiti

yathaiva hi rūpādisaṃvedanasya sukhādisaṃvedanasya ca viṣayabhedāt sāmagrībhedācca anyonyaṃ vailakṣaṇye'pi vaiśadyasvarūpapratyakṣalakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt pratyakṣatvam, tathā upamānāderapi avaiśadyasvabhāvaparokṣalakṣaṇalakṣitatvāt parokṣatvamiti
tulanā–yadekalakṣaṇalakṣita tadvyaktibhede'pyekameva yathā vaiśadyaikalakṣaṇalakṣita cakṣurādipratyakṣam, avaiśadyaikalakṣaṇalakṣitañca śabdādīti

nanvevamapi parokṣasya smṛtipratyabhijñānatarkā'numānāgamabhedaiḥ parigaṇitatvāt kathamupamānādestatrāntarbhāvaḥ, tadantarbhāve vā parigaṇanavirodhaḥ ? ityasamīcīnam; upamānādeḥ pratyabhijñānādirūpatayā tatparigaṇanā'virodhakatvāt

darśanasmaraṇakāraṇakaṃ hi saṅkalanaṃ pratyabhijñānamucyate, idamapyupamānādijñānaṃ darśanasmaraṇakāraṇakaṃ sādṛśyādi saṅkalanasvabhāvañca, ataḥ kathaṃ pratyabhijñānāt vyatiricyeta ? yad darśanasmaraṇakāraṇakaṃ sādṛśyādisaṅkalanasvabhāvañca tat pratyabhijñānameva yathā prasiddhapratyabhijñānam, tatkāraṇakaṃ sādṛśyādisaṅkalanasvabhāvañcopamānamiti
laghīyastrayasya jñānamādya smṛti kā॰ 10 iti kārikāyām, parīkṣāmu॰ 3
tad ityādinā prakṛtopasaṃhāramāha–yasmād upamānādeḥ parokṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ tat tasmāt samañjasam upapannam pratyakṣaṃ parokṣañca iti evaṃ dve eva pramāṇe iti
anyathā anyena prakāreṇa teṣāṃ pramāṇānāṃ saṅkhyāyā anavasthānāditi
iti śrīprabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre tṛtīyaḥ paricchedaḥ
atha pramāṇābhāsatvena prasiddhaṃ vijñānaṃ kathañcideva tadābhāsaṃ na sarvatheti pradarśayannāha–
akṣamindriyānindriya prati niyata pratyakṣa jñānamātram tadivābhātīti vyutpatte
kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? taimirādika timirādāgata taimira tadādiryasya āśubhramaṇāde tathoktam
katham ? kathañcit bhāvaprameyāpekṣayā dravyāpekṣayā vā, na sarvathā pramāṇābhāsameva, bahirarthākāraviṣaya eva jñānasya visavādāt svarūpāpekṣayā tasyāvisavādāt
yajjñāna yathaiva yāvadviṣayāvabodhanaprakāreṇa avisavādi, visaṃvādo gṛhītārthavyabhicāra tadrahitamavisavādi, tajjñāna tathā tāvadviṣayāvabodhana- prakāreṇa pramāṇa matamiṣṭa parīkṣakairiti

tathāhi–sarva maśayādika pramāṇābhāsa svarūpāpekṣayā dravyāpekṣayā vā pramāṇa bhavati tatravisavāditvāt, yadyaprāvisavādi tattatra pramāṇa yathā rase rasajñānam, avisavādi ca saśayādika svarūpe dravyarūpādau vā, tatastatra kathañcitpramāṇamiti
visavāda eva khalvaprāmāṇyanibandhanam avisavādaśca prāmāṇyanibandhanamiti nyāyamya sakalavādisammatatvāt sarvathā pramāṇābhāsasya nyāyaśūnyatvāt
bahi prameyāpekṣāyā pramāṇa tatribhañca te āptamī॰ ślo॰ 83 iti vacanāt
na hi jñāna svarūpe visavādi tasyāhampratyayasiddhatvāt
prasiddhe ca viṣaye pravartamāna kathamapramāṇa syāditi
asyā kārikāyā yaddignānādinā taimirādika pratyakṣābhāsamuktam, tasya kathañcideva pratyakṣābhāsatā darśayati
savṛtisatya hi svasmin arthāntaramāropya tatsvarūpakalpanāt pratyakṣābhāsam
avikalpakañcaika pratyakṣābhāsam, kīdṛśam ? āśrayasya indriyasya upaplavastimirādyupaghāta tasmādbhavo yasya tattathā

tulanā–pītaśasvādiṣu vijñāna tu na pramāṇameva tathārthakriyāvyāpnerabhāvāt, sasthānamātrārthakriyāprasiddhāvanyadeva jñāna pramāṇamamumānam, tato'numāna masthāne saśaya paraveti pratyayadvayametat pramāṇamapramāṇañca
tulanā–yathā yatra viśada tathā tatra pratyakṣam
pṛ॰ 65B tathā ca sarva svabhāve parabhāve vā kathañcideva pramāṇa na sarvathā
vivṛtiḥ–timirādyupaplavajñānaṃ candrādāvavisaṃvādakaṃ pramāṇaṃ yathā tatsaṅkhyādau visaṃvādakatvādapramāṇam, pramāṇetaravyavasthāyāḥ tallakṣaṇatvāt
nahi jñānaṃ yadapyanukaroti tatra pramāṇameva samāropavyavacchedākāṅkṣaṇāt
kathamanyathā dṛṣṭe pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ ? kṛtasya karaṇāyogāt, tadekāntahāneḥ kathañcitkaraṇāniṣṭeḥ
pratyakṣābham ityupalakṣaṇam, tena parokṣābhamapi yadekāntena vādināṃ lokānāṃ vā prasiddhaṃ tatkathañcit syād bhavet pramāṇam naikāntena tadābhāsam ityabhiprāyaḥ
yato yadvijñānaṃ yenaiva prakāreṇa avisaṃvādi tad vijñānaṃ tenaiva prakāreṇa pramāṇamabhipretam
4 ityādau ca yadabhrāntādigrahaṇaṃ bhrāntanivṛttyarthaṃ tad yadi sarvathā apratyakṣatvāt tenāpasāryate tadā pramāṇavirodhaḥ
āśubhramaṇamalātāde, mandaṃ hi bhramyamāṇe'lātādau na cakrabhrāntirutpadyate, tadarthamāśugrahaṇena viśeṣyate bhramaṇam, etacca viṣayagata vibhramakāraṇam
sakṣobho vātapittaśleṣmaṇām, vātādiṣu hi kṣobha gateṣu jvalitastambhādibhrāntirutpadyate, etaccādhyātmagata vibhramakāraṇam
hastiyānādayo bāhyāśrayasthā gāḍhamarmaprahārādaya ādhyātmikāśrayasthā vibhramahetavo gṛhyante
timirādīnāṃ kāryabhūtaṃ yad upaplavajñānaṃ dvicandrādiviṣayaṃ tat candrādau ādiśabdena dhāvalyavartulatvādiparigrahaḥ tatra pramāṇam
yathā tat timirādyupaplavajñānaṃ saṃkhyādau dvitvasthiratvādau visaṃvādakatvādapramāṇam
yadi nāma tattathāvidhaṃ kimetāvatā pramāṇetararūpaṃ bhaviṣyati ityāśaṅkya āha–pramāṇa ityādi
pramāṇañca itaracca apramāṇaṃ tayoḥ vyavasthāyāḥ tallakṣaṇatvāt saṃvādavisaṃvādalakṣaṇatvāt
nanu kathaṃ tadeva pramāṇamitaracca yuktaṃ virodhāditi cet ? atrāha–nahi ityādi
hiryasmāt na jñānaṃ bhavatkalpitaṃ nirvikalpakavedanaṃ yadapi ityapiśabdo'bhyupagame, paramārthataḥ arthākāratāyā jñāne'saṃbhavāt, tadasaṃbhavaśca prapañcataḥ prāgeva tatpratiṣedhāt siddhaḥ
abhyu pagamyāpyucyate–yathoktaṃ jñānaṃ yadapi vastvanukaroti yadākāraṃ bhavati tatra vastuni pramāṇameva, nahi ityabhisambandhaḥ, kintu apramāṇamapi ityevakārārthaḥ
kṣaṇike'kṣaṇikajñānaṃ samāropaḥ tasya vyavacchedo nirāsaḥ tasya ākāṅkṣaṇāt
kathamanyathā tadākāṅkṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa dṛṣṭe darśanaviṣayīkṛte kṣaṇabhaṅgādau pramāṇāntarasya anumānasya vṛttiḥ ? na kathamapi ityarthaḥ
kṛtasya anubhavena anubhūtasya kṣaṇabhaṅgādeḥ anumānena karaṇasya grahaṇasya ayogāt, anyathā anavasthā syāt, tadgṛhītepyasmin anumānāntareṇa grahaṇaprasaṅgāt
kṣaṇikāderagrahaṇādapramāṇa nirvikalpakam, yadi hi kṣaṇabhagādi nirvikalpakapratyakṣeṇaiva gṛhīta syāttadā tatsādhanārthamanumāna kimarthaṃ prayujyata iti hṛdayam –ā॰ ṭi॰
atha arthadarśanena nīlādikameva gṛhītaṃ na kṣaṇabhaṅgādikaṃ tenāyamadoṣaḥ, atrāha– tad ityādi
yatkṛtaṃ tatkṛtameva tasya hāneḥ hāniprasaṅgāt kathaṃ pramāṇāntaravṛttiḥ ? taddhāniḥ kutaḥ ? ityatrāha–kathañcid ityādi
kathañcit nīlādirūpeṇa na kṣaṇabhaṅgādirūpeṇa yat karaṇaṃ vastuno grahaṇaṃ tasyā'niṣṭeḥ, anyathā gṛhītetararūpatā ekasya syāt
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt asya arthākāradarśanasya visaṃvādo'pi vipralambhopi na kevalaṃ kathañcit prāmāṇyameva
avastuno bhavanmate bahirantarvā'sata eva sthūlākārasya nirbhāsād anukaraṇād darśana pramāṇaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ
candrādi ca tad vastu ca tasya nirbhāsānām upaplavajñānasambandhipratibhāsānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt pramāṇam ityetadanuvarttamānaṃ labdhabhāvapratyayamiha sambaddhyate
na khalu candrādiviplavajñānaṃ dhāvalyavarttulatvādau visaṃvadati iti
evaṃ tāvat yat pareṇa pratyakṣābhaṃ taimirikādīndriyajñānamuktaṃ tadapi kathañcit pratyakṣamiti vyavasthāpitam
yaddhi vastu tatsarvātmanā kṛta gṛhīta nirvikalpena ityekānta kṛtaikānta
ko'nyo bhāgo na dṛṣṭa syāt ya pramāṇai parīkṣyate
sāmprataṃ kalpanāpadena yat pareṇa vikalpajñānaṃ tadābhāsamuktaṃ tadapi pratyakṣaṃ sādhayannāha–
kim ? svasaṃvedyam svena tattvajñānātmanā saṃvedyaṃ grāhyam svasavedyaṃ jñānasvarūpamityarthaḥ
kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? viśadārthāvabhāsanam arthasya paramārthasato'vabhāsanamavabodhanamarthāvabhāsanam viśada spaṣṭa tacca tadarthābabhāsana ca tattathoktam
keṣām ? vikalpānām, ghaṭo'ya gauraya śuklo'yaṃ gāyako'yamityādiniścayajñānānām
kuta ? savikalpābabhāsanāt, vikalpo jātyādyākārāvabodha saha vikalpeneti savikalpaka tasyāvabhāsanādanubhavāt
kadā ? sahṛtāśeṣacintāyām, sahṛtā naṣṭā aśeṣā smṛtyādayaścintā vikalpā yasyāmavasthāyā sā tathoktā tasyām
cakṣurādibuddhau jātyādyākāraviśeṣasya avabodhanasya apratihatatvāt, tato vikalpajñānasya pratyakṣābhāsatvamayuktamityartha

vivṛtiḥ–sarvataḥ saṃhṛtya cintāṃ stimitāntarātmanā sthito'pi cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ saṃsthānātmakaṃ sthūlātmakamekaṃ sūkṣmānekasvabhāvaṃ paśyati na punaḥ asādhāraṇaikāntaṃ svalakṣaṇam, pratisaṃhāravyutthitacittasya tathaivāsmaraṇāt
na ca viśadetaravikalpayoḥ viṣayabhedaikāntaḥ pratyāsannetarārthapratyakṣāṇām ekārthaviṣayatopapatteḥ
dharmakīrtinokta yat–śāntacetaskatayā cakṣuṣā yadrūpadarśanaṃ bhavati tannirvikalpakam
124 granthakṛtā tatprativihitam– yattadavasthāyāmapi savikalpakameva jñāna sthirasthūlādyarthagrāhyanubhūyate
sthito'pi cakṣuṣā rūpaṃ svañca spaṣṭa vyavasyati
tulanā–na hi jātucidasahāyamākāraṃ paśyāmo yathā vyāvarṇyate tathaivānirṇayāt, nānāvayavarūpādyātmano ghaṭādeḥ bahi sampratipatteḥ na paramāṇusaṃcayarūpasya
saṃhṛtā aśeṣāścintā yasyāmavasthāyāṃ tasyāmapi savikalpakasyaiva jñānasya avabhāsanāt
nirvikalpānubaddhasya spaṣṭārtha pratibhāsate –nyāyabi॰ ṭī॰ ṭi॰ pṛ॰ 35
yattatpratyakṣamiti prasiddha tatkalpanāyā apoḍha draṣṭavya kalpanārtharahitamityartha
yadi tu kalpanāsvabhāvatvamasya syāttathaiva prakāśeta vikalpasyāparokṣatvāt
tathāhi –pratyātmavedya sarveṣā prāṇinā vikalpo nāmasaśraya śabdasasargavān
kena rūpeṇa ? svasaṃvedyena iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
tataste vikalpāḥ kathañcit pratyakṣābhā iti bhāvaḥ
sthimitaḥ sthirībhūtaḥ aparispandaḥ antarātmā manaḥ tena
cakṣurgrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ śrotrādeḥ, tena rūpaṃ paśyati, rūpagrahaṇamapi rasādīnāmupalakṣaṇam
punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭam ? sūkṣmānekasvabhāvam, sūkṣmo'nekaḥ svabhāvo yasya tattathoktam
nanu sasthānādika guṇatvād dravyasya na rūpasya, asya guṇatvena nirguṇatvāt; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, anekānte dravyaguṇayorabhedārpaṇayā rūpasyāpi dravyadharmā'virodhāt
nanu cakṣuṣā rūpa dṛśyamānam anyonyavilakṣaṇānekānaṃśaparamāṇusvabhāvasvalakṣaṇarūpameva dṛśyate natu sthūlādisvarūpam, ityatrāha–na punaḥ ityādi
punariti bhāvanāyām, na svalakṣaṇaṃ paśyati, kathambhūtam ? asādhāraṇam, asādhāraṇaḥ sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttaḥ eko'sahāyaḥ anto dharmo yasya tattathoktam

sahāraḥ aśepavikalpābhāvaḥ, pratisaṃhāraḥ punarvikalpapravṛttiḥ, tamāśritya vyutthitaṃ pratibuddhaṃ cittaṃ yasya sa tathokta tasya, tathaiva asādhāraṇaikāntaprakāreṇa asmaraṇāt smaraṇābhāvāt svalakṣaṇasya, ato na tasya kadācid darśanam sthūlādisvabhāvasyaiva tu smaraṇāt sadā darśanamiti
tasmāt ityādinā upasahāramāha–yasmānnirvikalpakaṃ jñānaṃ parasya pratyakṣatvenā'bhipretaṃ na kadācid viśadasvarūpatayā pratibhāti tasmād aviśadameva avikalpakaṃ pratyakṣābham

nanu viśadetarajñānānāṃ vibhinnapratibhāsatayā vibhinnaviṣayatvānna sthūlādi svabhāvaṃ rūpaṃ paśyati ityādi yuktam, yayorvibhinnapratibhāsatvaṃ tayorvibhinnaviṣayatvaṃ yathā rūparasajñānayoḥ, vibhinnapratibhāsatvañca pratyakṣetarajñānayoriti
tathā ca, viśadasvabhāvasya adhyakṣasya svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvaṃ siddham, aviśadasvabhāvasya tu vikalpasya sthūlādiviṣayatvam ityāśaṅkyāha–naca ityādi

naca naiva viśadetaravikalpayoḥ avagrahādismaraṇādyoḥ viṣayabhedaikāntaḥ, paramārthavastuni viśadavikalpaḥ pravarttate, kalpite aviśadavikalpaḥ iti, kintu viśadavikalpaviṣaya eva aviśadavikalpasya viṣayaḥ
pratyāsannaśca itaraśca apratyāsannaḥ artho yeṣāṃ tāni ca tāni pratyakṣāṇi teṣāṃ viśadetararūpapratibhāsabhedasaṃbhave'pi ekārthaviṣayatopapatteḥ
a siddha ityatrāpi yojyam – ā॰ ṭi॰

yadapyucyate–'pratyakṣe na santi kalpanā upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānāmanupalabdheḥ, yadyatra upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ sannopalabhyate tattatra nāsti yathā kvacit pradeśaviśeṣe ghaṭaḥ, nopalabhyante ca pratyakṣe tathāvidhāḥ satyaḥ kalpanā iti
na ca upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvaṃ tāsāmasiddham; nahi imāḥ kalpanā apratisaṃviditā eva udayante vyayante ca yataḥ satyo'pyanupalakṣitāḥ syuḥ iti; taddūṣayannāha–
yadāha–na cemā kalpanā apratisaviditā evodayante vyayante ceti
nāpi tatpratipattau liṅgānusaraṇena tadākārasamāropasaśaya śakyate kalpayitum –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1
kiṃ viśiṣṭā api ? satyo'pi vidyamānā api
puna kathambhūtā ? pratisaviditotpattivyayā, utpatti svarūpalābha vyayo'bhāvapratyaya, pratisaviditau pratiprāṇi samupalabdhau utpattivyayau yāsā tāstathoktā
na khula sattvaṃ vinā utpādavyayavattvamanubhūyate, anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt
nanu satā vikalpānā pratyakṣabuddhāvanupalakṣaṇe kiṃ kāraṇamiti cet; pratipatturaśaktirapraṇidhānañceti brūma
teṣā vikalpānāṃ svalakṣaṇa svarūpa tasya bheda sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛtti sa iva tadvat
ayamartha–yathā pratītotpādavyayā satyapi svalakṣaṇavyāvṛtti kalpanāsu na lakṣyate anumānata eva tatsiddhe tathā pratyakṣeṣu kalpanā api na lakṣyanta iti
tarhi kathamalakṣitānā tāsā tatrāstitvasiddhiriti cet ? na, punastadviṣayasmaraṇānyathānupapattyā tatsiddhe
sahṛtasakalavikalpāvasthā hi aśva vikalpayato godarśanāvasthā, tatrāpi godarśana niścayātmakameva punastadviṣayasmaraṇānyathānupapatte
tulanā– na hi savitte bahubahuvidhaprabhṛtyākṛtaya svayamasaviditā evodayante atyayante vā yata satyo'ṣyanupalakṣitā syu kalpanāvat
svahetoreva tathotpatte kṣaṇasthitidharmatā tatsvabhāva paśyannapi mandabuddhi sattopalambhena sarvadā tathābhāvasya śaṅkayā sadṛśāparāparotpattivipralabdho vā na vyavasyati
tā punaranityatā paśyannapi mandabuddhi nādhyavasyati sattopalambhena sarvadā tadbhāvaśaṅkāvipralabdha sadṛśāparāparotpattivipralabdho vā
prati prāṇi saṃviditau utpattivyayau yāsāṃ tāḥ tathoktā tāḥ tathāvidhāḥ satyo'pi vidyamānā api na kevalamasatyaḥ, pratyakṣeṣu, bahuvacanaṃ caturvidhasyāpi pratyakṣasya saṅgrahārtham
na ca sataḥ pratisaṃviditāvirbhāvavināśavato'nupalakṣaṇaṃ viruddham, ityasyārthasya samarthanārthaṃ tatprasiddhameva nidarśanaṃ pradarśayannāha–tatsvalakṣaṇabhedavat iti
tāsāṃ kalpanānāṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svasvarūpaṃ tasya bhedaḥ sajātīyādvijātīyācca vyāvṛttiḥ sa iva tadvaditi
etadukta bhavati–yathā pratisaṃviditotpattivyayaḥ sannapi kalpanāsu tadbhedo na lakṣyate, anyathā kṣaṇakṣayānumānamanarthakaṃ syāt, tathā pratyakṣeṣu kalpanāḥ satyo'pi na lakṣyanta iti

tadbhedānupalakṣaṇe parakīyāṃ yuktiṃ sadūṣaṇāṃ sadṛśa ityādinā pradarśya kārikārthaṃ pratisaṃhāraikānta ityādinā darśayati–sadṛśasya samānasya aparasyāparasya utpattiḥ tayā vipralambhaḥ alātacakravat cakṣuṣo bhramaḥ tasmāttadviśeṣādarśinaḥ ta prakṛtaṃ sajātīyavyāvṛttilakṣaṇaviśeṣam alātacakravanna paśyatītyevaṃśīlasya saugatasya anavadhāraṇaṃ yad bhedānupalakṣaṇam, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, kuta etat ? ityatrāha–sarvathā ityādi
sarvathā bhedābhedobhayānubhayaprakāreṇa tāsāṃ kalpanānāṃ sādṛśyasya aniṣṭeḥ tataḥ tadbhedopalakṣaṇameva syāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
nacaitadasti, ato yathā tadbhedaḥ sannapi nopalakṣyate tathā pratyakṣeṣu satyo'pi kalpanā iti
tataḥ pratisaṃhāraikāntaḥ pratyakṣeṣu sakalakalpanāvirahaikāntaḥ saṃbhavati na vā iti cintyametat paryālocyametat na sabhavati ityartha
nanu yadyapi tāsāṃ tadbhedo na lakṣyate tathāpi abhilāpasaṃsargayogyapratibhāso vidyamāno lakṣyeta, na ca upalakṣyate
ataḥ asyā'nupalakṣaṇāt abhāvasiddheḥ siddhaḥ pratisaṃhāraikāntaḥ, ityatrāha–kathañca ityādi

kathañca na kathañcidapi pratyakṣabuddhayaḥ, bahuvacanam aśeṣādhyakṣabuddhisaṅgrahārtham, sarvathā svarūpavad bahirapi avikalpāḥ, punariti vitarke vikalperan bahirvikalpātmikā bhaveyuḥ anekāntaprasaṅgāditi manyate
athavā tadbuddhayaḥ sarvathā'vikalpāḥ satyaḥ kathañca na punaḥ paścād vikalperan vikalpān kuryuḥ
na hi avikalpādanubhavād arthādiva vikalpaḥ saṃbhavatītyukta savikalpasiddhipraghaṭṭake
yathāhi abhilāpa-abhilapyamānajātiguṇakriyādirahitāt kṣaṇikārthāt na śabdasaṃsargī vikalpo jāyate tathaiva nirvikalpānubhavādapi śabdaśūnyāt na śabdātmako vikalpa samutpadyeta

tenābhisambandhād akṣadhyādīnā prathamāntatvam arthavaśādvibhaktivipariṇāma iti nyāyāt tata eva vyākhyāyate–akṣadhīsmṛtisajñābhi cintayā''bhinibodhakaiśca vyavahāre hānopādānarūpe avisaṃvādādavyabhicāra sakalavyavahāriṇā pratītisiddha tatastāni pramāṇāni bhavantītyartha

akṣāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ kāryabhūtā dhīrbuddhi avagrahādyātmikā matiḥ sā ca smṛtiśca saṃjñā ca tābhiḥ, cintayā tarkeṇa, ābhinibodhikaiḥ anumānaiḥ vyaktyapekṣaṃ bahuvacanam taiḥ samastairvyastaiśca vyavahārāvisaṃvādaḥ, atasteṣāṃ prāmāṇyam, anyathā ekāntavādiparikalpitaprakāreṇa tadābhāsaḥ pramāṇābhāsaḥ
pratyakṣasmṛtipratyabhijñānohānumānādibhiḥ avisaṃvādasiddheḥ kāraṇād artheṣu ghaṭādiṣu teṣāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ prāmāṇyam, anyathā ekāntavādikalpitaprakāreṇa tadābhāsavyavasthā prāmāṇyābhāsavyavasthā
smaraṇādinā anyasya śrutasya uktatvāt śābdaṃ śruta śrutajñānaśabdeneha gṛhyate, tathaiva vyavahārasaṃvāda-visaṃvādaprakāreṇaiva śrutajñānaṃ tadābhāsaśca tayorvyavasthā
nanu śrutajñānaṃ pramāṇameva na bhavati tatkathaṃ tadvyavasthā ityāśaṅkyāha–
āptavacanādinibandhana matipūrvamarthajñāna śruta tacca pramāṇa siddhameva
kīdṛkṣu ? dvīpāntarādiṣa, prakṛto jambūdvīpa tasmādanye dhātakīkhaṇḍādayo dvīpāntarāṇi tānyādiryeṣā kālasvabhāvavyavahitānā te tathoktā teṣu deśakālākāraviprakṛṣṭeṣvityartha
na hi śrutādartha paricchidya pravartamāno rasāyanādikriyāyā visavādyate grahaṇādau vā malayādiprāptau vā
kvacinnadītīre modakādipratipādane tasya śrutasya vyabhicāro visavādaḥ tasmāt
nahi kvacidvisavādādaprāmāṇye jñānasya sarvatrāprāmāṇya śaṅkanīya pratyakṣādiṣvapi tathātvaprasaṅgāt sakalavyavahāravilopāpatte
vivṛtiḥ–śrutajñānaṃ vaktrabhiprāyādarthāntare'pi pramāṇam, kathamanyathā dvīpadeśanadīparvatādikam adṛṣṭasvabhāvakāryaṃ digvibhāgena deśāntarasthaṃ pratipattumarhati nirārekamavisaṃvādañca ?
ca nāsti ī॰ vi॰, ja॰ vi॰
śrutaṃ dharmi, pramāṇamiti sādhyo dharmaḥ avisaṃvādasiddheḥ ityetadanuvarttamāna sādhanaṃ tena avisaṃvādaka śrutaṃ pramāṇa na sarvam ityuktaṃ bhavati
taditthambhūta śrutaṃ kva pramāṇamityāha–artheṣu, na puna abhiprāyamātre
kiṃviśiṣṭeṣu teṣu ? ityāha–dvīpāntarādiṣu siddhaṃ śāstrāntare loke vā prasiddham
nanu arthābhāve'pi śabdānāṃ pravṛttipratīteḥ katha tattatra pramāṇamityāha–anāśvāsam ityādi
anāśvāsam āśvāsābhāvaṃ na kurvīran kvacid aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste ityādau tasya śrutasya vyabhicārato vyabhicāramāśritya, indriyajñānepi ata eva tadbhāvāpatterityabhiprāyaḥ
kvacid dvicandrādijñāne cākṣuṣapratyakṣasya vyabhicāropalambhāt ekacandravijñāne'pi aviśvāsaprasaṅgāt

nanu śrutasya anumānād vyatirekā'siddhitaḥ tatprāmāṇyaprasādhanādeva pramāṇaprasiddheḥ pramāṇaṃ śrutamartheṣu ityādyayuktam, tathāhi–śabdo'numānānna vyatiricyate tadabhinnaviṣayatvāt tadabhinnasāmagrīsamanvitatvācca, yad yat tathāvidha tattadanumānānna vyatiricyate yathā kutaścidanumānād anumānāntaram, tathāvidhaścāyaṃ śabda iti
na cāsya tadabhinna viṣayatvamasiddham; śabdānumānayoraviśeṣataḥ sāmānyagocaracāritvāt
sambaddhārthapratipattihetutvācca; na hi śabdaḥ asambaddhamarthaṃ pratipādayati atiprasaṅgāt, sambaddhañca taṃ pratipādayannasau talliṅgatāṃ nātivartteta
nāpi tadabhinnasāmagrīsamanvitatvamasiddham, dhūmādivat śabdasya arthapratītau sambandhasmṛtyapekṣatvāt
anvayavyatirekavattvācca, yo hi śabdo yatrārthe loke dṛśyate sa tasya vācakaḥ yatra tu na dṛśyate na tasya vācakaḥ
pakṣadharmatvopetatvācca; tathāhi–vivakṣitaḥ śabdaḥ arthavān śabdatvāt pūrvopalabdhaśabdavat, yathā ayaṃ dhūmo'gnimān dhūmatvāt pūrvopalabdhadhūmavat
yathā ca pratyakṣato dhūmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vahniḥ pratīyate tathā śabdaṃ śrutvā tadartho'pi
antarbhāvavyavahāre ca samānavi dhitvāt samānalakṣaṇayogitvāditi hetūpanyāsaḥ –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 577

prasiddhaḥ samayo'vinā- bhāvo yasya puruṣasya tasya liṅgadarśanaprasiddhyanusmaraṇābhyā liṅgadarśana yatra dhūmastatrāgnirityevambhūtāyā prasiddheranusmaraṇañca tābhyā yathā'tīndriye'rthe bhavatyanumāna tathā śabdādibhyo'pīti
tāvaddhi śabdo nārtha pratipādayati yāvadayamasyāvyabhicārītyeva nāvagamyate, jñāte tvavyabhicāre pratipādayan dhūma iva liṅgaṃ syāt –praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 214
apratibandhakatve aprāmāṇyameva, sākṣātpratibandhakatve pratyakṣāntarbhāva, paramparāpratibandhakatve cānumāna evāntarbhāva –praśa॰ kira॰ pṛ॰ 309

yadyapyete padārthā mithaḥ sasargabanto vākyatvāditi vyadhikaraṇam, padārthatvāditi cānaikāntikam, padai smāritārthasasargavanti tatsmārakatvādityādau sādhyābhāva, tathāpi ākāṅkṣādimadbhi padai smāritatvāt gāmabhyājeti padārthavaditi syāt
padāni smāritārthavijñaptipūrvakāṇi yogyatāsattimattve sati saṃsṛṣṭārthaparatvāt gāmabhyājeti paratvāt gāmabhyājeti padakadambavadityanumānādeva sādhyasiddhe
yo yatra dṛśyate sabda sa tasyārthasya vācaka
kiñca śabdo vivakṣāyāmeva pramāṇaṃ na bāhye vyabhicārāt
na hi aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste ityādi śabdānāṃ bāhye'rthe prāmāṇyamupapadyate pratītivirodhāt
pusi dharmiṇi sā sādhyā kāryeṇa vacasā yata
prathama gośabdāduccaritādvaktu kakudādimadarthavivakṣā gamyate svasantāne gośabdoccāraṇasya tadarthavivakṣāpūrvakatvopalambhāt, tadarthavivakṣayā cārthānumānam
ayañcātra prayoga–puruṣo dharmī kakudādimadarthavivakṣāvān gośabdoccāraṇakartṛtvāt ahamiveti
yathāhi ākāśādhigame sarva śabdo'numānam, vivakṣākāryastu vivakṣādhigame'pi iti
yattāvaduktam–śabdo'numānānna vyatiricyate ityādi, tadasamīcīnam, abhinnaviṣayatvasya anayorasiddheḥ
arthamātraṃ hi śabdasya viṣayaḥ, anumānasya tu sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmī iti

kiñca, anayorviṣayābhedaḥ sāmānyamātragocaracāritayā, tadvanmātraviṣayatayā, sambaddhārthapratipattihetutayā vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe kimida sāmānyaṃ nāma–sakalavyaktyanusyūta nityaikatvādidharmopetam, anyavyāvṛttirūpa vā ? pakṣadvayamapyetadanupapannam, ubhayarūpasyāpi sāmānyasya sāmānyaparīkṣāvasare pratikṣiptatvāt, anyāpohamātraviṣayatvasya anayoḥ pratiṣetsyamānatvācca
nityādisvabhāvasāmānyaviṣayatve cānayoḥ mīmāṃsakamatānupraveśaḥ saugatasya syāt, sa cānupapannaḥ, tadviṣayatvasyāpyagre nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
atha tadvanmātraviṣayatayā tayorviṣayābhedo'bhipretaḥ, nanvevaṃ pratyakṣasyāpi anumānatvaprasaṅgaḥ tathā tadabhedasyātrāpyaviśeṣāt, sakalapramāṇānāṃ sāmānyaviśepātmakārthaviṣayatvapratipādanāt
na tāvadanumāna hi yāvattadviṣaya na tat
arthamātra hi śabdasya gocaro'numānasya tu sādhyadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmīti
anumāna tu vākyārthaviṣayam atrāgniragnimān parvata iti pratipatte
In the print edition there is a footnote reference but no footnote .
tulanā–api cānayorgocarābheda sāmānyamātraviṣayatayā tadvanmātragocaratayā vā bhavet ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 620
etena sambaddhārthapratipattihetutayāpyanumānatvaṃ śabdasya pratyākhyātam; pratyakṣasyāpi sambaddhārthapratipattihetutayā anumānatvānuṣaṅgāt
tadapi hi svaviṣaye sambaddha sat tatpratipattihetuḥ nānyathā'tiprasaṅgāt
atha tatra sambaddhasyāsya pratipattihetutvāviśeṣe'pi sāmagrībhedād anumānādbhedaḥ; kathamevaṃ śabdasyāpi ato bhedo na syāt tadaviśeṣāt ? tanna abhinnaviṣayatvāt śabdasyānumānatvaṃ yuktam
pakṣadharmatvādirūpatrayarūpā hi anumāne sāmagrī, sā ca śabde na saṃbhavati
tathāhi–na tāvat śabdasya pakṣadharmatvaṃ saṃbhavati; dharmiṇa evātra kasyacidasaṃbhavāt
atra hi dharmī śabdaḥ, artho vā syāt ? na tāvat śabdaḥ; tasyaiva dharmitve tasyaiva ca hetutve hetoḥ pratijñārthaikadeśatvaprasaṅgāt
atha śabdatvaṃ heturiti na pratijñārthaikadeśatvam; na; śabdatvasya sāmānyasvabhāvasya bhavanmate paramārthasato'saṃbhavāt
kalpitasya tu sattve'pi na gamakatvam artho hyarthaṃ gamayati iti ca bhavadbhireva abhyupagamāt
nanūkta yathānumāne dharmaviśiṣṭo dharmī sādhya evamihārthaviśiṣṭa śabda sādhyo bhavatu; maivam; śabdasya hetutvāt

astu vā śabdatvaṃ hetuḥ, tathāpi ataḥ śabdasya dharmiṇaḥ kim arthaviśiṣṭatvaṃ sādhyate, arthapratyāyanaśaktiyuktatvam, arthapratītiviśiṣṭatvaṃ vā ? tatra ādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; acalānalayoriva śabdārthayoḥ dharmidharmabhāvā'saṃbhavāt, āśrito hi dharmo bhavati, na cārthaḥ śabdāśrito vibhinnadeśatvāt
yad yato vibhinnadeśaṃ na tattatrāśritaṃ yathā sahye vindhyaḥ, śabdād vibhinnadeśaścārtha iti
yatra ca āśrayāśrayibhāvo nāsti na tatra dharmadharmibhāvaḥ yathā citrakūṭakaśmīrayoḥ, āśrayāśrayibhāvābhāvaśca śabdārthayoriti
na cārthaviśiṣṭaṃ śabdaṃ kaścidavāliśo manyate, śabdāt pṛthagevārthasya ābālaṃ suprasiddhatvāt
tulanā–śabdasya dharmiṇa kimarthaviśiṣṭatva vā sādhyate, pratyāyanaśaktiviśiṣṭatva vā, arthapratītiviśiṣṭatva vā ? –nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 153
atha arthapratyāyanaśaktiyuktatvamasya sādhyate; tadapyasat; tadarthatayā śabdaprayogā'saṃbhavāt
na hi tacchaktisiddhaye śabdaḥ prayujyate śrūyate vā, kintu arthasiddhaye
tulanā–na śaktisiddhaye śabdaḥ kathyate śrūyate'pi vā
asiddhayā hi arthapratītyā tadvattvaṃ śabdasyāyuktam, atiprasaṅgāt
siddhāyāṃ tvasyāṃ kimanyadanumīyatām ? svasaṃviditasvabhāvāyāmasyāṃ visaṃvādābhāvāt ityasyānumānasya vaiphalyam
na ca dhūmādyanumāne'pyayaṃ doṣastulya ityabhidhātavyam; tatra kāryakāraṇabhāvā bhāvāt
na khalu dhūmena agnirjanyate kintu gamyate, śabdena tu arthapratītirjanyate ataḥ asyāmeva siddhāsiddhavikalpāvatāraḥ
tulanā– na hi tatra agnirdhūmena janyate api tu gamyate
nāpyarthasya, tena saha śabdasya bhavadbhiḥ sambandhānabhyupagamāt
na hyarthe śabdāḥ santi tadātmāno vā ityādivacanavirodhānuṣaṅgāt
na ca arthenā'sambaddhopi śabdaḥ tasya dharmaḥ atiprasaṅgāt
atha arthapratītihetutvāt taddharmo'sau, na, itaretarāśrayānuṣaṅgāt–pakṣadharmatvasiddhau hi śabdasya arthapratītihetutvasiddhi, tatsiddhau ca pakṣadharmatvasiddhiriti
tatpratītihetutvena cāsya taddharmatve cakṣurāderapi pakṣadharmatāsiddheḥ tatprabhavāpi pratītiḥ ānumānikyeva syāt
uktañca–na hyarthe śabdā tadātmāno vā yena tasmin pratibhāsamāne te'pi pratibhāserannityādi
yathāhi vahnau dhūmo janyajanakasambandhasambaddha uttarabhāvena bhavati eva nārthe janyajanakasambandhasambaddhā śabdā uttarabhāvena santi
etena tadutpattisambandha samartha śabdārtha yornāsti ityācaṣṭe
sa evārtha ātmā yeṣā śabdānā te tadātmānaḥ, anena tādātmyasambandho'pi nāstītyāha tasminniti
arthe pratibhāsamāne pratyakṣeṇa paricchidyamāne pratibhāseran pradīpyeran śabdā iti
tādātmye hi śabdārthayo śabdo vā syādartho vā na dvayam
tathā śabdārthayostādātmye kṣurikāmodakādiśabdoccāraṇe mukhapāṭanapūraṇādiprasaṅga, na ca dṛśyate
yata keya tadutpattirnāma ? kiṃ śabdādarthotpattirarthādvā śabdotpatti ? yadi śabdādarthotpatti syāttadā viśvamadaridra syāt hiraṇyādiśabdoccāraṇādeva tadutpatte
uktañca dharmakīrtinā–na hyarthe śabdā santi tadātmāno vā yena tasmin pratibhāseran
na hyarthe śabdā santi tadātmāno vā tathā satyavyutpannasyāpi vyutpannavad vyavahāra syādityuktam
pakṣadharmādibalena pratīti, pratītau ca satyā pakṣadharmādirūpalābha iti
nahi yatra deśe śabdaḥ tatrārthaḥ mukhe hi śabda upalabhyate bhūmāvarthaḥ śābarabhā॰ 1
nāpi vyavahāriṇāṃ tadanvayādhyavasāyo'sti; na khalu yatra yatra piṇḍakharjūrādiśabdaṃ śṛṇvanti tatra piṇḍakharjūrādyarthāstitvaṃ vyavahāriṇaḥ pratipadyante
yatra hi dhūmaḥ tatrāvaśyaṃ vahnirastitvena prasiddho'nvetā bhavati dhūmasya, natvevaṃ deśakṛtaḥ śabdasya arthenā'nvayo'sti

nāpi kālakṛtaḥ, na hi yatra kāle śabdaḥ tatra tadartho'vaśyaṃ saṃbhavati, rāvaṇaśaṅkhacakravartyādiśabdā hi varttamānāḥ tadarthastu bhūto bhaviṣyaṃśceti kuto'rthānāṃ śabdānvetṛtvam ? anvayābhāve ca vyatirekasyāpyabhāvaḥ tatpūrvakatvāttasya
tulanā–anvayo na ca śabdasya prameyeṇa nirūpyate
na tvena yatra śabdo'sti tatrārtho'stīti niścaya
anvayavyatirekāvapi tasya durupapādau, deśe kāle ca śabdārthayoranugamābhāvāt
yadapyuktam–yo hi śabdo yatrārthe dṛṣṭaḥ ityādi, tadapyayuktam; evaṃvidhā'nvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tadvācakatvasya asmābhirabhīṣṭatvāt
na caivaṃvidhānvayavyatirekatvamātreṇa asyānumānatvaṃ vācyam, pratyakṣasyāpi tatprasaṅgāt tanmātrasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
yatra hi ghaṭasadbhāvo'sti tatra tat pratyakṣaṃ bhavati, yatra tu sa nāsti tatra tanna bhavatīti
tulanā–anvayavyatirekopapatti pratyakṣe'pi, yathā yatra ghaṭastatra ghaṭajñānam, yatra nāsti tatra tadabhāva iti
yadapi–sambandhasmṛtyapekṣatvāt ityuktam, tadapyanupapannam, ananumāne'pi saṃśayopamānādau asya sadbhāvenā'naikāntikatvāt, ananumānatvañca upamānādeḥ prāgeva prasādhitam
anu ananu māne'pi smṛtyapekṣitvamasti, yathā saśaye yathā tarke yathopamāna iti
yaccānyaduktam–śabdo vivakṣāyāmeva pramāṇam ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; tatra tatprāmāṇyasya varṇāḥ padāni vākyāni prāhurarthānavāñchitān laghī॰ kā॰ 64 ityatra prapañcataḥ pratiṣetsyamānatvāt
tataḥ śabdo nānumānaṃ tadvibhinnaviṣayatvāt tadvibhinnasāmagrīsambandhitvācca pratyakṣavat
ito'pyananumānamasau puruṣairyatheṣṭaṃ niyujyamānasya arthapratītihetutvāt, yatṣunaranumānaṃ na tattathā yathā kṛtakatvādi, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmānnānumānamiti
na ca sādhanā'vyatireko'yaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tathā tairniyujyamānasyāsya sādhyapratītyajanakatvāt
na hi kṛtakatvaṃ nityatvasādhyecchayā dhūmatvādikaṃ vā jalādisādhyecchayā niyujyamānaṃ tatpratītihetuḥ, anyathā na kaścid viruddho hetuḥ syāt
tathā, śabdo nānumānam āptoktatvenaivā'vyabhicārijñānajanakatvāt, yat punaranumānaṃ na tattathā tajjanakam yathā kṛtakatvādi, tathā tajjanakaśca śabda iti
kṛtakatvādisādhanasya hi sādhye'vyabhicārijñānajanane avinābhāva eva nimittaṃ nāptoktatvamanāptoktatvaṃ vā śabdasya tu āptoktatvameveti
tulanā–evavidhaviṣayabhedāt sāmagrībhedācca pratyakṣavadanumānādanyaḥ śabda iti siddham
svarga apsarasa uttarā kurava sapta dvīpā samudro lokasanniveśa ityevamāderapratyakṣasyārthasya na śabdamātrāt pratyaya
kiṃtarhi ? āptairayamukta śabda ityata sampratyaya, viparyayeṇa sampratyayābhāvāt natvevamanumānamiti
śabda vikalpavāsanāmātrajanyatvādarthā'sasparśī, ata eva ca na tatprāmāṇyam iti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–
satyam, ananumānasvabhāva evāyaṃ śabda apramāṇatvāt, pramāṇatve hi tasya anumāne'ntarbhāvaprayāsaḥ phalavān
sambandho hi śabdārthayorbhavan tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ, tadutpattisvabhāvo vā bhavet ? na tāvat tādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ, vibhinnadeśatayā tayo pratīyamānatvāt, mukhe hi śabdaḥ pratīyate bhūmāvartha iti
nāpi tadutpattisvabhāvaḥ, aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste ityādi śabdānām arthābhāve'pyutpattipratīteḥ, sthānakaraṇaprayatnaprabhavatvācca

ato'rthā'sasparśina śabdā na bāhyārthe pratītiṃ janayitumala tatkathaṃ prāmāṇyabhājo bhaveyuḥ ? te hi vikalpamātrādhīnajanmāna svamahimnā tiraskṛtabāhyārthān pratyayānutpādayanti yathā aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste iti
vastubhi svalakṣaṇai saha śabdanāntarīyakatāyā avinābhāvasyābhāvāt tebhya śabdebhyo nārthasiddhirna bāhyavastuniścaya, yasmātte vaktrabhiprāyasūcakā
vacasā pratibandho vā ko bāhyeṣvapi vastuṣu
na hi vācyai vastubhi saha kaścittādātmyalakṣaṇastadutpattilakṣaṇo vā pratibandho vacasāmasti yena tāni vastūni pratipādayatāmeṣā vacasā prāmāṇya syāt
syāccedarthena sambandha kṣuramodakaśabdoccāraṇe mukhasya pāṭanapūraṇe syātām

anādi samānajātīyo yo vikalpastena āhitā yā vāsanāśaktistata udbhūtā utpannā yathāgama samāropitā ya ākāśādyākārā tadgocarā ta tpratibhāsinya eva kevala gatā tatra bāhyatvena kalpiteṣu ākāśādiṣu jāyante

puruṣadoṣāṇāmeṣa mahimā na śabdānām; ityapyayuktam; doṣavato'pi mūkādeḥ puruṣasya anuccāritaśabdasya īdṛśā'satyapratyayotpādanasāmarthyā'saṃbhavāt, asatyapi ca puruṣahṛdayakāluṣye āptaprayuktāni aṅgulyādivākyāni tānutpādayantyeva
nanvāptā nedṛṃśi vākyāni prayuñjante, prayuñjānā vā nāptāḥ syuḥ, ityapyasat; evamapi hi vaktṛdoṣāṇām ayathārthajñānodayakāraṇatvāsiddhiḥ, vyatirekāsiddheḥ
yadi hi vaktṛdoṣābhāve amūnyapi vākyāni prayujyeran na cāyathārthān pratyayān kuryuḥ, tadā anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vaktṛdoṣajatvaṃ śābdajñānasya syāt
āptaistu teṣāmaprayoge kiṃ śabdābhāvād ayathārthajñānānutpattiḥ, āhosviddoṣābhāvāt iti sandigdho vyatirekaḥ, śabde tu niścitaḥ-satsvapi doṣeṣu śabdānuccāraṇe mithyājñānānutpatteḥ
na cāptatvam īdṛgvākyaprayoktṛtvena virudhyate; tathāvidhaśabdoccāraṇe satyapi āśayadoṣābhāvato'nāptatvāyogāt
tathāhi–āpto'pi kasmaicidupadiśati na tvayā'nanubhūtārthavākyaṃ prayoktavyaṃ yathā aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste iti
tulanā–ihāpi puruṣadoṣāṇāmeṣa mahimā na śabdānāmiti cet, maivam, doṣavato'pi puruṣasya mūkāderanuccāritaśabdasyedṛśaviplavotpādanapāṭavābhāvāt
asatyapi ca puruṣahṛdayakāluṣye yathā prayujyamānāni aṅgulyagrādivākyāni viplavamāvahantyeveti śabdānāmevaiṣa svabhāvo na vaktṛdoṣāṇām
tulanā– na cāptā nedṛśāni vākyāni prayuñjate prayuñjānā vā nāptā syuriti cet; etadapyasundaram, evamapi hi vaktṛdoṣāṇāmayathārthajñānodayakāraṇatvāsiddhi, vyatirekāsiddheḥ –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 701
tulanā–uktañcaitadumbekena–yadāpto'pi kasmaiścidupadiśati na tvayā'nanubhūtārthaviṣaya vākya prayoktavya yathā'ṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāsta iti tatrārthavyabhicāra sphuṭa iti
kiñca, bādhakapratyayotpattāvapi śabdo mithyājñānaṃ janayatyeva nendriyavadudāste, ato'rthā'saṃsparśinaḥ śabdā vikalpamātrādhīnajanmānaḥ siddhāḥ
tulanā–api ca na cakṣurādi bādhakajñānodaye sati na viramati, viparītavedanajanmana śuktikārajatādibuddhiṣu vibhramasyāpāyadarśanāt

śabdastu śatakṛtvo'pi vādhyamāno yathaivoccarita karaśākhādiśikhare kareṇuśatamāsta iti tadaiva tathābhūta bhūyo'pi vikalpamayathārthamutpādayatyeveti vikalpādhīnajanmatvācchabdānāmeveda rūpa yadarthāsaṃsparśitva nāmeti
kāryakāraṇatā teṣā nārtha śabdā spṛśantyapi –nyāyāvatā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 44
tatpratividhānapurassara śabdasya paramārthasadarthavācakatvasya prathakpṛthak prāmāṇyasya ca samarthanam–
yattāvaduktam–vastuni sambandhāsabhavāt ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, tatra śabdasya tadabhāvā'sabhavāt
tathāhi–śabdaḥ arthena sambaddha eva ta prakāśayati pratiniyatatatpratyayahetutvāt cakṣurvat
śābdapratyayo vā sambaddhābhyāṃ śabdārthābhyāṃ janyate pratiniyatapratyayatvāt daṇḍītyādipratyayavat
nanu śabdārthayostādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇasambandhasyā'pāstatvāt kathaṃ sambaddhatvam ? ityapyanupapannam; tadabhāve'pyanayoḥ yogyatālakṣaṇasambandhasabhavāt
tadabhāve so'pi katham ? ityapyavācyam; cakṣūrūpayostadabhāve'pi taddarśanāt
na khalu cakṣupo ghaṭādirūpeṇa saha tādātmyaṃ tadutpattiḥ saṃyogo vā saugatairabhyupagamyate pratītivirodhānuṣaṅgāt, aprāpyakāritvakṣatiprasaṅgācca
tādṛśo vācaka śabda saketo yatra vartate
nanu yogyatātaḥ śabdasya arthavācakatve arthasyāpi śabdavācakatvaṃ kinna syāt ? ityapyasāmpratam, pratiniyataśaktitvād bhāvānām

naca jñānajñeyayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvāt tatpratiniyamo na yogyatāta ityabhidhātavyam; tatkāryakāraṇabhāvasya anvayavyatirekābhyāmarthaścet kāraṇaṃ vidaḥ laghī॰ kā॰ 54 ityatra vistarato nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt
kathañcaiva cakṣūrūpayoḥ ghaṭapradīpayośca prakāśyaprakāśakabhāvapratiniyamaḥ syāt ? yogyatāto'nyasya kāryakāraṇabhāvādipratibandhasya tatra tatpratiniyamahetorasaṃbhavāt
tulanā–sahajā svābhāvikī yogyatā śabdārthayo pratipādyapratipādakaśakti jñānajñeyayorjñāpyajñāpakaśaktivat
tulanā–itarathā jñānameva prakāśaka jñeyameva ca prakāśya napunarjñānamiti niyamasyāghaṭanāt

nanu yogyatāvaśāt śabdo yadyarthaṃ pratipādayati tadā bhūbhavanavarddhitotthitasyāpi pratipādayet viśeṣābhāvāt; ityapyapeśalam; saṅketasacivayogyatāvaśāttasya tatpratipādakatvābhyupagamāt, bhūbhavanavarddhitotthitaṃ prati cāsya tathāvidhatvābhāvānna tatpratipādakatvaprasaṅgaḥ

saṅketo hi idamasya vācyam idaṃ vācakam ityevaṃvidho vācyavācakayorviniyogaḥ, sa yasyāsti tasyaiva śabdaḥ svārthaṃ pratipādayati nānyasya, anyathā dhūmādisādhanamapyasya agnyādisādhyaṃ gamayedaviśeṣāt, avinābhāvo hi sādhanasya sādhyagamakatve aṅgam, sa ca sarvadā sarvaṃ pratyasyāsti
yenaiva sādhyasādhanayoravinābhāvo gṛhītaḥ taṃ pratyeva sādhanaṃ sādhyasya gamakamityabhyupagame yenaiva śabdārthayoḥ saṅketo gṛhītaḥ taṃ pratyeva śabdo'rthasya vācakaḥ ityabhyupagamyatāmaviśeṣāt
tulanā–ka punaraya samaya ? asya śabdasyedamarthajātamabhidheyamityabhidhānābhidheyaniyamaniyoga, tasminnupayukte śabdārthasapratyayo bhavati
asyārthasyāya vācaka ityarthakathana samaya –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1
ida padamamumartha bodhayatu iti asmātpadādayamartho boddhavya iti vecchā

nanu saṅketaḥ puruṣecchākṛtaḥ, naca tadicchayā vastuvyavasthā yuktā atiprasaṅgāt, ato'rthopi vācakaḥ śabdastu vācyaḥ kinna syāt tadicchāyā niraṅkuśatvāt ? ityapyasundaram, tatsaṅketasya sahajayogyatānibandhanatvād dhūmāgnivat

yathaiva hi dhūmāgnyornaisargika evāvinābhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ, tadvyutpattaye tu bhūyodarśanādinimittamāśrīyate, tathā śabdārthayoḥ svabhāvika eva pratipādyapratipādakaśaktyātmā sambandhaḥ, tadvyutpattaye tu saṅketaḥ samāśrīyate
tathā ca cakṣuḥpradīpādīnāṃ prakāśyatvaṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ tu prakāśakatvaṃ syāt
tulanā–sa hi puruṣakṛta saṅketa na ca puruṣecchayā vastuniyamo'vakalpyate, tadicchāyā avyāhataprasaratvāt
na caivamasti, na hi dahanamanicchannapi puruṣo dhūmānna tatpratyeti jala vā tata icchannapi pratipadyate

tatra yathā dhūmāgnyo naisargika evāvinābhāvo nāma sambandha jñaptaye tu bhūyodarśanādi nimittamāśrīyate eva śabdārthayo sāsiddhika eva śaktyātmā sambandha tadvyutpattaye tu vṛddhavyavahāraprasiddhisamāśrayaṇam
yathaiva hi dhūmapāvakayo svābhāvika evāvinābhāvaḥ –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 703
nanu śabdasya svābhāvikī śaktiḥ kimekārthapratyāyane, anekārthapratyāyane vā ? yadyekārthapratyāyane, tadā saṅketaśatairapi tato'rthāntare pratītirna syāt dhūmādanagnipratītivat
atha anekārthapratyāyane, tadā yugapat tato'nekārthapratītiprasaṅgāt pratiniyate'rthe pravṛttirna syāt, ityapyacarcitābhidhānam sarvaśabdānāṃ sarvārtheṣu pratyāyanaśaktisaṃbhavāt
kathamanyathā anavagatasambandhe śabde prayukte sandeha syāt–kamarthaṃ pratipādayitumanena śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ iti
nacaivaṃ sakṛtsarvārthapratipattiprasakteḥ pratiniyate'rthe tataḥ pravṛttirna syādityabhidhātavyam; pratiniyatasaṅketavaśātteṣāṃ pratiniyatārthapratipādakatvopapatteḥ
ekasyāpi hi śabdasya deśādibhedena pratiniyataḥ saṅketo'nubhūyate, yathā mālavakādau karkaṭikāśabdasya phalaviśeṣe, gurjarādau tu yonyāmiti

dṛśyate ca sarvatra rūpaprakāśane yogyasyāpi cakṣuṣaḥ pratyāsannatimiravaśādasannihite, dūratimiravaśācca sannihite rūpe, viśiṣṭāñjanādivaśāt andhakārāntarite'pi jñānajanakatvam, kācakāmalādivaśācca vivakṣitarūpābhāve'pīti

tayo yathā anekarūpaprakāśanayogyasyāpi cakṣuṣo dūratimirādipratiniyatasahakārivaśāt pratiniyatadūrarūpādijñānajanakatvaṃ tathā anekārthapratyāyanayogyasyāpi śabdasya pratiniyatasaṅketavaśāt pratiniyatārthapratipādakatvamaviruddham
ata eva cānadhigatasambandhe śrute sati sandeho bhavati kamarthaṃ pratyāyayitumanena śabda prayuktaḥ syāditi
tatkartṛtvena saphala yoginā tu na vidyate
vācyasya ca tathā'nyatra nāgo'sya samaye'pi hi
tathā ca sarve śabdā prāya sarvārthavācakaśaktimanta sarve cārthā sarvaśabdavācyaśaktiyuktā iti vicitrakṣayopaśamādisahakāriyogata tathā tathā pravartante iti na kācidvādhā –anekāntajaya॰ pṛ॰ 36A
tulanā–tathāhi–yavaśabda āryairdīrghaśūke padārthe prayujyate, te hi yavaśabdāt dīrghaśūka padārthaṃ pratipadyante mlecchāstu priyaṅga pratipadyate
eva trivṛtśabdamṛṣaya stotrīyānavake prayuñjate, āryāstu latāviśeṣe
ekasyāpi hi śabdasya deśādibhedena pratiniyata saṅketo'nubhūyate, yathā gurjarādau coraśabdasya taskare drābiḍādau punarodana iti

dṛśyate ca sarvatra rūpaprakāśane yogyasyāpi cakṣuṣa pratyāsannatimiravaśādasannihite dūratimirasāmarthyācca sannihite rūpe viśiṣṭāñjanādivaśādandhakārāntarite'pi jñānajanakatvam, kācakāmalādidūṣaṇabalācca vivakṣitarūpābhāve'pīti

atha matam–cakṣurādivat śabdasya arthe yogyatālakṣaṇasambandhasaṃbhave tadvadeva ataḥ saṅketānapekṣā arthapratītiḥ syāt, tadapyasaṅgatam; tasya jñāpakatayā tatsāpekṣasyaiva artha pratītyaṅgatopapatteḥ
yajjñāpakaṃ tat jñāpye pratipannapratibandhameva pratītimutpādayati yathā dhūmādi, jñāpakaśca śabda iti
cakṣurādīnāṃ tu kārakatvāt yuktaṃ svārthasambandhagrahaṇānapekṣāṇāṃ tadutpādakatvam
tadrūpatā ca śabdāderevāsti na cakṣurādeḥ, ataḥ sa eva pratipannapratibandhaṃ svārthaṃ gamayati
śaktistu svābhāvikī yathā rūpaprakāśane cakṣurādeḥ tathā arthaprakāśane śabdasya
tulanā–vācyavācakalakṣaṇo hi śabdārthayo pratibandha, tathāhi vācyasvabhāvā arthā vācakasvabhāvāśca śabdā iti tajjñaptivāda
na hi rūpaprakāśanasvabhāvo'pi dīpo'sati cakṣuṣi tatprakāśayati, cakṣu kalpaśca kṣayopaśama, sa ca saṅketatapaścaraṇabhāvanādijanyastathopalabdhe
śaktistu naisargikī yathā rūpaprakāśinī dīpādestathā śabdasyārthapratipādane

yadapyuktam–ato'rthāsaṃsparśinaḥ śabdāḥ ityādi, tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; yataḥ kimāptapraṇītasya śabdasya arthāsaṃsparśitvaṃ prasādhyate, anāptapraṇītasya, śabdamātrasya vā ? tatrādyapakṣe pratyakṣabādhā, āptapraṇītāt nadyāstīre phalāni santi iti vākyādatiraskṛtabāhyārthapratyayapratīteḥ tataḥ pravṛttasya tadarthaprāpteḥ
athā'nāptapraṇītasya; tarhi tasyaiva arthā'saṃsparśitvaṃ yuktaṃ nānyasya, anyathā kācādidoṣaduṣṭacakṣuḥprabhavapratyakṣasya arthāsaṃsparśitvopalambhāt guṇavaccakṣuḥprabhavapratyakṣasyāpi tatsyāt
tulanā–bhavedetadevaṃ yadi na kadācidapi yathārthaṃ śabda pratyayamupajanayet
bhavati tu guṇavatpuruṣabhāṣitānnadyāstīre phalāni santīti vākyādatiraskṛtabāhyārtho yathārthapratyaya tata pravṛttasya tadarthaprāpteḥ
nanvāptapraṇītād aṅgulyādivākyād viparyayajñānotpattipratīteḥ śabdasyaiṣa mahimā na vaktṛdoṣāṇām; ityapyacarcitābhidhānam; āptairevaṃvidhavākyā'prayogāt

yattu–āpto'pi kasmaicidupadiśati ityādyuktam; tatra niṣedhaparatvenāsya yathārtha taiva, vākyaikadeśasyāpi udāharaṇavivakṣāyām itikaraṇāvacchinnasya śabdaparatvenopādānāt pratiṣedhaikavākyatayā yathārthataiva
tasmād āptapraṇītaśabdānāmayathārthatvābhāvānna svato'rthāsaṃsparśinaḥ śabdāḥ, kintu puruṣadoṣavaśāt

tulanā–yattu āpto'pi kacidanuśāsti mā bhavānabhūtārtha vākyaṃ vādī aṅgalikoṭau karighaṭāśatamāste' iti, tatra itikaraṇāvacchinnasya dṛṣṭāntatayā śabdaparatvenopādānāt pratiṣedhaikavākyatayā yathārthatvameva
tasmādāptavākyānāmayathārthatvābhāvānna svato'rthāsasparśina śabdāḥ puruṣadoṣānuṣaṅgakṛta evāya viplava
aṅgalyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste iti vākyasya ekadeśa aṅgatyage ityādirūpa

nanvāptairevaṃvidhavākyāprayoge'pi sandigdho vyatirekaḥ ki śabdābhāvādayathārthajñānānutpattiḥ, vaktṛdopābhāvādvā; ityapyavicaritaramaṇīyam; anuccāritaśabdasyāpi doṣavataḥ puruṣasya hastasaṃjñādinā pratārakatvapratīteḥ
na ca hastasaṃjñādi nā śabdānumānaṃ tato vitathapratyaya ityabhidhātavyam; tathāpratītyabhāvāt
nadyādivākyādutpanne ca kvacidvijñāne taraṅgiṇītīramanusaran anāmāditaphalaḥ puruṣa puruṣamevādhikṣipati durātmanā'nena vipralabdho'smi iti, na śabdam

nanu puruṣasya guṇavato doṣavato vā śabdoccāraṇamātra eva vyāpāraḥ, arthapratipattistu śabdanibandhanaiveti tadviparyaye śabdasyaiva vyāpāro na vaktṛdoṣāṇām; ityapyayuktam yato guṇavadvaktṛpraṇītāt taraṅgiṇītīre phalāni santi iti vākyāt satyapratyayodaye'pyevaṃ śabdasyaiva vyāpāraḥ syāt tadvaktuḥ taduccāraṇamātre caritārthatvāt

utpanne ca kvacinnadyādivākyādvijñāne taraṅgiṇītīramanusarannanāsāditaphala pravṛttavādhakapratyaya puruṣamevādhikṣipati dhig hā tena durātmanā vipralabdho'smi iti na śabdam, prāptaphalaśca pusāmeva ślāghate sādhu sādhunā tenopadiṣṭamityata puruṣadoṣānvayānuvidhānāttadabhāvakṛta eva āpteṣu tūṣṇīmāsīneṣu vibhramānutpāda iti na sandigdho vyatireka
tulanā–hanta tarhi vaktari guṇavati sati saritastīre phalāni santīti samyakpratyaye'pi śabdasyaiva vyāpārāt puruṣasya uccāraṇamātre caritārthatvānnaikāntata śabdasyārthāsasparśitvameva svabhāva
kiñca, viparyayajñānotpatteryāvadbhiḥ saha tadbhāvabhāvitvamavagamyate tāvatāṃ tatra vyāpāraḥ, sā cātra śabdoccāraṇe satyapi anāptayogitā vinā na dṛṣṭeti śabdavattadāśayasyāpi tatra vyāpāraḥ
kiñca, cakṣurādivadarthaprakāśakatvamātraṃ śabdasya svarūpaṃ na punaḥ yathārthaprakāśaka tvamayathārthaprakāśakatvaṃ vā, tasya guṇadoṣanibandhanatvāt
sati hi nairmalyādiguṇe cakṣuryathāvadvastu prakāśayati kācādidoṣe tu sati ayathāvat, evaṃ śabdo'pi vaktṛguṇadoṣāpekṣaḥ satyetararūpaṃ vastu prakāśayati
ata eva aṅguliśikharādhikaraṇakareṇuśatavacasi vādhyamāne'pi punaḥ punaruccāryamāṇe bhavati bhrāntiḥ prakāśakatvasya tatsvarūpasya bādhakaśatopanipāte'pyanapāyāt
tulanā–yuktañcaideva yat dīpavat prakāśatvamāvameva śabdasya svarūpa na yathārthatvamayathārthatva vā, viparīte'pyarthe dīpasya prakāśatvānativṛtte
aya tu viśeṣa–pradīpe vyutpattinirapekṣameva prakāśakatva śabde tu vyutpattyapekṣamiti
ata eva aṅgaliśikharādhikaraṇakareṇuśatavacasi bādhite'pi puna punaruccaryamāṇe bhavati vibhrama prakāśakatvatadrūpānapāyāt, na tvepa śabdasya doṣa
na ca tatpravṛttau tat tadviṣayaṃ vijñānaṃ notpādayatītyabhidhātavyam; pratītivirodhāt
yadapyuktam–vikalpayonayaḥ śabdāḥ ityādi, tat savikalpakasiddhau kṛtottaratvādupekṣate
tataḥ pramāṇaṃ śabdaḥ arthopalabdhinimittatvāt pratyakṣādivata, svaparapakṣasādhanadūṣaṇasamarthatvācca samyagjñānavat, tathā sakalatattvavipratipattinivṛttinimittatvāt yogijñānavat
na khalu deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭā'khilārthānāṃ śabdādanyato vipratipattinivṛttiḥ saṃbhavati tadupāyāntarā'saṃbhavāt
liṅgaṃ tadupāyāntaraṃ saṃbhavatīti cet; na; tatpratibaddhaliṅgasya kasyacidapyapratipatteḥ
śabdārthayornityasambandhasaṃbhavānnāsti puruṣakṛta saṅketa iti mīmāsakasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanvastu śabdasyārthe sambandhaḥ, sa tu anitya, nityo vā syāt ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; anityasya sambandhasya karttumaśakyatvāt
samayo hi kriyamāṇaḥ pratipuruṣam, pratiśabdam, pratyartha sargādau sakṛdeva kriyate prakārāntarāsaṃbhavāt
vyāgyā– iyamasya saṃjñeti samaya, sa pratyartha pratipuruṣa vā kriyeta, pratipuruṣameva pratyuccāraṇa pratiprayogaṃ vā
athavā jagadādau jagata sṛṣṭikāle kenacit īśvarādinā dhātrā sakṛt ekayaiva helayā kriyateti trayo vikalpā
prathamapakṣe puruṣeṇa pratipuruṣaṃ sambandhaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ kimekaḥ kriyate, aneko vā ? yadyekaḥ, kathaṃ kṛtakaḥ ? pūrvamapyasya sadbhāvato'kṛtakatvaprasiddheḥ
athānekaḥ; kathamekārthasaṅgatiḥ ? yathā gośabdasya sāsnādimānarthaḥ kesarādimānaśvaśabdasyeti
ekatve tāvatkṛtataiva na syāt, na hi ekasya bahubhi kriyā saṃbhavatītyāha ekatva iti
ekatvapakṣe jātivaddeśakālabhedānuyāyitvātkṛtako na syāt, nitya eva syāditi yāvat
gaganaikaparamāṇvādīnāmekatvasya nityatvāvinābhūtatvāt, ekatva hyekarūpatvam, tacca kriyamāṇatve vinaśyati –ā॰ ṭi॰

kiñca, pratipuruṣaṃ sambandhakaraṇe kimekastatkarttā, bahavo vā ? yadyekaḥ; tadāsau deśāntaravyavasthitānāṃ katha samayaṃ vidadhyāt ? tatra tatra gatvā'sau karoti cet, tarhi puruṣāyuṣeṇāpi tatkaraṇānupapattiḥ teṣāmanantatvāt

athaikaḥ sannihiteṣu bahuṣu samayaṃ karoti, te ca kṛtasamayā anyeṣāṃtaṃ kariṣyanti, te'ṣyanyeṣām, ityevaṃ sarvatra vyavahāraḥ upapatsyate, tanna, teṣāṃ prayojanābhāvataḥ sarvatra gamanānupapatteḥ, ato yatraiva te na gacchanti tatra vyavahāro na prāpnoti
atha bahavaḥ samayasya karttāraḥ, tarhi sakaladeśakāleṣu ekarūpatā samayasya na prāpnoti, tasyāṃ nimittābhāvāt
na ca te sarve sabhūya paryālocya vā ekameva samayaṃ kurvantī tyabhidhātavyam; parasparānapekṣāṇāṃ svātantryeṇa samayaṃ kurvatāṃ tathā tatkaraṇānupapatteḥ
yathā'smindeśe sāsnādimati gośabda eva sarveṣu durgameṣvapi
bahava sambandhāra katha sagasyante ? eko na śaknuyāt
bahubhi kṛtasambandhe na caiko gamako bhavet
pratiśabdamapi uccārya samayaḥ kriyeta, anuccārya vā ? na tāvadanuccārya; asya nirāśrayatvaprasaṅgāt
na ca nirāśrayaḥ sambandho yuktaḥ atiprasaṅgāt
nāpi uccārya, puruṣāyuṣeṇāpi tathā sambandhasya karttumaśakyatvāt
kiñca, pratiśabdamuccārya abhinavaḥ sambandho vidhīyate, prāktana eva vā ? abhinavasya vidhāne kathamasya arthapratyāyanasāmarthyāvagatiḥ ? tadanavagatau ca sambandhakaraṇānupapattiḥ
ekasya hi vastuno jñaptireva asakṛdāvarttate na tūtpattiḥ

tulanā–pratyūccāraṇa prāktana eva kriyate, nūtano vā ? navasya tāvatkriyamāṇasya kathamarthapratyāyanasāmarthyamavagamyate tadavagatau vā kiṃ tatkaraṇena ? pūrvakṛtasya tadakṛtatvādeva puna karaṇamanupapannam
nāpi pratyarthaṃ sambandhaḥ karttuṃ śakyaḥ; arthānāmānantyād vidūratvācca
na hi sambandhavyatirikta kaścitkālo'sti, yasminna kaścidapi śabda kenacidarthena sambaddha āsīt
sargādau hi kriyā nāsti tādṛkkālo hi neṣyate

tatpratītiśca pramāṇatrayasampādyā, tathāhi–yadaiko'nyasmai pratipannasaṅketāya pratipādayati devadatta gāmabhyāja śuklāṃ daṇḍena iti, tadā pārśvastho'nyo'vyutpannasaṅketaḥ śabdārthau pratyakṣataḥ pratipadyate, śrotuśca tadviṣayakṣepaṇādiceṣṭopalambhādanumānato gavādiviṣayāṃ pratipattiṃ pratipadyate, tatpratipattyanyathānutpattyā ca śabdasyaiva tatra vācikāṃ śaktiṃ parikalpayatīti
devadattasya śrotu devadatta gāmabhyājeti vākyāt gokṣepaṇaviṣayiṇī pratītirjātā tadvākyaśravaṇānantarameva gokṣepaṇaceṣṭā'nyathānupapatte
devadatta gāmabhyājeti vākye gavādiviṣayakakṣepaṇārthavācikā śaktirasti tatastatpratītyanyathānupapatte
yanyathānupapattyā tu vetti śakti dvayāśritām | mī॰ ślo॰ sambandhā॰ 140-41 iti

vyākhyā–śabdavṛdvābhidheyānisambandhapratipatteraya nyāya kumārilena varṇita–yasmāt prathamaṃ tāvat pratyakṣeṇa śabda vṛddha ca śabdasyākhyātāram abhidheyañca vācya vastu paśyati, tata paścādanumānena ceṣṭālakṣaṇena liṅgena śrotu pratipannatva paśyati avadhārayatītyartha
tataśca paścādarthāpattyā dvyāśritā śabdārthāśritāṃ śaktiṃ vetti
vṛddhānā svārthe savyavaharamāṇānāmupaśṛṇvanto bālā pratyakṣamartha pratipadyamānā dṛśyante

kiñcāntyupāyo bālānām, nāvaśya sambandhakathanavākyenaiva vṛddhebhyo bālā sambandhaṃ pratipadyante kintu yadā vṛddhā prasiddhasambandhā svakāryārthena vyavaharanti tadā teṣāmupaśṛṇvanto bālāḥ sambandhaṃ pratipadyante

yadā hi kenacit gāmānayaṃ ityukta kaścit sāsnādimantamānayati tadā samīpasyo vālo'vagacchati–yasmādaya- metasmādvākyādayamartha pratyāyita ityeva sammugdharūpeṇāvagata pratyāyakatva paścādvahuṣu prayogeṣu anvayavyatirekābhyā vākyabhāgānā padānāṃ padabhāgānāñca prakṛtipratyayānā vākyārthabhāgeṣu padārtheṣu vivicyate tasmānna pauruṣeya sambandhaḥ –śāstradī॰ pṛ॰ 463
yattāvaduktam–anityo nityo vā ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tatsambandhasya nityarūpatayā vicāryamāṇasyānupapattito nityatvānupapatteḥ
yad yadrūpatayā vicāryamāṇaṃ nopapadyate na tat tadrūpatayā'bhyupagantavyam yathā jagadadvaitarūpatayā, nityarūpatayā vicāryamāṇo nopapadyate ca śabdārthayoḥ sambandha iti

na cāsya tadrūpatayā vicāryamāṇasyānupapadyamānatvamasiddham, tathāhi–tatsambandhasya nityatvaṃ svabhāvataḥ, sambandhinityatvādvā syāt ? yadi svabhāvata; tarhi sarvadā sarvasya arthamasau prakāśayatu svarūpatastasya prakāśakatvāt
nahi pradīpaḥ svarūpato rūpaprakāśakaḥ san kañcitprati tat prakāśayati kañcinneti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ

atha saṅketavyakto'sau tatprakāśakaḥ tenāyamadoṣaḥ; kathamevamasya nityaikarūpatā, vyaktāvyaktarūpatayā bhedaprasaṅgāt ? nityaika rūpaṃ hi vastu yadi vyaktaṃ tadā sarvadā vyaktameva abhinnasvabhāvatvāttasya
tulanā–asau nityaḥ san svabhāvato'rthaṃ prakāśayet, saṅketābhivyaktervā –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 701
na cecchabdārthayoḥ sāṅketiko vācyavācakatā sambandhaḥ kintu svābhāvika, tadā'gṛhītasaṅketo'pi śrutācchabdādarthaṃ pratipadyeteti
yadyarthapratipādane śabdasya svabhāvena śakti syāt; evantarhi sandehalakṣaṇamasyāprāmāṇya syāt iṣṭe'niṣṭe cārthe prakāśanaśaktisabhavāt
yadi cāsya svabhāvata eva sā śakti kiṃ saṅketena ? –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1
sāsiddhike hi tathātve bhramitvādiprayuktādanyato vā yata kutaścidabhinavādapi dīpādiva śabdādarthapratipatti syāt
saṅketa khalvenamabhivyaktime ti tarhi siddhopasthāyī kimakāraṇa poṣyate ? –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 1

yathā dīpasyārthaprakāśane śaktasyendriyāpekṣā tathā śabdasyendriyāpekṣā tathā śabdasyāpi saṅketāpekṣeti cet, na, pradīpendriyayo pratyekamabhāve'pyarthaprakāśakatvābhāvāt tatrānyonyāpekṣatva yuktaṃ naiva śabdaśaktisaṅketayo, saṅketamātreṇaivārthapratīterutpatte tasmānna svabhāvata śabdo'rthapratipādanasamartha ityutpattilakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyam
atha saṅketābhivyakte, kathamasya nityaikarūpatvamupapanna vyaktāvyaktarūpatayā bhedaprasakte
kiñca, saṅketaḥ puruṣāśrayaḥ, sa ca atīndriyārthajñānavikalatayā anyathāpi vede saṅketaṃ kuryāt ato mithyātvalakṣaṇamasyā'prāmāṇyaṃ syāt
kiṃ hyasyāpauruṣeyatayā ? yato hi samayādarthapratipatti, sa pauruṣeyaḥ vitatho'pi syāt, śīla sādhana svargavacanam, anyathā samayena viparyāsayet tenāyathārthamapi prakāśanasaṃbhavāt
arthajñāpanaheturiha saṅketa svīkarttavya, sa ca puruṣakṛtatvātpuruṣāśraya
ata saṅketasya puruṣāśrayatvāt girāmapauruṣeyatve'pi mithyātvasya sambhavaḥ
sa ca doṣāśrayeṇa puruṣeṇa kriyata iti tāsā na visavādaśaṅkānirāsa pauruṣeyavākyavaditi vyarthamapauruṣeyatvakalpanam

kiñca, nityasambandhavaśāt śabdaḥ ekarthaniyataḥ, anekārthaniyato vā syāt ? ekārthaniyataścet; kimekadeśena, sarvātmanā vā ? sarvātmanaikārthaniyame arthāntare vedāt pratipattirna syāt, tataścāsyājñānalakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyam
cauraśabdo vā nityasambandhāt taskare rūḍhaḥ kathaṃ dākṣiṇyaiḥ odane prayuktaḥ tamabhidadhyāt
athaikadeśenāsau tanniyataḥ; sa kimekadeśaḥ abhimataikārthaniyataḥ, anabhimataikārthaniyato vā ? anabhimataikārthaniyame mithyātvalakṣaṇaṃ vedasyā'prāmāṇyaṃ syāt
athā'bhimataikārthaniyataḥ; kiṃ puruṣāt, svabhāvādvā ? prathamapakṣe asyāpauruṣeyatvasamarthanaprayāso vyarthaḥ
puruṣo hi rāgādyandha tvāt pratikṣipyate tasmācced vedaikadeśo'rthaniyamaṃ pratipadyeta kimapauruṣeyatvena ? svabhāvādabhimataikārthaniyame tu bhāvanādyarthabhedānupapatti
anekārthaniyatatve tu vedasya sakalārthasādhāraṇatvāt kathamiṣṭavyaktāveva samayakāraḥ samaya kuryāt ?
tulanā–kiñca vācā kimekenārthena saha vācyavācakasambadha, athānekai ? girāmekārthaniyame na syādarthāntare gati
girāmekasminnarthe vācakatayā niyame sati saketavaśādanyatrārthe na syād gati, dṛśyate ca vivakṣāto'nekārthābhidhānam
anekairarthairvācakatvābhisambandhe viruddhasyārthasya vyakte pratīte sabhava syāt

yadi puna śabdasya vastuni svata eva yogyatva ko doṣo yena saṅketastatrāpekṣyate ? iti ceducyate–tatsarvaviṣaya niyataviṣayaṃ vā ? pūrvavikalpe tato yugapatsarvārthapratītiprasaṅgāt tathā ca na tato niyataviṣayapravṛttyādiriti vyavahāravilopa
tata āha –na sarvayogyatā sādhvī saṅketānniyamo yadi
tulanā–ya evārtho vastusthityā svargasādhana kintatraiva samayakāreṇagnihotrādiśabdo'bhivyakta kimbā'nyasminneva svargasādhanaviruddhe buddhimāndyāditi sandeha eva
tulanā–sa iti śabda sarvasmin vācakatvenāniyata niyama kvacidarthe puruṣāt puruṣasaṅketāt pratipadyate
sa ca puruṣo viruddhepyarthe saṅketa kuryāt
yāpīyamapauruṣeyatā vedasyeṣṭā tasyā vyarthā syāt parikalpanā
athānekā- rthābhidhāyyapi śabda puruṣeṇa saṅketādabhimatārthābhidhāyitvena niyamyate tadā–apauruṣeyatāyāñca vyarthā syātparikalpanā
tulanā–prakṛtyaiva svabhāvenaiva vaidikā śabdā niyatā abhimate'rthe tato na puruṣasaskārakṛto doṣa iti cet, eva satyarthaprakāśane nopadeśamapekṣeran, apekṣante ca, svatastebhyo'rthapratīterabhāvāta
yadi ca te svabhāvata eva pratiniyatā syu tadā yatra kvacidarthe ekadā samitā puna kathañcit tato'nyathā saṅketenārthāntara na prakāśayeyu, prakāśayanti ca tato na prakṛtyaikārthaniyatā iti

svabhāvataścaikārthaniyame yo'ya vaidikeṣu vākyeṣu vyākhyātṝṇā vyākhyāvikalpaśca aparāparavyākhyābhedaśca na syāt ekārthapratiniyamāt, bhavati ca, tasmāt pauruṣeyavākyavannaikārthaniyatā vaidikā śabdā iti
bhāvanāvidhiniyogarūpeṇa bhāṭṭavedāntiprābhākārāṇā vedārthaviṣaye vyākhyābhedo na syāditi bhāva
khādet śvamāsamityeṣa nārtha ityatra kā pramā || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 318
vyākhyā teneti aparijñātārthatvena agnihotra juhuyāt svargakāma iti śrutau vedavākye khādecchvamāsamityeṣa nārtha kintvanyo'bhimato'rthaṃ ityatra kā pramā ? naiva kiñcitpramāṇam
agni hantīti agniha śvā tasyotra māsa juhuyāt khādet
athavā agati gacchatītyagni śvā hūyate'dyate yattat hotra māsam agnerhotramityagnihotra śvamāsa tajjuhuyāt khādet svargakāma pumān dvija
nāpi sambandhinityatvāt, yataḥ ko'tra nitya sambandhī–śabda, arthaḥ, dvayaṃ vā ? na tāvacchabdaḥ, tasyāgre'nityatvaprasādhanāt

atha sāmānyaṃ tadarthaḥ, tacca nityam, atastadāśritaḥ sambandho'pi nitya ityucyate, tadasat; sāmānyasya tadarthatvānupapatteḥ, tadvāneva śabdārthaḥ ityagre samarthayiṣyamāṇatvāt, paraparikalpitasāmānyasya niṣiddhatvācca
astu vā kutaścinnityaḥ sambandhaḥ; tathāpyasau kimaindriyaḥ, atīndriyaḥ, anumānagamyo vā syāt ? natāvadaindriyaḥ, nityasvabhāvasya kvacidapīndriye'pratibhāsamānatvāt
athātīndriyaḥ, kathamarthapratipattyaṅgam ajñātasya jñāpakatvavirodhāt ? nājñātaṃ jñāpakaṃ nāma ityabhidhānāt

athāsyāpratyakṣatve'pi anumānāt pratibandhagraho bhaviṣyati, nanu kimata evā'numānāt, tadantarādvā tadgrahaḥ syāt ? yadyata eva, anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi anumāne tadgrahasiddhiḥ, tatsiddheścānumānasiddhiriti
anumānāntarāttatsiddhau anavasthā, tatrāpi tadgrahasya anumānāntarāt prasiddheḥ
tulanā–kiñcāsau sambandha aindriya atīndriya anumānagamyo vā syāt
tulanā–na ca nitya sambandha śabdārthayo pramāṇenāvasīyate, pratyakṣeṇa tasyānanubhavāt, tadabhāve nānumānenāpi, tasya tatpūrvakatvābhyupagamāt
kiṃ kāraṇam ? aprasiddhasya svena rūpeṇa aniścitasya ajñāpakatvāt
na hi yena saha yasya sambandho na gṛhyate taddvāreṇa tasya pratītiryuktā
sambandhasya sannidhimātreṇa sattāmātreṇārthajñāpane'bhyupagamyamāne śabdārthasambandha pratyavyutpannānāmapi arthasyāya vācaka iti pratipatti syāt
na hi kvacid dṛṣṭānte sambandhakāryā arthapratīti pratipannā
kiṅkāraṇam ? tatrāpi dṛṣṭāntatvenopanīte sambandhasyātīndriyatvena kāraṇena sādhanāpekṣaṇāt
nityasambandhasya hi liṅgam–arthajñānam, arthaḥ, śabdo vā ? na tāvadarthajñānam; sambandhāsiddhau tatkāryatvenāsyā'niścayāt
nāpyarthaḥ; tasya tena sambandhāsiddhe, nahi sambandhārthayostādātmyaṃ saṃbhavati ghaṭādyarthavat sambandhasyānityatvaprasaṅgāt
tato nityasambandhasya kutaścidaprasiddheḥ anitya evā'sau abhyupagantavyaḥ
tasya hi liṅga jñānamartha śabdo vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 430
pratipanne hi sambandhe tasya kāryamarthajñāna niścīyate, sa cādyāpi na siddha –ā॰ ṭi॰
na hi tatra sambandhaviśeṣe śabdarūpamartho vā liṅgam
sarvasya śabdasya sarvasminnarthe vācakatvena yogyatvāt sarvasya cārthasya sarvasmin śabde vācyatvena yogyatvāt
arthaviśeṣapratīteśca kāraṇa sambandhaviśeṣaḥ, tasya ca arthaviśeṣapratītisamāśrayasya sambandhasya aniyatābhyā śabdārthābhyāmapratyāyanāt
yadapi tadanityatve pratipuruṣam ityādi dūṣaṇamuktam, tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; anāditvāt śābdavyavahārasya
nahi sarvathā sato jagato nirmūlanāśalakṣaṇo mahāpralayaḥ asataścātmalābhalakṣaṇā sṛṣṭiḥ asmākaṃ bhavatāṃ vā prasiddhā yena apūrvasṛṣṭiprādurbhāvāśrayaṇena samaya pratimartya vā ityādyuktaṃ śobheta
nityatve'pi ca tatsambandhasya abhivyaktiranityā'bhyupagantavyā, atastatrāpīdaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ tulyam

athāgnidhūmatvasāmānyayornityasvarūpayoḥ sambandhitvena tatsambandhanityatvasabhavāt noktavikalpānāṃ tatrāvakāśaḥ; tadapyapeśalam; kevalasāmānyayoḥ sambandhitvasya vyāptivicārapraghaṭṭake pratiṣiddhatvāt
ato yathā sādṛśyapradhānatayā sādṛśyopalakṣitānāṃ sādhyasādhanavyaktiviśeṣāṇāmanantānāmapi vyāptijñānena kroḍīkaraṇa tathā vācyavācakavyaktiviśeṣāṇāmapi
ataḥ sambandhastripramāṇakaḥ mī॰ ślo॰ pṛ॰ 680 yattvayocyate, tatra śabdavṛddhābhidheyāni pratyakṣeṇātra paśyati iti yuktam
śrotuśca pratipannatvamanumānena ceṣṭayā ityapyupapannam, anyathānupapattyā tu vetti śaktiṃ dvayāśritām ityetattvanupapannam, nityaśaktau sambandhākhyāyāmanyathānupapatterabhāvāt
nāgnitvadhūmatvayoravinābhāvo gṛhyate kintu agnitvaviśiṣṭāgninā saha dhūmatvaviśiṣṭadhūmasyāvinābhāva gṛhyate iti bhāva

sādhyasādhanavyaktīnāmānantye'pi sādṛśyād vyāptijñānena kroḍīkṛti eva vācyavācakavyaktīnāmapi sādṛśyavaśāttena kroḍīkaraṇam, asti hyatrāpi sādṛśyam, ghaṭaśabdavācyo'ya pṛthubudhnodarādyākāratvāt pūrvopalabdhaghaṭāntaravat
tulanā–ataeva ca sambandhastripramāṇaka iti yattvayocyate tadasmābhirna mṛṣyate
śabdavṛddhābhidheyāśca pratyakṣeṇātra paśyatīti satya śrotuśca pratipannatvamanumānena ceṣṭayetyetadapi satyam
anyathānupapattyā tu vetti śaktiṃ dvayāśritāmityetattu na satyam, anyathāpyupapatterityuktatvāt
yathāhi vahnidhūmayo jñāpyajñāpakaśaktiranityā'pi anumeyārthapratipattiprayojikā tathaiva śabdārthayo vācyavācakaśaktirapi
sūtrāṇā sānutantrāṇāṃ bhāṣyāṇāñca praṇetṛbhi || vākyapa॰ 1 | 23 iti;
nitya śabda nityo'rtha nitya sambandha ityeṣā śāstravyavasthā
vyākaraṇa eva ye sūtrādīnā praṇetāraste vyapadiśyante
na hyanityatve śabdādīnā śāstrārambhe kiñcidapi prayojanamasti
vyavahāramātra hyetadanarthaka na mahānta śiṣṭā samanugantumarhantīti tasmād vyavasthitasādhutveṣu śabdeṣu smṛtiśāstra pravṛttamiti
sambandhasyānityatvasamarthanāt, śabdasya tadarthasya cāgre anityatayā samarthayiṣyamāṇatvācca, sarvathā nityasya vastunaḥ kramayaugapadyābhyāmarthakriyākāritvābhāvapratipādanācca
