kathañcaivaṃvādinaḥ kāryerthe codanāyāḥ prāmāṇyaṃ syāt kāryasyā'nityatvāt ? tataḥ siddhaṃ kathañcidanityayogyatālakṣaṇasambandhavaśāt śrutasyārthapratipādakatvam
ya eva hi śabdāḥ satyarthe dṛṣṭāḥ te tadabhāve'pi dṛśyante, ataḥ śabdānāṃ vidhidvareṇā'rthābhidhāyakatvānupapatteḥ anyāpohamātrābhidhāyakatvamevopapannam
uktañca–aṣohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyāṃ na vastu vidhinodhyatevidhinocyate kṣaṇabhaṅgādhyāya ? iti

prayogaḥ–yadyatra pratibhāti tattasya viṣayaḥ yathā akṣaje savedane parisphuṭapratibhāsamānavapurarthātmā nīlādistadviṣayaḥ, śabdaliṅgaprabhave ca pratyaye bahirarthatattvarahitaṃ svarūpamātrameva pratibhāti atastadeva tasya viṣaya iti
tathāhi–śabdasya bahirartho viṣayo bhavan svalakṣaṇasvabhāvo bhavet, sāmānyasvarūpo vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; tatra saṅketābhāvataḥ śabdānāṃ pravṛttyanupapatteḥ
saṅketo hi saṅketavyavahārakālānuyāyisvarūpe'rthe vidhīyate, na ca svalakṣaṇasya tathāvidhaṃ svarūpaṃ saṃbhavati deśakālākārasaṅkucitatvena ananuyāyisvarūpatvāt
yaḥ saṅketavyavahārakālānanuyāyī na tatra vyavahāribhiḥ śabdaḥ saṅketyate yathā utpannamātrapradhvasini kvacidarthe, nānveti ca vivakṣitadeśādibhyaḥ śāvaleyādirdeśāntarādāviti

vikalpānā prativimbeṣvākāreṣu tanniṣṭheṣu tadvyāvṛttivastutvena vyavasthāviṣayatayā tadvyavahāravyavasthitiṣu saṅketakāle nibaddhyate tato vikalpapratibimbānā bāhyavyāvṛttātmatvena vyavahāraviṣayatvāt anyāpohaniṣṭhatvāt kāraṇāt uktā śrutiranyāpohakṛt
nanu śābde jñāne grāhyaṃ bāhyatayaiva pratīyate na jñānākāratayā ityāha–vyatirekīva yajjñāne bhātyarthapratibimbakam
yathā taimirikadṛṣṭeṣu keśeṣu bāhyabhrama eva vikalpākāre'pi vāhyavyavahāro'vidyāvaśādityarthaḥ

tatra yattadāropita vikalpadhiyā artheṣvabhinnaṃ rūpa tadanyavyāvṛttapadārthānubhavabalāyātatvāt svayañca anyavyāvṛttatayā prakhyānād bhrāntaiścānyavyāvṛttārthena sahaikyenādhyavasitatvāt anyāpoḍhapadārthādhigatiphalatvāccānyāpoḍha ityucyate

apoho bāhyatayā āropita ākāro'pohyate'neneti kṛtvāyadvā apohyate'sminnatyapoha svalakṣaṇam tasmānna vikalpānā svarūpeṇa bāhyo grāhyopi tu svākāreṇa sahaikīkṛta eva vāhyo viṣaya, sa cāsatyo'pohyate'nyadaneneti apoha ucyate
nanu ko'yamopoho nāma ? yathāvyavasāyaṃ bāhya eva ghaṭādirartho'poha ityabhidhīyate apohyate'smādanyadvijātīyamiti kṛtvā
yathāpratibhāsa buddhyākāro'pohaḥ apohyate pṛthakkriyate'smin buddhyākāre vijātīyamiti kṛtvā
yathātattva nivṛttimātra prasahyarūpo'poha apohanamamoha iti kṛtvā
tulanā–katha sa eva vyavaccheda śabdaliṅgābhyā vidhinā pratipādyate na vasturūpamiti gamyate ? – pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
anyāpohaviṣayā ācāryeṇa proktā apoha śabdaliṅgābhyā pratipādyate iti bruvatā
śabdaliṅgaprabhavapratyayayo bahirartharahita svarūpamātrameva viṣaya tatra svarūpamātrasyaiva pratibhātatvāt
tathāhi–asmābhiriṣyata evaipāmantarjalpavāsanāprabodho nimittam, na tu viṣayabhūta bhrāntatvena pūrvasya śabdapratyayasya nirviṣayatvāt
etadevāgamena saspadayannāha yasya yasyetyādi–yasya yasya hi śabdasya yo yo viṣaya ucyate
sa sa savidyate naiva vastūnā sā hi dharmatā
tadā svalakṣaṇa nāsti saṅketastena tatra na
tadā vyavahārakāle tatsvalakṣaṇa nāsti yatra saṅketa kṛta

ekasyāpi svalakṣaṇasya kṣaṇikatvāt kālāntare tenaiva rūpeṇānugamo nāsti, akṣaṇikatve vā saṅketajñānābhāvādeva tadviṣayatvasya kālāntare'nugamo nāsti kimuta deśakālabhinneṣu svalakṣaṇeṣu, tena kāraṇena tatra svalakṣaṇeṣu sakato na kriyate
etadukta bhavati– samayo hi vyavahārārtha kriyate na vyasanitayā, tena yasyaiva saṅketavyavahārāptakālavyāpakatvamasti tatraiva samayo vyahartṝṇā yukto nānyatra
ekaparamāṇvākāratayā ekakṣaṇasyāyitayā niraśatayā ca na deśakālākārāntaravyāpti svalakṣaṇasyeti bhāva
tasya deśakālabhedeṣvanāskandanāt, tasyeti saṅketakāladṛṣṭasya vyavahārāvasthānādiṣu deśakālabhedeṣu anāskandanāt ananugamāt
na hi ekatra dṛṣṭo bhedo'nyatra sabhavati
yo hi vivakṣitadeśe so'nya yaśca deśāntara yāti so'nya kṣaṇikatvāt –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, asyedamabhidhānam iti yasmin jñāne sambandhaḥ pratibhāti na tatra jñāne pratiniyatendriyaviṣayayoḥ śabdārthasvalakṣaṇayoḥ pratibhāsaḥ
na ca tatrāpratibhāsanayoḥ stayostena sambandhakaraṇaṃ yuktamatiprasaṅgāt

yau asyedamiti sambandhakāriṇi jñāne na pratibhāsete na tayostena jñānena sambandhakaraṇaṃ yathā gośabdatadarthayoḥ sambandhajñāne'pratibhāsamānayoḥ aśvaśabdatadarthayoḥ na tena jñānena sambandhakaraṇam, na pratibhāsete ca svendriyajñānapratibhāsinau śabdārthasvabhāvau asyedamiti sambandhakāriṇi jñāne iti
yo yena sahā'kṛtasambandho na sa tamartha pratyāyayati yathā aśvena sahākṛtasambandho gośabdaḥ, akṛtasambandhaśca svalakṣaṇena sarvaḥ śabda iti
svalakṣaṇaviṣayatve ca śābdapratyayasya indriyaprabhavapratyayavat spaṣṭapratibhāsaprasaṅgaḥ, na caivam, pratītivirodhāt
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yadyagṛhītasaṅketamartha śabda pratipādayettadā gośabdo'pyaśva pratipādayet, saṅketakaraṇānarthakyañca syāt, tasmādatiprasaṅgāpatti bādhakam

prayoga–ye yatra bhāvata kṛtasamayā na bhavanti na te paramārthatastamabhidadhati yathā sāsnādimati piṇḍe'śvaśabdo'kṛtasamaya, na bhavanti ca bhāvata kṛtasamayā sarvasminvastuni sarve dhvanya iti vyāpakānupalabdhe kṛtasamayatvenābhidhāyakatvasya vyāptatvāt
vyākhyā–anyadeva rūpādisvalakṣaṇamindriyagrāhyam, tasmādanya śabdasya gocaro viṣaya iti gṛhyatām
śabdātpratyeti bhinnākṣaḥ pradhvastanayana, na tu pratyakṣa yathā bhavati tathekṣate
tathātve indriyāgnisambandhādivad dāhaśabdādapi dāhārthapratipattiḥ syādityāha–anyathaiva –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 584
anyadevendriyagrāhya svalakṣaṇam, anyacchabdasya gocara sāmānyalakṣaṇam, kuta ? śabdānpratyeti bhinnākṣa anvo'pi ghaṭādi, na tu pratyakṣamīkṣate cakṣuṣmāniva

etadeva bhāvayati–anyathā spaṣṭānubhavena dāhasambandhāt indriyārthayogena dāha svagata dagdho'bhimanyate, eva pumānna jānāti, anyathā svaspaṣṭānanubhavata dāhaśabdena tena dāhārtha sapratīyate śrotrā

vyākhyā–dāhādyartha pratīyate–yadi śabdena yathāvadvāhyo'rthaḥ pratyāyyeta tadā śabdasannighāpito'sau tāmārthakriyā kathanna kuryāt yataścāgnisambandhādṛgdho dāhamanyathā'nubhavati dāhaśabdena ca dāhamanyathā'vagacchatīti śabdārthayornāsti kaścidvāstava samanvaya iti boddhavyam
yathā hyuṣṇādyarthaviṣayendriyabuddhi sphuṭapratibhāsā vedyate na tathoṣṇādiśabdabhāvinī
anyathā dāhaśabdena dāhārthaḥ sampratīyate || vākyapa॰ 2 | 425 iti
nacaikasya vastuno rūpadvayamasti yena aspaṣṭaṃ vastugatameva rūpaṃ śābdapratyaye pratibhāseta, ekasya dvitvavirodhāt
prayogaḥ–yatkṛte pratyaye yanna pratibhāsate na tattasya viṣayaḥ yathā rūpaprabhavapratyaye rasaḥ, na pratibhāsate ca śabdapratyaye svalakṣaṇamiti
yenāspaṣṭa vastugatameva rūpa śabdairabhidhīyate iti syāt, ekasya dvitvavirodhāt
na hi spaṣṭāspaṣṭe dve rūpe parasparaviruddhe ekasya vastuna sta yata ekenendriyabuddhau pratibhāseta anyena vikalpe
na sa tasya ca śabdasya yukto yogo na tatkṛte
pratyaye sati bhātyartho rūpabodhe yathā rasa
prayoga–yo hi tatkṛte pratyaye na pratibhāsate na sa tasyārtha yathā rūpajanite pratyaye rasa, na pratibhāsate ca śabde pratyaye svalakṣaṇamiti vyāpakānupalabdhi –tattvasa॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 280

vyākhyā–paramārtha svalakṣaṇam tasmin ekasthāna ekastāna pravṛttiryeṣā tadbhāvastattva tasmin sati śabdānāmanivandhanā paramārthanibandhanarahitā pravṛttirna syāt darśanāntarabhinneṣvartheṣu siddhāntabhedabhinneṣu

paramārthaikatānatve paramārthaikaparatve śabdānāmartheṣu darśanāntarabhediṣu pratidarśana bhinnābhyupagamena nityatvānityatvatriguṇīmayatvādikalpitabhedeṣu anibandhanā paramārthanibandhanarahitā pravṛttirna syāt
na hi parasparaviruddhā bahavo dharmā ekatra santi
na syāt pravṛttirartheṣu samayāntarabhediṣu || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 206 iti
nāpi sāmānyarūpaḥ; vāstavasya sāmānyasyaivā'saṃbhavāt, tadasaṃbhavaśca aśvaviṣāṇavadanarthakriyākāritvāt suprasiddhaḥ
na khalu nityaikasvabhāvasya kramayaugapadyābhyā marthakriyākāritvaṃ saṃbhavatītyuktaṃ sāmānyaniṣedhāvasare
na khalu loko'saketayan śabdānaprayuñjāno vā du khita syāt
vyasanāpanna atha kimiti cet, sarva evādheya ārambha phalārtha
tenāyamiṣṭāniṣṭasādhanāsādhana kṛtvā tatra pravṛttiṃ nivṛttiṃ vā kuryāṃ kārayeya veti niyoga ādriyeta śabdān vā niyuñjīta anyathopekṣaṇīyatvāt

nāpi jñānatadākārayoḥ; tayorapi svena rūpeṇa svalakṣaṇatvāt, tasya ca saṅketāviṣayatayā śabdagocaratānupapatteḥ, kintu sa eva jñānākāro dṛśyavikalpāvekīkṛtya bahīrūpatayā'dhyasto'rdhapañcamākāraḥ anyāpohaḥ
jātivyaktijñānatadākārā ete satyā, ardhapañcamākāra ardhatva tu dṛśyasya satyatvāt vikalpasyāsatyatvāt –ā॰ ṭi॰
vyākhyātāra eva vivecayanti na hi vyavaharttāra
te tu svālambanameva arthakriyāyogya manyamānā dṛśyavikalpyārthāvekīkṛtya pravartante
te hi yathāvasthita vastu vyavasthāpayantaḥ evaṃ vivecayanti
anyo vikalpabuddhipratibhāsa anyatsvalakṣaṇamiti, na vyavaharttāra eva vivecayanti
te tu vyavaharttāra svālambanameveti vikalpapratibhāsamevārthakriyāyogya bāhyasvalakṣaṇarūpa manyamānā

etadeva spaṣṭayati–dṛśyo'rtha svalakṣaṇam vikalpyo'rtha sāmānyapratibhāsa tāvekīkṛtya svalakṣaṇameveda vikalpabuddhyā viṣayīkriyate śabdena codyate ityevamadhimucyārthakriyākāriṇyarthe pravartante, tadabhiprāyavaśād vyavahartṝṇāmabhiprāyavaśādevamucyate vivekiṣu bhāveṣu vikalpabuddhirbhavatīti
dṛśyavikalpyāvekīkṛtya pravṛtteriti vadatā na svākāre bāhyāropa ityukta bhavati anyathā svākāra eva pravṛttiprasagāt marīcikāyā jalāropādiva
nāpi bāhye svākārāropa; āropyamāṇaphalārthitvenaiva pravṛttiprasagāt jalārthina iva jalabhrāntī
arthānubhave sati tatsaskāraprabodhena tadākāra utpadyamāno vikalpa svākāraṃ bāhyābhinnamadhyavasyati na tvabhinna karoti
tatra buddhyātmano viśeṣalakṣaṇam–svabhāvata parasparavilakṣaṇānarthānekārthakāritayā samānahetutvenāśritya yadekapratyavamarśarūpamarthapratibimbasvabhāvaṃ jñānamutpanna tasya apoha iti sajñā
vastubhāgacchāyo vikalpenollikhyamāno bāhyatvenā'bhimanyamāno vikalpākāraḥ svākāraviparītākāronmūlako'pohaḥ apohyate anena iti, vikalpāntaravarttyākārād bhedena svaya pratibhāsamānatvāt
apohyate anyasmāt ityanyāpohaḥ, ayaṃ hi mukhyatayaiva anyāpohaśabdābhidheyaḥ

tribhistu kāraṇaiḥ aupacārikaḥ–kāraṇe kāryadharmāropāt, kārye kāraṇadharmoṣacārādvā, vijātīyavyāvṛttasvalakṣaṇena sahaikatvādhyavasāyādvā ? kāryaṃ hi yathoktānyāpohasya anyavyāvṛttavastuprāptiḥ, atastatkāraṇatayā kāryadharmo'nyavyāvṛttiḥ tatrādhyāropyate

kārye kāraṇadharmo vā, kāraṇa hi ekapratyavamarśātmano'nyāpohasya anyāsasṛṣṭaṃ svalakṣaṇa tadanubhavena tasya janitatvāt, asti ca kāraṇabhūte svalakṣaṇe anyavyāvṛtti atastasyāḥ kāryabhūte pratyavamarśe upacāraḥ
vijātīyavyāvṛtta yatsvalakṣaṇaṃ tena saha pratyavamarśapratibhāsino rūpasya ekatvenādhyavasitatvādvā anyāpohateti prarūpitaḥ paryudāsarūpo'pohaḥ

tulanā–trividho hi vopoha–ekastāvad vyāvṛtta svalakṣaṇameva anyo'pohyate'sminniti kṛtvā, yadadhikṛtyāha–svabhāvaparabhāvābhyā yasmād vyāvṛttibhāgina itivyavacchedamātraṃ dvitīya anyāpohanamanyāpoha iti kṛtvā, vikalpabuddhipratibhāsastu tṛtīya apohyate'neneti kṛtvā, ayañca śabdasya nibandhanatayā'bhyupagamyate

yathā harītakyādayo bahavo'ntareṇāpi sāmānyameka jvarādiśamanalakṣaṇa kārya kurvanti tathā śābaleyādayo'pyarthāḥ satyapi bhede prakṛtyā ekākārapratyavamarśasya hetavo bhaviṣyantītyantareṇāpi vastubhūta sāmānyamiti

tānupāśritya iti–tānabhayādisamānarthānāśritya hetūkṛtya tadanubhavabalena yadutpanna vikalpaka jñāna tatra yadarthākāratayā'rthapratibimbakamarthā- bhāso bhāti tādātmyena tatrānyāpoha ityeṣā sajñā ukteti sambandha
atha katha tasyāpoha ityeṣa vyapadeśa ityāha–pratibhāsāntarādityādi
vikalpāntarāropitapratibhāsāntarād bhedena svayaṃ pratibhāsanāt mukhyata, apohyata ityapoha, anyasmādapoho'nyāpoha iti vyutpatte
aśliṣṭam anyāsambaddham anyato vyāvṛttamiti yāvat, tadeva vastu dvāramuṣāya, tadanubhavabalena tathāvidhavikalpotpatte
saha nibandhanena pratibhāsāntarād bhedādinoktena caturvidhena vartata iti sanibandhanā
prasajyarūpastu gaurayam agaurna bhavati iti vyavacchedamātraparyavasita iti
vācyavācakabhāvaśca kāryakāraṇabhāvānnānyaḥ; buddhisambandhino hi pratibimbasya śabdajanyatvāt tadvācyatvaṃ tajjanakatvācca śabdasya vācakatvamiti
tadeva trividhamapoha pratipādya prakṛte śabdārthatve yojayannāha–tatrāyamityādi
yadeva hi śābde jñāne pratibhāsate sa eva śabdārtho yuktaḥ
na cātra prasajyapratiṣedhādhyavasāyo'sti, na cāpīndriyajñānavat svalakṣaṇapratibhāsaḥ
kiṃ tarhi ? bāhyārthādhyavasāyinī kevalaṃ śābdī buddhirupajāyate
tena tadevārthapratibimbakaṃ śābde jñāne sākṣāttadātmatayā pratibhāsanācchadārtho yukto nānya iti bhāvaḥ
evaṃ tāvatpratibimbalakṣaṇo'pohaḥ sākṣācchabdairupajanyamānatvānmukhyaḥ śabdārtha iti darśitam
na tadātmā parātmeti sambandhe sati vastubhiḥ
na tu sākṣādayaṃ śābdo dvividho'poha ucyate
kasmātpunaḥ sāmarthyena prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ pratīyata iti darśayannāha–na tadātmeti
tasya gavādipratibimbasyātmā yaḥ parasya aśvādipratibimbasyātmā svabhāvo na bhavatīti kṛtvā
evaṃ prasajyalakṣaṇāpohasya nāntarīyakatayā pratītergauṇaṃ śabdārthatvaṃ pratipādya svalakṣaṇasyāpi pratipādayannāha–sambandhe satītyādi
tatra sambandhaḥ śabdasya vastuni pāramparyeṇa kāryakāraṇabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ pratibandhaḥ

prathamaṃ yathāvasthitavastvanubhavaḥ tato vivakṣā tataḥ tālvādiparispandaḥ tataḥ śabda ityevaṃ paramparayā śabdasya vastubhiḥ bāhyairagnyādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ syāttadā tasmin sambandhe sati vijātīyavyāvṛttasyāpi vastuno'rthāpattito'dhigamo bhavati
ato dvividho'pi prasajyapratiṣedhaḥ anyavyāvṛttavastvātmā cāpohaḥ śabdārtha ityupacaryate
nanu saugataistādātmyatadutpattirūpa eva sambandha iṣyate tatkimatra vācyavācakabhāvo'pīṣyate ityāha –ā॰ ṭi॰
yaścāpi śabdasyārthena sa vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ prasiddhaḥ nāsau kāryakāraṇabhāvādanyo'vatiṣṭhate, api tu kāryakāraṇabhāvātmaka eveti darśayati–tadrūpapratibimbasyetyādi
śabdaḥ pratibimbasya janakatvādvācaka ucyate, tacca pratibimbaṃ śabdena janyamānatvādvācyam

yattāvaduktam–apohaḥ śabdaliṅgābhyām ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ pramāṇataḥ kutaścittatsiddhau tasya tadviṣayatvaṃ yuktam, na cāsau kutaścit pramāṇātprasiddhaḥ; tathāhi–apohaḥ pratyakṣataḥ siddhyet, anumānādvā ? na tāvatpratyakṣataḥ; svalakṣaṇaviṣayatvāttasya
tādātmyatadutpattipratibandha prakāreṇa hi bhavanmate avinābhāvo vyavasthitaḥ

tathāhi–akṛtakatvavyāvṛtti kṛtakatvam, tat svalakṣaṇātmakam, nityavyāvṛttirūpā'nityatvātmakaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvatsvalakṣaṇātmakam; avasturūpatvāt, yadavasturūpa na tat svalakṣaṇātmaka yathā kharaviṣāṇam, avasturūpañca akṛtakatvavyāvṛttirūpatayā kṛtakatvamiti
yayo nīrūpatva na tayostādātmyasambandhaḥ yathā khapuṣpavandhyāsutayoḥ, nīrūpatvañca anyavyāvṛttisvabhāvayo kṛtakatvānityatvayoriti
tathāhi–yannīrūpa tanna kasyacijjanyaṃ janaka vā yathā kharaviṣāṇam, nīrūpañca sādhyasādhanatvenā'bhipreta prakṛtamanyāpohadvayamiti
nānyatra śabdavṛttiśca kiṃ dṛṣṭvā sa prayujyatām
pratyakṣaṃ na ca tacchaktaṃ na ca sto liṅgavācakau
yataḥ syād grahaṇaṃ tasya, liṅgādīnāñca kalpane
anyavyāvṛttirūpayo kṛtakatvānityatvayo tādātmya na bhavati nīrūpatvāt

nanu cārthābhāve'pi arthākāraṃ yat pratibimbamutpannaṃ tadevānyāpohaḥ, sa ca svasaṃvedanapratyakṣata eva siddhyati, ityanarthaka tatrānumānam; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, jñāne'rthākāradhāritvasya tannirākāratvasiddhau pratiṣiddhatvāt
astu vā tat, tathāpi–atra kasya pratibimbanam–svalakṣaṇasya, sāmānyasya vā ? na tāvatsvalakṣaṇasya, tasya vyāvṛttākāratvāt
anugataikarūpañca pratibimbam anyāpoho'bhipretaḥ, ataḥ svalakṣaṇenāpi tathāvidhenaiva bhavitavyam
tathāhi–yasya hi yadākāraṃ pratibimbaṃ tat svayamapi tadākārameva yathā mukhacandrādi, anugataikākārañca svalakṣaṇasya jñāne pratibimbamiti
atha sāmānyasya jñāne pratibimbanamiṣyate; tadapyasat, tasyā'sataḥ pratibimbanānupapatteḥ
yadasanna tat kvacit pratibimbati yathā khapuṣpam, asacca bhavanmate sāmānyamiti
yatra yat pratibimbati taddvayaṃ pratibimbodayātprāganyonyaviviktamupalabhyate yathā mukhādarśādi, pratibimbati ca jñāne sāmānyākāra iti
pratibimbādhārasya jñānasya pratibimbyasya ca sāmānyasya vivikta svarūpadvaya pratibhāseta iti bhāva
jñāna sāmānyañca vibhinnatayā upalabhyetām tatra pratibimbyamānatvāt
atha vāhadohādyekārthakriyākāritayā svalakṣaṇamevānuvṛttākāraṃ sat sāmānyam, ato noktadoṣāvakāśaḥ; tadayuktam; ekārthakriyāmakurvatastatkāritvābhāvataḥ pratibimbo dayābhāvānuṣaṅgāt
kiñca, ekārthakriyākāritvaṃ svalakṣaṇe yadyekamabhyupagamyate tadā bāhyāvabhāsitayopalabhyamānapratibhāsabalāt tadeva pratibhāsyamastu kiṃ pratibimbāgrahagraheṇa ?

kiñca, yadi svapratibimbamātrādhyavasāyitvaṃ śābdavikalpasya syāt tarhi ataḥ kuto bahirarthe pravṛttiḥ syāt ? svapratibhāse'narthe arthādhyavasāyāccet, nanu ko'yamarthādhyavasāyo nāma–bāhyasyārthasya grahaṇam, karaṇam, yojanam, samāropo vā ? prathamapakṣe paramatasiddhiḥ; śākyaiḥ śābdapratyayānāṃ bahirarthagrahaṇānabhyupagamāt
dvitīyapakṣopyanupapannaḥ; nahi bāhyārthakaraṇe jñānānāṃ sāmarthyam, svasāmagrītasteṣāmāvirbhāvāt, anyathā apratihatā sarvasya sarvārthasiddhiḥ syāt
tulanā–na, tadekīkaraṇāsiddhe, dṛśyavikalpyayoratyantabhinnatvāt, sādharmyāyogāt, ekasyobhayānubhaviturabhāvāt tadā dvayadarśanādarśanavikalpānupapatte
svākāramavāhya bāhyamadhyavasyan vikalpa svākārabāhyaviṣaya iti cet, yathāha–svapratibhāse'narthe'rthādhyavasāyena pravṛttiriti
atha ko'yamadhyavasāya–kiṃ grahaṇamāhosvit karaṇam uta yojanā atha samāropaḥ ? tatra svapratibhāsamanarthamartha katha gṛhṇīyāt kuryādvā vikalpa
na hi pīta nīla śakya grahītu vā śilpiśatenāpi
na ca svalakṣaṇa vikalpagocara iti copapāditam
jñānamātreṇaiva yadyarthasya samutpatti syāttadā asaṅkhyarūpyakaparijñānādeva asakhyarūpyakotpattau viśvamadaridra syāt
atha svākāraṃ vikalpo bāhyenārthena yojayati; tadasat; tathāpratīterasaṃbhavāt
nahyevaṃ kasyacit pratītiḥ yo'yamākāro madīyaḥ sa bāhyārthaviśiṣṭaḥ iti, bāhyārthena saha svākārasya sambandhābhāvato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvānupapatteḥ
svalakṣaṇarūpo bāhyorthaḥ tato nirvikalpakamiti tato nirvikalpaka tasmācca savikalpakamiti pāramparyeṇa vikalpāryayostadutpattisambandha –ā॰ ṭi॰
atha bāhyamarthaṃ vikalpa svākāre samāropayati; tadapyasāmpratam; samāropo hi ubhayagrahaṇe sati syāt, asati vā ? na tāvadasati; ubhayagrahaṇapurassaratvāttasya
yaḥ samāropaḥ sa ubhayagrahaṇapurassara yathā gorvāhīke samāropaḥ, samāropaśca vikalpākāre bāhyārthasyeti
na cedaṃ nidarśanaṃ sādhyavikalam; yenaiva hi gauranubhūtaḥ vāhīkaśca, sa taddharmān bahubhārodvahanādīn vāhīke niścitya gotvamāropayati gaurvāhīkaḥ iti
athobhayagrahaṇe sati āropa syāt; nanu ubhayorgrahaṇa vikalpena, nirvikalpena vā syāt ? na tāvannirvikalpena, asya svalakṣaṇagocaratayā anyāpohasvarūpavikalpākāre pravṛttyanupapatteḥ
nāpi vikalpena; asya bāhyārthaparāmarśaparāṅmukhatvāt, ataḥ kathamasau svākāre bāhya tatra vā svākāramāropayet ?
vikalpa eveti cet, na, tatra sāmānyāvabhāsāt anyathā vikalpatvāyogāt
anya iti cet, na, ātmavādāpatteḥ tattathādhyavasāyanimittābhāvācca
tadekatva hi darśanamadhyavasyati tatpṛṣṭhajo vyavasāyo jñānāntara vā

astu vā'syobhayagrahaṇam; tathāpi–pūrvaṃ svapratibhāsamanarthamanubhūya paścādarthamāropayati, yugapadeva vā svapratibhāsañcānubhavati arthañca samāropayati, kiṃ vā yāvadevoktaṃ bhavati–svākāramanubhavatīti tāvadevokta bhavati arthamadhyavasyatīti ? na tāvatsvarūpānubhavaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādarthasamāropaḥ, kṣaṇadvyāvasthānavikalpatvājjñānānām, anyathā kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ

atha yugapadeva svapratibhāsamanubhavati arthañca samāropayati, tarhi grāhyagrāhakākārātmake vikalpasvarūpe savedyamāne svānubhavasamānakāla evārthaḥ samāropyamāṇo vikalpasvarūpād bahirevā'vatiṣṭhate tatkathamātmānamanartham arthamāropayedasau ? atha svākārānubhava eva arthasamāropaḥ, tadapyasundaram; anubhavitavyavikalpayitavyayorbhedāt
śabdasasṛṣṭaṃ hi svarūpaṃ vikalpayitavyam, aśabdasaṃsṛṣṭa tu svasaṃvedanenānubhavitavyam, tatkathamanayorekatvam ?
na tāvadagṛhīta svākāra śakya āropayitumiti tadgrahameṣitavyam
tatkiṃ gṛhītvā āropayati, atha yadaiva gṛhṇāti tadaivāropayati
na tāvatpūrva pakṣa, na hi vikalpajñāna kṣaṇika kramavantau grahaṇasamāropau kartumarhati
uttarasmistu pakṣe vikalpasvasavedanapratyakṣādvikalpākārādahaṅkārāspadād anahaṅkārāspada samāropyamāṇo vikalpo nāsvagocaro na śakyo'bhinna pratipattum
nāpi bāhyasvalakṣaṇaikatvena śakya pratipattu vikalpajñānena svalakṣaṇasya bāhyasyāpratibhāsanāt

yadi yadaiva vikalpākāra svapratibhāsamanarthamanubhavati tadaivārthe samāropayati, tadā vikalpasya svānubhavavyāpṛtatvādartho'vakāśamalabhamāna tatsvarūpād bahirevāste vikalpe na saṅkrāmati, tatkathamātmani anarthabhūte artha vikalpākāra āropayatīti tātparyam

etena dṛśyavikalpyāvekīkṛtya bahīrūṣatayā'dhyastaḥ ityādi pratyuktam, tadekī karaṇañca kiṃ tenaiva jñānena, jñānāntareṇa vā ? na tāvattenaiva svākāraṃ dṛśyañca pṛthak pratipadyaikyaṃ pratīyate, tathā pratītyabhāvāt, kṣaṇikatvācca
nāpi jñānāntareṇa; taddhi ekam, anekaṃ vā ? yadyanekam; kathamaikyaṃ pratipadyeta ? svasaṃvedanena hi jñānasvarūpaṃ pratīyate darśanena tu dṛśyam
eka tu yadi dvayaṃ pratyeti, kathamaikyam ? athaikyaṃ pratyeti; kathaṃ dvayaṃ virodhāt ?
kiñca, ayamapoho bhāve bhāvasya pratīyate, kevalo vā ? prathamapakṣe bhāvayoḥ pratītiḥ kiṃ śabdādeva, pramāṇāntarādvā ? na tāvat śabdādeva; asya apohādanyatra pravṛttyanabhyupagamāt

abhyupagame vā kiṃ bhāvau pratītya ato'pohaḥ pratīyate, apohaṃ vā pratītya bhāvāviti ? tatrādyavikalpe nānyāpohaḥ śabdārthaḥ, mukhyato bhāvayoreva tadarthatvāt, pratītyuttarakālaṃ sāmarthyādeva vā anyavyāvṛtteḥ pratīteḥ
nīlañca pratītya anīlavyāvṛttipratītyabhyupagame skhalantī tatpratītiḥ syāt
dvitīyavikalpe tu pratītivirodhaḥ, na khalu kevalo'pohaḥ prathamaṃ śabdāt pratīyate paścād bhāvāviti kasyacitsvapne'pi pratītirastīti
etena pramāṇāntarādapi tatpratītiḥ pratyākhyātā, tato'pi bhāvayoḥ pratītau uktadoṣānuṣaṅgāviśeṣāt
astu vā kutaścidasya pratītiḥ, tathāpi–bhāvābhyāṃ bhinnasyāpohasya pratītau kathamasya bhāvasambandhitā syāt, bhāvābhāvayostādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇasambandhāsambhavāt ?
tulanā–yaścāyamanyāpoha agaurna bhavatīti gośabdasyārtha sa kiṃ bhāvo'tha abhāva iti ? –nyāyavā॰ pṛ॰ 329
bhāvasya pratiniyatamasādhāraṇa svarūpaṃ hi anyavyāvṛttyātmaka bhavatyeva
kevalo'pohaḥ pratīyate ityayamapi pakṣo'nenaiva prativyūḍhaḥ, yadi ca kevalo'pohaḥ śabdālliṅgādvā pratīyeta, tarhi sarvaśabdānāṃ paryāyatā syād apohamātrasyā'viśiṣṭasyāśeṣaśabdaiḥ pratipādanāt
evañca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhedaḥ atītādikālabhedaḥ strīpuṃnapuṃsaka liṅgabhedaḥ ekadvibahuvacanādibhedaśca durlabhaḥ
liṅgaliṅgibhedaśca dūrotsārita eva syāt, yadeva hi liṅgaśabdavācyamapohamātraṃ tadeva liṅgiśabdasyāpi
api ca ye vibhinnasāmānyaśabdā gavādayo ye ca viśeṣaśabdā śābaleyādayaste bhavadabhiprāyeṇa paryāyāḥ prāpnuvanti arthabhedābhāvāt vṛkṣapādapādiśabdavat
athāpohasya bhedābhyupagamānnāyaṃ doṣaḥ; tadayuktam, tasya bhedā'siddheḥ

tasya hi bhedaḥ apohyabhedād, vāsanābhedāt, vibhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvāt, vibhinnakāryakāritvāt, āśrayabhedāt, svarūpabhedādvā syāt ? na tāvadapohyabhedāt; sarva-prameyādiśabdānāmapohyabhedābhāvataḥ paryāyatāprasaṅgāt
na hi asarvaṃ sarvarāśervyatiriktam, aprameyaṃ vā kiñcidasti yadapohena sarvādikaṃ siddhyet
katha vā sattva-kṛtakatvādihetoḥ siddhiḥ ? na hi asadakṛtakaṃ vā jagati kiñcidasti yadapohena sattvādisādhana siddhyet
apohyabhedādapohabhede cānyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hyapohyabhede apohabhedasiddhi, tatsiddhau cāpohyabhedasiddhiriti
anubhavabhedanibandhano hi vāsanābheda, apohasya caikarūpatve anubhavabhedo durghaṭa
nāpi vibhinnasāmagrīprabhavatvādapohabhedaḥ, asya kalpitarūpatayā sāmagrīviśeṣataḥ prādurbhāvasyaivā'nupapatteḥ
yat kalpitarūpa tanna kutaścitprādurbhavati yathā turaṅgamottamāṅge śṛṅgam, kalpitarūpaśca bhavanmate apoha iti
yat kutaścidutpadyate tanna kalpitarūpaṃ yathā svalakṣaṇam, utpadyate ca sāmagrīviśeṣato'poha iti
yatra dvairāśya bhavati tatretarapratiṣedhāditara pratīyate yathā gauriti pade gau pratīyamāna agau pratiṣidhyamāna
na puna sarvapada etadasti, na hyasarva nāma kiñcidasti yatsarvapadena nivartyeta
agaurityasya ca bhedena gosāmānya ca bhidyate
etena vibhinnakāryakāritvāttadbhedaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ; aparamārthasato vibhinnakāryakāritvānupapatteḥ khapuṣpavat

kutaśca kāryakāraṇayorbhedaḥ siddho yataḥ tadbhedādapohasya bhedaḥ siddhyet–apohabhedāt, svarūpato vā ? apohabhedācced; anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi kāraṇabhede kāryabhede ca tatprabhavatayā tatkāritayā ca apohabhedasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca kāryakāraṇayorbhedasiddhiriti
yadavasturūpaṃ na tat kvacidāśritam yathā gagananalinam, avasturūpaścāpoha iti
āśritatve vā kimasau prativyakti bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā syāt ? yadi bhinnaḥ; tadā dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ madhye anyatamarūpataivāsyābhyupagatā syāt, prativyaktyanyasya āśritatvānupapatteḥ
athābhinnaḥ; tadā sāmānyarūpataiva nāmāntareṇoktā syāt ityubhayathāpyanyāpoharūpatānupapattiḥ
apoharūpasya sāmānyasya āśrayabhūtāni dravyaguṇakarmāṇyeva bhavitumarhanti, sāmānyasya dravyāditrayavṛttitvāt
atha svarūpabhedādapohasya bhedaḥ; tanna; aparamārthasattve'sya svarūpabhedānupapatteḥ
yadaparamārthasanna tasya svarūpabhedaḥ yathā khapuṣpakharaviṣāṇādeḥ, aparamārthasaṃścāpoha iti
kiñca, paryudāsarūpaḥ, prasajyarūpo vā'pohaḥ svarūpato bhinnaḥ śabdairabhidhīyeta ? yadi paryudāsarūpaḥ; tadāsya bhāvāntararūpatābhyupagantavyā
bhāvāntarañca viśeṣaḥ, sāmānyam, tadupalakṣito vā viśeṣaḥ, tatsamudāyo vā syāt iti pakṣacatuṣṭaye'pi vidhireva śabdārthaḥ syāt nā'pohaḥ
atha prasajyarūpaḥ; tadā niṣedhamātrameva śabdairabhihitaṃ syāt, taccāyuktaṃ tathāpratītyabhāvāt
parapratipādanārtho hi śabdaprayogaḥ, paraśca nīlārthī na anīlaniṣedhamātraṃ jijñāsate, ajijñāsitañca pratipādayataḥ pratipādakasyā'prekṣāpūrvakāritvaprasaṅgaḥ
kiñcāpohākhya sāmānya vācyatvenābhidhīyamāna paryudāsalakṣanañcābhidhīyeta, prasajyalakṣaṇa vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 432
yathā ghaṭa paṭāt svarūpato bhinna san bhāvāntara –ā॰ ṭi॰
niṣedhamātrābhidhāyitve ca nīlotpalaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyanna prāpnoti, nīlaśabdo hyanīlavyavacchedamātre caritārthaḥ, utpalaśabdo'pi anutpalavyavacchedamātre
na caitau vyavacchedau ekasmin dharmiṇi sambaddhau, bhāvābhāvayostādātmyādisambandhāsabhavāt
napi tau śabdau ekadharmiviṣayau; ghaṭapaṭaśabdayorivā'nayoḥ ekadharmiviṣayatvānabhyupagamāt
bhinnanimittayo śabdayorekasminnadhikaraṇe vṛtti sāmānādhikaraṇyam –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ 1
tulanā–yasya cānyāpohaḥ śabdārthastenānīlānutpalavyudāsau katha samānādhikaraṇāviti vaktavyam
yasya punarvidhīyamāna śabdārthastasya jātiguṇaviśiṣṭa nīlotpalaśabdābhyā dravyamabhidhīyate, jātiguṇau dravye vartete na punaranīlānutpalavyudāsau, tasmāt samānādhikaraṇārtho nāstīti
na cāsādhāraṇa vastu gamyate'nyacca nāsti te
sāmānādhikaraṇya hi bhinnapravṛttinimittayo śabdayo ekatrārthe vṛtti –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, nañeva paryudāsavṛttiḥ prasajyavṛttirvā bhavati, gauriti ca nāyaṃ nañ, ataḥ kathamagoparyudāsena gośabdavṛttiḥ ? gaurayamiti vidhirūpeṇaivāsya pravarttamānatvāt
tataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣavānarthaḥ śabdasya viṣayo'bhyupagantavyaḥ ala pratītyapalāpena
tasya ca saṅketavyavahārakālānuyāyitvaprasiddheḥ netthambhūte svalakṣaṇe saṅketakaraṇavaiphalyam
bhavatkalpitasya tu svalakṣaṇasya sugatamataparīkṣāyāṃ prapañcata pratikṣiptatvāt tatra tatkaraṇaṃ viphalameva
sambandhaśca vācyavācakayoḥ ūhākhyapramāṇena pratīyate, sarvatra sambandhapratītestadadhīnatvāt

ataḥ asyedamabhidhānamiti sambandhakāriṇi jñāne pratiniyatendriyaviṣayayo śabdārthayorna pratibhāsaḥ ityādyapyayuktamuktam, sāmānyaviśeṣātmanoreva śabdārthayoḥ pratiniyatendriyaviṣayatopapatteḥ, ata katha tayoḥ tatkāriṇi jñāne pratibhāsābhāvaḥ ?

nanu cātītānāgatārthaśabdānāṃ nadyāstīre modakarāśayaḥ santi ityādiśabdānāñca arthābhāve'pi pravṛttipratīteḥ kathamarthe pratibandhasiddhisteṣām ? ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, yato na vayaṃ sarvaśabdānāmarthanāntarīyakatvaṃ pratipannāḥ
na ca keṣāñcicchabdānāmarthavyabhicāritvadarśanāt sarveṣāṃ tadvyabhicāritvaṃ yuktam; marīcikādau jalādyavabhāsino'dhyakṣasya aprāmāṇyopalammāt satyajalādyavabhāsinopyasyā'prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
marīcikādau jalādyavabhāsina evāsyā'prāmāṇya vādhakasadbhāvānnetarasya ityanyatrāpi samānam
tulanā–na hi vayaṃ sarvaśabdānā prāmāṇyaṃ pratipadyemahi kiṃ tarhi suniścitāptapraṇetṛkāṇāmeva

yathaiva hi dūrāsannadeśādisāmagrīviśeṣavaśāt pādapāderabhinnasyāpi vibhinnapratibhāsaviṣayatvaṃ tathā śābda-pratyakṣapratyayayorabhinnaviṣayatve'pi śabdendriyādisāmagrībhedād aspaṣṭetarapratibhāsabhedo na virodhamadhyāste
ataḥ andhasya cakṣuṣmataśca abhinne'pi viṣaye sāmagrībhedāt pratibhāsabhedopapatteḥ ayuktamuktam– śabdātpratyeti bhinnākṣo natu pratyakṣamīkṣate

yathā hi sakṛdekasminnartha pādapādau upanibaddhadarśanayo pratyāsannaviprakṛṣṭapuruṣayorjñānābhyā viṣayīkṛte spaṣṭāspaṣṭapratibhāsabhedānna svabhāvabheda pādapasya tasyaikatvāvyatikramāt, tathaiva grāhakayoḥ pratyakṣasmṛtipratibhāsayoḥ bhede'pi spaṣṭamandatayā na tadviṣayasya bheda svalakṣaṇasyaikasvabhāvatvābhyupagamāt
andhasya hi śabdādrūpaviṣaya vijñānamutpadyate na tu cākṣuṣamiti

yaccānyaduktam–vācyavācakabhāvaśca kāryakāraṇabhāvānnānyaḥ ityādi, tadapyacāru; yataḥ sati buddhisambandhini pratibimbe asya śabdajanyatvāt tadvācyatvaṃ syāt śabdasya ca tajjanakatvād vācakatvam, na ca tadasti, prāgevāsya prapañcataḥ pratiṣedhāt
yadi ca kāryakāraṇabhāva eva vācyavācakabhāvaḥ syāt; tadā śrotrajñāne pratibhāsamāno'pi śabdaḥ svapratibhāsasya bhavatyeva kāraṇam atastasyāpyasau vācaka syāt
yathā ca vikalpasya śabdaḥ kāraṇam eva pāramparyeṇa svalakṣaṇamapi, atastadapi vācakaṃ syāt

tato yadyatra yathā nirbādhabodhe pratibhāsate tattatra tathaivā'bhyupagantavyam yathā anta sukhamāhlādanākāratayā, pratibhāsate ca abādhe śābde pratyaye sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatayā vahirghaṭādikaṃ vastviti
iyatā kārya vācyaṃ kāraṇa vācakamiti siddham –ā॰ ṭi॰
śabda nirvikalpakapratyakṣasya kāraṇam, nākāraṇa viṣaya ityabhyupagamāt
tulanā–yato yadi kāryakāraṇabhāva eva vācyavācakabhāva syāt, tadā śrotrajñāne pratibhāsamāna śabda svapratibhāsasya bhavatyeva kāraṇamiti tasyāpyasau vācakaḥ syāt
yathā ca vikalpasya śabda kāraṇam eva paramparayā svalakṣaṇamapi atastadapi vācakaṃ syāt –ratnākarāva॰ 4
śabdasvalakṣaṇācchabdagrāhinirvikalpaka tasmācca savikalpakam, athavā svalakṣaṇānnirvikalpaka tasmācca sabikalpakamiti
śābde bodhe sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatayaiva artha pratibhāti tatra tathaiva nirbādhabodhapratītiviṣayatvāt
nanu sāmānyaviśeṣātmakatayā śābdapratyaye bahirghaṭādivastunaḥ pratibhāsamānatvamasiddham, śabdānāṃ sāmānyamātragocaracāritayā tatprabhavapratyayasya tatmātraviṣayatāyā evopapatteḥ
sāmānyamātrameva hi śabdānāṃ gocaraḥ, tasya kvacit pratipannasya ekarūpatayā sarvatra saṅketaviṣaya topapatteḥ, na punarviśeṣāḥ teṣāmānantyataḥ kārtsnyenopalabdhumaśakyatayā tadviṣayatānupapatteḥ
atha yāvatāmupalambhaḥ tāvatsveva saṅketakriyopagamyate; tarhi viśeṣāntareṣu saṅketā'saṃbhavāt śābdavyavahārānupapattiḥ
na cā'yoginaḥ pratipattuḥ pratyekamaśeṣaviśeṣopalambhaḥ sakṛt krameṇa vā saṃbhavati, ayogitvavirodhānuṣaṅgāt

na cānupalabdheṣu teṣu idamasya vācakam, idañca vācyam ityabhidhānābhidheyapratipattiniyamalakṣaṇaḥ saṅketaḥ sabhavati, tadasaṃbhave ca śabdaśravaṇādarthapratipattyanupapatteḥ siddhaḥ śābdavyavahārocchedaḥ
tatastadvyavahāramicchatā sāmānyamātre saṅketo'bhyupagantavyaḥ atastadeva śabdārthaḥ siddhaḥ
ākṛtiśabdena jātirevābhipretā mīmāsakai, tathāhi–jātimevākṛtiṃ prāhu vyaktirākriyate yayā
yadyekameva vastvanekākāra tattarhi tādṛgeva śabdo'bhidadhat sāmānyamātrābhidhāyī na syādata āha–na ceti
na ca tattādṛśa kaścicchabda śaknoti bhāṣitum

gośabdoccāraṇe hi pūrvamevāgṛhītāsu vyaktiṣu sāmānya pratīyate, tadākārajñānotpatte paścād vyaktaya pratīyante, ataścākṛtipratyayasya nimittāntarābhāvād vyaktipratyaye ca pūrvapratītasāmānyanimittatvāt ākṛti śabdārtha iti vijñāyate
yadi ca vyaktayo'bhidheyā bhaveyustatastāsā citrakhaṇḍamuṇḍādiviśeṣasvarūpagrahaṇādvicitrā śabdoccāraṇe buddhiḥ syāt
gāmānayeti codite arthaprakaraṇābhāve yā kāñcit sāmānyayuktā vyaktimānayati na sarvā na viśiṣṭām
yadi ca vyakterabhidheyatva tataḥ sarvāsā yugapadabhihitatvādaśeṣānayana syāt
yā vā'bhidheyā saivaikā ānīyeta, yatastvaviśeṣaṇa jātimātrayuktā ānīyate tenāpi sāmānyasya padārthatva vijñāyate
mīmāsako hi sarvajñaṃ na manute –ā॰ ṭi॰

kiñca, jātimadviśeṣaśabdārthavādināṃ kiṃ jātimabhidhāya śabdo vyaktimabhivatte, anabhidhāya vā ? na tāvadabhidhāya; jātilakṣaṇaviśeṣaṇaviśeṣapratipattāveva upakṣīṇaśaktikatvenāsya viśeṣyāpratipādakatvaprasaṅgāt
abhidhā padaśaktiḥ, viśeṣya na gacchet na prāpnoti
tathā ca yato viśeṣaṇa prāpya padaśakti kṣīṇaśakti kṣīṇasāmarthyā bhavatyato viśeṣya nābhidhā gacchet na prāpnuyāditi paryavasitārtha

na ca sāmānyamātrasya abhidhānairabhidhāne viśeṣāṇāmanabhidhānāt prayojanārthinaḥ śabdātpravṛttirna prāpnoti, pratipannasyāpi tataḥ tanmātrasya prayojanāprasādhakatvādityabhidhātavyam, tatpratipattyanyathānupapattyā viśeṣāṇāmapi pratipattisaṃbhavāt
prathamato hi śabdātsā mānyamātra pratīyate, paścāttadanyathānupapattyā piṇḍaviśeṣo lakṣaṇayā pratīyate nirādhārasya sāmānyasya aśvavipāṇavadasabhavāt
na hyanamidhāya gotvamupalakṣaṇa govyaktāveva prayogavyavasthā labhyate
na hyanabhidhāya jātiṃ tajjātīyatvena rūpeṇa vyaktirabhidhātu śakyate
tadabhidhāne ca tata eva atyantāvinābhūtavyaktipratipattisiddhe na tatra abhidhānaśaktikalpanāvasaraḥ
yatra tu śakyārthasya paramparāsambandharūpā lakṣaṇā sā lakṣitalakṣaṇetyucyate
yathā dvirephādipade rephadvayasambandho bhramarapade jñāyate, bhramarapadasya ca sambandho bhramare jñāyate tatra lakṣitalakṣaṇā
yattāvaduktam–sāmānyamātrameva hi śabdānāṃ gocara ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; saṅketānusāreṇa śabdasya vācakatvopapatteḥ
saṅketaścāsya tadvatyeva pratipanno na puna sāmānyamātre, pravṛttyādyagocaratayā vāhadohādyarthakriyākāritvavikalatayā ca kevale'smin śābdavyavahārāsaṃbhavataḥ saṅketapratipatterniṣphalatvāt
evaṃvidhāddhi śabdādevavidho'rtha tvayā pratipattavya, evañjātīya ke cārthe śabdo'pyevañjātīyakaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti sadṛśapariṇāmāpannayoreva vācyavācakayoḥ saṅketayitrā saṅketaṃ pratipādyo grāhita
tataśca bāhadohādyarthino jāticodanā niṣphaleti na tadartha śabdaprayoga
yāpi svapratipattilakṣaṇā'rthakriyā jāterupavarṇyate, na tadarthampuruṣa pravartate śabdaprayogādeva tasyā siddhatvāt
jātau ca vācyāyā satyā gāmānayetyatra vākye na vākyārthapratīti syāt gotvasya kriyātve'nvayābhāvāt
na khalu sarvātmanā sāmānya vācya tatpratipatte arthakriyā pratyanupayogāt

yadapi viśeṣāṇāmabhidheyatve ānantyataḥ kārtsnyenopalabdhumaśakyatayā ityādyuktam, tadapyasāmpratam, sādhyasādhanavyaktivat sadṛśapariṇāmāpannānāṃ vācyavācakavyaktīnāmānantye'pi ūhajñānena kārtsnyata pratipattuṃ śakyatvāt
etacca śabdārthayo rnityasambandhaniṣedhe apohapratiṣedhe ca prapañcitamityuparamyate
tathā ca na cāyoginaḥ pratipattuḥ pratyekamaśeṣaviśeṣopalambhaḥ sakṛt krameṇa vā saṃbhavati ityādi pratyuktam; ayoginopi aśeṣaviśeṣāṇāmuktavidhinopalambhasaṃbhavapratipādanāt
yadapyuktam–kiṃ jātimabhidhāya śabdo vyaktimabhidhatte ityādi, tadapyasāmpratam; jātitadvatoryugapadeva ekatra jñāne pratibhāsasambhavāt

nacaikajñānaviṣayatve viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratiniyamo na syād, viparyayo vā syāt-viśeṣaṇasyāpi viśeṣyarūpatānuṣaṅgādityabhidhātavyam, daṇḍapuruṣayoryugapadekatrāpi jñāne pratibhāsamānayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvapratiniyamapratīteḥ
tatpratibhāsāviśeṣe'pi hi yena viśiṣṭaṃ yat pratīyate tadviśeṣaṇam itarad viśeṣyam
na khalu daṇḍādeḥ puruṣe viśiṣṭapratītijananādanyad viśeṣaṇatvaṃ sabhavati
yathā ca cākṣuṣe jñāne daṇḍapuruṣayoḥ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannayoryugapatpratibhāsamānatvāt tatpratiniyamāvirodhaḥ tathā daṇḍītiśabde'pi
nahyatra daṇḍamātraṃ puruṣamātraṃ vā pratibhāsate, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannasya yugapadubhayasya pratipādanāt
ato daṇḍiśabdāt daṇḍaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣo yathā pratibhāsate tathā gośabdāt gotvaviśiṣṭaḥ piṇḍaḥ iti pratipattavyam

atha gośabdaśravaṇāt śābaleyādiviśeṣā'pratīterna viśeṣaḥ śabdārthaḥ; tanna; tadviśeṣāpratītāvapi sāmānyayuktaḥ kakudādimān viśeṣo gośabdāt pratīyata eva śābaleyādiviśeṣāstu tadyuktāḥ śābaleyādiśabdebhyaḥ pratīyante
nacaitāvatā sāmānyameva śabdārtho yuktaḥ, pradhānopasajarnabhāvena ubhayoḥ pratibhāsanāt
gāmānaya ityādi prayāgeṣu sāmānyavato'rthasya ānayanādikriyābhisambandhapratīteśca tadvāneva śabdārthaḥ
tulanā–pratyakṣe tāvad dvayorapi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayorindriyaviṣayatva sāmānye hi sayuktasamavāyādindriya pravartamāna viśeṣaṇavadviśeṣyamapi viṣayīkaroti
na hi sāmānya pratyakṣa viśeṣo'numeya iti vyavahāraḥ
tasmād viśeṣaparyanta pratyakṣa tathā padamapi tattulyaviṣaya na tu sāmānyamātraniṣṭhamiti yuktam yathā vidhyantaparyanto vākyavyāpāra iṣyate
daṇḍa eva viśeṣaṇa puruṣa eva ca viśeṣyamiti

tulanā– atha gośabdaśravaṇācchābaleyādiviśeṣāpratipatterna viśeṣa śabdārtha, satyam, kiṃ tarhi ? sāmānyayukto'rtha pratīyate na śābaleyādibiśeṣa, sa ca śābaleyādiśabdebhya eva pratīyata iti, na caitāvatā sāmānyameva śabdārtha, pradhānopasarjanabhāvenobhayoḥ pratibhāsanāt
yadā hi bhedavivakṣā viśeṣāvagatiśca tadā vyaktiḥ pradhānam aṅga tu jātyākṛtī, yadā tu bhado'vivakṣita sāmānyagatiśca tadā jāti pradhānam aṅga tu vyaktyākṛtī

yaccānyaduktam–viśeṣyaṃ nābhidhā gacchet ityādi, tadapyapeśalam, viśeṣaṇaṃ prāk pratipādya punarviśeṣyaṃ śabdaḥ pratipādayati iti viramya vyāpārānabhyupagamāt, yugapadevāsya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyapratipādanavyāpārapradarśanāt
kṣīṇaśaktitvañcāsyā'nupapannam, śakteḥ kāryānumeyatvāt, viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyapratipattilakṣaṇa hi kāryamupalabhyamāna tatrāsya śaktimanumāpayati
bhinnajñānālambanayośca viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyatve ida codyaṃ syāt, na tvekajñānālambanayoḥ

bhavato'pi caitaccodya samānam–upalabdhasya hi śabdasya arthapratipādakatvaṃ syāt, ataḥ svātmapratipattāvevāsya kṣīṇaśaktitvāt sāmānyalakṣaṇā'rthapratipādakamapi na syāditi lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ syāt
tulanā–prathama jātimātramavaboddhyāparyavasānādanantara viśeṣamavabodhanti, kiṃ vā'ntarbhāvitaviśeṣāmeva jātim ? nādya, padabuddhyo viramya vyāpārābhāvāt
tulanā–nanūkta kṣīṇaśaktirviśeṣaṇeti viśeṣya nābhidadhyāt iti, tāvacchakte kāryaviṣayatvāt
atha kāryasyaivābhāva brūyāt, sa caiva bruvāṇa svasavedanamapi bādhate, viśeṣyapratipatte savedanāt
tulanā– samānañcaitad upalabhyamānasya śabdasya arthapratipādakatvābhyupagamāt, svātmapratipattau ca kṣīṇatvāt sāmānyapratipādakatva na syāt
atha sāmānyapratipatterdṛṣṭatvānna tatrāsya śakteḥ prakṣayaḥ, tarhi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyapratipatterapyato dṛṣṭatvāt katha tatrāpyasya tatprakṣayaḥ syāt

yadapyabhihitam–tatpratipattyanyathānupapattyā ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; yato yadi śabdātsāmānyameva pratīyate tarhi vyakteḥ kimāyāta yena tattāṃ lakṣayati ? atha vyaktyā saha tasya sambandhasadbhāvāt tatastatpratīyamānaṃ tāṃ lakṣayati; kaḥ punastasyāstena sambandho nāma–saṃyogaḥ, samavāyaḥ, tadutpattiḥ, tādātmyaṃ vā ? na tāvatsaṃyogaḥ, adravyatvāt
tādātmyābhyupagame tu sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ tādātmyāpannayoḥ ekasmādeva gavādiśabdāt viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyarūpatayā pratīyamānayoḥ kathamekasyaiva śabdārthatvaṃ vaktu yuktam, aprāmāṇikatvaprasaṅgāt ?
tulanā–vyakteraśakyacodanatvāt lakṣitalakṣaṇayā jātirucyate iti cet, aśabdacodite sambandhe satyapi katha pravarteta ? na hi kaścit daṇḍa chindhītyukte daṇḍina chinatti
satya na sāmānyamarthakriyākāri kintu vyaktireva, kevala vyakteraśakyacodanatvāt kāraṇāt sāmānye niyukta śabda sāmānya lakṣayati
tena sāmānyena śabdalakṣitena sambandhād vyaktirapi lakṣyata iti, na hi gośabdāduccaritād gotva pratīyate api tu gaurevāvasīyate
yadi nāma jātitadvatossambandha tathāpi aśabdacodite vyaktiviśeṣe katha pravartate ? naiva
daṇḍadaṇḍinossatyapi sambandhe na hi kaścitprekṣāpūrvakārī daṇḍa chindhi ityukte daṇḍina chinatti aśabdacoditanvāt
tathā jātau coditāyā vyaktau pravṛttirna yuktetyartha
lakṣitalakṣaṇayā vṛttiratādātmye na bhavet sambandhāntarāsiddhe kārmukādivat
kiñca yadi nāma śabdājjāti pratipannā vyakte kimāyāta yenāsau tā gamayati

kiñca, anayostallakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ śabdaprayogakāla eva pratipannaḥ, pūrva vā ? na tāvattatkāla eva; vyakteḥ śabdoccāraṇakāle'pratīteḥ, pratītau vā kiṃ lakṣaṇayā ? tatkāle tatpratītiśca ki pratyakṣataḥ, anumānāt, śabdādeva vā syāt ? na tāvatpratyakṣataḥ; deśakālasvabhāvaviprakṛṣṭāyāḥ vyakteḥ indriyasambandhābhāvatastatprabhavapratyakṣeṇa pratyetumaśakyatvāt
śabdādeva tatpratītau tu siddhaṃ vyakterapi śabdārthatvam

atha pūrvaṃ jātivyaktyostādātmyalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ pratipannaḥ, yadi nāma tadā tayorasau dṛṣṭo naitāvatā sarvatra sarvadā tayostena bhāvyam, anyathā paṭasya śuklarūpeṇa kvacit kadācittādātmyadarśanāt sarvatra sarvadā tathābhāva syāt
na hi vyaktyanadhigatāvapi tanniṣṭha sambandho grahītuṃ śakya iti

atha jāteridameva svarūpaṃ yad vyaktiniṣṭhatā; nanu kiṃ sarvasarvagatāyāstasyāstadrūpaṃ syāt, vyaktisarvagatāyā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; vyaktyantarāle tadabhāvaprasaṅgāt tatra tadrūpasyāsaṃbhavāt
vyaktisarvagatāyāstu tasyāḥ tadrūpopagame vyaktivajjāterapyanekatvaprasiddheḥ ubhayoraviśeṣataḥ śabdārthatvaṃ syāt, na vā kasyacit

astu vā avicāritasvarūpāyāstasyāstanniṣṭhasvabhāvatā; tathāpyasau sarvatra sarvadā vyaktiniṣṭhā iti pratyakṣataḥ pratīyeta, anumānato vā ? pratyakṣataścet; kiṃ yugapat, krameṇa vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; nikhilavyaktīnāṃ yugapadapratipattau jātestanniṣṭhatayā yugapatpratipattyanupapatteḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tu niravadhervyaktiparamparāyā yugasahasreṇāpi krameṇa pratipattyabhāvataḥ tasyāstanniṣṭhatāvasāyasaṃbhavo'tīva durghaṭa
jāte yad vyaktiniṣṭhatākhya svarūpamuktaṃ tasya abhāvaprasagāt
vyaktyabhāve hi na vyaktiniṣṭhatākhya svarūpaṃ siddhyati, ataśca svarūpābhāvāt svarūpavata sāmānyasyāpyabhāva
tulanā–kiñca, sarvadā jātirvyaktiniṣṭheti pratyakṣeṇa pratīyate anumānena vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 412
kiñca, sāmānye saṅketitaḥ śabdaḥ tadabhivatte, asaṅketito vā ? na tāvadasaṅketitaḥ; atiprasaṅgāt
atha saṅketitaḥ, kiṃ pratipanne sāmānye tatsaṅketa syāt, apratipanne vā ? yadyapratipanne, atiprasaṅgaḥ
atha pratipanne, kutastatpratipatti ? na tāvat pratyakṣānumānābhyām; nityādisvabhāvasāmānyagrāhakatvena anayoḥ sāmānyaparīkṣāvasare pratikṣiptatvāt
tathāhi–yadi ya eva śabdaḥ sāmānye saṅketyate tata eva tatpratipattiḥ, tadā itaretarāśrayaḥ– pratipanne hi sāmānye tatrāsya saṅketasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tata sāmānyapratipattiriti
śabdāntarāttu tatsiddhau anavasthā, tasyāpi hi śabdāntarasya pratipanne sāmānye saṅketo bhaviṣyati, tatpratipattiśca anyasmācchabdāntarāditi
yadi ca śabdātsāmānyameva pratīyate, tadā śābdamapramāṇameva syād gṛhītagrāhitvāt, śabdārthayoḥ sambandhagrāhiṇaiva hi pramāṇena sāmānyaṃ gṛhītamiti
yadeva hi śabdārthasambandhagrahaṇakāle sāmānyaṃ gṛhīta tadeva śabdoccāraṇakāle'pi –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, śabdānnirviśiṣṭaviśiṣṭaṃ sāmānyaṃ pratīyamāna puruṣaṃ pravarttayati, viśiṣṭaṃ vā ? na tāvannirviśiṣṭam, atiprasaṅgāt

atha viśiṣṭam, kiṅkṛtamasya vaiśiṣṭyam–viśiṣṭavyaktitādātmyakṛtam, tatraiva tatpravṛttihetutvakṛtam, asyedamiti pratītikṛta vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, tasya svakīyasakalavyaktibhiḥ saha tādātmyasadbhāvato viśiṣṭavyaktāveva tādātmyānupapatteḥ
atha svakīyākhilaviśiṣṭavyaktitādātmyakṛtameva asya vaiśiṣṭyamucyate, nanveva sarvatra tadvyaktau puruṣasya pravṛttiprasaṅgāt pratiniyatadvyaniyatatadvyaktau pravṛttyabhāva syāt
na ca gośabdād gotvamātrapratītau kvāpi vyaktau pravṛttirupapadyate, tasyāḥ sarvathā'pratipannatvāt
yasmin pratīyamāne yat sarvathā na pratīyate na tatpratītitastatra pravṛttiḥ yathā jalapratītito'nale, gośabdād gotvamātrapratītau na pratīyante ca khaṇḍādayo vyaktiviśeṣā iti
śabdād gotvapratītāvapi na śāvaleyādiṣu pravṛtti tatpratītāvapi teṣā sarvathā'pratipannatvāt
atha gośabdād gotvaṃ pratīyamānaṃ govyaktisambaddhameva pratīyate; kathamevaṃ sāmānyameva śabdārthaḥ syāt ? viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣayoḥ tataḥ pratīteḥ

nanu gośabdātsākṣād gotvameva pratīyate, vyaktistu tadanyathānupapattyaiva pratīyate iti, tadapyasundaram; evaṃ jātereva śabdārthatvamāyātaṃ vyaktestu pramāṇāntaragamyatā, tathā ca śabdasya lakṣaṇayā viśeṣapratipādakatvaṃ durghaṭam

atha śabdasyaiva ayamāntaro vyāpāraḥ yat sāmānyaṃ pratipādya tatpratipattisahakārī vyaktimapi gamayati lakṣaṇayeti; tadasāmpratam; yato yatraiva sambandhasmaraṇasahakārī śabdaḥ pravarttate sa eva tasyārtho na punastadarthāvinābhāvitvena yadyatpramāṇāntarataḥ pratīyate tattatsarvaṃ śabdodare prakṣeptavyam, anyathā pratyakṣasiddhadhūmānyathānupapattyā siddho vahniḥ pratyakṣasiddha eva syāt
śabdena hi sāmānyaṃ gṛhīta viśeṣastvarthāpattyā, kiṃ lakṣaṇayā ? –ā॰ ṭi॰
tathāhi–sāmānyasya viśiṣṭatvasiddhau satyāṃ viśiṣṭaviśeṣeṣveva pravṛttihetutvasiddhiḥ, tasyāñca satyāṃ sāmānyasya viśiṣṭatvasiddhiriti
tasyāñca satyāṃ tatraiva tasya pravṛttihetutvasiddhiriti ā॰
tṛtīyapakṣe tu cakrakamāsajyate–siddhe hi sāmānyasya vaiśiṣṭye viśiṣṭaviśeṣeṣu pratītihetutvasiddhiḥ, tasyāṃ satyām asyedam iti pratītisiddhiḥ, tasyāñca satyāṃ tasya vaiśiṣṭyasiddhiriti

tataḥ pramāṇato vastuvyavasthāmicchatā yad yathā yataḥ pratibhāsate tat tasya sadṛśetararūpatayā viṣayo'bhyupagantavyam yathā cakṣurādipratyayasya nīlādirūpatayā pratibhāsamānaṃ rūpādi, gavādiśabdāt pratibhāsate ca gavādikaṃ vastu, tasmāttadeva tacchabdānāṃ viṣayaḥ, na punaḥ sāmānyamātramiti
asyedamiti pratītikṛtaṃ vā iti tṛtīye vikalpe
tallakṣaṇe ca vidhau vādināṃ vipratipattiḥ; tathāhi–vākyarūpaḥ śabda eva pravarttakatvād vidhirityeke
anuṣṭheye hi viṣaye vidhi pusā pravarttaka
yo hi vidhyarthena liṅā loṭā kṛtyairvā'pūrvopadeśa kiyate sa vidhi
tatra śabdavidhivādino bruvate–anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ pravarttakatvamavadhāryate, tau ca ananyathāsiddhau śabdasyaiva pravarttakatvamavagamayataḥ, ataḥ sa eva vidhiḥ
arthasya vidhitve kriyāyāḥ pravarttaka vacanam śābarabhā॰ 1
pravarttakārthapratipādanadvāreṇa vacanasya pravarttakatve ca aupacārika pravarttakatvamasya syāt, mukhyañca vastuvṛttyā tatra tadvyavasthitam ityarthanirapekṣamevāsya tatpratipattavyam
vyāpārātiśayapravarttakatvapakṣe'pi na śabdasya mukhyapravarttakatvakṣatiḥ, vyāpārātiśayasamāśrayaṇenaiva sarvasya sādhyavastusampādakatvāt
na khalu kāṣṭhādīnāṃ jvālādyavāntaravyapārāvalambane'pi pāke mukhyaṃ kārakatvābhidhānaṃ virudhyate
pravarttakatvañca yadyapi sāmānyena śabdasyocyate tathāpi liṅloṭtavyapratyayāntasyaiva tad yuktaṃ śabdāntarāṇāṃ pravṛttihetutvā'dṛṣṭeḥ
atrānye śabdasya vidhitvamasahamānāḥ pramāṇatvāt, aniyamātpravṛtteḥ, savidāśrayaṇāt ityādiyuktivirodhaṃ darśayanti
tathāhi–pramāṇatvaṃ tāvat pravarttakā'rthā'vabodha katvaṃ vinā svataḥ pravṛttikārakatve asya durghaṭaṃ vāyvādivat, kārakahetoḥ pramāṇatvānupapatteḥ, bodhakasyaiva tatsaṃbhavāt
athocyate–vāyvādijanitabhūtapravṛttivilakṣaṇaiveyam icchādisamānarūpā cidrūpātmapravṛttiḥ viṣayāvabodhāpekṣiṇī liṅādibhiḥ kriyate; tanna; pravṛttikārakatvāṃśe parakārakāṇāmiva prāmāṇyānupapatteḥ
bodhakatvamātreṇāpi prāmāṇye varttamānādyapadeśakālapravarttakalaḍādiyukteṣvapi vākyeṣu tatprasaṅgāt tena pravarttaka vākyaṃ śāstre'smiścodanocyate
tasmāt sādhyasvabhāvayāgādivyāpāralakṣaṇaviṣayāvabodhakatvenaiva liṅādyantasya śabdasya pramāṇatvopapatteḥ na śabdasya svarūpeṇaiva vidhitvam
pramāṇa hi śabda pratijñāyate, bodhakañca pramāṇam, tatra pravṛttihetu kañcanārthātiśayamavagamayan śabdaścodanātvena pramāṇatāmaśnute, svayameva tu pravṛtta kārakastā pramāṇatāmapajahyāt
na hi kārako hetu pramāṇamapi tu jñāpaka
–pramāṇa hi śabda pratijñāyate codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma iti
svayameva tu pravṛtterapramāyā kāraka tā pramāṇatāmaprajahyāt
nanvapramāyā api pravṛtte kāraka kasmānna pramāṇamata āha–nahi kārako hetu pramāṇam
kiṃ tarhi pramāṇamityāha–api tu jñāpaka, indriyādau tathā bhāvāt
ata eva śabdopi na svarūpamātreṇa pravarttaka vāyvāditulyatvaprasaṅgāt
yadi pavana iva piśāca iva kunṛpa iva śabda pravarttako bhavet anavagataśabdārthasambandho'pi śravaṇaparavaśa pravartteta, na caivamasti
na ca nāma liṅādireva śabda pravartakābhidhānadvāreṇa pravartako bhavitumarhati
śabdasya ca jñāpakatvāccakṣurādikārakavailakṣaṇye satyapi pratītijanmani kāraṇatvamaparihāryam
kāraṇa ca kārakam, kārakañca na nirvyāpāra svakāryanirvṛtikṣamamiti vyāpārastasyāvaśyambhāvī –nyāyama॰ pṛ॰ 342
viṣayāvabodhanānna doṣa iti cenna, tanmātrasyānyatrāpi tulyatvāt; codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma ityabhyupagamānarthakyāt
kuta ? tanmātrasya anyatrāpi vartamānāpadeśe'pi caitra pacatītyādau tulyatvāt
astu tulyatā, kā no hānirityata āha–codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharma ityabhyupagamānarthakyāt
pravarttakatva codanātva pravṛttihetu kañcanārthātiśayamavagamayan anena rūpeṇa prāmāṇyamaśnute na bhāvanāmātravacanatvena tasya anyatrāpi tulyatvāt
tasmādyena rūpeṇa prāmāṇya na tena codanā, yena codanā na tena prāmāṇya tasya pravṛttiṃ prati kārakatvāt

tathā, aniyamātpravṛtteḥ; śabdasya hi viṣayāvabodhanirapekṣasya svarūpeṇaiva vidhitve cetanātmakasyāpi puruṣasya abhiprāyatiraskāreṇa mantrādijanyavikṣobhasyeva vivaśasya balātkāreṇa śabdātpravṛttirudbhavantī na vāyvādijanitapravṛttivailakṣa yamaśnuvīta
tathā cāsyāṃ haṭhādeva bhavantyāṃ puruṣasvātantryāśritavihitā'karaṇāparādhanibandhanaprāyaścittapratipādanasya nirviṣayatvaprasakteḥ ayuktamuktam–
śabdasvātantrye ca niyogato'vaśyaṃ pravṛtti syāt, tathā ca akurvan vihita karmeti nirviṣaya syāt
na hi tadānī balavadanilasalilaughanudyamānasyevecchāpi tantraṃ pravṛttiṃ prati puruṣasya
puruṣasvātantrye satyeva vihitasya sandhyāde akaraṇāt prāyaścitta bhavet, yadā tu puruṣasya pravṛttau svatantryameva nāsti tadā kathaṃ tadakaraṇena prāyaścittabhāktvam

vyākhyā– prasaktaścendriyārtheṣunitya yadvihita sandhyopāsanādi naimittikañca śavasparśādau snānādi tadakurvan, tathā pratiṣiddha hiṃsādyanutiṣṭhan avihitaniṣiddheṣvatyantāsakti kurvannaro manuṣyajātimātra prāyaścittamarhati
nahi bījādīnāṃ saṃvedanasāpekṣāṇāṃ svakāryakartṛtva dṛṣṭam, jñāpakasyaiva dhūmādestadapekṣāpratīteḥ
jñāpakaśca svarūpakarmasanbandhaviṣayajñānamapekṣate liṅādisvarūpañca pravṛtte kārakamityanupayuktasvarūpatatkarmasambandhaviṣayasavido'pi pusa pravṛttiprasaṅga

kiñca, aśrutaphaleṣu viśvajidādiṣu vākyeṣu phalasya svargādeḥ adhikāriṇaśca svargakāmādeḥ adhyāhāra, agniṣṭomādiṣu ca svargakāmādau anyapadārthopasarjanībhūtasvargādipadārthānāṃ phalatvādhyavasāya evamādyarthābhisambandho vyarthaḥ, vāyvādivat phalādisambandhānapekṣasyaiva śabdasya pravṛttihetutvaprasaṅgāt
viśvajidādiyajñeṣu svargādiphala na śrutau kaṇṭhoktamata tatra sāmānyarūpeṇa svargarūpasya phalasya adhyāhāra kriyate
api cāśrutaphaleṣu phalādhyāhāra kvacitkratūpakārakalpanā, śrutānāmapi svargādīnā phalatvādhyavasāya iti sarva eva mahimā vidhe

sa śabdasya tadbhāve'nupapanna–api cāśrutaphaleṣu piṇḍapitṛyajñādiṣu svargādiphalādhyāhāra kvacit kratūpakārakalpanā samidādau, śrutānāmapi puruṣaviśeṣaṇatayā svargādīnā phalatvādhyavasāya iti sarva eṣa mahimā vidhe
ava hi śrutivākyaviṣaya adhikārī cokto na tu phalam, tacca svargakāmākhyādhikārilakṣaṇe padārthe svargakāmo'syeti samāse pūrvapadatayā upasarjanībhūta svarga phalatayā'dhyavasīyate –ā॰ ṭi॰
pravarttakasyeti cenna, tasyāpi pavanādivartina ivopapatte phalarūpa kāraka vinā
śakate–pravartakasyeti cet, liṅādaya khalu pusā pravarttakāḥ, na caite niṣphale pravartayitu puruṣamīśate iti tadanyathānupapattyā phalakalpanetyartha
nahi yo ya pravartayati sa sarva phalamapekṣate, pavanādīnā pravartayatāmapi tadanapekṣatvadarśanādityartha

śabdavyāpāravidhivādinastu bruvate–liṅādiliṅādiśabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ vṛddhavyavahāre pravṛttyākhyakāryadarśanāt tatkāraṇatvena kalpitasya śabdavyāpārasya mantrapavanādivailakṣaṇyena pravṛttiheto sabhavānna pūrvoktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ
tatrārthātmikāyā bhāvanāyā liṅādiśabdānā yaḥ puruṣa prati prayojakavyāpāra sā dvitīyā śabdadharmo'bhidhātmikā bhāvanā vidhirityucyate
yathā kaścinmatreṇa abhicārikādinā pāravaśya nīto'nicchayāpi pravarttate –ā॰ ṭi॰

vyākhyā–karttṛvyutpattyā karaṇavyutpattyā vā abhidhāśabdasya śabdaparatvamaṅgīkṛtya abhidhāyā śabdasya ātmano bhāvanā vyāpāra pravartanāsāmānyavyaktibhūta liṅādayaḥ pravartanāsāmānyamabhidaghānā nirviśeṣasāmānyāyogāt praiṣādau ca lokadṛṣṭasya viśeṣasya puruṣadharmatvena apauruṣeyavede'sambhavāt pravartanāsāmānyasya ca praiṣādipravartakavyāpāravartitvadarśanāta liṅādereva ca vede pravartaka- nvāvadhāraṇāt lakṣaṇayā gamayantītyartha
abhidhīyata iti abhidhā pravartanā karttavyatā vā, saiva ca puruṣapravṛttiṃ bhāvayatīti bhāvanā tāmāhuriti
athavā abhidhāyā śabdasya bhāvanā abhidhābhāvanā saiva pravartanā parasamavetāpi śabdena puruṣa pravartayatā tatsiddhaye abhidhīyamānā śabdavyāpāratvenocyate tāmāhariti
athavā iṣṭasādhanatābhidhānamamidhā saiva vidhāna vidhiriti vyutpattyā vidhirityacyate
saiva ca bhatikartṛtvaṃ pratipadyamānāyā puruṣapravṛtte prayojakasya śabdasya vyāpāro bhāvanā tāmāhuḥ
abhidhāyāḥ śabdasya liṅāderyāsau bhāvanā puruṣapravṛttyutpatti prati svakīyaprayojakavyāpāraḥ tasya abhidhāyakā liṅādayaḥ
śabda bhāvanāyāśca bhāvyā puruṣapravṛtti, pravṛttimān vā puruṣaḥ
prāśastyābhidhānañca vinā vidhiśaktirnimittatvamupagatāpi pravarttanāyāṃ na samarthā bhavati
na hi imāṃ gāṃ krīṇīṣva iti śatakṛtvopyukta kaścit kretuṃ pravarttate yāvat ghaṭodhnī sampannakṣīrā ityādi prāśastyajñānaṃ na pravarttate
sā ca tryaṃśaparipūrṇā bhavati–kim, kena, katham iti
setthaṃ tryaṃśaparipūrṇā śabdabhāvanā phalabhāvanāyāṃ puruṣa pravarttayati
yadyapi cecchāsmṛtyādayaḥ puruṣapravṛttihetavaḥ tathāpi na teṣāṃ mukhyaḥ pravarttanāvyapadeśaḥ, śabdabhāvanāyāstu sādhyāvagatikāritvena mūlabhūtatvāt mukhyaḥ
śabdabhāvanā iti śabdaśabdena śabdadharmatayā vyapadeśāt, yathā grāmādidāne rājño dātṛtvavyapadeśo mukhyaḥ lākuṭikādīnāṃ tu rājādeśānusāreṇa pravṛttānāmaupacārikaḥ evamatrāpi
iha hi liṅādiyukteṣu vākyeṣu dve bhāvane gamyete
tatra liṅādīnā prayojakakartṛtva puruṣa prayojya, tena kimityapekṣāyā puruṣapravartanamiti sambadhyate
atha tu yogyatayaiva liṅādiviṣayā kriyocyate pravartayediti tata kimityapekṣite puruṣamityeva sambadhyate
kuta etat ? buddhipūrvakāriṇo hi puruṣā yāvat praśasto'yamiti nāvabudhyante tāvanna pravartante, tatra vidhivibhaktiravasīdati tā prāśastyajñānamuttabhnāti
tacca puruṣārthātmake phalāśe sarvasya svayamevānuṣṭhāna bhavatīti prasiddhatvānna vedādutpadyamānamapekṣyate
tatra pravṛttyanukūlo vyāpāro'bhidhā, phalānukūlo vyāpāro bhāvaneti viveka
bhāvya hi svargādiphala sādhyamānatvāt tanniṣṭhastadutpādakaśca puruṣavyāpāro yassa bhāvanā ṇyantena bhavatinocyate
prakṛtyarthasya bhavateḥ kartā ya svargādi sa eva ṇyantasya karmatā pratipadyate
karttā tvasya prayojaka puruṣa, ṇeścārtha ṇijvācya prayojakavyāpāra, puruṣo hi bhavanta svargādimartha svavyāpāreṇa bhāvayati sampādayati, sa tatmapādako vyāpāro bhāvanetyucyate
tatrārthabhāvanāyā bhaviturjāyamānasya svargāde prayojakavyāpāratvāt lakṣaṇasagati śabdabhāvanāyāmapi puruṣapravṛttirūpasya bhavitu prayojakavyāpāratvāllakṣaṇasaṅgati –mī॰ pari॰ pṛ॰ 20

tasmādasti puruṣapravṛttikarmikā vidhijñānakaraṇikā arthavādotpāditaviṣayaprāśastyajñānetikarttavyatopetā liṅādivyāpāra preraṇātmikā śabdabhāvanā abhidhānalakṣaṇo'pi ca devadattāderiva vyāpāra śabdabhāvanā
sā ca liṅśravaṇe'va mā pravartayati, satpravṛttyanukūlavyāpāravāniti niyamena pratīte

yadyasmācchabdānniyamata pratīyate nattasya vācyam yathā gāmānayetyasmin vākye gośabdasya gotvam, sa ca vyāpāraviśeṣo laukikavākye puruṣaniṣṭho'bhiprāyaviśeṣa, vaidikavākye tu puruṣābhāvālliṅādiniṣṭha eva
eṣā hi bahukṣīrā stryapatyā anaṣṭaprajā ceti
sā ca bhāvanāśatrayamapekṣate sādhya sādhanamitikartavyatāñca, kiṃ bhāvayet kena bhāvayet katha bhāvayediti
tatra sādhyākāṅkṣāyā bakṣyamāṇāśatrayopetā ārthībhāvanā sādhyatvenānveti ekapratyayagamyatvena samānābhidhānaśrute
sādhanākāṅkṣāyā liṅādijñāna karaṇatvenānveti, tasya ca karaṇatva na bhāvanotpādakatvena tatpūrvamapi tasyā śabde sattvāt, kintu bhāvanājñāpakatvena śabdabhāvanābhāvyanirvartakatvena vā
pravṛttiphalikāyāñca abhidhāyāmapi sādhyasādhanetikartavyatārūpamaśatrayamapekṣitam, anyathā tasya svarūpata phalataścājñānādapravṛttiprasaṅgāt
tatra liṅādividhijñāna karaṇatvenānveti yāga iva arthabhāvanāyām
pravṛttireva ca sādhyatvena svarga iva arthabhāvanāyām
taduktam–liṅābhidhā saiva ca śabdabhāvanā bhāvya ca tasyā puruṣapravṛtti
prarocyate'nayeti prarocanā prāśastyajñāna taccāṅga phalopakāriprayājādivat –mīmāṃsābāla॰ pṛ॰ 81

tatra kiṃ bhāvayet kena bhāvayetkatha bhāvayedityākāṅkṣāyā svarga bhāvayet yāgena bhāvayet agnyanvādhānaprayājāvaghātādibhirupakāra sampādya bhāvayedityeva bhāvyakaraṇetikarttavyatāsamarthanena ākāṅkṣāpūraṇāt prakaraṇāmnāta sakala śabdasandarbha bhāvanāvācina ākhyātasyaiva prapañca
sā sarvāpi śabdabhāvanā yā bhāvyā vidhāyako liṅādi karaṇam arthavādasampādita stutiritikartavyatā
amāvamyāyā kriyamāṇo yajñaviśeṣo darśa, paurṇamāsyāñca vidhīyamāna yajñānuṣṭhāna paurṇamāsa iti

tathā ca śabdabhāvanāsadbhāve kiṃ pramāṇamiti paryanuyogo'nupapannaḥ; yathaiva hi arthapratipattyanyathānupapattyā śabdasya abhidhātmako vyāpāraḥ parikalpa kalpya te tathā pravṛttyanyathānupapattyā liṅādeḥ pravarttanātmako'pīti
tatra yajeta svargakāmaḥ ityatra dve bhāvane pratīyete śabdātmikā puruṣapreraṇārūpā arthātmikā ca puruṣavyāpārarūpā iti
sāpyaṃśatrayamapekṣate sādhya sādhanamitikarttavyatāñca kiṃ bhāvayetkena bhāvayetkatha bhāvayediti
tatra sādhyākāṅkṣāyā svargādiphala sādhyatvenānveti, itikarttavyatākāṅkṣāyā prayājādyaṅgajātamitikartavyatātvenānveti
svargecchājanito yāgaviṣayo ya prayatna sa bhāvanā
yajata ityākhyātaśravaṇe yāge yateta iti pratīterjāyamānatvātataśca prayatna evārthī bhāvanā
yathāhu–nyāyasu॰ pṛ॰ 579 prayatnavyatiriktārthībhāvanā tu na śakyate
iyaṃ tvanyaiva sarvārthā sarvākhyāteṣu vidyate | tantravā॰ 2 | 1 | 1 iti

vyākhyā–vidheyāyā bhāvanāyā puruṣārtharūpabhāvyaniṣṭhatvasūcanāya icchāyonitva sūcayitum icchārthād arthayate ṇijantādarthayata iti kartṛvivakṣāyāmerajityacpratyayotpādanena arthina puruṣasya arthaśabdena abhidhānād bhāvanāyāśca puruṣadharmatvāt dharmadharmiṇoścātyanta bhedābhāvāt tādātmya vivakṣitvā arthātmā cāsau bhāvanā ceti vigraha kārya
puruṣavyāpārasya hi sarvatrārthe vidyamānatvāt sarvārthā arthabhāvanā, yajate, ayajata, ayaṣṭa ityādi sarvākhyāteṣu ca vidyate
na hi tatra puruṣapreraṇārūpā śabdabhāvanā'nubhūyate siddhasya ātmavyāpārasya arthabhāvanāparaparyāyasya anubhavāt
liṅādiviṣaye tu yajeta ityādau dvayamanubhūyate–svārthaṃ lipsamāno hi puruṣa svavyāpāre yāgavidhānalakṣaṇe pravarttate iti arthabhāvanā, tamayaṃ liṅpravarttayatīti śabdabhāvanā ceti
yadā hi sarvākhyātānuvartinī karotidhātuvācyā puruṣavyāpārarūpā bhāvanā'vagatā bhavati, tadā tadviśeṣā sāmānyākhyātavyatiriktaśabdaviśeṣavācyā vidhipratiṣedhabhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānādaya pratīyante
tathā ca sarvatra sāmānyata karo- tyartho'vagamyate

tadetadbhāvanāvādino matamayuktam, yataḥ śabdasya bhāvanā, śabda eva vā bhāvanā śabdabhāvanā syāt ? prathamapakṣe śabdasya bhāvanā prerakatvam, tacca preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇarūpam, tasya cetanātmakapuruṣadharmatvāt kathaṃ śabde'nupacaritasya sabhavaḥ ? taddharmādhyāsitapuruṣaprayuktād vākyādeva hi śabde tatsabhāvyate na mukhyata
sajñāpurassarā vyāpāraṇā preṣaṇam, nikṛṣṭaviṣayo niyoga ityartha
pravartyapuruṣāpekṣayā jyāyasā vaktrā pratipādyamāna kārya praiṣa iti vyapadiśyate
na hi preṣaṇābhyanujñālakṣaṇā śabdasya vyāpāro nirūpyate tasya puruṣadharmatvāt
na hi preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇābhyanujñālakṣaṇa śabdasya prayogo vyāpāro nirūpyate
nanu śabdoccāraṇānantara tadavagamāttainoktamiti katha preṣaṇādilakṣaṇa śabdaprayogo na nirūpyata ityāha–tasya puruṣadharmatvāt
śabdasya acetanatvāt puruṣābhiprāyarūpā preṣaṇādaya upacaritā eva sambhāvyante na tu mukhyā iti
hi śabde na tatsaṃ– ā॰, hi tacchabde sabhāvyate ba॰
kiñciddhi svātmani paratra vā arthānarthaprāptiparihārādiprayojanamabhisandhāya kaścit prerakaḥ preryaśca prasiddha
na cācetane śabde tadabhisandhāna saṃbhavati tatkathaṃ tasya prerakatvam ? balavatprabhañjanāderivāsya anabhiprāyasyāpi prerakatve śabdavidhipakṣanikṣiptā'śeṣadoṣopanipātaḥ syāt
na hi sarvasmin pravartayitari pravṛtti prekṣāvatām api tvanuvidheye
syānmata pavanādiriva laṅādi prerayati puruṣam, tadasat, abhidhānavaiyarthyāt, apratītavyāpārasyāpi vāyvāderiva svabhāvata prerakatvāt, pūrvoktadoṣāpātācca
na hi pravṛttiṃ prati kārakatve śabdasya sadapi tadvyāpārābhidhānamaṅgam, anabhihitavyāpārasyāpi tasya kārakatvāt, kārakasyānapekṣitajñānatvāt
kiñca, asyāḥ sadbhāve pramāṇam liṅādiśravaṇānantarabhāvinī pravṛtti, liṅādiśabda eva vā ? na tāvatpravṛttiḥ; tasyāstannibandhanatvena kvacidanyatrā'dṛṣṭatvāt
yannibandhanā hi pravṛttirloke dṛṣṭā tadeva tāṃ dṛṣṭvā'numātuṃ yuktam, na punaḥ apratipannapūrvaḥ śabdavyāpāraviśeṣaḥ aprāmāṇikatvaprasaṅgāt
nāpi liṅādiśabda eva tatra pramāṇam, agṛhītasambandhasya śabdasya avācakatvāt
nahi anavadhārite sambandhini sambandhabodhaḥ saṃbhavati; atiprasaṅgāt
liṅādiśabdānantarabhāvinī pravṛttireva pramāṇamiti cenna, tannibandhanatvena pravṛtteranyatrādṛṣṭatvāt
ta ya nnibandhanā hi pravṛttirdṛṣṭā tadeva tā dṛṣṭvā śakyamanumātum, na punarapratipannapūrvakaraṇabhāva śabdavyāpāraviśeṣa
liṅādiśabda eva pramāṇamiti sāhasam, agṛhītasambandhasya śabdasyāvācakatvāt
kiñca, śabdaḥ svavyāpāraṃ vidhijñānasavyapekṣo janayati, anapekṣo vā ? na tāvadanapekṣaḥ, vidhijñānasya puruṣapreraṇāyāṃ karaṇatvābhyupagamāt
atha śabdo vidhijñānaṃ janayitvā tatkaraṇānugṛhītastatpreraṇārūpaṃ svavyāpāramārabhate, tadidamalaukikam; na hi kasyacidvastunaḥ svajñānam utpādahetuḥ loke pratītam

yadi ca śabdaḥ svavyāpāraṃ karoti abhidhatte ca, tadā utpādya paścāttamabhidhatte, yugapadvā utpādayati abhidhatte ca ? tatra prathamapakṣo'nupapannaḥ; na khalu śabdaḥ svavyāpāramutpādya paścāttamabhidadhātīti śrāddhikādanyaḥ pratipadyate
dvitīyapakṣo'pyaprātītikaḥ, nahi sakṛduccaritaḥ śabdaḥ svavyāpārasya karttā vaktā ca bhavati iti prāmāṇikaḥ pratipadyate
siddhe hi vastuni pratibandhāvagamapūrvikā vacanasya pravṛttiḥ pratīyate

syānmata śabdo vidhijñāna janayitvā tatkaraṇānugṛhīta preraṇārūpa svavyāpāramārabhata iti na karaṇatvābhāvaḥ kriyāniṣpattāveva karaṇatvāt, tadidamalaukikam, na hi kasyacidvastunaḥ svajñānamutpādahetu pratītam
tulanā–yaścāsau vyāpāra kriyate cābhidhīyate ca, sa kiṃ pūrvamabhidhīyate tata kriyate, pūrva vā kriyate paścādabhidhīyate, yugapadeva vā asya karaṇābhidhāne iti
na tāvatpūrvamabhidhīyate anutpannasya abhidhānānupapatte, na hyajāte putre nāmadheyakaraṇam, arthāsasparśī ca śabda syāt
tata eva na yugapadubhayam, anutpannatvānapāyāt prayatnagauravaprasaṅgācca

nanu liṅādiśabdaśravaṇānantaraṃ pravṛttyākhyakāryasya pravarttito'hamiti pratipattitaḥ pratīteḥ kathaṃ tatra tatkarttṛtvāpratipattiriti cet ? tadayuktam; yato dvividhā pravṛttiḥ pratī yate–ekā paravaśasya, anyā tu prekṣāpūrvakāriṇa
tatrādyapakṣe haṭhād yāgādikarmaṇi bauddhāderapi pravṛtti śabdena kriyatāṃ puruṣasvātantryābhāvāt
na khalu balavajjalaprabhañjanapreritasya svātantryābhāve haṭhātpravṛttirna dṛṣṭā anicchannapyaha prabhañjanādinā preritaḥ pravartte iti pratīteḥ
dvitīyapakṣe tu yenāhaṃ śabdena pravarttitaḥ sa kiṃ pravarttanāyogyo na vā iti yāvanna prekṣāpūrvakārī vimṛśati tāvanna pravṛttiṃ vidadhāti
nahi śabdenāha pravarttitaḥ iti avaśyaṃ pravartte ityasau śabdamātre samāśvasiti tatkāritvavirodhānuṣaṅgāt
ato'pauruṣeyāt kākavāsitaprakhyāt śabdāt kathaṃ kasyacit pravṛttiḥ syāt ? pauruṣeyasyaiva śabdasya pravarttanāyogyatvopapatteḥ
tatpraṇetuḥ kutaścidāptatāmavasāya prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ sadvaidyādyupadeśādiva niḥśaṅka pravṛttisabhavāt
tasmādapauruṣeyatve śabdasya puruṣapravṛtteranaṅgatvānna śabdasya bhāvanā–pravarttakatva śabdabhāvanā iti pakṣo ghaṭate
atha śabda eva bhāvanā; tadapyasāmpratam, śabdasvarūpamātrasya bhāvanāsvabhāvatve ghaṭādiśabdeṣvapi bhāvanāprasaṅgāt tanmātrasya atrāpyaviśiṣṭatvāt
tadevaṃ śabdabhāvanāsvarūpasya vicāryamāṇasyā'vyavasthiteḥ kathaṃ tayā arthabhāvanā bhāvyeta ? yato bhāvyaniṣṭho bhāvakavyāpāro bhāvanā iti suvyavasthitaṃ syāt
atha matam–abhidhaiva bhāvanā vidhirliṅādyartha iti, atrocyate–pravṛtte sarvato'rthe vā prasaṅgāt kāryato gate
abhidhā cedvidhi sarvaśabdānā yathāsvamabhidheyeṣu tadbhāva iti ghaṭādiśabdebhyo'pi pravṛttiprasaṅgaḥ asyāviśeṣāt
tulanā–yattāvadukta śabdavyāpāra śabdabhāvaneti; tatra śabdāttadvyāpāro'narthāntarabhūto'rthāntarabhūto vā ? –aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 31
yā tu śabdabhāvanaiva liṅādyartha iti kaumārilakusṛti sā tu pratītivisavādādipratihatā
na hi vidhivākyaśrāvipuruṣo liṅādisvavyāpāramabhidhatte ato mayā pravartitavyamiti manyate –nyāyapari॰ pṛ॰ 398
apare puna niyoga eva pravṛttihetutvād vidhiḥ ityācakṣate
tatra cānekadhā vipratipattiḥ–kecit liṅādipratyayārtho niyogaḥ ityātiṣṭhante
anye tu prerakatvameva niyogaḥ iti bruvate
tulanā–ko'ya niyogo nāma ? niśabdo ni śeṣārtha yogārtho yukti niravaśeṣo yoga niyoga
niravaśeṣatvam ayogasya manāgapyabhāvāt, avaśyakartavyatā hi niyoga
niyukto'hamanena vākyeneti niravaśeṣo yoga niyoga, tatra manāgapyayogāśakāyā sabhavābhāvāt
yadapi darśanam– pramāṇāntarāpocara śabdamātrālambano niyukto'smīti pratyātmavedanīya sukhādivat aparāmṛṣṭakālatrayo liṅādīnāmartho vidhiriti
kāryarūpaśca tenātra śuddhaṃ kāryamasau mataḥ || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 29
liṅādiyuktavākyaśravaṇe tadbhāvabhāvinyā pravṛttyā viśiṣṭakāryāvagatimanumāya vākyasya tāvaddhetutāmadhyavasyati

tatrāpi ko'rthabhāga kena śabdāśenābhihita iti vivecane liṅādyāvāpena kāryāvagatidarśanāt taduddhāre cādarśanāt ta eva kāryāvagati kurvantīti śabdāntaravat liṅādīnā kāryavācakatvavyutpattisiddhi kāryameva hi sarvatra pravṛttāvekakāraṇam
pṛ॰ 179 kāryasyaiva pradhānatvād vākyārthatva ca yujyate
ata kṛtsno veda kāryaparata eva pramāṇam
idameva kāryaṃ mānāntarāgocaratvādapūrvamiti, svātmani puruṣa niyuñjāno niyoga iti gīyate
liṅāderavagamyamāna kāryarūpa preraṇātmā ca vākyārtho niyoga
prerakatvaṃ tu yattasya viśeṣaṇamiheṣyate tasyāpratyayavācyatvāt śuddhe kārye niyogatā
tatra śuddhā preraṇā niyoga iti pakṣe preraṇāyā niyojyatārūpatvāt yāganirūpitaniyojyatāvān svargakāma ityevamādyo bodha
tato niyojyena niyojakākṣepāt yāgaviṣayaka svargakāmīya niyojakamityaupādāniko'pūrvaviṣayo dvitīya ityādi bodhyam
nāprerito yataḥ kaścinniyuktaṃ svaṃ prapadyate || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ 29
preraṇāsahitaṃ kāryaṃ niyogaḥ iti cāpare manyante
mamedaṃ kāryamityevaṃ jñātaṃ pūrvaṃ yadā bhavet
tāvat kadāpi me tatra pravṛttirabhavanna hi
svasiddhau prerakaṃ tatsyādanyathā tanna siddhyati || pramāṇavārtikālaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 30
preryate puruṣo naiva kāryeṇeha vinā kvacit
tataśca preraṇā proktā niyogaḥ kāryasaṅgatā || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30
preraṇāviṣayaḥ kārya na ca tatpreraka svataḥ
vyāpārastu pramāṇasya prameya upacaryate || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30
preraṇā hi vinā kārya prerikā naiva kasyacit
kārya vā preraṇāyogaḥ niyogastena sammataḥ || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30
siddhatvaina na tatkārya preraka kuta eva tat || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30
yantrārūḍho dṛṣṭāntatayā yatra sa yantrārūḍho viṣayārūḍhatvābhimāno niyoga ityartha
yajet svargakāma ityato yāgārūḍhatvābhimānavān svargakāma iti bodha
kāmī yatraiva ya kaścinniyoge sati tatra saḥ
mamedaṃ bhogyamityeva bhogyarūpa pratīyate | mamatvena ca vijñāna bhoktaryeva vyavasthitam
svāmitvenābhimāno hi bhokturyatra bhavedayam | bhogya tadeva vijñeya tadeva sva nirucyate
sādhyarūpatayā yena mamedamiti gamyate | tatprasādhyena rūpeṇa bhogyaṃ sva vyapadiśyate
siddharūpa hi yad bhogyaṃ na niyoga sa tāvatā | sādhyatveneha bhogyasya prerakatvānniyogatā
pusaḥ kāryaviśiṣṭatvaṃ niyogo'sya ca vācyatā || pramāṇavārtikāla॰ pṛ॰ 30 | iti
kāryasya siddhau jātāyā tadyukta puruṣa sadā

tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; yato niyojyapreraṇānirapekṣasya kāryasya niyogarūpatopagamyate, tatsāpekṣasya vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ, tannirapekṣasya kāryamātrasya apravṛttihetutayā niyogatvānupapatteḥ

tatsāpekṣasya tu niyogatve kathaṃ kāryasyaiva niyogarūpatā ? tritayasyāpi pravṛttihetutayā tadrūpatāprasaṅgāt preraṇā niyogaḥ ityapyanenāpāstam, niyojyādinirapekṣāyāḥ preraṇāyāḥ pralāpamātratayā niyogarūpatānupapatteḥ
preraṇāsahitaṃ kāryaṃ niyogaḥ; ityapyayuktam, niyojyābhāve niyogasyaivānupapatteḥ
kāryasyaivopacārataḥ pravarttakatvaṃ niyogaḥ; ityapyasāram, niyojyādinirapekṣasyāsya pravarttakatvopacārāyogāt

kāryapreraṇayoḥ sambandho'pi sambandhibhyo'rthāntarabhūtaḥ san, anarthāntarabhūto vā niyogarūpatāṃ pratipadyate ? na tāvadarthāntarabhūtaḥ; tathābhūtasya sambandhasyaivā'saṃbhavato niyogarūpatānupapatteḥ
kāryapreraṇāvinirmuktastu niyogo brahmādvaitamavalambate, tacca prāgeva kṛtottaram

yatpunaḥ svargakāmaḥ puruṣo'gnihotrādivākyaniyoge sati yāgalakṣaṇaṃ viṣayamārūḍhamātmānaṃ manyamānaḥ pravarttate iti yantrārūḍhaniyogābhidhānam; tadapyacāru; apauruṣeyavākye niyoktṛtvasya nirākṛtatvānnirākariṣyamāṇatvācca
puruṣasvabhāvatve tu niyogasya śāśvatikatvaprasaṅgaḥ tasya śāśvatikatvāt
niyogo naiva kasyāpi niyoga iti kīrtyate
yuktastu puruṣaḥ kārye yatra naiva pratīyate
niyojyādinirapekṣasya kāryasya pravartakatvopacārāyogāt, kadācit kvacit paramārthatastasya tathānupalambhāt
sambandhyātmana sambandhasya niyogatvamityapi duranvayam; preryamāṇapuruṣanirapekṣayo sambandhyātmanorapi kāryapraraṇayīrniyogatvānupapatte
na sambandho'sti bhogyātmā rūḍhaśca na narastadā
tadapi na paramātmavādapratikūlam, puruṣābhimānamātrasya niyogatvavacanāttasya ca avidyodayanibandhanatvāt
kiñca, kimayaṃ niyuṅkte iti niyogaḥ, kiṃ vā niyuktiḥ, niyujyate'nena iti vā ? tatra prathamapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, niyuktikriyāyāṃ karttṛtvasya prekṣāvarddhamatayā kāryādisvabhāve niyoge saṃbhavābhāvāt
nahi amuṣmai prayojanāya amumahaṃ niyokṣye iti yasya nāsti parāmarśa tasya niyoktṛtopapannā, svāmyādau tatparārśavatyeva asyāḥ pratīteḥ
nahi niyoktṛmātrasadbhāvata kaścit pravarttate, yāvat tadanuvidheyatāmātmano na pratipadyeta
niyuktirniyogaḥ niyujyate'nenetivā ityapyanupapannam, bhāvakaraṇayoḥ kartṛkarmāpekṣatvāt, tayoścāsaṃbhave bhāvakaraṇayorapyasaṃbhavāt
yathāhi samīraṇa abhiprāyaśūnyo'pi salila samīrayati tathaiva abhiprāyarahitasyāpi niyoktṛtā syādityukte prāha
tulanā–api ca niyoktṛvyāpāro niyogo na niyokturvinā'vakalpate
kiñca, ayaṃ niyoga śabdavyāpārarūpaḥ, puruṣavyāpārarūpaḥ, ubhayarūpaḥ, anubhayarūpo vā ? prathamapakṣe śabdabhāvanāpakṣanikṣiptadopānuṣaṅgaḥ, śabdavyāpārasya śabdabhāvanārūpatvāt
tulanā–sarvatra ca vākyārthe aṣṭaprakāro bheda –pramāṇa kiṃ niyoga syāt prameyamathavā puna

anubhayapakṣepyasau viṣayasvabhāvaḥ, phalasvabhāvaḥ, ni svabhāvo vā syāt ? yadi viṣayasvabhāvaḥ; tadā'sau yāgādirviṣayaḥ agniṣṭomena yajeta svargakāmaḥ ityādiniyoktṛvākyakāle asti, na vā ? yadi nāsti, tadā tatsvabhāvo niyogo'pi nāstīti kathamasau khapuṣpavad vākyārthaḥ syāt ? buddhyārūḍhasya bhāvinastasya vākyārthatve saugatamatānusaraṇaprasaṅgaḥ
atha tatkāle so'sti; evamapi na niyogo vākyārthaḥ, tasya yāgādiniṣpādanārthatvāt
na cānayostādātmye svātmaiva svātmano niṣpādako yukto virodhāt, niṣpannasya yāgādeḥ puruṣādivanniṣpādanavirodhācca
atha tasya kiñcidaniṣpannaṃ rūpamasti tanniṣpādanārtho niyogaḥ; tarhi tatsvabhāvo niyogopyaniṣpanna iti kathaṃ vākyārthaḥ ? kalpanārūḍhasya vākyārthatve sa eva saugatamatānupraveśaḥ
phalasvabhāvo niyogaḥ, ityapyayuktam; nahi svargādiphalaṃ niyogo ghaṭate phalāntaraparikalpanaprasaṅgāt, niṣphalasya niyogasyānupapatteḥ
phalāntarasya ca phalasvabhāvaniyogavādināṃ niyogatvāpattau tadanyaphalakalpane anavasthāprasaṅgaḥ
phalasya ca vākyakāle'sannihitatvāt tatsvabhāvo niyogo'pyasannihita eveti kathaṃ vākyārthaḥ ? buddhyārūḍhasya vākyārthatve paramatapraveśaprasaṅgaḥ
niḥsvabhāvo niyogaḥ ityapyanena pratyuktam, niḥsvabhāvasyāsya anyāpohatvānatikramāt
so'pi viṣayasvabhāvo vā syāt, phalasvabhāvo vā, ni svabhāvo vā ? –aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 8
tulanā–viṣayadharmatāyāmapi viṣayasyāpariniṣpatteḥ svarūpābhāvāt katha śabdādasau pratyetu śakyaḥ ? –pramāṇavārtikālaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 17
tulanā–atha tadvākyakāle vidyamāno'sau, tarhi na niyogo vākyasyārtha, tasya yāgādiniṣpādanārthatvāt, niṣpannasya ca yāgāde punarniṣpādanāyogāt
tulanā–dvitīyapakṣe'pi nāsau niyoga, phalasya bhāva bhāvi tvena niyogatvāghaṭanāt, tadā asannidhānācca
tasya vākyārthatve nirālambanaśabdavādāśrayaṇāt kuta prabhākaramatasiddhi ? –tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 262
kiñca, ayaṃ niyogaḥ pravarttakasvabhāva, apravarttakasvabhāvo vā ? prathamapakṣe prabhākaravat tāthāgatādīnāmapi pravarttakaḥ syāt tasya sarvathā pravarttakasvabhāvatvāt
teṣāṃ viparyāsādapravartakaḥ iti cet, na; bhavatāmapi viparyāsāt pravartakaḥ ityapi vaktuṃ suśakatvāt
athāpravarttakasvabhāvo'sau; tarhi siddhastasya pravṛttihetutvābhāvaḥ, sa ca vākyārthatvābhāvaṃ sādhayati
na ca agniṣṭomādivākye viṣayādipadārthavācakapadavyatirekeṇa viṣayaphalayoḥ madhyavarttina taṭasthasya vā niyogasya vācakaṃ kiñcitpadamasti, yataḥ sopi viṣayādivat padārthatāṃ pratipadyeta
na cāpadārtho vākyārtho bhavitumarhati; anyo nyasāpekṣapadāntaranirapekṣapadārthasamudāyalakṣaṇatvād vākyārthasya
sa hi pravartakasvabhāvo vā syādatatsvabhāvo vā ? –tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 264
tulanā–teṣā viparyāsādapravartaka iti cet, pareṣāmapi viparyāsāt pravartako'stu
śakya hi vaktum–prābhākarā viparyastatvāt śabdaniyogāt pravartante netare, teṣāmaviparyastatvāditi
saugatādayo viparyastā tanmatasya pramāṇabādhitatvāt na puna prābhākarāḥ ityapi pakṣapātamātram; tanmatasyāpi pramāṇabādhitatvāviśeṣāt
tulanā–padārtha eva vākyārtho na ca so'nanyagocaraḥ

ye'pi prepaṇādhyepaṇābhyanujñālakṣaṇaḥ prayoktṛdharmaḥ pravṛttihetutvena prasiddho vidhi ityāmananti, tepyatattvajñāḥ; puruṣasambandhaśūnyeṣu vedavākyeṣu puruṣadharmatayā prasiddhānāṃ prepaṇādīnām atyantāsaṃbhavato vidhitvakalpanānupapatteḥ
tatra teṣāṃ kalpane vā pauruṣeyatvānuṣaṅgād apaurupeyatvakalpanānupapattiriti ekaṃ sandhitsoranyatpracyavate

asatkārapūrvikā hi vyāpāraṇā prepaṇā ucyate, satkārapūrvikā tu adhyepaṇā, pareṣṭasya apratikūlavṛttirabhyanujñeti sarve ete prepaṇādayaḥ puruṣagatāśayaviśeṣasvabhāvatvād apaurupeyeṣu vedavākyeṣu na manāgapi saṅgacchante iti
yad vākya vidhāyaka codaka sa vidhi, vidhistu niyogo'nujñā vā
yadvākya vidhatte idaṃ kuryāditi sa niyoga
pravṛttyādī ityādipadānnivṛtti, viṣayasaptamīyam, tena pravṛttinivṛttiviṣaya āptābhiprāyo liṅartha ityartha
loke hi pratīta preṣaṇādhyeṣaṇābhyanujñālakṣaṇo'bhiprāyātiśaya prayoktṛdharmo liṅartha, tasyāpīruṣeyeṣu vedavākyeṣvasabhava
pratīte sabhava iti cet, na, pauruṣeyatvāpatte

anye tu praipādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ vyabhicārāt anekaśaktikalpanādopācca sarvatrā'vyabhicāriṇaḥ pravarttanāmātrasyaikasya vidhitvamiti pratipannāḥ, tepyasamīkṣitatattvā, nirviśe ṣasya sāmānyasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
yathaiva hi khaṇḍādiviśeṣaśūnyaṃ gotvādi na saṃbhavati, evaṃ parityaktapraiṣādiviśeṣaṃ pravarttanāmātramapi
vedasya cā'pauruṣeyatvābhyupagame puruṣagatāśayaviśeṣasvabhāvānāṃ praiṣādiviśeṣāṇāmasaṃbhavāt kā pravarttanāmātrasya saṃbhāvanāpi ?
tatraiva liṅ vidhātavya kiṃ bhedasya vivakṣayā
tatra ca praipādīnā viśeṣāṇā vyabhicāritvena avācyatvāt sarvānuyāyina pravarttanāsāmānyasya vācyatve'vagate –nyāyasu॰ pṛ॰ 30
pravṛttyanukūlo vyāpāraḥ pravartanā sa ca vyāpāra praiṣādirūpo vividha iti pratyeka vyabhicāritvādvidhiśabdavācyatvānupapatte pravartanāsāmānyameva vidhiśabdavācyamiti kalpayati

na ca pravartanāmātramaviśeṣamakarttṛkam yadapi matam–anekasāmarthyaparikalpanādoṣād vyabhicārācca praipādīnāmavācyatvādavyabhicārātpravartanāmātra loke liṅādyartha tasya vedepyupapattiriti; idamapyacaturasram, nirviśeṣasāmānyāyogāt, akarttṛkatve vyāpārānupapatteśca
pravartanā ca pravartayiturvyāpāra, sa tamantareṇa nātivirājate, puruṣasyābhāvāt śabdasya ca pravartakatvaniṣedhāt pravarttayiturabhāva
yaccoktam–praiṣādīnāṃ vyabhicārāt ityādi; tadayuktam; yathāsaṃbhavaṃ yathāsvarūpañca pravarttakatvābhyupagamāt
yadā hi prepaṇātaḥ pravarttate tadā tasyāḥ pravartakatvam, yadā tu adhyeṣaṇātastadā tasyā iti

nahi kadāciddīrghāḥ śuklādisvarūpāstantavaḥ paṭasya janakāḥ kadācittu hrasvā raktādisvabhāvā vā ityetāvatā tantuvyatiriktasyānyasyaiva kasyacitpaṭotpattiṃ prati upādānakāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ pratītivirodhāt
preṣaṇāyāḥ vidhitve adhyeṣaṇāyāṃ vidhitvaṃ na syāt adhyeṣaṇāyā vidhitve ca preṣaṇāyāṃ vidhitvābhāvaḥ iti parasparaṃ vyabhicāraḥ
sarvo'pi hi prekṣāpūrvakārī phaloddeśena pravarttate, ataḥ phalasya pravarttakatvam
prītyātmakatā tasya pravṛttau vyāpāraḥ sa eva ca pravarttanā vidhiriti; tadapyasaṅgatam; phalasya pravṛttihetutvānupapatteḥ
nahi avagatamapi phalam arthitāṃ vinā pravṛttihetuḥ
arthitā ca na phalasya vyāpāraḥ, kintu pratipatturicchārūpatayā taddharmatvāt

artha phalasya prītyātmakatvamantareṇa icchāyā evānutpatteḥ tadutpādanadvāreṇa phaladharmasya prītyātmakatvasya pravṛttihetutvam; nanvevamapi prītyātmakatvasya phale evā'vasthānāt tatraiva ātmanaḥ pravṛttiḥ syāt na karmaṇi

athā'bhipretaphalasādhanatvāt karmaṇyeva pravṛtternātiprasaṅgaḥ, na khalu prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ upāyaṃ parityajya anupāye'sādhane vā sādhye pravarttante, kathamevaṃ phalasya pravarttakatā tatsādhanasyaiva tatprasaṅgāt
tasmātpuṃsaḥ pravṛttau prabhavati na vidhirnāpi śabdo liṅādiḥ
prādhānyayogādathavā phalasya vākyārthatā tatra satāṃ hi yatnaḥ
yadi manyeta phalaṃ pravarttakaṃ tadvyāpāraḥ pravarttanā, phalārthinaḥ puruṣasya tatsādhane pravṛtteḥ anyathā'bhāvāt

na kaścidvyāpāraviśeṣaḥ pravartanā api tu pravṛttisamarthaṃ vyāpāramātraṃ ca prayojakavyāpāraḥ, bhikṣā vāsayati kārīṣo'gniradhyāpayatīti darśanāt; tadasat; arthitā vyāpṛtiḥ puṃso niyamaḥ kinnibandhanaḥ
phalārthitā cet pravṛttihetuḥ; secchā tadyogo vā icchāsamavāyo vā kṛttaddhitasamāseṣu sambandhābhidhānaṃ tvatalbhyām iti vacanāt puruṣadharma iti na phalaṃ vyāpṛtiḥ
atha tadicchopahāramukhena phalasya pravṛttiheturdharmaḥ prītyātmatā phalavyāpāraḥ pravarttanā; sāpi tatraiva na karmaṇi
tatsādhanatvāt karmaṇyeva pravartate na sarvatra, tata eva tarhi tatsādhanatva pravṛttihetu karmaṇi na phalarūpam tacca karmasamavāyīti karma pravartaka syāt
codayati–tatsādhanatvāt karmaṇyeva pravartate sarvatra sarveṣā phalasādhanatvābhāvāt
bhavatu tarhi tatsādhanatva pravṛttihetu karmaṇi, na phalarūpam
bhavatu ko doṣa ? ityata āha–tataśca karmasamavāyi na phalasamavāyīti karmaiva pravartaka syāt
phalasādhanabhūtasya yāgasyaiva pravarttakatva syāt, yāgasya tatsādhanatve niścite satyeva pravṛttidarśanāt

nanu niyatakarmasādhyatāyāḥ phalasamavetāyāḥ pravṛttihetutvāt phalasya pravarttakatvam, niyate ca upāyabhūte karmaṇi pravṛttiraviruddhā, nanu keyaṃ tatsādhyatā-phalasya svarūpam, śaktibhedo vā ? yadi svarūpam, tadā tasya sarvatrāviśeṣāt niyatakarmaṇīvaṃ arthāntare'pi pravṛttiḥ syāt
nahi tṛptiḥ bhujyapekṣayaiva tṛptirbhavati nāgnyapekṣayā iti, tṛptyarthinā agnāvapi pravarttitavyam
śaktibhedo'pi phalasya svasattvakāle, abhāvakāle vā syāt ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ, yataḥ pratiniyatādeva karmaṇaḥ pratiniyatasya phalasyotpattyarthaṃ tacchaktibhedaḥ parikalpyate
na cotpannasya sambandhinī śaktiḥ utpādaniyame samupayujyate
dvitīyavikalpopyasundaraḥ, nahi phalamavidyamānaṃ khapuṣpaprakhyaṃ sādhyatākhyaśaktibhedāśrayo bhavitumarhati

eva tarhi tatsādhyatā pravṛttihetu, sā ca phalasamavāyinīti na doṣa, tathāhi samabhilaṣitasya tṛptyāde karmaviśeṣeṇa sādhyatvāttatraiva pravṛtti, kā punariya sādhyatā ? yadi rūpa phalasya; sarvatra pravṛttiprasaṅga
etadukta bhavati–phalasamavāyinyapi sādhyatā sādhanādhīnanirūpaṇatayā sādhanamapi gocarayati na punarasādhanamapi tenaiva tasmādviśeṣāt sādhana eva pravarttayati na tu sarvatreti
tadetad dūṣayati–kā punariya sādhyatā ? yadi rūpa phalasya, tatastasya sādhanādhīnanirūpaṇatvābhāvānna sādhane pravarttayet pravarttayedvā sarvatraiva anyatvāviśeṣāt
jyotiṣṭomādiyāgajanyatā hi svargādiphalasamavāyinī ata vastuta yāgasādhyatāyā pravṛtihetutve phalasyaiva pravartakatva phalitamiti bhāva
kadā punaraya śaktibheda sādhyatābhidhāna ? phalasya bhāvasamaye na tāvat, vaiyarthyādapravṛttihetutvācca
utpannasya utpattivirodhāt, anutpannasyaiva hi samutpādo dṛśyate
abhāvakālepyasat katha śaktimat khapuṣpavat– vidhivi॰ pṛ॰ 29
kiñca, idaṃ phalaṃ vidyamānaṃ sat puruṣaṃ prerayati, avidyamānaṃ vā ? yadi vidya mānam, kimarthaṃ prerayati ? phalārthī hi puruṣaḥ pravarttate, tacced vidyate; alaṃ pravṛttyā
nahi loke yasya yadasti sa tadarthaṃ punaḥ pravarttate iti pratītam pravṛttyanuparamaprasaṅgāt
sato'pi phalasya ātmasambandhitāṃ karttu pravarttate, ityapyayuktam, yataḥ phalaṃ sukham, dukhābhāvaśca, tadubhayamapyupajāyamānam ātmasambaddhamevopajāyate
atha svargakāmaḥ puruṣaḥ svargādeḥ phalasya vidyamānasyaiva ātmasambaddhatāṃ karttuṃ pravarttate, nanvevaṃ putrakāmādau kā vārttā ? nahi putrādiphalasya tadā vidyamānatā saṃbhavati pratītivirodhāt
putrakāmanayā kriyamāṇe putreṣṭiyajñe na hi putra svargādivat vidyamāno'sti
kiñca, idaṃ phalaṃ sattāmātreṇa pravṛttihetuḥ, sādhyatāviśiṣṭaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhepi phale puruṣapravṛttihetutvaṃ syāt, sattāmātrasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
na ca siddhasya siddhaye prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttiryuktā tadanuparamaprasaṅgāt
atha sādhyatāvacchinnaṃ phalaṃ pravṛttiheturna kevalam; tadapyanupapannam; anarthino'pyataḥ pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
phalaṃ hi sādhyatayā viśiṣṭaṃ pratīyamānaṃ yadi pratipattāraṃ pravarttayati tadā anarthinamapi pravarttayettadaviśeṣāt
nāpyavidyamānasya, asyā'sataḥ kārakatvānupapatteḥ, asacca prerakañca–iti vipratiṣedhāt

ye'pi 'phalābhilāṣa eva preryagataḥ prerakatvād vidhiḥ, anarthinaḥ pravṛttyapratīteḥ, sa hi śabdamantareṇāpi kvacidabhilaṣite vastuni arthinaṃ puruṣaṃ pravarttayati ityācakṣate, te'pyasamīkṣitavācaḥ, abhilāṣasya avyāpakatayā pravṛttyaṅgatānupapatteḥ
tathāhi–kaścidācāryaprerito bālakaḥ kārya kimapi kurvan kenacit prayojanaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sannuttaramāha–na vedmi karaṇe asya kimapi prayojanam, kevalamācāryapreritaḥ karomi iti
tataḥ phalābhilāṣamantareṇāpi puruṣapravṛttipratīteḥ avyāpakaḥ sarvapravarttanānāṃ phalābhilāṣaḥ
anye tu karmaiva abhipretārthaprasādhakatvād vidhiḥ iti pratipannāḥ, tanmatamapyasaṅgatam, karmaṇo vidhiviṣayatayā vidhisvabhāvatvānupapatteḥ
vidherviṣayo hi karma loke prasiddhaṃ na tatsvabhāvam, ato'nyenātra pravarttakena hi bhavitavyam
nahi svasyaiva svātmasiddhyarthaṃ pravarttakatvaṃ yuktaṃ virodhāt
astu tarhi karma pravartakam, abhimatasādhanatā tasya pravartanā, pravṛttiheturūpatvāt; na, viṣayatvāt
tadetad dūṣayati na tasya viṣayatvāt, pravṛttikarttu prayojaka pravarttaka
tadiha siddha cet karma pravṛtte prāk pravṛtte bhāvanāyā viṣayo na bhāvyam
na hi ghaṭasya jñānaviṣayatve jñānasvabhāvatā yuktā –ā॰ ṭi॰
kiñca, utpannaṃ karma ātmasiddhyarthaṃ puruṣaṃ pravarttayati, anutpannaṃ vā ? tatra utpannasya svarūpasiddherjātatvāt puruṣapreraṇā vyarthā
sadeva hi kiñcit kasyacitprerakaṃ nāsat kharaviṣāṇādikam, tathāvidhasya kārakatvāyogāt
asatā cānena saha apauruṣeyavacasaḥ sambandhāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ tad vedavākyaiḥ pratipādyeta yataḥ puruṣapravṛttihetutvāt tad vākyārthaḥ syāt
atha sāmānyākāreṇa sat karma viśeṣākārasampādanāya puruṣaṃ prerayati, tanna, yenāṃśena tat sanna tenāṃśena puruṣasādhyam, yena cāṃśena sādhyaṃ na tena tadabhidheyaṃ sambandhāsaṃbhavāt
