nahi sambandhā'bhidheyābhidhānānāṃ nityatvābhyupagame anitye karmaviśeṣe nityasya sambandhasya saṃbhāvanāpi saṃbhavati
lakṣaṇayā tatpratipattiḥ, ityapyayuktam, tasyāstadvat śabdārthanirūpaṇāvasare nirastatvāt

nanu vidherliṅādivākyatābhyupagamāt taduccāraṇāt prāgasiddhatve sati agṛhītasambandhatvena bācyatvāyogālliṅādyuccāraṇāt prāgeva siddhe tatparatva na yuktamityāśakya śabdaśravaṇānantarabhāvipravṛttihetupreṣaṇādhyeṣaṇādivyāpārānuvṛttapravarttanāsāmānyābhidhānena tadviśeṣāpekṣāyāmaporuṣeye vede puruṣadharmasya preṣaṇāderasambhavāt tadvyatiriktavidhyākhyasya viśeṣasya pariśeṣyāllakṣaṇayā gamyamānasya sambandhagrahaṇānapekṣatvena prāk siddhyanapekṣaṇādaviruddhā śabdavyāparateti –nyāyasu॰ pṛ॰ 559, tathā pṛ॰ 30

atha ātmano'prāptakriyāsambandhapratipattiḥ pravarttakatvād vidhiḥ, tavedaṃ karma ityukte hi kriyāsambandhamātmanyavagamya pravarttamānāḥ pratīyante laukikā iti, tadapyayuktam, nahi kriyāsambandhapratipattimātreṇa pravṛttirloke pratīyate, api tu tadanurodhitayā, anyathā sarvasyaiva tavedaṃ karma iti karmasambandhapratipattimātreṇa pravṛttiḥ prasajyeta, atastadanurodhitāpi pravarttakatvād vidhiḥ prasajyeta
sāpi vā na prāpnoti, svāmivākyavad vedavākye tasyāḥ sattvā'saṃbhavāt
idaṃ kuru iti vākyāddhi svāmino'bhiprāyaṃ viditvā tadicchānatikrameṇa tadanurodhitayā pravarttate
yadapi samarthanam–aprāptasambandhayā kriyayā ātmana sambandhasya pratītyā pravṛtti yathā'dya taveda karmeti loke
mṛṣā bhavettathā kāma kiṃ mudhaiṣa prayasyati
pratipadyatānāmāyamātmana kriyāyoga śabdāt, ta ca tathābhāve tatheti niścinotu viparyaye naitadevamiti
pravartate tu kasmāt ? loke tvadya taveda karmeti vacanādadhigatavaktrabhiprāyo yo yadabhiprāyānurodhī sa pravartitumarhati anyathā sarvasya pravṛtte
vākyaprayoktṛpuruṣasya abhiprāyānurodhāt pravṛttirbhavati ata abhiprāyānurodha eva vidhyartha syāditi bhāva

ye'pi svargādiphalasādhanatvena dhātvarthaṃ pratītya puruṣārthasādhanatvādasminn pravarttāmahe iti śreyaḥsādhanatvākhyadharmāvagamaḥ pravṛttihetutvād vidhiḥ' ityācakṣate, te'pyaśabdārthavidaḥ; śreyaḥsādhanātāyāḥ vidhitvena loke'prasiddheḥ, praiṣādīnāmeva tatra tattvena prasiddheḥ
na ca śreyaḥsādhanatā tacchabdavācyatayā loke prasiddhā, yenāsyā vidhitvaṃ syāt, lokānusāreṇa ca padārthavyavasthā
ya eva laukikāḥ śabdāḥ ta eva vaidikāḥ śābarabhā॰ 1
maṇḍanamiśrā hi ida macchreya sādhanam ityavagamasyaiva pravṛttihetutā svīkurvanti; tathā cokta tai–pu~sā neṣṭābhyupāyatvāt kriyāsvanya pravarttaka
pravattisamartho hi kaścid bhāvātiśayo vyāpārābhidhāna pravartanā
na hi tathātvamapratipadya tatra pravartate kaścit
śreyaḥsādhanatā hyeṣā nitya vedāt pratīyate mī॰ ślo॰ pṛ॰ 49

tasmādiṣṭasādhanataiva vidhi liṅādyabhidheyeti tadyuktāyā bhāvanāyā phalameva bhāvya dhātvarthastu karaṇamiti pṛ॰ 46 tenābhidhāvyāpārapravartanābhidhānavat pravartanārūpeṇa iṣṭasādhanatā śabdo'bhidhatte na svarūpeṇeti na pratītivirodha
idameva bhagavato maṇḍanamiśrasyāpi 'pu~sā neṣṭābhyupāyatvat kriyāsvanyaḥ pravartaka
tathā ca pravartanatvānurodhāt vidherapi iṣṭasādhanatvādikamevārthaḥ –muktā॰ pṛ॰ 516
kiñca, kasyeyaṃ śreyaḥsādhanatā–bhāvanāyāḥ, dhātvarthasya vā ? na tāvad bhāvanāyāḥ, tasyāḥ prāguktaprakāreṇa asiddhasvarūpatvāt
na khalu hiṃsā śreyaḥsādhanam; brāhmaṇavadhāderapi tatprasaṅgāt
vihitānuṣṭhānatvāttatsādhanatve sadhanaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt ityāderapi vihitānuṣṭhānatvāt śreyaḥsādhanatvānuṣaṅgaḥ
tulanā–kiñca, bhāvanāgata śreyaḥsādhanatva pravarttakamiṣyate tai, tacca na pṛthagabhidhātu yuktam
bhāvanāyā tryaśatvena tatsvarūpāvagamasamaye etadaśayo svargayāgayo sādhyasādhanabhāvāvagatisiddhe
yajño hi vede vihito'ta sa śreya sādhanamityukte satyāha

tulanā–vidhipūrvakasya paśvādivadhasya vihitānuṣṭhānatvena hisāhetutvābhāvāt asiddho heturiti cet, tarhi vidhipūrvakasya sadhanavadhasya khārapaṭikānā vihitānuṣṭhānatvena hiṃsāhetutva mā bhūditi sadhanavadhāt svargo bhavatīti vacana pramāṇamastu –tattvārthaślo॰ pṛ॰ 12
upadeśaśabdena ca viṣayo liṅādiḥ abhidhā cocyate
tatra upadiśyate pratyāyyate ityupadeśo viṣayo yāgādiḥ, upadiśyate'nena ityupadeśo liṅādiḥ, upadeśanamupadeśaḥ abhidhā uccāraṇamucyate, tadapyasaṅgatam, ṭhakopadeśasyāpi vidhitvaprasaṅgāt
bhavatparikalpitaprakriyāyāḥ agniṣṭomena yajeta svargakāmaḥ ityādivat sadhanaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hanyādbhūtikāmaḥ ityādāvapi tulyatvāt
"nanu codanāyā prāmāṇya pratijñāta kathamupadeśasya sādhyate ? ata āha–codanā copadeśaśca vidhiścaikārthavācina
prathito guruvaidyādau nitye'pi na na kalpyate
anujñā tu yadyapyeva kvacit tathāpi pravṛttapuruṣaviṣayatvānnopadeśa
nāpi bhaikṣya cet cara jvarita pathyamaśnīyāditi pratīti, bhūyasā caiṣa pauruṣeyeṣu kāmārthaśāstrādiṣvājñādibhiranārūṣito loke prajñāyate, gopālādivaca su ca mārgākhyānapareṣu anena pathā gaccheti
preṣaṇādivat tairapi hi yathāvivakṣitamarthādayo nirdiśyante siddhāntamupakramate–ucyate–upadeśo niyo upadeśastu yujyate tasya apauruṣaye'pi sabhavāt
na hyasau niyojakārthakarmeti vakṣyati, yena cetanakartṛka syāt, na cāsau na laukika apreraṇātmako vā yenāvidhi syādityāhaso'pi tadvadeva ājñāvadeva preraṇātmakaścaturtho loke prajñāyate
etadukta bhavati–ājñābhyarthanopadeśā karmaṇi pravṛttijananena tadgocarayanto bhavanti preraṇātmatayā samānā

upadeśagocarastu karma anādṛtopadeśakaprayojanamupadeṣṭavyārthamevetyayam ājñā'bhyarthanābhyāmupadeśasya bheda, preraṇātmakatva ceti niyojyārtha karma yasyopadeśasya na tu niyoktrartha sa tathokta ityakṣarayojanā
aprasthitasya apravṛttasya pusa prasthāpanā codanā nanūpadeśo vidhi, sa cārthabhedābhidhāyaka, śabda iti kvacitkvaciduccāraṇamāha śabdasyoccāraṇamiti
kvacit jñāna śāstra śabdavijñānādasannikṛṣṭe'rthe vijñānamiti, vārtikakāraśca abhidhā bhāvanāmāhurityabhidhāmiti
ata āha–pradarśanārthaṃ ceda viśiṣṭa śabdo vidhiriti
kiñca, parānugrahapravṛttasya āptasya vacanam upadeśaḥ prasiddhaḥ
na ca vede tathāvidhaḥ kaścit puruṣo'sti apauruṣeyatvābhāvaprasaṅgāt, tatkathamasya upadeśatāpi ? na khalu upadeṣṭṝvyatirekeṇa upadeśaḥ kadācitpratipannaḥ
guruvaidyādyupadeṣṭṝsadbhāve satyeva bhaikṣaṃ cara, dhyānādhyayane kuru, jvarita aupadhaṃ pivet, pathyamaśnīyāt ityādyupadeśasya pratīteḥ
na ca śabda eva upadeṣṭā ityabhidhātavyam; avyutpannasyāpyato'rthapratipattiprasaṅgāt

atha śabdārthasambandhavyutpattisavyapekṣa evāsau tattvamupadiśati; nanu kutastadvyutpattiḥ ? viśiṣṭapuruṣāccet, sa eva upadeṣṭā'stu kimanayā paramparayā ? pratiṣetsyate ca apauruṣeyatvamasya agre ityalamatiprasaṅgena
nanūktamupadeśa iti viśiṣṭasya śabdasyoccāraṇam; yadyevamavyutpannasyāpi pravṛttiprasaṅga
puruṣārthasyopāyamanavagatamavagamayannutkarṣādviśiṣṭa śabda ukta, anyathā sarva eva śabdaḥ śabdāntarād bhinna ityaviśeṣaṇameva syāt

yepi viṣayasya yāsau karttavyatāpratītiḥ saiva pravarttakatvādvidhiḥ iti pratijānate; nahi idaṃ me karttavyam ityapratipadyamānaḥ kaścitpravarttate iti; te'pyasamīkṣitavacasaḥ; yataḥ kiṃ karttavyatāpratipattiḥ nirviśiṣṭā pravṛttihetuḥ, śreyaḥsādhanatāviśiṣṭā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ, sarvasya sarvatra karttavyatāpratipattimātreṇa pravṛttiprasaṅgāt, tathā ca brāhmaṇādivadhakarttavyatāpratipattimātreṇa bhavatastadvadhādāvapi pravṛttiḥ syāt
atha śreyaḥsādhanatāviśiṣṭā sā pravṛttihetuḥ; tarhi śreyaḥsādhanataiva pravṛttihetutvād vidhiḥ syānna karttavyatā tasyāstāmantareṇā'pravarttakatvāt
atra kecidāmnāya prati śrāddhamānina prāhu–nanu kartavyamiti pratipatteḥ pravṛtti
anumitā ca buddhi asmatpravṛttihetubuddhigocaracāriṇī pravṛttihetubuddhitvāt asmatpravṛttihetubuddhivat
tasyāśca viṣaya svayameva cakṣurunmītya piṇḍikaroga ḍiṇḍikarāgaṃ parityajya paryālocayantaḥ śabdavyāpārapuruṣāśayatatsamīhitatatsādhanatāvyudāsena karttavyatāmeva pratipadyāmahe
tathāhi–stanapānādāvapi na jātu samīhitopāya ityeva pravṛttā sma, kintu karttavyametaditi liṅādiśravaṇānantarā pravṛtti karttavyatābhidhānameva liṅādīnāmāpādayati
tathā ca viditasaṅgatitayā liṅādayo vede'pi tāmevābhidaghate

tulanā–nanvapekṣitopāyatāmantareṇa karttavyamiti śataśo'pyabhidhīyamāna na pravṛttaye kalpyata ityata āha–katha hi tathā pratipadyamāno na pravartteta ? śabdastāvatkartavyatāyā viditasaṅgati tāmavagamayati
tathā naimittikaniṣedhādhikārayorasau pratīyamānā na śakyā neti vaktum
nahi pratibhāvyatirekeṇa liṅā divyāpāro'pi balavatsalilasamīraṇanyāyena puruṣaṃ pravarttayati sarvasya pravṛttiprasaṅgāt
ato yā kācit pravṛttiḥ sā sarvā pratibhāsamānākāranirṇayarūpapratibhāpūrvikaiva
nahi pratibhāte'pyarthe yāvat sukhasādhanamidamiti pratibhā notpadyate tāvat kaścit pravarttate
uktañca–viśiṣṭasādhanāvyavacchinnakriyāpratītyanukūlā prajñā pratibhā vidhivi॰ pṛ॰ 246 iti, tadapyasāram, yataḥ siddhe pratibhāsvarūpe vidhirūpatā syāt
na ca bhavatpratipāditaṃ pratibhāyāḥ svarūpaṃ yuktam

indriyādibāhyasāmagrīnirapekṣaṃ hi manomātrasāmagrīprabhavam arthatathābhāvaprakāśaṃ jñānaṃ pratibheti prasiddham–śvo me bhrātā āgantā ityādivat, na punaḥ pratibhāsamānākāranirṇayarūpatāmātram, nirvikalpakādhyakṣottarakālabhāvinaḥ savikalpakapratyakṣasyāpi tadrūpatayā pratibhātvānuṣaṅgāt, tathā ca savikalpakapratyakṣavārttocchedaḥ syāt
pratibhāsamānākāro yo nirṇaya tadrūpā pratibhā –ā॰ ṭi॰
kriyāviśeṣo na puruṣaṃ pravarttayati sarvasya pravṛttiprasaṃgāt parisphuraṇaṃ ba॰
vyākhyā–na hi te pratibhāvida ye savedanamaniścayātmaka pratibhāmācakhyu
vaya tu sādhyasādhanetikartavyatāvacchinnāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ pratipattāvanukūlā tatpratipattyā kārye'nuṣṭhānalakṣaṇe karttavye sahakāriṇī karttavyamiti prajñā pratibhāmadhyagīṣmahi

tulanā– āmnāyavidhātṝṇāmṛṣīṇāmatītānāgatavartamāneṣvatīndriyeṣvartheṣu gharmādinibaddheṣu granthopanibaddheṣu ca ātmamanaso sayogād dharmaviśeṣācca yat prātibha yathārthanivedana jñānamutpadyate tadārṣamityācakṣate
kadācideva laukikānā yathā kanyakā bravīti śvo me bhrātā''ganteti hṛdaya me kathayatīti
pramāṇa pratibha śvo me bhrātā''ganteti dṛśyate
tatra dṛṣṭakāraṇa vinaiba akasmād vyavahitaviprakṛṣṭātītānāgatasūkṣmādyarthasphuraṇe sāmarthyaṃ pratibhā
indriyaliṅgādyabhāve yadarthapratibhāna sā pratibhā –praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 258

yadapi sādhanaviśeṣe kriyāviśeṣaparisphuraṇam, tatkiṃ pūrvāhitasaṃskāravaśāt, pratyakṣādipramāṇavyāpārānusārataḥ, codanātaḥ, śvo me bhrātetyādivat manomātrato vā syāt ? tatrā'ntyavikalpo'yuktaḥ, aśrutacodanāvākyasya yāgādisādhane kriyāviśe ṣasya svapne'pyasphuraṇāt
prāktanavikalpatraye tu pratibhātvaṃ viruddhyeta, anyathā saṃskārādibhyaḥ samutpannānāṃ smṛtyādīnāmapi pratibhātvānuṣaṅgāt tadevaikaṃ pramāṇaṃ syāt
agnihotra juhuyāt ityādi pravartaka hi vākya codanā
na khalu śraddhāparaparyāyāṃ bhaktiṃ vinā paramātmaśravaṇānumananadhyānādau yāgādau vā pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati
eva ca sati liṅāde ko'yamartha parigṛhīta iti cet, yaj devapūjāyāmiti devatārādhanabhūtayāgādeḥ prakṛtyarthasya kartṛvyāpārasādhyatā vyutpattisiddhā liṅādayo'bhidadhatīti na kiñcidanupapannam
tayā śūnyaṃ bhavet puṃsāṃ śāstraṃ śāsanamātrakṛt
bhaktyaṃśena ca tadbhinnaṃ loke rājānuśāsanāt || iti
tadapyasamyak; yasmādutpannā satī bhaktiḥ pravṛttinimittaṃ syāt, utpattiścāsyāḥ śabdāt, nigrahānugrahasamarthapuruṣaviśeṣādvā ? na tāvacchabdādeva, draṣṭavyoreyamātmā vṛhadā॰ 4
6 ityādiśabdaśrāviṇo'śeṣasyāpi pratipattuḥ ātmādau bhaktyutpattiprasaṅgāt taddarśanādau pravṛttiḥ syāt
yadaviśeṣe'pi yannotpadyate na tat tanmātrahetukam yathā aviśiṣṭe'pi bīje anutpadyamāno'ṅkuraḥ, notpadyate ca aviśiṣṭe'pi śabde tacchabdaśrāviṇo'śeṣasya ātmādau bhaktiriti
atha nigrahānugrahasamarthāt puruṣāviśeṣādabhimataṃ phalaṃ vāñchatāṃ sotpadyate; yuktametat; tasyā eva bhaktiśabdavācyatvaprasiddheḥ
anavacchinnapūrṇatvadharmopetasya cātmanaḥ brahmādvaitapraghaṭṭake pratyākhyātatvātkathaṃ kasyacittatra tathāvidhapuruṣādanyato vā kharaviṣāṇādiva bhaktiḥ syāt
ātmā vā are draṣṭavyaḥ otavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyo maitreyyātmani khalvare dṛṣṭe śrute mate vijñāta idaṃ sarvaṃ viditam
veda īśvarārādhanarūpā bhakti vidadhīta tadā dharme'pi īśvarasyaiva prāmāṇya syāt tathā ca vedasya apauruṣeyatvavyādhātaḥ, īśvarasya nigrahānugrahakaraṇavat vedakartṛtvamapi syāditi bhāva
icchāprayatnaprabhṛtayo'pi vidhiprakārāḥ prāguktaprakāreṇaiva pratyākhyeyāḥ, viṣayaphalādinirapekṣāṇāṃ teṣāmapi puruṣapravṛttihetutvābhāvato vidhirūpatānupapatteḥ
tatsāpekṣāṇāṃ tu pravṛttihetutve kathaṃ teṣāmeva vidhitvaṃ syāt viṣayādīnāmapi tatprasaṅgāt ? tataḥ paraparikalpitasvarūpasya vidhervicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ na tasyāpi śabdārthatā ghaṭate
ataḥ siddha na tārkikarītyā iṣṭasādhanatve liṅādyarthatvamapi tu pūrvoktarītyā pravarttakecchāyā eva

tulanā–apare punarliṅādiśabdaśravaṇe sati samupajāyamānamātmaspandaviśeṣamudyoga nāma vākyārthamācakṣate; tatsvarūpa tu na vaya jānīma, ko'yamātmaspando nāma buddhirvā syāt prayatno vā icchādveṣayoranyataro vā
śrutajñānam ityādinā kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe–śrutajñānaṃ śabdajñānaṃ vaktrabhiprāyādarthāntare'pi bahirarthe'pi na kevalaṃ tadabhiprāya eva pramāṇam
katham ? na kathañcid anyathā bahirarthe tatprāmāṇyābhāvaprakāreṇa pratipattumarhati saugato'nyo vā
tamitthambhūtamarthaṃ digvibhāgena kathanna pratipattumarhati ? ityāha–nirārekamavisaṃvādañca yathā bhavati tatheti
nanu cārthābhāve'pi śruteḥ prāyaḥ pravṛttidarśanānna kvacidapyasau pramāṇamityāśaṅkyāha–
keṣām ? pratibandhamapaśyatā śabdārthayo sahajayogyatālakṣaṇa sambandhamanīkṣamāṇānā saugatānām
kāsām ? akṣaliṅgadhiyām, akṣamindriya liṅga hetu tābhyā janitā dhiyo jñānāni tāsāmapi prasaktamityartha kvacitkadācidvisavādadarśanāt
tathāviśeṣaṇe śrutajñāne ko'paritoṣaḥ ? yathā kṛttikādeḥ śakaṭādijñānaṃ svabhāvapratibandhamantareṇa tathaiva adṛṣṭapratibandhārthābhidhānaṃ jñānamavisaṃvādakam
kvacidvyabhicārāt sākalyenānāśvāse vaktrabhiprāye'pi vācaḥ kathamanāśvāso na syāt tatrāpi vyabhicārasaṃbhavāt ? tathānicchataḥ śrutikalpanāduṣṭādeḥ uccāraṇāt
indriyajñānasya lakṣaṇe abhrāntam iti viśeṣaṇa saugatai prayujyate– kalpanāpoḍhamabhrānta pratyakṣam
pratyakṣalakṣaṇe avyabhicāri iti viśeṣaṇaṃ naiyāyikāpekṣayā jñeyam
tulanā– vivakṣāprabhava vākya svārthe na pratibadhyate
vaktrabhiprāyamātra vākya sūcayantītyaviśeṣeṇākṣipan na pāramparyeṇāpi tattva pratipadyeta
na ca vaktrabhiprāyamekāntena sūcayanti śrutiduṣṭāderanyata eva prasiddhe
prāyo bāhulyena śruteḥ śabdasya tajjñānasya vā visaṃvādāt sarvatra satyaśrutāvapi ced yadi anāśvāsaḥ
kim ? ityāha–pratibandham, sambandhaṃ santamapi yogyatārūpamavinābhāvam, saḥ sarvatrānāśvāsaḥ akṣaliṅgadhiyāṃ samaḥ tāsāmapi prāyo visaṃvādadarśanādityabhiprāyaḥ
kena vinetyāha–abhrāntamavyabhicārīti vā viśeṣaṇamantareṇa, tadviśeṣaṇe satyeva tatpramāṇamiti
nahi nirviśeṣaṇasya jñānamātrasya prāmāṇyābhyupame dvicandrādijñānasya prāmāṇyavyavacchedaḥ karttuṃ śakyaḥ
atha tadviśeṣaṇe satyeva tatpramāṇaṃ tenāyamadoṣaḥ; atrāha–tathā ityādi
tathā abhrāntā'vyabhicāriprakāreṇa viśeṣaṇe indriyajñānasya aṅgīkriyamāṇe śrutajñāne ko'paritoṣaḥ ? tasyāpi tadviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasyaiva prāmāṇyamastu
nanu indriyajñānasya arthakāryatvāt yuktam abhrāntatvamavyabhicāritvaṃ vā na punaḥ śrutajñānasya viṣaryayāt; ityatrāha–yathā ityādi

yathā yena yogyatāprakāreṇa kṛttikādeḥ sakāśāt yat śakaṭādijñānaṃ tat svabhāvapratibandhamantareṇa, svabhāvapratibandhaśabdena tādātmyapratibandhastadutpattisambandhaśca gṛhyate svo bhāvaḥ kāraṇam iti vyutpatteḥ, tamantareṇa avisaṃvādakaṃ tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa adṛṣṭapratibandhārthābhidhānajñānam adṛṣṭaḥ tādātmyādipratibandho yasmin arthā bhidhānajñāne tattathoktam, taditthambhūtaṃ jñānamavisaṃvādakam
hiryasmāt na dṛṣṭe grahoparāgādau śrutāvisaṃvādakatve anupapannaṃ nāma
bahirarthe asya prāyo vyabhicāradarśanāt sarvatrānāśvāse ca vaktrabhiprāye'pi prāmāṇyanna syāditi darśayannāha–kvacid ityādi
kvacit niyate viṣaye vyabhicārāt sākalyenā'nāśvāse śruteraṅgīkriyamāṇe vaktrabhiprāye'pi na kevalaṃ bahirarthe vācaḥ kathamanāśvāsaḥ sākalyena na syāt ? api tusyādeva

yena hi yā bhavataḥ priyā ityādiprakāreṇa paraṃ prahṛtya viśrāntaḥ puruṣo vīryavān ityādiprakāreṇa ca śrutiduṣṭaṃ kalpanāduṣṭañcoktaṃ tathā tena prakāreṇa anicchataḥ tathābhiprāyarahitasyāpi śrutikalpanāduṣṭādeḥ ādiśabdena gotraskhalanādiparigrahaḥ uccāraṇāt bhāṣaṇāt
tulanā–api cānyavivakṣāyāmanyaśabdadarśanāt vivakṣāyāmapi kvacidvyabhicārāt sarvatrānāśvāsāt kathaṃ vivakṣāviśeṣasūcakā api te syu
yā bhavata priyā ityatra śṛṅgārarasavarṇanāvasare niṣiddhasya rephasya prayogādeva śrutikaṭutva jñeyam
para prahṛtya ityatra hi yadā vīryavān puruṣa para prahṛtya prahārānantara viśrānta viśeṣeṇa śrānta klāntaḥ tadā tasya bīryavattvena varṇanamanucitameva
yadi hi prahārānantara klānta katha vīryavān ? klāntatvavīryavattvayorvirodhāt
satyetaravyavasthā hi vāhyārthaprāptyaprāptinibandhanaiva, tathā coktam–āptamīmāsāyām kā॰ 87 buddhiśabdapramāṇatva bāhyārthe sati nāsati
vivṛtiḥ–nahi puruṣārthābhisandhayaḥ sarve'rthān vyabhicaranti, anyathā vāgarthavyabhicāraikāntasaṃbhavāt

vāco'bhiprāyavisaṃvāde kutastadanumānam ? sugatetarayoḥ āptetaravyavasthāṃ kutaścit sādhanāsādhanāṅgavyavasthāṃ vā svayamupajīvan vakturabhipretaṃ tu vācaḥ sūcayanti aviśeṣeṇa nārthatattvamapi iti kathamaviklavaḥ ?
tulanā–nāntarīyakatābhāvācchabdānā vastubhi saha nārthasiddhistataste hi vaktrabhiprāyasūcakā
anyavivakṣāyāmanyaśabdoccāraṇamapi pratīyate yathā devadattavivakṣāyā yajñadattoccāraṇa gotraskhalane'nubhūyate

yo yasyā'vañcakaḥ sa tasya āptaḥ tadukteḥ tadvacanāt hetuvādācca liṅgādivacanācca bahirarthāviniścaye aṅgīkriyamāṇe satyaṃ sugatavacanam itaradasatyaṃ kapilādivacanam tayoḥ vyavasthā kā ? na kācit, sarvamasatyameva syāt
tathā sādhanetaratā kutaḥ ? pakṣādivacanāni sādhanam, itarat taddūṣaṇavacanaṃ tayorbhāvastattā sāpi kutaḥ ? naiva syāt
tathā ca yat sattat sarva kṣaṇikam ityāderasādhanāṅgatayā nigrahasthānatā syādityabhiprāyaḥ
āpta khalu sākṣātkṛtadharmā yathādṛṣṭasyārthasya cikhyāpayiṣayā prayukta upadeṣṭā
āpti sākṣādarthaprāptiḥ yathārthopalambha tayā vartata ityāpta sākṣātkṛtadharmā yathārthaprāptyā śrutārthagrāhī
yo yatrāvisavādakaḥ sa tatrāptaḥ paro'nāpta tattvapratipādanamavisavāda tadarthajñānāt
na khalu puruṣābhisandhayaḥ puruṣābhiprāyāḥ sarve arthān vyabhicaranti
anyathā teṣāṃ tadvyabhicāraprakāreṇa vāgarthavyabhicāraikāntasambhavāt, vācāmarthasya bāhyasya anyasya vā yo vyabhicāraikāntaḥ tasya saṃbhavāt
vāco'bhiprāyavisaṃvāde sati kutaḥ na kutaścit tasya abhiprāyasya anumānam

athedānīṃ parasyonmattaceṣṭitaṃ sugata ityādinā darśayannāha–sugatasya hi āptatvavyavasthāṃ kutaścid anupadeśā'liṅgāvisaṃvādicaturāryasatyopadeśāt kapilādestu anāptatvavyavasthāṃ visaṃvādipradhānāditattvopadeśāt svayam ātmanā upajīvan, sādhanāsādhanāṅgavyavasthāṃ vā, trirūpahetuvacanasya hi svasādhyasiddhyaṅgavyavasthā pakṣādivacanasya tu tadasiddhyaṅgavyavasthā tāṃ vā upajīvan vakturabhipretaṃ tu vācaḥ sūcayanti aviśeṣeṇa nārthatattvamapi iti evaṃ bruvāṇo dharmakīrtyādiḥ kathamaviklavaḥ svasthaḥ ? atrāha saugataḥ–vaktrabhiprāye'pi yadi vacanasya prāmāṇyannāsti, mā bhūt, kinnaṣṭaṃ pramāṇadvayavādinaḥ ? vyavahārijanānurodhādeva tatra tasya prāmāṇyābhyupagamādityāśaṅkyāha–
tadvat pramāṇa bhagavān yathābhihitasya satyacatuṣṭayasyāvisaṃvādanāttasyaiva parairajñātasya prakāśanācca
"tāyitvācca bhagavata sugatasya prāmāṇya tathāhi–tāya svadṛṣṭamārgokti vaiphalyādvakti nānṛtam
–duḥkhahetunivartakatvena svayaṃ dṛṣṭasya mārgasyoktirdeśanā tāya karaṇe kāryopacārāt

viśeṣata satyābhidhānahetureva kṛpāstītyāha–dayālutvācca parārthañca sarvasya mārgābhyāsāderārambhe'bhiyogata parārthamevoddiśya bhagavānabhisambuddha kathantasya mithyābhidhānena sattvavañcanāśaṅkā'pi
parairajñātasya satyacatuṣṭayasya prakāśana vā tāyaḥ tadyogāt tāyī pramāṇa bhagavānukta
catvāryāyasatyāni, tadyathā duḥkha samudayo nirodho mārgaśceti
athavā sādhyate yena pareṣāmapratīto'rtha iti sādhana trirūpahetuvacanasamudāya, tasyāṅga pakṣadharmādivacanaṃ athavā tasyaiva sādhanasya yannāṅga pratijñopanayanigamanādi –vādanyāya॰ pṛ॰ 61
tulanā–vicitrābhisandhitayā vyāpāravyāhārādisākaryeṇa kvacidapyatiśayānirṇaye kaimarthakyādviśeṣeṣṭi jñānavato'pi visavādāt kva punarāśvāsa labhemahi
kasmāt ? citrābhisandhe citra satyāsatyādirūpo nānābhisandhirabhiprāyo vivakṣā tasmāt
kasya ? puso vaktu sarāgā api vītarāgavacceṣṭante iti vacanāt
tarhi vijātīyādapi kāraṇāt kārya dṛṣṭamaviruddha syāt
tatastat kāraṇabhedi kāraṇa pratiniyata svātmalābhanibandhana bhinatti vijātīyādviśinaṣṭītyeva śīla kiṃ śakya syāt ? na syādevetyartha

vivṛtiḥ–śruterbahulaṃ bahirarthāvisaṃvāde'pi tadarthapratibandhāsiddheḥ vaktrabhiprāyānuvidhāyinyāḥ sarvatra tadarthānāśvāsaḥ iti ceduktamatra–tādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ vināpi parokṣārthapratipatteravisaṃvādaḥ iti

api ca vṛkṣo'ya śiṃśapātvāt agniratra dhūmāditi vā kathamāśvāsaḥ ? kvacillatācūtāderupalabdheḥ śiṃśapāyāḥ svayamavṛkṣatve'pyavirodhāt, kāṣṭhajanmano maṇyādisāmagrīprabhavasya aśanijanmanaḥ tadarthāntarajanmanaśca sākalyena agnisvabhāvāvirodhe punaḥ agnijanmaiva dhūmaḥ nārthāntarajanmā iti kuto'yaṃ niyamaḥ ? yataḥ kāryahetoravyabhicārāt dhūmādagniratra ityāśvāsaḥ
kasyacidanyathānupapattyā parokṣārthapratipattau śrutajñānasya svayamadṛṣṭatādātmyatadutpatteḥ kvacidavisaṃvādasya anyathānupapatteḥ siddhaṃ prāmāṇyamiti
tulanā–na caiva vādina kiñcidanumānaṃ nāma, nirabhisandhīnāmapi bahula kāryasvabhāvāniyamoṣalambhāt
sati kāṣṭhādisāmagrīviśeṣe kvacidupalabdhasya tadabhāve prāyaśo'nupalabdhasya maṇyādikāraṇakalāpe'pi sabhavāt

yajjātīyo yata maprekṣitastajjātīyāttādṛgiti durlabhaniyamatāyā dhūmadhūmaketvādīnāmapi vyāpyavyāpakabhāva kathamiva nirṇīyeta vṛkṣa śiśapātvāditi latācūtāderapi kvacideva darśanāt prekṣāvatā kimiva ni śaka ceta syāt –aṣṭaśa॰, aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 72
puṃso yaḥ citro'bhisandhiḥ sarāgā api vītarāgavacceṣṭante ityabhidhānāt, tasmāt vāk ced yadi arthavyabhicāriṇī kārya dṛṣṭaṃ vijātīyād abhimatakāraṇajātiparihāreṇa jātyantarādapi
śakyaṃ śaktaṃ kāraṇabhedi kāraṇaviśeṣaṃ gamayituṃ kim ? naiva śaktamityarthaḥ
tulanā–caitasebhya samyakmithyāpravṛttayaste cātīndriyasvaprabhavakāyavāgvyavahārānumeyā syu vyavahārāśca prāyaśo buddhipūrvamanyathāpi kartu śakyate puruṣecchāvṛttitvātteṣā ca citrābhisandhitvāt
tadaya liṅgasakarāt kathamaniścinvan pratipadyeta ? durbodhatvāt duprāpyatvādanyaguṇadoṣaniścāyakānā pramāṇānām caitasebhya ityādinā vyācaṣṭe
caitasebhya guṇebhyaḥ kṛpāvairāgyabodhādihetubhya samyakpravṛttaya yathārthapravṛttaya, caitasebhyo doṣebhya rāgādibhyo mithyāpravṛttayo viparītapravṛttayo bhavanti
te ceti pareṣā caitasā guṇadoṣā cetodharmatvenātīndriyā tato na pratyakṣagamyā
kintu svasmād guṇadoṣarūpāt prabhava utpādo yasya kāyavākkarmaṇa tena kāryaliṅgenānumeyā
yasmād vyavahārāśca kāyavākkarmalakṣaṇā prāyaśo bāhulyena buddhipūrvamiti kṛtvā pratisakhyāne anyathāpi karttu śakyante
tathāhi sarāgā api vītarāgavat ātmāna darśayanti vītarāgāśca sarāgavat
kiṃ kāraṇam ? puruṣecchāvṛttitvāt vyavahārāṇā teṣā ceti pusā citrābhisandhitvāt citrābhiprāyatvāt tato yatheṣṭaṃ vyavahārā pravatante iti nāsti guṇadoṣaprabhavāṇā vyavahārāṇā vivekaniścaya
taditi tasmādayamanumātā pumān liṅgamakarāt liṅgavyabhicārādaniścinvan kṣīṇadoṣa kathamāgamasya kartāra pratipadyeta naiveti nigamanīyam
eva na vacanamātrāt, nāpi viśeṣāt pratipatti abhiprāyasya durbadhitvāt vyavahārasakareṇa sarveṣā vyabhicārāt
virakto hi raktavacceṣṭate rakto'pi viraktavadityabhiprāyo durbodha –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰, ṭī॰ 1
kṣīṇāvaraṇa samadhigatalakṣaṇo'pi san vicitrābhisandhiranyathā deśayediti vipralambhaśakī –pramāṇasaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 116
śruteḥ śabdasya bahulaṃ prācuryeṇa bahirarthāvisaṃvāde'pi na kevalaṃ tadabhāve, tadarthena bahirarthena pratibandhasya tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇasya asiddheḥ kāraṇāt
kva kimityāha–sarvatra tadarthānāśvāsaḥ bahirarthānāśvāsa iti evaṃ cet atrāha–uktam ityādi
ki tadityāha–tādātmyatadutpattibhyāṃ vināpi parokṣārthapratipatteḥ kāraṇāt avisaṃvādaḥ śruteḥ iti etat
api ca ityādinā parapakṣepi taddūpaṇaṃ yojayati
api ca kiñca ayaṃ dṛśyamāno bhāvaḥ vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapātvāt, atra parvate agniḥ dhūmāt iti vā yadanumānaṃ tatra kathaṃ naiva āśvāsaḥ ? kuta etadityāha–kvacid ityādi
kvacid deśaviśeṣe latācūtādeḥ, ādiśabdena latābadaryādiparigrahaḥ tasyā upalabdheḥ kāra ṇāt

tathā ca śiṃśapāyāḥ svayam ātmanā avṛkṣatve'pyavirodhāt kathamāśvāsaḥ ? kāṣṭhajanmanaḥ pāvakasya maṇyādisāmagrīprabhavasya tathā'śanijanmanaḥ tasmādaśanibhāvāt kāṣṭhādyarthaḥ tadantaraṃ tajjanmanaśca sākalyena anavayavena agnisvabhāvāvirodhe punaḥ aṅgīkriyamāṇe agnijanmaiva dhūmo nārthāntarajanmā iti kuto'yaṃ niyamaḥ yato niyamāt kāryahetoravyabhicārāt dhūmādagniratra ityādau āśvāsaḥ syāt
atha suvivecita kārya kāraṇanna vyabhicarati ityucyate

kasyacit svabhāvakāryaviśeṣasya yā anyathā sādhyābhāvaprakāreṇa anupapattiḥ tayā parokṣārthapratipattau aṅgīkriyamāṇāyāṃ śrutasya svayam ātmanā adṛṣṭatādātmyatadutpatteḥ bhādau voktapuska puvat jainendravyā॰ 5
kvacid dvīpādau yaḥ tasya avisaṃvādaḥ tasya anyathānupapatteḥ siddhaṃ prāmāṇyamiti
tulanā–yatnata parīkṣita kārya kāraṇa nātivartate iti cet stutam prastutam –aṣṭaśa॰, aṣṭamaha॰ pṛ॰ 72
atha suvivecita kāryaṃ kāraṇa na vyabhicaratīti nyāyād
bhāvau bokta– ba॰, bhādau cokta– śra॰
adṛṣṭe tādātmyatadutpattī yasya tat adṛṣṭatādātmyatadutpatti tasya agṛhītasvabhāvakāryādirūpasya śrutajñānasya ityartha

atra adṛṣṭatādātmyatadutpattiśabda śrutasya viśeṣaṇatvāt napusakaliṅgo'pi bhādau ityādi sutrānusāreṇa bhādau ajādau supi uktapuskamiganta nap napusaka vā puvad bhavati iti pulliṅge prayukta, napusakaliṅge tu numāgame sati adṛṣṭatādātmyatadutpattina iti prayogaḥ syāt iti bhāva

pramāṇaṃ sābhāsaṃ viṣayaphalasaṃkhyādita iha, prasannairgambhīraiḥ katipayapadairyena gaditam | sa jīyād dustarkaḥ pratimiraraviḥ nyāyajaladhiḥ, jagajjantusvāntapravarakumudendurjinapatiḥ || cha || itthaṃ samastamatavādikarīndradarpamunmūlayannamalamānadṛḍhaprahāraiḥ | syādvādakesarasaṭāśatatīvramūrttiḥ pañcānano bhuvi jayatyakalaṅkadevaḥ || cha
nyāyakumudacandra tatkarttā prabhācandraśca anena viśeṣaṇena sūcita
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ
uddhṛteyam–tathā cāhākalaṅka–bhedābhedā yato'pekṣānape –āva॰ ni॰ malaya॰ pṛ॰ 370B.
kābhyām ? apekṣānapekṣābhyām, apekṣā pratipakṣadharmākāṅkṣā anapekṣā tato'nyā sarvathaikānta tābhyām

kiṃviśiṣṭā ? te ye bhedābhedābhisandhaya bhedo viśeṣa paryāyaḥ vyatirekaśca, abheda sāmānyamekatva sādṛśyañca, bhedāścābhedaśca bhedābhedī tayo bhedābhedayorabhisandhayo'bhiprāyāḥ śrutajñānino vikalpā ityartha
kiṃviśiṣṭe ? bhedābhedātmake, bhedābhedāvātmānau svabhāvau yasya tattathoktam tasmin
tamhā savve vi ṇayā micchādiṭṭhī sapakkhapaḍibaddhā
nirapekṣā nayā mithyā sāpekṣā vastu te'rthakṛt
nayāḥ sāpekṣā durnayā nirapekṣā lokato'pi siddhā –siddhivi॰, ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 537B
dharmāntarādānopekṣāhānilakṣaṇatvāt pramāṇanayadurṇayānā prakārāntarāsabhavācca, pramāṇāttadatatsvabhāvapratipatte tatpratipatteḥ tadanyanirākṛteśca
sadeva sat syātsaditi tridhārtho mīyeta durnītinayapramāṇai
vivṛtiḥ–dravyaparyāyātmakamutpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat prameyaṃ vastu tattvam, tatraiva kathañcit pramāṇatadābhāsayorbhedāt
sa dravyārthikaḥ paryāyā rthikaśca, dravati droṣyati adudravaditi vā dravyam, tadeva artho'sti yasya saḥ dravyārthikaḥ so'bhedāśrayaḥ
tulanā–uppanne vā vigae vā ghuve vā –sthānāṃga॰ sthā॰ 10
guṇapajjayāsaya vā ja ta bhaṇṇati savvaṇhū
guṇava ca sapajjāya ja ta davva ti buccati
davva pajjayaviuya davvaviuttā ya pajjavā ṇatthi
tulanā–nayā prāpakā kārakā sādhakā nirvartakā nirbhāsakā upalambhakā vyañjakā ityanarthāntaram
jīvādīn padārthān nayanti prāpnuvanti kārayanti sādhayanti nirvartayanti nirbhāsayanti upalambhayanti vyajayantīti nayā
vastunyanekāntātmani avirodhena hetvarpaṇāt sādhyaviśeṣasya yāthātmyaprāpaṇapravaṇaprayogo naya
nayaṇa dhammeṇa tao hoī nao sattahā so ya
ṇayadi tti ṇao bhaṇio bahūhi guṇapajjaehi ja davva
sārasagrahepyukta pūjyapādai–anantaparyāyātmakasya vastuno'nyatamaparyāyādhigame karttavye jātyahetvapekṣo niravadyaprayogo naya
nayante arthān prāpayanti gamayantīti nayā, vastuno'nekātmakasya anyatamaikātmaikāntaparigrahātmakā nayā iti
nayantīti nayā anekadharmātmaka vastu ekadharmeṇa nityamevedamanityameveti vā nirūpayanti
pṛ॰ 118 nīyate gamyate yena śrutārthāśo nayo hi saḥ
ta iha ṇaya pautta ṇāṇī puṇa nehi ṇāṇehi
nānāsvabhāvemyo vyāvṛtya ekasmin svabhāve vastu nayati, prāpnotīti vā naya
ekadeśasya netā ya sa nayo'nekadhā smṛta
nīyate yena śrutākhyapramāṇaviṣayīkṛtasyārthasyāśa taditarāśaudāsīnyata sa pratipatturabhiprāyaviśeṣo naya
pramāṇaparicchinnasyānantadharmātmakasya vastuna ekadeśagrāhiṇa taditarāśāpratikṣepiṇa adhyavasāyaviśeṣā nayā

malayagiryācāryamatena sarve'pi nayā mithyā eva; tathāhi–anekadharmātmaka vastvavadhāraṇapūrvakamekena nityatvādyanyatamena dharmeṇa pratipādyasya buddhiṃ nīyate prāpyate yenābhiprāyaviśeṣeṇa sa jñāturabhiprāyaviśeṣo naya

iha hi yo nayo nayāntarasāpekṣatayā syātpadalāñchita vastu pratipadyate sa paramārthata paripūrṇaṃ vastu gṛhṇāti iti pramāṇa evāntarbhavati, yastu nayavādāntaranirapekṣatayā svābhipretenaiva dharmeṇa avadhāraṇapūrvaka vastu paricchettumabhipraiti sa nayaḥ vastvekadeśaparigrāhakatvāt
tacca saccaturvidham–tadyathā dravyāstika mātṛkāpadāstikam utpannāstikam paryāyāstikamiti
ittha dravyā- stikaṃ mātṛkāpadāstikaṃ ca dravyanayaḥ
davvaṭṭhio ya pajjavaṇao ya sesāṃ viyappāsiṃ
teṣāṃ vā śeṣaśāsanārāṇāṃ–dravyārthaparyāyārthanayau dvau samāsato mūlabhedau tatprabhedā saṃgrahādayaḥ
tulanā–athavā yasya guṇāntarepvapi prādurbhavatsu tattvaṃ na vihanyate tad dravyam
kiṃ punastattvam ? tadabhāvastattvam tadyathā āmalakādīnāṃ phalānāṃ raktādayaḥ pītādayaśca guṇāḥ prādurbhavanti āmalakaṃ badaramityeva bhavati
daviyadi gacchadi tāiṃ tāiṃ sabbhāvapajjayāiṃ jaṃ
daviyaṃ taṃ bhaṇṇaṃte aṇaṇṇabhūdaṃ tu sattādo
yathāsvaṃ paryāyairdrūyante drabanti vā tāni dravyāṇi
davie duyae doravayavo vigāro guṇāṇa saṃdāvo
davvaṃ bhavvaṃ bhāvassa bhūabhāvaṃ ca jaṃ joggaṃ
dravati droṣyati dudravaiti adudravat druḥ drorvikāro'vayavo vā dravyam
drorvikāro dravyam, droravayavo vā dravyam, dravyaṃ ca bhavyaṃ bhavatīti bhavyam dravyam, dravatīti dravyam drūyate vā, dravaṇāt guṇānāṃ guṇasandrāvo dravyam
dravati gacchati tāstān paryāyān drūyate gamyate vā taiḥ paryāyairiti vā dravyam
dravyeṇārthaḥ dravyārthaḥ, dravyamartho yasyeti vā, athavā dravyārthikaḥ dravyamevārtho yasya so'yaṃ dravyārthaḥ
bhedo viśeṣaḥ, abhedaḥ sāmānyam, tau ātmānau yasya tasmin tadātmake kathañcittatsvabhāve vastuni, na naiyāyikādiparikalpite, tasya prāgevāpāstatvāt
tataḥ sarvaṃ vastu bhedābhedātmakaṃ jñeyatvāt iti gamyate, yathā sadanityam ityukte sattvāditi
nacāyamanaikāntiko heturviruddho vā; sarvathā bhede abhede vā pramāṇaparicchedyatvasya viṣayaparicchede pratikṣiptatvāt
tatra bhedābhedābhisandhayaḥ sāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayāḥ puruṣābhiprāyāḥ ye te lakṣyante niścīyante nayāḥ durnayāśca
kābhyāmityāha–apekṣā'napekṣābhyām, apekṣayā nayāḥ itarayā durnayā iti
tattvagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ? āśrayāsiddhiniṣedhārtham, tathāhi–na jīvādi bhrāntaṃ nāpi śūnyaṃ kalpitaṃ vā kintu tattvaṃ paramārthasat
astvevam, tathāpi ekāntarūpaṃ tad bhaviṣyatītyāha–dravya ityādi
nahi sāṃkhyaparikalpitasya ātmanaḥ kāñcidarthakriyāmakurvataḥ prameyatvaṃ ghaṭate ityuktaṃ prāgeva
nanvekasmin vastutattve pratīyamāne pratibhāsabhedāsaṃbhavāt kathaṃ pratipatrabhiprāyāṇāṃ nayarūpatopapadyate ityāśaṅkyāha–tatraiva ityādi
tatraiva anantaroktasvarūpe candrādivastuni kathañcit sattvadhāvalyādiprakāreṇa yat pramāṇaṃ yaśca kathañcid dvitvādiprakāreṇa tadābhāsaḥ tayorbhedāt bhedapratīteḥ
tasmādekasminnapi vastuni pratipattibhedasaṃbhavāt yukto vikalādeśaviśeṣamāśritya jñāturabhiprāyo nayaḥ
dravati droṣyati adudravat iti vā dravyam, tadevārthaḥ so'sti yasya sa dravyārthikaḥ
nanu sakalabhāvānāṃ deśakālākārairatyantabhedānna abhedo nāma, ataḥ kathasau abhedāśrayaḥ syāt ? ityārekāpanodārthamāha–
ke ? jīvājīvaprabhedā, jīvaścetanālakṣaṇa ajīva punastadviparyaya pudgalādi prabhedāśca trasasthāvarādyavāntaraviśeṣā, jīvājīvau ca prabhedāśca te tathoktā
na khalu dravya paryāyo vā sattvavyatiriktamastīti kiñcidvyabaharttu śakya svavacanavirodhādatiprasaṅgācca
yathā eka jñāna citrapaṭādiviṣaya svanirbhāsi sve ātmīyā jñānātmāno nirbhāsā nīlādyākārā vidyante asyeti svanirbhāsi
yathā caiko jīva ātmā svaparyayai, sve cidrūpā paryayā rāgādaya pariṇāmā tairākrānta pratītipadārūḍho na virudhyate tathā sattvamapi jīvādyanekabhedākrānta na virudhyate ityartha
vivṛtiḥ–yathaiva jñānasya ātmanirbhāsabhedā naikatvaṃ vādhante jīvasyājīvasya vā kasyacit svaguṇaparyāyāḥ tathaiva sattvasya bhedāḥ jīvājīvādayaḥ
jīvaśca ajīvaśca tayoḥ prabhedā avāntaraviśeṣā yadantarlīnā yasya antaḥ praviṣṭāḥ tadasti vidyate
sve ātmīyā na jñānāntaragatā nirbhāsā nīlādyākārāḥ te yasya santi tad svanirbhāsijñānam ekaṃ citraikajñānam ityarthaḥ
yathā yena pratibhāsādiprakāreṇa asti tathā prakṛtamapi, saugatāpekṣayā idamuktam
jīvagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam sakalājīvatattvasya, tena jīvādiḥ svaparyayairyukto yathā eko'sti tathā sadekamiti siddham

yathaiva yenaiva aśakyavivecanā'bhinnayogakṣemaprakāreṇa jñānasya ātmanaḥ svarūpasya ye nirbhāsabhedā grāhyādinīlādyākārāḥ te naikatvaṃ bādhante, jīvasya ātmanaḥ ajīvasya vā ghaṭādeḥ kasyacit sakalajanaprasiddhasya na naiyāyikādikalpitasya tasya pūrva nirastatvāt
svaguṇaparyāyā yathaiva naikatvaṃ bādhante iti sambandhaḥ
tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa sattvasya sattāsāmānyasya bhedāḥ
tasmin sattve evam uktaprakāreṇa jīvājīvātmake sthite sati–
aśakyavivecana hi ekacitrajñānasya nīlādyākārāṇā jñānāntare netumaśakyatvam
yoga aprāptaviṣayasya paricchedalakṣaṇā prāptiḥ, kṣema tadarthakriyānuṣṭhānalakṣaṇa paripālanam
kim ? śuddha dravya satsāmānyaṃ tasyānyopādhirahitatvena śuddhisabhavāt, tadviṣayo hi nayaḥ sagraha
sajātyavirodhena paryāyānākrāntabhedānaikadhyamupanīya samastagrahaṇa sagraha iti nirvacanāt
kuta ? tadabhedata, tasya satsāmānyalakṣaṇasya śuddhadravyasya abhedāt sarveṣu jīvājīveṣu avyatirekāt
nanu prāgabhāvādeḥ sattvavyatirekāt katha tadabheda ityāśaṅkyāha– bhedānā jīvādīnā sadviśeṣāṇāṃ madhye eko'pi bhedo jīvastatparyāyo'nyo vā'sadātmā asatsvarūpo nāsti na vidyate
virodhataḥ–ṣadyasadātmā, kathamasti ? yadyasti, kathamasadātmeti ? svavacanavirodhādasya asiddheḥ
tata prāgabhāvādiranyo vā kathañcitsadātmaka evābhyupagantavyaḥ pratītibalāt
āha ca yatsagṛhītavacana sāmānye deśato'tha ca viśeṣe
śuddha dravya samāśritya sagrahastadaśuddhita –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 272, 311
nahi kiñcijjñānaṃ sadrūpaṃ dravyamanavabuddhya bhedaṃ gṛhṇāti nāma
śuddhaṃ dravyaṃ sattālakṣaṇam abhipraiti viṣayīkaroti na sato'pi ātmādiviśeṣān
kuta etadityāha– tadabhedataḥ tasya sattvasya sarvaviśeṣeṣu aviśeṣataḥ
bhedānāṃ jīvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ madhye asadātmā asatsvabhāvaḥ eko'pi na kevalam aneko nāsti bhedo viśeṣaḥ, kintu sadātmaiva asti iti sambandhaḥ
tathāhi–yadi asan kathamasti, asti cet kathamasan iti
etena abhāvacatuṣṭayaṃ carcitam, tathāhi– yadi tat astītipratyayavedyam kathasadātmakam ? svarūpeṇa tasyāpi sadātmakatvāt
athā'sadātmakam, na tarhi tatpratyayavedyamiti kathaṃ tadastitvasiddhiḥ ?
sarvaṃ cetanācetanasvabhāvaṃ vastu ekam abhinnaṃ sadaviśeṣāt sattā'viśeṣamāśritya iti evaṃ saṃgrahaḥ
sadaviśeṣe'pi sattvāt tadvatāṃ bhedaprasiddheḥ sarvamekam ityādyayuktamityāśaṅkyāha–satāñca ityādi
satāñca vidyamānānāṃ punaḥ svabhāvānāṃ bhāvadharmāṇām bhāvaikatvābādhanāt sattvaikatvānirākaraṇāt
hiryasmāt na asadātmā asattāsvabhāvaḥ kaścit dravyādīnāmanyatamo bhedaḥ viśeṣaḥ asti
itaśca asadātmā bhedo nāstīti daśayannāha–nahi ityādi
kiñcit pratyakṣamanumānaṃ vā jñānaṃ sadrūpaṃ sattvasvarūpam anavabuddhya agṛhītvā bhedaṃ viśeṣaṃ dravyaṃ dravyarūpam, dravyagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ guṇādeḥ, tatkimityāha–nahi gṛhṇāti nāma iti

tato nirākṛtametat na dravyādi svata sat nāpyasat sattāsambandhātsat iti; sadrūparahitasya hi dravyādeḥ tatsvabhāvaśūnyasya ca sadrūpasya grahaṇe sati etat syāt, na ca tadgrahaṇamasti, sarvadā ubhayoḥ ubhayātmano vedanāditi bhāvaḥ
pūrveṇa parapakṣe virodhodbhāvanam, anena tu pratītito bhedasya sadātmakatvasādhanamiti vibhāgaḥ

atrāha saugataḥ–yaduktam–yathaiva jñānasya ātmanirbhāsabhedāḥ naikatvaṃ bādhante iti, tadapyuktam; niraṃśaikajñānopagamāt, sarvo'pyayaṃ viruddhadharmādhyāsī stambhādipratibhāso vibhramo marīcikācakre jalavaditi kathaṃ tannidarśanena abhimatatattvasiddhiḥ syāt ? puruṣādvaitavādyapi āha–nistaraṅgaṃ puruṣamātraṃ tattvam, jīvajīvaprabhedaḥ punaḥ upaplavaḥ, tato jīvasya ajīvasya vā ityādyapyayuktam, ityāśaṅkyāha–
kiṃviśiṣṭam ? bhedājñānam, bhedān paraparikalpitān niraṃśakṣaṇānna jānāti na gṛhṇātīti bhedājñānam
kiṃ śaset ? dravya śuddhamaśuddha vā svalakṣaṇa vastubhūta na kalpitamityartha
kena ? sadātmanā sadrūpeṇa, na khalu sadrūpeṇa bhedaḥ padārtheṣu pratyakṣato jñāyate yena pratyakṣa dravya na śaset
kiṃ viśiṣṭāt ? sāmānyalakṣaṇāt, sāmānyamanvayo lakṣaṇa liṃgaṃ yasyāsau sāmānyalakṣaṇastasmāt
na hi bhedanirapekṣamabheda pratyakṣamanyadvā pramāṇa sādhayati tasyānupalabdhe
tata pratyakṣamapi dravyasiddhinibandhanameveti kuta sagrahanayo mithyā syāt ? –laghī॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 53
vivṛtiḥ–svārthabhedānavabodhe'pi bhrāntaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ sadrūpeṇa pratyakṣaṃ dravyaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ vidyāt, anyathā bhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt
pratyakṣamuktalakṣaṇam, kathambhūtaṃ tadityāha–bhedājñānam, bhedasya niraṃśakṣaṇikavibhramaviviktaviśeṣasya ajñānam agrahaṇam yena yasmin vā tattathoktam
nahi tattatra niraṃśakṣaṇikādirūpaṃ paraparikalpitaṃ viśeṣaṃ jātu pratipadyate vibhramābhāvānuṣaṅgāt
yadi tattatra bhedājñānam, kena tarhi prakāreṇa pratyakṣamityāha– sadātmanā iti
dravyamanantaroktaṃ svalakṣaṇa vastu śaṃset stuyāt na paraparikalpitaṃ paramāṇvādi
evamapi puruṣādidravyaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ śaṃsedityāha– bhedāt ityādi
bhedāt viśeṣāt sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya, sāmānyena vā lakṣyate yaḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasmāt tamāśritya ityarthaḥ
yathā ca kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇvādirūpaṃ puruṣādvaitarūpaṃ vā tattvaṃ na vyavatiṣṭhate tathā prāgeva prapañcataḥ pratipāditam
bhrāntaṃ viplutaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ laukikaṃ śāstrīyañca, yadi vā saugatakalpitaṃ puruṣādyadvaitavādikalpitañca
svañca arthaśca tayorbhedo vivekaḥ arthasya paramāṇulakṣaṇasya parasparam§ svajñānasya viplavākārād bhedo nāvabudhyate sarvaṃ hi jñānaṃ nātmānaṃ viplutaṃ jānāti§ viplutākārāt tasya anavabodhe'pi
nanu syādetat yadi tadbhedānavabodhaḥ syāt yāvatā svārthayoḥ sadrūpeṇeva bhedarūpeṇāpyavabodho'stītyāśaṅkyāha–anyathā ityādi
uktaprakārād anyena prakāreṇa anyathā bhrānterabhāvaprasaṅgāt tat tatkuryāt iti sambandha

tathāhi–yathā tat pratyakṣa sadrūpeṇa tathā yadi svārthabhedarūpeṇāpi, tarhi sthūlākārā bhrāntiḥ kuta ? grāhyādicetanetarādibhrāntirvā ? nahi yathāvadrūpeṇa vastunaḥ pratibhāse sā yuktā, kadācidapi tadanuparatiprasaṅgāt
tathā tadbhedānavabodhavat sadrūpeṇāpi yadi tadapratyakṣam, tadā kasyacidapi pratibhāsābhāvāt kuto bhrānti ?
svajñānasya ityādi §etaccihnāntargata pāṭha ba॰, śra॰ pratyo truṭitāyā pū॰ pratau ca nāsti
arthānurodhāttu svasya viplutākārāt ityaśasya ṭippaṇyātmaka eva bhāti
yadi ca yathāvadvastugrahaṇe'pi bhrānti na nivarteta tadā na kadāpi tasyāḥ nivṛtti sabhāvyeti bhāva
kasyacidapi puruṣasya sāmānyano viśeṣato vā pratibhāsābhāvāt na bhrānti syāt, bhrānte sāmānyapratibhāsanivandhanatvāditi bhāva
nanu pratikṣaṇavilakṣaṇajñānādikṣaṇavyatiriktasya jīvādidravyasyāsabhavāt kathaṃ dravyaṃ śaṃset ityuktaṃ śobheta ityāśaṅkyāha–

ayamartha–yathā sadbhi jñānagatākārai asadbhirarthākārai nīlādibhi sahaika jñāna vibhāti tava na virudhyate, tathā arthavyañjanaparyāyai sahakramavivartibhi vyajjanaparyāyai sahaika dravyamapi vibhāti na virudhyate iti
dṛśyā sthūlā vyajjanaparyāyā adṛśyā sūkṣmā kevalāgamagamyā arthaparyāyā
vivṛtiḥ–yathaikaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ jñānaṃ sadbhirasadbhirvā pratibhāsabhedaiḥ svayamabhedakairiṣṭaṃ tathā ekaṃ dravyaṃ sahakramabhāvibhiḥ svayamabhedakaiḥ bhedaiḥ dṛśyairadṛśyaiścānādinidhanamavagantavyam
vahiriva jñānaparamāṇusañcaye punaḥ anyonyānātmakatve sarvathā'saṅkramavyavasthāyām ekasthūlanirbhāsavirodhāt
santaśca asantaśca te ca te svasya arthanirbhāsāśca nīlasthūlādipratibhāsāstaiḥ, kathambhūtaiḥ ? svayam ātmanā abhedakaiḥ, yathā ekaṃ jñānaṃ viśeṣeṇa deśakālanarāntarābādhitarūpeṇa bhāti bhāsate
kadā ? saha ekasmin kāle tathā kramavivarttibhiḥ taiḥ ekaṃ vibhāti
yadi vā sadbhiḥ svanirbhāsaiḥ sadādibhiḥ asadbhiḥ arthanirbhāsaiḥ ekaṃ yathā, tathā kramavivārtibhiḥ sukhādibhiḥ ekaṃ vibhātīti grāhyam
yathā yena prakāreṇa ekaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ jñānam, upalakṣaṇametat tena puruṣasyāpi grahaṇam
kathambhūtaiḥ ? svayamabhedakaiḥ iṣṭam aṅgīkṛtam, tathā ekaṃ dravyamabhyupagantavyam
kathambhūtai ? sahakramabhāvibhiḥ sahabhāvibhiḥ guṇaiḥ kramabhāvibhiḥ paryāyaiḥ
nanu jñānamapi tairekaṃ neṣyate ki syātsā citrataikasyāṃ na syātattasyāṃ matāvapi pramāṇavā॰ 2
yathā bahiḥ parasparāsaṃsṛṣṭaniraṃśakṣaṇikaparamāṇusañcayaḥ tathā tadgrāhiṇāmanyeṣāṃ vā jñānaparamāṇūnāṃ sañcaye aṅgīkriyamāṇe, punaḥ iti pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ

anyonyaṃ parasparam anātmakatvam asvarūpatvaṃ tasmin sati, sarvathā sarveṇa sākṣātkaraṇaprakāreṇa svarūpamiśraṇaprakāreṇa vā asaṅkrameṇa asaṅkareṇa yā vyavasthā avasthitiḥ tasyāṃ satyām ekasthūlanirbhāsavirodhāt kāraṇāt eka dravyamabhyupagantavyam
etadukta bhavati–sthūlaikapratibhāsaviruddhā jñānetaraparamāṇavaḥ, tatpratibhāsopagame tadvirodhaḥ nīle pītavirodhavat
tathābhyupagacchataśca adhyakṣavirodhaḥ niraṃśādirūpatayā śatadhā tattvaṃ vicārayato'pi sthūlādipratibhāsānivṛtte
vyākhyā–nanu yadi sā citratā buddhau ekasyā syāt, tayā ca citrameka dravyaṃ vyavasthāpyeta tadā kiṃ dūṣaṇa syāt ? āha–na syāttasyā matāvapi
na kevala dravyaṃ tasyā matāvapi ekasyā na syāccitratā ākāranānātvalakṣaṇatvād bhedasya, nānātve'pi citratā kathamanekapuruṣapratītivat
kathantarhi pratītirityāha–yadīda svayamarthebhyo rocate tatra ke vayam
yadīdam atādrūpye'pi tādrapyaprathanam arthānā bhāsamānānā nīlādīnā svayam aparapreraṇayā rocate, tatra tathāpratibhāse ke vayamasahamānā api niṣeddhum, avastu ca pratibhāsate ceti vyaktamālīkyam
tasmānnārtheṣu vāhyeṣu na jñāne tadgrāhake sthūlābhāma sthūla ākāra saṅgacchate
bahūṣvapi teṣu sabhavo nāsti militā api hi ta eva
te ca pratyeka sthaulyavikalā iti samuditā api tathaiva syu
tathā nīlādyākāreṣu pratyeka citrasya sthaulyasyābhāvāt samudāye'pyabhāva –pramāṇavā॰ manoratha॰ 2
eva pratibhāsabalena svaparamatavidhipratiṣedhau abhidhāya sāmpratam arthakriyākāritvabalena tau pratipādayitukāmaḥ prathamaṃ kṣaṇikaikānte arthakriyāṃ nirākurvannāha–
vivṛtiḥ–saha krameṇa vā arthakriyām akṣaṇikasya nirācikīrṣuḥ kathañcit kṣaṇike arthakriyāṃ sādhayet anyathā tallakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ tato vyāvartteta
na ca kṣaṇikānāmaniścayātmanāṃ bhāvānāṃ pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ siddhyet viprakṛṣṭā'rthāntaravat
yasmin satyeva yadbhāvaḥ tat tasya kāryamakāryamitarat kāraṇama iti lakṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅge na saṃbhavatyeva kāryakāraṇayoḥ sahabhāvāpatteḥ, anyathā kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt
sati kṣaṇike kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ syāt kṣaṇikamakrama jaganni santāni syāt
tasminnasati bhavata kuta puna kāraṇāntarotpattiniyama ? sadeva kāraṇa svasattākālameva kārya prasahya janayet
svarasata eva kāryotpattikālaniyame svatantrasya kuta eva kāryatvam ? nairantaryamātrātprabhavaniyame sarvatra sarveṣāmaviśeṣe kuta prabhavaniyamḥ ? dravyasya prabhavaniyame na kiñcidatiprasajyate
kiṃ punarasau kāryakāraṇabhāva anupalambhasahāyapratyakṣanibandhana ? ityāha–tadbhāve bhāva tadabhāve'bhāvaśceti ? –hetubi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 69
lakṣaṇam arthasya paramārthasato vastunaḥ nārthakriyā arthasya kāryasya kriyā karaṇam
sati vidyamāne kāraṇe hetau kāryabhāvaḥ kāryotpattiḥ ced yadi na kāryakāraṇalakṣaṇaṃ kāryasya kāraṇānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvaṃ yallakṣaṇam kāraṇasya ca tajjanakatvaṃ yallakṣaṇaṃ tanna

idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam–svotpattikālavat kāryotpattikāle'pi sati kāraṇe kāryabhāvaścet kāryakāraṇayoḥ yallakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ grahaṇaṃ vā atra pramāṇabhāvāt ghaṭate ityadhyāhāraḥ, kintu kṣaṇabhaṅgāya datto jalāñjaliḥ syāt
kāryotpattikāle'pi kāraṇasadbhāve tasya dvikṣaṇāvasthāyitva syāditi bhāva
sā hi satī, asatī vā tallakṣaṇam ? na tāvadasatī, kharaviṣāṇavat tathāvidhāyāstasyāḥ tallakṣaṇatvāyogāt
atha satī; kiṃ svataḥ, parato vā ? yadi svataḥ; arthena kimaparāddhaṃ yenāsya svataḥ sattvaṃ neṣyete ? atha parataḥ, tadā anavasthā iti
tulanā–arthakriyākāritvena sattābhyupagame samānañcaitad dūṣaṇam–kiṃ satāmarthakiyākāritvamathāsatāmiti ? satāmarthakriyākāritve sattābhyupagame tathā duruttaramitaretarāśrayatvam
atha arthakriyāmantareṇa sato'rthakriyājanakatvam, tatrāpyaya vikalpa ityanavasthā
prakṛtārthakriyāyā sattvavyavasthāpikā aparā'rthakriyā tasyā apyaparā ityanabasthā

ta saha ityādinā nityavādinā samānaṃ vyavavasthāpya yasmin ityādinā kārikārthaṃ prakaṭayati–saha yugapat krameṇa vā paripāṭyā vā arthakriyā akṣaṇikasya nityasya sambandhinī yā tāṃ nirācikīrṣuḥ saugataḥ kathañcit yaugapadyaprakāreṇa vā pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa vā kṣaṇike'rthe arthakriyāṃ sādhayet, anyathā tadasādhanaprakāreṇa tallakṣaṇam arthakriyālakṣaṇaṃ sattvaṃ tataḥ kṣaṇikāt nityādiva vyāvartteta
sādhyata eva tatra sā iti cet; atrāha– naca ityādi
punarapi kathambhūtānām ? aniścayātmanām na vidyate niścayo nirṇayo yasya sa tathāvidha ātmā svabhāvo yeṣām
pratyakṣānupalambhau sādhanaṃ yasya, pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanatvādeva ca aniścayātmanāṃ teṣāṃ tadbhāvona yuktaḥ
pūrvottarakoṭivicchinnādarthād anyaḥ trikālānuyāyī arthaḥ tadantaram tasya ca grahaṇopāyābhāvād viprakṛṣṭatvam, viprakṛṣṭañca tad arthāntarañca tasyeva tadvat

etaduktaṃ bhavatiyathaikasya kālatrayānuyāyinaḥ kutaścitpratipattumaśakteḥ na tatra pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ siddhyati tathā pratiparamāṇuniyatena jñānena kṣaṇikabhāvānāmapratipatteḥ na tatsādhanastadbhāvaḥ siddhyet
sāmprataṃ teṣāṃ tatsādhanaṃ tadbhāvamabhyupagamya tatra dūṣaṇamāha–yasmin ityādi
yasmin vastuni satyeva vidyamāna eva yadbhāvo yasya vastunaḥ bhāva ātmalābhaḥ tadvastu tasya pūrvasya kāryam
yasmin satyeva ityanena yannirdiṣṭam tad, itarat kāraṇam iti evaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāryakāraṇayoḥ kṣaṇabhaṅge na saṃbhavatyeva
atrāyamabhiprāya–kāraṇasattākāla eva kāryasya bhāve yasmin satyeva iti ghaṭate, parantu kāryakāraṇayoḥ sahabhāvāpatteḥ santānocchedaḥ syāditi
nanu syādayaṃ doṣaḥ yadi yadaiva kāraṇamutpadyate tadaiva svakāryaṃ kuryāt, yāvatā pūrvamutpadya punaḥ kāryakāle sat kāryamutpādayati; ityatrāha–anyathā ityādi
kṣaṇabhaṅge kāryakāraṇayoḥ lakṣaṇaṃ na saṃbhavatyeva iti sambandhaḥ
tulanā– kṣaṇasthāyi kāraṇa svasattāyā kāryaṃ kurvadabhyupagacchan kramotpattimuparuṇaddhi sakalajagadekakṣaṇavṛttitvaprasaṅgāt –aṣṭaśa॰ aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 91
satyeva kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ trailokyamekakṣaṇavarti syāt, kāraṇakṣaṇakāla eva sarvasya uttarottarakṣaṇasantānasya bhāvāt tata santānābhāvāt –aṣṭaśa॰ aṣṭasaha॰ pṛ॰ 187
nanu yasmin iti saptamī kāraṇabhāve kāryabhāvaṃ sūcayati, sa ca pūrvameva svasattākṣaṇe kāraṇe sati uttarakṣaṇe kāryabhāvo na virudhyate, yathā goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ dugdhāsu āgataḥ iti
ced yadi viruddhā vipratiṣiddhā syāt, kā ? kāryotpatti, kāryasyottarapariṇāmasyotpatti svarūpalābha
kayā ? svaya kāraṇasattayā, svaya kāraṇaṃ vivakṣitakāryajanaka dravyasvarūpamupādāna tasya sattayā bhāvena
kim ? arthakriyāsabhavasādhanam, arthasya abhimataprayojanasya kriyā niṣpatti tatsabhavasādhanam nitye kramayaugapadyavirahādityanumānam
na ca sā viruddhā kāryakāle sata eva kāraṇatvāt, anyathā kāryasya ākasmikatvaprasaṅgāt…" –laghī॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 56
yasmin satyeva yadbhāva tattasya kāryamitaratkāraṇamiti kṣaṇikatve na sabhavatyeva sahotpattiprasaṅgāt kutaḥ santānavṛtti
vivṛtiḥ–nahi kāryotpattiḥ kāraṇasyābhāvaṃ pratīkṣate yataḥ tadarthakriyā akṣaṇike viruddhyeta
niṣkāraṇasya anyānapekṣayā deśakālasvabhāvaniyamāyogāt sarvatra sarvadā sarvathaiva bhāvānuṣaṅgāt
tadayaṃ bhāvā'bhāvayoḥ kāryakāraṇatāṃ lakṣayet sarvathā bhāvasyaiva vā
svalakṣaṇasya kvacit pratyakṣānupalambhāsiddheḥ kutaḥ kāryavyatirekopalakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaśakteḥ ?
kāryasya utpattiḥ ātmalābhaḥ viruddhā cet yadi svayam ātmanā, kayā ? kāraṇasattayā
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yadi kāraṇasattayā kāryotpattirvirudhyate tadā yuktametat pūrvameva tadbhāve tadbhāva iti
kathambhūte ? kṣaṇike vinaṣṭe kāraṇe tadasaṃbhavāt iti manyate
yadi vā, tayā tadutpattirviruddhā yadi tadā yujyeta arthe kṣaṇike arthakriyā'saṃbhavasādhanam, na ca tayā sā viruddheti pratipādayiṣyate
hiryasmāt na kāryasya utpattiḥ kāraṇasya abhāvaṃ pratīkṣate yāvat kāraṇaṃ nirmūlanna naśyati tāvat svayaṃ nopapadyate iti
yataḥ tadapekṣaṇāt tadarthakiyā kramayaugapadyārthakriyā akṣaṇikatve api virudhyeta
yataḥ iti ca ākṣepe, naiva virudhyate

idamatra tātparyam–vinaṣṭe kāraṇe yadā kāryaṃ jāyate tadā tanniṣkāraṇaṃ bhavati, tasya ca anyasya deśādeḥ anapekṣā apekṣā'bhāvaḥ tayā deśakālasvabhāvaniyamāyogāt sarvatra sarvadā sarvathaiva bhāvānuṣaṅgāt kāraṇāt nahi tadabhāvaṃ sā pratīkṣate iti sambandhaḥ
tat tasmāt tadapekṣaṇāt–ayaṃ saugataḥ kāryasya yo bhāvaḥ ātmalābhaḥ yaśca kāraṇasya abhāvaḥ tayoḥ yathāsaṃkhyena kāryakāraṇatāṃ lakṣayet
yaddhi kāryam ātmalābhe apekṣate tat kāraṇam, apekṣyate ca tena tallābhe tadabhāvaḥ iti manyate
kāryeṇa ātmalābhe apekṣyamāṇatvāt kāraṇābhāva eva kāraṇaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ
idamaparaṃ vyākhyānam–yadā kāraṇānna kāryaṃ kintu kāraṇāt tadabhāvaḥ tataśca kāryaṃ tatrāha–tat ityādi
tat tasmānnyāyāt ayaṃ bhāvābhāvayoḥ kāraṇatannivṛttyoḥ kāryakāraṇatāṃ bhāvasya kāraṇatām abhāvasya kāryatāṃ lakṣayet
atha matam–na abhāvaḥ prakhyopākhyāvihīnatvāt kasyacit kāraṇaṃ kāryañca, ityatrāha–sarvathā bhāvasyaiva vā sata eva vā kāryakāraṇatāṃ lakṣayet iti sambandhaḥ
kāraṇavat kāryasyāpyasattvā'sabhavāt ataḥ sāṃkhyamataprasaṅgaḥ saugatasya ityabhiprāyaḥ
nanu mā bhūt kṣaṇike pratyakṣānupalambhasādhanaḥ kāryakāraṇabhādhaḥ, kāryavyatirekasādhanastu indriyaśaktivatsyāt, ityatrāha–svalakṣaṇasya ityādi

svalakṣaṇasya paraparikalpitaparamāṇulakṣaṇasya kvacid antarbahirvā pratyakṣānupalambhāsiddheḥ, pratyakṣapūrvako'nupalambhaḥ pratyakṣānupalambhaḥ tasya asiddheḥ kāraṇāt kutaḥ kāryasya vyatirekeṇopalakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaśakteḥ ? na kutaścit
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yadā tasya tadrūpa kāryaṃ kutaścit pratyakṣaṃ sat puna itarakāraṇasadbhāve'pi nopalabhyate tadā yukta tenopalakṣaṇa tacchakteḥ, na caivamastīti
prakhyāyate iti prakhyā vikalpa, upākhyāyate iti upākhyā śruti tābhyā vikalpaśabdābhyā rahitvāt

kāryavyatirekeṇa kāraṇavyatireko jñāyate, kṣaṇike ca na kāryavyatireka ata kṣaṇike'rthe kāryakāraṇabhāva sādhanīyaḥ, yathā hi–rūpajñānotpattyabhāvena rūpajñānajananaśaktyabhāva vyāpta, cakṣuṣi avikale sati na rūpajñānotpattyabhāva atastatra rūpajñānajananaśakti vyavasthāpyate
nahi cakṣuṣi rūpajñānajananaśaktivyavasthāpane pratyakṣānupalambhau prabhavata, śakteratīndriyatvāt pratyakṣānupalambhā'gocaratvāt
tathaiva kṣaṇike'rthe pratyakṣānupalambhasādhana kāryakāraṇabhāvo māsetsyat kāryavyatirekeṇānumīyamānastu siddhyatyeva ityabhiprāya
nanu yaduktam–bahiriva jñānaparamāṇusañcaya ityādi, nahi kāryotpattiḥ ityādi ca, tadayuktam, yathāpratibhāsa citraikajñānopagamāt
tathā kāryasya deśavat kāle'pi asata eva kāraṇādeva udayopagamāt kathamanyathā jāgradvijñānāt prabodhaḥ bhāvimaraṇādervā ariṣṭādikam ityāśaṅkya āha–
yathāhi kāryasya deśe'vidyamānamapi kāraṇa kāryotpādakam, tathā kāryakāle'vidyamānamapi kāryotpādakaṃ bhavatu
yadi kāryakāle'vidyamānādapi kāraṇāt kāryotpatti na svīkriyate tadā

prajñākaragupto hi pramāṇavārtikālaṅkārakāra, sa ca bhāvina bhūtañcārtha kāraṇamācakṣate, tathāhi– avidyamānasya karaṇamiti ko'rtha ? tadanantarabhāvinī tasya sattā, tadetadānantaryamubhayāpekṣayāpi samānam
yathaikaṃ bhinnadeśārthān kuryād vyāpnoti vā sakṛt

yathā yenāvirodha- prakareṇaikaṃ saugatābhimataṃ kṣaṇikasvalakṣaṇa sakṛdekakṣaṇe bhinnadeśārthān bhinno viprakṛṣṭo deśo yeṣāṃ te bhinnadeśā te ca te'rthāśca kāryāṇi tān, svamantānavartinamupādānatvena santānāntaravartinañca nimittatvena janayedityartha

yathā vā eka jñāna bhinnadeśārthān viprakṛṣṭanīlādyākārān vyāpnoti na virudhyate tathā ekamabhinnadravya kramāt kālabhedena bhinnakālārthān bhinna pūrvāparabhūtaḥ kālo yeṣā te ca te'rthaśca kāryāṇi tān kuryāt, pūrvottarākāraparihārāvāptisthitirūpeṇa pariṇamat ityartha
nāneva vyāpnoti vā tādātmyamanubhavati vā, na virudhyate
vivṛtiḥ–yathā kṣaṇikaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ nānādigdeśabhāvīni kāryāṇi sthānasaṅkaravyatikaravyatirekeṇa karoti tatkaraṇaikasvabhāvatvāt
nahi sāmagrībhedāt kāryabhedepi tatkāraṇasvabhāvabhedaḥ, tathaikamakṣaṇikaṃ yadyadā utpitsu kāryaṃ tattadaiva karoti tatkaraṇaikasvabhāvatvāt
yathā vijñānaṃ svanirbhāsabhedān guṇī guṇān avayavī avayavān vyāpnoti sakṛdapi tadātmakatvāt, tathaiva dravyaṃ svaparyāyabhedān svayamabhedakatvātteṣāṃ svabhāvānāmiti
yathā yena yogyatāprakāreṇa ekaṃ niraṃśaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ vastu bhinno deśo yepāmarthānām, deśagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena prajñākaraguptāpekṣayā bhinnakālagrahaṇam, tān kuryāt sakṛd ekadaiva
tathāhi–pradīpakṣaṇaḥ pramātari svajñāna sthālyāṃ tailaśoṣaṃ daśānanadāhañca upari kajjalam ityādi bhinnadeśaṃ sakṛdevā'nekaṃ kāryaṃ kuryād evamanyadapi cintyam

tathā yadaiva jāgradvijñānaṃ svāpānantaraṃ vyāpārādikāryaṃ kuryāt tadaiva kālāntarabhāvisvakālaniyataṃ pravodham, yadaiva ca bhāvirājyādikaṃ svakālaniyataṃ darśanaṃ kuryāt tadaiva cirātītakāla hastarekhādikam, tathaikaṃ nityaṃ bhinnakālārthān
ekadaikaṃ kṛtvā punaranyaṃ kuryāt tatkāle'pi tadbhāvāt
yathā caikaṃ jñānaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ bhinnadeśārthān nānādeśanīlādyākārān vyāpnoti tadātmakaṃ bhavati
vāśabdaḥ pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ, sakṛd ekadā tathā ekamātmatattvaṃ bhinnakālārthān sukhādīn vyāpnoti cākramāt
daśā vartikā tasyā ānanaṃ mukham agrabhāga tasya dāham
na hi svāpānantarabhāvivyāpārādīnā pravodhasya ca jāgradvijānaṃ vibhinnakālavarti sat samutpādaka ghaṭate tasya ekakṣaṇamātravṛttitvādityāśayenāha–yadaiveti
kramād bhavantī ghīḥ kāyāt kama tasyāpi śamati
nā'kramāt kramiṇaḥ kāryasya bhāva, kramarahitatvāt kāraṇasya tannipyādyāni kāryāṇi sakṛjjāyeran
kramavata sahakāriṇo'pekṣya kramājjanipyatīti cet; nāpyaviśeṣiṇa sthiraikarūpasya parairanādheyaviśeṣasya pareṣāṃ sahakāriṇāmapekṣā'sti
tasmāt kramād bhavantī dhīḥ kāyāt kramantasyāpi kāyasya śasati
uddhṛto'yam–nākramāt kramiṇo bhāvāvīśceya kramaṃ –siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 161A., 197A.
yathā yena prakāreṇa svalakṣaṇam, kathambhūtam ? kṣaṇikam, karoti kāryāṇi
kathambhūtāni ? nānādigdeśabhāvīni, diggrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena nānākālabhāvīnyapi gṛhyante
hiryasmāt na sāmagrībhedāt kāryabhede'pi kāraṇasvabhāvabhedaḥ, tathā ekamakṣaṇika kāraṇaṃ yad yadā utpitsu kāryaṃ tat tadaiva karoti
nanu kramabhāvīnyanekakāryāṇi kurvat kathaṃ tadekam tāvaddhā bhedaprasaṅgāt ? iti cedatrāha–sarvadā ityādi
sarvadā sarvakālaṃ kāryakālānatikrameṇa karaṇasāmarthyāt kāraṇāt tadātmakaṃ tatkaraṇasāmarthyātmakam ekamevetyaviruddham
yathā saugatasya vijñānaṃ svanirbhāsabhedān ātmanīlādyākāraviśeṣān naiyāyikasya guṇī guṇān, avayavī avayavān vyāpnoti kathañcittadātmako bhavati
nanu jñānatannirbhāsayoḥ guṇaguṇino avayavāvayavinośca atyantabhedānna yuktametadityatrāha–tadātmakatvāt, jñānādeḥ svanirbhāsabheda-guṇa-avayavātmakatvāt
anyathā ghaṭapaṭavat tajjñānavacca guṇaguṇyādibhāvaḥ citrajñānarūpatā ca na syādityukta vistarataḥ prāgeva

vyākhyā–sarvasyobhayarūpatvam–ubhayagrahaṇamanekatvopalakṣaṇārtham tasmin sati, tadviśeṣasya uṣṭra uṣṭra eva na dadhi, dadhi dadhyeva noṣṭra ityeva lakṣaṇasya nirākṛte, dadhi khāda iti codita puruṣa kimuṣṭra khāditu nābhidhāvati ? uṣṭro'pi dadhyabhinnāt dravyatvādavyatirekāt syāddadhi, nāpi sa eveti uṣṭra uṣṭra eva ityekāntavāda, yenānyo'pi dadhyādika ta syāduṣṭra
tathā dadhyapi syāduṣṭra uṣṭrābhinnena dravyatvena dadhnastādātmyenābhisambandhāt
nāpi tadeveti dadhyeva dadhi, yenānyadapi uṣṭrādika ta syāddadhi
codito dadhi khādeti kimuṣṭra nābhidhāvati ? || pramāṇavā॰ 3 | 181
tulanā–sugato'pi mṛgo jāta mṛgo'pi sugata smṛta
tathāpi sugato bandyo mṛga khādyo yatheṣyate
na hyasmābhirdadhyuṣṭrayoreka tiryaksāmānya vastutvādika vyaktyabhedena vyavasthitaṃ tathābhūtapratibhāsābhāvādabhyupagamyate
yādṛgbhūta tu prativyakti bhinna samānā iti pratyayaviṣayabhūtamabhyupagamyate tathābhūtasya tasya śabdenābhidhāne kimityanyatra prerito'nyatra khādanāya dhāvet yadyunmatto na syāt
svasya brahmavādasya artho viṣaya sanmātra tasya bhedā jīvādiviśeṣā teṣā nirākṛte pratiṣedhāt
bhedarahitaṃ ca tatkathaṃ sāmānya nāma nirāśrayatvāt arthakriyāvirahācca
yad yadātmakaṃ tat tadeva, yathā svanirbhāsabhedātmakaṃ jñānam, tasmāt sadātmano bhedāḥ sanmātrameva nānyaditi saṃgrahaḥ
saṃgrahaḥ saṃgrahanayaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhedānāṃ jīvādiviśeṣāṇām aikyamabhipraiti kena rūpeṇa ? ityāha–sadātmanā
brahmavāde'pi sadātmanā teṣāṃ saṃgrahaḥ saṃbhavati iti so'pi saṃgrahanayaḥ syādityāśakāpanodārthamāha– brahmavādastadābhāsa iti
svārthaḥ sanmātraṃ tasya bhedo jīvādiḥ tasya nirākṛteḥ asau tadābhāsaḥ saṃgrahābhāsaḥ, tannirākṛtau sanmātrasyāpi nirākṛtisiddheḥ
na khalu nirāśrayaṃ sāmānyaṃ nāma aśvaviṣāṇāderapi tattvaprasaṅgāt
hiryasmāt na kaścit cetanaḥ itaro vā bhedo viśeṣa asadātmā asti, kuta etat ityāha– virodhāt
nanu bhavatvevam, tathāpi bhedebhyo bhinnaṃ sattvam ityatrāha–yad yadetyādi

yad dravyādi yadātmakaṃ yat sattvamātmā yasya tad yadātmakam tad dravyādi tadeva bhavati sadrūpameva bhavati, yathā svanirbhāsabhedātmakaṃ saṃśayetaraviparyāsetaraviśeṣātmakaṃ jñānaṃ saṃśayādirūpameva bhavati
yata evaṃ tasmāt sadātmano bhedāḥ sanmātrameva nānyat bhāvādbhinnaṃ prāgabhāvādi iti evaṃ saṃgrahaḥ
kutaḥ sa ityāha–tatprādhānyāt, sanmātraprādhānyāt natu na punaḥ bhedapratikṣepāt
ka ? naigama, nigamo mukhyagauṇakalpanā, tatra bhavo naigama iti
guṇabhāvaḥ apradhānabhūta ekaśca pradhānabhūta, anyonya paraspara guṇabhūtaikau tau ca tau bhedābhedau ca tayo prarūpaṇāt grahaṇāt
tathāhi guṇaguṇināmavayavāvayavinā kriyākārakāṇā jātitadvatāñca kathañcid bheda guṇīkṛtya abheda prarūpayati, abheda vā guṇīkṛtya bheda prarūpayati
tasyoktau prarūpaṇāyā naigamābhāsa iṣyate tasya pramāṇabādhitatvāt
tulanā–ṇegehiṃ māṇehiṃ miṇaitti ṇegamassa ya niruttī
nigameṣu ye'bhihitā śabdāsteṣāmartha śabdārthaparijñāna ca deśasamagrāhī naigama
yadasti na tad dvayamatilaṅghya varttate iti naika gamo naya sagrahāsagrahasvarūpadravyārthiko naigama iti yāvat
yadvā naika gamo yo'tra sa satā naigamo mata
naikairmānaiḥ mahāsattāsāmānyaviśeṣaviśeṣavijñānai mimīte minoti vā naikama
nigameṣu vā arthabodheṣu kuśalo bhavo vā naigama
athavā naike gamā panthāno yasya sa naikagam
dharmayo dharmiṇo dharmadharmiṇośca pradhānopasarjanabhāvena yadvivakṣaṇa sa naikagamo naigama –pramāṇanaya॰ 7
tulanā–ja sāmannavisese paroppara batthuo ya so bhinno
vivṛtiḥ–svalakṣaṇabhedābhedayoḥ anyatarasya prarūpaṇāyām itaro guṇaḥ syāt iti naigamaḥ
yathā jīvasvarūpanirūpaṇāyāṃ guṇāḥ sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ, tatprarūpaṇāyāṃ ca ātmā
katham ? guṇaguṇinām avayavāvayavinām kriyākārakāṇāṃ jātitadvatāṃ ca mitho'rthāntaratve sarvathā vṛttivirodhāt
ekamanekatra varttamānaṃ pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā yadi syāt tad ekamityevaṃ na syāt
yadi punaḥ ekadeśena vartteta tadekadeśeṣvapi tathaiva prasaṃgāt kva kiṃ vartteta ?
tasya teṣu sarvātmanā'nyathā vā vṛttyayogo bādhaka pramāṇam
ekadeśena cāniṣṭā naiko vā na kvacicca sa
aśā a śeṣu varttante sa ca kutra svaya sthita
sarvātmanā cet sarvatra sthita kāya karādiṣu

pramāṇato hi dravyaparyāyāṇāṃ kathañcidbhede abhede ca vyavasthite sati anyonyaṃ parasparaṃ guṇabhūta apradhānabhūtaḥ bhedasya abhedaḥ, tasya ca bhedaḥ ekaḥ pradhānabhūto bhedasya abhedaḥ tasya ca bhedaḥ tayoḥ prarūpaṇāt
arthāntaratvoktau bhedābhedayoḥ ekāntena nānātvoktau satyāṃ naigamābhāsa iṣyate

svalakṣaṇaṃ paryāyātmakaṃ dravyaṃ tadātmakā paryāyāśca, tasya yau bhedābhedau tayormadhye anyatarasya bhedasya abhedasya vā prarūpaṇāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyām itaraḥ bhedaprarūpaṇāyām abhedaḥ tatprarūpaṇāyāṃ vā bhedaḥ guṇaḥ syāt iti evaṃvidho naigamo nayaḥ

atrārthe suspaṣṭapratītyartha yathā ityādyudāharaṇamāha–yathā yena anādinidhanacaitanyaprakāreṇa jīvasya yat svarūpaṃ guṇaparyāyavyāpakatvaṃ tasya nirūpaṇāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ guṇā apradhānabhūtāḥ, ke ? sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ
nanu sukhādayaḥ ityevāstu kiṃ duḥkhagrahaṇena ? iti cet; na; anyonyaṃ jīvācca bhedapratipattyarthatvāt tadubhayagrahaṇasya
tatprarūpaṇāyāñca sukhaduḥkhādiprarūpaṇāyāñca ātmā jīvasvabhāvo guṇaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

nanvevaṃ vyākhyānaṃ kasmānna bhavati–jīvasvarūpasya jīvasattāyā nirūpaṇāyāṃ guṇāḥ sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ, teṣāṃ sattaiva guṇa iti, tatprarūpaṇāyāñca sukhādisattāprarūpaṇāyāñca ātmā jīvo guṇaḥ iti cet ? saṃgrahaṛjusūtrābhyāmasya bhedābhāvaprasaṅgāditi brūmaḥ
sattāprādhānyapakṣe sagrahe'ntarbhāvaprasaṅga, sukhādiparyāyaprādhānye tu ṛjusūtre'ntarbhāvaprasaṅga iti
teṣāṃ jīvasukhādīnāṃ prakramād ekāntena arthāntaratābhisandhiḥ naigamābhāsaḥ
katham iti praśne uttaramāha–guṇaguṇinām avayavāvayavināṃ kriyākārakāṇāṃ jātitadvatāñca mithaḥ parasparamarthāntaratve aṅgīkriyamāṇe, kim ityāha–sarvathā ityādi
sarveṇa vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa sarvathā vṛtteḥ guṇādīnāṃ guṇyādau varttanasya virodhāt naigamābhāsaḥ iti sambandha

anekatra deśakālākārabhinne avayavādau varttamānaṃ ekameka prati pratyekaṃ sarvātmanā sākalyena yadi syād bhavet varttamānaṃ tadavayavyādikam ekam ityevaṃ na syāt, api tu yāvanto'vayavādayaḥ tāvanta eva avayavyādayaḥ syu
nahi ekasya niraśasya kriyāto bhinnasya paramāṇuvad yugapad deśādibhinneṣvādhāreṣu varttanaṃ yuktam

punariti pakṣāntarasūcakaḥ, ekamanekatra pratyekaṃ yadyekadeśana vartteta tarhi tasya anekadeśā kalpanīyā teṣu cāsya vṛtti kalpanīyā, anyathā katha te tasya iti vyapadiśyante ? tatkalpane ca dūṣaṇamāha– tad ityādi
te ca te ekadeśāśca teṣvapi tathaiva sarvātmanaikadeśaprakāreṇaiva prasaṅgāt doṣādanavasthā syāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
tathāca kva avayavādau kim avayavyādi vartteta ? nirākṛtā ca avayavādau avayavyādervṛtti viṣayaparicchede prapañcata ityalamativistareṇa
avayaviniṣṭhā kriyā ekā niraśāpi satī bhinnadeśeṣu avayaveṣu vartetāpi, na tu kriyāto bhinno'nya kaścinniraśo'rya bhinnadeśādhāreṣu vartate iti bhāva
yadi punarityādi iti pāṭha ādarśe likhitvāpi niṣkāsita
te ca te tadekade– śra॰, ba॰
evaṃ guṇaguṇyādīnāṃ bhedaikāntaṃ nirākṛtya sattātadvatāṃ taṃ nirākartumāha–
svato'rthāḥ santu sattāvat sattayā kiṃ sadātmanām
yaugamate bhāvānā svata sadātmanā sattāsamavāya, asadātmanā veti vikalpadvaya manasikṛtya prathamapakṣe dūṣaṇamāha–svata svarūpeṇa arthā padārthā santu
kiṃvat ? sattāvat, yathā sattāntarādvinā'pi sattā parasāmānyaṃ svata evāsti tathā dravyādīnyapi svata eva santu vidyantām
tathā ca svata sadātmanā sattayā kiṃ sādhya na kimapītyartha
dvitīyavikalpa dūṣayati–sarvathā'sadātmasu dravyādiṣu parā sattā na syāt na varteta atiprasaṅgāt kharavipāṇādāvapi sarvathā'sati sattāsamavāyaprasaṅgāt
tulanā– sattājogādasao sao va satta havejja davvassa
asao na khapupphassa va sao va kiṃ sattayā kajja
vivṛtiḥ–yathā sadarthāntarāṇi svataḥ santi tathaiva dravyaguṇakarmāṇyeva santu kiṃ tatra sattāsamavāyena ? svataḥ satāṃ tadvaiyarthyāt asatāṃ cā'tiprasaṃgāt
gotvādeḥ sarvagatatve tatpratyayasāṅkaryyam, anyathā niṣkriyasya arthotpitsudeśamavyāpnuvataḥ anaṃśasya anekatra kādācitkavarttanamayuktam
guṇānāṃ vṛttaṃ calaṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ sukhaduḥkhakhājñānādikaṃ caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpamacalam ityetadapi tādṛgeva, tadarthāntaratā'siddheḥ
guṇānāṃ dṛśyādṛśyātmakatve puṃsāmeva tadātmakatvaṃ yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ guṇakalpanayā
calañca guṇavṛttamiti kṣiprapariṇāmi cittamuktam–pradīpāvayavānāmiva buddhyavayavānā guṇānā vṛtta kriyā cañcalā pratikṣaṇamanyā'nyā ca bhavati, na tu nirvyāpārā guṇāstiṣṭhanti –yogabhā॰, yogavā॰ 2
svataḥ ātmanaiva arthā dravyādayaḥ santu vidyamānā bhavantu sattāvat sattā para sāmānyaṃ seva tadvat
sattāgrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena avāntarasāmānyasamavāya-viśeṣavat iti ca draṣṭavyam
idamatra tātparyam–svataḥ santo'rthāḥ sattāsamavāyāt tadvantaḥ, anyathābhūtā vā syuḥ ? prathamapakṣe sat sattvam ātmā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ sadātmanāmarthānāṃ kim ? na kiñcit sattayā kriyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
nahi teṣāṃ tayā svarūpasattvaṃ kriyate; svata evāsya saṃbhavāt, sataśca karaṇāyogāt, anyathā anavasthā syāt
atha svato'santaḥ tatsamavāyāt tadvantaḥ atrāha–asad ityādi
asan avidyamāna ātmā yeṣāṃ teṣu naiṣā paraparikalpitā sattā syāt
prativyūḍhañca prapañcataḥ sattātaḥ sattvamarthānā ṣaṭpadāthaparīkṣāvasare iti kṛtamativistareṇa
svata satāmapi padārthānā sattayā saditi śabdaprayoga saditi jñāna vā kriyeta, ata āha nāpītyādi

yathā yena anavasthādidoṣabhayaprakāreṇa santi ca tāni arthāntarāṇi ca sāmānyādīni svataḥ ātmanaiva na sattāsamavāyāt santi sattāvanti tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa dravyaguṇakarmāṇyeva na kharaviṣāṇādīni svataḥ santu kiṃ tatra teṣu dravyādiṣu sattāsamavāyena ? kuta etadityāha–svataḥ ityādi
svato hi satāṃ dravyādīnāṃ sattāsamavāyāt sattvaṃ syāt, asatāṃ vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ, svataḥ satāṃ tadvaiyarthyāt sattāsamavāyavaiyarthyāt
tad anantarokta dūṣaṇam evam uktavidhinā yojyam

tathāhi–yathā saddravyaṃ san guṇaḥ sat karma svataḥ tathā svato dravyaṃ dravyaṃ guṇo guṇaḥ karma karma khaṇḍādirgau karkādiraśvaḥ, kiṃ tatra dravyatvādisamavāyena ? svato dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ tadvaiyarthyāt, adravyaguṇakarmaṇāñcātiprasaṅgāt
nahi tathā'pariṇatamanyasambandhāt tathā bhavati ākāśakuśeśayasyāpi tathātvaprasaṅgāt
atra ādiśabdena aśvatvādiparigrahaḥ, sarvagatatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe tatpratyayasāṅkaryyam gotvādipratyayasāṅkaryam khaṇḍādivat karkādāvapi gopratyayaḥ syāt
nirākṛtā ca viśeṣato nityā sarvagatā jātiḥ sāmānyaparīkṣāvasare ityalamiha vistareṇa
anyathā anyena asarvagatatvaprakāreṇa niṣkriyasya gotvādeḥ, arthaḥ utpitsuḥ yasmin deśe tamavyāpnuvataḥ icchāto viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ iti arthasya viśeṣaṇatvamiti na utpitsuśabdasya pūrvanipātaḥ
anaṃśasya niravayavasya anekatra svādhāre kādācitkaṃ varttanamayuktam
sāmānyādīnā trayāṇā svātmasattva–samprati sāmānyādīnā sādharmyamāha sāmānyādīnāmiti
svātmaiva sattvaṃ svarūpa yatsāmānyādīnā tadeva teṣā sattva na sattāyoga sattvam
viśeṣeṣvapi sāmānyasadbhāve saśayasyāpi sambhavāt nirṇayārtha viśeṣānusaraṇe'pyanavasthaiva
samavāye'pi sattābhyupagame tadvṛttyarthaṃ samavāyābhyupagamādaniṣṭāpattireva dūṣaṇam –praśa॰ bhā॰, kanda॰ pṛ॰ 19
karkādāvapi gaurgauriti śabdaprayoga gauriti jñāna vā syāt
durjñeyam, yato hi gotva govat sarvatra aśvādau syāt tathā ca tat mahāsāmānyameva syānna tvavāntarasāmānyamiti bhāva
dṛśyante vṛttibhājo vā tasminniti na gamyate
guṇānāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ vṛttaṃ varttanaṃ calam avirbhāvatirobhāvavat
etadeva sukha ityādinā vyācaṣṭesattvasya hi sukhādilakṣaṇaṃ vṛttam, rajaso duḥkhādilakṣaṇam, tamaso'jñānādikamiti
caitanyaṃ darśanaṃ puruṣasya svam ātmīyamasādhāraṇaṃ rūpam
na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sāṃkhyakā॰ 3 ityabhidhānāt
etadapi sāṃkhyamatamapi na kevalaṃ vaiśeṣikamataṃ tādṛgeva naigamābhāsa eva
tayoḥ sukhādivṛttapuruṣayoḥ arthāntaratām va tāva stvantaratvaṃ tasya asiddheḥ aniścayāt
sukhādivṛttapuruṣayoḥ paramārthato'bhede'pi pratīyamāne evaṃ paraiḥ svamatadurāgrahābhiniveśaprakāreṇa bhede abhyupagabhyamāne atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt ekameva na kiñcit syāt iti bhāvaḥ
nanu tadabhedavirodhāt siddhaiva tadarthāntaratā ityāha–tadabheda ityādi
tayoḥ puruṣavṛttayorabhede ekatve sati virodhābhāvāt sahānavasthānalakṣaṇasya parasparaparihārasthitisvarūpasya pramāṇabādhārūpasya vā virodhasyābhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ
atha matam acalapuruṣasvarūpe calavṛttānupraveśe dvayoścalatvamacalatvaṃ vā rūpaṃ syāt ato virodhaḥ ityatrāha–guṇānām ityādi
guṇānāṃ sattvarajastamolakṣaṇānāṃ dṛśyādṛśyātmakatve vyaktāpekṣayā dṛśyātmakatve pradhānāpekṣayā adṛśyātmakatve aṅgīkriyamāṇe puṃsāmeva tadātmakatvaṃ dṛśyādṛśyātmakatvaṃ yuktam upapannam
kṛtaṃ paryāptaṃ guṇakalpanayā pradhānakalpanayā, tasya tadātmakatvādityabhiprāyaḥ
prītyaprītiviṣādātmakā, atrāya samāsa prītiścāprītiśca viṣādaśca te ātmā svarūpaṃ yeṣā guṇānā te bhavanti prītyaprītiviṣādātmakā
yo hi kaścit kvacit prītiṃ labhate tatra ārjavamārdavasatyaśaucahrībuddhikṣamānukampājñānādi ca, tatsattva pratyetavyam
yo hi kaścit kadācit kvacidaprītimupalabhate tatra dveṣadrohamatsaranindāstambhotkaṇṭhānikṛtivañcanābandhacchedanāni ca, tadraja pratyetavyam
yo hi kaścit kadācitkvacinmohamupalabhate tatra ajñānamadālasyabhayadainyākarmaṇyatānāstikyaviṣādasvapnādi ca, tattama pratyetavyam
dvividho hi padārthānā virodha, avikalakāraṇasya bhavato'nyabhāve'bhāvādvirodhagati śītīṣṇasparśavat
prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahārāddhi sa na syāt tattvatastayoḥ
sa ca tattvata paramārthato na syāt
na khalu nirapekṣe bhāvaikānte pramāṇādibhedavyabahārosti nirākṛtatvāt bhedaikānte vā pramāṇaphalavyavahāro'sti sambandhābhāvāt
mithyaikānte pramāṇaphalavyavahārasyāvāstavaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe viśeṣa bhedo'pi ka ? na kopītyartha
kayo ? svapakṣavipakṣayo, svapakṣo brahmavādo bhedavādo vā, vipakṣa kṣaṇikavādo'dvaitavādo vā tayo sakaraprasagādityartha
vivṛtiḥ–śuddhamaśuddhaṃ vā dravyaṃ paryāyaṃ samastaṃ vyastaṃ vā vyavasthāpayatā tatsādhanaṃ pramāṇaṃ mṛgyam anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt

tataḥ sapra saḥpra tipakṣaṃ kathamatiśayīta satyetarasvarūpavat ? mithyaikāntāviśeṣe'pi tadvyavasthāpanamayuktam; tadubhayopalabdheravitathātmakatvāt, anyathā svapnāntaravat tadvisaṃvādānna kiñcit pramāṇam
naigame'pi calaṃ guṇapravṛttaṃ nityaṃ caitanyam iti vyavahārāsiddheḥ svaruciviracitadarśanapradarśanamātram
nahi guṇānāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ na dṛṣṭipathamṛcchati
iti pramāṇamasti samavāyena svāvayaveṣu avayavī vartteta
śṛṅge gauḥ śākhāyāṃ vṛkṣaḥ iti lokavyavahāramativartteta viparyayāt
svayamajñasvabhāvātmā jñānasamavāye kathamiva jñaḥ syāt ? nahi tathā'pariṇatasya tattvam, samavāyasyāpi jñatvaprasaṅgāt
na vai jñānasamavāyo'sti samavāyasyeti cet; kathaṃ svasvabhāvarahitaḥ so'sti vartteta vā samavāyāntarābhāvāt tadanavasthānuṣaṅgāt
māyeva laukikamāyāvat kṣaṇabhaṅgaram, ata sutucchakam atyantatucchamalpasāra sthirāśābhāvāditi
atra suśabdena pariṇāmitayā guṇānāmapi tucchatva sūcita guṇā eva pariṇāmitayā kūṭasthanityāpekṣayā tucchā, guṇakārya tu dṛśyamāna guṇāpekṣayāpi tuccham, ata sutucchamiti
parama rūpa mūlarūpamavyaktāvasthā na dṛṣṭipathamṛcchati gacchati, vyakta dṛṣṭipatha prāpta yad guṇarūpa tad māyeva sutucchaka māyayā pradarśita prapañca yathā tuccha tatheti
śṛṅga gavīti loke syāt śṛṅge gaurityalaukikam
vṛkṣe śākhā śilāścāga ityeṣā laukikā mati
tata eva tadastu ko doṣaḥ iti cedatrāha–sa ityādi
sa vyavahāro na syāt tattvataḥ paramārthataḥ tayoḥ saṃgrahanaigamābhāsayoḥ
nanu yadi tayorvyavahāro vāstavo nāsti, mā bhūt avāstavastu bhaviṣyati ityatrāha–mithyaikānta ityādi
ayamabhiprāyaḥ–yatra vyavahāro mithyā tatra tadāśritaṃ pramāṇamapyekāntena mithyā, tasmin mithyaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe viśeṣo bhedaḥ kaḥ na kaścit
śuddhaṃ dravyaṃ paryāyarahitaṃ brahmādi, śuddhaṃ paryāyaṃ dravyarahitaṃ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇurūpam
samastam anyonyātmakam, anenāpi sāṃkhyadarśanaṃ prakāśitam, vikāravikāriṇoḥ sāṃkhyaistādātmyābhyupagamat
tatsādhanaṃ tayoḥ śuddhāśuddhavyastasamastadravyaparyāyayoḥ sādhanaṃ mṛgyam anveṣyam
anyathā pramāṇānveṣaṇābhāvaprakāreṇa tadvyavasthāpane atiprasaṅgāt sarvataḥ sarvasya sarvārthasiddhiprasaṅgāt
nanu saṃgrahanaigamābhāsaprarūpaṇaprastāve kimarthamaprastutaṃ śuddhaṃ paryāyam ityetat prastūyate iti ca na vācyam; dṛṣṭāntārthatvāt
yathaiva śuddhaṃ paryāyaṃ vyavasthāpayatā saugatena pramāṇaṃ mṛgyam tathā anyadapi anyena vyavasthāpayatā tanmṛgyamiti
yadivā, uttaratra ṛjusūtrābhāse idamavaśyaṃ vaktavyam, tadihaivoktam
mṛgyata eva tarhi pramāṇamiti cedatrāha–tad ityādi
tasya tadvyavasthāpakasya prāmāṇyañca vyavahāreṇaiva na paraparikalpitaparamārthaprakāreṇa tatra tadasiddheḥ
sa ca vyavahāraḥ saṃgrahe mithyaiva leśato'pi satyo na bhavati iti evakārārthaḥ
bhavatvevam, ko doṣaḥ ? iti cedatrāha–tataḥ ityādi
tasmāt mithyārūpāt pramāṇādivyavahārāt saṃgrahaḥ pratipakṣaṃ bhedaikāntaṃ kathamatiśayīta ? na kathañcit
nanu abhedātmakaḥ sagrahaḥ bhedātmakaścā pratipakṣa, tatkathaṃ sa taṃ nātiśete ? ityatrāha–satya ityādi
satyam avitatham itarad vitatham te ca te svarūpe ca te yasya sta tat tadvat
kriyāviśeṣaṇametat–satyarūpavad yathā bhavati tathā saṃgraho'tiśayīta, itarasvarūpavat yathā bhavati tathā pratipakṣamiti, pratipakṣavat saṃgraho'pi mithyaiva syāt ityartha
mithyaikāntasya saṃgrahapratipakṣayoḥ yo'viśeṣaḥ tasminnapi na kevala viśeṣe tasya saṃgrahasya vyavasthāpanamayuktam
yata eva tat tasmāt ubhayopalabdheḥ saṃgrahetarayoḥ upalabdheḥ avitathātmakatvāt satyasvabhāvatvāt sa kathaṃ pratipakṣamatiśayīta iti sambandhaḥ
anyathā avitathātmakatvābhāvaprakāreṇa svapnāntaravat svapnabhedavat tasyāḥ visaṃvādānna kiñcit pramāṇam
vyavahāro hi bhedamāśritya pravartate ata abhedagrāhisagrahanayadṛṣṭyā mithyaiva
evaṃ saṃgrahābhāse pramāṇābhāvaṃ pradarśya idānīṃ naigamābhāse ta darśayannāha–naigame'pi ityādi
na kevalaṃ saṃgrahe api tu naigame'pi na kiñcit pramāṇam
guṇānāṃ sattvādīnāṃ vṛttaṃ mahadādirūpeṇa pariṇamanaṃ nityaṃ caitanyam iti evaṃ svaruciviracitadarśanapradarśanamātram

hiryasmāt na guṇānāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ paramaṃ pradhānalakṣaṇa rūpaṃ na dṛṣṭipathamṛcchati, yattu rūpaṃ mahadādi dṛṣṭipathaprāptaṃ tanmāyeva sutucchakam iti eva pramāṇamasti pratyakṣāderatrā'navatārāditi
sāṃkhyanaigamābhāse pramāṇābhāvaṃ pradarśya adhunā naiyāyikatadābhāse taṃ darśayannāha– samavāyena ityādi
samavāyena sambandhena svāvayaveṣu avayavī varttete ti nahi pramāṇamasti iti sambandhaḥ
nanu śṛṅge gauḥ śākhāyāṃ vṛkṣaḥ iti pratītiḥ tatra pramāṇamastīti cedatrāha–śṛṅge ityādi
śṛṅge gauḥ śākhāyāṃ vṛkṣa iti evaṃ yat pramāṇaṃ tat lokavyavahāramativartteta tatra tathāpratīterabhāvāt
kuta etadityāha–viparyayāt, gavi śṛṅgaṃ vṛkṣe śākhā iti lokavyavahāre pratītisadbhāvāt
svayam ātmanā ajñasvabhāvaḥ acetanaḥ san ātmā jñānasamavāye sati kathamiva jñaḥ syāt cetano bhavet ? nahi tathā jñatvaprakāreṇa apariṇatasya tattvaṃ jñatvaṃ yuktam
navai ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkate–navai naiva jñānena samavāyasya samavāyo'sti tatkathamasya jñatvaprasaṅgaḥ iti cet tatrāha–katham ityādi
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa samavāyo'sti ? na kenacid, vyavasthāpakapramāṇānāṃ samavāyaparīkṣāyāṃ prapañcataḥ pratiṣiddhatvāt
tasya hi svabhāvo'yutasiddhasambandhatvam, tacca tatraiva vistarato niṣiddham
kathaṃ ca samavāyiṣvavarttamānasya aśvaviṣāṇasyeva asya ayutasiddhasambandhatvaṃ yuktam ? atha varttata evāsau tatra; atrāha–vartteta vā ityādi
atrāsya jñatvalakṣaṇaṃ dūṣaṇamuktamiti mattvā dūṣaṇāntaramāha–vartteta vā kathaṃ samavāyāntarābhāvāt ekatvāttasya
viśeṣaṇībhāvād varttate iti cedatrāha tad ityādi

samavāyasya tadantarakalpane yā anavasthā tasya anuṣaṅgāt kathamasau kvāpi vartteta ? ayamabhiprāyaḥ– anavasthābhayāt samavāyasya samavāyāntaraṃ pareṇa na kalpyate, sā ca viśeṣaṇībhāvakalpane'pyaviśiṣṭā sambandhāntarakalpanasya atrāpyaviśeṣāt
nahi asambaddho viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ samavāyasya samavāyiṣu vṛttihetuḥ ityuktaṃ samavāyaniṣedhapraghaṭṭake
vartteta nahi ba॰, vartteti nahi śra॰
ayutasiddhānāmādhāryādhārabhūtānā ya sambandha ihapratyayahetu sa samavāyaḥ
kathambhūtaḥ san ? vyavahārāvisaṃvādī, hetuphalabhāvādivyavasthā vyavahāra tasyāvisavādo'vyabhicāra so'syāstīti tathokta
vyavahārasya hi sunayatve tadāśrayā hetuphalabhāvādisiddhi syāt anyathā vyavahāravisavādī durnaya syāt
itiśabda prakāravācī, sanmātrameva tattva vibhrama eva tattvamityādiprakārān sūcayati
katham ? utpādavigamadhrauvyalakṣaṇaṃ sat, guṇaparyayavaddravyam jīvaścaitanyasvabhāvaḥ iti

katham ? bahirapi svalakṣaṇamarthakriyāsamarthaṃ sad aṃgīkṛtya tatpratikṣepeṇa vijñaptimātramantastattvam iti pratyavasthāpya tadapi sūkṣmekṣikayā nirīkṣyamāṇaṃ na parīkṣākṣamamiti svabhāvanairātmyamasādhyasādhanamākulaṃ pralapanna kvacid vyavatiṣṭheta svaparivaṃsavādavyasanīyena pratyakṣādivirodhāt
lakkhaṇa pajjavāṇa tu ubhao assiyā bhave
guṇapajjayāsaya vā ja ta bhaṇṇati savvaṇhū
ta pariyāṇahu davvu turhu ja guṇapajjayajuttu
sahabhuva jāṇahi tā~ha guṇa kamabhuva pajjau vuttu
tulanā–api ca bāhyārthabijñānaśūnyavādatrayamitaretaraviruddhamupadiśatā sugatena spaṣṭīkṛtamātmano'sambaddhapralāpitva pradveṣo vā prajāsu viruddhārthapratipattyā vimuhyeyurimā prajā iti
bahirartho'sti iti nayasya udāharaṇam, śeṣaṃ durnayasya
bahirarthagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇaṃ tena pramāṇamasti kāryakāraṇabhā vādirasti ityādiḥ sarvo nayaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ
vijñaptimātraṃ tattvam, śūnyaṃ tattvam itīdṛśo durnayaḥ syāt
na kevalamanumānādeḥ api tu pratyakṣasyāpi prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahārāpekṣam
ataḥ pramāṇamavisaṃvādijñānam ityādi vyavahāreṇa, ājñātārthaprakāśo vā ityetattu paramārthena pramāṇam ityayuktam, vyavahāravyatiriktasya paramārthasyā'saṃbhavāt
yo'sau prāmāṇyena apekṣyate sa punaḥ vyavahāraḥ arthābhidhānapratyayātmakaḥ, tadvyatiriktastu anyo na kaścitsaṃbhavati yaḥ paramārthaḥ syādityabhiprāyaḥ
arthābhidhānayorarthatve'pi atra arthaśabdena vivakṣātaḥ tadviṣayo gṛhyate tadanyatamāpāye vyavahārānupapatteḥ
svapnenā'viśeṣacodanāyāṃ kuto nānāvijñānasantānavyavasthā vibhramavyavasthā anyā vā syāt ityuktaṃ bāhyārthasiddhiprastāve
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa arthātmano vyavahārasya svarūpaṃ sthitamiti ? uttaramāha–utpāda ityādi
kathaṃ bauddhaṃ prati dhrauvyaṃ siddhamityāha–guṇa ityādi
sahabhuvo guṇāḥ sukhajñānavīryādayaḥ, kramabhuvaḥ paryāyāḥ sukhaduḥkhādayaḥ, tadvaddravyam
idañca prasaṅgasādhanaṃ saugataṃ pratyevaṃ vyākhyeyam–sahabhāvinānādharmātmakaṃ cittamanyadvā cedaṅgīkriyate, kramabhāvyanekadharmātmakamaṣyaṅgīkarttavyam
naiyāyikaṃ prati punarevam–icchādiguṇasamavāyitvaṃ cet kasyacidiṣyate'pa rāparaparyāyātmakatvameṣṭavyam
tato yata eva guṇaparyāyavaddravyaṃ tata eva utpādavigamadhrauvyalakṣaṇaṃ saditi
jīva ātmā utpādādirūpaṃ sat ghaṭādiprameyaṃ pratipadyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
prasādhiścātmā tattvāntaram anādinidhanasvabhāvaśca cārvākamataparīkṣāyāṃ santānaniṣedhāvasare ca
nanu yadi sattāmātreṇa asau tatpratipadyate tadā'tiprasaṅgaḥ
caitanyasvabhāvaḥ svaparagrahaṇasvarūpaḥ iti hetoḥ pratyakṣādiparyāyapariṇataḥ san tatpratipadyate
tathā ca utpādādyātmakārthalakṣaṇo'rthātmako vyavahāraḥ siddhaḥ, tatpratipattilakṣaṇaḥ pratyayātmakaḥ, tatprarūpakaśabdalakṣaṇaḥ śabdātmaka iti
tulanā–tato yadukta pramāṇamavisavādijñānamityādi vyavahāreṇa pramāṇalakṣaṇamuktam, ajñātārthaprakāśo vā iti paramārthena, pramāṇāntareṇājñātasya advayapratibhāsārthasya ātmavedanasya evamabhidhānāt
yogācārā mādhyamikāśca arthaṃ svapnavat mithyārūpa vāsanākalpita manyante tathā coktam–phenapiṇḍopama rūpa vedanā budbudopamā
yadi pratyakṣādidvāreṇa jānāti tadā svayamātmana prameyabodhe'śakti prāptā ata āha caitanyasvabhāva iti
truṭitāyā pū॰ pratāvapi tadā'śakti ityeva pāṭha
–ti caitanyasya svabhāva iti caitanyasyabhāvaḥ svapara – śra॰
atha śabdātmake vyavahāre ko visaṃvādaḥko'visaṃvādaḥ ? ityāha–śruteḥ ityādi
kathamatyantaparokṣe'rthe tadavisaṃvādaḥ pramāṇāntarābādhanasya anyasya vā grahītumaśakyatvādityatrāha–pūrva ityādi
pūrvaṃ yadvākyaṃ yacca aparaṃ tayoravirodhaśca avisaṃvādaḥ, na kevalaṃ pramāṇāntarābādhanameva, asti cāyaṃ syādvādalāñchitāgamasya
ato na hiṃsyāt sarva sarvā bhūtāni yajñārtha paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayameva svayambhuvā manusmṛ॰ 5
ityādyāgamasya ca nāvisaṃvādaḥ pūrvāparavirodhasadbhāvāt ityuktam bhavati
yajñasya śca bhūtyai sarvasya tasmādyajñe badho'vadha
na hiṃsyāt ityahiṃsāvidhāna yajñe paśuvadhena virudhyate gagādvārāditīrthasnānavidhānañca tīrthasnānānna śuddhyati iti tīrthasnānasya nirarthakatvapratipādanena virudhyate
evaṃ vyavahāraṃ pradarśya tadāśrayaṃ nayaṃ pradarśayannāha–tadapekṣa ityādi
tasmin vyavahāre apekṣā yasyāsau tadapekṣo'yaṃ lokasiddho vyavahārākhyo nayaḥ
nanu tadapekṣa eva durnayaḥ apramāṇamūlasya vyavahārasyāvalambanāt, na tato'nyo niraṃśakṣaṇikaparamārthāśrayaṇāt
na kathañcit tato'nyathā durnayaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

na kevalamantaḥ kintu bahirapi svalakṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇikaniraṃśaparamāṇulakṣaṇam arthakriyāsamarthaṃ yataḥ tataḥ sad vidyamānam aṅgīkṛtya punaḥ tasya svalakṣaṇasya pratikṣepeṇa nirāsena vijñaptimātramantastattvaṃ nātmādikam iti evaṃ pratyavasthāpya punaravasthāpya tadapi vijñaptimātramapi sūkṣmekṣikayā nirīkṣyamāṇaṃ paryālocyamānaṃ nityādivanna parīkṣāṃ kṣamate iti evaṃ svabhāvanairātmyaṃ niḥsvabhāvatvam, kathambhūtam ? asādhyasādhanaṃ sādhyasādhanavikalam ākulaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pralapan saugato na kvacid antarbahiḥ sakalaśūnyatāyāṃ vā vyavatiṣṭheta yataḥ tadapekṣa eva durnayaḥ ityuktaṃ śobheta
nanu kimucyate svabhāvanairātmyamasādhyasādhanam yāvattatra sādhanaṃ vicāra eva iti cedatrāha–svapara ityādi
svaḥ saugataḥ paro naiyāyikādiḥ tayoḥ visaṃvādaḥ tattvāpratipattiḥ vyasanaṃ saṃsārasaritpātārttiḥ te adhikṛtya kṛtena punaḥ paścād alaṃ paryāptaṃ śeṣapralāpena asambaddhābhidhānena
kuta etadityatrāha pratyakṣādivirodhāt, pratyakṣamādiryasya anumāna-lokaprasiddhyādeḥ tattathoktaṃ tena tasya vā virodhāt
teṣāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ madhye anyatamasya abhimatatvād aṅgīkṛtatvāt saugataiḥ, kuto'nyathā teṣāṃ svaparābhimatasādhanadūṣaṇamityabhiprāyaḥ ?
tadapekṣaṇaṃ ca du– ba॰, tadupekṣa eva du– ā॰
tasya cāviro– ba॰, tasya viro– ā॰
evaṃ vyavahāranayaṃ sābhāsaṃ pratipādya idānīṃ ṛjusūtranayaṃ sābhāsaṃ darśayannāha–
pratipādyedānīṃ ṛjusūtrasya nayasya tadabhi– ā॰, ba॰
vyākhyā–ṛju vartamānaparyāyalakṣaṇa praguṇa sūtrayati nirūpayatīti ṛjusūtrasya pradhāna viṣaya syād bhavet
atītasya vinaṣṭatvena bhaviṣyataścāsiddhatvena vyavahārānupayogāt vyavahārāvisavādī naya iti vacanāt

nanu citrajñānamekamanekākāra vyavahāropayogi syāditi cedatrāha–citretyādi, citrā savit jñānaṃ tasyā cetanāṇusamūhatvāt, cetanā jñānaṃ tasyāṇava aśā avibhāgapraticchedāsteṣā samūha samudāya tattvāt, na citrasavid ṛjusūtranayasya viṣaya
nanveva tatra bheda kimiti nopalakṣyata iti cedatrāha–bhedānupalakṣaṇāditi
tato bhedasya nānātvasyānupalakṣaṇamadarśana sadṛśāparāpa rotpattyā vipralabdhabuddhi syāditi vyākhyāyate
ayamartha–yathā'yogolakādī paryāyabhedo vidyamāno'pi vipralabdhabuddhinā na niścīyate tathā citrasavidyapi tadaśabhedo vasannapi nopalakṣyata iti
athavā syāt kathañcid dravyāvinābhāviparyāya ṛjusūtrasya pradhānam, sarvathā dravyanirapekṣasya paryāyasyāvastutvāt
ṛju praguṇa mūtrayati tantrayata iti ṛjusūtra
ṛju praguṇa sūtrayati nayata iti ṛjusūtra
vivṛtiḥ–yathā vahiḥ paramāṇavaḥ sanniviṣṭāḥ sthavīyāṃsamevaikamākāramabhūtaṃ darśayanti tathaiva saṃvitparamāṇavo'pi
tannaikamanekarūpaṃ tattvamakramam, yat sakramaṃ sādhayet bhedasya abhedavirodhāt
pratibhāsabhedāt svabhāvabhedaṃ vyavasthāpayan tadabhedādabhedaṃ pratittumarhatyeva viśeṣābhāvāt
ṛjusūtrasya nayasya tadabhiprāyavato vā paryāyaḥ prabhedaḥ pradhānam, pradhānaśabdasya sambandhiśabdatvāt dravyaṃ tasya apradhānam
nanu tasyāpi citraikā saṃvidasti tatkathaṃ paryāyaḥ pradhānamityāha–citrasaṃvidaḥ cetanāṇusamṛhatvāt naikā citrā saṃvidasti iti bhāvaḥ
atha matam–paryāyatve'syāstathaivopalakṣaṇaṃ syādataḥ pratisamayaṃ bhedānumānamanarthakamityatrāha–syāt ityādi
syād bhaved bhedasya nānātvasya anupalakṣaṇam aniścayanaṃ sadṛśāparāparotpattivipralambhāt māyāgolakavaditi
