yathā yena dūrasthitaviralakeśanidarśanapradarśanaprakāreṇa vahiḥ paramāṇavaḥ jaḍaparamāṇavaḥ sanniviṣṭāḥ racanāviśeṣeṇa vyavavasthitāḥ sthavīyāṃsameva na sūkṣmam, ekameva nānekam ākāram abhūtam asantaṃ darśayanti, tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇa saṃvitparamāṇavo'pi, bahiḥparamāṇuvat saṃvitparamāṇūnāmapi svarūpeṇāpratibhāsanāditi bhāvaḥ
yata evaṃ tat tasmāt naikam abhinnaṃ tattvam anekarūpam
punarapi kathambhūtam ? akramam akṣaṇikam yuktam ityadhyāhāraḥ
yat tathāvidhaṃ tattvaṃ sakramaṃ sādhayet jainaḥ
kvacid antarbahirvā nānātvameva anekatvameva, anyathā bhedasya abhedavirodhābhāvaprakāreṇa na syāt
evaṃ ṛjusūtrasya sāmānyena svarūpaṃ pradarśya adhunā tadbhedaṃ pradarśayannāha–sāpekṣa ityādi
svaviṣayādanyatra yā apekṣā tayā saha varttamānaḥ ṛjusūtranayaḥ, nirapekṣo durnayaḥ
pratibhāsabhedāt svabhāvabhedaṃ vastusvarūpanānātvaṃ vyavasthāpayan nayo vādī vā tadabhedād tasya pratibhāsasya abhedāt abhedaṃ bhāvaikatvaṃ pratipattumarhatyeva
nanu tatpratibhāsayoḥ satyetaratvakṛto viśeṣo'sti tato na bhedapratibhāsādiva abhedapratibhāsādapi tattvasiddhirityatrāha–viśeṣābhāvāt iti
dvayorapi pratibhāsayoḥ satyetaralakṣaṇaviśeṣasya bhedasya abhāvāt, ubhayorapi satyatvāt ityarthaḥ

tayoḥ bhedābhedapratibhāsayormadhye anyatarasya apāye aṅgīkriyamāṇe arthasya vastuno'nyatarapratibhāsavikalasya anupalabdheḥ upalambhābhāvāt sarvadā ubhayātmakasya vopalabdheḥ taṃ pratipattumarhatyeva
yathā hi dīpādau nairantaryeṇa sadṛśāparāparajvālāpadārthasabhavāt satyapi bhede ekatvavibhramo bhavati tathā nairantaryeṇānekasūkṣmatarapadārthasavedanato'yamekatvavibhrama
kiṃ viśiṣṭa ? arthabhedakṛt arthasya prameyasya bheda nānātva karotyabhipraitītyarthabhedakṛt
tu puna abhirūḍho nāma naya paryāyaiḥ paryāyaśabdai
arthabhedakṛt yathā indanādindra śakanāt śakra pūrdāraṇāt purandara iti
na hi indanādidharmabhedābhāve indrādiśabda prayoktu śakya anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt
abhi svārthābhimukhyena rūḍha prasiddho'bhirūḍha iti nirukte
punaritthambhūto nāma naya kriyāśraya vivakṣitakriyāpradhāna sannarthabhedakṛt yathā yadaivendati tadaivendra nābhiṣecako na pūjaka iti, anyathāpi tadbhāve kriyāśabdaprayoganiyamo na syāt
tathā paryāyabhedāt indra śakraḥ purandara iti
tatkathaṃ punaḥ śabdajñānaṃ vivakṣāvyatiriktaṃ vastu pratyeti ? kathaṃ ca na ? tadapratibandhāt; nahi buddherakāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ ityetat prativyūḍhaṃ vijñānasya anāgataviṣayatvanirṇayena
ja ja saṇṇa bhāsai taṃ ta ciya samabhirohae jamhā
athavā yo yatrābhirūḍha sa tatra sametyābhimukhyenārohaṇāt samabhirūḍha
samabhirūḍha eva mattvaikībhāvena ābhimukhye eka eva rūpādirartha eveti yā jñānānā ? samabhirūḍha
athavā yenātmanā yena jñānena bhūta pariṇata tenaivādhyavasāyayati
jaha ghaṭasadda ceṭṭhāvayā tahā taṃ pi teṇeva
na parasparavyapekṣāpyasti varṇārthasakhyākālādibhirbhinnānā padānā bhinnapadāpekṣāyogāt tato na nākyamapyastīti siddham
eva bhavanādevambhūta asminnaye na padānā samāso'sti svarūpataḥ kālabhedena ca bhinnānāmekatvavirodhāt
na padānāmekakālavṛtti samāsa kramotpannānā kṣaṇakṣayiṇā tadanupapatteḥ
tata eka eva varṇa ekārthavācaka iti padagatavarṇamātrārtha ekārtha ityevabhūtābhiprāyavān evambhūtanaya
kālādīnāṃ bhedāt śabdaḥ śabdanayaḥ arthasya jīvādeḥ bhedaṃ karoti pratipādayati iti tadbhedakṛt
tāvacchabdaḥ kramavācī, kālabhedāt kālaviśeṣād arthabhedastāvadudāhriyate–abhūt atītakālasambandhyanubhavādiparyāyātmanā jīvādiḥ, bhavati varttamānakālasambandhismaraṇādiparyāyarūpeṇa jāyate
hetuhetumadbhāvaścātra draṣṭavyaḥ–yasmād bhavati tasmād abhūta, pariṇāmyupādānakāraṇamantareṇa bhavati ityasyāyogāt
bhaviṣyati anāgataparyāyasvabhāvena utpatsyate, atrāpi yasmād bhavati tasmād bhaviṣyati anyathābhavato'bhāvaḥ kāryābhāvāditi manyate
kārakāṇāṃ kartrādīnāṃ bhedāt śabdo'rthabhedakṛt iti sambandhaḥ
yadā hi devadattaḥ svatantro vivakṣito ghaṭādikārye tadā karoti ghaṭaṃ devadattaḥ iti bhavati
yadā tu sa eva anyopakāryatvena vivakṣyate tadā kriyate devadattaḥ iti
ādiśabdāt devadatte nidhehi, devadattādaparaḥ ityādi ṣaṭkārakīparigrahaḥ
tathā liṅgabhedāt śabdo'rthabhedakṛt yathā devadatto devadattā iti
iti yathā ca ādiśabdāt ā॰, ba॰
yathā śabdaḥ kālādibhedād arthabhedakṛt tathā abhirūḍhaḥ paryāyabhedāt indraḥ, śakraḥ, purandaraḥ iti
tathā prāguktaprakāreṇaiva etau anantaroktau śabdasamabhirūḍhau kathitau
itthambhūtaḥ kīdṛśaḥ ? ityāha kriyāśrayaḥ evambhūta iti
nanu ca itthambhūtasvarūpaprarūpaṇe prastute evambhūtābhidhāne kiṃ kena saṅgatam ? ityasat, yasmāt itthambhūtasyaiva idam evambhūtaḥ iti nāmāntaram
kasmādasau kriyāśraya ityāha-kurvata eva kārakatvaṃ yataḥ iti
yadā yasmin kāle na karoti kāryam indanādi śacīpatiḥ tadā karttṛtvāyogāt na indrādivyapadeśaḥ syāt

atrāha saugataḥ–trayo'pyete nayāḥ śabdato'rthaṃ pratipadyante ataḥ kālādibhedādarthabhedaṃ pratipadyamānaṃ tat śabdajñānam kathaṃ punarvivakṣāvyatiriktaṃ vastu svalakṣaṇaṃ pratyeti ? tamācāryaḥ pṛcchati, kathañca na pratyeti iti sambandhaḥ
sa uttaramāha tadapratibandhāt tena vastunā'pratibandhāt, tadātmyatadutpattipratibandhābhāvāt śabdajñānasya iti sambandhaḥ
tadabhāve'pi tat tatpratyeti iti cedatrāha–nahi ityādi
nahi naiva buddheḥ śabdaja nitāyāḥ yadakāraṇaṃ svalakṣaṇarūpaṃ vastu tattasyā viṣayaḥ nānanukṛtānvayavyatireka kāraṇam, nākāraṇa viṣaya ityabhidhānāt
kena ityāha–vijñānasya anāgataviṣayatvanirṇayena, pratipāditaścāsya anāgataviṣayatvanirṇayaḥ bhaviṣyat pratipadyeta laghī॰ kā॰ 14 ityādinā
nanu śabdāḥ saṅketitamevārthaṃ prāhuḥ nānyam atiprasaṅgāt
saṅketaśca na aviṣayīkṛtānāṃ śabdārthānāṃ yuktaḥ, tannirviṣayatāprāpteḥ
tadviṣayīkaraṇañca nādhyakṣeṇa, śabdādhyakṣasya abhidheye tadadhyakṣasya vā'bhidhāne apravṛtteḥ
akṣairjanitā buddhirjñānamatītārthaṃ svakāraṇabhūta śabda vācyañca, cedyadi, vetti jānāti
saugate mate hi viṣayasya jñānakāraṇatvāt, kāraṇañca kāryakṣaṇāt pūrvakṣaṇavartītyucyate
tadā kuta kāraṇāt smṛtirapi atītārtha na vetti api tu vettyevetyartha
eko'bhinno'tītatvāviśeṣāt sādhāraṇo'rtho viṣaya śabdārthalakṣaṇastasminnapi smṛti pramāṇamiti śeṣa
kuta ? pratibhāsabhidā pratibhāsasya atītākāraparāmarśasya bhid bhedastayā
pratyakṣeṇa hi idamiti yadanubhūyate tadeva kālāntare punastadityatītākāgtayā smṛtyā viṣayīkriyata iti
yathā pratyakṣajñānānā spaṣṭāspaṣṭapratibhāsabhedāt prāmāṇya tathā smṛterapītyartha
vivṛtiḥ–kṣaṇikākṣajñānajñeyayoḥ kāryakāraṇatvaniyame nirviṣayaṃ pratyakṣam tatkāraṇasya atītasya tadanātmakatvāt
prāgabhāvapradhvaṃsābhāvayoḥ samanantaretaravināśayośca abhāvā'viśeṣāt, tadutpattisārūpyayoḥ asaṃbhavāt vyabhicārācca kiṃ kasya jñānamityuktam
yadi punaḥ atītamarthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃcidvetti; smṛtiḥ kathaṃ na saṃvidyāt ? sākṣādatadutpatteratādrūpyācca iti vaiyātyam; vyavahitotpattāvapi tadrūpānukṛterdarśanāt dṛṣṭārthasvapnavat
pratyakṣasmṛtyoḥ pratibhāsabhedāt naikārthatvamanaikāntikam; dūrāsannaikārthapratyakṣayoḥ bhinnapratibhāsayorapi tadekārthaviṣayatvāt
nahi tato'rthaṃ paricchidya pravṛttau visaṃvādaikāntaḥ tadapramāṇaṃ yataḥ syāt
tadayaṃ śabdārthau smṛtyā saṅkalayya saṅkete punaḥ śabdapratipattau tadarthaṃ pratyeti smṛtipratyabhijñānāderapi paramārthaviṣayatvāt
akṣāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ kāryabhūtā buddhiḥ atītārthaṃ vetti viṣayīkaroti ced yadi na kutaḥ kāraṇāt smṛtiḥ atītārthaṃ vetti ? kintu vetti eva
athaivaṃ sati akṣabuddhismṛtyorabhinnaḥ pratibhāsaḥ syāt abhinnaviṣayatvāt nīlākṣabuddhidvayavad ityucyate; tatrāha–pratibhāsa ityādi
akṣabuddhismṛtyoḥ ekārthe ekārthatve satyapi bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ nirdeśaḥ
smṛtiḥ pratibhāsabhidā aspaṣṭapratibhāsāt itarapratibhāsaviśeṣaṣeṇārtha vetti iti sambandhaḥ
suprasiddho hi dūrāsannākṣabuddhīnāṃ viṣayābhede'pi spaṣṭetararūpaḥ pratibhāsabhedaḥ pādapasyaikasyaiva tathāpratibhāsanāt
kṣaṇikau ca tau akṣajñānajñeyau ca tayoryathākramaṃ kāryakāraṇatvaniyame abhyupagamyamāne nirviṣayaṃ nirālambanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāt
sa pratyakṣaviṣayo'nātmā svatmā'svabhāvo yasya tattathoktaṃ tasya bhāvāt
pratyakṣakāle hi sarvātmanā asya vinaṣṭasya svarūpābhāvato na tadviṣayatvaṃ ghaṭate
svakāle sattvāt tadviṣayatvam; kutaḥ smṛternirviṣayatvam ? tadarthasyāpi svakāle sattvāviśeṣāt
etattu akṣajñānaṃ prati atītasya kāraṇatvamabhyupagamya dūṣaṇamuktam
tasmād viṣayābhimatād utpattisārūpye tadutpattisārūpye, kā bhītiḥ bhībhiḥ jainendravyā॰ 1
athavā, taditi nipātaḥ tasmād ityasyārthe varttate
tayorasaṃbhavāt kāraṇāt, kiṃ pratyakṣamanyadvā kasya pratyakṣābhimatasya anyasya vā viṣayasya jñānaṃ grāhakam ityadhyāhāraḥ, sambandhi vā
utpatteḥ pūrvamabhāvaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ, labdhātmalābhasya svarūpapracyutiḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, tayorabhāvāviśeṣāt abhāvatvā'bhedāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ–yadā sati kāraṇe kāryaṃ na bhavati asati ca bhavati tadā tad ātmanaḥ kāraṇābhimatasyā'bhāvaṃ kāraṇaṃ sūcayati
atha kāraṇapradhvaṃsābhāva eva kāryotpādako na tatprāgabhāvaḥ, atrāha–samanantara ityādi
kāryotpatteḥ prāganantaraṃ jātaḥ kāraṇapradhvaṃsaḥ samanantaraḥ, itaraḥ anādyatītakāle cirajātaḥ tayoḥ vināśayoścāviśeṣāt
ayamabhiprāyaḥ–yadi abhāvatvāviśeṣe'pi pradhvaṃsābhāva eva kāryotpādako na prāgabhāvaḥ tarhi anādyanantātītānāgatāḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvāḥ kāryotpādakāḥ syuḥ tathā ca kāryasya anādyanantatāprasaktiḥ
atha kāraṇapradhvaṃsa eva kāryotpādako netaraḥ; na pradhvaṃsasyaiva kāraṇatvābhyupagame asya parihārasyā'nupapatteḥ
na ca prāganantara eva pradhvaṃsaḥ tajjanako nānya ityabhidhātavyam, deśakālayoranabhyupagame asyāpi parihārasya durghaṭatvāt
itaśca kiṃ kasya jñānamiti darśayannāha–'vyabhicārācca kāraṇāt kiṃ kasya jñānamiti ? etacca jñānasya nirākāratvasiddhau prapañcitamiti nehocyate
truṭitāyā pū॰ pratau bhībhi iti pāṭha pratibhāti
kāntasya pañcamyantasya subantasya bhīvācibhi subantai saha ṣasa tatpuruṣasamāsa bhavati
yogavibhāge sati kā bhībhi iti sūtrasya ayamartha syāt–yathā kāntasya bhayavācibhiḥ śabdai samāso bhavati, tathā kāntasya anyairapi śabdaiḥ samāsa syāt
bauddhamate hi kāraṇakāryābhimatakṣaṇayo ekadeśābhāvāt ekakālābhāvācca na deśakālakṛtamānantaryaṃ sabhavati
tanmate hi kāraṇābhimatasya anyo deśa kālaśca kāryābhimatasya cānya, deśakālayorapi kṣaṇikatvāt
na ca tai ākāśa kālo vā vastubhūta svīkriyate, chidrasya ākāśatvāt, pūrvāparādibuddhereva ca kālavyapadeśārhatvāt
nanu naiva pratyakṣasya anyasya vā atīto'nyo vā bhāvato viṣayo'sti bhinno yastūcyate sa vyavahāreṇa ityāśaṅkyāha–yadi punaḥ ityādi
yadi punaḥ atītamarthaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathañcid vyavahāreṇa anyena vā prakāreṇa vetti viṣayīkaroti tadā smṛtiḥ kathaṃ na saṃvidyāt atītamartham iti sambandhaḥ
sākṣāt avyavadhānena atadutpatteḥ atītārthādutpattarebhāvāt smṛteḥ atādrūpyatvācca atītārthena sārūpyāsaṃbhavācca nāsau taṃ saṃvidyāt iti sambandhaḥ
iti evaṃ vaiyātyaṃ viyātasya durvidagdhasya bhāvo vaiyātyaṃ parasya
vyavahito'ntarito yo'rtho'nubhavena tasmāt paramparayotpattiḥ smṛteḥ tasyāmapi tasya vyavahitasya yadrūpaṃ tasya anukṛterdarśanāt
jāgraddaśāyāṃ yo dṛṣṭo'rthaḥ sa dṛṣṭaḥ, tasya svapnaḥ tatreva tadvaditi
syānmatam–pratyakṣasmaraṇe naikārthe bhinnapratibhāsatvāt rūpādijñānavadityatrāha– pratyakṣa ityādi
pratyakṣasmṛtyoḥ pratibhāsabhedāt hetoḥ ekārthatvanna iti yat parasyābhimataṃ tadanaikāntikam– anaikāntikahetuviṣayatvādupacāreṇa anaikāntikam
etadeva dūrāsanna ityādinā samarthayate– dūrāsanne ca te ekārthapratyakṣe ca tayoḥ
kutaḥ ? bhrānteḥ aspaṣṭasya darśane spaṣṭasya prāpteḥ iti paraḥ
pratyakṣānumānābhyām anyat pramāṇaṃ tajjñānaṃ syāt aspaṣṭatvā'liṅgajatvābhyāṃ pramāṇadvayānantarbhūtatvāt
nanu visaṃvādāttat pramāṇameva na bhavati tatkathaṃ tadantaram ? iti cedatrāha nahi ityādi

nahi naiva tena dūrākṣārthajñānena arthaṃ vṛkṣādi paricchidya pravṛttau kriyamāṇāyāṃ visaṃvādaikāntaḥ, aspaṣṭākāratayā visaṃvāde'pi vṛkṣādyākāratayā tadabhāvāt tadapramāṇaṃ taddūrārthajñānam ekāntenāpramāṇaṃ yataḥ syāt

yasmād uktaprakāreṇa pratyakṣavat smṛtervastuviṣayatvaṃ siddham tat tasmād ayaṃ saugato vyavahārī vā śabdārthau pūrvadarśanena viṣayīkṛtau smṛtyā karaṇabhūtayā saṅkalayya pratyabhijñāya saṅkete evaṃvidho'rthaḥ evavidhaśabdavācyaḥ iti samaye sati punaḥ paścād vyavahārakāle śabdapratipattau satyām arthaṃ sampratyeti viṣayīkaroti
nanu smṛtyāderavastuviṣayatvād avastuni saṅketaḥ tatpratipattiśca; ityatrāha–smṛti ityādi
ādi- śabdene tarkādiparigrahaḥ, tasyāpi na kevalaṃ pratyakṣasya paramārthaviṣayatvāt
nanu paramārthaviṣayatve śabdānāṃ na kvacit tadabhāve tajjñānaṃ syādityatrāha–tad ityādi
tasya śabdasya arthaḥ tadarthaḥ tasya abhāve'pi na kevalaṃ bhāva eva śabdārthajñānaṃ śabdasya kāryabhūtamarthajñānaṃ jagatprapañcasya prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam, īśvaraḥ kāraṇaṃ, brahma kāraṇam ityādi
yathā pratyakṣaṃ dvicandrādyarthābhāve'pi bhavati tathā tadapīti
nanu yadi arthābhāve'pi tajjñānaṃ syāt tarhi sarvameva śābdajñānamapramāṇaṃ syāt
kim ? akṣaśabdārthavijñānam, akṣamindriya śabdo varṇapadavākyātmako dhvani tābhyā janitamarthasya sāmānyaviśeṣātmakavastuno viśiṣṭa saśayādivikala jñānamavabodhanam
na hi spāṣṭyamaspāṣṭya vā prāmāṇyetaranibandhana tayo savādetaranibandhanatvāt
vivakṣāvyatirekeṇa vāg arthajñānaṃ vastutattvaṃ pratyāyayati anumānavat sambandhaniyamābhāvāt
akṣāṇi ca śabdāśca teṣām arthajñānaṃ samam
kena ityāha avisaṃvādataḥ, avisaṃvādena yathā akṣajñānamavisavādakaṃ tathā śabdārthajñānamapi
ayamabhiprāyaḥ–yathā akṣajñānasya kasyacidvisaṃvādino darśane'pi na sarvamakṣajñānamapramāṇaṃ tattvāt dvicandrādijñānavat ityabhidhātuṃ śakyam, tathā śabdārthajñānamapi
tarhi pratyakṣāt ko'sya viśeṣaḥ ? iti cedatrāha–aspaṣṭamaviśadaṃ śabdavijñānam, akṣajñānaṃ tu spaṣṭam ityanayorviśeṣaḥ
tarhi tatpramāṇaṃ kimiveti cedatrāha–pramāṇaṃ śabdajñānam anumānavat
nanu cākṣajñānasya arthotpattisārūpyasaṃbhavāt yuktamavisaṃvādakatvaṃ na śabdajñānasya tadviparyayāt ataḥ akṣa ityādyayuktam, ityārekādūṣaṇapuraḥsaraṃ kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha–tadutpatti ityādi

tasmād arthād utpattiśca sārūpyañca ādiryasya tadadhyavasāyasya sa tathoktaḥ, sa eva lakṣaṇaṃ prāmāṇyasya avisaṃvādasya vā tasya vyabhicāre'pi tadutpatteḥ cakṣurādinā, sārūpyasya samānārthasamanantarajñānena, tadadhyavasāyasya marīcikācakre jaladarśanena tatra jalādhyavasāyahetunā, tattritayasya śukle śaṅkhe pītajñānaprabhavottarapītajñānena, na kevalamavyabhicāre
uttaratra tacchabdadvayaprayogād atrāpi dvitīyo yacchabdo draṣṭavyaḥ
tato'yamartho jātaḥ–yajjñānaṃ yadarthaparicchedalakṣaṇaṃ yadarthagrahaṇasvarūpaṃ tat jñānaṃ tasya arthasya

etaduktaṃ bhavati–tatra yayā pratyāsattyā sattvāviśeṣe'pi kiñcit kasyacit kāraṇaṃ na sarva sarvasya, kāraṇatvāviśeṣe'pi ca kasyacit kiñcidākāramātmasātkaroti, tadaviśeṣe'pi ca kiñcidvyavasyati tayā tadutpattyādirahitamapi tatparicchedavat iti
evaṃ tadvyabhicāre'pi jñānārthayoḥ sambandhāt vāgarthajñānasyāpi na kevalamanyasya syayam ātmanā avisaṃvādāt pramāṇatvaṃ samakṣavat pratyakṣavat
nanu bhavatu tatpramāṇaṃ kintu vivakṣāyāmeva, ityatrāha–vivakṣā ityādi
vivakṣāvyatirekeṇa yadvāhyaṃ vastutattvam arthasvarūpaṃ tat pratyāyayati gamayati
yathā anumānaṃ vivakṣāvyatiriktamartha gamayati tathā vāgarthajñānamapi
vivakṣāyāmeva na bahirarthe tasya sambandhaḥ iti yo niyamaḥ tasyā'saṃbhavāt
athavā, tādātmyatadutpattirūpa eva sambandhaḥ nāparaḥ iti yaḥ sambandhaniyamaḥ tasyā'bhāvāt
na kevalamanyasya api tu vācyavācakalakṣaṇasyāpi sambandhasya bahirarthapratipattihetutopalabdheḥ
ayamabhiprāyaḥ-anyo'pi sambandhastatpratītiṃ kurvan upalabhyamāna eva asti ityucyate nānyathā'tiprasaṅgāt, tathā prakṛtasyāpyupalabhyamānatve astitvamastu iti
samarthitañcāsyāstitvaṃ pramāṇaṃ śrutamartheṣu laghī॰ kā॰ 26 ityatra prapañcataḥ ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
cakṣurādimya ghaṭajñānamutpadyate na ca tat cakṣurādigrāhakaṃ bhavati

samānārthe ekasminnarthe tilādau yatprathama jñāna jāta tasmājjāta yadanantara dvitīya tilajñāna tasya prathamatilajñānena saha sārūpyamasti, na ca dvitīyajñāna prathama gṛhṇāti, jñāna jñānasya na niyāmakamiti tatsiddhāntāt
marīcicakre jāyamāna jaladarśanamanukūla jalamidamityākāraka vikalpamutpādayati na ca tatpramāṇam
śukle śakhe jāyamānapītajñānāt utpannasya anantarapītajñānasya śakhajñānādutpannasya tadākārānukāriṇaḥ tadunukūlaśakho'yamityākārakavikalpotpādakasya pūrvajñāne prāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt
na caitadasti jñāna jñānasya na niyāmakamiti niyamabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt
siddhe hi artheṣvatītādibhede tasmāt kālasya atītāditvam, tasmāccārthānāmatītāditeti
kim ? kālādidakṣaṇam, kāla ādiryeṣā kārakaliṅgasakhyāsādhanopagrahādīnā te kālādaya teṣā lakṣaṇamasādhāraṇaṃ svarūpam
kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? parīkṣita vicārita svāmisamantabhadrādyai sūribhi

dravya pūrvāparapariṇāmavyāpakamūrdhvatāsāmānyam, paryāyā ekasmin dravye kramabhāvina pariṇāmā, sāmānya sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇa tiryak sāmānyam, viśeṣo'rthāntaragato vyatireka, dravya ca paryāyāśca sāmānyañca viśeṣaśca dravyaparyāyasāmānyaviśeṣā te ātmā svabhāvo yasyāsau tathokta
sa cāsāvarthaśca tasminniṣṭhita niyata tadātmakamiti yāvat
vivṛtiḥ–nahyekānte varttanālakṣaṇaṃ kālasya saṃbhavati, bhūtabhaviṣyadvarttamānaprabhedo yataḥ syāt, tadarthakriyānupapatteḥ
na ca dravyaṃ śaktiḥ tadubhayaṃ veti kārakalakṣaṇaṃ śaktiśaktimatorvyatirekaikānte sambandhāsiddhiḥ anavasthānuṣaṅgāt

kutaḥ punaḥ styāyatyasyāṃ garbha iti strī, prasūte svān paryāyān iti pumān tadubhayātyaye napuṃsakam' iti śabdārthapratyayānāmanyatamasyāpi liṅgavyavasthā ? tathā ekasyārthasya indanādindraḥ, śakanāt śakraḥ, puraṃdārayatīti purandaraḥ iti paryāyabhedād bhinnārthatā tadvācināṃ śabdānāṃ na saṃbhavatyeva vyatireketaraikāntayoḥ tatra virodhāt
śaktikārakavādina bhartṛhariprabhṛtaya; tathāhi– svāśraye samavetānā tadvadevāśrayāntare
kriyānivṛttau dravyasya śakti sādhana sādhyate'nena kriyeti bhāṣyakāraprabhṛtayo vidu
tulanā–na ca dravyamātra kāraka na ca kriyāmātram, kārakaśabdo hi kriyāsādhane kriyāviśeṣayukte pravartate
dhātvarthāśe prakāro ya subartha so'tra kārakam –śabdaśa॰ kā॰ 67
adhikaraṇasādhanā loke strī styāyatyasyā garbha iti
sastyānavivakṣāyā strī, prasavavivakṣāyā pumān, ubhayavivakṣāyā napusakamiti

kāla ādiryasya kārakādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ vā anyatra tattvārthabhāṣyādau parīkṣitaṃ vicāritam īkṣyam anveṣyam nyakṣeṇa ātmanā, niścitaḥ pūrvaṃ pramāṇena vyavasthāpito'kṣo nyakṣaḥ iti vyutpatteḥ
dravyam ūrdhvatāsāmānyaṃ tasya sahakramabhuvo vivarttāḥ paryāyāḥ, sadṛśapariṇāmaḥ sāmānyam, visadṛśapariṇāmo viśeṣaḥ te eva ātmā yasyārthasya tatra niṣṭhitam tadātmakamiti yāvat
tato nirākṛtametat–kālādeḥ svayamabhedāt kathaṃ tadbhedāt kaścidarthabhadekṛt iti
yadi cāvā, anyārthapariṇatiḥ kālāpekṣā kālapariṇatistu svarūpāpekṣā, yathā ghaṭādiprakāśaḥ pradīpanibandhanaḥ pradīpaprakāśastu svanibandhana iti, ataḥ anavasthā'nyonyāśrayāsaṃbhavaḥ
athavā, tadarthena liṅgabhūtena niṣṭhā svarūpavyavasthitirjñātā asyeti tanniṣṭhitaṃ tallakṣaṇam tatpramāṇakam ityarthaḥ
tathāhi–ayaṃ tadarthaḥ asmāt pūrvaṃ paścāt anena saha vā bhavatīti pratītiḥ tadarthavyatiriktārthapūrvikā, pūrvāparādipratītitvāt, ayaṃ tadartho'smātpūrvadeśaḥ ayamaparo deśa ityādipratītivat
tathāhi–karoti kriyate ityādipratītiḥ vibhinnaśaktikārthanibandhanā, vilakṣaṇapratītitvāt, jalānalapratītivat
tathā, devadatto devadattā ityādipratītiḥ vibhinnasvarūpārthanibandhanā, viśiṣṭapratītitvāt, ghaṭapaṭapratītivat
hiryasmāt na kṣaṇikādyekānte varttanā svayaṃ trikālagocaraiḥ paryāyaiḥ varttamānān bhāvān prati prayojakatvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kālasya saṃbhavati yato lakṣaṇāt bhūtabhaviṣyadvarttamānaprabhedaḥ kālādeḥ syāt
yataḥ iti ākṣepe vā, yataḥ tatprabhedaḥ syāt, naiva syāt
yā bhūtādyarthasya kriyā niṣpattiḥ tasyā anupapatteḥ ekānte iti sambandhaḥ
yathā ca ekānte kālasya atītādyarthakriyānupapattiḥ tathā kālaparīkṣāvasare viśeṣataścintitam
vṛterṇijantātkarmaṇi bhāve vā yuṭi strīliṅge vartaneti
dharmādīnā dravyāṇā svaparyāyanivṛttiṃ prati svātmanaiva vartamānānā vāhyopagrahādvinā tadvṛttyabhāvāt tatpravarttanopalakṣita kāla iti kṛttvā vartanā kālasyopakāra
evaṃ kālasya ekānte lakṣaṇaṃ varttamānān bhāvān prati prayojakatva nirākṛtya kārakasya tannirākurvannāha–naca ityādi
kiṃtadityāha– dravyaṃ śaktiḥ tadubhayaṃ vā ityetat, ekānte tadarthakriyānupapatteḥ ityetadatrāpi sambandhanīyam
atha tadekānte'pi rājapuruṣavad upakāryopakārakabhāvāt sambandhasiddhiriṣyate, atrāha–anavasthānuṣaṅgāt iti
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ–yathā rājapuruṣayoranyonyamupakāryopakārakabhāvaḥ tathā cet śaktitadvatostadbhāvaḥ tadā tatra pratyekam aparā śaktiḥ kalpanīyā tatrāpyevaṃ codyamityanavasthā
etena anayoḥ samavāyaḥ viśeṣaṇībhāvaḥ anyo vā bhinnaḥ sambandhaḥ cintitaḥ
tayoḥ śaktiśaktimatoḥ avyatirekaikānte abhedaikānte aṅgīkriyamāṇe śaktiḥ śaktimat iti eva yā parasya vācoyuktiḥ vacanopapattiḥ sā riktā nirarthikā
tasmin sati śaktireva syāt, na ca sā parasya nirādhārā yuktā dravyādikalpanāvaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
na ca dravyādikameva śaktirityabhidhātavyam, śaktiparīkṣāyāṃ tasyā tato vyatiriktāyāḥ prasādhitatvāt
yato bhedābhedaikānte śaktiśaktimadbhāvo nopapadyate tat tasmāt naikānte ṣaṭkārakī kartrādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇā kārakāṇāṃ samāhāro vyavatiṣṭheta, kārakābhāve tatsamāhārābhāvāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
nanu yadi kārakavyavasthā nāsti kimāyāta liṅgāvyavasthāyā yena sāpi na syāt ? ityāha–styāyati ityādi
styāyati saṅghātībhavati asyāṃ garbha iti strī
pratūte janayati svān ātmīyān paryāyān iti pumān
eva yā vyavasthā, sā kutaḥ ? liṅgavyavasthāyāḥ kārakanibandhanatvena tadabhāve'bhāvāditi manyate
atraiva ekānte location unknown dūṣaṇāntaramāha–tathā ityādinā
tathā tena kārakābhāvaprakāreṇa ekasya abhinnasya arthasya surapatilakṣaṇasya indanād indraḥ śakanāt śakraḥ purandārayati iti purandaraḥ ityevaṃ paryāyabhedāt indanādipariṇāmabhedāt
athavā, indrādiśabdaparyāyabhedāt sakāśāt tadbhedañcāśritya yāsau pareṇābhyupagatā
sā kim ? ityāha–na saṃbhavatyeva, manāgapi tatsaṃbhavo nāsti ityevakārārthaḥ
yaḥ surapatilakṣaṇa ekārthaḥ yaśca śakanādiḥ tayoḥ parasparaṃ vyatirekaikāntaḥ bhedaikāntaḥ yaśca itaraikāntaḥ abhedaikāntaḥ tayoḥ tatraikānte virodhāt
itaraikānte ca indanādeḥ ekatvasiddheḥ sa siddha iti
nanu na dravyaṃ nāpi śaktistadubhayaṃ vā kārakalakṣaṇam, kintu kriyāviṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ kārakam; iti cedatrāha–tata eva ityādi
tata eva anantaroktavirodhādeva kriyākārakayoḥ kriyā adhiśrayaṇādilakṣaṇā, kārakaṃ kartrādi, tayoḥ tatra mithyaikānte asaṃbhavo vijñeyaḥ
tulanā–sastyānaprasavau liṅgamāstheyau iti paribhāpita bhāṣye liṅgamukta tathā cāha–sastyāne styāyaterṅaṭ strī, sūtessapprasave pumāniti
styāna sahanana prasava upacayo rūpādīnā sattvādiguṇānām
sūterdhātorbhāve prasava upacaye ḍumsun pratyaye paratassakārasya pakārādeśe kṛte pumāniti
anena ca prakāreṇa viṣaye sūtyarthevṛtti sūcayati
–gatā keṣām ā॰, –gatā ketyāha bhinnārthatā keṣām ba॰
yasmād ekānte kālakārakalakṣaṇaṃ nopapadyate tat tasmād anekāntasiddhiḥ tatraiva asyopapatteḥ
nanu ekāntavyatiriktasya śabdārthasyāsaṃbhavāt sarvatra liṅgādyasaṃbhavo bhavataḥ syāditi cedatrāha–tad ityādi

kutaḥ ? na kutaścit tadabhidhānaliṅgādyasaṃbhavopālambhaḥ, tasya anekāntārthasya abhidhānaṃ pratipādakaṃ vacanaṃ tasya liṅgādiḥ, ādiśabdāt vacanādiparigrahaḥ tasyā'saṃbhavaḥ, sa eva upālambhaḥ kutaḥ na kutaścit syādvādam anekāntavādam anuvarttena yāyāt
nanu sarvathā bhāvānāmabhāvāt tadarthābhidhānamasiddham ityatrāha–nābhāvaikāntaḥ śūnyataikāntaḥ
yathā cāsau nāsti tathā viṣayaparicchede vyāsataścintitam
kā ? ṣaṭkārakī, ṣaṇṇāṃ kārakāṇāṃ samāhāraḥ ṣaṭkārakī
katham ? pratikṣaṇam, kṣaṇaḥ samayaḥ kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati pratikṣaṇam
kasmāt ? anekasāmagrīsannipātāt, anekā bahiraṅgā'ntaraṅgā sāmagrī kāraṇakalāpaḥ tasyāḥ sannipātaḥ sannidhistasmāt

tathāhi–yadaiva cakrādisannidhānāt ghaṭasya kartā devadattaḥ tadaiva svaprekṣakajanasannidhānāt sa eva daśyate iti karma, prayojanāpekṣayā devadattena kārayatīti karaṇam, dīyabhāvadravyāpekṣayā devadattāya dadātīti sampradānam, apāyāpekṣayā devadattādapaitīti apādānam, tatrasthadravyāpekṣayā devadatte kuṇḍalamityadhikaraṇamityavirodhāttathāpratīteḥ
tathā yugapadiva kālādibhedataḥ kāladeśākārāṇāṃ bhedaḥ kramaḥ tenāpi ṣaṭkārakī prakalpeta
ayavā tathā ekasya ṣaṭkārakīprakalpanavat kālādyapi prakalpeta
vivṛtiḥ–pratikṣaṇaṃ pratyarthaṃ ca nānāsāmagrīsannipātāt ṣaṭkārakīsaṃbhave'pi yathaikaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svabhāvakāryabhedānāṃ tadabhedakatvāt tathā kālādibhede'pi
tatpratikṣepo durnayaḥ tadapekṣo nayaḥ, svārthaprādhānye'pi tadguṇatvāt
tulanā–evamete śabdasamabhiruḍhaivambhūtā nayāḥ parasparāpekṣāḥ samyak anyonyamanapekṣāstu mithyeti pratipattavyam
evaṃ śabdādayo'pi sarvathā śabdāvyatirekamarthaṃ samarthayanto durnayāḥ
yathā babhūva bhavati bhaviṣyati sumerurityādayo bhinnakālāḥ śabdā bhinnamevārthamabhidadhati bhinnakālaśabdatvāttādṛksiddhānyaśabdavadityādiriti
yathendraḥ śakraḥ purandara ityādayaḥ śabdā bhinnābhidheyā eva bhinnaśabdatvāt karikuraṅgaturaṅgamaśabdavadityādiriti
yathā viśiṣṭaceṣṭāśūnyaṃ ghaṭākhyaṃ vastu na ghaṭaśabdabācyaṃ ghaṭaśabdapravṛttinimittabhūtakriyāśūnyatvāt paṭādivadityādiriti
ekasya vastunaḥ, apiśabdo'tra draṣṭavyaḥ tato'nekasyāpi prakalpeta
kuta ityāha–anekasāmagrīsannipātāt anekā nānā yā sāmagrī anekakāryotpādakakāraṇasamagratā tasyāḥ sannipātāt
kathaṃ prakalpeta ityāha–pratikṣaṇaṃ, kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati pratikṣaṇaṃ yathābhavati tathā prakalpeta

tathāhi–yadaiva cakrādisannidhānāt ghaṭasya karaṇād devadattaḥ karttā tadaiva pratyakṣadeśādisāmagrīsannidhānāt sa eva karma, anyakarmāpekṣayā karaṇam, tasmai dīyamānadravyādyapekṣayā sampradānam, tasmād ākṛṣyamāṇabhāvāpekṣayā apādānam, tatra sthāpyamānārthāpekṣayā adhikaraṇamiti
tathā tena prakāreṇa kālādibhedataḥ kāla ādiryasya deśādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tadbhedata ekasya ṣaṭkārakī prakalpeta iti sambandhaḥ
tadyathā āsīd devadatta kartrādisvabhāvo bhavati bhaviṣyati vā
kārikārthaṃ darśayan atra sunayadurnayabhedaṃ darśayati–pratikṣaṇam ityādinā
kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ prati pratikṣaṇam, arthamartha prati pratyarthañca nānāsāmagrīsannipātāt ṣaṭkārakīsaṃbhave'pi tatpratikṣepaḥ tasyāḥ ṣaṭkārakyāḥ pratikṣepo nirāsaḥ durnayaḥ
kathaṃ tatsaṃbhavaḥ ? ityatrāha–yathaikaṃ svalakṣaṇam, yathā ekaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ vyavasthitaṃ tathā yathā bhavati tathā tatsaṃbhave'pi iti
nanvekasya svalakṣaṇasya anekasya svabhāvasya kāryasya ca saṃbhave tadvadanyatrāpi tatsaṃbhavaḥ syāt, nacāsāvasti, tatsaṃbhave tasyāvaśyaṃ bhedāt ityatrāha–svabhāva ityādi
na khalu sajātīyetarakāryabhede tatkāraṇasvabhāvabhede vā svalakṣaṇasya bhedo'sti
evaṃ kālādibhede ṣaṭkārakīsaṃbhave'pi tannirāso durnayaḥ iti darśayannāha–tathā ityādi
yathā sāmagrībhede ekasya ṣaṭkārakīsambhave'pi tannirāso durnayaḥ, tathā kālādibhede'pi ṣaṭkārakīsaṃbhave'pi iti sambandhaḥ
tasyāṃ ṣaṭkārakyām apekṣā yasya asau nayaḥ
svaḥ viṣayīkriyamāṇo yo'rthaḥ tasya prādhānye'pi tadguṇatvād avivakṣitadharmāṇāmapratikṣepeṇa guṇībhūtatvāt
yadi evaṃvidho nayo bhavati, pramāṇaṃ tarhi kīdṛśam ? ityāha–tad ityādi
tad aguṇībhūtaṃ vivakṣitāvivakṣitadharmobhayam ātmā yasya arthasya tasya jñānaṃ pramāṇam

nanu nayaḥ sarvo'pi mānaso vikalpaḥ, vikalpaśca nirviṣaya eva tattvāt pradhānadivikalpavat, tatkathaṃ tena kasyacidadhigamaḥ syāt ? ityāśaṅkya vikalpatvāt ityasya hetoḥ tarkādinā anaikāntikatvaṃ darśayannāha–
vyāptiṃ sādhyena hetoḥ sphuṭayati na vinā cintayaikatra dṛṣṭiḥ,
kā ? ekatra dṛṣṭi ekasmin mahānasādau sādhyasādhanayo dṛṣṭirdarśana pratyakṣamityartha
kena ? sākalyena sakalānā deśakālāntaritasādhyasādhanavyaktīnā bhāva sākalya tena
na hi dṛṣṭāntadharmiṇi sādhyasādhanasambandhadarśana sākalyena vyāptipratipattau samarthamanumānānarthakyaprasaṅgāt taddraṣṭurabhijñatvāpatteśca
tarhi kiṃ pramāṇa tā sphuṭayatīti ceducyate ? eṣa tarka ya mākalyena sādhyasādhanayo vyāptiṃ sphuṭayati jñāna sa eva ca sakalānumānikaprasiddhastarka ityucyate
kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? adhigatārthāvisavādi, adhigata pratyakṣeṇānubhūto'rtho viṣayastatra avisavādi visavādarahitamiti
kva ? tatkṛtārthekadeśe, tena tarkeṇa kṛto niścita artho'vinābhāvastasyaikadeśa sādhya tatrānumānaprāmāṇyasya smṛtitarkaprāmāṇyāvinābhāvitvādityartha
na kevalametat parokṣameva vikalpātmaka pramāṇamapi tu sarvaṃ pratyakṣamapi vikalpātmaka pramāṇa tasyaiva vyavahāropayogitvāt, nirvikalpakasya kvacidapyanupayogāt
ata kāraṇāttarkādivat vikalpātmakaireva nayodhai samadhigati samyagadhigamo jīvāditattvanirṇayo bhavati
kiṃ bhūtai ? saptadhākhyai, saptaghā naigamādisaptaprakārā ākhyā yeṣā tairiti
vyāptim avinābhāvaṃ hetoḥ liṅgasya sādhyena liṅginā saha sphuṭayati prakāśayati na, kā'sau ? dṛṣṭiḥ darśanam ekatra ekasmin deśe, upalakṣaṇametat tena ekadā ca yā dṛṣṭiḥ iti gṛhyate
kena vinā ityāha–vinā cintayā, tayā sahitā tu sphuṭayati
katha tayā vinā sā tāṃ na sphuṭayati ityāha–sākalyena sāmastyena
deśatastu yadi sphuṭayati tadā sphuṭayatu, kintu tathā'numānānudayaḥ
kastarhi sākalyena tāṃ sphuṭayati ? ityāha–eṣaḥ ityādi
kathambhūtaḥ ? ityāha–anadhigataviṣayaḥ anadhigataḥ pramāṇāntareṇā'paricchinnaḥ viṣayo yasya sa tathoktaḥ
sa kim ? ityāha–saṃjñānameva, ca śabdaḥ evakārārthaḥ, ata eva pramāṇam
yathā cāsau sākalyena vyāptiprakāśakaḥ anadhigataviṣayaḥ sajñānañca location unknown bhavati tathā vyaptijñānaparīkṣāyāṃ prapañcataḥ prarūpitamityalamatiprasaṅgena
tataḥ siddham– nayasya nirviṣayatve sādhye vikalpatvāt ityasya hetoḥ tarkeṇa anaikāntikatvam
smaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ saṃjñānaṃ pramāṇam iti sambandhaḥ
kathambhūtam ? ityāha–adhigatārthāvisaṃvādi, svayaṃ smaraṇena adhigato yo'rthaḥ tadavisaṃvādi, yadi vā, pramāṇāntareṇa adhigatārthāvisaṃvādi
tena tarkeṇa kṛto niścito'rthaḥ avinābhāvalakṣaṇaḥ tasya ādhārabhūte ekadeśe'pi sādhyasvarūpe, ca śabdo bhinnaprakramaḥ apiśabdārthaḥ
ataḥ asmāt nayānāṃ nirviṣayatvaprasādhakahetoḥ tarkasmṛtyanumānajñānaiḥ vyabhicāritvalakṣaṇāt nyāyāt samadhigatiḥ jīvādyarthānāṃ saptadhākhyaiḥ nayaudhaiḥ
taiśca teṣāṃ samadhigatau satyāṃ yajjātaṃ taddarśayati–
na syāt sakalavit trikālagocarāśeṣadravyaparyāyavedī na bhavet
kim ? tattvam kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? anekāntabhāk anekānta dravyaparyāyātmatā bhajatyātmasātkaroti ityanekāntabhāk
puna kathambhūtam ? śakya parīkṣaṇa śakyaparīkṣaṇa saśayādivyavacchedena vivecana yasya tathokta laukikagocaramapītyartha
katham ? pratyakṣam, kiṃ kṛtvā ? abhyasya bhāvayitvā
kim ? svamatam sarvathaikāntadarśana niranvayavināśādibhāvanāvahitacetaso'nekāntatattvamadhigantumanalamiti katha sarvaveditva teṣāmityartha
tata kāraṇāt, bho akalaṃka jñānāvaraṇādikalaṅkarahita, namaskaravāṇi
kathambhūtāya ? sarvajñāya puna kiṃ viśiṣṭāya ? nirastamanekāntatattvabhāvanābalādviśleṣita bādhaka doṣāvaraṇadvaya yasyāḥ sā nirastabādhakā tādṛśī dhīryasya tathoktastasmai
na kevalamahameva te namaskāromi kintu prekṣāvān parīkṣaka sarvopi tvāmeva śaraṇa yāti pratipadyate, nityapravṛttamānavivakṣayā eva vacanāt
punarapi kathambhūtam ? jinam bahuvidhaviṣamagahanabhramaṇakāraṇaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ jayatīti jinastam –laghī॰ tā॰ pṛ॰ 72
prekṣāvānakalaṅka yāti śaraṇaṃ tvāmeva vīraṃ jinam || 50
pālībhāṣāyā tu jināterdhāto jinātīti jina iti siddhyati

etacchalokānantara paricchedasamāpti vidhāya ja॰ vi॰ pratau nimnaślokaḥ samullikhita, parañca sa tātparyavṛttikṛtā abhayacandreṇa nyāyakumudakṛtā cā'vyākhyātatvāt arthaprakaraṇadṛṣṭyā'saṅgatatvācca prakṣipta eva bhāti–mohenaiva nāha naiva paro'pi karmabhiriha pretyābhibandha puna
ki vā tatra tapo'sti kevalamime dhūrtairjaḍā vañcitā
aya śloka yaśastilakacampūttarabhāge'pi pṛ॰ 257 praśrutirūpeṇa niṣṭaṅkita
tataḥ tasyāḥ samadhigateḥ sakāśāt ekāntavādī sugatādiḥ sakalavit sarvajño neti jñāyate ityadhyāhāraḥ
śakyaṃ parīkṣaṇaṃ saṃśayādivyavacchedena svarūpavivecanaṃ yasya tat tathoktam
punarapi kathambhūtam ? pratyakṣam, pratyakṣagrāhyamapi, atrāpi apiśabdo draṣṭavyaḥ
kiṃ kṛtvā'lakṣayan ? ityāhaabhyasya, kim ityāha–svamatam, ekāntam, athavā suṣṭhu amatamajñānaṃ kṣaṇikaniraṃśatattvam
nanu tallakṣaṇe kiṃ prayojanam ? iti cedatrāha–prekṣāvān ityādi
atrāpi tataḥ ityetadapekṣyam, tato'yamarthaḥ siddhaḥ–tataḥ tajjñānāt prekṣāvān parīkṣako lokaḥ akalaṅkaḥ nirdoṣaḥ atattvābhyāsarahitaḥ
kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ tvām ? vīram, vīranāmānam antima tīrthakaradevam
yadi vā, viśiṣṭām anyajanāsādhāraṇām īm antaraṅgabahiraṅgalakṣaṇāṃ śriya rātīti vīraḥ tīrthakarasamudayaḥ tam
na kevalaṃ tvāmuktaviśeṣaṇaṃ śaraṇameva yātyayaṃ prekṣāvān janaḥ, kintu namaskaroti ca
kathambhūtāya ? ityāha–nirastabādhakadhiye, nirastā bādhakānām ekāntavādināṃ dhīryena
yadi vā, nirastaṃ bādhakaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathāvidhā dhīryasya nirastā vā bādhikā dhīryasya tasmai
punarapi kathambhūtāya ? syādvādine te tubhyaṃ namaḥ stāt namaskāro'stu iti
akalaṅkāya vīrāya jināya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena uttaraṃ padatraya yojyamiti

syādvādograraveraśeṣaviṣayapradyotino deśataḥ, tadrūpapratirūpaṇāya gaditāḥ saptaiva te sannayāḥ | kiṃ bhāsvānnikhilaprakāśanapaṭurbālāgramapyuccakaiḥ, śakto dyotayituṃ vinonnatakarairnirmūlya bāḍha tamaḥ ? || cha
śakto dyotayituṃ vinonnatakarairnirmūlya bāḍha tamaḥ ? || cha
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre pañcamaḥ paricchedaḥ || cha
atha pramāṇanayasvarūpaṃ nirūpya idānīṃ pramāṇaviśeṣasya āgamasya svarūpaṃ pṛthak nirūpayitumupakramate, tatra anekadhā vipratipattisadbhāvāt
syādastītyādisaptabhagamayo vāda syādvāda īkṣaṇānā saptakam īkṣaṇasaptakam syādvāda evekṣaṇasaptaka yasmādvineyānā bhavatyasau tathoktastam
syādastītyādisaptabhaṅgamayo vādaḥ syādvādaḥ īkṣaṇasaptakaṃ yasya sa tathokta tam
nanu syādvādasya īkṣaṇavyapadeśaḥ mukhyataḥ, upacārato vā syāt ? na tāvat prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ; cakṣuṣyeva mukhyataḥ tadvyapadeśaprasiddheḥ
dvitīyapakṣo'pyanupapannaḥ, yato rūpādipratipatte hetubhūtaṃ cakṣuḥ īkṣaṇaṃ loke prasiddham

na ca bhagavataḥ tatpratipattau syādvādo hetubhūta, tatkathamasya upacārato'pi īkṣaṇavyapadeśaḥ ? atha aparamanenāsau bodhayatīti tatpratipatterhetubhūtatvāt tadvyapadeśaḥ; tarhi parasyaiva tadīkṣaṇasaptakaṃ na bhagavataḥ, anyadīyāttato anyasya pratipatterayogāt; tadasamīcīnam; anyathā vyākhyānāt
syādvāda eva īkṣaṇasaptakaṃ yasmād bhavyānāṃ sa tathoktastam
yadi vā, īkṣaṇasaptakamiva īkṣaṇa- saptakaṃ syādvādaḥ tat saptaka yasyāsau sa tathoktaḥ tamiti
kiṃ punaḥ tatsaptakena syādvādasya sādharmya yenaivamucyate iti cet; upadeśādyanapekṣā'rthajñānajanakatvam
yathaiva hi īkṣaṇāt paropadeśaliṅgānvayavyatirekanirapekṣa rūpādijñāna jāyate tathā syādvādād bhagavata kevalajñānamiti
tamitthambhūtam iṣṭadevatāviśeṣa praṇipatya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇalakṣitān pramāṇanayanikṣepān abhidhāsye
kiviśiṣṭam ? jñāna jānāti jñāyate'nena jñaptimātra vā jñānamityucyate, dravyaparyāyayo bhedābhedavivakṣāyā kartrādisādhanopapatte
kasya ? ātmāde ātmā svarūpamādiryasya bāhyārthasya sa ātmādi tasya svārthasya grāhakamityartha
athavā ātmā ciddravyamādiśabdena āvaraṇānā kṣayopaśama kṣayaścāntaraṅga bahiraṅga punarindriyānindriya gṛhyate, tasmādupajāyamānamityadhyāhāra
yuktita pramāṇanayanikṣepairevārthasya jīvāde parigraha pramitirna svata iti
tulanā–jñātṝṇāmabhisandhaya khalu nayāste dravyaparyāyata, tatra dravyamanantaparyayapada bhedātmakā paryayā
viṣamo'yamupanyāsaḥ asannikṛṣṭasya tadakāraṇatvāditi; naitatsāram; arthasya tadakāraṇatvāt tasyendriyānindriyanimittatvāt arthasya viṣayatvāt
na hi tatparicchedyo'rthaḥ tatkāraṇatāmātmasātkuryāt pradīpasyeva ghaṭādiḥ
tulanā– jñāna pramāṇa nājñānamindriyārthasannikarṣādi –pramāṇavā॰ manoratha॰ pṛ॰ 3
nanu jñānārthayoḥ tādātmyādisambandhāsabhavāt kathaṃ tattasya ityucyate iti cet, na, tadabhāve'pi viṣayaviṣayibhāvalakṣaṇasambandhasabhavāt
tadabhāve so'pi katham ? ityapi vārttam; tādātmyatadutpattyorabhāve'pi pradīpārthayoḥ prakāśyaprakāśakabhāvavat jñānārthayoḥ viṣayaviṣayibhāvasya samarthitatvāt
nanu ca ātmāderabhāvānna kiñcittasya jñānam ? ityapi śraddhāmātram, tasya viṣayaparicchede prabandhena prasādhitatvāt
yadi vā, ātmā svarūpam, ādiśabdena arthaparigrahaḥ, tena svārthayoḥ ityayamartha siddho bhavati
prasādhitañca svaparavyavasāyātmakatvaṃ jñānasya prapañcataḥ svasaṃvedanasiddhau ityalaṃ punastatprasādhanaprayāsena
upāyaḥ kāraṇam ātmādijñānasya nāmādi nyāso nikṣepaḥ iṣyate
nayo jñāturabhiprāyaḥ, pramāṇaviṣayīkṛte'rthe ekāṃśaviṣayo jñātuḥ pramāturabhiprāyaḥ
kiṃ phalameteṣāṃ svarūpavyāvarṇane ? ityāha–yuktitaḥ pramāṇādilakṣaṇāyāḥ arthasya parigrahaḥ svīkāraḥ
pramāṇaṃ dharmi jñānamiti sādhyam, pramāṇatvānyathānupapatteḥ iti heturatra draṣṭavyaḥ
nanu sannikarṣādinā ayaṃ heturvyabhicārī, tasyā'jñānarūpasyāpi avyapadeśyāvyabhicārivyavasāyātmakajñānajanakatvena pramāṇatvasaṃbhavāt ityatrāha–kāraṇasyāpi ityādi
sannikarṣaḥ sannikṛṣṭaṃ tacca indriyañca arthaśca sannikṛṣṭendriyārthāḥ, vivakṣitebhyastebhyaḥ anye asannikṛṣṭendriyārthāḥ teṣāmiva tadvat
yadvā, asannikṛṣṭau ca tau indriyārthau ca tayoriva tadvat
yadvā, prayogaḥ–vivādagocarāpannaṃ sannikarṣādi apramāṇam acetanatvāt avivakṣitasannikarṣādivat
yathā ca acetanasya sannikarṣādeḥ prāmāṇyannopapadyate tathā pratyakṣaparicchede prapañcataḥ pratipāditam
viṣamaḥ dārṣṭāntikena samāno na bhavati upanyāso dṛṣṭāntarūpaḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yadi naiyāyikādiḥ cetanatvena kvacit prāmāṇyamabhyupagacchati tarhi dṛṣṭānte caitanyābhāve yathā prāmāṇyābhāvaḥ tathā dārṣṭāntike'pi syāt, yāvatā jñānakāraṇatvena tadabhyupagatam
tatkāraṇatvañca dṛṣṭānte yadyapi nāsti tathāpi dārṣṭāntike asti iti siddhamasya prāmāṇyamiti
arthanimittatva kuto neti cedatrāha–arthasya viṣayatvāt paricchedyatvāt
nanu viṣayaśca syāt kāraṇañca iti ko'nayorvirodhaḥ ? ityatrāha–nahi ityādi
hiryasmāt na tasya jñānasya paricchedyo'rthaḥ tatkāraṇatāṃ jñānahetutām ātmasātkuryāt
atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ–yathā pradīpaprakāśyo ghaṭādiḥ na pradīpakāraṇatāmātmasātkaroti tathāpi pradīpena prakāśyate tathā jñānaprakāśyo'pyasau tatkāraṇatāmanātmasātkurvannapi tatprakāśya iti
anena paraparikalpitaḥ nākāraṇa viṣayaḥ iti niyamo nirastaḥ, pradīpaṃ pratyakāraṇasyāpi ghaṭādeḥ tatprakāśanaviṣayatopalabdheḥ
prāmāṇya svīkṛta na cetanatvena nāpyacetanatveneti bhāva
kiñca, nākāraṇa viṣayaḥ ityabhyupagacchatā kiṃ kāraṇameva viṣaya ityabhipretam, kāraṇaṃ viṣaya eva iti vā ? prathamapakṣe vijñānasvarūpasaṃvedanānupapattiḥ
nahi svarūpa svasyaiva kāraṇam, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt
kiñca, arthasya jñāna prati kāraṇatve siddhe ayaṃ niyama parikalpyeta, asiddhe vā ? na tāvadasiddhe, atiprasaṅgāt
atha siddhe, kutastatsiddhiḥ– tata eva jñānāt, anyato vā ? na tāvat tata eva, yataḥ–
dvividhaśca sahakārārtha parasparopakārako vā yathā ekārthakriyā vā yathonmiṣitamātreṇa rūpa gṛhṇata
ubhayathāpi vijñānasya kāraṇaviśeṣa eva viṣaya ucyate

tulanā–tathāhi–kiṃ kāraṇa viṣaya eva, uta kāraṇameva viṣaya ? prathamapakṣe rūpādisavidā cakṣurādyapi viṣayo bhavet dvitīyapakṣepi bhaviṣyati rohiṇyudaya kṛttikodayādatītakṣapāyāmiva ityasyānumānasya bhāvī rohiṇyudayo'kāraṇatvādviṣayo na syāt –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 510
vijñānasvarūpasavedana hi tadā syād yadā vijñānasya svarūpa svasavedana prati kāraṇa syāt
punarna vidyāt, kām ? utpattim ahamasmādutpannamiti svajanma

idañca prameya pratītisiddhameva, anyathā yadyarthāt svotpattiṃ jñāna vidyāt tadā vādiprativādinorvivādo jñānamarthādutpanna na veti vipratipattiḥ, kiṃvat ? kulālādighaṭādivat, yathā kulālādeḥ sakāśād ghaṭāderjanmani pratītisiddhe kasyāpi na vivādo'sti tathā'rthāt jñānajanmanyapi vivādo mā bhūt, asti cāya vivāda syādvādināṃ jñānajanmanīti
nahi tataḥ svabhāvalābhaṃ prati vyāpriyamāṇasya tatparicchittiḥ anutpannatvāt
yadi kāraṇakāryabhāvam ātmārthayorvijñānaṃ paricchindyāt na kaścid vipratipattumarhati karttṛkaraṇakarmasu
ghaṭādyarthagrāhakaṃ hi jñānaṃ deśakālākāraviśiṣṭo ghaṭādyartho'yam ityanenollekhena arthameva vidyāt, na utpattim ātmalābhamarthato vidyāt
atha tat tataḥ tāṃ vetti ityucyate, atrāha–anyathā ityādi
anyathā anyena tatparijñānaprakāreṇa na vivādaḥ syāt
yasya yasmādutpattiḥ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyate na tasya tadutpattau kasyacid vivādaḥ yathā kulālād ghaṭasya, vivādaśca jñānasya arthādutpattau, tasmāt sā tasya pratyakṣato na pratīyate iti

atha pramāṇāntarāttasya arthakāryatā pratīyate–nanu tatkiṃ pratyakṣarūpam, anumānarūpaṃ vā syāt ? yadi pratyakṣarūpam, tatkiṃ jñānaviṣayam, arthaviṣayam, ubhayaviṣayaṃ vā syāt ? tatrādyavikalpadvaye tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītiranupapannā, ekaikaviṣayajñānagrāhyatvāt, yayoḥ ekaikaviṣayajñānagrāhyatvaṃ na tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvapratītiḥ yathā rūparasayoḥ dhūmapāvakayorvā, ekaikaviṣayajñānagrāhyatvañca arthajñānayoriti
atha ubhayaviṣayapratyakṣāt tatpratītiḥ; tanna, tathāvidhapratyakṣasya asmādṛśāmasambhavāt

tulanā–kiñcārthakāryatayā jñāna pratyakṣata pratīyate pramāṇāntarādvā ? pratyakṣataścet, kiṃ tata eva pratyakṣāntarādvā ? atha pramāṇāntarāttasyārthakāryatā pratīyate, tatkiṃ jñānaviṣayamarthaviṣayamubhayaviṣaya vā syāt ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 232
kiñca, tadubhayaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tābhyāmutpannaṃ sat tayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaṃ pratyeti, anutpannaṃ vā ? na tāvadanutpannam, ādyajñānasyāpi arthādanutpannasya arthagrāhakatvaprasaṅgāt
atha utpannam; tarhi tasyāpi tadutpattiḥ aparasmāt tata utpannājjñānāt pratyetavyā tasyāpyanyasmādityanavasthā
arthaṃ ghaṭādikaṃ paricchindad vijñānam ātmanaḥ svasya kāraṇāntaramaparaṃ paraparikalpitādarthalakṣaṇakāraṇād aparameva cakṣurādilakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇāntaraṃ sūcayati
na hiryasmāt tato'rthāt svabhāvalābhaṃ prati vyāpriyamāṇasya svarūpalābhamarthayamānasya tatparicchittiḥ arthaparicchittiḥ
yadanutpannaṃ sad yadā yata ātmalābhaṃ labhate na tattadā tasya paricchedakam yathā alabdhātmalābhāvasthāyāṃ pitu putraḥ, anutpannaṃ sadarthādātmalābhaṃ labhate ca utpattikṣaṇe jñānamiti
atha utpannasya sato jñānasya arthagrahaṇe vyāpāro bhaviṣyati ityucyate; atrāha–utpannasyāpi 'ityādi
na kevalamanutpannasya api tu utpannasyāpi jñānasya kāraṇe svajanake na vyāpāraḥ tadgrahaṇalakṣaṇaḥ
karaṇaṃ cakṣurādi ādiryasya adṛṣṭādeḥ tatreva tadvaditi
prayoga–artho na jñānakāraṇam, tena paricchidyamānatvāt, yattu tatkāraṇaṃ na tattena paricchidyate yathā cakṣurādi, paricchidyate ca jñānenārthaḥ, atastatkāraṇanna bhavatīti
na ca ālokena anekānta; tatra jñānakāraṇatvasya nirākariṣyamāṇatvāt

tarhi putreṇa anekāntaḥ, piturutpannasyāpyasya tatparicchedakatvāt, ityapyasat, putraśarīrasyaiva tata utpatteḥ, na ca tat tatparicchedakaṃ kintu jñānam, tacca tato notpadyate cakṣurādita evāsyotpatteḥ
kathamevaṃ pūrvaprayoge tasya dṛṣṭāntatopapadyate ? ityapyacodyam; śarīrataḥ tadviśiṣṭajñānato vā'labdhātmalābhasya paricchedakatvābhāvamātrāpekṣayā tasya tadupapatteḥ saṃbhavāt
dṛṣṭāntatopapatte, yathā hi śarīrarūpeṇa viśiṣṭajñānātmakatayā vā'niṣpanna putra na pitṛparicchedaka tathaiva jñānamanutpanna sannārthasya paricchedakam
nanu ca arthakāryatayā jñāna svayameva ātmānaṃ pratipadyate, ataḥ tadvādhitakarmanirdeśānantara prayuktatvena kālātyayāpadiṣṭaḥ paricchidyamānatvāt iti hetuḥ, ityatrāha– yadi ityādi
yadi kāraṇakāryabhāvam ātmārthayoḥ, ātmanaḥ kāryabhāvam arthasya kāraṇabhāvaṃ vijñānaṃ karttṛ paricchindyāt, tadā na kaścidvipratipattumarhati
arthaḥ karttā, cakṣurādi karaṇam, jñāna karma, teṣu iti
yatra kāraṇakāryabhāvo nirbādhāyāṃ saṃvidi pratibhāsate na tatra kartrāditraye kaścid vipratipadyate yathā kulālaghaṭayo, vipratipadyate ca arthajñānayo kartrādau jainādiriti
nanu sarvatra anvayavyatirekasamadhigamyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ, tau cātrāpi vidyete–arthe satyeva jñānasyotpatteḥ tadabhāve cā'nutpatteḥ
prayogaḥ–yad yasyānvayavyatirekāvanukaroti tattasya kāryam yathā agnerdhūmaḥ, anvayavyatirekāvanuroti ca jñānamarthasya ityāśaṅkyāha–
kābhyām ? anvayavyatirekābhyām, sati bhavanamanvaya asatyabhavanaṃ vyatirekaḥ tābhyām
tadā kautaskuta syāt, kutaskuta āgataḥ kautaskuta
ityevamīkṣyatā tadvādibhi svamanasi paryālocyatām arthābhāve'pi saṃśayādyutpatte
na hi sthāṇupuruṣātmaka keśoṇḍukasvabhāvo vārthastajjñānotpattau vyāpriyate, tato bhāgāsiddhamarthānvavyatirekānuvidhānaṃ jñānasyeti
yadā hi devadattārthī kaścid vrajati tadgṛham
tatrāsannihita caina gatvāpi na sa paśyati
anāgate devadatte na devadattajñānamudapādi tasminnāgate tadutpannamiti tadbhāvabhāvitvāttajjanyatva tadavasīyate
vivṛtiḥ–buddhereva vyabhicāro nārthasya kathamavyabhicāriṇo'rthasya anvayavyatirekāvanukurvatī vyabhicarennāma ? tataḥ saṃśayādijñānamahetukaṃ syāt
tataḥ subhāṣitam–indriyamanasī kāraṇaṃ vijñānasya artho viṣayaḥ iti
āśubhramaṇamalātāde, manda hi bhrāmyamāṇe'lātādau na cakrabhrāntirutpadyate tadarthamāśugrahaṇena viśeṣyate bhramaṇam
gacchantyā nāvi sthitasya gacchadvṛkṣādibhrāntirutpadyate iti yānagrahaṇam
arthasadbhāve bhāvo'nvayaḥ tadabhāve'bhāvo vyatirekaḥ tābhyāmarthaśced yadi kāraṇaṃ vido jñānasya
saṃśayaḥ ādiryasyāḥ sā cāsau vit ca tasya utpāda ātmalābhaḥ kautaskuta ityevamīkṣyatāṃ paryālocyatām
buddhereva vyabhicāraḥ anyadeśādiviśiṣṭasyārthasya anyadeśādinā grahaṇalakṣaṇo nārthasya, vyabhicāraḥ iti sambandhaḥ
sa hi yathārthāmayathārthāṃ vā anvayavyatirekāvanu kārayan buddhiṃ janayatyeva
kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa avyabhicāriṇo'rthasya anvayavyatirekāvanukurvatī buddhiḥ arthaṃ vyabhicarennāma ? naiva vyabhicaret
yathaiva hi vyavasthito'rtha tathaiva gṛhṇīyāt, tata ātmalābhalakṣaṇatvādavyabhicārasya
ato yathā anyadeśādisambaddhasya dharmasyāsana eva grahaṇaṃ tathā dharmiṇo'pyasata eva grahaṇasambhavānna viparītakhyātyaityekānta śreyān, asatkhyāterapi prasaṅgāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
tataḥ tasmād buddhervyabhicārāt saṃśayādijñānamahetukam, arthalakṣaṇakāraṇaśūnya syāt dharmavat dharmiṇo'pi asata eva pratibhāsasaṃbhavāt
dṛśyate hi tāvad akṣipakṣmādyapāye'pi taimirikasya keśoṇḍukādijñānam
yathā cirakālīnādhyayanādikhinnasyotthitasya nīlalohitādiguṇaviśiṣṭa keśoṇḍrakākhya kaścinnayanāgre parisphuṭati, athavā karasamṛditalocanaraśmiṣu yeya keśapiṇḍāvasthā sa keśoṇḍraka
keśoṇḍukā nāma pakṣiṇa ye keśamūlānyutpāṭayanti –śikṣāsamu॰ pṛ॰ 70

tulanā–kāmalādyupahatacakṣuṣo hi na keśoṇḍukajñāne'rtha kāraṇatvena vyāpriyate–tatra hi keśoṇḍukasya vyāpāro nayanapakṣmādervā kāmalādervā gatyantarābhāvāt ? na tāvadādyavikalpa, na khalu tajjñāna keśoṇḍukalakṣaṇe'rthe satyeva bhavati bhramābhāvaprasaṅgāt
nayanapakṣmādestatkāraṇatve tasyaiva pratibhāsaprasaṅgāt gaganatalāvalambitayā pura sthatayā keśoṇḍukākāratayā ca pratibhāso na syāt
atha nayanakeśā eva tatra tathā'santo'pi pratibhāsante tarhi tadrahitasya kāmalino'pi tatpratibhāsābhāva
nanu keśoṇḍukādijñānaṃ bhrāntatvād arthāpāye'pi utpadyate, nānyad viparyayāt
nacānyasya vyabhicāre anyasya vyabhicāraḥ atiprasaṅgāt, ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, paranirapekṣatayā hi svaparaprakāśātmakatvaṃ jñānasya svarūpaṃ na punaḥ satyatvamasatyatva vā
tatra ca yathā satyābhimata jñānaṃ svaparaprakāśātmakaṃ tathā keśoṇḍukādijñānamapi
etāvāṃstu viśeṣaḥ–kiñcit satparaṃ prakāśayati saṃvādasaṃbhavāt, kiñcittu asad visaṃvādāt

na caitāvatā jātyantaratvena anayoranyatva vyabhicārābhāvo vā, anyathā prayatnānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvād ghaṭādivat ityāderapi aprayatnānantarīyakaiḥ vidyudvanakusumā dibhirvyabhicāro na syāt, tālvādidaṇḍādijanitāt śabdaghaṭādeḥ tadviparītasya vidyudāderanyatvāt
svaparagrahaṇalakṣaṇa hi jñānam, tatra ca yathā satyābhimatajñāna svaparagrāhaka tathā keśoṇḍukādijñānamapi
etāvā~stu viśeṣa kiñcitsatpara gṛhṇāti savādasadbhāvāt, kiñcidasadvisavādāt
timira ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkate–timirādīnāṃ dvandvaḥ, punaḥ ādiśabdena bahubrīhiḥ
tena ekatra ādiśabdena kāmalādisakalendriyadoṣaparigrahaḥ, anyatra dṛḍhaprahārādisvīkāraḥ, itaratra aśvayānādyupādānam, aparatra kodravādyupayogagrahaṇam
taddhetutve aṅgīkriyamāṇe kamarthaṃ kiṃ prayojanam arthaḥ puṣṇāti iti evaṃ mṛgyaṃ na kañcidityarthaḥ
na kevalamasatyajñāne api tu satyajñāne'pi timirādyabhāvasya, kathambhūtasya ? indriyamanogatasya

indriyagatasya timirādyabhāvasya, manogatasya saṅkṣobhādyabhāvasya, indriyamanogatasya āśubhramaṇādyabhāvasya kāraṇatvāt indriyādikameva ca tadviviktaṃ tadabhāva iti manyate, bhāvāntarasvabhāvatvādabhāvasya
yathā ca anyata evotpannaṃ saṃśayādijñānam asato'kāraṇasya arthasya grāhakaṃ tathā sataḥ satyajñānamiti sūrerabhiprāyaḥ
yasmāduktaprakāreṇa arthasya vijñānaṃ prati kāraṇatvaṃ nopapadyate tataḥ subhāṣitam–indriyamanasī kāraṇaṃ vijñānasya artho ghaṭādirviṣayaḥ paricchedya iti
na hi tadarthe satyeva bhavati abhrāntatvānuṣaṅgāt, tadviṣayabhūtasya sthāṇupuruṣalakṣaṇārthadvayasyaikatra sadbhāvāsaṃbhavācca
nanu ca indriyārthayoḥ satorapi sannikarṣavyatirekeṇa buddheranutpatteḥ tasmin satyeva utpatteḥ tasyaiva-tatra sādhakatamatvopapatteḥ nendriyamanasī tatkāraṇam ityāśaṅkāpanodārthamāha–
keṣām ? indriyārthānām, indriyāṇi cakṣurādīni arthāśca rūpādaya teṣām
na kevala sannidherapi tu anvayavyatirekayośca sannikarṣasya bhāvābhāvayośca
tataḥ saiva pramāṇaṃ na sannikarṣādi tasya prameyatvāt

vivṛtiḥ–sannikarṣādayaḥ kāraṇāntarādutpannayā buddhyā'dhyavasīyante na ca tairbuddhiḥ prāganadhyavasāyāt, anyathā kaimarthakyād buddheranveṣaṇam ? ātmamanaindriyārthānāṃ kāraṇānāmatīndriyāṇāṃ sannikarṣo duravabodhaḥ
kathaṃ tasya vijñānotpattāvaṅgīkaraṇamiti cintyam ? prāgvijñānotpatteḥ arthamanavabuddhyamānāḥ kāraṇamakāraṇaṃ vā kathaṃ brūyuḥ ? utpannaṃ hi vijñānamarthasya paricchedakaṃ na tatkāraṇatāyāḥ
duravabodha prāgvijñānotpatterarthamanavabuddhyamanā kāraṇamakāraṇa vā kathaṃ brūyu
katha tasya vijñānotpattāvagīkaraṇamiti vityāsādhijñānotpatterarthamavabuddhyamānāḥ kāraṇamakāraṇa vā katha brūyuḥ ? utpanna ja॰ vi॰
kāryakāraṇayoścāpi ityapiśabdaḥ sannidheḥ ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ, tato'yamartho jāyate–na kevalamarthasya kintu sannidherapi sannikarṣasyāpi buddhiradhyavasāyinī
na kevalamanayoḥ apitu kāryakāraṇayośca, kārya sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam indriyādi
yadi vā, kārya jñānam, kāraṇaṃ sannikarṣa tayośca buddhiradhyavasāyinī
etaduktaṃ bhavati–sannikarṣādisadbhāve'pi yāvad buddhirnotpadyate tāvattasya tadanvayavyatirekayoḥ tatkāryakāraṇabhāvasya anyasya vā na vyavasthā, buddhikalpanāvaiphalyaprasaṅgāt
utpannāyāṃ tu tasyām anyāpekṣāmantareṇaiva tattvavyavastheti, ataḥ saiva sādhakatamatvāt pramāṇaṃ na sannikarṣādi
sannikarṣa ādiryeṣām anvayavyatirekādīnāṃ te tathoktāḥ, kāraṇāntarāt indriyamanolakṣaṇād utpannayā buddhyā adhyavasīyante
na ca naiva taiḥ sannikarṣādibhirbuddhiḥ adhyavasīyate
prāk buddhyutpādāt pūrvam anadhyavasāyāt sannikarṣādīnāṃ buddhiviṣayavyavasāyarahitatvāt
anyathā anyena prāgadhyavasāyaprakāreṇa kaimarthakyād buddheḥ anveṣaṇam
na caivam, ato buddhereva sarvatra sādhakatamatvātprāmāṇyamityabhiprāyaḥ
yatpunaretat–ātmā manasā yujyate, mana indriyeṇa, indriyamarthena nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 74 iti tatrāha–ātmana tmamana ityādi
kathambhūtānām ? atīndriyāṇām indriyātikrāntānāṃ yaḥ sannikarṣaḥ sa duravabodhaḥ jñātumaśakyaḥ
ataḥ kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa tasya sannikarṣasya vijñānotpattau aṅgīkaraṇam ? iti evaṃ cintyam
yatkutaścijjñātunna śakyate na tat jñānotpattau kāraṇatvena prekṣāvatā aṅgīkarttavyam yathā kharaviṣāṇam, kutaścidapi pramāṇāt jñātunna śakyate ca sannikarṣādiriti
yathā cāsau kutaścidapi pramāṇāt jñātumaśakyaḥ tathā pratyakṣaparicchede prapañcataḥ pratipāditam
bhavatkalpitaśca ātmā mana indriyamarthaśca niraṃśādirūpo yathā nopapadyate tathā viṣayaparicchede saprapañcaṃ prapañcitam
tatra bāhye rūpādau viṣaye catuṣṭayasannikarṣājjñānamutpadyate ātmā manasā sayujyate mana indriyeṇa indriyamartheneti
ātmani tu yogino dvayorātmamanasoreva sayogājjñānamupajāyate tṛtīyasya grāhyasya grāhakasya tatrābhāvāt
evam saṃśayādividutpādaḥ ityādinā arthavyatireke jñānavyatirekābhāvaṃ pratipādya sāmpratam arthānvayagrahaṇābhāvaṃ darśayitumāha–prāg ityādi
prāk pūrva vijñānotpatteḥ arthamanavabuddhyamānā naiyāyikādayaḥ kāraṇamakāraṇameva vārthaṃ vijñānotpatteḥ katham na kathañcid brūyuḥ
etaduktaṃ bhavati–yathā agnidarśanānantaraṃ dhūmadarśanaṃ tathā yadi arthadarśanānantaraṃ jñānadarśanaṃ syāt tadā syādarthakāryaṃ tat, na caivamasti
nanu tadutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ grāhakābhāvānna tatra kāraṇākāraṇavibhāgapratipattiḥ tadutpattau tu bhaviṣyati, ityatrāha–utpannam ityādi
utpannaṃ labdhātmalābhaṃ hi sphuṭaṃ vijñānam arthasya paricchedakaṃ na tatkāraṇatāyāḥ
na kevalam arthādiḥ, kintu āloko'pi na kāraṇam vijñānotpatteḥ iti sambandhaḥ
nanu yadyālokaḥ tadutpatteḥ kāraṇaṃ na syāttarhi tadabhāve'pi rūpajñānotpattiḥ kuto na syādityāśaṅkyāha–
ālokakā raṇatāvādī bauddha, tathā ca tadgrantha–yathā indriyālokamanaskārāḥ ātmendriyamanaskārā vā rūpajñānameka janayanti –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ 1
tamo nirodhi vīkṣante tamasā nāvṛtaṃ param
asminnarthe dṛṣṭāntamāha–iva yathā kuḍyādikamīkṣante īkṣakā kuḍyāditirohita punarghaṭādika nekṣante tathā tamo vīkṣante tadāvṛta tu para nekṣante iti
anyatra vijñānābhāvaheturiti cet; āloko'pi tamovijñānābhāvahetutvāt tamovadabhāvahetuḥ syāt
tamaḥ andhakāraṃ vīkṣante viśeṣeṇa avādhyamānatayā prasphuṭarūpatayā vā īkṣante paśyanti janāḥ

tathā ca ālokābhāve'pyupajāyamānaṃ tajjñānaṃ kathaṃ tatkāryaṃ syāt ? yadabhāve'pi yadupajāyate na tat tatkāryam yathā cakṣuṣo'bhāve'pyupajāyamānaṃ rasajñānaṃ na tatkāryam, ālokābhāve'pyupajāyate ca andhakārarūpādijñānamiti
atha matam–ālokasya tajjñānāhetutve tamasi sthitānāṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syāt, tadayuktam, tasya tannirodhitvāt
tamasā andhakāreṇa āvṛtaṃ pracchāditaṃ paraṃ ghaṭādikaṃ na īkṣante
kathambhūtam ? kuḍyāditirohitaṃ pareṇa kuḍyādinā vyavahitaṃ tathā prakṛtamiti
jñānānutpattivyatirekeṇanāsti tamo'rthāntaramiti śālikanāthasya, tejo'māvarūpa eva tama iti yaugasya ca pūrvapakṣa–

nanu jñānānutpattivyatirekeṇa aparasya tamaso'saṃbhavāt kasya tannirodhitvaṃ syāt ? nahi asat kasyacinnirodhakannāma aśvaviṣāṇāderapi tatprasaṅgāt ? na ca tadanutpattivyatirekeṇa anyasyāsya asaṃbhavo'siddhaḥ, sāloke'pi garbhagṛhādipradeśe bahirdeśādāgatasya pratipattuḥ asatyapyandhakāre jñānānutpattau tamaḥpratītyupalabdheḥ
dravyāntaratve tvasya cakṣuṣaḥ tatprakāśane ālokānapekṣā na syāt
ālokameva hi cakṣuḥ ālokanirapekṣaṃ prakāśayati na dravyāntaram
asti cāsyāḥ tathābhūtāyāḥ pratītiḥ tato bījādaṭkuravat tato'sau dravyāntaraṃ siddhā
tathābhūtā cāsau siddhyantī tamaso dravyāntaratvaṃ sādhayatīti, tadasamīcīnam; ālokābhāvarūpatayā asyā dravyāntaratvāsaṃbhave'pi vibhramavaśāt tatra tatpratīterupapatteḥ

tathāhi–yena yena pradeśāntareṇa chatrādyāvārakadravyapratibaddhaṃ tejo na saṃyujyate tatra tatra chāyā pratīyate, pratibandhakasya ātapatrāderapāye tu svarūpeṇa ālokaḥ pratīyate, ityālokābhāva eva chāyā
dravyāntaratve tu tasyāstadapāye'pi ālokena sahāvasthitāyāḥ pratītiḥ syāt
na hi jātu kiñciddravyaṃ dravyāntareṇa sahānavasthāyi pratītam
katha punarguṇo na kasyacit ? satyam, guṇa evāyamaprasiddha
siddhyedyadi prasiddhireva siddhyet, sā tu kāraṇābhāvānna siddhā
nanu cakṣureva kāraṇam, na, ālokopakārānapekṣasya cakṣuṣo'prakāśakatvāt, tena apratītāvevāya pratītibhramo mandānām
ata eva divānupalambha, anyathā saurībhi bhābhiranugṛhīta cakṣuḥ sphuṭatara vyomni nīlimāna prakāśayet
tamaso niṣpattyanavakḷpte, rūpavattvena hi tamo dravya syāt, taccānekadravyārabdha saccākṣuṣa bhaveta
na ca dravyāṇi santi, santi ceddivāpyārabheran
tamo nāma dravyāntara na bhavati, andhānāmiva kevala nīlimābhimāna
truṭitāyā pū॰ pratau tamaso'dravyā– ayameva pāṭho bhāti
yaccedamucyate chāyaiva tama sā calatvācalatvamahattvāmahattvadūratvāsannatvādiguṇayoginī vastubhūteti; tadidamapyasāram; anavakḷptereva

etena chāyā dravyāntaraṃ deśāddeśāntaraprāptimattvena kriyāvattvāt ityetat pratyākhyātam; tathāhi–yatra yatra ātapatrādyāvārakadravyeṇa tejasaḥ sannikarṣaḥ pratiṣidhyate tatra tatra anyā'nyā chāyopalabhyate, na punaḥ pūrvadeśopalabdhā anyatra deśe, iti āvārakadravyagataṃ karma tatrādhyāropya pratipattā chāyā gacchati iti pratipadyate, yathā aśvādyārūḍhaḥ svagataṃ karma vṛkṣe'dhyāropya vṛkṣaḥ āgacchati iti
deśāntaraprāptiścāsyāḥ deśāntareṇa saṃyogaḥ, samavāyo vā ? yadi saṃyogaḥ, anyonyāśrayaḥ–taddravyatvasiddhau hi saṃyogasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca taddravyatvasiddhiriti
atha samavāyaḥ, tadapyanupapannam, ekatra samavetasya dravyasya anyatra samavāyā'saṃbhavāditi

dravya chāyā gatimattvāditi hetuḥ sādhyenāviśiṣṭasādhya tāvadetat–kiṃ puruṣavacchāyāpi gacchati, āhosvit āvārakadavye sasarpati āvaraṇasantānādasannidhisantāno'ya tejaso gṛhyate iti ? sarpatā khalu dravyeṇa yastejobhāga āvriyate tasya tasyāsannidhirevāvacchinno gṛhyate iti
ābārake dravye prasarpati tejaso'sannidhiviśiṣṭa dravyaṃ yadupalabhyate tattu chāyetyucyate
api ca tadguṇaścākṣuṣo nālokamantareṇa śakyagraha, chāyā tu tamantareṇa gṛhyate tasmistu sati na gṛhyata iti durghaṭam
nāpi dravyam, taddhi pṛthivyādīnāmanyatamameva bhavedanyadvā daśamam
tasmādabhāva eva chāyā na tu satīti siddham
tasmādrūpaviśeṣo'yamatyanta tejo'bhāve sati sarvata samāropitastama iti pratīyate
divā cordhva nayanagolakasya nīlimāvabhāsa iti vakṣyāma
yadā tu niyatadeśādhikaraṇo bhāsāmabhāvastadā taddeśasamāropite nīlimni chāyetyavagama
ata eva dīrghā hrasvā mahatī alpīyasī chāyetyabhimāna taddeśavyāpina nīlimna pratīte
tathāhi–yatra yatra vārakadravyeṇa tejasa sannidhirniṣidhyate tatra tatra chāyeti vyavahāra
vārakadravyagatāñca kriyām ātapābhāve samāropya pratipadyate chāyā gacchatīti, anyathā vārakadravyagata kriyāpekṣitvaṃ na syāt
yattu teja pratirodhi dravya tadyathā yathā sañcarati tathā tathā''loka pratimucyate pratirudhyate ceti calatīva chāyā pratibhāti, anyathā śarīre'pi calati kimiti chāyā'pi calet hetvabhāvāt
yacceda deśāntaraprāptimattva tatki deśāntareṇa sayoga, tasyāpi sādhyatvāt
tathāhi–dravyatvasiddhau sayoga siddhyati, sayogāt dravyatvamiti itaretarāśrayatva syāt
na ca kriyāvattva deśāntarasamavāyāt siddhyati tasyāpyayutasiddheṣveva bhāvāditi
yattāvaduktam–jñānānutpattivyatirekeṇa nāparaṃ tamaḥ ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, pratītivirodhāt
suprasiddhā hi ālokatamasoḥ svasvarūpeṇa anyonyavilakṣaṇayoḥ pratiprāṇi pratyakṣato vilakṣaṇā pratītiḥ
na ca viṣayavailakṣaṇyavyatirekeṇa pratītervailakṣaṇyaṃ yuktam, puruṣādyadvaitasiddhiprasaṅgato bhedavādocchedaprasakteḥ
bhāvābhāvarūpaviṣayavailakṣaṇyapūrvakatvena ālokatamaḥpratīteriṣṭatvāt siddhasādhyatā, ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, tamaso rūpādimattvena ālokavad abhāvarūpatvānupatteḥ
yo'bhāvo nāsau rūpādimān yathā ghaṭādyabhāvaḥ, ālokābhāvarūpatayeṣṭañca tama iti
na cāsya rūpādimattvamasiddham, ālokavat tatrāpi tatsadbhāvapratīteḥ
yathaiva hi āloke bhāsuraṃ rūpam uṣṇasparśaśca loke prasiddhaḥ tathā chāyāditamasi kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ śītasparśa iti
tato dravyaṃ tamaḥ guṇavattvāt, yad yad guṇavat tattad dravyam yathā ālokādi, guṇavacca tama iti
na kevalaṃ chāyāderloka eva guṇavattvaṃ prasiddham, api tu vaidyakaśāstre'pi
tulanā–ata eva nālokajñānābhāva; abhāvasya pratiyogigrāhakendriyagrāhyatvaniyamena mānasatvaprasaṅgāt
jainā hi tamaḥ pudgaladravyātmaka svīkurvanti, tathāhi–goyamā diyā subhā poggalā subhe poggalapariṇāme, rātiṃ asubhā poggalā asubha poggalapariṇāme
saddo bandho suhumo thūlo saṭhāṇa bheda tama chāyā
anyānyapi tamaso dravyarūpatāmurarīkurvanti matāntarāṇi–tamodarśana tu bhūcchāyādarśanam
katamatpunardravyādīnā tama ? nanu dravyameva kālimaguṇaśālitvāt spandavattvācca
evaṃ saṃkhyāpyekatvādikā, parimāṇa taccaturvidha pṛthivyādyaṇūnāmiva tamo'ṇūnāmapyanumānāt, pṛthaktvasayogavibhāgaparatvāparatvasaskārāśca
na ca pṛthivyādīmanānyatamamtasmātpratyakṣasiddhamasati bādhake dravyāntaramekādaśa tamo navaguṇa ceti siddham
kimida tamo nāma ? dravyaguṇakarmaniṣpattivaidharmyād bhābhāvastama iti kāśyapīyāḥ, tathā tu nīlabuddhirnirnimittā syāt abhāvasya nīlimābhāvāt
na cāsato nīlimna kiñcid grāhaka smāraka vā'sti
ālokādarśanamātreṇa tu tadbhramo bhavastacchūnyabhāge'pi syāt, ato dravyāntaramida vāyubannīlimaguṇam, vāyusvarūpa sparśavān idañcā'sparśaṃ rūpavadityetāvānviśeṣa

athavā, ya ete pārthivāstrasareṇavo vātāyanavivareṣu dṛśyamānā sarvato bhramanti teṣā ye nīlaguṇakā tadgatamida nīlarūpa gṛhyamāṇa guṇāntarāṇā dravyāntarāṇāñca tadantarālasya ca agrahaṇād vyāptākhilabrahmāṇḍavaccakāsti
kaṣāyamadhurā jyotsnā sarvavyādhiharaṃ karaṃ tamaḥ || rājani॰
tathāhi– rasanendriyavyāpārād yathā kṣīrādiṣu mādhuryapratipattiḥ na tathā chāyāyām

tasmāt madhurādidravyaniṣevaṇād yau guṇadoṣau dṛṣṭau chāyāniṣevaṇādapi tāveva iti vaidyakaśāstratātparyam, ato'siddhaṃ guṇavattvaṃ chāyādeḥ, ityapyanalpatamovilasitam, tatrāsya abādhabodhādhirūḍhapratibhāsatayā aupacārikatvānupapatteḥ
yadyatra abādhabodhādhirūḍhatayā pratibhāsate na tattatraupacārikam yathā tejasi bhāsuratvādi, abādhabodhādhirūḍhatayā pratibhāsate ca chāyādyandhakāre śītalatvādiguṇasadbhāva iti
tathāvidhasyāpyasya atraupacārikatve jyosnā''tapayorapi mukhyato guṇasiddhirmā bhūt, kaṭukatvādiguṇānāṃ tatrāpyaupacārikatvaprasaṅgāt, prāguktavaidyakagranthaprakriyāyāḥ tatrāpi kalpayituṃ suśakatvāt
tataḥ pratītiṃ pramāṇayatā jyotsnādivat chāyādyandhakāre'pi anupacaritaguṇasadbhāvasiddhirabhyupagantavyā, iti siddhamasya guṇavattvād dravyatvam
yaccedamāgamāt mādhuryaṃ śaitya vā chāyāyā, tadapyupacārāt
ye hi madhuradravyasya śītadravyasya vā guṇā te chāyāsasevanād bhavantīti tatkāryakartṛtvena tathokta
tulanā–na ca tamasa paudagalikatvamasiddham, cākṣuṣatvā'nyathānupapatte pradīpālokavat
na ca rūpavattvamasiddham, andhakāra kṛṣṇo'yamiti kṛṣṇākārapratibhāsāt

yadapyuktam–asatyapi andhakāre garbhagṛhādau jñānānutpattau tamaḥ pratīyate ityādi, tatrāpi sarvathā jñānānutpattistatpratītihetuḥ, tadantarvarttipadārtheṣu vā ? prathamapakṣe svavacanavirodhaḥ mātā me vandhyā ityādivat
na khalu sarvathā jñānānutpattiṃ vadataḥ tamaḥpratītiraviruddhā, tatpratītau vā sarvathā jñānānutpattiriti
dvitīyapakṣe tu pracuratarālokopahatadṛṣṭiḥ pratipattā tatrasthānarthān yathāvatpratipattumasamarthaḥ jalarūpatayā marīcikācakramiva ālokameva tamorūpatayā pratipadyate
na ca mithyātamaḥpratibhāsena amithyātamaḥpratibhāsasya sāmyamāpādayituṃ yuktam, satyajalādipratibhāsasyāpi asatyajalādipratibhāsena sāmyāpādanaprasaṅgato vastuvyavasthābhāvaprasaṅgāt
tulanā–kiṃ punarandhakārāvasthāyā jñāna nāsti ? tathā cet, kathamandhakārapratīti tadantareṇāpi pratītau anyatrāpi jñānakalpanānarthakyam
pratīyate jñānaṃ nāstīti ca svavacanavirodha pratītereva jñānatvāt
kiñca, jñānānutpattivyatirekeṇa aparasya tamaso'nabhyupagame viśadajñānotpattivyatirekeṇa anyasya ālokasyāpi abhyupagamo mā bhūt
asatyapi hi āloke bahalāndhakāraniśīthinīsamaye naktañcarāṇām añjanābhisaṃskṛtacakṣupāñca prasphuṭajñānotpattau saprakāśaṃ sakalaṃ vastu prakāśate
yathaiva hi madhyāhne atitīvrāloke bahirgantumasamarthāḥ iti laukikī pratītiḥ tathā bahalāndhakārāyāṃ rātrau bahirgantuṃ trastāḥ ityapi
tato nirbādhabodhādhirūḍhapratibhāsatvena ālokadravyasya vāstavatvābhyupagame tamodravyasyāpi tadabhyupagantavyaṃ viśeṣābhāvāt
na ca gatimattvamasiddham; vegena chāyā gacchati śanaiśchāyā gacchati iti pratiprāṇi prasiddhapratītitaḥ tasyāḥ tatprasiddheḥ
tulanā– tamastāvatpudgalapariṇāma dṛṣṭipratibandhakāritvāt kuḍyādivat, āvārakatvāt paṭādivat
yadapyabhihitam–deśāntaraprāptiḥ deśāntareṇa saṃyogaḥ samavāyo vā ityādi; tatra deśāntareṇa asyāḥ prāptiḥ sambandho'bhipretaḥ, sa ca saṃyoga eva paryavasyati
deśāntaraprāptito hi tasyā gatimattvaṃ prasādhyate, tasmācca dravyatvamiti
na caivaṃ cakrakaprasaktirityabhidhātavyam; tatprāpteḥ pratyakṣata eva prasiddhasvarūpatvāt
yadi hi dravyatvasiddhyā tatprāptiḥ prasādhyeta tataśca gatimattvaṃ tadā syāccakrakam
kathamanyathā gatimān ādityo deśāntaraptāptiprāptimattvāt ityādāvapi itaretarāśrayādidoṣānuṣaṅgo na syāt ?
na hi deśāntaraprāptimattvād dravyatva prasādhayitumudyatā sma, kintu gatimattva tasmāttu dravyatvamiti
tathāhi–deśāntarasayogāt kriyāvattvam, kriyāvattvāt dravyatvam, dravyatvāt deśāntarasayogavattvamiti; utsvapnāyitametat, deśāntaraprāpte pratyakṣa eva chāyāyā prasiddhasvarūpatvāt
yadi hi dravyatvasiddhyā deśāntaraprāpti prasādhyena tadā syāttaddūpaṇam
pratyakṣeṇeti siddhena deśāntaraprāptimattvena siddhāt kriyāvattvātsiddha chāyāyā dravyatvam
yaccānyaduktam–āvārakadravyagataṃ karma chāyāyāmadhyāropya chāyā gacchati iti pratipadyate ityādi, tadapyapeśalam, chāyāyā asattve tatra āvārakadravyagatāyā gaterāropānupapatteḥ
satyeva hi vṛkṣādau aśvādyārūḍha puruṣaḥ svagata karma tatra adhyāropayati nāsati iti, ataḥ tadadhyāropānyathānupapatteḥ chāyāyā vāstava sattva siddham
prayogaḥ– chāyā paramārthasatī adhyāropyamāṇagatitvāt, yad adhyāropyamāṇagati tat paramārthasat yathā vṛkṣādi, adhyāropyamāṇagatiśca chāyā iti

nanu siddhasyāpi dravyāntarabhūtasya tamasaḥ cakṣurjñānapratibandhakatvādayuktamuktam– tamo nirodhi vīkṣante ityādi, tadasāpratam, yataḥ tatkiṃ svātmani tatpratibandhakam, anyatra vā ? tatrādyapakṣe–nahi ityādinā dūṣaṇamāha–nahi naiva tamaḥ cakṣurjñānapratiṣedhakaṃ svātmani ityadhyāhāraḥ
tamovijñānābhāvaprasaṅgāt, asti ca tajjñānam, ato na tat tatpratiṣedhakam
prayogaḥ–yad yajjñānasya viṣayo na tat svātmani tajjñānasya pratiṣadhakam yathā kāṇḍapaṭādi, cakṣurjñānasya viṣayaśca tama iti
atha anyatra ghaṭādau na svātmani, tat tadvijñānābhāvaheturiti cet; tarhi āloko'pi tamovijñānābhāvahetutvāt tamovadabhāvahetuḥ syāt
cakṣurvijñānasya abhāvaḥ anutpattiḥ utpannasya vā pradhvaṃsaḥ, tasya hetuḥ kāraṇaṃ syād bhavet
tathā ca taijasa cakṣū rūpādīnā madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvād ālokavat ityatra prayoge sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ
atha ālokaḥ tamovijñānābhāvahetuḥ svarūpa–ghaṭādiviṣayajñānahetuśceṣyate, tarhi tamo'pi ghaṭādiviṣayajñānā'hetuḥ svaviṣayavijñānahetuśceṣyatāmaviśeṣāt
atha āloke satyeva keṣāñcid rūpajñānotpatteḥ tadabhāve cānutpatteḥ asau taddhetuḥ, tarhi tamaso'pyabhāve keṣāñcittajjñānānutpatteḥ tasmin satyeva utpatteḥ tadapi taddhetuḥ syāt
tathā ca rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpādīnāṃ prakāśakatvāt ityayaṃ hetuḥ tamasā'naikāntikaḥ, tasyā'taijasatve'pi rūpaprakāśakatvāt
tulanā–pradīpasya ca ghaṭarūpavyavadhāyakatamo'panetṛtve 'taijasaṃ cakṣū rūpādīnāṃ madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt pradīpavaditi sādhanavikalatvāt dṛṣṭāntasya nirastaṃ draṣṭavyam
āloko hi na tamaso rūpasya prakāśaka ata sa rūpādīnā madhye rūpasyaiva prakāśakatvāt iti sādhanaśūnya
arvāgbhāgaṃ paśyatītyevaṃ śīlasya taddarśinaḥ parabhāgaparicchedābhāvāt tasyāpi arvāgbhāgasyāpi na kevalaṃ tamasa eva jñānanirodhitvaṃ syāt, prakramāt cakṣurjñānanirodhitvaṃ syāt iti manyate
tathā ca tadvad arvāgbhāgasyāpyadarśanaprasaṅgād asarvadarśino'ndhataiva syāt
yaccakṣurjñānanirodhi na tat tajjñānagrāhyam yathā tamaḥ, cakṣurjñānanirodhī ca arvāgbhāga iti
nanu mā bhūt tama āvaraṇaṃ timirādi tu bhaviṣyati ityatrāha–pratyartham ityādi
arthamarthaṃ prati pratyartham, āvaraṇasya jñānāvaraṇīyakarmaṇo yo viccheda abhāvaḥ tadapekṣayā jñānasya paricchedakatvāt arthagrāhakatvāt kāraṇāt nāvaraṇaṃ jñānasya pracchādakam
jñānāvaraṇīyaṃ karmaiva hi niyamena tatpracchādakam, tasmin sati jñānasya arthaparicchedakatvābhāvāt, na timirādi tasmin satyapi satyasvapne rūpadarśanasadbhāvāt
prayogaḥ– yatparicchedyaṃ na tad āvaraṇam yathā arthaḥ, paricchedyañca timirādi iti

nanu timirādīnāmanāvaraṇatve yadvijñānaṃ svaviṣaye viparyastaṃ tatsāvaraṇam yathā cakṣurvijñānaṃ dvicandrādigocaram, tathāvidhañca mithyādṛśāṃ jñānam ityācāryīyaṃ vacaḥ svābhyupagamaviruddhaṃ syāditi cet, na, anyathābhiprāyāt
tamastimirādi vā adṛṣṭakāraṇanirapekṣamāvaraṇaṃ na bhavati, tatsāpekṣaṃ tu bhavatyeva ityayamācāryasyāmiprāyaḥ
nanu ca ātmano jñānasvabhāvatayā savartra sarvadā sarvathā sarvārthagrahaṇasvabhāvatvena aśeṣajñatvaprasaṅgānna kiñcidāvaraṇakalpanayā ityāśaṅkāpanodārthamāha–
kā ? malaviddhamaṇivyakti malai kālimarekhādibhi viddha sa cāsau maṇiśca padmarāgādi tasya vyakti teja prādurbhāvaḥ
katham ? anekaprakārata aneke bahavaḥ prakārā viśadāviśadadūrādūraprakāśyaprakāśanaviśeṣāḥ tānāśritya
kā ? karmaviddhātmavijñapti karmāṇi jñānāvaraṇādīni tairāviddha sambaddhaḥ sa cāsāvātmā ca tasya vijñaptirarthopalabdhi
katham ? anekaprakārata aneke nānārūpā pratyakṣetaradūrāsannārthapratibhāsanaviśeṣā kṣayopaśamaviśeṣāśca tānāśrityetyartha
tadāvaraṇaviśeṣanirāse tu sakalārthavijñaptirātmana upapadyate eva jñānasvabhāvatvāttasyeti
vivṛtiḥ–yathāsvaṃ karmakṣayopaśamāpekṣiṇī karaṇamanasī nimittaṃ vijñānasya na bahirarthādayaḥ
nānanukṛtānvayavyatirekaṃ kāraṇaṃ nākāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ iti bāliśagītam; tāmasakhagakulānāṃ tamasi sati rūpadarśanam āvaraṇavicchedāt, tadavicchedāt āloke satyapi saṃśayādijñānasaṃbhavāt
mumūrṣūṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavam arthe satyapi viparītapratipattisadbhāvāt nārthādayaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñānasya iti sthitam
malairviddhaḥ sambaddho yo maṇiḥ tasya vyaktiḥ āvirbhāvo yathā yena viśrasopayogaprakāreṇa anekaprakārataḥ viśedataraprakāram ekadeśasākalyaprakāraṃ nikaṭadūradeśavartisvaprakāśyaprakāśanaprakāram

anyaṃ vā viṣayāpahārādilakṣaṇamāśritya, tathā tena prakāreṇa karmabhiḥ jñānāvaraṇīyādibhiḥ viddhasya pracchāditasya ātmano jīvasya vijñaptiḥ arthaprakāśakatvalakṣaṇā anekaprakārataḥ indriyā'nindriyā'tīndriyaprakāram sakalavikalasannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭārthaprakāśanaprakāram svapararūpodyotanaprakāram pratyakṣetaratvaprakāraṃ vā āśritya bhavati

nanu pūrvottarajñānakṣaṇavyatiriktaḥ, kāyākārapariṇatabhūtacatuṣṭayavyatirikto vā na kaścidātmā'sti tatkasya anekaprakārato vijñaptiḥ syāditi saugata-cārvākau, tau ca pratipāditavismaraṇaśīlau, santānaniṣedhāvasare hi pūrvottarajñānakṣaṇavyatiriktaḥ anādinidhanaḥ pratipāditaḥ pramātā, cārvākamataparīkṣāyāñca kāyākārapariṇatabhūtacatuṣṭayavyatiriktaḥ ityalamatiprasaṅgena
yasya jñānasya yad āvārakaṃ svam ātmīyaṃ karma tasyānatikrameṇa yathāsvam
karmakṣayopaśamāvapekṣete ityevaṃ śīle tadapekṣiṇī karaṇamanasī indriyānindriye nimittaṃ vijñānasya, na bahirarthādayaḥ, etaccānantarameva prapañcitam
dṛṣṭe ca karaṇamanasī svāvaraṇarajonīhārādikṣayopaśamāpekṣiṇī pādapādivijñānasya nimittam
nānanukṛta ityādinā paramatamāśaṅkate–kāryeṇa ananukṛtāvanvayavyatirekau yasya tat tathāvidhaṃ na kāraṇam api tu anukṛtānvayavyatirekameva kāraṇam
yacca akāraṇaṃ tanna viṣayo jñānasya, iti śabdaḥ paramataparisamāptau
kuta etadityāha–tāmasakhagakulānāṃ tamasi sati rūpadarśanam āvaraṇavicchedāt, nālokāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
tathā tadavicchedāt tasya āvaraṇasya vicchedābhāvāt hetoḥ āloke satyapi saṃśayādijñānasaṃbhavāt
kācaḥ cakṣuṣo vyādhiviśeṣaḥ ādiryasya timirādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tena upahatāni indriyāṇi yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ śukle śaṅkhādau pītādyākārajñānotpatteḥ satyapi āloke bāliśagītam iti sambandhaḥ
tathā mumūrṣūṇāṃ prāṇināṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ saṃbhavānatikrameṇa arthe satyapi viparītapratipattisadbhāvāt kāraṇāt na arthādayaḥ ādiśabdena ālokādiparigrahaḥ, kāraṇaṃ vijñānasya iti sthitam
na tajjanma na tādrūpyaṃ na tadvyavasitiḥ saha
kinta ityāha–tajjanma tasmādarthājjanma utpatti, tasya karaṇagrāmeṇa vyabhicārāt
na ca tādrūpya tasyārthasya rūpamiva rūpamākāro yasya tattadrūpa tasya bhāvastādrūpyam, tasya samānārthasamanantarajñānena vyabhicārāt
nāpi tadvyavasiti tatrārthe vyavasitirvyavasāyo niścaya, tasya dvicandrādivyavasāyena vyabhicārāt
saha militvā vā tāni prāmāṇyahetutā na bhajanti
tattritayasyāpi śukle śakhe pītākārajñānajanakena samanantarapratyayena vyabhicārāt
tajjanmāditrayasya prāmāṇyahetutānirūpakā bauddhagranthā–viṣayākāra evāsya pramāṇa tena mīyate
bhinnakālaṃ katha grāhyamiti ced grāhyatā vidu
tadākaraṃ hi savedanamarthaṃ vyavasthāpayati nīlamiti pītañceti
kimarthaṃ tarhi sārūpyamiṣyate pramāṇam ? kriyākarmavyavasthāyāstalloke syānnibandhanamsārūpyato'nyathā na bhavati nīlasya karmaṇa savitti pītasya veti kriyākarmapratiniyamārthamiṣyate
pratyekaṃ vā bhajantīha prāmāṇyaṃ prati hetutām || 58
vivṛtiḥ–nārthaḥ kāraṇaṃ vijñānasya kāryakālamaprāpya nivṛtteḥ atītatamavat
na jñānaṃ tatkāryaṃ tadabhāva eva bhāvāt tadbhāve cābhāvāt bhaviṣyattamavat
mūrttā eva hi darpaṇādayaḥ mūrttamukhādipratibimbadhāriṇo dṛṣṭāḥ, nāmūrttaṃ mūrttapratibimbabhṛt, amūrttaṃ ca jñānaṃ mūrttidharmābhāvāt
nahi jñāne artho'sti tadātmako vā yena tasmin pratibhāsamāne pratibhāseta śabdavat
kathametadavidyamānaṃ tritayaṃ jñānaprāmāṇyaṃ prati upakārakaṃ syāt lakṣaṇatvena ?
tulanā–yathaivākṣaviṣaye'bhidhānaṃ nāsti tathā'kṣajñāne viṣayo'pi naivāsti tatastatra pratibhāsamāne'pi na pratibhāseta
tasmād arthāt janma tajjanma na jñānasya prāmāṇyaṃ prati hetutāṃ bhajantītīhaloke, na tādrūpyaṃ tasya arthasya rūpamiva rūpaṃ yasya tasya bhāva tādrūpyaṃ na tatprati tāṃ bhajati iti sambandhaḥ
na tadvyavasitiḥ tasya arthasya vyavasitiḥ nirṇītiḥ na tatprati tāṃ bhajatīti, saha yugapat pratyekaṃ vā ekamekaṃ vā ekamekaṃ prati pratyekam, vā iti samuccaye
tatra na tāvat pratyekam; tajjanmanaḥ karaṇagrāmeṇa vyabhicārāt, tādrūpyasya samānārthasamanantarajñānena, tadvyavasiteḥ dvicandrādhyavasāyena
nāpi saha, śukle śaṅkhe pītabhrāntikāraṇena pītajñānena anekāntāt
tru॰ pū॰ pratau bhajatīha ityeva pāṭha
tajjanma iti kartranurodhāt bhajatīti pāṭha eva samucita
tajjanmādaya pratyeka prāmāṇya prati hetutā na bhajanti
yaccārthasārūpyamanubhavanibandhanamukta tadapyasambhavi iti darśayannāha–sarūpayanti tatkena sthūlābhāsañca te'ṇava
tataśca tatmavedanabhāvasya arthasavedanatvasya prasādhaneṣu sā'rtharūpatā na samarthā
kiṃ tarhi ? sārūpyatadutpattibhyā te ca dvicandrajñānādīnā na staḥ candradvayasyābhāvāt tadutpatterayogāt
tena grāhyeṇa sārūpya tasmādutpatti svasavedyasya lakṣaṇa yadi sammatam, tadāpi samanantara jñānamuttarajñānena samānārthaṃ samānagrāhya savedya syāt tatsarūpatadutpattyo sabhavāt
kiñca yadākāra yataśca saṃvedanamutpadyate yadi tadālambana tarhi dhārāvāhikavijñānānā pūrvapūrvamālambanamuttarottarasya syāt utpādakatvāt sarūpatvācca –bṛhatīpa॰ pṛ॰ 79
tatpuna tajjanmasārūpyādilakṣaṇa samānārthanānaikasantāneṣu sabhavāt vyabhicarati tadadhyavasāyahetutvañca
na kevala viṣayavalād dṛṣṭerutpattirapi tu cakṣurādiśakteśca

viṣayākārānukaraṇāddarśanasya tatra viṣaya pratibhāsate na puna karaṇam tadākārānukaraṇāditi cettarhi tadarthavatkaraṇamanukarttumarhati na cārthaṃ viśeṣābhāvāt, darśanasya tajjanmarūpāviśeṣe'pi tadadhyavasāryānayamād vahirarthaviṣayatvamityasāram; varṇādāviva upādāne'pyadhyavasāyaprasaṅgāt
api ca vyaste samaste vaite grahaṇakāraṇa syātām ? yadi vyaste; tadā kapālādyakṣaṇo ghaṭāntyakṣaṇasya jalacandro vā nabhaścandrasya grāhaka prāpnoti tadutpattestadākāratvācca
atha samaste, tarhi ghaṭottarakṣaṇa pūrvaghaṭakṣaṇasya grāhakaḥ prasajati
jñānarūpatve satyete grahaṇakāraṇamiti cet, tarhi samānajātīyajñānasya samantarapūrvajñānagrāhakatva prasajyeta
tajjanmādaya saha militvā'pi prāmāṇyaṃ prati hetutā na bhajanti
etattritayamasaṃbhavadoṣeṇa dūṣayan kārikāṃ vyācaṣṭe nārthaḥ ityādinā

prayogaḥ–anantarātīto'rthaḥ na jñānakāraṇam, tatkāle sarvathā'vidyamānatvāt, yasya tatkāle sarvathā'vidyamānatvaṃ nāsau tatkāraṇam yathā atītatamo'rthaḥ, tatkāle sarvathā'vidyamānaśca anantarātīto'rthaḥ iti
yathā ca artho na tajjñānakāraṇaṃ tathā na tajjñānaṃ tatkāryam
tasya paraparikalpitasya arthasya abhāve eva bhāvāt utpatteḥ tajjñānasya tadbhāve ca abhāvād anutpatteḥ, anyathā santānocchedaḥ syāt
niṣiddhā ca arthakāryatā jñānasya prapañcataḥ prāg ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena

yadi kāraṇabhūtasya aryasya kāle eva kāryabhūta jñāna samutpadyeta tadā kāryakāraṇayo samakālatvāpattyā kāraṇabhūtasyārthasyāpi svakāraṇakālatā tasyāpi svakāraṇakālatetyeva sakalottarakṣaṇānāmādyakṣaṇavṛttitā dvitīye ca kṣaṇe nāśa iti sakalasantānocchedaprasaṅgaḥ iti bhāva
tulanā–satyeva kāraṇe yadi kāryaṃ trailokyamekakṣaṇavarti syāt, kāraṇakṣaṇakāla eva sarvasya uttarottarakṣaṇasantānasya bhāvāt tata santānābhāvāt
nanu amūrttañca syāt tadbhṛcca, ko virodhaḥ ? iti cedatrāha–mūrttā eva ityādi
mūrttā eva hiryasmāt darpaṇādayo mūrttamukhādipratibimbadhāriṇo dṛṣṭāḥ
amūrttamapi kiñcit dṛṣṭam iti cedatrāha–'nā'mūrttaṃ mūrttapratibimbabhṛd dṛṣṭamiti
prayogaḥ–jñānaṃ nārthapratibimbabhṛt, amūrttatvāt, yat punararthapratibimbabhṛt tannāmūrttam yathā darṣaṇādi, amūrttañca jñānamiti
taddharmo hi rūparasagandhasparśavattve sati acetanatvam, naca jñāne tadasti
nirākṛtañcāsya vyāsataḥ sārūpyaṃ tannirākāratvasiddhipraghaṭṭake iti kṛtaṃ prayāsena
hiryasmāt na jñāne adhikaraṇabhūte artho ghaṭādiḥ asti, kintu bahiḥ so'sti, tadātmako vā jñānasvabhāvo vā arthaḥ iti sambandha, sārūpyaniṣedhāt, anyatra tatpratibhāsanāt iti manyate
yena tatra sattvena tadātmakatvena vā tasmin vijñāne pratibhāsamāne pratibhāseta, arthaḥ iti ghaṭanā
ka iva sa tatra nāsti tadātmako vā na iti cedatrāha–śabdavat, śabda iva tadvaditi
yato jñānasvarūpe pratibhāsamāne'pi tadādheya-tadātmakatayā śabdārthayoḥ pratibhāso nāsti tataḥ tasyārthasya adhyavasāyo na syāt
adhyavasāyo hi abhilāpavatī pratītiḥ, na cāsau tayorananubhave ghaṭate atiprasaṅgāt
vistarataśca avikalpakāt tadadhyavasāyapratiṣedhaḥ savikalpakasiddhau prarūpita ityuparamyate
ataḥ siddhaṃ phalaṃ katham ityādinā darśayannāha–etat pareṇoktamavidyamānaṃ tritayaṃ tadutpattisārūpyādhyavasāyalakṣaṇaṃ jñānaprāmāṇyaṃ pratikathamupakārakam ? na kathañcit
kena rūpeṇa upakārakaṃ naitat syāt ? ityāha– lakṣaṇatvena
kimbhūto'pi svahetujanito'pi svasya heturmṛdādisāmagrī tena janito'pi niṣpādito'pi
kiviśiṣṭamapi ? svahetūtthamapi, svasya heturantaraṅga āvaraṇakṣayopaśamalakṣaṇa bahiraṅga punarindriyānindriyarūpa tasmādutthā utpattiryasya tattathokta tādṛśamapītyartha
tataḥ tadutpattimantareṇāpi grāhyagrāhakabhāvasiddhiḥ svabhāvataḥ syāt, anyathā vyavasthābhāvaprasaṅgāt
svena ātmīyena hetunā janito'pyarthaḥ ghaṭādyarthaḥ paricchedyaḥ svataḥ svarūpeṇa tatsvabhāvatayaivāsya svahetorutpatteḥ
nahi jñānena arthastatsvabhāvo janyate, anyonyāśrayānuṣaṅgāt–siddhe hi jñāne tathāvidhārtha siddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca jñānasiddhiriti
yathā yena yogyatāprakāreṇa tathā jñānaṃ svahetūtthaṃ karaṇamanolakṣaṇasvakāraṇaprabhavaṃ paricchedātmakam arthagrahaṇasvabhāvaṃ svato na arthotpattyādeḥ
arthasvabhāvo ā॰, artha svataḥ svabhāvo ba॰
svakāraṇāt na parasparataḥ ātmalābhamāsādayatoreva yathāsaṅkhyena paricchedyaparicchedakabhāvaḥ, na alabdhātmanoḥ sarvathā nityayoḥ kṣaṇikayorvā
yathā svakāraṇād ātmalābhamāsādayatoreva anayoḥ karttṛkarmasvabhāvaḥ naikāntena satoḥ nāpyasatoḥ, tathā prakṛto'pi iti
yata svakāraṇādutpannayoḥ tayoḥ tathābhāvaḥ siddhaḥ tataḥ tasmāt arthād utpattimantareṇāpi arthajñānayoḥ grāhyagrāhakabhāvasiddhiḥ syāt
jñāna ghaṭa jānāti ityatra jñānasya kartṛtā ghaṭasya ca karmatvamiti
nanu siddhe'pi svarūpatastadbhāve tatphalaṃ vaktavyam, tacca adhigatimātram ityeke, svarūpasyaiva adhigatiḥ ityanye, arthasyaiva ityapare ityāśaṅkyāha–
kiṃ svarūpam vyavasāyātmaka viśeṣasya jātyādyākārasya avasāyo niściya sa evātmā svarūpaṃ yasya tattathoktam

puna kiṃviśiṣṭam ? ātmārthagrāhakam, ātmasvarūpamartho bāhyo ghaṭādistau gṛhṇāti nirṇayatītyātmārthagrāhakam anena jñānamarthagrāhakameva na svarūpagrāhakam svagrāhakameva nārthagrāhakamityekāntadvaya nirākṛtam
tena kāraṇena aśnute bhajati kim ? grahaṇaṃ jñāna kartṛ
tadutpattiṃ pratyaṅgatve abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatā na pratiṣedhyā, anyathā vikalpotpattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
sati mukhye nirṇayātmake jñāne sakalavyavahāraniyāmake kathamasaṃvedyamakiñcitkaramanupāyamanupeyaṃ bruvāṇaḥ svasthaḥ ?
vyavasāyaḥ svārthaniścāya ātmā svabhāvo yasya tat tadātmakam vyavasāyaphalātmakamityarthaḥ
anena nirvikalpaka vibhinnā'dhigatimātraphalapramādhakaṃ pramāṇam iti pratyākhyātam
anenāpi cakṣurādikamajñāna pramāṇam iti prativyūḍham, tasya tadātmakatvavirodhāt
prasādhitañca prapañcataḥ pramāṇāt svaparavyavasāyātmakaṃ phalaṃ kathañcidabhinnam pūrvapūrvapramāṇatvaṃ phalaṃ syāduttarottaram laghī॰ kā॰ 7 ityatra
samarthitañca vyāsato jñānasya ātmagrāhakatvaṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhau, arthagrāhakatvañca bāhyārthasiddhau ityalamativistareṇa
yena kāraṇena vyavasāyātmakaṃ jñānam ātmārthagrāhakaṃ tena kāraṇena grahaṇaṃ svārthādhigati nirṇayo mukhyamanupacaritaṃ prāmāṇyamaśnute, na nirvikalpaka cakṣurādi vā
nādhigamo'sti nānubhavosti, kuta etadityāha–vicāryamāṇāyogāt, yasya vicāryamāṇasyāyogo na tasyānubhavo yathā advaitaśūnyāditattvasya, vicāryamāṇasyāyogaśca nirvikalpakadarśanasya iti
yathā cāsya vicāryamāṇasyā'yogaḥ tathā savikalpakasiddhau prapañcataḥ pratipāditam
atha avikalpakasya avisaṃvādakatvāt prāmāṇyaṃ prārthyate, atrāha–avisaṃvāda ityādi
tasya nirṇayasya abhāve kṣaṇakṣayādidarśane marīcikādidarśane vā saṃśayakāriṇi abhāvāda avisaṃvādakatvasya, tadbhāve ca nirṇayasadbhāve ca bhāvād avisaṃvādakatvasya iti
vyavasāyaphalaṃ jñānaṃ mukhyaṃ pramāṇam iti eva vyavasthitamityupasahāraḥ
mābhūnnirvikalpakaṃ svayamavyavasāyātmakatvāt tatphalaṃ tajjanakatvāttu syāt iti cedatrāha–svataḥ ityādi
tasya vikalpasya utpattiṃ pratyaṅgatve svato'vyavasāyasya abhilāpasasaṃrgayogyatā na pratiṣedhyā
abhilapyate'nena abhilapyata iti vā abhilāpaḥ śabdajātyādī tayoḥ saṃsargo vācyavācakabhāvalakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ tasmai yogyaḥ tasya bhāvastattā na pratiṣedhyā
yathaiva hi vikalpasya arthākāraleśadarśanād darśanasya tadākāratā'numīyate tathā tasya abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatādarśanāt darśanasyāpi sā'numīyatāmaviśeṣāt
darśane'saṃbhavinī tasya tadyogyatā bhavati nārthākāra iti kiṃkṛto'yaṃ vibhāgaḥ ? tanniṣedhe anyathā ityādinā dūṣaṇamāha
anyathā tadyogyatāniṣedhaprakāreṇa vikalpotpattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt, sā na niṣedhyā iti sambandhaḥ
nanu vikalpavāsanāta eva vikalpotpattiḥ, darśanaṃ tu kevalaṃ tatprabodhakam tato'yamadoṣaḥ; ityatrāha–sati ityādi
sati vidyamāne mukhye svaparavyavasthāyām anyanirapekṣe nirṇayātmake jñāne
arthānubhavasaṃskāratatprabodhasmaraṇapratyabhijñānatarkānumānapravṛttilakṣaṇaḥ sakalo vyavahāraḥ tanniyāmake bruvāṇaḥ saugataḥ kathaṃ svasthaḥ ? kiṃ bruvāṇa ityāha–jñānam
kathambhūtam ? akiñcitkaraṃ nirvikalpakaṃ asaṃvedya na saṃvedyate ityasaṃvedyam, na vidyate vā saṃvedyaṃ grāhyaṃ yasya, ata eva anupāyamanupeyamiti
pūrvapakṣa– tasmādadhyavasāya kurvadeva pratyakṣa pramāṇa bhavati, akṛte tvadhyavasāye nīlabodharūpatvenāvyavasthāpita bhavati vijñānam
bauddhā hi pratyakṣaṃ nirvikalpakātmakamurarīkurvanti atastaiḥ śabdasaṃsargayogyatā pratyakṣasya niṣidhyate
nirvikalpakaṃ nīlākāraṃ tata utpanne vikalpe nīlākāratvā'nyathānupapatteḥ
nirvikalpake abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatā'sti tata utpanne vikalpe abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatā'nyathānupapatteḥ

yadi darśane'saṃbhavinī abhilāpasaṃsargayogyatā vikalpe ghaṭeta tarhi darśane'saṃbhabannapi nīlākāraḥ vikalpe syāt tathā ca nīlavikalpasya sākṣānnīlasvalakṣaṇaviṣayatāprāpteḥ vikalpo'vastunirbhāsaḥ iti siddhāntavirodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ
tulanā–yathaiva hi varṇādāvabhilāpābhāvaḥ tathā pratyakṣe'pi tasya abhilāpakalpanāto'poḍhatvāt anabhilāpātmakārthasāmarthyenotpatteḥ
pratyakṣasya tadabhāve'pyadhyavasāyakalpanāyāṃ pratyakṣaṃ kinnādhyavasyet svalakṣaṇaṃ svayamabhilāpaśūnyamapi

pratyakṣamadhyavasāyasya heturna punā rūpādiriti kathaṃ sunirūpitābhidhānam ? yadi punaravikalpakādapi pratyakṣādvikalpātmano'dhyavasāyasyotpattiḥ pradīpādeḥ kajjalādivat vijātīyādapi kāraṇāt kāryasyotpattidarśanāditi matam; tadā tādṛśo'rthādvikalpātmanaḥ pratyakṣasyotpattirastu tata eva tadvaditi
jātidravyaguṇakriyāparibhāṣākalpanārahitādarthāt kathaṃ jātyādikalpanātmakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ syāditi cet; pratyakṣāttadrahitādvikalpaḥ kathaṃ jātyādikalpanātmakaḥ syāditi samaḥ paryanuyogaḥ
evaṃ sāmānyena vyavasāyātmakaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ vyavasthāpya, adhunā tadbhedaṃ darśayannāha–
kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ ? paraparikalpitā parai saugatādibhi kalpitā racitāḥ
