vivṛtiḥ–indriyārthajñānaṃ spaṣṭaṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthaṃ prādeśikaṃ pratyakṣam avagrahehāvāyadhāraṇātmakam
tulanā–jñānanibandhanā tu siddhiranuṣṭhānam, heyasya hānamanuṣṭhānamupādeyasya copādānam
hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthaṃ hi pramāṇa tato jñānameva tat
yadvyavasāyātmaka jñānaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratipāditaṃ tat dvidhaiva, naikavidha nāpi tryādividham ityevakārārthaḥ
itiśabdo'tra draṣṭavya, iti evam, na pratyakṣānumānaprakāreṇa
nanu anumānopamānādeḥ tato'rthāntaratvāt kathaṃ dvidhaiva iti niyamaḥ syāt ? ityāha– atra ityādi
atra pratyakṣaparokṣayo anyāsāṃ samīcīnasaṃvidām antarbhāvāt dvidhaiva iti
ataśca na yujyante niyamāḥ paraiḥ saugatādibhiḥ kalpitāḥ
indriyāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ kāryabhūtam arthasya ghaṭāde grāhaka na marīcikātoyādeḥ, jñānaṃ pratyakṣam
nirvikalpakaṃ parokṣaṃ jñānāntarapratyakṣaṃ vā tathā syāt ityatrāha–hita ityādi
hitaṃ sukhaṃ tatsādhanañca ahitaṃ dukhaṃ tatkāraṇañca tayoḥ prāptiparihārau tatra samarthaṃ yogyam
naca nirvikalpakādeḥ tatra sāmarthyam arthamātragrahaṇe'pyasya sāmarthyāsaṃbhavāt ityuktam savikalpakādisiddhipraghaṭṭake
nanu savikalpakapratyakṣeṇa sarvātmanā arthasya gṛhītatvāt tatra pramāṇāntarāpravṛttiḥ syāt ityatrāha–prādeśikam
indriyāṇāṃ kāryam ātmanaḥ saṃvidāṃ svarūpasya jñānaṃ spaṣṭaṃ hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthaṃ prādeśikaṃ pratyakṣam iti
vyākhyātā avagrahādayaḥ pratyakṣaparicchede, te ātmā yasya tat tadātmakam
idānīm anindriya ityādinā'nindriyapratyakṣaṃ darśayati–anindriyasya manasaḥ kāryaṃ jñānam anindriyapratyakṣam
nanu ca indriyajñānamapi anindriyasya bhavatyeva kāryaṃ tatkathamayaṃ pravibhāgaḥ iti cet ? pradhānetarabhāvāt
indriyajñāne hi indriyāṇāṃ pradhānabhāvaḥ, atra tu anindriyasya iti yuktaḥ pravibhāgaḥ

nanu smṛtyādīnāṃ parokṣatayā pūrva pratipāditatvāt kathamatra pratyakṣatayā pratipādanaṃ yuktaṃ pūrvāparavirodhaprasaṅgāt, ityapyacarcitābhidhānam, yatrāṃśe teṣāṃ spaṣṭatvaṃ tatraiva pratyakṣatvapratipādanāt
svarūpe eva hi teṣāṃ spaṣṭatvam atastatraiva pratyakṣatvam ātmajñānam ityabhisambandhāt
bahirarthe tvasya aspaṣṭatvāt parokṣatā iti na kaściddoṣaḥ
atrāpi hita ityādi, prādeśikam iti ca sambadhyate
indriyebhyo'tikrāntam atīndriyaṃ pratyakṣam, kathambhūtam ? vyavasāyātmakam, anena sāṃkhyasautrāntikakalpitaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ tannirastam
sphuṭataram, asmadādipratyakṣāt samaste svagocare atiśayena viśadam
anena bhikṣavo'hamapi māyo pamaḥ svapnopamaḥ iti pratyākhyātam

atīndriyam indriyavyāpārājanyam, kutaḥ ? avyavadhānam deśādivyavadhānarahitaṃ yataḥ, yat svagocare deśādivyavadhānarahita na tad indriyavyāpārajanyam yathā satyasvapnajñānam, svagocare deśādivyavadhānarahitañca atīndriyapratyakṣamiti
tathā ca īśvarajñānam indriyārthasannikarṣajaṃ pratyakṣatve sati jñānatvāt itarajñānavat iti nirastam
lokottaraṃ sakalalokotkṛṣṭamātmārthaviṣayam, ātmaviṣayam ityanena asvasaṃviditamīśvarādhyakṣaṃ nirākṛtam
arthaviṣayam ityanena tu nānyo'nubhāvyo buddhyāsti pramāṇavā॰ 2
nanu vandhyāsutasaubhāgyavyāvarṇanaprakhyametat atīndriyapratyakṣasya sadbhāvāvedakapramāṇābhāvataḥ khapuṣpavadasattvāt ityāśaṅkyāha–tadasti ityādi
tad atīndriyapratyakṣam asti suniścitāsaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇatvāt sukhādivat iti

yathā ca svarūpādanyo buddhyā anubhāvyo nāsti tathā tasya jñānasya cā'paro'nubhavo nāsti

tasmāttajjñānamaparokṣatayā utpanna svaya prakāśate nānyena prakāśyate
sakalaṃ yat pramāṇaṃ yacca prameyaṃ tayoḥ iyattāsvarūpābhidhāyi, anena ca pratyakṣā'numeyā'nyantaparokṣalakṣaṇe sthānatraye'pyasya prāmāṇyaṃ darśayati
tathā ca nirākṛtametat–tṛtīyasthānasaṅkrāntau nyayyaḥ nyāyyaḥ śāstraparigrahaḥ
nahi pramāṇānāṃ sāpatnyanyāyo'sti yena ekaviṣaye dvitīyasyāpravṛttiḥ syāt
atha matam–arthāpattyādeḥ pramāṇāntaratvaprasiddhe kathaṃ pratyakṣaparokṣarūpatayā pramāṇadvitvasiddhiḥ, yato dvidhaiva iti niyamaḥ sughaṭaḥ syāt ? ityatrāha–atra ityādi
atra parokṣe arthāpattyanumānopamānādīni, ādiśabdena aviśadamanyadapi pramāṇaṃ gṛhyate, antarbhavanti
nanvevaṃ saugatādīnāmapi svopakalpitapramāṇasaṃkhyāyām itarapramāṇānāmantarbhāvo bhaviṣyati, ityatrāha– para ityadi
paraiḥ sauganādibhiḥ parikalpitasya pramāṇāntarbhāvasya nirākaraṇam anyatra parokṣaparicchede uktamiti neha praghaṭṭake punarucyate
tasya śāstrasya virodhena tatsiddheṣvartheṣu liṅgādiṣvasiddhakalpeṣu gamakacintāyā ayogata
yasmāt pratyakṣaparokṣārthayornāgamādhikāra tasmāt tṛtīyasthāne atīndriye viṣaye vicārasaṅkānte śāstraparigraho nyāyya prakārāntarāsabhavāt
yathā yadaikā sapatnī patisamīpe samupatiṣṭhati tadā dvitīyā īrṣyābaliptā anavakāśatayā patyupakaṇṭha nopasarpati na tathā pramāṇānā sāpatnyabhāvo irṣyāvaliptatā anavakāśatā vā samasti iti bhāva
kasya ? śrutasya, śrūyate iti śrutamāptavacana varṇapadavākyātmakaṃ dravyarūpa tasya, bhāvaśrutasya vā śravaṇa śrutamiti nirukte

kinnāmānau ? syādvādanayasajñitau, syātkathañcit pratipakṣāpekṣayā vacana syādvāda, nayana vastuno vivakṣitadharmaprāpaṇa naya, syādvādaśca nayaśca syādvādanayau, ittha sajñe vyapadeśau yayostau tathoktau

kā ? vikalasakathā, vikalasya vivakṣitaikadharmasya samyak pratipakṣāpekṣayā kathā pratipādana yathā jīvo jñātaiva draṣṭaiva ityādi

tatra jīva ityukte jīvaśabdo yogyatāpekṣo'nādisaṃketaḥ svabhāvabhūtā'nyāpohasvārthapratipādanaḥ nyakṣeṇa pratipakṣaṃ nirasya jīvamātrameva abhidadhyāt tataḥ syātpadaprayogāt sarvathaikāntatyāgāt svarūpādicatuṣṭayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭo jīvaḥ abhidhīyate iti sveṣṭasiddhiḥ
syājjīva eva ityukte'nekāntaviṣayaḥ syācchabdaḥ, syādastyeva jīvaḥ ityukte ekāntaviṣayaḥ syācchabdaḥ

tulanā–syātpadaprayogāttu ye jñānadarśanasukhādirūpā asādhāraṇā ye cāmūrttatvāsakhyātapradeśasūkṣmatvalakṣaṇā dharmādharmādharmagaganāstikāyapudgalai sādhāraṇā ye'pi ca sattvaprameyatvadharmitvaguṇitvādaya sarvapadārthai sādhāraṇāste'pi ca pratīyante

sakalādeśavikalādeśayo svarūpe prāya sarveṣāmaikamatye'pi kecidakalaṅkādyācāryā saptasu bhageṣu sarvānapi bhaṅgān ekadharmamukhena aśeṣadharmātmakavastupratipādanakāle sakalādeśarūpān ekadharma pradhānatayā anyadharmāśca gauṇatayā'bhidhānasamaye vikalādeśātmakān svīkurvanti
kecicca siddhasenagaṇiprabhṛtaya sadasadavaktavyarūpa bhaṅgatraya sakalādeśatvena śiṣṭāśca caturo bhagān vikalādeśarūpeṇa manyante
akalaṅkādīnā granthā– tathā coktam–sakalādeśa pramāṇādhīno vikalādeśo nayādhīna iti
yadā tu krama tadā vikalādeśa pṛ॰ 180 niraśasyāpi guṇabhedādaśakalpanā vikalādeśa
sakalādeśo hi yaugapadyenāśeṣadharmātmaka vastu kālādibhirabhedavṛttyā pratipādayati abhedopacāreṇa vā, tasya pramāṇādhīnatvāt
iya saptabhaṅgī pratibhaṅga sakalādeśasvabhāvā vikalādeśasvabhāvā ca

yadā madhyasthabhāvenārthitvavaśāt kiṃciddharmaṃ pratipādayipava śeṣadharmasvīkaraṇanirākaraṇavimukhayā dhiyā vāca prayuñjate tadā tattvacintakā api laukikavat sammugdhākāratayācakṣate–yaduta jīvo'sti karttā pramātā bhoktetyādi, ata sampūrṇavastupratipādanābhāvāt vikalādeśo'bhidhīyate nayamatena sabhavaddharmāṇā darśanamātramityartha

yadā tu pramāṇavyāpāramavikala parāmaśya pratipādayitumabhiprayanti tadāṅgīkṛtaguṇapradhānabhāvā aśeṣadharmasūcakakathañcitparyāyasyācchabdabhūṣitayā sāvadhāraṇayā vācā darśayanti syādastyeva jīva ityādikayā, ato'ya syācchabdasasūcitābhyantarībhūtānantadharmakasya sākṣādupanyastajīvaśabdakriyābhyā pradhānīkṛtātmabhāvasyāvadhāraṇavyavacchinnatadasabhavasya vastuna saṃdarśakatvāt sakalādeśa ityucyate
sakalagrāhi tu māna vikalagrāhī nayo jñeya
siddhasenagaṇiprabhṛtīnāṃ granthāḥ– evemete traya sakalādeśā bhāṣyeṇaiva vibhāvitā sagrahavyavahārānusāriṇa ātmadravye
samprati vikalādeśāścattvāra paryāyanayāśrayā vaktavyāstatpratipādanārthamāha bhāṣyakāra–deśādeśena vikalpayitavyamiti vivakṣāyattā ca vacasa sakalādeśatā vikalādeśatā ca draṣṭavyā

dravyārthajātyabhedāttu sarvadravyārthabhedānevaika dravyārthaṃ manyate, yadā paryāyajātyabhedāścaika paryāyārthaṃ sarvaparyāyabhedān pratipadyate, tadā tvavivakṣitasvajātibhedatvāt sakala vastu ekadravyārthābhinnam ekaparyāyārthābhedopacarita tadviśeṣaikābhedopacarita vā tanmātramekamadvitīyāśa bruvan sakalādeśa syānnitya ityādistrividho'pi nityatvānityatvayugapadbhāvaikatvarūpaikārthābhidhāyī

yadā tu dravyaparyāyasāmānyābhyā tadviśeṣābhyā vā vastunaḥ ekatva tadatadātmaka samuccayāśraya caturthavikalpe, svāśayugapadvṛttaṃ kramavṛttañca pañcamaṣaṣṭhasaptameṣūcyate tathāvivakṣāvaśāt tadā tu tathā pratipādayan vikalādeśa

tatra vivakṣākṛtapradhānabhāvasadādyekadharmātmakasyāpekṣitāparāśeṣadharmakroḍīkṛtasya vākyārthasya syātkārapadalāñchitavākyāt pratīteḥ syādasti ghaṭa syānnāsti ghaṭa syādavaktavyo ghaṭa ityete trayo bhaṅgā sakalādeśāḥ vivakṣāviracitadvitridharmānuraktasya syātkārapadasasūcitasakaladharmasvabhāvasya dharmiṇo vākyārtharūpasya pratipatte catvāro vakṣyamāṇakā vikalādeśā–syādasti ca nāsti ghaṭa iti prathamo vikalādeśa, syādasti cāvaktavyaśca ghaṭa iti dvitīyaḥ, syānnāsti cāvaktavyaśca ghaṭa iti tṛtīya, syādasti ca nāsti cāvaktavyaśca ghaṭa iti caturtha

etacca dvayamapi laghīyastrayyalaṅkāre sākṣādakalaṅkenodāhṛtam, atra cobhayatrāpyaviśeṣa, tathāhi–syājjīva evetyatra jīvaśabdena prāṇadhāraṇanibandhanā jīvaśabdavācyatāpratipatti, astītyanenodbhatākāraśabdaprayogādajīvaśabdavācyatāniṣedha, syācchabdaprayogato'sādhāraṇasādhāraṇadharmākṣepa

syādastyeva jīva ityatra jīvaśabdena jīvaśabdavācyatāpratipatti, astītyanenodbhūtavivakṣitāstitvāvagati, evakāraprayogāttu yadāśakita sakale'pi jagati jīvasya nāstitva tadvyavaccheda, syātprayogāt sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇapratipattirityubhayatrāpyaviśeṣa eva

u॰ yaśovijayai etanmalayagirikṛtam ākalaṅkamatālocana parvapakṣīkṛtya itthaṃ samāhitam–atredamavadheyam– yo nāma nayo nayāntarāpekṣa tasya pramāṇāntarbhāve vyavahāranaya pramāṇa syāt tasya tapa sayamapravacanagrāhakatvena saṃyamagrāhiniścayaviṣayakatvena tatsāpekṣatvāt
nayāntaravākyasayogena sāpekṣatve ca grāhye syātpadaprayogeṇa sapratipakṣanayadvayaviṣayāvacchedakasyaiva lābhāta tenā'nantadharmātmakatvāparārśa
na cedeva tadā'nekānte samyagekāntapraveśānupapatti avacchedakabheda vinā sapratipakṣaviṣayasamāveśasya durbacatvāt, iṣyate cāyam

samyaganekāntasādhakasya anekāntākṣepakatvāt na tvanantadharmaparāmarśakam, ato na syātpadaprayogamātrādhīnamādeśasākalya yena pramāṇanayavākyayorbhedo na syāt, kintu svārthopasthityanantaramaśeṣadharmābhedopasthāpakavidheyapadavṛttyadhīnam
sā ca vivakṣādhīnetyādeśasākatyamapi tatheti nayapramāṇavākyayoritya bheda eva

malayagiripādavacana tu apratipakṣadharmābhidhānasthale avacchedakabhedābhidhānānupayuktena syātpadena sākṣādanantadharmātmakatvābhidhānāt, tatra pramāṇanayabhedānabhyupagantṛdurvidagdhadigambaranirākaraṇābhiprāyeṇa yojanīyam
ko'sau syādvādaḥ kaśca nayaḥ ityāha–syādvādaḥ ityādi
syādvādo bhavati, ko'sau ? sakalādeśaḥ sakalasya sampūrṇasya vastunaḥ ādeśaḥ kathanam
anekāntātmakasya anekadharmasvabhāvasya arthasya jīvādeḥ kathanaṃ syādvādaḥ
yathā ityudāharaṇapradarśane, jīvaḥ pudgalaḥ dharmo'dharma ākāśaṃ kāla iti ṣaṭdravyarūpo'rthaḥ, tasya anekāntātmakatvanirūpaṇaṃ syādvādaḥ
tatra jīve tāvadanekāntātmakatvaṃ tatra ityādinā nirūpayati
tatra teṣu jīvādiṣaṭpadārtheṣu madhye jīva ātmā anekāntaḥ iti sambandhaḥ

nanu darśanameva puruṣasya svarūpaṃ na jñānādayaḥ, teṣāṃ prakṛtidharmatvāt tatkathaṃ tairasau anekāntaḥ ? ityapyayuktam, prakṛtidharmatāṃ nirākṛtya teṣāṃ taddharmatāyāḥ pratyakṣaparicchede pratipāditatvāt
nanu buddhyādayo nava ātmano'sādhāraṇā guṇāḥ santi tatkimarthamete catvāra eva darśitāḥ iti cet ? teṣāmeva sahabhuvāṃ tadguṇatvapratipādanārtham
icchādayo hi kramabhāvinaḥ paryāyāḥ na guṇāḥ, anyathā bhayaharṣaśokakaruṇāmarṣaudāsīnyādīnāmapi tadguṇatvaprasakteḥ navaiva iti saṃkhyāniyamo durghaṭaḥ syāt
rūpādirahitatvam amūrttatvam, na punaḥ asarvagatadravyaparimāṇābhāvaḥ, jīvasya mūrttatvaprasaṅgāt
asaṅkhyātapradeśatvam asaṃkhyātāvayavopetatvam, sūkṣmatvaṃ śuddhasya tasya kevalajñānādanyato'sākṣātkaraṇam, taiḥ anekānto jīvaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
kiṃ viśiṣṭaiḥ sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇaiḥ, sādhāraṇaiḥ gaganādāvapi bhāvāt, asādhāraṇaiḥ pudgaleṣvabhāvāt
tasya evaṃvidhasya jīvasya ādeśāt kathanāt pramāṇaṃ syādvādaḥ tatra tadavisaṃvādāt iti bhāvaḥ
tathā tena asādhāraṇobhaya sādhāraṇadharmādhikaraṇatvena anekāntaprakāreṇa itare pudgalādayaḥ padārthāḥ paramāgamataḥ paramāgamamāśritya yojyāḥ

mahān buddhirdhṛtirbrahmā pūrtiḥ khyātirīśvaro vikhara iti paryāyāāha–ukta pradhānādvuddhirutpadyate iti ? tatra vaktavya kiṃ lakṣaṇā punarbuddhirityucyate–adhyavasāyo buddhirdharmo jñāna virāga aiśvaryam

jīva iti dharmiṇo nirdeśaḥ, jñaḥ cetanāsvabhāvaḥ iti sādhyasya, sukhaduḥkhādivedanāditi hetoḥ, iti evaṃ prayogaḥ ādiryasya anityaśabdādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ, sa cāsau vikalasya dharmāntaranirapekṣasya dharmasya ādeśaśca nayaḥ
nanu kimidaṃ sākalyaṃ vaikalyañca ādeśasya yataḥ syādvādaḥ sakalādeśo nayo vikalasaṃkathā iti syāt ? ityatrāha–sākalyam ityādi
sakalasya anantadharmātmakasya vastuno bhāvaḥ sākalyam anantadharmātmakatā
vikalasya ekadeśasya bhāvo vaikalyam–ekāntaḥ, tadādeśaḥ tathoktaḥ
vivakṣitadharmād anyo dharmaḥ tadantaraṃ tasya avivakṣātaḥ, nānyathā durnayatvaprasaṅgāt
nanu śabdasya arthe sambandhābhāvataḥ pravṛtterevā'saṃbhavāt na sakalavikalādeśaprarūpaṇaṃ yuktam, ityatrāha–tatra ityādi
tatra anantātmake tattve sthite sati, yadi vā tatra evaṃ syādvādanayasvarūpe nirūpite sati jīva ityukte jīvaśabdaḥ avāntaraviśeṣarahitaṃ jīvamātrameva abhidadhyāt
yogyatāyām apekṣā yasya yogyatāṃ vā apekṣate iti yogyatāpekṣaḥ, anādiḥ saṅketo yasya sa tathoktaḥ
yogyatā ityanena tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇasambandhavirahe nityaikarūpasambandhā'sattve'pi ca śabdārthayoḥ vācyavācakabhāvaṃ darśayati, yogyatāsvabhāvasambandhasaṃbhavāt

nanu yogyatāto'pi śabdasya arthapratipādakatve ekasmācchabdāt yugapadanekārthapratipattiḥ syāt, sarvasya śabdasya sarvatrārthe pratipādanayogyatāsaṃbhavāt, tadanupapannamiti saṅketa ityanena darśayati–satyāmapi anekārthapratipādanayogyatāyāṃ viniyatasaṅketavaśād viniyatārthapratītyupapatteḥ
etacca pramāṇaṃ śrutam laghī॰ kā॰ 26 ityatra prarūpitam

nanu yadā jīvaśabdo'rthamabhidhatte na tadā pūrvasaṅketo'sti tatkathaṃ tadapekṣasyāsya niyatārthapratītihetutvamiti cet, na, asyedaṃ vācyam idaṃ vācakam iti cittasya saṅketatvāt, tasya ca tadāpi bhāvāt
na cedamavāntarakalpitam iti anādi- padena darśayati
nanu jīvamātramabhidadhyāt ityayuktam, anyāpohasyaiva jātereva anyonyavibhinnataddvayasyaiva vā śabdārthatvāt, ityatrāha–svabhāva ityādi
svabhāvabhūtaḥ anyataḥ sarvato'pohaḥ pararūpeṇa asattvaṃ yasya sa tathokta sa cāsau svārthaśca svābhidheyaḥ tasya pratipādanaḥ jīvaśabdaḥ tanmātramabhidadhyāt
yathā ca apohādeḥ śabdārthatā na ghaṭate tathā pramāṇaṃ śrutamartheṣu laghī॰ kā॰ 26 ityatra prapañcataḥ pratipāditam

tataḥ tasmāt nyāyāt syātpadaprayogāt sarvathaikāntasya sanneva jīvaḥ, asanneva, dravyarūpa eva, paryāyarūpa eva vā ityevaṃrūpasya tyāgāt nirāsāt, svarūpādicatuṣṭayaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ svadravyakṣetrādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ jīvaḥ jīvaśabdena abhidhīyate iti sveṣṭasya anekāntātmano jīvasya siddhiḥ
evaṃ pramāṇavākyamupadarśya sāmprataṃ nayavākyaṃ darśayannāha–nayo'pi ityādi
nayo'pi nayavākyamapi na kevalaṃ pramāṇavākyam, tathaiva syātpadaprayogaprakāreṇaiva samyagekāntaḥ samyagekāntaviṣayaḥ syāt, anyathā mithyaikāntagocaraḥ syāditi
tato'yamarthaḥ siddhaḥ–syāt kathañcit jīva eva jñānadarśanasukhavīryaiḥ dharmaiḥ anekāntaḥ nānyaḥ iti evakārārthaḥ
ityevamukte evaṃ vākye prayukte sati naikāntaviṣayaḥ kintu anekāntaviṣayaḥ syād bhavet śabdaḥ syājjīva eva itivākyam anekāntarūpasya tasya abhidhānāt
syādastyeva jīvaḥ ityukte sati ekāntaviṣayaḥ samyagekāntagocaraḥ syād bhavet śabdaḥ syādastyeva iti vākyam, pradhānataḥ tadastitvaikāntapratipādanāt
nanu na sarvatra vākye laukikāḥ syātkāramevakārañca prayuñjate, anyathaiva tatprayogadarśanāt, ato na yuktametadityārekāpanodārthamāha–
ka ? syātkāra syāditi padamavyayam, kva ? sarvatra śāstre loke vā
na kevala vidhau kintu niṣedhe'pi asattvādāvapi sādhye
tarhi kuta pratīyate iti cedatrāha–arthāt sāmarthyāt
cedyadi kuśala syāt vyavahāre prabuddha syāt
uddhṛto'yam– vidhau niṣedhenyatrāpi –āva॰ ni॰ malaya pṛ॰ 369B.
pārtho dhanurdharo nīla sarojamiti vā yathā
kiṃ bahunā vidhiniṣedhānuvādātideśādivākyeṣu kārakeṣu kartrādiṣu svārthādiṣu prātipadikārtheṣu sādhanadūṣaṇatadābhāsavākyeṣu syādvādamantareṇa prastutā'prasiddhiḥ ityābālaprasiddham
aprayukto'pi na kevalaṃ prayuktaḥ sarvatra vākye syātkāraḥ, upalakṣaṇametat tena evakāro'pi pratīyate
tathāhi–pānīyamānaya ityukte yadi pānīyasya anyasya cānayanaṃ laukikānāmabhipretaṃ syāttadā pānīyapadopādānamanarthakaṃ syāt
asti ca tadubhayagrahaṇam, ataḥ evakārapratītiḥ iti
kva ? vidhau niṣedhe'pi, bhinnaprakramaḥ apiśabdaḥ anyatra ityasyānantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ
atha yadi sarvatra saḥ pratīyate aṅgulyagre hastiyūthaśatamāste ityādāvapi pratīyeta
yathā yo'rthaḥ pramāṇataḥ pratipannaḥ tathaiva tasya pratipādakaḥ prayojakaḥ kuśalo bhavet nānyathā, sa cet yadi prayojakaḥ śabdānāmiti

kvacid vidhyādivākye syātkāramanicchadbhiḥ ekāntavādibhiḥ sarvathā dharmāpekṣayā iva dharmyapekṣayā'pi, yadvā yathā dharmyapekṣayā tathā dharmāpekṣayāpi ekāntaḥ sarvathaikāntaḥ so'bhyupagataḥ syāt tatra ca pramāṇavirodhaḥ ityabhiprāyaḥ
evaṃ vyatirekamukhena sarvatra syātkāraṃ prasādhya idānīṃ tathaiva evakāraṃ prasādhayannāha–avadhāraṇa ityādi
avadhāraṇasya evakārasya abhāve'pi na kevalaṃ syātkārābhāve sarvathaikānto'bhyupagataḥ syāt iti sambandhaḥ

tathāhi–jñānadarśanopayogalakṣaṇo jīva eva iti anyayogavyavacchedena jīvasyaiva etallakṣaṇalakṣitasya anekāntānabhyupagame ajīvo'pi tallakṣaṇaḥ syāditi bahirarthavyavasthāvilopaḥ, tadvilope ca sakalapramāṇaprameyādivyavahārāpahāraḥ
tallakṣaṇa eva saḥ iti ayogavyavacchedānabhyupagame ca rūpādirapyetallakṣaṇaṃ syāt iti jīvetaravibhāgābhāvaḥ syāt
tatra viśeṣyagataivasthale pārtha eva dhanurdhara ityādau anyatādātmyavyavacchedo'rtha
evakārābhāve ajīvo'pi jñānādimān syāttathā ca sarvasya cetanātmakatvaprāptyā bāhyadravyasya acetanasya sarvathā'bhāva syāditi bhāva
bāhyārthāpalāpe hi pramāṇādivyavasthā'bhāva, bāhyārthāpekṣayaiva hi jñāne pramāṇatadābhāsa vyavahāro bhavati bahi prameyāpekṣāyā pramāṇa tannibhañca te āptamī॰ kā॰ 83 ityabhidhānāt
tāni jñānadarśanādīni lakṣaṇāni yasya jīvasya asau tallakṣaṇa
viśeṣaṇasaṅgataivasthale ayogavyavaccheda śaṅkha pāṇḍura eva ityādau śaṅkhatvāvacchedena pāṇḍuravattvasamavāyābhāvavyavacchedabodhanāt
nanu sākṣātprayuktasya sāmarthyagamyasya vā evakārasyaiva pratītiryuktā tatsādhyasya ayogādivyavacchedaphalasya sarvatra vākye saṃbhavānna punaḥ syātkārasya niṣphalatvāt
ayoga yogamaparairatyanipāta evakāro vyatirecaka niyāmaka kvacid dharmasya viśeṣaṇasya ayoga vyavacchinatti
kvacidaparai viśeṣyādanyai yoga vyavacchinatti kvacidatyantāyoga vyavacchinatti
nanu nipāto na svaya vācaka kintu dyotaka tadasya kathamayamarthaprabheda ityāha–viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyābhyā kriyayā ca sahodita
viśeṣyeṇa sahokto'nyayogasya, kriyayā ca sahokto'tyantāyogasyeti viśeṣaṇādipadavācya eva ayogavyavacchedādi tatsahoktanipātadyotya ityarthaḥ

tatra caitro dhanurdhara eva ityatra ayogavyavacchedaḥ, tathāhi–parapratipattaye vākyaṃ prayujyamānaṃ yadeva pareṇa vyāmohādāśaṅkitam tadeva vyavacchinatti, caitraśca loke dhanurdharo na pratītaḥ, tataścaitrasya adhanurdharatvaśaṅkāvyavacchedena dhanurdharatvavidhānārthaṃ caitro dhanurdhara eva iti vākyaṃ prayujyate
nahi pārthe adhanurdharatvāśaṅkā kasyacidasti dhanurdharatvena akhilajanaprasiddhatvāttasya
tasmāt yadatiśayavaddhanurdharatvaṃ tat puruṣāntarasādhāraṇamāśaṅkitamiti tadvyavacchedāya pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ iti vākyaṃ prayujyate

nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva ityatra tu atyantāyogavyavacchedaḥ, yadā hi sarojaṃ nīlavarṇaviviktaṃ prasiddhamiti nīlatvamasya nāstīti āśaṅkitaṃ bhavati tadā tadvyavacchedāya nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva iti vākyaṃ prayujyate iti
yatra dharmiṇi dharmasadbhāva sandihyate tatrā'yogavyavacchedasya nyāyaprāptatvāt
atra dṛṣṭānto yathā caitro dhanurdhara iti
caitre hi dhanurdharatva sandihyate kimasti nāstīti
tataścaitro dhanṛrdhara ityukte pakṣāntaramadhanurdharatva śroturākāṅkṣopasthāpita nirākaroti ayogavyavacchedo'tra nyāyaprāpta
yathā pārtho dhanurdhara iti sāmānyaśabdo'pyaya dhanurdharaśabdaḥ prakaraṇasāmarthyādinā prakṛṣṭaguṇavṛttiriha pārthe hi dhanurdharatva siddhameveti nā'yogāśaṅkā
tādṛśantu sātiśaya kimanyatrāpyasti nāsti ityanyayogaśaṅkāyā śroturyadā pārtho dhanurdhara ityucyate tadā sātiśaya pārtha eva dhanurdharo nānya iti pratīyate
pārthe dhanurdharatva prasiddhameva kintu tādṛśamanyasyāpi kimastīti sandehe anyayogavyavacchedaphala viśeṣaṇam
na khalu sarvameva nīla saroja yenāyogavyavaccheda syāt, nāpi sarojameva nīlaṃ yena anyayogavyavacchedo bhavet
kintu nīla saroja sabhavati na vā ityatyantāyogasandehe viśeṣaṇena sa eva vyavacchidyate

tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, syātkāramantareṇa iṣṭāniṣṭayorvidhiniṣedhānupapatteḥ, tathāhi-pārtha eva dhanurdharaḥ ityukte sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣāmanyapuruṣāṇāṃ dhānurdharyābhāvaḥ pratīyate, tatra ca pratyakṣādivirodhaḥ

atha viśiṣṭaṃ tadanyapuruṣeṣu pratiniyatadeśakālāpekṣayā pratiṣeddhumiṣṭaṃ na dhanurdharatvamātra tato'yamadoṣaḥ, nanu ayamarthaḥ syātkāraprasādādeva pratyetuṃ śakya iti, etatprayojanatvāt kathasau niṣphalaḥ yataḥ sākṣātprayuktasya sāmarthyagamyasya vā asya sarvatra vākye pratītirna syāt ? tathā caitro dhanurdhara eva nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeva ityatra ayogā'tyantāyogayoḥ sarvathā vyavacchede caitra–dhānurdharyayoḥ nīlasarojayośca anyataradeva syāt
atha svasvarūpāparityāgenaiva anayoḥ ayogā'tyantā'yogavyavacchedaḥ natu anyonyasvarūpasvīkāreṇa ato'yamadoṣaḥ, tanna; syātkāramantareṇa asyārthasya pratyetumaśakyatvāt
yādṛśa dhanurdharatva pārthe na tādṛganyatra iti
tulanā–yatrāpi anyayogavyavacchedo'bhipretastatrāpi yogaviśeṣī vyavacchidyate na yogasāmānyam, yādṛg pārthe dhanurdharatā tādṛganyatra nāstīti
sa ca yoga kiṃ sāmānyarūpeṇa astinā pratyāyyate'tha viśeṣarūpeṇa utobhayarūpeṇeti sarvathā prāktanadoṣaprasaṅga
vyavacchedo'pi astitvasāmānyāyogasya vā astitvaviśeṣāyogasya vā ubhayāyogasya vā ? –tattvārthabhā॰ vyā॰ pṛ॰ 409
caitrasya dhanuṣā ayoge vyavacchinne yoga pratipādito bhavet itarathā caitro dhanurdhara eveti prayogānupapatti
saiva sarvathā kathañcidvā syāt ? ādye padye caitrasya ghanuṣā'yoge vyavacchinne sati na caitratā siddhyet dhanurbhāva siddhyet
atyantāyogavyavacchede'pi atyantamayogo nāsti yoga eva sarvathā, athavā kadācidasti kadācinnāstītyeva ca vikalpadvaye'pi prācya eva prasaṅgo yojya
yaccānyadukta kriyayā sahodito'tyantāyogameva ca vyacchinatti nipāto vyatirecaka iti, tatra dūṣaṇamāha–prāptamityādi
nīlaṃ saroja bhavatyeveti cet yadi tarhi samantāt nitya sarvadā nīlaṃ sarojaikarūpa vyaktaṃ yathā bhavati tathedaṃ jagat prāptam
ayamabhiprāya–sarvathā kathañcidvā nīla saroja bhavatyeva ? prathamapakṣe'ya doṣa, anyatra anekānta iti

kiñca, caitro dhanurdharaḥ ityādivākyeṣu dhanurdharatvādibhiḥ ayogādivyavaccheda kurvatā evakāreṇa adhanurdharatvādīnāmaśabdavācyānāmapi tato'nyatvānnivṛttiryadi vidhīyate, tarhi śūratvodāratvādidharmāṇāmapi vidhīyatāṃ śabdavācyebhyo dhanurdharatvādibhyo'nyatvāviśeṣāt

atha yo dharmo yatra niyamyate tadvirodhina eva tatra nivṛttiḥ caitre ca dhanurdharatvaniyame adhanurdharatvaṃ viruddham, pārthe ca asādhāraṇadhanurdharatvavidhau sakalajagatsādhāraṇaṃ tad viruddham, saroje ca nīlatvasaṃbhavavidhau tadasaṃbhavamātraṃ viruddham, ataḥ tasyaivā'to nivṛttiḥ natu śūratvādidharmāṇām teṣāṃ tadanyatve'pyaviruddhatvāt iti; tadetadandhasarpavilapraveśanyāyamanusarati, evaṃvidhapravibhāgasya syādvādānabhyupagame anupapatteḥ
nanu tadabhyupagame'pi śabdānabhidheyatvāviśeṣe kathaṃ virodhina eva nivṛttiḥ natu sarvasya iti cet, tathā sāmarthyāt
naca aviruddhasya pratiyogitvaṃ yuktam, ataḥ kathaṃ sarvasya nivṛtteḥ śaṅkāpi iti ? tataḥ sthitam avadhāraṇa ityādi
dhanurdharo'pi syāt śūraśca udāraśca iti na ko'pi virodha
svarūpasya pratiyoginaścāpekṣā, svarūpāpekṣo bhāvavyavahāra pratiyogyapekṣo'bhāvavyavahāra –ā॰ ṭi॰
nanu jīvo'sti ityukte tatra astitvam, nāsti ityukte nāstitvam, ubhayavacanena ubhayaṃ pratīyate ato na yuktam avadhāraṇa ityādi, ityatrāha–anyathā ityādi
anekāntanirāsasya avaśyaṃbhāvitvābhāvaprakāreṇa anyathā pramāṇanayayorabhedaprasaṅgāt kāraṇāt sarvathaikānto'bhyupagataḥ syāt iti sambandhaḥ
aparamapi syādvādamantareṇa naśyati iti darśayannāha–kiṃ bahunā ityādi
kim ? na kiñcit bahunā uktena ityadhyāhāraḥ

vidhiniṣedhānuvādātideśādivākyeṣu, ādiśabdena niyamādivākyaparigrahaḥ, kārakeṣu kartrādiṣu, svārthādiṣu ādiśabdena liṅgādiparigrahaḥ, prātipadikārtheṣu sādhanadūṣaṇatadābhāsavākyeṣu, caśabdaḥ atra samuccāyārtho draṣṭavyaḥ
iti evam ābālaprasiddham na svecchayā kalpitamiti yāvat

syājjīva sanneveti hi nayavākyam, atra cedavadhāraṇa na kriyate tadā yathā dharmiṇi jīve avadhāraṇarahite anekānto'sti tathā dharme'pi astitvākhye sa prāpnoti, nayarūpañcedam, dharmiṇyanekānta dharme ekānta –ā॰ ṭi॰
nanu śabdaḥ sarvo'pi vivakṣāpratibaddhatvāt tāmeva gamayati nārtham, ato'yuktamuktam–tatra jīva ityukte ityādyāśaṅkyāha–
tathā padāni gavādīni tathā vākyāni ca gāmānayetyādīni
kiṃ viśiṣṭān ? avāñchitān, avivakṣitān bhūmyādīn, vāñchitāśca vivakṣitānapi sāsnādimadādīn
kvacit mandabuddhiṣu pratipādyeṣu na prāhu teṣā tato'rthādhigamābhāvāt ityeva prakārā sarvajanapratītā prasiddhi rūḍhi
svecchayā svairabhāvena vadatā kathayatā saugatānā yujyate yukta bhavatīti, adhikṣepavacanam
kasya ? vaktrabhipretamātrasya vaktu prayojakasyābhipretamabhiprāyo vivakṣā tāvanmātrasyaiva na bahirarthasyeti
nu aho āścaryamityākṣepo gamyate, sāmānyaviśeṣātmano bahirarthasya śabdaprayogātpratītestasyaiva tadarthatvāt abhiprāyasya tata svapnepyapratīte
ayaṃ ca prasaṃgo'nyatra vistareṇoktaḥ iti neha pratanyate
ubhayatra vyabhicārānna kasyacidvācakāḥ śabdā iti alaukikapratibhānam
loko hi arthasyāptyanāptiṣu satyānṛtavyavasthāmātiṣṭheta śabdasya nābhiprāyamātre tatra śabdavyavahārabāhulyābhāvāt
abādhitāṃ tatpratītimatikramya svecchayā pramāṇaprameyasvarūpamātiṣṭhamānānāṃ yuktam–abhipretamātrasūcakatvaṃ śabdānām
vāñchanto vā na vaktāraḥ śāstrāṇā mandabuddhaya
vāñchanto vā na vaktāra śāstrāṇā mandabuddhaya
kiṃviśiṣṭān ? avāñchitān vāñchayā'viṣayīkṛtān vāñchitāṃśca tadviṣayīkṛtāṃśca śāstravyākhyānādyarthān kvacit mandabuddhiprāṇiṣu na prāhuḥ iti evaṃ prasiddhiḥ lokapratītiriyaṃ sakalajanasākṣikī
svecchayā svābhipretaprakriyāmātreṇa tāṃ prasiddhimatikramyaiva vadatāṃ saugatānāṃ yujyate
kiṃ tad ? ityāha–vaktrabhipretamātrasya sūcakaṃ vacanaṃ tviti

nanu varṇādayo'rthānavāñchitān kimanityāḥ santaḥ pratipādayanti, nityā vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; anityatve teṣām utpannamātrapradhvaṃsitvena saṅketavyavahārakālānanuyāyitvataḥ tatpratipādakatvānupapatteḥ
dvitīyapakṣastu upapannaḥ, nityānāṃ teṣāṃ tadanuyāyitvena tatpratipādakatvopapatteḥ
tathāhi–sa evā'yaṃ gakāraḥ ityādi pratyabhijñā khyapratyakṣata eva tāvacchabdānāṃ nityatvaṃ pratīyate
ubhayāṃśāvalambī hi pratyayaḥ saśaya, na cedaṃ tathā
yadeva hi jñānaṃ bādhyate tadeva mithyā prasiddhaṃ yathā śuktikāyāṃ rajatajñānam, na ceda deśakālanarāntareṣvapi bādhyate
yadā hi kṣaṇika śabdo na śakto'rthāvadhāraṇe
na hi kṣaṇikasya sambandhagrahaṇa saṃbhavati –mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 3, nyāyara॰
prabhākaramate ca śabdo nityo'pi ākāśasya guṇo na tu svatantra dravyam
draṣṭavyam–ākāśaśca śabdavāniti, sa eva śrotra tadguṇaśca śabda –praka॰ pa॰ nyāyaśuddhiprakaraṇam
vaya tāvatpratyabhijānīmo na na karaṇadaurbalyam, evamanye'pi pratyabhijānanti, sa evāyamiti pratyabhijānānā pratyabhijānanti cedvayamivānye'pi nānya iti vaktumarhanti
eva sati vyaktibhede sāmānya tadabhāvāttu nāsti sāmānyamityeva vaktavyam, ata siddha pratyabhijñayā śabdasya nityatvam
yaḥ pūrvāvagato'śo'tra sa na nāma pratīyate
nanu gṛhītamapi gṛhyate iti katha prāmāṇyamata āha ya iti
tasminnaśe mā bhūtprāmāṇyam agṛhītakālāntarasambandhāpekṣameva tu prāmāṇyamiti
nanu na kevalamadhika gamyate kintu prāgavagatamapi iti katha prāmāṇyamata āha ya pūrveti

savikalpake hi śabdārthasvarūpasambandhakālasambandhā prathante tatra śabdādiraśo'smṛtiviṣaya iti mā nāma pramāṇaviṣayo bhavatu idānīntanī tu vastusattā na pūrvamavadhṛtetyasti tatra pramāṇāvasara iti sthita prāmāṇyam
pūrvamavagato'śa sa na nāma– prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 339
pūrvamavagato nāśa sa ca nāma –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ 319
ya pūrvāvagato'śo'tra sa no nāma –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 675
na ca smṛtipūrvakatvādasya apratyakṣatva yuktam; tatpūrvakatve'pyasya satsamprayogajatvena pratyakṣatvopapatte
saścāsī samprayogaśceti karmadhāraya tathā ca indriyāṇāmarthena sāka sambandhe vidyamāne satītyartha
tulanā–kiṃ punarida pratyabhijñāsya pramāṇam ? pratyakṣamiti brūma
nahi smaraṇato yat prāk tatpratyakṣamitīdṛśam | vacanaṃ rājakīyaṃ vā laukikaṃ vāpi vidyate || 1
nanvidaṃ bhavatyadhikaviṣayaṃ smaraṇottarakāle bhavat katha pratyakṣam ? na hi nirvikalpakasya pratyakṣasyaiṣa dharmo dṛṣṭa ata āha–nahīti
na hi smaraṇāt prāgbhāvitā pratyakṣalakṣaṇam, api tarhi indriyajatvam, taccātrāpyaviśiṣṭamiti bhāva
yadi smaraṇenendriyapravṛttireva vāryate tadā dūṣyate, tatastaduttarakālaṃ jāyamāna savikalpaka pratyakṣaṃ bhavedapi, na tvetadasti ityāha na ceti
yataḥ smṛtyā nendriya virudhyate na vā dūṣyate, tena prāgūrdhvaṃ vā smṛteryadindriyārthasambandhād jñāna jāyate sarvaṃ tatpratyakṣamabhyupagantavyamityāha–teneti
rājakīya vā vaidika vāpi mī॰ ślo॰
rājakīya vā laukika nāpi –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 319
na cāpi smaraṇāt paścādindriyasya pravarttanam | vāryate kenacinnāpi tattadānīṃ praduṣyati || 2
tenendriyārthasambandhāt prāgūrdhvañcāpi yatsmṛteḥ | vijñānaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ pratyakṣamiti gamyatām || 3
evamataḥ śabdasya nityatve siddhe idānīmiva anyadāpi yacchabdasyoccāraṇaṃ na tattasya janakaṃ kintu abhivyañjakam
ata idamucyate–anyadāpi yat śabdasya uccāraṇaṃ tadasyābhivyañjakam uccāraṇatvāt, yad yad uccāraṇaṃ tattadabhivyañjakam yathā etatkālopalakṣitamuccāraṇam, tathā ca prakṛtam, tasmādidamapi tathā
yadi vispaṣṭena hetunā śabdasya nityatva vaktu śakṣyāmaḥ tato nityapratyayasāmarthyāt prayatnenābhivyajyate iti bhaviṣyatīti
sa ca pratyabhijñābalena dvitīyādidarśaneṣvabhivyañjakatāmāpādita iti prathamadarśanepyasau abhivyañjaka eva ata kāraṇarahitatvena sattvānnitya śabda gaganāderiva nāsyā'nityateti
evañcoccāraṇaṃ śabdasya na kāraṇa kintu abhivyañjakamiti siddham
śabda prayatnābhivyaṅgya yathā tadanutpādyatve sati tadanantaramupalabdhe, yo yadanutpādyatve sati yadanantaramupalabhyate sa tadabhivyaṅgyaḥ yathā pradīpānantaramupalabhyamāno ghaṭa
tathā, vivādādhyāsito vā kālaḥ gādisambaddhaḥ kālatvāt pratipāditaśabdasambaddhakālavat
ito'pyanumānāt tatsiddham–nityaḥ śabdaḥ, śrāvaṇatvāt, yad yadevaṃ tattathā yathā śabdatvam, tathā cā'yam, tasmādayamapi tathā
tathā, deśakālādibhinnā gośabdavyaktibuddhayaḥ ekagośabdaviṣayā na cānekārthagocarā gaurityutpadyamānatvāt sampratyutpannagośabdabuddhivat
gośabdavyaktibuddhayaḥ ityucyamāne siddhasādhyatā syāt, ekagośabdavyaktibuddheḥ ekaviṣayatvābhyupagamāt, tannivṛttyarthaṃ bahuvacanam
tathā sāmānye gośabdanibandhanāḥ samānā evaṃ dhiyaḥ prabhavanti iti tannirāsārthaṃ vyaktigrahaṇam
ekasmin deśe kāle vā bahūnāṃ pramātṝṇāṃ gośabdajñānāni ekagośabdavyaktigocarāṇi iti siddhasādhyatāprasaṅgavyavacchedārthaṃ deśakālādibhinnāḥ ityuktam
hyastano vā gośabdaḥ adyāpyanuvarttate gauriti jñāyamānatvāt adyoccāritagośabdavat
adyatano vā gośabdaḥ hyo'pi āsīt gauriti jñāyamānatvāt hya uccāritagośabdavat
śabdo vā vācakaḥ dīrghakālāvasthāyī sambandhabalena arthamatijanakatvāt dhūmasāmānyavat
yastu asthiraḥ sa sambandhabalena nārthaṃ bodhayati tādātvikanimittatvāt pradīpavidyutprakāśavat
yadvā śrotrapratyakṣatvamatra hetu, taddhi śabdatvadṛṣṭāntena śaknoti nityatva sādhayitumityāha śrautreti
iya vā ta vijānāti taddhetoḥ pūrvabuddhivat
gośabdavyaktiṣu yā buddhyo deśakāladrutamadhyabilambitādipratibhedabhāsabhinnāstā ekārthaviṣayā nānārthaviṣayā na vā bhavanti gaurityākāropagraheṇotpadyamānatvāt sampratyutpannagobuddhivat
athavā yā yā gośabdaviṣayā buddhi sā'dyatanagośabdaviṣayā gośabdaviṣayatvāt adyaprasūtagośabdabuddhivat

athavā ahyastanī gośabdabuddhirdharmiṇī hyastanagośabdaviṣayatva sāvyadharmaḥ gośabdaviṣayatvāditi hetu hyastanī gośabdabuddhirdṛṣṭānta athavā, ubhe hyastanyadyatanyau buddhī ekaviṣaye gośabdaviṣayatvādekagośabdabuddhivat
athavā, samastā gotvabuddhaya deśādibhedabhinnā ekagośabdajanyā godhītvādekagobuddhivat
pūrva gośabdaviṣayā buddhaya dharmiṇya ekaviṣayatvañca sādhyam, idānīñca gotvajātiviṣayā buddhayo dharmiṇya ekagośabdajanyatva sādhyamiti viśeṣa
nitye tu sati gośabde bahukṛtva uccarita śrutapūrvaścānyāsu govyaktiṣu anvayavyatirekābhyāmākṛtivacanamavagamayiṣyati, tasmādapi nitya
tulanā–gauriti śrūyamāṇo'dya hyo'pi śabdo mayā śrutaḥ
tulanā–śabdo vā vācako yāvān sthiro'sau dīrghakālabhāk
ya īdṛk sa sthiro dṛṣṭa dhūmasāmānyabhāgavat
na hi pradīpādiprakāśasya niyatena ghaṭādinā sambandho'sti, tādātvikanimittatvāt, yatra yatra yāti tatra tatra prakāśayati
sambandhe hi smṛtyapekṣā bhavati, na ca ghaṭapradīpādayastathā –ā॰ ṭi॰
tādātvika tāvatkālika vyavahārakālānuyāyi nimitta sambandho yasya sa tathokta tadbhāvastattvam
kañcit kālaṃ sthiraḥ śabdaḥ sarvakālamapi sthiraḥ
yeṣāmanavagatotpattīnā dravyāṇā bhāva eva lakṣyate teṣāmapi keṣāñcidanityatā gamyate yeṣā vināśakāraṇamupalabhyate, yathā abhinava paṭa dṛṣṭvā
na caina kriyamāṇamupalabdhavān atha cānityatvamavagacchati rūpameva dṛṣṭvā
sa hi sambandhakaraṇakālaṃ yāvadanupadruta paścādapi kenāpanīyatāmiti
tathā, vivādādhyāsitaḥ kālaḥ gādiśabdaśūnyo na bhavati kālatvāt idānīntanakālavat
tathā, arthāpattitopyasya nityatvaṃ siddham, tathāhi–nityaḥ śabdaḥ tato'rthapratipattyanyathānupapatteḥ
na ceyam anyathāpi anyathaiva vā upapadyate; śabdasyānityatve sarvathānupapadyamānatvāt
na cā'nityatve śabdasya pratipannapratibandhasya uttarakālamanuvṛttiḥ saṃbhavati; tasya tadaiva vināśāt
uccaritamātre hi vinaṣṭe śabde nacā'nyo'nyānartha pratyāyayitu śaknuyāt, ato na parārthamuccāryeta
atha na vinaṣṭastato bahuśa upalabdhatvādarthāvagama iti yuktam
na hi pratyuccāraṇamanyasyānyasya kriyamāṇasyārthapratyāyakatva sabhavati sambandhagrahaṇāsabhavāt, agṛhītasambandhasya cā'pratyāyakatvāt
arthāpattiriyaṃ coktā pakṣadharmādivarjitā | yadi nāśininitye vā vināśinyeva vā bhavet || 1
śabdo nitya darśanasya parārthatvā'nyathānupapatte, parārthavākyoccāraṇānyathānupapatte, arthapratītyanyathānupapattervā
tadihāpi yadyanityatve'pyarthapratyāyakatvamupapadyeta anityatva eva vā tato dūṣaṇa syāt natu tadastītyāha yadīti
yadi śabde nāśini nitye vā vācakasāmarthyamityanena saśaya ukta vināśinyeva vā śabde vācakasāmarthyamityanena tu viparyaya upadarśita tadā dūṣaṇamucyatāmiti
yadaiva śabde vācakasāmarthyaṃ sandigdha viparyastañca syāttadā dūṣaṇāvasara etaccātrobhayamapi nāstīti bhāva
nāśini nitye veti nirabadhāraṇātvāt militameva anyathāpi ityasya vyākhyānam, vināśinyeva iti tu anyathaiva ityasya –ā॰ ṭi॰
nanu mābhūdarthapratyāyana tathāpi kimityanityatā na bhavati ? ata āha–phalavaditi
phalabato gavānayanādivyāpārasya aṅgabhūto'rthapratyaya tatphalatvenaiva phalavān, śabdasyoccāraṇasaskārabhāja svayamaphalasya phalavatpratyayāṅgatā'vagamyata iti
arthapratyayāṅgasya śabdasya sa eva dharmaḥ svāṅgatvena grahītavyo yaśca pradhānamarthapratyaya na bādhata iti
arthapratyayāṅgabhūtasya śabdasya yadaṅgamanityatva tadanurodhena yattatpradhāna śabda tatphalasya arthapratyayasya bādhanamayuktamiti
niṣphalatvena śabdasya yogyatvādavagamyate | parīkṣyamāṇastenāsya yuktyā nitya-vināśayoḥ || 3
sa dharmobhyupagantavyo yaḥ pradhāna na bādhate | nahi aṅgāṅgyanurodhena pradhānaphalabādhanam || 4
yujyate, nāśipakṣe ca tadekāntāt prasajyate | nahi adṛṣṭārthasambandhaḥ śabdo bhavati vācakaḥ || 5
tathā ca syādapūrvo'pi sarvaḥ sarva prakāśayet | sambandhadarśanañcāsya nā'nityasyopapadyate || 6
sambandhajñānasiddhiśced dhruvaṃ kālāntarasthitiḥ | anyammin jñātasambandhe na cānyo vācako bhavet || 7
nanu kiyanta citkālamavatiṣṭhantā śabdā, yāvatsambandhadarśana tasya vyavahāraśca sabhavati, naināvatā nityatvasiddhirata āha–sambandheti
nanvanyasyaiva gośabdasya sambandha gṛhītvā anyasmādarthaṃ pratyeṣyāmo nāvaśyamekasyaiva sthāyitvamata āha–anyasminniti, eva hyavyavasthā syāditi
yasya hi sambandho jñāta so'nya yaśca vācaka so'nya vināśitvāt –ā॰ ṭi॰
ātha sadṛśatayā śabdasya arthapratipattihetutvopapatteḥ nārthāpattito'sya nityatvasiddhiḥ, tadayuktam, tatsādṛśyasya vicāryamāṇasyānupapattitaḥ tathā tasya taddhetutvānupapatteḥ
arthatvasādṛśyādarthāvagama iti cet, na kaścidarthavān sarveṣā navatvāt
kasyacitpūrvasya kṛtrimasambandho bhaviṣyatīti cet, taduktam, sadṛśa iti cāvagate vyāmohātpratyayo vyāvarteta śālāśabdānmālāpratyaya iva
nanu tattulyopādānamabhedamupādāya sidhyati pārārthyaṃ darśanasya; satyam; sidhyati, kintu netthambhūtatve pramāṇamasti
na kasyacidapyāsasāra janto pūrvoktasadṛśamuccārayāmi tatsadṛśa evāyamimiti jñānotpādo dṛṣṭa
sadṛśatvātpratītiścet taddvāreṇāpyavācakaḥ | kasya caikasya sādṛśyāt kalpyatāṃ vācako'paraḥ
śabdastu na tathā bālānāmapi pratītiprasaṅgādityarthavatsādṛśyādarthāvagama iti bhāṣyam, tasyārthamāha–sadṛśatvāditi
śabdāntare gṛhītasambandhe'rthavati śabdāntara tatsādṛśyāt tattvena bhrāntyavagata tadarthaṃ pratyāyayatīti
idañca na hi kaścidarthavānityanena bhāṣyeṇoktamiti etadevopapādayati–adṛṣṭeti
adṛṣṭasaṅgatitvena sarveṣāṃ tulyatā yadā | arthavān pūrvadṛṣṭaścet tasya tāvān kṣaṇaḥ kutaḥ
dvistāvānupalabdho hi arthavān sampratīyate | mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 248–50
tathā bhinnamabhinnaṃ vā sādṛśyaṃ vyaktito bhavet | evamekamanekaṃ vā nityaṃ vā'nityameva vā
bhinne caikatvanityatve jātireva prakalpitā | vyaktyananyadathaikaṃ ca sādṛśyaṃ nityamiṣyate
yattāvaduktam–sa evāyaṃ gakāraḥ ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, asya pratyabhijñānasya sādṛśyanibandhanatayā ekatvā'prasādhakatvāt pradīpādipratyabhijñānavat
na khalu sa evāyaṃ pradīpaḥ, aṅgahāraḥ, lūnapunarjātanakhakeśādirvā ityādi pratyabhijñānaṃ pradīpādīnāmekatvaṃ prasādhayati

nanu tailādikāraṇasya uttaratra kṣayopalambhataḥ pradīpādeḥ pratikṣaṇamanyatvaprasiddheḥ yuktamekatvāsattvaṃ na śabdasya viparyayāt, ityapyanupapannam, asyāpi tālvādisaṃyogavibhāgalakṣaṇakāraṇasya uttaratra prakṣayapratītitaḥ pratisamayamanyatvasiddheḥ ekatvāsattvopapatteḥ

tatsaṃyogavibhāgayoḥ tadabhivyañjakavāyūtpāde kāraṇatvaṃ na śabde ityabhyupagame varttikāmukhatailānalasaṃyogāderapi pradīpādyabhivyañjakavāyūtpāde kāraṇatvaṃ na tadutpāde ityapyabhyupagamyatāmaviśeṣāt
vivādagocarāpanna śabdo'bhivyakta pratyabhijñānakāla yāvannāvatiṣṭhate śabdapratyayaviṣayatvāt pūrvānubhūtaśabdavat
tathā hyanitye'pi pradīpādau pratyabhijñāna dṛṣṭaṃ tasmādanaikāntikametat, yathā kṣaṇike'pi karmaṇi prayoge dṛśyate – pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 379
sādṛśāparagrahaṇenāpi tattvasaṃbhavāt kṣaṇikeṣvapi karaṇāṅgahārādiṣu pratyabhijñānādviruddho hetu
yadapi pratyabhijñānasya pratyakṣatvamuktam, tadapyayuktam, pratyakṣaparicchede viśadasvabhāvasyaiva jñānasya pratyakṣatvapratipādanāt

na cedaṃ tatsvabhāvam, ataḥ kathamasya pratyakṣatāśaṅkāpi ? akṣānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāttasya tadrūpatā, ityapyasat, tasya tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvābhāvāt, darśanasmaraṇānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitayā tasya pratyabhijñāparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake prarūpitatvāt
tadgrāhakatve vā kathaṃ yogipratyakṣasya pratikṣeṣaḥ pratyakṣatve'pyasya tadvad atītādyarthagrāhakatvāvirodhāt ?

tulanā–evammanyate –prathame kṣaṇe śabdagrahaṇa dvitīyakṣaṇe pūrvagṛhītaśabdāhitasaskāraprabodha tato'nyasmin kṣaṇe śabdasmaraṇam, tataścaturthe kṣaṇe tirohite tasmin sa evāya ghaṭaśabda iti pratyabhijñāna katha pratyakṣa syādasannihitaviṣayatvāt

astu vā yathākathañcit tatpratyakṣam, tathāpi na tat śabdasyaikatvaprasādhakam, tadutpādavināśagrāhiṇā pramāṇāntareṇa bādhyamānatvāt, yat pramāṇāntareṇa bādhyate na tat svaviṣayavyavasthāpakam yathā śuktiśakale rajatagrāhipratyakṣaṃ śuktisvarūpagrāhipratyakṣāntareṇa, bādhyate ca tadutpādavināśagrāhiṇā tena tadekatvagrāhipratyabhijñānamiti
na cedamasiddham, pratyakṣasyaiva tāvat tadutpādavināśagrāhakatvena tadvādhakatvasaṃbhavāt
tathāhi–utpannaḥ śabdaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ iti pratītiḥ indriyavyāpārānantaraṃ pratiprāṇi saṃvedyamānopajāyate
na ceyaṃ mithyā, deśakālanarāntareṣu abādhyamānatvāt utpanno ghaṭaḥ vinaṣṭo ghaṭaḥ iti pratītivat
atha pratyabhijñānenaiva iyaṃ kasmānna bādhyate ? tanna, asya sādṛśyanibandhanatayā tannityatvāprasādhakatvāt
utpanna śabda vinaṣṭa śabda iti pratīti
api ca pratyabhijñā vyabhicarati karmādiṣu gṛhyate

tenāsyā śabdepyabhāvapratyayopahatavapuṣi ka samāśvāsa ? na caivaṃ pratyakṣepyanaikāntikatvodbhāvanamapi tu vināśapratyayapratihataprabhāvā pratyabhijñā nityatvaṃ karmādiṣviva śabde'pi na sādhayitu prabhavati –nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 224
bhrāntivaśādbhavata sa evāya śabda iti pratyabhijñānasya

nanu ekajñānasaṃsargipadārthāntaropalambhāt kvacid ghaṭādyabhāvapratītiryuktā, natu śabdābhāvapratītiḥ, tatraikajñānasaṃsargiṇaḥ kasyacidapyasaṃbhavāt, ityapyacodyam; vivakṣitaśabdābhāvapratītau śabdāntarasyaiva ekajñānasaṃsargiṇaḥ saṃbhavāt
niḥśabdapradeśe sarvaśabdābhāvapratītau tarhi tadasaṃbhava iti cet, na, tatrāpi ātmasvarūpasaṃvedanasya tadekajñānasaṃsargiṇaḥ saṃbhavāt
yathaiva hi ghaṭabhūdeśādīnām ekatra jñāne saṃsargaḥ tathā svapararūpayorapi, akhilajñānānāṃ svapararūpāvabhāsisvabhāvatvāt
na caivaṃ śabdābhāvavat rūpādyabhāvo'pi ato'nuṣajyate, teṣāṃ pratiniyatendriyagrāhyatayā tadabhāvasyāpi pratiniyatādeva indriyāt prasiddheḥ
yo hi yadindriyagrāhyaḥ tadabhāvo'pi tadindriyādeva vyavasthāpyate
yadindriyopayukto hyātmā yatra yadā yadviṣayamupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptaṃ nopalabhate tatra tadā tasyābhāvamadhigacchatīti

svapararūpāvabhāsakasvabhāvasya hyātmana parasmin yogyadeśāvasthite vastuni na kevalamātmasvarūpasavedanaṃ bhavet yāvanti khalu vastūni pratiṣedhyatvasammatavastunā sākaṃ yogyadeśāvasthitāni santyavaśya pratibhāsante, tāni sarvāṇyekajñānasasargīṇi
śabde tu pratiṣedhye saśabdake pradeśe śabdāntaramātmasvarūpañca, ni śabdake tu kevalamātmasvarūpam
athavā mā bhavatvekajñānasasargipadārthāntara pramāṇāntaragṛhīta tu bhaviṣyati
yathā smṛtigocare caityakulādau kvacidabhāvapramāṇena bhavatāmabhāvagrahaṇe caityakulādi
paratvāviśeṣāt yathā śabdābhāvo jñāta tathā rūpābhāvo'pi jñāyatāmityartha –ā॰ ṭi॰
yadgrahe yadapekṣa cakṣu tadabhāvagrahe'pi tadapekṣate iti kiraṇāvalīvacanāt yadbhāvo yāvatyā sāmagryā gṛhyate tadabhāvo'pi tāvatyaiva –ā॰ ṭi॰
yenendriyeṇa yadgṛhyate tena tanniṣṭhā jātistadabhāvaśca gṛhyate iti niyamāt
nityatve ca śabdasya prāguccāraṇādanupalambhaḥ kutaḥ syāt–indriyābhāvāt, śabdasyāsannihitatvāt, āvṛtatvādvā ? na tāvadindriyābhāvāt; uccāraṇānantaraṃ śabdo palambhāt
na ca prāgasataḥ tadaiva indriyasya prādurbhāvaḥ, pratītivirodhāt
nāpi śabdasyāsannihitatvāt, nityavyāpitayā sarvatra sarvadā tasya sannihitatvāt
na khalu dṛśyasvabhāvaparityāgena adṛśyasvarūpā'svīkāre śabdasya āvṛtatvaṃ ghaṭate atiprasaṅgāt

yad yadā yatsvarūpaṃ na parityajati na tasya tadā tatpratyanīkasvarūpasaṃbhavaḥ yathā anāvṛtāvasthāyāṃ dṛśyasvarūpamaparityajato nādṛśyasvarūpasaṃbhavaḥ, na parityajati ca āvṛtāvasthāyāṃ dṛśyasvarūpaṃ śabda iti
tadā tatsvarūpaparityāge vā siddhamasya anityatvam, svarūpabhedasvabhāvatvāttasya
nanu ghaṭādīnāṃ svarūpābhede'pi andhakārādinā āvṛtatvaṃ dṛśyate, ityapyayuktam, tatrāpi svarūpabhede satyeva āvṛtatvopapatteḥ
uccāraṇāt prāk tadgrāhaka śrovamindriya nāsīt uccāraṇakāla eva śabdena sahotpadyate ityukte satyāha na ceti
tulanā–yadyadā yatsvarūpa na parityajati –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 682
tulanā–tadayaṃ tālvādivyāpārajanitaśrāvaṇasvabhāva parityajya viparītasvabhāvamāsādayannapi nityaścenna kiñcidanityam

tulanā– syānmata yathā ghaṭāderātmānamakhaṇḍayattamastasyāvaraṇa tathā śabdasyāpīti, tadasat; tasyāpi tena ātmakhaṇḍanopagamāt, dṛśyasvabhāvasya khaṇḍanāt tamasastadāvaraṇatvasiddhe sarvasya pariṇāmitvasādhanāt
tamasā'pi ghaṭāderakhaṇḍane pūrvavadupalabdhi kinna bhavitumarhati, tasya tena upalabhyatayā'pyakhaṇḍanāt
tasya bāhyasya upalabhyātmano dṛśyasya kiñcidupalambhāvaraṇa sambhavati
sato'pi vā vidyamānasyāpi cāvaraṇasya tadātmānamakhaṇḍayato nityaśabdātmānamapracyāvayata sāmarthyatiraskārāyogāt jñānajananaśaktyabhibhavāyogāt
akiñcitkaraścārtha ka kasyāvaraṇa jñānavivandhakamanyadveti prakārāntareṇopaghātaka naiveti yāvat
akiñcitkarasya āvaraṇatva dṛṣṭamiti kathayannāha para–kuḍyādaya ityādi
kuḍyādayo ghaṭādīnā kamatiśayamutpādayanti kambā sāmarthyātiśaya khaṇḍayanti yenāvaraṇamiṣyante
tasmād yathā te'tiśayamanutpādayanto ghaṭādīnāmāvaraṇamiṣyante tathā nityasyāpi śabdasya kiñcidāvaraṇa bhaviṣyatītyabhiprāya
te kuḍyādaya kiñcid ghaṭādikamatiśāyayanti viśiṣṭa svabhāva kurvantīti na brūma
kathantarhyāvaraṇamucyanta ityāha–api tu na sarva ityādi

na sarvaghaṭakṣaṇā sarvasya puruṣasya indriyajñānahetava kintarhi parasparasahitāstu viṣayendriyālokāḥ parasparato viśiṣṭakṣaṇāntarotpādāt kāraṇād vijñānahetavaḥ te ca viṣayendriyādaya tena pratighātinā kuḍyādinā'vyavahitā yadā bhavanti tadā'nyonyasyopakāriṇa sati ca vyavadhāyake kuḍye anyasyotpitso samarthasya kṣaṇasya yathoktakāraṇābhāvenānutpatterjñānakāraṇavaikalyamata kāraṇavaikalyāt ghaṭādiṣu kuḍyādivyavahiteṣu jñānānutpattiriti kṛtvā kuḍyādaya āvaraṇamucyate na puna prāgvijñānajananayogyasya ghaṭāde pratibandhāt –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 361-62
kiñca, vyañjakavyāpārāt pūrvaṃ śabdasya kutaścit pramāṇāt siddhe sadbhāve āvaraṇaṃ siddhyet, spārśanapratyakṣapratipanne ghaṭe andhakārādivat, na cāsau siddhaḥ
yathā dīpo'nyathā vāpi ko viśeṣo'sya kārakāt
svapnatipattidvāreṇa anyapratipattiheturloke vyañjaka siddho dīpādivat, sa cetprāksiddha syāt
ye puna asiddhopalambhanā kārakā eva kulālādivad ghaṭādau
yadyasau vyaṅgya prāgasiddha syāttadā ko viśeṣo'sya vyañjakasya kārakāddhetoḥ
yata pramāṇāntareṇa śabdasadbhāve siddhe tasyāvaraṇa siddhayet spārśanapratyakṣapratipanne ghaṭe'ndhakārādivat
astu vā yathākathañcittepāmāvaraṇam, tathāpi tat dṛśyam, adṛśyam, nityam, anityam, vyāpakam, avyāpakam, ekam, anekaṃ vā syāt ? na tāvad dṛśyam; pratyakṣapramāṇataḥ tatpratītyabhāvāt

athādṛśyam; kathaṃ tadasti atiprasaṅgāt ? nanu nityasya sataḥ śabdasya uccāraṇāt prāganupalabdhau nimittāntarāsaṃbhavāt tannimittamadṛśyamapyāvaraṇaṃ kalpyate; ityapyasādhīyaḥ; anyonyāśrayānuṣaṅgāt–siddhe hi śabdasya āvaraṇe nityasya sato'sya uccāraṇāt prāganupalabdhisiddhiḥ, tasyāñca satyāṃ tadāvaraṇasiddhiriti
nanu pratyabhijñānāt śabdasya nityatvasiddheḥ uccāraṇāt prāk tadanupalabdhau nāvaraṇādanyannimittam, ityapi śraddhāmātram; pratyabhijñānasya tannityatvaprasādhakatvapratiṣedhāt
tulanā–tathāpi tadāvaraṇaṃ dṛśyadṛśya vā nityamanitya vā vyāpakamavyāpaka vā ekamaneka vetyaṣṭau vikalpā
nityatve ca āvaraṇasya sadā śabdasyānupalabdhiḥ syāt
anityatve tvasya pradhvastasya punarutpāde kāraṇābhāvāt sarvadā sarvasya upalambhaprasaṅgaḥ
vyāpakatve cāsya ubhayorapi āvāryāvārakayoḥ sarvagatatvāt kiṃ kasya āvārakaṃ syāt ? na hi ākāśamātmādī nāmāvārakaṃ pratītam
avyāpakatve tvasya nitarāṃ tena śabdasya āvāryatvānupapattiḥ, tanmadhye taddeśe pārśve ca vidyamānatvāt, pratyuta śabda evāsya āvārakaḥ syāt, anyathā sarṣapo'pi ghaṭasya āvārako bhavet
nanu bhūmyādinā ākāśasya tathāvidhasyāpi āvriyamāṇatvopalambhādadoṣo'yam, ityapyasat, tatpradeśasyaiva tena āvriyamāṇatvābhyupagamāt
śabdapradeśasyāpi vāyunā āvriyamāṇatvābhyupagame śabdasya sāvayavatvamanityatvañca syāt
tulanā–tadvattadāvārakamapi sarvagatamiti cet, na tarhyābārakam, na hyākāśamātmādīnāmāvārakam
yadyalpaparimāṇamapi vastu mahata āvāraka syāt tadā
tathā nikhilaśabdānāṃ yadi ekamevāvaraṇaṃ kalpyate, tadā ekopalambhe sarveṣāmupalambhaprasaṅgaḥ, tadāvaraṇāpagame tadvat sarveṣāmanāvṛtatvāt
atha vibhinnam; tanna; sarvaśabdānāṃ vyāpitayā samānadeśatve samānendriyagrāhyatve ca āvaraṇabhedasya vyañjakabhedasya cānupapatteḥ

tathāhi– śabdāḥ pratiniyatāvaraṇāvāryāḥ pratiniyatavyañjakavyaṅgyā vā na bhavanti, abhinnadeśatve sati ekendriyagrāhyatvāt, yaditthaṃ tattathā yathā ekaghaṭavṛttisāmānya-saṃkhyā-rūpa-parimāṇakarmādi, tathā caite śabdāḥ, tasmāttatheti
abhinnadeśatvāt ityucyamāne rūparasādibhirvyabhicāraḥ, teṣāmekadravyavṛttitve'pi pratiniyatavyañjakapratīteḥ, ataḥ ekendriyagrāhyatvāt ityuktam
tasmiṃścocyamāne bhinnadeśavyavasthitaghaṭādiniṣṭhaiḥ sāmānyādibhiḥ anekāntaḥ, tannivṛttyartham abhinnadeśatvāt ityabhihitam
kvacicchabdasyābhivyaktau tasya vyāpakatayā sarvadeśāvasthitapuruṣāṇāmupalambha syāt nirāvaraṇasya vyāpakatvāviśeṣāt
tulanā–niyamaśca na syāt, yadi cāneke śabdā yugapadākāśe vartante iti, evañca yatkiñcid vyañjakamupātta samānadeśān sarvānabhivyanaktīti yadā vīṇā bādyate tadā rāsabhadhvanirapi śrūyeta
na hi samānendriyagrāhyāṇā samānadeśānā vyañjakeṣu niyamo dṛṣṭa
yadyasya vyañjaka tena tasya vyaktiriti cet, tanna, adṛṣṭatvāt
atha manyase anekaśabdasannipāte sati vyañjakāni bhidyante vyañjakabhedānuvidhāyinyo vyaktaya pratiśabdamupajāyanta iti; tanna, adṛṣṭatvāt
na hi pradīpa ekendriyagrāhyamanekamarthaṃ yugapatsannipatita na prakāśayati
na ca gośabdābhivyaktyarthaṃ prerito vāyurnāśvaśabda vyanaktīti vācyam, vyañjakeṣu niyamānupalabdhe
śabdā vā vivādaviṣayā pratiniyatavyañjakavyagyā na bhavanti samānendriyagrāhyasamānadeśāvasthitatvāt ghaṭādivat
na ca samānakaraṇānā samānendriyagrāhyāṇāñca bhāvānā pratiniyatavyañjakavyagyatvamupalabdham
śrotra tāvatsamānendriyagrāhyasamānadeśasamānadharmāpannārthānā grahaṇāya pratiniyatasaskārakasaskāryaṃ na bhavati indriyatvāccakṣurvat
śabdā vā pratiniyatasaskārakasaskāryā na bhavanti samānendriyagrāhyasamānadharmāpannatve sati yugapadindriyasambaddhatvāt ghaṭādivat
na hiryasmāt samānadeśānām samānākṣaviṣayāṇāmetat niyatavyañjakatva nyāyyam
samānakaraṇānā tādṛśāmabhivyaktiniyamāyogāt sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣā sakulā śruti syāt
anyārthaṃ prerito vāyuḥ yathānyaṃ na karotiḥ vaḥ | tathānyavarṇasaṃskāraśakto nānyaṃ kariṣyati || 1
anyavarṇasaṃskāraśakta iti anyavarṇapratītyarthaḥ saskāro yaḥ śrotrasya so'nyavarṇasaṃskāraśabdenokta na tu varṇasaskāra eva śrotrasaskārasya prakṛtatvāt
nānyaṃ kariṣyati iti nānyaṃ varṇaṃ śrotrasaskāradvāreṇa saṃskariṣyatītyartha
ekopalambhe sarveṣāmupalambhaprasaṅga ityupālambhasya samādhānamida mīmāsakena proktam –ā॰ ṭi॰
yadi ca tālvādayo dhvanayo vā śabdānāṃ vyañjakāḥ; tarhi tadvyāpāre niyamena upalabdhirna syāt
kārakavyāpāro hyeṣaḥ–svasannidhāne niyamena kāryasannidhāpanaṃ nāma, na vyañjakavyāpāraḥ
na khalu yatra yatra vyañjakaḥ pradīpādiḥ tatra tatra vyaṅgyasya ghaṭādeḥ sannidhānamupalabdhirvā niyamato'sti kāraka-vyañjakayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgāt, cakrādivyāpāravaiyarthyānuṣaṅgācca
atha ghaṭāderasarvagatatvānna vyañjakasannidhāne niyamataḥ sannidhāna mupalambho vā, śabdasya tu bhavati viparyayāt; tadapyacarcitābhidhānam; tatsarvagatatvāsiddheḥ
tathāhi–śabdaḥ sarvagato na bhavati sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati bāhyendriyapratyakṣatvāt ghaṭādivat
tato ghaṭādibhyaḥ śabdasya viśeṣābhāvād ubhayoḥ kāryatvaṃ vyaṅgyatvaṃ vā'viśeṣato'bhyupagantavyam
nahi kadācid vyāpṛteṣu karaṇeṣu śabdānupalabdhi, na cāvaśyaṃ vyañjakavyāpāro'rthamupalambhayati kvacit prakāśe'pi ghaṭānupalabdhe
kiñca karaṇānā samagrāṇā vyāpārāt parispandādilakṣaṇāt niyamena śabdasya upalabdhitaḥ kāraṇāt kāryatva prāptam
kiṃ kāraṇam ? vyañjake hetau tadasambhavāt niyamena vyaṅgyasyopalambhāsaṃbhavāt
vyañjakavyāpṛtau na syād vyaṅgyasya niyamād gati nāvaśyambhāvaniyama syācchru teruccāraṇāttata
na kaścidviśeṣahetuḥ tālvādayo vyañjakā na punaścakrādayo'pi iti
te vā ghaṭādeḥ kārakā na puna śabdasya tālvādayo'pīti
sannidhāpayati ca tālvādivyāpṛtirniyamena śabda tato nāsau tālvādīnā vyaṅgyaḥ cakrādīnā ghaṭādivat
yadi ca tālvādayo dhvanayo vāsya –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 415
prāk sataḥ svarūpasaskāraka hi vyañjakam, asataḥ svarūpanirvartaka kārakam

tulanā–vyāpina śabdā nityāśca, tato vyāpinityatvācchabdānā vyañjakasya karaṇasya vyāpārāt sarvatropalabdhi ghaṭādayastu na vyāpina nāpi nityā tena te vyañjakavyāpāreṇa nāvaśyamupalabhyanta iti, yadyeva ka idānī ghaṭādiṣu samāśvāsa niścaya, yathā te na nityā nāpi vyāpina iti yāvatā te'pi nityā vyāpinaśca bhavantu
naiṣa doṣa sarvagatatvādvarṇānāmityapi vārtam; pramāṇavalāyātatvābhāvāt anyatrāpi tathābhāvānuṣaṅgāt
tulanā– tadukta na ca sarvagatā'mūrtanityaikātmā'tra yujyate
na sarvagata śabda sāmānyaviśeṣavattve sati vāhyaikendriyapratyakṣatvāt ghaṭādivat

kiñca, ete dhvanayaḥ kutaḥ pratipannāḥ yena tadadhīnā śabdaśrutiḥ syāt–pratyakṣeṇa, anumānena, arthāpattyā vā ? pratyakṣeṇa cet; kiṃ śrautreṇa, spārśanena vā ? na tāvat śrautreṇa; tathā pratītyabhāvāt
nahi śabdavat śrotre dhvanayaḥ pratibhāsante, vipratipattyabhāvaprasaṅgāt
tatra tatpratibhāsābhyupagame ca aparaśabdakalpanāvaiyarthyam, dhvanīnāmeva śrāvaṇasvabhāvatayā śabdatvaprasaṅgāt

atha spārśanapratyakṣeṇa dhvanayaḥ pratīyante, svakarapihitavadano hi vadan svakarasaṃsparśanena tān pratipadyate, ityapyasāmpratam; vāyuvat tālvādivyāpārānantaraṃ vipruṣāmupalambhataḥ śabdābhivyañjakatvaprasaṅgāt
vaktṛmukhapradeśa eva tāsāṃ prakṣayataḥ śrotṛśrotrapradeśe gamanābhāvānna tad, ityanyatrāpi samānam
na khalu vāyavo'pi tatra gacchantaḥ pratyakṣata pratīyante
yathā ca stimitabhāpiṇo na vipruṣāmupalambhaḥ tathā vāyūpalambhopi nāsti
etena vadato mukhāgrasthitatūlādeḥ preraṇopalambhāt anumānato dhvanīn pratipadyate; ityapi pratyuktam; tadvad vipruṣāmapi ataḥ pratipattiprasaṅgāt
tulanā–dhvanaya eva hi viśiṣṭā varṇarūpā vācakā
kiṃ kāraṇam ? yato na vayamavācaka dhvaniṃ śabdañca vācaka pūyagrūpamiti dhvanibhyo bhinnasvabhāvamupalakṣayāma tasmāt dhvaniviśeṣa evākārādirūpeṇa sthita varṇāsya –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 368

tena drutoccārito dhvaniviśeṣa drutā gavyaktirucyate, madhyoccārito madhyagavyakti, bilambitoccāritā dhvaniviśeṣo bilambitā gavyakti na tu vyañjakebhyo dhvanibhyo'nyo gakāra pratibhāsate –pramāṇavā॰ svavṛ॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 382
yadyattālvādivyāpārānantaramupalabhyate tattacchadābhivyañjakaṃ yathā vāyu tathā ca vipruṣa iti –ā॰ ṭi॰
atha arthāpattyā dhvanayaḥ pratīyante; tathāhi–śabdastāvat nityatvāt notpadyate, saskṛtireva tu kriyate, sā ca viśiṣṭā nopapadyeta yadi dhvanayo na syuḥ
tathā hi santi śabdavyañjakā dhvanaya śabdapratipattyanyathānupapatteḥ
nanvevamaviśeṣe kimiti saskāraviśeṣotpattirevāṅgīkriyate na śabdaviśeṣotpattirata āha–śabdeti
prāganupajātapaścādupajātaśabdopalambhānupapattyā'vaśya kalpanīye kasmiścit pratyakṣatayā śabdotpatterniṣedhāt saskārakalpanaiva yukteti
tadapyacāru; yataḥ keyaṃ viśiṣṭā saṃskṛtirnāma–śabdasaṃskāraḥ, śrotrasaṃskāraḥ, ubhayasaṃskāro vā ? trividho hi saṃskāro mīmāṃsakairiṣṭaḥ
sā'bhivyakti śabdasya bhavantī vāyavīyai sayogavibhāgaiḥ śabdasaṃskārādvā bhavet indriyasaṃskārādvā ubhayasya vā śabdasyendriyasya ca saskārāt
tatra ya sthira sadhanāndhakāravat śabdamāvṛtyāste tasya ca vaktṛprayatnasamutthena vāyunā sayogavibhāgā utpadyante
taiśca sayogavibhāgai tasya sthirasya vāyorapanaya kriyate sa eva ca śabdasya saskāro nānya svalakṣaṇapuṣṭyādi tasya nityatvenaikarūpatvāt

tatrādyapakṣe ko'yaṃ śabdasaṃskāro nāma–śabdasyopalabdhiḥ, ātmabhūtaḥ kaścida tiśayaḥ, anatiśayavyāvṛttiḥ, svarūpaparipoṣa, vyaktisamavāyaḥ, tadgrahaṇāpekṣagrahaṇatā, vyañjakasannidhimātram, āvaraṇavigamo vā ? yadi śabdasya upalabdhiḥ; kathamasau dhvanīnāṃ gamikā śabdaśrotramātrabhāvitvāttasyāḥ ? tathāpyanyanimittakalpane hetūnāmanavasthitiḥ
ātmabhūtaḥ kaścidatiśayaḥ anatiśayavyāvṛttirvā, ityatrāpi atiśayaḥ– dṛśyasvabhāva eva, anatiśayavyāvṛttiśca adṛśyasvabhāvakhaṇḍanameva
te ca tato bhinne, abhinne vā vidhīyete ? yadi bhinne; tadā tatkaraṇe śabdasya na kiñcitkṛtamiti tadavasthā asya aśrutiḥ syāt
atha abhinne, tarhi śabdasyāpi tadvat kāryatānupaṅgādanityatvaprasaktiḥ
yo hi yasmādabhinnasvabhāvaḥ tatkaraṇe tasyāpi karaṇam yathā atiśayānatiśayavyāvṛttisvarūpasya, tābhyāmabhinnasvabhāvaśca śabda iti
tulanā–bhavantī vā kāraṇebhyo'tiśayavattā vā śabdasya vyakti āvaraṇavigamo vijñānaṃ vā gatyantarābhāvāt
yata evantasmāt na vyakti śabdasya kāraṇebhya kintūtpattireva

bhavantī vā kāraṇebhyaḥ sakāśād vyaktistridhā bhavet–pūrvāvasthāparityāgena atiśayavattā vā śabdasya vyaktirbhavet, upalambhāvaraṇavigamo vā, śabdālambana vijñāna vā vyakti, prakāratrayavyatirekeṇa gatyantarābhāvāt
atiśayo dṛśyasvabhāva eva anatiśayavyāvṛttistvadṛśyasvabhāvakhaṇḍanameva, te cettato'nye, tatkaraṇe'pi śabdasya na kiñcitkṛtamiti tadavasthā'syā'śruti
adṛśya san atiśaye jāte dṛśyo jāta –ā॰ ṭi॰
–tau ca tato bhinnau abhinnau vā ā॰
kiñca, śrotrapradeśa eva asya dhvanibhiḥ saskāraḥ kriyeta, sarvatrāpi vā ? prathamapakṣe tāvanmātraka eva śabdaḥ syāt na sarvagataḥ
dṛśyetararūpatā caikasya brahmavāda samarthayate, cetanetararūpatayāpi ekasya tadvadavasthityavirodhāt
ghaṭāderapi caivaṃ sarvagatatvānuṣaṅgaḥ, so'pi hi dṛśyapradeśe dṛśyaḥ anyatra cādṛśya iti vadato na vaktraṃ vakrībhavet
sarvatra cāsya saskāre sarvatra sarvadā upalabdhiḥ syāt, na vā kvacit kadācidaviśeṣāt
śrotrapradeśa eva cāsya saskāre tāvanmātraka eva śabda na sarvagata syāt
nāpi vyaktisamavāyaḥ; anabhyupagamāt, anyathā śabdasya sāmānyādirūpatāprasaṅgaḥ
nāpi vyañjakasannidhimātram; sarvatra sarvadā sarvapratipattṛbhiḥ sarvaśabdānāṃ grahaṇaprasaṅgāt
mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 69–71 iti; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, indriyasaṃskārapakṣe'pi sakṛt saṃskṛtasya śrotrasya yugapannikhilaśabdaprakāśakatvaprasaṅgāt

nahi añjanādinā saṃskṛtaṃ cakṣuḥ sannihitaṃ svaviṣayaṃ nīladhavalādikaṃ kañcit paśyati kañcinneti, balautalādinā saṃskṛtaṃ śrotraṃ vā kāṃścedava gakārādivarṇān śṛṇoti kāṃścinneti niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ, yenātrāpi tathā kalpanā syāt
mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 42–43 iti, pradīpādyanugṛhītacakṣuṣā yugapad ghaṭādyanekārthagrahaṇavat dhvanyanugṛhītaśrotreṇa ekadā anekaśabdagrahaṇaprasaṅgāt
prayogaḥ–śrotram ekendriyagrāhyā'bhinnadeśasthitārthagrahaṇāya pratiniyatasaṃskārakasaṃskāryaṃ na bhavati indriyatvāt cakṣurvat
athāpīndriyasaṃskāraḥ sopyadhiṣṭhānadeśataḥ | śabdaṃ na śroṣyati śrotraṃ tenāsaṃskṛtaśaṣkuli || 1

yadyapyadhiṣṭhānasaskārakāriṇo nādāstaddeśendriyasaskārakā vā, tathāpi prāptā eva santa saskārabhāji padārthe saskāraṃ kurvanti nāprāptā ityato na sarvapuruṣādhiṣṭhānādisaskāra –tattvasaṃ॰ paṃ॰ pṛ॰ 606
aprāptakarṇadeśatvāt dhvanerna śrotrasaṃskriyā | ato'dhiṣṭhānabhedena saṃskāraniyamaḥ sthitaḥ || 2
yasyaiva karṇadeśa dhvani prāpta tasyaiva śrotrasaskāraḥ –ā॰ ṭi॰

indriyasaskārasyonmīlanālokāde sakṛdindriyasambandhayogyasarvārthopalabdhyanukūlasaskārajanakatva dṛṣṭaṃ tadvadvāyurapi sakṛdeva sarvaśabdopalabdhyanukūlaṃ śrotre saskāramādadhyāt tathā ca sarvaśabdopalabdhi syāt
nanvevamapi aśeṣaśabdopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ, saskṛte hi śrotre sarveṣā sānnidhyāt
valātailādinā saskṛta śrotraṃ vā kāścideva gakārādīn śṛṇoti kāścinneti niyamo dṛṣṭa
yathā ghaṭāderdīpādirabhivyañjaka iṣyate | cakṣuṣo'nugrahādevaṃ dhvaniḥ syāt śrotrasaṃskṛteḥ
tejasaścākṣuṣasya āpyāyanānugraha kurvan pradīpo yathā cākṣuṣāṇā ghaṭādīnā vyañjako bhavati tathā dhvanayo'pi śrotrasaskāra kurvanta śabdasyābhivyañjakā bhaviṣyantīti
na ca paryanuyogo'tra kenākāreṇa saskṛtiḥ | utpattāvapi tulyatvāt śaktistatrāpyatīndriyā
taduktam– dvayasaskārapakṣe tu vṛthā doṣadvaye vacaḥ

iti; tadapyayuktam; uktadoṣānuṣaṅgādeva; tathāhi–yadā ekavarṇagrāhakatvena saṃskṛtaṃ śrotraṃ saṃskṛta varṇaṃ pratipadyate tadā tatratyasarvavarṇānapi pratipadyeta, saskṛtañca varṇaṃ sarvatra sarvadā sthitatvena, anyathā tatpratītireva na syāt tadātmakatvāttasya
dvayasaskārapakṣe tu vṛthā doṣadvaye vacaḥ | yenānyataravaikalyāt sarvaiḥ sarvo na gṛhyate
śrotrasaskāravaikalyānna sarvai puruṣai śrūyate, śabdasaskāravaikalyācca na sarva śabda, samuccitayordvayo kāraṇatvāt
saskāradvayapakṣe tu vṛthā doṣadvaya hi tat
anyatarasya śrotrasaskārasya arthasaskārasya vā vaikalyāt na śabdo gamyate
tathāhi–satyapi śabdasaskāre badhirasya śrotrasaskāravaikalyānna śabdagrahaṇam, abadhirasyāpyanabhivyakte śabdasyāgrahaṇam
yadaikavarṇagrāhakatvena saskṛta śrotra saskṛta varṇaṃ pratipadyate tadā tatratyasarvavarṇān pratipadyeta
tadākāśadeśe sarveṣāmapi varṇānā vyāpitayā nityatayā ca vidyamānatvāt
yadi saskṛta varṇaṃ sarvatra sarvadā'vasthitatvena na jānāti tadā
tato nityaikarūpatve śabdasya āvāryāvārakabhāvasya vyaṅgyavyañjakabhāvasya vā'nupapatteḥ nāvaraṇakṛtā prāguccāraṇādasyā'nupalabdhiḥ
ataḥ tālvādivyāpārāna ntaramasyopalambhāt tadabhāve cānupalambhāt tatkāryatvameva abhyupagantavyam
nanukhananādyanantaraṃ vyoma upalabhyate tadabhāve ca nopalabhyate, naca tattatkāryam, ato'naikāntikatvamasya
mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 19 ākāśamapi nityaṃ sad yadā bhūmijalāvṛtam
mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 30–33 iti; tadapyasundaram; ekasvabhāvatvasya ākāśe'pyasiddhatvāt
taddhi tatsvabhāvaṃ sat svavipayajñānajananaikasvarūpam, tadviparītaṃ vā syāt ? yadi tajjananaikasvarūpam; tadā tasya na khananādyanantarameva upalabdhiḥ, kintu pūrvamapi syāt
kathañcaivaṃ dhvanīnāmapi prāksattvasiddhirna syāt ? ya eva pūrvamakārasya vyañjako dhvaniḥ sa eva paścādapi iti pratīteḥ
tathā ca vyaṅgyavad vyañjakasyāpi sarvatra sadbhāvasiddheḥ tālvādivyāpāravaiyarthyam, sarvatra sarvadā vyaṅgyapratītiśca syāt
anena āvṛta śabdo nopalabhyate asannikṛṣṭendriyavyavadhānādityevamādi anupalabdhikāraṇa na gṛhyate iti so'yamanuccārito nāstīti
ūrdhvañcoccāraṇānna śrūyate sa bhūtvā na bhavati abhāvānna śrūyate iti
anaikāntikatā tāvāddhetūnāmiha kathyate | prayatnānantaraṃ dṛṣṭirnitye'pi na viruddhyate
tāvacchabdenāsiddhatāpi vakṣyata iti prayatnānantaradarśanādityasya tāvadanaikāntikatva darśayati–prayatneti
darśana hi tatra sattā gamayati na kālāntare niṣedhati, tena vipakṣe'pi kālāntare sattvasabhavāttatra darśanamanaikāntikamiti
ākāśamapi nityaṃ sad yadā bhūmijalāvṛtam | vyajyate tadapohena khananotsecanādibhiḥ
prayatnānantaraṃ jñānaṃ tadā tatrāpi vidyate | tenā'naikāntiko heturyaduktaṃ tatra darśanam
dhvanyutpattāveva tālvādīnāmupayoga te ca sarvadā santīti
etenedamapi pratyuktam–anyadāpi yat śabdasyoccāraṇaṃ tadasyābhivyañjakam uccā raṇatvāt ityādi, dhvanāvapyasya samānatvāt
tathāhi–anyadāpi yad dhvaneruccāraṇaṃ tattasyābhivyañjakam uccāraṇatvāt idānīṃ taduccāraṇavat
mī॰ ślo॰ śabdani॰ ślo॰ 366 ityetadapi pratyuktam, dhvanerapi pratyabhijñānāt pūrvottarakāladvayāvasthāyinaḥ prasiddhasya paścāt kenacinnāśānupapatteḥ

yadapyabhihitam–vivādādhyāsitaḥ kālo gādisambaddhaḥ kālatvāt ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram, gādeḥ upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya kālāntare'nupalambhato'bhāvasiddheḥ, tatra tatsadbhāvāvedakānumānasya bādhitapakṣatayā kālātyayāpadiṣṭahetutayā ca agamakatvāt
vidyudāderapi caivaṃ nityatva syāt, tathāhi–vivādādhyāsitaḥ kālo vidyudādisambaddhaḥ, kālatvāt vidyudādisambaddhakālavat
ata eva nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇatvāt ityādyapyayuktam; udāttādibhirdhvanidharmaiḥ anaikāntikatvācca, tehi śrāvaṇatve'pi anityā bhavadbhi pratijñātāḥ
teṣāmaśrāvaṇatve śrotreṇa śabdagatadharmatayā upalambho na syāt, yadaśrāvaṇasvarūpaṃ na tasya śabdadharmatayā śrotreṇopalambhaḥ yathā nīlatvādeḥ, aśrāvaṇasvarūpāśca udāttādayo dhvanidharmā iti
tulanā–gāderuccāraṇādanantara vināśasya pratyakṣapratipannatvena pratipādanāt –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 689
te hi śravaṇagrāhyatve'pi na nityā bhavadbhiraṅgīkṛtā
teṣāmaśrāvaṇatve tu nīlādīnāmiva śrotreṇopalambho na bhavet
yaccānyaduktam–deśakālādibhinnā gośabdavyaktibuddhayaḥ ityādi; tadapi na sādhīyaḥ; gośabdalipibuddhyā hetoranaikāntikatvāt, sā hi gauḥ ityutpadyate na ca sampratyutpannagośabdabuddhyekaviṣayā iti
tataśca akhilavastubuddhīnām ekaghaṭalakṣaṇavastuviṣayatve ghaṭabuddhitvameva syāt na gośabdabuddhitvam

ataḥ kathaṃ deśādibhinnagośabdavyaktibuddhīnāṃ dharmitvam, kathaṃ vā gośabdabuddhitvaṃ hetuḥ, sampratyutpannagośabdabuddhivaditi dṛṣṭānto vā siddhyet yato'numānaṃ syāt ? atha gavāśvādivastubhedasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt tadbuddhīnāmekaghaṭaviṣayatve sādhye vastubuddhitvāt ityasya kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvam agneranuṣṇatve dravyatvavadityucyate, yadyevam, udāttādidharmabhedena gośabdavyaktibhedasyāpi pratyakṣasiddhatvāt tadbuddhīnāmapi ekaviṣayatve sādhye gorityutpadyamānatvāt ityasyāpi kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvaṃ syāt
sā hi gaurityullekhenotpadyate na caikagośabdabiṣayā deśakālādibhinnatvād gośabdalipīnām
anyā hi lipibuddhi anyā hi gośabdabuddhi –ā॰ ṭi॰
yadapyabhihitam–hyastano gośabdo'dyāpyanuvarttate ityādi, tadapyabhidhānamātram; hyastanā'dyatanagośabdayorbhedasya pratyakṣaprasiddhatvena tadabhedaprasādhanasya kālātyayāpadiṣṭatvāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktuṃ hyastano vidyutprakāśo'dyāpyanuvarttate vidyutprakāśatvāt adyatanavidyutprakāśavaditi

atha tīvrā vidyut tīvratarā tīvratameti pratyakṣataḥ tīvrādidharmātmakatayā vidyutprakāśasya vibhinnasvabhāvasya pratīteḥ na tadaikyaprasādhakamanumānaṃ gamakam; tadanyatrāpi samānam–gośabdasyāpi tīvrādidharmopetasya śrotrapratyakṣe pratibhāsanāt
taddharmasya atraupādhikatve vidyutyapi asya tadastu viśeṣābhāvāt
atha śuddhāyāḥ vidyutaḥ kadācidapyasaṃvedanāt na tatrāsyaupādhikatvam; tadetat śabde'pyaviśiṣṭam, nahi taddharmaśūnyaḥ sopi svapne'pi pratibhāsate
etena adyatano vā gośabdaḥ hyo'pyāsīt ityādi prativyūḍham; nyāyasya samānatvāt
tulanā– svābhāvikatvāvadhāraṇanyāyasya yatra tatra prasiddhasya atrāpi tulyatvāt
na hi payasi śaityadravatve tejasi vā bhāsvaratvoṣṇatve svābhāvike ityatrānyatpramāṇa pratyakṣāt –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 690
yadapyuktam–śabdo vācako dīrghakālāvasthāyī ityādi; tadapi ceṣṭayā anaikāntikam, tasyāḥ sambandhabalena arthamatihetutve'pi dīrghakālāvasthāyitvābhāvāt
etena yastvasthiraḥ sa sambandhabalena nārthaṃ bodhayati ityādi pratyākhyātam, ceṣṭāyāḥ sambandhabalena arthabodhakatve'pi tādātvikanimittatvasaṃbhavāt
tato'yuktametat– kañcitkālaṃ sthiraḥ śabdaḥ sarvakālamapi sthiraḥ

iti, yataḥ kañcitkālāvasthāyitva kim upalambhakālāvasthāyitvamabhipretam, atītavarttamānakālāvasthāyitvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe ceṣṭāyā vidyudādeśca sarvakālamapi sthāyitvaprasaṅgaḥ, tathāvidhakiyatkālasthiratvasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt
atītavarttamānakālāvasthāyitvañcāsya na kutaścit siddhyati ityukta prāgeva
yat kādācitkaṃ na tat vināśahetuśūnyam yathā vidyudādi, kādācitkaśca śabda iti
tulanā– kādācitkatvācca śabde tadasiddham –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 692
yadapi–vivādādhyāsitaḥ kālo gādiśabdaśūnyo na bhavati ityādyuktam; tadapi vidyudādau samānatvādayuktam
tathāhi–vivādādhyāsitaḥ kālo vidyudādiśūnyo na bhavati kālatvāt tatsattvopetakālavat
tulanā– tadapi vidyudādau tulyatvādayuktam –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 692
yadapyuktam–nityaḥ śabdaḥ tato'rthapratipattyanyathānupapatteḥ ityādi, tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, dhūmādivadanityasyāpyasya sādṛśyato'rthapratipādakatvopapatteḥ
na khalu ya eva saṅketakāle dṛṣṭaḥ tenaiva arthapratītiḥ karttavyā iti niyamo'sti, mahānasadṛṣṭadhūmasadṛśādapi parvatadhūmād vahnipratipattipratīteḥ
na ca parvatamahānasapradeśavartinyoḥ dhūmavyaktyoraikyaṃ saṃbhavati, pratītivirodhāt, sarvasya sarvagatatvānuṣaṅgācca

atha dhūmasāmānyasya atra gamakatvam, śabdasāmānyasya anyatra vācakatvaṃ kinna syāt ? nanu śabdasāmānyasya vācakatve śabdasya kimāyātam ? tarhi dhūmasāmānyasyāpyanumāpakatve dhūmasya kimāyātam ? atha dhūmāttasyā'bhedāt tadanumāpakatve dhūmasyāpyanumāpakatvam, tarhi śabdāt tatsāmānyasyāpyabhedāt tadvācakatve tasyāpi vācakatvamastu aviśeṣāt

atha śabde sāmānyameva nāsti tatkathamasya vācakatvamucyate, dhūme'pi tarhi tannāsti tatkasya gamakatvamucyeta ? atha tadbhedasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt dhūmo dhūmaḥ ityasandigdhā'bādhyamānā'nugatapratītidarśanāt asti tatra tat, tadetadanyatrāpi samānam

nanu śabdavyaktīnāṃ pratyakṣato bhedaprasiddheḥ tatra iṣṭameva śabdatvasāmānyam, gādīnāṃ tu ekaikavyaktikatvena bhedābhāvānna tatra gatvādisāmānyaṃ saṃbhavatīti tatra tasyaṃ vācakatvābhāvaḥ, tadapyasāmpratam, teṣāmapi udāttādibhedato nānāvyaktikatvasaṃbhavād gatvādisāmānyasadbhāvopapatteḥ
dhvanidharmā eva udāttādayaḥ iti ca manorathamātram, teṣāṃ taddharmatvasya prāgeva kṛtottaratvāt
prasādhitañca nityasambandhaparīkṣāvasare anityatva eva śabdasya vācakatvamityalamatiprasaṅgena

tatra yatra gakāraukāravisarjanīyānāmitthambhūtānupūrvīmupalabhase tatra tatra gotvaviśiṣṭo'rtha pratipattavya pratipādayitavyaśceti saṅketagrahe sati tathāvidha śabdamupalabhamāna tamarthaṃ pratipadyate pratipādayati ceti
mahānasīyaparvatīyādibhedena dhūmavyaktīnāmanekatvādasti tatrānugataṃ dhūmatvākhya sāmānyam, gādiśabdastu eka ata katha tatra śabdatvam vyakterabhedasya jātibādhakatvādityāśayena śaṅkate atheti
yaccānyaduktam–sādṛśyasya vicāryamāṇasyānupapatteḥ ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; tasya ābālamabādhapratītigocaracāritayā apahnotumaśakyatvāt
ekasya hi svasāmagrīto yādṛśaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tādṛśa evāparasya sādṛśyaṃ yamalakavat
tacca vyaktibhyo bhinnamabhinnañca sāmānyaparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake saprapañcaṃ prapañcitamiti kṛtaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
tato yad yadrūpatayā kutaścidapi pramāṇānna pratīyate na tattadrūpatayā'bhyupagantavyam yathā jagad advaitarūpatayā, sarvathā nityasvabhāvatayā na pratīyate ca kutaścitpramāṇāt śabda iti
tulanā–svahetorekasya hi yādṛśa pariṇāma tādṛśa evāparasya sādṛśya na tu sa eva
tacca pramāṇam–anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakatvāt, yatkṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, kṛtakaścāyamiti
na cedamasiddham; tathāhi–kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ, kāraṇānvayavyatirekānu vidhāyitvāt, yaditthaṃ taditthaṃ yathā ghaṭaḥ, tathā ca śabdaḥ, tasmāttatheti
nacedamapyasiddham, tālvādikāraṇavyāpāre satyeva asyātmalābhopalambhāt tadabhāve cānupalambhāt mṛddaṇḍādikāraṇavyāpārabhāvābhāvayoḥ ghaṭasya ātmalābhā'lābhopalambhavat
na ca tadvyāpāre tadabhivyaktereva ātmalābho na śabdasya ityabhidhātavyam, tasyāḥ prāgeva prapañcato'pāstatvāditi
kā punariyamarthadeśanā kāraṇavattvāditi ? utpattidharmakatvādanitya śabda iti, bhūtvā na bhavati vināśadharmaka iti
sāśayikametat–kimutpattikāraṇa sayogavibhāgau śabdasya āhosvidabhivya- ktikāraṇamityata āha–aindriyakatvāt indriyapratyāsattigrāhya aindriyakaḥ
kimaya vyajjakena samānadeśo'bhivyajyate rūpādivat, atha sayogajācchabdācchabdasantāne sati śrotrapratyāsanno gṛhyata iti ? sayoganivṛttau śabdagrahaṇānna vyañjakena samānadeśasya grahaṇam
dāruvraścane dāruparaśusayoganivṛttau dūrasthena śabdo gṛhyate, na ca vyañjakābhāve vyaṅgyagrahaṇaṃ bhavati tasmānna vyañjaka sayogaḥ…itaśca śabda utpadyate nābhivyajyate kṛtakavadupacārāt
tīvra mandamiti kṛtakamupacaryate tīvra sukha manda sukha tīvra duḥkha manda duḥkhamiti, upacaryate ca tīvra śabdo manda śabda iti
anitya śabda tīvramandaviṣayatvāt duḥkhavaditi kṛtakavadupacārādityanena sūtreṇa sarvānityatvasādhanavargasagraha kṛtakatvagrahaṇasya udāharaṇārthatvāt
yathā sāmānyaviśeṣavato'smadādibāhyakaraṇapratyakṣatvāt, upalabhyasya anupalabdhikāraṇābhāve satyanupalabdhe, guṇasya sato'smadādibāhyakaraṇapratyakṣatvāt ityevamādi
ato yatnajanitavarṇādyātmā śravaṇamadhyasvabhāva prāk paścādapi pudgalānā nāstīti tāvāneva dhvanipariṇāma

tasmādvarṇo na nityo'nityo vā sattve satyutpattimattvāt, asmadādivahirindriyagrāhyatve sati jātimattvāt, asmadādipratyakṣaguṇatvādvā, ātmaikatvapratyakṣatvapakṣe pratyakṣaviśeṣaguṇatvāt, vyāpakasamavetapratyakṣaviśeṣaguṇatvāt, anātmapratyakṣaguṇatvāt, avyāpyavṛttitvāt, vahirindriyavyavasthāhetuguṇatvāt, bhūtapratyakṣaguṇatvāt, utkarṣāpakarṣaśabdapravṛttinimittajātimattvādvetyādi
tadeva varṇānāṃ pauruṣeyatvaprasiddhau padavākyānāmanāyāsataḥ tatprasiddhyati tadātmakatvātteṣām
nanvastu laukikānāṃ teṣāṃ tatsiddhiḥ na vaidikānāmiti cet, na; tadatyantavailakṣaṇyāpratīteḥ
ya eva hi laukikā śabdāḥ ta eva vaidikāḥ śābarabhā॰ 1

tadapauruṣeyatvaprasādhakapramāṇābhāvācca; na ca tadabhāvo'siddhaḥ, yataḥ tatprasādhaka pramāṇa pratyakṣam, anyadvā bhavet ? na tāvatpratyakṣam; tasya śabdasvarūpamātragrahaṇe caritārthatvena tatpauruṣeyatvā'pauruṣeyatvagrāhakatvā'saṃbhavāt

tulanā–yadā ca varṇā eva na nityāstadā kaiva kayā puruṣavivakṣādhīnānupūrvyādiviśiṣṭavarṇasamūharūpāṇā padānā kutastarāñca tatsamūharūpasya vākyasya kutastamāñca tatsamūhasya vedasyeti –tattvaci॰ śabda॰ pṛ॰ 464

kiñca, anādisattvasvarūpamapauruṣeyatvam, tatkatham akṣaprabhavapratyakṣaparicchedyam ? akṣāṇāṃ pratiniyatarūpādigocaracāritayā anādikālenā'sambandhāt tatkālasambaddhasattvenāpyasambandhataḥ tajjñānā'hetutvāt
nanu mā bhūt pratyakṣatastadapauruṣeyatvasiddhiḥ, anumānāttu sā bhaviṣyati
taccānumānam–apauruṣeyo vedaḥ karttuḥ smaraṇayogyatve sati asmaryamāṇakarttṛkatvād vyomavat
na cāyamasiddhaḥ; vedakarttuḥ kadācit kenacit smaraṇābhāvāt
sataścāsya tadarthānuṣṭhānasamaye anuṣṭhātṝṇāmaniścitaprāmāṇyānāṃ tatprāmāṇyaprasiddhaye smaraṇaṃ syāt

ye hi yadarthānuṣṭhāne pravarttante te avaśyaṃ tacchāstrakarttāramanusmaranti yathā aṣṭakādyarthānuṣṭhānārthina tatpraṇetāraṃ manum, vedavihitārthānuṣṭhāne bahuvittavyayāyāsasādhyā'gniṣṭomādikarmalakṣaṇe pravarttante ca prekṣāpūrvakāriṇaḥ, atasteṣāṃ mahatī tatkarttṛsmaraṇāpekṣā
tehi adṛṣṭaphaleṣu karmasu evaṃ niḥsaśayāḥ pravartteran yadi teṣāṃ tadviṣayaḥ satyatāniścayaḥ syāt
na cāsau tadupadeṣṭuḥ smaraṇābhāve ghaṭate pitrādyupadeśavat
yathaiva hi pitrādikamupadeṣṭāra smṛtvā svayamadṛṣṭaphaleṣvaṣi karmasu tadupadeśāt pitrādibhiretadupadiṣṭa tenā'nuṣṭhīyate iti, evaṃ vaidikeṣvapi karmasu anuṣṭhīyamāneṣu karttuḥ smaraṇaṃ syāt
na cābhiyuktānāmapi vedārthānuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ traivarṇikānāṃ tatsmaraṇamasti, ato'sau tatra nāstīti niścīyate
katha punaridamavagamyata apauruṣeya eva sambandha iti ? puruṣasya sambandhurabhāvāt
katha sambandhā nāsti ? pratyakṣasya pramāṇasyābhāvāt tatpūrvakatvāccetareṣām
na ca himavadādiṣu kūpārāmādivadasmaraṇa bhavitumarhati, puruṣaviyogo hi teṣu bhavati deśotsādena kulotsādena vā
syādetat–sambandhamātravyavahāriṇo niṣprayojana kartṛsmaraṇamanādriyamāṇā vismareyuriti, tanna; yadi hi puruṣa kṛtvā sambandha vyavahārayet vyavahārakāle avaśya smartavyo bhavati
sapratipattau hi kartṛvyavahartrorartha siddhyati na vipratipattau
na hi vṛddhiśabdena apāṇinervyavaharata ādaica pratīyeran pāṇinikṛtimananumanyamānasya vā
tathā makāreṇa apiṅgalasya na sarvagurustrika pratīyeta piṅgalakṛtimananumanyamānasya vā
tena vede vyavaharadbhiravaśyaṃ smaraṇīya sambandhasya karttā syāt vyavahārasya ca
tasmāt kāraṇādavagacchāmo na kṛtvā sambandha vyavahārārthaṃ kenacidvedā praṇītā iti
na svaśaktyā tadāptatva mitau na smaryate katham

yadā hi kaścit padapadārthasambandha kṛtvā dharmādharmapratipādanāya bedavākyāni kṛtavān tadā'vaśyamasau sambandhasya kartā, sa eva ca tai padaiḥ vedavākyaracanātmaka vyavahāraṃ karotīti samayavyavahārayorekakartṛtva pratipatṛbhi smartavyam, tathā ca vākyādartha pratipadyamānānāmavaśya vākyakarturāptatva pratipatṛbhi smatarvyam, tadadhīnatvādarthaniścayasya, na vedādartha pratipadyamānā samayakartāra tena saha vedakarturekatva tasya cāptatva smaranto dṛśyanta iti
evaṃ gāmānayetyevamādiṣu mā nāma samayakartu vyavahārakartuśca saṃpratipattirbhūt, vede'pi pratipattimātra vinā'pi saṃpratipattyā siddhyatu nāma

vyavahārastu yo'gnihotrādyanuṣṭhānātmaka so'dṛṣṭārtho vākyaikapramāṇako nā'sati vākyakārāptasmaraṇe siddhyet, tadavaśyasmartavyasya vedānā sambandhānāñca karturasmaraṇāt yogyānupalambhanādabhāve'vadhārite siddha vedānā sambandhānāñca nityatvamityāha–dṛṣṭa iti
smartavyatve satyasmaraṇād yogyānupalabdhinirastasya karturanumānāsabhavāt samākhyāyāśca pravacananimittatvādapauruṣeyā vedā iti
āgrahāyaṇyā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṣu tisṛṣu kriyamāṇa pitṛśrāddhaviśeṣa

smaraṇasya hi anubhavo mūlam, na cāsau vede karttṛviṣayatvena vidyate tatkathaṃ tatsmaraṇasaṃbhāvanāśaṅkā'pi ? na ca racanāvattvena atra bhāratādivat karttṛsadbhāvaprasiddhernāsya chinnamūlatvamityabhidhātavyam; vedaracanāyā karttṛpūrvakaracanāvilakṣaṇatvāt
na ca racanāmātrasyātropalambhāt kartranumānaṃ yuktam, jagato buddhimaddhetukatvānumānānuṣaṅgato'niṣṭasiddhiprasaṅgāt
ato yādṛśī racanā kartranvayavyatirekānuvidhāyinī pratipannā tādṛśyeva paridṛśyamānā karttāramanumāpayati ityabhyupagantavyam
tatkatha vede tataḥ kartranumānaśaṅkā'pi saṃbhāvyate ? ato vaidikī racanā apauruṣeyī dṛṣṭakarttṛkaracanāvilakṣaṇatvāt ākāśavaditi
mī॰ ślo॰ vākyādhi॰ ślo॰ 366 atītānāgatau kālau vedakāravivarjitau
✢nanvāptapraṇītatvābhāve kathamasya prāmāṇyaṃ syāditi cet ? apaurupeyatvādeva iti vrūmaḥ
viplavate khalvapi kaścitpuruṣakṛtādvacanātpratyaya, na tu vedavacanasya mithyātve kiñcana pramāṇamasti
nanu sāmānyato dṛṣṭa pauruṣa vacana vitathamupalabhya vacanasāmyādidamapi vitathamavagamyate, na, anyatvāt
na hyanyasya vitathabhāve anyasya vaitathya bhavitumarhati anyatvādeva
na hi devadattasya śyāmatve yajñadattasyāpi śyāmatva bhavitumarhati

prakṛṣṭa hi vacana kasyacideva kutracideva tāvatsaghātmakatva na pauruṣeyatāmanumāpayitumalam vedārthaviṣayavākyaracanāsāmarthyānupapatte ya eva hi padasaghātā pauruṣeyai viracayitu śakyante tatraiva pauruṣeyatva dṛṣṭamityaśakyaviracaneṣu pauruṣeyatvānumāna na kramate
na ca pauruṣeyatva vinā padasadhātātmakataiva nopapadyate, uccāraṇavaśena hi padāni sahatatāmāpadyante

vedasya karturasmaraṇam, vedārthasyātīndriyatvamityevamādihetubhiravyetṝṇāmanādipravṛttānā śabdapūrvaṃ uccāraṇāntarapūrvo vedo na kenaciccintayitvā pravartita iti akṛtakatvahetoruktatvāt –mīmāsābhā॰ pa॰ pṛ॰ 78
tadidamāha sūtrakāra–ukta tu śabdapūrva- tvam iti

tadayamartha–sarvapusāmadhyayanamadhyayanāntarapūrvakam, sarve hi yathaiva guruṇā'dhīta tathaivādhijigāsante na punaḥ svātantryeṇa kaścidapi prathamo'dhyetā vedānāmasti ya kartā syāt tasmādapauruṣeyā vedā
vimata vedādhyayana paratantrādhyetṛkaṃ vedādhyayanatvāt sampratipannādhyayanavat, ātmatva vedakartṛvyaktisamaveta na bhavati jātitvāt gotvavaditi pratihetuviruddhañca vākyatvam
viplavate hi khalvapi kaścitpuruṣakṛtādvacanāt pratyaya, na tu vedavacanasya mithyātve kiñcana pramāṇamasti
śabde doṣodbhavastāvad vaktradhīna iti sthitam | tadabhāvaḥ kvacittāvad guṇavadvaktṛkatvataḥ
tadguṇairapakṛṣṭānāṃ śabde saṃkrāntyasaṃbhavāt | yadvā vakturabhāvena na syurdoṣā nirāśrayāḥ

na ca āptaguṇasaṃkrāntyaiva śabdasya prāmāvyam, vede ca āptapraṇītatvābhāvataḥ tatsaṃkrāntyasaṃbhavānna prāmāṇyamityabhidhātavyam; yato nātra āptaguṇasaṃkrāntyā prāmāṇyam śabdoccāraṇamātre tasya vyāpārāt, śabdastu svamahimnaiva avitathāmarthapratipattiṃ kurvāṇaḥ pramāṇam

na caivamanāptasyāpi taduccāraṇamātre vyāpārāt śabdaḥ svamahimnaivāsatyapratīti kurvāṇaḥ apramāṇamityabhidhātavyam; anāptapraṇītatvādidoṣāṇām aprāmāṇyotpādanādanyaprayojanābhāvāt, āptapraṇītatvādiguṇānāṃ tu doṣāpasāraṇe vyāpārāt svataḥ prāmāṇyaṃ vede āptānāptapraṇītatvābhāvānna prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ vā; ityapyasundaram; yatra hi puruṣakṛtā padānupūrvī tatra tadapekṣaṃ prāmāṇyamaprāmāṇyaṃ vā syāt, vedānupūrvyāstu nityatvāt svasāmarthyenaivārthāvabodhakatvāt tannirapekṣaṃ prāmāṇyam
nahi tādṛśīmānupūrvī kaścit karttuṃ kṣamaḥ anyatrā'bhivyakteḥ
kurvāṇo vā tāṃ tadadhyetṛbhiḥ anyairvā nivāryeta
na yuktam, apramāṇatve kalpye tatprārthanā bhavet
anyathākaraṇe cāsya bahubhyaḥ syānnivāraṇā | mī॰ ślo॰ codanāsū॰ ślo॰ 150 iti

yattāvaduktam–karttuḥ smaraṇayogyatve sati asmaryamāṇakartṛkatvāt ityādi, tadasamīcīnam, yataḥ kimidam asmaryamāṇakarttṛkatvannāma– kiṃ karttṛsmaraṇābhāvaḥ, akarttṛkatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe vyadhikaraṇāsiddho hetu, karttṛsmaraṇābhāvo hi ātmani varttate apauruṣeyatvaṃ tu vede iti
nahi pratyakṣa tadgrāhakam; pratiniyatarūpādigocaracāritayā abhāve tasya pravṛttyasabhavāt
saṃbhave vā abhāvapramāṇakalpanā'narthakyam tatsādhyasya adhyakṣādita eva prasiddheḥ
abhāvapramāṇāttatsiddhau tu tatra tadutpattau kāraṇaṃ vācyam, niṣkāraṇasya kāryasyodayānupapatteḥ
mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 27 iti tatkāraṇamastīti cet; nanu ata prādurbhūtamabhāvapramāṇaṃ tadabhāvaṃ nirāśrayam, sāśrayaṃ vā prasādhayet ? na tāvannirāśrayam; gṛhītvā vastusadbhāvam ityabhidhānāt
anena hi niṣedhyādhāravastugrahaṇamabhidadhatā bhaṭṭena niṣedhyābhāvāśrayaḥ sūcita eva, anyathā pratiniyatavṛttitayā karttṛsmaraṇābhāvasiddhiḥ tato'tidurlabhā
yannirāśrayaṃ na tat pratiniyatavṛtti yathā ākāśam, nirāśrayaśca bhavadbhirabhipreto'bhāvapramāṇātprasiddhyan karttṛsmaraṇābhāva iti
tulanā–kimida kartṛrasmaraṇa nāma kartṛsmaraṇābhāva asmaryamāṇakartṛkatva vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 392
apausṣeyo veda kartrasmaraṇāt ityeva prayoge hetorvyadhikaraṇatvadoṣāt
mānasa nāstitājñānaṃ jāyate'kṣānapekṣayā || mī॰ ślo॰ abhāva॰ ślo॰ 27
nanvata prādurbhūtamabhāvapramāṇa tadabhāva sāśrayameva prasādhayet gṛhītvā vastusadbhāvamityabhidhānāt

atha sāśrayo'sau prasādhyate; nanu ko'sya āśrayaḥ–svātmā, sarvapramātāro vā ? yadi svātmā amuṣminmadīya ātmani vedakarttṛsmaraṇaṃ nāsti iti; kimetāvatā siddham ? padārthajātasya anekasya atra smaraṇaṃ nāsti, na caitāvatā tasyābhāvaḥ siddhyati
mamānuṣṭhāturavaśyaṃ smarttavyo'sau, yadā smṛtipathaprasthāyī na bhavati tadā'san; ityapyasāram; bhavatsmaraṇābhāvamātreṇa arthābhāvā'siddheḥ
tasya svayaṃ nihite'vaśyaṃ smarttavye kvacid dravyādau vidyamāne'pi sadbhāvena anekāntāt
tathā vyādhitena upayujyamānamauṣadhaṃ svayaṃ dhṛtaṃ mahatyāmapyarthitāyāṃ na smaryate, nacaitāvatā tasyā'bhāva ityanena cā'nekāntaḥ
atha sarvapramātāraḥ; nanu trailokyodaravarttinaḥ pramātāro vedakarttāraṃ na smaranti ityasarvavido vedanānupapattiḥ
api ca kimaśeṣajanasmaraṇanivṛttiriha hetutvena vivakṣitā, āhosvit katipayapuruṣasmaraṇavinivṛtti
avadhāraṇe vā ta eva sarvajñā syu arvāgbhāgavido na bhaveyu
atha katipayapuruṣāpekṣayā; tadā'naikāntiko hetu, vidyamānakartṛkeṣvapi kartā na smaryate kaiścit
āśrayaścāsya svātmā sarvepramātāro vā –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 629
eva tarhi pitāmahasya pitara mātāmahīmātaram, tanmātāpitarau ca na smarati tatteṣāmabhāvo bhavet
tulanā– sarve pumāsa kartāra vedasya na smaranti iti katha jānāti bhavān
na hi tava sakalalokahṛdayāni pratyakṣāṇi sarvajñatvaprasaṅgāt
na ca yat tva na jānāti tadanyo'pi na jānātīti yuktamatiprasaṅgāt
kiñca, sarvapramātṛdeśān gatvā tāṃśca pṛṣṭvā tatra smaraṇābhāvaḥ pratīyeta, anyathā vā ? na tāvadanyathā, gatvā gatvā tu tān deśān mī॰ ślo॰ arthā॰ ślo॰ 38 ityasya virodhānuṣaṅgāt

gatvā cet; nanu tatra teṣu pṛṣṭeṣu na smarāmaḥ iti prativacanañca vruvāṇeṣvapi kaḥ samāśvāsaḥ puruṣavacasāmaprāmāṇyena arthatathābhāvānupapatteḥ ? na ca sarveṣāmāptatāpratipattirasti, yataḥ tadguṇasaṃkrāntyā tatra prāmāṇyaṃ syāt; tatpratipattereva asarvavido yugapatkrameṇa vā'saṃbhavāt
tulanā–api ca sarvapramātṛdeśān gatvā tāśca pṛṣṭvā tatra kartṛsmaraṇābhāva pratīyetānyathā vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 630
tatra smara na smarantītyasarvavido vedanānu gatvā gatvā ā॰
gatvā gatvā tu tāndeśān yadyartho nopalabhyate
kiñca, abhāvapramāṇasya tatra pravṛttiḥ yatra vastusattāvabodhakaṃ pramāṇapañcakaṃ na pravarttate
vede ca ātmanaḥ karttṛsadbhāvāvedake sati kathaṃ tatpravṛttiḥ ? sa hi rudra vedakarttāram
yo brahmāṇa vidadhāti pūrva vedāṃśca prāhiṇoti
18 tathā prajāpatiḥ soma rājānamanvasṛjata, tataḥ trayo vedā anvasṛjyanta
