yathaiva hi saṃskṛtavyākaraṇena prakṛtipratyayavibhāgena śabdā vyutpādyante tathā prākṛtenāpi

yaccānyaduktam–saskṛtā vāgudyate ityādi; tatrāpyasau kadā vaktavyā–karmakāle, adhyayanakāle vā ? adhyayanakāle cet, kasya adhyayanakāle prākṛtasya, saṃskṛtasya vā ? na tāvat prākṛtasya, tadā saṃskṛtavāco'nabhidhānāt, anyathā tadadhyayanānupapattiḥ
atha saṃskṛtasya, kathaṃ tadadhyayanakāle anadhīyamānatvāt prākṛtavāco'sādhutvam ? anyasyādhyayanakāle anyasyā'prayogādasādhutve tu purāṇādhyayanakāle vedavācāmapyaprayogādasādhutvaṃ syāt
atha karmakāle; kutastadā prākṛtā na vaktavyāḥ–arthāpratipādakatvāt, apaśabdatvāt, adharmahetutvādvā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ, gāvyādiśabdebhyaḥ saṃskṛtetaravedināṃ suspaṣṭārthapratipattipratīteḥ
apaśabdatvañca gāvyādiśabdānāṃ svarūpamātrāt, vyākaraṇādaniṣpattervā ? yadi svarūpamātrāt; tarhi gośabdasyāpi apaśabdatvaprasaṅgaḥ tadaviśeṣāt
vyākaraṇādaniṣpattirapi saṃskṛtāt, prākṛtādvā syāt ? na tāvat prākṛtāt, tatra teṣāṃ svarūpaniṣpattipratīteḥ
saṃskṛtavyākaraṇato'pi gāvīśabdasya svarūpamātreṇā'niṣpattiḥ, arthaviśeṣe vā ? na tāvat svarūpamātreṇa, yattye tadādi guḥ jainendra॰ 1
114 iti gusajñāyāṃ satyāṃ goriyaṃ gāvī prakriyā iti svarūpamātreṇa tanniṣpattiprasiddheḥ
atha arthaviśeṣe gotvalakṣaṇe gāvīśabdasva ato'niṣpatteḥ apaśabdatvamucyate, tadapyasundaram, tatra tasyā'vyutpādakatvāt
prākṛtavyākaraṇameva hi gotvalakṣaṇe'rthe gāvīśabdaṃ vyutpādayati nānyat
ataḥ saṃskṛtetaravyākaraṇaprasiddhayoḥ gogāvīśabdayoḥ gotvalakṣaṇārthābhidhāyitvena pravṛtteḥ kuto'yaṃ niyamaḥ gośabda eva gotvasya vācako na gāvīśabdaḥ śabdaḥgāvīśabdaḥ tathā
yathaiva hi tulyapramāṇāvadhāritavācakatvā vṛkṣatarupādapādayaḥ paryāyaśa bdāḥ tathā gogāvyādayo'pi
tathāhi–go-gāvī-gauṇī-gopotaliketyādayaḥ śabdāḥ gotvasya vācakāḥ vṛddhaistatra avigānena prayujyamānatvātgauḥ uśrāsrāityādivat
tathā, gāvyādayaḥ śabdāḥ gotve anādiprayogāḥ anavagamyamānā'vadhitvāt gauruśrāsrāityādivat
yasya tya yattya tasmin parata tadādi śabdarūpa gusajña bhavati

atha adharmahetutvādasādhutvamasyāḥ, nanu kadā tasyā adharmahetutvam–sarvadā, yāgādikarmakāle vā ? yadi sarvadā; na kadācid dharmasyāvasaraḥ syāt, nitya-naimittikānuṣṭhānasamaye'pi prākṛtaśabdānāṃ ghṛtasamidādyabhidhāyināṃ gobhūmyādidānābhidhāyināñca prayuktānāmadharmasyaiva hetutvaprasaṅgāt
atha yāgādikarmakāle; mahat tatkarmaṇo māhātmyaṃ yenānyadā adharmasyājanakamapi ātmasattākāle'dharmajanakaṃ karoti iti
kiñca, prākṛtavacasāmadharmahetutvaniyamaḥ tadā siddhyet yadā saṃskṛtānāṃ teṣāṃ dharmahetutvaniyamaḥ syāt
tanniyamābhyupagame ca naṭabhaṭavaruṭacarmakārādīnāṃ saṃskṛtavedavaco'bhidhāyināṃ prākṛtavaktṛmāsopavāsinyādibhyaḥ atīvādhikadharmotpattiḥ syāt
atha brāhmaṇasyaiva tadabhidhāyino dharmaḥ nānyasyeti cet, na; brāhmaṇyasya kutaścidapi pramāṇādapratīteḥ
pulindā nāhalā niṣṭyā śavarā varuṭā bhaṭā

nanu pratyakṣeṇaiva brāhmaṇyaṃ pratīyate; visphāritākṣasya purovyavasthiteṣu kṣatriyādisaṅgheṣu tadvailakṣaṇyena brāhmaṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yam ityanugataikākārapratyayaviṣayatayā brāhmaṇasaṅghe manuṣyatvādyatiriktasya anugataikākārasya brāhmaṇaṇyasya pratibhāsapratīteḥ
yadi ca brāhmaṇyaṃ pratyakṣa na syāt tadā brāhmaṇo'yaṃ puruṣaḥ §iti viśiṣṭapratibhāso na syāt
atra hi brāhmaṇatvānurāgaviśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ pratibhāsate, na punaḥ pratibhāsate tacchūnyaṃ puruṣamātram
tatpratibhāse hi puruṣo'yam iti pratibhāsaḥ syāt natu brāhmaṇo'yam § iti, puruṣātirekitvād brāhmaṇyasya
na ca apratipanne viśeṣaṇe viśiṣṭaḥ pratyayo yuktaḥ, atiprasaṅgāt

na ca tathābhūtasya brāhmaṇyasya artheṣu saṃbhave prathamadarśane'pi pratibhāsaprasaṅgaḥ, yataḥ svaviśeṣavyaṅgyā jātiḥ, viśeṣāśca itarajātiparihāreṇa avabhāsamānā jātyantaraparihāreṇa svajātīrvyañjayanti yathā gavāśvādayaḥ, ataḥ tatra pratibhātā'pi jātiḥ vyañjakabhedāgrahaṇānnollikhati

dṛśyate ca dravyaparīkṣakāṇāṃ kūṭākūṭaviveke maṇiparīkṣakāṇāñca maṇikācādiviveke avadhānavatāṃ naisargikābhyāsikapratibhāsasāmagrīsadbhāva eva kūṭākūṭaviveko maṇikācādivivekaśca, evamatrāpi aviplutena brāhmaṇena aviplutāyāṃ brāhmaṇyāmutpannaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ ityādyaupadeśikamātāpitṛbrāhmaṇyajñānalakṣaṇasāmagrīsadbhāva eva brāhmaṇo'yam iti vivekena pratibhāsāvirbhāvo bhavati
yadi vā, tadbrāhmaṇyajñānanirapekṣaḥ brāhmaṇo'yam ityupadeśasahakṛtena indriyeṇa brāhmaṇo'yam iti brāhmaṇyajātigrāhī pratyayo janyate
na ca sāmagryabhāvāt yanna pratibhāsate tannāstīti vaktuṃ yuktam, atiprasaṅgāt
vyabhicāro hi pravādena vyāptaḥ, ataḥ pravādo nivarttamānaḥ vyabhicāraṃ nivarttayati, vyāpakanivṛttau vyāpyasyā'nivṛttivirodhāt
kṣatriyāyā tathaiva syād vaiśyāyāmapi caiva hi
tailād ghṛta vilīnañca gandhena ca rasena ca
aśvatvādau ca dūrasthe niścayo jāyate svanai
katha punarida lokasya prasiddham ? pratyakṣeṇeti brūma
kasmātpuna mātāpitṛsambandhānabhijñā cakṣu sannikṛṣṭeṣu manuṣyeṣvanākhyāta na pratipadyante ? śaktyabhāvāt yathā vṛkṣatva prāgabhidhānavyutpatte
ayañcotpādyotpādakasambandho mātureva pratyakṣo'nyeṣā tu anumānāptopadeśāvagata kāraṇam
naca tapa ādīnāṃ samudāyo brāhmaṇyam, na tajjanita saskāra, na tadabhivyaṅgyā jāti

yathā brāhmaṇatvādijātirupadeśasavyapekṣacakṣurindriyagrāhyāpi na pratyakṣagamyatāmapojjhati yathā ca brāhmaṇatvādijātipratītau kāraṇāntaramuktaṃ kvacidācārataścāpi samyagrājānupālitāditi manvādidarśitānavadyavartmānusaraṇanipuṇanarapatiparipālyamānavarṇāśramāṇā śaṅkitakapaṭakṛtakāryaveśadṛṣṭaśūdravyabhicāre deśe viśiṣṭācāragamyāpi brāhmaṇatvādijātirbhavati
stryaparādhāttu durjñāno'ya sambandha iti svayameva vakṣyati
na ca strīṇā kvacid vyabhicāradarśanāt sarvatraiva kalpanā yuktā
viśiṣṭena hi prayatnena mahākulīnā parirakṣantyātmānam, anenaiva hetunā rājabhirbrāhmaṇaiśca svapitṛpitāmahā- dipāramparyāvismaraṇārthaṃ samūhalekhyāni pravartitāni
na ca nirmūlakatvena lokasyāprāmāṇyam, prayatnena rakṣaṇe yogyānupalabdhermūlatvasabhavāditi darśayitumāha–viśiṣṭena hīti
mahākulīnānā puruṣāṇāṃ strīrakṣaṇameva ātmarakṣaṇam, jāyāyā rakṣyamāṇāyāmātmā bhavati rakṣita iti smaraṇāt
yadvā duṣkulaprasūtatvaṃ vyabhicāraśīlatve prayojaka na strītvamiti darśayitu mahākulīnatva strīṇāmuktam
vyabhicārābhāvāniścaye hi nirmūlatvāt pitṛpitāmahādiparamparālekhanātmakasamūhalekhya vyarthaṃ syāditi bhāva
yatra yāvadupalabdhisāmagrī tāvatyā satyāmapi yāsā vyabhicāro na dṛśyate tāsā nāstyeva vyabhicāra iti lokapramāṇakametat
api ca apramattai striyo rakṣaṇīyā, tāsu nāstyeva vyabhicārasabhāvanāvakāśo yāsu tvasti mā bhūt tadapatyeṣu tatsantatiprabhavatvaniścaya
na caitāvatā yatrāpi niścaya śakyastatrāpi aniścaya iti yuktamiti
yadi ca brāhmaṇaśabdasya brāhmaṇyajātirartho na syāt tadā'yamanarthakaḥ syāt, na caitad yuktam, etaduccāraṇānantarabhāvino'rthapratyayasya upalabhyamānatvāt
tannibandhanavyavahārasya ca brāhmaṇaṃ bhojaya ityādirūpasya asandigdhābādhitasya supratītatvāt
pāśupatādiliṅgināmapi brāhmaṇatvādijātyanurūpo nāmacihnācāropadeśādivyavahāro dṛśyate, ataḥ sudṛḍhavyavahāradarśanād vyaktibhyo'rthāntarabhūtā pratyakṣataḥ prasiddhā brāhmaṇyajātiḥ

tathā anumānato'pi; tathāhi–asati pratibandhake yo yadākāraḥ pratyayaḥ saṃ tadākāraviṣayanimittakaḥ yathā nīlādipratyayaḥ, asati pratibandhake bhavati ca brāhmaṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yam ityanugataikākāraḥ pratyayaḥ, tasmāt piṇḍavyatirikta-anugataikākārabrāhmaṇyanimittaka iti
yadākāro hi pratyayaḥ viṣayeṇāpi tadākāreṇaiva bhavitavyam, anyathā nīlādipratyayasya anīlādiviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt pratiniyatavastuvyavasthāvilopānuṣaṅgaḥ
brāhmaṇo'yamiti pratyaya piṇḍavyatiriktabrāhmaṇyanibandhana asati pratibandhake brāhmaṇo'yamityākaratayā samutpadyamānatvāt
nāpi sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; paṭādipadeṣu padatvasya vidyamānatvāt
nāpi sādhyavikalaḥ; teṣu vyaktivyatiriktaikanimittābhidheyasambaddhatvābhāve vyaktīnāmānantyena anantenāpi kālena sambandhagrahaṇānupapatteḥ
tathā varṇaviśeṣādhyayanācārayajñopavītādivyatiriktanimittanibandhanaṃ brāhmaṇa iti jñānaṃ tannimittabuddhivilakṣaṇatvāt gavāśvādijñānavaditi
tathā brāhmaṇena yaṣṭavya brāhmaṇo bhojayitavyaḥ ityādyāgamādapi brāhmaṇyajātiḥ prasiddhā
tathā vedetihāsapurāṇaprasiddhā cāsau ādau brahmā mukhato brāhmaṇa sasarja, bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyam, ūrubhyāṃ vaiśyam padbhyāṃ śūdram ityādi vacasāṃ bhūyasāṃ tatra tatpratipādakānāṃ śravaṇāditi
asya prajāpate brāhmaṇatvajātiviśiṣṭa puruṣa mukhamāsīt sukhādutpanna ityartha
yo'ya rājanya kṣatriyatvajātiviśiṣṭa sa bāhū kṛto bāhutvena niṣpādito bāhubhyāmutpādita ityartha
tattadānīmasya prajāpateryadyābūrū tadrūpo vaiśya sampannaḥ ūrubhyāmutpādita ityartha
tathāsya padbhyāṃ pādābhyā śūdra śūdratvajātimān puruṣo'jāyata
11 saptamakāṇḍe sa mukhatastrivṛta niramimīta ityādau vispaṣṭamāmnātā
sadṛśapariṇāmarūpa eva brāhmaṇyam, natu yoninibandhanamiti samarthanam–

yattāvaduktam–pratyakṣeṇaiva brāhmaṇyaṃ pratīte ityādi; tadasamīcīnam, yataḥ kiṃ kevalendriyajanitena tena tatpratīyeta, anyasahakṛtendriyajanitena vā ? prathamapakṣe kiṃ nirvikalpakena, savikalpakena vā tajjanitena tena tatpratīyeta ? na tāvannirvikalpakena, tatra jātyādipratibhāsābhāvāt, bhāve vā nirvikalpakatvavirodhaḥ kathamanyathedaṃ śobheta–
tulanā–tatra kiṃ nirvikalpakāt vikalpakādvā tatastatpratipatti syāt
asti hyālocanājñāna prathamaṃ nirvikalpakam | vālamūkādivijñānasadṛśa śuddhavastujam
vyākhyā– yastvapiśabdamasahamāna sarvameva jñāna śabdānuviddhatvāt savikalpakameva na kiñcinnirvikalpakamastīti manyate taṃ pratyāha–astīti
bālānāmiva avyutpannānāmasmākamapi cakṣu sannipātānantara savikalpakāt prathamamasti nirvikalpaka pratītisiddhamālocanavijñāna śuddhavastuviṣayam, tadabhāve hi nirnimitta śabdasmaraṇa syāt
asmṛtaśabdasya ca na śabdānuviddho vikalpa sabhavatīti
tataḥ para punarvastudharmairjātyādibhiryayā | buddhyāvasāyate sāpi pratyakṣatvena sammatā
tato nirvikalpakāduttarakāla jātyādibhirvikalpya vastu yayā buddhyā gṛhate sā'pi pratyakṣameveti

na ca visphāritākṣasya purovarttikhaṇḍamuṇḍakarkādivyaktiṣu gavāśvādijātivat śuklatvādiguṇavadvā manuṣyavyaktiṣu manuṣyatvapuṃstvādyatiriktasya brāhmaṇyasyaikasya akhilasvavyaktiṣvanugatasya pratibhāso'sti

kathamevaṃ kvacid brāhmaṇatvānurakto'nugatapratyayaḥ syāditi cet ? saṅketavaśāt, yathaiva hi parasparavilakṣaṇeṣu govajrādiṣu ekagotvarūpasāmānyābhāve'pi gauḥ gauḥ ityanugatākāraikapratyayaḥ tathā anyonyavilakṣaṇeṣvapi manuṣyavyaktiviśeṣeṣu brāhmaṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yam ityanugatākāraikapratyayo bhaviṣyati
vastusāmarthyaprabhavatve tu agṛhītasaṅketāsvapi vyaktiṣu tanmātropalambhenaiva avyabhicārigopratyayavat sa syāt, na caivam
na khalu yathā mahiṣādisaṅghe gavāṃ gojātiḥ vailakṣaṇyena pratibhāsate svasaṅghe ca guṇaḥ kriyā vā, tathā brāhmaṇyamapi
nahi hastapādādyākāravyaṅgyamanuṣyatvād vyatiricyamānapuṃstvādisāmānyavat brāhmaṇatvaṃ vaiviktyena jātu pratibhāsate
anyasahakṛtendriyajanitenāpi tena nirvikalpakena, savikalpakena vā tat pratīyeta ? ubhayatra uktadoṣānuṣaṅgaḥ
tulanā–visphāritākṣasya purovartikhaṇḍamuṇḍakarkādivyaktiṣu gabāśvādijātivat manuṣyavyaktiṣu manuṣyatvapustvādyatiriktabrāhmaṇasya kasyacidapratibhāsāt
manuṣyatva hi strīṣu puruṣeṣu ca vyāptam, puruṣatvaṃ tu puruṣamātra eva

kiñca, indriyāṇāṃ tadviṣayaṃ pratyakṣamupajanayatāṃ kiṃ tadanyat sahakāritvena abhipretam–brāhmaṇabhūtapitṛjanyatvam, pitroraviplutatvopadeśaḥ, ācāraviśeṣaḥ, saṃskāraviśeṣaḥ, vedādhyayanam, yajñopavītādikam, brahmaprabhavatvaṃ vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; yataḥ pitrorbrāhmaṇye siddhe tajjanyatvena putrasya brāhmaṇyaṃ siddhyet, taccānayoḥ brāhmaṇabhūtapitṛjanyatvāt siddhyet, tathābhūtaputrajanakatvādvā ? prathamapakṣe anavasthā

bījāṅkuravadanāditvāt tatkāryakāraṇapravāhasya ato nānavasthā doṣāya; ityapyayuktam; yato bījāṅkurayoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ pūrvavījāṅkurakāryakāraṇabhāvagrahaṇanirapekṣaḥ pramāṇataḥ pratīyate, atra tu pūrvapūrvabrāhmaṇyapratipattyabhāve parāparabrāhmaṇyapratipatteḥ karttumaśakyatvānna dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayoḥ manāgapi sāmyam
dvitīyapakṣe tu anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi pitṛbrāhmaṇye brāhmaṇabhūtapitṛjanyatvena putrabrāhmaṇyasiddhiḥ; tatsiddhau ca brāhmaṇabhūtaputrajanakatvāt pitṛbrāhmaṇyasiddhiriti

nanu kimidamindriyasahakāritvenātreṣṭam–brāhmaṇabhūtasvapitṛjanyatvam, pitṛgocaro'viplutatvopadeśaḥ, ācāraviśeṣa, saṃskāraviśeṣa, vedādhyayanam, yajñopavītādikam, brahmaprabhavatvaṃ vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 958
taccānayo brāhmaṇabhūtapitṛjanyatvāt siddhyet tathābhūtaputrajanakatvādvā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 959
putrabrāhmaṇyasiddhiḥ tatsiddhau ca brāhmaṇyasiddhiḥ tatsiddhau ca brāhmaṇa– ā॰
aviplutena brāhmaṇena aviplutāyāṃ brāhmaṇyāmutpanno brāhmaṇaḥ ityaviplutamātāpitrupadeśastatsahakārī, ityapi śraddhāmātram, pramāṇato'pratipanne'rthe vāstavopadeśāsaṃbhavāt
yanna kutaścit pramāṇāt pratīyate na tatropadeśo vāstavaḥ yathā sakalaśūnyatāyām, kutaścidapi pramāṇānna pratīyate ca bhavatkalpitaṃ brāhmaṇyamiti

atha pratyakṣata eva brāhmaṇyaṃ pratītya yathoktopadeśo vidhīyate, tadasat, parasparāśrayaprasaṅgāt–siddhe hi brāhmaṇyapratyakṣatve pramāṇabhūtayathoktopadeśasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tathābhūtopadeśasahakṛtena indriyeṇa brāhmaṇyapratyakṣatāsiddhiriti
sa hi jātiyogalakṣaṇa gotralakṣaṇa kriyāsāmarthyātiśayayogo vā ? paropadeśaprāmāṇya pratyakṣārthe na yuktimat
tadyoge vā upadeśasyaiva kevalasya vyāpāra iti upadeśamātravyaṅgyataiva
kiñca, brāhmaṇyajāteḥ pratyakṣatāsiddhau yathoktopadeśasya pratyakṣahetutāsiddhi, tatsiddhau ca tatpratyakṣatāsiddhirityanyonyāśraya

aviplutatvañca vivakṣitapitrapekṣayā, anādikālapitṛpravāhāpekṣayā vā abhipretam ? yadi vivakṣitapitrapekṣayā, tatrāpi anayoḥ tajjanmani aviplutatvamabhipretam, anādikāle vā ? tajjanmani cet, kena tattatra tayoḥ pratīyeta–putreṇa, anyairvā ? na tāvat putreṇa, svajanmakāle'pi tasya tadvivecanāsāmarthyāt
nāpyanyaiḥ, taddhi taiḥ pratyakṣataḥ pratīyeta, anumānāt, āgamādvā ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ, ayametasmādeva etasyāmutpannaḥ ityevaṃrūpasyārthasya arvāgdṛśā pratyakṣīkarttumaśakyatvāt
tatra hi liṅgam-pitroḥ saṃvṛtākārādiviśeṣaḥ, apatyeṣvavilakṣaṇatā vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'yuktaḥ, duścāriṇām atīva saṃvṛtākāradarśanāt
dvitīyapakṣo'pyapeśala; yato yadi-viplutetarapitṛprabhavā'patyeṣu vilakṣaṇākāratā siddhyet tadā avi lakṣaṇākārā'patyopalambhāt pitroraviplutatvaṃ niścīyate, na cāsau siddhā
na khalu vaḍavāyāṃ gardabhāśvaprabhavā'patyeṣviva brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇaśūdraprabhavāpatyeṣvapi vailakṣaṇyaṃ svapne'pi pratīyate
āgamato'pi apauruṣeyāt, pauruṣeyādvā tayoraviplutatvapratipattiḥ syāt ? na tāvadapauruṣeyāt; tatpratipādakasya apauruṣeyasya āgamasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
pauruṣeyopyāgamaḥ tatpraṇetrā pramāṇāntareṇānayoraviplutatve pratipanne sati pravarttamānaḥ pramāṇatāṃ bhajate, na tatpratipattiḥ kutaścidasti ityuktam
tanna tajjanmani anayoraviplutatvaṃ kutaścit pratyetuṃ śakyam

aviplutatvañca vivakṣitapitrapekṣayā anādikālapitṛpravāhāpekṣayā vā'bhipretam ? yadi viṃbakṣitapitrapekṣayā; tatrāpyanayostajjanmanyaviplutatvamabhimatamanādikāle vā ? tajjanmani cet, tarhi kena tatra tayo pratīyeta putreṇa anyairvā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 959
naca pitroraviplutatve kiñcilliṅgamasti, tadvi ddhi savṛtākārādiviśeṣa apatyeṣvavilakṣaṇatā vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 959
na khalu vaḍavāyā gardabhāśvaprabhavāpatyeṣviva brāhmaṇyā brāhmaṇaśūdraprabhavāpatyeṣvapi vailakṣaṇya lakṣyate
na ca jātyantarasthena puruṣeṇa striyā kvacit
yadi vā tadvadeva syād dvayorvisadṛśa suta
etena anādikāle tayostatpratipattiḥ pratyākhyātā; yayorhi tajjanmanyaṣyaviplutatvaṃ pratyetuṃ na śakyate tayoḥ anādikāle tat pratīyate iti mahaccitram !
kiñca, sadaiva abalānāṃ kāmāturatayā iha janmanyapi vyabhicāropalambhāt anādau kāle tāḥ kadā kiṃ kurvantīti brahmaṇāpi jñātumaśakyam
tathā ca vyabhicāro hi pravādena vyāptaḥ ityādyayuktam; atyantapracchannakāmukānāṃ pravādābhāve'pi vyabhicārasaṃbhavataḥ tasya tena vyāptyanupapatteḥ
ataḥ pitroraviplutatvasya kutaścidaprasiddheḥ na tadupadeśo brāhmaṇyapratyakṣatāprādurbhāve cakṣuṣaḥ sahakāritvaṃ pratipadyate
iti jñāna kathannāma kāmārtā hi sadā striya
tad bhavatyapi niścetu brāhmaṇatva na śakyate
atīndriyapadārthajño na hi kaścit samasti va
prāyeṇa pramādānā kāmāturatayā ihajanmanyapi vyabhicāropalambhātkuto yoninibandhano vāhmaṇyaniścayaḥ
anādigotrapaddhatau ca kāmārtatvāt sarvadā pramadānā kasyāścid vyabhicārasabhavāt kuto yoninibandhanabrāhmaṇyaniścayāt saskārasya adhyayanādeśca aviparyastatvaniścaya
kālenānādinā gotre skhalana kva na jāyate

nāpi ācāraviśeṣaḥ; sa hi brāhmaṇasyā'sādhāraṇo yājanā'dhyāpanapratigraha grahādiḥ, sa ca tatpratyakṣatānimittaṃ na bhavati avyāpterativyāpteścānuṣaṅgāt, yājanādirahiteṣu hi brāhmaṇeṣvapi tadvyavahārābhāvaprasaṅgādavyāptiḥ, śūdreṣvapi akhilasya yājanādyācārasyopalabdhito brāhmaṇyānuṣaṅgāccātivyāptiḥ
atha mithyā'sau ācāraviśeṣastatra, anyatra kutaḥ satyaḥ ? brāhmaṇyasiddheścet, anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi ācārasatyatve brāhmaṇyasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca ācārasatyatvasiddhiriti
tulanā–athādhyayanādinā kriyāviśeṣeṇa jñāyate nopadeśamātrāt; tadapyasat, dvijātitve kriyā sādhyā na kriyārto dvijātitā
ata evādhyayana kriyāviśeṣo vā tatsahāyatā na pratipadyate
dṛśyate hi śūdro'pi svajātivilopāddeśāntare brāhmaṇo bhūtvā vedādhyayana tatpraṇītāñca kriyā kurvāṇa
tatra avyāptiḥ–saṃskāraviśeṣāt pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇasyāpi abrāhmaṇyaprasakteḥ syāt
ativyāptiḥ punaḥ abrāhmaṇasyāpi tathāvidhasaṃskṛtasya brāhmaṇatvāpatteḥ syāditi
brahmaprabhavatvasya ca tadaṅgatve atiprasaṅga eva, sakalaprāṇināṃ tatprabhavatayā brāhmaṇyaprasaṅgāt
tulanā–etena saskāraviśeṣasya vedādhyayanasya yajñopavītādeśca cakṣu sahakāritā pratyuktā, avyāptyativyāptyoratrāpyaviśeṣāt
avicchedaśca gotrasya pratyetu śakyate na ca
jñāyanta eva te tajjñairiti cenniyamo na hi
kiñca, brahmaṇo brāhmaṇyamasti, na vā ? yadi nāsti; kathamato brāhmaṇotpattiḥ ? na hi amanuṣyāt manuṣyotpattiḥ pratītā
atha asti, kiṃ sarvatra, mukhapradeśe eva vā ? yadi sarvatra, sa eva prāṇināṃ bhedābhāvānuṣaṅgaḥ
atha mukhapradeśa eva, tadā'nyatrāsya śūdratvānuṣaṅgāt na viprāṇāṃ tatpādādayo vandyāḥ syuḥ
tulanā–kiñca, brahmaṇo brāhmaṇyamasti vā na vā ? nāsti cet, kathamato brāhmaṇotpatti ? asti cet; kiṃ sarvatra mukhapradeśa eva vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 484
kiñca, brāhmaṇa eva tanmukhājjāyate, tanmukhādeva vāsau jāyate ? vikalpadvayepi anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi brāhmaṇatve tasyaiva tanmukhājjanmasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca brāhmaṇatvasiddhiriti
na ca brahmaprabhavatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ brāhmaṇyapratyakṣatākāle kenacit pratīyate
na ca apratipannaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣye pratipattimādhātuṃ samarthamatiprasaṅgāt
yad viśeṣaṇaṃ tat pratipannameva viśeṣye pratipattimādhatte yathā daṇḍādi, viśeṣaṇañca brāhmaṇyapratipattau brahmaprabhavatvamiti
tulanā–kiñca, brāhmaṇa eva tanmukhājjāyate tanmukhādevāsau jāyeta ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 484
etena asati pratibandhake yo yadākāraḥ pratyayaḥ ityādyanumānaṃ brāhmaṇyasadbhāvaprasādhakaṃ pratyākhyātam; anekadhā pratibandhakasadbhāvapratipādanāt

yadapi–brāhmaṇapadam ityādyanumānamuktam, tadapyayuktam; pakṣasya adhyakṣabādhitatvāt, kaṭhakalāpādibrāhmaṇavyaktiṣu hi brāhmaṇapadaṃ vyaktivyatiriktaikanimittābhidheyasambandhaśūnyameva adhyakṣataḥ pratīyate aśrāvaṇatvaviviktaśabdavat
aprasiddhaviśeṣaṇaśca pakṣaḥ, na khalu vyaktivyatiriktaikanimittābhidheyasambaddhatvaṃ mīmāṃsakasya asmākaṃ vā kvāpi prasiddham vyatiriktāvyatiriktasya sāmānyasyobhābhyāmabhyupagamāt
hetuścānaikāntikaḥ; sattā''kāśakālapade advaitādipade vā vyaktivyatiriktaikanimittābhidheyasambaddhatvābhāve'pi padatvasya bhāvāt
advaitākhilaśūnyatvādeśca sāmānyavattvena paramārthasattvānupaṅgāt kuto'pratipakṣā pakṣasiddhiśca syāt ? dṛṣṭānto'pi sādhyavikalaḥ; paṭādipade vyaktivyatiriktaikanimittatvāsiddheḥ
nityaikarūpasāmānyamantareṇāpi anantānāṃ vācyavācakavyaktīnāṃ sambandho yathā siddhyati tathā nityasambandhaniṣedhāvasare prarūpitam
tulanā–yato yadi vyaktyādibhyo vyatirivata nimittamātramasya jñānasya viṣayatvena sādhyate tadā siddhasādhyatā, tatsamudāyasya samudāyibhya kathañcidavyatiriktasya tadviṣayatvena svīkārāt

atha prativyakti parisamāptamekāntavyatiriktamabhidhīyate; tadā pakṣasya pratipakṣabādhitatvam, kaṭhakalāpādibrāhmaṇavyaktiṣu hi brāhmaṇajñānaṃ vyaktyādivyatiriktasāmānyanimittarahitamevādhyakṣata pratīyate aśrāvaṇatvaviviktaśabdavat
na khalu nagaraṃ senā vanam ityādijñāne vyaktivyatiriktam anuvṛttapratyayanibandhanaṃ kiñcidasti
taddhi dravyam, sattā, pratyāsattiviśeṣo vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe nagarādikameva tatra dravyam, anyadvā ? na tāvat nagarādikameva, tasya dravyatvā'saṃbhavāt
nahi nagaraṃ senādikaṃ vā dravyaṃ saṃbhavati; gṛhādibhirasaṃyuktaiḥ vijātīyaiśca tasya ārambhā'saṃbhavāt
katipayagṛhāṇāmasti saṃyoga iti cet; na, teṣāṃ svayaṃ saṃyogarūpatayā sayogānāśrayatvāt

na hi nagarādijñāne'pi vyatirikta dravyāntaramasti yadekākārajñānanibandhana bhavet, kāṣṭhādīnāmeva pratyāsattyā kayācit prāsādādivyavahāranibandhanānā nagarādivyavahāranibandhanatvopapatte, anyathā ṣaṇṇagarītyādiṣvapi vastvantarakalpanāprasakte
dravyāṇi dravyāntaramārabhante guṇāśca guṇāntaram vaiśe॰ sū॰ 1
sattā nagarādikam ityatrāpi asau gṛhādiviśeṣitā, kevalā vā tatpratyayamutpādayet ? na tāvat kevalā; gṛhādivivikte'pi pradeśe tataḥ tatpratyayaprasaṅgāt
atha gṛhādiviśeṣitā; na, kūṭasthanityāyā viśeṣyatvāsaṃbhavāt, akiñcitkarasya aviśeṣaṇatvācca
kathañcaivaṃ ṣaṇṇagarī ityatra samudāyopapattiḥ sattāyā ekarūpatayā samudāyatānupapatte ?

pratyāsattiviśeṣo'pi kasya kena saha nagarādivyapadeśamarhet ? gṛhādīnāṃ gṛhādyantaraiḥ iti cet, kaḥ punarasau–teṣāṃ taiḥ saha samavāyaḥ, sayogo vā ? na tāvatsamavāyaḥ, teṣāṃ yutasiddhatayā anādhāryādhārabhūtatayā ca tadasabhavāt
na ca nagarādiśabdāt saṃyuktasayogālpīyastvalakṣaṇe pratyāsattiviśeṣe ekasmin kasyacit pratipatti-pravṛtti-prāptayo'nubhūyante, kintu gṛhādāvanekatra
nagaraśabdāddhi gṛhādau, senāśabdād aśvādau, vanaśabdācca dhavādāvanekatrārthe tāḥ pratīyante iti
yatra hi śabdāduccaritāt pratipattyādayaḥ pratīyante sa śabdasyārthaḥ tathā vṛddhavyavahārāt
deśādipratyāsattiviśiṣṭā gṛhādayo nagarādivyapadeśabhājaḥ ityapyanenā'pāstam, deśādau hi pratyāsattiḥ–teṣāṃ samavāyaḥ, saṃyogo vā ? tatra ca uktadoṣo'viśiṣṭaḥ
bhavatāmapi kathamevaṃ nagarādivyapadeśaḥ syāt ? ityapyacodyam; deśapratyāsattiviśiṣṭe prāsādādau tadvyapadeśasya asmābhirabhyupagamāt
vijātīyaiḥ kāṣṭheṣṭikādibhiḥ tasya ārambhāsaṃbhavāt kathamavayavitvam ? ityapyanupapannam; vijātīyairapi pṛthivyādibhiḥ śarīrādyavayavinaḥ ārambhopalambhāt
sajātīyānām ārambhaniyamasya ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ pṛthivyādīnāṃ tattvāntaratvaniṣedhāvasare niṣiddhatvāt
na cānyat kiñcid brāhmaṇye liṅgamasti yataḥ tatsiddhiḥ syāt
ekena gṛheṇa sayuktamapara gṛha tena cāparamiti sayuktasayogād yadalpīyastvam alpadeśāvagāhitva tatra
yatra hi śabdāt pratītipravṛttiprāptaya samadhigamyante sa śabdasyārtha prasiddhastathā bṛddhavyavahārāt
na ca senāvanādiśabdāt pratyāsattiviśeṣe pratītipravṛttiprāptayo'nubhūyante yena sa tasyārtha syāt
astu vā kiñcittatra liṅgam, tathāpi agṛhītapratibandhaṃ tat na tatpratipatteraṅgam, atiprasaṅgāt
pratibandhagrahaśca apratipanne brāhmaṇye na saṃbhavati, atiprasaṅgāt
anumānataḥ tatpratipattau cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ–siddhe hi anumānato brāhmaṇye tena liṅgasya pratibandhasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca anumānasiddhiḥ, tataśca brāhmaṇyasiddhiriti
āgamatopi apauruṣeyāt, pauruṣeyādvā tatpratipattiḥ syāt ? na tāvadapauruṣeyāt; tasya kārye evārthe prāmāṇyāt, brāhmaṇatvasya ca nityatayeṣṭito'kāryatvāt
nāpi pauruṣeyāt tataḥ tatpratipattiḥ; tasya pramāṇāntarasāpekṣatvāt, tasya cātrā'saṃbhavāt
nāpyāgamataḥ, yato'sau pauruṣeyo vā syādapauruṣeya –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 962
āmnāyasya kriyārthatvāt–kriyā kathamanuṣṭheyeti tā vaditu samāmnātāro vākyāni samāmananti
vaktu pratipādyaviṣayajñānasya pramāṇatve siddha eva tatpraṇītāgamasya prāmāṇyam
apratipanne ca pramāṇāntareṇa brāhmaṇye kathaṃ tena sādṛśyaṃ kasyacit pratīyeta yataḥ taddarśanād brāhmaṇyaṃ pratīyeta ?
ato brāhmaṇyajāteḥ sattvasyaivā'saṃbhavāt prathamadarśane pratibhātāpi jātiḥ vyañjakabhedāgrahaṇānnollikhati ityādi pratyākhyātam
yadapyuktam–dravyaparīkṣakāṇām ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam, yato na pītatāmātraṃ suvarṇam, vicitrarekhāracitapariṇatimātraṃ vā dravyam, vṛttasaṃsthānamātraṃ vā maṇiḥ, atiprasaṅgāt
sa ca na pratyakṣaḥ, dāhacchedādeḥ tuṣāmbusaṃprakṣālanādeḥ parapraśnādeśca vaiyarththaprasaṅgāt
tasyāpi tatpratipattau sahāyatve tajjātau kiñcittathāvidhaṃ sahāyaṃ vācyam
tacca brāhmaṇabhūtapitṛjanyatvādikam, ākāraviśeṣo vā syāt ? sarvametat prāgeva kṛtottaratvānna tatpratipattau sahāyatāṃ pratipadyate
ato'yuktamuktam–na ca sāmagryabhāvād yanna pratibhāsate tannāsti ityādi, tatpratibhāsasāmagryāḥ prāgeva aśepaviśeṣato nirastatvāt
tulanā–kāñcanādyupadeśasya hi yadā'satyatāśaṅkā tadā pratyakṣadarśanādasau nivartate naiva jātyādyupadeśasyāsatyatāśakāyā pratyakṣāt satyatā jātisvarūpagrahaṇākārāt
suvarṇādau hi rūpaviśeṣasadbhāvāt evambhūtameva suvarṇaṃ bhavatīti vyavahārasya parisamāpterdṛṣṭasya na kācitkṣati, atra tu punarevavidhameva brāhmaṇyamiti na pādaprasāraṇamātraṃ trāṇam

nanu brāhmaṇatvādisāmānyānabhyupagame kathaṃ bhavatāṃ varṇāśramavyavasthā tannibandhano vā tapodānādivyavahāraḥ syāt ? ityapyacodyam; kiyāviśeṣayajñopavītādicihropalakṣite vyaktiviśeṣe tadvyavasthāyāḥ tadvyavahārasya ca upapatteḥ
tanna bhavatkalpitaṃ nityādisvabhāvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ kutaścidapi pramāṇāt prasiddhyatīti kriyāviśeṣanibandhana evāyaṃ brāhma ṇādivyavahāro yuktaḥ

kathamanyathā veśyāpāṭakādipraviṣṭānāṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ vrāhmaṇyābhāvo nindā ca syāt, jātiryataḥ pavitratā hetuḥ ? sā ca bhavanmatena nityaikarūpatayā tadavasthaiva, anyathā gotvajāterapi brāhmaṇyaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ syāt
gavādīnāṃ hi cāṇḍālādigṛhe ciroṣitānāmapi iṣṭaṃ śiṣṭairādānaṃ na tu brāhmaṇīnām
atha kriyābhraṃśāttāsāṃ nindyatā anādānañceṣyate, tarhi kimanena antargaḍunā brāhmaṇyena kalpitena ? kalpayitvāpi tat kriyāviśeṣavaśādeva vandyatāyā brāhmaṇavyavahārasya cābhyupagamanīyatvāt
tulanā–na jaṭāhi na gottehi na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo
yamhi saccañca dhammo ca so sucī so ca brāhmaṇo
na cāha brāhmaṇa brūmi yonija mattisabhava
bho vādi nāma so hoti sa ve hoti sakiñcano
kammuṇā babhaṇo hoi kammuṇā hoi khattio
vaīso kammuṇā hoi suddo havai kammuṇā
tathāhi–athavā sarva ete śabdā guṇasamudāyeṣu vartante brāhmaṇa kṣatriyo vaiśya śūdra iti
tulanā–kathamanyathā veśyāpāṭakādipraviṣṭānā brāhmaṇīnā brāhmaṇyābhāvo bhavet –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 962
kiñca, kriyānivṛttau brāhmaṇyajāternivṛttiḥ syāt, yadi sā tasyāḥ kāraṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ vā syāt, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
na cāsyāḥ kāraṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ vā kiñcidiṣṭam
nāpi kriyābhraṃśāt tasyā vikāro'sti bhinneṣvabhinnā nityā niravayavā ca jātiḥ ityabhidhānāt
tadevaṃ bhavatkalpitabrāhmaṇyasya ākāśakuśeśayavadaprasiddhasvarūpatvānna brāhmaṇasyaiva saṃskṛtaśabdaprayogāt dharmo yuktaḥ, kintu sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇaiva ato'sau syāt, na caivam
tathāvidhañca tat saṃskṛtaśabdasyeva prākṛtaśabdasyāpyaviśiṣṭam, ato dvayorapyanayoḥ sādhutvam
tataḥ sādhūktam–varṇāḥ padāni vākyāni prāhurarthānavāñchitān ityādi
varṇapadavākyānāṃ vācakatvam arthapratipādakatvam, yathāsvaṃ svasyārthasya anatikrameṇa āgamāt pratipattavyam
kutaḥ punaḥ vivakṣāto'nyasya vācakāḥ śabdāḥ ? ityāha–vaktrabhiprāyāt ityādi
vaktrabhiprāyād bhinnasya bahirbhūtasya arthasya ghaṭādeḥ vācakāḥ śabdāḥ
yatra satyānṛtavyavasthā tad vaktrabhiprāyād bhinnārthaviṣayaṃ yathā pratyakṣādi, satyānṛtavyavasthā ca śabdeṣviti
ayañca prasaṅgaḥ bahirartha viṣayatāmantareṇa satyānṛtavyavasthānupapattilakṣaṇaḥ anyatra pramāṇaṃ śrutamartheṣu laghī॰ kā॰ 26 ityādau vistareṇoktaḥ iti neha praghaṭṭake punaḥ pratanyate
nanvarthābhāvepi śabdānāṃ pravṛttidarśanāt kathaṃ tadvācakatvam ityatrāha–śabdānām ityādi
śabdānām arthavyabhicāritve'bhyupagamyamāne abhipretavyabhicāritvaṃ kutaḥ pramāṇāt na kutaścit apanīyate nirākriyate
kuta etat ? ityatrāha–suṣuptādau ityādi, ādiśabdena mattādiparigrahaḥ vāgvṛtterdarśanāt
nanu vivakṣāprabhavācchabdādanya eva śabdaḥ, yaḥ tadabhāve tatra jāyate
suvivecitaṃ hi kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ na vyabhicarati iti, tadetadat arthaviśeṣasadbhāvāsadbhāvapratibaddhātmalābheṣvapi śabdeṣu samānam
sāmye'pi teṣāṃ vivakṣetaraprabhavāḥ śabdāḥ vailakṣaṇyenā'vasīyante natu arthaviśeṣasadbhāvā'sadbhāvapratibaddhātmalābhā iti svadarśanānurāgamātram

vivakṣāmātragocaratve ca amīṣāṃ bahirarthe pravṛttyādihetutvānupapattiḥ, tadaviṣayatvād, yad yadviṣayaṃ na bhavati na tat tatra pravṛttyādihetuḥ yathā rūpajñānaṃ rasāviṣayaṃ na rase, na bhavanti ca bahirarthaviṣayā bhavanmate śabdā iti
suprasiddhā hi śabdebhyo bahirarthe pratipattipravṛttiprāptipratītiḥ ābālaṃ pratyakṣavat
yad yatra pravṛtyādihetuḥ tattadviṣayam yathā rasajñāna rase pravṛttyādihetū rasaviṣayam, bahirarthe pravṛttyādihenavaśca śabdā iti
nacāyamasiddho hetuḥ; pratyakṣavat śabdebhyaḥ tatra pravṛttyādipratīteḥ
yathaiva hi pratyakṣāt pratipattṛpraṇidhānādisāmagrīsāpekṣāt pratyakṣārthe pratipattyādipratīti sakalajanaprasiddhā, tathā saṅketādisāmagrīsāpekṣāt śabdāt śabdārthe'pi iti
na ca arthe arthino'rthitvādeva pravṛtteḥ śabdo'pravarttaka ityabhidhātavyam, pratyakṣāderapyevamapravarttakatvaprasaṅgāt, tadarthe'pi arthitvādeva pravṛttipratīteḥ
paramparayā'tra pravarttakatve śabde'pi tathā tadastu aviśeṣāt

yathaiva hi pratyakṣāt pratipattṛpraṇidhānasāmagrīsavyapekṣāt pratyakṣārthapratipatti tathā saṅketasāmagrīsāpekṣādeva śabdācchabdārthapratipatti sakalajanaprasiddhā, anyathā tato bahirarthe pratipattipravṛttiprāptyayogāt
na cārthavedanādeva arthe puruṣasyārthina svayameva pravṛtte śabdo'pravarttaka ityeva vaktu yuktam, pratyakṣāderapyevamapravartakatvaprasaṅgāt, tadarthe'pi sarvasyābhilāṣādeva pravṛtte
kā ceyaṃ vivakṣā nāma–śabdoccāraṇecchāmātram, anena śabdena amumarthaṃ prati pādayāmi ityabhiprāyo vā ? prathamapakṣe vaktṛśrotroḥ śāstraśravaṇapraṇayanādau pravṛttirna prāpnoti
na khalu kaścidanunmattaḥ śabdanimittecchāmātrapratipattyarthaṃ śāstraṃ vākyāntaraṃ vā praṇetuṃ śrotuṃ vā pravarttate
atha anena śabdenāmumarthaṃ pratipādayāmītyabhiprāyo vivakṣā, tatsūcakatvena akhilaśabdānāṃ vivakṣānumāpakatvam; tadaṣyanupapannam; vyabhicārāt
kā ceya vivakṣā nāma–kiṃ śabdoccāraṇecchāmātram –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 450
kiñca, samayānapekṣaḥ śabdaḥ tādṛśamabhiprāyaṃ gamayet, tatsāpekṣo vā ? ādyavikalpe na kaścit kvacidbhāṣānabhijñaḥ syāt, sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ śabdārthapratipattiprasaṅgāt
samayāpekṣastu śabdaḥ arthameva kinna gamayet ? nahyayam arthād vibheti yena tatra sākṣānna vartteta
aśakyasamayatvānna śabdo'rthaṃ gamayati; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; abhiprāye'pi tadagamakatvānuṣaṅgāt, tatrāpi tasya aśakyasamayatvāviśeṣāt
asiddhañcāsya aśakyasamayatvam; pramāṇaṃ śrutamartheṣu laghī॰ kā॰ 26 ityatra tacchakyasamayatvasya prapañcataḥ pratipāditatvāt
tulanā–kiñca, samayānapekṣaṃ vākyaṃ tādṛśamabhiprāyaṃ gamayet tatsāpekṣaṃ vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 450
na kevalaṃ suṣuptādau vāgvṛtterdarśanādabhipretavyabhicāritvaṃ kuto'panīyate iti, api tu itaśca
tathā vāñchatāmapi mandabuddhīnāṃ śāstravaktṛtvābhāvāt tatkuto'panīyate ? atrāha paraḥ–ubhayatra ityādi
ubhayatra arthe'bhiprāye ca vyabhicārāt śabdānām na kasyacidarthasya abhiprāyasya vā vācakāḥ śabdāḥ, itiśabdaḥ paramatasamāptyarthaḥ
atra dūṣaṇamāha–alaukikaṃ pratibhānamiti pratibhottarapratītiḥ ityarthaḥ, alaukikañca tat pratibhānañca, lokabādhitam ityarthaḥ
kuta etat ? ityatrāha– loko hi ityādi

yadi hi na kasyacidvācakāḥ śabdāḥ syuḥ tarhitebhyo ghaṭādyarthasya svapne'pyapratīteḥ na tatprāptyā keṣāñcicchabdānāṃ satyatvam anyeṣāṃ tu anṛtatvaṃ viparyayāt ityevaṃ loko vacasāṃ tadvyavasthāmātiṣṭheta ityabhiprāyaḥ
abhiprāyamātre śabdārthe na lokaḥ tadvyavasthāmātiṣṭheta iti sambandhaḥ
tatra tanmātre śabdavyavahārabāhulyābhāvāt, kvacit tatra tadvyava hārepi bahulaṃ bahiḥ tadvyavahāropalambhāt iti bhāvaḥ
ityāha tatra tanmātre ba॰, ityatrāha tatra tanmātre ā॰
nanu pratīyate śabdādarthaḥ sa tu vicāryamāṇo na saṅgacchate, tatra tasya sambandhābhāvataḥ pratyāyakatvāyogāt, ityatrāha–abādhitām ityādi

atrāyamabhiprāyaḥ-yādṛśe'rthe saṅketitaḥ yādṛśaḥ śabda deśāntare kālāntare ca yogyatālakṣaṇasambandhavaśāt tādṛśasya tādṛśo vācakaḥ, na tatra kiñcidvādhakam ityuktam–yogyatāpekṣānādisaṅketaḥ laghī॰ svavṛ॰ kā॰ 62 ityatra

ataḥ abādhitāṃ śabdādupajāyamānāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣātmakārthaviṣayāṃ tatpratītimatikramya svecchayā pratītyanāśrayaṇena pramāṇasvarūpam–pratyakṣānumānalakṣaṇameva pramāṇaṃ nāgamādi iti, prameyasvarūpam pratyakṣasya pūrvāparakoṭivicchinnaṃ svalakṣaṇameva prameyam anumānasya tu anyavyāvṛttimātram ityātiṣṭhamānānāṃ saugatānāṃ yuktam upapannam kiṃ tat ? abhipretamātrasūcakatvam
śrutasya sakalādeśasya āgamasya bhedā vikalpā vikalādeśā
kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? ekānvayānugam, ekañcānvayaśca ekānvayau tāvanugacchati vyāpnotītyekānvayānugam
tatraikānugam arthatā ūrdhvatā sāmānya pūrvāparavyāpakam, sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇa tiryaksāmānyamanvayānugam
puna kiṃ viśiṣṭam ? niścayātmakam, nirgataścayaḥ paryāyāntarasaṃkaro yasmādasau niścaya paryāya sa ātmā yasya tattathoktam
kiṃ viśiṣṭa ? vyatirekapṛthaktvaga, vyatirekaśca pṛthaktvañca te gacchati tādātmyena pariṇamatīti sa tathokta
taṃ jahā ṇegame, saṃgahe, vavahāre, ujjusue, sadde, samabhirūḍhe, evabhūe
sadde ya samamirūḍhe evabhūe ya mūlanayā
siddhasenadivākarāstu ṣaṅ nayān svīkurvanti, tanmatānusāreṇa naigamasya sagrahavyavahārayorantarbhāvāt
vivṛtiḥ–nahi matibhedā nayāḥ trikālagocarānekadravyaparyāyaviṣayatvāt, mateḥ sāmpratikārthagrāhitvāt
vyavahāraparyāyāḥ krodhādayaḥ jīvasya saṃsāriṇaḥ, niścayaparyāyāḥ śuddhasya jñānādayaḥ pratikṣaṇam ātmasātkṛtānantabhedāḥ
niścayanayāt pudgaladravyamekam, pṛthivyādibhede'pi rūparasagandhasparśavattvam āvirbhūtānāvirbhūtasvarūpamajahat skandhaparamāṇuparyāyabhedepi rūpādimattvamaparijahat
nahi avasthādeśakālasaṃskārāḥ mūrttatvamatyantaṃ bhindanti amūrttabhedaprasaṅgāt, sattābhedāśca jīvādayaḥ sattām ityuktaprāyaṃ nehocyate
bhedavādino'pi jñānamekam ekasmin kṣaṇe svayamanekākāramātmasātkurvat kathaṃ nirākuryuḥ ? tataḥ tīrthakaravacanasaṃgrahaviśeṣaprastāvamūlavyākāriṇau dravyārthikaparyāyārthikau niścetavyau
nahi tṛtīyaṃ prakārāntaramasti; tasya pramāṇa evā'ntarbhāvāt
tulanā–utpannāvinaṣṭārthagrāhaka sāmpratakālaviṣaya matijñāna śrutajñānaṃ tu trikālaviṣayam utpannavinaṣṭānutpannārthagrāhakam
davvaṭṭhio ya pajjavaṇao ya sesā viyappāsiṃ
śrutasya āgamasya bhedāḥ viśeṣāḥ na punarmatijñānasya
dravyaparyāyau mūlam āśrayo yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ
ekaśabdo'yaṃ bhāvapradhānaḥ, ekatvañca anvayaśca sadṛśapariṇāmaḥ tābhyāṃ yathāsaṃkhyena svaparyāyān dravyāntarāṇi ca anugacchati anuyāti iti ttadanugam
ekatvānugam ityanena bhedaikāntaniṣedha, anvayānugam ityanena tu sarvadravyaikatvanirāsaḥ
tadevavidha dravyaṃ pramāṇāparicchedyaṃ bhaviṣyati ityatrāha–niścayātmakam iti
saśayādivyavacchedalakṣaṇā prameyasthā gṛhītikriyā niścayaḥ, sa ātmā svabhāvo yasya tat tathoktam
na kevalaṃ dravyameva niścayātmakam, kintu anyo'pi paryāyo'pi, niścayātmakaḥ iti liṅgapariṇāmena sambandha
svadravyaparyāyāntarāpekṣayā vyatirekaṃ parasparavyāvṛttim ekadravyāparityāgena gacchatīti vyatirekagaḥ, dravyāntaraparyāyāpekṣayā pṛthaktvaṃ pṛthagdravyavṛttitva gacchatīti pṛthaktvagaḥ
nanu yadi naigamādayo nayā dravyaparyāyamūlāḥ tarhi dravyārthikaparyāyārthikalakṣaṇau mūlanayau kimmūlau ? ityāha–niścaya ityādi
cetanasya acetanasya vā yaḥ san svabhāvaḥ na kadācidvinaśyati tadavalambī nayo niścayaḥ dravyārthikanayaḥ ityartha
yo vinaśyati svabhāvaḥtadavalambī vyavahāraḥ paryāyārthika iti yāvat tau
vakṣyati ca tatra mūlanayau dravyaparyāyārthikau ityādi
tatra prathamakārikāyāḥ prathamabhāgaṃ vyatirekamukhena vivṛṇvannāha–nahi ityādi
nahi naiva matibhedāḥ kintu śrutabhedāḥ, ke te ? nayāḥ
trayaḥ kālā gocaro yeṣām anekadravyaparyāyāṇāṃ te viṣayo yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ bhāvāt tattvāt
mateḥ indriyajanitāyāḥ sāmpratikārthagrāhitvāt varttamānakālagocaradravyaparyāyātmakārthagrāhakatvāt na matibhedā nayāḥ iti sambandhaḥ
anindriyajanitāyāstasyāḥ te tarhi bhedāḥ bhavantu tasyā trikālagocaradravyādiviṣayatvāt ityatrāha–manomateḥ ityādi
na kevalam indriyamateḥ api tu manomaterapi nahi bhedāḥ nayāḥ iti sambandhaḥ
viśadā'vitathā matiḥ manomateḥ kāraṇatvāt kāraṇamatiḥ ityucyate, tayā paricchinno yo'rthaḥ tadviṣayatvānmanomateḥ
tatraivaṃ śrutabhedatve nayānāṃ vyavasthite mūlanayau kāraṇanayau naigamādīnām
kau ? ityāha–dravyaparyāyārthikau, dravyañca paryāyaśca tāveva arthau tau yathāsaṃkhyena vidyete yayoḥ tau tathoktau
ekatvānvayau vyākhyātau, tau ātmā yasya tat tadātmakam
sa ca vivakṣitaḥ asaśca avivakṣitaḥ tadatau, tau ca tau pariṇāmau ca tau yasya staḥ tat tadatatpariṇāmi, yadi vā, tayoḥ pariṇamata ityevaṃ śīlaṃ tadatatpariṇāmi, tasya bhāvāt tattvāt
sāmpratam anvayātmakaṃ tat ityetat samarthayate–anvayi dravyāntareṇa anugamavad dravyam iti sambandhaḥ
atrāha saugataḥ–asamānānapekṣya samānapariṇāmāḥ anupādānopādeyānapekṣya ekapariṇāmāḥ kecana bhāvāḥ kalpyante na paramārthataḥ, apekṣākṛtasya dharmasyā'tāttvikatvāt; ityatrāha–puruṣa ityādi
asyāyamarthaḥ–nānaikasantānātmanām nānāsantānasvabhāvānām ekasantānasvabhāvānāñca yugapatkramabhāvināṃ kṣaṇānām ityarthaḥ

teṣāṃ yadapekṣātaḥ yathoktāyāḥ apekṣāyāḥ sakāśāt kalpitaṃ puruṣatvaṃ tiryaksāmānyam, ādiśabdena dravyaviśeṣaparigrahaḥ, tasmāt satyapi vidyamāne'pi samānetarapariṇāmātiśaye samānapariṇāmātiśaye tatprakarṣe itarapariṇāmātiśaye ekatvapariṇāmaprakarṣe

nanu itaraśabdasya uktaviparītārthābhidhāyitvāt samānapariṇāmād itaro visadṛśapariṇāma eva labhyate, na ekatvapariṇāmātiśaya iti cet, evametat, tathāpi–iha samānaikatvapariṇāmātiśayayoḥ prakṛtatvāt samānapariṇāmāt itaraḥ ekatvapariṇāma eva ucyate
nahi tathā'pariṇatam apekṣātaḥ tad bhavati vipratiṣedhāt, anyathā svayamamūrttamapi jñānaṃ jñānāntarāt amūrttāt vyavarttamāna mūrttaṃ syāt
nanu ca vicāryamāṇasya tadatatpariṇāminaḥ sadṛśapariṇāmalakṣaṇasāmānyasya cānupapatteḥ abhimatarūpavad anabhimatarūpeṇāpi prasaṅgācca ayuktam–ekatvamityādi, iti cedatrāha–tathā ityādi

tathā tadatiśayaprakāreṇa yau saṅkara-vyatikarau tayoḥ vyatirekād abhāvād anvayinoḥ tadatatpariṇāmisāmānyayoḥ askhalatsamānaikapratyayaviṣayatvam sākalyena nānaikasantānātmasvabhāvam anumimīmahe anumānena pratipadyāmahe anumānanimittasya uktatarkasya pravijṛmbhaṇāt ityabhiprāyaḥ
dravyamityādi dravyamityanuvarttate ba॰, dravyamityādi ityanuvarttate śra॰
na hi agnitvenāpariṇata apekṣāta anagnivyāvṛttyapekṣayā agnirbhavati, jalādāvapi anagnivyāvṛttyā agnitvaprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt iti bhāva
yadi vā vaiśeṣikādirāha–puruṣatvamapekṣya samānapariṇāmātiśayo nānātmasu, buddhyādiguṇasamavāyitvamapekṣya ekātmani ekatvapariṇāmātiśayo na paramārthataḥ iti; tatrāha–puruṣatvādeḥ ityādi
puruṣatvam ādiryasya buddhyādisamavāyitva-triguṇasaṃyogitvādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tasya yā apekṣā tataḥ satyapi samānetarapariṇāmātiśaye
nānā ekasantānāśca te ātmānaśca teṣām iti, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat
nanu bhavatu ātmanā samānaikatvapariṇāmaḥ na ghaṭādīnāṃ tatra samānapariṇāmasyaiva saṃbhavāt ityāśaṅkyāha–tathāhi ityādi
tathāhi tena askhalatsamānaikapratyayaviṣayatvaprakāreṇa ca skandho ghaṭādyavayavī, sa kim ? ityāha–ekatvam
svaśabdena skandhaḥ parāmṛśyate tasya ye guṇā rūpādayaḥ ye ca paryāyā navapurāṇādayaḥ teṣām ekatvam na samānapariṇāmaḥ askhaladekapratyayaviṣayatvāt iti bhāvaḥ
nanu bhinnasantānātmanāmiva ekasantānātmanāmapi samānapariṇāma evāstu iti saugataḥ
na kevalaṃ skandhaḥ kintu puruṣo'pi svaguṇaparyāyāṇāmekatvam iti sambandhaḥ
nanu yathā kramabhāvināṃ sukhādīnāmekatvaṃ puruṣaḥ tathā yugapadbhāvināmātmanām ekatvaṃ so'stu iti cedatrāha–samāna ityādi
samānapariṇāma eva sakalapadārthagaḥ naikatvaṃ sakalapadārthagam puruṣasya iti vibhaktipariṇāmena sambandhaḥ
anena tathābhāva ityādi samarthitam, dravyamekānvayānugam iti kārikāpādaśca vyākhyātaḥ
niścayanayād dravyārthikanayād ekaḥ abhinnaḥ jīvaḥ sarvo'pi sarvasādhāraṇacetanāpariṇāmāpekṣayā
sa eva dvividho vyahāranayāt iti darśayannāha–karma ityādi
karmaṇā jñānāvaraṇīyādinā nirmukto rahito jīvaḥ, sakarmakaśca
tathā ca tena ba॰, tathā tena ā॰
tatra pṛthaktvapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe–pṛthaktvam, ekatra ekasmin dravye guṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣāṇāṃ parasparaparihāreṇa kathañcit avasthānam ityarthaḥ
niścayaparyāyāḥ dravyārthikagocarāḥ paryāyāḥ śuddhasya jīvasya iti sambandhaḥ
kathambhūtāste ? te ca ityāha ityāha te ca pratikṣaṇam ātmasātkṛtānantabhedāḥ
na kevalaṃ dravyārthikanayājjīvasyaiva abhedaḥ api tu pudgaladravyasyāpi ityāha–niścaya ityādi
ajahat aparityajat, kim ? ityāha–rūparasagandhasparśavattvam rūparasagandhasparśavantaḥ pudgalāḥ tattvārthasū॰ 5
pṛthivyāṃ tad āvirbhūtasvarūpaṃ jalādau anāvirbhūtasvarūpam, jale gandhasya anale gandharasayoḥ anile rūparasagandhānāmanāvirbhāvāt

nanu jalādau gandhādisadbhāve pramāṇataḥ siddhe anāvirbhāvo yuktaḥ, anyathā sarvasya sarvatrā'nāvirbhāvaprasaṅgāt sāṃkhyadarśanapratiprasaṅgaḥ syāt iti cet; ucyate–jalādayo gandhādimantaḥ, sparśavattvāt, yaditthaṃ taditthaṃ yathā pṛthivī, sparśādimantaścaite, tasmādgandhādimanta iti
yat punaḥ gandhādimanna bhavati na tat sparśavat yathā ātmādi, ityādi ṣaṭpadārthaparīkṣāyāṃ pṛthivyādīnāmatattvāntarabhāvasamarthanāvasare prapañcataḥ prarūpitamihāvagantavyam

skandhāśca ghaṭādayaḥ paramāṇavaḥ atyantasūkṣmāḥ pudgalāḥ ta eva paryāyāḥ parasparataḥ prādurbhāvāt, paramāṇubhyo hi skandhāḥ prādurbhavanti tebhyaśca paramāṇava iti, teṣāṃ bhedepi rūpādimattvamaparityajadekaṃ
dṛṣṭāntārthametat, tato yathā tat paramāṇurūpaṃ skandhībhavat skandhasvabhāvaṃ vā paramāṇurūpatāmādadhat rūpādimattvamaparityajat ekaṃ tathā prakṛtamapi iti
hiryasmāt na avasthā ca deśaśca kālaśca saṃskāraśca te mūrttatvaṃ rūpādimattvam rūpādimayī mūrttiḥ ityabhidhānāt
atyantaṃ suṣṭhu bhindanti pṛthivyādibhedasya skandhaparamāṇuparyāyabhedasya ca iti sambandhaḥ
amūrtto rūpādirahito yo bhedaḥ vyaktiviśeṣaḥ tasya prasaṅgāt
yathā ca avasthādayo na rūpādimattvamatyantaṃ bhindanti, tathā sattābhedāśca location unknown jīvādayaḥ sattām atyanta na bhindanti iti sambandhaḥ
asadbhedaprasaṅgāt ityuktaprāyaṃ jīvājīvaprabhedā yadantarlīnāḥ laghī॰ kā॰ 31 ityatra, neha punarucyate

nanu jīvādidravyasya sattādisāmānyasya vā kasyacidasaṃbhavāt niścayanayādeko jīvaḥ ityādyayuktam, tatsaṃbhave ca avasthādibhedena viruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ bhedaprasaṅgānna tadekatvam ityāśaṅkyāha–bheda ityādi
ye viruddhadharmādhyāsataḥ sarvathā vastuno bhedaṃ vadanti saugatāḥ te'pi kathaṃ naiva nirākuryuḥ ? kiṃ tat ? jñānam, kathambhūtam ? ekam
kiṃ kurvat ? svayam ātmano'nekākāraṃ nīlapītādivicitrākāraṃ grāhyagrāhakākāraviviktetararūpatayā pratyakṣaparokṣākāraṃ vā ātmasātkurvat
sā ca pratyakṣaparicchede prapañcataḥ pratikṣiptā ityalaṃ puna prasaṅgena
tato yathā viruddhadharmādhyāse'pi ekamekadā jñānamaviruddhaṃ tathā krameṇa jīvādidravyamapi iti
asaścāsau bheda viśeṣa tasya prasaṅgāt asadrūpatvaprasaṅgādityartha
citrajñānam, grāhyagrāhakādyanekākāra savedanam grāhyādyākārarāhitya-savedanāpekṣayā pratyakṣaparokṣātmaka savedana vā

yata uktaprakāreṇa jīvādi sukhādiparyāyātmaka vyavasthitaṃ tataḥ tīrthakarasya bhavāvato'rhato vacanaṃ syādvādapravacanaṃ tasya viṣayabhūtāḥ, śrutabhedatvāt nayānām, ye saṅgrahaviśeṣāḥ saṅgrahaśca viśeṣāśca vyavahārādinayabhedāḥ teṣā prastārasya prapañcaprarūpaṇasya mūlavyākāriṇau ādyau utpādakau niścetavyau
anyaḥ kuto neti cet ? atrāha–nahi ityādi
tasya tadantarasya pramāṇe eva na naye antarbhāvāt na tadasti iti sambandhaḥ
naigamo'pi tarhi pramāṇa syāt iti cedatrāha–na ityādi
tādātmyena pramāṇasvabhāvatvena vivakṣāyāḥ abhāvāt, nayatvena vivakṣāsadbhāvāt ityarthaḥ
kva ? ekadharmiṇi eko'bhinno dharmī dravyaṃ tasmin
kā ? atyantabhedokti atyanto nirapekṣa bhedo nānātva tasyoktirvacana naiyāyikādyabhiprāyo naigamābhāsa ityartha
vivṛtiḥ–jīvaḥ sannamūrttaḥ karttā sūkṣmo jñātā draṣṭā'saṃkhyātapradeśo bhoktā pariṇāmī nityaḥ pṛthivyādibhūtavilakṣaṇaḥ iti pradhānavṛttyā jīvasvattattvanirūpaṇāyāṃ guṇībhūtāḥ sukhādayaḥ
guṇaguṇinām avayavyavayavānāṃ kriyākārakāṇāṃ jātitadvatāṃ cetyādi tādātmyamavivakṣitvā guṇaguṇinoḥ dharmidharmayorvā guṇapradhānabhāvena vivakṣā naigame, saṃgrahādau ekavivakṣeti bhedaḥ

guṇapradhānabhāvena mukhyāmukhyarūpatā dharmayoḥ ekasmin dharmiṇi vivakṣā pratipatturabhisandhiḥ naigamaḥ sa kathaṃ pradhānabhūtobhayadharmasvabhāvadharmiviṣayapramāṇarūpatāṃ pratipadyeta ? tadābhāsamāha–atyantabhedoktiḥ dharmayoḥ ekadharmiṇi iti sambandhaḥ, syāt tadākṛtiḥ naigamābhāso bhavet

kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha–jīvaḥ sannamūrttaḥ sūkṣmo jñātā draṣṭā karttā'saṃkhyātapradeśī bhoktā pariṇāmī nityaḥ pṛthivyādibhūtavilakṣaṇaḥ evaṃ pradhānavṛttyā jīvasvatattvanirūpaṇāyāṃ jīvasvarūpaprarūpaṇāyāṃ kriyamāṇāyāṃ guṇībhūtāḥ sukhādayo dharmāḥ
āhlādanākāraṃ sukhaṃ tadviparītasvarūpaṃ duḥkhaṃ svārthagrahaṇasvabhāvaṃ jñānam ityevaṃ mukhyataḥ sukhādisvarūpanirūpaṇāyāṃ vā ātmā guṇībhūtaḥ iti sambandhaḥ
yato'sau dharmadharmiṇostadātmyaṃ sadapi avivakṣitvā svadurāgamavāsanāviparyāsitamateḥ pratipattuḥ pravarttate tato'sau naigamābhāsaḥ iti
dharmadharmiṇoḥ ityupalakṣaṇārthametat, tena avayavāvayavinoḥ kriyākārakayoḥ jātitadvatośca grahaṇam
dharmayorvā guṇapradhānabhāvena vivakṣā naigame yataḥ tato'tyantabhedavivakṣā tadābhāsa ityabhiprāyaḥ
saṃgrahaḥ ādiryasya vyavahārādeḥ sa tathoktaḥ tatra ekasya guṇādeḥ guṇyādervā vivakṣā iti hetoḥ bhedaḥ naigamāt saṃgrahādeḥ iti
vyākhyā–samastasya jīvājīvaviśeṣasya aikyena aikatvena sagrahāt sakṣiṣya grahaṇāt
kathamanekasya sakṣepaṇamityāśaṅkyāha–sadabhedāt, sat sattvasāmānya saccāsāvabhedaśca tamāśritya
nahi sattvāt kiñcid bhinnamastīti vaktu yukta virodhāt
kuta ? tatsvarūpānavāptita, tasya paraparikalpitabrahmaṇa svarūpa bhedaprapañcaśūnya sanmātra tasyānavāpti pramāṇādaprāptistata, na khalu tat pratyakṣādipramāṇāt prāpyate tathā'pratīte
samastasya jīvājīvaviśeṣaprapañcasya aikyena saṃgrahāt kāraṇāt saṃgraho nayaḥ pravarttate ityupaskāraḥ
brahmavādo'pi sadabhedamāśritya samastaikyaṃ saṃgṛhāti iti so'pi saṃgrahaḥ syādityatrāha–durnaya ityādi
tasya brahmaṇaḥ yatsvarūpaṃ nirākṛtasakalabhedaprapañcaṃ sattāmātraṃ tasya anavāptitaḥ prāpterabhāvāt
kārikāṃ vivṛṇvannāha–sarvam ityādi sarvaṃ cetanācetanarūpaṃ vastujātam ekaṃ sadaviśeṣāt iti evaṃ saṃgrahanayaḥ pravarttate
nāpi tasya brahmaṇaḥ upeyatvaṃ svīkaraṇīyatvam upāyābhāvāt ityabhisambandhaḥ
yasya upāyāmāvo na taduṣeyam yathā kharaviṣāṇam, upāyābhāvaśca brahmaṇaḥ iti
yathā cāsya na kaścidupāyo ghaṭate tathā brahmādvaitaniṣedhāvasare vyāsataḥ cintitam
tatra pramāṇetaravyavasthānibandhanatvāt vyavahāro naya, anyathā tadābhāsa ityartha
vivṛtiḥ–pramāṇānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ vyavahārāvisaṃvādāt iti ākumāraṃ prasiddham, anyathā saṃśayaviparyāsasvapnajñānādīnāmapi prāmāṇyamanivāryaṃ syāt

utpādavigamadhrauvyalaṇaṃ sat guṇaparyayavaddravyam jīvaścaitanyasvabhāvaḥ ityādi śrutajñānasya pramāṇāntarābādhana-pūrvāparāvirodhalakṣaṇasaṃvādasaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyam, arthābhidhānapratyayātmakavyavahārānukūlyācca
pramāṇānām adhyakṣādīnāṃ yā pramāṇatā saugatādibhiriṣyate sā vyavahārānukūlyādeva upapannā nānyathā, anyathā vyavahāraprātikūlyaprakāreṇa na, kuta etat ? ityatrāha–bādhyamāna ityādi
pramāṇānāṃ pratyakṣādīnāṃ prāmāṇyam amithyātvam iṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihāralakṣaṇavyavahārāvisaṃvādāt, ityetat ākumāram ābālaṃ prasiddham
anyathā vyavahārāvisaṃvādābhāvaprakāreṇa tatprāmāṇye saṃśayaviparyāsasvapnajñānādīnāmapi prāmāṇyamanivāryaṃ syāt
tadavisaṃvādācca tatprāmāṇye yat pareṣāṃ nirvikalpakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tadapramāṇaṃ vyavahārāvisaṃvādābhāvāt iti manyamānaḥ prāhaḥ–pratyakṣam ityādi
pratyakṣaṃ savikalpakam pramāṇaṃ syāt ityanena sambandhaḥ
na punaḥ nirvikalpakaṃ tadviparyayāt iti bhāvaḥ
sāmprataṃ śrutasya tata eva prāmāṇyaṃ darśayannāha–utpāda ityādi

utpādavigamadhrauvyāṇi lakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya tadetallakṣaṇaṃ jīvādivastu sad bhavati, guṇaparyayavadravyaṃ jīvaścaitanyasvabhāvaḥ ityevamādiśrutajñānasya aspaṣṭatarkaṇasya prāmāṇyaṃ syāt iti gatena sambandhaḥ
śrutāt anyat pratyakṣādi pramāṇāntaraṃ tena abādhanañca pūrvāparayoḥ śrutavākyayoḥ avirodhaśca lakṣaṇaṃ yasya saṃvādasya tasya tatra saṃbhavāt
artho jīvādiḥ abhidhānaṃ jīvādiśabdaḥ pratyayaḥ tadviṣayo jñānaṃ te ātmā yasya vyavahārasya tasyānukūlyācca hetoḥ śrutajñānasya prāmāṇyam iti sambandhaḥ
bahirarthaśca vijñaptimātrañca tābhyāṃ śūnyaṃ tatpratipādakavacasāṃ durnayatvam
nahi tadvacassu iṣṭāniṣṭaprāptiparihārādilakṣaṇavyavahārasya avirodho yuktaḥ pramāṇaprameyasadbhāve satyeva asyā'virodhāt
lakkhaṇa pajjavāṇa tu ubhao assiā bhave
guṇapajjayāsaya vā ja ta bhaṇṇanti savvaṇhū
ta pariyāṇa hu davvu tuhu~ jaṃ guṇapajjayajuttu
sahabhuva jāṇahi tāha~ guṇa kamabhuva pajjau uttu
prādhānyata mukhyatvena, anena gauṇatvena dravyamapyapekṣata ityartha
kiṃ viśiṣṭa ? ekatvavikṣepī, ekatva dravya vikṣipati nirākarotyevaśīla ekatvavikṣepī
katham ? sarvathā prādhānyato'prādhānyataśca, puna kiṃ viśiṣṭa ? alaukika loko vyavahārastatprayojano laukika tadviparyayo'laukika alaukikādityartha
na hi paraspara sajātīyavijātīyavyāvṛttā pratikṣaṇaviśarārava paramāṇavo vyavahriyante parīkṣakai yatastidvaṣayo nayābhāso na syāt
vivṛtiḥ–bahiraṇavaḥ saṃcitāḥ sthūlamekākārapratyayamabhūtaṃ yathā darśayanti tadvat saṃvitparamāṇavo'pi citrākāramekam
tato naikamanekarūpaṃ tattvamakramaṃ yat sakramaṃ sādhayet bhedasyābhedavirodhāt, anyathā kvacinnānātmeva na syāt
pratibhāsabhedāt svabhāvabhedaṃ vyavasthāpayan tadabhedādabhedaṃ pratipadyata eva viśeṣābhāvāt, tadanyatarāpāye arthasyā'nupapatteḥ
saugatamate puñjībhūtā paramāṇava eva sthūlākārapratyahetava; tathāhi–arthāntarābhisambandhājjāyante ye'ṇavo'pare
sarvasya sarvato bhedaṃ prādhānyato'nvicchan ṛju prāñjala varttamānaparyāyamātraṃ sūtrayati prarūpayati iti ṛjusūtraḥ nayo mataḥ
pradhānaśabdasya ca sambandhiśabdatvāt dravyaṃ tasya apradhānam
sarvathā guṇapradhānabhāvābhāvaprakāreṇa ekatvavikṣepī ekatvanirākārakaḥ tadābhāsaḥ ṛjusūtrābhāsaḥ
na khalu sarvathaikatvapratikṣepeṇa sthāsakośakuśūlādau bālakumārādau vā bhedavyavahāro loke prasiddhaḥ
ṛju praguṇa sūtrayati tantrayata iti ṛjusūtra
bahiraṇavaḥ darśayanti janayanti sthūlamekākārapratyayam, kiṃviśiṣṭam ? abhūtam aparamārthaviṣayam
evavidhāste yathā yena prakāreṇa tathā vidhaṃ pratyayaṃ darśayanti tadvat saṃvitparamāṇavo'pi, kathambhūtam ? citrākāram, nīlādigrāhyādyanekākāramekam ata eva abhūtam
yasmādekākārapratyayasya aparamārthaviṣayatvaṃ tato naikamabhinnasvabhāvaṃ tattvaṃ jīvādivastu akramaṃ yugapad anekarūpam yuktam ityupaskāraḥ
yat sakramaṃ kramavat sukhādibhedabhinnam ātmānaṃ sādhayet
anyathā anyena tadavirodhaprakāreṇa kvacid ghaṭapaṭādau nānātvameva na syāt iti
saha pratyanīkadharmāpekṣayā varttate iti sāpekṣaḥ nayaḥ
apekṣāto niṣkrāntaḥ nirastā vā apekṣā yenāsau nirapekṣaḥ durnayaḥ
nanu pramāṇābhāvena abhedasya kvacidanupapatteḥ kathaṃ tadapekṣo nayaḥ syāt ? ityatrāha–pratibhāsa ityādi
pratibhāsasya pratyakṣādisaṃvedanākārasya bhedāt svabhāvabhedaṃ cetanetarasvarūpanānātvaṃ vyavasthāpayan saugataḥ tadabhedāt pratibhāsābhedāt abhedaṃ pratipadyata eva viśeṣābhāvāt
etacca arthakriyā na yujyeta nityakṣaṇikapakṣayoḥ laghī॰ kā॰ 8 ityatra saprapañcaṃ prapañcitam
tayoḥ bhedābhedayormadhye anyatarasya bhedasya abhedasya vā apāye arthasya uttarakāryasya saṃvedanasya vā'nupapatteḥ, sāpekṣo nayaḥ nirapekṣo durnaya iti
atha saptanayeṣu madhye ke arthapradhānāḥ ke ca śabdapradhānāḥ ? ityāha–
ke ? naigamādaya prāguktā catvāro'rthanayā arthapradhānā nayāḥ
trayaḥ śeṣā śabdasamabhirūḍhaivambhūtāḥ śabdanayā śabdapradhānā nayā
kiṃ viśiṣṭā ? satyapadavidyā samāśritā, satyāni pramāṇāntarābādhitāni padāni kālakārakādibhedavācīni teṣā vidyā vyākaraṇaśāstra tāmāśritā ālavināḥ vyākaraṇāśritatvādityartha
tatra sagrahavyavahārarjusūtrā arthanayāḥ śeṣā śabdanayā –rājavā॰ pṛ॰ 186
eṣu catvāraḥ prathame'rthanirūpaṇapravaṇatvādarthanayāḥ śeṣāstu traya śabdavācyagocaratayā śabdanayāḥ
vivṛtiḥ–kālakārakaliṅgabhedāt śabdaḥ arthabhedakṛt abhūt bhavati bhavi ṣyati, karoti kriyate, devadatto devadattā iti
paryāyabhedād abhirūḍho'rthabhedakṛt indraḥ śakraḥ purandara iti
yadā na karoti tadā karttṛtvasya ayogāt iti
kathaṃ punaḥ śabdajñānaṃ vivakṣavyatiriktamarthaṃ pratyeti ? kathaṃ ca na ? tadapratibandhāt
nahi buddherakāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ ityetat prativyūḍham; vijñānasya anāgatanirṇayāt

kṛttikodayadarśane śakaṭodayo bhaviṣyati buddhiravisaṃvādinī, ādityaḥ śva udetā, sūryācandramasoḥ grahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tantavaḥ paṭo bhaviṣyanti, mṛtpiṇḍo ghaṭo bhaviṣyati, tandulā bhaviṣyantyodanam, brīhayaḥ tandulā bhaviṣyanti, ityādyanāgataviṣayāṇām avisaṃvādinām ānantyāt
tataḥ śabdajñānamapi vivakṣāvyatiriktārthagrāhi siddhaṃ pratibandhamantareṇāpi tatpratipādanasvābhāvyāt vijñānavaditi
varttanālakṣaṇaḥ kālaḥ, kriyāviṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ kārakam, styāna-prasava-tadubhayābhāvasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ liṅgam, kathañcid vastusvabhāvabhedakaṃ tathāpratīteḥ
kriyābhedāt eko'pi śabdaḥ kriyānimittakavyutpattiḥ tadabhāvāt tadarthaṃ nācaṣṭe iti paramaiśvaryamanubhavanneva indraḥ nānyadā, tataḥ siddhaḥ kriyābhedaḥ pācakapāṭhakādivat
nahi varṇapadavākyānāṃ vyutpādakaṃ śāstraṃ vitatham paramārthaśabdaprāptyupāyakṛt jñāturabhiprāyātmakanayavat

vyāvahārikaprakṛtyādiprakriyārpravibhāgena yathā pāramārthikādanekāntātmakādarthādapoddhṛtya tadaṃśamekāntaṃ vyāvahārikaṃ tatpratipattyupāyaṃ prakāśayan nayaḥ na mithyātvamanubhavet, nirapekṣasyaiva mithyātvāt
anekāntanirākṛteḥ nirapekṣatvam tadanirākṛteḥ sāpekṣatvaṃ nānyathā nayānāṃ samyaktvamithyātve iti sthitam
cattvāra ete naigama-saṃgraha-vyavahāra-ṛjusūtrākhyā vyākhyātasvarūpā hi sphuṭam arthanayā eva arthapradhānanayā arthanayāḥ
trayaḥ śabdasamabhirūḍhaivambhūtāḥ śabdanayāḥ śabdapradhānā nayāḥ śabdanayāḥ
satyāni avitathāni apaśabdasvarūparahitāni yāni padāni kālakārakādibhedavācīni teṣāṃ vidyā vyākaraṇaṃ yatra tāni vyutpādyante tāṃ samāśritāḥ yataḥ tataḥ te śabdapradhānāḥ
kārikāpūrvārddhasya anantarameva vyākhyātatvāt uttarārddhaṃ vivṛṇvannāha–kāla ityādi
śacīpateḥ indanādikriyāṃ kurvata eva kārakatvam, yadā na karoti tadā karttṛtvasyā'yogāt iti
katham ? na kathañcit, punaḥ ityākṣepe, śabdajñānaṃ śabdasya kārya yadarthajñānaṃ tat vivakṣāvyatiriktamarthaṃ bahiḥsvalakṣaṇaṃ pratyeti viṣayīkaroti
tadapratibandhe'pi tat tamavevaiti iti cedatrāha–nahi ityādi
hiryasmāt na buddheḥ akāraṇaṃ kintu kāraṇaṃ viṣayaḥ ityetat prativyūḍham
anāgatasya alabdhātmalābhatayā akāraṇabhūtasya arthasya nirṇayāt nirṇayasaṃbhavāt

tathāhi–kṛttikodayadarśane śakaṭodayo bhaviṣyati buddhiravisaṃvādinī, evam ādityaḥ śva udetā, sūryācandramasorgrahaṇaṃ bhaviṣyati, tantavaḥ paṭo bhaviṣyanti, mṛtpiṇḍo ghaṭo bhaviṣyati, tandulāḥ bhaviṣyantyodanaḥ, brīhayaḥ tandulā bhaviṣyanti ityādyanāgataviṣayāṇāmavisaṃvādināṃ jñānānāmānantyāt
tataḥ ityādinā prakṛtamarthamupasaṃharannāha–yataḥ anāgataviṣayatvaṃ jñānasya siddhaṃ tataḥ śabdajñānamapi na kevalaṃ pratyakṣānumānajñānam vivakṣāvyatiriktārthagrāhi siddham
nanu śabdasya arthapratibandhābhāvāt kathaṃ tajjñānam arthagrāhi ? ityatrāha–pratibandha ityādi
pratibandhamantareṇāpi tādātmyatadutpattisambandhaṃ vināpi tasya śabdasya yat pratipādakaṃ svābhāvyaṃ yogyatālakṣaṇaṃ svarūpaṃ tasmāt tat tadgrāhi siddham
śabdajñānasya dārṣṭāntikatvāt iha vijñānagrahaṇena yat prāg arthājanyatayā samarthitaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tadeva gṛhyate, tadiva tadvaditi
śakaṭodaye bhavi– ā॰, śakaṭodaye ca bhavi– śra॰

nanu kālādibhedāt śabdanayasya arthabhedakatvaṃ pratipāditam, kālādīnāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ noktam, nacālakṣitarūpāṇām arthabhedapratītihetutvaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt ityāśaṅkya teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prarūpayannāha–varttanā ityādi
sakalapadārthānāṃ vṛttihetutvaṃ varttanā sā lakṣaṇaṃ yasya asau tallakṣaṇaḥ kālaḥ
kriyayā āviṣṭaṃ yuktaṃ dravyaṃ kārakam, kriyāṃ kurvaddravyaṃ kārakamityarthaḥ
tade taduktalakṣaṇaṃ kālādi kathañcid vastusvabhāvabhedakam tathāpratīteḥ pratipattavyam
nanu paryāyabhedādabhirūḍho'rthabhedakṛt ityayuktamuktam, paryāyasyārthā'bhedakatvāt ityāśaṅkyāha–paryāya ityādi
na kevalaṃ kālādayaḥ kintu paryāyo'pi indraḥ, śakraḥ, purandaraḥ ityādirūpaḥ arthasya śacīpatyādeḥ bhedakaḥ kathañcid vailakṣaṇyāpādakaḥ tathāpratīteḥ ityanantareṇābhisambandhāt
yadapi kriyāśraya evabhbhūtaḥ ityuktam, tatrāpi kuto'sya ekatrāpi paryāye kriyābhedād bhedahetutvam ? ityatrāha–kriyā ityādi

kriyābhedād indanādibhedāt eko'pi śabdaḥ indrādiparyāyarūpaḥ kriyānimittakavyutpattiḥ tadabhāvāt tannimittakavyutpatterabhāvāt tadartham indrādyarthaṃ nācaṣṭe iti hetoḥ paramaiśvaryam indanakriyāṃ anubhavanneva indraḥ nānyadā abhipecanādikāle
evaṃ śakanakāla eva śakraḥ pūrdāraṇasamaya eva purandaraḥ nānyadā tathāpratīteḥ iti gatena sambandhaḥ
yato yatkriyāpariṇataḥ padārthaḥ tatkriyānimattavyutpattikaiḥ śabdaiḥ tatkāla evābhidhīyate nānyadā
tataḥ siddhaḥ kriyābhedo bhedako bhāvānāṃ pācakapāṭhakādivat
nanu kriyāmāśritya śabdā vyākaraṇena vyutpādyante, tacca mithyā ityeke, varṇā eva padameva vākyameva vā satyamityanye, tanmatamapākarttumāha–nahi ityādi
nahi na khalu varṇapadavākyānāṃ vyutpādakaṃ śāstraṃ vyākaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ vitatham paramārthaśabdaprāptyupāyatvāt
nahi vyākaraṇāsatyatve apaśabdavyudāsena samyakśabdapratītyupāyaḥ kaścit saṃbhavati

nanu vṛddhavyavahāraparamparāta eva śabdā'paśabdaviveko bhaviṣyati atastadartha vyākaraṇasamāśrayaṇamayuktam, ityapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; vyākaraṇānapekṣād vṛddhavyavahārādeva ānantyenā'khilaśabdānāṃ pratipadaṃ tadvivekasya karttumaśakyatvāt
vyākaraṇāśrayaṇena tu sāmānyaviśeṣavatā lakṣaṇena upalakṣitānāṃ svalpaprayatnenāpi teṣāṃ tadvivekaḥ karttuṃ suśakaḥ

1 ityekenaiva sūtreṇa kumbhakāra-kāṇḍalāva-śāstrādhyāyādayo bahavaḥ śabdāḥ sallakṣyante, ataḥ vyākaraṇānugṛhītāt lokavyavahārāt sukhenaiva śabdāpaśabdavibhāgasya karttuṃ śakyatvāt asti vyākaraṇasyopayogaḥ
na cāsyā'pramāṇatvāt tadvibhāge nopayogaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tadaprāmāṇye kartrādikārakaprapañcasya samplavaprasaṅgāt
ataḥ ayameva tadasamplavaḥ svasiddhaye vyākaraṇaṃ pramāṇayati, anyataḥ tadvyavasthānupapatteḥ
vyākaraṇata eva hi prakṛtipratyayavibhāgadvāreṇa anyonyavibhaktasya karmakartrādikārakaprapañcasya pratipattiryuktā nānyataḥ, tathāpratipattihetostato'nyasyā'saṃbhavāt

nanu varṇapadavākyānāṃ niraṃśatvāt kiṃ tena prakṛtyādi pravibhāgamāśritya vyutpādyeta ? niraṃśānāmapi teṣāṃ tatpravibhāgaṃ parikalpya vyutpādane tacchāstraṃ vitathameva syāt tatsvarūpā'saṃsparśitvāt ityatrāha–vyāvahārika ityādi
vyavahāre vyavahāranayabhedaprarūpake vaiyākaraṇavyavahāre vā bhavā yā prakṛtyādiprakriyā tasyāḥ pravibhāgo bhedaḥ tena paramārthaḥ vāstavo yaḥ śabdaḥ varṇapadavākyarūpaḥ
varṇo hi udāttādibhedena bhinnaḥ vyavahāre vāstavaḥ prasiddhaḥ, padaṃ tu suptiḍantabhedena, vākyamapi anyonyāpekṣāṇāṃ padānāṃ nirapekṣaḥ samudāyaḥ ityādibhedena iti
yathā ca nityaniraṃśādirūpāṇāṃ varṇapadavākyānāmanupapattiḥ tathā varṇāḥ padāni vākyāni prāhurarthānavāñchitān laghī॰ kā॰ 64 ityatra prapañcataḥ prarūpitam
nahi tadvyutpādakaṃ śāstraṃ vitatham iti sambandhaḥ
prayogaḥ–yaḥ paramārthabhūtasya prāptyupāyo nāsau vitathaḥ yathā jñāturabhiprāyātmako nayaḥ, paramārthabhūtasya śabdasya prāptyupāyaśca varṇapadavākyānāṃ vyutpādakaṃ śāstramiti
tatra jñāturabhiprāyātmakanayavat ityamuṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ yathā ityādinā vyācaṣṭe–yathā yena prakāreṇa na mithyātvamanubhavet, ko'sau ? nayaḥ jñāturabhiprāyaḥ
kiṃ kurvan ? prakāśayan, kiṃ tat ? ekāntam
punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭam ? tatprāptyupāyaṃ tasya anekāntātmakārthasya prāptiḥ tasyā upāyaḥ sā vā upāyo yasya
pratyanīkadharme niṣkrāntā apekṣā yasyāsau nirapekṣaḥ tasyaiva noktaprakārasya mithyātvāt
atha kasya nirapekṣatvaṃ kasya ca sāpekṣatvam ? ityāha–anekāntanirākṛteḥ nirapekṣatvaṃ tadanirākṛteḥ sāpekṣatvam
evaṃvidhasāpekṣānapekṣatvaprakāreṇaiva nayānāṃ samyaktva-mithyātve nānyathā iti sthitam

yuktisvacchajalaṃ subodhakamalaṃ sadbhaṅgavīcīcayam, gambhīraṃ nikhilārthapālikalitaṃ satsādhuhaṃsākulam | prajñādhīśapaṭiṣṭhapāṭhakakhagadhvānapratānānvitam, jīyād durgatitāpatṛḍivatṛḍvihananaṃ jaināgamākhyaṃ saraḥ || cha
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre ṣaṣṭhaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ || cha

vyākhyā–punarapi kathabhūta ? taponirjīrṇakarmā, tapasā yathākhyātacāritralakṣaṇena vyuparatakriyānivṛttiśukladhyānena nirjīrṇāni nirmūlitāni karmāṇi jñānāvaraṇādīni dravyabhāvarūpāṇi yenāsau tathokta
puna kiṃviśiṣṭa ? vivṛddhābhiniveśana, viśeṣeṇa vṛddha kṣāyikasvarūpeṇa pariṇatamabhiniveśana samyagdarśana yasyāsau tathokta
kiṃ kṛtvā vivṛddhābhiniveśana sajāta ityāśakyāha– anuyujya pṛṣṭvā
tatra kimityanuyoge vastusvarūpakathana nirdeśa yathā cetanālakṣaṇo jīva iti
katividha ityanuyoge caitanyasāmānyādekavidha iti prakārakathana vidhānam
kān ? arthavākpratyayātmabhedān, arthaśca vāk ca pratyayaśca te ātmāna svabhāvā yeṣā te ca te bhedāśca vyavahārāstān
kai ? nayānugatanikṣepai, nayān dravyaparyāyaviṣayānanugatā anuvṛttā nikṣepā nyāsāstai
tena ca nikṣiptāḥ padārthaḥ nirdeśādibhiḥ sadādibhiścānuyogaiḥ anuyujyante
anuyuktāḥ prayuktāḥ sarve padārthāḥ, tathāpi jīvapadārthaviṣayaviśeṣaprarūpakāṇi jīvasthānaguṇasthānamārgaṇāsthānāni

evaṃ pramāṇanayanikṣepānuyogaiḥ sarvān padārthānadhigamya puruṣatattvaṃ jīvasthānaguṇasthānamārgaṇāsthānaiḥ dṛḍhataramavabuddhya pravṛddhābhiniveśātmakasamyagdarśanaḥ tapasā nirjīrṇakarmā sarvakarmavinirmuktaḥ bādhārahitamavyavacchinnamanantamatīndriyaṃ sukhamṛcchati ātmā
nahi guṇavināśāt jaḍaḥ guṇaguṇivināśāt śūnyaḥ, bhogyavirahāttadabhoktā, tathādhigamābhāvāt tadbādhāsaṃbhavācca
śarīrādikaṃ dharmi jñānāvaraṇādisvarūpaṃ na bhavati sādhyatā'sya tatsatyapi jñānodayasaṃbhavāt
teṣāmeva viśeṣāpekṣayā ādirantaśca sabhavatīti matipūrvamityucyate, yathā'ṅkuro bījapūrvakaḥ sa ca santānāpekṣayā anādinidhana iti
tulanā– vistareṇa lakṣaṇato vidhānataścādhigamārtho nyāso nikṣepa
ya iha guṇākṣepa syādupacarita kevala sa nikṣepa
tulanā–jattha ya ja jāṇejjā nikkheva nikkhive niravasesa
jatthavi a na jāṇejjā caukkaga nikkhive tattha
mūlācāre ṣaḍāvaśyakādhikāre gā॰ 17 sāmāyikasya nikṣepa nāmasthāpanādravyakṣetrakālabhāvai ṣaḍvidha ukta
atadguṇe vastuni savyavahārārthaṃ puruṣākārānniyujyamānaṃ sajñākarma nāma
jāicchia ca nāma jāvadavva ca pāeṇa
tattha ṇimittaṃ cauvviha jāi davva guṇa kiriyā cedi
ya kāṣṭhapustacitra- karmākṣanikṣepādiṣu sthāpyate jīva iti sthāpanā jīva devatāpratikṛtivad indro rudra skando viṣṇuriti
kīrai va nirāgāra ittaramiyara va sā ṭhavaṇā
ittaramaṇittarā vā ṭhavaṇā nāma tu āvakaha
dravyajīva iti guṇaparyāyaviyukta prajñāsthāpito'nādipāriṇāmikabhāvayukto jīva ucyate
guṇai droṣyate guṇān droṣyatīti vā dravyam
davve puṇa talladdhī jassātītā bhavissate vā vi
jo vā vi aṇuvajutto idassa guṇe parikaheī
danae duyae doravayavo vigāro guṇāṇa sadāvo
davva bhavva bhāvassa bhūabhāva ca ja jogga
bhūtasya bhāvino vā bhāvasya hi kāraṇa tu yalloke
jo puṇa jahatthajutto suddhanayāṇa tu esa bhāviṃdo
atha kimati nikṣepa kriyate iti cet ? ucyate–trividhā śrotāra avyutpanna avagatāśeṣavivakṣitapadārtha ekadeśato'vagatavivakṣitapadārtha iti
dvitīya saśete ko'rtho'sya padasyādhikṛta iti, prakṛtādarthādanyamarthamādāya viparyasyati vā
tatra yadyavyutpanna paryāyārthiko bhavennikṣepa avyutpannavyutpādanamukhena aprakṛtanirākaraṇāya
atha dravyārthika, taddvāreṇa prakṛtaprarūpaṇāyāśeṣanikṣepā ucyante, vyatirekadharmanirṇayamantareṇa vidhinirṇayānupapatte
niddese purise kāraṇa kahiṃ kesu kāla kaiviha
keṇa kasya katthavi kevacira kadividhī ya bhāvo ya
sataparūvaṇā davvapamāṇāṇugamo settāṇugamo phosaṇāṇugamo kālāṇugamo atarāṇugamo bhāvāṇugamo appābahugāṇugamo cedi
se kiṃ ta aṇugame ? navavihe paṇṇatte
ta jahā–satapaya parūvaṇayā, davvapamāṇaṃ ca, khitta, phusaṇā ya, kālo ya, aṃtara, bhāga, bhāva, appābahu ceva
suhumā bādarakāyā te khalu pajjattayā apajjattā
eiṃdiyā du jīvā jiṇehi kahiyā caduviyapyā
pajjattāpajjattā viya hoti vigaliṃdiyā du chabbheyā
pajjattāpajjattā saṇṇi asaṇṇī ya sesā du
micchādiṭṭhī sāsādaṇo ya misso asajado ceva
desavirado pamatto apamatto taha ya ṇāyavvo
gai idie kāe joge vede kasāe ṇāṇe sajame dasaṇe lessā bhaviya sammatta saṇṇi āhārae cedi
gai idiye ca kāye joge vede kasāya ṇāṇe ya
sajama dasaṇa lessā bhaviyā sammatta saṇṇi āhāre
ayaṃ śāstrasya kartā'dhyetā vā ātmā sukhamṛcchati sukhamayo bhavati
vimukto'pi kathambhūtaḥ sannasau syāt ityāha– taponirjīrṇakarmā iti
tapasā yathākhyātacāritralakṣaṇena nirjīrṇāni nirmūlonmīlitāni karmāṇi yenāsau tathoktaḥ
punarapi kathambhūtaḥ sannasau vimuktaḥ syāt ityāha–jīvasthāna ityādi
pratyekaṃ caturdaśabhiḥ jīvasthānaiḥ guṇasthānaiḥ mārgaṇāsthānaiśca tattvavit jīvādisvarūpavit
punarapi kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ sannasau vimuktaḥ syāt ? ityāha–vivṛddha ityādi
viśeṣeṇa vṛddhaṃ kṣāyikarūpatayā paramaprakarṣaṃ prāptam abhiniveśanaṃ samyagdarśanaṃ yasya sa tathoktaḥ
tatrāyamarthaḥ–vivṛddhā'bhiniveśato'yamātmā jīvāditattvavit taponirjīrṇakarmā ca bhavati samyagdarśanapūrvakatvāt samyagjñānacāritrayoriti
anena ca granthena vimukteḥ samyagdarśanajñānacāritrātmikā sāmagrī prarūpitā bhavati, tadanyatamasyāpyapāye tasyā anupapadyamānatvāt
kiṃ kṛttvā'sau vivṛddhābhiniveśanaḥ tattvavicca ityāha–anuyujya ityādi
anuyogaśabdaḥ praśne prativacane ca pravarttate, tadyathā kṛtānuyogo'pi bhavānna kiñcid bravīti tūṣṇīmādāya sthitaḥ ityatra anuyogaśabdaḥ praśne prasiddhaḥ
dattānuyogo'pi bhavān punaḥ punaḥ pṛcchati ityatra tu pṛṣṭaprativacane iti
tenāyamarthaḥ sthito bhavati–anuyujya jīvadravyādeḥ svarūpādi tajjijñāsayā pṛṣṭvā
nirdeśa ādiryeṣāṃ svāmitvādisadādīnāṃ tadbhidāṃ gataiḥ nirdeśādibhedarūpaiḥ ityarthaḥ
nirdeśādau ca praśnaṃ prati dvayī gatiḥ–nāmani nirjñāte lakṣaṇanirṇayārthaḥ praśno bhavati lakṣaṇe vā nirjñāte nāmanirjñānārtha iti
tatra pūrvasmin pakṣe kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jīvādidravyam iti praśnaḥ, upayogādilakṣaṇam iti prativacanam
aparasmin pakṣe upayogādilakṣaṇaḥ kinnāmā padārthaḥ iti praśnaḥ; jīvādināmā ityuttaram
ke punarnirdeśādayaḥ iti cet ? ucyate–kim ityanuṃyoge vastusvarūṣakarūpakathanaṃ nirdeśaḥ
atra kim, kasya, kena, kasmin, kiyacciram, katividham' iti praśnarūpaḥ anuyogaḥ
nirdeśaḥ svarūpābhidhānam, svāmitvamādhipatyam, sādhanamutpattinimittam, adhikaraṇamadhiṣṭhānam, sthiti kālapariccheda, vidhāna prakāra
sadādayo nirūpyantāmiti ceducyate–sakalapadārthādhigatimūlaṃ dravyaparyāyaguṇasāmānyaviśeṣaviṣayaṃ sat ityabhidhānaṃ sat
sakalādeśa tvāt saṃgrahanimittam, vyavahāranimittaṃ vā vikalādeśatvāt
kasyacit santānena varttamānasya kutaścidantaro virahakālaḥ antaram
evamuktaprakāranirdeśādirūpairanuyogaiḥ kiṃ kṛtvā jīvādidravyāṇyanuyuṅkte'yamātmā ? ityāha–viracayya iti
viśeṣeṇa racayitvā vidhāya, kān ? ityāha– artha ityādi
arthātmako hi bhedaḥ–dravyabhāvarūpaḥ, vāgātmakaḥ nāmarūpaḥ, pratyayātmakaśca sthāpanārūpaḥ iti
kaiḥ kṛtvā tān viracayya ? ityāha–naya ityādi
nayeṣu vastvaṃśaprarūpakeṣu pravṛtteṣu satsu anu paścād gatāḥ pravṛttā ye nikṣepāḥ taiḥ
kutaḥ punareṣāṃ nayānugatatvaṃ siddhamiti cet ? nayanirūpite vastvaṃśe pravṛtteḥ
parīkṣya vicārya tāṃstān dravyaparyāyādīn, taddharmān anekāntātmakā'rthāṃśān
kathaṃ punardravyaṃ santānaśabdavācyamiti cet ? samīcīnaḥ trikālapravṛttanikhilaparyāyānuyāyī tānaḥ vistāro yasya iti vyutpatteḥ
kathaṃ tarhi tat sādi ? ityāha–sādhanam ityādi
sādhyate nirvarttyate iti sādhano varṇapadādiparyāyaḥ, sādhyate pratipādyate'nena iti vā, taṃ prati sādi śrutam iti sambandhaḥ
anena sarvathā nityamanityaṃ vā tat iti pratyākhyātam
tadevaṃvidhaṃ śrutaṃ pramāṇam, kutaḥ ityāha–trikāla ityādi
trikālagocarāśca te sarvaparyāyāśca jīvādipadārthāśca teṣāṃ nirūpaṇam yathāvasthitasvarūpodyotanaṃ tatra pravaṇaṃ dakṣam
prayogaḥ–yat trikālagocarasarvaparyāyajīvā dipadārthanirūpaṇapravaṇaṃ tat pramāṇam yathā sarvavitpratyakṣam, tathābhūtañcoktaprakāraṃ śrutamiti
kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ ? tadarthāṃśaparīkṣāpravaṇaḥ, tasya śrutasya artho viṣayaḥ uktaprakāro jīvādiḥ tasya aṃśo dharmaḥ nityatvādiḥ tasya parīkṣāyāṃ pravaṇo dakṣaḥ

athedānīṃ tadadhigata ityādinā nayānugatatvaṃ nikṣepasya pradarśya tatsvarūpaṃ vyācaṣṭe–tadadhigatānāṃ śrutanayādhigatānāṃ dravyaparyāyarūpāṇāṃ jīvādīnāṃ vācyatāmāpannānāṃ sādhāraṇasvarūpāṇām, na hi asādhāṇasvarūpā arthaparyāyā vācyatāmāpadyante
vācakeṣu jīvādiśabdeṣu bhedena saṅkaravyatikaravyatirekeṇa upanyāsaḥ jīvādyarthānāṃ prarūpaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ nikṣepa iti yāvat
sa kati prakāro bhavati ? ityāha–saḥ ityādi
saḥ prarūpitasvarūpo nyāsaḥ avarataḥ saṅkṣepataḥ caturdhā
tatra ityādinā tān vyācaṣṭe–tatra teṣu nikṣepaprakāreṣu nāmādipu madhye kinnāma ? ityāha–nimitta ityādi
kiṃ punaḥ nāmno nimittaṃ kiṃ vā nimittāntaramiti cet ? vakturabhiprāyo'sya nimittam, jātyādikaṃ tu nimittāntaram iti brūmaḥ
tadanapekṣaṃ yat saṃjñākarma saṃjñākaraṇam icchāvaśāt tannāma
tacca uktasvarūpaṃ nāma anekadhā anekaprakāraṃ bhavati
kasmāt tadaniyataprakāram ? ityāha–jātidravyaguṇakriyālakṣaṇanimittānapekṣasaṃjñākarmaṇo'nekatvāt aniyatatvāt, jātyādiniyatanimittāpekṣāṇāmeva śabdānāṃ niyatatvopapatteḥ
jātidvāreṇa hi ye śabdāḥ dravyādiṣu pravarttante te jātiśabdāḥ yathā gauḥ aśvaḥ ityādayaḥ
dravyadvāreṇa tu ye varttante te dravyaśabdāḥ
tatra saṃyogidravyaśabdāḥ kuṇḍalī ityādayaḥ, samavāyidravyaśabdāḥ viṣāṇī ityādayaḥ
guṇa-karmadvāreṇa tu ye dravye varttante te guṇaśabdāḥ karmaśabdāśca pratipattavyāḥ, yathā śuklo nīlaḥ ityādayaḥ, gacchatyāgacchati ityādayaśca
sarveṣā yugapatprāpti saṅkara, parasparaviṣayagamana vyatikara, tābhyā vyatirekeṇa pratiniyatasvasvarūpasthitatveneti bhāva
–vat sa kati yāvat sa katiprakā– ā॰

tathā vyastājīvaviṣayatopapatte sa nu tya kya ca ityādi
ekājīvaviṣayatopapatte ākāśa kāla dharma adharma ityādivat
ta jahā, jīvo vā, jīvā vā, ajīvo vā, ajīvā vā, jīvo ya ajīvo ya, jīvā ya ajīvo ya, jīvo ya ajīvā ya, jīvā ya ajīvā va
daṇḍadhārako dvārapāla, tatra eko'jīva daṇḍa jīvaśca dvārapāla iti
eko jīva dhīvara, anekāśca ajīvā jalāharaṇāya upayujyamānā ghaṭādaya
tulanā–yadṛcchāśabdeṣu nāmnā viśiṣṭo'rtha ucyate ḍittha iti
saṃjogadavvaṇimitta ṇāma daṃḍī chattī mīlī iccevamādi
samavāryāṇamitta ṇāma galagaṅo kāṇo kuḍo iccevamāi
jātihetu sa vijñeya gauraśva iti śabdavat
sthāpyate iti sthāpanā pratikṛtiḥ, sā ca āhitanāmakasya adhyāropitanāmakasya dravyasya indrādeḥ so'yam ityabhisandhānena vyavasthāpanā
sā cāhitanāmakasya indrādervāstavasya tattvādhyāropāt pratiṣṭhā sotyamityabhisambandhenānyasya vyavasthāpanā sthāpanāmātra sthāpaneti vacanāt

tulanā– jaṇṇa kaṭṭhakamme vā potthakamme vā cittakamme vā leppakamme vā gathime vā veḍhime vā pūrime vā saghāime vā akkhe vā varāḍae vā ego vā aṇego vā sabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā vā asabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā vā āvassaetti ṭhavaṇā ṭhavijjai se taṃ ṭhavaṇāvassaya
tattha āgāravatae vatthummi sabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā, tavvivarīyā asabbhāvaṭṭhavaṇā
tatrādhyāropyamāṇena bhāvendrādinā samānā pratimā sadbhāvasthāpanā, mukhyadarśina svaya tasyāstadbuddhisabhavāt kathañcitsādṛśyasadbhāvāt
mukhyākāraśūnyā vastumātrā punarasadbhāvasthāpanā paropadeśādeva tatra so'yamiti sapratyayāt
nanu anāgatapariṇāmaviśeṣaṃ prati gṛhītābhimukhyaṃ dravyam iti dravyalakṣaṇamayuktam, guṇaparyayavaddravyam tattvārthasū॰ 5
38 ityāgamavirodhāditi kaścit, so'pi sūtrakārābhiprāyānabhijñaḥ, guṇaparyayavaddravyam iti hi sūtrakāreṇa vadatā trikālagocarānantakramabhāvipariṇāmāśrayaṃ dravyamuktam
tacca yadā anāgatapariṇāmaviśeṣaṃ pratyabhimukhaṃ tadā varttamānaparyāyākrāntaṃ parityaktapūrvaparyāyañca niścīyate, anyathā anāgatapariṇāmābhimukhyānupapatteḥ kharaviṣāṇavat
kevalaṃ dravyārthapradhānatvena vacane anāgatapariṇāmābhimukham atītapariṇāmānuyāyidravyamiti nikṣepaprakaraṇe tathā dravyalakṣaṇamuktam
sūtrakāreṇa tu paramatavyavacchedena pramāṇārpaṇāt guṇaparyayavaddravyam iti sūtritam, kramā'kramānekāntasya tathā vyavasthiteḥ
tatra ātmā yo jīvādiprābhṛtaṃ tattvato jānāti parantu cintana-parapratipādanalakṣaṇopayogā'nupayuktaḥ sa āgamadravyam
sa eva yadā jīvādiprābhṛtaṃ na jānāti kevalamagre jñāsyati tadā bhāvinoāgamaḥ
tulanā–so'pi sūtrārthānabhijña, guṇaparyayavaddravyamiti hi sūtrakāreṇa vadatā trikālagocarānantakramabhāvipariṇāmāśraya dravyamuktam
tacca yadā'nāgatapariṇāmaviśeṣaṃ pratyabhimukha tadā varttamānaparyāyākrānta parityaktapūrvaparyāyañca niścīyate, anyathā anāgatapariṇāmābhimukhyānupapatte kharaviṣāṇādivat
se kiṃ ta davvāvassaya ? duviha paṇṇatta ta jahā āgamao a noāgamao a

jassa ṇa āvassaetti pada sikkhitaṃ ṭhita jita mita parijita nāmasama dhosasama ahīṇakkhara aṇaccakkhara avvāiddhakkhara se ṇa tattha vāyaṇāe pucchaṇāe pariaṭṭaṇāe dhammakahāe no aṇuppehāe, kamhā ? aṇuvaogo davvamiti kaṭṭu
jīvaprābhṛtajñāyī manuṣyajīvaprābhṛtajñāyī vā anupayukta ātmā āgamadravyajīva
tattha āgamao davvamagala ṇāma magalapāhuḍajāṇao aṇuvajutto, magalapāhuḍasaddarayaṇā vā, tassatthaṭṭhavaṇakkhararayaṇā vā
se kiṃ ta no āgamao davvāvassaya ? tiviha paṇṇatta, ta jahā–jāṇayasarīrada vvāvassaya bhaviasarīradavvāvassaya jāṇayasarīrabhaviasarīravatiritta davvāvassaya
sāmānyāpekṣayā noāgamabhāvijīvo nāsti jīva- nasāmānyasya sadāpi vidyamānatvāt
viśeṣāpekṣayā tvasti–gatyantare jīvo vyavasthito manuṣyabhavaprāpti pratyabhimukha manuṣyabhāvijīva
no āgamao davva āgamarahiotti ja bhaṇia
ahavā no desammi no āgamao tadegadesāo
bhūyassa bhāviṇo vā jassa ja kāraṇa deho
jā magallā kiriyā ta kuṇamāṇo aṇuvautto
yadi vā, tathā āgamanoāgamarūpatayā upayogo jīvasya upayuktatvaṃ bhāvaḥ
ataśca dravyavad bhāvo'pi āgamanoāgamavikalpād dvividhaḥ pratipattavyaḥ
sa kimarthaṃ prarūpyate niṣphalatvāt ityāśaṅkyāha–aprastuta ityādi
aprastutārthasya mukhyasya indrādeḥ apākaraṇāt nirākaraṇāt, prastutasya nāmasthāpanendrādeḥ vyākaraṇād vyutpādanācca hetoḥ nikṣepaḥ phalavān sārthakaḥ
tena ca itthambhūtena nikṣepeṇa nikṣiptā uktaprakāreṇa prarūpitāḥ padārthāḥ jīvādayaḥ anuyujyante anu paścāt yujyante jīvadravyādeḥ svarūpādīni tajjijñāsayā pṛcchyante
kiṃviśiṣṭaiḥ ? nirdeśādibhiḥ nirdeśasvāmitvasādhanādhikaraṇasthitividhānalakṣaṇaiḥ, na kevalametaireva api tu sadādibhiśca, satsaṃkhyākṣetrasparśanakālāntarabhāvālpabahutvalakṣaṇaiśca

evaṃvidhaiśca anuyogaiḥ anuyuktā yadyapi sarve padārthāḥ tathāpi jīvapadārthaviṣayo yo viśeṣaḥ itarapadārthebhyaḥ svarūpātiśayaḥ tasya prarūpakāṇi jīvasthānaguṇasthānamārgaṇāsthānāni pratyekaṃ caturdaśa bhavanti
taiḥ prarūpitasvarūpātiśaye jīvadravye yathāvajjñāte mumūkṣūṇāṃ muktyaṅgaṃ paripūrṇaṃ ratnatrayaṃ bhavati nānyathā

evam uktaprakāreṇa pramāṇanayanikṣepānuyogaiḥ padārthapratipattyupāyaiḥ sarvān padārthānadhigamya puruṣatattvaṃ punaḥ jīvasthānaguṇasthānamārgaṇāsthānaiḥ dṛḍhataramavabuddhya, ityanena mumukṣoḥ samyagjñānaṃ muktyaṅgaṃ prarūpitam
pravṛddhābhiniveśātmakasamyagdarśanaḥ ityanena samyagdarśanam, tapasā nirjīrṇakarmā ityanena tu samyakcāritramiti
tena ca samyagdarśanāditrayeṇa nirjīrṇakarmā sarvakarmavinirmuktaḥ san ayamātmā sukhamṛcchati sukhamayo bhavati
kiṃviśiṣṭaṃ tatsukham ? bādhārahitaṃ vigatabādham, avyavacchinnaṃ śāśvatam, anantam iyattāvadhāraṇavarjitam, atīndriyam viśuddhātmamātrottham
nanu ātmano muktau buddhyādyaśeṣaviśeṣaguṇocchedāt kathaṃ sukhamayatvamiti vaiśeṣikāḥ
nahi naiva guṇavināśād buddhyādiguṇocchedāt jaḍaḥ pāpāṇakalpaḥ muktau ātmā bhavati, guṇaguṇivināśāt śūnyaḥ nahi iti sambandhaḥ
guṇāḥ jñānādayaḥ guṇī cittasantānaḥ teṣāṃ vināśād atyantocchedāt ātmā śūnyaḥ sakalasvarūpavivikto bhavati nahi iti sambandhaḥ
bhogyavirahāt tadā draṣṭuḥ svarūpe'vasthānād abhoktā ātmā sukhādeḥ nahi iti sambandha
yathā ca muktau tathāvidhasya ātmasvarūpasya kutaścidapi pramāṇādadhigamāsaṃbhavaḥ tatra ca bādhāsaṃbhavaḥ tathā agre prapañcataḥ prarūpayiṣyate
se kiṃ ta bhāvāvassaya ? duviha paṇṇatta, ta jahā–āgamato a, no āgamato a
jāṇae uvautte, se ta āgamato bhāvāvassaya
tatra jīvaprābhṛtaviṣayopayogāviṣṭo manuṣyajīvaprābhṛtaviṣayopayogayukto vā ātmā āgamabhāvajīva
jīvanaparyāyeṇa manuṣyajīvanaparyāyeṇa vā samāviṣṭa ātmā no āgamabhāvajīva
ṇo āgamado bhāvamagala duviha upayuktastatpariṇata iti
nanu jñānāvaraṇādikarmaṇaḥ sadbhāvaprasiddhau taponirjīrṇakarmā ityabhidhātu yuktam
taddhi śarīram, rāgādi, deśakālādikaṃ vā bhavet ? tatra ādyavikalpadvayamayuktam, śarīre rāgādau ca satyapi arthajñānodayasaṃbhavāt
yasmin satyapi jñānodayasabhava na tasya jñānāvaraṇādisvarūpatā yathā cakṣurādeḥ, arthajñānodayasabhavaśca śarīrādau satyapi, tasmānna tasya jñānāvaraṇādisvarūpatā iti
tasya tatsvarūpatāyāṃ vā kāṇḍapaṭādivanna tatsadbhāve tadupalambhasaṃbhavo bhavet

tarhi deśakālādestatsvabhāvatā'stu, suprasiddhā hi mervādau dūradeśatāyā āvaraṇatā rāvaṇādau dūrakālatāyāḥ paramāṇvādau sūkṣmasvabhāvatāyāḥ, mūlakīlo dakādau ca bhūmyādeḥ; ityapyasamīcīnam; tadabhāvasya yogino'pyaśakyakriyatvāt
na khalu sātiśayarddhimatā'pi yoginā deśādyabhāvo vidhātuṃ śakyaḥ
astu vā tat, tathāpi-avidyārūpaṃ tad bhaviṣyati na paudgalikam, mūrtimatā'nena amūrttasya jñānāderāvaraṇānupapatteḥ, anyathā śarīrāderapyāvaraṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ
bhavatu paudgalikatvam anyathābhūtatvaṃ vā'sya; tathāpi na sākalyena kvacinnirjarāsaṃbhavaḥ kāryakāraṇapravāheṇa pravarttamānasyāsya anāditvāt, anādeśca ātmādivad vināśāsaṃbhavādityapare
tulanā– taddhi śarīra rāgādayo deśakālādika vā syāt
śarīra rāgādika vā nāvaraṇasvarūpam tatsadbhāve'pi jñānodayāt
na tu durnirūpatvamātreṇa tadapalāpo yukta anumānasiddhatvāt

tathāhi–asti tāvanmūḍhānāmeva vyavahāra aśanāyādyatīta vivekiprasiddhamātmatattvaṃ nāsti na prakāśate ca iti yo'ya vyavahāraḥ ātmani bhāvarūpāvaraṇanimitto bhavitumarhati, asti prakāśate ityādivyavahārapuṣkalakāraṇe sati tadviparītavyavahāratvāt, yannaiva tannaivaṃ yathāsti prakāśate ghaṭa iti vyavahāra
na cānyathāsiddhi; ito'tiriktāvaraṇasya mūrtadravyasya ātmani niravayave sarvagate du sapādatvāt
tulanā–anye tu mithyājñānajanitasaskārasya sahakāriṇo'bhāvāt vidyamānānyapi karmāṇi na janmāntare śarīrārambhakāṇīni manyante
sahakārivaikalyāt kusūlāvasthitabījavat karmaṇāmanārabhbhakatve sati na kaściddoṣa
eṣa eva ca teṣā dāho yatkāryānārambhakatvam
nanvavinaṣṭasvarūpāṇi kusūlabījavadeva kadācidārapsyante kāryaṃ tasmādvaramucchidyantāmeva; kimidānī nityamātmānamapyucchettu yatāmahe ? – nyāyamaṃ॰ pṛ॰ 523

yattāvaduktam–jñānāvaraṇādikarmaṇaḥ sadbhāvaprasiddhau ityādi; tatra kiṃ karmamātrasadbhāve bhavatāṃ vipratipattiḥ, jñānāvaraṇādikarmaviśeṣe vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ, śarīrādivyatiriktasya karmamātrasya anumānataḥ sadbhāvaprasiddheḥ

tathāhi–svaparaprameyabodhaikasvabhāvasya ātmano hīnagarbhasthānaśarīraviṣayādiṣu viśiṣṭābhiratiḥ ātmatadvyatiriktakāraṇapūrvikā, tattvāt, kutsitaparapuruṣe kamanīyakulakāminyāḥ tantrādyupayogaprabhavaviśiṣṭābhirativat

tathāhi–yat sat tatsarvamanekāntātmakamityādi vyāptijñānaṃ sāvaraṇam, svaviṣaye'spaṣṭatvāt, yat svaviṣaye'spaṣṭaṃ tatsāvaraṇam yathā rajonīhārādyantaritatarunikarādijñānam, svaviṣaye'spaṣṭañcedaṃ jñānamiti
mithyādṛśāṃ sarvatra anekāntasvabhāve bhāve viparītajñānaṃ sāvaraṇam, mithyājñānatvāt, dhattūrakādyupayogino mṛcchakale kāñcanajñānavaditi
vivādādhyāsito jīvasya mohodaya sambandhyantarakāraṇaka mohodayatvāt madirākāraṇakamohodayavadityanumānāt
yacca jñānasya svaviṣayapratibandhaka dravya tad jñānāvaraṇādi vastusat pudgalarūpa karma
yadapravṛttimatsvaviṣaye tatsāvaraṇa yathā taimirikasya locanavijñānamekacandramasi, apravṛttimacca svaviṣaye samastārthalakṣaṇe'smadādijñānamiti
tathā mithyātvapaṭalaviluptavivekadṛśā yadetatsarvasminnanekāntātmake vastuni viparyayajñāna tatsāvaraṇa mithyājñānatvāt
yadapyuktam–avidyārūpaṃ tad bhaviṣyati na paudgalikam ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; amūrttasya amūrttenaiva āvaraṇaniyamā'saṃbhavāt, mūrttenāpi madirādinā amūrttasya jñānāderāvaraṇadarśanāt
kathamevaṃ śarīrāderna tadāvaraṇatvaṃ syāditi cet ? tadaviruddhatvāt iti brūmaḥ
mūrttatvāviśeṣe'pi hi yadeva jñānena viruddhaṃ tadeva tasya āvaraṇaṃ yuktaṃ nānyat, anyathā amūrttatvāviśeṣāt avidyāvat ākāśāderjñānāntarasya ca āvaraṇatvamanuṣajyeta
tasya tena virodhaśca madirādivat paudgalikakarmodaye prabandhena pravarttamānasya jñānasya nirodhānniścīyate
na ca mithyājñānajanitāparamithyājñānena anekāntaḥ, tasyāpi aparāparapaudgalikakarmodaye satyeva saṃbhavāt aparāparonmattakādirasasadbhāve tatkṛtonmādādisantānavat
etena ātmaguṇatvāt karmaṇāṃ na paudgalikatvam ityapi pratyuktam, teṣāmātmaguṇatve tatpāratantryanimittatvānupapattitaḥ sadaiva ātmano muktiprasaṅgāt
yo yasya guṇaḥ sa tasya pāratantryanimittaṃ na bhavati yathā pṛthivyādeḥ rūpādiḥ, guṇaśca dharmādharmasaṃjñakaṃ karma parairiṣṭam iti
na caitat yuktam, ātmanaḥ paratantratayā pramāṇataḥ pratīteḥ
hīnasthānaṃ hi śarīram, ātmano duḥkhahetutvāt, kārāgāravat, tatparigrahavāṃśca saṃsārī sarveṣāṃ suprasiddha eva
naca devaśarīre tadabhāvāt pakṣāvyāptiḥ; tasyāpi maraṇe duḥkhahetutvaprasiddheḥ
yatparatantraścāsau tacca karma, iti siddhamasya anātmaguṇatvam, ataḥ paudgalikatvamevāsyopapannam
krodhādipariṇāmo hi jīvasya pāratantryaṃ na punaḥ pāratantryanimittam
yaccānyaduktam–na sākalyena kvacinnirjarāsaṃbhavaḥ ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam, karmaṇāṃ santānaparamparayā'nāditvepi kvacid vipakṣaparamaprakarṣasadbhāve sākalyena prakṣayopapatteḥ
yasya kvacid vipakṣaparamaprakarṣasadbhāvaḥ tasya tatra sākalyena prakṣayaḥ yathā śītasparśasya, samyagdarśanādilakṣaṇatadvipakṣaparamaprakarṣasadbhāvaśca kvacidātmani iti

nacāyaṃ sādhyavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ; nahi anādisantatirapi śītasparśo vipakṣabhūtasyoṣṇasparśasya prakarṣasadbhāve nirmūlatalaṃ pralayamupavrajanna pratītaḥ, kāryakāraṇapravāheṇa bījāṅkurādisantāno vā'nādi pratipakṣabhūtadahananirdagdhabījo nirdagdhāṅkuro vā na pratīyate iti
pratipakṣaparamaprakarṣasadbhāvaśca anumānataḥ prasiddhaḥ; tathāhi–jñānādayaḥ kvacit paramaprakarṣaṃ pratipadyante, prakṛṣyamāṇatvāt, parimāṇavat
itthaṃ vā sākalyena karmaprakṣaye prayogaḥ karttavyaḥ–jñānāvaraṇādihāniḥ kvacitpuruṣaviśeṣe paramaprakarpamāyāti, prakṛṣyamāṇatvāt, nabhasi parimāṇavat
na cātrā'siddhaṃ sādhanam, tathāhi–prakṛṣyamāṇā āvaraṇahāniḥ, āvaraṇahānitvāt, māṇikyādyāvaraṇahānivat
yadvā, jñānāvaraṇādikarma kvacidāmūlaṃ prakṣīyate, samagrakṣayahetūpetatvāt, locane timirādivat

tatkarmaprakṣayasya hi hetū saṃvaranirjare, tadanvayavyatirekānuvidhāyitvāt, yo yasyānvayavyatirekānuvidhāyī sa taddhetuḥ yathā dhūmo'gneḥ, anvayavyatirekāvanuvidhatte ca tatprakṣayaḥ saṃvaranirjarayoriti
sati saṃvare bhāvikarma notpadyate apūrvakarmaṇāmāsravanirodhaḥ saṃvaraḥ tattvārthasū॰ 9
sañcitaṃ punaḥ tannirjarātaḥ pralīyate–upāttakarmaṇāṃ nirharaṇaṃ nirjarā iti vacanāt
tatra aupakramikī tapasā dvādaśavidhena sādhyā, anaupakramikī tu yathākālaṃ saṃsāriṇaḥ syāditi

yadutkarṣatāratamyāt yasyāpacayatāratamya tatprakarṣaniṣṭhāgamane bhavati tasya ātyantika kṣaya, yathā uṣṇasparśatāratamyāt śītasparśasya, bhavati ca jñānavairāgyāderutkarṣatāratamyāt ajñānarāgāderapacayatāratamyamiti
karmaṇā tu vipākāttapasā vā ya śāṭaḥ sā nirjarā –tattvārthabhā॰ vyā॰, tattvārthahari॰ 1

tatra caturgatāvanekajātiviśeṣāvaghūrṇite sasāramahārṇave cira paribhramata śubhāśubhasya karmaṇa krameṇa paripākakālaprāptasya anubhabodayāvalisroto'nuprabiṣṭasya ārabdhaphalasya yā nivṛtti sā vipākajā nirjarā
