yatkarma aprāptavipākakālam aupakramikakriyāviśeṣasāmarthyādanudīrṇaṃ balādudīrṇaṃ balādudīryodayāvaliṃ praveśya vedyate āmrapanasādipākavat sā avipākajā nirjarā
tatra pūrvā yathākālaṃ sasāriṇa syāt, upakramikī tu tapasā dvādaśavidhena sādhyate
sopakrama nirupakrama ca karma–āyurvipāka karma dvividham–sopakrama nirupakramañca
tatra yathārdravastra vitānita laghīyasā kālena śuṣyet tathā sopakramam, yathā ca tadeva sapiṇḍitaṃ cireṇa śuṣyedeva nirupakramam
yathā yathā cāgni śuṣke kakṣe mukto vātena samantato yukta kṣepīyasā kālena dahettathā sopakramam, yathā vā sa evāgni tṛṇarāśau kramato'vayaveṣu nyastaścireṇa dahettathā nirupakramam
atra sāṃkhyā bruvate–satyam, anātmaguṇo'dṛṣṭaṃ prakṛtipariṇāmatvāttasya prakṛti– pariṇāmaḥ śuklakṛṣṇañca karma ityabhidhānāt
prakṛtyā hi karma kriyate atastat tatpariṇāmo nātmanaḥ tasyā'karttṛtvāt
tulanā–catuṣpāt khalviya karmajāti–kṛṣṇā, śuklakṛṣṇā, śuklā, aśuklākṛṣṇā ceti
kṛṣṇaṃ śuklaṃ tathā miśraṃ karmānyeṣāṃ tridhā bhavet
nirguṇaḥ puruṣo vivekī bhoktetyādiguṇānāṃ puruṣasya yo viparyāsa uktaḥ tasmāt sattvarajastamaḥsu kartṛbhūteṣu sākṣitvaṃ siddhaṃ puruṣasyeti
yo'yamadhikṛto bahutvaṃ prati, guṇā eva kartāraḥ pravartante sākṣī na pravartate nāpi nivartata eva
yathā kaścit parivrājako grāmīṇeṣu karṣaṇārtheṣu pravṛtteṣu kevalo madhyasthaḥ, puruṣo'pyevaṃ guṇeṣu pravartamāneṣu na pravartate tasmāt draṣṭṛtvamakartṛbhāvaśca
yasmānmadhyasthaḥ tasmād draṣṭā tasmādakartā puruṣaḥ teṣāṃ karmaṇāmiti
sattvarajastamāṃsi trayo guṇāḥ karmakartṛbhāvena pravartante na puruṣaḥ
akartṛbhāvaścetyanena saptavidhamakartṛbhāvamāśrayati–na hyayaṃ viṣayeṣu svasyāntaḥkaraṇasānnidhye'dhyavasāyaṃ kurute
na ca sattvādīnāṃ prakāśapravṛttiniyamalakṣaṇairdharmaiḥ itaretaropakāreṇāpravartamānānāṃ svena caitanyalakṣaṇena dharmeṇa aṅgabhāvaṃ pratipadyate nāpyaṅgibhāvam
evaṃ saha guṇaiḥ kāryaṃ na kurute strīkumāravat
sthitaprayogaṃ na kurute rathaśakaṭayantraprerakavat, na svātmano mṛtpiṇḍavat, na parataḥ kumbhakāravat, nāpyādeśāt māyākāravat, nobhayato mātṛpitṛvat

tasmācca tasmādeva triguṇaviparyāsāt siddhamātmanaḥ sākṣitvādisvarūpam; tathāhi– sākṣitvaṃ tāvadātmanaḥ guṇapravṛtteradhiṣṭhātṛtvam svayamasya nairguṇyāt, sukhādibhyo hi yato'yamarthāntarabhūtaḥ tasmāt tatpravṛttau sākṣī
yataḥ khalvayaṃ guṇebhyaḥ pṛthagbhūtaḥ tasmādeva kevalaḥ, na taiḥ saha saṃsargeṇa varttate
viṣayāṇāṃ hi tulyabalatvāt nyūnādhikatopapatteśca anyonyaṃ bādhānugrahau upapannau, viṣayī cāyam, tasmānnāsya nyūnatādi, ata eva itarayoranupapattiḥ
prakṛtivikārabhūtā hi sattvādayaḥ, atastebhyaścaitanyamapoddhṛtya puruṣa eva sthāpyate, tasmāt puruṣa eva caitanyasvarūpatvāt draṣṭā
etadeva hi ātmanaḥ svam ātmīyaṃ rūpaṃ svabhāvaḥ yat caitanyaṃ nāma, tasya vyaktāvyaktayorasabhaṃvāt
tathā'karttṛbhāvo'pi aprasavadharmitvādasya siddhaḥ, yasmāt praspandanapariṇāmau prasavārthau nātmani vidyete tasmādakarttā iti
tatra sākṣitvamityanena guṇānāṃ pravṛttau asvātantryaṃ khyāpayati pradhānasya tadarthanibandhanatvāt pravṛtteḥ
guṇānāṃ sattvarajastamasāṃ pravṛtteḥ, guṇasya vā pradhānasya pravṛtteḥ
na yathā sattvādīnāṃ paraspareṇa prakāśādidharmāpekṣāṇāṃ saṃsargaḥ evaṃ puruṣasya tairbhavati
mādhyarsthyamityanena atiśayanirhrāsānupapatteḥ, puruṣasya guṇaiḥ saha bādhānugrahānupapattiḥ svakāryapravṛttau cāpakṣapātaṃ darśayati
yadā citireva puruṣastadā kimatra kena vyapadiśyate ? bhavati ca vyapadeśe vṛttiryathā caitrasya gauriti

nanu sattvādīnāṃ karttṛtve ṣuruṣaḥ puṇyaṃ karoti ityātmani karttṛtvapratītiḥ kathamupapanneti cet ? upacārāt, yathaiva hi svayamacetanāpi buddhiḥ cetanāsaṃsargāt cetanā upacaryate, tathā karttṛpradhānasaṃsargāt svayamakarttāpyātmā kartteva upacaryate

tāvetau bhogāpavargau buddhikṛtau buddhāveva vartamānau katha puruṣe vyapadiśyate iti ? yathā vijaya parājayo vā yoddhṛṣu vartamāna svāmini vyapadiśyate, sa hi tasya phalasya bhokteti, eva bandhamokṣau buddhāveva vartamānau puruṣe vyapadiśyete
etena grahaṇadhāraṇohāpohatattvajñānābhiniveśā buddhau vartamānāḥ puruṣe'dhyāropitasadbhāvā, sa hi tatphalasya bhokteti
tasmāttatsayogādacetana cetanāvadiva liṅgam yasmāccetanasvabhāva puruṣa tasmāt tatsayogādacetana mahadādiliṅgam adhyavasāyābhimānasaṅkalpālocanādiṣu vṛttiṣu cetanāvat pravartate
ko dṛṣṭānta ? tadyathā anuṣṇāśīto ghaṭaḥ śītābhiradbhi saspṛṣṭa śīto bhavati agninā sayukta uṣṇo bhavati, eva mahadādi liṅgamacetanamapi bhūtvā cetanāvad bhavati
tadyathā'sau acaura tatsasargadoṣeṇa cauratayā pratītastai tathā sattvādayo guṇā karttāra taiḥ sayukta puruṣo'pi akartā'pi kartā bhavati, kartṛsasargāt karteva, para paramārthatayā akartā puruṣa
tasmāt kāraṇasya grahaṇarūpatā puruṣasya ca kartṛrūpatā sambandhyantarasamparkāt anyagatā'nyatropalabhyamānā bhaktyā'dhyavasātavyā na paramārthata
guṇakarttṛtve'pi tathā kartteva bhavatyudāsīnaḥ || sākhyakā॰ 20 iti
tataḥ cicchaktirapariṇāminyapratisaṃkramā darśitaviṣayā śuddhā cānantā cā'bhyupa gantavyā
na ca pradhānasya karttṛtvādidharmasadbhāvābhyupagame puruṣakalpanānarthakyamityabhidhātavyam; draṣṭṛtvāttasya
na ca draṣṭāramantareṇa dṛśyamupapadyate paṅgvandhayorivānayoḥ anyonyāpekṣatvāt

yathaiva hi andho darśanaśaktivikalaḥ tacchaktiyuktapaṅgūpadeśamantareṇa neṣṭapradeśamupasarpati, paṅgurapi kriyāśaktiśūnyaḥ tacchaktiyuktā'ndhasaṃsargādvinā iti, tathā pradhānaṃ nāntareṇa puruṣaṃ kṛtamapi kāryaṃ draṣṭuṃ kṣamam, puruṣo'pi satyapi caitanye pradhānaṃ vinā dṛśyābhāvānna draṣṭā syāt
citiśaktirapariṇāminyapratisaṅkramā darśitaviṣayā śuddhā cānantā ca, sukhadu khamohātmakatvamaśuddhi sukhamohāvapi vivekina duḥkhākuruto'to duḥkhavad heyau
tathā cātisundaramapi antavad dunoti tena tadapi heyameva vivekina
seyamaśuddhirantaśca citiśaktau puruṣe na sta ityata ukta śuddhā cānantā ceti
nanu sukhadu khamohātmakaśabdādīniya cetayamānā tadākārāpannā katha viśuddhā ? tadākāraparigraha-parivarjane ca kurvatī kathamanantetyata uktam–darśitaviṣayā iti
bhevadetadevaṃ yadi buddhivaccitiśaktirviṣayākāratāmāpadyeta, kintu buddhireva viṣayākāreṇa pariṇatā satī, atadākārāyai citiśaktyai viṣayamādarśayati, tata puruṣaścetayata ityucyate
nanu viṣayākārā buddhimanārūḍhāyāścitiśakte katha viṣayavedanam ? viṣayārohe vā kathanna tadākārāpattirityata uktam–apatisaṅkrameti
sa eva kuto'syā nāstītyata uktam–apariṇāminī iti
na citestrividho'pi dharmalakṣaṇāvasthālakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmo'sti yena kriyārūpeṇa pariṇatā satī buddhisayogena pariṇameta citiśakti
yathā buddhirviṣayaṃ gacchati tadgrahaṇārtha naiva citirakriyatvāt
athavā nāsti pratiṣaṅkramaḥ saṅgo viṣayeṣu yasyā ityapratisaṅkramā nirlepeti yāvat

nanu apariṇāmitve cātmano viṣayākāratvābhāvāt kathaṃ viṣayasphuraṇam ? tatrāha–darśitaviṣayā, darśito buddhyā nivedito viṣayo yasyā iti vigraha, viṣayaiḥ saha buddhivṛttiścitau pratibimbitā satī bhāsata iti bhāvayato'pariṇāminī ata eva śuddhā anantā ca
tulanā–tathā cokta pañcaśikhena–tattvavai॰ apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛśaktirapratisaṅkramā ca pariṇāminyarthe pratisaṅkrānteva tadvṛttimanupatati –yogabhā॰ 2
yathā ṣaṅgurnāntareṇāndha dṛkśaktyā viśiṣṭenārthena arthavān bhavati, andhaśca nāntareṇa ṣaṅguṃ viśiṣṭenārthena
evaṃ pradhāna nāntareṇa puruṣa kṛtamapi kāryaṃ draṣṭu śaktamanavadhikañca pravartamāna viśeṣābhāvānnaiva nivartate
tathā puruṣa satyapi cetanatve nāntareṇa pradhānam upalabhyābhāvād upalabdhā bhavediti pradhānamapekṣate

nanu cidrūpatvāt puruṣaḥ kathaṃ saṃsāraprabandhapravṛttihetau pradhāne sthitaṃ phalamupabhuṅkte ? ityapyacodyam; cidrūpasyāpyasya ajñānatamaśchannatayā prakṛtisthamapi sukhādiphalam ātmasthaṃ manyamānasya tadupabhoktṛtvopapatteḥ, yadā tu jñānamasya āvirbhavati duḥkhahetu riyam na mama anayā saha saṃsargo yuktaḥ iti, tadā vivekakhyāterna tatsampāditaṃ karmaphalamupabhuṅkte, sāpi ca vijñātavirūpā'haṃ na madīyaṃ karmaphalamanena bhoktavyam iti mattvā na tatsampādanāya ta prati pravarttate kuṣṭhinīstrīvad dūrādapasarpati
anye guṇāḥ sattvādayo'cetanāḥ parārthāḥ prakṛtivikārabhūtā, anyo'ham na prakṛtirna vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ sākhyakā॰ 3 iti bhedapratyayaḥ guṇapuruṣāntaradarśanam, tasmāt tatprāptiriti
puruṣa prakṛtistho hi bhuṅkte prakṛtijān guṇān
tathā caitadatroktam pañcaśikhena vyaktamavyaktaṃ vā sattvamātmatvenābhipratītya tasya sampadamanunandati ātmasampada manvāna tasya vyāpadamanuśocatyātmavyāpada manyamānaḥ sa sarvo'pratibuddhaḥ
abhyāsenaiva tattvadarśana tasmādabhyāsāt puruṣasya buddhirutpadyate–nāsmi tattvāni, na me tattvāni, nāha tattvānām kintu pradhānakānyetāni
atrāha tena jñānena puruṣa kiṃ karoti ? atrocyate –tena nivṛttaprasavāmarthavaśāt saptarūpavinivṛttām
prakṛte sukumāratara na kiñcidastīti me matirbhavati
yathā kācit kulastrī sādhvī svagṛhadvāri sthitā puruṣeṇa sahasaivāgatena dṛṣṭā sahasaiva brīḍamānā tvarita gṛha praviṣṭā
sā eva matvā dṛṣṭā'hamanena iti na punardarśanamupaiti puruṣasya
sati sayoge'pi tayo prayojana nāsti sargasya
yathemā raṅgagatā nartakī sarvāsvavasthāsu vartamānā dṛṣṭvā vinmati raṅgāta prekṣaka dṛṣṭā mayetyupekṣaka eka kevala śuddha puruṣatathā prakṛtirapi anena aha dṛṣṭeti nivṛttā
ekā trailokyasyāpi pradhānakāraṇabhūtā na dvitīyā prakṛtirasti
nartakyapi ahamanena dṛṣṭetyuparamate nṛtyāt eva puruṣo'pi dṛṣṭā mayeya jñānacakṣuṣā prakṛti iti prekṣakavaduparamate mokṣa gacchatītyartha
taduktaṃ nāradīye–savikārāpi mauḍhyena cira bhuktā guṇātmanā
puruṣastu punarna prakṛtiranutpādakatvāt na ca vikṛtiranutpannatvāt
yattāvaduktam–prakṛtipariṇāma ityādi, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, yataḥ siddhe dharmiṇi dharmacintā upapadyate
naca prakṛtiḥ dharmiṇī kutaścitpramāṇāt siddhā, tatprasādhakapramāṇānāṃ prakṛtiparīkṣāpraghaṭṭake prapañcataḥ pratikṣiptatvāt

ataḥ kathaṃ tatpariṇāmatayā karmaṇāṃ vyāvarṇanamupapannam ? astu vā'sau, tathāpi–puruṣastha nimittamapekṣya tathā pariṇamet, anapekṣya vā ? na tāvadanapekṣya, muktātmanyapi śarīrādisampādanāya tasyāḥ tathā pariṇamanaprasaṅgāt
atha apekṣya; kiṃ tadapekṣyam–vivekānupalambhaḥ, adṛṣṭaṃ vā ? na tāvad vivekānupalambhaḥ; tasya vivekopalambhābhāvarūpatayā muktātmanyapi saṃbhavāt
adṛṣṭāpekṣāyāstu tasyāḥ tathāpariṇāme anyonyāśrayaḥ–siddhe hi adṛṣṭe tadapekṣāyāḥ prakṛteḥ śuklakṛṣṇakarmapariṇāmasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca adṛṣṭasiddhiriti
anāditvāt tatpravāhasya ayamadoṣaḥ–pūrvaṃ hi adṛṣṭamapekṣya aparaḥ tasyāstatpariṇāmo bhavati tataśca aparaḥ iti; tadapyanupapannam, muktātmanyapi evamasyāḥ śarīrādisampādanāya tathā pariṇāmaprasakteḥ
tatrāsyāḥ nivṛttādhikāratvānna tatprasaktiḥ; ityāpi vārttam, amuktātmanyapi asyāḥ tatsampādanāya tathāpariṇāmā'bhāvānuṣaṅgāt

tatra pravṛttādhikāratvānna doṣo'yam; ityapi śraddhāmātram, sarvathaikasyā'naṃśasya pradhānasya pravṛtta-nivṛttādhikāratvadharmayoryugapadvirodhāt, tadavirodhe vā sarvathāsya ekatvā'naṃśasyānupapattiḥ
tulanā–yadi pradhāna puruṣastha nimittamanapekṣya pravartate, muktātmanyapi śarīrādisampādanāya pravarteta aviśeṣāt
tulanā–athādarśanāpekṣamiti cet, yasya hi guṇapuruṣāntaravivekadarśanānupapatti taṃ prati pradhāna pravarttate, na cāsau muktātmanīti; tanna; muktātmanyapi vivekadarśanasya vināśena pravṛttipraṅgāt
sasārāvasthāyā vivekasyānutpattiḥ muktadaśāyā ca samutpannasyāpi vivekasya vināśa iti na abhāvatvena kaścid bheda
tulanā–athādṛṣṭāpekṣaṃ pravartata iti cet; tadasat, tasyāpi pradhāne śaktirūpatayā vyavasthitasya ubhayatrāviśeṣāt
–kṛtārthameka puruṣa prati dṛśya naṣṭamapi nāśa prāptamapi anaṣṭa tadanyapuruṣasādhāraṇatvāt
kuśala puruṣa prati nāśa prāptamapi akuśalān puruṣān prati akṛtārthamiti teṣāṃ dṛśe karmaviṣayatāmāpannaṃ labhata eva pararūpeṇa ātmarūpamiti

kiñcadem amuktātmanyasya pravṛttādhikāratvannāma–tatra sambaddhatvam, śarīrasukhādisampādakatvaṃ vā ? na tāvat sambaddhatvam; muktātmanyasya gatatvāt, pradhānātmanoḥ nityasarvagatatvena sarvatra sarvadā saṃbhavāt
atha śarīrasukhādisampādakatvam; tarhi itaretarāśrayaḥ–siddhe hyamuktātmānaṃ prati pravṛttādhikāratve taṃ pratyeva tatsampādakatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca taṃ prati pravṛttādhikāratvasiddhiriti
kiñca, śarīrādinā tatsampāditena asya kaścidupakāraḥ kriyate, na vā ? yadi na kriyate, kathaṃ tat tasya iti vyapadiśyeta ? muktātmano'pi tadvyapadeśaprasaṅgāt
atha kriyate, kiṃ tato bhinnaḥ, abhinno vā ? yadi abhinnaḥ, tadā tatkaraṇe puṃso'pi kāryatvānuṣaṅgāt nityatvakṣatiḥ
atha bhinna, tadā puṃso na kiñcitkṛtaṃ syāt, tasyetivyapadeśaśca na prāpnoti tena tasyā'sambandhāt, tenāpyupakārāntarakaraṇe anavasthā
tataḥ pradhānasya svarūpeṇa asattvāt, sato'pi vā karmapariṇāmānupapatteḥ, dravyarūpasya karmaṇaḥ pudgalapariṇāmatvaṃ bhāvarūpasya tu ātmapariṇāmatvamabhyupagantavyam
pudgalātmanoḥ sadbhāvasya vicitrapariṇāmādhāratvasya ca prāk prasādhitatvāt
tulanā–sahi pradhānasya vikāro mahadādi puruṣāryo bhavatuvan puruṣasya kañcidupakāra karoti na vā ? yadi karoti, puruṣādarthāntaramanarthāntaraṃ vā ? –yuktayanu॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 29

yadapyuktam–sākṣitvaṃ tāvat ātmano guṇapravṛtteradhiṣṭhātṛtvam ityādi, tadapi manorathamātram, sattvarajastamolakṣaṇaguṇānāṃ pravṛtteḥ prakṛtiparīkṣāyāṃ pratikṣiptatvāt, sarvathā nityavyāpitvādisvabhāvasya cātmanaḥ svadehapramitau prativyūḍhatvāt, ataḥ kiṃ kasya adhiṣṭhātṛ syāt ?
yadapi akarttṛbhāvo'pi aprasavadharmitvāt ityādyuktam, tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; sarvathā'kāryakāraṇabhūtatvābhyupagame puṃso'vastutvāpattiprasaṅgāt
prayogaḥ–bhavatkalpitaḥ puruṣo vastu na bhavati, sarvathā'kāryakāraṇabhūtatvāt, gaganendīvaravat
yadapi yasmāt praspandanapariṇāmau prasavārthau nātmani vidyete tasmādakarttā ityabhihitam; tadapyapeśalam, svadehapramitau ātmanaḥ praspandanapariṇāmayo prasādhitatvāt
akarttṛtve ca ātmano bhoktṛtvavirodha, yadayaṃ bhujikriyāṃ kurvan bhoktā ityucyate yathā gamikriyāṃ kurvan gantā iti
tathā ca karttari tṛco'nutpatteḥ bhoktā ityātmano vyapadeśo durlabhaḥ
nanu bhokteti tṛco darśanāt na vāstavaṃ karttṛtvaṃ siddhyati śabdajñānānupātinaḥ karttṛtvavikalpasya vastuśūnyatvāt; ityapyasundaram, bhoktṛtvādidharmāṇāmapyātmano'vāstavatvopapatteḥ
tathopagame ca cetayate iti cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ paramārthato na siddhyet cetanaśabdajñānānupātino'pi vikalpasya vastuśūnyatvāviśeṣāt
atha etaddoṣabhayād bhujau karttā iṣyate; tarhi akartṛtvavirodhaḥ
prayogaḥ–saṃsāryātmā sukhādyupabhoktā na bhavati, dharmādīnāmakarttṛtvāt, muktātmavat
tulanā–ata puruṣasya karttṛtve yukta vāstava bhoktṛtvam
anyathā hi bhogakriyāmakurvata kathamudāmīnasya bhoktṛtva syāt, bhogasya sukhadu khavedanārūpatvāt, tadādhāratā tu bhoktṛtvam
virodhe tu tayorbhoktu syād bhujau kartṛtā katham
kartā ātmā svakarmaphalabhoktṛtvātsākhyakalpita puruṣo vastu na bhavati akartṛtvāt khapuṣpavat
kiṃca, ātmā bhoktā aṅgīkriyate, sa ca bhujakriyā karoti na vā ? yadi karoti tadā'parābhi kriyābhi kiṃmaparāddham ? atha bhujikriyāmapi na karoti, tarhi katha bhokteti nityam
–śabdajanitaṃ jñāna śabdajñānaṃ tadanu patitu śīlaṃ yasya sa śabdajñānānupātī, vastunastathātvamanapekṣamāṇo yo'dhyavasāya sa vikalpa ityucyate

tulanā–bhoktṛtvādidharmāṇāmapi puruṣasyā'vāstavatvāpatte, tathopagame cetayata iti cetana puruṣo na vastuta siddhyet cetanaśabdajñānānupātino vikalpasya vastuśūnyatvāt kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiśabdajñānānupātivikalpavat
tulanā–saṃsāryātmā bhoktā na bhavati akartṛtvāt muktātmavat

akartturbhoktṛtvābhyupagame ca kṛtanāśā'kṛtābhyāgamadoṣaprasaṅgaḥ, prakṛtyā hi kṛtaṃ karma na ca tasyāḥ phalenābhisambandha iti kṛtanāśaḥ, puruṣeṇa ca tanna kṛtam atha ca tatphalena tasyābhisambandha iti akṛtābhyāgamaḥ
cetanatvādātmanaḥ akarttṛtvepi tadabhisambandhaḥ ityapyanena pratyuktam; muktātmano'pi ata eva tadabhisambandhānuṣaṅgāt, saṃsāryātmano'pi vā tadvadasau na syādaviśeṣāt
prayogaḥ–saṃsāryātmā phalābhisambandhavān na bhavati, cetanatvāt, muktātmavat
tathā pradhānaṃ karmaṇāṃ tatphalasya ca karttṛ na bhavati, abhoktṛtvāt, muktātmavat
pradhānena hi kṛtau bandhamokṣau na ca tasya phalānubhavanamiti kṛtanāśa, puruṣeṇa tu tau na kṛtau tatphalānubhavanañca tasyetyakṛtābhyāgama katha parihartu śakya ? –āptapa॰ kā॰ 114
tulanā–kartu nāma vijānanti gṛhādīn sarvathā guṇāḥ
bhoktu ca na vijānanti kimayuktamata param
yaccoktam–yathaiva hi svayamacetanāpi buddhiḥ cetanāsaṃsargāt ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; buddhicetanayorbhedā'saṃbhavāt, vijñānasyaiva hi buddhiḥ, cetanā, adhyavasāyaḥ iti paryāyāḥ
ataḥ kathaṃ taddṛṣṭāntāvaṣṭambhena upacārādātmanaḥ karttṛtvaṃ syāt ? tataḥ puruṣaḥ puṇyaṃ karoti, dhyānaṃ karoti ityādyabādhyamānapratītisiddhaṃ karttṛtvamasya anupacaritamevābhyupagantavyam
etena cicchaktirapariṇāminī ityādi pratyākhyātam; apariṇāminaḥ kasyacidvastutvānupapatteḥ khapuṣpavat

nanu muktasyātmana śuddhasyā'pariṇāmitve'pi vastutvaṃ bhavadbhiriṣṭam; ityapyanalpatamovilasitam; tasyāpi pratisamayaṃ pariṇāmitvapratijñānāt pratisamayaṃ dṛśyasya pariṇāmitve draṣṭurapariṇāmitvānupapatteḥ
na ca dṛśyaṃ vastu vastva pariṇāmyeva ityabhidhātavyam; sāṃkhyaistasya pariṇāmitvā'bhyupagamāt
atha cicchaktiḥ apratisaṅkramatvādapariṇāminītyucyate, tanna, asyāḥ prativiṣayaṃ darśitaviṣayatve pratisaṅkramoṣapatteḥ
buddhereva tathā pratisaṅkramo na cicchakteḥ, ityapyayuktam, buddherapyevam apratisaṅkramaprasaṅgāt, viṣayasyaiva pratisaṅkramaprasaṅgāt

buddhyādhyavasīyamānasya viṣayasya pratisaṅkramasaṃbhave buddheḥ kathaṃ tadasaṃbhava iti cet ? tarhi buddheḥ viṣayapradarśikāyāḥ pratisaṅkrame tadviṣayaṃ paśyantyāścicchakterapi kathamapratisaṅkramaḥ ? yathaiva hi pratiniyataṃ viṣayaṃ cicchaktaye darśayantī buddhi saṅkrāmati tathā krameṇa cicchaktirapi taṃ paśyantīviśeṣābhāvāt
sa hi sarvajña pūrvottarasvabhāvatyāgopādānābhyāmavasthitasvabhāva pariṇāmyeva sarvārthān paśyati nānyathā, pratisamaya dṛśyasya pariṇāmitve draṣṭurapariṇāmānupapatte
na cāya dṛśyamarthamapariṇāmina vaktu samartha; svaya tasya pariṇāmitvopagamāt siddhāntaparityāgānuṣaṅgāt
tathā buddhereva pratisaṅkramo na tu cicchakteriti cet, na, buddherapyapratisaṅkramaprasaṅgāt viṣayasyaiva pratisaṅkramaprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi viṣaya pratiniyata darśayantī buddhiścitiśaktaye sakrāmati tathā krameṇa citiśaktirapi paśyantī viśeṣābhāvāt

kiñca, yadā buddhyā viṣayaḥ tasyai pradarśyate tadā prācīnam adarśitasvarūpamasau tyajati na vā ? na tyajati cet; kathaṃ prāgavattadāpyasau darśitaviṣayā syāt ? atha tyajati; kathamapariṇāminī, adarśitaviṣayatvatyāgena darśitaviṣayatvopādānasya pariṇāmitvāvinābhāvitvāt ? atha matam–cicchakte eka evā'bhinna svabhāvastādṛśo yena yo yatra yadā yathā artho buddhyā'dhyavasīyate taṃ tatra tadā tathā paśyatītyato darśitaviṣayatve'pi asyāḥ na prativiṣayaṃ svabhāvabhedaḥ yataḥ pariṇāmitvaṃ syāditi, tadapyasamīcīnam, buddherapyevamekasvabhāvatvaprasaṅgāt
śakyaṃ hi vaktum–buddhereka eva kramabhāvyanekaviṣayā dhyavasāyasvabhāvo yena yo yatra yadā yathā'vasthito'rthaḥ taṃ tatra tadā tathā adhyavasyatīti
tathā indriyamano'haṅkārādīnāmapi viṣayā''locanasaṅkalpanā'bhimananādyekasvabhāvatvaprasaṅgāt na kvacit svabhāvabhedaḥ siddhyet
śakya hi vaktu buddhereka eva kramabhāvyanekaviṣayavyavasāyasvabhāvo yena yathākāla yathādeśa yathāprakārañca viṣayamadhyavasyatīti na kiñcidanekasvabhāva siddhyet
yadapi–cicchakterapratisaṅkramasiddhau śuddhatvāditi sādhanamucyate; tadapyasādhu; yataḥ śuddhātmano'śuddhapariṇāmasaṅkrama eva virudhyate na punaḥ śuddhapariṇāmasaṅkramaḥ
nanu śuddhapariṇāmenāpi cicchaktirapratisaṅkramā anantatvāt; ityapyacāru; prakṛtyā anekāntāt, anantatve'pi hi tasyāḥ mahadādipariṇāmasaṅkramaḥ sāṃkhyairabhyupagamyate

yadapyuktam–paṅgvandhayoriva ityādi; tadatīvā'saṅgatam; dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt, paṅgvandhayorhi cetanatvāt idamitthameva asmadiṣṭaṃ kāryaṃ setsyatīti sampradhārya anyonyāpekṣayoḥ pravṛttiryuktā, natu prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ viparyayāt
tulanā–acetane hi niraṅkuśe pradhāne bandhari sutarāmanirmokṣaḥ syāt
tattvavidamapi pumāṃsaṃ na badhnāti prakṛtiriti ko'syā niyantā ? paṅgvandhanyāyena saṃyogasya tulyatvāt

yatpunaruktam–cidrūpasyāpi asya ajñānatamaśchannatayā ityādi; tatra kim ajñānameva tamaḥ, uta ajñānañca tamaśca iti ? prathamapakṣe muktātmāpi prakṛtisthamapi sukhādiphalaṃ kinna ātmasthaṃ manyeta, tadupabhoktā ca kinna syāt, tasyāpi jñānābhāvato'jñānatamaśchannatvā'viśeṣāt ? dvitīyapakṣe tu kimidam ajñānādanyat tamo nāma ? rāgādikamiti cet; na; tasya ātmano'tyantārthāntarabhūtaprakṛtidharmatayā ātmācchādakatvānupapatteḥ
atha adhikāriṇa eva tad ācchādakam na muktātmātmanaḥ; nanu kimidamadhikāritvaṃ nāma ? yaṃ prati pradhānaṃ pravṛttādhikāri so'dhikārīti cet; na; pradhāne pravṛttādhikāritvasya prāgeva kṛtottaratvāt
yataḥ kimajñānameva tamaḥ uta ajñānañca tamaśceti
muktidaśāyāṃ jñānaṃ vinaśyati ataḥ teṣāmapi jñānapradhvaṃsātmakamajñānamastyeva

yadapyuktam–vivekakhyāteḥ ityādi; tatra keyaṃ vivekakhyātirnāma ? prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ svena svena rūpeṇāvasthitayoḥ bhedena pratibhāsanamiti cet; sā kasya–prakṛteḥ, puruṣasya, tadvyatiriktasya vā kasyacit ? na tāvattadvyatiriktasya; prakṛti-puruṣavyatirekeṇa anyasya kasyacidapi sāṃkhyairanabhyupagamāt
nāpi prakṛteḥ, tasyāḥ asaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitatvāt, acidrūpatvāt, anabhyupagamācca
ataḥ prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ asaṃvedyaparvaṇi sthitayoḥ svarūpamātrasyāpratibhāse vivekena khyātiḥ atidurghaṭā
ghaṭapaṭādau hi svasvarūpeṇa saṃvedyaparvaṇi sthite kutaścidvibhramanimittāt vivekenā'pratīteḥ yathāvasthitavastupratibhāsipramāṇavaśād vivekena khyātirdṛṣṭā, na cātra etadati
tatra keyaṃ khyātirnāma–prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ svena svena rūpeṇāvasthitayoḥ bhedena pratibhāsanamiti cet; sā kasya–prakṛteḥ, puruṣasya vā ? –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
kiñca, vivekena khyātiḥ tanniścayaḥ, sā ca buddhidharmatvād bhavanmate puruṣe na saṃbhavati
saṃbhave vā sā tato bhinnā, abhinnā vā syāt ? yadyabhinnā, tadā ātmavattatrāpi nityatvānupaṅgāt na kadācidamuktaprasaṅgaḥ

bhinnā cet, astu, tathāpi–asau nityā, anityā vā ? yadi nityā; kiṃ sambaddhā, asambaddhā vā ? asambaddhā cet; kathaṃ tasyeti vyapadiśyeta ? asambaddhāyā api tasyāḥ tena vyapadeśe sarveṇa saha vyapadeśaprasaṅgāt na kasyacidapi saṃsāraḥ syāt
atha sambaddhā; na, nityayostayoḥ anyonyamanupakārakayoḥ kasyacidapi sambandhasyānupapatteḥ
upapattau vā tasyāpi nityatvāt sadātmano muktiprasaṅgaḥ
atha anityā vivekakhyātiḥ; nanvanityā satī asau janyā, ajanyā vā ? tatra anityāyāstasyāḥ ghaṭādivadajanyatvānupapattiḥ
janyatve'pyasyāḥ kim ātmanā, prakṛtyā, tadvyatiriktena vā kenacidasau janyeta ? na tāvat tadvyatiriktena, prakṛti-puruṣavyatiriktasya kasyacidapi tajjanakasyā'nabhyupagamāt

abhyupagame vā prakṛtiviyuktena, tatsahitena vā tenāsau janyeta ? prathamapakṣe cakrakaprasaṅgaḥ–siddhe hi vivekakhyāterjanyatve prakṛtipuruṣayorviyuktatvasiddhiḥ, tatsiddhau ca tadviyuktena ātmanā vivekakhyāterjanyatvasiddhiriti
tatsahitātmajanyatve tu sarvatra sarvadā sarveṣāṃ mokṣaḥ syāt, tathā sarvatra sarvadā'viśeṣataḥ tadutpattiprasaṅgāt
yadapi–vijñātavirūpāham ityādyabhihitam; tadapyacarcitābhidhānam; prakṛte rjaḍatayā itthaṃ vijñānānupapatteḥ
na khalu jaḍasvarūpo ghaṭādiḥ virūpatakatayā'hamanena jñāto'to naitasmai phalaṃ sampādayāmi' iti svayaṃ saṃvedayamāno dṛṣṭaḥ jaḍājaḍayoḥ svarūpasaṅkaraprasaṅgāt
svarūpapratipattau hi paramukhaprekṣitvaṃ jaḍasya svarūpam tannirapekṣatvaṃ tu ajaḍasya taditthaṃ saṅkīryeta
tulanā–acetanatvāt, tathāhi–acetanatayā pradhānasya ahamanena dṛṣṭa duṣṭa tayā vijñātamiti vijñānābhāve pūrvavat pravṛttiraviśiṣṭetyalamatiprasaṅgena
dṛṣṭāsmīti viramatīti cet, maivam, na hyasau ekapatnīvratadurgrahagṛhītā ni sakhyapuruṣopabho- gasaubhāgyā paṇyavaniteva nāsau niyamena vyavahartumarhatītyāstāmetat
kiñca, vijñātāpi prakṛtiḥ saṃsāradaśāvat mokṣadaśāyāmapi ātmano bhogasampādanāya svabhāvato vāyuvat pravarttatām tatsvabhāvasya nityatayā tadāpi sattvāt

nahi pravṛttisvabhāvo vāyuḥ virūpakatayā yena jñātaḥ taṃ prati tatsvabhāvāduparamate, ataḥ kuto mokṣaḥ syāt ? tadā tadasattve vā prakṛternityaikarūpatānupapattiḥ, pūrvasvabhāvatyāgena uttarasvabhāvopādānasya tatra virodhāt, pariṇāminitye eva tadavirodhāt
prakṛteśca pariṇāminityatvābhyupagame ātmano'pi tadabhyupagantavyam, tasyāpi prāktanasukhādyupabhoktṛsvabhāvaparihāreṇa tadabhoktṛsvabhāvasvīkārāt, amuktādisvabhāvatyāgena muktādisvabhāvopādānācca
siddhe cāsya pariṇāminityatve sukhādipariṇāmairapi pariṇāmitvamasyā'bhyupagantavyam, iti siddhaḥ– mokṣe'pyātmā viśuddhajñānādisvabhāva iti
yatheya kṛte'pi śabdādyupalabhbhe punastadartha pravartate tathā vivekakhyātau kṛtāyāmapi punastadarthaṃ prarvartiṣyate svabhāvasyānapāyitvāt
siddhe cāsya pariṇāminityatve sukhādipariṇāmairapi pariṇāmitvamasyābhyupagantavyamanyathā mokṣābhāvaprasaṅga

pratyakṣādipramāṇena hi ātmasvarūpe pratipanne manaḥpraṇidhānapūrvikāyāṃ bhāvanāyāṃ prakarṣaprāptāyāṃ paripākaṃ prāpte tattvajñāne navānāmātmaviśeṣaguṇānāmatyantocchede svasvarūpeṇa ātmano'vasthāna mokṣaḥ
taducchede ca pramāṇam–navānāmātmaviśeṣaguṇānāṃ santāno'tyantamucchidyate, santānatvāt, pradīpādisantānavat

ātyantikī duḥkhavyāvṛttirapavargo na sābadhikā dvividhadu khāvamarśinā sarvanāmnā sarveṣāmātmaguṇānā duḥkhāvamarśād atyantagrahaṇena ca sarvātmanā tadviyogābhidhānāt navānāmātmaguṇānā buddhisukhaduḥkhecchādveṣaprayatnadharmādharmasaskārāṇāṃ nirmūlocchedo'pavarga ityukta bhavati
tatsiddhametat nityasavedyam, anena sukhena viśiṣṭā ātyantikī duḥkhanivṛtti puruṣasya mokṣa iti
navānāmātmaguṇānā santāno'tyantamucchidyate, santānatvāt, yo ya santāna sa so'tyantamucchidyamāno dṛṣṭaḥ yathā pradīpasantāna, tathā cāya santāna, tasmāt atyantamucchidyate
nanu santānocchedarūpe'pi mokṣe kaściddheturvaktavyaḥ nirhetukavināśā'nabhyupagamāt iti ca na śaṅkanīyam, tattvajñānasyaiva taddhetutvāt
nivṛtte ca mithyājñāne tanmūlā rāgādayo nivarttante kāraṇābhāve ✢kāryānutpādāt
ārabdhaśarīrendriyaviṣaya✢kāryayostu sukhādiphalopabhogāt prakṣayaḥ, anārabdhatatkāryayorapyavasthitayoḥ tatphalopabhogādeva prakṣayaḥ
tathā cāgamaḥ– nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi iti
atraivārthe anumānam–pūrvakarmāṇi upabhogādeva kṣīyante karmatvāt prārabdhaśarīrādikarmavat

naca upabhogāt tatprakṣaye karmāntarasyāvaśyambhāvāt saṃsārānucchedaḥ; samādhibalādutpannatattvajñānasya avagatakarmasāmarthyotpāditayugapadaśeṣaśarīradvārā'vāptāśeṣabhogasya upāttakarmaprakṣayāt bhāvikarmotpattinimittamithyājñānajanitā'nusandhānavikalatvācca saṃsārocchedopapatteḥ
anusandhānaṃ hi rāgadveṣau, anusandhīyate gataṃ cittamābhyām iti vyutpatteḥ

jñānapūrvakāttu kṛtādasakalpitaphalād viśuddhe kule jātasya duḥkhavigamopāyajijñāsorācāryamupasaṅgamya utpannaṣaṭpadārthatattvajñānasya ajñānanivṛttau viraktasya rāgadveṣādyabhāvāt tajjayordharmādharmayoranutpattau pūrvasañcitayoścopabhogānnirodhe santoṣasukha śarīraparicchedañca utpādya rāgādinivṛttau nivṛttilakṣaṇa kevalo dharma paramārthadarśanaja sukha kṛtvā nivartate
tadā nirodhānnirvījasya ātmana śarīrādinivṛtti, puna śarīrādyanutpattau dagdhendhanānalavadupaśamo mokṣa iti
dravyaguṇakarmasāmānyaviśeṣasamavāyānā ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānā sādharmyavaidharmyābhyā tattvajñāna ni śreyasahetu
te ime mithyājñānādayo duḥkhāntā dharmā avicchedenaiva pravartamānā sasāra iti
yadā tu tattvajñānāt mithyājñānamapaiti tadā mithyājñānāpāye doṣā apayānti doṣāpāye pravṛttirapaiti, pravṛttyapāye janmāpaiti, janmāpāye duḥkhamapaiti, duḥkhāpāye cātyantiko'pavargo niśre yasamiti
tathā hyupalabdha samyagjñānasya mithyājñānanivṛttau sāmarthyaṃ śuktikādāviti –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 20 ka॰
nivṛtte ca mithyājñāne tanmūlatvādrāgādayo naśyanti kāraṇābhāve kāryasyānutpādāditi
rāgādyabhāve ca tatkāryā pravṛttirvyāvartate, tadabhāve ca dharmādharmayoranutpatti
pūrvakarmāṇyupabhogādeva kṣīyante, karmatvāt, yadyatkarma tattadupabhogādeva kṣīyate yathā''rabdhaśarīra karma, tathā cāmūni karmāṇi, tasmādupabhogādeva kṣīyante
samādhibalādutpannatattvajñāno hi karmaṇāñca sādhyamarthaṃ viditvā yugapaccharīrāṇi nirmāyopabhoga – praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 20 kha॰

atha mithyājñānabhāve tattvajñāninaḥ tadupabhoktumabhilāṣasyaivā'saṃbhavāt tadupabhogānupapattiḥ; tanna, tadupabhogaṃ vinā karmaṇāṃ prakṣayānupapattitaḥ tattvajñāninaḥ tadupabhoktumabhilāṣābhāve'pi karmakṣayārthitayā tatra pravṛttyupapatteḥ vaidyopadeśena āturavadauṣadhācaraṇe
yathaiva hi āturasya anabhilaṣite'pi auṣadhācaraṇe vyādhiprakṣayārthaṃ pravṛttiḥ tadvyatirekeṇa tatprakṣayānupapatteḥ, evamatrāpi

vivādāpannaḥ śarīrādinivṛttau ātmā sarvavaiṣayikasukhaduḥkhaśūnyaḥ, samastadharmādharmaśūnyatvāt, yastu vaiṣayikasukhaduḥkhavānnāsau samastadharmādharmaśūnyaḥ yathā saṃsāryātmā, samastadharmādharmaśūnyaśca muktātmā, tasmāt sarvavaiṣayikasukhaduḥkhaśūnyaḥ ityanumānāt, na ha vai saśarīrasya prayāpriyayorapahatirasti, aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ priyāpriye na spṛśataḥ chāndo॰ 8
jānannapi hi tadarthitayā pravartata eva vaidyopadeśādāturavadauṣadhācaraṇe –praśa॰ vyo॰ pṛ॰ 20 kha॰
tasya ca na ha vai saśarīrasya sata priyāpriyayo bāhyaviṣayasayogaviyoganimittayo bāhyaviṣayasaṃyogaviyogau mameti manyamānasya apahatirvināśa ucchedaḥ santatirūpayornāstīti
ta punardehābhimānādaśarīrasvarūpavijñānena nivartitā'vivekajñānamaśarīra santa priyāpriye na spṛśata

spṛśi pratyeka sambadhyata iti priyaṃ na spṛśati apriya na spṛśatīti vākyadvayaṃ bhavatidharmādharmakārye hi te, aśarīratā tu svarūpamiti tatra dharmādharmayorasambhavāttatkāryabhāvo dūrata evetyato na priyāpriye spṛśata

yattāvaduktam–santānatvāt ityādi; tadasamīcīnam; yasmād ātmanaḥ sarvathā bhinnānāṃ buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇānāṃ santānasya ucchedaḥ prasādhyate, atha abhinnānām, kathañcidbhinnānāṃ vā ? tatrādyapakṣe āśrayāsiddho hetuḥ; ātmano'tyantabhinnānāṃ tadviśeṣaguṇānāṃ prāgeva asattvapratipādanatastatsantānasya dharmiṇo'siddheḥ
tathā teṣāṃ bhavatā asvasaṃviditatvopagamāt, jñānāntaravedyatve ca anavasthādidoṣānuṣaṅgāt, ajñātānāñca sattvā'saṃbhavādito'pyāśrayāsiddhatvam
ātmanaḥ sarvathā'bhinnānāṃ tu teṣāṃ tatsādhane tadvattasyāpyatyantocchedaprasaṅgāt kasyāsau mokṣaḥ syāt ? kathañcittadabhedastu parairnābhyupagamyate apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt
tathāpi tadabhyupagame sarvathā taducchedāsiddhiḥ kathañcittadanucchedasyāpyevaṃ prasiddheḥ
tulanā–yata ātmanaḥ sarvathā bhinnānā buddhyādiguṇānā santānasyoccheda sādhyate, abhinnānā vā, kathañcid bhinnānā vā ? –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
tulanā–tathā buddhyādīnā viśeṣaguṇānā pareṇa svasaviditatvenānabhyupagamāt jñānāntaragrāhyatve vā'navasthādidoṣaprasakteravedyatvamityajñātasya sattvāsiddheḥ punarapyāśrayāsiddha santānatvāditi hetu
santānatvañca sādhanaṃ sāmānyarūpam, viśeṣarūpaṃ vā ? yadi sāmānyarūpam, tadā svarūpāsiddho hetuḥ, vyaktibhyaḥ sarvathā bhinnasyāsya sāmānyaparīkṣāyāṃ pratikṣiptatvāt
astu vā tadrūpaṃ tat; tathāpi parasāmānyarūpam, aparasāmānyarūpaṃ vā syāt ? prathamapakṣe gaganādinā'nekāntaḥ, atyantocchedābhāve'pi atra sattāparaparyāyasya santānatvahetoḥ sadbhāvāt
atha aparasāmānyarūpam, viśeṣaguṇāśritā hi jātiḥ santānatvam; tarhi dravyaviśeṣe pradīpe tasyāsaṃbhavāt sādhanavikalo dṛṣṭāntaḥ
santānatva hetutvenopādīyamāna yadi sāmānyamabhipreta tadā buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇeṣu pradīpe ca tejodravye sattāsāmānyavyatirekeṇa aparasāmānyasyāsabhavāt svarūpāsiddha
sattāsāmānyarūpatve vā santānatvasya satsaditi pratyayahetutvameva na punaḥ santānapratyayahetutvam –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 156

atha viśeṣarūpam, tatrāpi upādānopādeyabhūtabuddhyādikṣaṇalakṣaṇaviśeṣarūpam, pūrvāparasamānajātīyakṣaṇapravāhamātrarūpaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe santānatvasya asādhāraṇā'naikāntikatvam, tallakṣaṇasyāsya anyatra kvacidapyapravṛtteḥ

abhyupagamavirodhaśca, buddhyādikṣaṇānām upādānopādeyabhāvasya yaugairanabhyupagamāt, anyathā tatsantānasya atyantocchedo na syāt muktāvasthāyāmapi pūrvapūrvabuddhyādyupādānakṣaṇād uttarottaropādeyabuddhyādikṣaṇotpattiprasaṅgāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu pākajaparamāṇurūpādinā anekānta, tathāvidha santānatvasyātra sadbhāve'pi atyantocchedāsaṃbhavāt
tulanā– kimupādānopādeyabhāvaprabandhena pravartamānatvam, kāryakāraṇabhāvaprabandhena pravṛtti, aparāparapadārthotpattimātra vā ? –ratnākarāva॰ 7
nanu kimida santānatvam–svatantram, aparāparapadārthotpattimātra vā, ekāśrayāparāparotpattirvā ? –syā॰ maṃ॰ pṛ॰ 83
anaikāntikaśca pākajaparamāṇurūpādibhi, tathāvidhasantānatvasya tatra sadbhāve'pi atyantocchedābhāvāt
viruddhaścāyaṃ hetuḥ, kāryakāraṇakṣaṇapravāhalakṣaṇasantānatvasya nityānityaikāntayorasaṃbhavāt, arthakriyākāritvasya anekānta eva pratipāditatvāt
sādhyavikalaśca dṛṣṭāntaḥ, pradīpāderatyantocchedāsaṃbhavāt, tasya svarūpāntareṇa avasthānāt
na ca dhvastasyāpi pradīpāde rūpāntareṇāvasthānopagame pratyakṣabādhā, vāristhite tejasi bhāsurarūpopagame'pi tatprasaṅgāt

atha uṣṇasparśasya bhāsurarūpādhikaraṇatejodravyābhāve'saṃbhavāt tatra anudbhūtasyāsya parikalpanam; tarhi pradīpāderapi anupādānotpatteriva antyāvasthāto'parāparapariṇāmādhāratvamantareṇa sattvakṛtakatvāderanupapatteḥ atyantasantatyanucchedo'pi parikalpyatāmaviśeṣāt

satpratipakṣaścāyaṃ hetuḥ, tathāhi–buddhyādisantāno nātyantocchedavān, akhilapramāṇānupalabhyamānatathocchedatvāt, ya evaṃvidhaḥ sa na tattvenopādeyaḥ yathā pākajaparamāṇurūpādisantānaḥ, tathā cāyam, tasmānnātyantocchedavāniti
viruddhaścāya hetu, śabdabuddhipradīpādiṣu atyantānucchedavatsveva santānatvasya bhāvāt
sādhanavikalaśca dṛṣṭānta, pradīpāderatyantocchedāsaṃbhavāt, taijasaparamāṇūnā bhāsvararūpaparityāgena andhakārarūpatayā'vasthānāt
tulanā–tarhi pradīpāderapyanupādānotpattivanna santativipattyabhāvamantareṇa vipatti sabhavatītyanumānata kinna kalpyate tatsantatyanuccheda
kiñca, ato'numānāt indriyajānāṃ buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇānāmatyantocchedaḥ sādhyeta, atīndriyāṇāṃ vā ? tatrādyavikalpe siddhasādhanam, asmābhirapi tatra taducchedābhyupagamāt
dvitīyavikalpastvanupapannaḥ, atīndriyāṇāṃ teṣāmatyantocchede muktau kasyacidapi pravṛttyanu papatteḥ
mokṣārthī hi sarvo niratiśayasukhajñānādiprāptyabhilāṣeṇaiva pravarttate na punaḥ sakalabuddhyādiviśeṣaguṇocchedābhilāṣeṇa, asya kenacidapyanabhilaṣaṇīyatvāt
na hi kaścit prekṣāvān ātmanaḥ sadguṇocchedāya yatate tadutkarṣaṇārthamevāsya prayatrapratīteḥ
yadi hi mokṣāvasthāyāṃ śilāśakalakalpaḥ apagatasukhasaṃvedanaleśaḥ puruṣaḥ sampadyate tadā kṛtaṃ mokṣeṇa
saṃsāra eva vasmastu yatra sāntarāpi sukhaleśapratipattirasti
taccintyatāmidam– kim alpasukhānubhavo bhadrakaḥ, kiṃ vā sakalasukhocchedaḥ iti ? ato na vaiśeṣikopakalpite nikhilaguṇocchedalakṣaṇe pāṣāṇakalpe mokṣe kasyacid gantumicchāpyupapannā
kiñcendriyajānā buddhyādiguṇānāmuccheda sādhyamāno'sti uta atīndriyāṇām ? –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
teṣyadṛṣṭahetukānā buddhyādīnāmātmānta karaṇasayogajānā ca muktau nivṛttiṃ bruvāṇā na nivāryante, karmakṣayahetukayostu praśamasukhānantajñānayornivṛttimācakṣāṇāste na svasthā pramāṇavirodhāt
tata kathañcid buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇānā nivṛtti kathañcidanivṛttirmuktau vyavatiṣṭhate
api vṛndābane śūnye śṛgālatvaṃ sa icchati
na tu nirviṣaya mokṣa kadācidapi gautama
vara vṛndāvane vāsa śṛgālaiśca sahoṣitam –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
varaṃ vṛndāvane ramye kroṣṭṭatvamabhivāñchitam –syā॰ maṃ॰ pṛ॰ 86
na tu vaiśeṣikīṃ muktiṃ gautamo gantumicchati || iti

kiñca, muktau buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇānāmabhāvaḥ kāraṇābhāvāt, niṣprayojanatvāt, viruddhatvādvā syāt ? tatrādyapakṣe kasya kāraṇasya tatrā'bhāvaḥ–cakṣurādeḥ, tatpratibandhakāpāyasya vā ? cakṣurādeścet; tarhi tajjanyasyaiva jñānādeḥ tatrābhāvaḥ syāt nānyasya, ataḥ siddhasādhyatā
nanu sarvasya jñānādeḥ dharmādharmaśarīrendriyādikāraṇakalāpādhīnajanmatvāt tadabhāve jñānāderevā'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ siddhasādhyatā ? ityapyasādhīyaḥ; maheśvarajñānādyabhāvānuṣaṅgāt
nityatvāt tajjñānāderadoṣoyam; ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam, tannityatvasya īśvaranirākaraṇapraghaṭṭake prativyūḍhatvāt
tataḥ cakṣurādyapāye'pi īśvarasya pratibandhakāpāyaprabhavaṃ jñānādyabhyupagantavyam, tadvad anyamuktātmanāmapi teṣāṃ tatsvabhāvatvāt
atha muktasya kṛtakṛtyatayā jñānādinā prayojanābhāvāt muktau tadabhāvaḥ; tanna; pratibandhakāpāyopetasya ātmasvarūpasyaiva ebavidhatvena niṣprayojanatvāsiddheḥ
anantajñānādilakṣaṇaviśiṣṭaguṇāvāptireva ca ātmanaḥ kṛtakṛtyatā na punaḥ nikhilaguṇocchedaḥ, guṇotkarṣe eva loke'pi kṛtakṛtyaśabdaprayogapratīteḥ
muktau teṣāṃ virodhāmyupagame ca maheśvarepyeṣāṃ virodhato'bhāvānuṣaṅgāt lābhamicchato mūlocchedaḥ syāt
kiñca, buddhyādiviśeṣaguṇānāmātyantikocchedasya mokṣarūpatāyāṃ saṃsārasvarūpaṃ vaktavyam–tatkhalu tadviśeṣaguṇānucchedaḥ, bhavāntarāvāptirvā syāt ? prathamapakṣe maheśvarasya sasāritvaprasaṅgaḥ
tato'nyeṣāmeva tadanucchedaḥ tallakṣaṇam ato nāsya saṃsāritvānuṣaṅgaḥ; ityapi śraddhāmātram, ardhajaratīyanyāyānusaraṇaprasaṅgāt
tadyadi tadanucchedaḥ saṃsāralakṣaṇam, tarhi yatrāsau asti tatra sarvatra saṃsāritvaprasaṅgaḥ muktasvarūpeṇāsya virodhāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu asmanmatasiddhiḥ, svopāttakarmavaśād bhavād bhavāntarāvāptiḥ saṃsāraḥ ityasmābhirabhyupagamāt
yadavaṣṭambhenātmana sasaraṇamitaścetaśca gamana bhavati sa sasāra, athavā balavato mohasyākhyā sasāra, nārakādyavasthā vā sasāra

kiñca, atyantaṃ buddhyādiguṇocchedasya mokṣatve pradīpanirvāṇavādinaḥ bhavataḥ ko viśeṣaḥ syāt ? tatra hi svarūpeṇa ātmano'sattvam, bhavanmate tu sato'pyasya sarvathā tadvikalasya grāhakapramāṇābhāvāt
tathābhūtaṃ hi tatsvarūpaṃ pratyakṣataḥ, anumānato vā pratīyeta ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ, mokṣāvasthāyāṃ tasyaivā'saṃbhavāt
nāpyanumānataḥ; pratyakṣābhāve bhavanmate anumānānudayāt, pratyakṣapūrvakatvena tasyābhyupagamāt
yasminna jātirna jarā na mṛtyurna vyādhayo nāpriyasaprayoga
dīpo yathā nirvṛtimabhyupetaḥ naibābaniṃ gacchati nāntarikṣam
diśa na kāñcidvidiśa na kāñcitsnehakṣayāt kevalameti śāntim
eva kṛtī nirvṛtimabhyupeto naivāvaniṃ gacchati nāntarikṣam
diśa na kāñcidvidiśa na kāñcitkleśakṣayāt kevalameti śāntim

yadapi–tattvajñānasya viparyayajñānavyavacchedakrameṇa niḥśreyasahetutvamuktam; tadupapannam; ✢sakalabuddhyādisantānocchedahetutvaṃ tu tasyānupapannam;✢ svaviruddhamithyājñānasantānocchedahetutvasyaiva tatropapatteḥ śuktikādau tathādarśanāt

nanu mithyājñānanivṛttau rāgādyanutpatteḥ tatpūrvakadharmāprādurbhāvataḥ śarīrādyasaṃbhave siddha eva mokṣadaśāyāṃ sakalabuddhyādisantānocchedaḥ; ityapyapeśalam; śarīrāderabhāvepi anantātīndriyā'khilapadārthaviṣayasamyagjñānasukhādisantānasya ucchedāsiddheḥ, indriyajajñānādisantānasyaiva tadabhāve'bhāvaprasiddheḥ, tatra ca siddhasādhanam ityuktam
yattūktam–ārabdha ityādi; tadapi na sūktam; upabhogāt karmaṇāmātyantikaprakṣayānupapatteḥ
tadupabhogasamaye hi aparakarmotpattikāraṇasya abhilāṣapūrvakamanovākvāyavyāpārādeḥ saṃbhavāt avikalakāraṇasya pracuratarakarmaṇo bhavataḥ kathamātyantikaprakṣayaḥ ?

yadapi samādhibalāt ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; abhilāṣarūparāgādyabhāve sāti śayarddhimato bhavadabhiprāyeṇa yogino'pi tattvajñānādavagatakarmasāmarthyasya nānāśarīrāṇi vidhāya aṅganādyupabhogā'saṃbhavāt
tatsaṃbhave vā avaśyambhāvī nṛpatyāderiva atibhogino yogino'pi pracuratarakarmasaṃbhavaḥ

yadapi–vaidyopadeśena ityādyabhihitam; tadapyabhidhānamātram, āturasyāpi nīrugbhāvābhilāṣeṇaiva auṣadhyādyācaraṇe pravṛttyupapatteḥ, ataḥ kathaṃ taddṛṣṭāntāt nirabhilāpasyāpi tattvajñāninaḥ tattvajñānamātrāt karmakṣayārthitayā aṅganādyupabhogaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaḥ, dṛṣṭānta-dārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt ? tanna aśeṣaśarīradvārā'vāptāśeṣabhogasya karmāntarānutpattiḥ
kiṃ tarhi ? paripūrṇasamyagdarśanajñānacāritrasya ityalaṃ vivādena, jīvanmukteriva paramamukterapi tritayātmakādeva kāraṇādutpatteḥ
saṃsārakāraṇaṃ hi mithyādarśanāditrayātmakam ataḥ tannivarttakenāpi tritayātmakenaiva bhavitavyam, ekarūpeṇa samyagjñānādimātreṇa asya nivarttayitumaśakteḥ

samyagjñānaṃ hi viparītābhiniveśaviviktā''tmasvarūpasvabhāvasamyagdarśanopacitaṃ bāhyābhyantarakriyānivṛttilakṣaṇacāritropabṛṃhitaṃ tritayātmakameva āgāmikarmānutpattau sañcitakarmakṣaye ca samartham, uṣṇasparśasya bhāviśītasparśānutpattau pravṛttatatsparśapradhvaṃse ca sāmarthyavat
nādasaṇissa nāṇa nāṇeṇa vinā na hunti caraṇaguṇā

yadapi–vivādāpannaḥ śarīrādinivṛttāvātmā ityādyanumānam na ha vai ityādyāgamaśca ātmanaḥ sarvavaiṣayikasukhādiśūnyatāyāṃ pramāṇam' ityuktam, tadapyayuktameva, siddhasādhanāt, śarīrādinivṛttau hi samastadharmādinivṛtteḥ tatprabhavameva sukhādi muktātmano nivartteta na svātmottham
yaddhi yatkāryaṃ tat tadabhāve na bhavati nānyadatiprasaṅgāt
dharmādyabhāve kutastastadutpattiḥ iti cet ? pratibandhāpāyāt ityasakṛdāveditam
ataḥ paramakāṣṭhāprāptaṃ samyagdarśanāditrayaṃ paramaprakarṣaprāptajñānādisvarūpaṃ mokṣaṃ prasādhayatīti prekṣādakṣaiḥ pratipattavyamiti

tulanā–śubhāśubhādṛṣṭaparipākaprabhavena bhavasabhavinī hi priyāpriye parasparānuṣakte apekṣyāya vyavasthita, sakalādṛṣṭakṣayakāraṇaka punaraikāntikātyāntikarūpa kevalameva priyaṃ ni śreyasadaśāyāmiṣyate tatkuta pratiṣidhyate ? –ratnākarāva॰ 7
nanu paramaprakarṣaprāptasukhasvabhāvataiva ātmano mokṣaḥ na tu jñānādisvabhāvatā, tatra pramāṇābhāvāt
tathāhi–ātmā sukhasvabhāvaḥ, atyantapriyabuddhiviṣayatvāt, ananyaparatayopādīyamānatvācca, yad yadevaṃvidhaṃ tattatsukhasvabhāvam yathā vaiṣayikaṃ sukham, tathā cātmā, tasmātsukhasvabhāva iti
tathā, ātmā sukhasvabhāvaḥ, vastutve sati mukhyapreyobuddhiviṣayatvāt, nirupacaritapreyaḥśabdavācyatvādvā, rāgiṇāṃ vaiṣayikasukhavaditi
paramātiśayaprāptatā ca tatsukhasya ato'numānātprasiddhā–sukhatāratamyaṃ kvacid viśrāmyati, tāratamyaśabdavācyatvāt, parimāṇatāratamyavaditi
tathā āgamo'pi ātmano mokṣe tatsvabhāvatāyāṃ pramāṇam– ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ tacca mokṣe'bhivyajyate
yadā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ brahma sarvaṃ tyajati bandhanam
eṣa eva hyānandayati ānanda brahmaṇo vidvānna bibheti kadācana –taitti॰ 2
savedye ca sukhe loke ānandākhyā prayujyate
tadetatpreya putrātpreya anyasmātsarvasmādantaratara yadayamātmā ātmānameva priyamupāsīta
kadāpi nāvadhi prīte svātmani prāṇinā kvacit
ātmā sukhābhinnaḥ sukhalakṣaṇavattvād baiṣayikasukhavat ātmā sukham anaupādhikapremagocaratvāt –saṃkṣepaśā॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 30–31
vittastrīputrādayo hi ātmārthamupādīyante, parañcātmana upādāna tu nānyārtham, svayamātmā ātmārthamevopādīyate ityartha
ānanda brahmaṇo rūpa tacca mokṣe pratiṣṭhitam
yadā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ brahma sarvaṃ tyajati bandhanam
tadā tannityamānandaṃ muktaḥ svātmani vindati || iti

nanu nityānandasya ātmani sarvadā sadbhāvāmyupagame saṃsāradaśāyāmapyupalambhaprasa ṅgāt muktetarāvasthayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ iti ca na vācyam, nityānandasya nityātmani sadā sadbhāvepi saṃsāradaśāyāmāvṛtatvena anabhivyaktito'nupalambhasaṃbhavā'virodhāt, yogābhyāsādāvaraṇaprakṣaye mokṣāvasthāyāṃ tadabhivyakterupalambhaḥ iti
yadyapi sasāradaśāyāmavidyāvṛtasvarūpatvādātmā paramānandarūpatayā na prathate tathāpi tattvavidyayā'vidyānivṛttau svaprakāśatayā svayameva paramānandasvarūpatayā prakāśate –siddhāntabi॰ pṛ॰ 450
yattāvaduktam–ātmā sukhasvabhāvaḥ ityādi, tatra kimida sukhasvabhāvatvaṃ nāma–sukhatvajātisambandhitvam, sukhādhikaraṇatvaṃ vā ? na tāvat sukhatvajātisambandhitvam, guṇe eva asya sadbhāvāt
§ nahi ekā kācijjātiḥ dravyaguṇayoḥ ātmasukhayoḥ sādhāraṇā upalabhyate
§ nāpi sukhādhikaraṇatvam, nityā'nityavikalpā'natikramāt–yasya hi sukhasya adhikaraṇamātmā tatsukhaṃ kiṃ nityam, anityaṃ vā ? na tāvadanityam; ātmano'pi tatsvabhāvatayā'nityatvaprasaṅgāt
na khalu svabhāvābhāve tadvato'vasthānaṃ yuktam atiprasaṅgāt

atha nityam, kiṃ kathañcit, sarvathā vā ? yadi kathañcit, jainamatasiddhiḥ, dravyato nityasya paryāyataśca anityasya kathañcidāvirbhāvatirobhāvavataḥ sukhaparyāyasya ātmani jñānādiparyāyavat syādvādibhirabhyupagamāt
tatra yadi sukhasvabhāvatva sukhatvajātisambandhitvam, tanna ātmani sabhāvyate guṇe evāsyopalambhāt

nanu muktau sukhādiparyāyasya aparāparasya āvirbhāvābhyupagame tatkāraṇaṃ vaktavyam, akāraṇakasya tatparyāyasya āvirbhāvānupapatteḥ iti ca na cetasi nidheyam, ātmana eva natpratibandhakāpāyopetasya tatra tatkāraṇatvena prāk prarūpitatvāt
saukhyādipratibandhakamohādikarmāpāyopeto hi ātmaiva mokṣāvasthāyāṃ tathābhūtasukhajñānādikāraṇam ghaṭādyāvaraṇāpāyopetapradīpakṣaṇavat svaparaprakāśakā'parapradīpakṣaṇotpattau
kimapekṣo'sau tadā tajjanayatīti cet ? tatpratibandhakāpāyāpekṣa eva iti brūmaḥ

tathābhūtasyāsya tadutpādanasvabhāvatayā tadā'nyāpekṣā'nupapatteḥ, yad yadā yadutpādanasvabhāvaṃ na tattadā tadutpādane anyāpekṣam yathā antyāvasthāyām antyā kāraṇasāmagrī svakāryotpādane, tadutpādanasvabhāvaśca mokṣāvasthāyām atīndriyasukhādyutpattau pratibandhakāpāyopeta ātmā iti
dṛśyate hi–saṃsārāvasthāyāmapi vāsīcandanakalpānāṃ sarvatra samavṛttīnāṃ viśiṣṭadhyānādivyavasthitānāṃ sendriyaśarīrādivyāpārājanyaḥ paramāhlādarūpo'nubhavaḥ
sa eva uttarottarabhāvanāviśeṣavaśāduttarottarāmavasthāmāsādayan paramakāṣṭhāṃ pratipadyate iti sarvaṃ sustham
tataḥ taddaśāyāmapi tatparyāyasya kathañcidāvirbhāvanimittasadbhāvāt kathañcidevānityaḥ sukhādiparyāyo'bhyupagantavyaḥ

tulanā–upalabhyate ca vāsīcandanakalpasya mumukṣo sarvatra samavṛtterviśiṣṭadhyānādivyavasthitasya sendriyaśarīravyāpārājanya paramāhlādarūpo'nubhava, tasyaiva bhāvanāvaśāduttarottarāmavasthāmāsādayataḥ paramakāṣṭhāgatirapi sabhāvyate –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 161

tasya hi grāhakaṃ pramāṇaṃ pratyakṣam, anumānam, āgamo vā syāt ? pratyakṣañcet; kimaindriyam, mānasam, svasaṃvedanaṃ vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'yuktaḥ; indriyāṇāṃ pratiniyatarūpādigocaracāritayā tatprabhavapratyakṣasya tato'nyatra pravṛttyanupapatteḥ
bahireva asya tannirapekṣasyāpravṛttiḥ nāntaḥ iti cet, na; tatrāpi sambaddhasya asambaddhasya vā tasya svasaṃvedanasiddhau tatra jñānajanakatvapratiṣedhāt
nahi svasaṃvedanapratyakṣe anavacchinnadeśakālakalākalāpaḥ trikālānuyāyī nityaniraṃśaḥ sukhasvabhāvo'nubhūyate pratītivirodhāt
pratyakṣa tāvadasmadādīnāmanyeṣā vā kepāñcidasminnarthe na prabhavatīti keya kathā
tasya grāhakaṃ pratyakṣamanumānamāgamo vā syāt ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 1115
astu vā kutaścittannityatvapratītiḥ; tathāpi yatastatpratītiḥ tat nityam, anityaṃ vā ? na tāvadanityam, tathāvidhāttato nityaṃ tatpratītivirodhāt
kutaścāsya utpattiḥ syāt, anityasya anutpattidharmakatvānupapatteḥ ? indriyādibhyaśca tadutpattyabhyupagame sukhaviṣayatvaṃ na prāpnoti ityuktamanantarameva

atha yogajadharmāpekṣa ātmamanaḥsaṃyoga eva tajjanakaḥ, nanu yogajadharmasya muktāvasaṃbhavāt kathamasau tatsaṃyogena apekṣeta yatastatra tatastadutpattiḥ syāt ? atha ādyaṃ yogajadharmāpekṣaḥ tatsaṃyogaḥ jñānaṃ janayati, taccāpekṣya uttarottaraṃ jñānamasau janayati iti, tadapyasāmpratam, apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt
nahi śarīrasambandhānapekṣaṃ jñānaṃ tatsaṃyogasya jñānotpattau sahakārikāraṇamiti bhavatāṃ rāddhāntaḥ, tadapekṣasyaiva tasya tadutpattau kṛtānte tatsahakārikaraṇatvopavarṇanāt
tulanā–tadananta sukha muktau pusa savedyasvabhāvamasavedyasvabhāva vā ? savedyañceta, tatsavedanasya anantasya siddhiṃ, anyathā anantasya sukhasya svaya savedyatvavirodhāt
yadi punarasavedyameva tat, tadā katha sukha nāma ? sātasaṃvedanasya sukhatvapratīte
sa kimānando muktāvanubhūyate na vā ? yadi nānubhūyate; sthito'pyasthitānna viśiṣyate anupabhogyatvāt
anubhūyate cet; anubhavasya kāraṇa vācyam –praśa॰ kanda॰ pṛ॰ 286
nitya sukhamabhivyajyate iti ko'bhivyaktyartha ? jñānamiti cet, nityamanitya veti kalpanānupapatti
astu vā yatkiñcittadgrāhaka tathāpi tannityamanitya vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 1116

dharmasya kāraṇavacanam–yadi dharmo nimittāntaram, tasya heturvācyo yata utpadyata iti ? yogasamādhijasya kāryāvasāyavirodhāt prakṣaye savedananivṛtti–yadi yogasamādhijo dharmo hetu, tasya kāryāvasāyavirodhāt prakṣaye savedanamatyanta nivarteteti
tulanā–athādyasayogajadharmādupajāta vijñānamapekṣya uttara vijñāna tasmāccottaramiti santānam, tanna; pramāṇābhāvāt
tathā ca śarīrasambandhānapekṣa vijñānameva ātmānta karaṇasayogasya apekṣākāraṇamiti na dṛṣṭam
atha ādya jñāna yogajadharmāpekṣastatsayogo janayati –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 1116
atha nityam; tadā muktetarāvasthayoraviśeṣaprasaṅgaḥ, sukhatatsaṃvedanayoḥ nityatvena ubhayatra sadbhāvā'viśeṣāt
indriyajasukhena cāsya saṃsārāvasthāyāṃ sāhacaryānubhavaprasaṅgāt sukhadvayopalambhaḥ syāt

pratibaddhatvāttadā tasyā'nupalambha iti cet, kenāsya pratibaddhatvam–śarīreṇa, avidyayā, vaipayikasukhādyanubhavena, bāhyaviṣayavyāsaṅgena vā ? na tāvat śarīreṇa, asya sukhasādhakatvena tatpratibandhakatvāyogāt
nahi yad yadarthaṃ tat tasyaiva pratibandhakam atiprasaṅgāt
na ca śarīraṃ sukhasya vighātakam tasmin sati tasya ātmalābhāt
yasmin sati yasyātmalābhaḥ na tat tasya pratibandhakam yathā bījamaṅkurasya, śarīre sati ātmalābhaśca sukhasyeti
tasya tatpratibandhakatve ca tadapahanturhisāphalaṃ na syāt, pratibandhavighātakasya upakārakatvena loke prasiddheḥ
yat tuccharūpaṃ na tadarthakriyākāri yathā mṛgatṛṣṇikājalam, tuccharūpā ca avidyā bhavadbhiriṣṭā iti
pratiṣiddhañca avidyāyāḥ pratibandhakatvaṃ brahmādvaitapraghaṭṭake prapañcena ityalaṃ punaḥ prasaṅgena
nāpi vaiṣayikasukhādyanubhavena; tena hi nityasukhasya tadanubhavasya vā pratibandhaḥ anutpattilakṣaṇo vināśalakṣaṇo vā na yuktaḥ; dvayorapi nityatvābhyupagamāt

nāpi bāhyaviṣayavyāsaṅgena, tena hi pramātuḥ, indriyādervā sambandhinā tatpratibandhaḥ kriyate ? pakṣadvayamapyetadayuktam; ātmano hi pramāturvyāsaṅgaḥ rūpādau viṣaye jñānotpattau viṣayāntare jñānānutpattiḥ, indriyasyāpi ekasmin viṣaye jñānajanakatvena pravṛttasya viṣayāntare jñānā'janakatvam
sa cātra asambhāvyaḥ; sukhavat tajjñānasyāpi sadā sattvāt

tulanā– sukhavannityamiti cet, sasārasthasya muktenāviśeṣa, abhyanujñāne ca dharmādharmaphalena sāhacaryyaṃ yaugapadya gṛhyeta–yadidamutpattisthāneṣu dharmādharmaphala sukha duḥkha vā savedyate paryāyeṇa, tasya ca nityasaṃvedanasya ca sahabhāva yaugapadya gṛhyeta
tataśca dharmādharmaphalābhyā sukhaduḥkhābhyāmasya nityasya sukhasya sāhacaryamanubhūyeta
kenāsya pratibaddhatvam–śarīreṇa, avidyayā, vaiṣayikasukhādyanubhavena, bāhyaviṣayavyāsaṅgena vā ? –syā॰ ra॰ pṛ॰ 1116
tulanā–śarīrādisambandha pratibandhaheturiti cet, na, śarīrādīnāmupabhogārthatvāt, viparyayasya cānanumānāt
syānmatam–sasārāvasthasya śarīrādisambandho nityasukhasavedanaheto pratibandhaka tenāviśeṣo nāstīti, etaccāyuktam, śarīrādaya upabhogārthā te bhogapratibandha kariṣyantītyanupapannam
pratibandhaka kāryavyāghātakṛducyate, na ca nityasukhasya anutpatti sabhavati
tathā hi pratibandhavighātaka upakāraka eveti dṛṣṭam
na hi nityasukhasavedanasya pratibandhakasya śarīrāderapahanturhisāphalasya abhāva ityalam
prakāśasya tucchenāvarītumaśakyatvāt meghā api raveranye svarūpeṇa ca vāstavā
tathā hi ātmano rūpādiviṣayakajñānotpattau viṣayāntare jñānānutpattirvyāsaṅga
evamindriyasyāpi ekasmin viṣaye jñānajanakatvena pravṛttasya viṣayāntare jñānājanakatva vyāsaṅgaḥ
na caivamātmano rūpādiviṣayakajñānotpattau nityasukhe jñānānutpattiḥ tajjñānasyāpi nityatvāt
kiñca, yathā muktyavasthāyām anityaṃ sukhaṃ jñānañcā'tikramya nityaṃ tatparikalpyate tathā nityatvadharmādhikaraṇaṃ dehendriyādikamapi parikalpyatāmaviśeṣāt
atha dharmādeḥ kāryo dehaḥ kathaṃ tadabhāve tatra bhavet pratītivirodhāt ? tadanyatrāpi samānam
atha saṃsārarisukhavilakṣaṇaṃ tatsukham tenāyamadoṣaḥ, tarhi deho'pi saṃsāridehād vilakṣaṇaḥ tatra asyāstu viśeṣābhāvāt
yathā dṛṣṭamanitya sukhaṃ parityajya nityasukha kāmayate, eva dehendriyabuddhīranityā dṛṣṭā atikramya muktasya nityā dehendriyabuddhaya kalpayitavyāḥ
tadbhāve tatra ā॰, tadabhāve tata prasave tatra ba॰

kiñca, sukhavat jñānasya muktāvabhyupagame tacchakteḥ viparītābhiniveśanivṛttila kṣaṇadarśanasya ca sāmarthyasiddhatvāt anantacatuṣṭayasvarūpalābhalakṣaṇamokṣaprasiddheḥ jainamatasiddhiḥ syāt, ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpam ityekāntatyāgāt
tanna sukhasvabhāvatvalakṣaṇaṃ sādhyaṃ vicāryamāṇaṃ bhavanmate ghaṭate
sādhanañca atyantapriyabuddhiviṣayatvam ananyaparatayopādīyamānatvañca anaikāntikatvādasādhanam; duḥkhābhāve'pi bhāvāt
ananyaparatayopādīyamānatvañcāsiddham; nahi ātmā anyārthaṃ nopādīyate, sukhādyarthamasyopādanāt
yadapi ātmā sukhasvabhāvaḥ vastutve sati mukhyapreyobuddhiviṣayatvāt ityuktam; tadapyetena pratyuktam; sukhasvabhāvatve prāguktāśeṣadoṣānuṣaṅgāt
anyathāsiddhañca; ātmano hi ātyantiko duḥkhābhāvo mokṣe syāt iti tatra tat sādhanadvayaṃ na punaḥ sukhasvabhāva iti
tathāhi–duḥkhābhāvarūpo'yamātmā, vastutve sati mukhyapreyobuddhiviṣayatvāt, nirupacaritapreyaḥśabdavācyatvādvā, rāgiṇāṃ vaiṣayikaduḥkhābhāvavaditi
yadapyuktam–iṣṭārtho mumukṣūṇāṃ prayatnaḥ ityādi; tadapyasundaram; hetoranekāntāt
nahi iṣṭārthasādhanāyaiva prekṣāvatāṃ prayatno bhavati, vyādhiviśeṣakhinnānāṃ teṣām aniṣṭoparamārthamapi prayatnapratīteḥ
tulanā– iṣṭādhigamārthā pravṛttiriti cet; na; aniṣṭoparamārthatvāt
atidurvahaścāyaṃ saṃsāraduḥkhabhāra iti tadupaśamāya vyavasyantaḥ santo na niṣprayojanaprayatnā bhavantītyanaikāntiko hetuḥ

kiñca, iṣṭaśabdenātra kiṃ sukhamabhidhīyate, abhipretaprayojanamātraṃ vā ? yadi abhipretaprayojanamātram; kathamataḥ puṃsaḥ sukhasvabhāvatā siddhyet ? parasparaviruddhānekāpavargasaṃsiddhiprasaṅgaśca, kapilādimatānusāriṇāmapi mumukṣūṇāṃ prayatnasya tadiṣṭāpavargalakṣaṇaprayojanaprasādhakatvaprasakteḥ
prayatnasya prekṣāvattvaviśeṣaṇāt na anekaviruddhāpavargasaṃsiddhiriti cet; na; tadvivekasya karttumaśakyatvāt
nahi bhavanmatānusāriṇaḥ prekṣāvanta na kapilādimatānusāriṇaḥ iti vivekaḥ karttuṃ śakyaḥ, pramāṇaprabādhitasarvathānityādi svabhāvatattvāṅgīkāreṇa aśeṣāṇāmapyaprekṣāvattvaprasiddheḥ
atha sukham iṣṭaśabdena ucyate; tadā sādhyavikalatā dṛṣṭāntasya
na khalu kṛṣīvalādīnāṃ kṛṣyādiprayatnaḥ sākṣātsukhārtho bhavati, kṛṣyādiphalaniṣpattyarthatvāttasya
paramparayā tasya tadarthatve mumukṣuprayatnasyāpi tathā tadarthatvamastu

nanu mumukṣavo yadi sākṣātsukhārthaprayatnā na bhavanti tadā te niṣprayojanaprayatnā eva syuḥ prayojanāntarasya tatprasādhyasyā'saṃbhavāt; tadapyapeśalam; saṃsāraduḥkhocchedalakṣaṇaprayojanasya tatprayatnaprasādhyasya sadbhāvāt
dussaho hi saṃsāraduḥkhabhāro'yam ataḥ taducchittaye prayatamānāste na niṣprayojanaprayatnā bhavitumarhanti
yatpunaḥ sukhatāratamyaṃ kvacidviśrāmyati ityādyabhihitam, tadapyabhidhānamātram; paratvādinā anekāntāt
parāparādibuddhiprakarṣasamadhigato hi paratvādiprakarṣaḥ tāratasyaśabdavācyo na ca kvacidviśrāntaḥ
kiñca, duḥkhepyevaṃ paramaprakarṣaprasaṅgaḥ–duḥkhatāratamyaṃ kvacidviśrāmyati tāratamyaśabdavācyatvāt parimāṇatāratamyavat iti
na ca duḥkhaparamaprakarṣo bhavadbhiriṣṭaḥ ityanenāpiṃ anekāntaḥ
yadapi–ānandaṃ brahmaṇo rūpam ityādyāgamaḥ mokṣe sukhasvabhāvatāyāyātmanaḥ pramāṇam ityādyuktam, tadatīvā'saṅgatam; tasya prāmāṇyāsaṃbhavāt
apauruṣeyatvenāsya prāmāṇyam; ityapi śraddhāmātram; tadapauruṣeyatvasya prāgeva prativyūḍhatvāt

astu vā tasya tathā pramāṇyam, tathāpi yathāsau muktau ānandarūpatām ātmanaḥ pratipādayati tathā tadabhāvamapi na ha vai saśarīrasya priyāpriyayorapahatirasti, aśarīraṃ vāva santaṃ priyāpriye na spṛśataḥ
ataḥ kvāsya prāmāṇyam iti vyāghrataṭīnyāyo bhavataḥ samāyātaḥ

atha idamāgamavacanam anyathā vyākhyāyatesaśarīrasya iti prakramāt sāṃsārike sukhaduḥkhe anukūletaraviṣayopalambhasaṃbhave mokṣe location unknown aśarīramātmānaṃ na spṛśataḥ' iti, tadapi manorathamātram, ānandaṃ brahma ityasyāpi anyathā vyākhyātuṃ suśakatvāt, ātyantikasaṃsāraduḥkhābhāvaviṣayo hi atra ānandaśabdaḥ na punaḥ sukhaviṣayaḥ
dṛṣṭaśca duḥkhābhāve sukhaśabdaprayogaḥ yathā bharākrāntasya ciraṃjvaraśirorttyādivyādhiduḥkhitasya vā tadapāye ciraṃ tadduḥkhena khinnāḥ sukhino vayamadya iti tadātmanāṃ pratibhāsapratīteḥ
syādetadeva yadyetadeva kevalamāgamavacanamaśroṣyata, vacanāntaramapi tu śrūyate–na havai
nanu bhavatpaṭhitamāgamavacanamanyathāpi vyākhyātu śakyate–saśarīrasyeti prakramāt sāsārike sukhaduḥkhe anukūletaraviṣayopalambhasabhave tadānīmaśarīramātmānaṃ na spṛśata ityartha
hanta tarhi tvadadhītamapi vedavacanamānanda brahmeti sasāraduḥkhaparihārakramaprakaraṇādeva taddu khāpāyaviṣaya vyākhyāsyate
kuṭumbamapi me preyān preyāstvamapi he sakhe
ki karomi dvidhā citta ito vyāghra itastaṭī
ātyantike ca sasāraduḥkhābhāve sukhavacanād āgame'pi satyavirodha
dṛṣṭo hi duḥkhābhāve sukhaśabdaprayogo bahula loke
sukhaśabdo duḥkhābhāve yathā bhārākrāntasya bāhikasya tadapāye iti

yaccoktam–nityānandasya saṃsāradaśāyām āvṛtatvenā'nabhivyaktito'nupalambhaḥ ityādi, tadapyuktimātram, avidyādeḥ tadāvārakatvapratipedhāt, nityaikasvabhāvasya svaprakāśātmana āvriyamāṇatvāyogācca, pariṇāmina eva hi vastunaḥ kenacidāvaraṇaṃ yuktam kathañcidanāvṛtarūpaparityāgena āvṛtarūpasvīkārāt
ataḥ kathañcideva nityajñānakhādisvabhāvo muktau ātmā pratipattavya iti
nairātmyabhāvanāto viśuddhajñānotpattirūpo mokṣa iti bauddhasya pūrvapakṣa–
nanu kāryakāraṇabhūtajñānakṣaṇapravāhavyatirekeṇa aparasya ātmano'saṃbhavāt kasya jñānādisvabhāvatā muktau prasādhyeta ? muktiśca ātmadarśino dūrotsāritā

yo hi paśyati ātmānaṃ sthirādirūpaṃ tasya ātmani sthairyādiguṇadarśananimittaḥ sneho'vaśyambhāvī, ātmasnehācca ātmasukheṣu paritṛṣyan sukheṣu tatsādhaneṣu ca doṣāstiṃraskṛtya guṇānāropayati, guṇadarśī ca paritṛṣyan mameti sukhasādhanānyupādatte, tato yāvad ātmadarśanaṃ tāvatsaṃsāra eva
yaḥ paśyatyātmānaṃ tatrāsyāhamiti śāśvataḥ snehaḥ | snehātsukheṣu tṛṣyati tṛṣṇā doṣāṃstiraskurute
yaḥ paśyātmāna tatrātmani asya draṣṭu ahamiti śāśvata anapāyisneho bhavati
snehāt sukheṣu tṛṣyati tṛṣṇāvān bhavati, tṛṣṇā ca sukhasādhanatvenādhyavasitānā vastūnā doṣānaśucitvādīn tiraskurute pracchādayati
doṣatiraskaraṇāt guṇadarśī śucitveṣṭatvaguṇān paśyan paritṛṣyan mameti mameda sukhamiti garddhamāna tasya sukhasya sādhanāni garbhagamanādīnyupādatte
tena ātmadarśanamūlatvena janmāderātmābhiniveśo yāvattāvat sa ātmadarśī sasāra eva
na kevala janmaprabandhastasya doṣā api samastā santītyāha
ātmani sati tato'nyasmin parasajñā parabuddhirbhavati, svaparayoryathākrama parigraho'bhiṣvaṅga dveṣa parityāga tau bhavata
anayo anunayapratiṣedhayo sapratibaddhā sarve doṣā rāgamātsaryerṣyādaya prajāyante
ya paśyatyātmānaṃ tasyātmani bhavati –siddhivi॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 55 B.
guṇadarśī paritṛṣyan mameti sukhasādhanānyupādatte | tenātmabhiniveśo yāvattāvat sa saṃsāraḥ
ātmani sati parasaṃjñā svaparavibhāgāt parigrahadveṣau | anayoḥ sampratibaddhāḥ sarve doṣāḥ prajāyante

tato muktimicchatā svarūpaṃ putrakalatrādikañca anātmakamanityamaśuci duḥkhamiti śrutamayyā cintāmayyā ca bhāvanayā bhāvayitavyam, evaṃ bhāvayataḥ tatra abhiṣvaṅgābhāvāt abhyāsaviśeṣato vairāgyamupajāyate, ataḥ sāsravacittasantānalakṣaṇasaṃsāranivṛttirūpā muktirupapadyate
niranvayavinaśvareṣu hi cittakṣaṇeṣu ekatvādhyāropeṇa ātmābhiniveśāt ātmapremānugataḥ prāṇyabhidhānaḥ skandhasantānaḥ sāṃsārikasukhasādhaneṣu pravarttamānaḥ sāsravacittasantānaṃ santanoti
tato'sya vyalīkābhiniveśasya apohārthaṃ yatnaḥ nairātmyābhyāsādilakṣaṇa asatyapi ātmani nityaniraṃśādisvabhāve moktari iti

tatra śrutamayī śrūyamāṇebhya pararthānumānavākyebhyaḥ samutpadyamānena śrutaśabdavācyatāmāskandatā nirvṛttā paraṃ prakarṣaṃ pratipadyamānā svārthānumānalakṣaṇayā cintayā nirvṛttā cintamayī bhāvanāmārabhate
kiṃ punarida nairātmya nāma yadasatsu nopadeṣṭavya satsu copadeṣṭavyamityāha–advitīya śivadvāra kudṛṣṭīnā bhayaṅkaram
tatra pudgalo nāma ya skandhānupādāya prajñapyate
sa ca skandheṣu pañcadhā mṛgyamāṇo na saṃbhavati

dharmāstu skandhāyatanadhātusaśabditā padārthā tadeteṣā dharmāṇā pudgalasya ca yathāsva hetupratyayādhīnajanmatvādupādāya prajñapyamānatvācca svāyattamaparātta nijamakṛtaka rūpa nāstīti pudgalasya dharmāṇāñca nai svābhāvya vyavasthāpyate
yasya cārthasya svarūpasiddhirnāsti tasya kenānyenātmanāstu siddhiriti
tasmātsarvathā'siddhalakṣaṇā eva padārthā mūrkhajanasya visavādakenātmana pratītya bopādāya vā varttamānā mūḍhadhiyā saṅgāspada bhavanti
yathāsvabhāvaṃ tu samyagdarśanai pratibhāvyamānā dharmapudlayo saṅgaparikṣayabāhakā bhavanti
viditanairātmyasya hi sarveṣu parikṣīṇasaṅgasya na kvacitkācitprārthanā kuto vā nimittopalambha ityadvitīyameva śivadvārametannairātmyam
pṛ॰ 151 tattvato nairātmyamiti yasyaiva vartate mati
yatastato vāstu bhaya yadyaha nāma kiṃcana
ahameva na kiñciccet bhayaṃ kasya bhaviṣyati
vara nairātmyabhāvanā nairātmyasya pudgalādivirahasya bhāvanā abhyāsaḥ varamuttamam, ātmadarśanapravṛttāhaṅkāranivṛttihetutvāt
tathāhi tāvad bhāvanāprakarṣaparyantagamanāt sākṣānnairātmyadarśanāt virodhina satkāyadarśana nivartate
tannivṛttau caikasyānugāmino darśanābhāvāt pūrvāpararūpavikalasya kṣaṇamātrasya darśanam
tata pūrvāparasamāropābhāvānnānāgatasukhasādhana kiṃcidātmana paśyati, tato na tasya kvacidviṣaye rāgo jāyate nāpi tatprativirodhini dveṣa āsaṅgābhāvādeva
nāpyapakāriṇa prati apakārasthāna paśyati, yena yasmin kṛto- 'pakāra tayordvayorapi dvitīyakṣaṇābhāvat
na cānyena kṛte'pakāre prekṣāvato'nyatra vairaniryātanamucitam, nāpi yasya kṛtastenāpi
eva rāgādinivṛttau anyepi tatprabhavā kleśopakleśā notpadyante
eva hi pudgalaśūnyatāyā satkāyadarśananivṛttau chinnamūlatvāt kleśā na samudācaranti
yathoktamāryatathāgataguhyasūtre–tadyathāpi nāma śāntamate vṛkṣasya mūlacchinnasya sarvaśākhāpatrapalāśa śuṣyati
mithyādhyāropasya sasāritvādhyavasāyasya hānārtha yatno'satyapi kasmiṃścidātmādau moktari
na hi yathāvastveva vyavahāraḥ kintu yathāvasāyañca
nairātmyābhyāsādilakṣaṇayatnābhāve tu ātmābhiniveśā'nivṛtteḥ indriyādiṣu upabhogāśrayatvena gṛhīteṣu ātmīyabuddhernivārayitumaśakyatvato vairāgyāsabhavāt mokṣāya datto jalāñjaliḥ
uyabhogāśrayatvena ātmīyabuddhihānyā tatrāhidaṣṭāṅge tyāgo na tu viparyaye ātmīyabuddhisattāyām
yasmād upabhogasya āśrayatvena kāraṇatvena gṛhīteṣvindriyādiṣu svatve dhī ātmīyatvabuddhi kena hetunā vāryeta ? ka kenacit
tatkutastatra upabhogasādhane svīyāvavave vairāgya yena tyajyate
na caiva snehādiṣvātmīyabuddhihānirasti yenaiṣā tyāga syāt
svatvadhīḥ kena vāryeta vairāgya tatra tatkutaḥ

athocyate–nendriyādiṣu upabhogāśrayatvabuddhinibandhanasvatvabuddhiprabhavo'yam ātmīyasnehaḥ yenāya doṣaḥ syāt kintu guṇadarśananibandhanaḥ, ataḥ tadviruddhadoṣadarśane tannivṛttito vairāgyopapatteḥ muktirupapanneti, tadayuktam, tannibandhanasvatvabuddhereva asyāvirbhāvāt, svacakṣurādiṣu guṇadoṣaparīkṣāvikalānāmapi bālapaśuprabhṛtīnām upabhogāśrayatvabuddhinibandhanāyāḥ svatvabuddheḥ tatra snehasyāvirbhāvāt
ātmīyeṣvapi ca piccaṭakāṇakuṇṭādidoṣadarśane'pi asya bhāvāt, parakīyeṣu guṇadarśane'pyabhāvāt
ātmīyeṣvapi atīteṣu svadehacyuteṣu ca aṅgāvayaveṣu guṇadarśane'pi ātmīyabuddhityāge snehasyābhāvāt tannibandhanasvatvabuddhiprabhava evāsau abhyupagantavyaḥ
atha tadbhāvanābhāve'pi kāyakleśalakṣaṇāttapasaḥ sakalakarmaprakṣayānmokṣo bhaviṣyati; tanna; kāyakleśasya karmaphalatayā nārakādikāyasantāpavat tapastvāyogāt
vicitraśaktikañca karma vicitraphaladānā'nyathānupapatteḥ, tacca kathaṃ kāyasantāpamātrāt kṣīyeta atiprasaṅgāt

atha tapaḥ karmaśaktīnāṃ saṅkareṇa kṣayakaraṇaśīlamiti kṛtvā ekarūpādapi tapasaḥ citraśaktikasya karmaṇaḥ kṣayaḥ; nanvevaṃ svalpakleśena ekopavāsādinā'pi aśeṣasya karmaṇaḥ kṣayāpattiḥ śaktisāṅkaryānyathānupapatteḥ

–karmaṇāṃ phalavaicitryasya nānāgatyupabhogyānekavidhopakaraṇasādhyavividhasukhaduḥkhopabhogaprakārasya dṛṣṭeśca śaktibhedaḥ sāmarthyanānātvamanumīyate, ato nānāprakāraphalajananasāmarthyāt kāraṇādekarūpāt phalāt tāpasaṃkleśānna karmaṇāṃ kṣayaḥ
–athāpi tapasaḥ śaktyā śaktisaṃkareṇa tāpakleśamātraphalena tāni hīyante
yacca kiñcidaviśiṣṭaṃ tat kleśātkutaścit keśolluñcanādeḥ kṣīyate
yadi tapasā karmakṣayo'śeṣaṃ karma hīyeta, akleśato vinaiva keśolluñcanādiduḥkhāt karmaṇaḥ kṣīṇatvāt
yathā nārakādiduḥkhaṃ na bhavati tathā alpīyopi na syāt
śaktisāṃkaryepi leśataḥ santāpakleśāt kevalāt karma hīyeta, na duḥkhāntarānubandhī saṃsāraprabandhaḥ tapasvinaḥ syāt
yadīṣṭamaparaṃ kleśāt tattapaḥ kleśa eva cet
tapasaḥ śaktyā śaktisaṃkarasaṃkṣayaśca tadā vaktuṃ śakyo yadi kleśādiṣṭaṃ kleśādaparamanyattapo nānyathā
kleśa eva cettatapaḥ, tatkleśarūpaṃ tapaḥ karmaphalamityasmāt karmaphalabhūtāttapasaḥ śaktisaṃkarādikaṃ na yuktam
karmakṣayādvimokṣaḥ sa ca tapasaḥ tacca kāyasantāpaḥ
yattāvaduktam–kāryakāraṇa ityādi; tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam; kāryakāraṇabhūtajñānakṣaṇapravāhavyatiriktasya ātmanaḥ santānaniṣedhāvasare vyāsataḥ samarthitatvāt

yatpunaruktam–yaḥ paśyatyātmānaṃ sthirādirūpam ityādi; tatsūktameva; kintu location unknown ajño janaḥ duḥkhānanuṣaktasukhasādhanamapaśyan ātmasnehāt sāṃsārikeṣu duḥkhānuṣaktasukhasādhaneṣu pravarttate
hitāhitavivekajñastu tādātvikasukhasādhana stryādikaṃ parityajya ātmasnehāt ātyantikasukhasādhane muktimārge pravarttate
yathā pathyāpathyavivekamajānannāturaḥ tādātvikasukhasādhana vyādhivivṛddhinimittaṃ dadhyādikamupādatte, pathyāpathyavivekajñastu tatparityajya peyādau ārogyasādhane pravarttate
tulanā–tatsūktameva, kintvajño jano duḥkhānuṣaktaṃ sukhasādhanaṃ paśyannātmasnehāt sāṃsārikeṣu duḥkhānuṣaktasukhasādhaneṣu pravartate apathyādau ca mūrkhāturavat

yadapyuktam–tato muktimicchatā svarūpaṃ putrakalatrādikañca ityādi; tadapyetena pratyuktam; sarvathā'nityā'nātmakatvādibhāvanāyā nirviṣayatvena mithyārūpatvāt sarvathā nityādibhāvanāvanmuktihetutvānupapatteḥ
tannivirviṣayatvañca ātmasiddheḥ kṣaṇabhaṅgabhaṅgasya ca prasādhitatvāt prasiddham
na ca kālāntarāvasthāyyekānusandhātṛvyatirekeṇa bhāvanāpyupapadyate ityuktaṃ santānaniṣedhapraghaṭṭake

yo hi nigaḍādibhirbaddhaḥ tasyaiva tanmuktikāraṇaparijñānānuṣṭhānābhisandhivyāpāre sati mokṣaḥ iti ekādhikaraṇye satyeva bandhamokṣavyavasthā loke prasiddhā, iha tu anyaḥ kṣaṇo baddhaḥ anyasya ca tanmuktikāraṇaparijñānam anyasya ca anuṣṭhānābhisandhiḥ vyāpāraśceti vaiyadhikaraṇyāt sarvamanupapannam
tulanā–kṣaṇikādibhāvanāyā mithyārūpatvāt, naca mithyājñānasya ni śreyasakāraṇatvamatiprasaṅgāt
bhāvanāyā vikalpātmikāyā śrutamayyāścintāmayyāścāvastuviṣayāyā vastuviṣayasya yogijñānasya janmavirodhāt
na bandhamokṣau kṣaṇikaikasasthau–kṣaṇikameka yaccitta tatsasthau bandhamokṣau na syātām
yasyaiva bandha tasyaiva mokṣa iti ekacittasasthau bandhamokṣau –yuktyanu॰, ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 41
kiñca, sarvo buddhipūrva pravarttamānaḥ kiñcididamato mama syāt ityanusandhānena pravarttate

iha ca kastathāvidho mārgābhyāse pravarttamānaḥ mokṣo mama syāt ityanusandadhyāt–kṣaṇaḥ, santāno vā ? na tāvat kṣaṇaḥ, tasya ekakṣaṇasthāyitayā nirvikalpakatayā ca etāvato vyāpārān karttumasamarthatvāt
nāpi santānaḥ, tasya santānivyatiriktasya saugatairanabhyupagamāt, santānaniṣedhe niṣiddhatvācca
tulanā– kiṃca, sarvo buddhipūrvaṃ prayatamāna kiṃcididamato mama syādityanusandhānena pravartate
yaccānyaduktam–niranvayavinaśvareṣu ityādi, tadapyuktimātram, ātmano'na bhyupagame tathābhūtacittakṣaṇeṣu ekatvādhyāropānupapatteḥ
niranvayavinaśvaratve ca saṃskārāṇāṃ mokṣārthaḥ prayāso vyartha
rāgādyuparamo hi bhavanmate mokṣaḥ, taduparamaśca vināśaḥ, tasya ca nirhetukatayā ayatnasiddhatvāt tadarthānuṣṭhānādiprayāso niṣphala eva

tena hi prāktanasya rāgādicittakṣaṇasya nāśaḥ kriyeta, bhāvino vā'nutpādaḥ, tadutpādakaśaktervā kṣayaḥ, santānasya vocchedaḥ anutpādo vā, nirāśrasravacittasantatyutpādo vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'nupapannaḥ; vināśasya nirhetukatayā bhavanmate kutaścidutpattivirodhāt

dvitīyapakṣo'pyata eva anupapannaḥ; utpādābhāvo hi anutpādaḥ, so'bhāvarūpatvāt kathaṃ kutaścidutpadyeta apasiddhāntaprasaṅgāt ? tacchaktikṣayārtho'pi tatprayāso'saṅgataḥ; tatkṣayasyāpyabhāvarūpatayā kutaścidātmalābhāsaṃbhavāt
santānasyocchedārtho'nutpādārtho vā tatprayāsaḥ ityapyetena pratyuktam; kṣaṇocchedānutpādavat taducchedānutpādayorabhāvarūpatayā kutaścidutpattyanupapatteḥ
ākasmike'rthe pralayasvabhāve mārgo na yukto badhakaśca na syāt
– tathā ca sakalāsravanirodhalakṣaṇamokṣasya cittasantatināśarūpasya vā śāntanirvāṇasya mārgo hetu nairātmyabhāvanālakṣaṇo na yukta syāt nāśakasya kasyacidvirodhāt

kiṃca, tena mokṣārthānuṣṭhānena prāktanasya rāgādikṣaṇasya nāśa kriyate, bhāvino vā'nutpāda, tadutpādakaśaktervā kṣaya, santānasyocchedo'nutpādo vā, nirāśrayacittasantatyutpādo vā ? –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
kutaścidātmalābhāsaṃbhavāta santānasyocchedārtho'nutpādārthoṃ vā tatprayāso yukto na cāsau ba॰
kiñca, siddhe vāstave santāne taducchedārtho'nutpādārtho vā tatprayāso yuktaḥ; na cāsau tathābhūtaḥ siddhaḥ, kṣaṇātiriktasya tasya vāstavasya bhavatānabhyupagamāt, santānaniṣedhe niṣiddhatvācca
tulanā–kiṃca vāstavasya santānasyānabhyupagamāt kiṃ taducchedādiprayāsena ? nahi mṛtasya māraṇa kvāpi dṛṣṭam
tacca kuto na karoti sattvāt tadutpāde śaktatvācca ? śaktamapi sahakārikāraṇābhāvāt notpādayati, ityapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tadabhāvasya apratibandhakatvāt

tena hi pratibandho bhāvasyotpatteḥ, utpādakatvasya vā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ, śākyapakṣe hi kāraṇāntarābhāvaḥ abhāvarūpatayā sakalaśaktivirahasvabhāvo bhāvasya notpattipratibandhaṃ karttumarhati
yat sakalaśaktivirahasvabhāvaṃ na tat kasyacidutpattipratibandhakam yathā śaśaviṣāṇam, tathābhūtaśca śākyamate sahakārikāraṇābhāva iti
dvitīyavikalpo'pyetena prativyūḍhaḥ; utpādakatvasya hi pratibandhaḥ kāryotpādakapadārthasattā'pahāraḥ, sa ca aśvaviṣāṇaprakhye tadabhāve durghaṭaḥ
vyutpādakasya hi śra॰, utpādakatve hi ba॰
kiñca, antyacittakṣaṇasya anarthakriyākāritve avastutvaṃ syāt, tataḥ tajjanakasya iti, evamāyātamaśeṣasya cittasantānasya avastutvam

atha svasantānavartino jñānakṣaṇasya ajanakatve'pi santānāntaravartino yogijñānasya jananāt nā'śeṣasya tatsantānasyā'vastutvam; tadayuktam; rasāderekakālasya rūpādeḥ avyabhicāryanumānā'bhāvānuṣaṅgāt, antyakṣaṇavat rūpādervijātīyakāryajanakatve'pi sajātīyājanakatvasaṃbhavāt
ekasāmagryadhīnatvena rūparasayorniyamena kāryadvayārambhakatve anyatrāpi kāryadvayārambhakatva syāt, yogijñāna-antyakṣaṇayorapi ekasāmagryadhīnatvā'viśeṣāt
atha svasantānavarttikāryajananasāmarthyavad bhinnasantānakāryajananasāmarthyam antyakṣaṇasya neṣyate, tarhi sarvathā arthakriyāsāmarthyarahitatvena asya ākāśakuśeśayavadavastutvaṃ syāt
tathāvidhasyāpi vastutve sarvathā'rthakriyārahitasya akṣaṇikasyāpi vastutvaṃ syāt, tathā ca sattvādayaḥ kṣaṇikatvanna sādhayeyu anaikāntikatvāt
tanna santānocchedalakṣaṇā muktiḥ tatkāraṇānuṣṭhānaprayāsena prasādhyā iti pakṣaḥ kṣemaṅkaraḥ
vidyudāde sajātīyākaraṇe'pi yogijñānasya karaṇānnāvastutvamiti cet, na, āsvādyamānarasasamānakālarūpopādānasya rūpākaraṇe'pi rasasahakāritvaprasaṅgāt, tato rasādrūpānumāna na syāt
yadā hi kaciśtsarvajño yogī tam antyakṣaṇa jānāti tadā so'ntya kṣaṇa yogijñānasya sahakāritayā samutpādako bhavati nākāraṇa viṣaya iti siddhāntāt
ata sajātīyakṣaṇānutpādako'pi antyakṣaṇa yogijñānasya sahakāritayā janakatvāt arthakriyākārī bhavatyeva
bauddhamate hi dvitīyakṣaṇavartino rasasya prathamakṣaṇavartī rasa upādānam prathamakṣaṇavartirūpañca sahakāri bhavati
prathamakṣaṇavartirūpa hi sajātīya dvitīyakṣaṇavartina rūpa janayitvaiva vijātīye dvitīyakṣaṇavartirase sahakāri bhavati

yadi hi antyo jñānakṣaṇa sajātīya jñānakṣaṇāntaramanutpādyāpi vijātīye santānāntaravartini yogijñāne ālambanatayā sahakāri syāt tadā pūrvakṣaṇavartirūpamapi dvitīyakṣaṇavartisajātīya rūpakṣaṇāntaramajanayitvaiva vijātīye dvitīyakṣaṇavartini rase sahakāri syāt
tathā ca dvitīyakṣaṇavartirasāt rūpānumānaṃ na syāt iti bhāva
nirāśrasravacittasantatyutpattilakṣaṇā sā tatprayāsaprasādhyā iti pakṣastu jyāyān
kevala sā cittasantatiḥ sānvayā, niranvayā vā iti vaktavyam ? tatra asyāḥ sānvaya pakṣa eva yuktaḥ; tathābhūte eva cittasantāne mokṣopapatteḥ, baddho hi mucyate nā'baddhaḥ
na ca niranvaye cittasantāne baddhasya muktiḥ saṃbhavati, tatra hi anyo baddhaḥ anyaśca mucyate

santānaikyād baddhasyaiva muktiratrāpi iti cet; nanu santānārthaḥ paramārthasan, saṃvṛtisan vā syāt ? yadi paramārthasan, tadā ātmaiva nāmāntareṇa uktaḥ syāt ? atha saṃvṛtisan; tadā ekasya paramārthasato'sattvād anyo baddhaḥ anyaśca mucyate ityāyātam, tathā ca baddhasya muktyarthaṃ pravṛttirna syāt
kevala sā cittasantati sānvayā niranvayā veti vakttavyam
ādye siddhasādhana tathābhūta eva cittasantāne mokṣopapatte
yadi santānārtha paramārthasastadā ātmaiva santānaśabdenokta syāt
atha saṃvṛtisan, tadā ekasya paramārthasato'sattvādanyo baddho'nyaśca mucyata iti baddhasya muktyarthaṃ na pravṛtti syāt
atha atyantanānātve'pi kṣaṇānāṃ dṛḍhatararūpatayā ekatvādhyavasāyāt baddhamātmānaṃ mocayiṣyāmi ityabhisandhāya pravarttate; kathamevaṃ nairātmyadarśanam ? yatastadbhāvanābhyāsānmuktiḥ syāt
atha śāstrasaṃskāraprabhavaṃ taddarśanamasti; na tarhi ekatvādhyavasāyaḥ assakhaladrūpaḥ, ityekaṃ sandhitsoranyatpracyavate
ataḥ kuto baddhasya muktyarthaṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt yato mithyādhyāropahānārthaṃ yatno'satyapi moktari pramāṇavā॰ 1
tarhi na nairātmyadarśanamiti kutastannibandhanā mukti ? –sanmati॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 162
nairātmyabhāvanāyāmaskhaladrūpāyā hi baddhameva ātmāna mocayiṣyāmi ityekatvādhyavasāyasya saṃbhāvanaiva nāsti
yatpunaruktam–upabhogāśrayatvena ityādi; tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam; heyopādeyattvajño hi ātyantikasukhasādhanam upabhogāśrayamātmīyañcābhimanyate na tādātvikasukhasādhanam; tathāhi–
śeṣā me bāhyā bhāvā sarve sayogalakṣaṇā
sesā me bāhirā bhāvā savve saṃjogalakkhaṇā
dārā paribhavakārāḥ bandhujano bandhana viṣa viṣayāḥ
kāya ko'ya janasya moha ye ripavasteṣu muhṛdāśāsuhṛdāśā

ityeva bhāvayato vivekinaḥ saṃyogasambandhiṣu duḥkhahetuṣu bhāveṣu sukhaleśasādhanatvasya sadbhāve'pi anyadā ātyantikasukhasādhanaṃ ratnatrayaṃ paśyataḥ kutasteṣu ātmīyabuddhiḥ yatastato nivṛttirna syāt ? nanu ātmīyabuddheḥ tataḥ syānnivṛttiḥ yadi ekāntena teṣāṃ duḥkhahetutvameva syāt, na caivam, leśataḥ sukhahetutvasyāpyatra saṃbhavāt, tena duḥkhahetutve'pi ātmīyasnehāt yenākāreṇa sukhahetutā tāvatāṃśena svasyopakārakān indriyādīn manyamānaḥ teṣu nātmīyabuddhiṃ jahātīti, tadapyasāmpratam; teṣāṃ sukhaleśasādhanatve'pi anyasya ātyantikasukhasādhanasya sadbhāvena nirviṣānnasya sadbhāvena saviṣānnasyeva tyāgasaṃbhavāt
tulanā–tatra prathama tāvat trīṇi ratnāni tadyathā–buddho dharma saghaśceti
yadapyabhihitam–piccaṭakāṇakuṇṭādidoṣadarśane'pi ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram; yato na saurūpyādiguṇadarśanāt sneho bhavatītyasmābhiriṣyate, kintu upabhogāśrayatvākhyaguṇadarśanāt

vivekinaśca sayogasambandhiṣu bhāveṣu jātijarāmaraṇaprabandhalakṣaṇasaṃsāraduḥkhahetutvākhyam ātyantikadoṣaṃ paśyato na upabhogāśrayatvākhyasya guṇasya darśanamastīti tannibandhanasnehasya vyāvṛtte kathaṃ doṣadarśanaṃ snehasya bādhakanna syāt

nanu taddoṣaṃ paśyato yadyapi tatkāle'nurāgiṇī matiścalitā, tathāpi tatrāsau naiva atyantaṃ virakto draṣṭavyaḥ, punastadguṇaledarśanādanurāgasaṃbhavāt; ityapyasundaram, ajño hi tādātvikaduḥkhahetutvākhyasya tādātvikadoṣasya darśanād viraktaḥ tādātvikasukhahetutvākhyasya tādātvikaguṇasya darśanāt punaranurajyate iti yuktam, heyopādeyatattvajñastu jātijarāmaraṇaprabandhalakṣaṇaduḥkhahetutvākhyasya ātyantikadoṣasya darśanādvirakto na tādātvikasukhahetutvākhyasya tādātvikaguṇasya darśanāt punaranurajyate, kintu ātyantikasukhahetutvākhyaguṇadarśanāt
na ca saṃyogasambandhiṣu taddarśanamasti iti sākalyenāsau tatra upekṣālakṣaṇaṃ vairāgyamātmasātkaroti

nanu yadi tatprabandhalakṣaṇaduḥkhahetutvena tatrāsau virajyate tadā ātmanyapi virajyatām tathāvidhaduḥkhahetutvasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt, tatrāvirāge vā anyatrāpi na virajyeta viśeṣābhāvāditi, atra ajñamātmānabhipretya evamucyate, tadviparītaṃ vā ? yadi ajñam; tadā siddhasādhanam, heyopādeyatattvajñānarahite tathāvidhaduḥkhahetau ātmani vairāgyā'bhyupagamāt
tulanā–yādṛśo dukhahetu stādṛśo heya eva, sopādhiśca tathā
yaccoktam–kāyakleśasya karmaphalatvāt ityādi, tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; hiṃsādiviratilakṣaṇavṛtopabṛṃhakasya kāyakleśasya karmaphalatve'pi tapastvāvirodhāt
na caivaṃ nārakādikāyakleśasyāpi tapastvānuṣaṅgaḥ, tasya hiṃsādyāveśapradhānatayā tadavirodhitvāsaṃbhavāt
ataḥ kathaṃ prekṣāvatāṃ tena samānatā mumukṣukāyakleśasya āpādayituṃ yuktā ?

yadapi śaktisaṅkarapakṣe svalpenaiva ityādyuktam, tatsūktam; vicitraphaladānasamarthānāṃ karmaṇāṃ śaktisaṅkare sati kṣīṇamohāntyasamaye ayogicaramasamaye ca akleśataḥ svalpenaiva paramaśukladhyānarūpeṇa tapasā prakṣayābhyupagamāt, jīvanmukteḥ paramamukteścānyathānupapatteḥ
sa tu tacchaktisaṅkaraḥ bahutarakleśasādhyaḥ iti yuktaḥ tadartho'nekavidhopavāsādiduścarakāyakleśādyanuṣṭhānaprayāsaḥ, tamantareṇa tatsaṅkarā'prasiddheḥ
vicitraphaladānasamarthānāṃ karmaṇā śaktisakare sati –ṣaḍda॰ bṛha॰ ślo॰ 52
nanu anavacchinno jñānasantānaḥ ityayuktam, suṣuptādyavasthāyāmapi tadavacchedapratīteḥ
kiñcidapi aparicchindanneva hi suṣuptaḥ ityucyate, tatra jñānasadbhāve tadaparicchedānupapatteḥ
yadi ca tatra jñānasadbhāvaḥ syāt tadā jāgratsuṣuptāvasthayorbhedo na syāt, ubhayatra svaparāvabhāsijñānasadbhāvā'viśeṣāt

tatra tatsadbhāve'pi nidrayā'bhibhavāt, jāgradavasthāyāñca tadabhāvāt nānayoraviśeṣa iti cet, nanu ko'yaṃ tayā jñānasyā'mibhavo nāma–nāśaḥ, tirobhāvo vā ? yadi nāśaḥ, kathaṃ tatra tatsadbhāvaḥ tasya tadvirodhitvāt
ataḥ suṣuptādyavasthāyām upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptasya jñānasyānupalabdheḥ abhāva eva jyāyāniti
suṣuptikāle tvaca tyaktvā purītati vartamānena manasā jñānājananamiti
suṣuptāvasthāyā jñānasadbhāve jāgradabasthāto na viśeṣa syāt, ubhayatrāpi svasavedyajñānasya sadbhāvāviśeṣāt
suṣuptau nidrayābhibhūtatva viśeṣa iti cet, asadetat, taddharmatayā tasyāpi tādātmyena abhibhāvakatvāsaṃbhavāt
vyatireke tu rūpādipadārthānāmeva sattvāt tatsvarūpa nirūpyam
abhivaśca yadi vināśa, na vijñānasya sattva vināśasya vā nirhetukatvam
atha tirobhāva, na; vijñānasya sattvena tatsattaiva savedanamityabhyupagame tasyānupapatte
yattāvaduktam–kiñcidapyaparicchindanneva hi ityādi, tadasamīcīnam, suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ svāpādisaṃvedanasya tatsukhasaṃvedanasya ca sadbhāvāt

tatra hi jñānānabhyupagame sukhamahamasvāpsam iti suptotthitasya svāpasukhasmaraṇasya etāvatkālaṃ nirantaraṃ supto'ham etāvatkālañca sāntaram iti svāpasmaraṇasya cābhāvānuṣaṅgāt, tasya jñātavastuviṣayatvena svaviṣayajñānāntarāvinābhāvitvāt
yat smaraṇaṃ tat svaviṣayajñānāntarāvinābhāvi yathā ghaṭādismaraṇam, smaraṇañca suptosthitasya svāpasukhādisaṃvedanamiti

asya svaviṣayajñānāntaramantareṇāpyāvirbhāve ghaṭādismaraṇasyāpi tadantareṇāvirbhāvaḥ syāt, ataḥ kutastadanubhavādirapi siddhyet ? tataḥ suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ yenānubhavena svāpasukhādismaraṇamāvirbhāvyate sa tadviṣayo'bhyupagantavyaḥ
tataśca suṣuptāvanubhūta ānanda ātmā bhāvarūpājñānañceti trayamapyutthitena parāmṛśyate sukhamahamasvāpsa na kiñcidavediṣamiti

etena mattamūrcchitādyavasthāyāmapi jñānasadbhāvaḥ prasādhitaḥ, tadavasthāyāḥ pracyutasya tadā mayā na kiñcidanubhūtam iti smaraṇanibandhanena yenānubhavena satā ātmā nikhilānubhavavikalo'nubhūyate tasyāmavasthāyāṃ so'nubhavo'bhyupagantavya, tamantareṇa tatsmaraṇānupapatteḥ
naca suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ svāpasukhasya tatsavedanasya vā idamittham iti nirūpaṇābhāvādabhāvaḥ ityabhidhātavyam; tadaharjātabālakasya mukhaprakṣiptastanyajanitasukhena tatsaṃvedanena cā'nekantāt
na khalu tattena idamittham iti nirūpyate, atha ca asti
naca duḥkhābhāvāt sukhaśabdaprayogo'tra gauṇaḥ, abhāvasya pratiyogibhāvāntarasvabhāvatayā abhāvavicārāvasare vyavasthāpitatvāt
tulanā–suptamūrcchādyavasthāsu ceto neti ca te kuta
na vedmi cittamityeva sati siddhā sacittatā
yadi ca tāsu mūrcchādyavasthāsu na vedmyaha cittamityeva niścaya pravarttate bhavata, tadā tenaiva tathā pravṛttena niścayena sacittatā siddhā
mṛti syāttatra cautpattau maraṇābhāva eva vā
nanu suṣuptā– śra॰, na ca suptā– ā॰
–yadi hyanubhūta ityetāvanmātreṇaiva smaraṇa syātsyādetat, yāvatā satyapyanubhave pāṭavābhyāsārthitvādivaikalyāt smaraṇa na bhavati, yathā sadyojātādyavasthāyāmanubhūtasyāpi cittasya
pratiyogina sakāśāt yadbhinnaṃ bhāvāntara bhūtalādi tatsvabhāvatayā
yadapyuktam–tatra jñānasadbhāve ityādi; tadapyasamīkṣitābhidhānam; tatra jñānasadbhāve'pi jāgratsuṣuptāvasthayorbhedopapatteḥ
yatra hi anabhibhūtaṃ bāhyādhyātmikā'rthavicāracaturaṃ jñānaṃ sā jāgradavasthā, yatra tu nidrādyabhibhavavaśāttadviparītaṃ sā suṣuptādyavasthā
middhādisāmagrīviśeṣād, viśiṣṭaṃ suṣuptādyavasthāyā gacchattṛṇasparśajñānatulya bāhyādhyātmikapadārthānekadharmagrahaṇavimukha jñānamasti anyathā jāgratprabuddhajñānapravāhayorapyabhāvaprasaktiriti
yadapi–ko'yaṃ nidrādinā jñānasyābhibhavaḥ ityādyuktam; tatrāsya tadvaśād bāhyādhyātmikārthavicāravidhuratvamevā'bhibhavaḥ
svaparaprakāśasvabhāvatvāttasya kathaṃ tadvidhuratvam ? ityapyanupapannam; gacchattṛṇasparśasaṃvedanena vyabhicārāt, tasya tatsvabhāvatve'pi tannirūpaṇāsāmarthyapratīteḥ
nahi tatsvabhāvatvamātreṇaiva jñānasya tannirūpaṇasāmarthyam; sarvatrā'nabhibhūtasyaivāsya tannirūpaṇasāmarthyasaṃbhavāt
yathā ca gacchattṛṇasparśasaṃvedanam anyamanaskatayā'bhibhūtam tathā svapnādisaṃvedanaṃ nidrādinā iti yuktamutpaśyāmaḥ
kathañcaivaṃvādino maṇimantrādinā agnyādeḥ śarāvādinā ca pradīpādeḥ pratibandhaḥ siddhyet ? nahi tena tasya nāśaḥ pratibandhaḥ saṃbhavati; pratyakṣavirodhāt
tulanā–maṇimantrādinā agnyādipratibandhe śarāvādinā pradīpādipratibandhe'pi ca samānatvāt

kiñca, suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ jñānābhāvaṃ sa evātmā pratipadyate, pārśvastho vā ? yadi sa eva; kiṃ tata eva jñānāt, tadabhāvāt, tadanupalambhāt, jāgratprabodhadaśābhāvijñānāntarādvā ? na tāvattata eva; asyā'sattvāt
yadasanna tat kasyacitpratipattihetuḥ yathā bandhyāstandhayaḥ, asacca suṣuptādyavasthāyāmabhipretaṃ bhavadbhiḥ jñānamiti
nāpi tadabhāvāt, paricchedakatvasya jñānadharmatayā tadabhāve saṃbhavābhāvāt, anyathā jñānasyaiva abhāva iti nāmakṛtaṃ syāt
nathāhi–na tāvatsupta eva tadavasthāyā vijñānābhāva vetti, tadā vijñānānabhyupagamāt
tadavagame ca tasyaiva jñānatvāt na tadavasthāyā tadabhāva
nāpi pārśvasthito'nyastadabhāva vetti, kāraṇavyāpakasvabhāvānupalabdhīnā viruddhavidhervā'tra viṣaye'vyāpārāt, anyasya tadabhāvāvabhāsakatvāyogāt
tadanupalambhato'pi tatkālabhāvinaḥ, anyakālabhāvino vā tatra tadabhāvapratipattiḥ syāt ? prathamapakṣe kathaṃ tatra sarvathā jñānābhāvaḥ ? tadabhāvagrāhiṇo'nupalambhajñānasya tatra vidyamānatvāt
anupalambhaśca upalambhābhāvaḥ, abhāvaśca āśrayagrahaṇa-pratiyogismaraṇasāpekṣaḥ grahītuṃ śakyaḥ, tatparatantratayā tadgrahaṇasmaraṇābhāve grahītumaśakyatvāt

ataḥ anupalambhaṃ tatrecchatā tadāśrayatayā tatra prathamamātmā paricchettavyaḥ pratiyogī ca smarttavyaḥ, ataḥ kathaṃ suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ sarvathā jñānābhāvaḥ siddhyet ? tanna anupalambhato'pi tatra tadabhāvasiddhiḥ
āśrayabhūtasya ātmano jñānamatha ca jñānābhāvasya pratiyogino jñānasya smaraṇamastyeveti bhāvaḥ
nāpi jāgratprabodhadaśābhāvijñānāntarāt, tadapekṣayā suṣuptādijñānasya upalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptatvāsaṃbhavāt, taddaśābhāvinaḥ tadabhāvagrāhiṇaḥ kasyacijjñānāntarasyā'pratīteśca
nirbharasuptena mayā na kiñcijjñātam iti prabodhadaśābhāvijñānaṃ tadabhāvagrāhakatvena pratīyate eva, ityapyapeśalam; etasmāt tadā tatsadbhāvasyaiva pratīte
smṛtirūpaṃ hi idam, smṛtiśca taddaśāyāṃ tadabhāvagrāhijñānāntaramantareṇa nopapadyate ityuktamanantarameva, tanna suṣuptādyavasthāyāṃ sa evātmā jñānābhāvaṃ pratipattu samarthaḥ
nirbharasvapnena mayā na ki– ba॰, ā॰
nāpi pārśvasthaḥ; kāraṇasvabhāvavyāpakānupalabdheḥ viruddhavidhervā tadabhāvā'vinābhāvino liṅgasya atrāsaṃbhavāt

na ca tatra tatsadbhāvā'vinābhāvino'pyasyā'saṃbhavaḥ samāna ityabhidhātavyam, svātmani tadavinābhāvitvenā'vadhāritasya prāṇāpānaśarīroṣṇatākāraviśeṣādeḥ tatsadbhāvā'vinābhāvino liṅgasya atropalabdheḥ, jāgraddaśāyāmapi anyacetovṛtte tadvyatirekeṇa anyato'pratipatteḥ
