tulanā–svātmani svasaviditavijñānāvinābhūtatvena niścitasya prāṇāpānaśarīroṣṇatākāraviśeṣāde tadavasthāyāmupalabhyamānaliṅgasya sadbhāvena anumānapratītyutpatte
tatra caitanyaprabhavaprāṇāderjāgraddaśāyāṃ caitanyānumānaṃ yuktam na punaḥ prāṇādiprāṇādeḥ
na khalu gopālaghaṭikādau dhūmaprabhavadhūmādagnyanumānaṃ dṛṣṭam agniprabhavadhūmādeva taddarśanāt; ityapyacāru; suṣuptetarāvasthayoḥ prāṇāderviśeṣā'pratīteḥ
yathaiva hi suṣuptaḥ prāṇiti tathaiva itaro'pi, anyathā kimayaṃ suṣuptaḥ kiṃ vā jāgarti iti sandeho na syāt
yadi caite suṣuptasya caitanyaprabhavāḥ na syuḥ tarhi jāgrataḥ paravañcanābhiprāyeṇa suṣuptavyājenā'vasthitasya tādṛśāmeva teṣāṃ saṃbhavo na syāt
nahi agnerjāyamāno dhūmaḥ prayatnaśatairapi dhūmādanyato vā jāyate, dhūmaprabhavo vā'gneḥ iti
dṛśyante ca yādṛśā eva suṣuptasya prāṇādayaḥ tādṛśā eva asyāpi
caitanyetaraprabhavāṃśca prāṇādīn vivecayan vītarāgetaraprabhavān vyāpārādīnapi vivecayatu
tathā ca sarāgā api vītarāgavacceṣṭante vītarāgāśca sarāgavat ato vītarāgetaravibhāgo niścetumaśakyaḥ iti viplavate
nanu dvividho'tra prāṇādi caitanyaprabhavo jāgraddaśāyām, prāṇādiprabhavaśca suṣuptādyavasthāyāmiti
yathaiva hi suṣuptaḥ prāṇiti tathetaro'pi, anyathā kimaya suṣuptaḥ kiṃvā jāgarti iti sandeho na syāt
yadi caite suṣuptasya caitanyaprabhavā na syu kintu prāṇādiprabhavā, tarhi jāgrataḥ paravañcanābhiprāyeṇa suṣuptavyājenāvasthitasya tādṛśāmeva teṣā bhāvo na syāt

suṣuptādau ca prathamaḥ prāṇādiḥ kuto jāyatām ? jāgradvijñānasahakāriṇo jāgratprāṇādeḥ iti cet, na; ekasmājjāgradvijñānāt anantarabhāvī prāṇādiḥ kālāntarabhāvi ca prabodhajñānam ityasyā'sambhāvyamānatvāt
nahi ekasmāt sāmagrīviśeṣāt kramabhāvikāryadvayasaṃbhavo yuktaḥ; anyathā nityādaṣyakramāt kramavatkāryadvayotpattiḥ syāt
tathā ca nākramāt kramiṇo bhāvāḥ pramāṇavā॰ 1

tasmāt suṣuptāvasthābhāvina eva jñānāt tatkālabhāviprāṇādiprabhavo'bhyupagantavyaḥ, ataḥ kathaṃ tatra jñānābhāvasiddhiḥ ? tato jñānasya kadācidapi vyavacchedāsaṃbhavāt siddho'navacchinno jñānasantānaḥ, tasya ca muktikāraṇānuṣṭhānāt pratibandhakakarmaprakṣaye anantacatuṣṭayasvarūpalābho mokṣa iti
tathā ca ghātikarmaprakṣaye samutpannakevalajñānāderbhagavato muktibhuktiryairabhipretā taiḥ jīvanmuktaye datto jalāñjaliḥ anantacatuṣṭayāsaṃbhavāt
kavalāhāro hi kṣudvedanodaye gṛhyate, tadudaye ca kṣudduḥkhasaṃbhavāt bhagavataḥ kathamanantaṃ saukhyam ? yato'nantacatuṣṭayasvarūpalābhalakṣaṇā jīvanmuktiḥ syāt
kevalina kavalāhāriṇa iti śvetāmbarāṇā yāpanīyaśākaṭāyanasya ca pūrvapakṣa–
nanvidamasti–yadā bhuktiḥ avikalakāraṇā tadā'sau bhavatyeva yathā chadmasthāvasthāyām, tathābhūtā cāsau sayogikevalyavasthāyāmiti
tatra bāhyam–āhārādi, tattāvadavikalamāste na tatra vipratipattiḥ
taijasam antastejaḥ śarīroṣmā, yato bhuktā'nnādipāko bhavati iti
etadudayāt kṣudvedanā upajāyate, asti ca tadudayo bhagavati ato bhuktisiddhiḥ
tadanabhyupagame vā tatra kṣudabhāvaḥ pramāṇāt pratipattavyaḥ
tacca pramāṇam–āgamaḥ, anyadvā syāt ? na tāvadāgamaḥ, siddhavat sayogakevalini kṣudabhāvapratipādakasya āgamasyā'saṃbhavāt
asti ca kevalibhukti samagraheturyathā purā bhukte
naṣṭāni na karmāṇi kṣugho nimitta virodhino na guṇā
sāmagrī ceya prakṣepāhārasya, tadyathā paryāptatva vedanīyodaya āhārapaktinimitta taijasaśarīra dīrghāyuṣkatva ceti
tatra bāhyamaśanādi, tattāvadastyeva na tatra kasyāpi vivāda
pramāṇāntarācca niṣedhaḥ svabhāvānupalambhāt, anyato vā syāt ? na tāvat svabhāvānupalambhāt; kevalino viprakṛṣṭasvabhāvatvāt
anyato'pi vidhīyamānāt, niṣidhyamānādvā tanniṣedhaḥ syāt ? yadi vidhīyamānāt, tadā tena virodhinā bhavitavyam, aviruddhavidherabhāvā'sādhakatvāt
na ca kṣudvirodhi kevalini kiñcit pratīyate

na ca jñānādiguṇā eva tatra tadvirodhinaḥ ityabhidhātavyam, yato jñānādimātrasya kṣudhā virodhaḥ, tadviśeṣasya vā ? yadi jñānādimātrasya, tarhi yathā yathā tadguṇā vivarddhante tathā tathā kṣudho hānitāratamyena bhavitavyam prakāśavivṛddhāviva tamasaḥ, na caivamasti
nahi bālādau jñānādyapacaye kṣudupacayaḥ, tataḥ prabhṛti ca jñānādyupacaye tāratamyena kṣudapacayo lakṣyate
atha ye kevaligatā jñānādayaḥ prakarṣaparyantaprāptāḥ teṣāmeva kṣudhā virodhaḥ; tanna; tathāpratipattumaśakteḥ
nahi kevalijñānādayaḥ kṣudhaṃ virundhanti iti arvāgdṛśā pratipattuṃ śakyam; atīndriyatvātteṣām
tama iva bhāso vṛddhau jñānādīnā na tāratamyena
kṣugh hīyate'tra na ca tajjñānādīnā virodhagati
idamasya virodhīti jñāne na tadasti kevalini
kiñca, avikalakāraṇasya bhavato'nyabhāve'bhāvāt virodhagatirbhavati śītasparśasyeva agnisannidhau
etaccātra durghaṭam–kevaliguṇānāmatīndriyatayā etatsannidhau kṣunna bhavati iti pratīteranupapatteḥ
nipidhyamānaśca bhāvaḥ tasyāḥ kāryam, kāraṇam, vyāpako vā syāt ? yadi kāryam; tadātmanirvarttanasamarthā'vikalakāraṇasyaiva tat nivṛttimavagamayet na kāraṇamātrasya, asya kāryābhāve'pi bhāvāvirodhāt
kāraṇamapi nivarttamānaṃ kārya nivarttayati yathā vahnirdhūmam, vyāpakaṃ vā nivarttamānaṃ vyāpyam yathā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśāpām
na cātra kṣudhaḥ kāraṇasya vyāpakasya vā kasyacinnivṛttirasti
naca mohanīyādikarmacatuṣṭayā'bhāvāt kṣudho'bhāvaḥ; tasyāḥ tatkāryatvasya tatsvabhāvatvasya vā'saṃbhavāt
pratipakṣabhāvanā'nivarttyatvena mohasvabhāvatvā'saṃbhavācca; yo hi mohasvabhāvaḥ sa pratipakṣabhāvanayā nivarttyate yathā kṣamādibhāvanayā krodhādiḥ, mohasvabhāvā ca kṣud bhavadbhiriṣṭā iti
tathā ca kṣudvedanāpratīkārārthaṃ śāstre pratipakṣabhāvanaiva upadiśyeta na kleśabhūyiṣṭhadhyānādhyayanavighātakāriṇī piṇḍaiṣaṇā
śītoṣṇabādhātulyatvācca kṣudho na mohasvabhāvatvam, anyathā tadbā dhāyā api mohasvabhāvatvaṃ syādaviśeṣāt
niṣiddhamānaśca bhāvastasyā kāryaṃ kāraṇa vyāpako vā syāt
kimeva sati kavalāhārasya vyāpaka kāraṇa kāryaṃ sahacarādi vā sārvajñyena virodhamadhivaset
yadi kāryam; tadā tannivartamānam ātmanirvartanasamarthāyā eva kṣudho nivṛttimavagamayenna tu sarvathā, kāraṇamātrasya kāryābhāve'pi bhāvāvirodhāt
na bhavati, vimohapāka sarvo'pi hi tena vinivartya
yato mohavipākā kṣunna bhavati tadvipākasya pratipakṣabhāvanayā pratisakhyānena nivartyamānatvāt
tathāhi kaṣāyā pratikūlabhāvanayā nivartante kṣudvedanīya tu rogaśītopmādivat jīvapudgalavipākitayā na pratīpavāsanāmātreṇa nivartate ato na mohavipākasvabhāvā kṣuditi –sūtrakṛ॰ śo॰ pṛ॰ 346 A.
mūḍhasya bhavati mohāt tathā bhṛśaṃ vādhyamānasya

nanu bhagavataḥ kṣudabhyupagame aśepajñatvādivirodhaḥ, kṣududaye asmadādivattatra jñānadarśanaceṣṭāde prakṣayāt, tadasamīcīnam, jñānāvaraṇādiprakṣaye jātāyāmapi kṣudhi jñānādikṣayā'yogāt, tatkṣayo hi jñānāvaraṇādikarmodayanibandhanaḥ
ataḥ asmadādau tadudayātiśayāt tatkṣayātiśayo yukta bhagavati tu tadāvaraṇāderaśeṣasyāpagamāt satyāmapi kṣudhi na jñānādikṣayaḥ
tatkarmacatuṣṭayaprabhavatve ca kṣudhaḥ ekādaśa jine kṣutpipāsādayaḥ parīṣahāḥ vedanīyaprabhavāḥ ityāgamavirodhaḥ
naca utkarṣeṇa deśonapūrvakoṭiṃ viharataḥ sayogakevalinaḥ tāvatkālaṃ kāyasthitiḥ bhuktiṃ vinā ghaṭate
atha anantavīryatvāt tāṃ vināpyasya tatsthitiḥ; tarhi āyuṣkarmaṇāpi vinā tatsthitiprasaṅgāt na kadācit śarīrādyapāyaḥ syāt iti mokṣāya datto jalāñjaliḥ
tatsthiteḥ āyuṣkarmāpekṣaṇe vā āhārāpekṣaṇamapyastu ubhayasyāpi tatkāraṇatvā'viśeṣāt
kṣudhādayo na bādhante pūrṇaṃ tvasti mahodaye
nirastaghātikarmacatuṣṭaye jine vedanīyasadbhāvāttadāśrayā ekādaśa parīṣahā santi athavā ekādaśa jine na santīti vākyaśeṣa kalpanīya
sūtroktamupāpādi na muktiśca na niyatakālā syāt
kiṃñca, pradīpajvālājaladhārāsamānaṃ śarīram, tatra ca yathā tailakṣaye na pradīpajvālā'vatiṣṭhate jalāgamanamantareṇa vā jaladhārā tathā śarīramapi bhuktyabhāve na sthitimāstidhnute
tailakṣaye na dīpo na jalāgamamanteraṇa jaladhārā
tiṣṭhati yathā tano sthitirapi na vināhārayogena

atha bhuktirdoṣaḥ, yadupavāsādipratyākhyānaṃ kriyate, nirdoṣe ca kevalini doṣo viruddhaḥ; tarhi niṣadyā gamanañca arhati na prāpnoti sthānayogādinā niṣadyādeḥ pratyākhyānāt, vacanañca na prāpnoti maunavratikopalambhāt
bhuktirdoṣo yadupoṣyate na doṣaśca bhavati nirdoṣai
atha matam–aśeṣajñasya māṃsādikaṃ paśyataḥ katha bhuktiḥ antarāyopapatteḥ ? tada saṅgatam; avadhijñānibhiḥ paramarṣibhiranekāntāt, te hi sakalaṃ trailokyaṃ paśyanti atha ca bhuñjate, evaṃ kevalyapi
indriyaviṣaye eva hi antarāyo nānyatra, anyathā chadmasthāvasthāyāmapyantarāyaḥ syāt, bhagavatā tadāpi avadhijñānena aśeṣavastusākṣātkaraṇāt
na ca bhuktau jihvārasaprāpteḥ kevalino matijñānānuṣaṅgaḥ; yato na indriyaviṣayasambandhamātreṇa matijñānaṃ bhavati
kiṃ tarhi ? tatsambandhe matijñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśame ca sati

etacca prakṣīṇāśeṣāvaraṇe kevalini nāsti iti na tajjñānānuṣaṅgaḥ, anyathā śrotrādīndriyāṇāṃ divyatūryādiraveṇa gaṇadharadevādirūpeṇa sugandhikusumadhūpavāsādigandhena marutsiṃhāsanasparśena sambandhe'pi matijñānamanuṣajyeta

sa ca bhagavān pūrvāhepūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe ca pādonapraharaṃ dharmoṣadeśanākāla eva siṃhāsanādhirūḍha āste, śeṣadinaṃ tu divyasthāne devacchandakābhidhāne gaṇadharadevānvihāya anyamanuṣyatiraścāmagocare īśānadiśāyāṃ samavaśaraṇīyadvitīyaprākārābhyantaravarttini gatvā palyaṅke āsane vā yathā sukhamāste
tatra ca gaṇadharadevairānītamāhāraṃ sakaladoṣaśuddhaṃ jñātvā kṣudvedanodaye gṛhṇāti
te ca āhāraṃ tadīyahaste nikṣiptaṃ paśyanti, kathamasau bhuṅkte ityetattu na paśyanti, manuṣyatiraścāṃ sarvajñāhāranīnihārāṇāmagocaratvāt iti
tathāhi sa bhagavān pūrvāhṇe aparāhṇe ca pādonapraharaṃ yāvat dharmoṣadeśakāla eva siṃhāsanādhirūḍha āste, śeṣa tu dina devacchandakanāmni divyasthāne yathāsukha gamayati
tatra ca gaṇadharadevairānītamāhāra nikhiladoṣaviśuddha vijñāya kṣudvedanodaye gṛhṇāti
āhāra ca tadīyapāṇipallavanyasta māsacakṣuṣa paśyanti, kathamasau bhuṅkte ityetattu na paśyanti, sarvajñāhāranihārayormāsacakṣuṣāmagocaratvāt

yattāvaduktam–āhāravedyādikarmodayalakṣaṇabāhyābhyāntarakāraṇasadbhāvāt kṣududaye sati avikalakāraṇā bhagavato bhuktirbhavatyeva ityādi, tadasamīcīnam; yataḥ tatsadbhāvāttadudaye kevalini āhāramātraṃ prasādhyeta kavalāhāro vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanam, āsayogakevalino jīvā āhāriṇa ityabhyupagamāt
ṣaḍvidho hi āhāraḥ pravacane prasiddhaḥ– nokamma–kammahāro kavalāhāro ya leppamāhāro
ujja maṇo vi ya kamaso āhāro chavviho ṇeyo
tatra ca kavalāhārābhāve'pi anyasya karma-nokarmā''dānalakṣaṇasya āhārasya bhāvāt na āhāritvaṃ bhagavato viruddham
na ca kavalāhāreṇaiva āhāritvaṃ jīvānāmityabhyupagamo yuktaḥ; ekendriyāṇḍajatridaśānām abhuñjānatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāñca anāhāritvaprasaṅgāt
dvitīyapakṣe tu tridaśādibhirvyabhicāraḥ; teṣāṃ vedyādikarmodayāt kṣududaye satyapi kavalāhārābhāvāt
athātra tadudayaḥ tamasādhayannapi kevalini prasādhayati, tadetat kevalino mahanmāhātmyam–yadviṣayaviṣamagrahābhibhūtaprāṇiṣu kavalāhāraprasādhanā'samartho'pi tadudayaḥ tatra samartho bhavatīti!
atra kimāhāramātra prasādhyate kavalāhāro vā ? –ratnaka॰ ṭī॰ pṛ॰ 5
āhārā eidiyappahuḍi jāva sajogakevalitti–atra kavalalepoṣmamana karmāhārān parityajya nokarmāhāro grāhya
ṇokamma kammahāro kavalāhāro ya leppahāro ya
ujja maṇo vi ya kamaso āhāro chavviho ṇeo
ṇa hu ṇicchaeṇa so vi hu sa vīyarāo paro jamhā
śvetāmbarāgameṣu trividha āhāra prarūpita– bhāvāhāro tiviho oe lome ya pakkheve
pajjattagā ya lome pakkheve hoi nāyavvā
bauddhadharmasagrahe pacadhā āhārā prarūpitā–pacāhārā dhyānāhārā kavalīkāhārā pratyāhārā sparśāhārā sacetanikāhārāśceti
ujja maṇo vi ya kamaso āhāro chavviho ṇeyo || bhāvasa॰ gā॰ 110
siṃhāṇa khelaseo ṇatthi dugachā ya do so ya
lābhāntarāyasyāśeṣasya nirāsāt parityaktakavalāhārakriyāṇā kevalinā yata śarīrabalādhānahetavo'nyamanujā'sādhāraṇā paramaśubhā sūkṣmā anantā pratisamaya pudgalā sambandhamupayānti sa kṣāyiko lābha
prathamapakṣe siddhasādhanatā, āsayogakevalina āhāriṇo jīvā ityabhyupagamāt
kiñca, tatra tadudayaḥ tatsādhanasamarthaḥ ityetat kutaḥ pratipannam–abhyupagamamātrāt, pramāṇato vā ? yadi abhyupagamamātrāt; atiprasaṅgaḥ, sarvasya sveṣṭatattvasiddhiprasaṅgāt

atha pramāṇataḥ; kimatra pramāṇam–pratyakṣam, anumānam, āgamo vā ? pratyakṣañcet; kim aindriyam, atīndriyaṃ vā ? na tāvadaindriyam; tasya aśeṣajñāhāranihārā'gocaratvābhyupagamāt, anyathā āhārā ya nihārā kevaliṇo pacchannā ityāgamavirodhaḥ
atīndriyaṃ tu tattatra pravarttate ityatra kośapānaṃ vidheyam
athānumānam; kimatra liṅgam–tadudaya eva, manuṣyatvam, dehasthititvaṃ vā ? na tāvattadudaya eva; asya tridaśādibhirvyabhicāraprarūpaṇāt
athāsya manuṣyaprakṛtyatikrāntatvāt nā'nena anekāntaḥ; tarhi asiddho hetuḥ, sayogakevalino'pi tadvattadatikrāntatvāt
mānuṣīṃ prakṛtimabhyatītavān devatāsvapi ca devatā yataḥ

nāpi dehasthititvam; tathāhi–bhagavato dehasthitiḥ āhārapūrvikā dehasthititvāt asmadādidehasthitivat ityatra prayoge kim āhāramātrapūrvakatvaṃ tatsthiteḥ prasādhyeta, kavalāhārapūrvakatvaṃ vā ? prathamapakṣe siddhasādhyatā ityuktam
dvitīyavikalpe tu tridaśādibhirvyabhicāraḥ, teṣāṃ kavalāhārābhāve'pi dehasthitisaṃbhavāt
atha audārikaśarīrasthititvāt iti viśiṣya ucyate tato na vyamicāraḥ; tanna; tadīyaudārikaśarīrasthiteḥ paramaudārikaśarīrasthitirūpatayā asmadādyaudārikaśarīrasthitivilakṣaṇatvāt
tad bhagavataḥ śarīramaudārika na bhavati kintu paramaudārikam–śuddhasphaṭikasakāśa tejomūrtimaya vapu

atha tadvṛddhyabhāvo devopanītaḥ na ghātikarmakṣayajaḥ yena tadvat kevalyavasthāyāṃ tadbhuktyabhāvo'pyāpādyeta, bālotpāṭanānantaraṃ hi indro vajraṃ nakhakeśeṣu bhagavato bhrāmayati atastadvṛddhyabhāva iti; tadayuktam; vajraprabhāvataḥ teṣāṃ mūlato'pyutthānābhāvaprasaṅgāt, sarvatīrthakṛtāmekādṛśakeśādipratītiprasaṅgācca, na caivam, ṛṣabhāditīrtha kṛtāṃ keśakalāpasya gurulaghubhāvena vilakṣaṇasya upalabdheḥ
tato ghātikarmakṣayāvasthāyāṃ yasya yāvanto nakhakeśāḥ tasya tāvanta evā'vatiṣṭhante iti
kevalyavasthāyāṃ ghātikṣayajo yathā taccharīrasthitau keśādivṛddhyabhāvalakṣaṇo'tiśayo'sti tathā tadbhuktyabhāvalakṣaṇo'pyastu aviśeṣāt
dṛśyate hi pañcakṛtvo bhuñjānasya yādṛśī śarīrasthitiḥ tādṛśyeva pratipakṣabhāvanopetasya catustridvyekabhojanasyāpi, tathā pratidina bhuñjānasya yādṛśī sā tādṛśyeva ekadvyādidināntaritabhojino'pi
śrūyate ca bāhuvaliprabhṛtīnāṃ saṃvatsarapramitāhāravaikalye'pi viśiṣṭā śarīrasthitiḥ
āyuḥkarmaiva hi pradhānaṃ tatsthiternimittam, bhuktyādikaṃ tu sahāyamātram
taccharīropacayo'pi lābhāntarāyaprakṣayāt pratisamayaṃ tadupacayanimittabhūtānāṃ divyaparamāṇūnāṃ lābhād ghaṭate
lābhāntarāyasyāśeṣanirāsāt parityaktakavalāhārakriyāṇā kevalinā yata śarīrabalādhānahetavo'nyamanujāsādhāraṇā paramaśubhā sūkṣmā anantā pratisamaya pudgalā sambandhamupayānti sa kṣāyiko lābha
tasmādaudārikaśarīrasya kiñcinnyūnapūrvakoṭivarṣasthiti kavalāhāramantareṇa katha sabhavatīti yadvacana tadaśikṣitakṛta vijñāyate

nanu māsaṃ varṣaṃ vā tadabhāve tatsthitāvapi nākālaṃ tatsthitiḥ punaḥ tadāhāre pravṛttipratīteriti cet, kutaḥ tatsthiteḥ ākālamapratītiḥ–pratyakṣataḥ, anumānādvā ? yadi pratyakṣataḥ, sarvajñavītarāgāya datto jalāñjaliḥ tadvat tataḥ tadapratīterapyaviśeṣāt

yathaiva hi jñānaprakarpaḥ doṣāvaraṇāpakarṣaśca kvacit paramaprakarṣamāpadyate prakṛṣyamāṇatvāt parimāṇavat ityucyate, tathā ekadvyādidināntaritabhojinām abhuktipūrvako dehasthitiprakarṣaḥ kvacit paramakāṣṭhāmāpadyate tattvāt tadvadeva ityucyatāmaviśeṣāt
tanna śarīrasthiterapi bhagavato vedyādyudayāt kṣududayaḥ kavalāhāraprasādhanasamarthaḥ pratyetuṃ śakyaḥ
māsa varṣaṃ vāpi ca tāni śarīrāṇi tena bhuktena
tiṣṭhanti na cākāla nānyathā pūrvamapi bhukti

vipakṣabhāvanāvaśād rāgādīnā hānyatiśayadarśanāt kevalini tatparamaprakarṣasiddhe vītarāgatāsabhave bhojanābhāvaparamaprakarṣo'pi tatra kinna syāt ? tadbhāvanāto bhojanādāvapi hānyatiśayadarśanāviśeṣāt
tathāhi ekasmin dine yo'nekavārān bhuṅkte kadācit vipakṣabhāvanāvaśāt punarekabāra bhuṅkte, kaścitpunarekadinādyantaritabhojana, anya puna pakṣamāsasavatsarādyantaritabhojana iti
asiddhañca avikalakāraṇatvaṃ bhukteḥ, mohanīyasahāyaṃ hi vedyādikarma kṣudādikāryakaraṇe'vikalasāmarthya bhavati, nānyathā atiprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi patite sainyanāyake asāmarthya sainyasya, tathā mohanīye vinaṣṭe adhātikarmaṇāmiti
yathā ca nirviṣīkṛtya mantriṇā upayujyamānamapi viṣaṃ na dāhamūrcchādi karttu samartham tathā śukladhyānānalanirdagdhamohodayaṃ vedyādi kṣudhādikamiti
prayogaḥ–bhagavati bubhukṣā nāsti, tatkāraṇamohābhāvāt, yatra yatkāraṇābhāvo na tatra tatkāryam yathā anagnipradeśe dhūmaḥ, nāsti ca arhati moha iti
ghādiṃ va veyaṇīya mohassa baleṇa ghādade jīva
yathaiva brīhyādivīja jalasahakārikāraṇasahitamaṅkurādikāryaṃ janayati tathaivāsadvedyakarma mohanīyasahakārikāraṇasahita kṣudhādikāryamutpādayati

kiñca, karmaṇāmudayo yadyanapekṣaḥ kāryamutpādayet, tarhi trivedānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāṃ vā pramattādiṣu udayo'sti iti maithunaṃ bhrakuṭyādikañca syāt, tataśca manasaḥ saṅkṣobhāt kathaṃ śukladhyānāvāptiḥ kṣapakaśreṇyārohaṇaṃ vā yataḥ karmakṣapaṇā syāt ? nanvevaṃ nāmādyudayo'pi tatra svakāryakārī na syāt; ityayuktam; śubhaprakṛtīnāṃ tatra apratibaddhatvena svakāryakāritvopapatteḥ
yathaiva hi balavatārājñā svamārgānusāriṇā labdhe deśe duṣṭā jīvanto'pi na svaduṣṭācaraṇavidhātāraḥ sujanāstu apratihatatayā svakāryasya vidhātāraḥ, tathā prakṛtamapi

kathaṃ punaraśubhaprakṛtīnāmeva arhati pratibaddhaṃ sāmarthyaṃ na punaḥ śubhaprakṛtīnāmiti cet ? ucyate–aśubhaprakṛtīnāmarhan anubhāgaṃ ghātayati na tu śubhaprakṛtīnām, yato guṇaghātināṃ daṇḍo nā'doṣāṇām
yadi mohābhāve'pi kṣudhādiparīṣaha janayati tarhi badharogādiparīṣahamapi janayatu, na ca tathā
yadi ca pratibaddhasāmarthyamapyasātāvedanīyaṃ svakāryakāri syāt tarhi daṇḍakapāṭādividhānaṃ bhagavato vyartham
taddhi yadā nyūnamāyuḥ vedanīyādikamadhikasthitikaṃ bhavati tadā tena karmaṇāṃ samasthityarthaṃ vidhīyate
naca adhikasthitikatvena phaladānasamarthaṃ karma upāyaśatenāpi anyathā karttuṃ śakyamiti na kaścinmuktaḥ syāt
atha tapomāhātmyāt nirjīrṇam adhikasthitikatvena phaladānā'samartham āyuḥkarmasamānaṃ karma kriyate, tathā vedyamapi taddānāsamarthaṃ kriyatāmaviśeṣāt
naca kāraṇamasti ityetāvataiva kāryotpattiḥ, anyathā indriyādikāryasyāpyanuṣaṅgāt bhagavato matijñānasya rāgādīnāñca prasaṅgaḥ
atha āvaraṇakṣayopaśamasya mohanīyakarmaṇaśca sahakāriṇo virahāt nendriyādi svakāryaṃ kuryāt; ata eva vedanīyamapyaviśeṣāt
vedanīyasya bahutvādalpatvāccāyuṣonābhogapūrvakamāyuḥsamīkaraṇārtha dravyasvabhāvatvāt surādravyasya phenavegabudbudāvirbhāvopaśamanavaddehasthātmapradeśānā bahiḥ samuddhātana kevalisamuddhāta
na ceyaṃ bubhukṣā mohanīyānapekṣasya vedanīyasyaiva kāryam yena atyantaprakṣīṇāmohe'pi syāt, tathāhi–bubhukṣā mohanīyānapekṣasya vedanīyasya kāryanna bhavati icchātvāt riraṃsāvat
bhoktumicchā hi bubhukṣā, sā kathaṃ vedanīyasyaiva kāryam ? anyathā yonyādiṣu rantumicchā riraṃsāpi tatkāryaṃ syāt, tathā ca kavalāhāravat stryādāvapi tatprasaṅgāt neśvarādasya viśeṣaḥ
yathā ca riraṃsā pratipakṣabhāvanāto nivarttate tathā bubhukṣāpi
prayogaḥ– bhojanākāṅkṣā pratipakṣabhāvanāto nivarttate ākāṅkṣātvāt stryādyākāṅkṣāvat
nanvastu tadbhāvanākāle tannivṛttiḥ tadabhāve tu pravṛttiḥ punaḥ syāt, ityetat stryādyākāṅkṣāyāmapi samānam
yathā cāsyāḥ cetasaḥ pratipakṣabhāvanāmayatvāt atyantanivṛttiḥ tathā bhojanākāṅkṣāyā api, yathā ca nirmohatvena stryādyākāṅkṣā viruddhā tathā bubhukṣāpi

tathā ca prayogaḥ–na bubhukṣāvān kevalī, tadvirodhinirmohasvabhāvopetatvāt, yo yadvirodhisvabhāvopetaḥ nāsau tadvān yathā uṣṇasparśasvabhāvopetaḥ kaścit pradeśaḥ na śītasparśavān, kṣudvirodhinirmohasvabhāvopetaśca kevalīti
bhoktumicchā hi bubhukṣā, sā mohanīyakāryatvāt katha prakṣīṇamohe bhagavati syāt anyathā rirasāyā api tatra prasagāt

etena idamapi pratyuktam–pratipakṣabhāvanātaḥ kṣudho nivṛttau kṣudvedanāpratīkārārthaṃ śāstre saiva upadiśyeta na piṇḍaipaṇā ityādi, cetaso hi pratipakṣabhāvanāmayatvasiddheḥ prāk piṇḍaipaṇopadeśāt, tanmayatvasiddhau tu kāmavedanānivṛttivat niḥśeṣakṣudvedanānivṛttisiddheḥ na kiñcit tadvedanāpratīkārārthaṃ dravyāntaraipaṇayā ? atha ākāṅkṣārūpā kṣunna bhavati tena vītamohepi asyāḥ saṃbhavaḥ, kathamevaṃ riraṃsāyā api anākāṅkṣārūpāyāḥ tatra saṃbhavo na syāt ? atha anākāṅkṣārūpatā'syāḥ pratītiviruddhā, tadetad bubhukṣāyāmapi samānam
astu vā'nākāṅkṣārūpatvamasyāḥ, tathāpi duḥkharūpatvāt anantasukhe bhagavatyasaṃbhavaḥ, yad duḥkharūpaṃ na tattatra saṃbhavati yathā kāmapīḍādi, duḥkharūpā ca kṣuditi
yatra hi anantasukhaṃ na tatra duḥkhaleśo'pyasti yathā siddheṣu, anantasukhañca arhati iti

nanu sakalabādhānivṛttyātmakaṃ yadanantaṃ sukhaṃ tatrābhipretaṃ tadasiddham, kṣudbādhābhyupagamāt, sakalakarmavipramuktānāṃ siddhānāmeva hi tathāvidhaṃ tadasti nā'rhatām tatra vedanīyodayasaṃbhavāditi, tadasat; tadudayasya tatra tadbādhāhetutvābhāvapratipādanāt
yadi kṣudhā vādhāsti tarhi kṣudhā kṣīṇaśakteranantavīrya nāsti, tathaiva kṣudhā duḥkhitasya anantasukhamapi nāsti

kiñca, arhati anantaṃ sukhaṃ sarvapradeśavyāpi avyāhatamāste aprādeśikatvāttasya, sukhaduḥkhayorekatraikadā virodhato'saṃbhavācca, tatkathaṃ kṣudduḥkhaleśo'pi tatra saṃbhāvyaḥ ? anyathā asmadādisukhavat prādeśikameva tatsukhaṃ syāt
ataḥ tathāvidhaṃ sukhaṃ bhagavati sannidhīyamānaṃ svaviruddhaṃ duḥkhaṃ nivarttayati yathā agniḥ śītam
tannivṛttau ca tadvyāpyāyāḥ kṣudho nivṛttiḥ, vyāpakanivṛttau vyāpyasyāvaśyaṃ nivṛtteḥ vṛkṣanivṛttau śiṃśapāvat
prayogaḥ–yatra yadvirodhi balavadasti na tatra abhyuditakāraṇamapi tad bhavati yathā atyuṣṇapradeśe śītam, asti ca kṣudduḥkhavirodhi balavat kevalini anantasukhamiti

tathā, yatkāryavirodhyanivarttyaṃ yatrāsti tatra tadavikalamapi svakāryaṃ na karoti yathā śleṣmādiviruddhā'nivarttya-pittavikārākrānte puruṣe na dadhyādi śleṣmādi karoti, vedyaphalaviruddhā'nivarttyasukhañca bhagavati iti
tato nirākṛtametat–nahi bālādau jñānādyapacaye kṣudupacayaḥ ityādi; anantasukhasahabhāvināmeva jñānādīnāṃ kṣudvirodhitvavyavasthiteḥ
kevalini vedanīya svakāryaṃ kṣudduḥkhaṃ na karoti tatkāryavirodhyanivartya-anantasukhasadbhāvāt

yadapyuktam–nahi kevalijñānādayaḥ kṣudhaṃ virundhanti ityarvāgdṛśā pratipattuṃ śakyamatīndriyatvāttepām ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; atīndriyatvātteṣāṃ tadvirodhitvā'pratipattau sarvārthasākṣātkāritvāderapi apratipattiprasaṅgāt
yathaiva hi teṣāmatīndriyatvāt etatsannidhau kṣunna bhavati ityarvāgdṛśā pratyetuṃ na śakyate tathā ete sarvasākṣātkāriṇaḥ ityapi
atha anumānātteṣāṃ tatsākṣātkāritvaṃ pratīyate, tadvirodhitvena kimaparāddhaṃ yena eṣāmanumānāt tanna pratīyeta ? pratipāditañca kṣudvirodhitvānumānaṃ prāk ityalamatiprasaṅgena
sarvajñatvācca bhagavataḥ kṣudabhāvaḥ, kṣudabhyupagame hi tadvādhayā sarvajñatā hīyeta niḥśaktikatvañca syāt
asmadādau hi kṣutprabhavapīḍākrānte jñānāderabhāvaḥ supratītaḥ kṣutpīḍito'haṃ na kiñcijjānāmi, na kiñcitpaśyāmi, utthātumapi na śaknomi iti pratīteḥ
yadapyuktam–jñānāvaraṇādikarmodayanibandhanaḥ tatkṣayaḥ ityādi, tadapyasāmpratam; prakṣīṇāśeṣāvaraṇasya bhagavato jñānādikṣayābhāvavat prakṣīṇāśeṣamohasya kṣutpīḍāleśasyāpyanupapatteḥ
mohanīyasahāyaṃ vedanīyaṃ kṣutkaraṇe prabhuḥ' iti prāk prapañcataḥ samarthitatvāt
11 ityāgamo'pi kṣudhādyekādaśaparīpahapratiṣedhaparaḥ pratipattavyaḥ, ekena adhikā na daśa ekādaśa iti vyutpatteḥ

mohanīyasahāyasya vedanīyasya kāryabhūtāḥ kṣudhādyekādaśaparīpahāḥ, tatsahāyasya ca arhati atyantaprakṣayāt na vedanīyodayodayamātrāt tatra te santi, anyathā rogādiparīṣahāṇāmapi tatra sattvaprasaṅgāt, asmadādau tadudaye kṣutpipāsāvad rogādīnāmapyupalambhāt
chadmasthajineṣu bhogabhūmijādiṣu ca tadudaye'pi rogādīnāmabhāvād vyabhicāre kavalāhārasyāpi vyabhicāro'stu, devādiṣu tadudaye'pi tadabhāvāt
athavā ekādaśa jine na santi iti vākyaśeṣa kalpanīya sopaskāratvātsūtrāṇām
athavā nāya vākyaśeṣa ekādaśa jine kaiścitkalpyante iti, kiṃ tarhi ? ekādaśa santīti

katham ? upacārāt, yathā niravaśeṣanirastajñānāvaraṇe paripūrṇajñāne ekāgracintānirodhābhāve'pi karmarajovidhūnanaphalasabhavāt dhyānopacāra tathā kṣudhādivedanā-bhāvaparīpahābhāve'pi vedanīyakarmodaya-dravyaparīṣahasadbhāvāt ekādaśa jine santītyupacāro yukta
śaktita eva kevalinyekādaśa parīṣahā santi na punarvyaktita, kevalād vedanīyād vyaktakṣudhādyamabhavādityupacārataste tatra parijñātavyā
yaccopacāratopyasyaikādaśa parīṣahā na sabhāvyante tatra tanniṣedhaparatvāt sūtrasya, ekenādhikā na daśa parīpahā jine ekādaśa jine iti vyutpatte
yaccānyaduktam–utkarṣeṇa deśonapūrvakoṭi viharata ityādi; tadapyacāru, śarīrasthiteḥ āyuḥkarmaṇa eva niyatanimittapratipādanāt, bhuktiṃ vināpi ākālaṃ tatsthiteḥ samarthitatvācca

yadapyabhihitam–bhukterdoparūpatayā bhagavatyasaṃbhave vacanāderapyasaṃbhavaḥ syāt ityādi; tadapyabhidhānamātram, vacanādeḥ tīrthakaratvakarmodayāpāditatvāt doṣarūpatvāsaṃbhavācca, nahi aṣṭādaśadopeṣu madhye kṣudhādivad vacanamapi paṭhyate
bhukterapi vedanīyodayāpāditatvāt tatra sattvamastu, ityapyasaṅgatam, mohasadbhāvasahāyasyaivāsya tatsampādane sāmarthyapratipādanāt
yathaiva hi mohaprakṣayasahāyaṃ tīrthakaratvaṃ viśiṣṭavacanādividhāne samartha tathā mohasadbhāvasahāyaṃ vedyaṃ bhuktyādividhāne iti
bhukterapi vedanīyodayāpāditatvāt tatra gattvamastu ityapyasaṃbhavācca nahi aṣṭādaśa– ā॰
yadapyuktam–avadhijñānivat sakalajñasya sakalaṃ jagatpaśyato'pi antarāyāsaṃbhavaḥ ityādi; tadapyanupapannam; tajjñānasya sopayogatayā tatkāla eva svaviṣayā'śeṣārthasākṣātkaraṇasaṃbhavāt

yadaiva hi avadhijñānopayogamavadhijñānī karoti tadaivāsau tadviṣayabhūtamaśeṣaṃ vastu paśyati nānyadeti, bhojanakāle yadyasau upayogaṃ karoti tadā'ntarāyo bhavatyeva, nacāyaṃ prakāraḥ kevalajñāne saṃbhavati tasya sadā upayuktatvāt
yadapyuktam–nendriyārthasambandhamātreṇa matijñānaṃ bhavati ityādi; tadapyasundaram; viṣayaviṣayisambandhe samupajāyamānasya jñānasya amatijñānatve matijñānavārttocchedaprasaṅgāt
atha matijñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamasya sahakāriṇo'bhāvāt nendriyāṇi svaviṣayasambandhe'pi svakāryamāvirbhāvayanti, tarhi mohanīyasyāpi sahakāriṇo'bhāvāt vedyamapi svakāryaṃ na kuryāt ityuktam

kiñca, kimarthamasau bhuṅkte–śarīropacayārtham, jñānadarśanavīryādikṣayanivṛttyartham, kṣudvedanāpratīkārārtham, āyuṣo'sādhitamuktikasyāpavarttananivṛttyartham, rasagṛddhyupaśamārtham, lokānugrahārthaṃ vā ? na tāvat śarīropacayārtham, lābhāntarāyaprakṣayāt pratisamayaṃ viśiṣṭaparamāṇulābhādeva tatsiddheḥ
tadartha tadgrahaṇe ca kathamasau nirgranthaḥ syāt śarīrasammūrcchāsaṃbhavāt prākṛtapuruṣavat
jñānādikṣayasya hi nibandhanaṃ jñānāvaraṇādikṣayopaśamaḥ, tasmin sati bhojanādyabhāve tatkṣayapratīteḥ
sa ca prakṣīṇāśeṣāvaraṇe bhagavati nāsti iti kathaṃ tatprakṣayāśaṅkā'pi yato bhuktiḥ syāt ? nāpi kṣudvedanāpratīkārārtham, anantasukhavīrye bhagavati asyāḥ saṃbhavābhāvasya uktatvāt
nāpi lokānugrahārtham; anantavīryasya vīryakṣayanibandhanābhāvato bhuktimantareṇāpi lokamanugrahītuṃ samarthatvāt
tulanā–ṇa balāusāhaṇaṭṭha ṇa sarīrassa ya cayaṭṭha tejaṭhṭha
carama uttamo deho yeṣā te caramottamadehā viparītasaṃsārā tajjanmanirvāṇārhā ityartha
caramadehā antyadehā ityartha ye tenaiva śarīreṇa siddhyanti, uttamapuruṣā tīrthakaracakravartyardhacakravartina –tattvārthādhi॰
devā neraiyāvi ya asakhavāsāuyā ya tiramaṇuā
uttamapurisā ya tahā caramasarīrā ya niruvakamā

yaccoktam–devacchandake gatvā yathāsukhamāste ityādi; tadapyuktimātram; yataḥ samavaśaraṇaṃ vihāya bhagavān kimartha tatra gacchati–manovikṣepaparihāreṇa dhyānasiddhyartham, nirodhākṣamatvato yathāsukhamavasthānārtham, rahasyakāryānuṣṭhānārthaṃ vā ? tatrādyaḥ pakṣo'yuktaḥ; amanaskatayā bhagavato manovikṣepā'saṃbhavāt, yoganirodhasadbhāvena upacārataḥ tatra dhyānābhidhānācca
rahasyakāryañca nindyam, anindyaṃ vā ? na tāvannindyam; prakṣīṇāśeṣadoṣasya nindyakāryānuṣṭhānavirodhāt
atha anindyam; tatkiṃ bhojanam, karmakṣapaṇaṃ vā ? na tāvadbhojanam; tasya amohe bhagavati pratipiddhatvāt
apratiṣedhe vā kasmādasau ekānte gatvā bhuṅkte–dṛṣṭidoṣabhayāt, yācakabhayāt, anucitānuṣṭhānatvādvā ? tatrādyavikalpo'nupapannaḥ; bhagavato dṛṣṭidopāgocaratvāt
yadīyena hi nāmnā anyepāṃ dṛṣṭidoṣāderupaśamo bhavati sa kathaṃ taddopagocaraḥ syāt ? dvitīyavikalpe tu bhagavato mahaddīnatvaṃ prakhyāpitam
na khalu mahāsattvasya pṛṣṭhato lagnān bubhukṣāpīḍitaśiṣyān vihāya pituriva putram ekānte gatvā bhojanaṃ yuktam
anucitānuṣṭhānatve tu na tatra tatparikalpanā śreyasī stryādisevanaparikalpanāvat
karmaṇāmapi kṣapaṇa pūrvopārjitānām, bhuktikālopārjitānāṃ vā tatra arhatā vidhīyate ? pūrvopārjitānāñcet, ghātinām, aghātināṃ vā ? na tāvat ghātinām; teṣāṃ pūrvameva kṣapitatvāt
nāpyaghātinām; teṣāṃ yathākāla kṣapayiṣyamāṇatvāt, satata śukladhyānānalataḥ karmendhananicayanirdahanasamarthatvāccāsya
nahi bhagavataḥ śukladhyānānalo devacchandake eva prajvalati na tu samavaśaraṇādau ityabhyupagamo yuktaḥ; tatrasthasyāsya dhyānāntaraprasaṅgāt
bhuktikālopārjitakarmaṇāṃ tu katha kṣapaṇam ? pratikramaṇataścet, astu, parantu bhagavato nirdoṣatā durlabhā
yaḥ pratikramaṇa karoti nāsau nirdoṣaḥ yathā asmadādiḥ, pratikramaṇaṃ karoti ca bhagavāniti

kṛtadoṣanirākaraṇaṃ hi pratikramaṇam, tatkurvataḥ kathamasya nirdoṣatā syāt ? atha tāṃ ta na karoti, katha bhujikriyātaḥ samutpannadopaṃtpannaṃ doṣaṃ nirākuryāt ? āhārakathāmātreṇāpi hi apramatto'pi san sādhuḥ pramatto bhavati nārhan bhuñjāno'pi iti mahaccitram
doṣavattve cāsya śreṇītaḥ patitatvānna kevalabhāktva syāt
tulanā– kiṃ cāsau bhuktvā pratikramaṇādika karoti na vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 306
apramatto hi sādhurāhārakathāmātreṇāpi pramatto bhavati nārhanbhuñjāno'pīti mahaccitram

yadapyuktam–bhuñjāno'sau gaṇadharadevairapi na dṛśyate ityadi, tatrādarśane kiṃ kāraṇam– bahalatamaḥ paṭalācchāditatvam, kāṇḍapaṭādyāvṛtatvam, vidyāviśeṣeṇa svasya tirodhānam, anyajanātiśāyī māhātmyaviśeṣo vā ? tatrādyapakṣo'nupapannaḥ, taddehadīptyā tamaḥpaṭalasya nirmūlonmūlitatvāt
kāṇḍapaṭādyāvṛtāya ca tasmai kathaṃ bhikṣā dīyeta ? vidyāviśeṣābhyupagame cāsya vidyādharādivat nirgranthatāvirodhaḥ
atha anyajanātiśāyī māhātmyaviśeṣaḥ kaścittasyeṣyate yena bhuñjāno nā'valokyate iti; nanu anyajanātiśāyī bhojanābhāvalakṣaṇa evā'tiśayaḥ asya iṣyatām tasyaiva pramāṇopapannatvāt
tadiṣṭau ca ca bhuktyabhāvo'bhyupagantavyaḥ tamantareṇāsya anantasaukhyānupapatteḥ pratipāditatvāt iti
tatrādarśane'yuktasevitvādekāntamāśritya bhuṅkte iti kāraṇam, bahalāndhakārasthitabhojana vā, vidyāviśeṣeṇa svasya tirodhānaṃ vā ? –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 307
tatra tu pracchannabhuktau māyāsthāna dainyavṛtti anye'pi piṇḍaśuddhikathitā bahavo doṣā
tarhi paramaudārikaśarīratvād bhuktireva nāstyayamevātiśaya kinna bhavati
tallakṣaṇā ca muktiḥ puṃsa eva na striyāḥ, tasyāḥ napuṃsakavattadayogyatvāt, tanmuktiprasādhakapramāṇāsaṃbhavācca
nanvidamasti tatprasādhakaṃ pramāṇam–asti strīṇāṃ nirvāṇam avikalakāraṇatvāt puṃvat
nirvāṇasya hi kāraṇaṃ ratnatrayam, samyagdarśanajñānacāritrāṇi mokṣamārgaḥ tattvārthasū॰ 1
tacca strīṣu vidyate; tathāhi–sarvajñoktārthānām idamitthameva iti śraddhāna samyagdarśanam, yathāvadavagamaḥ samyagjñānam, taduktavratasya yathāvadanuṣṭhānaṃ samyakcāritram, etadratnatrayam
etacca strīṣu siddhyat sarvakarmavipramokṣalakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṃ sādhayati
nahi strīṣu ratnatrayasya kenacidvirodho'sti yato'vikalakāraṇatvāsiddhiḥ syāt
itthīliṅgasiddhā–samyagdarśanādīni puruṣāṇāmiva strīṇāmapyavikalāni dṛśyante tathāhi –prajñā॰ malaya॰ pṛ॰ 20A.

yathoktaṃ yāpanīyatantre–ṇo khalu itthī ajīvo, ṇa yāvi abhavvā, ṇa yāvi dasaṇavirohiṇī, ṇo amāṇusā, ṇo aṇāriuppattī ṇo asakhejjāuyā, ṇo aikūramaī, ṇo ṇa uvasantamohā, ṇo ṇa suddhācārā, ṇo asuddhabodī, ṇo bavasāyavajjiyā, ṇo apuvvakaraṇavirohiṇī, ṇo ṇavaguṇaṭhāṇarahiyā, ṇo ajogā laddhīe, ṇo akallāṇabhāyaṇaṃ ti kahaṃ na uttamadhammasāhigatti
taduktasya yathāvada– ā॰, taduktaṃ vratasya ba॰

suprasiddho hi devanārakatiryagbhogabhūmijānāṃ puṃso'nyeṣāṃ devāditvena ratnatrayasya virodhaḥ, evaṃ strīṇāṃ strītvenaiva asya virodhaḥ siddha iti, tadasamīkṣitābhidhānam, yato'vikalakāraṇasya bhavato'nyabhāve'bhāvāt virodhagatirbhavati
strītvasadbhāve ca ratnatrayābhāvaḥ pratyakṣataḥ, anumānāt, āgamādvā pratīyeta ? na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ, ratnatrayasya atīndriyatvāt
nahi suranārakādivat tatra tadabhāvapratipādakaṃ kiñcit pravacanavacanaṃ saṃbhavati

nanvastu ratnatrayamātraṃ tatra na tadasmābhirniṣidhyate tasya mokṣā'prasādhakatvāt, yattu mokṣaprasādhakaṃ prakarṣaparyantaprāptam tasya tatrābhāvāt mokṣābhāvaḥ iti, tadayuktam; adṛṣṭe virodhapratipatteranupapatteḥ
na khalu prakarṣaparyantaṃ prāptaṃ ratnatrayam asmākaṃ dṛśyam, na cādṛśyasya virodhaḥ pratipattuṃ śakya atiprasaṅgāt
na cāpratipannavirodhasya tasya tatrābhāvo grahītuṃ śakyaḥ atiprasaktereva
jānīte jinavacana śraddhatte carati cāryikā śabalam
atha strītvādeva na tāsā tatparikṣayasāmarthyam, na, strītvasya tatparikṣayasāmarthyena virodhāsiddhe
nahi avikalakāraṇasya tatparikṣayasāmarthyasya strītvasadbhāvādabhāva kvacidapi niścito yena agniśītayoriva sahānavasthānavirodha tayo siddho bhavet
–mātra tantram na ba॰, –mātraṃ taṃtraṃ na śra॰

atha matam–anumānataḥ strīṇāṃ nirvāṇābhāvapratīterna tatra tatsadbhāvābhyupagamo yuktaḥ; tathāhi–nāsti strīṇāṃ nirvāṇam saptamapṛthivīgamanābhāvāt sammūrcchimādivat iti, tadasaṅgatam; viparyayavyāpterasiddhitaḥ tadgamanābhāvasya nirvāṇābhāvenā'vyāpteḥ

iha yad yatra niyamyate tadviparyayeṇa tadvipakṣasya vyāptau niyamo dṛṣṭaḥ, yathā agninā dhūmasya vyāptau dhūmābhāvena agnyabhāvasya, śiṃśapātvasya ca vṛkṣatvena vyāptau vṛkṣatvābhāvasya śiṃśapātvābhāvena vyāptiḥ
na caivamatra viparyayavyāptirasti; tadabhāvaśca saptamapṛthivīgamanādeḥ nirvāṇa pratyakāraṇatvāt avyāpakatvācca siddhaḥ
nahi saptamapṛthivīgamana nirvāṇasya ratnatrayavat kāraṇaṃ siddham guṇāṣṭakavadvā vyāpakam yena tadabhāve nirvāṇābhāvaḥ syāt
nacākāraṇā'vyāpakasya nivṛttau akāryavyāpyasya nivṛttiḥ atiprasaṅgāt, ataḥ sandigdhavipakṣavyāvṛttikamidaṃ sādhanam
caramadehaiḥ niścitavyabhicārañca; te hi tenaiva janmanā muktibhājo na saptamapṛthivīṃ gacchanti atha ca mucyante
kiñca, viṣamagatayopyadhastāt upariṣṭāttulyamāsahasrāraṃ gacchanti ca tiryañcaḥ tadadhogatyūnatā'hetuḥ
nahi adhogatau strīpuṃsayoratulyaṃ sāmarthyamiti sugatāvapi atulyatvaṃ yuktam, aśubhapariṇāmasya śubhapariṇāmaṃ pratyahetutvāt

tathāhi–bhujagakhagacatuṣpātsarpajalacarāṇāṃ viṣamā'dhogatiḥ–bhujagānāṃ saṃnāmasaṃjñināṃ prathamāyām, khagānāṃ tṛtīyāyām, catuṣpadāṃ pañcamyām, sarpāṇāṃ paṣṭhyām, jalacarāṇāṃ saptamyāmadhobhūmau utpādāt, śubhagatistu samā sarveṣāmevaiṣāṃ sahasrārāntasyopari utpādasya saṃbhavāt

api ca bhujaparisarpā dvitīyāmeva pṛthivī yāvad gacchanti na parata parapṛthivīgamanahetutathārūpamanovīryapariṇatyabhāvāt, tṛtīyā yāvat pakṣiṇa, caturthī catuṣpadā, pañcamīmuragā, atha ca sarvepyūrdhvamutkarṣata sahasrāra yāvad gacchanti
prathamāyāmasajñina utpadyante prathamadvitīyayo sarīsṛpā tisṛṣu pakṣiṇa catasṛṣūragā paṃcasu siṃhā ṣaṭsu striyāḥ saptasu matsyamanuṣyā –rājavā॰ pṛ॰ 118
paḍhamādiṣu uppattī aḍavārādo du doṇṇi vārotti
asannī khalu paḍhama, ducca ca sarīsavā taiya pakkhī
sīhā jati cautthi uragā puṇa pacamiṃ puḍhaviṃ
chaṭhṭhiṃ ca itthiāo macchā maṇuyā ya sattamiṃ puḍhaviṃ
bhujagānāṃ prathamāyāṃ ā॰, śra॰, bhujagānāṃ saṃjñināṃ prathamāyāṃ ba॰, pū॰ tru॰

prathamāyā saṃjñināṃ dvitīyāyāṃ khagānāṃ tṛtīyāyām bhujagānāṃ caturthyāṃ catuṣpadānāṃ pañcamyām strīṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jalacarāṇāṃ ba॰, prathamāyāṃ khagānāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ catuṣpadānāṃ paṃcabhyāṃ sarpāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭhyām, jalacarāṇāṃ truṭitāyā pū॰ pratau
tairyagyonepu asajñina paryāptāḥ pacendriyā sakhyeyavarṣāyupa alpaśubhapariṇāmavaśena puṇyabandhamanubhūya bhavanavāsiṣu vyantareṣu cotpadyante
ta eva sajñino mithyādṛṣṭaya sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭayaścāsahasrārādutpadyante ta eva samyagdṛṣṭaya saudharmādiṣu acyutānteṣu jāyante
na ca vādādilabdhyabhāvāttāsāṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ; itthameva mokṣaḥ iti niyamā bhāvāt

śrūyante hi anantāḥ sāmāyikamātrasaṃsiddhāḥ tattvārthabhā॰ sambandhakā॰ 27? yadi ca strīṇāṃ yathā vādādyatiśayāḥ tapovibhavajanmāno na saṃbhavanti tathā mokṣopi na syāt; tadā āgame tadatiśayābhāvavat mokṣābhāvo'pyucyeta

atha strīṇāṃ vastralakṣaṇaparigrahasadbhāvānna mokṣaḥ; tarhi mokṣārthitvāt kinna tat tābhiḥ parityajyate ? na khalu vastraṃ prāṇāḥ, te'pi hi muktyarthinā parityajyante kiṃ punarna vastram ? atha no kappai ṇiggaṃthīe acelāe hottae kalpasū॰ 5
20 ityāgamavirodhaḥ tasyāḥ tatparityāge; tarhi pratilekhanavat muktyaṅgameva tatsyāt
yathaiva hi sarvajñaiḥ mokṣamārgapraṇāyakaiḥ upadiṣṭaṃ pratilekhanaṃ muktyaṅgaṃ bhavati na punaḥ parigrahaḥ tathā vastramapyaviśeṣāt
yadi ca dharmasādhanānāṃ sūtravihitānāṃ parigrahatvaṃ syāt tadā piṇḍauṣadhiśayyādīnāmapi vastravat parigrahatvaṃ syāt§ tathā ca tadupāyināṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ syāt §
satyapi vastre mokṣābhyupagame gṛhiṇāṃ kuto na mokṣaḥ iti cet ? mamatvasadbhāvāt
sati hi mamatve nagno'pi parigrahavān bhavati
nahi yaterapi grāmaṃ gṛhaṃ vā praviśataḥ karma nokarma ca ādadānasya aparigrahatve amamatvādanyat śaraṇamasti
yadi vastrādavimuktiḥ; tyajettad, atha na kalpate hātum
vihiyaṃ sue cciya jao dharejja tiṃhi kāraṇehiṃ vatthaṃ ti
teṇaṃ ciya tadavassaṃ niratisaeṇaṃ dhare avvaṃ
hīlajja tti va so saṃjamo tadatthaṃ viseseṇaṃ
atha vastre jantūtpatteḥ hiṃsāsadbhāvataḥ cāritrasyaivā'saṃbhavāt kathaṃ mokṣaprāptiḥ ? tanna; pramādābhāve hiṃsā'nupapatteḥ
arhaduktena yatnena sañcarato'sya pramādābhāvādarhisakatve āryikāyā location unknown api ahiṃsakatvaṃ syādaviśeṣāt
jiyadu ya marudu a jīvo ayadācārassa ṇicchidā hiṃsā
mriyatāṃ vā jīvatu vā jīvo ayatācārasya niścitā hiṃsā
payadassa ṇatthi bandho hiṃsāmetteṇa samidassa || pravacanasā॰ 3 | 17
na ca puruṣairavandyatvāt strīṇāṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ; gaṇadharādibhirvyabhicārāt, te hi nārhadādibhirvandyante atha ca mucyante
tato ratnatrayameva tatkāraṇaṃ na vandyatvamavandyatvaṃ vā
vandatāṃ tā yadi te nonatvaṃ kalpyate tāsām
atha mahāvratasthapuruṣāvandyatvāt na tāsāṃ muktyavāptiḥ; tarhi gaṇadharāderapi arhadavandyatvāt na muktyavāptiḥ syāt
na ca māyābāhulyāttāsāṃ nirvāṇābhāvaḥ; puṃsāmapi tadbāhulyasadbhāvāt
mohodayo hi tatkāraṇam, sa ca ubhayorapyaviśiṣṭaḥ
na ca hīnasattvāḥ striyaḥ tato na nirvānti ityabhidhātavyam; yataḥ sattvaṃ tapaḥśīlasādhāraṇam iha eṣṭavyam nānyat, tasya nirvāṇaṃ pratyanaṅgatvāt
strī nāma mandasattvā utsaṅgasamagratā na tenātra
sītādayaḥ kathaṃ tāstapasi viśīlā visattvāśca || strīmu॰ ślo॰ 31
thīliṃgeṇa ya vīsaṃ sesā dasaka tti bodhavvā
atraivārthe viśeṣāntarapratipādikāḥ prakṣepagāthāḥ–visitthigāu purisā aṭṭhasayaṃ egasamayao sijjhe
dasa ceva napuṃsā taha uvariṃ samaeṇa paḍiseho
ekasmin samaye utkarṣataḥ striyo viṃśatiḥ sidhyanti
thīliṃgeṇa ya vīsaṃ sesā dasaka tti bodhavvā
atha atra strīśabdena strīvedo gṛhyate, kathamevamapi strīṇāṃ nirvāṇaniṣedhaḥ ? yathaiva hi strīvedena puṃsaḥ siddhiḥ tathā strīṇāmapi syāt, bhāvo hi siddheḥ kāraṇam

kiñca, dravyata puruṣaḥ bhāvataḥ strīrūpo bhūtvā yathā nirvāti tathā dravyataḥ stryapi bhāvataḥ puruṣo bhūtvā kinna nirvāti aviśeṣāt ? na ca siddhyato vedaḥ saṃbhavati, anivṛttivādarasāmparāye eva asya parikṣayāt
atha bhūtapūrvagatyā kṣapakaśreṇyārohaṇa yena vedena karoti tenāsau muktaḥ ityucyate; nanu kimanena upacāreṇa striyā eva stanaprajananadharmādimatyā nirvāṇamastu iti

yattāvaduktam–avikalakāraṇatvāt ityādi, tatra avikalakāraṇatvamasiddham; tatkāraṇaṃ hi ratnatrayam, tatkiṃ paramaprakarṣaprāptaṃ sat tatkāraṇaṃ syāt, tanmātraṃ vā ? yadi tanmātram, tadā gṛhiṇāmapi nirvāṇaprasaṅgaḥ
atha paramaprakarṣaprāptam; tanna, tatra tasya paramaprakarṣaprāptatvā'nupapatteḥ
pratyakṣato hi adṛśyasyārthasya virodhaḥ pratipattumaśakyo na tu anumānādito'pi, anyathā kathaṃ saptamapṛthivīgamanakāraṇā'puṇyaparamaprakarṣasyāpi tatra virodhapratipattiḥ syāt ?
yadapyuktam–saptamapṛthivīgamanābhāvasya nirvāṇābhāvenā'vyāpteḥ ityādi; tadapyayuktam; akāryakāraṇasyāpi kṛttikodayāt śakaṭodayādeḥ pratipattidarśanāt
avinābhāvo hi gamyagamakabhāve nibandhanaṃ na kāryakāraṇatvādi, sa cātra astyeva
na khalu tādātmyatadutpattyoreva avinābhāvo niyataḥ, kṛttikodayādeḥ śakaṭodayādikaṃ pratyagamakatvaprasaṅgāt iti
ataśca saptamapṛthivīgamanādeḥ nirvāṇaṃ pratyakāraṇatvādavyāpakatvācca ityādi pratyuktam

kathañcaivavādino arvāgbhāgābhāvāt parabhāgābhāvo niścīyeta, anayoḥ tādātmyatadutpattilakṣaṇapratibandhāsabhavāt ? athātra ekārthasamavāyaḥ sambandho'sti tasmā location unknown deva anayoḥ gamyagamakabhāvo bhaviṣyati, nanu naiyāyikasya matametanna sitāmbarasya
na khalu samavāyāsiddhau tasya ekārthasamavāyasiddhirupapadyate tatsiddhipūrvakatvāttasyāḥ
astu vā tatsiddhiḥ; tathāpi–atastayorgamyagamakabhāve prakṛtayorapi so'stu tatrāpyekārthasamavāyasadbhāvāt, yatraiva hi ātmani saptamapṛthivīgamanayogyatā samevatā tatraiva muktigamanayogyatāpi

na ca saptamapṛthivīgamanābhāvāt strīṇāṃ nirvāṇaniṣedhaḥ sādhayitumiṣṭaḥ yenoktadopānuṣaṅgaḥ syāt, kiṃ tarhi ? paramaprakarṣatvāddhetoḥ dṛṣṭānte siddhasādhyavyāptikāt nirvāṇakāraṇābhāvaḥ tatra sādhayitumiṣṭaḥ
tato'yuktamuktam–saptamapṛthivīgamanaṃ na nirvāṇasya ratnatrayavat kāraṇam ityādi
ekasminneva bhittyākhye avayavini arvāgbhāgaparabhāgākhyayo avayavayo samavāyāt tayo parasparamekārthasamavāya samastyeva
na ca pu dehe strīvedodayabhāve pramāṇamaṅgañca
bhāva siddhau purvat pumā api puṃso'pi na siddhyato veda
yadapi–caramadehaiḥ niścitavyabhicāram ityādyuktam; tadapyayuktam; yataḥ saptamapṛthivīgamanābhāvaḥ tannirvarttanasamarthakarmārjanasāmarthyābhāvaḥ
śrūyate hi bharataprabhṛticakravarttināṃ caramaśarīrāṇāmapi prayāṇakasamaye saptamapṛthivyāṃ gamanayogyakarmārjanā, devārcanasamaye tu sarvārthasiddhāviti
utkṛṣṭo hi śubho'śubhaśca pariṇāmaḥ yathākramam utkṛṣṭāyāḥ śubhagateḥ aśubhagatervā hetubhūtaṃ karma ārabhate, tatpariṇāmaprārambhe ca puruṣasyaiva somarthya na striyāḥ
yathaiva hi tasyāḥ tīvratarāśubhapariṇāme sāmarthyābhāvaḥ tathā utkṛṣṭaśubhapariṇāme'pi
etena viṣamagatayo'pyadhastāt ityādyapi prativyūḍham; prakṛṣṭagatiprārambhahetubhūtakarmopārjanasamarthasyaiva muktiyogyatopapatteḥ na tadviparītasya

śrūyate hi pratiniyatā'vāntaragatiprārambhakakarmavaśāt pratiniyatotpādasthānānāmapi nārakāṇāṃ kṣapitakarmaṇāṃ tiryagloke sarveṣāmapi niyamataḥ saṃjñipañcendriyeṣu tiryakṣu manuṣyeṣu cotpādaḥ, devānāñca tathāvidhakarmavaśāt pratiniyatopapādasthānotpannānāṃ tiryagloka eva teṣu ekendriyeṣu ca niyamenotpāda iti
na ca tathāvidhakarmoṣārjanasāmarthyena muktiyogyatā saṃbhavati iti na muktiyogyatāvicārāvasare kiñcidanena prayojanam

yasya tu upariṣṭāt prakṛṣṭaśubhagatiprasādhane sāmarthyam tasya adhastāt prakṛṣṭāśubhagatiprasādhane'pi tadasti yathā puṃsa iti strīṇāṃ prakṛṣṭāyāṃ śubhagatau sāmarthyabhyupagacchatā aśubhagatāvapi tathāvidhāyāṃ tadabhyupagantavyam
tathā ca itthī chaṭhṭhīo aho na uppajaṃti ityādi bhavadīyāgamavirodhaḥ
itthīū chaṭṭhīdo aho ṇa u– ba॰

yaccānyaduktam–na ca vādādilabdhyabhāvāttāsāṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ ityādi; tadapyuktimātram, yato yatra aihikavādavikriyācāraṇādilabdhīnāmapi hetuḥ sayamaviśeṣo nāsti tatra mokṣaheturasau bhaviṣyatīti kaḥ sudhīḥ śraddadhīta ? vādalabdhiḥ khalu indrādyāsthāneṣu bṛhaspatyādiṣvapi pratibandhakeṣu satsu chalajātyādiparihāreṇa svatattvapratipādanasāmarthyam
taddhetuśca saṃyamaviśeṣo na strīṇāṃ pravacane pratipādyate
śakrādiṣvapi pratibandhiṣu satsu apratihatatayā niruttarābhidhāna pararandhrāpekṣaṇañca vāditvam
lābhāntarāyakṣayopaśamaprakarṣaprāptebhyo yatibhyo yato bhikṣā dīyate tato bhājanāccakradharaskandhāvāro'pi yadi bhuñjīta taddivase nānna kṣīyate te akṣīṇamahānasā
yadapyabhihitam–āgame vādādilabdhyatiśayābhāvavat mokṣābhāvo'pyucyeta ityādi, tadapyabhidhānamātram; saṃyamaviśeṣaniṣedhādeva āgame tāsāṃ mokṣābhāvapratipādanaprasiddheḥ
suprasiddho hi āgame pusāṃ mokṣaheto ācelakyādisaṃyamaviśeṣasya vidhiḥ, strīṇāṃ tu niṣedhaḥ
sayamamātraṃ tu sadapi āsāṃ na mokṣahetuḥ tiryaggṛhasthādisaṃyamavat
tathā, nāsti strīṇāṃ mokṣaḥ parigrahavattvāt gṛhasthavat
liṃga icchīṇa have bhujai piṃḍa su eyakālammi
ṇavi sijjhai vatthadharo jiṇasāsaṇe jai vi hoi titthayaro
bhaṇio suhumo kāo tāsa kaha hoi pavvajjā
jai dasaṇeṇa suddhā uttā maggeṇa sāpi sajuttā
ghora cariya caritta itthīsu na pāvayā bhaṇiyā
cittāsohi ṇa tesiṃ ḍhilla bhāva tahā sahāveṇa
vijjadi māsā tesiṃ itthīsu ṇa'sakayā jhāṇaṃ
ṇicchayado itthīṇa siddhī ṇa hi teṇa jammaṇā diṭṭhā
nirgranthaliṅgāt pṛthaktvena vikalpita kathita liṃga prāvaraṇasahitaṃ cihna strīṇāmiti

yadapyuktam–pratilekhanavat muktyaṅgameva vastram ityādi; tadapyacāru; yataḥ prati lekhanaṃ tāvat saṃyamapratipālanārtha bhagavatopadiṣṭam, vastraṃ tu kimarthamupadiṣṭamiti ? tadapi tatpratipālanārthamiti cet, tathāhi–abhibhūyante prāyeṇa vivṛtāṅgopāṅgasandarśanajanitacittabhedai puruṣaiḥ aṅganā akṛtaprāvaraṇāḥ ghoṭikeva ghoṭakairiti, tatra kutastāḥ tairabhibhūyante na punaste tābhiḥ akṛtaprāvaraṇatvāviśeṣe'pi iti vaktavyam ? tāsāmalpasattvopetatayā abhibhāvyatvāccet, suprasiddho hyayaṃ vibhāgaḥ gavāśvādau strīprakṛtirabhibhāvyā puruṣaprakṛtirabhibhāvikā iti; tadetanmahāmohavijṛmbhitam, yāsāmatitucchasattvānāṃ prāṇimātreṇāpyabhibhavaḥ tāḥ sakalatrailokyābhibhāvakakarmarāśiprakṣayalakṣaṇaṃ mokṣaṃ mahāsattvaprasādhyaṃ prasādhayantīti !

yadapyuktam–yadi dharmasādhanānāṃ parigrahatvaṃ syāt ityādi; tatra ko'yaṃ dharmaḥ yatsādhanatvaṃ vastrasya syāt–puṇyaviśeṣaḥ, saṃyamaviśeṣo vā ? prathamapakṣe kathaṃ tanmuktihetuḥ ? āgamavihitavidhinā gṛhyamāṇasyāsya gṛhasthavat puṇyasyaiva hetutvāt

saṃyamaviśeṣahetutvaṃ tu tasya durupapādam, bāhyābhyantaraparigrahaparityāgo hi saṃyamaḥ, sa ca yācanasīvanaprakṣālanaśoṣaṇanikṣepādānacauraharaṇādimanaḥsaṅkṣobhakāriṇi vastre gṛhīte kathaṃ syāt ? pratyuta saṃyamoṣaghātakamevaitat bāhyābhyantaranairgranthyapratipanthitvāt
geṇhadi va celakhaḍaṃ bhāyaṇamatthitti bhaṇidamiha sutte
jadi so cattālabo havadi kaha vā aṇārambho
geṇhai vidhuṇai dhovai sosei jadaṃ tu ādave khittā
pattha ca celakhaḍa bibhedi parado ya pālayadi
kidha tamhi ṇatthi mucchā ārabho va asajamo tassa
nanvevaṃ piṇḍauṣadhyādīnāmapi parigrahatvaprasaṅgāt kathaṃ tadādāyināmapi mokṣaḥ syāt ? ityapyasāram; teṣām udgamādidoṣaparihāreṇa upādīyamānānāṃ ratnatrayopabṛṃhaṇahetutvāt
na hi te siddhāntavihitavidhinā upādīyamānā mokṣahetorapakarttāraḥ
tadagrahaṇe ca apūrṇe'pi kāle vipatterāpatteḥ ātmaghātitvaṃ syāt, vastrā'grahe tu nā'yaṃ doṣaḥ
ṣaṣṭhā'ṣṭamādikrameṇa ca mumukṣubhiḥ piṇḍādikamapi tyajyate, paramanairgranthyabhāgbhiḥ taiḥ pratilekhanañca, na tu strībhiḥ kadācidvastram

naca gṛhīte'pi vastre mamedaṃbhāvasya āsāmasaṃbhavādaparigrahatvaṃ vācyam, virodhāt, buddhipūrva hi patitaṃ vastraṃ hastenādāya paridadhānāyā mūrcchārahitatvānupapatteḥ, yad buddhipūrva patitamapyādīyate na tatra mūrcchābhāvaḥ yathā suvarṇādau, tathā ādīyate ca strībhirvastramiti
buddhipūrvaka hi hastena patita vastramādāya –prameyaka॰ pṛ॰ 333
etena upasargādyāsaktamiva ambaramaparigrahaḥ ityādi pratyākhyātam; upasargādyāsakte vastre patite buddhipūrvagrahaṇāsaṃbhavāt
upasarge vā cīre gdādi sanyasyate cātte

athocyate–strīṇāṃ vastratyāgābhyupagame kulastrīṇāṃ lajjābhūyiṣṭhatvāt dīkṣāgrahaṇameva na syāt, vastre tu sati tatparigrahamātraṃ doṣaḥ sakalaśīlaparipālanaṃ tu guṇaḥ iti tyāgopādānayoḥ guṇadoṣālpabahutvanirūpaṇena bhagavatā vastramupadiṣṭaṃ tāsāmiti, tadetadasmākamabhīṣṭameva, nahi atrārthe vayaṃ vipratipadyāmahe, mokṣe eva asmākaṃ vipratipatteḥ
naca tacchīlaṃ mokṣaprasādhanāya prabhavati parigrahavadāśritatvāt gṛhasthaśīlavat
nahi gṛhasthaśīlaṃ tyāgopādānayo guṇadoṣālpabahutvanirūpaṇena bhagavatopadiṣṭamapi mokṣaprasādhanāya prabhavati eva prakṛtamapi
atha tacchīla hiṃsāśabalitatvāt na tatprasādhanāya prabhavati; tadanyatrāpi samānam
na khalu strīsambandhi śīlaṃ hiṃsāśabala na bhavati, yūkālikṣādyanekajantusammūrcchanādhikaraṇavastrasamanvitatvāt gṛhasthaśīlavat
tatsammūrcchanādhikaraṇasya ca vastrasya hiṃsānaṅgatve mūrddhajānāmapanayanānarthakyaṃ syāt
yadapyabhihitam–pramādābhāve tāsāṃ hiṃsānupapatteḥ ityādi; tadapyapeśalam, lobhakaṣāyapariṇatau tāsāmapramattatvānupapatteḥ, tatpariṇatereva pramādatvāt
taduktam– vikahā tahā kasāyā idiya ṇiddā ya taha ya paṇagoyoya
cadu cadu paṇa egege huṃti pamādā hu paṇṇarasa

atha vītarāgatve'pyāsāṃ lajjāpanodārthaṃ tatsvīkārasabhavāt nātastāsāṃ tatpariṇatisiddhiḥ, nanvevaṃ kāmapīḍāpanodārthaṃ kāmukādisvīkāropyāsāṃ kinna syādaviśeṣāt ? atha tatpīḍāsadbhāve vītarāgatvaṃ tāsāṃ viruddhyate, tadetat lajjāsadbhāve'pi samānam
na khalu vītarāgasya lajjā upapadyate, sati rāge bībhatsāvayavapracchādanecchārūpatvāttasyāḥ
yo vītarāgo nāsau lajjāvān, yathā śiśuḥ, vītarāgā ca bhavadbhirabhipretā āryikā iti
paiḍī pamādamaiyā edāsiṃ vitti bhāsiyā pamadā
tamhā tāo pamadā pamādabahulā tti ṇiddiṭṭhā
sati dhuva pamadāṇa mohapadosā bhaya duguchā ya
citte cittā māyā tamhā tāsiṃ ṇa ṇivvāṇa
vikahā tahā kasāyā idiya ṇiddā ya taha ya paṇagoyoya
catuścatu pañcaikaika bhavanti pramādā khalu pañcadaśa
cadu cadu paṇa egege huṃti pamādā hu paṇṇarasa || pacasaṃ॰ 1 | 15 iti
yadi ca puṃsām acelaḥ saṃyamo mukterhetuḥ strīṇāṃ tu sacelaḥ; tadā kāraṇabhedāt mukterapyavaśyamanuṣajyeta bhedaḥ
yo'tyantabhinnaḥ saṃyamaḥ so'tyantabhinnakāryārambhakaḥ yathā yatigṛhisaṃyamo'tyantabhinnasvargādyārambhakaḥ, atyantabhinnaśca sacelā'celarūpo muktihetutayā'bhipretaḥ ārya-aryikāsayamaḥ iti
na cānayoḥ muktibhedo'sti; sakalakarmakṣayalakṣaṇāyā mukteḥ ubhayorbhavadbhistulyatayā'bhyupagamāt
kiñca, sacelasaṃyamasya muktihetutve muktyarthināṃ na vastrādestyāgaḥ karttavyatayā upadiśyeta, upadiśyate cāsau teṣāṃ tathā, ato vastrādermuktyaṅgatānupapattiḥ

prayogaḥ– vastraṃ mukteraṅgaṃ na bhavati, muktyarthināṃ tattyāgasya karttavyatayopadiśyamānatvāt, yattyāgo muktyarthināṃ karttavyatayopadiśyate na tat mukteraṅgam yathā mithyādarśanādi, karttavyatayopadiśyate ca teṣāṃ vastratyāga iti
yatpunaḥ mukteraṅgaṃ na tattyāgastadarthināṃ karttavyatayā upadiśyate yathā samyagdarśanāderiti

yaccānyaduktam–puruṣairavandyatvasya gaṇadharairvyabhicāraḥ ityādi; tadapyasāmpratam, yato'rhatāṃ tīrthakaratvanāmapuṇyātiśayavaśāt paramamahattvapadaprāptatvena akhilajanairvandyatvameva na vandakatvam
nahi kaścit tatpadādadhikapadārho jagatyasti yasya te vandakā bhaviṣyanti, gaṇadharāṇāṃ tu tathāvidhapuṇyā'bhāvāt tatpadaprāpterabhāvānna tadvadvandyatvam
muktisāmagrī tu tīrthakaretareṣāṃ siddhyatāṃ na viśiṣyate
tathā, strīṇāṃ na nirvāṇapadaprāptiḥ, yatigṛhidevavandyapadā'narhatvāt, napuṃsakādivat
yatīnāṃ hi vandyaṃ padaṃ dvividham–param, aparañca
tathā gṛhiṇāṃ devānāñca vandyaṃ padaṃ dvividham–parā'parabhedāt
tatra teṣāṃ vandyaṃ paraṃ padam–cakravarttitvam indratvañca
tathā pitari satyasati ca putrasyaiva laghoḥ virūpakasyāpi sarvatra kārye'dhikāro na putrīṇāṃ mahatīnāṃ surūpāṇāmapi
ato yāsāṃ sāṃsārikalakṣmyāmapi adhikāro nāsti tāsāṃ mokṣalakṣmyāmadhikāro bhaviṣyati iti kimapi mahādbhutam !
nanu yadi mahatyāḥ śriyo'narhatvāttāsāmamuktiḥ tadā gaṇadharādīnāmapyamuktiḥ syāt mahatyāḥ tīrthakaratvaśriyaḥ tepāmapyanarhatvāviśeṣāt; ityapyasundaram, vyaktibhedasyātra vidhiniṣedhayoranaṅgatvāt

puruṣavargo hi mahatyāṃ śriyāmadhikṛto na strīvargaḥ atastatparihāreṇa tasyaiva muktirabhyupagantavyā, na punaḥ kvacidvyaktau tathāvidhaśriyo'saṃbhave'pi muktyupalambhād vyabhicāramudbhāvya muktiṃ prati strīṇāṃ tatsamānatā''pādayituṃ yuktā
na khalu ekasya rājaputrasya rājyaprāptau anyatatputrāṇāṃ tadaprāptitaḥ tato hīnatve'pi putryā samatvaṃ yuktam, putravargāt putrīvargasya sakalavyavahāreṣu loke atyantavilakṣaṇatayā prasiddheḥ
tataḥ strīṇāṃ na mokṣaḥ puruṣebhyo hīnatvāt napuṃsakādivat
na ca tebhyo hīnatvamāsāmasiddham, anantarameva asya samarthitatvāt
itaśca tatsiddham yataḥ sāraṇavāraṇaparicodanādīni strīṇāṃ puruṣāḥ kurvanti na striyaḥ puruṣāṇām, tīrthakarākāradharāśca puruṣā na striyaḥ

sāraṇā hite pravartanalakṣaṇā kṛtyasmāraṇalakṣaṇā vā, upalakṣaṇatvād vāraṇā ahitānnivāraṇalakṣaṇā, coyaṇā sayamayogeṣu skhalita sannayuktametad bhavādṛśā vidhātumityādivacanena preraṇā, praticodanā tathaiva puna puna preraṇā

nanu na hīnatvamadhikatvaṃ vā mukteraṅgam, kintu ratnatrayaṃ śiṣyācāryavat, tathāhi– śiṣyā ācāryebhyo hīnāḥ te tu tebhyo'dhikāḥ atha ca ubhayeṣāṃ muktiḥ, tadvad āryāṇām āryikāṇāñca sā bhaviṣyati, iti ca śraddhāmātram, yataḥ śiṣyācāryavat hīnādhikatve'pi strīpuruṣayormuktiḥ aviśeṣataḥ syāt yadi tadvat tayorapi muktihetubhūtaṃ ratnatrayamaviśeṣataḥ syāt, na ca strīṣu tadasti, taddhetubhūtasyāsya prapañcataḥ tāsu prāgeva pratiṣiddhatvāt
ratnatrayamātraṃ tu tatra sadapi na taddhetuḥ, gṛhasthāderapi muktiprasaṅgāt
nahi pracaṇḍamārttaṇḍaprasādhye kārye pradīpasya svapne'pi sāmarthyaṃ pratīyate

yadapyuktam–gārhasthye'pi susattvāḥ ityādi, tadapyavicāritaramaṇīyam, nahi yathā anekadurdharaparīṣahasahatvena akhilakarmanirmūlanasamarthaṃ mahāsattvaṃ pusāṃ prasiddham tathāvidhaṃ svapne'pi strīṇāmasti
nahi tāsāṃ puṃsāmiva sattvādhikyamasti kvāpi kārye
tathāhi–na strīśarīraṃ muktiheturatnatrayasamagratopetā''tmāśrayaḥ mahatā pāpena nirvarttitatvāt nārakādiśarīravat
tathāhi–na strīśarīraṃ sakalakarmakṣapaṇāprārambhahetuḥ mahatā pāpena mithyātvasahāyena upārjitatvāt nārakādiśarīravat
strīnirvarttakaṃ hi karma mahatpāpam na mithyādṛṣṭeranyena upārjyate
yadyapi sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭirapi tadupārjayati tathāpyasau samyagdarśanamavasādayan mithyādṛṣṭireva, mithyādarśanābhimukhasyāsya mithyādarśanenaiva vyapadeśāt
samyaḍmithyādṛṣṭirapi hi tattāvat nārjayati, kimaṅga punaḥ samyagdṛṣṭiḥ ? strītvena utpadyamāno'pi jīvo mithyātvapariṇata eva utpadyate
cittassāvo tāsi sitthilla attava ca pakkhalaṇa
vijjadi sahasā tāsu a uppādo suhamamaṇuāṇaṃ
ṇahu atthi teṇa tesiṃ itthīṇa duvihasajamoddharaṇa
sajamadharaṇeṇa viṇā ṇa hu mokkho teṇa jammeṇa
saptamaṃ naraka gantu śaktiryāsā na vidyate
na santi cenmatābhāva santi ced bhaṇḍimāspadam

tarhi mithyādṛṣṭirbhavatvaya nāsya sāsādanavyapadeśa iti cet, na, samyagdarśanacāritrapratibandhyanantānubandhyudayotpāditaviparītābhiniveśasya tatra sattvād bhavati mithyādṛṣṭirapi tu mithyātvakarmodayajanitaviparītābhiniveśābhāvānna tasya mithyādṛṣṭivyapadeśa kintu sāsādana iti vyapadiśyate
ṇedesu samuppajjai sammāiṭṭhī du jo jīvo –dhavalāṭī॰ pṛ॰ 209
heṭṭhimachappuḍhavīṇa joisi vaṇa bhavaṇa savva itthīṇaṃ
puṇṇidare ṇahi sammo ṇa sāsaṇo ṇārayāpuṇṇe
adhastanaṣaṭnarakeṣu jyotirvyantarabhavanavāsiṣu tiryaṅmanuṣyadevastrīṣudvādaśasu mithyātvopapādasthāneṣu samyagdṛṣṭaya na samutpadyante ityartha
vāresa vārasa micchuvavāde sammāiṭṭhī ṇa uppayadi || paṃcasaṃ॰ 1 | 193 ?
yāsāñca utkṛṣṭasthitikadevapadaprāptirapi nāsti tāḥ mokṣapadaṃ prāpsyanti iti mahannyāyakauśalam !

yadapyuktam–aṭṭhasamayegasamaye ityādyāgamaśca strīnirvāṇe pramāṇam' ityādi; tadapyanalpatamovilasitam; asya āgamasya asmatpratyapramāṇatvāt, tadapramāṇatvañca pramāṇabādhitārthapratipādakatvāt suprasiddham
yathā ca strīnirvāṇalakṣaṇo'rthaḥ pramāṇa bādhitaḥ tathā prapañcataḥ prāk pratipāditameva
sesodayeṇa vi tahā jhāṇuvajuttā ya te du sijjhaṃti

prā॰ siddhabha॰ gā॰ 6 ityāderapi pramāṇabhūtāgamasya tannirvāṇapratipādakasya sadbhāvāt kathaṃ prāktanāgamasya pramāṇabādhitārthapratipādakatvam, āgamāt strīnirvāṇā'siddhirvā ? ityapi manorathamātram, tasya tannirvāṇāvedakatvā'saṃbhavāt, sa hi puṃvedodayavat śeṣavedodayenāpi puṃsāmeva apavargāvedakaḥ, ubhayatra puruṣāḥ ityabhisambandhāt
veda iti hi mohanīyodayajanmā cittavikāro'bhilāṣarūpo'bhidhīyate, udayaśca bhāvasyaiva na dravyasya
sesodayeṇa vi tahā jhāṇuvajuttā ya te du sijjhaṃti

bhāvapu vedamanubhavanto ye puruṣā kṣapakaśreṇīmārūḍhā, na kevala bhāpuvavedenaiva api tu sesodayeṇa vi tahā–abhilāṣarūpabhāvastrīnapu sakavedodayenāpi tathā kṣapakaśreṇyārūḍhaprakāreṇa jhāṇuvajuttā ya śukladhyānopayuktāśca te dravyapuvedāstu sijjhati siddhyanti
avedatvena, tribhyo vā vedebhya siddhirbhāvata na dravyata, dravyata pulliṅgenaiva
atītagocaranayāpekṣayā aviśeṣeṇa tribhyo vedabhya siddhirbhavati bhāva prati, na tu dravya prati

yadapyuktam–dravyataḥ puruṣāḥ ityādi; tadapyacarcitābhidhānam, dravyataḥ strīvedasya mokṣaprasādhanasāmarthyābhāvasya pratipāditatvāt kathaṃ dravyataḥ stryapi bhāvataḥ puruṣo bhūtvā nirvāsyati ? yad dravyato mokṣaprasādhane asamarthaṃ tad bhāvato'pi tatprasādhane'samarthameva yathā tiryagādi, dravyato mokṣaprasādhane asamarthā ca strī iti
ato dravyataḥ puruṣasyaiva bhāvato vede yatra kutracidārūḍhasya niḥśepato nikhilakarmārātinirjayanasāmarthyamabhyupagantavyam lokavat

yathaiva hi loke puruṣo mahāsattvopeto gajaturagādau yatrakutracidārūḍhaḥ kiñciddivyamastramādāya raṇaraṅge nikhilaśatruvargamunmūlayan paramaiśvaryamanubhavati iti āvālaṃ prasiddham na punaḥ yathārthanāmā abalā, tathā dravyataḥ puruṣa eva bhāvato vedatrayānyatamavedādhirūḍhaḥ śukladhyānānupamāstramādāya karmārātivargamunmūlayan paramaiśvaryamanubhavati iti
yadapyabhihitam–na ca siddhyato vedaḥ ityādi, tatsatyameva, nahi asmābhirvedāt muktirabhyupagamyate, karmanicayanirdahanasamarthatīvrataraśukladhyānānalāt parāparamukterabhyupagamāditi
ka bhavya mokṣaheturatnatrayarūpeṇa bhaviṣyati pariṇasyatīti bhavya abhavyasya muktāvanadhikārāt
puna kathambhūta ? lokālokakalāvalokanabalaprajña, paṭdravyasamavāyo loka tato bahiralokaḥ kevalākāśarūpa tayo kalā vibhāga
athavā lokaśca alokaśca kalāśca jīvādaya padārthā tāsāmavalokana tatra balaṃ śakti prajñā prakṛṣṭaṃ jñāna ca vidyate yasya sa tathokta katha svayaṃ svenātmanā nendriyādisāhāyyena ityartha
kam ? tadartham, tasyāgamasya artho jīvādivastu tam
ādau kṛtvā ? budhvā adhītya jñātvā ca
puna kiṃviśiṣṭāt ? apabhraśata bhraṃśo lakṣaṇadoṣa tasmādapagata apabhraśa tasmāt
tata pūrvaṃ kiṃ kṛtvā ? ārādhya gurūn arhadādīn
kathayatu śivaṃ panthānaṃ vaḥ padasya mahātmanām || 78
kim ? sthānam avasthānam na kṣaṇabhagaṃ tatropadeśābhāvāt
kiṃviśiṣṭāt ? iddhāt ujvalāt saṃkaravyatikaravyatirekāt ahamahamikayā prakāśamānādityartha
paramāgamābhyāsāt pariṇataśrutajñāna śukladhyānānalanirdagdhadravyabhāvakalaṅka sārvajñyamāpanno mokṣamārgopadeśāya parārthāya ceṣṭatāmiti bhāvo devānām

vivṛtiḥ–lakṣaṇa-saṃkhyā-viṣaya-phalopetapramāṇa-naya-nikṣepasvarūpaprarūpake hi hetuvādarūpe āgame gurūpadeśaparamparāto yathāvadadhigate paramaprakarṣeṇa abhyaste sati ātmano jineśvarapadaprāptilakṣaṇasvārthasampattirbhavati
tatsaṃpattau ca mumukṣujanamokṣamārgopadeśadvāreṇa parārthasampattaye asau ceṣṭate iti

bodho me na tathāvidho'sti na sarasvatyā pradatto varaḥ, sāhāyyañca na kasyacidvacanatopyasti prabandhodaye | yatpuṇyaṃ jinanāthabhaktijanitaṃ tenāyamatyadbhuta, sañjāto nikhilārthabodhanilayaḥ sādhuprasādātparaḥ || 1 || kalyāṇāvasathaḥ suvarṇaracitaḥ vidyādharaiḥ sevitaḥ, tuṅgāṅgo vibudhapriyo bahuvidhaśrīko girīndropamaḥ | bhrāmyadbhirna bṛhaspatiprabhṛtibhiḥ prāptaṃ yadīyaṃ padam, nyāyāmbhodhinimanthanaḥ ciramasau stheyāt prabandhaḥ paraḥ || 2 || mūlaṃ yasya samastavastuviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ nirmalam, budhnaṃ saṃvyavahārasiddhamakhilaṃ saṃvādi mānaṃ mahat | śākhāḥ sarvanayā prapatranivaho nikṣepamālāmalā, jīyājjainamatāṃ'ghripo'tra phalitaḥ svargādibhiḥ satphalaiḥ || 3 || bhavyāmbhojadivākaro guṇanidhiḥ yo'bhūjjagadbhūpaṇaḥ, siddhāntādisamastaśāstrajaladhiḥ śrīpadmanandiprabhuḥ | tacchiṣyādakalaṅkamārganiratāt sannyāyamārgo'khilaḥ, suvyakto'nupamaprameyaracito jātaḥ prabhācandrataḥ || 4 || abhibhūya nijavipakṣaṃ nikhilamatodyotano guṇāmbhodhiḥ | savitā jayatu jinendraḥ śubhaprabandhaḥ prabhācandraḥ || 5
bodho me na tathāvidho'sti na sarasvatyā pradatto varaḥ,
mūlaṃ yasya samastavastuviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ paraṃ nirmalam,
iti prabhācandraviracite nyāyakumudacandre laghīyastrayālaṅkāre saptamaḥ paricchedaḥ samāptaḥ || cha
iti śrījayasiṃhadevarājye śrīmaddhārānivāsinā parāparaparameṣṭhipraṇāmopārjitāmalapuṇyanirākṛtanikhilamalakalakena śrīmatpramācandrapaṇḍitena nyāyakumudacandro laghīyastrayālakāraḥ kṛta iti magalam

śrīnandisaṃdhakulamandiraratnadīpapaḥ, siddhāntimūrdhvardhnatilakonandināmā | cūḍāmaṇiprabhṛtisarvanimittavedī cūḍāmaṇirbhavanimittavidāṃ babhūva || 1 || śiṣyastasya taponidhiḥ śamanidhirvi dyānidhi rdhīnidhiḥ | śīlānanditabhavyalokahṛdayaḥ saukhyaikanandītyabhūt || āruhya pa pra tibhāguṇapravahaṇaṃ sadvodhiratnodvahaṃ | satsi ddhāntamahodadheranavadheḥ pāraṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭavān || 2 || antevāsī samajani munestasya yo devanandī, dīptottaptaprabhṛtitapasā sāṃ dhāma yo devanandī | cāturvarṇyaśramaṇagaṇibhirdevavadvaṃradanīyo, devaścāsāvajani paramānandayogācca nandī || 3 || etasmādudayācalādvi dhivaśāllīlodayenābhitaḥ | śrīmadbhāskaraṇanandinā daśadiśastejobhirudyotitāḥ || vidvattārakacakravālamakhilaṃ mithyātamobhe dibhi rarthodbhā savacomarīcinicayairācchāditaṃ sarvataḥ || cha || 4 || tyaktā vādakathāpi vādinivahairnālpo'pi jalpaḥ kṛtaḥ | jalpākai strapayā ca no nigaditaṃ pākhaṇḍivaitaṇḍikaiḥ || ṣaṭtarkopaniṣanniśāṇaniśitaprajñasya taiḥ sevyate | śrīmadbhāskaraṇanandipaṇḍitapateḥ pādāravindadvayī || cha || iti nyāyakumudacandravṛttitarkaḥ samāptaḥmi pta i ti || cha || granthāgraṃ 16000 || 1520 || cha || śubhaṃ bhavatu || cha || śrī
